The university has not yet confirmed the final deadlines for all application and counselling activities. Candidates should check the official portal regularly for further announcements.

AEEE 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Before filling out the application form, candidates should check whether they satisfy the academic requirements for B.Tech admission.

According to the latest eligibility criteria currently displayed on the university's official website, applicants must fulfil the following conditions:

  • Candidates must have passed or be appearing in Class 12 or an equivalent examination.

  • Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics must be included in the qualifying examination.

  • A minimum aggregate of 55% in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics is required.

  • Candidates must secure at least 50% individually in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

  • The qualifying examination must be conducted by a recognised board or equivalent educational authority.

Students from CBSE, CISCE, recognised state boards, recognised international boards and eligible NIOS qualifications can check their qualification status under the university's admission rules.

The eligibility section on the website currently carries the 2026 label. Applicants should confirm whether any changes are introduced in the final 2027 admission handbook.

AEEE 2027 Application Fee

The latest published application fee schedule is available in the university's 2026 information handbook. It provides different charges depending on the admission route selected.

Application Route

Application Fee

AEEE Only

₹1,300

AEEE + JEE Main

₹1,300

JEE Main Only

₹500

Candidates applying through both AEEE and JEE Main do not have to pay an additional registration fee for selecting the JEE Main option after AEEE registration.

The above amounts are from the previous published admission handbook and should be treated as the latest available reference until the university confirms the 2027-28 fee schedule.

The payment must be completed online through the official application portal. Candidates should save their payment confirmation for future reference.

How to Fill the AEEE 2027 Application Form?

The application process is conducted online. Candidates should keep their personal and academic information ready before starting registration.

Follow these steps to apply:

Step 1: Visit the Official Website

Open https://aeee.amrita.edu/ and select the registration option for AEEE 2027. Candidates will be redirected to the official Amrita Online Application Portal.

Step 2: Complete Initial Registration

Enter your active email address or mobile number. An OTP will be sent for verification. Use the same contact details throughout the admission process.

Step 3: Fill in Personal Details

After successful verification, provide the required personal information, including:

  • Full name as per Class 10 records.

  • Date of birth.

  • Mobile number.

  • Email address.

  • Address details.

  • Other requested personal information.

Upload a recent photograph and digital signature in the prescribed format.

Step 4: Enter Parent or Guardian Information

Provide the name, email address and mobile number of your parent or guardian, as requested in the application portal.

Step 5: Add Academic Information

Select the state from which you completed or are appearing for your Class 12 examination. Enter the requested educational details carefully.

Step 6: Select the Admission Route

Choose the relevant examination application. Candidates can select AEEE and also indicate their interest in admission through the JEE Main 2027 percentile.

The portal also asks candidates to select three preferred examination cities.

Step 7: Pay the Application Fee

Complete the online payment according to the selected admission route. Check the amount displayed on the portal before proceeding.

Step 8: Submit the Application

Review all entered information and complete the application. Save the registration confirmation and payment receipt.

Documents Required for AEEE 2027 Registration

Candidates should keep the following information and documents ready:

  • Class 10 marksheet or certificate for personal details.

  • Class 12 marksheet, if available.

  • Class 12 appearing details, where applicable.

  • Recent passport-size photograph.

  • Digital signature.

  • Active mobile number.

  • Valid email address.

  • Parent or guardian contact details.

  • JEE Main application or score information, if applying through that route.

Additional documents may be requested during counselling and admission verification.

AEEE 2027 Exam Centres

AEEE 2027 will be conducted as a computer-based examination at test centres across more than 100 cities in India.

During registration, candidates are required to select three preferred examination cities. The university will provide further information about centre allocation and examination slots through the official portal.

Applicants should select their preferred cities carefully because the examination centre is an important part of travel planning.

Can Students Apply Through JEE Main Instead of AEEE?

Yes. Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham accepts JEE Main percentile scores as an alternative route for B.Tech admission.

Students who do not wish to appear for AEEE can select the JEE Main-only pathway. Those who want to keep both opportunities open can apply through AEEE and also submit their JEE Main percentile.

The application portal allows candidates to indicate their interest in JEE Main-based admission. The option can also be exercised later, according to the portal instructions.

What Happens After AEEE 2027 Registration?

After completing the application, candidates should monitor their registered email address and the official portal for further admission instructions.

The subsequent process generally includes:

  1. Slot booking for the entrance examination.

  2. Downloading the admit card.

  3. Appearing for AEEE, if selected as an admission route.

  4. Checking examination performance and rank.

  5. Registering for the Centralised Seat Allotment Process (CSAP).

  6. Selecting preferred campuses and B.Tech programmes.

  7. Participating in seat allocation.

  8. Completing admission and fee-payment formalities.

Candidates using JEE Main scores can participate in the admission process through the applicable percentile-based route.

Conclusion

AEEE 2027 Registration is open for students planning to pursue B.Tech at Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham in the 2027-28 academic session. Applications started on November 7, 2026, and the entrance examination is scheduled between April 15 and May 7, 2027.

Candidates can choose AEEE, JEE Main or both admission pathways. Before submitting the application, students should check the academic eligibility requirements, keep their documents ready and verify the applicable application fee.

Completing registration early will give applicants sufficient time to prepare for the examination and follow subsequent admission announcements. Students should use only the official Amrita application portal and avoid paying unauthorised admission agents.

title: VITEEE 2027: Notification, Eligibility, Pattern & Syllabus
description: Read the complete guide on VITEEE 2027. Find out about the official notification, eligibility criteria, registration dates, exam pattern, and core syllabus.
content:
The Vellore Institute of Technology Engineering Entrance Examination (VITEEE) is a national-level test for undergraduate engineering (B.Tech) admissions across VIT campuses in Vellore, Chennai, Bhopal, and Andhra Pradesh (Amaravati). The 2027 examination introduces a significant update to the marking scheme, shifting to a 500-mark format with negative marking. This guide covers the 2027 notification timeline, academic eligibility, application process, updated paper pattern, and core syllabus.

Official Notification and Important Dates

The official notification and application form for VITEEE 2027 are expected to be released in the first week of November 2026. The entrance examination is conducted once a year in an online format.

  • Application Form Release: First week of November 2026.

  • Last Date to Apply: Last week of March 2027.

  • Slot Booking & Admit Card Generation: First week of April 2027.

  • Examination Dates: Expected between the second and third week of April 2027.

  • Result Declaration: Last week of April 2027.

Academic and Age Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must strictly meet the subject, marks, and age conditions established by VIT before applying.

  • Age Limit: Candidates must be born on or after July 1, 2005, to be eligible for VITEEE 2027. The date of birth recorded on the Class 10 high school certificate is considered authentic proof.

  • Academic Qualification: Applicants must have passed or be appearing for their Class 12 (10+2) board examinations in 2027 from a recognized central or state board.

  • Mandatory Subjects: Candidates must have Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (PCM) or Biology (PCB) along with English. PCB candidates are restricted to biology-oriented B.Tech programs (such as Biotechnology and Biomedical Engineering).

  • Minimum Marks Requirement: General category candidates need a minimum aggregate of 60% in Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (or Biology). Candidates from SC/ST categories and applicants from Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, and Northeastern states require a minimum aggregate of 50%.

Registration and Application Process

The application process is exclusively online through the official VIT admissions portal.

  1. New Registration: Create a primary account using a valid email ID and mobile number to receive login credentials.

  2. Application Details: Enter personal information, educational history, and the preferred campus for the examination center.

  3. Document Upload: Upload a scanned passport-size photograph and a clear signature adhering to the specified file dimensions.

  4. Fee Payment: Pay the non-refundable application fee (typically ₹1,350) via net banking, credit card, or debit card.

  5. Slot Booking System (OTBS): Once the Online Test Booking System opens in April, candidates must log in to select their preferred exam date and test center. The admit card is generated immediately after booking.

Updated Examination Pattern and Marking Scheme

The VITEEE 2027 format features a significant structural change. The test is a Computer-Based Test (CBT) lasting 2 hours and 30 minutes (150 minutes).

For the first time, negative marking has been introduced. The paper contains 125 multiple-choice questions (MCQs), now carrying 4 marks each, totaling 500 marks. Candidates receive +4 marks for a correct response and incur a penalty of -1 mark for every incorrect response. Unattempted questions receive zero marks.

Total

Core Syllabus Overview

The syllabus covers standard concepts from the Class 11 and Class 12 NCERT curriculum.

  • Mathematics: Calculus (Differential and Integral), Coordinate Geometry (2D and 3D), Algebra (Matrices, Determinants, Complex Numbers), Vector Algebra, and Probability.

  • Physics: Electrodynamics (Electrostatics, Current Electricity, EMI), Mechanics, Optics, Thermodynamics, Modern Physics, and Semiconductor Devices.

  • Chemistry: Organic Chemistry (reaction mechanisms, functional groups), Physical Chemistry (Chemical Kinetics, Electrochemistry, Thermodynamics), and Inorganic Chemistry (Coordination Compounds, p-Block elements).

  • Aptitude and English: Logical reasoning, series completion, data interpretation, basic reading comprehension, and grammar rules.

Execution and Preparation Strategy

With the introduction of negative marking, the test strategy must shift from maximizing attempt volume to maintaining strict accuracy.

  • Adopt Question Filtering: Since a wrong answer costs 5 total marks (4 potential marks lost + 1 penalty mark), avoid blind guessing entirely. Only attempt questions where you can confidently eliminate at least two incorrect options.

  • Manage Time Effectively: Allocate 60 minutes to the 40 Mathematics/Biology questions, 50 minutes to Physics, and 35 minutes to Chemistry. Reserve the remaining time for the fast-paced English and Aptitude sections.

  • Secure Aptitude Marks First: The English and Aptitude sections contain 15 straightforward questions worth 60 marks. Clear these rapidly at the beginning of the exam to build momentum.

Conclusion

Preparing for VITEEE 2027 requires adapting to the new 500-mark framework and the introduction of negative marking. Meeting the 60% PCM/PCB aggregate eligibility is the first hurdle; from there, registering early ensures you receive your preferred test slot. Direct your revision toward high-weightage areas like Calculus, Electromagnetism, and Organic Chemistry based on the Class 11 and 12 curriculum. During the 150-minute exam, prioritize accuracy over blind attempts, clear the fast-paced Chemistry and Aptitude sections early, and manage your time deliberately through the calculation-heavy Mathematics portion to secure a top merit rank.

title: CAT 2026 Application Form Final Verification Protocol: Resolving Non-Editable Personal Data Fields, Academic Percentage Calculation Errors, and IIM Program Choice Locks
description: Comprehensive guide to verifying CAT 2026 application details, rectifying non-editable personal data errors, calculating academic percentages accurately, and locking IIM program preferences.
content:
Understanding the CAT 2026 Final Verification Phase

Completing the Common Admission Test (CAT) application requires meticulous attention to detail. As the submission deadline approaches, candidates must execute a thorough audit of all entered information. Errors in personal data, miscalculated academic scores, or omitted institute selections can severely impact a candidate's shortlist status across participating Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs).

This protocol provides structured guidelines for resolving crucial discrepancies before the registration window closes permanently.

Handling Non-Editable Personal Data Fields

During the initial registration, several core identity markers are captured and permanently tied to your profile. Understanding which fields are locked helps candidates determine the necessary course of action if errors occur.

Locked Fields vs Editable Fields

  • Non-Editable Fields: Full Name, Date of Birth, Email Address, Mobile Number, and Category (once payment is processed).
  • Editable Fields (during correction window): Passport-size photo, signature, and test city preferences.

If an error is discovered in a non-editable field prior to fee payment, the safest resolution is to re-register using a new email address and mobile number. However, if the fee has already been paid, re-registration requires making a fresh payment. Candidates must ensure that their registered name and date of birth match their official Class 10 certificate and government photo identification exactly.

Academic Percentage Calculation Rules

Academic profile evaluation forms a major portion of the shortlisting criteria at top business schools. Incorrect percentage entries can lead to disqualification during final document verification.

CGPA to Percentage Conversion Standard

Candidates must calculate their aggregate percentage based on the official guidelines of their respective boards or universities:

  • University Formula Priority: If your university provides a specific conversion formula (for example, CGPA multiplied by 9.5 or 10), you must strictly follow that official formula.
  • Absence of Formula: If no conversion scheme is specified by your board or university, the aggregate percentage must be calculated by dividing the total marks obtained in all subjects by the maximum total marks across all semesters or years.
  • Inclusion of All Subjects: All subjects appearing on the mark sheet must be included in the aggregate calculation, regardless of whether they are core, elective, or optional subjects.

IIM Program Choice Selection and Locks

The CAT application portal allows candidates to select all available management programs and interview cities across participating IIMs at no extra charge. Failing to select a specific program means you will not be considered for admission to that course, regardless of your percentile.

Best Practices for Selecting IIM Programs

  • Select All Options: Candidates are strongly advised to check every available program box across all campuses, provided they meet basic eligibility criteria.
  • Interview City Preference: Carefully select interview city preferences for each chosen program, as these cannot be modified after application freeze.
  • Post-Submission Policy: Once the final submission is completed, program choices cannot be added or modified. Verify that every desired course is checked before completing final payment.

Step-by-Step Checklist Before Final Submission

  1. Verify that your name, date of birth, and parents' names match your Class 10 certificate.
  2. Re-check category claims and ensure caste or category certificates are valid for the current financial year.
  3. Confirm that photo and signature uploads adhere strictly to specified dimensional and file-size limits.
  4. Ensure all undergraduate mark sheets are aggregated correctly following board or university rules.
  5. Confirm that all desired IIM programs and respective interview cities are selected.

Frequently Asked Questions

What fields in the CAT 2026 application form cannot be edited during correction windows?

Fields such as Candidate Name, Date of Birth, Email ID, Mobile Number, and Category generally cannot be edited once the registration fee is paid. Only specific items like photograph, signature, and exam city selection are allowed for editing during the official correction window.

How should CGPA be converted to percentage for CAT 2026 application?

Candidates must use the official conversion formula issued by their university or board. If no formula exists, the percentage must be calculated by dividing the total marks obtained in all subjects across all years by the maximum possible marks.

Can I change my IIM program preferences after submitting the CAT application?

No, program preferences and interview city selections are locked upon final submission and cannot be altered during the correction window or after registration closes.

What should candidates do if they spot a mistake in locked personal data fields?

If a critical mistake is noticed before payment, candidates should re-register with a new email ID. If discovered after payment, candidates must contact the official CAT helpline or re-register with fresh details and pay the fee again before the deadline.

How does university grading criteria affect CAT academic percentage calculations?

CAT strictly requires adherence to university-declared criteria. Candidates must obtain an official written conversion document from their university registrar if the formula is not printed on the back of mark sheets.

title: Maharashtra HSC Maths 2027: Should you follow code 40 or 88?
description: Both HSC Maths entries start at 11 am on 20 February. Find the index for your stream and read the neighbouring Geology row without mixing up the sessions.
content:
The Maharashtra HSC timetable puts two Mathematics and Statistics papers in the same box on Saturday, 20 February 2027. Code 40 is for Arts and Science; code 88 is for Commerce. Both run from 11 am to 2 pm. Write the code for your registered subject beside the date so you practise with the right course materials.

Read across the morning row on page 3

Open the board’s HSC general and bifocal timetable. On page 3, the orange first-half column contains both Maths entries. The purple second-half column on the same line is for Percussion Instruments; it does not give the time for either Maths paper.

Mathematics and Statistics entrySubject indexWritten exam
Arts or Science (A/S)4020 February 2027, 11 am to 2 pm
Commerce (C)8820 February 2027, 11 am to 2 pm

If you also study Geology, add a separate entry

The line immediately below Maths is for Monday, 22 February. Geology is index 41, from 11 am to 2 pm. The 3 pm start on that line belongs to Co-operation, index 53. Copying the date without the column heading could put you at the centre in the wrong session.

When the code on your paperwork looks different

Compare your registered subject and index with your junior college’s printed timetable. A shared time does not make codes 40 and 88 interchangeable. If your subject label or code differs, take both details to your college before choosing a practice paper or making your exam plan. The board says the timetable supplied to institutions is final.

For other papers, start at the Maharashtra board website or use the SSC and HSC timetable guide to select the PDF for your course. HSC vocational candidates have a separate timetable.

title: Narrowing Indian College Shortlists with ROI and Alumni Network Analytics across Engineering, Medicine, and Management
description: A practical framework for Indian students and parents to evaluate engineering, medicine, and management programs using ROI and alumni network analytics to trim college shortlists and maximize career outcomes.
content:
Make the shortlisting decision actionable

Choosing a college is about expected outcomes, not just prestige. A structured approach that weighs return on investment and the strength of an alumni network helps families distinguish programs with solid value from those that look impressive but deliver less long-term payoff. This guidance focuses on three fields-Engineering, Medicine, and Management-commonly pursued by Indian students, and translates data into concrete decisions you can apply during the shortlist stage.

Define ROI for Indian graduates

ROI in higher education combines cost, time, and eventual earning potential. Build a simple frame: total cost of attendance (tuition, living expenses, and fees) plus opportunity cost (salaries foregone during study) minus expected early-career earnings and long-term salary growth. Consider:

  • : annual tuition and living costs for the program duration.
  • : potential salary you would have earned if you pursued work instead of study.
  • : typical entry salaries, mid-career growth, and senior-level compensation for the field and geography.
  • : how a degree opens multiple career paths, including entrepreneurship, higher studies, or roles in large employers.

When comparing programs, normalize costs to a common currency and factor in regional salary ranges. If a program demands a higher upfront cost but positions graduates in high-demand roles or cities with strong growth, the ROI may still be compelling over 5-10 years.

Alumni network analytics you can use

Alumni networks influence internships, mentoring, placements, and career acceleration. Quantitative indicators help you compare networks without relying on anecdotes:

  • : size of alumni network and participation rate among recent graduates.
  • : percentage of graduates entering relevant fields within 12-24 months of completion.
  • : distribution of alumni across major industry hubs and cities where jobs grow.
  • : breadth of sectors where alumni work, indicating versatility for students exploring multiple paths.
  • : presence of formal mentoring programs, alumni-led events, and corporate partners.

Higher alumni engagement often translates into stronger internships, better placements, and clearer pathways to advanced roles. Compare programs that share similar ROI but differ in alumni activity to identify the more supportive long-term ecosystem.

Engineering: reading the ROI and the network

Engineering programs vary in hands-on opportunities, industry ties, and placement support. Prioritize:

  • : duration, industry partners, and guaranteed placements can shorten time to first job and increase early earnings.
  • : programs that align with growth sectors such as software, electronics, and sustainable technologies tend to deliver steadier ROI.
  • : graduates in core engineering roles at established tech and manufacturing firms often indicate strong pipelines.

Analytics tip: compare programs with similar annual tuition against the median starting salary and first-year bonuses in the same region. A program with higher upfront costs can still win if it yields faster placement in high-demand domains and robust mentorship.

Medicine: balancing cost, time, and network leverage

Medical education is long and costly, but the stakes are high. Focus on:

  • : early patient contact and internship intensity correlate with readiness for residency and independent practice.
  • : pathways into competitive specialties and the geographic spread of residency opportunities.
  • : networks that connect students with senior clinicians can accelerate career development.

Where ROI is tight is not necessarily a bad sign if the program offers exceptional residency support and ensures clinical competence that reduces long-run earning risk. In medicine, the value of a program often compounds through residency outcomes and long-term practice opportunities.

Management: ROI through leadership pathways and networks

Management programs draw ROI from leadership training, corporate connections, and entrepreneurship readiness. Priorities include:

  • : internships and live projects with firms across sectors such as consulting, tech, and operations.
  • : alumni in senior positions can unlock career accelerators and board exposure for graduates.
  • : access to incubators, funding networks, and mentorship for students aiming to launch ventures.

For management, a strong ROI profile often aligns with programs that offer practical capstones, case-based learning, and a well-connected alumni ecosystem that spans multiple sectors.

Putting it into practice during shortlisting

How to apply these analytics in a practical shortlist process:

  • : list programs side by side for each field, capturing total cost, duration, expected entry salary, and residency or internship supports.
  • : assign a simple 1-5 score for each criterion (cost efficiency, earnings potential, alumni engagement, internship density, and geographic reach).
  • : for engineers, weight practical exposure and job market alignment; for medicine, emphasize residency support and clinical readiness; for management, value industry links and leadership pathways.
  • : verify placement statistics, program duration, and fees on the program’s official site. For residency or licensing pathways, consult the official medical or management accreditation authorities or credible university pages.
  • : reach out through official channels to ask about recent placement outcomes and mentorship availability while avoiding reliance on informal, unverified claims.

What to decide now

By aligning ROI with the strength of the alumni network, families can prune a long list to a focused set that offers the best value and the strongest support system. The aim is to identify programs where graduation translates into solid starting salaries, accessible career progression, and an alumni ecosystem that can open doors at the right moments in your child’s career.

FAQs

How should I compare ROI across disciplines when costs differ a lot between programs?

Normalize costs to a common basis and look at net earnings potential after a realistic period, such as 5-10 years. Include pockets of value such as internships, scholarships, or stipends that offset living costs.

What if a program has excellent alumni engagement but modest placement rates?

Strong mentorship and industry connections can compensate for shorter initial placement data by accelerating job search and enabling targeted opportunities in later months.

How important is geographic reach for ROI and networks?

It matters. Networks that span multiple industry hubs increase internship chances, broaden job search options, and support long-term mobility within the country.

What sources of data should I trust for alumni network analytics?

Rely on official program reports, accredited accreditation bodies, and university publications. If you cannot verify a figure directly, treat it as indicative and seek corroboration from multiple official sources or alumni engagement data points.

How should I handle high upfront costs with potential high long-term payoff?

Compute long-term ROI by projecting earnings growth and time to break-even. Consider financing options, scholarships, and the value of early career advantages that a strong network can provide.

Are there field-specific indicators that signal a stronger ROI?

Yes. Engineering benefits from industry placements and lab exposure; medicine from residency and clinical training strength; management from internships, case-study intensity, and broad industry networking. Compare programs on these axes in addition to cost and generic ROI.

title: PharmEasy: India’s Leading Online Healthcare Platform | Success Story
description: Discover the inspiring success story of PharmEasy, India’s top online pharmacy and healthcare platform. Learn how it revolutionized medicine delivery, diagnostics, and teleconsultation services.
content:
PharmEasy: The Journey of India’s Leading Online Healthcare Platform

Introduction

PharmEasy has transformed the way Indians access healthcare by making medicine delivery, diagnostics, and teleconsultations seamless and convenient. Founded in 2015, this Mumbai-based healthtech startup has grown into one of India's largest online pharmacy platforms, redefining digital healthcare services.

The Vision Behind PharmEasy

PharmEasy was co-founded by Dharmil Sheth, Dr. Dhaval Shah, and Mikhil Innani with a vision to bridge the gap between patients and healthcare services. The founders recognized the challenges of accessibility and affordability in India’s medical sector and aimed to create a platform that would simplify medicine procurement and healthcare services.

The idea was simple—patients could upload prescriptions, compare prices, and get medicines delivered to their doorstep. Over time, the platform expanded its offerings to include lab tests, doctor consultations, and health & wellness products.

Challenges Faced in the Early Days

Like any startup, PharmEasy encountered multiple hurdles:

  1. Regulatory Compliance: Online pharmacies had to navigate complex government regulations and ensure legal adherence.

  2. Building Customer Trust: Consumers were initially hesitant to buy medicines online due to concerns about authenticity and quality.

  3. Logistics and Supply Chain Management: Delivering medicines across India with efficiency required robust logistics infrastructure.

To tackle these challenges, the company worked closely with licensed pharmacies, healthcare professionals, and regulatory authorities to ensure compliance and build a strong operational model.

PharmEasy’s Growth and Expansion

PharmEasy started its operations in select metro cities but quickly expanded across 1000+ cities and towns in India. The company adopted a B2B2C (Business-to-Business-to-Consumer) model, connecting local pharmacies with customers and ensuring fast, reliable, and cost-effective medicine delivery.

Some key milestones in PharmEasy’s journey include:

  • Strategic Mergers & Acquisitions: In 2021, PharmEasy acquired Thyrocare Technologies, India’s largest diagnostics chain, enabling it to expand into preventive healthcare and diagnostic services.

  • Funding & Valuation: With funding from investors like Temasek, Prosus Ventures, and TPG Growth, PharmEasy became one of India’s top-funded healthtech startups. In 2021, it entered the unicorn club with a valuation exceeding $1.5 billion.

  • Technological Advancements: The platform leveraged AI and data analytics to provide personalized medicine recommendations, enhance inventory management, and streamline healthcare services.

Impact on India’s Healthcare Industry

PharmEasy’s success has had a profound impact on India’s healthcare landscape:

Affordable Medicines: By offering discounts and price comparisons, the platform made medicines more accessible to millions.
Improved Healthcare Access: Patients in remote areas gained access to prescription medicines and healthcare services.
Digitization of Healthcare: PharmEasy played a key role in accelerating India’s transition to digital healthcare solutions.

Future Plans and Vision

PharmEasy aims to expand its reach by integrating AI-powered health monitoring, advanced diagnostics, and digital prescription management. The company also plans to strengthen partnerships with hospitals, healthcare providers, and insurance companies.

With the rise of telemedicine and e-health solutions, PharmEasy is well-positioned to lead India's healthcare revolution.

Conclusion

PharmEasy’s journey from a startup to India’s leading digital healthcare platform is an inspiring story of innovation, perseverance, and impact. By addressing key challenges in India’s healthcare ecosystem, it has empowered millions with affordable and accessible medical solutions. As it continues to grow, PharmEasy is set to redefine the future of healthcare in India.

title: CBSE ক্লাস 10 ব্যবসায়ের মূল বিষয় পরীক্ষা 2027: তারিখ, বিষয় কোড ও সময়
content:
ক্লাস 10-এ ব্যবসায়ের মূল বিষয় (কোড 154) পরীক্ষা 20 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027, 10:30 থেকে 13:30 পর্যন্ত।

2026 সালের 6 নভেম্বর প্রকাশিত CBSE-র মূল পরীক্ষার রুটিনে এই তথ্য রয়েছে। এটি পরীক্ষার সময়সূচি, মার্কশিট নয়। CBSE-র সরকারি রুটিন

ব্যবসায়ের মূল বিষয় পত্রের জন্য কত সময় পাওয়া যাবে?

ক্লাস ও পত্রকোডপরীক্ষার তারিখসময় (IST)মেয়াদ
ক্লাস 10: ব্যবসায়ের মূল বিষয় (Elements of Business)15420 ফেব্রুয়ারি 202710:30 - 13:303 ঘণ্টা

কেন্দ্রীয় মাধ্যমিক শিক্ষা বোর্ড, 6 নভেম্বর 2026, পৃষ্ঠা 4: বিষয় কোড, তারিখ ও পরীক্ষার সময়। মূল PDF-এ এই পৃষ্ঠাটি দেখো

সরকারি PDF-এ নিজের বিষয়ের সারিটি খুঁজে নাও

পৃষ্ঠা 4 খুলে আগে ক্লাসের শিরোনাম দেখো, তারপর 154 কোডটি খুঁজে নাও। একটি তারিখ বা সময়ের ঘর একাধিক বিষয়ের জন্য প্রযোজ্য হতে পারে। ফোনে পুরো পৃষ্ঠাটি বড় করে পড়ো।

স্কুলের নিবন্ধনে থাকা কোড ও বিষয়ের সম্পূর্ণ নাম মিলিয়ে নাও। অন্য ক্লাসেও একই নাম থাকলে শুধু নিজের ক্লাসের সারিটি বেছে নাও।

ইংরেজি পরীক্ষার সঙ্গে তারিখ মিলিয়ে পড়ার ছক

ক্লাস 10-এর ব্যবসায়ের মূল বিষয় (154) পরীক্ষা 20 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027। English Language and Literature (184) পরীক্ষা 26 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027। দুই তারিখের ব্যবধান 6 দিন।

এই ব্যবধানের সব দিন পড়ার ছুটি নয়। ক্যালেন্ডারে তোমার বাকি পত্রগুলিও লিখে মাঝে পরীক্ষা নেই এমন দিন গুনে নাও। অনুশীলনের সময় আসল পত্রের জন্য বরাদ্দ সময় রাখো।

পরীক্ষাকেন্দ্রে যাওয়ার আগে

পরীক্ষা শুরুর সময় আর কেন্দ্রে পৌঁছনোর শেষ সময় এক নয়। উপস্থিতি, প্রবেশ এবং নথির জন্য অ্যাডমিট কার্ড দেখো। তারিখ বদলানোর খবর পেলে বোর্ডের সংশোধিত বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে ক্লাস, কোড ও তারিখ মিলিয়ে নাও।

পরীক্ষাকেন্দ্রে যোগাযোগের যন্ত্র নিয়ে যাওয়া নিষেধ। কী সঙ্গে নেওয়া যাবে, সে বিষয়ে CBSE-র আলাদা নির্দেশ ও অ্যাডমিট কার্ডের নিয়ম মেনে চলো।

title: JosAA Float or Freeze: Which Choice Protects Your Upgrade?
description: Understand the JoSAA float and freeze choice, what each means for upgrades, and which allotment actions you must verify before deciding.
content:
Choose freeze only if you would join the allotted institute and programme even when no upgrade is possible. Choose float only when every higher preference above your allotted seat is genuinely acceptable. In both cases, the seat is tied to the actions and deadlines shown in your JoSAA allotment workflow, not to the label alone.

What does float mean in JoSAA?

Float is the choice for a candidate who is willing to move to a higher preference in a later round, if one is allotted. The change depends on your saved preference order, rank, category, seat availability and the rules for that counselling year. It isn’t a promise of an upgrade.

If a higher preference is allotted, the earlier seat generally gives way to the new allotment under the applicable JoSAA process. Don’t assume you can keep both seats or switch back later. Check the allotment letter and the active JoSAA business rules for what acceptance, fee payment, verification and reporting mean after movement.

When is freeze the safer choice?

Freeze suits you when the current branch and institute are acceptable on their own. It closes further upgrade consideration through the route shown in your counselling dashboard, subject to the applicable JoSAA instructions. This is not a “play safe now, decide later” button. Select it only after checking tuition, hostel charges, travel, branch content and your family’s budget.

Your positionPossible choiceWhat it means for you
You would leave this seat for any higher listed preferenceFloatYou accept the possibility of a changed allotment
You would join this exact seat without regretFreezeYou prioritise certainty over further movement
You’re unsure about a higher preferenceCompare before selectingThe better choice depends on preference order, affordability and willingness to accept that seat

What must you verify after allotment?

JoSAA is the responsible counselling authority, but the exact action and deadline can vary by round and year. Read the instructions displayed with your allotment instead of relying on a coaching message.

  1. Check whether fee payment is required and note the amount and deadline shown on the portal.
  2. Complete the document upload or verification step displayed for your case.
  3. Save the allotment letter, payment receipt and status confirmation.
  4. Check whether physical reporting or institute admission is required after the round, and record that separate deadline.

Missing a displayed payment, verification or reporting action may affect the allotment. For wider planning, compare engineering entrance exams and review college options before accepting a branch you cannot realistically fund or attend.

title: AACCC PG 2026 ಮೊದಲ ಸುತ್ತು: ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3ರ ಮೂರು ಗಡುವುಗಳು
description: ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2, ಪಾವತಿ ಸಂಜೆ 5 ಮತ್ತು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಲಾಕಿಂಗ್ ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:55ಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಮೊದಲ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
content:
AACCC ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ AYUSH ಸ್ನಾತಕೋತ್ತರ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಂತೆ ಮೊದಲ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30ರಿಂದ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3, 2026ರವರೆಗೆ ಇದೆ. ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನ ಮೂರು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಗಡುವುಗಳಿವೆ. ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮೊದಲು ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಲಾಕಿಂಗ್‌ನ ಕೊನೆಯ ಸಮಯದವರೆಗೆ ಕಾಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ನೋಂದಣಿಗೆ ತಡವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಪ್ರತಿ ಹಂತಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ನೆನಪು ಇರಲಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PG ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಇದೆ. AACCC ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯ ಸೀಟುಗಳನ್ನು ಬಯಸುವ ಅರ್ಹ AIAPGET 2026 ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ ಓದಬೇಕು.

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PG ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಪುಟ

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ

ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಮೊದಲ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಸಮಯ

ನೋಂದಣಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30ರಿಂದ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3, 2026 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರವರೆಗೆ

ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿಸಿ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3 ಸಂಜೆ 5ರವರೆಗೆ

ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ತುಂಬಿ

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30ರಿಂದ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3 ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:55ರವರೆಗೆ

ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:55ರವರೆಗೆ

ಈ ಸಮಯಗಳು ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಸರ್ವರ್ ಗಡಿಯಾರದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ನೋಂದಣಿ, ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

AACCC ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ 2026-27, ಪುಟ 1: ಮೊದಲ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಗಡುವುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವರದಿ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಆರಿಸಿ

ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ತೆರೆಯುವ ಮೊದಲೇ ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿ. ಲಭ್ಯ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಥಳವನ್ನು ನೀವು ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸೀಟ್ ಮ್ಯಾಟ್ರಿಕ್ಸ್ ಓದಿ; ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷ ಇದ್ದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಈ ಸುತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲೂ ಇರಲಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ ಖಾತೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ನೋಡಿ ರಸೀದಿ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳ ಕ್ರಮ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ನೀಡುವ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಅಥವಾ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಪಾವತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಬಗೆಹರಿಯದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸಹಾಯವಾಣಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. AIAPGET ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಕೈಪಿಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿದ ಇತರ ದಾಖಲೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗಿರಲಿ.

AIAPGET ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ

ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಲಾಕಿಂಗ್ ನಂತರ ಏನು?

ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 4, ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5 ಮತ್ತು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡುವುದು ನವೆಂಬರ್ 6ರಿಂದ 13ರವರೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಇವು ಮುಂದೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿರುವ ಹಂತಗಳು; ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಬಂದಿದೆ ಎಂದಲ್ಲ.

ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಬಂದ ಬಳಿಕ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಹಾಜರಾಗುವ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಓದಿ. ಅದರಂತೆ ದಾಖಲೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿ, ಮುಂದಿನ AACCC ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

title: ਆਈਆਈਐਮ ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ ਸਮਰ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ: 608 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ਾਂ, ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਸਟਾਈਪੈਂਡ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ
description: ਆਈਆਈਐਮ ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ 608 ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ਾਂ ਮਿਲੀਆਂ। ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਮੱਧਿਕਾ, ਔਸਤ ਸਟਾਈਪੈਂਡ ਅਤੇ ਕੰਸਲਟਿੰਗ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
ਆਈਆਈਐਮ ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ ਦੀ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ, PGP ਅਤੇ PGPBA ਦੇ 2026-28 ਬੈਚਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਾਰੇ 608 ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਰ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ਾਂ ਮਿਲੀਆਂ। 26-29 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ 128 ਸੰਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਈਆਂ। ਐਮਬੀਏ ਦੇ ਵਿਕਲਪਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖੋ ਕਿ ਸਟਾਈਪੈਂਡ ਦੇ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਇੰਟਰਨਸ਼ਿਪ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਹਨ, ਸਾਲਾਨਾ ਤਨਖ਼ਾਹ ਪੈਕੇਜ ਨਹੀਂ।

ਅੰਕੜੇ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਇਕਾਈ ਵੀ ਵੇਖੋ

ਮਾਪ

ਸੰਸਥਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਅੰਕੜਾ

ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ

ਇਹ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਮਰ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਤੋਂ ਹਨ। 100% ਨਤੀਜਾ ਇਸ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੇ 608 ਭਾਗੀਦਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਭਵਿੱਖ ਦੇ ਬਿਨੈਕਾਰ ਲਈ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਜਾਂ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੇ ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਦਾ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਨਾ ਸਮਝੋ।

ਕੰਸਲਟਿੰਗ ਅੱਗੇ, ਹੋਰ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਮੌਕੇ

ਸੰਸਥਾ ਨੇ 22 ਕੰਪਨੀਆਂ ਵੱਲੋਂ 308 ਕੰਸਲਟਿੰਗ ਪੇਸ਼ਕਸ਼ਾਂ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਵਿੱਤ, ਤਕਨਾਲੋਜੀ, ਉਤਪਾਦ ਸੰਬੰਧੀ ਕੰਮ, ਮਾਰਕੀਟਿੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਰਲ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਵੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ। ਹਿੱਸਾ ਲੈਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਲਗਭਗ 40% ਸੰਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਵਾਰ ਭਰਤੀ ਲਈ ਆਈਆਂ ਸਨ।

ਕਿਸੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕਰੀਅਰ ਦਾ ਟੀਚਾ ਰੱਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਲਈ ਕੁੱਲ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਖੇਤਰਵਾਰ ਮੌਕੇ ਵੱਧ ਕੰਮ ਦੇ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਜਿਸ ਖੇਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਣਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਭੂਮਿਕਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰੁਜ਼ਗਾਰਦਾਤਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਵੱਡਾ ਕੁੱਲ ਅੰਕੜਾ ਹਰ ਕੰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਮੌਕੇ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਮੱਧਿਕਾ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦਿੰਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ

ਸਟਾਈਪੈਂਡ ਦੀਆਂ ਰਕਮਾਂ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਮੱਧਿਕਾ ਹੈ। ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਰਕਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਜੋੜ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਨਾਲ ਵੰਡਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਨੂੰ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਮਿਲਿਆ, ਇਹ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਦੀਆਂ। ਸਮਰ ਇੰਟਰਨਸ਼ਿਪ ਦੀ ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਰਕਮ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਣਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਸਾਲਾਨਾ ਤਨਖ਼ਾਹ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਮਾਨ ਨਾ ਬਣਾਓ।

ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਬਿਜ਼ਨਸ ਸਕੂਲ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਵੇਖੋ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਮਹੀਨਾਵਾਰ ਸਟਾਈਪੈਂਡ, ਪੂਰੀ ਇੰਟਰਨਸ਼ਿਪ ਦੀ ਰਕਮ ਜਾਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਨੌਕਰੀ ਦੀ ਤਨਖ਼ਾਹ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। ਬੈਚ ਅਤੇ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ ਚੱਕਰ ਵੀ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਇਕਾਈਆਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਅਸਲ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਵੀ ਕਿਸੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਨੂੰ ਵਧੀਆ ਜਾਂ ਕਮਜ਼ੋਰ ਦਿਖਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਣ ਲਈ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਆਈਆਈਐਮ ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ ਦੇ PGP ਅਤੇ PGPBA ਪੰਨੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਸਾਡਾ ਆਈਆਈਐਮ ਅਹਿਮਦਾਬਾਦ ਕਲਸਟਰ 3 ਲੇਖ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਭੂਮਿਕਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪਲੇਸਮੈਂਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸਮਝਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

title: OUAT Courses After Class 12: Compare Subjects and Campuses
description: Agriculture is one of several OUAT degree options. Compare the subject combinations and college locations in the 2026-27 prospectus before building your shortlist.
content:
OUAT offers more than BSc Agriculture. If you are exploring study options after Class 12, start by comparing the degree, the subjects you studied and the college where it is taught. A course that sounds interesting may have a different Mathematics or Biology requirement from another course at the same university.

The comparison below uses OUAT’s 2026-27 undergraduate prospectus and official course directory. Students planning for 2027 should wait for the relevant new prospectus before treating these as next-cycle admission rules.

Which subject combinations match each degree?

Here, PCM means Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics; PCB means Physics, Chemistry and Biology; PCBt means Physics, Chemistry and Biotechnology. This is a subject comparison, not a complete eligibility decision.

Turn the course list into a useful shortlist

Pick two or three degrees you want to examine more closely. Open their syllabus and note the subjects you would actually study, the practical work involved and the location. Then compare those details with your own interests and strengths.

For example, a student with PCM should not assume that every biology-related programme is available to them. Equally, a PCB student should check the Mathematics requirement before choosing Agricultural Engineering. Let the published subject rule resolve the question rather than the broad label “agriculture course”.

Beyond subjects, read the prospectus clauses covering marks, age, residence or category requirements and the admission route relevant to you. Meeting one condition does not establish eligibility under all the others.

Diplomas have their own admission route

OUAT’s course directory also lists Agro-Polytechnic diplomas in Agriculture Science, Horticulture Science, Animal Science and Fishery Science. Use the diploma prospectus to assess those options. A diploma and a bachelor’s degree should not be treated as interchangeable qualifications or as sharing the same application rules.

Planning for 2027 without borrowing old deadlines

Keep your shortlist now, but use the OUAT admissions page for the notice covering the session you intend to join. The 2026-27 document is useful for understanding existing choices; it is not evidence that 2027 applications are open.

Compare other institutions in the college directory using the same questions: exact degree, subject eligibility, curriculum, location and total cost. This makes your comparison more useful than choosing solely by a course name.

title: CLAT 2026 Application Form: Eligibility, Step-by-Step Guide & Top NLU Cutoffs
description: CLAT 2026 Application Form: Eligibility, Step-by-Step Guide and Top NLU Cutoffs
content:
If you are planning to crack the Common Law Admission Test and land a seat at one of India's National Law Universities, understanding the full cycle - from the moment the application window opens to the day counselling closes - is half the battle. The CLAT 2026 application form set the stage for over 75,000 aspirants who sat the December 7, 2025 exam. Whether you are reviewing this cycle to plan smarter for CLAT 2027 or simply want a clear picture of how the entire process works, this guide walks you through every stage: dates, eligibility, the fee structure, the step-by-step filing process, and the closing ranks at top NLUs that tell you exactly how competitive things really are.

Key Takeaways

  • The CLAT 2026 application window opened on August 1, 2025 and closed on October 31, 2025 - giving aspirants three full months to apply.
  • The exam was held offline on December 7, 2025, from 2 PM to 4 PM, with 120 MCQs across five sections.
  • General and OBC candidates need at least 45% marks in Class 12; SC/ST candidates need 40%.
  • The application fee was Rs. 4,000 for General/OBC and Rs. 3,500 for SC/ST/BPL/PwD candidates.
  • NLSIU Bengaluru closed at around Rank 101 (General category) - confirming that the top 3 NLUs are accessible only within the top 350 ranks.
  • Results were declared on December 16, 2025, followed by counselling registration from December 17 onwards.
  • CLAT 2027 registrations are expected to open around August 2026 - plan accordingly.

What Is CLAT and Why Does It Matter for NLU Admission 2026?

The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) is a national-level law exam regulated every year by the CLAT Consortium. Currently, 26 NLUs in India consider CLAT scores for admission. These are not ordinary colleges - they were built on the model of IITs and IIMs specifically to transform legal education in India. Getting into one through a strong CLAT score is the single most direct route to a career in elite litigation, corporate law, the judiciary, or policy-making.

Around 65,000 candidates appear for CLAT UG each year, competing for approximately 3,700 total NLU seats. That ratio alone tells you why preparation and process knowledge both matter. Missing the application deadline or uploading the wrong document can cost you an entire year.

CLAT 2026 Important Dates at a Glance

Knowing dates is non-negotiable. The CLAT 2026 cycle followed a clean schedule that aspirants for the next cycle should use as a reference benchmark.

title: JEE Advanced 2026: Should a Qualified Student Attempt Both Papers?
description: Should a qualified JEE Advanced 2026 student attempt both papers? Learn the rule check, stamina test and paper-wise strategy before exam day.
content:
If you qualify for JEE Advanced 2026, prepare to sit for both papers unless the final 2026 instructions clearly state otherwise. Do not treat Paper 2 as optional recovery time. The exact attendance rule must come from the JEE Advanced 2026 information brochure or exam-day instructions, because the available official website excerpt confirms IIT Roorkee as the organising institute but does not itself establish whether missing one paper invalidates the result.

That distinction matters. The exam rule decides whether your attempt can produce a valid result. Your paper strategy decides how well you perform within that attempt. They aren't the same question.

Is attempting both papers worth the stamina?

For most qualified students, yes. A weak Paper 1 caused by nerves, a slow start or an unfriendly question mix doesn’t automatically predict Paper 2. The later session can offer a practical chance to recover marks, but this is an interpretation of exam strategy, not a promise about how JEE Advanced calculates the final result. The official marking and result rules always take priority.

JEE Advanced 2026 is being organised by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee. Check the official JEE Advanced website for the published brochure, instructions and notices. Don't rely on an old coaching slide or a previous year's memory.

When can the second paper hurt?

The danger is not simply tiredness. It is poor control during the break. Reconstructing answers, checking ranks with friends or chasing one difficult Mathematics problem can drain attention before the next session begins.

  • Leave a question when the method is unclear, rather than spending several minutes defending a bad start.
  • During the break, eat lightly, drink water and avoid answer discussions.
  • For every question type, read the instructions printed on the screen or question paper. Marking rules can differ, so never assume that guessing is safe or harmful.

How should you test your two-paper plan?

Run at least one full two-session simulation using the planned break. Compare the second session with the first on three points:

  1. accuracy, not just attempted questions;
  2. the number of unanswered questions;
  3. careless errors such as misreading, sign changes or marking the wrong option.

There is no official mock-test cutoff that decides readiness. If your second simulation shows a clear fall in accuracy or a rise in careless errors, practise shorter back-to-back sets and change your break routine. Use the JEE Advanced exam guide for subject planning, but verify time-sensitive rules on the official portal.

Qualifying only permits you to appear. Admission depends on the applicable JEE Advanced result and the separate IIT admission process, including JoSAA procedures. So plan for both papers, protect your attention, and let the published 2026 instructions settle the attendance rule.

title: CUET UG Score Normalisation: What Raw Marks Mean for University Choices
description: Learn how CUET UG raw marks, percentiles and normalised scores may affect course comparisons, merit calculations and university preferences.
content:
CUET UG raw marks aren’t automatically the right basis for comparing university choices. Never compare raw marks across different sessions unless the relevant NTA score field is specifically intended for that comparison. A wrong comparison can push you away from a suitable course or make your preference list too risky.

Does CUET UG normalisation apply in every cycle?

No fixed rule should be carried from one CUET UG cycle to another. The National Testing Agency may specify the scoring method, session treatment and fields shown on the scorecard for the relevant examination cycle. This article is cycle-neutral, so it doesn’t confirm that normalisation will apply to every paper, session or year.

Check the NTA information bulletin, result notice or scorecard notice for your cycle. Those documents should tell you what has been calculated and which fields are displayed. A provisional answer-key calculation is only an estimate from responses and recorded answers. It isn’t automatically the same as the final scorecard field.

Which CUET UG score should you use for course comparisons?

Use the score or subject combination named in the university’s current admission rules. A university may calculate merit from selected subjects, a total, a percentile or another score field, but you must not assume which one applies. The rule can also differ by programme.

When checking University of Delhi or another participating institution, read the course-specific eligibility and merit notice rather than relying on a general admission page. The score is only one input. Required subjects, category conditions, programme eligibility and the university’s own applicant pool and merit process also affect selection.

Build a course-level worksheet before locking preferences

Make one row for every programme, not one row for every university. Record:

  • University and exact course name.
  • Required CUET UG language, domain subjects and General Test, if listed.
  • Whether the university uses subject-wise scores, a stated total, percentile or another field.
  • Eligibility, category conditions, tie-break rules and programme-specific tests.
  • Your competitive, realistic and safer choices, based only on the applicable score field.

Save your final scorecard and the admission notices you used. If a university preference form asks for subject-wise scores but you have checked only the total, stop and verify the entry fields before submitting. You can also compare colleges after matching each course rule. Past cut-offs can provide context, not a promise for the next cycle.

title: KCET 2027 Preparation: Why Early Mock Tests Matter
description: Learn why early mock tests are important for KCET 2027 preparation. Explore time management, accuracy tips, test analysis, and an effective study strategy.
content:
Preparing for KCET 2027 is more than just finishing the syllabus and memorising formulas. If you aim for engineering, pharmacy, or other professional courses in Karnataka, you must start practicing tests early. Regular practice helps you spot spots, boost accuracy, and build good time‑management skills before the exam.

1. Identify Topics Early

By solving mock tests before you finish the whole syllabus, you can see how ready you are now. You will spot chapters in physics, chemistry, mathematics, or biology and change your study plan to focus there.

2. Improve Speed and Accuracy

KCET preparation means answering questions within a set time limit. Mock‑test practice lets you get used to the question style and learn ways to avoid wasting too much time on hard questions.

3. Understand the Exam Pattern

Mock tests show you how the exam is built and how many questions come from each subject. You should also read the KCET 2027 notification when it comes out to check the latest pattern and marking rules.

4. Reduce Exam‑Day Anxiety

Practicing under timed conditions will make the real exam feel more familiar. You can grow confidence by adding more full‑length tests as you get better.

5. Analyze Every Mock Test

Trying a test is the first step. You should look at answers to skipped questions and problems that took too long. Keeping a mistake notebook can stop you from making the mistakes again.

KCET 2027 Mock-Test Preparation Strategy

Preparation Stage

Recommended Action

Early preparation

Take diagnostic tests

Syllabus completion

Practise chapter-wise questions

Mid-preparation

Attempt subject-wise mock tests

Final preparation

Solve full-length timed tests

After every test

Analyze mistakes and revise concepts

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Waiting until the syllabus is completely finished before taking a mock test.

  • Attempting tests without analyzing mistakes.

  • Ignoring weak subjects or difficult chapters.

  • Taking too many tests without sufficient revision.

  • Relying entirely on mock scores instead of understanding concepts.

Conclusion

Starting tests early can give KCET 2027 aspirants more time to spot weak spots, boost speed, and deepen conceptual understanding. A balanced routine that mixes syllabus review practice questions and mock‑test analysis can help students prepare effectively. Students should aim for progress instead of comparing each score with other students, and they should keep an eye on official notifications for confirmed examination details.

title: Top Career Options Without a Degree in 2025
description: Discover the top career options without a degree in 2025. From digital marketing to freelancing and entrepreneurship, explore high-paying jobs where skills matter more than college qualifications.
content:
Success in the modern world is no longer solely determined by one's level of education. There are a lot of professional options in 2025 for those without traditional degrees because to the growth of digital platforms, skill-based occupations, and entrepreneurship. These days, practical knowledge, talents, and inventiveness are what count most. Let's look at some of the best non-degree-required employment paths for 2025.

Quick Highlights Table

 

Career Option Key Skills Needed Growth Opportunity 2025
Digital Marketing SEO, social media, ads, content writing High demand across industries
Content Creation Creativity, video editing, consistency Growing with influencer marketing
Graphic/UI-UX Design Design tools, creativity, user experience Strong demand in tech & design
Web Development Coding, problem-solving, programming Global opportunities with remote jobs
Freelancing Writing, virtual assistance, services Flexible income & global clients
Entrepreneurship Innovation, leadership, business planning Huge potential in startups

1. Digital Marketing

Digital marketers are in great demand as more businesses move their operations online. You can get jobs or even launch your own firm with expertise in SEO, social media management, and paid advertisements.

2. Content Creation & Influencing

Platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube are generating full-time jobs. Through brand partnerships and advertisements, you can make money if you have the ability to inspire, educate, or amuse others.

3. Graphic Designing & UI/UX

In sectors like app development, gaming, and advertising, designers are crucial. Here, a good portfolio is more important than a degree.

4. Web Development

Proficiency in web development and coding can help you land IT positions or work as a freelancer anywhere in the world. Online bootcamps are a common way for developers to learn.

5. Freelancing & Gig Economy

People can offer services like writing, translation, virtual help, and more on websites like Upwork, Fiverr, and Freelancer. Flexibility, international exposure, and the opportunity to make money without formal training are all benefits of freelancing.

6. Entrepreneurship

You can become your own boss if you have a company idea. Tech services, food delivery, and e-commerce startups are flourishing. Many young entrepreneurs without degrees are succeeding because to government assistance and technology tools.

Conclusion

Opportunities for employment in 2025 are not restricted to those with degrees. Your skill level, inventiveness, and commitment are what really count. There are innumerable ways to establish a prosperous profession, ranging from digital marketing to freelancing and entrepreneurship. You can succeed without a degree if you're driven, open to learning, and flexible.

title: State-specific Medical Admissions Counselling 2026-27: A Practical Playbook for Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and Delhi
description: A practical guide for Indian students and parents navigating medical admissions counselling in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Delhi for 2026-27, with step-by-step processes, timelines, and essential tips.
content:
Understanding the Counselling Landscape for 2026-27

Medical admissions in India follow a multi-stage process that varies by state and by the central entrance framework. For the 2026-27 cycle, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Delhi have distinct counselling structures, timelines, and seat allotment methods. Students and parents should track official notices from respective state bodies and the national entrance portal. The core goal is to secure a MBBS or BDS seat through a transparent sequence of registrations, document verification, choice filling, and seat allotment.

Tamil Nadu: State Quota, Community Reservations, and Important Dates

Tamil Nadu typically conducts counselling for government and aided medical seats under the state quota. Key steps include registration on the official counselling portal, document verification, and two or more rounds of seat allotment. Candidates may need to provide caste, income, or special category certificates to avail reservations where applicable. Be mindful of the last dates for modification of choices and reporting at designated colleges after seat allotment.

  • Required documents commonly include class 10 and 12 mark sheets, Karnataka or Tamil Nadu board certificates if applicable, domicile proof, category certificates, NEET scorecard, and passport-sized photographs.
  • Ethnicity and community reservations are region-specific; verify eligibility based on district and residence proofs before the counselling window closes.
  • Special rounds may offer seats to eligible candidates who did not secure a seat in earlier rounds or who failed to participate initially.

Practical tip: prepare scanned copies of essential documents early and ensure they match the spelling and details on your NEET scorecard to prevent last-minute discrepancies during verification.

Maharashtra: MCC Framework, State Allocation, and Web Options

While Maharashtra learners often follow a national seat allotment through a central process, the state may conduct its own counselling for state quota seats in government colleges. The process typically includes registration, choice filling, and multiple rounds of allotment with the possibility of up-gradation in later rounds. Parents should monitor the deadline for seat confirmation and reporting to the allotted college. Some seats, especially in government institutions, are allocated on merit and tie-breaking rules are clear in official guidelines.

  • NEET qualification remains mandatory for medical admissions across most government seats in the state.
  • Counselling outcomes depend on category eligibility, seat availability, and the number of applicants in each round.
  • Document verification usually occurs at designated centres or via the online portal; carry originals and photocopies for verification.

Practical tip: check the state eligibility criteria early. If you belong to a category with reserved seats, ensure that all required certificates are up to date and accepted by the state authority.

Delhi: Central and State Coordination, Seat Matrix, and Reporting

Delhi’s counselling landscape combines central entrance framework with state-level seat allocations. Students should verify whether their seat comes under central counselling or the Delhi state quota, and understand the timings for choice filling, mock rounds, and final seat allotment. The capital’s medical counselling emphasizes timely reporting to the allotted college and completing document verification to avoid disqualification.

  • Keep NEET scorecard ready in both hard copy and digital form for quick submission during verification.
  • Certificate requirements mirror other states but may include additional Delhi-specific domicile or local student criteria where applicable.
  • In case of discrepancies in the merit lists, follow the official grievance or redressal process outlined by the counselling authority.

Step-by-Step Playbook for 2026-27

  1. Identify the correct counselling authority: state quota vs central framework, and determine the rounds you are eligible for.
  2. Register early on the official portal, ensuring you have NEET details, identity proofs, and domicile information ready.
  3. Prepare and upload documents: mark sheets, NEET scorecard, category certificates, domicile proofs, and recent photographs. Verify spelling and DOB across all documents.
  4. Fill choices thoughtfully: begin with preferred institutions and courses. Remember to consider location, college facilities, and internship opportunities when ranking options.
  5. Attend verification sessions as scheduled: carry originals and photocopies. Correct any data mismatches on the spot to prevent later rejection.
  6. Monitor seat allotment results: be ready for further rounds if vacancies exist. Some states allow upgradation in subsequent rounds.
  7. Report to the allotted college within the specified window: pay fees, confirm admission, and complete any additional state-specific formalities.

Common Pitfalls to Avoid

  • Missing calendar dates or late registrations, which could close access to preferred rounds.
  • Discrepancies between documents and online records leading to verification failures.
  • Inadequate backup options in case preferred seats remain unavailable after several rounds.
  • Assuming all seats are department or college-specific without checking the latest eligibility criteria.

Verifying Details and Staying Updated

Counselling rules can shift within a cycle due to policy updates or seat recalibrations. Always rely on official state education boards and the relevant central counselling portal for the latest instructions, dates, and required documents. If any step seems unclear, consult the official guidelines and contact the designated helpline. When in doubt, verify details on the official authority website before acting on any information from third-party sources.

FAQ: Quick Answers to Common Questions

What is the first step to start counselling for 2026-27?

Register on the official counselling portal of the relevant state or central agency and prepare required documents for verification.

Do I need a domicile certificate for state quota seats?

In many cases yes, but requirements vary by state. Check the state counselling guidelines for domicile or local candidate criteria.

Can I modify my choices after submission?

Most states allow modification within designated windows. Monitor notices and complete any required edits before the deadline.

What if I am allotted a seat in a later round?

If you obtain a seat in a later round, you must report to the allotted college within the specified period and follow the college’s admission process.

How should I handle document verification?

Carry originals and multiple photocopies of all documents. Ensure consistency of names, dates of birth, and marks with NEET scorecard and online records to avoid delays.

Where can I get authoritative guidance during counselling?

Refer to the official state education board announcements and the central counselling portal for the most reliable, up-to-date information. For serious concerns, contact the official helpline or designated helpdesk as advised in the portal notices.

Final Recommendations

Approach the 2026-27 medical admissions counselling with a clear plan: know your options in Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Delhi, prepare documents early, and fill choices strategically. Stay organized with deadlines, verify every detail, and keep backup plans for seat availability across rounds. A calm, prepared approach often translates into smoother verification, quicker seat confirmation, and better alignment with your preferred medical college and program.

title: CUET 2027: Central and state counselling steps and timelines explained
description: A clear, student-focused overview of CUET 2027 counselling: who conducts it, timeline milestones, document checklists, and step-by-step process for central and state seat allotment in India.
content:
Quick takeaway: Know the counselling flow to secure your seat on time

CUET 2027 combines national and state admissions with a layered counselling process. Understanding who handles central versus state seats, the key deadlines, and the required documents will help you plan ahead with your family. This article outlines the step-by-step process, typical timelines, and practical tips for students and parents navigating central and state counselling.

What is CUET counselling and who runs it?

CUET counselling is the post-exam admission process that allocates seats in undergraduate programs. Central universities follow a common allocation framework under national guidelines, while state and private institutions may run their own counselling or participate in state-level seat allotment. In practice, two tracks emerge:

  • Central counselling: Coordinated by a central authority for all participating central universities. Seat allotment decisions are based on CUET scores, options entered by applicants, and availability across central campuses.
  • State counselling: Managed by state education departments or designated nodal agencies. This governs admissions to state universities and affiliated colleges, often with separate merit lists, reservations, and category rules.

Key documents you’ll need

Prepare these in advance to avoid last-minute stress. Always verify exact requirements on the official admission portal of the relevant authority:

  • CUET admit card and score/merit sheet
  • Class 12 mark sheet and passing certificate
  • Birth certificate or age proof
  • Residence and domicile proofs as applicable for state quotas
  • Category certificates (OBC, SC, ST, EWS) if eligible
  • Passport-size photos and signature
  • Passport or other identity documents for verification

Central counselling: typical steps and timeline

Central counselling follows a standardized path across participating central universities. Timelines can vary slightly by year, but the common steps are:

  1. Registration and choice filling: Create a candidate profile on the central counselling portal, verify credentials, and select preferred programs and campuses.
  2. Preference locking: Ensure your options reflect your true priorities; changes are often limited after locking.
  3. Merit-based seat allotment: Seats are allotted based on CUET scores, category reservations, and available seats across central universities.
  4. Document verification: Selected candidates must visit designated centres or complete online verification to confirm eligibility.
  5. Fee payment and admission confirmation: Pay the required seat confirmation fee (as applicable) and secure your admission by the specified deadline.
  6. Reporting to the allotted campus: Final reporting at the chosen central university along with original documents for verification.

State counselling: typical steps and timeline

State-level counselling often resembles the central process but may operate under separate portals, schedules, and reservation rules. Common steps include:

  1. Registration and document upload: Submit your CUET score, academic records, and domicile or category proofs as required by the state authority.
  2. Choice filling: Select programs and campuses within the state quota, including any home state reservations.
  3. Seat allotment result: A merit-based list is released; candidates are allotted seats accordingly.
  4. Document verification and fee payment: Complete verification and pay admission fees to confirm the seat.
  5. Reporting and joining: Report to the allotted institution by the stipulated date with original documents.

Timelines you should track for CUET 2027 counselling

  • CUET result and score declaration: Marks and percentile are released by the official CUET authorities. Check your score against the expected cutoffs for central and state seats.
  • Registration window: Central and state portals open for profile creation and option entry. Missing this window can limit seat choices.
  • Choice filling and revision period: You can typically modify program preferences within a defined period before final submission.
  • Seat allotment rounds: Central and state authorities may run multiple rounds. Keep track of round-wise results and any waiting list movements.
  • Document verification windows: Verification centers or online processes operate within specific dates. Delays here can affect admission confirmation.
  • Admission confirmation deadlines: Pay fees and confirm admission by the last date to avoid seat forfeiture.

Practical tips for students and parents

  • Map your options to both central and state offerings to maximize chances of admission within your preferred field.
  • Keep digital copies of all documents and ensure names and dates match across certificates to prevent mismatches during verification.
  • If your first choice is a central university but you are eligible for a stronger state seat, plan backups for multiple rounds to avoid losing options.
  • Stay informed about reservation norms and category-specific cutoffs, which can shift year to year.
  • Check official portals regularly for updates about deadlines, required documents, and any changes to the process.

What if you miss a deadline or a round?

Missed deadlines typically lead to loss of the allotted seat in that round. Some authorities offer a limited grace period or a waitlist movement in subsequent rounds. If you are affected, promptly contact the admissions helpdesk and follow official instructions. Do not assume a late submission will be considered in future rounds without explicit permission from the governing authority.

How to verify details without confusion

Because procedures can differ by year and by state, rely on the official admission portals for your final, authoritative information. If you are unsure about a rule or deadline, seek clarification from the designated helpdesk or your school counselor. Never rely on third-party summaries alone for critical decisions.

Next steps

Link your CUET 2027 plan to a concrete timetable: list your target programs, mark deadline dates on a shared family calendar, and prepare your document set early. With careful preparation and timely action, you can navigate central and state counselling more confidently and secure a seat aligned with your education goals.

Frequently asked questions

Q1: When will central and state counselling for CUET 2027 begin?

A1: Timelines vary by year and authority. Monitor the official CUET and state admissions portals for the start of registration, option filling, and round-wise seat allotment announcements.

Q2: Can I participate in both central and state counselling with the same CUET score?

A2: Yes. You may apply through both tracks if eligible, but you must follow each authority’s separate registration and submission requirements. Seat allotment will be carried out independently.

Q3: What if I belong to a reserved category? How does it affect counselling?

A3: Reserved category seats are allocated based on relevant rules, which can differ between central and state authorities. Ensure you submit the correct category certificate and check applicable cutoffs and quotas for each track.

Q4: Do I need to pay a counselling fee?

A4: Some authorities require a non-refundable counselling or processing fee during registration. Confirm exact amounts on the official portal and pay within the specified window to avoid disqualification.

Q5: What should I do after I receive a seat allotment?

A5: Complete document verification, pay the fee, and report to the allotted institution by the deadline. If you plan to decline or wait for a better option, understand the rules about withdrawal and seat cancellation to avoid penalties.

Q6: How can I prepare a strong set of program choices?

A6: Research program lists across central and state institutions, consider campus locations, course accreditation, and future employment avenues. Rank choices by interest, eligibility, and feasibility given your CUET score.

title: IIM Ahmedabad Cluster 3 Summer Placements: What the 70-Plus Roles Figure Means
description: IIM Ahmedabad has completed summer placements for its 2026-28 PGP batch. Read what Cluster 3 reports and which figures still await a consolidated release.
content:
IIM Ahmedabad has concluded the summer internship placement process for its 2026-28 PGP batch after Cluster 3 on 30 October 2026. For MBA aspirants comparing placement reports, the key number needs careful reading: the institute reports more than 70 roles in this cluster. It does not present that number as the total students placed across the batch.

What the final cluster covered

The institute’s 30 October press release describes 12 recruiter cohorts and a process conducted both online and in person. Its sector mix includes artificial intelligence, enterprise technology, banking and insurance, core manufacturing, renewable energy and social enterprises.

Microsoft and Sprinklr were among the enterprise technology recruiters. Tata Consultancy Services recorded the highest hiring within the analytics and IT consulting cohort. The release also identifies Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank and NaBFID among banking and insurance recruiters. These are examples of participation, not a ranking of salaries or stipends.

What remains to be published

IIMA says a consolidated placement release will follow. This cluster announcement does not provide a batch-wide average or median stipend, a complete count of students placed, or a final employer-by-employer offer table. Do not fill those gaps using an older batch’s report.

It also covers summer internships. A summer placement outcome is not the same measure as final placement into a full-time job after the MBA. Keep the two separate when comparing institutions or estimating the return on a course fee.

How to use the update in a college shortlist

Start with the kind of work you want to explore. A sector represented in this cluster can help you identify questions for a programme discussion: what does the internship involve, which skills does it use, and how broad is the recruiter pool? The presence of an employer alone does not tell you how many opportunities will be available to a future batch.

For a fair numerical comparison, use reports for the same placement type and cohort, and check whether stipend figures are monthly or cover the whole internship. Read the earlier Cluster 2 coverage for context, then return to the official placement releases page for the consolidated result. A missing number should remain a missing number until the institute supplies it.
