title: JoSAA 2027 Seat Withdrawal: What Happens Before You Choose Exit
description: Understand what rejecting, retaining or withdrawing a JoSAA 2027 seat can mean, and check the right decision points before leaving IIT counselling.
content:
JoSAA 2027 seat withdrawal can remove a confirmed IIT admission option. Rejecting an allotment, failing to complete acceptance and formally withdrawing are different actions, so don’t treat them as interchangeable. Before you exit, check your seat status, payment position, next counselling option and the rule attached to your round.

A delayed or disappointing alternative can leave you without a JoSAA seat and without a confirmed replacement. That’s the decision risk.

How are retaining, rejecting and withdrawing different?

Retaining means keeping the allotted seat while completing the next required step under the applicable JoSAA process. You may still need to meet payment, document, reporting or institute requirements. An online allotment alone doesn’t finish admission.

Rejecting generally means declining an allotment or not accepting it. Withdrawing usually means leaving after entering the counselling process or accepting a seat, subject to the rule for that stage. The exact portal action, deadline, refund treatment and later-round effect must come from the JoSAA 2027 business rules and your candidate dashboard. Those 2027 rules aren’t established in the supplied evidence as of 15 October 2026.

ActionLikely decision meaningWhat you could lose
RetainKeep the current option and complete required formalities.The seat, if you miss a payment or reporting step.
RejectDecline the offered allotment.A fallback seat that may not return.
WithdrawExit the process or give up an accepted seat.The seat, and possibly part of the paid amount.

What must you check before leaving JoSAA?

Use this order. It prevents a rushed click from becoming an admission problem.

  1. Read the exact action label for your round and seat status. Don’t rely on a screenshot or an old cycle’s advice.
  2. Check whether the seat acceptance amount is paid, whether a refund applies and whether any deduction or deadline is stated.
  3. Write down your actual backup: another entrance route, a state allotment or a confirmed private college offer. “I’ll decide later” isn’t a backup.
  4. Compare course, fees, location, reporting date and exit conditions through college comparisons.
  5. Save the acknowledgement, payment receipt and final dashboard status after the action.

Should you exit while waiting for another result?

Usually, not while the other option is only a hope. If state counselling has not allotted you a seat, giving up JoSAA removes a real option for an uncertain one. Keep a written answer to one blunt question: if the next result disappoints you, where will you study?

For a second entrance route, compare its counselling timeline through entrance exam information. JoSAA, not an older cycle or a message group, decides the applicable rule. Verify the live notice and dashboard before submitting any exit request.

Where to download the AIAPGET 2026 scorecard

On NTA's AIAPGET page, choose the “AIAPGET - 2026 Score Card” link under Candidate Activity and sign in with the details requested there. Save a copy you can read clearly, then check your name, exam discipline and category against your application records. If the portal is slow, return to the official page instead of entering credentials on a search-result link or a third-party form.

NTA's result notice dated 18 September 2026 reports 51,482 registered candidates and 49,864 who appeared across Ayurveda, Homoeopathy, Siddha and Unani. Those totals describe the exam, not your individual rank or admission chance.

Which authority handles the next step?

It is easy to mix up the result portal with the counselling portal. NTA explicitly says it has no role in counselling, so use the right authority for the action you need.

What does a qualifying result actually tell you?

Before assuming you have a seat, compare your scorecard with the official qualifying row and wait for the applicable counselling authority's merit and allotment process. A student seeking both All India and state quota options should check both sets of rules; NTA's result alone does not register you for either one.

Keep these records before counselling

Download the scorecard now and keep the original application details that let you re-enter the NTA portal. Compare the category printed on the scorecard with your supporting certificate, and save the official result notice in case you need to explain a threshold later. Then consult the verified AACCC round schedule before paying a counselling fee or locking choices. An applicant whose details appear wrong should contact NTA through its official helpdesk rather than relying on a social post.

Why a qualifying score is not an admission guarantee

NTA reports the exam scores and qualifying thresholds. It does not conduct counselling. AACCC handles the All India quota and designated institutions, while the relevant state or UT authority handles state-quota seats. A college's eventual closing score depends on its seat matrix, your category, merit position and the choices made by applicants. Do not use the 115-mark Ayurveda UR/EWS threshold, for example, as a prediction of a particular college's closing mark.

What to check on your scorecard

Open the official AIAPGET candidate page and download your 2026 scorecard. Match its discipline and category to NTA's notice before deciding which counselling route applies. Keep the scorecard and your eligibility documents ready; a qualifying result alone does not complete registration or choice filling. For the next steps and verified round dates, read our AIAPGET counselling schedule.

title: TS Inter 2027 ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ: ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਕੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ?
description: ਤੇਲੰਗਾਨਾ ਇੰਟਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਅਤੇ ਲਿਖਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਸਮਾਂ, ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਲੱਭਣ ਦਾ ਤਰੀਕਾ ਅਤੇ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਜਾਣੋ।
content:
ਤੇਲੰਗਾਨਾ ਇੰਟਰਮੀਡੀਏਟ ਦੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਲਈ 2027 ਦੀਆਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਦਾ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਦਿਨ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਆਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਹੀ ਪੱਕੀ ਕਰੋ। ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ 2026-27 ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਜਨਵਰੀ ਦੇ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਲਿਖਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਫਰਵਰੀ ਦੇ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਲਈ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਹਨ, ਹਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ।

TGBIE ਨੇ ਹਾਲੇ ਕੀ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ?

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਸਾਲਾਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਨੂੰ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪ੍ਰੀ-ਫਾਈਨਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਲਈ 18 ਤੋਂ 23 ਜਨਵਰੀ 2027 ਦਿੱਤੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ। ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ IPE 2027 ਦੀ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦੀ ਹਾਲੇ ਉਡੀਕ ਹੈ।

ਫਾਰਵਰਡ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਜਾਂ ਦੂਜੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦਿਖੇ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪੱਕੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਗਣਿਤ, ਜੀਵ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਇਸ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਨਾਲ ਤੈਅ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਫੀਸ ਦਾ ਸਰਕੁਲਰ ਵੀ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸਦਾ।

TGBIE ਦਾ 28 ਮਾਰਚ 2026 ਦਾ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ, ਪੰਨਾ 2। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੇ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਪੂਰਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ (PDF)

ਸਹੀ ਸਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਕਿੱਥੋਂ ਲੱਭੀਏ?

ਤੇਲੰਗਾਨਾ ਬੋਰਡ ਆਫ ਇੰਟਰਮੀਡੀਏਟ ਐਜੂਕੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਦੇ News & Announcements ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ IPE 2027 ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਲੱਭੋ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ PDF ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ। ਪੁਰਾਣੇ IPE ਅਤੇ ਐਡਵਾਂਸਡ ਸਪਲੀਮੈਂਟਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਵੀ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਸਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਜਾਂਚੋ।

ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਜਾਂ ਦੂਜਾ ਸਾਲ ਚੁਣੋ। ਆਮ ਜਾਂ ਵੋਕੇਸ਼ਨਲ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਵੇਖੋ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਾਲ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਂ, ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਲਿਖਤੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖ ਰੱਖੋ। ਸੋਧੀ ਹੋਈ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਆਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਕਾਪੀ ਬਦਲੋ।

ਉਡੀਕ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਕਰੋ

ਬਾਕੀ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਹਫ਼ਤਾਵਾਰੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਣਾਓ। ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਟੀਚਾ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਆਉਣ ਤੱਕ ਰੋਜ਼ਾਨਾ ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਗੁੰਜਾਇਸ਼ ਰੱਖੋ।

TGBIE ਨੇ 2026-27 ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਾਲ ਦੇ ਸਿਲੇਬਸ, ਸਾਲਾਨਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਯੋਜਨਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਡਲ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ ਪੱਤਰ ਲਿੰਕ ਕੀਤੇ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਹੱਲ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਗ਼ਲਤੀਆਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਪਹਿਲੇ ਸਾਲ ਦਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਪੇਪਰ ਢਾਂਚਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਸਾਲ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੀ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਜ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਜੂਨੀਅਰ ਕਾਲਜ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ। ਗ਼ੈਰ-ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨਸ਼ਾਟ ਉੱਤੇ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੈਸੇ ਵਾਪਸ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਯਾਤਰਾ ਬੁੱਕ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਆਉਣ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਕਾਲਜ ਦੀ ਕਾਪੀ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਪੱਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ।

title: Maharashtra GNM Nursing CAP 2026: Public Health Department Registration Rules and MH-NURSING CET Merit Logic
description: Comprehensive guide to Maharashtra GNM Nursing CAP 2026, including Public Health Department registration guidelines, MH-NURSING CET merit tie-breaking criteria, and seat allocation rules.
content:
The centralized admission process for General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM) programs in Maharashtra for the 2026 academic session has introduced streamlined procedures under the Directorate of Health Services and the Public Health Department. Prospective nursing students seeking admission to government and private nursing institutes must strictly align with state-specified eligibility guidelines and entrance test merit logic.

Overview of Maharashtra GNM Centralized Admission Process (CAP)

The Centralized Admission Process (CAP) governs seat distribution across public and private nursing colleges in Maharashtra. Admission is administered through systematic online registration, document verification, publication of state merit lists, and choice-filling rounds.

Public Health Department Registration Guidelines 2026

Candidates must ensure all criteria are met before completing the online portal application:

  • Academic Requirements: Completion of 10+2 or equivalent examination from a recognized board, preferably with Science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and English, achieving minimum aggregate marks specified by state norms.
  • Age Limit: Applicants must be at least 17 years old by December 31, 2026.
  • Domicile and Reservation Rules: Candidates seeking state quota seats must submit valid Maharashtra Domicile Certificates along with relevant category (SC, ST, OBC, EWS, NTC, etc.) and Non-Creamy Layer documents where applicable.
  • Document Upload Protocol: All certificates, including SSC and HSC mark sheets, caste validity, and identity proofs, must be scanned legibly and uploaded according to the prescribed file sizes.

MH-NURSING CET Merit Calculation and Tie-Breaking Logic

Merit ranking for GNM seats relies on performance in the standardized MH-NURSING CET examination or designated state aggregate scores. When two or more candidates secure equal scores, the authority applies specific tie-breaking logic in sequence:

  1. Higher Marks in Biology: Score achieved in the Biology section takes primary precedence.
  2. Higher Marks in Chemistry and Physics: Subsequent evaluation of Chemistry followed by Physics scores.
  3. HSC Aggregate Score: Higher overall percentage in the 12th standard examination.
  4. SSC Aggregate Marks: Higher percentage obtained in Class 10 board examinations.
  5. Age Criteria: Preference is given to the older candidate based on birth date details.

Step-by-Step CAP Round Participation

Navigating the allocation process requires attention to timelines and seat acceptance procedures:

  • Online Registration: Fill out personal, academic, and category details accurately on the official portal.
  • Document Verification: Physical or online scrutinization of uploaded documents by designated nodal centers.
  • Provisional & Final Merit List: Verification of candidate rank and submission of grievances if errors exist.
  • Choice Filling (Option Form): Entering preferred choices of nursing institutes in order of preference.
  • Seat Allotment & Reporting: Confirmation of assigned seats, payment of admission fees, and physical reporting to the allotted college.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum age limit to apply for Maharashtra GNM CAP 2026?

Applicants must be at least 17 years old on or before December 31, 2026.

How is a tie resolved during the MH-NURSING CET merit listing?

Ties are resolved sequentially by comparing Biology scores, Chemistry scores, Physics scores, Class 12 aggregate percentage, Class 10 aggregate percentage, and finally candidate age.

Are students from outside Maharashtra eligible for government GNM seats?

State quota seats in government nursing colleges are primarily reserved for candidates possessing a valid Maharashtra domicile certificate.

Where should candidates verify official Maharashtra GNM registration schedules?

Candidates should regularly check the official State Common Entrance Test Cell or Public Health Department portal for official notifications and updates.

title: IIT Kharagpur Plans Physical AI School: Courses Await Approval
description: IIT Kharagpur plans the Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI. Proposed programmes need academic approval; application dates and admission rules are not announced in the release.
content:
IIT Kharagpur plans to establish the Benjamin Gupta School of Physical AI, but students should wait for a programme-specific admission notice before making application plans. The proposed courses remain subject to academic approval. The announcement does not give an application window, fees or eligibility criteria.

The institute has signed an agreement with alumnus Vinod Gupta and IITKGP Foundation USA for the school. The Ministry of Education announcement, issued on 26 October 2026, describes an initiative connecting AI with engineering, science and medicine.

What could students study?

The proposals include hybrid master’s programmes, executive education, professional certificates and interdisciplinary learning modules. The release envisages programmes from the upcoming academic session, subject to the required approvals. That is a planned start, not a confirmed admission timetable.

Research areas include physics-informed machine learning, robotics, digital twins and computational engineering. Applications could span manufacturing, energy, healthcare and other physical systems. The intended audience includes students, researchers and working professionals from several disciplines.

Read the course notice before choosing an application route

When an admission notice appears, check these details together:

  • The exact qualification awarded and the department administering it.

  • Accepted previous degrees, any work-experience requirement and the selection method.

  • Whether “hybrid” includes compulsory campus visits, laboratory work or examinations.

  • The total fee, course duration, attendance rules and application closing date.

These are questions to resolve, not requirements already confirmed for the proposed school. Keep the IIT Kharagpur website as your starting point for subsequent notices. Avoid paying anyone who claims to reserve a seat before the institute publishes an authorised application route.

Does this change undergraduate IIT admissions?

The school announcement does not establish a new undergraduate entry route. If you are planning an undergraduate engineering application, use the separate IIT admission guide and the applicable official admission rules. Do not assume that a proposed master’s or professional certificate is interchangeable with a BTech programme.

title: CSIR NET December 2026: Finish the Form and Fee Payment by 5 November
description: NTA’s regular CSIR NET December application window ends at 11:50 pm on 5 November. Check the later ₹500 late-fee period, correction dates and confirmation-page step.
content:
Complete your CSIR UGC NET December 2026 application and successful fee payment by 5 November 2026, 11:50 pm, to avoid the scheduled late fee. Creating an application number is only the first step. Return to your account and check that the form, payment and confirmation page are complete.

NTA’s schedule also provides a later application period from 6 to 9 November with a ₹500 late fee. That is a separate window, followed by corrections from 10 to 12 November. Keeping these stages apart will help you avoid treating the correction period as extra time for a first application.

What the three application windows mean

The NTA public notice dated 7 October 2026 gives the following schedule for the December examination.

Stage

Published window or deadline

What to complete

Regular application and fee payment

5 November 2026, 11:50 pm

Submit the application and complete the successful fee transaction.

Late application

6-9 November 2026; fee transaction by 9 November, 11:50 pm

Complete the application with the scheduled ₹500 late fee.

Online correction

10-12 November 2026, ending at 11:50 pm

Make permitted changes to an application through the official website.

National Testing Agency public notice dated 7 October 2026: application, late-fee and correction schedule for Joint CSIR UGC NET December 2026. Read the original official notice.

Check for the confirmation page

The official CSIR NET website links the December 2026 application portal. Its stated steps are registration, completing the online form, paying the examination fee and obtaining the confirmation page.

Existing applicants should use their application number and password to return to the same account. Review the submitted details and payment status rather than relying only on a bank debit message. Save the confirmation page and transaction reference so you can identify the application if you need help.

If money has been debited but the account does not show a completed payment, check the transaction details and contact the official helpdesk with the application and payment reference. Keep your password and OTP private.

The ₹500 late fee is a separate charge

The notice labels ₹500 as the late fee for the later submission window. It is not the entire examination fee. Follow the applicable fee shown for your category in the official bulletin and application account before authorising payment.

If you can finish during the regular window, leave enough time to review the form and complete payment before the 5 November cutoff. Do not assume a saved form or a pending transaction amounts to successful submission.

Corrections come after submission

The scheduled correction period ends on 12 November at 11:50 pm. Use the instructions and editable fields made available in the candidate account. Do not assume that every entry, photograph or document will become changeable.

If you have a separate UGC NET application, keep its records apart from CSIR NET. Our guide to the two December application portals explains why the exams should not be treated as one registration process.

Keep the exam schedule separate from admit-card release

The same NTA notice schedules examinations for 19, 22 and 27 December 2026. It leaves city information and admit-card release dates for a later announcement. Use the official website for those updates rather than assuming that submitting the form also makes a hall ticket available.

For application clarification, the notice lists csirnet@nta.ac.in and the helpdesk numbers 011-40759000 and 011-69227700.

title: GATE 2027 फोटो या हस्ताक्षर में कमी: दोबारा अपलोड से पहले जांचें
description: GATE की त्रुटि सूचना के अनुसार फोटो या हस्ताक्षर सुधारें। JPEG आकार, पिक्सेल, चेहरे की स्पष्टता और क्रॉप के आधिकारिक नियम जानें।
content:
GATE 2027 में फोटो या हस्ताक्षर की कमी दूर करने के लिए सिर्फ फाइल छोटी करना पर्याप्त नहीं है। नई तस्वीर IIT मद्रास के नियमों के अनुरूप होनी चाहिए और स्क्रूटिनी ईमेल में बताई गई समस्या भी दूर करनी चाहिए। मूल फोटो या हस्ताक्षर का स्कैन खोलें, उसकी स्पष्टता जांचें और फिर GOAPS के लिए उसकी कॉपी क्रॉप या संपीड़ित करें।

आधिकारिक GATE घोषणा में स्क्रूटिनी की कमियां सुधारने की अंतिम तारीख 3 नवंबर 2026 है। यह उन्हीं उम्मीदवारों के लिए है जिन्हें सुधार की सूचना मिली है। इससे पंजीकरण दोबारा नहीं खुलता और अलग शुल्क वाले डेटा सुधार की तारीख तय नहीं होती। बढ़ी हुई समयसीमा की जानकारी से समझें कि किसे कार्रवाई करनी है।

फाइल का आकार और पिक्सेल साथ जांचें

IIT मद्रास के फोटो और हस्ताक्षर संबंधी निर्देश दोनों फाइलों के लिए अलग सीमाएं बताते हैं। फाइल किलोबाइट सीमा में होने पर भी उसके पिक्सेल गलत या तस्वीर अस्पष्ट हो सकती है।

IIT मद्रास के GATE 2027 फोटो निर्देश, 1 नवंबर 2026 को लिया गया चित्र। पेज पर अलग जारी करने की तारीख नहीं है। फोटो के पूरे आधिकारिक नियम पढ़ें।

केवल आकार घटाने से खराब फोटो नहीं सुधरेगा

फोटो में सादा सफेद बैकग्राउंड और सामने की ओर देखता स्पष्ट चेहरा होना चाहिए। माथा, आंखें, नाक और ठुड्डी दिखाई दें। चश्मे की चमक हटाएं; ऐसा संभव न हो तो निर्देशों के अनुसार फोटो के लिए चश्मा उतारें। धूप का चश्मा, चेहरे पर छाया, आसपास की वस्तुएं और धुंधलापन सही फाइल आकार होने पर भी समस्या हैं।

धार्मिक कारण से सिर ढकना स्वीकार्य है, लेकिन ठुड्डी से माथे तक और चेहरे के दोनों किनारे स्पष्ट रहें। तय आकार में लाने के लिए फोटो खींचकर विकृत न करें। मूल फोटो धुंधली या खराब रोशनी वाली हो तो बार-बार संपीड़ित करने के बजाय साफ फोटो लें। यही अपलोड फोटो प्रवेश पत्र और स्कोरकार्ड पर इस्तेमाल होती है।

हस्ताक्षर साफ और आपके अपने होने चाहिए

काले या गहरे नीले स्याही में अपने हस्ताक्षर करें। अतिरिक्त खाली जगह काटें, लेकिन पूरा हस्ताक्षर स्पष्ट और सीधा रहे। आधिकारिक उदाहरण डिजिटल हस्ताक्षर, सभी बड़े अक्षरों या केवल आद्याक्षरों वाले हस्ताक्षर, गहरा बैकग्राउंड, बहुत छोटा आकार और बॉक्स से बाहर के हस्ताक्षर अस्वीकार्य बताते हैं।

बदलने से पहले फाइल सामान्य आकार में खोलकर त्रुटि संदेश से मिलाएं। अपने मौजूदा GOAPS आवेदन से अपलोड करें, प्रीव्यू देखें और उपलब्ध पुष्टि सुरक्षित रखें। सफल अपलोड का अर्थ स्क्रूटिनी पास होना नहीं है; आवेदन की स्थिति फिर जांचें। परीक्षा के समय हस्ताक्षर न मिलने पर अयोग्यता हो सकती है।
author: Geethika Reddy

title: CBSE Class 12 West Asia Special Result 2026: Find Your Document on DigiLocker
description: CBSE has confirmed that results for the Class 12 special examination held in West Asia from 23 to 28 October are available on DigiLocker.
content:
The CBSE Class 12 special-examination result for West Asia is available on DigiLocker. CBSE confirmed this in its notice dated 6 November 2026. The announcement covers the special examination held from 23 to 28 October 2026.

Match the result to your examination

If you took that special examination, use the CBSE result notification to identify the announcement. It names Class XII, West Asia and the October examination dates. Keep those details beside you when looking for your own result document.

CBSE, 6 November 2026: excerpt from the official result notification linked above.

Access your result through DigiLocker

Go to the official DigiLocker website and sign in to your account. Use its education-document search to look for the CBSE document relevant to your examination. Follow the details requested by the service rather than entering information into an unrelated results page.

Once a document is available in your account, check your name, roll number, class and examination details before saving or sharing it. Keep a copy where you can find it for an admission or school-record request. Share the result document only with the intended recipient; do not share your login password or OTP.

If the document is missing or the details do not match

First confirm that you have signed in to the correct account and selected the appropriate CBSE document. If you still cannot retrieve it, contact your school with the examination details and a description of the problem. For a DigiLocker access issue, use the official support service.

A missing document in your account is not enough to establish a result status. Similarly, if a name or examination detail looks wrong, ask the school how to resolve it before submitting the document elsewhere.

Keep result and timetable documents separate

This announcement concerns the October 2026 special-examination result. The Class 12 board timetable for 2027 serves a different purpose: it lists upcoming examination dates. Check the year and document heading each time you save a CBSE PDF so that your result and examination schedule remain easy to identify.

title: A Practical, Region-Wise Admissions Planner for Indian MBBS, Engineering, and Management Programs in 2027-28
description: A region-wise approach to planning MBBS, Engineering, and Management admissions for Indian students in 2027-28, with timelines, counseling steps, and budgeting tips tailored for diverse states and admission processes.
content:
Introduction: A clear path for 2027-28 admissions

Indian students and parents face multiple admission routes across MBBS, engineering, and management programs. The goal of this planner is to provide a practical, region-wise roadmap that aligns with typical state quotas, national entrance patterns, and college-level counseling timelines for the 2027-28 cycle. The emphasis is on proactive preparation, transparent budgeting, and timely actions that reduce last-minute stress.

Key timelines and decision checkpoints

While exact dates vary by state and institution, a typical admission calendar follows this rhythm:

  • June-August: Complete basic eligibility checks, register for national and state entrance exams, and start shortlisting programs by region.
  • September-October: Submit applications or choice filling for institutes with multiple admission rounds; begin securing required documents; plan for spot admissions or counseling sessions where applicable.
  • November-February: Attend counseling sessions, verify eligibility, and finalize seat acceptance. Some programs may have late rounds or special rounds in early 2028.
  • March-June: Complete anti-date formalities, document verification, and course commencement preparations.

Because MBBS requires national screening tests and extensive counseling, while engineering and management offer a mix of national and state counseling, a region-aware plan helps families allocate time and funds efficiently.

Region-wise approach: what to expect in North, South, East, West, and Central India

Regions differ in popular programs, reservation patterns, and fee structures. Here is a focused checklist for each region.

North India

  • MBBS: Expect substantial government seats in major states; prepare for national entrance preparation with practice tests and coaching if needed.
  • Engineering: Tier-1 state engineering colleges and central institutes are highly competitive; consider state entrance scores and counseling rounds.
  • Management: Regional management institutes often participate in state-level counseling; plan for required tests and group discussions where applicable.

South India

  • MBBS: Strong seat presence in government and private colleges; regional entrance patterns may vary; keep track of state medical counseling portals.
  • Engineering: High demand for engineering streams; option to apply to both state and national institutes with early completion of application forms.
  • Management: Private management programs with regional emphasis; look for clusters in metropolitan hubs and tier-2 cities.

East India

  • MBBS: Government seats in several states; private sector options also available with varying fees and scholarships.
  • Engineering: Public universities and institutes offer competitive programs; plan for annual counseling cycles and document checks.
  • Management: Regional institutes may have fewer seats; early application can secure better options.

West India

  • MBBS: Strong public and private college networks; keep an eye on state quota rules and eligibility criteria.
  • Engineering: A mix of renowned private institutes and state universities; consider scholarship avenues and capitation nuances where relevant.
  • Management: Numerous business schools; prioritize accreditation, placement history, and regional industry ties.

Central India

  • MBBS: Public medical colleges are prominent; private options may require higher fees but offer accelerated processes in some states.
  • Engineering: Engineering education networks are expanding; explore both state and national seat allocation processes.
  • Management: MBA and PGDM programs vary in focus; region-specific industry connections can influence internships and placements.

Regional variations matter for eligibility, reservation quotas, and fee structures. Students should map their preferred institutes to the state or central counseling authority that governs admissions in that region.

Practical steps by stream

MBBS

  • Identify the national screening test requirements and state eligibility rules early. Track counseling portals and cut-off trends from the previous year as a rough guide.
  • Prepare documents in advance: academic records, birth certificates, PAN or Aadhaar where required, and category certificates if applicable.
  • Consider a balanced list of government and private colleges across regions to diversify seat options and budget needs.

Engineering

  • List streams of interest (e.g., computer science, mechanical, electrical) and region-specific demand. Balance IIT/NIT-level options with trusted state institutes.
  • Complete application forms early and confirm eligibility criteria for each institute. Some will require additional tests or statements of purpose for management-oriented programs.
  • Plan for scholarships or financial aid where available, and compare tuition ranges across regions.

Management

  • Shortlist institutes by accreditation, industry ties, and placement performance. Private schools often have rolling admissions, while some government-affiliated programs run fixed cycles.
  • Prepare for group discussions, written tests, and personal interviews if applicable. Build a compelling profile reflecting leadership, internships, or project work.
  • Budget for tuition, living costs, and potential relocation; consider regional living costs when evaluating total cost of attendance.

Documents and budgeting: a practical checklist

  • Academic transcripts, board/year-wise mark sheets, and certificate of birth.
  • Identity documents, category certificates if applicable, and domicile proofs required by state authorities.
  • Passport-sized photos, transfer certificates, migration certificates where relevant.
  • Application fees, counseling fees, and travel costs for caps and counseling sessions.
  • Contingency fund for unexpected fees or late rounds.

Families often underestimate travel and lodging costs during counseling days. Create a region-specific budget that anticipates possible changes in seat allotment timelines and counseling rounds.

How to use this planner: a quick-reference approach

Start with a region map of your preferred states, then align MBBS, engineering, and management options within each state. Build a three-column table: your top programs, their admission process (national or state), and the estimated timeline. Review this table every month from June onward and adjust based on test results and counseling updates.

Always verify details on the relevant official authority website before acting on deadlines or fees. If uncertain, contact the institute’s admissions office or the state counseling portal directly to confirm eligibility and round schedules.

FAQ

Q1: When should I start preparing for MBBS entrance and state counseling?

A1: Begin by early identification of eligibility and exam calendars. Prepare by building a study plan for the national screening test and monitor state portal announcements for counseling windows.

Q2: How should I balance options across regions?

A2: Create a prioritized list that includes a mix of government and private institutes from multiple regions. This reduces risk if one region’s seats fill quickly and broadens chances for a good fit.

Q3: What costs should I budget for in 2027-28?

A3: Include application and counseling fees, tuition and living costs, travel for counseling days, and a buffer for late rounds or add-on charges. Fees vary widely by state and program.

Q4: Are there region-specific scholarships I should consider?

A4: Some regions offer state-funded scholarships or institute-level waivers. Check eligibility criteria and application windows for each program you target.

Q5: What if I miss a counseling round?

A5: Stay informed about any subsequent rounds or waitlists and have a backup list of institutes to approach. Timely action and flexibility improve outcomes.

Final note

Admitting to MBBS, engineering, or management in 2027-28 requires coordinated planning across regions. A region-aware plan helps families optimize options, manage costs, and stay on track through the admission cycle. Always verify official details at the appropriate counseling portals and institute pages to ensure accuracy as timelines may shift.

title: Rashtriya Military School Admission 2027: Age and Document Checks
description: RMS admission 2027 may stop at scrutiny when age proof, names or certificates do not match. Check the records before the written test.
content:
Rashtriya Military School Admission 2027 can end at document scrutiny before a candidate reaches the written test. Check the child’s date of birth against the entry-class age band, then compare every name, certificate and uploaded detail with the records. One wrong digit can make a well-prepared form unsafe.

The exact 2027 cut-off dates and accepted proofs will come from the responsible Rashtriya Military Schools admission notice. Until that notice is available, don’t treat an old poster, coaching video or school-year estimate as a final rule.

What age rule applies to RMS admission 2027?

Age eligibility depends on the entry class and the date fixed in the 2027 notice. The child’s present age is not enough. The deciding check is whether the date of birth on the accepted record falls within the permitted range on the stated cut-off date.

  1. Copy the date of birth exactly as printed on the accepted birth record.
  2. Check the minimum and maximum age condition for the chosen entry class.
  3. Read any relaxation rule and identify the proof required for it.
  4. Save the relevant eligibility page with the application records.

If the child reaches the required age shortly after the cut-off, that normally won’t fix the problem. Eligibility follows the notified date, not a parent’s estimate of when the academic year begins.

Which documents can stop an RMS admission 2027 form?

A valid document must prove the claim and match the application. A birth certificate, school record and form showing different spellings or dates can trigger identity or eligibility questions, even when each document looks genuine. The 2027 notice must decide which record and certificate formats the schools will accept.

CheckComparePossible problem
Date of birthForm, birth record and school recordAge eligibility questioned
Candidate nameSpelling, initials and name orderIdentity mismatch
Parent detailsNames and relationship across recordsClarification may be sought
Category or service claimFormat, issuing authority and validityClaim may not be counted

Run this check before submission

  • Enter names and dates from the record, not from memory.
  • Preview every uploaded page and confirm that certificate numbers and issuing details are visible.
  • Use only files in the size and format stated in the 2027 instructions.
  • Keep the final form, payment record and uploaded files in one folder.
  • Never crop, edit or alter a certificate image.

Need a correction? Approach the issuing authority before submitting the RMS admission 2027 form and retain proof of the request. Keep original documents ready for later verification. While waiting, families can compare schools and colleges for a backup choice, but another option won’t repair an invalid RMS application.
author: Geethika Reddy

meta_description: Check RMS admission 2027 age proof, certificate matching and form errors before scrutiny, so your child reaches the written-test stage safely.

content:
The SBI Clerk Mains Result 2025 will soon be available on the State Bank of India's (SBI) official website, sbi.co.in.  Those who took the Mains exam are keen to find out if they qualify for the Junior Associate (Customer Support & Sales) positions.  Whether or not candidates advance to the final selection stage will depend on this outcome.

Mains Result Release Update

The Mains results, scorecard, and state-by-state cutoff are anticipated to be released by SBI soon.  After the results are available, candidates can download them by logging in with their registration number and password.  To prevent missing crucial alerts, candidates are urged to regularly check the official website for real-time updates.

Expected Cutoff for SBI Clerk Mains 2025

The anticipated cutoff for SBI Clerk Mains 2025 is determined by the amount of open positions, the exam's difficulty level, and historical trends.  Because there are more test takers this year and areas like Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, and General/Financial Awareness have intermediate difficulty levels, the cutoff is probably going to be a little higher.

title: NPAT 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਹੀ ਕੋਰਸ ਅਤੇ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਚੁਣੋ
description: NMIMS ਦੇ NPAT 2027 ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਵੇਖੋ। ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਫੀਸ ਅਤੇ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਮੰਨਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਸ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਸਾਲ ਦੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਜਾਂਚੋ।
content:
NPAT 2027 ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਲਈ ਢੁੱਕਵਾਂ ਕੋਰਸ ਅਤੇ NMIMS ਕੈਂਪਸ ਚੁਣੋ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੰਨੇ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵਿੱਚ 2027 ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਉੱਥੇ ਜੋੜੀ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਸਾਲ 2026-27 ਦੀ ਹੈ। ਉਸ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਨੂੰ 2027 ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮਿਆਦ, ਫੀਸ ਜਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਕਿਹੜੇ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ?

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ BBA, B.Com., B.Sc. Finance, BBA FinTech, ਸਾਂਝਾ BBA-MBA, B.Sc. Economics ਅਤੇ BA Liberal Arts ਹਨ। Branding and Advertising, International Business, Management and Marketing ਅਤੇ Finance ਵਰਗੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਦੇ BBA ਕੋਰਸ ਵੀ ਦਿਸਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨਾਮ ਪਸੰਦ ਆਉਣ ਕਰਕੇ ਚੁਣਨ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ ਕਿ ਕੋਰਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੀ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਇਆ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਮੁੰਬਈ, ਬੈਂਗਲੁਰੂ, ਨਵੀ ਮੁੰਬਈ, ਹੈਦਰਾਬਾਦ, ਇੰਦੌਰ, ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਅਤੇ ਅਹਿਮਦਾਬਾਦ ਕੈਂਪਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਹਰ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ, ਇਹ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਤੁਹਾਡੀ ਪਸੰਦ ਦਾ ਕੋਰਸ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਸੰਬੰਧਿਤ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕੋਰਸ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰੋ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ NPAT ਕੋਰਸ ਪੰਨਾ

ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਦਾ ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਸਾਲ ਜ਼ਰੂਰ ਵੇਖੋ

Admissions Handout ਅਤੇ Important Dates ਦੇ ਲਿੰਕ 2026-27 ਦੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਵੱਲ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਵੈੱਬਪੰਨੇ ਦਾ 2027 ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਅਤੇ PDF ਦਾ ਅਕਾਦਮਿਕ ਸਾਲ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫੀਸ ਜਾਂ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਵੇਂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ 2027 ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੀ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਆਉਣ ਤੱਕ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਪੱਕੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ।

SVKM’s NMIMS ਦੀ 2026-27 ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ। ਇਸ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਇਹ 2027 ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਅਸਲ 2026-27 ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ

ਪਸੰਦ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਹੁਣੇ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ FAQ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਵੱਧ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਪੰਜ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਚੁਣੇ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਤਰਜੀਹਾਂ ਉਸ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਲਗਾਓ; 2027 ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਿਯਮ ਮੁੜ ਪੱਕੇ ਕਰੋ। ਹਰ ਚੋਣ ਲਈ ਕੋਰਸ, ਕੈਂਪਸ, ਯੋਗਤਾ, ਬਾਰ੍ਹਵੀਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ, ਗਣਿਤ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਕੜਾ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਤ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ, ਪਾਠਕ੍ਰਮ, ਥਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਰਚ ਲਿਖੋ।

Finance ਵਿੱਚ ਦਿਲਚਸਪੀ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਇਸ ਦੇ ਗਣਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਤਰਾਤਮਕ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਵੇਖੋ। Management ਜਾਂ Liberal Arts ਲਈ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਖੇਤਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਦੋ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਹੋਣ ਤਾਂ ਵੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੀ ਹੋਣੀ ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਨਹੀਂ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਹਨ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ, ਕਿਹੜੀ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਰਾਹ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਦੀ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਦੇਣੀ ਹੈ, NMIMS ਦੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਵਿਭਾਗ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪੁੱਛਗਿੱਛ ਦਾ ਫਾਰਮ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ

ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਵਾਪਸੀ ਕਾਲ ਲਈ ਫਾਰਮ ਭਰਨ ਨਾਲ NPAT ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ। ਉਸ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀਆਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਮੰਨਣੀਆਂ ਪੈਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਦੀ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਮਿਲਣ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਹੀ ਅੱਗੇ ਵਧੋ। ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ।

ਨਵੀਂ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਆਉਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ, ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ, ਫੀਸ, ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਚੋਣ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮੁੜ ਜਾਂਚੋ। ਉਦੋਂ ਤੱਕ ਸਹੀ ਕੋਰਸ-ਕੈਂਪਸ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਉਣਾ ਵਰਤੋਂਯੋਗ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਹੈ।

title: CBSE 10, 12వ తరగతులు మల్టీమీడియా పరీక్ష 2027: తేదీ, సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్, సమయం
description: 10వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (కోడ్ 415) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది. 12వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (కోడ్ 821) పరీక్ష 7 ఏప్రిల్ 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.
content:
10వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (కోడ్ 415) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది. 12వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (కోడ్ 821) పరీక్ష 7 ఏప్రిల్ 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.

2026 నవంబర్ 6న విడుదల చేసిన CBSE ప్రధాన పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్‌లో ఈ వివరాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఇది పరీక్షల టైమ్‌టేబుల్ మాత్రమే; మార్కుల జాబితా కాదు. అధికారిక CBSE టైమ్‌టేబుల్

మల్టీమీడియా పేపర్ ఎప్పుడు, ఎంతసేపు?

తరగతి, పేపర్కోడ్పరీక్ష తేదీసమయం (IST)వ్యవధి

కేంద్రీయ మాధ్యమిక విద్యా మండలి, 6 నవంబర్ 2026, పేజీ 4: సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్లు, తేదీలు, సమయాలు. అధికారిక PDFలో ఈ పేజీ చూడండి

కేంద్రీయ మాధ్యమిక విద్యా మండలి, 6 నవంబర్ 2026, పేజీ 12: సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్లు, తేదీలు, సమయాలు. అధికారిక PDFలో ఈ పేజీ చూడండి

అధికారిక PDFలో మీ పేపర్‌ను గుర్తించండి

పేజీ 4, 12లో ముందుగా తరగతి శీర్షిక చూసి, తర్వాత 415, 821 కోడ్ గుర్తించండి. ఒక తేదీ లేదా సమయం వరుసగా ఉన్న అనేక సబ్జెక్టులకు వర్తించవచ్చు. ఫోన్‌లో పూర్తి పేజీని పెద్దదిగా చేసి చదవండి.

పాఠశాల నమోదు వివరాల్లోని కోడ్, కోర్సు పేరు సరిపోల్చుకోండి. ఒకే పేరుతో వేర్వేరు తరగతుల పేపర్లు ఉన్నా మీ తరగతి వరుసనే ఎంచుకోండి.

ఇంగ్లిష్ పేపర్‌తో తేదీలను పోల్చుకోండి

10వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (415) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. English Language and Literature (184) పరీక్ష 26 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఈ రెండు తేదీల మధ్య 8 రోజుల తేడా ఉంది. 12వ తరగతి మల్టీమీడియా (821) పరీక్ష 7 ఏప్రిల్ 2027న ఉంటుంది. English Core (301) పరీక్ష 5 మార్చి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఈ రెండు తేదీల మధ్య 33 రోజుల తేడా ఉంది.

ఈ తేడా మొత్తం చదువుకోడానికి దొరికే సెలవు కాదు. మీ ఇతర పరీక్షలను కూడా క్యాలెండర్‌లో పెట్టి, మధ్యలో పరీక్ష లేని రోజులను మాత్రమే లెక్కించండి. సాధన చేసేటప్పుడు అసలు పేపర్ వ్యవధిని పాటించండి.

ప్రాక్టికల్స్‌కు వేరే షెడ్యూల్

ఈ వరుస బోర్డు పేపర్‌కు సంబంధించినది. ప్రాక్టికల్, ప్రదర్శన, ప్రాజెక్టు లేదా అంతర్గత మూల్యాంకనం ఉంటే వాటి తేదీ, తీసుకెళ్లాల్సిన సామగ్రి గురించి పాఠశాలలో అడగండి.

కేంద్రంలోకి కమ్యూనికేషన్ పరికరాలను అనుమతించరు. తీసుకెళ్లే వస్తువుల విషయంలో CBSE విడిగా ఇచ్చే సూచనలను, అడ్మిట్ కార్డులోని నియమాలను పాటించండి.

పూర్తి పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్ · పేపర్ వ్యవధి వివరాలు

title: UGC NET December 2026: Submit the Form and Fee by 31 October
description: The UGC NET December 2026 form and fee deadlines are both 31 October at 11:50 pm. Complete these final checks before closing your application.
content:
UGC NET December 2026 applicants have until 11:50 pm on 31 October 2026 to submit the online form and complete a successful fee transaction. NTA's deadline-extension notice gives the same cut-off for both steps and says there is no late fee within the extended window.

If you started the form earlier, log back in through the official UGC NET website. Check what remains incomplete instead of assuming that account registration or a bank debit finishes the application.

Review the application as a whole

Read the subject choice, qualification details and category entries together. A spelling correction will not resolve a wrongly selected subject or an unsupported eligibility claim. Compare the form with your certificates and use the current information bulletin for any condition you are unsure about.

Preview the photograph, signature and other required uploads. Check that the files belong to you, are legible and are in the correct fields. Keep access to the email address and mobile number used in the form.

Check the fee status before logging out

After completing the payment flow, return to your application account and check its status. Retain the acknowledgement or confirmation page and payment record when available. If the bank shows a debit but the application does not reflect success, use the help route on the official portal and keep the transaction reference ready.

Do not send passwords, OTPs or full card details to anyone offering to fix a pending application. A clear screenshot of the error and the relevant transaction reference are more useful for describing the problem through the official support channel.

What the extension does not change

The notice keeps the other bulletin terms unchanged. It does not remove eligibility conditions or guarantee another extension after 31 October. A later correction window should not be treated as extra time to submit an unfinished form.

Once your application is complete, turn to subject preparation. Use the DekhoCampus exam directory to organise further reading, and rely on the UGC NET portal for changes to the application or examination schedule.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਤੇ 12 Electronics and Hardware ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
description: ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ Electronics and Hardware (ਕੋਡ 420) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ Electronics and Hardware (ਕੋਡ 847) ਪੇਪਰ 4 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ Electronics and Hardware (ਕੋਡ 420) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ Electronics and Hardware (ਕੋਡ 847) ਪੇਪਰ 4 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

Electronics and Hardware ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5, 10 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 420, 847 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ Electronics and Hardware (420) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Language and Literature (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਵਿੱਚ Electronics and Hardware (847) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 4 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Core (301) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 5 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

content:
JEE Main 2027 Registration is a step for students who want to get into engineering programs at NITs, IIITs and other schools that take part in the exam. The National Testing Agency (NTA) is the one that runs the test. Anyone who wants to apply needs to keep an eye on the news to find out when registration begins, when the last day to apply is and what the rules are for being eligible.

On October 20 2026 the exact dates, for registration have not been officially announced yet. Students need to stay from any dates that are not confirmed and get their papers ready early.

JEE Main 2027 Registration: Important Details

Documents Required for JEE Main 2027

Candidates should keep the following documents and details ready:

  • Class 10 certificate or marksheet

  • Recent passport-size photograph

  • Scanned signature

  • Valid identity details

  • Class 12 academic information

  • Category certificate, if applicable

  • PwD/PwBD certificate, where applicable

  • Active email address and mobile number

  • Online payment method

Check the official information bulletin for prescribed file formats, sizes and verification requirements.

JEE Main 2027 Eligibility

Candidates must pass the qualifying examination. Meet the subject requirements set by NTA. Students need to look at the Class 12 passing years, the subjects that are needed, and other eligibility conditions in the official 2027 information bulletin.

Admission to NITs, IIITs, and other institutes that take part may also have their own Class 12 marks or board-percentile requirements.

How to Apply for JEE Main 2027

  1. Visit the official NTA JEE Main website.

  2. Open the JEE Main 2027 registration link when available.

  3. Register using the required personal and contact details.

  4. Complete the application form and academic information.

  5. Select examination preferences.

  6. Upload the required documents.

  7. Pay the application fee online.

  8. Review and submit the form.

  9. Save the confirmation page for future reference.

Conclusion

Students preparing for JEE Main 2027 registration should organize their documents. Carefully review their application before submission. Students should monitor NTA announcements for confirmed dates, eligibility rules, and application instructions to avoid missing important deadlines.

title: BITSAT 2027 Retake: When Does Paying for a Second Attempt Make Sense?
description: Should you pay for another BITSAT 2027 attempt? Compare mock-score movement, target campus or branch, preparation time and family budget before paying.
content:
A BITSAT 2027 retake is worth the fee only when a realistic score gain can change your campus, branch or admission decision. If your recent mocks are flat, your target is vague and the payment strains the household budget, a second attempt may add pressure without adding a better option.

Start with evidence, not panic. Compare your latest full-length mock scores, the branch or campus you want at the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, and the preparation time left after boards and other entrance exams.

When can a second BITSAT attempt make sense?

Paying again has a fair case when you know what went wrong and can correct it before the next session. A student losing marks through rushed Physics calculations needs a different plan from one leaving Chemistry questions because revision is incomplete.

  • Your scores are moving up: several recent, timed mocks show progress rather than one lucky result.
  • The target is concrete: the possible improvement could shift you towards a preferred branch or make another BITS campus realistic.
  • You have usable study time: school exams, practicals and other tests won’t consume the hours needed for focused correction.
  • The fee fits: paying won’t reduce money needed for other applications, counselling, travel or essential household expenses.

When is saving the money the smarter choice?

Be cautious when the retake is driven only by comparison with classmates. Three or four properly timed mocks in the same score band suggest that extra revision time, not another payment, needs closer examination. Also ask whether your current score already supports a branch you’d genuinely accept. A small possible increase may not justify another preparation cycle.

Use our entrance exam information and college comparison resources to compare realistic alternatives, not imagined ones.

A practical retake check before payment

  1. Write the exact campus and branch you want.
  2. Review five recent full mocks and classify every lost mark as a concept gap, speed issue, calculation error or poor selection.
  3. Set a score target linked to that choice.
  4. Run a focused trial: timed Physics numericals, Chemistry recall sheets and Maths accuracy drills.
  5. Pay only if the trial shows improvement and the amount is affordable.

The Birla Institute of Technology and Science will establish the 2027 application schedule, fee, session conditions and permitted attempts through its admission notice. These details aren’t confirmed here. Check that notice before payment, and treat online claims about fees or attempts as unverified until BITS publishes them.

title: Holistic College Fit in India: A Practical Framework to Compare Programs Beyond Rankings
description: A practical framework to help Indian students and parents evaluate higher education programs using criteria beyond rankings, focusing on alignment with interests, strengths, finances, and long-term outcomes.
content:
Lead: Make a smarter college choice by measuring fit, not just ranking

For Indian students and families, college selection often centers on rankings. A holistic approach shifts the focus to fit: how a program supports your interests, strengths, finances, and career trajectory. This framework helps you compare programs with a practical set of criteria that you can apply across disciplines and institutions.

1) Clarify your goals and core interests

Start with a concrete self-assessment. Map your strongest subjects, preferred learning styles, and long-term goals. If you love project work, practical labs, or independent research, identify programs that emphasize experiential learning, capstone projects, and industry partnerships. If you value entrepreneurship or social impact, look for incubators, internships, and community engagement components embedded in the curriculum.

  • Articulate 3-5 learning outcomes you want from college.
  • Note whether programs offer disciplinary flexibility or interdisciplinary tracks that align with your interests.

2) Assess curriculum design and learning experience

Curriculum matters as much as credentials. Examine:

  • Course structure: core requirements vs. electives,选ives that align with your interests.
  • Hands-on opportunities: labs, studios, fieldwork, internships, industry projects.
  • Assessment methods: are there frequent feedback loops, portfolio development, or research components?
  • Flexibility: ability to switch majors or add minors without losing time or credits.

Programs that pair theoretical grounding with real-world practice tend to translate into clearer skill development and employability beyond grade averages.

3) Consider campus ecosystem and support structures

A supportive ecosystem enhances learning outside the classroom. Look for:

  • Mentorship and advising quality, including career and academic advising.
  • Student clubs, research groups, and competition opportunities relevant to your field.
  • Support services: mental health, disability accommodations, tutoring, and language support if needed.
  • Campus culture and peer networks that reflect your values and aspirations.

Visit campuses if possible or speak with current students to gauge whether the environment matches your needs.

4) Analyze career pathways and long-term outcomes

Rankings do not always reveal the quality of post-graduate opportunities. Focus on:

  • Placement trends: average salary, roles, and sectors trending for your discipline.
  • Industry connections: internship pipelines, alumni networks, and collaboration with employers.
  • Higher studies readiness: availability of structured programs for exams like postgraduate entrance tests or research funding.
  • Entrepreneurship and innovation track records: startup support, accelerators, and funding access.

Cross-check official placement reports and course-to-career mappings rather than relying solely on brand recognition.

5) Evaluate cost, financial aid, and value

Financial clarity drives sustainable choice. Compare:

  • Tuition and mandatory fees across years, including any annual increases.
  • Living expenses, travel costs, and local cost of living in the college town.
  • Scholarships, merit aid, and need-based aid availability and criteria.
  • Return on investment: projected debt burden and typical early-career earnings in your chosen field.

Ask about installment options, return policies, and any transfer credit implications if you switch programs later.

6) Consider location, culture, and personal fit

Location shapes experiences and opportunities. Think about:

  • Proximity to family and access to internships in nearby cities.
  • Urban vs. rural setting, climate, safety, and commute times.
  • Campus diversity, inclusion initiatives, and support for international students or underrepresented groups.

Personal fit matters: a program should feel welcoming and align with your daily rhythms and values.

7) Use a structured comparison checklist

Create a side-by-side matrix for each program you consider. Include: accreditation status, faculty expertise, research opportunities, industry partnerships, graduate outcomes, climate of campus life, and available experiential learning components. Score each criterion on a consistent scale to reveal trade-offs clearly.

8) Practical steps to implement the framework

Take these steps in parallel with your college search:

  • Gather official program guides, course catalogs, and internship reports from each institution.
  • Attend information sessions, campus tours, and online webinars to ask targeted questions.
  • Connect with current students and alumni to gauge day-to-day experience and outcomes.
  • Document your criteria and revisit your priorities as you learn more about each option.

Conclusion: A disciplined approach yields durable fit

Beyond rankings, a holistic comparison frame helps Indian students and parents identify programs that align with interests, strengths, financial realities, and long-term goals. The aim is not to chase the strongest name, but to map a path where education translates into meaningful skills, confident career choices, and sustainable growth.

Visible FAQ

FAQ 1: How important is a program’s ranking when assessing fit?

Rankings capture some aggregate indicators but may overlook curriculum design, learning opportunities, and career outcomes. Use rankings as one data point within a broader, criteria-driven comparison.

FAQ 2: What should I look for in internships or industry projects?

Look for structured internship programs, predefined project partners, and evidence of student work that leads to portfolios or tangible deliverables. Availability of repeatable pipelines with reputable employers matters.

FAQ 3: How can families manage the cost aspect effectively?

Compare total cost of attendance over the typical duration, not just annual tuition. Consider scholarships, living costs, transportation, and potential debt loads. Seek transparent financial aid policies and clear timelines for award decisions.

FAQ 4: Is campus culture a decisive factor in program success?

Yes. A supportive environment enhances learning and persistence. Prioritize indicators like mentoring quality, student support services, and inclusive practices that match your needs.

FAQ 5: How should I validate a program’s career outcomes?

Review official placement reports, talk to alumni, and assess whether graduates enter your target fields. Look for consistency in roles, industry sectors, and geographic distribution post-graduation.

title: JET ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ 2026 ਕਟਆਫ PDF: ਕਾਲਜ, ਸੀਟ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਮਿਲਾਓ
description: JET ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਕਟਆਫ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਲਜ, ਕੋਰਸ, ਸੀਟ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਖਵੀਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਰਿਟ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
ਰਾਜਸਥਾਨ JET 2026 ਦੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਕਟਆਫ ਕਾਲਜ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਬਣੀ ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ। ਸਾਰੇ ਬਿਨੈਕਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਇੱਕੋ ਅੰਕ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ। ਆਪਣੇ ਮੈਰਿਟ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸੰਸਥਾ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ, ਸੀਟ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਅਤੇ ਰਾਖਵੀਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਦਾ ਕਾਲਮ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਕਤਾਰ ਦਾ ਅੰਕ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀ ਸੰਭਾਵਨਾ ਬਾਰੇ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਧਾਰਨਾ ਦੇ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਸਹੀ PDF ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ JET ਕਟਆਫ ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਕਾਊਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਅਤੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪੜਾਅ ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਲਿੰਕ ਹਨ। ਦੂਜੇ ਪੜਾਅ ਦੀ PDF ਚੁਣੋ। ਇਸ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੂਜਾ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਅਤੇ ਛਪੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ 28 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦਰਜ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਸਵਾਮੀ ਕੇਸ਼ਵਾਨੰਦ ਰਾਜਸਥਾਨ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ, ਬੀਕਾਨੇਰ ਨੇ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕਟਆਫ ਪੰਨਾ

ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

  1. ਕਾਲਜ ਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਹੇਠਾਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਲੱਭੋ। ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ, ਵਣ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਗਬਾਨੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਐਂਟਰੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਨ।

  2. ਸੀਟ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਵੇਖੋ। ਜਿੱਥੇ Normal ਅਤੇ Payment Seat ਦੀਆਂ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਹਨ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਕ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਕਟਆਫ ਸਾਰਣੀ ਫੀਸਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

  3. ਆਪਣੀ ਕਾਊਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਰਜ ਰਾਖਵੀਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਨਿਯਮਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਹੀ ਕਾਲਮ ਚੁਣੋ।

  4. ਉਸ ਕਤਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਮ ਦੇ ਮਿਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਥਾਂ ਦੇ ਮੈਰਿਟ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਡੈਸ਼ ਜਾਂ ਖਾਲੀ ਖਾਨੇ ਨੂੰ ਜ਼ੀਰੋ ਅੰਕ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਹੇਠਾਂ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕਤਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਮ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਕਿਉਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਹਨ। ਇਸ ਹਿੱਸੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਪੂਰੀ PDF ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਵਾਮੀ ਕੇਸ਼ਵਾਨੰਦ ਰਾਜਸਥਾਨ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ, ਬੀਕਾਨੇਰ: ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਕਟਆਫ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ; ਛਪੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ 28 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਸੰਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿਖਾਈਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ।

ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਕਟਆਫ PDF ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕਟਆਫ ਅੰਕ ਨਹੀਂ

Intake, Admitted, Allotted ਅਤੇ Remaining Vacancy ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਵਾਰ ਮੈਰਿਟ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਕਾਲਮ ਹਨ। ਖਾਲੀ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਇਸ ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਦੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਅਗਲੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਸੀਟ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਆਪਣੀ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਅਤੇ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰਸ਼ੁਦਾ ਕਾਰਵਾਈਆਂ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਲੌਗਇਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਰਾਊਂਡ ਅਤੇ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਸਮਝੋ

ਇਹ ਦੂਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦਾ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ, ਤੀਜੇ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਦੀ ਕਟਆਫ ਦੀ ਭਵਿੱਖਬਾਣੀ ਨਹੀਂ। PDF ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਹੋਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਇਹ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ ਕਿ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਵਾਲੀ ਸੀਟ ਸਵੀਕਾਰ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਅਜੇ ਵੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੀ ਹੈ। ਅਗਲੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੇਖੋ। ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਨਾਲ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਅਤੇ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਗਾਈਡ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੋਰਟਲ · ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਅਤੇ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ ਗਾਈਡ

title: DU Fee Hike 2025-26: दिल्ली यूनिवर्सिटी में पढ़ाई हुई महंगी, 6 महीने में दूसरी बार बढ़ी फीस
description: DU Fee Hike: दिल्ली यूनिवर्सिटी ने 6 महीने में दूसरी बार फीस बढ़ाई। UG और PG कोर्सेज़ की नई फीस कितनी हुई, पूरी जानकारी यहाँ पढ़ें।
content:
दिल्ली यूनिवर्सिटी प्रशासन के अनुसार, यह फैसला इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर डेवलपमेंट, डिजिटल सुविधाओं में सुधार, स्मार्ट क्लासरूम, लैब अपग्रेडेशन और प्रशासनिक खर्चों को ध्यान में रखते हुए लिया गया है। विश्वविद्यालय का कहना है कि गुणवत्तापूर्ण शिक्षा और बेहतर सुविधाओं के लिए फीस बढ़ाना जरूरी हो गया था।

हालांकि, छात्र संगठनों और अभिभावकों का मानना है कि लगातार बढ़ती फीस से मिडिल क्लास और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्ग के छात्रों के लिए DU में पढ़ाई करना मुश्किल होता जा रहा है।

DU Fee Hike: अब कितनी देनी होगी फीस?

 

कोर्स पहले की फीस (₹) नई फीस (₹)
UG (BA, BSc, BCom) 8,000 – 10,000 12,000 – 15,000
PG Courses 12,000 – 15,000 18,000 – 25,000
Professional Courses 15,000 – 20,000 25,000+

नोट: फीस कॉलेज, कोर्स और कैटेगरी के अनुसार अलग-अलग हो सकती है।

छात्रों पर क्या पड़ेगा असर?

  • पढ़ाई का कुल खर्च बढ़ेगा
  • कई छात्रों को एजुकेशन लोन लेना पड़ सकता है
  • ड्रॉपआउट का खतरा बढ़ सकता है
  • DU की “कम खर्च में बेहतर शिक्षा” वाली पहचान पर असर

छात्र संगठनों ने इस फैसले के खिलाफ प्रदर्शन और ज्ञापन देने की तैयारी शुरू कर दी है। उनका कहना है कि शिक्षा को व्यापार नहीं बनाया जाना चाहिए।

आगे क्या?

अगर आने वाले समय में फीस में और बढ़ोतरी होती है, तो यह DU में एडमिशन लेने वाले छात्रों के फैसलों को प्रभावित कर सकता है। ऐसे में छात्रों को स्कॉलरशिप, फीस रियायत और सरकारी योजनाओं की जानकारी रखना जरूरी हो जाता है।

title: NEET UG 2026 State Counselling: How to Read Seat-Matrix Codes
description: Learn how to read NEET UG 2026 state counselling seat-matrix codes for quota, category, eligibility and safer choice filling.
content:
NEET UG 2026 state counselling seat matrix codes are not national shorthand. Read each row through the relevant state authority’s own code legend, then match the quota, category, seat type and document conditions before adding it to your choices. A familiar abbreviation can still mean something different in another state.

The National Testing Agency handles NEET UG exam notices, not state seat allocation rules. You can check exam-related updates on the official NEET UG website, but the state counselling authority’s notice, matrix and instructions decide how its codes work.

How should you read the NEET UG 2026 state counselling seat matrix?

Start with the row details rather than the college name. The exact meanings cannot be standardised across states, and no verified 2026 state matrix or legend was supplied here. Treat the following as a reading framework, not as a 2026 code dictionary.

Code areaWhat the row may describeWhat this row can blockDocument risk
QuotaState, institutional or another seat poolApplicants outside the permitted poolDomicile or other state condition may apply
CategoryOpen or a state-recognised reserved categoryApplicants using the wrong category routeCertificate format, validity and issuing authority
Seat typeGovernment, private, minority or management seatApplicants unable to accept its conditionsFee, bond, service or reporting terms
CourseMBBS, BDS or another programmeApplicants selecting the wrong programmeCourse eligibility and reporting requirements

What can a code mistake do during choice filling?

A technically accepted choice is not automatically a safely admissible choice. For example, “GOV, SQ, OBC” is only a hypothetical illustration, not a standard national code. “SQ” might mean state quota in one portal, while “OBC” may follow a different state list or certificate rule elsewhere.

If the portal accepts the row but your documents fail later verification, the result can depend on that state’s rules. It may affect that choice, your reporting, or the seat process itself. Do not assume every portal treats an invalid preference in the same way.

  1. Save the state authority’s matrix and code legend.
  2. Match quota wording with domicile evidence.
  3. Check the category list and certificate format.
  4. Separate government and private options after checking fees and bonds.
  5. Arrange only choices you can defend with documents.

How should you order choices safely?

Use the NEET UG 2026 state counselling seat matrix to filter eligible options, not to predict allotment. Put a genuinely acceptable college above a tempting row that depends on paperwork you cannot prove. Before locking, compare the final list with the state notice and keep a record of the version used.

For exam-level context, see the NEET UG exam guide. The state authority remains the decision-maker for its counselling conditions.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਤੀ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ (ਕੋਡ 405) ਪੇਪਰ 18 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਵਿੱਤੀ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ
ਜਮਾਤ 10: Introduction to Financial Markets40518 ਫਰਵਰੀ 202710:30 - 12:302 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 4: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 4 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 405 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿੱਤੀ ਬਾਜ਼ਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣ-ਪਛਾਣ (405) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 18 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Language and Literature (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 8 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: Engineering Sciences vs Core Disciplines: Evaluating Career Outcomes and PSU Eligibility via GATE Two-Paper Options
description: A comprehensive comparative guide analyzing Engineering Sciences (XE) against core engineering disciplines for GATE candidates, covering postgraduate admissions, PSU recruitment eligibility, and strategic benefits of the two-paper combination.
content:
Choosing between core engineering branches such as Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, or Computer Science and multi-disciplinary papers like Engineering Sciences (XE) represents a vital decision for Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) aspirants. With the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering allowing candidates to appear for two test papers from approved combination lists, students often wonder whether opting for Engineering Sciences offers a tactical advantage for postgraduate admissions and Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) recruitment or if sticking exclusively to a core branch remains the safer path.

Understanding the Core Discipline and Engineering Sciences (XE) Structure

Core engineering disciplines focus comprehensively on traditional engineering syllabi designed to align directly with single-discipline undergraduate curriculums. In contrast, the Engineering Sciences (XE) paper is structured modularly. Candidates appearing for Engineering Sciences must answer Section A (Engineering Mathematics) and choose any two optional sections from the following list:

  • Section B: Fluid Mechanics
  • Section C: Materials Science
  • Section D: Solid Mechanics
  • Section E: Thermodynamics
  • Section F: Polymer Science and Engineering
  • Section G: Food Technology
  • Section H: Atmospheric and Oceanic Sciences

This modular flexibility allows students to focus on subjects where they possess maximum academic strength, frequently yielding higher qualifying scores compared to extensive single-discipline core papers.

Postgraduate Admissions and Academic Career Outcomes

Higher education opportunities via GATE differ noticeably between core disciplines and Engineering Sciences:

  • Master of Technology (M.Tech) Admissions: Leading Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs), National Institutes of Technology (NITs), and Indian Institute of Science (IISc) accept Engineering Sciences (XE) scores for interdisciplinary and specialized M.Tech programs. These include Materials Engineering, Computational Mechanics, Nanotechnology, Industrial Metallurgy, Aerodynamics, and Thermal Engineering.
  • Higher Cut-off Flexibility: Because XE candidates select two specialized subjects alongside Engineering Mathematics, many students secure higher percentile scores. These scores are recognized on par with core papers for specific specialized master's programs across premier institutions.
  • Core Discipline Scope: Core papers (such as ME, CE, EE, CSE) remain mandatory for admission into traditional core specialization degrees. A student seeking an M.Tech in Design Engineering or Structural Engineering usually requires a valid score in the corresponding primary core paper.

PSU Recruitment Eligibility: The Core Paper Dominance

While Engineering Sciences provides exceptional opportunities for higher education and research careers, its standing in Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) recruitment differs significantly from core papers.

  • Direct PSU Recruitment: Major PSUs such as BHEL, NTPC, IOCL, ONGC, HPCL, and GAIL recruit executive trainees primarily through traditional core discipline codes (ME, CE, EE, EC, CS). Most official PSU notifications specifically list core paper codes as mandatory eligibility requirements.
  • Limited PSU Acceptance for XE: Engineering Sciences (XE) scores are rarely listed as eligible criteria for direct engineering trainee positions in premier PSUs, unless the specific job post calls for specialized roles like Materials Specialist or Food Technologist.
  • Strategic Recommendation: Candidates whose primary objective is securing a job in a public sector enterprise must register their primary core paper as their main GATE paper to maintain baseline eligibility for PSU recruitment notifications.

Maximizing Strategy with the GATE Two-Paper Option

The introduction of the two-paper combination strategy by GATE organizing authorities has resolved the dilemma between choosing core disciplines or Engineering Sciences. Candidates can appear for both papers, provided the chosen pair is permitted in the official GATE notification.

Benefits of Writing Core Paper + XE as Second Paper

  1. Safety Net for Postgraduation: If a candidate experiences a difficult core paper on exam day, a strong performance in the XE paper can secure admission to top-tier M.Tech programs at premier institutes like IITs.
  2. Syllabus Overlap: Substantial syllabus overlap exists between core Mechanical, Civil, or Chemical branches and XE optional sections such as Fluid Mechanics, Solid Mechanics, and Thermodynamics. This allows candidates to prepare for both papers without doubling their study hours.
  3. Dual Career Outcomes: Writing the primary core paper preserves full eligibility for PSU recruitment, while writing the XE paper enhances top-tier academic admission opportunities.

Comparative Overview: Core Disciplines vs. Engineering Sciences (XE)

Evaluation MetricCore Engineering DisciplinesEngineering Sciences (XE)
Primary Target AudienceStudents pursuing core M.Tech or direct PSU jobsStudents aiming for specialized M.Tech, research, or higher percentile scores
Paper StructureFixed comprehensive syllabus across 100% core topicsMandatory Engineering Maths + Choice of any 2 optional subjects
PSU Recruitment ScopeHigh eligibility across major Maharatna/Navratna PSUsExtremely restricted eligibility for direct PSU hiring
IIT/IISc Admission ScopeTraditional M.Tech core specializationsSpecialized, interdisciplinary M.Tech and Ph.D. programs
Scoring PotentialModerate to high competition across broad syllabiHigh scoring potential due to focused subject selection

Making an Informed Decision

To determine the optimal strategy, candidates should evaluate their long-term career priorities. If your sole goal is immediate entry into a Public Sector Undertaking, focusing heavily on your primary core discipline paper is essential. However, if your objective includes pursuing advanced research, interdisciplinary master's degrees at premier institutions, or maximizing your overall qualifying probability, incorporating Engineering Sciences (XE) as a secondary paper offers a highly strategic advantage. Candidates should always verify the latest approved two-paper combination matrix and individual institutional admission criteria on official GATE and university portals before finalizing their application choices.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I get a PSU job using a GATE Engineering Sciences (XE) score?

Most major PSUs require valid GATE scores in core disciplines like Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil Engineering. Direct recruitment using an Engineering Sciences (XE) paper score is rare and generally limited to specialized non-standard job roles.

Are XE candidates eligible for M.Tech programs at IITs?

Yes, premier institutes including IITs and IISc accept GATE XE scores for many specialized and interdisciplinary M.Tech programs such as Materials Science, Nanotechnology, Fluid Mechanics, and Aerospace Engineering.

Can I choose any two subjects in the GATE XE paper during the exam?

Yes, candidates choose two optional sections out of the available XE subject choices in the examination hall alongside the compulsory Engineering Mathematics section.

Does preparing for XE require a completely separate study plan from core papers?

Not necessarily. Core branches like Mechanical or Chemical Engineering share significant syllabus overlap with XE sections like Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics, and Solid Mechanics, allowing simultaneous preparation.

description: 10ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (குறியீடு 408) தேர்வு 25 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 12:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (குறியீடு 808) தேர்வு 29 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.

10ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (குறியீடு 408) தேர்வு 25 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 12:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (குறியீடு 808) தேர்வு 29 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.

2026 நவம்பர் 6 தேதியிட்ட CBSE முதன்மைத் தேர்வு அட்டவணையில் இந்த விவரங்கள் உள்ளன. இது தேர்வு நடைபெறும் நேரத்தைக் காட்டும் ஆவணம்; மதிப்பெண் சான்றிதழ் அல்ல. CBSE அதிகாரப்பூர்வத் தேர்வு அட்டவணை

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 5: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 11: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 5, 11 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 408, 808 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (408) தேர்வுத் தேதி 25 பிப்ரவரி 2027. ஆங்கில மொழி மற்றும் இலக்கியம் (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன. 12ஆம் வகுப்பு வேளாண்மை (808) தேர்வுத் தேதி 29 மார்ச் 2027. English Core (301) தேர்வுத் தேதி 5 மார்ச் 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 24 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

செய்முறைத் தேர்வுக்கு வேறு தேதி இருக்கலாம்

இந்த வரி வாரியம் நடத்தும் தேர்வுக்குரியது. செய்முறை, செயல்திறன் மதிப்பீடு, திட்டப்பணி அல்லது அகமதிப்பீடு இருந்தால் அதன் தேதியையும் தேவையான பொருட்களையும் பள்ளியிடம் கேட்டுத் தெரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.
