title: AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Seat Allotment 2026 Issued: Mandatory Document Verification List, Self-Reporting Portal, and Admission Formalities
description: AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Seat Allotment 2026 is published. Read the complete guide on online self-reporting, required physical verification documents, and college joining procedures.
content:
AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Seat Allotment 2026 Overview

The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) has officially released the AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Seat Allotment results for candidates seeking admission into Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Food Technology, and Agriculture courses across Andhra Pradesh. Candidates who participated in the web counseling phase can now check their seat allotment status through the official portal.

Securing a provisional seat is only the preliminary step in the admissions cycle. To retain the allocated seat, applicants must complete two critical steps: online self-reporting through the official portal and physical reporting at the designated college within the stipulated window. Failure to execute either step within the given timeframe results in the automatic cancellation of the allocated seat.

How to Access the AP EAMCET BiPC Seat Allotment Letter

Candidates can view and download their allotment order by following the step-by-step procedure below:

  • Visit the official Andhra Pradesh admissions portal (eapcet-sche.aptonline.in or cap.apcfss.in).
  • Click on the AP EAPCET / EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Seat Allotment Result link.
  • Enter your Hall Ticket Number and Date of Birth to log into the portal.
  • View the provisional allotment status displayed on the dashboard.
  • Download the seat allotment letter and print multiple copies for future reference.

Mandatory Document Verification List for Physical Reporting

When visiting the allocated institution for physical document verification, candidates must submit both original certificates and two sets of self-attested photocopies. Keep the following documents arranged in the specified order:

  • AP EAMCET BiPC Rank Card and Hall Ticket
  • AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 1 Provisional Seat Allotment Letter
  • Self-Reporting Confirmation Receipt
  • SSC or equivalent Class 10 Marks Memo (for date of birth verification)
  • Intermediate / Class 12 Marks Memo and Pass Certificate
  • Transfer Certificate (TC) and Conduct Certificate from the last attended institution
  • Study Certificates from Class 6 to Intermediate
  • Integrated Community Certificate (Caste Certificate) for BC/SC/ST candidates, if applicable
  • Income Certificate or White Ration Card issued on or after the prescribed date for fee reimbursement eligibility
  • Residence Certificate or Local Status Certificate (if applicable)
  • EWS Certificate issued by the competent authority for the current financial year (if applicable)
  • Aadhaar Card copy of the candidate
  • Passport-size photographs (minimum 6 copies)

Online Self-Reporting Portal and Physical College Joining Formalities

The admission completion process involves two distinct stages: virtual acceptance and physical validation.

Step 1: Online Self-Reporting

After downloading the allotment letter, candidates must log into the applicant portal and click on the Self-Reporting option. Upon clicking, a unique self-reporting joining report is generated. Completing this online step confirms your acceptance of the seat without surrendering original certificates immediately.

Step 2: Physical Reporting at Allocated College

Candidates must physically report to the allotted college along with all original documents, self-attested copies, and the downloaded self-reporting acknowledgment receipt. College authorities will verify the original documents against the online records. Once verified, the admission is formally confirmed in the university master database.

Important Points for Candidates and Parents

Parents and candidates should keep the following guidelines in mind to avoid common admission errors:

  • Reporting Deadlines: Ensure physical reporting is completed before the deadline published on the official notification. Late arrivals are strictly not entertained.
  • Fee Reimbursement (Jagananna Vidya Deevena): Eligible candidates claiming tuition fee reimbursement must ensure their Income Certificate and Ration Card details are updated during the verification process.
  • Participating in Subsequent Rounds: Candidates wishing to opt for a better college option in Phase 2 can retain their Phase 1 seat by completing the self-reporting procedure now. If you do not self-report, your Phase 1 seat will be forfeited immediately.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happens if I complete online self-reporting but fail to report to the college physically?

Online self-reporting alone does not guarantee your seat. If you fail to physically report to the allocated college within the given deadline with your original documents, your provisional seat allotment will be canceled automatically.

Can I participate in AP EAMCET BiPC Phase 2 counseling if I accept the Phase 1 seat?

Yes. You can accept the Phase 1 seat by completing both online self-reporting and physical college reporting. If you get a higher-preference seat in Phase 2, your Phase 1 seat will automatically be canceled and transferred to the new allotment.

Are original certificates retained by the college during physical reporting?

Colleges verify original certificates for authenticity. Depending on state government regulations, colleges may hold certain original certificates temporarily until the completion of enrollment verification, while returning others after instant verification.

Where can I check my official AP EAMCET BiPC allotment result?

The seat allotment results can be checked exclusively on the official Andhra Pradesh admissions web portals (cap.apcfss.in or eapcet-sche.aptonline.in).

title: CLAT 2027 Form: Documents, Fees and Final Submission Checklist
description: Prepare the right documents, check the application fee and confirm final submission before the CLAT 2027 deadline. Registration alone does not complete your application.
content:
Have your documents ready before starting the CLAT 2027 form. Use your own accessible mobile number and email address, and keep your academic and category records beside you. A registered account is only the starting point; the application must also be completed, paid for and submitted.

Keep the two November deadlines separate

New UG and PG applications close on 7 November 2026 at 11:59 pm. The separate correction facility ends on 10 November at 11:59 pm. That later date does not extend the time available to submit a new application.

The Consortium's 3 November notice explains the permitted corrections and test-location changes.

Consortium of National Law Universities, notice dated 3 November 2026. Read the official correction notice.

Gather the documents your category requires

The official UG instructions list a recent front-facing photograph with a plain background and your signature. They also list category certificates for SC, ST or OBC applicants, and relevant certificates for PwD or BPL claims where applicable.

Keep readable copies available and follow the upload controls in the current portal. Avoid reducing a certificate until its name, issuing authority or details become unreadable. Check the UG and PG eligibility rules before choosing a programme.

Budget for the application, not just registration

Applicant category

Application fee

General or OBC

₹4,000

SC, ST, BPL or PwD

₹3,500

The Consortium lists previous years' question papers separately at ₹500. Bank transaction charges are additional and appear at the payment gateway. Application fees are non-refundable and non-adjustable.

Finish with a submission check

Register on the official CLAT portal, validate your mobile number using the OTP and sign in. Enter names as they appear in your records, complete the required fields and uploads, then review the form before payment and final submission.

Afterwards, inspect the account's submission and payment status. Save a copy of the completed application and transaction record. If something needs correction, follow the current correction notice and steps; do not assume an older instruction about locked fields describes the present facility.

Give yourself time to resolve a failed upload or payment. Keep your password and OTP private, even when asking someone to help you complete the form.

title: CUCET 2027 స్కాలర్‌షిప్‌లు: బడ్జెట్‌కు ముందు దశ, కోర్సు చూసుకోండి
description: ఒకే CUCET స్కోరుకు దశ, కోర్సును బట్టి స్కాలర్‌షిప్ మారవచ్చు. 2027 సాధారణ శ్లాబులు, పంజాబ్ ప్రత్యేక మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ కోర్సుల మినహాయింపులు తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
CUCET 2027లో 80 మార్కులు సాధారణ దశ I పట్టికలో 50% స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పరిధిలోకి వస్తాయి; దశ IIలో 40%. కొన్ని ప్రత్యేక కోర్సులకు సొంత రేట్లు ఉన్నాయి. కుటుంబం చెల్లించాల్సిన మొత్తం లెక్కించే ముందు స్కోరును సరైన దశ, క్యాంపస్, పూర్తి కోర్సు పేరుతో పోల్చండి.

సాధారణ స్కాలర్‌షిప్ రేట్లు దశను బట్టి మారతాయి

చండీగఢ్ విశ్వవిద్యాలయ అధికారిక పోర్టల్ దశ Iను అక్టోబర్ 2026 నుంచి మే 2027 వరకు, దశ IIను జూన్ 2027 నుంచి ప్రవేశాలు ముగిసే వరకు చూపుతోంది. దశ Iలో దరఖాస్తు ఎంపిక ఉంది; దశ II మూసివేసినట్లు ఉంది. ఇవి విస్తృత కాలవ్యవధులు మాత్రమే; రోజువారీ పరీక్షల పట్టిక లేదా ఖచ్చితమైన చివరి దరఖాస్తు తేదీ కాదు.

కింద పోలికలో ప్రచురించిన స్కోరు హద్దులనే ఇచ్చాం. 30 నుంచి 39.99 మార్కుల పరిధికి పోర్టల్ శాతం స్కాలర్‌షిప్‌ను చెప్పకుండా అర్హులు అని పేర్కొంది. సరిహద్దుకు దగ్గరగా ఉన్న స్కోరును విశ్వవిద్యాలయ నిర్ధారణ లేకుండా పై శ్లాబుకు రౌండ్ చేయవద్దు.

కొన్ని పంజాబ్ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ కోర్సులకు ప్రత్యేక శ్లాబు

పంజాబ్ క్యాంపస్‌లో MBA (FinTech & AI), MBA (Banking, Financial Services & Insurance), MBA (Strategic-HR), పేర్కొన్న B.Com. Applied Finance and Analytics లేదా Forensic Accounting and Fraud Investigation కోర్సులకు వేరే రేట్లు ఉన్నాయి. వీటిలో 90.01-100, 80-90 రెండింటికీ 40%; చిత్రంలోని తదుపరి నాలుగు దిగువ శ్లాబులకు వరుసగా 30%, 20%, 15%, 10%. MBA (Applied Finance and Analytics) with PwC కోసం విశ్వవిద్యాలయ వెబ్‌సైట్ చూడాలని విడిగా సూచిస్తోంది. సాధారణ 100% ప్రకటనను అన్ని మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ కోర్సులకు వర్తింపజేయవద్దు.

మైగ్రేషన్ ద్వారా వచ్చే విద్యార్థులకు స్కాలర్‌షిప్ వర్తించదని పోర్టల్ చెబుతోంది. ఉత్తరప్రదేశ్ క్యాంపస్ ప్రత్యేక కోర్సులకు మరో విభాగం ఉంది; పంజాబ్ మినహాయింపులను ఆ క్యాంపస్‌కు పూర్తి నియమాలుగా భావించవద్దు. ఫీజు అంచనాను అంగీకరించే ముందు ఖచ్చితమైన కోర్సు, క్యాంపస్ తనిఖీ చేయండి.

చండీగఢ్ విశ్వవిద్యాలయ CUCET 2027 పోర్టల్: దశల రేట్లు, పంజాబ్ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ మినహాయింపులు, మైగ్రేషన్ విద్యార్థుల అనర్హత. ఈ పేజీలో ప్రత్యేక జారీ తేదీ లేదు.

అధికారిక CUCET 2027 స్కాలర్‌షిప్ పోర్టల్

ఫీజు బడ్జెట్‌కు ముందు లబ్ధిని నిర్ధారించుకోండి

స్కోర్‌కార్డు ఉంచుకుని ప్రవేశాల విభాగం ద్వారా ఆఫర్ లేదా ఫీజు వివరాల్లో వర్తించే స్కాలర్‌షిప్ నిర్ధారించుకోండి. ఏ ఫీజులు కవర్ అవుతాయి, ఎంతకాలం వర్తిస్తుంది, కొనసాగింపునకు ఏ షరతులు ఉన్నాయో అడగండి. స్కోరు పట్టికలో శాతం ఉందంటే ట్యూషన్, హాస్టల్, భోజనం సహా అన్ని ఛార్జీలు మాఫీ అని కాదు. వివరాలు స్పష్టమయ్యేవరకు మొత్తం కలిపిన ఖర్చు నుంచి ఆ శాతాన్ని తీసివేయవద్దు.

title: UP NEET PG 2025 Round-3 Counselling Dates Revised Again; Check Details
description: Check revised UP NEET PG 2025 Round-3 counselling dates, registration, seat allotment, and document verification details. Official portal: upneetpg.gov.in
content:
The Directorate of Medical Education and Training has once again revised the dates of UP NEET PG 2025 Round-3 Counselling. Candidates seeking admission to MD/MS/Diploma courses in Uttar Pradesh should keep themselves updated on the revised schedule along with the instructions mentioned for smooth and error-free counselling.

Revised Counselling Schedule

The UP NEET PG 2025 Round-3 counselling will be conducted as per the revised dates announced by the authorities. Candidates should carefully note the new schedule to avoid missing any important deadlines:

Counselling Activity Revised Dates
Online Registration & Choice Filling 12 February – 14 February 2026
Seat Allotment Result 16 February 2026
Document Verification & Reporting 17 – 18 February 2026
Last Date to Accept/Reject Seat 19 February 2026

Candidates are advised to complete all activities within the given time frame to avoid cancellation of their candidature.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  1. Online registration is required via the official UP NEET PG counseling portal.
  2. Verify that all of your academic and personal information matches your NEET PG 2025 credentials.
  3. Upload the necessary files, such as your ID proof, MBBS marksheets, internship completion certificate, and NEET PG scorecard.
  4. To increase your chances of getting a seat, carefully consider your preferences for courses and colleges.
  5. Regularly check the official portal for any new announcements or updates.

Conclusion

The revised dates for UP NEET PG 2025 Round-3 counselling emphasize the importance of timely registration and document verification. Candidates should ensure that all counselling steps are completed promptly to secure admission to their preferred postgraduate medical courses.

title: CGBSE Class 12 Time Table 2027: Official PDF Still Awaited
description: CGBSE’s notice board carries 2027 form instructions, but no confirmed Class 12 subject-wise timetable is listed. Use the board’s official notice section and keep revision flexible.
content:
The CGBSE Class 12 subject-wise timetable for 2027 is not listed among the current notices on cgbse.nic.in. Students should wait for the Higher Secondary main-examination schedule before treating any proposed paper date as final. A November release forecast is not a confirmed board announcement.

Look under सूचना पटल, not the result links

The Chhattisgarh board homepage separates notices from results and admit cards. In the notice section, look for a title identifying the 2027 Higher Secondary main-examination timetable. A Class 10 schedule, D.El.Ed timetable or second-main/opportunity examination notice serves a different group of candidates.

The board currently links 2027 private-candidate form instructions and a 2026-27 teaching and examination plan. It also retains the revised Higher Secondary main-examination timetable for 2026. None of those titles should be treated as a released subject-wise Class 12 timetable for 2027.

Build a subject checklist before the PDF arrives

Write down the subjects recorded by your school, including languages and any additional subject. Ask your teacher about a mismatch between your class records and the examination form. Resolving that now is more useful than copying an expected timetable from an unofficial graphic.

Once the PDF appears, match every chosen subject to its code and examination date. Check the session and all notes below the schedule. Keep the full file, because a screenshot of one row can omit a practical-examination instruction or an exception.

Plan revision without inventing an exam order

Give each subject regular practice time and review the mistakes from your latest school assessments. Keep a separate list of chapters needing teacher help. Adjust that plan around the actual paper gaps after the board issues its schedule.

If your school shares dates, ask for the original board document or official link. A timetable with the right class but the wrong year can look convincing. For practical assessments, confirm the applicable instructions with your school rather than deriving them from a theory-paper calendar.

When a revised timetable appears

Compare the revised PDF with your saved copy and change every affected reminder. Keep the revision notice with the timetable so that you can explain which version you are following. The board examination guide explains the difference between form notices, exam-cycle announcements and paper schedules.
author: Geethika Reddy

title: MP SI 2026: તમારી પરીક્ષા તારીખ, શિફ્ટ અને કેન્દ્ર એડમિટ કાર્ડમાં જુઓ
description: MPESB સુબેદાર અને સબ-ઇન્સ્પેક્ટર 2026 એડમિટ કાર્ડ ફોર્મની જરૂરી વિગતો, કેન્દ્રની તપાસ અને કાર્ડ ન મળે ત્યારે આગળ શું કરવું તે જાણો.
content:
MPESBએ સુબેદાર અને સબ-ઇન્સ્પેક્ટર ભરતી પરીક્ષા 2026નું એડમિટ કાર્ડ પેજ ઉપલબ્ધ કર્યું છે. તમારી MP SI પરીક્ષાની તારીખ શોધતા હો તો સત્તાવાર ફોર્મથી તમને ફાળવેલી વ્યવસ્થા જુઓ. ભરતીની સામાન્ય તારીખ તમારા વ્યક્તિગત એડમિટ કાર્ડનો વિકલ્પ નથી.

સત્તાવાર એડમિટ કાર્ડ ફોર્મ ખોલો

આ ત્રણ વિગતો તૈયાર રાખો

ફોર્મ અરજી નંબર, જન્મતારીખ અને અરજીમાં આપેલી વિગતોથી બનતો ચકાસણી કોડ પૂછે છે. અરજી નંબર વધુમાં વધુ 13 અંકોનો હોઈ શકે છે. જન્મતારીખ DD/MM/YYYY સ્વરૂપમાં ભરો.

કોડ માટે અરજીમાં નોંધાયેલા માતાના નામના પ્રથમ બે અક્ષર અને તમારા આધાર નંબરના છેલ્લા ચાર અંક જોડો. શરૂઆતના અક્ષર કે ઉપાધિ ધરાવતા નામનાં ઉદાહરણો ફોર્મની નીચે છે. નોંધાયેલું નામ સામાન્ય ઉપયોગના નામથી અલગ રીતે શરૂ થતું હોય તો તે વાંચો.

MPESB, ભોપાલ: સુબેદાર અને સબ-ઇન્સ્પેક્ટર ભરતી પરીક્ષા 2026નું જાહેર એડમિટ કાર્ડ ફોર્મ. સત્તાવાર એડમિટ કાર્ડ ફોર્મ ખોલો

મુસાફરી નક્કી કરતાં પહેલાં કાર્ડ વાંચો

  1. ફોર્મના શીર્ષકમાં સુબેદાર અને સબ-ઇન્સ્પેક્ટર ભરતી પરીક્ષા 2026 છે તેની ખાતરી કરો.

  2. તમારી અરજીની વિગતો ભરો અને પેજની સુરક્ષા ચકાસણી પૂરી કરો.

  3. Searchથી ઉપલબ્ધ કાર્ડ માહિતી મેળવો. ફાળવેલી તારીખ, શિફ્ટ, રિપોર્ટિંગ સૂચનાઓ અને કેન્દ્રનું પૂરું સરનામું વાંચો.

  4. કાર્ડ સાચવો અને તેની સૂચના મુજબ પ્રિન્ટ તથા દસ્તાવેજો તૈયાર કરો. માત્ર શહેર નહીં, ચોક્કસ કેન્દ્ર સુધીનો રસ્તો જુઓ.

કાર્ડ ખાનગી રાખો. તેમાંની ઓળખ વિગતો જાહેર ટિપ્પણી કે બિનસત્તાવાર ડાઉનલોડ સેવા સાથે વહેંચશો નહીં.

વિગતો ભરવા છતાં કાર્ડ ન મળે તો

પહેલાં સાચવેલી અરજી સાથે તમારી એન્ટ્રી સરખાવો. તારીખનું સ્વરૂપ અને નામના પ્રથમ બે અક્ષર તપાસીને ફરી પ્રયાસ કરો. ફોર્મ તપાસવા બીજા ઉમેદવારની વિગતો વાપરશો નહીં.

સમસ્યા રહે તો MPESB વેબસાઇટના સંપર્ક માધ્યમથી મદદ લો. ભૂલ અને ભરતી પરીક્ષા સ્પષ્ટ જણાવો. પછીની સત્તાવાર સૂચના વ્યવસ્થા બદલે તો તેને અનુસરો.

MPESBની સત્તાવાર વેબસાઇટ

ભરતી ચક્રની પૃષ્ઠભૂમિ માટે અમારી MP SI સમયપત્રક માર્ગદર્શિકા જુઓ. તમારી વ્યક્તિગત પરીક્ષા વ્યવસ્થા માટે એડમિટ કાર્ડ અને તાજી MPESB સૂચનાઓ અનુસરો.

title: UGC NET December 2026 Fee Payment Extended to 1 November: Who Can Use It
description: NTA has allowed already-submitted UGC NET forms one extra day for successful fee payment. Registration, form submission and image uploads remain closed.
content:
If you submitted your UGC NET December 2026 application but could not complete the fee payment, NTA has given you until 1 November 2026, 11:50 pm for a successful transaction. The extra day applies only to candidates whose online application forms were already submitted.

This does not reopen registration, form submission or image uploads. NTA's notice dated 1 November says those activities closed at 11:50 pm on 31 October. An unfinished draft should not be treated as an already-submitted form.

Which applicants can use the extra day?

The new NTA fee-payment notice is addressed to candidates who completed and submitted the application within the earlier timeline but did not complete payment. Check the status in your existing account before deciding your next step.

National Testing Agency, public notice dated 1 November 2026. Read the complete official fee-payment notice.

Complete payment and keep the confirmation page

Use the application link on the official UGC NET website to access your existing application. Review whether the form is submitted and whether payment is recorded as successful. If your submitted form still needs payment, complete the available payment process well before the 11:50 pm deadline.

NTA specifically asks candidates to download and retain the confirmation page generated after successful payment. Keep that page with your transaction reference. A debit message from your bank is useful evidence of a transaction, but check the application portal's confirmation rather than assuming the application process is complete from that message alone.

If the payment status remains unresolved, retain the transaction details and use the helpdesk information on the official website. Do not assume that a pending transaction gives you an automatic extension beyond the published cutoff.

What remains unchanged?

The notice leaves the other terms in the information bulletin and earlier public notices unchanged. It does not announce a new registration opportunity or a general reopening of application fields. Candidates looking ahead to amendments should refer separately to the UGC NET correction dates and field checks and any subsequent NTA notice.

Once your fee is confirmed and the confirmation page is saved, continue to monitor the official UGC NET website for the next application and examination updates.

title: CSAB 2026 After JoSAA: Which NIT Seats Still Make Sense?
description: A practical CSAB 2026 counselling guide to NIT branch choices, payment exposure, institute checks and safer decisions after JoSAA.
content:
CSAB 2026 counselling can give you another NIT option after JoSAA, but a vacant seat isn’t automatically worth taking. Rank a seat only when you can accept the branch, afford the full cost and live with the institute’s location and academic rules.

The current CSAB notice, seat matrix and fee instructions must control your decision. No 2026 dates, payment amounts, eligibility condition, refund rule or reporting deadline should be assumed from an older counselling cycle.

Which CSAB 2026 seat should you rank?

Start with the branch, not the NIT name. A preferred course at a newer institute may suit you better than an unwanted course at a famous NIT, but only after you check teaching resources, placement evidence and family costs.

ChoiceIt may make sense whenCheck before ranking
Preferred branch at a newer NITYou genuinely want the course and accept the campusAccreditation where relevant, curriculum, labs and latest official placement disclosure
Unwanted branch at a well-known NITYou can study and complete that subjectDo not depend on a future branch change
Distant or less established instituteTravel and living costs fit your budgetFirst-year hostel availability, mess charges and campus access
Seat chosen only to avoid losing a yearOnly if the course and costs remain acceptableFour-year fit and possible payment loss

Use this priority rule: acceptable branch first, total four-year cost next, institute fit after that. A better-known NIT doesn’t cancel a branch mismatch.

How do CSAB 2026 counselling payments work?

Separate the counselling or seat-acceptance payment from institute fees. The first is paid through the counselling process and may have its own refund or forfeiture conditions; tuition, hostel, mess and other charges are set or collected by the institute. The 2026 notice must state the amount and treatment of each component.

  1. Read the eligibility, participation and JoSAA-status clauses in the current CSAB notice.
  2. Check whether your case involves accepting, reporting to, withdrawing from or not taking a JoSAA seat.
  3. Compare the stated counselling payment with the institute’s first-year fee demand.
  4. Record the published allotment, payment and reporting deadlines. They vary by the 2026 schedule.
  5. Save receipts, locked choices and reporting documents.

Before locking choices, check the institute’s branch-change policy, minimum academic conditions and vacancy rules. Treat branch change as a possible exception, not your admission plan. Keep a confirmed alternative until the CSAB rules and payment consequences are clear.

Before you lock the next step, compare entrance exams against the options you have shortlisted.

title: JEE Main 2027 நேரடிப் புகைப்படப் பொருத்தம்: கேமரா, QR சோதனைகள்
description: JEE Main 2027 நேரடிப் புகைப்படம் பொருந்தாவிட்டால் NTA கூறும் கேமரா, QR, ஸ்கேன் படம் மற்றும் அடையாள விவரங்களைச் சரிபார்க்கவும்.
content:
JEE Main 2027 விண்ணப்பத்தில் நேரடியாக எடுக்கப்படும் புகைப்படம் பொருந்தவில்லை என்ற செய்தி வந்தால், கேமரா சிக்கலையும் அடையாள விவரச் சிக்கலையும் தனித்தனியாகப் பாருங்கள். NTA நேரடிப் புகைப்படத்துடன் அண்மையில் எடுத்த பாஸ்போர்ட் அளவுப் படத்தின் ஸ்கேன் பிரதியையும் கேட்கிறது. ஒரு கோப்பை மாற்றுவதால் மற்ற படிநிலை தானாகச் சரியாகாது. குறிப்பிட்ட மறுமுயற்சி சிக்கலைத் தீர்க்கும் என்று தகவல் கையேடு உறுதி அளிக்கவில்லை.

NTA வழிமுறையின்படி நேரடிப் படம் எடுக்கவும்

2027 தகவல் கையேடு விண்ணப்பிக்கும் சாதனத்தின் கேமராவை இயக்க அல்லது வெப்கேமை இணைக்கச் சொல்கிறது. வெள்ளைப் பின்னணியும் போதிய வெளிச்சமும் இருக்க வேண்டும். முகக்கவசமின்றி காதுகள் உட்பட முகம் தெளிவாகத் தெரிய வேண்டும். 80% முகம் தெரிய வேண்டும் என்பது NTA விதி.

சாதனம் வெப்கேமை ஆதரிக்கவில்லை என்றால் மொபைல் அல்லது டேப்லெட்டால் QR குறியீட்டை ஸ்கேன் செய்ய கையேடு அனுமதிக்கிறது. அதிகாரப்பூர்வ விண்ணப்ப நடைமுறையில் காட்டப்படும் விருப்பத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தவும். பொருத்தமான சாதனத்தில் உங்கள் படம் எடுப்பதற்கான வழி இது; வேறொருவரின் படத்தைப் பயன்படுத்த அனுமதி அல்ல.

NTA, JEE Main 2027 தகவல் கையேடு, அச்சுப் பக்கம் 9: அடையாளம் மற்றும் நேரடிப் புகைப்பட வழிமுறைகள். NTA வழிமுறையின்படி நேரடிப் படம் எடுக்கவும்

மறுமுயற்சிக்கு முன் உலாவிக்கு கேமரா அனுமதி உள்ளதா, முன்னோட்டத்தில் உங்கள் முகம் தெரிகிறதா என்பதைப் பாருங்கள். சாதனத்தை அசையாமல் வைத்து முகத்தை மறைக்கும் நிழலை அகற்றவும். இவை படத் தரத்துக்கு உதவலாம். அடையாள ஒப்பீடு ஏன் தோல்வியடைந்தது என்பதை நிரூபிக்கவோ ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளப்படும் என உறுதி தரவோ முடியாது.

ஸ்கேன் படத்தின் விதிகளைத் தனியாகப் பார்க்கவும்

ஸ்கேன் பாஸ்போர்ட் அளவுப் படம் அண்மையில் எடுத்த வண்ணப் படமாக இருக்க வேண்டும். வெள்ளைப் பின்னணியில் முகக்கவசமின்றி காதுகள் உட்பட 80% முகம் தெரிய வேண்டும். தெளிவான JPG அல்லது JPEG கோப்பு 10 kB முதல் 200 kB வரை இருக்க வேண்டும்.

பதிவேற்றவுள்ள உண்மையான கோப்பைப் பாருங்கள்; செய்திச் செயலியில் உள்ள சிறிய முன்னோட்டத்தை மட்டும் பார்க்க வேண்டாம். பலமுறை சுருக்கினால் அளவு சரியாக இருந்தாலும் முகம் மங்கலாம். பொருத்தச் சோதனையைத் தவிர்க்க முக அமைப்பை மாற்ற வேண்டாம். உங்கள் படத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி தள வழிமுறைகளைப் பின்பற்றவும்.

மீண்டும் முயல்வதற்கு முன் அடையாள விவரங்கள்

NTA-வின் அக்டோபர் 28 பதிவுச் சுற்றறிக்கை உங்கள் DigiLocker, JanParichay அல்லது e-Pramaan உள்நுழைவு விவரங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தச் சொல்கிறது. புதிய விவரங்கள் பெறப்படுவதற்காக விண்ணப்பத்திற்கு முன் DigiLocker Re-KYC செய்யவும் அறிவுறுத்துகிறது. பெயரும் பிறந்த தேதியும் 10ஆம் வகுப்புச் சான்றிதழ் அல்லது மதிப்பெண் பட்டியலுடன் பொருந்த வேண்டும்.

UIDAI வழிமுறைகளின்படி புகைப்படம் உள்ளிட்ட ஆதார் விவரங்களைப் புதுப்பித்து வைத்திருக்கவும் கையேடு தனியாக அறிவுறுத்துகிறது. Re-KYC செய்வதும் ஆதாரைப் புதுப்பிப்பதும் வெவ்வேறு நடவடிக்கைகள். Re-KYC பழைய ஆதார் படத்தை மாற்றும் அல்லது எல்லா நேரடிப் படப் பொருத்தச் சிக்கல்களையும் தீர்க்கும் என்று சுற்றறிக்கை கூறவில்லை.

அதே பிழை தொடர்ந்தால்

சரியான பிழைச் செய்தியையும் அது தோன்றும் படிநிலையையும் குறித்துக்கொள்ளவும். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ JEE Main தளத்தின் NTA உதவி மையத்தை அணுகவும். பதிவுச் சுற்றறிக்கையில் 011-40759000 மற்றும் jeemain@nta.ac.in உள்ளன. சிக்கலை விளக்கி அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழியில் கேட்டால் விண்ணப்பக் குறிப்பெண்ணை வழங்கவும். கடவுச்சொல் அல்லது OTP பகிர வேண்டாம்.

கேமரா முன்னோட்டம் சரியாக இருப்பது விண்ணப்பம் முடிந்துவிட்டதாகாது. சேமித்த படத்தையும் படிவத்தையும் பார்த்து தேவையான படிநிலைகளுக்குப் பிறகு கிடைக்கும் உறுதிப்படுத்தலை வைத்திருக்கவும். மீண்டும் கட்டணம் செலுத்தும் முன் புதிய விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் திருத்த வழிகாட்டியை படிக்கவும். புதிய படிவம் புகைப்படப் பிழைக்கான உறுதியான தீர்வு அல்ல.

title: JCECE NEET UG 2025 Round 3 Seat Allotment Today
description: The JCECE NEET UG 2025 Round 3 Seat Allotment will be released today. Check admission confirmation dates, document verification schedule, and next steps for Jharkhand NEET counselling.
content:
The NEET UG Round 3 Seat Allotment 2025 will be made public today on the Jharkhand Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board's (JCECEB) official website, jceceb.jharkhand.gov.in. Using their login information, candidates who registered for the Jharkhand NEET counseling can view their online allotment status.

Admission & Document Verification Dates

After the announcement of the Round 3 allotment, candidates allotted seats must confirm their admission and complete the document verification process within the specified schedule. The tentative dates are as follows:

Event Dates
Round 3 Seat Allotment Result November 1, 2025
Reporting & Document Verification November 2 – 5, 2025
Admission Confirmation November 5, 2025
Official website jceceb.jharkhand.gov.in.

After being assigned, candidates must present their NEET scorecard, allotment letter, Class 10 and 12 marksheets, domicile, and category certificates at the designated medical or dental college.

Important Instructions

  • The assigned seat may be cancelled if you don't show up within the allocated time.
  • To ensure admittance, candidates who are happy with their allocation should freeze their selection.
  • If there are additional rounds, those who were not given a spot may have to wait.

The official website, jceceb.jharkhand.gov.in, will have the most recent counseling schedule and final merit list.

title: NMAT 2026 സ്കോർകാർഡ്: 48 മണിക്കൂർ, ഓഡിറ്റ്, വീണ്ടും പരീക്ഷയെഴുതാനുള്ള ചട്ടങ്ങൾ
description: NMAT സ്കോർകാർഡ് ലഭിക്കുന്ന സമയം, സുരക്ഷാ ഓഡിറ്റ് ഒഴിവ്, മാർക്ക് പരിധി, വീണ്ടും പരീക്ഷയ്ക്കുള്ള ഇടവേള എന്നിവ അറിയാം. കോളേജ് അപേക്ഷ വേറെയാണ്.
content:
NMAT 2026 സ്കോർകാർഡ് നിങ്ങളുടെ പരീക്ഷാദിവസത്തെ ആശ്രയിച്ചാണ് ലഭിക്കുക; എല്ലാവർക്കും ഒരേ ഫലപ്രഖ്യാപന ദിവസം ഇല്ല. GMAC പ്രകാരം സാധാരണയായി പരീക്ഷ കഴിഞ്ഞ് 48 മണിക്കൂറിനുള്ളിൽ ഔദ്യോഗിക കാർഡ് ഡൗൺലോഡിന് ലഭിക്കും; ഇമെയിൽ അറിയിപ്പും വരും. അനൗദ്യോഗിക സ്കോർ പ്രിവ്യൂവിനെ പ്രവേശന വാഗ്ദാനമായി കരുതരുത്.

ഔദ്യോഗിക സൈറ്റിൽ 2026 പരീക്ഷാകാലം 2 നവംബർ മുതൽ 20 ഡിസംബർ വരെയാണ്. ബുക്ക് ചെയ്ത തീയതി അനുസരിച്ച് സ്കോർ വിലയിരുത്തലും കോളേജ് അപേക്ഷകളും ആസൂത്രണം ചെയ്യുക.

ഔദ്യോഗിക NMAT വെബ്സൈറ്റ്

സുരക്ഷാ ഓഡിറ്റിന് പ്രത്യേക സമയപരിധി

പരീക്ഷാ സുരക്ഷയുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട സംഭവങ്ങളുള്ള പരീക്ഷകൾ ഓഡിറ്റിന് വിധേയമാണ്; ഫലം 10 പ്രവൃത്തിദിവസങ്ങളിൽ പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കും. വൈകുന്നതിനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ അക്കൗണ്ടിലെ സന്ദേശവുമായി ബന്ധപ്പെടുത്തി മനസ്സിലാക്കുക. പരീക്ഷാ അപ്പോയിന്റ്മെന്റ് വിവരങ്ങൾ സൂക്ഷിച്ച് ആവശ്യമെങ്കിൽ ഔദ്യോഗിക സഹായസംഘത്തിൽനിന്ന് വിശദീകരണം തേടുക.

GMAC-ന്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക NMAT Exam Score നിർദേശങ്ങൾ. പേജിൽ പ്രസിദ്ധീകരണ തീയതിയില്ല; ഓഡിറ്റ് സംബന്ധിച്ച ഒഴിവും വായിക്കുക. യഥാർത്ഥ സ്കോർകാർഡ് ചട്ടം

വിഭാഗ സ്കോറിനൊപ്പം കോളേജ് നിബന്ധനയും നോക്കുക

കാർഡിൽ മൂന്ന് വിഭാഗങ്ങളുടെ സ്കെയിൽ ചെയ്ത സ്കോറുകളും ആകെ സ്കോറും ഉണ്ടാകും. ഓരോ വിഭാഗത്തിനും 12 മുതൽ 120 വരെ; ആകെ 36 മുതൽ 360 വരെ. മൂന്നിനും തുല്യ പ്രാധാന്യമുണ്ട്; സ്കോറിന് ഒരു വർഷം സാധുതയുണ്ട്.

സ്കോറിന്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക വിശദീകരണം

തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത ഓരോ കോഴ്സിന്റെയും ഔദ്യോഗിക പ്രവേശന പേജിൽ അംഗീകരിക്കുന്ന പരീക്ഷാചക്രം, അവസാന തീയതി, യോഗ്യത, ആകെ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വിഭാഗ സ്കോർ നിബന്ധനകൾ പരിശോധിക്കുക. പൊതുവായ കട്ട്ഓഫ് പ്രവചനം പ്രത്യേക ക്യാമ്പസിലെ യോഗ്യത ഉറപ്പിക്കില്ല. നിബന്ധനകളും ഔദ്യോഗിക ലിങ്കുകളും പട്ടികപ്പെടുത്തുക.

NMAT രജിസ്ട്രേഷനും ബിസിനസ് സ്കൂൾ അപേക്ഷയും വ്യത്യസ്ത നടപടികളാണ്. സ്കോർ അയച്ചാൽ കോളേജ് അപേക്ഷ പൂർത്തിയാകില്ല; സ്ഥാപനത്തിന്റെ നടപടിക്രമം വേറെ പാലിക്കണം.

വീണ്ടും പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് ഇടവേള നൽകുക

1 ജൂലൈ മുതൽ 30 ജൂൺ വരെയുള്ള ഒരു പരീക്ഷാചക്രത്തിൽ പരമാവധി മൂന്ന് ശ്രമങ്ങൾ അനുവദിക്കും. സാധുവായ സ്കോറുള്ള ശ്രമത്തിന് ശേഷം അടുത്ത ബുക്കിംഗ് ഉടൻ ചെയ്യാം; എന്നാൽ അടുത്ത പരീക്ഷ കുറഞ്ഞത് ഏഴു ദിവസം കഴിഞ്ഞായിരിക്കണം. പണമടയ്ക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് ലഭ്യമായ സമയവും കോളേജ് ചട്ടങ്ങളും നോക്കുക.

വീണ്ടും പരീക്ഷയെഴുതാനുള്ള ചട്ടങ്ങൾ

ആദ്യ അപേക്ഷ പൂർത്തിയായിട്ടില്ലെങ്കിൽ ഞങ്ങളുടെ NMAT രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ, സ്ലോട്ട് ബുക്കിംഗ് മാർഗദർശി ഉപയോഗിക്കുക. ശരിയായ പരീക്ഷാ അപ്പോയിന്റ്മെന്റ് ഉറപ്പാക്കിയ ശേഷം സ്കോർ സംബന്ധിച്ച പദ്ധതി തയ്യാറാക്കുക.

രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ, സ്ലോട്ട് ബുക്കിംഗ് മാർഗദർശി
author: Geethika Reddy

content:
10ஆம் வகுப்பு மலையாளம் (குறியீடு 012) தேர்வு 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு மலையாளம் (குறியீடு 112) தேர்வு 3 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.

2026 நவம்பர் 6 தேதியிட்ட CBSE முதன்மைத் தேர்வு அட்டவணையில் இந்த விவரங்கள் உள்ளன. CBSE அதிகாரப்பூர்வத் தேர்வு அட்டவணை

மலையாளம் தேர்வின் நேரமும் கால அளவும்

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 5: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 9: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 5, 9 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 012, 112 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு மலையாளம் (012) தேர்வுத் தேதி 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027. English Language and Literature (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன. 12ஆம் வகுப்பு மலையாளம் (112) தேர்வுத் தேதி 3 மார்ச் 2027. English Core (301) தேர்வுத் தேதி 5 மார்ச் 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 2 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்திற்குப் புறப்படும் முன்

தேர்வு தொடங்கும் நேரமும் மையத்துக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டிய நேரமும் வேறு. வருகை, நுழைவு, ஆவணங்கள் குறித்த விவரங்களுக்கு அனுமதிச் சீட்டைப் பாருங்கள். தேதி மாறியதாகத் தகவல் வந்தால் வாரியத்தின் திருத்தப்பட்ட அறிவிப்பில் வகுப்பு, குறியீடு, தேதி மூன்றையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

முழுத் தேர்வு அட்டவணை · தேர்வுக் கால அளவைப் புரிந்துகொள்ள

title: પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ NEET PG 2026: પસંદગીઓ પહેલાં ચકાસણી પૂર્ણ થયેલી યાદી જુઓ
description: WBMCCના કામચલાઉ કાર્યક્રમમાં પસંદગી ભરવાનું 30 ઓક્ટોબરે સાંજે 4 વાગ્યાથી છે. પહેલાં ચકાસેલી યાદી, બેઠકો અને રિપોર્ટિંગના ચોક્કસ દિવસ જુઓ.
content:
પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ NEET PG ઉમેદવારો કોલેજ અને વિષયની પસંદગી ભરતાં પહેલાં ચકાસણી પૂર્ણ થયેલા ઉમેદવારોની યાદીમાં પોતાની નોંધ તપાસે. WBMCCના કામચલાઉ રાઉન્ડ 1 કાર્યક્રમ પ્રમાણે યાદી અને બેઠકની વિગતો 30 ઓક્ટોબર 2026ના બપોરે 2 વાગ્યા પછી જાહેર થવાની છે. યાદીમાં સામેલ ચકાસાયેલા ઉમેદવારો માટે એ જ દિવસે સાંજે 4 વાગ્યાથી પસંદગીઓ ભરવા અને લૉક કરવાનો સમય નક્કી છે. માત્ર અરજી અને ફી ભરવાથી પસંદગીઓ આપવાની પાત્રતા નક્કી થતી નથી.

કામચલાઉ કાર્યક્રમના આગળના તબક્કા

14 ઓક્ટોબર 2026ના સત્તાવાર કાર્યક્રમમાં આ તારીખો છે. કાર્યક્રમ કામચલાઉ છે; WBMCC પછી ફેરફાર જાહેર કરે તો નવીનતમ સૂચનાઓ અનુસરો.

તબક્કો

નક્કી કરેલો સમય

ચકાસેલા ઉમેદવારોની યાદી અને રાઉન્ડ 1 બેઠકની વિગતો

30 ઓક્ટોબર, બપોરે 2 પછી

પસંદગીઓ ભરવી અને લૉક કરવી

30 ઓક્ટોબર સાંજે 4થી 1 નવેમ્બર મધરાત સુધી

રાઉન્ડ 1 ફાળવણીનું પરિણામ

4 નવેમ્બર, સાંજે 4 પછી

રિપોર્ટિંગ અને પ્રવેશ

5, 6, 7 અને 10 નવેમ્બર, સવારે 10થી સાંજે 4

પશ્ચિમ બંગાળ તબીબી શિક્ષણ નિયામક કચેરીનો 14 ઓક્ટોબર 2026નો કામચલાઉ રાઉન્ડ 1 કાર્યક્રમ. રિપોર્ટિંગ ફક્ત દર્શાવેલી તારીખોએ છે. મૂળ સત્તાવાર કાર્યક્રમ વાંચો (PDF).

ચકાસણી પૂરી થઈ છે તેની ખાતરી કરો

WBMCCના PG મેડિકલ કાઉન્સેલિંગ પેજ પર યોગ્ય વર્ષ અને રાઉન્ડની યાદી ખોલો. અરજીની વિગતોથી પોતાની નોંધ શોધીને ઓળખ અને પાત્રતા મેળવો. નામ ન મળે કે માહિતી અલગ હોય તો હાલની સત્તાવાર સૂચના અને સંપર્ક માર્ગનો ઉપયોગ કરો. સમસ્યા જણાવવા અરજી, ચુકવણીની રસીદ અને ચકાસણીની પહોંચ તૈયાર રાખો.

આ કાર્યક્રમમાં નોંધણી 28 ઓક્ટોબર સાંજે 6 સુધી અને ફી ચુકવણી એ જ દિવસની મધરાત સુધી હતી. પસંદગી ભરવાનું શરૂ થવું એટલે નવી નોંધણી ફરી ખૂલી એવું ન માનો. રાજ્ય ક્વોટા, ખાનગી મેનેજમેન્ટ ક્વોટા અને NRI બેઠકો માટેની પાત્રતા અને બેઠકની વિગતો અલગ તપાસો.

સ્વીકારી શકો એવી પસંદગીઓ જ ભરો

ઉપલબ્ધ બેઠકો સાથે કોલેજ, વિષય, ફી અને બોન્ડની શરતો વાંચો. પ્રાથમિકતાના ક્રમમાં પસંદગીઓ ભરી સમયસર લૉક કરો. જમા કરેલી યાદીનો પુરાવો રાખો. રેન્ક કે ગમતી કોલેજની પસંદગી માત્રથી ફાળવણીની ખાતરી મળતી નથી.

રિપોર્ટિંગના ચાર દિવસ છે, સતત છ દિવસ નહીં

5થી 10 નવેમ્બર વચ્ચે દરરોજ રિપોર્ટિંગ છે એમ માની મુસાફરી ન ગોઠવો. કાર્યક્રમમાં 5, 6, 7 અને 10 નવેમ્બર, સવારે 10થી સાંજે 4 આપ્યું છે. ફાળવણી પછી યોગ્ય રિપોર્ટિંગ સ્થળ, મૂળ દસ્તાવેજો, ફી અને બોન્ડ તપાસો. ખાનગી કોલેજની કેટલીક પ્રક્રિયાઓ નક્કી કરેલી સરકારી સંસ્થામાં થઈ શકે; ફક્ત કોલેજના નામથી સ્થળ ન પસંદ કરો. જરૂરી રૂબરૂ દસ્તાવેજ ચકાસણી પછી જ પ્રવેશની પ્રક્રિયા પૂરી થાય છે.

title: UCEED 2027 MSQ: काही बरोबर पर्याय निवडल्यास गुण कधी मिळतात?
description: UCEED 2027चे अंशतः गुण, MSQची -1 कपात आणि NAT, MCQचे वेगळे नियम IIT बॉम्बेच्या अधिकृत गुणतक्त्यासह समजून घ्या.
content:
UCEED 2027च्या MSQमध्ये एक बरोबर पर्याय निवडला म्हणजे नेहमी एकच गुण मिळतो असे नाही. तोच एकमेव बरोबर पर्याय असेल आणि फक्त तो निवडला असेल, तर पूर्ण चार गुण मिळतात. अनेक बरोबर पर्यायांपैकी काहीच निवडले आणि एकही चुकीचा पर्याय निवडला नाही, तर अंशतः गुण मिळतात. चुकीचा पर्याय जोडल्यास -1 मिळतो.

15 MSQचे गुण कसे मोजले जातात

IIT बॉम्बेच्या अधिकृत प्रश्नपत्रिका रचनेतील नियम असे आहेत. पूर्ण किंवा अंशतः गुणांसाठी निवडलेला प्रत्येक पर्याय बरोबर असावा:

  • +4: सर्व बरोबर पर्याय निवडा आणि एकही चुकीचा पर्याय निवडू नका.

  • +3: चारही पर्याय बरोबर असताना फक्त तीन निवडल्यास.

  • +2: किमान तीन पर्याय बरोबर असताना फक्त दोन बरोबर पर्याय निवडल्यास.

  • +1: किमान दोन पर्याय बरोबर असताना फक्त एक बरोबर पर्याय निवडल्यास.

  • 0: प्रश्न अनुत्तरित ठेवल्यास. इतर सर्व परिस्थितीत -1.

एका उदाहरणातून फरक समजून घ्या

A, B आणि C बरोबर आहेत असे धरा. A आणि B निवडल्यास +2; फक्त A असल्यास +1; A, B, C तिन्ही असल्यास +4. चुकीचा D जोडल्यास -1. फक्त A बरोबर असेल तर केवळ A निवडल्यास +4 मिळतात. ही प्रकाशित नियमांची उदाहरणे आहेत; परीक्षेतील प्रश्नांचा अंदाज नाही.

सर्व विभागांत अंदाज बांधण्याची एकच पद्धत वापरू नका

Part Aमध्ये 57 प्रश्न, 200 गुण आणि दोन तास आहेत. 14 NAT प्रश्नांत बरोबर उत्तराला +4; चुकीच्या उत्तराला कपात नाही. 28 MCQमध्ये बरोबर उत्तराला +3, चुकीला -0.71. अनुत्तरित प्रश्नाला शून्य. 15 MSQचे जास्तीत जास्त 60 गुण आहेत.

IIT बॉम्बेची UCEED 2027 प्रश्नपत्रिका रचना. या पानावर स्वतंत्र प्रसिद्धीची तारीख दिलेली नाही. संपूर्ण अधिकृत गुणांकन नियम वाचा.

Part Bही अनिवार्य आहे: एक तास, 100 गुण. एक रेखाटनाचा आणि एक डिझाइन अभिक्षमतेचा प्रश्न, प्रत्येकी 50 गुण. प्रश्न स्क्रीनवर दिसतात; दिलेल्या उत्तरपुस्तिकेत लिहावे किंवा काढावे लागते. सरावात दोन्ही भागांची वेळ पाळा; संपूर्ण तीन तास वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्नांना देऊ नका.

सरावाच्या नोंदीत सुटलेला बरोबर पर्याय आणि जास्तीचा निवडलेला चुकीचा पर्याय वेगळा लिहा. विषयाची समज वाढवायची की पर्याय अधिक काळजीपूर्वक तपासायचे हे कळेल. व्यापक सरावासाठी Part A आणि Part B सराव मार्गदर्शक वाचा.

title: CTET Exam Date 2025 Out - Check July Session Schedule & Details
description: CTET July 2025 is tentatively scheduled. Learn about the exam pattern, eligibility, application dates, and more. Stay updated for the official notification.
content:
CTET Exam Date 2025 Announced – Check July Session Schedule, Pattern & Key Details

The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has tentatively scheduled the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) 2025 for July 6, 2025. CTET is a national-level exam conducted twice a year — typically in July and December — to assess the eligibility of candidates for teaching positions at the primary and upper primary levels across India.

If you're aspiring to become a teacher in government or aided schools, this is the right time to start your preparation. Here's everything you need to know about the CTET July 2025 exam, including the expected date, exam pattern, and eligibility requirements.

CTET 2025 July Exam Date – Key Highlights

  • Exam Name: Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET)

  • Conducting Body: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)

  • Tentative Exam Date: July 6, 2025 (Sunday)

  • Frequency: Twice a year (July & December)

  • Mode of Exam: Offline (Pen-and-Paper Based Test)

CTET Exam 2025 – Overview

Particulars Details
Exam Level National
Eligibility B.Ed. or D.El.Ed. qualified candidates
Mode of Application Online
Application Fee Varies based on category and number of papers
Languages Offered 20+ languages including Hindi, English, Urdu, etc.

CTET Exam Pattern 2025

The CTET exam is divided into two papers:

  • Paper I: For candidates intending to teach classes I to V (Primary Level)

  • Paper II: For candidates intending to teach classes VI to VIII (Upper Primary Level)

Paper Structure:

Subject Questions Marks
Child Development and Pedagogy 30 30
Language I 30 30
Language II 30 30
Mathematics / Science or Social Studies 60 60
Total 150 150

  • Duration: 2 hours 30 minutes for each paper

  • Marking Scheme: 1 mark per correct answer, no negative marking

CTET July 2025: Who Should Apply?

CTET is a mandatory qualification for teaching jobs in:

  • Central Government Schools (KVS, NVS, etc.)

  • Schools under the administrative control of UTs

  • Private schools (as per their policies)

Candidates pursuing or having completed B.Ed., D.El.Ed., or equivalent teaching qualifications can apply.

Important Dates for CTET 2025 (Tentative)

Event Date
Notification Release May 2025
Application Start Date May 2025
Last Date to Apply June 2025
Admit Card Release Last week of June 2025
Exam Date July 6, 2025
Result Declaration August 2025

CTET Certificate Validity

The CTET certificate is valid for a lifetime and can be used to apply for various teaching positions across India.

How to Stay Updated?

  • Regularly visit the official CTET website: https://ctet.nic.in

  • Keep track of the notification, syllabus updates, and mock test resources

  • Subscribe to alerts from reliable education portals

Final Words

The announcement of the CTET July 2025 exam date brings a great opportunity for teaching aspirants. With the exam likely to be held on July 6, 2025, now is the perfect time to begin your focused preparation. Stay tuned for the official notification and application form expected to be released in May 2025.

title: NEET PG 2026 Hall Ticket Discrepancy Resolution: Steps for Name, Roll Number, and Test Center Corrections
description: Learn how to identify and rectify errors on your NEET PG 2026 hall ticket, including name misspellings, roll number discrepancies, and test center mistakes.
content:
The release of the NEET PG 2026 admit card marks a critical milestone for postgraduate medical aspirants across India. However, downloading the hall ticket can sometimes bring unexpected distress if candidates notice errors in their printed details. A misspelt name, an incorrect roll number, a blurred photograph, or an unexpected test center allocation can raise serious concerns regarding exam day entry. Prompt action is essential to ensure these discrepancies do not disrupt your examination experience.

This guide provides a comprehensive roadmap for medical candidates and parents to identify, report, and rectify discrepancies on the NEET PG 2026 hall ticket effectively.

Common Types of Hall Ticket Discrepancies

Before initiating a correction request, candidates should carefully verify every field printed on their admit card against their original application submission form. Common errors usually fall into the following categories:

  • Candidate Name and Parent Name Errors: Spelling mistakes, missing middle names, or inverted surname order that do not match government-issued identity cards.
  • Roll Number and Application ID Errors: Discrepancies between the application form ID and the allocated roll number on the portal.
  • Image and Signature Issues: Indistinct, blurred, missing, or swapped photograph and signature images.
  • Category and Gender Mismatches: Incorrect reservation category (GEN, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) or gender details that could impact merit evaluation.
  • Test Center and City Allocation Errors: Printing errors in the test center address, venue code, or allocation outside chosen city preferences.

Immediate Action Plan: Contacting Official Authorities

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is the official conducting body for NEET PG 2026. If you spot any variance between your confirmation page and your admit card, follow these steps immediately:

1. Cross-Check with the Application Form

Compare the downloaded hall ticket directly with your submitted application confirmation receipt. Corrections are generally entertained only if the discrepancy represents a deviation from what you submitted during registration.

2. Raise an Official Support Ticket

Log in to the official NBEMS candidate portal using your registration credentials. Use the integrated communication portal or webform to log your query. Attach clear scannable evidence showing the mistake.

3. Send a Formal Email to the NBEMS Helpdesk

Draft a concise, factual email to the designated helpline email address listed on the official NBEMS portal. Make sure to structure your email correctly:

  • Subject Line: Urgent: Discrepancy in NEET PG 2026 Admit Card - User ID [Your Application Number]
  • Body Content: Specify candidate full name, application ID, roll number, exact detail needing correction, and correct detail.
  • Attachments: Attach a clean PDF of the downloaded admit card, the original application confirmation page, and a valid photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, or PAN Card).

4. Call the Official Helpline

Follow up your email request by contacting the official NBEMS phone helpline during operating business hours. Keep your application registration details ready to provide to the helpline representative for quick assistance.

Resolving Specific Types of Errors

Addressing Name and Roll Number Discrepancies

If your name on the hall ticket differs from your government-issued identification, entry supervisors at the exam center may flag the mismatch. Contact the helpline immediately to obtain a revised hall ticket or an official clarification email from NBEMS confirming the record update.

Fixing Photograph and Signature Errors

If your photo is distorted or missing, authorities may ask you to upload a fresh passport-sized photograph through the portal or submit an authorized undertaking. Candidates should carry printed copies of the exact photograph uploaded during application submission to the exam center.

Handling Test Center and Address Inconsistencies

Exam centers are allotted based on availability and candidate choices. If the venue address is incomplete, confusing, or contains a printing glitch, verify the complete location code on the official site. NBEMS rarely changes test cities post-allotment unless a technical error occurred on their end. Verify the exact venue location at least one day before the exam.

What to Do If Corrections Are Pending on Exam Day

If you have reported a discrepancy but have not received an updated hall ticket before the examination date, do not panic. Follow these precautionary steps:

  • Carry a printed copy of your official helpdesk email correspondence and ticket confirmation.
  • Bring your original application confirmation page demonstrating that your initial entry was correct.
  • Bring multiple valid, original government-issued photo identity cards (such as Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving License).
  • Report to the assigned examination center well ahead of the reporting time to speak with the center superintendent.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I change my test center city after the admit card is issued?

No, requests to change the allotted test city or center are strictly not entertained unless the change is due to an administrative or system error verified by NBEMS.

What should I do if my photograph is missing on the NEET PG 2026 admit card?

You must immediately inform the NBEMS helpdesk via email and online support. Carry extra passport-size photographs matching the uploaded file and a copy of your submitted application form to the exam hall.

Is a minor spelling mistake in my name acceptable at the exam center?

While minor typos might be permitted upon producing supplementary government IDs, it is safer to get an official confirmation or updated hall ticket from NBEMS prior to exam day.

Where can I verify official candidate updates regarding hall tickets?

Always verify official notifications directly on the official NBEMS website (natboard.edu.in) to avoid reliance on unverified rumors.

title: INI-CET జనవరి 2027 ఫలితం: జాబితాలో రోల్ నంబర్, MyPageలో పర్సెంటైల్ ఎలా చూడాలి?
description: జనవరి సెషన్‌కు ఎయిమ్స్ ప్రకటించిన అర్హుల జాబితాలో మీ రోల్ నంబర్ వెతకండి. జాబితాలో లేకపోయినా పర్సెంటైల్ ఎక్కడ చూడాలో, సీటు కేటాయింపునకు ఏ సమాచారం కోసం వేచి ఉండాలో తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
జనవరి 2027 ప్రవేశాలకు INI-CET ఫలితం విడుదలైంది. తాత్కాలికంగా అర్హత పొందిన వారి రోల్ నంబర్లు పబ్లిక్ PDFలో ఉంటాయి. పరీక్ష రాసిన వారందరూ, ఆ జాబితాలో లేనివారు కూడా, తమ పర్సెంటైల్‌ను MyPageలో చూడవచ్చు.

నవంబరులో రాసిన పరీక్షకు ఏ జాబితా వర్తిస్తుంది?

AIIMS పరీక్షల వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో Results & Announcements కింద INICET January 2027 జాబితాను తెరవండి. వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో నవంబర్ 7న పెట్టిన ఈ ఫలితానికి సంబంధించిన నోటిఫికేషన్ 304/2026పై నవంబర్ 6 తేదీ ఉంటుంది. పరీక్ష నవంబర్ 1న జరిగింది. హాల్‌టికెట్‌లో ఉన్న రోల్ నంబర్‌ను PDFలో వెతకండి. వరుస రోల్ నంబర్ ప్రకారం ఉంటుంది; మొదటి వరుస మొదటి ర్యాంక్ కాదు. MD, MS, ఆరేళ్ల DM, MCh విభాగం నుంచి MDS విభాగాన్ని వేరు చేసి మీ వరుసలోని ర్యాంక్, పర్సెంటైల్ చూడండి.

జాబితాలో రోల్ నంబర్ కనిపించకపోతే?

Candidate ID, పాస్‌వర్డ్‌తో ఎయిమ్స్ MyPageలోకి లాగిన్ అవ్వండి. పర్సెంటైల్ ఇతర పరీక్షార్థులతో పోలిస్తే మీ స్థానం ఎలా ఉందో చెబుతుంది. అది సరైన సమాధానాల శాతం కాదు.

నోటిఫికేషన్‌లోని వర్గంఅర్హత పర్సెంటైల్
అన్‌రిజర్వ్‌డ్, EWS, స్పాన్సర్డ్, డిప్యూటెడ్, విదేశీ పౌరులు, OCI50
OBC, SC, ST, PwBD45
భూటాన్ జాతీయులు, చండీగఢ్ PGIMERకు మాత్రమే45

ర్యాంక్ రావడం సీటు కేటాయింపు కాదు

ఇది తాత్కాలిక జాబితా. పేరు కనిపించినంత మాత్రాన అర్హత, ధ్రువపత్రాల పరిశీలన పూర్తయినట్లు కాదు. OBC లేదా EWS సర్టిఫికెట్ అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి ఉంటే రిజిస్టర్ చేసిన ఈమెయిల్ చూడండి; ప్రాథమిక పరిశీలన స్థితిని అక్కడ తెలియజేస్తారు. సంస్థ, సబ్జెక్టు ఎంపికలకు వేరుగా సూచనలు వస్తాయి.

ఎయిమ్స్ న్యూఢిల్లీ, ఫలిత నోటిఫికేషన్ 304/2026, 6 నవంబర్ 2026, పేజీ 880. AIIMS: Results & Announcements.

ఎయిమ్స్ పరీక్షల క్యాలెండర్‌లో కౌన్సెలింగ్ తేదీలు ఫలితం నుంచి విడిగా ఉంటాయి. ఫలితం ఎప్పుడు వస్తుందనే పాత వార్తకు బదులుగా ఇప్పుడు అధికారిక జాబితా, మీ MyPage చూడండి.

title: JEE Main ప్రత్యామ్నాయాలు 2027: VIT, SRM ఫారాలు తెరిచాయి; అమృత తదుపరి
description: VITEEE, SRMJEEE, AEEE, KIITEE, GITAM అధికారిక దరఖాస్తు స్థితులను పోల్చండి. తెరిచిన 2027 ఫారాలు, రాబోయే అవకాశం, పాత పోర్టల్ మధ్య తేడా తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
JEE Mainకు మించిన ఇంజినీరింగ్ అవకాశాల కోసం నవంబర్‌లో ఒకే ఉమ్మడి ప్రారంభ తేదీ వరకు వేచి ఉండనవసరం లేదు. VIT, SRM ఇప్పటికే 2027 ఫారాలను చూపిస్తున్నాయి; అమృత B.Tech 2027 దరఖాస్తులు నవంబర్‌లో ప్రారంభమవుతాయని చెబుతోంది. KIIT, GITAM పాత ఫారాలను 2027 దరఖాస్తులుగా భావించే ముందు కొత్త ప్రవేశ సంవత్సరాన్ని తనిఖీ చేయాలి.

ఐదు మార్గాలు, వేర్వేరు దరఖాస్తు దశలు

పోలికలోని అధికారిక లింకులు వాడి, వ్యక్తిగత వివరాలు ఇచ్చే ముందు లేదా చెల్లించే ముందు ప్రవేశ సంవత్సరం మళ్లీ చూడండి. రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ బటన్ పనిచేస్తేనే సరైన సంవత్సరం దరఖాస్తు అని నిర్ధారణ కాదు.

ప్రవేశ మార్గం

అధికారిక పేజీ స్థితి

తదుపరి చర్య

VITEEE

B.Tech 2027 నమోదు, లాగిన్ ఫారం అందుబాటులో ఉంది

దరఖాస్తుకు ముందు 2027 సూచనలు చదవండి

SRMJEEE

2027 ప్రవేశాలు తెరిచాయి; UG ఫారం ఉంది

ఫారంలో కోర్సు, క్యాంపస్ తనిఖీ చేయండి

AEEE

B.Tech 2027 దరఖాస్తులు నవంబర్‌లో అని ప్రకటన

ప్రారంభ నోటీసు, తాజా సూచనలకు వేచి ఉండండి

KIITEE

పోర్టల్ ఇంకా KIITEE 2026 మూసివేసినట్లు చూపుతోంది

ఇక్కడ 2027 దరఖాస్తు ప్రారంభం నిర్ధారణ కాలేదు

GITAM GAT

దరఖాస్తు పేజీ ఇంకా GAT 2026 అని చూపుతోంది

ఫారం వాడే ముందు 2027 సంవత్సరం నిర్ధారించండి

అమృత నవంబర్ ప్రకటన అర్థం

అమృత నోటీసు ఒక నెలను నిర్ధారిస్తుంది, ఖచ్చితమైన ప్రారంభ రోజును కాదు. AEEEతో పాటు JEE Main పర్సెంటైల్ ద్వారా B.Tech ప్రవేశ మార్గాన్ని కూడా పేజీ చూపుతోంది. ఫారం తెరిచినప్పుడు 2027 సూచనలు చదవాలి; పాత ఫీజు, అర్హత పరిమితి లేదా దశ నియమాలను కొనసాగుతాయని భావించవద్దు.

కింద చిత్రం విశ్వవిద్యాలయం స్వయంగా ఇచ్చిన దరఖాస్తు ప్రారంభ ప్రకటన. రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ఇప్పటికే తెరిచిందనడానికి ఆధారం కాదు. తదుపరి చర్య నిర్ణయించేటప్పుడు ప్రకటించిన భవిష్యత్ అవకాశం, ప్రస్తుతం అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఫారం మధ్య తేడా పాటించండి.

అమృత B.Tech 2027 ప్రవేశాల పేజీ ప్రకారం దరఖాస్తులు నవంబర్‌లో ప్రారంభమవుతాయి. ఈ వెబ్ నోటీసులో ప్రత్యేక జారీ తేదీ లేదు. అమృత అసలు దరఖాస్తు నోటీసు

చెల్లింపుకు ముందు ఎంపికల జాబితా తయారు చేయండి

ప్రతి ఎంపిక చేసిన కోర్సుకు క్యాంపస్, ప్రోగ్రామ్, ప్రవేశ మార్గం, దరఖాస్తు స్థితి, అధికారిక URL నమోదు చేయండి. ప్రస్తుత పత్రాల్లో అర్హత, ట్యూషన్, జీవన ఖర్చు, రిఫండ్, స్కాలర్‌షిప్ షరతులు పోల్చండి. అనేక పరీక్షలకు దరఖాస్తు అవకాశాలను పెంచవచ్చు; ప్రవేశం లేదా ప్రతి క్యాంపస్ ఖర్చు భరించగలగడాన్ని హామీ ఇవ్వదు.

సరిగ్గా పూర్తి చేయగల దరఖాస్తులకు ప్రాధాన్యం ఇవ్వండి. సొంత ఈమెయిల్, మొబైల్ అందుబాటులో ఉంచి, సరైన విద్యా వివరాలతో చివరి నిర్ధారణను సేవ్ చేయండి. VIT కోసం ప్రత్యేక పత్రాలు, లైవ్ ఫోటో మార్గదర్శిని ఉపయోగపడుతుంది. నిర్ధారణ కాని సంవత్సరానికి అధికారిక పేజీ సేవ్ చేసి తాజా ప్రకటన కోసం వేచి ఉండండి; ముందస్తు సీటు పేరుతో మధ్యవర్తికి చెల్లించవద్దు.

title: Karnataka DCET 2026 Mock Allotment Result Released: Check Allotment Status at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in
description: The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has released the DCET 2026 mock allotment results. Discover how lateral entry engineering diploma students can check their status and modify choices.
content:
The Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) has officially declared the Karnataka DCET 2026 Mock Allotment Result on August 6, 2026. Candidates who appeared for the Diploma Common Entrance Test (DCET) can now access their provisional seat allotment status on the official website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.

This mock allotment acts as a trial run for diploma holders seeking lateral entry into second-year (third-semester) B.E. and B.Tech programmes across engineering colleges in Karnataka. It provides candidates with a realistic expectation of where they stand based on their merit rank and initial option entries, offering a final opportunity to adjust their preferences before the actual first-round seat allocation.

Quick Answer: Karnataka DCET 2026 Mock Allotment

The KEA released the DCET mock allotment results on August 6, 2026. Candidates must log in using their DCET number to check their status. If you are unsatisfied with your allocated college or branch, you have the opportunity to modify, add, delete, or reorder your options through the official KEA portal. This change window is vital for securing a better seat in the final rounds.

Key Facts: Karnataka DCET 2026 Counselling

To help candidates navigate the lateral entry process, here is a summary of the essential facts and dates surrounding the Karnataka DCET mock allotment phase:

Event / Parameter Details
Conducting Authority Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA)
Academic Purpose Lateral entry admission into B.E. / B.Tech (2nd year)
Mock Allotment Release Date August 6, 2026
Official Website cetonline.karnataka.gov.in
Required Credentials DCET Application / Roll Number
Next Step for Candidates Review, modify option entry, and wait for actual Round 1 result

Similar to how regular first-year engineering admissions are conducted through the Karnataka Common Entrance Test (KCET), the DCET platform caters specifically to diploma holders, making the strategic filling of preferences equally competitive.

Step-by-Step Guidance: How to Check DCET 2026 Mock Allotment Result

Follow these straightforward steps to check your provisional mock allotment status online:

  1. Visit the KEA Website: Go to the official Karnataka Examinations Authority portal at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.
  2. Locate the Link: Under the "Latest Announcements" or "Admissions" tab, look for the link titled "DCET-2026 Mock Allotment Result".
  3. Enter Credentials: You will be redirected to a login window. Enter your unique DCET number in the specified field.
  4. View Status: Click on the "Submit" button to view your mock allotment details on the screen.
  5. Download and Print: Take a screenshot or print out the page for your records during option modification.

How to Modify Options Post-Mock Allotment

The primary purpose of the mock allotment is to give you a clear picture of your admission probability. If you did not receive your preferred college, or if you feel you have a chance at a better option, follow these strategies during the choice-editing window:

1. Analyze the Mock Cut-off Ranks

KEA will publish the mock allotment cut-off ranks for various engineering disciplines and institutions. Compare your rank with these cut-offs to understand which colleges are within your reach.

2. Reorder Your Preferences

If you were allotted a lower-preference college, check if you want to swap the order of choices above it. Remember that if you qualify for a higher option in the actual round, your lower options will automatically be closed.

3. Add More Choices Safely

If no seat was allotted to you in the mock phase, it means your selected choices had higher cut-off ranks than your score. To avoid missing out, add a wider range of colleges and branches, including several safety options.

4. Avoid Last-Minute Rush

Ensure all your edits, deletions, and additions are saved before the deadline set by the KEA. Options recorded in the system after the modification window closes will be treated as final for the Round 1 allotment.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is the mock allotment seat final?

No. The mock allotment is purely indicative. It helps you understand which college you might get based on the current options entered by all candidates. The final seat allotment in Round 1 could change depending on how candidates modify their choices.

Can I participate in the first round if I missed the mock option entry?

Generally, candidates who did not enter options before the mock allotment are still allowed to enter their fresh choices during the option modification window before the final Round 1 schedule is locked. Keep a close check on official KEA notifications for confirmation.

What credentials do I need to log in to the DCET portal?

You will need your DCET application number or roll number to access your mock allotment result and complete the option modification process.

title: INSPIRE Scholarship 2026 Renewal: Documents Students Should Check
description: Check the marksheets, academic records, bank proof and portal details needed for INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026, plus errors that can delay payment.
content:
For INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026, keep your latest official marksheet or grade card, academic details, permitted bank proof and matching personal information ready. A missing result, incorrect account number or unresolved portal query can delay support for the next academic year. Check the live renewal instructions before uploading anything.

The Department of Science and Technology is the responsible government entity for INSPIRE. Its current renewal instructions and portal fields take priority over old screenshots, forwarded messages and last year's document list.

Key facts about INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026

Renewal is not just a repeat application. The authority has to review your academic continuity, current course details, submitted documents and payment information before the application can move ahead.

  • The latest official academic record is usually the starting document for renewal.
  • Marks, grades, credits or CGPA must be entered exactly as the current form asks.
  • Bank proof must clearly show the permitted account holder, account number and IFSC.
  • A continuation or bonafide certificate may be needed if the current form asks for it.
  • “Submitted” does not mean approved. Verification or correction may still be pending.
  • The current 2026 notice decides the deadline, file format, size limit and required uploads.

Which documents are needed for INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026?

Keep your latest university marksheet or grade card, academic performance details, bank proof, identity information and previous application details ready. A continuation certificate, category certificate or other supporting document is needed only when the current renewal form or your scholarship record asks for it.

  • Latest marksheet or grade card: Use the record for the academic year being renewed. If your college issues semester-wise results, check whether the form asks for a consolidated record or separate files.
  • Academic performance details: Copy marks, grades, credits or CGPA from the official record. Do not convert CGPA into a percentage unless the form or institution gives a permitted method.
  • Continuation or bonafide certificate: Keep a current certificate showing course enrolment and academic year if the portal requests it.
  • Bank proof: A permitted passbook page, cancelled cheque or bank certificate should show the account details requested by the portal. Use only an accepted document type.
  • Identity and personal details: Check your name, date of birth, registered mobile number and email against the scholarship record.
  • Supporting eligibility records: Keep a valid category, disability or other certificate available where your record includes such a claim and the form asks for proof.
  • Previous submission details: Save the application number, acknowledgement and earlier renewal information. These can help when a query or correction appears.

A college fee receipt doesn't automatically replace a marksheet or bank document. Upload it only when the relevant field or current instructions specifically accept it.

What should you check on the academic record?

Check the academic record before you scan it, not after a query appears. The document should belong to the correct academic year, show the final status clearly and match the personal details stored in your scholarship record.

  1. Confirm the examination year, semester and course.
  2. Check your name, roll number and enrolment details.
  3. Include every required page, including the page showing the final result or grade.
  4. Read the result status carefully. Pass, promoted, withheld and reappear can have different consequences.
  5. Follow the academic condition stated in the current renewal notice. Don't assume last year's rule applies unchanged.
  6. If the downloaded record has no authentication detail, ask the college office whether it can issue a signed or digitally verifiable copy.

If a supplementary result is pending, don't enter a completed result just to finish the form. Use the option given in the current instructions, or ask your college scholarship office how the pending result must be reported.

Can bank details delay the scholarship payment?

Yes. A single wrong digit, outdated IFSC or mismatch in the account holder's name can send the application into correction or delay payment. Compare the bank proof with the form character by character, and confirm with the bank that the account can receive credits.

Detail to checkCommon problemSafer action
Account holder nameA parent’s account is used without checking the permitted ruleFollow the current scholarship instruction for the allowed account holder
Account numberA digit is copied incorrectly or an old account is usedRead it from a recent bank record
IFSCAn old branch code remains on the formConfirm the current IFSC with the bank
Document imageThe name or number is cut off, blurred or hiddenUpload a complete, readable file in the permitted format and size
Account statusThe account is dormant, frozen or closedAsk the bank whether it can receive the scholarship credit

Never share your banking password, PIN or OTP with anyone offering to complete the renewal. The application requires scholarship and document details, not banking login access.

How should you submit and track the renewal?

Treat the renewal as a sequence of checks rather than one upload. Keep proof of each stage because a form can be submitted while institution verification, document review or correction is still pending.

  1. Prepare: Collect the current marksheet, bank proof and any requested continuation or supporting certificate.
  2. Fill: Copy the documents, not from memory. Check every digit before saving.
  3. Submit: Save the application number and download the acknowledgement after final submission.
  4. Track: Look for a query, defect, institution action or request for a fresh file.
  5. Close the loop: Check that no correction remains pending before expecting payment.

Verify the 2026 opening date, closing date and status instructions on the current INSPIRE portal managed by the Department of Science and Technology. Don't rely on dates circulated in a class group.

Which renewal errors should you fix before submission?

Most avoidable trouble comes from treating renewal as copy-paste work. Your course year, result, contact information or bank account may have changed since the previous payment.

  • Uploading the previous year's marksheet.
  • Entering a percentage when the record shows only CGPA, without checking the permitted method.
  • Using a parent’s account or a closed account without confirming the rule.
  • Leaving a spelling difference between the portal, marksheet and bank document.
  • Uploading a blurred, password-protected or unsupported file.
  • Ignoring a registered email, portal notification or college query.
  • Assuming “submitted” means “approved”.
  • Starting a second application instead of correcting the existing one.

Parents can check the bank proof and acknowledgement, but the student should retain access to the registered email, login and application number. Those details may be needed if the authority asks for a correction.

What if a result or document is still pending?

Don't upload an unrelated file just to fill a compulsory field. Read the current instructions for provisional results, institution certification or later submission, and contact your college office if the portal gives no clear route.

Keep evidence of the genuine issue, such as a result notice, written college response, acknowledgement or query number. It cannot guarantee approval, but it gives the responsible authority a clear record to examine.

FAQs about INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026

Which documents are needed for INSPIRE Scholarship renewal 2026?

Keep the latest official marksheet or grade card, academic performance details, permitted bank proof, identity details, previous application information and any continuation or supporting certificate requested by the current form. The live 2026 instructions decide the final upload list.

Is a bank passbook accepted for INSPIRE Scholarship renewal?

A passbook page may be accepted when it clearly shows the permitted account holder's name, account number and current IFSC. Check the current portal's file type and size rules before uploading it.

Can I submit renewal without the latest marksheet?

Don't replace the latest marksheet with an unrelated document. Check whether the current instructions allow a provisional result, institution certificate or later submission. If no option appears, ask your college and follow the route provided by the responsible authority.

Does “submitted” mean my INSPIRE renewal is approved?

No. “Submitted” confirms that the form was sent, not that review is complete. Institution verification, document checking or correction may still be pending, so keep checking the portal and registered email.

Can I use my parent’s bank account for INSPIRE renewal?

Don't assume it is allowed. Follow the account holder rule in the current instructions. If the record requires the student's account, a parent’s account can delay or stop the credit even when the academic documents are correct.

What should I do if my bank details have changed?

Use the permitted bank-change or correction option shown in the current renewal form, if one is available, and upload fresh bank proof. Don't edit an old document or enter a new account in a field meant for the previous record without checking the instructions.

title: Bihar BEd CET 2026 Reporting: Documents to Carry and Mistakes to Avoid
description: Prepare for Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting with a clear original, copy and digital document plan, fee-proof checks and ways to avoid admission delays.
content:
Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting can affect whether your allotted seat is confirmed without delay. Carry the originals named in your allotment or reporting notice, at least two photocopy sets, fee proof and digital backups. Before travelling, compare this pack with the latest instructions issued by the Bihar BEd CET counselling authority and your allotted college.

A missing certificate, unclear category document or payment record that cannot be matched may send you back for clarification. Small gaps become expensive problems during a short reporting window.

Key facts for Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting

Document groupWhat to carryWhat it is used for
OriginalsAllotment letter, identity proof, academic certificates and other papers named in the noticeIn-person verification and record matching
PhotocopiesAt least two self-attested sets of each required paperSubmission to the college or counselling record
Category papersCaste, EWS, disability, domicile or other applicable certificatesVerification of the claim used for seat allotment
Payment proofReceipt, transaction ID, date, amount and bank or UPI recordConfirmation that the required payment reached the correct account or portal
Digital backupClear PDFs or photographs saved on two devices or accountsQuick recovery if a paper is damaged or misplaced

The final list can vary by counselling round, category, college and the wording of the current notice. Treat the table as a preparation tool, not a replacement for the written instructions.

Keep these originals in the front folder

  • Allotment letter, seat confirmation page or provisional admission letter.
  • Bihar BEd CET admit card or examination record, if listed in the reporting instructions.
  • Application form printout and counselling registration details, if generated by the portal.
  • Photo identity proof used during the application, or another identity document accepted in the notice.
  • Class 10 certificate or marksheet for date-of-birth verification.
  • Graduation marksheets for every required year or semester and the degree or provisional certificate.
  • Postgraduate marksheets or certificate only if they were used for eligibility or entered in the application.
  • Recent passport-size photographs in the count and format stated by the college.
  • Migration, transfer or character certificate if the allotted college asks for it at joining.

If the notice says original verification, a colour printout is not the same thing as the original certificate. A downloaded document can support your case, but it does not automatically replace a paper or certificate specifically demanded by the authority.

Category and special-claim documents

Match the certificate to the claim recorded in your application. Check the issuing authority, prescribed format, validity condition and spelling of your name. A document accepted for one purpose or state may not satisfy the admission rule being applied here.

  • Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, Extremely Backward Class, Backward Class or EWS certificate, where applicable.
  • Non-creamy-layer or income proof, where the current rule requires it.
  • Disability certificate or other accepted PwD document, if a disability reservation or relaxation was claimed.
  • Domicile or residence certificate, if required under the applicable Bihar admission rule.
  • Service, sports or other special-quota documents only when the allotment notice refers to that quota.

Do not assume that a missing category paper can be submitted later. Ask the reporting desk whether later submission is allowed under the current notice and get the response recorded on a receipt or written application.

Document pack: original, copy or digital?

Use three separate folders. This prevents a hurried counter exchange from turning into a document loss.

PackHow to prepare itDo not rely on it for
Original folderArrange certificates in the order shown in the college checklist and add a paper indexPermanent submission without an acknowledgement
Copy folderCarry two or three sets, with self-attestation only where requiredReplacing an original when original verification is stated
Digital folderSave clear PDFs on your phone and a parent’s phone or secure storageAutomatic acceptance at a counter

Photocopies and scans

Keep both sides of identity cards visible in the copies. Use simple file names such as “10th certificate” and “allotment letter”, and open each file once before leaving to check that seals, signatures and numbers can be read.

Do not depend on a compressed messaging-app image. Connectivity may fail at the college, and a blurred scan can slow verification just when the queue is moving.

Fee proof needs its own envelope

Print the counselling or admission fee receipt. Also write down the transaction ID, date, amount and payment status, then save the bank or UPI confirmation with the portal receipt.

If money was debited but the portal still shows pending, do not pay again immediately. Check the transaction status and contact the designated helpdesk through the official channel. Keep the complaint number or acknowledgement.

If payment is to be made at the college, verify the accepted mode and amount in the current written instruction. A screenshot of a forwarded message is not enough.

Decision guidance before you leave home

Use this quick decision check when a document is missing or different:

  • Original available: Pack it separately and carry the matching copy.
  • Only a scan available: Check whether the notice expressly permits digital submission. If not, contact the allotted college before travelling.
  • Name or date differs: Carry the supporting correction paper or affidavit only if it is accepted for that purpose, and ask the desk before signing any form.
  • Category certificate is unclear: Take the certificate, application record and related proof. Ask whether the claim can be verified or corrected under the current rule.
  • Payment is debited but not updated: Keep the bank record, transaction ID and portal status together, and seek written helpdesk guidance before a second payment.
  • Original is retained: Ask for a signed receipt listing every document and the date received.

Candidate presence may be required for signatures, identity checks or other verification. A parent should not report in your place unless the written instruction or the allotted college confirms that this is permitted.

What normally happens at reporting

  1. Entry staff check the allotment or reporting document and identity proof.
  2. The college compares originals with the application and submitted copies.
  3. Academic eligibility, category details and special claims are checked.
  4. Payment is matched with the portal or college record.
  5. You complete forms and undertakings. Read your name, category, course, college and contact details before signing.
  6. You collect the fee receipt, document acknowledgement and joining instructions.

Reach early, but do not sign unread forms merely because the queue is long. A wrong mobile number or category entry can create trouble when admission data is uploaded.

Mistakes that can delay joining

  • Taking only downloaded documents: Carry physical certificates wherever original verification is required.
  • Ignoring name or date mismatches: Compare the application, identity proof, marksheets and certificates before reporting.
  • Using the wrong category format: Check the issuing authority, validity and format stated in the current instructions.
  • Leaving out graduation proof: Take final marksheets and a degree or permitted provisional certificate. Do not assume a final-year status will be accepted.
  • Carrying no payment trail: Keep the portal receipt, transaction number and bank or UPI record together.
  • Handing over originals without proof: Obtain a signed document receipt if the institution retains anything.
  • Following forwarded messages: Confirm changes in date, venue or fee only through the written instruction of the Bihar BEd CET counselling authority or the allotted college.

The 24-hour packing check

  • Download the latest allotment and reporting instructions.
  • Mark each paper as original, copy or digital backup.
  • Check category, domicile and special-claim documents against your application.
  • Print fee receipts and note every transaction ID.
  • Pack two pens, photographs, water, a power bank and a transparent folder.
  • Save the reporting address, time and helpdesk details offline.
  • Tell a parent or trusted adult where the originals are kept.

If a certificate is genuinely unavailable, disclose it at the desk. Carry proof that you applied for it, ask whether an undertaking or later submission is allowed, and request the answer in writing. Verbal assurance from someone who is not handling the admission record may not protect your seat.

FAQs on Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting

Which documents are needed for Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting?

Carry the allotment letter, admit card or exam record, application details, identity proof, Class 10 proof, graduation marksheets and certificate, photographs, applicable category or domicile documents, fee receipt and any joining certificate named by the allotted college. The latest written reporting notice has priority.

Do I need originals during Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting?

Yes, when the reporting notice requires original verification. Take the originals with at least two photocopy sets. Digital scans are useful backups, but they are not replacements unless the authority clearly permits them.

How many photocopies should I carry for B.Ed admission reporting?

Carry at least two self-attested sets of every required document, plus a spare set if travelling to the college is difficult. Keep the originals in a separate folder so they are not submitted accidentally.

What payment proof should I carry to reporting?

Carry the printed portal or college fee receipt, transaction ID, payment date and amount. Save the successful-status screenshot and bank or UPI record. If the amount was debited but the portal remains pending, contact the designated helpdesk before paying again.

What if my category certificate is missing or has a mismatch?

Take the available certificate, application record and supporting papers to the reporting desk. Ask whether correction or later submission is permitted under the current notice and obtain the response in writing. Do not assume that the reserved seat will be protected automatically.

Can a parent attend Bihar BEd CET 2026 reporting instead of the candidate?

Do not assume so. Candidate presence, signatures or identity checks may be required. Read the reporting instruction and contact the allotted college before sending anyone in the candidate’s place.
