title: NEET PG 2026 Post-Exam Normalization Score Breakdown: Evaluating Multi-Shift Percentile Calculations and Specialty Cutoff Shifts
description: A comprehensive analysis of NEET PG 2026 multi-shift score normalization, percentile calculations, and expected clinical specialty cutoff shifts.
content:
With the conclusion of the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduate (NEET PG) 2026, medical graduates across India are turning their focus to score evaluations, percentile calculations, and counseling strategies. Conducting the examination across multi-shift sessions necessitates a robust post-exam normalization process to ensure equity among test-takers who faced varying difficulty levels across different question papers.

Understanding the Multi-Shift Normalization Process

When competitive entrance examinations are administered across multiple time slots, raw marks cannot serve as the sole criterion for rank generation. The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) uses standard percentile-based normalization formulas to bring scores from different sessions onto a uniform scale.

Instead of comparing absolute raw marks, the multi-shift normalization model evaluates a candidate's performance relative to all other test-takers within the exact same session. This mitigates any advantage or disadvantage resulting from minor fluctuations in session difficulty.

How Percentile Scores Are Calculated

A candidate's percentile rank reflects the proportion of examinees in that specific session who scored equal to or lower than that candidate. The general mathematical representation for percentile in a shift is:

Percentile = (Number of candidates in a session with raw score equal to or less than the candidate / Total number of candidates in that session) × 100

Key points regarding percentile determination include:

  • Top Score Alignment: The highest scorer in each shift receives a 100th percentile, regardless of their actual raw mark.
  • Resolution of Ties: Specific tie-breaking criteria are applied if candidates secure identical percentiles, prioritizing fewer incorrect responses, higher marks in specific subject sections, or age seniority as dictated by official guidelines.
  • Merging Sessions: Once percentiles are determined for all individual shifts, the data sets are merged to generate an all-India merit rank list.

Evaluating Specialty Cutoff Shifts for Medical Streams

With normalized percentiles dictating the final merit order, candidates must evaluate how cutoff ranks translate to post-graduate seat allotment across clinical, non-clinical, and para-clinical specialties.

High-Demand Clinical Specialties

Specialties such as Radio-diagnosis, Dermatology, General Medicine, and Pediatrics consistently attract top-tier ranks. Normalization stabilizes raw mark variations, meaning admission thresholds for these streams remain strictly tied to narrow percentile bands (typically above the 98th percentile for open seats in premier government institutions).

Surgical and Intermediate Clinical Branches

Fields including General Surgery, Orthopedics, Obstetrics and Gynecology, and Ophthalmology usually observe moderate cutoff movements. Factors influencing these shifts include:

  • Changes in the total number of recognized MD/MS and DNB seats available for seat matrix pooling.
  • State quota distribution ratios and seat retention rules.
  • Shift in candidate preferences toward sub-specialty pathways and hospital infrastructure quality.

Para-Clinical and Pre-Clinical Disciplines

Disciplines like Pathology, Pharmacology, Anesthesiology, and Microbiology generally display wider percentile ranges. Lower raw score requirements after normalization allow candidates across broader rank brackets to secure clinical or academic seats.

Recommended Action Plan for Aspirants and Parents

Navigating the post-exam phase requires structured planning prior to the commencement of Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) registration and state-level counseling rounds.

  1. Analyze Historical Rank Ranges: Examine opening and closing ranks from prior allotment years rather than relying strictly on raw score predictions.
  2. Verify Official Documents: Ensure internship completion certificates, medical council registration, and category certificates meet standard formatting and validity timelines.
  3. Track Official Bulletins: Regularly check the official NBEMS portal (natboard.edu.in and nbe.edu.in) and the official MCC website for seat matrix updates, counseling schedules, and official percentile notifications.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is score normalization in NEET PG 2026?

Score normalization is a mathematical process used in multi-shift examinations to account for variations in paper difficulty, ensuring candidates across all shifts are evaluated on an equal scale using percentile ranks.

How does normalization affect raw scores?

Raw scores are converted into percentile ranks based on candidate performance within a specific shift. Final merit ranks depend on these normalized percentiles rather than direct raw marks.

Why do cutoff ranks for clinical branches change every year?

Cutoff ranks shift due to changes in total candidate volume, variations in seat matrix availability, introducing new DNB or MD/MS seats, and evolving candidate branch preferences.

Where can candidates verify official NEET PG results and counseling schedules?

Candidates must rely exclusively on the official NBEMS portal (natboard.edu.in) for scorecards and the Medical Counselling Committee website (mcc.nic.in) for counseling details.

title: A Practical Guide to College-Specific Scholarship Portals: How to Find, Compare, and Apply for India’s Region-Wise Grants
description: Navigate India’s region-wise scholarship portals with clarity. This guide explains where to find India-centric college scholarships, how to compare offers, and how to prepare compelling applications for students and parents.
content:
Why scholarship portals matter for Indian students

Region-specific grants are designed to support students from diverse states and union territories. They can cover tuition, living costs, and books, making higher education more accessible. Accessing the right portal early helps families align application timelines with college deadlines and eligibility rules.

Where to begin: identifying the right portals

Start with official government portals and state education departments, which often curate scholarship lists for local students. Look for portals associated with central schemes that offer state-level variations. When you search, focus on two questions: Is the grant targeted to state or district level? Does it require a specific course, income threshold, or reservation category?

  • State merit grants: Typically awarded to high performers in state boards or entrance tests, with emphasis on domicile status.
  • District and municipal schemes: Often support first‑generation learners or economically disadvantaged families.
  • Course-specific options: Some portals prioritize particular streams such as engineering, technology, or teacher education.

How to compare scholarships across portals

Use a simple framework to compare offers side by side. Create a data sheet with these fields for each scholarship:

  • Maximum award amount and whether it’s per year or for the entire course
  • Eligible courses and institutions
  • Residency and domicile requirements
  • Income criteria and family assets considerations
  • Renewal conditions and required performance benchmarks
  • Submission deadlines and required documents

Many portals publish lists with eligibility notes. If the information isn’t explicit, check the official notification or contact the administering department. Do not rely on secondary summaries alone.

Documentation and common eligibility criteria

Most scholarships require:

  • Proof of domicile and identity documents
  • Academic records or entrance test results
  • Income certificates or family income tax details
  • Bank details and sometimes caste or category certificates
  • Statement of purpose or essays for some schemes

Keep digital and physical copies organized. Create a master file with versions of documents and a checklist for each portal to track submission status and deadlines.

Best practices for applying through portal-specific processes

Follow these steps to optimize each application:

  • Read the notification thoroughly and note the exact eligibility and deadlines.
  • Prepare a standardized but adaptable application package that can be reused with portal-specific tweaks.
  • Fill forms carefully, double-checking spellings of names and bank details.
  • Attach all required documents in the specified format and size.
  • Submit well before the deadline and capture the confirmation receipt.

How to manage region-wise decisions

Region-wise grants can differ in eligibility and renewal conditions. Some may require minimum academic performance, while others emphasize financial need. In states with large student populations, the demand often exceeds the supply of awards. Have a backup plan by applying to multiple schemes and preparing alternate documents if needed.

Tips for parents: supporting, not pressuring

Parents can assist by helping students organize timelines, verify deadlines, and ensure the student maintains eligible status across years. Avoid pressuring for haste; instead, encourage careful preparation, verified information, and careful reading of official guidelines.

Crucial reminders for reliable information

Always verify details on the relevant official authority’s website. Portal content may be updated, and rules can change with new年度 announcements. If you encounter conflicting information, contact the administering office directly for clarification before submitting any application.

Frequently asked questions

FAQ 1: How do I know if a scholarship is region-specific?

Region-specific scholarships target students from particular states or districts. Check the eligibility section on the official notification and confirm domicile requirements and area-based criteria on the agency’s site.

FAQ 2: Can I apply to more than one region-specific scholarship?

Yes, if you meet each scheme’s eligibility. Maintain separate application materials and deadlines for each portal to avoid confusion.

FAQ 3: What documents are commonly required for region-specific grants?

Common documents include identity proof, domicile certificates, income certificates, academic transcripts, bank details, and sometimes category certificates. Prepare these in advance in both scanned and original formats if required.

FAQ 4: How should I track application status across multiple portals?

Maintain a centralized tracker with portal login details, submission dates, and status updates. Set reminders for renewal deadlines if the scholarship is renewable.

FAQ 5: What if I miss a deadline?

Missing a deadline can disqualify a scholarship. If a portal offers a grace period, use it only if officially permitted. For most region-specific grants, late submissions are not accepted, so plan ahead.

Sample strategy to maximize region-wise aid

1) List all state and district portals relevant to your region. 2) From each portal, extract the exact eligibility and required documents. 3) Create a consolidated document pack with copies and scans. 4) Prioritize schemes with higher awards and broader eligibility, while ensuring you meet renewal criteria. 5) Prepare a robust statement of purpose or motivation letter if requested. 6) Apply early and confirm receipt of all submissions.

Conclusion: turning portals into a practical plan

Region-wise scholarship portals offer tangible support for Indian students pursuing diverse paths. A disciplined approach-identify the right portals, compare offers with a clean data sheet, gather required documents, and apply ahead of deadlines-turns potential funding into real outcomes. Keep track of changes announced by official authorities, and verify details before acting.

This content contains structured guidance for navigating India’s region-specific scholarship portals. For accuracy, always consult the relevant official authority site on eligibility, timelines, and documentation.

title: SRMJEEE 2027 Registration Open: ₹1,400 Per Phase and Key Dates
description: SRMJEEE 2027 applications are open. Compare the two phase deadlines and exam dates, understand the ₹1,400 fee per phase and keep track of your submission.
content:
SRMJEEE 2027 registration is open on SRM’s official BTech application portal. The application costs ₹1,400 for each phase, so decide which attempt you want before paying. You may apply for Phase 1, Phase 2 or both; taking both is optional.

Phase 1 applications close on 2 April 2027, ahead of the examinations on 17 and 18 April. Phase 2 applications close on 4 June 2027, with examinations on 19 and 20 June. Keep the application deadline separate from the test dates when planning your preparation.

Two phases, two application deadlines

SRM’s official 2027 schedule lists the following dates. The document does not specify a closing time for applications, so do not assume you can wait until a particular hour on the final day.

SRMJEEE 2027 phase

Application deadline

Examination dates

Phase 1

2 April 2027

17 and 18 April 2027

Phase 2

4 June 2027

19 and 20 June 2027

SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Important Dates for SRMJEEE (UG) 2027. This schedule is undated. Read the original official PDF.

Budget for the attempt you select

The university’s SRMJEEE 2027 FAQ document sets the application fee at ₹1,400 per phase and states that it is non-refundable. At that rate, applying for both phases means ₹2,800 in application fees. This is the entrance application cost, not the tuition or admission fee for a BTech seat.

SRM lists online payment through debit card, credit card, UPI and net banking. Check the selected phase and the amount displayed in your account before authorising payment, then keep the acknowledgement.

Complete the form through the official portal

Use the SRM BTech and integrated MTech application portal. It identifies the application as the 2027 cycle and provides separate registration and existing-user login options.

  1. Register with your name, email address, mobile number and the location details requested on the form.

  2. Choose the relevant faculty, degree and programme, and complete the account-verification instructions.

  3. Enter the academic and personal details requested in the application. The official FAQ identifies a photograph and signature as the images to upload.

  4. Review the phase choice, pay the required application fee and complete the submission steps shown in your account.

  5. Save the application reference and payment record. Return to the same account for further instructions.

Before paying, read the official 2027-28 eligibility document linked by the portal. Subject requirements depend on the programme. Our guide to Mathematics and PCB eligibility routes can help you identify which rules to examine.

If payment is pending or a detail needs correction

SRM’s FAQ advises applicants whose payment status remains pending to wait 24 hours or raise a request under the dashboard’s Payment queries category. Check the existing transaction before attempting another payment.

For a form error, the same document directs applicants to the form Correction query category. Raise the issue through your application account and follow the response rather than assuming every submitted field can be edited directly.

Registration does not book an exam slot

The official FAQ describes SRMJEEE 2027 as a centre-based test. It says candidates can choose a slot when slot booking opens and then obtain their hall ticket. Completing the application now is a separate step from booking that slot.

Course and campus preferences entered in the application are also different from the choices made during counselling. SRM says the actual preference selection takes place at counselling, based on rank and seat availability. A submitted application does not guarantee a particular branch or campus.

title: JEE Main Photo Rejection: What Applicants Must Fix Before Submission
description: Learn how to inspect your JEE Main application photograph, identity details and final preview before submission to avoid preventable registration trouble.
content:
A rejected JEE Main application photograph can leave you scrambling during correction windows and may create questions during admit-card or identity checks. Before you submit, inspect the image, match every personal detail with your documents and review the complete application preview on the JEE Main portal.

The National Testing Agency runs JEE Main, so the current application notice and upload instructions on the official JEE Main website should decide the final format and file requirements. Do not rely on an old screenshot or a coaching-centre checklist.

What should you check in the JEE Main application photograph?

Your photograph should be recent, clearly visible and free from anything that makes identification difficult. A technically accepted upload can still become a problem if your face looks unclear or the image does not match your present appearance.

  • Use a clear, front-facing image with your full face visible.
  • Choose even lighting. Shadows across the eyes, forehead or cheeks can reduce clarity.
  • Keep the background plain and avoid filters, beauty effects, heavy editing or cropped group photos.
  • Remove sunglasses, caps and anything else that hides facial features, unless the current NTA instructions permit an exception.
  • Open the uploaded file after saving it. Check that it is not blurred, stretched, upside down or cut at the chin.

File size, dimensions, format and any live-photo or identity-image rules can change between application cycles. Check the 2027 instructions displayed during registration rather than copying requirements from an earlier JEE Main session.

Does the photograph match your identity details?

Photo checks are only half the job. Read your name, date of birth, parents' names and identification details beside the documents you plan to carry later. One spelling difference may force a correction request or create confusion at verification.

  1. Keep the identity document beside you while entering details.
  2. Match initials, spacing and surname spelling exactly where the form asks for them.
  3. Check that the selected category, gender, nationality and PwD-related fields, if applicable, reflect your supporting documents.
  4. Ask a parent to read the final screen aloud. Fresh eyes catch errors students miss after a long form.

Use the final preview as a hard stop

Don’t rush to payment or final submission because the upload box shows a green tick. Save the preview or print it, then inspect the photograph, personal details, exam city choices and uploaded documents line by line. If the portal shows a confirmation page, keep its application number and download it immediately.

For more exam application decisions, see our guide to comparing entrance exams. The sensible rule is simple: submit only when the image is readable, the identity details match and the final preview has been checked by one other person.

title: KNRUHS Telangana NEET UG 2026 Web Options: Priority List, Seat Matrix, and Choice Locking Rules
description: Comprehensive guide for Telangana NEET UG 2026 web options phase under KNRUHS. Learn how to analyze seat matrix, rank your college priority list, and follow choice locking rules for MBBS and BDS admissions.
content:
Securing an MBBS or BDS seat in Telangana requires strategic planning beyond a strong NEET UG score. Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, conducts the centralized web-based counseling for medical seats across government and private institutions in the state. The web options phase is the most critical stage of this admission cycle, as seat allotment depends entirely on your NEET merit rank and the college preferences you submit online.

Understanding the seat matrix, constructing a logical priority list, and adhering to strict choice locking regulations will maximize your chances of securing a medical college seat aligned with your rank.

Understanding the KNRUHS Telangana Seat Matrix 2026

Before entering web options on the official portal, candidates and parents must thoroughly study the published seat matrix. KNRUHS categorizes seat distribution across multiple quotas to ensure clear allocation based on merit and state rules.

1. Competent Authority Quota (Category A)

Category A seats comprise 100 percent of seats in government medical and dental colleges, along with 50 percent of total intake in private non-minority and minority medical colleges. These seats carry standard government-regulated fee structures and are restricted to eligible local candidates, with a 15 percent unreserved quota open to non-local applicants based on merit eligibility.

2. Management Quota (Category B)

Private self-financing medical colleges reserve 35 percent of their total intake for Management Quota applicants. Candidates from all Indian states are eligible to apply under Category B, subject to registration under the separate KNRUHS Management Quota notification.

3. NRI Quota (Category C)

The remaining 15 percent of seats in private institutions fall under Category C (NRI Quota). Admissions to these seats follow specific eligibility criteria and financial documentation guidelines issued by the university.

Step-by-Step Web Options Submission Process

KNRUHS releases a dedicated web options link on its official website during each counseling round. Follow these steps to complete the choice submission safely:

  1. Login Credentials: Access the candidate portal using your NEET Roll Number, Telangana State Rank, registration number, and OTP sent to your registered mobile number.
  2. College List Selection: Select the medical and dental colleges from the master list displayed on your dashboard.
  3. Arranging Options: Move colleges up or down to set your preferred order of choice. Priority number 1 represents your highest preference.
  4. Previewing Options: Review the filled choices thoroughly to verify college names, code codes, and seat categories.
  5. Saving and Locking: Save your choices periodically. You must lock your choices before the deadline. Unlocked saved choices automatically lock when the portal closes.

How to Build an Effective College Priority List

The seat allotment system processes options in sequential numerical order. If a seat is available in your highest listed preference at your rank, it will be allotted immediately without checking lower preferences. Therefore, ordering your priority list requires careful tactical planning.

Top-Tier Aspirations First

Place top-tier government medical colleges (such as Osmania Medical College, Gandhi Medical College, and Kakatiya Medical College) at the very top of your list if you qualify for Category A seats. Always place your dream institutions first, regardless of cutoff projections, because the allotment algorithm evaluates options from top to bottom.

Mid-Range Realistic Choices

Include established peripheral government institutions and reputable private medical colleges in the middle of your priority list. Base these selections on past opening and closing rank trends released by KNRUHS for your specific reservation category.

Safety Colleges at the Bottom

Always list newer government colleges or private institutions with acceptable fee structures toward the end of your options list. Omitting realistic choices due to overconfidence can result in no seat allotment during Round 1.

Crucial KNRUHS Choice Locking Rules and Guidelines

Candidates must strictly adhere to university rules during the web options phase to protect their admission rights throughout the counseling rounds:

  • Mandatory Round 1 Web Option Rule: Candidates who do not exercise web options in Round 1 under Competent Authority Quota may become ineligible to participate in subsequent rounds of counseling for that category. Always fill options in the initial round.
  • No Restriction on Option Count: Candidates can select an unlimited number of available colleges within their eligible quota. Selecting maximum choices reduces the risk of non-allotment.
  • Free Exit Policy Rules: KNRUHS specifies free exit deadlines after Round 1 seat allotment. If a candidate is allotted a seat but fails to join or resigns after the deadline, strict penalty provisions apply, including forfeiture of university fees and exclusion from further counseling.
  • Upgradation Option: Joining an allotted college in Round 1 is mandatory to remain eligible for sliding or upgradation to a higher preference college in Round 2.

Checklist for Parents and Students Before Final Submission

Before submitting and generating the final option printout, cross-check these crucial points:

  • Verify that fee structures for private colleges under Management Quota align with your budget before adding them to your preference list.
  • Ensure minority institutions (Muslim or Christian minority medical colleges) are prioritized accurately according to your category status.
  • Check that college codes match the exact institution intended, as similar institution names can lead to errors.
  • Download, print, and securely archive the final locked options summary sheet containing the timestamp and candidate details.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can I modify my web options after saving them?

Yes, you can modify and re-order saved options as many times as needed before the official deadline. However, once options are locked or the deadline passes, no changes can be made.

What happens if I do not lock my options before the portal closes?

The portal automatically locks the last saved preference list when the specified deadline expires. However, candidates are strongly advised to lock choices manually and print the confirmation page.

Is it compulsory to join the allotted college in Round 1?

Yes, if you wish to participate in Round 2 for upgradation, you must report to the Round 1 allotted college, complete document verification, and pay the administrative fees as per KNRUHS rules.

Where can I verify official cutoffs and notifications?

Candidates and parents should verify all seat matrix details, fee updates, and detailed notification circulars directly on the official KNRUHS university portal.

title: Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2026: DMER Round 1 Registration Begins, Check Eligibility and Document Verification Schedule
description: DMER Haryana has started Round 1 registration for Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2026. Read our complete guide on eligibility rules, registration process, and physical document verification schedule for MBBS and BDS seats.
content:
The Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DMER), Haryana has officially commenced the Round 1 registration process for Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2026. Medical and dental aspirants looking for admissions to MBBS and BDS courses in Haryana's government, government-aided, and private medical colleges can now apply online. This centralized state-level counselling handles 85% of state quota seats, while the Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) manages the remaining 15% All India Quota (AIQ) seats.

With registration portals active, candidates must understand the eligibility rules, key registration dates, and the mandatory physical document verification phase to secure their seats. Below is a comprehensive walkthrough of the entire admission process.

Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2026: Quick Overview

Before diving into the step-by-step registration, here is a quick snapshot of the ongoing Haryana NEET UG counselling session:

Counselling Event Details
Conducting Authority Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DMER), Haryana
Admission Portal Official DMER Haryana Admission Website
Core Courses Offered MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) & BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery)
Entrance Exam Required Qualified in National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) 2026
Counselling Type Online Registration followed by Physical Document Verification

Important Dates & Tentative Schedule

To avoid missing crucial cut-offs, candidates must keep track of the official dates released by the DMER Haryana counselling committee. While registration typically starts in mid-August, the precise timeline for key events is detailed below:

  • Online Registration & Choice Filling Window: Active now for Round 1
  • Release of Provisional Merit List: To be declared shortly after registration closes
  • Grievance Redressal Window: 2 days following the merit list declaration
  • Final Seat Allotment Results: To be updated dynamically
  • Physical Document Verification (at Pt. B.D. Sharma UHS, Rohtak): Scheduled post-seat allotment

State Quota Eligibility Rules

To qualify for the 85% state quota seats during the Haryana NEET UG Counselling 2026, aspirants must fulfill the following state-specific eligibility parameters:

1. Domicile Requirements

Candidates must be bona fide residents of Haryana. To claim state quota benefits, a candidate must meet one of the following criteria:

  • The candidate's parents must have resided in Haryana for a continuous period of at least 15 years, or
  • The candidate must have completed their schooling (Class 10 to Class 12) from a recognized educational institution situated in Haryana.

2. Academic Qualifications

Candidates must have passed Class 12 (or equivalent examination) with Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English as core subjects. General category candidates need a minimum aggregate of 50% marks in the science subjects, while SC/BC candidates require 40%.

3. Minimum NEET Cut-off Percentile

Only candidates who have secured the minimum qualifying percentile in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) 2026 are eligible to register. This includes the 50th percentile for General, 45th for General-PH, and 40th for SC/ST/OBC categories.

Step-by-Step DMER Haryana Round 1 Registration Guide

Registering correctly is vital to ensure your candidature is not rejected during the scrutiny phase. Follow these steps to complete your online form on the official DMER Haryana admission portal:

Step 1: Fresh Registration

Visit the official DMER Haryana counselling portal. Click on the 'New Registration' tab. You will be prompted to enter your NEET UG 2026 Roll Number and Application Number to retrieve your scores automatically. Enter a valid mobile number and email ID to generate your unique login credentials.

Step 2: Uploading Mandatory Documents

Log in with your newly generated user ID and password. Fill out your personal details, academic background, and reserve category details (if applicable). Next, upload scanned copies of your signature, recent passport-sized photograph, and necessary certificates in the specified format and size.

Step 3: Paying the Registration Fee

Pay the non-refundable counselling registration fee through the integrated online gateway (using net banking, credit card, or debit card). The standard registration fee structure is as follows:

  • General / Unreserved Category: INR 4,000
  • SC / BC / EWS Categories: INR 1,000
  • NRI Candidates: INR 10,000

Step 4: Choice Filling and Locking

Once the registration fee is processed, access the choice-filling module. Select your preferred medical and dental colleges from the available list. Prioritize your choices carefully. Once satisfied, save and lock your preferences before the specified deadline. If you fail to lock them manually, the system will automatically lock the last saved choices.

Physical Document Verification Process

Unlike many other states that conduct online document verification, Haryana follows a mandatory offline verification process. After the provisional seat allotment list is released, candidates must report physically for verification. This process is generally held at Pt. B.D. Sharma University of Health Sciences (UHS), Rohtak.

Candidates must bring one set of self-attested photocopies along with the following original documents:

  • NEET UG 2026 Admit Card and Result Card
  • Class 10 and Class 12 Marksheets and Passing Certificates
  • Haryana Resident / Domicile Certificate (if applicable)
  • Category Certificate (SC/BC-A/BC-B/EWS/PWD/ESM) issued by a competent authority
  • Character Certificate from the last attended school or college
  • Copy of Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Passport for identity proof
  • Four recent passport-sized photographs (matching the ones uploaded in the application form)

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: Can non-Haryana residents apply for medical seats in Haryana?

Non-Haryana residents are generally eligible to apply under the Management Quota seats in private medical colleges. However, the 85% State Quota seats in government and government-aided colleges are strictly reserved for eligible Haryana domicile candidates.

Q2: Is physical verification compulsory for all rounds of Haryana NEET counselling?

Yes, any candidate allotted a seat in any round must undergo physical document verification at the designated venue (usually Pt. B.D. Sharma UHS, Rohtak) before they can finalize their admission and pay the college tuition fees.

Q3: What happens if I do not lock my choices during registration?

If you fail to lock your college choices before the deadline, the system will automatically lock your last saved preferences. However, it is highly recommended to review and lock your choices manually to avoid unexpected allocation outcomes.

Q4: Can I upgrade my seat in Round 2 if I secure a seat in Round 1?

Yes, candidates who are allotted a seat in Round 1 can opt for upgradation in Round 2 by expressing their willingness online through the DMER portal and participating in the subsequent choice-filling round.

title: East Coast Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026: 1,599 Vacancies, Seat Matrix, and Selection Process
description: Comprehensive guide to the East Coast Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026 covering 1,599 trade vacancies, unit-wise seat matrix, eligibility criteria, and merit selection rules.
content:
Overview of East Coast Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026

The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC) of the East Coast Railway (ECoR) has released its official notification for Act Apprentice training for the 2026 academic year. A total of 1,599 seats are available across various divisions and workshops situated in Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Chhattisgarh. This apprentice drive provides Class 10 and ITI pass-outs with practical technical training inside Indian Railways establishments.

Apprenticeship training in Indian Railways helps ITI certificate holders gain real-world industrial exposure. Candidates who complete this one-year training earn a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC), which offers significant preference in future Railway Level-1 (Group D) recruitment drives.

Division and Unit-Wise Vacancy Breakup

The 1,599 vacancies are spread across major operating divisions and repair workshops of the East Coast Railway zone. Candidates must select their preferred unit during the online registration process.

  • Carriage Repair Workshop, Mancheswar (Bhubaneswar): Approx. 300+ seats focusing on coach maintenance, fitting, welding, and electrical systems.
  • Khurda Road Division: Around 350+ seats allocated across loco sheds, carriage workshops, and track maintenance units.
  • Waltair Division (Visakhapatnam): Over 500+ seats spanning diesel loco sheds, electric loco sheds, and railway workshops.
  • Sambalpur Division: Over 400+ seats covering various technical maintenance trades.

Trade allocations within these units include high-demand disciplines such as Fitter, Electrician, Welder (Gas & Electric), Machinist, Wireman, Carpenter, Sheet Metal Worker, Painter (General), Mechanic Motor Vehicle, and Computer Operator and Programming Assistant (COPA).

Eligibility Criteria: Education, ITI Trades, and Age Limit

Candidates planning to register for the East Coast Railway Apprentice 2026 recruitment must satisfy specific educational and age parameters before submitting their application.

Educational Qualifications

Applicants must have completed Class 10 (Matriculation) under the 10+2 education system with a minimum of 50 percent aggregate marks from a recognized educational board. Additionally, candidates must possess a National Trade Certificate (NTC) or State Trade Certificate (STC) in the relevant trade issued by NCVT or SCVT.

Age Criteria and Relaxations

The standard age limit guidelines for applicants are outlined below:

  • Minimum Age: Candidates must have completed 15 years of age.
  • Maximum Age: Candidates should not have completed 24 years of age as of the specified cut-off date.
  • Upper Age Relaxation: SC/ST candidates receive up to 5 years relaxation, OBC candidates receive 3 years, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) receive up to 10 years upper age relaxation.

Merit-Based Selection Process Explained

Selection for the East Coast Railway Apprentice training is strictly based on academic merit. There is no written examination, viva-voce, or oral interview conducted by the recruitment cell.

The merit list is formulated by taking the simple average of marks obtained in two examinations:

  1. Percentage of marks obtained in Class 10 (Matriculation) with a minimum threshold of 50 percent.
  2. Percentage of marks obtained in the relevant ITI trade course.

Both components carry equal weightage (50% each) in preparing the final trade-wise and community-wise merit list. Candidates shortlisted on merit are subsequently invited for Document Verification (DV) and a mandatory Medical Fitness examination at designated railway medical centers.

Stipend and Duration of Training

Selected candidates undergo engagement as Act Apprentices for a period of one year. During this training phase, apprentices receive a monthly stipend as prescribed under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and rules set by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship. The training does not constitute an offer of employment or guarantee direct absorption into permanent railway service.

Steps to Apply for East Coast Railway Apprentice 2026

Applications are accepted exclusively through the official East Coast Railway online recruitment portal. Follow these standard steps to complete your registration:

  1. Visit the official RRC East Coast Railway website and navigate to the Apprentice 2026 recruitment section.
  2. Complete the basic registration with a valid email address and active mobile number.
  3. Fill out personal details, educational qualifications, and ITI marks accurately.
  4. Select your preferred division or workshop unit and trade preference.
  5. Upload scanned copies of required documents including Class 10 mark sheet, ITI certificate, category certificate, photo, and signature.
  6. Pay the non-refundable application fee (exempted for female applicants, SC/ST, and PwBD candidates).
  7. Submit the application form and download a printed copy for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is there a written test for East Coast Railway Apprentice Recruitment 2026?

No, there is no written examination or interview. Selection is made purely on a merit list calculated from Class 10 and ITI marks.

What is the minimum qualification required to apply?

Candidates must have passed Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks along with an ITI certificate (NCVT or SCVT) in the trade applied for.

Can candidates awaiting ITI final results apply?

No, applicants must possess the final National Trade Certificate or National Council for Vocational Training mark sheet at the time of online application submission.

Does completing this apprenticeship guarantee a job in Indian Railways?

No, apprenticeship training provides course completion certificates. However, candidates holding this certificate get reserved quotas and concessions in future Railway Level-1 direct recruitment examinations.

title: State Open Schooling vs NIOS: Recognition, Higher Education Eligibility, and Exam Regulations
description: Comprehensive comparison of State Open Schooling (SOS) and National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) covering recognition, higher education eligibility, exam regulations, and entrance exam acceptance.
content:
Flexible learning through open schooling has gained significant momentum across India, serving diverse student requirements. Whether preparing for national competitive exams, balancing sports or creative pursuits, or resuming discontinued studies, distance education offers a viable pathway. Students and parents frequently evaluate two main routes: the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) and State Open Schooling (SOS) boards operating under individual state governments, such as BBOSE in Bihar or MPSOS in Madhya Pradesh. Understanding their recognition, university eligibility, and exam regulations helps learners make an informed decision.

Recognition and Institutional Framework

Both NIOS and State Open Schools aim to provide accessible secondary and senior secondary education, but their administrative scope and jurisdictional authority differ.

National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)

Established as an autonomous institution under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, NIOS is a central board. Its Senior Secondary (Class 12) and Secondary (Class 10) certificates hold national validity, at par with CBSE and CISCE. It is a recognized member of the Council of Boards of School Education (COBSE).

State Open Schooling (SOS)

State Open Boards are established under the acts or departments of respective state education boards. These boards primarily cater to students within their home states. Recognition depends on whether the specific State Open Board is recognized by COBSE and approved by the respective State Education Department.

Higher Education and Entrance Exam Eligibility

One of the primary concerns for parents and candidates is whether open school qualifications permit entry into higher education institutions and national competitive examinations.

  • Competitive Exams (JEE Main, NEET UG, CUET): The National Testing Agency (NTA) accepts senior secondary passouts from NIOS for entrance tests like JEE Main, NEET UG, and CUET UG, provided the student meets subject-combination and percentage criteria. State Open School candidates are also eligible if their specific state board is listed under COBSE and recognized by regulatory bodies.
  • University Admissions: Central universities, state public universities, and deemed institutions accept NIOS certificates nationwide. For State Open School students, admission acceptance is generally smooth within the home state public universities. However, outside the home state, acceptance depends on the target university recognition list. Students must verify admission guidelines directly on the official portal of their target university.
  • International Studies: NIOS certificates are widely acknowledged by foreign credential evaluation agencies and international universities. Conversely, State Open School certificates may require extra verification or apostille services for overseas education admissions.

Exam Regulations, Flexibility, and Evaluation Rules

The operational mechanisms of examination and credit systems vary significantly between central and state open boards.

Examination Cycles and On-Demand Testing

NIOS conducts nationwide public examinations twice a year, typically in April-May and October-November. Additionally, NIOS offers an On-Demand Examination System (ODES), allowing students to appear for tests when they feel prepared, subject to seat availability at designated examination centers. State Open Boards generally operate on fixed bi-annual public examination schedules linked to the state board calendar and rarely offer full-scale on-demand testing.

Transfer of Credit (TOC)

Both systems provide Transfer of Credit (TOC) facilities for ex-students of formal boards who failed or dropped out. Under TOC rules, marks of up to two passed subjects can be transferred from recognized formal boards. NIOS maintains a standardized national TOC policy, whereas State Open Boards enforce TOC rules specific to their regional formal state boards.

Key Differences: NIOS vs State Open Schooling

FeatureNational Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)State Open Schooling (SOS)
Governing BodyMinistry of Education, Government of IndiaRespective State Education Board / Department
JurisdictionAll-India and Overseas Study CentersState-specific Jurisdiction
COBSE RecognitionFully Recognized NationallyVaries by Board (Requires individual verification)
Exam FlexibilityPublic Exams and On-Demand Exam SystemScheduled Public Exams (Bi-annual)
Medium of InstructionEnglish, Hindi, and Regional LanguagesRegional State Language and English/Hindi

Which Board Should You Choose?

Selecting the right open board depends on individual career goals, geographic mobility, and language preference.

Choose NIOS if you plan to compete in national entrance exams, relocate across states, apply to foreign universities, or need flexible examination dates through On-Demand testing.

Choose State Open Schooling if you prefer studying in your regional state language, intend to pursue higher studies or state government employment within your native state, and prefer local study centers situated nearby.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is an NIOS Class 12 passing certificate valid for NEET and JEE?

Yes. NIOS Class 12 qualifications are recognized by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for entrance exams such as NEET UG and JEE Main, provided candidates fulfill subject and marks criteria.

Are State Open School certificates recognized across all Indian states?

Recognition varies. While many State Open Schools are listed with COBSE, candidates applying outside their home state should verify acceptance policies on the target institution or state authority website.

Can I transfer marks from a regular CBSE board to NIOS or SOS?

Yes, both NIOS and SOS offer Transfer of Credit (TOC) for up to two subjects passed in regular boards like CBSE or State Boards, subject to board regulations.

title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1: Should You Choose the Early Attempt?
description: A practical decision guide for choosing JEE Main 2027 Session 1 or waiting for Session 2, based on preparation, boards and revision readiness.
content:
JEE Main 2027 Session 1 can give you an early performance check, but it can also expose unfinished preparation at the worst time. Choose it if your syllabus, mock-test practice and board-exam plan are under control. If major chapters are still untouched, waiting for Session 2 may protect your score and your confidence.

The two-session format gives eligible candidates more than one route through the exam cycle. Your job isn’t to appear early just because the option exists. First, check the current notice on the official JEE Main website for the confirmed schedule, registration conditions and attempt-related rules.

Who should seriously consider Session 1?

Session 1 suits a student who has completed most of the Class 11 and 12 syllabus and can already solve mixed-topic questions under time pressure. It’s also useful if you want an early reality check before changing your preparation plan.

  • You have revised the main formulas, reactions and concepts at least once.
  • Your recent full-length mocks show stable performance, not one lucky high score.
  • You can spare exam-week time without wrecking practicals, school tests or board preparation.
  • You’ll review mistakes after the exam instead of treating the result as a final judgement.

For these students, Session 1 isn’t a wasted attempt. It becomes a live diagnostic. A weak Physics chapter or repeated calculation error can then be fixed before Session 2.

When is waiting for Session 2 the smarter choice?

Don’t rush into the early attempt if large parts of Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry remain unread. Sitting for an exam without a revision base may consume travel time, money and emotional energy while giving you little useful feedback.

Board exams change the calculation too. If your school schedule peaks around the same period, forcing JEE Main preparation into already crowded weeks can damage both targets. A student still building fundamentals should use the extra preparation window for chapter tests, error logs and timed numerical sets rather than chasing an early score.

Use this decision test before registering

  1. Take one full JEE Main-style mock in exam conditions.
  2. Separate mistakes into concept gaps, forgotten formulas and time-management errors.
  3. Ask whether you can repair the biggest two problem areas before Session 1.
  4. Make a fixed Session 2 plan even if you appear in Session 1.

If your mock is uneven but your errors are identifiable, Session 1 can still help. If you are guessing across entire units, wait and build the base first. For subject-wise resources, see these JEE Main study materials, and compare other routes through engineering entrance exams before locking your plan.

title: Google 27th Birthday: From Backrub to Google | First Logo Doodle Celebration
description: Google celebrated its 27th birthday with a special doodle featuring its first logo. Discover how Google started as “Backrub” and evolved into the world’s biggest search engine.
content:
With its official 27th birthday, tech behemoth Google is commemorating almost 30 years of revolutionizing how people connect, search, and learn. Users were taken on a nostalgic journey back to the beginning when Google unveiled a special doodle with its original logo to commemorate the milestone. However, did you realize that Google wasn't always known by that name? Let's examine its intriguing beginnings.

Google’s Original Name – “Backrub”

Google was formerly known as \"Backrub\" before it became the most popular search engine in the world. Its founders, Larry Page and Sergey Brin, came up with the name in 1996 while they were conducting research at Stanford University. Backrub's premise, which was groundbreaking at the time, was to evaluate a web page's \"back links\" to ascertain its rating and relevancy.

But as the project expanded, the founders saw that they needed a name that more accurately reflected their goal, which was to organize the vast amount of online information available worldwide. Inspired by the mathematics word \"Googol\"—one followed by 100 zeros—\"Google\" was born at that point. It accurately represented their goal of indexing all of the internet's information.

Quick Facts About Google’s Journey

Fact Details
Original Name Backrub
Founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin
Founded Year 1998
Original Project Started 1996 at Stanford University
Inspired By The term “Googol” (1 followed by 100 zeros)
Headquarters Mountain View, California, USA
Current CEO (2025) Sundar Pichai

Celebrating 27 Years of Innovation

More than merely a celebration, Google's 27th birthday doodle serves as a reminder that creativity can begin with a straightforward concept. With products like Search, Gmail, Android, YouTube, and AI-powered tools, Google has grown from a small dorm room experiment to a global tech giant that continues to influence the direction of technology.

Conclusion

The journey from Backrub to Google represents imagination, ingenuity, and foresight. As the business marks its 27th anniversary, it's not just about how far technology has advanced; it's also about how Google keeps changing the way we communicate with the outside world.

title: NEET PG 2026: How to Compare Government and Private Seat Costs
description: Compare the real three-year cost of government and private NEET PG seats, including tuition, hostel charges, deposits, service bonds and exit exposure.
content:
A government NEET PG seat usually costs less in tuition, but it may still carry hostel charges, deposits, service obligations or resignation costs. A private seat can demand a far larger loan from the first year. During NEET PG counselling, compare the full three-year financial exposure, not just the headline fee.

What changes the real cost of a NEET PG seat?

The responsible counselling authority and the individual college decide the payable fee, refund terms and bond conditions. The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences handles the NEET PG examination notices through its official website, while seat-specific payment and joining rules come from the relevant counselling and college documents.

Cost or obligationWhat to checkFinancial consequence
TuitionYear-wise amount and course durationSets the family contribution or loan size
Hostel and messWhether residence is compulsory and billed separatelyRaises the annual living budget
DepositRefund date, deductions and forfeiture clauseBlocks cash at admission
Service bondService period, posting terms and breach amountCan limit job choices or create a payment liability
Exit costResignation, upgrade and refund conditionsMay make leaving after joining expensive

How can you calculate the safer option?

Prepare one sheet for every seat you may accept. Record the amount payable before joining, the yearly charges and the worst-case cost of leaving. Treat a bond as financial exposure even when no money is collected on admission.

  1. Add tuition, hostel, mess, university charges, examination fees, equipment and expected travel for all years.
  2. Mark each payment as refundable, partly refundable or non-refundable, based on written terms.
  3. Record the bond period, service location, breach amount and any stated document or undertaking.
  4. For a private seat, test the loan EMI against delayed income after residency, not an optimistic salary estimate.
  5. Compare the total with your family’s available cash and borrowing limit.

Which seat should you lock?

Pick the government seat when its service terms fit your career plan and the upfront charges are manageable. Consider a private seat only when the complete fee schedule, refund policy and bond terms are available in writing. A low-fee seat can become costly if you cannot meet its service obligation. A high-fee seat can create years of repayment pressure.

Before payment, save the fee notice for the relevant 2026 counselling round and obtain the college breakup in writing. If a rule, amount or exit clause is unclear, pause the choice and verify it with the responsible counselling authority.

title: उत्तराखंड नर्सिंग 2026: रिजल्ट, अंतिम उत्तर कुंजी और सीट आवंटन
description: उत्तराखंड नर्सिंग का रिजल्ट और अंतिम उत्तर कुंजी कहां देखें? रैंक को प्रवेश मानने से पहले अलग काउंसलिंग रिकॉर्ड और रिपोर्टिंग निर्देश जांचें।
content:
उत्तराखंड नर्सिंग में प्रवेश के लिए अपना परीक्षा परिणाम और काउंसलिंग का सीट आवंटन अलग-अलग जांचें। 2026 के प्रवेश परीक्षा पोर्टल पर कोर्स के अनुसार परिणाम और उत्तर कुंजियां हैं। काउंसलिंग पोर्टल पर राउंड के अनुसार आवंटन मिलता है। सिर्फ अंक या रैंक आने से किसी कॉलेज में प्रवेश पक्का नहीं होता।

अपने कोर्स का रिजल्ट कैसे निकालें

HNBUMU की वेबसाइट से Nursing/Paramedical Entrance Examinations 2026 का लिंक खोलें। प्रवेश परीक्षा पोर्टल के Result मेन्यू में अपना कोर्स चुनें। BSc Nursing, Post Basic Nursing, MSc Nursing, ANM और GNM के अलग विकल्प हैं। पैरामेडिकल पाठ्यक्रम भी अलग दिए गए हैं।

विश्वविद्यालय की 18 जुलाई 2026 की परिणाम सूचना के अनुसार अभ्यर्थी 20 जुलाई 2026 से अपने लॉगिन द्वारा स्कोर या रैंक कार्ड डाउनलोड कर सकते थे। यह जुलाई की घोषणा है, अक्टूबर में नया परिणाम जारी होने की सूचना नहीं। डाउनलोड की गई प्रति आवेदन और काउंसलिंग दस्तावेजों के साथ रखें।

HNBUMU की 18 जुलाई 2026 की परिणाम सूचना। इसमें जुलाई की तारीखें हैं; इसे नई काउंसलिंग समय-सारणी न मानें। मूल आधिकारिक सूचना

सूची में सिर्फ नाम के बजाय रोल नंबर और कोर्स से मिलान करें। मोबाइल पर PDF खाली दिखे तो डाउनलोड करके PDF रीडर में खोजें। परिणाम निकालने का दावा करने वाले किसी व्यक्ति को लॉगिन जानकारी या OTP न दें।

अंतिम उत्तर कुंजी और आपत्ति की समय-सीमा

परीक्षा पोर्टल के Answer Key मेन्यू से सही कोर्स चुनें। उत्तर मिलाने से पहले प्रश्नपत्र का सेट जांचें। जुलाई की सूचना में औपबंधिक परिणाम के साथ अंतिम उत्तर कुंजियां प्रदर्शित किए जाने की जानकारी है।

पुरानी आपत्ति सुविधा को अभी खुला न मानें। परिणाम पर प्रत्यावेदन की अंतिम तारीख 22 जुलाई 2026, शाम 5 बजे थी और यह बीत चुकी है। सूचना की PDF अब भी दिखने का मतलब आपत्ति की अवधि दोबारा खुलना नहीं है।

कॉलेज जाने से पहले काउंसलिंग रिकॉर्ड देखें

आधिकारिक नर्सिंग और पैरामेडिकल काउंसलिंग पोर्टल पर कोर्स के अनुसार राउंड 3 की औपबंधिक ब्रॉड शीट और प्रवेश प्रक्रिया की अलग सूचनाएं हैं। अपने व्यक्तिगत रिकॉर्ड के लिए Applicant Login खोलें और उसी राउंड के निर्देश पढ़ें।

नई स्ट्रे-वैकेंसी रिपोर्टिंग समय-सारणी की यहां पुष्टि नहीं है। अगले राउंड के खुले होने का दावा मिले तो विश्वविद्यालय की तारीख वाली सूचना और उससे संबंधित आवंटन रिकॉर्ड देखें। केवल वायरल स्क्रीनशॉट के आधार पर यात्रा या कॉलेज को भुगतान न करें।

  • अपने आवंटन में कोर्स और कॉलेज की पुष्टि करें।

  • संबंधित प्रवेश सूचना में रिपोर्टिंग की तारीखें देखें।

  • मांगे गए दस्तावेजों का अपने मूल प्रमाणपत्रों से मिलान करें।

  • भुगतान की व्यवस्था से पहले कॉलेजवार आधिकारिक फीस देखें।

  • पूरे किए गए प्रवेश चरण की पावती संभालें।

परीक्षा परिणाम और काउंसलिंग रिकॉर्ड में अंतर हो तो आधिकारिक पोर्टल से विश्वविद्यालय को कोर्स, राउंड और अंतर बताएं। अगला कदम वर्तमान प्रवेश निर्देशों के अनुसार लें, किसी पुरानी रिजल्ट सूचना की तारीख के आधार पर नहीं।

title: Odisha NEET UG 2026 Revised Final Merit List: Which PDF to Check
description: OJEE now lists a revised final state merit list for Odisha MBBS and BDS admissions after stray-vacancy registration. If you downloaded the earlier final list, open the revised version and check your details again before relying on your rank.
content:
Odisha Joint Entrance Examination (OJEE) has placed a revised final state merit list for MBBS and BDS admission 2026-27 on its official site. The medical notices page still shows the earlier final list separately. That distinction matters: a saved copy of the first PDF may not be the latest version for the stray-vacancy stage.

The official list is labelled as being after stray-vacancy round registration. OJEE's page confirms publication of a revised file, but it does not explain every change in its listing. Do not assume that your rank, category or eligibility changed until you compare your own entry in the current PDF.

Find the current Odisha merit-list PDF

Go to OJEE Medical Notices and look for the notice headed “Revised Final State Merit List for MBBS / BDS Admission 2026-27 (After Stray Vacancy Round Registration).” Open the View link from that item. The page also carries an older “Final State Merit List” entry, so check the word “Revised” before downloading.

Search the PDF using the identifier shown for your application, then check your name, NEET details, state rank and category against your own records. If you find a mismatch, use the official OJEE contact instructions for the counselling process. Avoid forwarding screenshots that include another candidate's personal details.

A merit-list entry is not a seat allotment

The merit list tells candidates where they stand in the state counselling record. It is not an admission letter. OJEE separately publishes allotment and reporting notices, and a candidate must follow the instructions applicable to the round and college concerned. Check the official MBBS/BDS counselling page for those documents rather than inferring a reporting deadline from the merit-list PDF.

For candidates dealing with the current stray-vacancy upgradation stage, OJEE's urgent notice dated 22 October 2026 sets a 6 pm, 23 October reporting deadline for newly allotted candidates. That instruction applies to the group named in the notice, not automatically to everyone in the merit list. Verify your individual allotment and follow the official directions if you are affected.

What to keep together

Save the revised PDF and your application acknowledgement, then keep any allotment order, payment proof and reporting communication in the same folder. If you are unsure which quota applies to you, our NEET quota checklist can help frame the question, but OJEE's current rules remain decisive.

title: CLAT Previous-Year Question Papers: Official Access and Cost
description: The Consortium lists previous-year CLAT question papers at Rs 500, separate from the application fee. Check the paper package before paying for preparation material.
content:
Previous-year CLAT question papers carry a separate Rs 500 charge under the Consortium's CLAT 2027 application instructions. The paper cost is not included in the examination application fee. Before paying, check that you are selecting preparation material for the correct programme and understand what the package contains.

The amount is stated in the Application Fee section of the official CLAT 2027 instructions. That page does not list every included examination year or promise worked explanations. Do not assume that a paper package contains detailed solutions merely because another website describes it that way.

Start from the official candidate portal

Open the CLAT 2027 website and use its candidate login. Check the previous-year-paper option and the terms displayed in your account before making a payment. This is separate from downloading an admit card or looking up an old result.

If you have already paid for papers, return to the same account and check the access or payment status before paying again. Keep the receipt and any transaction reference. Where the account does not explain how to obtain the material, use the helpdesk contact published on the official portal and describe the issue without sharing your password.

There is no need to give another person access to your application account just to obtain a study PDF. Keep login details private, even if someone offers to organise your preparation material for you.

A question paper, answer key and scorecard serve different purposes

A question paper gives you the passages and questions to attempt. An answer key lets you compare responses, but it is not necessarily a set of worked solutions. A scorecard records an individual candidate's result; it is not a question-paper download.

The Consortium's previous-year scorecard page is specifically for results. If you reach that page while looking for practice questions, return to the relevant paper-access option instead of trying to retrieve someone else's scorecard.

Match the answer key to the exact paper

Before marking an attempt, note the examination year, UG or PG programme, and booklet series. Keep the paper and its matching key in the same folder. If a later official answer-key revision applies to that paper, use it instead of continuing with an earlier key.

A mismatch can make a correct attempt look wrong and send your revision in the wrong direction. Where no verified matching key is available, separate the questions you can resolve confidently from those that still need checking rather than assigning yourself a definitive score.

Practise for the current format, not just the old paper

The official CLAT 2027 UG format specifies 120 questions in two hours, with one mark for a correct answer and a deduction of 0.25 for an incorrect answer. Older material should be used with its own structure in mind, not automatically treated as a full simulation of the current test.

For a timed attempt, put away the answer key until you finish. Mark the questions that took too long, as well as those you got wrong. Afterwards, distinguish a missed fact from a passage you misread or an inference you could not justify. Those problems need different follow-up practice.

Buy material you will actually review

A large folder of papers is less useful than a smaller set you attempt and analyse properly. Before buying another package, check whether you have reviewed the papers already available to you. Keep a short note of the errors that recur, then revisit those questions after a gap without looking at the earlier answer.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ (ਕੋਡ 414) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ
ਜਮਾਤ 10: Apparel41425 ਫਰਵਰੀ 202710:30 - 12:302 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 5: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 414 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਪਹਿਰਾਵਾ (414) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਤ (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: CEED 2027 में स्क्राइब: Part A की सहायता और अतिरिक्त समय का अनुरोध
description: CEED 2027 में स्क्राइब और अतिरिक्त समय के लिए आवेदन के साथ सही दस्तावेज दें। Part B की सीमा, Appendix 11 और नई पंजीकरण तारीखें समझें।
content:
CEED 2027 में स्क्राइब की जरूरत है तो आवेदन भरते समय ही अनुरोध करें। IIT Bombay यह सहायता Part A के लिए देता है। Part B आपको स्क्राइब के बिना स्वयं हल करना होगा। तैयारी और परीक्षा की व्यवस्था इसी अंतर को ध्यान में रखकर करें।

सहायता किस हिस्से के लिए है

आधिकारिक CEED वेबसाइट के अनुसार Part A कंप्यूटर पर होता है, जबकि Part B में उत्तर लिखने और चित्र बनाने होते हैं। अनुरोध में अपनी जरूरत स्पष्ट करें; पूरी परीक्षा में एक जैसी सहायता मिलने का अनुमान न लगाएं।

IIT Bombay, CEED 2027 पंजीकरण निर्देश। वेबसाइट का अंश 31 अक्टूबर 2026 को लिया गया; इस अनुच्छेद की अलग जारी तारीख नहीं है। आधिकारिक निर्देश पढ़ें.

पंजीकरण के साथ सही फॉर्म दें

1 अक्टूबर की सूचना पुस्तिका का खंड 1.7.1 प्रक्रिया बताता है। पंजीकरण फॉर्म में सहायता का विकल्प चुनें और दिव्यांगता के समर्थन में दस्तावेज अपलोड करें। स्क्राइब और/या प्रतिपूरक समय के अनुरोध का प्रारूप Appendix 11 में है। प्रतिपूरक समय 20 मिनट प्रति घंटा बताया गया है। Part A और Part B का अतिरिक्त समय एक-दूसरे में स्थानांतरित नहीं किया जा सकता।

जहां अतिरिक्त प्रमाणपत्र जरूरी हो, वहां Appendix 10 लागू होता है। अपनी श्रेणी और दस्तावेजों के अनुसार प्रमाणपत्र संबंधी प्रावधान पढ़ें; सभी दिव्यांगता श्रेणियों को एक जैसा न मानें। IIT Bombay ने आधिकारिक प्रमाणपत्र और अनुरोध के प्रारूप साथ दिए हैं।

स्क्राइब की व्यवस्था कौन करेगा

CEED कार्यालय अनुरोध और सहायक दस्तावेजों की जांच करता है तथा जरूरत होने पर ईमेल से आगे के निर्देश भेज सकता है। पात्र अभ्यर्थी परीक्षा केंद्र के पैनल से स्क्राइब चुनते हैं, आम तौर पर परीक्षा से एक दिन पहले। अपना स्क्राइब साथ लाने की अनुमति नहीं है।

भरे हुए अनुरोध की प्रति रखें और पंजीकरण वाले ईमेल खाते को देखते रहें। किसी निर्देश या प्रमाणपत्र को लेकर संदेह हो तो जमा करने से पहले ceed@iitb.ac.in पर CEED कार्यालय से पूछें। निर्धारित परिशिष्ट की जगह सामान्य ऑनलाइन नमूना न लगाएं।

बढ़ी हुई तारीखों का सही उपयोग करें

IIT Bombay के 31 अक्टूबर के अपडेट के अनुसार नियमित शुल्क के साथ पंजीकरण 5 नवंबर 2026 तक और विलंब शुल्क के साथ 10 नवंबर, शाम 5 बजे तक है। तारीख बढ़ने से सहायता के अनुरोध की शर्तें नहीं हटतीं। दोनों अवधियों के लिए UCEED और CEED की संशोधित अंतिम तारीखों की जानकारी देखें।

title: UGC NET ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 2026: ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳ ಶುಲ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1ರವರೆಗೆ ಅವಕಾಶ
description: ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ UGC NET ಅರ್ಜಿಯ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1 ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:50ರವರೆಗೆ ಪಾವತಿಸಬಹುದು. ಹೊಸ ನೋಂದಣಿ, ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿತ್ರ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ.
content:
UGC NET ಡಿಸೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ಅರ್ಜಿಯನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿಸಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗದವರಿಗೆ, ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಪಾವತಿಗಾಗಿ NTA 1 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:50ರವರೆಗೆ ಸಮಯ ನೀಡಿದೆ. ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿರುವ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಈ ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ದಿನ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಹೊಸ ನೋಂದಣಿ, ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆ ಅಥವಾ ಚಿತ್ರಗಳ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1ರ NTA ಸೂಚನೆಯ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಇವು ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31ರ ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:50ಕ್ಕೆ ಮುಗಿದಿವೆ. ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಕರಡು ಅರ್ಜಿಯನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಜಿಯೆಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಅವಧಿ ಯಾರಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?

ಹಿಂದಿನ ಗಡುವಿನೊಳಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ದರೂ ಪಾವತಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗದವರಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೂ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಈಗಿನ ಖಾತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅರ್ಜಿಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಸೂಚನೆ ಓದಿ.

ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ, 1 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026ರ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸೂಚನೆ. ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಸೂಚನೆ ಓದಿ.

ಪಾವತಿಯ ನಂತರ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಪುಟ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ UGC NET ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ನ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮೂಲಕ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿ. ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಲ್ಕ ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗಿ ದಾಖಲಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಎಂದು ನೋಡಿ. ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಜಿಗೆ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಬಾಕಿ ಇದ್ದರೆ, ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:50ರ ಗಡುವಿಗಿಂತ ಮುಂಚಿತವಾಗಿಯೇ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಪಾವತಿ ವಿಧಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ UGC NET ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್.

ಯಶಸ್ವಿ ಪಾವತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಸೃಷ್ಟಿಯಾಗುವ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವಂತೆ NTA ತಿಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಅದನ್ನು ವಹಿವಾಟಿನ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇರಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆಯಿಂದ ಹಣ ಕಡಿತವಾದ ಸಂದೇಶವು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾದರೂ, ಅದರಿಂದಲೇ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸದೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

ಪಾವತಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ವಹಿವಾಟಿನ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಂಡು ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ನ ಸಹಾಯವಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ. ಬಾಕಿ ಇರುವ ವಹಿವಾಟು ಪ್ರಕಟಿತ ಗಡುವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ವಿಸ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಇತರ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಇಲ್ಲ

ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳ ಇತರ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ಹೊಸ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅರ್ಜಿ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ತಿದ್ದುವ ಅವಕಾಶ ಘೋಷಿಸಿಲ್ಲ. ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಗಾಗಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು, ಅನುಮತಿಸಲಾದ ವಿವರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನಂತರದ NTA ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ. UGC NET ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅನುಮತಿಸಲಾದ ವಿವರಗಳು.

ಶುಲ್ಕ ದೃಢಪಟ್ಟ ನಂತರ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಪುಟ ಉಳಿಸಿ, ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಮುಂದಿನ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್ ಗಮನಿಸುತ್ತಿರಿ.

title: CAT ಹಳೆಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳು: ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಿಂದ ಮುಂದಿನ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ ಯೋಜನೆ ರೂಪಿಸಿ
description: CAT ಹಳೆಯ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಜ್ಞಾನದ ಕೊರತೆ, ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ತಪ್ಪು ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯದ ಬಳಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಅಂಕ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ಪರ್ಸೆಂಟೈಲ್ ಅಲ್ಲ.
content:
ಹಳೆಯ CAT ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಮುಂದೇನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂಬುದನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿದಾಗ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ ನಂತರ ಅಂಕವನ್ನು ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕಿಟ್ಟು ಕೇಳಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ: ಯಾವ ಉತ್ತರ ತಪ್ಪಾಯಿತು, ಪರಿಹರಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿರಿ, ಪ್ರಗತಿಯಿಲ್ಲದೆ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಯ ಕಳೆಯಿತು?

ಟೈಮರ್ ಆರಂಭಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ

ವರ್ಷ, ಅವಧಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಮೂಲವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ. ಅದು ಮೂಲ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಮರುಮುದ್ರಣವೇ, ನೆನಪಿನ ಆಧಾರದ ಮರುರಚನೆಯೇ ಅಥವಾ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಸೆಟ್‌ವೇ ಎಂದು ನೋಡಿ. ಮರುರಚಿತ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪದಗಳು ತಪ್ಪಿರಬಹುದು. ಪ್ರಕಾಶಕರ ಪರಿಹಾರ ತಾನಾಗಿಯೇ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಉತ್ತರವಲ್ಲ.

ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸುವಾಗ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೀ ಮುಚ್ಚಿಡಿ. ಚಿತ್ರ, ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಅಥವಾ ಪಠ್ಯ ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಗದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಎಂದು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ; ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಯ ವಿಫಲತೆ ಎಂದು ಎಣಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತ CAT ತಾಣ ನೋಡಿ. ಹಳೆಯ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಈ ವರ್ಷದ ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಯಲ್ಲ.

ವಿಷಯಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ

ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿದ ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಟ್ಟ ಎರಡೂ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬಹುದಾಗಿದ್ದ ಪ್ರತಿ ನಷ್ಟಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕಾರಣ ಕೊಟ್ಟರೆ ಮುಂದಿನ ಕ್ರಮ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

ಏನಾಯಿತು

ಮುಂದಿನ ಕ್ರಮ

ವಿಧಾನ ತಿಳಿದಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ

ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಓದಿ, ಕೆಲವು ಹೋಲುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ.

ವಿಧಾನ ತಿಳಿದಿದ್ದರೂ ಲೆಕ್ಕ ಅಥವಾ ಓದಿನಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪು

ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ತಪ್ಪು ಆರಂಭವಾದ ಹಂತ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ.

ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಮಯ ಕಳೆದ ಬಳಿಕ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿರಿ

ಮುಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಗಲು ಸೂಚಿಸಬೇಕಾಗಿದ್ದ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಗುರುತು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ.

ನಂತರ ಬಿಡಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟಿರಿ

ಆ ವಿಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಆಯ್ದ ವಿಧಾನ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

ವಾಚನ ಗ್ರಹಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ದ ಉತ್ತರ ಏಕೆ ಸರಿಯೆನಿಸಿತು, ಪಠ್ಯದ ಯಾವ ಭಾಗ ಅದನ್ನು ನಿರಾಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ. ತಾರ್ಕಿಕ ಸೆಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆರಂಭದ ಜೋಡಣೆ ತಪ್ಪಿತ್ತೇ ಅಥವಾ ನಂತರದ ನಿರ್ಣಯ ತಪ್ಪಿತ್ತೇ ನೋಡಿ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಪರಿಹಾರ ನಕಲು ಮಾಡುವುದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಇದು ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ.

ಉತ್ತರ ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳದೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ

ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಅಂತರದ ನಂತರ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಕೆಲವೇ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ. ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ನೋಡದೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿ. ಉತ್ತರ ನೆನಪಿದ್ದರೂ ವಿಧಾನ ವಿವರಿಸಲಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದೇ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯದ ಬೇರೆ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬಳಸಿ.

ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯ ಗುರುತು, ತಪ್ಪಿನ ವಿಧ, ಸರಿಪಡಿಸುವ ಕ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮರುಪ್ರಯತ್ನದ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ. ಕೊನೆಯ ವಾಕ್ಯದ ಷರತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಿದರೆ ಓದುವ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಬೇಕು, ಸಂಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲದ ಇಡೀ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯಲ್ಲ.

ಅಂಕ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ, ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ಮುನ್ಸೂಚನೆಯಲ್ಲ

ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿ, ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಪರಿಚಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉತ್ತರದ ಮೂಲ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶಕ್ಕೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರುತ್ತವೆ. ಮನೆಯ ಒಂದೇ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಅಂಕವು ಮುಂದಿನ CAT ಪರ್ಸೆಂಟೈಲ್ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಆಯ್ಕೆಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆಗುವ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕೆಲಸ ನೆರವಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆಯೇ ನೋಡಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಧ್ಯಯನದ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯಿಂದ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಸೂಚನೆ ದೃಢಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ನಂತರ CAT ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ದಾಖಲೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು. ವಿಂಗಡಿಸದ PDF ರಾಶಿಗಿಂತ ನಾಳೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಕಾದ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಯೋಜನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮುಗಿಸಿ.

title: Class 12 IP Project Ideas: Python, Pandas and SQL for 2026-27
description: Choose a manageable Class 12 Informatics Practices project with useful data, clear analysis and charts. See original topic ideas, a file plan and viva preparation.
content:
A good Class 12 IP project starts with a question you can answer using data. Choose a topic small enough to build yourself, then show how you cleaned the data, analysed it and explained the result. A working project you understand is more useful than a long downloaded file you cannot demonstrate.

The CBSE Informatics Practices syllabus for 2026-27 asks for a useful IT application based on a real-world problem. It allows analysis of CSV or database data with Python libraries and suitable charts. For Class 12, project work carries 5 marks within the 30-mark practical assessment; viva voce carries a separate 5 marks.

Five project ideas you can keep manageable

These are suggested starting points, not a board-approved topic list. Discuss the scope with your teacher before collecting data.

1. School canteen demand

Question: which items sell most on different days? Use a small dataset with date, item, quantity and price. Calculate item-wise sales, check for missing entries and compare demand with a labelled bar chart. Use sample data if the canteen cannot share records, and clearly label it as simulated.

2. Library borrowing patterns

Question: which book categories are borrowed most? Work with book category, issue date and return date. Summarise borrowing by month and identify overdue durations. Use anonymous record IDs instead of student names; the analysis does not need personal contact details.

3. Household electricity use

Question: how does monthly electricity consumption change? Record billing month and units consumed from bills you have permission to use. Plot units over time and discuss unusual changes. Keep tariff calculations outside your scope unless you can explain the applicable rules accurately.

4. A small shop’s stock movement

Question: which products need attention because sales are high or stock is low? Create product and sales tables, use SQL to retrieve the records you need and compare categories in Python. Start with a few products and a clear date range rather than trying to build a complete billing system.

5. Daily temperature patterns

Question: how does temperature vary across a selected month? Use a public dataset with a stated source and units. Check missing dates, calculate summary values and draw a line chart. Describe observed patterns; this analysis is not a weather forecast.

Build a small version before adding features

  1. Write one question and identify the columns needed to answer it.

  2. Prepare a small CSV or database table and explain each field.

  3. Check missing values, duplicate records and inconsistent units.

  4. Run the analysis and create a chart with a readable title and axis labels.

  5. Test the result on a few rows you can calculate manually.

  6. Write what the result shows and what the dataset cannot tell you.

Keep an unchanged copy of the original data. If you correct or remove a record, note why. That makes your analysis easier to explain and repeat.

What to put in your project file

Follow your school’s required cover-page and certificate format. For the main report, a useful order is: problem, dataset and source, tools, cleaning decisions, code, outputs, findings, limitations and references. This is a suggested structure, not a compulsory CBSE page template.

Reference any borrowed data, images or code. The syllabus permits individual work or groups of two to three students. In a group, keep a short record of each member’s contribution and make sure everyone can explain the complete result.

Prepare to explain your own work

Practise answering why you selected a chart, how you treated a missing value and what a SQL query returns. Then change one input row and explain what should happen to the output. A business plan or accounting file becomes an IP project only when the computing and data work is clearly demonstrated; a topic name alone does not satisfy that purpose.

Keep revision of theory and practical work moving together. For board-examination planning, see the CBSE 2027 date-sheet guide.

title: OUAT 2027 ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ Form A ਅਤੇ Form B ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸਮਝੋ
description: OUAT 2027 ਦੇ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਹੈ। ਪਿਛਲੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੇ ਦੋ ਫਾਰਮ, ਅੰਕ ਭਰਨ ਦੇ ਨਿਯਮ ਅਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
OUAT ਵਿੱਚ 2027 ਦੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ਜਾਂ ਲਿੰਕ ਉੱਤੇ ਭਰੋਸਾ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਨਵੀਂ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਕਰੋ। ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅੰਡਰਗ੍ਰੈਜੂਏਟ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਚੱਕਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਲਈ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇਣਾ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਕੰਮ ਸਨ।

ਦੋ ਫਾਰਮ ਕਿਉਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਸਨ?

2026-27 ਦੇ ਅੰਡਰਗ੍ਰੈਜੂਏਟ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਵਿੱਚ Form A ਅਤੇ Form B ਦੋਵੇਂ ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਸਨ। Form A ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਸੀ। Form B ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਅੰਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਦੇ ਦਾਅਵਿਆਂ ਸਮੇਤ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਲਈ ਵਾਧੂ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਦੇਣੀ ਸੀ।

ਆਮ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਵਾਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਲਈ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਨੇ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਬਾਵਜੂਦ Form B ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਾ ਕਰਵਾਉਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਰੈਂਕ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਲਈ ਯੋਗ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ। ਇਹ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਤ ਹੈ, 2027 ਦਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਐਲਾਨਿਆ ਨਿਯਮ ਨਹੀਂ। ਨਵਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਆਉਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੇਖੋ ਕਿ ਇਹੋ ਪੜਾਅ ਲਾਗੂ ਹਨ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਇੱਕ ਦੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਲਿਖੋ। ਹੇਠਲੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ਾਂ ਵੀ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ 2026 ਚੱਕਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ।

ਅੰਕ-ਪੱਤਰ ਵੇਖ ਕੇ ਹੀ ਅੰਕ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ

ਪਿਛਲੇ Form B ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਸਵੀਂ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਰ੍ਹਵੀਂ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਕ, ਵਾਧੂ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਧੂ ਚੋਣਵੇਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਸਮੇਤ, ਮੰਗੇ ਗਏ ਸਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਚੁਣੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਪੰਜ ਜਾਂ ਛੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਹਿਸਾਬ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਸੀ। ਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੋਰਡਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਦੋ ਸਾਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਕ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਬੋਰਡਾਂ ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਸਨ।

ਅਸਲ ਅੰਕ-ਪੱਤਰ ਕੋਲ ਰੱਖ ਕੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ, ਕੁੱਲ ਅੰਕ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਅੰਕ ਸਾਫ਼ ਲਿਖੋ। ਗ੍ਰੇਡ ਹੋਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਵਿਧੀ ਵੇਖੋ। ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਨਾ ਕੱਢੋ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਾਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਇੱਥੇ ਨਾ ਦੁਹਰਾਓ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਹਨ

2026 ਦੇ Form A ਵਿੱਚ ਭੌਤਿਕ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਅਤੇ ਰਸਾਇਣ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਗਣਿਤ ਜਾਂ ਜੀਵ ਵਿਗਿਆਨ ਨੂੰ ਚੋਣਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਚੁਣਨਾ ਸੀ। ਇਸ ਚੋਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਵੀ ਸੀ। 2027 ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਿਰਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪਸੰਦੀਦਾ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਯੋਗਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

ਪਸੰਦੀਦਾ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੈਂਪਸਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਬਾਰ੍ਹਵੀਂ ਦੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਚੁਣਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੀ ਲਾਜ਼ਮੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਯੋਗਤਾ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ।

ਸੂਚਨਾ ਆਉਣ ਤੱਕ ਕੀ ਤਿਆਰ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਹੈ?

  • ਅਜਿਹਾ ਈਮੇਲ ਅਤੇ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਨੰਬਰ ਰੱਖੋ ਜੋ ਸਾਰੀ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਵਰਤ ਸਕੋ।
  • ਪੜ੍ਹਨਯੋਗ ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਕਰਕੇ ਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ਮਿਲਾਓ।
  • ਰਾਖਵੇਂ ਜਾਂ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕੋਟੇ ਦੇ ਦਾਅਵੇ ਲਈ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਪਛਾਣੋ।
  • ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਹਰ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਫਾਰਮ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ।

ਨਵੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਧਾਂ ਲਈ OUAT ਦਾ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੰਨਾ ਵੇਖੋ। 2026 ਦੀ ਫੀਸ, ਕਟਆਫ਼, ਸੀਟਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਜਾਂ ਕਾਊਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ਨੂੰ 2027 ਦੀ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੱਕ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਦੀ ਗੁੰਜਾਇਸ਼ ਰੱਖੋ।
