title: IIT BHU SAMARTH Portal Registration: Speed Post Hard-Copy Submission Rules and Non-Teaching Screening Criteria
description: Comprehensive guide to IIT BHU SAMARTH portal online registration, hard-copy Speed Post submission guidelines, document verification, and non-teaching post screening criteria.
content:
Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi invites applications for various non-teaching administrative and technical posts. Candidates must navigate a two-tier process involving online registration on the SAMARTH portal followed by mandatory hard-copy submission via Speed Post. Missing physical submission deadlines or submitting incomplete documents will lead to immediate application rejection.

Understanding the SAMARTH Portal Online Registration Process

The SAMARTH recruitment portal serves as the centralized platform for candidate registration, application filling, fee payment, and document upload for IIT BHU recruitment drives. Applicants must ensure all details entered match their official certificates precisely.

  • Account Creation: Register using a valid email ID and active mobile number to receive login credentials and official updates.
  • Profile Completion: Fill in personal details, educational qualifications, work experience, and category certificates accurately.
  • Document Upload: Upload scanned copies of photographs, signatures, mark sheets, and category proofs following the specified file format and size limits.
  • Fee Payment: Pay the required application fee online through the integrated payment gateway before generating the final application PDF.

Mandatory Speed Post Hard-Copy Submission Rules

Completing the online registration on the SAMARTH portal is only the first step. IIT BHU mandates that candidates print, sign, and mail their completed application forms along with all supporting document self-attestations.

Key Guidelines for Physical Application Dispatch

  1. Printout of Online Form: Download and print the finalized SAMARTH application form containing the system-generated application number.
  2. Self-Attested Enclosures: Attach self-attested photocopies of Class 10th certificate (proof of age), degree certificates, mark sheets for all semesters, experience certificates, salary slips, and caste or category certificates.
  3. Envelope Super-scription: Clearly write "Application for the post of [Post Name] - Post Code [Code]" on top of the physical envelope.
  4. Postal Mode: Send the entire application package strictly via Speed Post or Registered Post to the designated recruitment cell address at IIT BHU Varanasi. Submissions through private couriers or hand delivery are generally not accepted.
  5. Deadline Compliance: The physical hard copy must reach the recruitment office by the specified cutoff date. Postal delays are not accepted as valid grounds for extension.

IIT BHU Non-Teaching Post Screening Criteria

Due to the high volume of applications received through the SAMARTH portal, IIT BHU applies strict screening criteria to shortlist candidates for written examinations, skill tests, or interviews.

  • Essential Qualification Verification: Certificates are vetted to ensure the candidate meets minimum educational percentage criteria from recognized institutions.
  • Relevant Experience Calculation: Work experience is calculated strictly up to the closing date of online registration. Only experience in relevant pay levels, reputed academic institutions, government organizations, or established private firms is counted.
  • Age Limit & Relaxation Rules: Age is calculated as of the last date of online application. Category-based age relaxations apply according to Government of India rules upon submission of valid valid format certificates.
  • NOC Requirement: Candidates currently employed in Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Bodies, or PSUs must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) or send their hard copy through proper channel.

Essential Checklist for IIT BHU Recruitment Candidates

Before mailing your application packet, review this final verification checklist:

  • Is the online form successfully submitted on the SAMARTH portal with fee payment confirmed?
  • Are all pages of the printed application form signed by hand?
  • Are all attached document photocopies self-attested?
  • Is the envelope properly super-scribed with the targeted post name and code?
  • Have you dispatched the envelope using India Post Speed Post service well in advance of the hard-copy deadline?

Frequently Asked Questions

Is online registration on the SAMARTH portal sufficient for IIT BHU recruitment?

No, submitting the online application on the SAMARTH portal is not sufficient. Candidates must print the completed online form, attach all self-attested supporting documents, and send them to IIT BHU via Speed Post or Registered Post before the physical submission deadline.

What happens if my hard copy reaches IIT BHU after the deadline?

Applications received after the specified physical submission deadline are rejected automatically, regardless of when the online portal form was submitted or dispatched. Candidates are advised to post their applications early.

How is work experience calculated for non-teaching screening at IIT BHU?

Work experience is calculated up to the last date of online portal registration. The experience must be relevant to the post applied for and backed by valid service certificates specifying post designation, pay scale, and exact employment duration.

Do I need to submit an NOC if I am currently working in a government department?

Yes, candidates serving in Central or State Government, Autonomous Bodies, or PSUs must provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer or submit their hard-copy application through proper channel.

Can I send my hard-copy application via private courier services?

IIT BHU guidelines typically mandate sending hard copies strictly via India Post Speed Post or Registered Post. Private courier deliveries or hand submissions are generally not entertained. Verify official notifications for specific mode rules.

title: UGC NET ডিসেম্বর 2026 ফর্ম সংশোধন: তারিখ ও তথ্য যাচাই
description: ফর্ম সংশোধনের সময় 2 থেকে 4 নভেম্বর নির্ধারিত। কোন তথ্য বদলানো যাবে, কী প্রমাণ রাখবেন এবং 31 অক্টোবরের আবেদনসীমা আলাদা করে বুঝুন।
content:
UGC NET ডিসেম্বর 2026-এর ফর্মে ভুল হয়েছে? NTA-র তথ্যপুস্তিকা অনুযায়ী অনলাইন সংশোধন 2 থেকে 4 নভেম্বর 2026-এর জন্য নির্ধারিত। শেষ দিন রাত 11:50-এ সময় শেষ হবে। সংশোধনের সুযোগ এখনও চালু হওয়ার অপেক্ষায়। এখন জমা দেওয়া ফর্মের সঙ্গে শংসাপত্র মিলিয়ে দেখুন এবং কোন তথ্য ঠিক করতে হবে তা লিখে রাখুন।

সব তথ্য পরিবর্তনের সুযোগ থাকবে না

সরকারি তথ্যপুস্তিকা অনুযায়ী NTA অনুমতি দেওয়া তথ্যেই পরিবর্তন করা যাবে। নাম, ছবি, যোগাযোগের তথ্য বা অন্য কোনও ঘর নিজে থেকেই সম্পাদনযোগ্য হবে বলে ধরে নেবেন না। প্রার্থী পোর্টালে সংশ্লিষ্ট তথ্যের নির্দেশ এবং উপলব্ধ বিকল্প অনুসরণ করুন।

সরকারি তথ্যপুস্তিকা

বর্তমান তথ্য, সঠিক তথ্য এবং তার প্রমাণ হিসেবে থাকা নথির একটি ছোট তালিকা তৈরি করুন। সংশোধন চালু হলে এই স্পষ্ট তালিকা দ্রুত ফর্ম যাচাই করতে সাহায্য করবে।

আবেদন জমা ও সংশোধনের সময় আলাদা

27 অক্টোবরের মেয়াদ বৃদ্ধির বিজ্ঞপ্তি অনুযায়ী আবেদন জমা এবং সফল ফি পরিশোধ 31 অক্টোবর রাত 11:50 পর্যন্ত বিলম্ব ফি ছাড়াই করা যাবে। তথ্যপুস্তিকার অন্য শর্ত অপরিবর্তিত। পরবর্তী সংশোধনের সময় অসম্পূর্ণ আবেদন জমা দেওয়ার বাড়তি সুযোগ নয়।

27 অক্টোবরের মেয়াদ বৃদ্ধির বিজ্ঞপ্তি

তথ্যপুস্তিকায় সংশোধনের সময় 2 থেকে 4 নভেম্বর এবং শেষ সময় রাত 11:50 দেওয়া আছে। পরবর্তী বিজ্ঞপ্তি ও প্রার্থী লগইনের জন্য সরকারি UGC NET ওয়েবসাইট ব্যবহার করুন।

সরকারি UGC NET ওয়েবসাইট

NTA UGC NET ডিসেম্বর 2026 তথ্যপুস্তিকা, মুদ্রিত পৃষ্ঠা 4: নির্ধারিত অনলাইন সংশোধনের সময়। সরকারি তথ্যপুস্তিকা

সংরক্ষিত পরিবর্তন আবার পড়ুন

পোর্টালে সম্পাদনার সুযোগ এলে শেষে সংরক্ষিত তথ্য আপনার তালিকার সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিন। শুধু বোতাম চাপাকে সাফল্যের প্রমাণ ভাববেন না। ফর্ম আবার খুলে পরিবর্তিত তথ্য পড়ুন এবং পোর্টাল যে নতুন নিশ্চিতকরণ দেবে তা রেখে দিন।

প্রয়োজনীয় ঘর লক থাকলে দেখানো বার্তা লিখে রেখে সরকারি ওয়েবসাইটের হেল্পডেস্কে যোগাযোগ করুন। সমস্যা ব্যাখ্যা করুন, কিন্তু পাসওয়ার্ড বা OTP দেবেন না। অননুমোদিত এজেন্টের মাধ্যমে সংশোধন পাঠাবেন না। সাহায্যের জন্য বার্তা পাঠালেই আবেদন বদলে গেছে ভাববেন না। অসম্পূর্ণ আবেদনের জন্য ফর্ম ও ফি যাচাই-তালিকা এবং ক্যামেরার সমস্যায় লাইভ ফটো নির্দেশিকা পড়তে পারেন।

title: NEET UG Stray Vacancy Round: When Waiting Becomes a Costly Bet
description: Decide whether to wait for NEET UG stray vacancy by comparing fees, available seats, reporting risk and the cost of leaving a confirmed option.
content:
Waiting for a NEET UG stray vacancy seat isn’t a guaranteed upgrade. You may receive a fresh allotment, not a better version of your current seat, and the reporting window can be short. Before giving up an available option, compare the money at risk with the actual seats you could accept.

This is a decision framework, not a statement of the current MCC rules. The Medical Counselling Committee’s notice for the relevant round must decide whether fresh registration, choice filling, payment, reporting or joining is required. Those conditions can change, so don’t act on an old screenshot or a coaching-group message.

Should you wait when you already have a seat?

Wait only when the possible gain is clear: a college your family can afford, a better location, or a course choice that changes your career plan. A vague hope of moving up isn’t enough. Stray vacancy availability can shrink quickly, and refusing a workable seat may leave you with no acceptable option.

Begin with the seats you can see through our college comparison. Then write down your best confirmed option and the minimum result you’ll accept. Compare real, available choices rather than last year’s closing-rank rumours.

How should you compare the money?

A lower annual fee may still demand more cash immediately. Record each item separately before deciding:

  • Tuition and compulsory institutional charges
  • Hostel, mess and travel costs
  • Security deposit and counselling payment
  • Any amount already paid
  • Possible non-refundable or forfeited amounts if you withdraw

Now compare two figures: the cash needed this week to report, and the full first-year cost. Keep written refund terms and payment receipts. If the family can’t fund reporting on time, the seat isn’t a safe plan, even if its yearly fee looks attractive.

What must you verify before entering the round?

Check the current MCC notice and the round-specific seat information for the exact route. Confirm whether you must register again, fill fresh choices, pay a specified amount, report in person or online, and join by a stated deadline. This article cannot verify those conditions because no fetched MCC notice or seat-matrix excerpt is available here.

General risk: a late allotment may require quick payment and reporting. Keep documents scanned, arrange travel only after an allotment, and decide in advance who will make the payment. If your present seat is affordable and acceptable, retaining it may be the smarter choice. For a separate medical admissions option, you can compare relevant routes on our entrance exams page, but don’t let that distract from this round’s deadline.

title: AP DSC 2025: Apply for Over 16,000 Teaching Jobs in Andhra Pradesh.
description: Andhra Pradesh Government releases AP DSC 2025 notification for 16,347 teaching posts. Apply online from April 20 to May 15, 2025.
content:
AP DSC 2025 Application Form Released: Apply Now

The Andhra Pradesh Department of School Education has officially released the notification for the Andhra Pradesh District Selection Committee (AP DSC) 2025 recruitment drive. This initiative aims to fill 16,347 teaching positions across various districts in the state. The application process commenced on April 20, 2025, and will continue until May 15, 2025. Eligible candidates are encouraged to apply through the official website: apdsc.apcfss.in .​

Overview of AP DSC 2025 Recruitment

The AP DSC 2025 recruitment encompasses a significant number of vacancies across different teaching positions. The distribution of these vacancies is as follows:​

Post Number of Vacancies
School Assistants 7,725
Secondary Grade Teachers (SGT) 6,100
Language Pandits 1,200
Physical Education Teachers (PET) 1,322
Total 16,347

This recruitment drive presents a substantial opportunity for aspiring teachers to secure positions in government schools across Andhra Pradesh.​

Important Dates

Event Date
Notification Release April 20, 2025
Application Start Date April 20, 2025
Application End Date May 15, 2025
Examination Dates June 6 – July 6, 2025

Candidates should ensure they complete the application process within the stipulated timeframe to be eligible for the examination.​

Application Process

The application process for AP DSC 2025 is based completely online. Candidates must visit the official website apdsc.apcfss.in to access the application form. The steps involved in the application process include:​

  1. Registering on the portal with valid credentials.

  2. Filling in personal and educational details.

  3. Uploading necessary documents, including photographs and signatures.

  4. Paying the application fee online.​

The application fee is ₹750 per post. It is imperative to complete the fee payment to successfully submit the application.​

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must follow through the following eligibility criteria to apply for AP DSC 2025:​

  • Educational Qualification: A Bachelor's degree in the relevant subject along with a B.Ed. degree from a recognized institution.

  • Age Limit: The minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age is 44 years. Age relaxations and restrictions are applied as per government norms for reserved categories.

  • TET Qualification: Candidates must have qualified in the Andhra Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (AP TET).​

It is advisable for candidates to thoroughly read the official notification for detailed eligibility criteria pertaining to each post.​

Examination Details

The AP DSC 2025 examination will take place in a Computer-Based Test (CBT) format. The exam will assess candidates' proficiency in their respective subjects, teaching aptitude, and general knowledge. The detailed syllabus and examination pattern are available on the official website.​

Conclusion

The AP DSC 2025 recruitment drive is a significant opportunity for qualified teaching professionals to join the government education sector in Andhra Pradesh. With a substantial number of vacancies, candidates are encouraged to apply promptly and prepare diligently for the upcoming examination. For more information and updates, regularly visit apdsc.apcfss.in

title: XAT 2027-এ নতুন প্রতিষ্ঠান: কলেজে আলাদা আবেদন করতে হবে কি?
description: XLRI আরও প্রতিষ্ঠানে XAT স্কোর দিয়ে ভর্তির সুযোগের কথা জানিয়েছে। কলেজ বাছার সময় প্রতিটি কোর্সের আবেদন, শেষ তারিখ ও নির্বাচন পদ্ধতি আলাদা করে দেখুন।
content:
2027 সালে MBA পড়ার জন্য কলেজ বাছছেন? XLRI XAT পরীক্ষার্থীদের জন্য আরও প্রতিষ্ঠানের বিকল্প ঘোষণা করেছে। পছন্দের প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্দিষ্ট কোর্সের ভর্তি তথ্য পড়ে পরের সিদ্ধান্ত নিন। XAT পরীক্ষায় নাম নথিভুক্ত করলেই সব কলেজে আবেদন হয়ে যায় না।


নতুন প্রতিষ্ঠানের তালিকা কোথায় দেখবেন


XAT-এর সরকারি ওয়েবসাইটে 17টি নতুন সহযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠান যুক্ত হওয়ার ঘোষণা রয়েছে। সেখানে হায়দরাবাদের Mahindra University, বেঙ্গালুরুর RV University, আহমেদাবাদের Narayana Business School এবং গ্রেটার নয়ডার Sparsh Global Business School-এর উল্লেখ আছে। জয়পুরের Xavier Institute of Management and Informatics-কে নতুন XAMI সদস্য হিসেবে আলাদা করে দেখানো হয়েছে।



XLRI-এর XAT 2027 দীপাবলির ঘোষণা; ছবিতে তারিখ দেওয়া নেই। এতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের তালিকা সম্প্রসারণের তথ্য রয়েছে। সরকারি ঘোষণাটি পড়ুন।


সরকারি সহযোগী প্রতিষ্ঠানের তালিকা থেকে পছন্দের কলেজের ওয়েবসাইট খুলতে পারেন। এটি অংশগ্রহণকারী প্রতিষ্ঠানের বড় তালিকা। সেখানে থাকা প্রতিটি নাম এ বছর নতুন করে যুক্ত হয়েছে, এমন ধরে নেবেন না।


পরীক্ষার নিবন্ধন আর কলেজের আবেদন আলাদা


নিবন্ধন সম্পর্কে সরকারি ব্যাখ্যা অনুযায়ী নির্বাচিত XLRI কোর্সের জন্য আবেদন করতে হয়। অন্য অংশগ্রহণকারী প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলিরও নিজস্ব নির্বাচন পদ্ধতি ও শর্ত রয়েছে। একই পরীক্ষার স্কোর গ্রহণ করলেও তাদের সব ভর্তি নিয়ম এক নয়।


প্রতিটি কোর্সের ক্যাম্পাস, শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা, আবেদন করার উপায়, শেষ তারিখ এবং নির্বাচনের ধাপ প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভর্তি পেজে দেখে লিখে রাখুন। যে আবেদন সত্যিই জমা দিয়েছেন, তার প্রাপ্তিস্বীকার সংরক্ষণ করুন। XAT-এর তালিকায় কলেজটির নাম আছে বলে সেখানে আবেদন সম্পূর্ণ হয়েছে বলে চিহ্ন দেবেন না।


XAT-এর শেষ তারিখ আলাদা করে লিখুন


সরকারি XAT সূচি অনুযায়ী নিবন্ধনের শেষ তারিখ 6 ডিসেম্বর 2026। পরীক্ষা হবে 3 জানুয়ারি 2027, দুপুর 2টো থেকে বিকেল 5টা। এগুলি পরীক্ষার তারিখ। কলেজের ভর্তি আবেদনেও একই সময়সীমা আছে ধরে না নিয়ে সেই প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিজস্ব শেষ তারিখ দেখুন।


কোর্সের নাম, সরকারি আবেদনের লিঙ্ক, শেষ তারিখ ও আবেদন জমা হয়েছে কি না একসঙ্গে লিখলে তুলনা করা সহজ হয়। খরচ লেখার আগে প্রতিষ্ঠানের বর্তমান ফি পড়ুন। শুধু আবেদন ফি নয়, পুরো কোর্সের খরচও বিবেচনা করুন।


প্রতিষ্ঠান নতুন ভর্তি বিজ্ঞপ্তি দিলে নিজের তালিকা আবার মিলিয়ে নিন। অন্যান্য চলতি আবেদনের খবর DekhoCampus-এর সংবাদ পেজে পড়তে পারেন।
author: Geethika Reddy

title: UGC NET டிசம்பர் 2026: சமர்ப்பித்த விண்ணப்பத்திற்கான கட்டணத்தை நவம்பர் 1 வரை செலுத்தலாம்
description: ஏற்கெனவே சமர்ப்பித்த UGC NET விண்ணப்பத்திற்கான கட்டணத்தை நவம்பர் 1 இரவு 11:50 வரை செலுத்தலாம். புதிய பதிவு, விண்ணப்பச் சமர்ப்பிப்பு, படப் பதிவேற்றம் மீண்டும் திறக்கப்படவில்லை.
content:
UGC NET டிசம்பர் 2026 விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்தும் கட்டணம் செலுத்த முடியாமல் போனவர்களுக்கு, வெற்றிகரமாகப் பணம் செலுத்த 1 நவம்பர் 2026 இரவு 11:50 வரை NTA அவகாசம் அளித்துள்ளது. ஏற்கெனவே ஆன்லைன் விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்தவர்களுக்கு மட்டுமே இந்தக் கூடுதல் நாள் பொருந்தும்.

புதிய பதிவு, விண்ணப்பச் சமர்ப்பிப்பு அல்லது படப் பதிவேற்றம் மீண்டும் திறக்கப்படவில்லை. நவம்பர் 1 அறிவிப்பின்படி, இவை அக்டோபர் 31 இரவு 11:50 மணிக்கு முடிந்துவிட்டன. சேமித்துவைத்த முழுமையற்ற வரைவு விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்த விண்ணப்பமாகக் கருத வேண்டாம்.

கூடுதல் அவகாசம் யாருக்குப் பொருந்தும்?

முந்தைய காலக்கெடுவுக்குள் விண்ணப்பத்தைப் பூர்த்திசெய்து சமர்ப்பித்தும் கட்டணத்தைச் செலுத்த முடியாதவர்களுக்காகப் புதிய அறிவிப்பு வெளியிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. அடுத்த நடவடிக்கைக்கு முன், உங்கள் தற்போதைய கணக்கில் விண்ணப்ப நிலையைப் பார்க்கவும். முழு அதிகாரப்பூர்வக் கட்டண அறிவிப்பைப் படிக்கவும்.

தேசியத் தேர்வு முகமை, 1 நவம்பர் 2026 பொது அறிவிப்பு. முழு அதிகாரப்பூர்வக் கட்டண அறிவிப்பைப் படிக்கவும்.

கட்டணம் செலுத்தியதும் உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கத்தைச் சேமிக்கவும்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ UGC NET இணையதளத்தின் விண்ணப்ப இணைப்பில் உங்கள் கணக்கைத் திறக்கவும். விண்ணப்பம் சமர்ப்பிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளதா, கட்டணம் வெற்றிகரமாகப் பதிவாகியுள்ளதா எனப் பாருங்கள். சமர்ப்பித்த விண்ணப்பத்தில் கட்டணம் நிலுவையில் இருந்தால், இரவு 11:50 காலக்கெடுவுக்கு முன்பே கிடைக்கும் கட்டண முறையில் செலுத்துங்கள். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ UGC NET இணையதளம்.

வெற்றிகரமான கட்டணத்திற்குப் பிறகு உருவாகும் உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கத்தைப் பதிவிறக்கிப் பாதுகாக்குமாறு NTA கூறுகிறது. பரிவர்த்தனை எண்ணுடன் அதை வைத்திருங்கள். வங்கியில் பணம் பிடித்ததற்கான குறுஞ்செய்தி ஆதாரமாக உதவும்; அதைக் கொண்டு மட்டும் விண்ணப்பம் முடிந்ததாகக் கருதாமல், விண்ணப்பத் தளத்திலும் உறுதிப்படுத்துங்கள்.

கட்டண நிலை தெளிவாகவில்லை என்றால் பரிவர்த்தனை விவரங்களைப் பாதுகாத்து, அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தளத்தில் உள்ள உதவி மையத்தை அணுகுங்கள். நிலுவைப் பரிவர்த்தனையால் காலக்கெடு தானாக நீளும் எனக் கருத வேண்டாம்.

மற்ற நிபந்தனைகள் தொடர்கின்றன

தகவல் கையேடு மற்றும் முந்தைய பொது அறிவிப்புகளின் பிற நிபந்தனைகள் மாறவில்லை. புதிய பதிவு வாய்ப்போ அனைத்து விண்ணப்ப விவரங்களையும் திருத்தும் பொதுவான வசதியோ அறிவிக்கப்படவில்லை. திருத்தங்களுக்கு, தனியான திருத்தத் தேதிகள் மற்றும் அனுமதிக்கப்பட்ட விவரங்களையும் பின்னர் வரும் NTA அறிவிப்புகளையும் பார்க்கவும். UGC NET திருத்தத் தேதிகள் மற்றும் அனுமதிக்கப்பட்ட விவரங்கள்.

கட்டணம் உறுதியாகி, உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கத்தைச் சேமித்த பிறகு, விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் தேர்வு தொடர்பான அடுத்த அறிவிப்புகளை அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தளத்தில் தொடர்ந்து கவனிக்கவும்.

title: FMGE ഒക്ടോബർ 2026: ചോദ്യത്തിലെ സാങ്കേതിക പിശകിന് നവംബർ 2 വരെ പരാതി
description: FMGE ചോദ്യത്തിലെ സാങ്കേതിക പിശകിനെതിരെ വൈദ്യശാസ്ത്ര തെളിവുകളോടെ നവംബർ 2നകം പരാതി നൽകാം. ചോദ്യം ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടായിരുന്നു എന്ന കാരണം മാത്രം സ്വീകരിക്കില്ല.
content:
31 ഒക്ടോബർ 2026ന് FMGE എഴുതിയ നിങ്ങൾക്ക് ഒരു ചോദ്യത്തിൽ സാങ്കേതിക പിശകുണ്ടെന്ന് തോന്നുന്നുവെങ്കിൽ, NBEMS ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ പ്രകാരം 2 നവംബർ 2026 വരെ പരാതി നൽകാം. പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുന്ന വൈദ്യശാസ്ത്ര ഗ്രന്ഥങ്ങളോ പഠനങ്ങളോ ചേർത്ത്, ഔദ്യോഗിക Communication Web Portalൽ രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്ത ഇമെയിൽ ഉപയോഗിക്കണം. ചോദ്യം ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടായിരുന്നു എന്ന പരാതി മാത്രം ഈ വ്യവസ്ഥയിൽ സ്വീകരിക്കില്ല.

രണ്ടുദിവസത്തെ അവസരം ആർക്കാണ്?

ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 ഔദ്യോഗിക വിവര ബുള്ളറ്റിൻലെ വകുപ്പ് 10.2 പ്രകാരം പരീക്ഷയിൽ യഥാർത്ഥത്തിൽ പങ്കെടുത്തവർക്കു മാത്രമാണ് അവസരം. പരീക്ഷയ്ക്കു ശേഷം പരമാവധി രണ്ട് കലണ്ടർ ദിവസത്തിനുള്ളിൽ പരാതി നൽകണം. നവംബർ 2ന് ശേഷം ഉന്നയിക്കുന്ന അവകാശവാദങ്ങൾ പരിഗണിക്കില്ല. തെളിവുള്ള സാങ്കേതിക പരാതിയുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ഫലം വരുന്നതുവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കരുത്.

NBEMS, FMGE ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 വിവര ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ, പേജ് 89. പരാതിക്കുള്ള അവസാന തീയതി 2 നവംബർ 2026 എന്ന് ഈ ഭാഗം വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു. ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 ഔദ്യോഗിക വിവര ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ

കൃത്യമായ പിശക് തെളിവോടെ വിശദീകരിക്കുക

എവിടെയാണ് സാങ്കേതിക പിശക്, അത് ചോദ്യത്തെ എങ്ങനെ ബാധിക്കുന്നു, നിങ്ങളുടെ വാദത്തെ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുന്ന വൈദ്യശാസ്ത്ര ആധാരം ഏതാണ് എന്നിവ വ്യക്തമായി എഴുതുക. ചോദ്യപേപ്പറിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പൊതുവായ അനുഭവം സാങ്കേതിക പിശകിന്റെ തെളിവാകില്ല. പരിശോധിക്കുന്നവർക്ക് പ്രശ്നം കൃത്യമായി മനസ്സിലാകുന്ന രീതിയിൽ ചുരുക്കി വിവരിക്കുക.

  1. ഔദ്യോഗിക പരീക്ഷാ വെബ്‌സൈറ്റിൽനിന്ന് NBEMS Communication Web Portal തുറക്കുക.

  2. FMGE അപേക്ഷയിൽ രജിസ്റ്റർ ചെയ്ത ഇമെയിൽ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് പോർട്ടൽ ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്ന ഉദ്യോഗാർഥി വിവരങ്ങൾ നൽകുക.

  3. സാങ്കേതിക പരാതിയും അതിനെ പിന്തുണയ്ക്കുന്ന വൈദ്യശാസ്ത്ര രേഖകളും നിശ്ചിത സമയപരിധിയിൽ സമർപ്പിക്കുക.

  4. സ്വീകരിച്ചെന്ന അറിയിപ്പോ റഫറൻസ് നമ്പറോ, കൂടാതെ സമർപ്പിച്ച രേഖകളുടെ പകർപ്പും സൂക്ഷിക്കുക.

ഈ വ്യവസ്ഥയിൽ അവസാന തീയതിയാണ് നൽകിയിരിക്കുന്നത്; പ്രത്യേക അവസാന സമയം പറഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല. അർധരാത്രിവരെ സമയമുണ്ടെന്ന് കരുതരുത്. ലോഗിൻ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ രേഖകൾ അപ്‌ലോഡ് ചെയ്യുന്നതിലെ പ്രശ്നങ്ങൾ പരിഹരിക്കാൻ സമയം ലഭിക്കുമാറ് നേരത്തേ സമർപ്പിക്കുക.

ഉത്തരസൂചികയുടെ ലഭ്യത പ്രത്യേകം പരിശോധിക്കുക

വകുപ്പ് 10.3 പ്രകാരം ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 അപേക്ഷക ലോഗിനിൽ ചോദ്യ IDകൾ, ശരിയായ ഉത്തരത്തിന്റെ IDകൾ, അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തിയ മറുപടികളുടെ IDകൾ, ഓരോ ചോദ്യത്തിനും നൽകിയ മാർക്ക് എന്നിവ ലഭ്യമാക്കും. ഈ വ്യവസ്ഥ ഉള്ളതുകൊണ്ടുമാത്രം ഉത്തരസൂചിക ഇതിനകം പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ചുവെന്ന് ഉറപ്പിക്കാനാവില്ല. പ്രസിദ്ധീകരണ അറിയിപ്പിനും പ്രവേശന നിർദേശങ്ങൾക്കും ഔദ്യോഗിക FMGE പേജ് കാണുക.

ഫലത്തിനു ശേഷമുള്ള പുനഃപരിശോധനയുടെ നിയമം

ഫലം 30 നവംബർ 2026നകം പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കാൻ സാധ്യതയുണ്ടെന്നാണ് ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ പറയുന്നത്. ഇത് പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്ന സമയപരിധിയാണ്; ഫലം പുറത്തിറങ്ങിയെന്ന സ്ഥിരീകരണമല്ല. FMGEയിൽ പുനർമൂല്യനിർണയം, പുനഃപരിശോധന, മാർക്കിന്റെ വീണ്ടും കൂട്ടൽ, ഗ്രേസ് മാർക്ക് എന്നിവയ്ക്ക് വ്യവസ്ഥയില്ല. ഫലത്തിനു മുമ്പുള്ള സാങ്കേതിക ചോദ്യപരാതിയുമായി ഇവയെ കലർത്തരുത്.

തോറ്റോ ജയിച്ചോ എന്ന് തീരുമാനിക്കുന്ന പ്രത്യേക മാർക്ക് നിബന്ധനയ്ക്ക് FMGE വിജയമാർക്ക് മാർഗദർശി വായിക്കുക. പരീക്ഷയുടെ ബുദ്ധിമുട്ടിനെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള അഭിപ്രായങ്ങളോ ഓർമയിലുള്ള ചോദ്യങ്ങളോ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഔദ്യോഗിക ഫലം നിർണയിക്കില്ല.

title: NSP Scholarship 2026: How to Register on National Scholarship Portal & Check Status
description: NSP Scholarship 2026: How to Register on National Scholarship Portal & Check Status
content:
Key Takeaways

  • This page covers everything you need to know about NSP scholarship 2026 — dates, eligibility, process, and fees.
  • Always verify details on the official website. Dates shift every year.
  • Apply early — portals crash on the last day without exception.
  • Category certificates must be current-year valid for reserved category candidates.

Getting the details right on NSP scholarship 2026 is the difference between securing your seat and starting over next year. This guide cuts through the confusion and gives you the exact information you need — in the right order — so you can take action today.


Important Dates and Deadlines

These are the dates to mark in your calendar right now. Set reminders three days before each deadline — not on the day itself. Indian exam portals routinely slow down or go offline on deadline days under heavy traffic.

Event Date
Official Notification Released August 5, 2025
Event Tentative Date 2026 Status
Official Notification Release To be announced Expected soon
Registration Window Opens To be announced Watch official site
Last Date to Apply To be announced Apply 3 days early
Application Correction Window To be announced After registration closes
Admit Card Release To be announced Download immediately
Exam Date To be announced Check official portal
Result Declaration To be announced Post-exam
Counselling Begins To be announced After result
Pro tip: The official website URL ends in .nic.in or .gov.in for government exam bodies. Do not trust third-party countdown timers — they often have incorrect dates.

Eligibility Criteria — Check Every Point Before You Apply

One missed eligibility criterion means outright rejection — even after you have filled and paid for the application. Do not skim this section.

Criterion Requirement Important Notes
Educational Qualification Class 12 pass or appearing From a recognised board (CBSE, ICSE, State boards)
Subject Combination As specified in official notification Varies by exam stream — verify before applying
Minimum Percentage Varies (typically 45-75% in Class 12) SC/ST candidates often get 5% relaxation
Age Limit Varies by exam (typically 17-25 years) Some exams have attempt limits too
Nationality Indian citizen (NRI/OCI as per clause) Check notification for OCI eligibility
Category Certificate Required for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD OBC-NCL certificate must be current year

 

Step-by-Step Application Process

Follow these steps in order. Skipping any step — or doing them out of sequence — causes problems that are difficult to fix after submission.

Step 1 - Read the Official Notification PDF First

Download the full notification PDF from the official exam website before touching the application form. Most problems at the verification stage trace back to something in the notification that applicants missed. It takes 20 minutes to read and saves you months of regret.

Step 2 - Register on the Official Portal

Use your own email address and mobile number — not a parent's or friend's. Every OTP, admit card link, and counselling update comes to these contacts. If you lose access to either, recovery becomes a bureaucratic nightmare.

Step 3 - Fill the Application Form Carefully

Your name must match exactly what appears on your Aadhaar card or Class 10 certificate — including spellings and spacing. Date of birth must match your board certificate. Category must be correct. These are the three fields that cause the most rejections and are extremely difficult to change after submission.

Step 4 - Upload Documents to Exact Specifications

Every document has a specified file format, size limit, and dimension. A 300KB JPG when the portal asks for 100KB will fail without explanation. Use a scanner app rather than a phone camera for documents. Resize images before uploading.

Step 5 - Pay the Fee and Save Everything

Pay via UPI, debit card, or net banking. Immediately after successful payment — before closing the browser — download the application PDF and payment confirmation receipt. Screenshot your application number. Save it in at least three places.

If payment fails: Wait 24 hours before trying again. Most failed transactions auto-reverse within 24-48 hours. Do not attempt multiple payments for the same application.

Application Fee Structure

Category Fee (Approx.) Mode of Payment
General / OBC-NCL / EWS As per official notification Online only
SC / ST / PwD (Female) Reduced or nil Online only
Female (General) May be reduced Check official notice

Common Mistakes That Get Applications Rejected

These are the errors that repeat every year — and every year students are surprised when their applications are rejected for them.

  • Incorrect photo: The photo must be recent (within 3 months), taken against a white background, with ears visible, no spectacles, and no cap. Phone selfies and WhatsApp profile pictures get rejected.
  • Expired OBC-NCL certificate: OBC non-creamy layer certificates are valid only for the current financial year. If yours was issued last year, get a fresh one before applying.
  • Applying on the last day: Server load causes timeouts, payment failures, and browser crashes every single year. Apply at least three days before the deadline.
  • Mismatched name spelling: One extra letter or a missing initial can flag your application at verification. Cross-check your name against your Aadhaar before entering it.
  • Not checking the preview: Review every page of your filled form before clicking final submit. Once submitted, most fields cannot be changed outside of the official correction window.

What to Do Right Now

You have all the information you need. The difference between students who get into good colleges and those who miss out is rarely talent — it is preparation timing.

Bookmark this page, set your deadline reminders, gather your documents today, and submit your application at least three days before the closing date. If you have questions about specific college options or cutoffs after the exam, explore our college comparison tools and cutoff predictor.

title: BMAT 2026 Registration Extended; Apply Now
description: BMAT 2026 registration deadline has been extended. Check eligibility, application process, important instructions, and complete your BMAT application online before the revised last date.
content:
The BMAT 2026 registration deadline has been extended. This is news for people who want to take the BMAT 2026. They now have time to apply for the BMAT 2026 entrance examination. If you missed the deadline for the BMAT 2026 you can still apply now. You can complete your BMAT 2026 application within the registration time frame, for the BMAT 2026.

BMAT is a widely accepted entrance exam for admission to management and allied programmes offered by participating institutes. With the extension announced, candidates are advised to complete the registration process at the earliest to avoid last-minute technical issues.

What Is BMAT 2026?

BMAT is a national-level entrance examination conducted to assess candidates’ aptitude in areas such as quantitative ability, logical reasoning, verbal skills, and general awareness. title: Digital Marketing Course After 12th: Eligibility & Career Scope
description: Discover digital marketing courses after Class 12, including certificates, diplomas and degree programmes. Compare eligibility, fees, syllabus, career opportunities and salary prospects in India.
content:
Students who have completed Class 12 and want to explore a career in marketing, social media, online business or content creation can consider a digital marketing course. As businesses increasingly use websites, search engines, social media and online advertising to reach customers, digital marketing has become an important part of their growth strategies.

A digital marketing course after 12th can help students learn how to promote products, create online campaigns, improve website visibility and understand customer behaviour. Depending on their goals, students can choose a short-term certificate, diploma or a three-year undergraduate degree in digital marketing.

The best option depends on whether you want to enter the workforce quickly, pursue a formal degree or eventually build your own business.

Digital Marketing Course After 12th: Overview

Particular

Details

Course name

Digital Marketing

Eligibility

Class 12 pass for many entry-level courses

Eligible streams

Science, Commerce and Arts

Popular courses

Certificate, Diploma, BBA in Digital Marketing and related degrees

Course duration

Around 3 months to 3 years, depending on the programme

Admission process

Merit-based admission or institute-specific selection

Entrance exam

Not universally required

Approximate fees

Vary by institute, course level and duration

Popular skills

SEO, social media marketing, online advertising, content marketing and analytics

Career opportunities

SEO Executive, Social Media Executive, Digital Marketing Executive, Content Marketer and Performance Marketing Executive

What Is Digital Marketing?

Digital marketing is the promotion of products, services and brands through online channels. It involves reaching the right audience, creating useful content, attracting website visitors, generating leads and measuring the results of marketing campaigns.

For example, when a student searches Google for the best colleges for BBA, watches a brand advertisement on YouTube or discovers a product through Instagram, digital marketing may be involved in that experience.

A digital marketing professional helps businesses connect these activities with specific goals, such as increasing website traffic, generating enquiries, improving sales or building brand awareness.

What do students learn in a digital marketing course?

Most comprehensive programmes introduce students to some or all of the following areas:

  • Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)

  • Social Media Marketing (SMM)

  • Search Engine Marketing (SEM) and paid advertising

  • Content writing and content marketing

  • Email marketing

  • Website planning and optimisation

  • Performance marketing

  • Web analytics and reporting

  • Online reputation management

  • Digital branding and marketing strategy

Some courses also include e-commerce marketing, influencer marketing, marketing automation and the use of AI-assisted tools. The exact subjects depend on the institution and programme.

Types of Digital Marketing Courses After 12th

Students can select a programme based on their budget, learning preferences and long-term plans.

Course

Typical duration

Best suited for

Certificate in Digital Marketing

3-12 months

Students seeking introductory or focused training

Diploma in Digital Marketing

6 months-2 years

Students looking for specialised, practical learning

BBA in Digital Marketing

Usually 3 years

Students interested in marketing and business management

BBA in Digital Marketing (Honours)

Often 4 years, depending on the programme

Students seeking an extended undergraduate programme

B.Com or BA with marketing-related subjects

Usually 3-4 years, depending on the degree structure

Students who want a broader degree with relevant marketing knowledge

Durations are indicative. Check the current programme structure before applying.

1. Certificate Course in Digital Marketing

A certificate course is a shorter option for students who want to learn the fundamentals without committing to a full-time degree.

Common topics include SEO, social media management, content creation, paid advertising and basic analytics. Some programmes also offer practical assignments and introductory projects.

For example, Parul University lists a three-month Certificate Programme in Fundamentals of Digital Marketing. Its published programme page gives a fee of ₹7,000 and eligibility of Class 12 pass; students should verify the current fee and admission availability before enrolling.

This route may suit students who want to test their interest in the field or add practical skills alongside another qualification.

2. Diploma in Digital Marketing

A diploma generally provides more structured training than a short introductory course. Depending on the institute, students may work on campaign planning, website optimisation, social media strategy, advertising and marketing analytics.

Before selecting a diploma, check whether it includes live projects, internship opportunities and training with commonly used marketing platforms. The value of a diploma depends on its curriculum, practical exposure and the credibility of the provider.

3. BBA in Digital Marketing

A BBA in Digital Marketing combines business education with specialised digital marketing subjects. Along with online promotion, students may study management, business communication, consumer behaviour, branding, accounting and marketing strategy.

This course can suit students who want a recognised undergraduate degree and may later consider roles in digital marketing, e-commerce, brand management or business development.

For example, CMR University lists a three-year BBA in Digital Marketing, while Parul University offers a BBA in Digital Marketing. Their eligibility conditions and fees differ, so students should compare the official programme details.

4. Other Undergraduate Degrees with Marketing Subjects

Digital marketing can also be explored through broader degrees such as BBA, B.Com or BA programmes that include marketing, advertising, communication or business-related subjects.

These programmes may be useful for students who want flexibility to move into sales, business development, brand management or other areas later. However, a general marketing degree may not cover every practical digital marketing skill in depth, so additional training or projects may be necessary.

Digital Marketing Course Eligibility After 12th

The eligibility criteria depend on whether you choose a certificate, diploma or undergraduate degree. Many introductory courses are open to students who have passed Class 12, while degree programmes follow the admission requirements of the relevant university.

Educational qualification

Most entry-level digital marketing courses accept candidates who have completed Class 12 from a recognised board. Some programmes may also admit students with equivalent qualifications.

Which stream is required?

Students from all three major streams can explore digital marketing.

  • Arts: Suitable for students interested in content creation, communication, social media and branding.

  • Commerce: Useful for those interested in business, advertising, e-commerce and customer behaviour.

  • Science: Suitable for students interested in analytics, technology-driven campaigns and performance marketing.

A particular degree may require English or a specified minimum percentage. Always check the programme's eligibility criteria rather than assuming every course follows the same rules.

Is Mathematics compulsory?

Mathematics is not generally compulsory for many introductory digital marketing courses. However, quantitative subjects may be useful for students who want to specialise in marketing analytics, reporting or data-driven advertising.

Is an entrance exam required?

Many certificate and diploma courses do not require a common entrance examination. Undergraduate programmes may offer merit-based admission or use institution-specific selection procedures, depending on the university.

Digital Marketing Course Fees After 12th

Course fees vary significantly depending on the institution, programme duration, learning format and practical facilities.

Course type

Fee considerations

Certificate course

Often a lower-cost option for learning specific skills

Diploma course

Depends on duration, curriculum and practical training

Undergraduate degree

Usually requires a larger investment over several academic years

Online course

May offer flexible learning, but practical support and assessment quality vary

As a real example, Parul University's published three-month certificate programme lists a fee of ₹7,000. Its one-year diploma page lists ₹25,000, while its BBA in Digital Marketing page lists ₹1,55,000 per year. These are institution-specific published figures, not standard fees for all digital marketing courses.

Before admission, ask for a complete fee breakdown covering tuition, registration, examination charges, learning materials and any additional costs.

Digital Marketing Course Syllabus

A good course should help students understand not only what each marketing channel does, but also how to use it to achieve a business objective.

Subject

What students learn

SEO

Improving website visibility in organic search results

Social Media Marketing

Planning content and managing brand accounts

Paid Advertising

Creating and optimising online advertising campaigns

Content Marketing

Developing useful articles, posts, videos and other content

Email Marketing

Communicating with audiences through email campaigns

Website Fundamentals

Understanding website structure, landing pages and user experience

Web Analytics

Measuring traffic, engagement, conversions and campaign performance

Marketing Strategy

Identifying audiences, objectives and suitable marketing channels

E-commerce Marketing

Promoting products and improving online shopping performance

AI-Assisted Marketing

Using suitable AI tools to support research, ideation and workflow tasks

Course syllabuses differ, so review the module list before enrolling. A programme with practical assignments and campaign analysis may provide more job-ready experience than one focused only on theory.

Career Scope After a Digital Marketing Course

Digital marketing skills can be applied across industries, including education, retail, healthcare, hospitality, finance, entertainment, e-commerce and technology.

Students may work with marketing agencies, startups, established businesses, online stores or independent clients. Some also use these skills to promote their own businesses.

Popular job profiles after digital marketing courses

Job profile

Main responsibilities

Digital Marketing Executive

Supports online marketing campaigns across multiple channels

SEO Executive

Works on keyword research, website optimisation and organic search visibility

Social Media Executive

Plans posts, manages brand accounts and tracks engagement

Content Marketer

Develops content to attract and inform target audiences

Performance Marketing Executive

Helps manage paid campaigns and monitor results

PPC Executive

Works on pay-per-click advertising campaigns

Email Marketing Executive

Supports email campaigns and audience communication

Digital Marketing Analyst

Studies campaign data and prepares performance reports

E-commerce Marketing Executive

Helps promote products and improve online sales

Freelance Digital Marketer

Provides marketing services to clients independently

Freshers generally start in junior or executive-level positions. With experience, they may move into specialist roles, campaign management, team leadership or consulting.

Digital Marketing Salary in India

Digital marketing salaries depend on the role, employer, city, practical skills, portfolio and experience. The figures below are broad indicative estimates, not guaranteed salaries or official industry averages.

Experience level

Indicative annual salary

Fresher

₹2-4 lakh

2-5 years of experience

₹4-8 lakh

Experienced specialist or manager

₹7-15 lakh or more

Senior leadership or independent consultant

Highly variable

These ranges overlap because a specialist in paid advertising, analytics or SEO may earn differently from someone in a general marketing role. Freelancers may charge per project or on a monthly retainer, and their income depends on the clients and results they deliver.

How can freshers improve their earning potential?

Students can improve their career prospects by learning a specialisation, practising with real or sample campaigns, understanding analytics and building a portfolio that demonstrates their work.

For example, a student interested in SEO could create a small website, conduct keyword research, improve its content and track search performance. Someone interested in paid advertising could practise campaign planning using demo exercises or supervised projects.

Employers can assess demonstrated skills more easily when candidates can explain what they did, why they chose a particular strategy and what results they measured.

Best Digital Marketing Colleges and Institutes to Explore

Students should compare programmes based on their curriculum, practical assignments, faculty, fee structure and support for internships or placements.

Institution

Programme or option to investigate

Parul University

BBA in Digital Marketing, diploma and certificate options

CMR University

BBA in Digital Marketing

BML Munjal University

BBA in Digital Marketing

Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies, University of Delhi

Digital Marketing short-term programme, subject to current availability

Other recognised universities

BBA or related degrees with marketing specialisations

The availability of programmes, admission requirements and fees may change between academic sessions. A short-term certificate offered by an institution should not be confused with a full undergraduate degree.

Check the official programme page for the current course title, qualification awarded, duration, total fees and admission requirements. Also ask whether the course includes internships, live campaigns, portfolio projects and placement assistance.

How to Choose the Right Digital Marketing Course

Before spending money on a course, compare its practical value rather than relying only on advertisements or placement claims.

Consider these factors:

  1. Course curriculum: Check whether the syllabus covers SEO, social media, advertising, analytics and other skills relevant to your goals.

  2. Practical training: Look for projects, campaign exercises and opportunities to apply what you learn.

  3. Faculty and mentorship: Find out who teaches the course and whether students receive individual feedback.

  4. Qualification and recognition: Understand whether the programme awards a certificate, diploma or recognised university degree.

  5. Fees and additional costs: Compare the total cost, not just the advertised tuition fee.

  6. Internship and placement support: Ask what support is actually provided and whether placement claims can be verified.

  7. Learning format: Choose between classroom, online or blended learning based on your schedule and need for hands-on guidance.

A shorter course may be sufficient for learning specific tools, while a degree can provide broader academic and business knowledge. Neither automatically guarantees employment.

Is Digital Marketing a Good Career After 12th?

Digital marketing may suit students who enjoy creativity, communication, business, technology or analysing how people interact with brands online. It offers different specialisations, so students do not need to become experts in every marketing channel at once.

However, the field changes as platforms, advertising systems, search engines and customer behaviour evolve. Completing a course is only the starting point. Continuous learning, practical experience and the ability to measure results remain important.

If you want to enter the workforce early, you can consider a short-term course alongside practical projects. If you prefer a broader academic foundation, a BBA or another relevant undergraduate degree may be a better fit.

Conclusion

A digital marketing course after 12th can provide a pathway into online marketing, content, advertising, SEO, social media and e-commerce. Students can choose a short certificate, diploma or undergraduate degree according to their interests, budget and long-term goals.

Before enrolling, verify the institute's eligibility rules, syllabus, fees and practical training opportunities. Combine formal learning with projects, internships and continuous skill development to build a stronger foundation for a career in digital marketing.

title: Practo Success Story | How India’s Digital Healthcare Platform Became a Global Healthtech Leader
description: Discover the inspiring success story of Practo, India’s leading digital healthcare platform. Learn about its founders, journey, valuation, funding, and how it transformed healthcare access in India.
content:
Practo Success Story | How India’s Digital Healthcare Platform Became a Global Healthtech Leader

In a country where healthcare access was often complex and unorganized, Practo emerged as a game-changer. Founded in 2008 by Shashank ND and Abhinav Lal, Practo transformed the way Indians book doctor appointments, consult online, order medicines, and access diagnostic tests. Today, it stands as one of the largest healthtech platforms in India, serving millions of patients every month.

The Beginning of Practo

The idea of Practo was born when Shashank ND faced difficulties in accessing his father’s medical records. This frustration led him and his co-founder Abhinav Lal to build a digital healthcare platform that could make health records, doctor discovery, and consultations easily accessible to everyone.

Launched in Bengaluru, Practo started as a doctor discovery and appointment-booking platform. Over the years, it expanded to include online consultations, medicine delivery, health check-ups, insurance, and diagnostic test bookings.

Practo’s Growth Journey

  • 2008 – 2012: Launched as Practo Ray (SaaS for doctors) to digitize medical records.

  • 2013 – 2015: Expanded into doctor discovery and appointment booking.

  • 2015 – 2017: Entered international markets like Singapore, Indonesia, and the Philippines.

  • 2018 – 2020: Introduced telemedicine and online consultations.

  • 2020 onwards: Saw massive growth during the COVID-19 pandemic as teleconsultations became a necessity.

  • 2023: Serves over 30 crore patients annually, with 1 lakh+ doctors on its platform.

Funding and Valuation of Practo

Practo has raised funding from leading investors such as Sequoia Capital, Tencent Holdings, Matrix Partners, and Sofina.

Practo Valuation Table

Year Funding Raised (INR) Funding Raised (USD) Valuation (Approx. INR) Valuation (Approx. USD)
2012 ₹90 Crore $15 Million ₹500 Crore $80 Million
2015 ₹3,100 Crore $55 Million ₹4,000 Crore $600 Million
2017 ₹4,200 Crore $60 Million ₹7,500 Crore $1.1 Billion
2020 ₹3,700 Crore $50 Million ₹8,000 Crore $1.15 Billion
2023 ₹11,000+ Crore $150+ Million ₹12,500 Crore $1.6 Billion

 

Why Practo Stands Out

  1. End-to-End Healthcare Ecosystem – Doctor discovery, consultations, diagnostics, and medicines in one app.

  2. Strong Doctor Network – Over 100,000+ doctors listed.

  3. Telemedicine Revolution – Millions of online consultations, especially during the pandemic.

  4. Digital Health Records – Easy access to prescriptions and reports.

  5. Affordable Healthcare Access – Bridging the gap between patients and doctors.

  6. Global Presence – Expanded beyond India into Southeast Asia.

Practo’s Future Goals

  • Expanding into Tier-2 and Tier-3 Indian cities.

  • Strengthening AI-based health diagnostics and digital prescriptions.

  • Growing its insurance and preventive healthcare offerings.

  • Becoming a global leader in digital healthcare beyond India and Asia.

Conclusion:

The Practo success story shows how two young entrepreneurs transformed India’s fragmented healthcare system into a digital-first experience. By simplifying doctor consultations, digitizing health records, and offering end-to-end healthcare services, Practo has become a global healthtech leader with a valuation of over $1.6 Billion. Its journey reflects the power of innovation in healthcare accessibility.

title: IISER Aptitude Test or NEST: Which Route Fits Your Science Plan?
description: Compare the IISER Aptitude Test and NEST by destination, course commitment and research goals before choosing a science admission route.
content:
Choosing between the IISER Aptitude Test and NEST is not just a question of which paper looks easier. The real choice is between different institute destinations, course commitments and long-term science plans. NEST is linked to NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai, while the IISER route must be checked against the current admission notice for your cycle.

Where can each route take you?

NEST, the National Entrance Screening Test, is a common entrance test for admission to the five-year integrated MSc programme at NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai. The official NEST website states this directly. So, a NEST score is not a general pass for unrelated science colleges.

The IISER Aptitude Test belongs to the IISER admission route. However, the participating institutes, programme choices, eligibility rules and application process can depend on the current cycle. Don’t treat an old brochure or coaching post as a permanent rule.

Decision pointIISER routeNEST route
First questionDoes the current notice offer your preferred IISER programme?Are NISER or CEBS your intended destinations?
Course commitmentCheck the current programme structure and duration.Five-year integrated MSc programme.
Common mistakeAssuming last year’s admission route continues unchanged.Assuming the score applies to every science degree.

Which route suits your science plan?

Choose NEST when NISER Bhubaneswar or UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai is a serious target and you’re comfortable with a five-year integrated MSc. Keep IISER in your plan when you specifically want an IISER institute, but confirm the current route before preparing your preference list.

  • For physics, chemistry, biology or mathematics research, compare the actual curriculum and institute environment, not just the perceived difficulty of the entrance paper.
  • If you want a shorter or more flexible undergraduate course, compare other recognised routes before submitting either form.
  • Applying through both routes makes sense only when you would genuinely join an offer from either path.

How should you prepare without mixing the two exams?

Build your preparation around Class 11 and 12 science concepts, then practise timed physics and mathematics sets. Use reaction maps for chemistry and redraw biology diagrams from memory. Review the current syllabus, paper pattern and sample material for each exam separately, because a shared science base does not make the exams identical.

For NEST notices and application updates, check the official NEST website. Confirm the IISER route, participating institutes, eligibility and dates through the current notice issued by the responsible IISER admissions authority. Do this once before you pay or lock your preferences. For a closer look at the NEST pathway, read the NEST exam guide.

title: Puducherry Free Tablet Scheme 2026: Eligibility Criteria, Distribution Timeline, and Specifications for Class 9 and 10 Students
description: Complete guide on the Puducherry Free Tablet Scheme 2026 for Class 9 and 10 students, covering eligibility rules, device specifications, distribution timelines, and application process.
content:
Overview of Puducherry Free Tablet Scheme 2026

The Government of Puducherry has announced a digital learning initiative aimed at empowering secondary school students across the Union Territory. Under the scheme, free smart tablets will be distributed to students studying in Class 9 and Class 10. The main goal is to bridge the digital divide, ensure equal access to modern educational resources, and assist students in preparing for high school board examinations.

This initiative covers government and government-aided schools across all four regions of the Union Territory: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam. By integrating digital hardware directly into foundational secondary education, the administration aims to facilitate self-paced learning, interactive study modules, and seamless access to e-textbooks.

Key Features and Objectives of the Tablet Distribution Initiative

The free tablet program offers multiple educational benefits designed for secondary school students:

  • Digital Resource Integration: Direct access to digital textbooks, interactive study material, and curriculum-aligned videos.
  • Interactive Learning: Support for educational mobile applications that make science, mathematics, and language concepts easier to grasp.
  • Exam Preparation Support: Provision of sample question papers, online practice tests, and revision modules for board preparation.
  • Equitable Access: Ensuring underprivileged students in government institutions receive equal technological tools as private school peers.

Eligibility Criteria for Class 9 and 10 Students

To ensure that benefits reach the targeted group, the Directorate of School Education has specified basic eligibility guidelines for the distribution drive in 2026:

1. Domicile Requirement

The student must be a bona fide resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry (covering Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, or Yanam).

2. School Enrolment

The applicant must be actively enrolled in Class 9 or Class 10 in a recognised Government School or Government-Aided School located within the Union Territory during the 2026-2027 academic session.

3. Attendance and School Verification

Students must maintain satisfactory attendance as prescribed by their respective school heads. Registration and verification are processed directly through official school rolls.

CategoryDetails
Target AudienceClass 9 and Class 10 Students
School Types CoveredGovernment & Government-Aided Schools
Geographic CoveragePuducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam
Cost to Student100% Free of Cost
Implementing BodyDirectorate of School Education, Puducherry

Expected Hardware and Technical Specifications

The devices provided under the scheme are customized for educational usage. Built with child safety features and durable hardware, the expected technical specifications include:

  • Display: 8-inch to 10-inch HD touchscreen for safe and comfortable reading.
  • Processor and RAM: Octa-core processor paired with 3GB or 4GB RAM to run educational software smoothly.
  • Storage: 32GB or 64GB internal storage, expandable via microSD card to store offline study materials and video lectures.
  • Battery Capacity: 5000 mAh or higher to ensure long hours of uninterrupted learning at home or in school.
  • Connectivity: Wi-Fi and 4G SIM connectivity options for seamless internet access.
  • Pre-installed Software: Custom learning management systems, state board e-books, language learning tools, and parental control features to prevent misuse.

Distribution Timeline and Application Process

Parents and students do not need to fill out complex online forms on external third-party portals. The distribution process is managed systematically through school authorities.

Step-by-Step Distribution Mechanism

  1. Data Collection: Headmasters and principals prepare verified rosters of enrolled Class 9 and 10 students.
  2. Aadhaar Linking: Student records are mapped with Aadhaar numbers to avoid duplicate allocations.
  3. School-Level Camps: Distribution camps are organized at school premises where tablets are handed over to students in the presence of parents or guardians.
  4. Acknowledgment Receipt: Parents sign a device receipt form containing device serial numbers for inventory tracking and warranty coverage.

Expected Timeline for 2026

The initial phase of verification begins following the start of the academic term. Tablet distribution across schools in Puducherry and Karaikal is expected to proceed in phases, followed by Mahe and Yanam. Students should verify exact distribution dates with their respective class teachers and school administration.

Important Instructions for Students and Parents

To ensure proper use and maintenance of the government-issued devices, families should keep the following points in mind:

  • Educational Use Only: The devices come pre-loaded with security controls. System software should not be modified or rooted.
  • Warranty and Service: Devices carry a standard manufacturer warranty. If technical faults occur, students should report them to the designated school coordinator for official service center support.
  • Safe Handling: Using protective covers and screen guards is recommended to protect the screen from accidental drops.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Are private school students eligible for the Puducherry Free Tablet Scheme 2026?

No, the scheme is specifically targeted at students enrolled in Government and Government-Aided schools within the Union Territory of Puducherry.

Is there any registration fee or application fee for receiving the tablet?

No, the tablet is distributed completely free of cost by the Puducherry administration. No fee is charged at any stage of distribution.

What documents are required for verification at school?

Students generally require their Student ID card, Aadhaar card copy, and parent's identity proof for school-level verification.

What should a student do if the tablet is damaged or develops technical problems?

Students should inform their school administration immediately. Repairs covered under warranty will be processed through designated government supply partners. Official guidelines should always be verified on the official website of the Directorate of School Education, Puducherry.

title: NAAC or NBA: Which Accreditation Matters for Your Course Choice?
description: Understand what NAAC and NBA accreditation mean, how they differ, and what engineering students should verify before choosing a college or programme.
content:
NAAC and NBA accreditation answer different questions. NAAC assesses the institution as a whole, while NBA assesses a specific technical programme such as Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering. So, a good NAAC grade doesn’t prove that your chosen BTech branch has NBA accreditation.

Before you pay a seat-confirmation fee, match the claim to your college, campus, programme and likely batch. The badge alone isn’t enough.

What is the difference between NAAC and NBA accreditation?

NAAC accreditation helps you judge the wider institution, including teaching systems, governance, facilities, research activity and student support. NBA accreditation examines a named programme against academic and outcome-related standards. In plain terms, NAAC asks how the college functions overall; NBA asks whether a particular technical course meets its stated standards.

Point of comparisonNAACNBA
Unit assessedCollege or universitySpecific technical programme
Useful questionWhat systems support students across the institution?What evidence supports this engineering programme?
CoverageInstitution-level statusNamed branch or programme
Common mistakeAssuming every course has the same statusAssuming one branch covers all branches

Which accreditation matters more for an engineering applicant?

For your branch choice, NBA accreditation is the more direct signal because it relates to the programme you may join. NAAC still adds useful context about campus systems and institutional practices. Neither status is a placement promise, and neither replaces checking faculty, labs, internships, fees and branch-wise outcomes.

That distinction matters when an advertisement displays a college-wide NAAC claim beside several engineering courses. A college can hold NAAC accreditation while only selected programmes have NBA accreditation, or while the relevant branch has a different status.

How should you check the claim before admission?

Use the college’s exact legal name and campus while checking records. If a brochure uses broad wording, ask the admission office for the written order or programme-level details.

  1. Record the exact college, campus, degree and branch.
  2. Check whether the NAAC status belongs to that institution.
  3. Look for the NBA status of the precise programme, not just the college name.
  4. Note the stated validity period and whether it covers your admission batch.
  5. Compare the result with the programme syllabus, faculty list, laboratories, internship access and placement report.

You can compare colleges and explore courses, but treat accreditation as one input. The safest decision is the one where the institution-level claim and the branch-level evidence both line up.

title: IIT Branch Change After First Year: What Students Must Check First
description: IIT branch change after first year is not guaranteed. Check CGPA rules, seat limits, course conditions and branch demand before accepting a JoSAA seat.
content:
IIT branch change after first year can help some students, but it isn't a backup admission route to Computer Science or another preferred programme. Before accepting a JoSAA seat, check the concerned IIT's written rules and ask yourself one uncomfortable question: would you still join if the transfer never happens?

That answer matters because a lower-preference branch can become your four-year degree. A strong first year alone may not open the door.

What decides an IIT branch change?

There isn't one common rule for every IIT. The concerned institute's academic regulations, admission material and student-section notices take priority over coaching claims or a senior's old experience.

  • Application point: Check whether students may apply after the first year and when the decision is issued.
  • Academic condition: Confirm the minimum CGPA, required grades and whether every first-year course must be cleared.
  • Seat position: Find out whether movement depends on vacant seats, sanctioned strength or a fixed intake limit.
  • Selection method: Ask how the institute ranks eligible applicants when demand exceeds available seats.
  • Course effect: Check whether changed subjects, laboratories or missed credits could affect your graduation plan.

A high CGPA may only make you eligible to apply. It doesn't reserve a seat. If 15 students meet the academic condition but only a few seats are available in a high-demand branch, the institute's ranking method and vacancies decide what happens.

Why branch demand can upset your plan

Suppose you accept Mechanical Engineering hoping to move to Computer Science and Engineering. Good marks can strengthen your application, but competing students, limited seats and programme restrictions can still block the move. Permission to apply isn't approval.

So compare the institute and branch together, not just the branch label. Look at course content, fees, location, workload and the kind of work you may want later. You can also use DekhoCampus's college comparison page when weighing a suitable branch elsewhere against an uncertain transfer plan.

What should you check before locking JoSAA choices?

  1. Read the latest branch-change rule issued by the IIT you may join.
  2. Write down its CGPA, course-clearance, timing and seat conditions.
  3. Treat older transfer cases as background, not as a promise for your batch.
  4. Keep at least one choice you would genuinely study without changing branches.

Parents should ask: “Would we accept this seat if internal transfer were removed?” If the answer is no, reorder the choices. A branch you can accept now is safer than a disliked branch supported only by hope.

title: CBSE Class 12 Compartment Result 2026: How to Download Supplementary Marksheet at cbse.gov.in
description: Step-by-step guide on checking the newly released CBSE Class 12 supplementary/compartment results for 2026, downloading digital marksheets on DigiLocker, and applying for urgent college admissions.
content:
The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has announced the CBSE Class 12 Compartment Result 2026 (officially referred to as the Supplementary Examinations). For thousands of students across India, this result is the final key to unlocking their higher education dreams and securing college seats before the ongoing admission cycle closes.

Quick Answer: How to Check CBSE 12th Compartment Result 2026

Immediate Action Steps:

  • Go to the official CBSE results portal: results.cbse.nic.in or cbseresults.nic.in.
  • Click on the link "Class XII Supplementary Examination Results 2026".
  • Enter your Roll Number, School Number, and Admit Card ID.
  • Click "Submit" to view and download your provisional scorecard.
  • For the official digital marksheet, log in to your DigiLocker account.

Key Facts: CBSE Class 12 Supplementary Exam 2026

Understanding the timeline and official platforms is crucial for students who need to submit their updated scorecards to universities urgently. Below is a quick summary of the key facts regarding the CBSE 12th Compartment Results.

Detail Information
Exam Conducting Body Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
Exam Name CBSE Class 12 Supplementary/Compartment Examination 2026
Official Portals cbse.gov.in, results.cbse.nic.in, cbseresults.nic.in
Alternative Access Platforms DigiLocker App, UMANG App
Credentials Required Roll Number, School Number, Admit Card ID

Step-by-Step Guide to Check Your Result Online

To avoid server lag during peak hours, make sure you follow these steps directly on the official secondary servers provided by the board:

  1. Visit the Portal: Open your web browser and go to results.cbse.nic.in.
  2. Locate the Link: On the homepage, find and click on the link titled "Senior School Certificate Compartment Examination (Class XII) Results 2026".
  3. Enter Your Details: Input your Roll Number, School Number, and Admit Card ID exactly as printed on your supplementary admit card.
  4. Submit and Print: Double check your credentials and click "Submit". Once your scorecard appears on the screen, download the PDF copy and take a printout for immediate reference.

How to Download Digital Supplementary Marksheet via DigiLocker

Most universities and colleges require a digitally signed marksheet for confirming admission. The provisional printout from the website serves as temporary proof, but the DigiLocker copy is legally equivalent to the original physical marksheet. Here is how you can fetch it:

  • Sign In/Sign Up: Go to the DigiLocker website (digilocker.gov.in) or download the DigiLocker app on your mobile device. Sign in using your registered mobile number or Aadhaar card.
  • Search Document: Go to the "Search Documents" tab and search for "Central Board of Secondary Education" or "CBSE".
  • Select Class XII Marksheet: Click on "Class XII Marksheet" (select the option indicating Supplementary/Compartment if listed separately, or standard Marksheet as updated by the board).
  • Provide Credentials: Enter your Name, Year of Passing (2026), and your Roll Number as registered with CBSE.
  • Retrieve Document: Click on "Get Document". The system will fetch your revised digital marksheet. You can download and share this secure PDF directly with admissions offices.

Next Steps: Urgent College Admissions for Cleared Students

Time is of the essence. Now that you have cleared your compartment exams, you must act fast to lock in your undergraduate admissions. Many institutions keep specialized portals open or allow late registrations for compartment-cleared candidates.

1. Approach State and Private Universities Directly

Many colleges reserve a small percentage of seats or run special counseling rounds for students coming through the supplementary route. Keep both your original CBSE Class 12 marksheet (which contains the failed/compartment mark) and your new supplementary marksheet ready to prove your eligibility.

2. Local Admission Pathways

If central university portals have closed their admission windows, localized colleges offer excellent alternatives with direct entry paths. For instance, students looking to pursue legal studies can explore admissions at regional institutes such as the Classic College of Law, Bareilly, which offer structured LL.B. and integrated law programs suited for career progression.

3. Check for Open Distance Learning (ODL) and Online Degrees

If regular seat cycles have concluded, you do not have to waste a year. Top-tier universities approved by the UGC offer online and distance learning degrees with enrollment cycles that extend late into the year. These degrees carry the same academic weight as regular classroom programs.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: Will my new marksheet mention the word "Compartment"?
A: Historically, CBSE supplementary marksheets indicate that the subject was cleared in a subsequent attempt. However, the academic validity of the passing certificate remains identical to the regular passing certificate for all higher education and employment purposes.

Q2: What if I do not clear the compartment exam on this attempt?
A: Students who are unable to clear the subject in this supplementary exam get subsequent attempts in the next academic cycle. You can appear as a private candidate in the next board session.

Q3: How long does it take for the physical supplementary marksheet to arrive at school?
A: Physical copies of the updated marksheets are dispatched to respective schools within 15 to 30 days of the online declaration. Meanwhile, the DigiLocker version serves as official verification for college admissions.

title: GATE 2027 लाइफ साइंसेज: XL0-XL5 कोड और वैकल्पिक विषय
description: GATE 2027 XL में रसायन विज्ञान अनिवार्य है। नए सेक्शन कोड, दो वैकल्पिक विषयों के अंक और आधिकारिक पाठ्यक्रम के अनुसार तैयारी की योजना बनाएँ।
content:
GATE 2027 लाइफ साइंसेज की तैयारी कर रहे हैं तो पुरानी अध्ययन योजना अपनाने से पहले नोट्स के सेक्शन कोड बदलें। IIT Madras ने संशोधित पाठ्यक्रम जारी किया है। रसायन विज्ञान का नया कोड XL0 है और यह अनिवार्य है। XL1 से XL5 तक के पाँच वैकल्पिक सेक्शन में से दो हल करने होंगे।

मुख्य प्रश्नपत्र का कोड अभी भी XL है। उसके बाद के अंक उसी प्रश्नपत्र के सेक्शन बताते हैं। ये छह अलग GATE पेपर नहीं हैं जिनके लिए अलग आवेदन करना हो।

अपने विषयों को नए कोड से मिलाएँ

आधिकारिक प्रश्नपत्र और पाठ्यक्रम पृष्ठ पर पुराने अक्षरों के सामने नए कोड दिए हैं। PDF, अभ्यास प्रश्न और नोट्स व्यवस्थित करते समय कोड के साथ विषय का नाम भी देखें।

पाँच में से दो वैकल्पिक सेक्शन चुनें

आधिकारिक परीक्षा पैटर्न के अनुसार दोनों वैकल्पिक सेक्शन परीक्षा के दौरान चुने जाते हैं। रसायन विज्ञान सभी XL अभ्यर्थियों के लिए समान है। उदाहरण के लिए वनस्पति विज्ञान और प्राणी विज्ञान चुनने पर भी रसायन विज्ञान देना होगा।

तैयारी के लिए वे दो विषय पहले चुनें जिन्हें अच्छी तरह पूरा कर सकते हैं। स्नातक की पढ़ाई को मौजूदा पाठ्यक्रम से मिलाएँ और हर चुने विषय के कुछ प्रश्न समय बाँधकर हल करें। केवल विषय का नाम परिचित होना पर्याप्त नहीं; प्रश्न हल होना ज़रूरी है। साप्ताहिक योजना में दोनों वैकल्पिक विषयों के साथ रसायन विज्ञान और सामान्य अभिरुचि भी रखें।

संशोधित पाठ्यक्रम से नई सूची बनाएँ

लाइफ साइंसेज का संयुक्त पाठ्यक्रम PDF या आधिकारिक पृष्ठ से अलग सेक्शन की PDF डाउनलोड करें। रसायन विज्ञान में XL0.4 जैव-अकार्बनिक रसायन है। इसमें ऑक्सीजन परिवहन और भंडारण वाले मेटालोप्रोटीन, इलेक्ट्रॉन परिवहन वाले Fe-S मेटालोप्रोटीन, कार्बोनिक एनहाइड्रेज़ और Cu-Zn सुपरऑक्साइड डिसम्यूटेज़ शामिल हैं।

IIT Madras का GATE 2027 लाइफ साइंसेज पाठ्यक्रम, पृष्ठ 1। दस्तावेज़ पर परीक्षा वर्ष 2027 है; इस पृष्ठ पर जारी करने की तारीख नहीं छपी है। संशोधित पाठ्यक्रम से नई सूची बनाएँ.

वैकल्पिक विषय भी ध्यान से जाँचें। मौजूदा जैव रसायन पाठ्यक्रम में DNA मरम्मत, वनस्पति विज्ञान में जीनोम संपादन और खाद्य प्रौद्योगिकी में खाद्य मिलावट तथा प्रोबायोटिक खाद्य शामिल हैं। ये नोट्स जाँचने के उदाहरण हैं, पूरा पाठ्यक्रम या संभावित प्रश्नों की सूची नहीं।

हर सेक्शन के लिए तीन सूचियाँ बनाएँ: पढ़े हुए विषय, दोहराने वाले विषय और सामग्री में छूटे विषय। पुराने उपयोगी प्रश्न रखें, लेकिन पुराने प्रश्न-संग्रह को पूरा मानने से पहले 2027 के पाठ्यक्रम से मिलाएँ। पाठ्यक्रम में किसी विषय का होना उसके निश्चित अंकभार की गारंटी नहीं है।

पाठ्यक्रम और आवेदन सुधार अलग काम हैं

XL के भीतर दो वैकल्पिक सेक्शन चुनना, दूसरा GATE प्रश्नपत्र चुनने से अलग है। दूसरे प्रश्नपत्र पर अलग दो-पेपर संयोजन नियम लागू होते हैं। पाठ्यक्रम बदलने से पंजीकरण अपने-आप दोबारा नहीं खुलता और न आवेदन की नई अंतिम तिथि बनती है।

आवेदन में कमी की सूचना मिली है तो उसे आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर अलग से ठीक करें। GATE आवेदन की कमियाँ और सशुल्क सुधार वाली जानकारी दोनों प्रक्रियाओं का अंतर समझाती है।

title: BTech Placement Claims: Questions Parents Must Ask Before Admission
description: Check BTech placement claims with branch-wise results, median salary, job roles, internships and a written fee breakup before admission.
content:
A high package or familiar recruiter logo can hide a very different result for your child’s BTech branch. Before paying the admission fee, ask the college placement cell for written, branch-wise records and match them against the full cost of the course. That is how parents test a placement promise instead of trusting a brochure.

Start with documents, not a presentation. If the institute won’t share basic figures, keep the admission decision on hold.

Which placement numbers should you ask for?

A college-wide placement percentage may combine BTech branches, postgraduate courses and very different job markets. Ask the placement cell to show the denominator and the group behind every number.

  • Branch data: Request intake, eligible students, students who sat for drives, students placed and total offers for the exact branch.
  • Salary detail: Ask for median package, average package, lowest and highest reported packages. The median usually gives a steadier view than an average pulled up by a few large offers.
  • Job roles: Check company name, job title, work location, selection conditions and whether the role is technical, support, sales or operations.
  • Internships: Ask how many students received internships, their duration, stipend, employer and whether any converted into full-time offers.

Does the headline figure apply to your branch?

Ask for the last two or three placement cycles in the same format. One strong year or a combined Computer Science figure can make a weaker branch look better than it is. Also ask how the college defines “eligible”. Attendance rules, backlogs, marks and other conditions may keep some students out of placement drives.

Put the replies in one sheet: branch intake, eligible students, placed students, median package, internship count and job roles. A figure such as 120 placed students means little without the total eligible group.

What will you pay beyond tuition?

Get a year-wise fee breakup from the finance or admissions office. Check hostel, transport, examination charges, training, laptop requirements, uniforms, certifications, project expenses and any separate placement or internship charge. Ask whether these costs are compulsory.

Compare the college’s written replies with other options through compare colleges and review the relevant course details while you explore courses. Save brochures, fee sheets and email replies. If the evidence is branch-specific and the fee terms are clear, you can judge the claim fairly. If not, treat the promise as unverified, whatever the top package says.
