title: RV University 2027 Applications Open: Choose Your Campus Before Applying
description: RV University has opened its 2027 admission portal. Check the campus and programme, verify your email and review course requirements before submitting.
content:
RV University is accepting applications for 2027 admissions through its official online portal. Before registering, decide whether you want to study at Bengaluru or Mysuru and check the requirements for your chosen course. The form asks for a campus, programme and course, so those choices deserve attention before you pay.

The university homepage identifies admissions for 2027-28, while the official application portal displays “Admissions Open 2027”. A common closing date and application-fee amount are not displayed on the public registration screen. Check the instructions attached to your selected programme rather than assuming one deadline or fee applies across the university.

RV University’s official 2027 admissions portal, undated registration panel. Use the live university portal for the current form.

Start with the campus and the exact course

The registration form offers Bengaluru and Mysuru as campus choices. It also asks for a programme level and a course. Select the campus first, then check which options appear. A course offered at one location should not be assumed to be available at the other.

If you are still comparing institutions, use the college directory to build a shortlist. Write down the full degree name before you proceed. Similar subject names can lead to different qualifications, durations and selection requirements. Use the university’s admissions page and school links to read the programme details, then match that information to the option in your application.

From registration to the submitted application

The university describes five stages: create an account, verify your email, start the application, pay the application fee, and complete the submission. Registering your contact details is the beginning of this process, not the final application.

  1. Register with details you can keep using. The portal asks for the applicant’s name, email address, mobile number, state and city, along with campus and course choices. Use an email account you can access throughout admission.

  2. Verify your email. Follow the university’s verification message. The portal also provides a resend-verification option if needed.

  3. Complete the application. Add your academic details and programme preferences, and supply the documents requested for that course.

  4. Read the payment screen carefully. Confirm the amount and the applicable terms before paying. Keep the payment acknowledgement.

  5. Review and submit. Check spelling, contact details, marks and course selection. Save the submitted application and reference number for later correspondence.

Check eligibility before making a payment

RV University offers different study routes, so a single marks threshold or entrance-test rule would not explain every programme. Read the eligibility and selection instructions for the exact degree you want. Check required subjects, accepted qualifications and whether an assessment or interview applies to you.

The university says its admissions team will communicate further steps after submission, including interviews or assessments where applicable. An account, application payment or submitted form should not be treated as a confirmed seat. Follow the selection instructions and any offer conditions communicated by the university.

What to ask if the instructions are unclear

If the portal does not show the information you need, ask the admissions office for the current deadline, application fee, accepted entrance scores and selection steps for your named course and campus. Request clarification before relying on a general admission calendar.

The university lists admissions@rvu.edu.in for admissions enquiries. Include your course and campus in the message, and your application reference if you have already registered. Keep passwords and OTPs private.

title: CBSE ক্লাস 10 ও 12 খাদ্য উৎপাদন পরীক্ষা 2027: তারিখ, বিষয় কোড ও সময়
description: ক্লাস 10-এ খাদ্য উৎপাদন (কোড 409) পরীক্ষা 18 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027, 10:30 থেকে 12:30 পর্যন্ত। ক্লাস 12-এ খাদ্য উৎপাদন (কোড 809) পরীক্ষা 6 মার্চ 2027, 10:30 থেকে 13:30 পর্যন্ত।
content:

সরকারি PDF-এ নিজের বিষয়ের সারিটি খুঁজে নাও

এই ব্যবধানের সব দিন পড়ার ছুটি নয়। ক্যালেন্ডারে তোমার বাকি পত্রগুলিও লিখে মাঝে পরীক্ষা নেই এমন দিন গুনে নাও। অনুশীলনের সময় আসল পত্রের জন্য বরাদ্দ সময় রাখো।

প্র্যাকটিক্যালের সময় আলাদা করে জেনে নাও

এটি বোর্ডের নির্ধারিত পত্রের সময়। প্র্যাকটিক্যাল, পারফরম্যান্স, প্রজেক্ট বা অভ্যন্তরীণ মূল্যায়ন থাকলে তার তারিখ ও কী কী লাগবে স্কুলে জেনে নাও।

পরীক্ষাকেন্দ্রে যোগাযোগের যন্ত্র নিয়ে যাওয়া নিষেধ। কী সঙ্গে নেওয়া যাবে, সে বিষয়ে CBSE-র আলাদা নির্দেশ ও অ্যাডমিট কার্ডের নিয়ম মেনে চলো।

title: GATE 2027 ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਮੀ: 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੱਕ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਫੀਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ
description: GOAPS ਵਿੱਚ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਸਮਝੋ। ਦੱਸੀ ਕਮੀ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੱਕ ਵਾਧੂ ਫੀਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਠੀਕ ਕਰੋ; ਫੀਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਹਾਲੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਈਆਂ।
content:
GATE 2027 ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਕਮੀ ਦੱਸੀ ਗਈ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਠੀਕ ਕਰੋ। ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਫੀਸ ਸਮੇਤ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ-ਸੁਧਾਰ ਵਿੰਡੋ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ। IIT ਮਦਰਾਸ ਨੇ ਉਸ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਹਾਲੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ।

ਪਹਿਲਾਂ GOAPS ਵਿੱਚ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ GATE 2027 ਸੂਚਨਾ

  • Under scrutiny ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਜ਼ੋਨ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰ ਰਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਈਮੇਲ ਅਤੇ GOAPS ਖਾਤਾ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਰਹੋ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਰੱਦ ਹੋਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।
  • Defective ਹੋਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਈਮੇਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੀ ਕਮੀ ਪੜ੍ਹ ਕੇ GOAPS ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹੀ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਕਰੋ।
  • In order and accepted ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਜਾਂਚ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਹੋ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਅਗਲੀਆਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸੂਚਨਾਵਾਂ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਰਹੋ।

ਸੁਧਾਰ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਸਬੂਤ ਰੱਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਜਾਂਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੱਭੀਆਂ ਕਮੀਆਂ 14 ਤੋਂ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਵਾਧੂ ਫੀਸ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਠੀਕ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। GOAPS ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਨੇਹਾ ਪੜ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਜਾਂ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰੋ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ GOAPS ਲੌਗਇਨ

ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਰਸੀਦ ਜਾਂ ਭੇਜੇ ਵੇਰਵਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਸਕ੍ਰੀਨਸ਼ਾਟ ਰੱਖੋ। ਖਾਤੇ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਮੁੜ ਵੇਖੋ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨਵੀਂ ਫਾਈਲ ਚੁਣ ਲੈਣਾ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਹੋਣ ਜਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਬੂਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਵਰਤਿਆ DigiLocker ਖਾਤਾ ਨਾ ਮਿਟਾਓ

ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਵਾਲਾ DigiLocker ਖਾਤਾ ਬਣਾਈ ਰੱਖੋ। ਬਿਨਾਂ ਤਸਦੀਕ ਵਾਲੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਲਈ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ DigiLocker Drive ਦੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਲਈ ਸਹਿਮਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਫੋਟੋ ਵਾਲਾ ਪਛਾਣ-ਪੱਤਰ ਦਿਓ।

ਸੁਨੇਹਾ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ GATE ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਉੱਤੇ ਸਬੰਧਤ ਜ਼ੋਨ ਦੇ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਮਦਦ ਲਵੋ। ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਾ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਹੀ ਗਲਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ, ਪਰ ਪਾਸਵਰਡ ਜਾਂ OTP ਨਾ ਦਿਓ।

ਆਪਣੀ ਲੋੜ ਲਈ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਬਦਲਣਾ ਜਾਂਚ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੱਸੀ ਕਮੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਹੈ। ਫੀਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਬਦਲਾਅ ਐਲਾਨੇ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਕਰੋ। ਕਮੀ ਠੀਕ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਵਿੰਡੋ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਹੋਰ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ

title: Top 5 Tips to Prepare for Exams Without Coaching
description: Learn how to prepare for exams without coaching. Discover 5 practical self-study tips to crack board and competitive exams with confidence.
content:
While it may seem challenging to prepare for competitive or board exams without coaching, it is completely feasible with the correct approach. Because it provides flexibility, saves money, and enables them to concentrate on both their assets and their weaknesses, self-study is the primary method used by many toppers.

These are the best 5 ways to study for tests without tutoring if you intend to do it yourself.

1. Understand the Syllabus and Exam Pattern

Gaining a thorough understanding of the official syllabus and exam format is the first and most crucial step. Examine the comprehensive syllabus and note the relative importance of each section. This will assist you in focused on the most important subjects. Without a well-defined syllabus, your preparation could be aimless.

2. Make a Realistic Study Plan

Your most effective self-study tool is a well-organized study schedule. Establish daily or weekly goals and break the material up into digestible chunks. Included in your plan should be:

  • Allotted time for studying theory
  • Sessions of problem-solving practice
  • Slots for performance analysis mock tests

Consistently adhere to your schedule. Ten hours of distracted study can be less productive than even five or six hours of concentrated study time each day.

3. Rely on NCERTs and Standard Books

NCERT publications are regarded as the foundation for the majority of Indian exams. They serve as the foundation for more complex learning and provide simple defense of ideas. After studying the NCERTs, proceed to the standard reference books that are suggested for your test. Don't accumulate too many books; it's better to reread the same book several times than to skim ten different ones.

4. Practice with Previous Year Papers and Mock Tests

The best method of determining the kind of questions and degree of difficulty of the test is to solve past year's question papers. Additionally, to enhance speed, accuracy, and time management, take practice exams frequently. After every exam, carefully review your errors and work on your weak areas. This will help you improve your exam strategy.

5. Use Online Resources Effectively

center. YouTube lectures, mobile learning apps, Khan Academy, Swayam, NPTEL, and other educational portals offer top-notch content. Additionally, several provide free practice tests, revision guides, and quizzes. But exercise caution—do not let social media or pointless browsing distract you from your studies.

Conclusion

The goal of self-study is to work more intelligently, not harder. Exam preparation can be achieved without the use of coaching centers by concentrating on the syllabus, a suitable schedule, standard literature, consistent practice, and internet resources. With perseverance and self-control, success is entirely possible.

content:
कक्षा 10 में परिधान (कोड 414) का पेपर 25 फरवरी 2027 को 10:30 से 12:30 बजे तक है।

CBSE ने 6 नवंबर 2026 के मुख्य परीक्षा कार्यक्रम में ये तारीखें दी हैं। यह परीक्षा की डेट शीट है; इससे अंकतालिका डाउनलोड नहीं होती। आधिकारिक CBSE डेट शीट

परिधान के पेपर का समय

कक्षा और पेपरकोडपरीक्षा की तारीखसमय (IST)अवधि
कक्षा 10: Apparel41425 फरवरी 202710:30 - 12:302 घंटे

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड, 6 नवंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 5: विषय कोड, तारीख और समय। मूल PDF का यह पृष्ठ देखें

आधिकारिक PDF में अपना विषय कैसे पहचानें

पृष्ठ 5 पर पहले कक्षा की पहचान करें, फिर कोड 414 खोजें। तारीख या समय का एक ही खाना कई विषयों पर लागू हो सकता है। मोबाइल पर पूरा पृष्ठ बड़ा करके देखें ताकि गलत पंक्ति न पढ़ लें।

अपने स्कूल के पंजीकरण विवरण से कोड और विषय का पूरा नाम मिलाएँ। एक ही नाम अलग कक्षाओं में दिखे तो केवल अपनी कक्षा की पंक्ति चुनें।

अंग्रेज़ी के पेपर के हिसाब से पढ़ाई की योजना

कक्षा 10 में परिधान (414) की तारीख 25 फरवरी 2027 है। अंग्रेज़ी भाषा और साहित्य (184) की तारीख 26 फरवरी 2027 है। दोनों पेपरों की तारीखों में 1 दिन का अंतर है।

यह दो तारीखों का अंतर है, पढ़ाई के लिए मिलने वाली छुट्टियाँ नहीं। अपने बाकी पेपर भी लिखें और केवल बीच के खाली दिनों को गिनें। अभ्यास के लिए अपने पेपर जितना समय रखें।

प्रैक्टिकल और लिखित परीक्षा की तारीख अलग रखें

यह प्रविष्टि बोर्ड के निर्धारित पेपर की है। यदि प्रैक्टिकल, प्रदर्शन, प्रोजेक्ट या आंतरिक मूल्यांकन है, तो उसका समय और ज़रूरी सामग्री स्कूल से पूछें।

परीक्षा केंद्र में संचार उपकरण ले जाने की अनुमति नहीं है। CBSE के अलग से जारी निर्देशों और प्रवेश पत्र के अनुसार ही सामान ले जाएँ।

title: AP SSC 2027 அட்டவணை காத்திருப்பு: சரியான அதிகாரப்பூர்வ மாதிரி வினாத்தாளைத் தேர்வுசெய்யுங்கள்
description: பாடவாரி அட்டவணை வரும் வரை AP SSC மாணவர்கள் 2027 மாதிரி வினாத்தாள்களில் பயிற்சி செய்யலாம். ஆண்டு, மொழி, பயிற்றுமொழி, தாள் குறியீட்டை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.
content:
வாரியத்தின் பொதுவான அட்டவணை இணைப்புகளில் AP SSC 2027 பாடவாரி தேர்வுத் தேதிகள் இன்னும் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகின்றன. முகப்பில் 2027 மாதிரி வினாத்தாள்களும் புளூபிரிண்ட்களும் உள்ளன; ஆனால் காணப்படும் பொதுத்தேர்வு, துணைத்தேர்வு அட்டவணை இணைப்புகள் 2026க்கானவை. பழைய PDF மூலம் 2027 தேதிகளை முடிவுசெய்ய வேண்டாம். நவம்பரில் வெளியிடலாம் என்ற கணிப்பை வாரிய அறிவிப்பாகக் கருத வேண்டாம்.

மாதிரி வினாத்தாள் தேர்வு அட்டவணை அல்ல

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ 2027 வளப் பட்டியல் தயாரிப்புக்கு உதவுகிறது. முதல், இரண்டாம், மூன்றாம் மொழி, கணிதம், அறிவியல், சமூக அறிவியல், OSSC எனப் பிரிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. இவை பயிற்சி வினாத்தாளின் வடிவத்தை விளக்குகின்றன; தேர்வு வரிசையையோ தேதிகளையோ அறிவிப்பதில்லை.

பதிவிறக்குவதற்கு முன் விவரங்களைப் பொருத்துங்கள்

வாரியப் பட்டியலில் பாடத்தைத் தேர்வுசெய்யுங்கள். அது உங்கள் முதல், இரண்டாம் அல்லது மூன்றாம் மொழியா, உங்கள் பயிற்றுமொழிக்கு ஏற்றதா என்று பார்க்கவும். கணிதத்தில் ஆங்கில வழி 15E, 16E குறியீடுகளும் தெலுங்கு வழி 15T, 16T குறியீடுகளும் தனித்தனியாக உள்ளன. ஆண்டு, பாடப்பெயர், தாள் குறியீடு அனைத்தும் பொருந்திய பின்னரே சேமிக்கவும்.

ஆந்திரப் பிரதேச இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியத்தின் SSC 2027 மாதிரி வினாத்தாள் பட்டியல்; கணித வடிகட்டி தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. தனி வெளியீட்டுத் தேதி பக்கத்தில் இல்லை.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ AP SSC 2027 மாதிரி வினாத்தாள் பட்டியல்

PDFஐத் திறக்க படத்திற்குக் கீழுள்ள மூலப் பட்டியல் இணைப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தவும். படம் தேர்வுசெய்யும் திரையைக் காட்டுகிறது; அதிலுள்ள பதிவிறக்கப் பொத்தான் செயல்படாது. பட்டியல் இணைப்பு ஆவணத்தைத் திறக்கவில்லை என்றால் ஆசிரியரிடம் பொருத்தமான வாரிய வினாத்தாளைக் கேளுங்கள். ஒரு கோப்பு திறக்கிறது என்பதற்காக வேறு மொழி அல்லது ஆண்டைத் தேர்வுசெய்ய வேண்டாம்.

மாற்றத்திற்கேற்ற மறுபயிற்சித் திட்டம் அமைக்கவும்

பயிற்சியாக ஒரு பொருத்தமான தாளை எழுதிப் பார்த்து, முடிக்க முடியாத கேள்விகளைக் குறிப்பிட்டு ஆசிரியரிடம் சந்தேகம் கேளுங்கள். அடுத்த தாளுக்கு முன் தொடர்புடைய பாடங்களை மீண்டும் படிக்கவும். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அட்டவணை வரும் வரை மாற்றக்கூடிய படிப்புத் திட்டம் வைத்திருங்கள். மாதிரி கேள்விகள் பயிற்சிக்கானவை; அதே கேள்விகள் தேர்வில் வரும் என்ற உறுதி அல்ல.

புதிய அட்டவணை வந்ததும் 2027 தேர்வு தலைப்பு, பாடம், தாள் குறியீடு, தேதிகள், நேரங்கள், திருத்த அறிவிப்பு உள்ளதா என்று பார்க்கவும். பயணம் அல்லது விடுப்பு ஏற்பாட்டுக்கு முன் பள்ளியிடம் பொருந்தும் தாளை உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள். புதிய அதிகாரப்பூர்வ பதிப்பை வைத்திருந்து, திருத்தம் வெளியானால் பழைய நகலை மாற்றவும்.

ஆந்திரப் பிரதேச வாரிய முகப்பு

title: Post Matric Scholarship 2026: How to Apply, Eligibility & State-Wise Last Dates
description: Post Matric Scholarship 2026: How to Apply, Eligibility & State-Wise Last Dates
content:
If you passed Class 10 and money is the only thing standing between you and the next chapter of your education, the Post Matric Scholarship is built for you. Every year, the Central Government and state governments together disburse thousands of crores directly into students' bank accounts - covering tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and hostel charges for students from Class 11 all the way up to PhD level. This guide breaks down everything you need: who qualifies, what documents to gather, how to apply step by step, and when exactly each state's window closes. No fluff - just the facts you need to apply with confidence.

Key Takeaways

  • Post Matric Scholarship 2026 is open to SC, ST, OBC, EBC, and minority students studying from Class 11 to PhD level at recognised institutions.
  • Central scheme applications go through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in; state-specific schemes use separate portals.
  • A One-Time Registration (OTR) on NSP is now mandatory before you can submit your final application - even for most state schemes.
  • Income limits differ by category: up to Rs. 2.5 lakh per year for SC/ST, and Rs. 1-2.5 lakh for OBC/EBC depending on the scheme and state.
  • The scholarship amount is transferred directly to your Aadhaar-linked bank account via DBT - no middlemen involved.
  • Missing your state's deadline means waiting a full academic year. Apply early.

What Is the Post Matric Scholarship?

The Post Matric Scholarship (PMS) is a government scheme designed to support students who have cleared Class 10 and want to continue studying without being held back by financial constraints. It runs across multiple categories - SC, ST, OBC, EBC (Economically Backward Class), and minorities - and covers a wide range of courses from Class 11 and 12 to ITI, diploma, graduation, post-graduation, and professional degrees like engineering, medicine, and law.

There are two broad tracks: Central Government schemes administered through the National Scholarship Portal, and State Government schemes run on dedicated state portals. Both ultimately use Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to credit scholarship amounts straight into students' accounts.

The scheme covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, books, and other academic expenses - making it genuinely useful for students across all levels of higher education. Students studying in government and recognised private institutions are both eligible to apply.

Eligibility Criteria at a Glance

Before you start filling any form, confirm you clear these eligibility bars. Failing even one condition can lead to rejection - so take five minutes and check each point carefully.

Eligibility Parameter SC/ST Students OBC/EBC Students Minority Students
Nationality Indian Citizen Indian Citizen Indian Citizen

content:
Class 12 Business Administration (CBSE) is a concept-based subject, which means it emphasizes management principles, business functions, and decision-making. This subject is considered a scoring subject if students focus more on concept-based answers with a structured format. While approaching the examination, it is important to revise the important questions and topics.

Important Topics at a Glance

Unit Key Topics

Principles of Management Fayol’s principles, management functions
Business Environment Types, importance

Directing Leadership, motivation
Controlling Process, techniques

Important Questions for Exam

1. Nature & Principles of Management

1. Define management. What are its features?
2. Explain Fayol’s 14 principles of management.
3. What are the functions of management?

2. Business Environment

3. Planning

1. Explain the steps involved in the planning process.
2. What are the different types of plans?

4. Organising & Staffing

1. Define delegation and decentralization.
2. Explain the recruitment and selection process.

title: How to build a career in fashion design after 12th step-by-step Guide students
description: Discover how to build a successful career in fashion design after 12th with our step-by-step guide. Learn about top courses, eligibility, entrance exams, skills required, and career opportunities in the fashion industry.
content:
Introduction

Combining technological know-how, inventiveness, and imagination, fashion design is a fascinating and dynamic industry. Fashion design is a great career choice for those who have finished their 12th grade and who are enthusiastic about fashion, trends, and using aesthetics to convey their uniqueness. The fashion industry is broad and offers chances to collaborate with international brands or even start your clothing line. But establishing a prosperous career in this field calls for commitment, the appropriate training, and real-world experience. Here is a detailed guide to help you reach your goals for aspiring fashion designers.

Step 1: Assess Your Skills and Passion

It's crucial to determine whether a job in fashion design actually fits with your interests and abilities before deciding to pursue it. Consider this:

  1. Do I have a strong interest in colors, fashion, and apparel design?
  2. Do I like drawing or designing and am I creative?
  3. Will I make the effort to get knowledgeable about the technical facets of fashion design?

If the majority of your responses are \"yes,\" fashion design might be the ideal career choice for you. To thrive in this cutthroat industry, one needs patience, perseverance, and a sincere love for design.

Step 2: Select the Appropriate Course

Pursuing a formal education in fashion design is the next step after finishing the 12th grade. A wide range of academic programs are offered, including bachelor's degrees, master's degrees, and certificate courses. Popular classes consist of:

  1. Fashion Design Bachelor's Degree (B.Des)
  2. Fashion Design Diploma
  3. Fashion design is a specialty of the Bachelor of Fine Arts (BFA).
  4. Fashion design master's degree (for students with an undergraduate degree already)

Your interests, academic background, and long-term professional objectives will all play a role in selecting the best program. Before choosing an institution, make sure to review its specialized possibilities, course structure, and eligibility requirements.

Step 3: Look into Institutes of Fashion Design

Selecting an institution that provides excellent instruction and industry exposure is essential for securing a prosperous career in fashion design. Numerous well-known fashion design schools in India and elsewhere are praised for their excellent curricula:

  1. Fashion Technology National Institute (NIFT)
  2. The Pearl Academy
  3. Design Institute of the Nation (NID)
  4. Institute of Technology for Fashion (FIT)
  5. LCF, or London College of Fashion

Before choosing an institute, look into its reputation, internship possibilities, professors, and curriculum. Additionally, a lot of these institutions offer internships and practical experience, which can greatly improve your educational process.

Step 4: Get Ready for Admission Tests

To evaluate applicants' creative and design skills, prestigious fashion design schools like NIFT and NID administer entrance tests. Usually, these tests consist of:

  1. Current Events & General Knowledge
  2. Reasoning logically
  3. The capacity for creativity
  4. Sketching and Drawing
  5. Design Proficiency

Early preparation is crucial for these entrance tests. Focus on honing your design expertise, sketching abilities, and overall fashion trend awareness. If necessary, think about signing up for one of the many coaching institutes that provide preparation courses tailored to these tests.

Step 5: Create a Portfolio and Improve Your Skills

It is essential to develop both technical and creative skills when studying fashion design. A well-rounded designer is proficient in textiles, fashion illustration, pattern making, and clothing production. Key areas to concentrate on are as follows:

  1. Fashion illustration and sketching: Develop your ability to express yourself clearly using digital tools and drawings.
  2. Sewing and Clothing creation: It is essential to obtain hands-on expertise in sewing, fabric manipulation, and clothing creation.
  3. Textiles & Fabrics: Being aware of the many kinds of fabrics and their characteristics will help you make well-made, wearable designs.

Presenting your work to prospective clients or companies requires a solid portfolio. Your best mood boards, finished designs, and sketches should be featured in your portfolio. It acts as a graphic depiction of your abilities and inventiveness.

Step 6: Acquire Real-World Experience

Theory is only one component of the equation for fashion design. You may better grasp the commercial side of design and how to turn your imaginative concepts into practical fashion by gaining real-world experience in the field. To acquire expertise:

  1. Intern with Fashion Designers or Brands: Internships teach you the practical parts of fashion design and give you real-world experience.
  2. Take Part in Fashion Shows: Many organizations host fashion shows where you may showcase your creations and obtain input from specialists in the field.
  3. Work Together with Other Designers: Collaborating in groups enables you to learn more and develop a network of contacts in the business.

Step 7: Start Your Own Company or Work for a Reputable Fashion House

You can work with an established fashion business or launch your own fashion brand after honing your craft and accumulating industry expertise. Each choice has unique benefits.

  1. Establishing Your Brand: You can develop your own clothing line, brand identity, and marketing plan if you possess an entrepreneurial spirit. This route calls for ingenuity, business savvy, and a robust network.
  2. Joining a Fashion House: Collaborating with a well-known fashion house or designer offers the opportunity to work on high-profile projects, network, and receive invaluable mentoring.

Step 8: Continue to Change

Trends, new technologies, and changes in customer behavior all contribute to the fashion industry's ongoing evolution. It's critical to keep your abilities up-to-date in order to remain relevant. You could:

  1. Take classes, seminars, and workshops to learn about new design ideas, technologies, or approaches.
  2. Follow top designers' social media profiles, websites, and fashion periodicals to stay up-to-date on trends.
  3. Make connections with other industry professionals to keep up with new developments and possibilities.

In conclusion

For people who are passionate about creativity, fashion, and innovation, a career in fashion design can be quite fulfilling. You can succeed in this fast-paced industry by taking the above-mentioned actions: picking the appropriate course, accumulating real-world experience, developing a solid portfolio, and always learning new things.

title: Top Private Universities in India with Scholarship
description: Discover top private universities in India offering scholarships in 2025. Explore options, eligibility, and tips to save on college fees.
content:
In 2025, a number of prestigious private institutions in India will provide large scholarships based on a variety of factors, including financial background, athletic accomplishments, entrance examinations, and merit. Regardless of your intended field of study—engineering, management, law, design, or science—it is worthwhile to investigate your choices for financial help.

Let's be real, attending a private university in India might be quite costly. Even though they frequently provide superior positions, international exposure, and contemporary campuses, the cost structure may cause parents and students to reconsider. Scholarships, however, are something that many students fail to consider.

1. Lovely Professional University (LPU), Punjab

Particularly in North India, LPU is one of the most talked-about private universities. It boasts state-of-the-art facilities, a sizable student body, and excellent placement records. However, the variety of scholarships it provides is what makes it even better.

Scholarship Types:

  • LPUNEST-based scholarship (their entrance test)

  • Class 12 board exam scores

  • National-level test scores (JEE, NEET, CUET, etc.)

  • Sports and cultural achievements

  • Financial aid for students from weaker sections

Students who perform exceptionally well may be eligible for a 100% tuition cost waiver. Some also receive discounts on hostel fees. Getting ready for LPUNEST can significantly increase your chances of receiving financial aid if you're hoping to be admitted here.

2. Shiv Nadar University, Greater Noida

This university is renowned for its emphasis on academia and research-oriented atmosphere. It provides a large selection of undergraduate degrees in management, engineering, science, and the humanities.

Scholarship Options:

  • Based on SNUSAT (university’s own test)

  • Merit-based and need-based financial aid

  • Additional aid for students from underrepresented backgrounds

The good news is that the university considers all factors when giving scholarships; your background, interview, and intent are just as important as your grades.

3. Ashoka University, Sonepat (Haryana)

Ashoka is among the greatest private choices if you have a preference for the social sciences or liberal arts. Although the tuition is expensive, they have a comprehensive and open financial aid program.

Financial Support:

  • Scholarships based on family income

  • Partial to full fee waivers available

  • Aid is given after a thorough evaluation, including document review and interviews

Don't be put off by the cost if you're driven and have a great academic record because Ashoka believes that money should never be a barrier.

4. Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE), Karnataka

One of India's oldest and most reputable private universities is Manipal University. It is well-known in the engineering, management, and medical domains.

Scholarship Types:

  • Based on MET (Manipal Entrance Test)

  • Board exam performance

  • Scholarships for Karnataka students

  • Support for children of defense personnel and sports achievers

Even if you're on a tight budget, Manipal is worth looking into because it also provides financial aid and fee waivers for worthy students.

5. Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Tamil Nadu

Amrita is renowned for its outstanding academic program and values-based education, particularly in the fields of business, engineering, and health sciences.

Scholarship Types:

  • Based on AEEE (Amrita’s own test) and JEE scores

  • Scholarships for girls under certain government or university schemes

  • Financial aid for top-ranking students

Students who consistently score well on board exams or perform exceptionally well on admission exams stand a good possibility of receiving partial or whole tuition waivers.

6. UPES Dehradun (University of Petroleum and Energy Studies)

Specialized courses in fields like business, law, design, energy, and petroleum are available at UPES. The purpose of these scholarships is to support talent in these specialized fields.

Scholarship Types:

  • Based on UPESEAT, JEE, CUET, and board marks

  • Special scholarships for Uttarakhand state board toppers

  • Girl student scholarships up to 25%–100% in tuition fee

Additionally, each academic year, UPES offers merit scholarships, so doing well in school pays off here.

7. SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Chennai

With several campuses around India, SRM is another well-known brand in the private education industry. It provides courses in business, law, engineering, medicine, and other fields.

Scholarships Provided:

  • SRMJEEE-based scholarships

  • Board toppers and rank holders get up to 100% waiver

  • Special scholarships for differently-abled students, sports achievers, and others

They even offer Chancellor's Scholarships for exceptionally bright students, which covers the full tuition fee.

Final Words

A private university does not necessarily indicate that it is unaffordable. The majority of India's best private schools actively provide scholarships to worthy students.

This is what you should do:

  • Start early and research scholarship schemes before applying.
  • Prepare well for university-specific entrance exams like LPUNEST, SRMJEEE, or AEEE.
  • Don’t ignore scholarships based on your board marks or co-curricular activities.
  • Check deadlines carefully — some scholarship forms need to be submitted separately.

If you’re serious about getting into a good university without putting pressure on your family’s finances, explore your scholarship options as much as you explore colleges.

title: West Bengal NEET UG Counselling 2026: WBMCC Round 1 Registration Begins, Check Complete Schedule and Seat Matrix
description: Get the complete guide to West Bengal NEET UG Counselling 2026, including WBMCC Round 1 registration steps, key dates, reservation rules, and MBBS/BDS seat matrix.
content:
The West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC) has officially commenced the registration process for the West Bengal NEET UG Counselling 2026. Aspiring medical and dental students who have qualified for the NEET UG exam can now apply online for state quota admissions. This state-level counselling handles admissions to MBBS and BDS programs across prestigious government and private medical institutions in West Bengal.

Quick Answer: West Bengal NEET UG Counselling 2026

WBMCC is conducting online registrations for the 85% State Quota seats, Private College State Quota seats, Management Quota seats, and NRI Quota seats. Eligible candidates can register, pay the counselling fee, and complete their document verification online and at designated centers. The official portal for all updates, choice filling, and seat allotment results is wbmcc.nic.in.

Key Facts: West Bengal NEET UG Counselling

  • Counselling Authority: West Bengal Medical Counselling Committee (WBMCC), Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal.
  • Admission Basis: National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) score and rank.
  • Seats Covered: 85% State Quota seats in Government Colleges and 100% seats in Private Medical/Dental Colleges in West Bengal.
  • Courses Offered: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) & Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS).
  • Official Website: wbmcc.nic.in

Complete Schedule for WBMCC Round 1 Counselling 2026

Candidates must keep track of the important counselling dates to avoid missing crucial steps. Below is the typical sequence of events for West Bengal NEET UG Counselling Round 1:

Counselling Event Timeline Details (Tentative)
Online Registration and Fee Payment Mid-August 2026 onwards
Verification of Physical Documents To be scheduled at chosen verification centers
Publication of State Merit List Post physical verification completion
Online Choice Filling and Locking Within 3 days of Merit List publication
Declaration of Round 1 Seat Allotment End of August/Early September 2026
Reporting to Allotted Medical/Dental College 3 - 4 days following allotment declaration

Step-by-Step Guidance for WBMCC Round 1 Registration

Eligible candidates can complete their WBMCC registrations by following this step-by-step process:

Step 1: Online Registration

Visit the official WBMCC website (wbmcc.nic.in) and click on the "UG Medical & Dental Counselling" tab. Enter your NEET UG roll number, application number, date of birth, and security pin to create your unique credentials.

Step 2: Pay the Counselling Fee

Candidates need to pay a non-refundable registration fee. The typical fee is INR 2,000 for General/OBC-A/OBC-B candidates and INR 1,500 for SC/ST/PwD candidates. Payment can be made online via credit card, debit card, or net banking.

Step 3: Upload Documents & Selection of Verification Center

Fill out the application form with personal, academic, and NEET exam details. Candidates must choose their physical document verification center from the list of designated government medical colleges in West Bengal.

Step 4: Physical Document Verification

Go to the chosen verification center with all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Upon successful verification, an "Acknowledgement Slip" will be generated online, which is mandatory for choice filling.

Step 5: Choice Filling and Locking

Log back into the portal using your credentials. Select your preferred choices of colleges and courses from the available list. Ensure you lock your choices before the deadline; otherwise, they will be locked automatically.

West Bengal Reservation Policies 2026

The allocation of medical and dental seats complies with the state reservation policy. The reservation categories for West Bengal State Quota seats are as follows:

  • Scheduled Castes (SC): 22%
  • Scheduled Tribes (ST): 6%
  • Other Backward Classes - A (OBC-A): 10%
  • Other Backward Classes - B (OBC-B): 7%
  • Economically Weaker Sections (EWS): 10%
  • Persons with Disabilities (PwD): 5% horizontal reservation within each category

West Bengal MBBS and BDS Seat Matrix

West Bengal boasts several prestigious medical institutions, offering over 4,500 MBBS seats across both government and private colleges. Prominent participating institutions include:

  • Medical College, Kolkata
  • Nil Ratan Sircar (NRS) Medical College, Kolkata
  • IPGMER and SSKM Hospital, Kolkata
  • R.G. Kar Medical College, Kolkata
  • Calcutta National Medical College (CNMC), Kolkata
  • Burdwan Medical College, Burdwan
  • North Bengal Medical College, Darjeeling

The exact seat matrix for the academic year 2026 will be released by WBMCC just before the choice filling phase begins. Candidates are advised to download the seat matrix PDF to understand category-wise seat availability.

Required Documents for Verification

Candidates must carry the following original documents for verification:

  • NEET UG Admit Card and Scorecard
  • Class 10 Admit Card or Birth Certificate (as age proof)
  • Class 12 Mark Sheet and Passing Certificate
  • Domicile Certificate (Proforma a1, a2, or b)
  • Category Certificate (if applicable, issued by competent WB authority)
  • Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport)
  • Passport-sized photographs (matching the NEET application)

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Who is eligible for West Bengal NEET State Quota counselling?

Only candidates who have qualified in the NEET UG exam and satisfy the domicile requirements of West Bengal (Proforma a1, a2, or b) are eligible for the 85% State Quota seats.

2. What is the application fee for WBMCC NEET counselling?

The standard registration fee is INR 2,000 for General/OBC candidates and INR 1,500 for Reserved categories (SC/ST/PwD).

3. Can non-domicile students apply for West Bengal medical seats?

Non-domicile candidates cannot apply for State Quota seats in government colleges. However, they may apply for management quota seats in private medical and dental colleges, subject to the rules laid down by WBMCC.

4. Is physical document verification mandatory for choice filling?

Yes. Only candidates who successfully verify their documents physically at the designated verification centers and receive an online acknowledgment slip can participate in the choice-filling round.

Sources

  • Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal

title: NMAT 2026: అక్టోబర్ 31లోగా రిజిస్ట్రేషన్‌తో పాటు పరీక్ష స్లాట్ బుక్ చేసుకోండి
description: NMAT 2026 రిజిస్ట్రేషన్, స్లాట్ బుకింగ్ రెండింటికీ అక్టోబర్ 31 గడువు. ఫీజు, అడ్మిట్ కార్డు, కాలేజీలకు వేరుగా దరఖాస్తు చేసే విధానం తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
NMAT 2026 అభ్యర్థులు రిజిస్ట్రేషన్, పరీక్ష స్లాట్ బుకింగ్ రెండింటినీ 31 అక్టోబర్ 2026లోగా పూర్తి చేయాలి. ఫీజు చెల్లించడం ఒక్కటే సరిపోదు; అభ్యర్థి డ్యాష్‌బోర్డులో పరీక్ష అపాయింట్‌మెంట్ నిర్ధారణ కూడా ఉండాలి. GMAC షెడ్యూల్ ప్రకారం పరీక్షలు 2 నవంబర్ నుంచి 20 డిసెంబర్ 2026 వరకు జరుగుతాయి.

గడువులోగా పూర్తి చేయాల్సిన రెండు పనులు

అధికారిక తేదీలు, ఫీజుల పేజీలో రిజిస్ట్రేషన్‌కూ షెడ్యూలింగ్‌కూ అక్టోబర్ 31 చివరి తేదీగా ఉంది. ఇప్పటికే ఫీజు చెల్లిస్తే డ్యాష్‌బోర్డులో పరీక్ష తేదీ, సమయం, కేంద్రం ఖరారయ్యాయో చూడండి. చెల్లింపు రసీదును స్లాట్ నిర్ధారణగా భావించకండి.

అందుబాటులో ఉన్న స్లాట్లు ముందుగా బుక్ చేసుకున్నవారికి కేటాయిస్తారు. ప్రయాణానికి అనువైన సమయాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి. మీకు కావాల్సిన కేంద్రం లేదా వారాంతపు రోజు చివరి వరకు ఉంటుందని అనుకోకండి. తర్వాత ఉన్న రీషెడ్యూలింగ్ గడువు ప్రారంభ రిజిస్ట్రేషన్, బుకింగ్ గడువును పొడిగించదు.

GMAC అధికారిక NMAT 2026 షెడ్యూల్‌లోని భాగం. ఈ వెబ్ పేజీలో పత్రం ప్రచురణ తేదీ ఇవ్వలేదు. అధికారిక తేదీలు, ఫీజులు

ఫీజు చెల్లించే ముందు గుర్తింపు వివరాలు చూడండి

GMAC సూచనల ప్రకారం ఖాతా తెరవండి లేదా లాగిన్ అవ్వండి. ఈమెయిల్ ధ్రువీకరించి ప్రొఫైల్, దరఖాస్తు పూర్తి చేయండి. పేరు, పుట్టిన తేదీ పరీక్షకు ఉపయోగించే ఫోటో గుర్తింపు పత్రంతో సరిగ్గా సరిపోవాలి. మిమ్మల్ని గుర్తించగలిగే ఇటీవలి ఫోటో అప్‌లోడ్ చేయండి.

రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ఫీజు ₹3,000తో పాటు వర్తించే పన్నులు. ఐదు ఎంపిక చేసిన సంస్థలకు స్కోర్ రిపోర్టులు పంపడం ఇందులో ఉంటుంది. అదనపు ప్రతి రిపోర్టుకు ₹400తో పాటు పన్నులు చెల్లించాలి. చెల్లింపుకు ముందు సంస్థల ఎంపికలు చూసి రసీదు ఉంచుకోండి.

రిజిస్ట్రేషన్, స్లాట్ బుకింగ్ అధికారిక సూచనలు

స్లాట్ నిర్ధారణ, అడ్మిట్ కార్డు భద్రపరచండి

ఫీజు చెల్లించాక డ్యాష్‌బోర్డులో Book Exam Slot ఎంచుకోండి. పరీక్ష కేంద్రంలో రాసే విధానాన్ని ఎంచుకుని నిబంధనలు చదివి, అందుబాటులోని నగరం, కేంద్రం, తేదీ, సమయం ఎంపిక చేయండి. మరో నగరానికి వెళ్తుంటే తుది నిర్ధారణను జాగ్రత్తగా పరిశీలించండి.

బుక్ చేసిన పరీక్ష తేదీకి ఏడు రోజుల ముందు డ్యాష్‌బోర్డు నుంచి అడ్మిట్ కార్డు డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసుకోవచ్చని GMAC తెలిపింది. దానికి రిమైండర్ పెట్టుకోండి. రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ సమస్యకు అధికారిక సహాయాన్ని సంప్రదించేటప్పుడు లావాదేవీ రిఫరెన్స్ సిద్ధంగా ఉంచండి; పాస్‌వర్డ్ లేదా రహస్య చెల్లింపు వివరాలు పంచుకోవద్దు.

బిజినెస్ స్కూళ్లకు విడిగా దరఖాస్తు చేయాలి

NMAT రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ చేస్తే విశ్వవిద్యాలయం లేదా బిజినెస్ స్కూల్ MBA దరఖాస్తు స్వయంగా సమర్పించబడదు. ప్రతి సంస్థ అర్హత, దరఖాస్తు గడువు, స్కోర్ అంగీకార విధానం వేరుగా ఉండవచ్చు. సంస్థ దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు చెల్లించే ముందు అధికారిక నిబంధనలు చదవండి.

ప్రతి కోర్సుకు దరఖాస్తు, చెల్లింపు నిర్ధారణ, స్కోర్ రిపోర్టు ఎంపిక, తదుపరి ఎంపిక దశల కోసం విడి జాబితా ఉంచుకోండి. పరీక్ష రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ పూర్తయిందంటే ప్రవేశ దరఖాస్తు కూడా పూర్తయిందని కాదు.

title: SRMHCAT 2027: Exam Dates, Eligibility, Registration, Syllabus, Pattern and Admission
description: Get the latest information on SRMHCAT 2027, including eligibility criteria, application process, exam dates, syllabus, pattern, preparation tips, results and admission at SRM University Delhi-NCR, Sonepat.
content:
SRMHCAT 2027 is the entrance examination associated with SRM University Delhi-NCR, Sonepat, Haryana, for admission to various undergraduate and postgraduate programmes. The examination assesses candidates through course-specific questions and aptitude-based sections, depending on the programme selected. Students planning to pursue engineering, management, commerce, law and other available courses should understand the examination requirements before applying.

The SRMHCAT 2027 exam is expected to be conducted in multiple phases, allowing candidates to select an available examination session during registration. According to the latest information available, the test pattern includes 100 multiple-choice questions, a duration of 90 minutes and a maximum score of 300 marks. However, applicants should confirm the final examination schedule, application fee and other details through the university's official admission portal.

This guide by DekhoCampus explains the SRMHCAT 2027 eligibility criteria, registration procedure, exam pattern, syllabus, preparation strategy, admit card, result and admission process.

What Is SRMHCAT?

SRMHCAT stands for SRM University Delhi-NCR Sonepat Haryana Common Aptitude Test. It is an entrance examination used by the university as part of its admission process for eligible undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.

The examination evaluates candidates according to the academic and aptitude requirements of their chosen course. Depending on the programme, the question paper may include Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or sections covering quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, language comprehension and general awareness.

Candidates seeking MBA admission may also be considered through accepted national-level management entrance examinations, subject to the university's admission rules.

SRMHCAT is generally organised in phases, and candidates may receive an examination date and time slot according to the available schedule and their registration details. Applicants should monitor the university website for the release of the application form and the announcement of examination sessions.

SRMHCAT 2027 Eligibility Criteria

The eligibility criteria for SRMHCAT depend on the course for which a candidate intends to apply. Students must meet the academic qualification and minimum percentage requirements applicable to their selected programme.

Eligibility for Undergraduate Courses

Candidates applying for undergraduate programmes such as BBA, B.Com, integrated MBA and eligible law courses should generally have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. The minimum qualifying marks depend on the course and university admission rules.

For programmes covered by the published eligibility criteria, a minimum aggregate of 50% in the qualifying examination is specified.

Eligibility for Postgraduate Courses

Candidates seeking admission to postgraduate programmes such as MBA, LLB where applicable, and MA English should hold a recognised bachelor's degree in accordance with the requirements of the selected course.

For MBA admission, the published criteria specify a bachelor's degree of at least three years' duration and a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying examination. Candidates must also meet the entrance examination and interview requirements or qualify through an alternative accepted entrance examination, where applicable.

SRMHCAT 2027 Application Form

Candidates can apply for SRMHCAT through the university's admission portal. The registration process involves creating an account, entering academic details, uploading the required documents and paying the prescribed application fee.

The application fee reported in previous admission information is ₹1,100. Candidates should confirm the applicable fee for SRMHCAT 2027 before submitting the form.

How to Apply for SRMHCAT 2027

  1. Visit the official SRM University Delhi-NCR admission website.

  2. Open the SRMHCAT or admissions section and select the relevant programme.

  3. Register using your name, email address and mobile number.

  4. Log in with the credentials provided during registration.

  5. Enter personal details, academic qualifications and programme preferences.

  6. Upload the photograph, signature and other documents requested in the application form.

  7. Pay the application fee through the available online payment options.

  8. Review the application details and retain the confirmation for future reference.

Candidates should enter accurate information because discrepancies in the application or supporting documents may affect admission and verification.

SRMHCAT 2027 Exam Pattern

Understanding the examination pattern helps candidates organise their preparation and manage the available time effectively. The test structure may differ according to the selected programme.

For the commonly published SRMHCAT pattern, candidates have 90 minutes to answer 100 multiple-choice questions. Each correct response carries three marks, and the published marking scheme does not deduct marks for incorrect answers.

SRMHCAT 2027 Syllabus

The SRMHCAT syllabus varies according to the course. Candidates should focus on the subjects prescribed for their programme rather than preparing from a single syllabus for every course.

1. Quantitative Techniques

This section may assess numerical ability, mathematical concepts and problem-solving skills. Important topics to practise include:

  • Percentages

  • Ratio and proportion

  • Algebra

  • Geometry and mensuration

  • Time, speed and distance

  • Time and work

  • Partnership

  • Probability

  • Data interpretation

2. Logical Reasoning

Logical reasoning questions test the ability to identify patterns, interpret information and solve analytical problems. Candidates can practise:

  • Coding and decoding

  • Number and letter series

  • Blood relations

  • Seating arrangements

  • Puzzles

  • Syllogisms

  • Venn diagrams

  • Charts and graphical reasoning

3. Language Comprehension

The language section focuses on English usage, vocabulary, grammar and reading comprehension. Important topics include:

  • Reading comprehension

  • Synonyms and antonyms

  • Sentence completion

  • Grammar and error correction

  • Para jumbles

  • Fill in the blanks

  • Vocabulary and one-word substitutions

4. General Awareness

Candidates should develop awareness of national and international developments, along with basic static general knowledge. Useful areas include:

  • Current affairs

  • Indian polity

  • Geography

  • Economics

  • Sports

  • Awards and honours

  • Business and industry news

  • Computer fundamentals

5. Engineering Subjects

Candidates applying for B.Tech should revise Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics according to the syllabus prescribed by the university. Class 11 and Class 12 concepts may be relevant, but applicants should use the official course-specific syllabus as their primary reference.

How to Prepare for SRMHCAT 2027

A focused preparation plan can help candidates improve accuracy and use the examination time efficiently. The strategy should reflect the course-specific syllabus and the candidate's current level of preparation.

Understand the syllabus first: Identify the topics prescribed for your programme and divide them into manageable study targets.

Build strong fundamentals: Revise basic mathematical formulas, English grammar rules, reasoning techniques or science concepts before attempting difficult questions.

Practise regularly: Solve topic-wise questions and timed practice sets. Review mistakes instead of only counting correct answers.

Improve time management: With 100 questions and 90 minutes, candidates have an average of 54 seconds per question. Practise deciding when to answer a question and when to move on.

Revise general awareness: Candidates whose examination includes this section should follow reliable current-affairs sources and revise important developments regularly.

Take mock tests: Simulate the examination duration to improve speed, confidence and question selection.

Review official instructions: Check the latest examination pattern, syllabus and test-day requirements before the scheduled date.

SRMHCAT 2027 Admit Card

Candidates should follow the university's instructions to obtain their SRMHCAT admit card or examination confirmation. Availability and download procedures will be announced through the official admission portal.

After downloading the document, check the following details:

  • Candidate's name and photograph

  • Registration or examination number

  • Examination date and time

  • Reporting time

  • Examination venue or online test instructions

  • Other instructions issued by the university

If any information is incorrect, contact the university's admission office before the examination. Candidates should follow the instructions regarding identification documents and reporting requirements.

SRMHCAT 2027 Result

The university will announce the result according to its admission schedule. Candidates should check their registered email address and the official admission portal for updates.

How to Check the SRMHCAT Result

  1. Visit the official university website.

  2. Open the admissions or SRMHCAT result section.

  3. Log in using the requested registration credentials.

  4. View the result or scorecard, if available.

  5. Download and save a copy for counselling and admission.

The result may be used to shortlist candidates for further admission stages. Applicants should check whether an interview, counselling session or additional assessment is required for their selected programme.

SRMHCAT 2027 Admission Process

Admission to SRM University Delhi-NCR, Sonepat, generally involves several stages. The precise process depends on the selected course and the university's admission rules.

  1. Registration: Submit the application form with accurate academic and personal information.

  2. Entrance examination or accepted score: Appear for SRMHCAT or submit an alternative entrance examination score where permitted.

  3. Shortlisting: The university evaluates candidates according to the applicable selection criteria.

  4. Interview or counselling: Attend the required interview, counselling or assessment round.

  5. Document verification: Provide the necessary educational and identity documents.

  6. Admission confirmation: Complete the prescribed fee payment and other formalities within the specified deadline.

For MBA applicants, accepted alternative entrance examinations may include CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT or NMAT, subject to the university's current policy. Candidates should confirm whether an alternative score exempts them from SRMHCAT and whether an interview remains compulsory.

SRMHCAT Scholarships

Eligible candidates may be considered for scholarships based on entrance examination performance, academic merit or other criteria announced by the university. Scholarship availability and award amounts can change between admission cycles.

Students should check the current scholarship policy for:

  • SRMHCAT rank-based awards

  • Academic merit scholarships

  • Scholarships linked to recognised entrance examinations

  • Haryana domicile-related benefits, where applicable

  • Other university-sponsored financial assistance

Scholarship eligibility, continuation requirements and seat allocation should be confirmed directly with the university before making financial decisions.

Conclusion

SRMHCAT 2027 is an important admission route for students considering eligible programmes at SRM University Delhi-NCR, Sonepat, Haryana. Before registering, candidates should review the course-specific eligibility requirements, syllabus, marking scheme, examination schedule and selection process. Preparing according to the prescribed subjects and checking official notifications regularly can help students avoid application errors and plan their admission journey more effectively.

For students comparing colleges, entrance examinations and admission options, DekhoCampus can help organise university information and understand the next steps. Candidates should always verify final eligibility, fees, scholarships and admission decisions with the university before completing enrolment.

title: CLAT NLU Choice: How to Compare Hostel and Living Costs
description: Compare NLU and local law-college costs using tuition, hostel, mess, travel, deposits and daily spending before accepting a CLAT counselling offer.
content:
A CLAT counselling college-cost comparison can change your choice completely: an NLU with lower tuition may still cost your family more once hostel fees, mess bills, travel and deposits are added. Before accepting an offer, calculate the full yearly outflow and compare it with the local law-college option.

What should you include in the comparison?

Don’t compare the tuition line alone. For an NLU, count every cost linked to living away from home. For a local college, count the costs that replace hostel spending, such as bus fare, fuel, rent or meals bought outside.

Cost headNLU away from homeLocal law college
Tuition and academic chargesAnnual fee, examination charges and library or activity chargesAnnual fee and college charges
AccommodationHostel fee, room deposit and maintenance amountUsually zero, unless rented accommodation is needed
FoodMess fee, snacks and occasional outside mealsHome meals or daily food expenses
TravelTrips home, local transport and holiday travelDaily commute and exam-day travel
First-year extrasBedding, laptop, books, uniform or joining itemsBooks, commute setup and admission costs

How do you calculate the real family bill?

Use one annual figure for each option. Add the one-time deposit separately, because it affects cash needed at admission even if it may be refundable later. A practical formula is: tuition and college charges + hostel or rent + food + travel + study materials + personal spending + one-time payment.

For example, if an NLU requires ₹1.6 lakh in academic and residential charges, ₹36,000 for travel, ₹24,000 for personal spending and ₹15,000 in first-year setup costs, the first-year outflow is ₹2.35 lakh. That number matters more than a brochure’s tuition figure. Treat this as a sample calculation, not a fee estimate.

When is the local option financially stronger?

A local college may win when the student can stay at home, commute safely and avoid a large refundable deposit. But don’t call it cheaper without checking travel time, daily transport, private coaching, books and the law opportunities actually available through the college.

For the NLU, ask for the current fee sheet, hostel rules, mess billing method, refund terms and likely travel cost. Compare colleges side by side through college comparison tools, and use the exam section for related CLAT planning. If the family would need a loan, calculate the repayment burden before locking the preference order. A prestigious name isn’t a blank cheque.

title: JEE Main 2027 Session Choice: When One Attempt Is the Smarter Plan
description: Should you choose JEE Main 2027 Session 1, Session 2 or both? Match your attempt plan to readiness, board pressure, correction risk and fees.
content:
For JEE Main 2027, one well-prepared attempt can be smarter than booking both sessions out of fear. Choose Session 1 when your syllabus, revision and timed-paper practice are ready. Make Session 2 your main target when board work or unfinished fundamentals will make an early attempt rushed. Plan both only when you can use the first result to fix a specific problem.

The National Testing Agency conducts JEE Main, but the 2027 dates, fees, correction rules and session instructions must come from its official notice. The official JEE Main portal is the place to check those details when released. Until then, decide through preparation evidence, not coaching rumours.

When is Session 1 the sensible choice?

Session 1 fits students who can finish the main syllabus early enough to revise and sit full papers under exam conditions. You should have worked through Physics formulas, Chemistry facts from NCERT and timed Mathematics sets, not just watched lectures. One paper can expose weak chapters and careless errors early, but that feedback helps only if you have time and discipline to act on it.

If your basics are still shaky in several chapters, an early attempt may consume revision time without giving useful information. That doesn't make you less capable. It means Session 2 may protect your preparation better.

When does taking both sessions make sense?

Both sessions are worth considering when the gap between them fits your study calendar, board commitments and fee plan. The second attempt should have a job: improve time division, reduce negative marking or repair a known topic gap. It cannot replace unfinished preparation.

Your situationBetter working planReason
Revision is active and full papers have startedSession 1, with Session 2 as an improvement optionEarly performance can guide targeted changes
Boards or major chapters need attentionPrepare mainly for Session 2You avoid forcing an under-ready paper
Fear is the only reason to pay for bothPause and reviewA second fee doesn't create readiness

How should you decide before registration?

  1. Take one complete three-hour paper in exam conditions.
  2. Separate unanswered questions, concept gaps and careless errors.
  3. Mark the board, practical and school-work weeks that will reduce study time.
  4. Choose the session your calendar can support properly.
  5. Before submitting details, check personal information, category entry, subjects, photograph rules, payment status and permitted corrections in the NTA notice. Save the form and payment record.

Keep your JEE preparation material focused on the errors your paper reveals. Your target isn't to collect attempts. It's to produce a score that helps with the next admission decision.

title: OUAT 2027: Form A, Form B வேறுபாட்டை முதலில் புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்
description: OUAT 2027 கால அட்டவணை இன்னும் வரவில்லை. முந்தைய ஆண்டின் இரு விண்ணப்ப நிலைகள், மதிப்பெண் பதிவு மற்றும் ஆவணத் தயாரிப்பை அறியுங்கள்.
content:
OUAT 2027 சேர்க்கைக்குத் தயாராகிறீர்களா? விண்ணப்பத் தேதி அல்லது இணைப்பை நம்புவதற்கு முன் பல்கலைக்கழகத்தின் புதிய அறிவிப்புக்குக் காத்திருங்கள். முந்தைய இளநிலைச் சேர்க்கையில் நுழைவுத் தேர்வுக்குப் பதிவு செய்வதும் சேர்க்கைக்குத் தேவையான முழுத் தகவல்களை அளிப்பதும் தனித்தனி பணிகளாக இருந்தன.

இரண்டு படிவங்கள் ஏன் தேவைப்பட்டன?

2026-27 இளநிலைச் சேர்க்கை விளக்கக் கையேடு Form A மற்றும் Form B இரண்டையும் கோரியது. Form A நுழைவுத் தேர்வுக்கான விண்ணப்பம். Form B கல்வி மதிப்பெண்கள், பொருந்தும் பிரிவு உரிமைகோரல்கள் உள்ளிட்ட கூடுதல் சேர்க்கைத் தகவல்களுக்கானது.

வழக்கமான நுழைவுத் தேர்வு வழியில், தேர்வு எழுதியிருந்தாலும் Form B சமர்ப்பிக்காவிட்டால் தரவரிசை உருவாகாது; சேர்க்கைக்குத் தகுதியும் இருக்காது என்று கையேடு கூறியது. இது முந்தைய ஆண்டின் விதி; 2027க்குப் புதிதாக அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட விதி அல்ல. புதிய கையேடு வந்ததும் இரு நிலைகளும் தொடர்கின்றனவா எனப் பார்த்து ஒவ்வொரு காலக்கெடுவையும் தனியாகக் குறித்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள். கீழுள்ள தேதிகள் பழைய 2026 சுற்றைச் சேர்ந்தவை.

மதிப்பெண் பட்டியலைப் பார்த்தே கணக்கிடுங்கள்

முந்தைய Form B வழிமுறைகள் பத்தாம், பன்னிரண்டாம் வகுப்புகளின் தொடர்புடைய அனைத்துப் பாட மதிப்பெண்களையும், கூடுதல் மற்றும் கூடுதல் விருப்பப் பாடங்களையும் சேர்த்துக் கேட்டன. தாங்களாகத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த சிறந்த ஐந்து அல்லது ஆறு பாடங்களின் கணக்கை ஏற்கவில்லை. தரநிலைகள் வழங்கும் வாரியங்களுக்கும் இரண்டு ஆண்டுகளுக்கான மதிப்பெண்கள் வழங்கும் வாரியங்களுக்கும் தனி வழிமுறைகள் இருந்தன.

அசல் மதிப்பெண் பட்டியல்களை வைத்துக்கொண்டு பாடப் பெயர், மொத்த மதிப்பெண், பெற்ற மதிப்பெண் ஆகியவற்றை எழுதுங்கள். தரநிலைகள் இருந்தால் உங்கள் வாரியத்தின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ மாற்று முறையைப் பாருங்கள். ஊகித்தோ வேறு விண்ணப்பத்தில் பயன்படுத்திய சதவீதத்தை எடுத்தோ நிரப்ப வேண்டாம்.

தேர்வுப் பாடமும் படிப்புத் தகுதியும் தனித்தனி

2026 Form Aவில் இயற்பியல், வேதியியலுடன் கணிதம் அல்லது உயிரியல் ஒன்றை விருப்பத் தேர்வுப் பாடமாகத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்க வேண்டியிருந்தது. அந்தத் தேர்வைத் திருத்தவும் காலக்கெடு இருந்தது. 2027 விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பிக்கும் முன் புதிய தேர்வு வழிமுறைகளையும் விரும்பும் படிப்பின் கல்வித் தகுதியையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.

விரும்பும் படிப்புகள், வளாகங்களைப் பட்டியலிட்டு உங்கள் பன்னிரண்டாம் வகுப்புப் பாடங்களுடன் பொருத்திப் பாருங்கள். நுழைவுத் தேர்வில் ஒரு பாடத்தைத் தேர்வு செய்ததால் படிப்புக்கான அடிப்படைப் பாடத் தகுதி நீங்கிவிடாது.

அறிவிப்பு வரும்வரை செய்யக்கூடியவை

  • சேர்க்கை முழுவதும் பயன்படுத்தக்கூடிய மின்னஞ்சல், கைப்பேசி எண்ணை வைத்திருங்கள்.
  • தெளிவான கல்வி ஆவணங்களைத் திரட்டி பெயர், பிறந்த தேதியை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.
  • இடஒதுக்கீடு அல்லது சிறப்பு ஒதுக்கீட்டுக்குத் தேவையான சான்றுகளை அடையாளம் காணுங்கள்.
  • விண்ணப்பம் திறந்ததும் சமர்ப்பித்த ஒவ்வொரு படிவத்தையும் கட்டண ரசீதையும் தனித்தனியாகச் சேமியுங்கள்.

புதிய கையேடு, திருத்தங்களுக்கு OUAT சேர்க்கைப் பக்கத்தை அணுகுங்கள். 2026 கட்டணம், கட்ஆஃப், இட எண்ணிக்கை அல்லது கலந்தாய்வுத் தேதியை 2027க்கான உறுதியாக எடுத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டாம். பல்கலைக்கழகம் உறுதிப்படுத்தும்வரை திட்டத்தில் மாற்றத்திற்கு இடமளியுங்கள்.

title: BTech Admission 2026: Five Placement Claims Parents Must Verify
description: Before paying BTech college fees, parents should test placement claims against batch size, median salary, recruiter records and approval status.
content:
A BTech college can advertise a high package while most students in the graduating batch remain outside that figure. Before paying fees for 2026 admission, ask for placement data that covers the full eligible batch, not just a glossy success story. These five checks will show whether the claim reflects your child’s likely outcome.

1. Ask: placed out of how many students?

“90% placements” means little without the number of eligible students, the number who accepted offers and the branches included. A college may combine computer science with smaller batches or leave students who did not sit for placements out of the calculation.

Request the batch strength, eligible students, students placed and students pursuing higher studies or entrepreneurship. If the college won’t separate these figures, treat the percentage as marketing, not evidence.

2. Read the median salary, not only the highest package

The highest package is an outlier. The median salary is more useful because half of the reported salaries fall below it and half above it. Also ask whether the figure is annual cost to company, fixed pay or an internship conversion package.

Compare the median with the total four-year cost, including tuition, hostel, transport and deposits. A ₹10 lakh fee against a low median salary needs a much harder look than a headline package suggests.

3. Match recruiters to roles and branches

A recruiter logo doesn’t prove that it hired BTech students from your chosen branch. Ask for the recruiting company, role, branch, joining status and number of offers. A list showing one company but several job titles can hide a major difference between software engineering, support, sales and analyst work.

For a safer college comparison, build a small sheet with these columns. If the admissions team only shares logos, ask for an anonymised placement report.

4. Check the year and batch behind the claim

Placement figures must carry a graduating year. A 2023 result shouldn’t silently sell a 2026 admission decision, especially after changes in hiring conditions, intake or course structure. Ask whether the published report is final or still collecting offers.

5. Separate approval from employability

AICTE approval, university affiliation or accreditation addresses regulatory and academic status. None of these guarantees a job, salary or recruiter participation. Check the approval or affiliation for the exact campus and programme, then judge placements separately.

Before you sign a fee agreement, save the brochure, placement page and written answers from the college. Compare the syllabus and branch details through course information, and ask what happens if a student doesn’t secure a placement. That answer often tells you more than the biggest package on the poster.

title: Comprehensive Guide to Indian Education Scholarships 2026: Eligibility, Windowed Applications, and Outcome Maximization Across Central and State Schemes
description: A detailed 2026 overview of Indian scholarship schemes across central and state governments, including eligibility criteria, application windows, and strategies to maximize successful outcomes for students and families.
content:
Editorial headline and overview

Seeking scholarships in 2026 requires understanding multiple central and state schemes, clear eligibility criteria, and timely action. This guide lays out practical steps to navigate windowed applications and to optimize outcomes for Indian students and parents across diverse streams and regions.

Key scholarship categories and who qualifies

Scholarships in India range from merit-based to need-based, and from general studies to inclusive programs for specific communities or disciplines. Core categories include:

  • Central government scholarships for pre-mellow and higher education, including schemes tied to national examinations and targeted groups.
  • State government scholarships aligned with domicile, income thresholds, and category-based criteria.
  • University-level and institute-specific awards that may complement government schemes.
  • Private-contributed funds and public-private partnership initiatives that follow their own eligibility rules.

Because eligibility varies by scheme, students should map potential awards to their profile, including course, level of study, income, category, disability status, and residency.

Eligibility essentials by scheme type

While each scholarship has its own criteria, common eligibility threads include:

  • Academic merit: many schemes require minimum grade points or exam percentile thresholds.
  • Residency and domicile: schemes often target students within specific states or union territories (or for central schemes, applicants nationwide).
  • Economic need: income proofs and family financial status commonly determine eligibility for need-based awards.
  • Course and level alignment: some awards are restricted to particular streams (science, engineering, arts, management) or to undergraduate, postgraduate, or doctoral studies.
  • If applicable, reserved category status: several schemes require valid caste or disability documentation and meet eligibility cutoffs.

Always verify the exact criteria on the official scheme website or the relevant government portal before applying.

Windowed application timelines in 2026

Application windows vary widely across schemes. Typical patterns include:

  • Annual cycles with a primary window in the first half of the academic year and a possible second window for renewing students.
  • Rolling registrations for some central schemes, with deadlines tied to the start of the academic term.
  • State-level windows that may differ from neighbouring states, sometimes linked to school board results or college admissions cycles.

To avoid missing deadlines, maintain a personal calendar with reminders two to three weeks before each scheme’s closing date and double-check required documents well in advance.

Document readiness and common submission requirements

Typical documentation includes:

  • Identity and residency proofs (Aadhaar or other government IDs, domicile certificates if applicable)
  • Academic records (marksheets, grade sheets, and graduation certificates where relevant)
  • Income certificates and family income proofs for needs-based awards
  • Community certificates to prove reserved category status
  • Bonafide or admission letters from the host institution
  • Passport-sized photos and digital copies as required by the portal

Ensure transcripts are legible and certified copies are submitted when asked. Some portals require scanned originals in specific file formats.

Strategies to maximize scholarship outcomes

Beyond meeting eligibility, applicants can improve their chances through these practices:

  • Early preparation: list potential scholarships and monitor official notifications at least three to six months ahead of deadlines.
  • Quality impact statements: if schemes request essays or personal statements, craft concise narratives that connect academics, goals, and community impact.
  • Strong recommendations: seek letters from teachers or mentors who can vouch for both scholarship-specific criteria and character traits like perseverance and leadership.
  • Correct data entry: typos or incorrect contact details can derail submission and communications. Double-check all fields before final submission.
  • Follow-up and compliance: after submission, monitor portals for status updates, additional documents requests, and interview calls if applicable.
  • Backup plans: apply to multiple eligible schemes to diversify chances. Do not rely on a single award.

Central vs state schemes: coordinating your approach

Central schemes typically cast a wider eligibility net and may offer broad-based support, while state schemes often reflect regional priorities and can be more accessible to domicile-based applicants. A coordinated plan should include:

  • A core set of 3-5 central schemes with lines of eligibility matching the student profile
  • 2-4 state schemes targeting the home state or region
  • Institution-specific scholarships that can complement government awards

Keeping a consolidated record of application IDs, submission dates, and communication threads helps manage multiple deadlines smoothly.

Verifying details and staying updated

Official portals contain the authoritative information on eligibility, documents, and deadlines. If any detail seems unclear or uncertain, verify directly through the relevant authority’s portal. For changes in rules, timelines, or required documents, rely on the official announcements rather than secondary summaries.

Next steps for students and parents

Begin with a personal scholarship map: list eligible schemes based on course, level, and domicile. Create a calendar of deadlines, prepare documents in advance, and allocate time for application drafting and reviews. Seek guidance from school counsellors or college offices if available, and consider connecting with scholarship coordinators at target universities for confirmation on institutional awards.

Frequently asked questions

Q1: How soon should I start looking for scholarships if I am entering undergraduate studies?

A1: Start researching at least six to nine months before the admission cycle. Many schemes open applications in the months preceding the academic year and require early submissions.

Q2: Can I apply for more than one scholarship at the same time?

A2: Yes, you can apply to multiple schemes if you meet the eligibility criteria. Ensure you can meet all reporting requirements and avoid conflicting deadlines.

Q3: What if I miss a deadline for a central scheme?

A3: Some central schemes have fixed deadlines; missing them means you may have to wait for the next cycle. In such cases, promptly explore alternative schemes with later windows or rolling admissions.

Q4: How can I verify the accuracy of eligibility and document requirements?

A4: Check the official scheme page or government portal for the most current criteria. If anything remains unclear, contact the designated helpline or the scholarship administrator for clarification.

Q5: Do state scholarships depend on my income level?

A5: Many state schemes consider family income, but some are targeted by merit or category. Review each scheme’s terms to understand whether income is a factor and what proofs are required.

Conclusion

In 2026, Indian students have a diversified landscape of scholarship opportunities. A proactive, organized approach-mapping schemes to profiles, maintaining a calendar, and ensuring document readiness-can significantly improve the likelihood of securing support across central and state programs. Verify specifics on official authority portals and follow up promptly to maximize outcomes.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
description: ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ (ਕੋਡ 154) ਪੇਪਰ 20 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ (ਕੋਡ 154) ਪੇਪਰ 20 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ
ਜਮਾਤ 10: ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ (Elements of Business)15420 ਫਰਵਰੀ 202710:30 - 13:303 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 4: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 4 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 154 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਰੋਬਾਰ ਦੇ ਬੁਨਿਆਦੀ ਤੱਤ (154) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 20 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Language and Literature (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 6 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ

ਪੇਪਰ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਦਾ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ, ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਵੇਖੋ। ਬਦਲਾਅ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਸੋਧੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਮਾਤ, ਕੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: UP NEET UG 2026 Round 3: Check Merit and Lock Choices by 31 October
description: The UP NEET UG round-three merit list is available. Review your college order and lock choices by 5 pm on 31 October to be considered for allotment.
content:
UP NEET UG 2026 round-three candidates should check their entry in the state merit list and complete choice filling by 5 pm on 31 October 2026. The official counselling portal lists the round-three merit list, schedule and participation guidelines under Latest News.

Locking matters: the round-three guidelines say candidates who do not lock their choices will not be included in the seat-allotment process. Once locked, the choices cannot be changed.

The next three stages

Stage

Official schedule

Choice filling closes

31 October 2026, 5 pm

Seat-allotment result

2 November 2026

Allotment-letter download and admission

3 to 7 November 2026

A merit-list entry is not a college allotment. Use it to check your counselling details, then follow the choice-filling stage and wait for the separate allotment result.

Put only acceptable options on your list

The official guidelines advise candidates to choose colleges where they actually want admission. Before ordering the list, compare the course, college, applicable fees and your eligibility for the seat category.

Keep the most preferred acceptable option above a less preferred one. Do not add an unaffordable or unsuitable option merely to lengthen the list. Review the full order once more before locking, then retain a copy of the choices and the locking status.

If you already hold a seat

Read the upgradation conditions in the round-three guidelines carefully. They explain when a previous seat is vacated after a new allotment and when it is retained. Do not assume that you can keep both seats or undo a choice after locking.

Use the UG section, not the PG portal

The website carries MBBS/BDS and postgraduate notices together. Match the heading to NEET UG 2026 and the third round before opening a merit list or using an online service.

For a problem with your eligibility or document status, the schedule lists helplines 8189011696 to 8189011700, available from 11 am to 5 pm. Keep your registration reference ready when contacting them.

You can use the college directory for background reading, but use the official seat matrix and fee notices for counselling decisions.

title: CBSE Class 12 Biology Exam Date 2027: 25 March, Code 044 and Timing
description: Biology (044) is scheduled for 25 March 2027. Check the official slot and why a PCB or PCMB student's last paper may be later.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Biology is scheduled for 25 March 2027, in the 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST slot. Check subject code 044.

The official CBSE date sheet issued on 6 November 2026 combines Classes 10 and 12. Use the Class 12 section and your school registration details to find the correct entry.

Read the official CBSE date-sheet PDF

Central Board of Secondary Education, date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. Open the original official document.

Biology has its own late-March theory date

The Class 12 Biology paper is on 25 March 2027. It carries code 044 and runs from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST. Locate it in the Class 12 section of the combined CBSE document, rather than using the Class 10 Science entry.

This date belongs to the main theory schedule. It does not announce an entrance-examination date or replace the school's separate directions for practical or internal assessment.

PCB and PCMB calendars need different planning

A student taking Mathematics has that paper on 9 March, leaving fifteen calendar dates from 10 to 24 March before Biology. A student without Mathematics should not add it to the calendar simply because it appears in a Science-stream summary.

In either case, additional languages or other subjects can fall inside the interval. Hindi is on 13 March and Economics on 16 March, for example. Count only the dates left after all of your registered papers are marked.

Biology is not everyone's final board paper

Computer Science, Informatics Practices and Information Technology are scheduled for 31 March. A Biology student with one of those subjects still has another paper after 25 March. The overall Class 12 timetable runs through 9 April.

For revision, use diagrams, written recall and timed practice where they are relevant to your syllabus. Keep a realistic sequence around the remaining examinations and avoid making travel plans solely from the Biology date.

For the wider timetable, see the CBSE 2027 date-sheet guide and official PDF. Keep the complete source document with your personal subject list.
