title: NEET 2026–27 counselling timeline for central and state portals explained
description: Understand NEET 2026–27 counselling timelines for both central and state portals, with clear deadlines, step-by-step actions for students and parents across India.
content:
Key takeaway: Know where to apply first and by when

The NEET counselling process for 2026-27 involves separate streams for central bodies and state authorities. Indian students must track both timelines, as seats in government medical colleges, private colleges, and special categories may be allocated through either portal. Planning early helps secure a seat without last‑minute issues.

Overview of the two tracks

Central counselling is typically conducted for seats in institutes funded by the central government or managed under a national framework. State counselling handles admissions to state medical and dental colleges, as well as some private institutions within the state. The timelines and registration windows vary by authority, so students must monitor both portals for opening and closing dates, seat filters, and merit-based allotments.

What to verify before registration

  • Your NEET result, rank, and category (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS, PwD).
  • Passport‑sized photo, scanned documents, and caste certificates if applicable.
  • Eligibility criteria for the target institutes, including domicile and reservation norms.
  • Any mandatory documents for verification, such as identity proof and parental income details if required.

Central counselling: typical steps

  1. Registration on the central portal during the announced window.
  2. Choice filling of institutes and programs, with careful consideration of rank and home state preferences.
  3. Document verification and declaration of eligibility as per the portal instructions.
  4. Seat allotment rounds, with options to freeze, slide to next round, or apply for counselling upgrades.
  5. Allotment results and admission formalities at the designated institutes.

State counselling: typical steps

  1. Registration on the state portal when it opens, often with separate timelines for domicile and non‑domicile students.
  2. Choice filling based on available seats, personal merit, and preferred locations.
  3. Document verification and provisional seat allotment in multiple rounds, followed by reporting to the chosen college.
  4. Fee payment, admission confirmations, and reporting for orientation or start of term.

Important differences to note

  • Seat matrices and reservation rules differ between central and state authorities, and may also vary by category and domicile status.
  • The number of rounds and the presence of upgradation options can differ; central counselling often has a fixed structure, while some states run multiple rounds with upgrades.
  • Some institutes may allow direct admission under specific categories outside the common counselling, but this depends on official rules and vacancies.

Timelines you should track

Because both portals run on separate schedules, a student should track the following sequence:

  • Announcement of counselling schedule and registration dates.
  • Document verification windows and any required upload deadlines.
  • Multiple rounds of seat allotment and the freeze/upgrade deadlines.
  • Final admission reporting dates and college confirmation procedures.

Practical steps to stay ahead

  • Prepare a comparison sheet listing top institutes in central and state streams, with expected fee ranges, location, and campus facilities.
  • Fill choices strategically: at least one backup option in a nearby state to reduce travel and relocation stress.
  • Keep digital copies of all required documents ready and verify the upload formats specified by each portal.
  • Watch for seat cancelations and vacancy updates after each round, and adjust your plan accordingly.
  • Plan travel and lodging in advance if a seat is allotted far from home, including budget considerations for study materials and living expenses.

Where to verify details and avoid misinformation

Official portals will publish the final schedules, eligibility criteria, and seat matrices. If you encounter conflicting information, rely on the official site announcements rather than third‑party articles or social media posts. Cross‑check the date ranges, required documents, and payment methods directly on the authoritative platform.

Frequently asked questions

FAQ 1: Do central and state counselling run simultaneously?

Not always. They often run on overlapping timelines but with separate registration periods, seat allotment rounds, and reporting procedures. It is essential to monitor both portals for the correct deadlines.

FAQ 2: Can I participate in both central and state counselling?

Yes, many students register on both portals to maximize seat options. Freeze and upgrade decisions can be based on rank, seat availability, and admission deadlines on each portal.

FAQ 3: What if I miss a deadline?

Missing a deadline may limit your options for the current round. Check the official notices for any late‑registration provisions or subsequent rounds, and be prepared to act quickly if such an opportunity is announced.

FAQ 4: How are seats allocated if I am from a non‑domicile background?

Reservation rules and domicile requirements influence seat allocation across state and central streams. Review the category and domicile guidelines on the official portals to understand eligibility and seat sharing between streams.

FAQ 5: What documents should I carry for verification?

Carry all original documents and self‑attested copies of NEET scorecard, class 10 and 12 mark sheets, identity proof, domicile or residence certificates if required, category certificates, and disability certificates if applicable. Check the portal instructions for any additional documents specific to rounds or institutes.

Bottom line

Two parallel counselling tracks shape the NEET 2026-27 admission landscape. A proactive approach-tracking both central and state timelines, preparing documents, and making strategic choices-can help secure a seat that aligns with your preferred location and financial considerations. For definitive details, always verify on the official counselling portals when dates are announced and before completing any application steps.

title: NPAT 2027: ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ
description: NMIMS NPAT 2027 ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿನ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ. ಅರ್ಜಿ ದಿನಾಂಕ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಹತೆಯನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಆ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ವರ್ಷದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕೈಪಿಡಿಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
content:
NPAT 2027ಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿದ್ಧರಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಹೊಂದುವ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು NMIMS ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ 2027 ಎಂಬ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ಇದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಅಲ್ಲಿನ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಕೈಪಿಡಿಯ ಲಿಂಕ್ 2026-27 ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷದ ದಾಖಲೆಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು 2027ರ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಅವಧಿ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಅಥವಾ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ದೃಢೀಕರಣವೆಂದು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಯಾವ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಬಹುದು?

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ BBA, B.Com., B.Sc. Finance, BBA FinTech, ಸಮಗ್ರ BBA-MBA, B.Sc. Economics ಮತ್ತು BA Liberal Arts ಇವೆ. Branding and Advertising, International Business, Management and Marketing, Finance ಮುಂತಾದ ವಿಶೇಷ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳ BBA ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳೂ ಕಾಣಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಬದಲು ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಏನಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಓದಿ.

ಮುಂಬೈ, ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು, ನವಿ ಮುಂಬೈ, ಹೈದರಾಬಾದ್, ಇಂದೋರ್, ಚಂಡೀಗಢ ಮತ್ತು ಅಹಮದಾಬಾದ್ ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಪುಟ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಯಾವ ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಭ್ಯ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಅದರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಮಾಹಿತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಅಧಿಕೃತ NPAT ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳ ಪುಟ

ಕೈಪಿಡಿಯ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷ ಮುಖ್ಯ

Admissions Handout ಮತ್ತು Important Dates ಲಿಂಕ್‌ಗಳು 2026-27 ದಾಖಲೆಗೆ ಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ವೆಬ್‌ಪುಟದ 2027 ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು PDFನ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಗಮನಿಸಿ. ಹಿಂದಿನ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಅಥವಾ ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವನ್ನು ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ 2027 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಚಕ್ರವನ್ನು ಸೂಚಿಸುವ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ ಆ ವಿವರಗಳು ದೃಢಪಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ.

SVKM’s NMIMS 2026-27 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಕೈಪಿಡಿಯ ಮೊದಲ ಪುಟದ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ. ಈ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇದು 2027ರ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. ಮೂಲ 2026-27 ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ

ಈಗಲೇ ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಬಹುದು

ಅಧಿಕೃತ FAQ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಐದು ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆದ್ಯತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಆ ಮಿತಿಯೊಳಗೆ ಕ್ರಮಬದ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸಿ; 2027ರ ಅರ್ಜಿಯ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗೆ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್, ಅರ್ಹತೆ, ಪಿಯುಸಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓದಿದ ವಿಷಯಗಳು, ಗಣಿತ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಷರತ್ತು ಇದೆಯೇ, ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ, ಸ್ಥಳ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚವನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

Finance ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಇಷ್ಟವಾದರೆ ಅದರ ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಮಾಣಾತ್ಮಕ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. Management ಅಥವಾ Liberal Arts ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ಹೋಲಿದರೂ ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಒಂದೇ ಆಗಬೇಕೆಂದಿಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯಗಳು ಹೊಂದಿಕೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆಯೇ, ಯಾವ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್ ಆದ್ಯತೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ನೀಡಬೇಕು ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು NMIMS ಪ್ರವೇಶ ವಿಭಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳಿ.

ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಅರ್ಜಿಯಲ್ಲ

ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಅಥವಾ ಮರಳಿ ಕರೆಗಾಗಿ ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ತುಂಬುವುದು NPAT ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ನೋಂದಣಿಯನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಚಕ್ರದ ಅರ್ಜಿ, ಪಾವತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಬುಕಿಂಗ್ ಕುರಿತು ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಅವು ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ನಂತರ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಿರಿ. ಸಲ್ಲಿಕೆಯ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ ರಸೀದಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಹೊಸ ಕೈಪಿಡಿ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದಾಗ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಹೆಸರುಗಳು, ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಅರ್ಹತೆ, ಶುಲ್ಕ, ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಈಗ ಮಾಡುವ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ಕೆಲಸವೆಂದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್-ಕ್ಯಾಂಪಸ್ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುವುದು.

ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಮೂಲ ಲೇಖನ

title: UCEED, CEED 2027 ನೋಂದಣಿ ವಿಸ್ತರಣೆ: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶುಲ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5, ತಡ ಶುಲ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 10 ಗಡುವು
description: UCEED ಮತ್ತು CEED 2027 ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ಹೊಸ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು, ಕೊನೆಯ ಸಮಯ ಹಾಗೂ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
content:
UCEED ಮತ್ತು CEED 2027 ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಮಯ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದೆ. IIT ಬಾಂಬೆಯ ಎರಡೂ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ಗಳು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ನೋಂದಣಿಗೆ 5 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:59 ಹಾಗೂ ತಡ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ನೋಂದಣಿಗೆ 10 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ಸಂಜೆ 5 ಅನ್ನು ಕೊನೆಯ ಸಮಯವಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ತಡ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ಅವಕಾಶ ಸಂಜೆಯೇ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯವರೆಗೆ ಸಮಯವಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಗಮನಿಸಬೇಕಾದ ಎರಡು ಗಡುವುಗಳು

ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ

ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ

ತಡ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯ

UCEED 2027

5 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:59

10 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಸಂಜೆ 5

CEED 2027

5 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ರಾತ್ರಿ 11:59

10 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಸಂಜೆ 5

ಈ ಸಮಯಗಳು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಿತ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. UCEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ 23:59 ಮತ್ತು 17:00 ಎಂದು, CEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ 11:59 pm ಮತ್ತು 5:00 pm ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ಗಳು ತಡ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ₹500 ಎಂದು ಸೂಚಿಸಿವೆ. ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ವರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನೂ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

IIT ಬಾಂಬೆ UCEED ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್, 31 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026ರಂದು ತೆಗೆದ ಚಿತ್ರ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ ದಿನಾಂಕ ತೋರಿಸಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ UCEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್.

ಅರ್ಜಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ

ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಇದ್ದರೂ ಈ ಎರಡು ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಸ್ಪರ ಬದಲಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. UCEED ಪದವಿಪೂರ್ವ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಇರುವ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ. CEED, M.Des. ಮತ್ತು Ph.D. ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ್ದು, ಅರ್ಹ ಪದವಿ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದೆ.

ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ಅಥವಾ 2026ರಲ್ಲಿ 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪಾಸಾದ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು UCEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಬಳಸಬೇಕೆಂದು CEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. CEED ಸೂಚನೆಯು ಅರ್ಹ ಪದವಿ ಅಥವಾ ಡಿಪ್ಲೊಮಾ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಅಥವಾ ಜುಲೈ 2027ರೊಳಗೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸುವ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅರ್ಹತಾ ನಿಯಮ ಓದಿ.

IIT ಬಾಂಬೆ CEED ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಹತಾ ಸೂಚನೆ, 31 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026ರಂದು ತೆಗೆದ ಚಿತ್ರ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಕಾಣಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ CEED ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್.

ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಾಕಿ ಅರ್ಜಿಯನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿ

ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ನೋಂದಾಯಿಸಿದ್ದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನ Login ಬಳಸಿ. ಹೊಸ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು Register ಮೂಲಕ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಿರುವ ಇಮೇಲ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಬೇಕು. ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿದೆ ಎನ್ನುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಮೂದಿಸಿದ ಮಾಹಿತಿ, ಅಗತ್ಯ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ ದೃಢೀಕರಣದ ಪ್ರತಿಯನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. UCEED ಅಧಿಕೃತ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಸ್ವರೂಪಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸಿ, ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳು ಅಮಾನ್ಯವೆಂದು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. UCEED ನೋಂದಣಿ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು. UCEED ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ. ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಲ್ಕದ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ಮಾಹಿತಿಗಾಗಿ ಮೇಲಿನ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. ಈ ವಿಸ್ತರಣೆಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ಹೊಸ ಗಡುವುಗಳನ್ನು ಈ ಲೇಖನದ ಕೋಷ್ಟಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿ.

title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Application: What to Check After Submission
description: Submitted the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application? Use this post-submission audit to check the confirmation page, images, fee status and correction needs.
content:
Submitting the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application is not the finish line. A missing image, wrong subject choice or unpaid fee can create trouble when NTA processes your application or releases the admit card. Open your saved confirmation page now and audit every field against your documents.

NTA is the authority responsible for JEE Main. The official JEE Main website should be your reference for the active notice, correction instructions and candidate login updates. Do not rely on a screenshot shared in a coaching group.

What should you check on the confirmation page?

Read the page slowly, not like a result announcement. The application number and candidate details must match the identity document and school records you used while applying.

  • Personal details: Check your name, date of birth, gender, category and PwD details. A category or disability entry can affect later document checks.
  • Exam choices: Confirm Session 1, the selected paper, language, preferred cities and any other choices shown on the page. A wrong paper choice is not a small spelling error.
  • Academic information: Compare board, passing status and year with your Class 10 or Class 12 records, as applicable.
  • Contact details: Test the registered email address and mobile number. Save access to both until the exam cycle ends.

Are the uploaded photo and signature actually visible?

Do not assume an upload succeeded just because the form moved to the payment screen. Open the confirmation page on a phone and computer if possible. The photograph should be recognisable, the signature should be legible, and neither file should appear blank, stretched or replaced by a broken-image box.

Keep the exact submitted files in a separate folder with the confirmation page. If the portal later displays a defective image or sends an image-related alert, you’ll have a record of what was submitted and can act through the permitted correction route.

How do you confirm that the fee and submission are complete?

Payment success and form submission are related but not identical screens. Check for a transaction status, payment reference and final confirmation page. If money left your account but the status remains pending or failed, don’t make a second payment in panic. Record the transaction details, check the candidate login and follow the payment instructions in the current NTA notice.

Parents can do one useful thing here: compare the application number, payment reference and saved PDF, then store copies in cloud storage and on the student’s phone. If you find a genuine error, note it before looking at other entrance exam timelines; correction windows, if announced by NTA, may not cover every field.

title: The Future of Cryptocurrency: Trends, Challenges, and Opportunities
description: Explore the future of cryptocurrency, including emerging trends, potential challenges, investment opportunities, and how digital currencies are shaping the global financial landscape.
content:
Cryptocurrency has evolved from a niche concept into a global financial phenomenon. Bitcoin, Ethereum, and thousands of other digital assets have captured the imagination of investors, technologists, and governments alike. As blockchain technology matures, the future of cryptocurrency promises innovation, disruption, and new opportunities—but also challenges that must be navigated carefully.

1. Emerging Trends in Cryptocurrency

  • Decentralized Finance (DeFi): DeFi platforms are revolutionizing traditional banking by enabling peer-to-peer lending, borrowing, and trading without intermediaries.

  • Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs): Governments are exploring digital versions of their currencies to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and maintain control over the financial system.

  • Integration with Everyday Payments: Cryptocurrencies are increasingly accepted for goods and services, bridging the gap between digital assets and daily transactions.

  • NFTs and Tokenization: Non-fungible tokens (NFTs) are transforming digital ownership, art, gaming, and collectibles by leveraging blockchain technology.

2. Opportunities for Investors

  • High Potential Returns: Cryptocurrencies can offer significant profits, especially for early adopters of emerging tokens.

  • Portfolio Diversification: Digital assets provide an alternative investment class that can complement traditional stocks, bonds, and real estate.

  • Global Accessibility: Anyone with an internet connection can access cryptocurrency markets, making investment opportunities more inclusive.

3. Challenges Ahead

  • Regulatory Uncertainty: Governments worldwide are still defining regulations for cryptocurrencies, which can impact market stability.

  • Volatility: Prices of digital assets can fluctuate dramatically, making them high-risk investments.

  • Security Risks: Hacking, scams, and lost private keys remain significant concerns for investors.

  • Environmental Concerns: Proof-of-work cryptocurrencies, like Bitcoin, require high energy consumption, raising sustainability issues.

4. The Role of Technology

  • Blockchain Advancements: Faster, more scalable blockchains are being developed to support growing transaction volumes.

  • Interoperability: Future networks may allow seamless transactions across multiple blockchain platforms.

  • AI and Automation: Artificial intelligence can optimize trading strategies, risk management, and blockchain security.

Conclusion

The future of cryptocurrency is a blend of exciting opportunities and complex challenges. While digital assets can democratize finance, enable innovation, and provide new investment avenues, careful navigation of risks, regulations, and technological developments is essential. As blockchain adoption grows, cryptocurrencies are likely to become an integral part of the global financial ecosystem.
author: Muskaan Dagar

title: NEET UG 2026 Choice Filling: How to Compare Bond and Refund Terms
description: A practical method for comparing service bonds, security deposits, tuition refunds and exit rules before NEET UG 2026 counselling choice filling.
content:
A seat that looks affordable during NEET UG 2026 counselling can carry a large financial or service obligation after admission. Before ranking a college, compare its bond period, penalty, security deposit, refund formula and withdrawal deadline alongside fees, location and clinical exposure.

Use the counselling authority's current information bulletin, the college prospectus and the written admission undertaking. Save copies before you lock choices, because a portal fee summary may not show every exit condition.

Why bond and refund terms belong in your choice list

Many applicants compare only tuition, hostel charges and closing rank. That is incomplete. A government or aided medical seat may have a service bond requiring work in a specified public health system after MBBS, while a private college may collect a large security amount or apply a restrictive refund clause when a student leaves.

These obligations are not identical. A bond may require service for a fixed period or payment of a stated amount. A security deposit is money held by the institution and may be refundable after deductions. A non-refundable fee is normally lost once the stated condition applies. The wording matters more than the label.

Rules can differ between All India Quota counselling managed by the Medical Counselling Committee, state counselling and institutional admission processes. The National Medical Commission governs medical education standards, but the responsible counselling authority and the admitting institution must be checked for the applicable fee and exit rule.

Key facts to record before NEET UG 2026 counselling

  • Bond type: Note whether it is a service bond, a discontinuation bond, a rural service condition or a combination.
  • Trigger: Record when the obligation begins and what event activates it. It could be resignation, migration, discontinuation, non-joining after reporting or failure to complete the course.
  • Amount and calculation: Write the exact penalty, whether interest is added and whether the amount changes by year.
  • Service details: Check the department, location, duration, salary treatment and whether postgraduate study postpones or changes the obligation.
  • Security deposit: Confirm the amount, permitted deductions, refund date, payment mode and the person to whom the refund is made.
  • Tuition refund: Identify the last date for withdrawal, the authority that approves it and the fee that remains payable after exit.
  • Document release: Look for the process for returning original certificates and obtaining a no-dues or relieving document.

Do not rely on a counselling brochure alone if it directs candidates to sign a separate undertaking at reporting. That undertaking may contain the operative wording.

A comparison table for Choice Filling decisions

Prepare one row for every serious option. The purpose is not to find the lowest annual fee. It is to estimate the largest realistic cost if the student changes course.

Item to compareWhat to recordWhy it affects the decision
Annual academic feeTuition, university charges and compulsory institutional feesShows the predictable yearly cost, but not the exit risk
One-time paymentAdmission, registration, development and other non-refundable chargesMay be lost even when tuition is partly returned
Security depositAmount, deductions and refund timelineImpacts the family's cash flow and final cost
Service bondService period, authority, posting terms and exemptionsCan affect employment and postgraduate plans after graduation
Exit or discontinuation bondPenalty, interest and the point at which it appliesCreates a possible liability if the student leaves
Refund deadlineLast date, application route and approval requirementMissing a deadline can reduce or remove the refund
Seat surrender effectWhether withdrawal affects later counselling participationPrevents a costly mistake during upgradation or migration

How to calculate the real financial exposure

Use two figures for each college: the stay cost and the exit cost. Stay cost is the amount the family expects to pay if the student completes the course. Exit cost is the money that may remain payable, be forfeited or be demanded under a bond if the student leaves at a particular stage.

A simple worksheet can include:

Exit exposure = unpaid or forfeited fees + bond penalty + non-refundable charges + likely travel or administrative costs minus confirmed refund.

Use the formula as a planning tool, not as a legal conclusion. For example, if a college collects a deposit that is refundable only after hostel and library clearance, do not count it as a permanent loss. If the prospectus says a fee is refundable but the signed undertaking adds a condition, seek written clarification before reporting.

Consider a student who has a realistic chance of upgrading from a private seat to a government seat in a later round. A college with a lower annual fee may still be the riskier option if it demands a large discontinuation payment after joining. The sensible choice may be the option with a slightly higher predictable cost and a clearly stated exit route.

How bonds can change the value of a medical seat

Service bonds

A service bond is a commitment to work for a specified authority or institution after graduation or training. Read the exact service location, duration, salary, joining deadline and consequences of non-joining. “Government service” is too vague for a financial decision.

Also check whether the bond applies to every admitted student, only a particular quota, or only students receiving a fee benefit. State rules may be revised for a counselling year, so a previous student's experience cannot replace the 2026 document.

Discontinuation bonds

A discontinuation bond may apply when a student leaves the course before completion. Questions to ask include whether the penalty is due immediately, whether it applies after migration to another medical college and whether the institution can withhold documents until payment.

Do not assume that a bond becomes irrelevant because the student has not attended classes for long. The trigger may be admission, reporting or withdrawal itself. The admission undertaking should be read before signatures are made.

Refund rules: read the calendar, not just the percentage

Refund clauses usually depend on timing. A student may receive a higher refund before a specified date and a reduced amount after that date, while some charges remain non-refundable throughout. The relevant date might be the written withdrawal application, the vacancy being filled or the institution's acceptance of the request. Confirm which date controls.

For every choice, record four dates:

  1. Last date to report and retain the seat.
  2. Last date to surrender the seat without the stated penalty.
  3. Last date for participating in an upgrade or later counselling round.
  4. Expected date and method of refund.

Keep payment receipts, allotment letters, signed forms, emails and screenshots of the portal submission. If a refund request is made, obtain an acknowledgement with the date and amount claimed. A phone conversation is not a reliable substitute for a written record.

A safer Choice Filling method for families

  1. Make a shortlist: Include academic fit, fee, distance, hostel, hospital workload and likely preference order.
  2. Collect current documents: Download the 2026 counselling bulletin, fee schedule, college prospectus and bond or undertaking format where available.
  3. Mark financial red flags: Highlight blank clauses, “as applicable” charges, open-ended penalties and terms that refer to a later document.
  4. Ask precise questions: Request written clarification on the trigger, penalty, refund deadline and certificate-release process.
  5. Separate preference from affordability: A high-ranked college should not be placed above a manageable option merely because its academic reputation is stronger.
  6. Lock only after a family stress test: Ask whether the family can meet the first-year payment and a possible exit liability without borrowing beyond its capacity.

When a clause is unclear, the safest next step is to contact the responsible MCC or state counselling authority and the college admission office through their published channels. Verify the answer against the current 2026 notice before paying or signing.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Comparing government and private fees without adding bond liability.
  • Assuming a refundable deposit will be returned immediately.
  • Paying through an unofficial account or without a proper receipt.
  • Signing a blank or partly completed undertaking.
  • Leaving after joining without submitting a dated written withdrawal request.
  • Relying on an older batch's bond terms for NEET UG 2026.
  • Ignoring the effect of withdrawal on subsequent counselling rounds.

The best choice is not always the cheapest seat or the first preference. It is the seat whose academic value, total cost and exit conditions the family understands and can carry.

FAQs about NEET UG 2026 counselling bonds and refunds

Should bond terms affect NEET UG 2026 choice filling?

Yes. Record the bond period, trigger, penalty, service conditions and exemptions beside the college fee before ranking the option. A bond can change both the financial cost and the student's post-MBBS plans.

Are security deposits always refundable?

No. The admission document should state whether the deposit is refundable, what deductions are allowed and when payment will be released. Hostel damage, unpaid dues or administrative conditions may affect the amount.

Can a college charge a discontinuation penalty after a student leaves?

It may, if the applicable undertaking or counselling rule creates that obligation. The result depends on the exact wording, the timing of withdrawal and the authority's rules. Read the signed document before joining.

Does the refund rule remain the same in every NEET UG counselling round?

Not necessarily. All India and state counselling processes can publish different schedules and conditions. Check the 2026 notice for the relevant quota, round and withdrawal date.

What should parents ask before paying a college fee?

Ask for the complete fee breakup, bond format, refund schedule, non-refundable items, document-release process and payment receipt. Ask the college to confirm unclear terms in writing.

Where should a candidate verify a disputed counselling condition?

Start with the responsible counselling authority for the quota, such as the Medical Counselling Committee for its process or the relevant state counselling authority. Also compare the answer with the admitting college's current prospectus and signed undertaking.

title: TS TET 2025 దరఖాస్తు ఫారం (అవుట్): రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ తేదీలను తనిఖీ చేయండి మరియు ఆన్‌లైన్‌లో దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోండి
description: TS TET 2025 దరఖాస్తు ఫారమ్ ఇప్పుడు అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉంది. తెలంగాణ ఉపాధ్యాయ అర్హత పరీక్షకు ఎలా దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవాలో, ముఖ్యమైన తేదీలు, అర్హత ప్రమాణాలు, ఫీజులు మరియు ఇతర వివరాలను తనిఖీ చేయడం గురించి తెలుసుకోండి.​
content:
TS TET 2025 దరఖాస్తు ఫారం విడుదల: ఆన్లైన్‌లో దరఖాస్తు చేయండి

తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర టీచర్ ఎలిజిబిలిటీ టెస్ట్ (TS TET) 2025 దరఖాస్తు ప్రక్రియ ఏప్రిల్ 15, 2025 నుంచి అధికారికంగా ప్రారంభమైంది. ప్రాథమిక మరియు ఎగువ ప్రాథమిక పాఠశాలల్లో ఉపాధ్యాయ ఉద్యోగాలను ఆశించే అభ్యర్థులు ఇప్పుడు tstet.cgg.gov.in అనే అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్ ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు. దరఖాస్తు గడువు ఏప్రిల్ 30, 2025 వరకు ఉంటుంది.​

ముఖ్యమైన తేదీలు మరియు షెడ్యూల్

తెలంగాణ రాష్ట్ర పాఠశాల విద్యా శాఖ TS TET 2025 కోసం క్రింది ముఖ్యమైన తేదీలను ప్రకటించింది:​

ఈవెంట్ తేదీ
నోటిఫికేషన్ విడుదల ఏప్రిల్ 11, 2025
దరఖాస్తు ప్రారంభం ఏప్రిల్ 15, 2025
దరఖాస్తు ముగింపు ఏప్రిల్ 30, 2025
పరీక్ష తేదీలు జూన్ 15 నుంచి జూన్ 30, 2025
 

పరీక్ష ప్రతి రోజు రెండు సెషన్లలో నిర్వహించబడుతుంది: ఉదయం సెషన్ 9:00 AM నుండి 11:30 AM వరకు, మధ్యాహ్నం సెషన్ 2:00 PM నుండి 4:30 PM వరకు.​

అర్హత ప్రమాణాలు

TS TET 2025 కు దరఖాస్తు చేయాలనుకునే అభ్యర్థులు కొన్ని విద్యా అర్హతలను కలిగి ఉండాలి:

  • పేపర్ I (తరగతులు I నుండి V): ఇంటర్మీడియట్/సీనియర్ సెకండరీ (లేదా సమానమైనది) కనీసం 50% మార్కులతో ఉత్తీర్ణత సాధించాలి మరియు 2 సంవత్సరాల డిప్లొమా ఇన్ ఎలిమెంటరీ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ (D.El.Ed) లేదా 4 సంవత్సరాల బ్యాచిలర్ ఆఫ్ ఎలిమెంటరీ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ (B.El.Ed) చివరి సంవత్సరం చదువుతున్న లేదా పూర్తిచేసిన వారు అర్హులు.

  • పేపర్ II (తరగతులు VI నుండి VIII): కనీసం 50% మార్కులతో బ్యాచిలర్ డిగ్రీ కలిగి ఉండాలి మరియు బ్యాచిలర్ ఇన్ ఎడ్యుకేషన్ (B.Ed) చివరి సంవత్సరం చదువుతున్న లేదా పూర్తిచేసిన వారు అర్హులు.

అభ్యర్థులకు వయో పరిమితి లేదు.

దరఖాస్తు ప్రక్రియ

TS TET 2025 కు దరఖాస్తు చేయాలనుకునే అభ్యర్థులు ఈ క్రింది దశలను అనుసరించాలి:​

  1. అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్ tstet.cgg.gov.in ను సందర్శించండి.

  2. \"Apply Online\" లింక్‌పై క్లిక్ చేయండి.

  3. వ్యక్తిగత వివరాలు, విద్యా అర్హతలు, సంప్రదింపు వివరాలు వంటి అవసరమైన వివరాలను నమోదు చేయండి.

  4. అవసరమైన డాక్యుమెంట్ల స్కాన్ కాపీలను (ఫోటో, సంతకం) సూచించిన ఫార్మాట్‌లో అప్‌లోడ్ చేయండి.

  5. అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఆన్లైన్ చెల్లింపు విధానాల ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు చెల్లించండి.

  6. దరఖాస్తు ఫారం సమర్పించండి మరియు భవిష్యత్తు అవసరాల కోసం ప్రింట్‌ఔట్ తీసుకోండి.

దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు

TS TET 2025 కోసం దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు ఇలా ఉంది:​

  • ఒకే పేపర్ (పేపర్ I లేదా II): ₹1,000

  • రెండు పేపర్లు (పేపర్ I & II): ₹2,000

ఫీజును అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఆన్లైన్ చెల్లింపు విధానాల ద్వారా చెల్లించవచ్చు.​

పరీక్ష విధానం

TS TET 2025 తొలిసారిగా కంప్యూటర్ ఆధారిత పరీక్ష (CBT)గా నిర్వహించబడుతుంది. పరీక్ష రెండు పేపర్లుగా ఉంటుంది:

  • పేపర్ I: తరగతులు I నుండి V బోధించాలనుకునే అభ్యర్థులకు.

  • పేపర్ II: తరగతులు VI నుండి VIII బోధించాలనుకునే అభ్యర్థులకు.

ప్రతి పేపర్‌లో 150 బహుళ ఎంపిక ప్రశ్నలు ఉంటాయి, ప్రతి ప్రశ్నకు ఒక మార్కు ఉంటుంది. నెగెటివ్ మార్కింగ్ లేదు. ప్రతి పేపర్‌కు వ్యవధి 2 గంటలు 30 నిమిషాలు.

అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ మరియు ఫలితాలు

TS TET 2025 అడ్మిట్ కార్డులు జూన్ 2025లో పరీక్ష తేదీలకు ముందు విడుదల అవుతాయి. అభ్యర్థులు తమ లాగిన్ వివరాలతో అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్ నుండి అడ్మిట్ కార్డును డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసుకోవచ్చు. ఫలితాలు జూలై 2025లో ప్రకటించే అవకాశం ఉంది. పరీక్షలో అర్హత సాధించిన అభ్యర్థులకు జీవితకాలం చెల్లుబాటు అయ్యే TET సర్టిఫికెట్ ఇవ్వబడుతుంది. ఇది తెలంగాణలోని ప్రభుత్వ మరియు ప్రైవేట్ పాఠశాలల్లో ఉపాధ్యాయ ఉద్యోగాలకు దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి అవసరం.

సంప్రదింపు వివరాలు

TS TET 2025కు సంబంధించిన ఏవైనా సందేహాలు లేదా సహాయం కోసం అభ్యర్థులు tstet.cgg.gov.in లో ఇచ్చిన సంప్రదింపు వివరాల ద్వారా తెలంగాణ పాఠశాల విద్యా శాఖను సంప్రదించవచ్చు. అభ్యర్థులు చివరి నిమిషంలో సాంకేతిక సమస్యలు ఎదుర్కొనకుండా ముందుగానే దరఖాస్తు చేయాలని సూచించబడింది. పరీక్షకు సంబంధించిన మార్పులు, ప్రకటనలకు సంబంధించి అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌ను తరచుగా సందర్శిస్తూ అప్డేట్స్ తెలుసుకోవాలి.

title: CLAT 2027: How to Compare an NLU Offer With a Stronger Local Option
description: Compare an NLU offer with a local law college on total cost, course fit, travel, internships and placement proof before accepting your CLAT 2027 seat.
content:
A CLAT 2027 NLU offer can look impossible to refuse, but the famous name alone doesn’t make it the right choice. Before accepting, compare the full five-year cost, teaching fit, travel burden, internship access and verifiable placement records with your strongest local Law College option.

Start with a written comparison, not family pressure. You can also review nearby institutions through college comparison listings and check course structures through course information.

What will the degree really cost?

Don’t compare only the tuition figure shown in the NLU offer. Add hostel and mess charges, deposits, books, laptop expenses, travel home, student insurance and likely annual increases. A local college may let you live at home, cutting a large recurring cost. That money could instead cover internships, mooting, coaching or postgraduate study.

Decision pointNLU offerLocal law college
Five-year spendingTuition plus hostel, mess and travelTuition plus daily commute or local living costs
Daily routineResidential campus and fixed hostel rulesFamily support with possible commuting time
Career accessAssess recruiter list, internships and alumni outcomesAssess court exposure, legal offices and local employer links

Is the NLU actually a better academic fit?

Read the syllabus, not just the brochure. Check whether the college offers the subjects you want, such as business law, technology law, public policy or litigation-focused papers. Ask who teaches those subjects, how often practical work happens and whether students can join clinics, moots and journals.

A student aiming for litigation may gain more from regular court visits and a nearby chamber than from a distant campus with a stronger general reputation. A student targeting corporate law may value structured internships and recruiter access more. The better choice depends on the work you plan to do.

How do you test placement claims?

Ask for the latest official placement report, graduating batch size, median or typical salary where published, recruiter names, internship conversion details and the share of students placed. Don’t treat a highest-package figure as the college’s normal outcome. If the data isn’t clearly available, mark placement evidence as unverified rather than filling the gap with assumptions.

A safer decision before you accept

  1. Calculate the five-year family payment for both colleges.
  2. Speak to at least two current students about classes, internships and hidden costs.
  3. Check the NLU’s current admission notice for payment, withdrawal and refund conditions before transferring money.
  4. Choose the college where cost, course fit and credible career access work together, even if its label sounds less impressive.

title: CBSE 10వ తరగతి మార్కెటింగ్ మరియు అమ్మకాలు పరీక్ష 2027: తేదీ, సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్, సమయం
description: 10వ తరగతి మార్కెటింగ్ మరియు అమ్మకాలు (కోడ్ 412) పరీక్ష 25 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.
content:
10వ తరగతి మార్కెటింగ్ మరియు అమ్మకాలు (కోడ్ 412) పరీక్ష 25 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.

2026 నవంబర్ 6న విడుదల చేసిన CBSE ప్రధాన పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్‌లో ఈ వివరాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఇది పరీక్షల టైమ్‌టేబుల్ మాత్రమే; మార్కుల జాబితా కాదు. అధికారిక CBSE టైమ్‌టేబుల్

మార్కెటింగ్ మరియు అమ్మకాలు పేపర్ ఎప్పుడు, ఎంతసేపు?

తరగతి, పేపర్కోడ్పరీక్ష తేదీసమయం (IST)వ్యవధి
10వ తరగతి: Marketing and Sales41225 ఫిబ్రవరి 202710:30 - 12:302 గంటలు

కేంద్రీయ మాధ్యమిక విద్యా మండలి, 6 నవంబర్ 2026, పేజీ 5: సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్లు, తేదీలు, సమయాలు. అధికారిక PDFలో ఈ పేజీ చూడండి

అధికారిక PDFలో మీ పేపర్‌ను గుర్తించండి

పేజీ 5లో ముందుగా తరగతి శీర్షిక చూసి, తర్వాత 412 కోడ్ గుర్తించండి. ఒక తేదీ లేదా సమయం వరుసగా ఉన్న అనేక సబ్జెక్టులకు వర్తించవచ్చు. ఫోన్‌లో పూర్తి పేజీని పెద్దదిగా చేసి చదవండి.

పాఠశాల నమోదు వివరాల్లోని కోడ్, కోర్సు పేరు సరిపోల్చుకోండి. ఒకే పేరుతో వేర్వేరు తరగతుల పేపర్లు ఉన్నా మీ తరగతి వరుసనే ఎంచుకోండి.

ఇంగ్లిష్ పేపర్‌తో తేదీలను పోల్చుకోండి

10వ తరగతి మార్కెటింగ్ మరియు అమ్మకాలు (412) పరీక్ష 25 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఆంగ్ల భాష మరియు సాహిత్యం (184) పరీక్ష 26 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఈ రెండు తేదీల మధ్య 1 రోజుల తేడా ఉంది.

ఈ తేడా మొత్తం చదువుకోడానికి దొరికే సెలవు కాదు. మీ ఇతర పరీక్షలను కూడా క్యాలెండర్‌లో పెట్టి, మధ్యలో పరీక్ష లేని రోజులను మాత్రమే లెక్కించండి. సాధన చేసేటప్పుడు అసలు పేపర్ వ్యవధిని పాటించండి.

ప్రాక్టికల్స్‌కు వేరే షెడ్యూల్

ఈ వరుస బోర్డు పేపర్‌కు సంబంధించినది. ప్రాక్టికల్, ప్రదర్శన, ప్రాజెక్టు లేదా అంతర్గత మూల్యాంకనం ఉంటే వాటి తేదీ, తీసుకెళ్లాల్సిన సామగ్రి గురించి పాఠశాలలో అడగండి.

కేంద్రంలోకి కమ్యూనికేషన్ పరికరాలను అనుమతించరు. తీసుకెళ్లే వస్తువుల విషయంలో CBSE విడిగా ఇచ్చే సూచనలను, అడ్మిట్ కార్డులోని నియమాలను పాటించండి.

title: AICTE Approval Check: How Students Can Verify a Technical College
description: Learn how to verify AICTE approval for the exact course, campus and academic year, and separate regulatory permission from placement and fee claims.
content:
An AICTE approval check should happen before you pay any technical college fee. Match the exact institution, programme, campus, intake and academic year in the approval record with your offer letter. A brochure, logo or WhatsApp message isn’t proof, and an unapproved course can create acceptance problems later.

AICTE approval applies to the programme and intake listed by the All India Council for Technical Education. It doesn’t certify teaching quality, placements or whether the fee is fair.

How can you verify AICTE approval?

Search the AICTE approval records for the relevant academic year and use the college’s registered name, not only its popular brand name. Then compare the entry with your admission documents. This simple check can expose a different campus, branch or intake before your money is stuck.

  1. Search by the institution’s registered name and state.
  2. Select the academic year that covers your admission.
  3. Check the programme name, level, campus address and approved intake.
  4. Compare those details with the offer letter, fee receipt and college website.
  5. Save the approval record and ask for a written explanation if anything differs.

Approval for one BTech branch doesn’t automatically cover an MBA, diploma, another branch or a newly opened campus. If staff show an old certificate, ask for the current record for your exact course.

What does AICTE approval prove, and what doesn’t it prove?

An AICTE approval check confirms regulatory permission for the listed technical programme and intake. It isn’t a report card for faculty, labs, placements or value for money. Treat “AICTE approved” as one admission check, not a complete quality claim.

CheckWhat it confirmsWhat you still need to verify
AICTE approvalListed programme and intake have regulatory approvalAcademic year, campus and course match
AccreditationA separate quality assessmentExact branch, validity and accrediting body
PlacementsCollege-reported employment claimsCourse-wise batch size, placed students, roles and salaries
FeesAmount demanded by the collegeWritten breakup, refund terms and hostel charges

What should you do before paying?

Pause if the college refuses to show a verifiable record or pressures you with a same-day payment demand. Ask for the approval entry, university affiliation details, signed fee schedule and refund rules in writing. Keep copies of every document.

For the wider decision, compare colleges and review the relevant technical courses. Check placement reports for the same course and graduating batch, then compare the number placed with total batch strength. Approval cannot confirm recruiter quality or salary outcomes.

title: CUET 2027 central and state counselling: portal by portal step login guide
description: A practical, portal-by-portal login guide for CUET 2027 central and state counselling, with step-by-step login, document checks, and timelines to help students and parents navigate the process confidently.
content:
Get a clear start: what counselling for CUET 2027 means for you

CUET 2027 results open doors to undergraduate programs across central and state universities. The counselling process is conducted in two broad phases: centralized (national/central authorities) and state-level coordination by respective boards or nodal agencies. Knowing exactly which portals to use, what documents to upload, and how to track your updates can save time and reduce stress for students and parents alike.

Overview of the counselling landscape for CUET 2027

Central counselling typically uses a unified portal managed by the central coordinating body. State counselling, however, may run on state-specific platforms or regional portals with separate login credentials. Both streams require candidate authentication, choice filling, document verification, and seat allotment. Keeping track of notifications from both streams is essential since merit-based rounds, eligibility criteria, and cut-off trends can differ across portals.

Key timelines you should map now

  • CUET 2027 results and merit lists release windows
  • Registration windows for central and state counselling
  • Document verification and choice locking deadlines
  • Seat allotment rounds and reporting timelines at allotted institutions

Note that official authorities publish dates in phases, and delays can occur if documents are incomplete or if technical issues crop up. Always cross-check the official portals for the latest information as soon as you receive notification.

Central counselling portal: login, verification, and seat allocation

This section covers the typical flow on the central counselling portal. Steps may vary slightly by year or architecture, but the core process remains consistent.

  1. Register or login: Use the credentials created during the CUET application or the dedicated central counselling login. If you forget your password, use the “Forgot password” option and link it to your registered email or mobile number.
  2. Upload/verify documents: You will need academic marksheets, identity proof, category certificate if applicable, and domicile documents as required. Ensure scans are legible and within the specified file size limits.
  3. Fill and freeze college preferences: Rank-based or preference-based seat allocation depends on merit and category. Prioritize programs and campuses you most want to attend.
  4. Lock choices and confirm: After submitting, confirm the choices. The portal will display a confirmation page or reference number. Save or print this for future reference.
  5. Seat allotment and reporting: If allotted a seat, complete the acceptance process and report to the designated institution as instructed. If not allotted, you may participate in subsequent rounds or opt for upgradation if offered.

Tips for central counselling

  • Keep multiple devices handy during login to verify you are on the official portal.
  • Use a stable internet connection during registration and verification to avoid session timeouts.
  • Double-check your personal details and spelling in certificates to prevent mismatch during document verification.

State counselling portals: login steps and common checks

State-level counselling platforms differ in layout but share a common logic: login, document upload, choice filling, and seat allocation. Here is a representative sequence to guide you through most state portals.

  1. Access the state counselling portal: Use the official state education department or conducting agency site. Look for sections labeled admissions, counselling, or CUET admissions 2027.
  2. Login with registered credentials: Many states require a candidate ID or applicant login. If you do not remember the credentials, use the official recovery process tied to your mobile number or email.
  3. Upload required documents: Common documents include your CUET marks statement, identity proof, category certificate if needed, domicile proof, and income certificates where applicable.
  4. Enter and lock choices: Prioritize programs and campuses as per your goal and chances of admission. Save frequently to avoid data loss.
  5. Seat allotment and confirmation: Review allotment results, accept or waitlist as required, and complete reporting to the allotted college if selected.

State portals may have additional steps such as payment of processing fees, mandatory counselling sessions, or submission of original documents at the reporting center. Read all notification emails or SMS alerts carefully to stay on track.

Document checklist and preparation strategy

Having the right documents ready in advance reduces delays across portals. Typical requirements include:

  • CUET admit card and score/merit statement
  • Class 12 or qualifying examination marks sheet
  • Identity proof (Aadhaar card, passport, etc.)
  • Category certificate (if applicable) and domicile certificate
  • Passport-size photographs (as specified by the portal)
  • Residence or family income proofs (where required by state policy)

Always verify the exact document list on the official portal before uploading. Incomplete submissions can lead to delays or denial of seat allocation.

Frequently asked questions

Q1: Do central and state counselling use the same login?

A1: Not always. Central counselling typically has a dedicated login on its national portal, while state counselling uses state-specific portals. Create or recover credentials on each portal as required.

Q2: What if I miss the counselling deadlines?

A2: Missed deadlines can limit options. Some rounds may be rescheduled, but it is essential to act quickly if you notice a delay. Check the official portal for any late-release windows or special rounds.

Q3: How can I track seat allotment status?

A3: Log in to the respective central or state counselling portal and navigate to the seat allotment or counselling status page. You will see current round status, your application number, and allotted program if any.

Q4: Can I change my college preferences after submitting?

A4: Many portals allow modifications during specific rounds or during a dedicated option upgrade window. Review the guidelines on the portal and confirm changes before the deadline.

Q5: What should I do after a seat is allotted?

A5: Accept the seat, complete any required fee payment, and report to the allotted institution within the allotted time. If you don’t report, the seat may be forfeited.

Q6: How can I verify if my documents are uploaded correctly?

A6: After uploading, check the status indicator on the portal. If there are errors, upload the corrected documents promptly and confirm the update.

Q7: Do I need to submit originals at the time of reporting?

A7: Many institutions require original documents during reporting. Carry originals along with photocopies as instructed by the college. Portals typically confirm the documentation flow during allotment.

Pro tips for a smoother counselling experience

  • Set calendar reminders for all key dates and time zones across portals.
  • Prepare digital copies of all documents with clear, legible scans.
  • Keep a backup email and mobile number for notifications related to both central and state processes.
  • Discuss options with a trusted mentor or parent but base final decisions on your merit and career goals.

Because the exact login steps and document requirements can shift year to year, verify details on the official authorities’ portals as soon as you receive notices. This guide outlines the standard flow so you can anticipate the user experience across central and state counselling platforms.

title: IIM லக்னோ குடும்பத் தொழில் MBA: CAT இல்லாமல் யார் விண்ணப்பிக்கலாம்?
description: MBA-FB படிப்புக்கான குடும்பத் தொழில் தகுதி, ₹20 கோடி நிபந்தனை, ஏற்கப்படும் தேர்வுகள் மற்றும் இரண்டு கட்ட விண்ணப்பக் காலக்கெடுகளை அறியுங்கள்.
content:
IIM லக்னோவின் MBA in Family Business படிப்புக்கு GMAT, GRE அல்லது நிறுவனத்தின் நுழைவுத் தேர்வு வழியாக விண்ணப்பிக்கலாம். குடும்ப நிறுவனங்களின் உரிமையாளர்கள் மற்றும் அடுத்த தலைமுறை உறுப்பினர்களுக்கான படிப்பு இது. பொதுவான MBA வாய்ப்பாகக் கருதும் முன் தொழில் சார்ந்த தகுதிகளைச் சரிபாருங்கள்.

குடும்பத் தொழிலுக்கான நிபந்தனையை முதலில் பாருங்கள்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ விண்ணப்ப அறிவுறுத்தல்களின்படி, விண்ணப்பதாரர் குடும்பத் தொழிலின் உரிமையாளராகவோ வாரிசாகவோ இருக்க வேண்டும். தொழில் முதலீடு அல்லது ஆண்டு விற்றுமுதல் குறைந்தபட்சம் ₹20 கோடியாக இருக்க வேண்டும். நேர்காணலுக்குத் தேர்வானவர்கள் விண்ணப்பத்தில் குறிப்பிட்ட தொழில் விவரங்களுக்கான ஆவணச் சான்றுகளைச் சமர்ப்பிக்க வேண்டும்.

10+2+3 அல்லது 10+2+4 கல்வி முறையிலான இளநிலைப் பட்டம் அல்லது இணையான கல்வித் தகுதியில் குறைந்தபட்சம் 50% மதிப்பெண்கள் அல்லது இணையான CGPA தேவை. பல்கலைக்கழகத்தின் CGPA மாற்றுச் சூத்திரம் இருந்தால் அதைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். சூத்திரம் இல்லாதபோது IIM லக்னோ பயன்படுத்தும் முறை விண்ணப்பப் பக்கத்தில் உள்ளது.

எந்தத் தேர்வு வழி ஏற்கப்படுகிறது?

செல்லுபடியாகும் GMAT அல்லது GRE மதிப்பெண், அல்லது IIM லக்னோ நுழைவுத் தேர்வு ஏற்கப்படுகிறது. MBA-FB சேர்க்கைக்கான தேர்வாக CAT பட்டியலிடப்படவில்லை. தேர்வு மையத்தில் எழுதிய GMAT அல்லது GRE மதிப்பெண்கள் மட்டுமே ஏற்கப்படும்; விண்ணப்பத்தின் கடைசித் தேதி வரை அவை செல்லுபடியாக வேண்டும். நிறுவனத்தின் நுழைவுத் தேர்வு நொய்டா வளாகத்தில் நடைபெறும்.

IIM லக்னோவின் வேறு படிப்புக்கான தேர்வு அல்லது பணி அனுபவ விதிகள் இதற்கும் பொருந்தும் எனக் கருதாதீர்கள். MBA-FB அறிவுறுத்தல்களையே பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

பணம் செலுத்தும் முன் விண்ணப்பத்தைத் தயாரியுங்கள்

முதற்கட்ட விண்ணப்பக் கடைசித் தேதி 31 டிசம்பர் 2026; இரண்டாம் கட்டத்துக்கு 2 ஏப்ரல் 2027. விண்ணப்பக் கட்டணம் ₹3,000; திருப்பித் தரப்படாது. விண்ணப்பத்தை இணையத்தில் சமர்ப்பிக்க வேண்டும்.

புகைப்படம், கையொப்பம், பொருந்தும் தேர்வு மதிப்பெண் ஆவணம், பள்ளிச் சான்றிதழ்கள் மற்றும் மதிப்பெண் பட்டியல்கள், படிவம் கோரும் ஒருங்கிணைந்த பட்டம் மற்றும் பருவ மதிப்பெண் ஆவணங்களைத் தயாராக வைத்திருங்கள். பொருந்தினால் பிரிவு அல்லது மாற்றுத்திறனாளிச் சான்றிதழ்களும் தேவை. தொழில் விவரங்களை ஆதார ஆவணங்களுடன் ஒப்பிட்டுப் பாருங்கள்.

சமர்ப்பிக்கும் முன் பலமுறை முன்னோட்டம் பார்க்கலாம். சமர்ப்பித்த பின் திருத்த அனுமதி இல்லை. இறுதியாகச் சமர்ப்பிக்கும் முன் பெயர், மதிப்பெண்கள், கல்வித் தகுதி மற்றும் பதிவேற்றிய கோப்புகளைச் சரிபாருங்கள்.

தொழிலிலிருந்து ஒதுக்க வேண்டிய நேரத்தைத் திட்டமிடுங்கள்

படிப்பின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வப் பக்கம் இதை நொய்டா வளாகத்தின் இரண்டாண்டு MBA எனக் குறிப்பிடுகிறது. ஒவ்வொரு மாதமும் ஏழு நாள் வளாகப் பயிற்சி தொகுதிகள் உள்ளன. சொந்தக் குடும்ப நிறுவனத்தை மையமாகக் கொண்ட திட்டப்பணிகளும் இடம்பெறும். விண்ணப்பிக்கும் முன் இந்த வருகைத் தேவை மற்றும் தொழிலில் தொடர்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டிய பொறுப்புகள் குறித்து ஆலோசியுங்கள்.

title: JEE Main 2027 Registration Date LIVE: Session 1 Form, Exam Dates & Documents
description: Check JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration updates, application form, expected exam dates, documents required, eligibility criteria, and steps to apply online.
content:
I think JEE Main 2027 Registration is an update for students who are preparing for engineering entrance examinations. The National Testing Agency, also known as NTA, is expected to release the Session 1 application form on the JEE Main website. Candidates should keep an eye on announcements for the confirmed registration start date, the last date, and the application instructions.

According to reports that cite the examination calendar, the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 is scheduled for January 22, 23, 24, 28, 29, and 30 of 2027. January 31 has been reported as a buffer date. Candidates should verify the schedule through NTA notifications.

Documents Required for JEE Main 2027 Registration

Candidates should keep the following documents and information ready before starting the application:

  • Recent scanned photograph in the prescribed format

  • Scanned signature

  • Class 10 certificate or marksheet

  • Valid email address and mobile number

  • Identity details required by NTA

  • Category certificate or related details, where applicable

  • PwD/PwBD certificate, where applicable

  • Academic information and qualifying examination details

  • Online payment method for the application fee

Check the official information bulletin for the exact file formats, sizes, and document requirements.

How to Fill the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Application Form

Once registration opens, candidates can generally follow these steps:

  1. Visit the website at jeemain.nta.nic.in.

  2. Open the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration link.

  3. Complete the registration by providing the required contact details.

  4. Log in. Fill in academic information, paper choices, and examination-city preferences.

  5. Upload the photograph, signature, and other required documents.

  6. Pay the application fee.

  7. Review all entered information carefully.

  8. Submit the form. Download the confirmation page.

  9. Candidates should submit one application form. They should use their parent/guardian's valid contact details as instructed by NTA.

JEE Main 2027 Eligibility

Candidates must meet the qualifying examination and subject requirements as stated in the information bulletin. Students who want to apply for B.E./B.Tech admission usually need to have completed the Class 12 subjects, including Physics and Mathematics, along with a valid additional subject combination.

Candidates should review the 2027 eligibility rules carefully before submitting their application.

Conclusion

JEE Main 2027 aspirants should get their documents ready early. Keep an eye on the NTA website for the Session 1 application form, registration deadline, and final exam schedule. Take time to check eligibility and application details. This helps avoid mistakes when registering.

title: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
Class 10 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments (033) is on 5 March 2027; Class 12 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments Mridangam (033) is on 1 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments0335 March 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours
Class 12: Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments Mridangam0331 March 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours

Find your Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 6, 9 and look for codes 033, 033. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments (033) falls 7 calendar days after English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Carnatic Music Percussion Instruments Mridangam (033) falls 4 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Keep school assessments separate

This row gives the scheduled board paper. Do not use it to guess a practical, performance, project or internal-assessment appointment. Where your course has a separate assessed component, obtain that schedule and the instructions for materials from your school.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: ਤਮਿਲਨਾਡੂ NEET PG 2026 ਰਾਊਂਡ 1: ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਮਿਆਦਾਂ
description: ਤਮਿਲਨਾਡੂ PG ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਦੇ ਆਰਜ਼ੀ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੋਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਭਰਨ ਦੀ ਤਜਵੀਜ਼ ਹੈ। ਲੌਕਿੰਗ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਰਕਮ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਮਿਆਦਾਂ ਜਾਣੋ।
content:
ਤਮਿਲਨਾਡੂ NEET PG 2026 ਦੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਤੈਅ ਕਰ ਲੈਣ। ਚੋਣ ਕਮੇਟੀ ਦੇ ਆਰਜ਼ੀ ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਭਰਨ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 12:01 ਤੋਂ 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਲੌਕ ਕੀਤੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਬਦਲੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ। ਇਹ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਹਨ; ਇਸ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਤਿੰਨ ਪੰਨਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਦੀਆਂ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ

ਇਹ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ PG ਡਿਗਰੀ/ਡਿਪਲੋਮਾ ਸੀਟਾਂ, ਸਵੈ-ਵਿੱਤੀ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਕੋਟੇ ਤੇ CMC ਵੇਲੋਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਕੋਟਾ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੈ। DNB ਜਾਂ ਦਿਵਿਆਂਗ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਦੀ ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਲਈ ਲਾਗੂ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ, ਚੋਣਾਂ ਭਰਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨਾ

ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਮਿਆਦ

10 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਸ਼ਾਮ 5

ਚੋਣ ਕਮੇਟੀ, ਮੈਡੀਕਲ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਖੋਜ ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟੋਰੇਟ, ਚੇਨਈ: 2026-27 PG ਡਿਗਰੀ/ਡਿਪਲੋਮਾ ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਦਾ ਆਰਜ਼ੀ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ, ਪੰਨਾ 1। ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਛਪੀ। ਤਿੰਨ ਪੰਨਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੋਟਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਕੋਟੇ ਦੇ ਜਨਰਲ ਰੈਂਕ 001-7952 ਅਤੇ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਕੋਟੇ ਦੇ ਜਨਰਲ ਰੈਂਕ 001-3643 ਸੱਦੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ। NEET ਅੰਕਾਂ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ GQ ਲਈ 705.64-226 ਅਤੇ MQ ਲਈ 625-226 ਹੈ। ਆਪਣੀ ਐਂਟਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਵਾਧੂ ਸੂਚੀ ਜਾਂਚੋ। ਰੈਂਕ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਣਾ ਸੀਟ ਦੀ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਤਮਿਲਨਾਡੂ PG ਰੈਂਕ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਧੂ ਸੂਚੀ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ

GQ ਅਤੇ MQ ਹਰੇਕ ਲਈ ਵਾਪਸ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਫੀਸ ₹1,000 ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖ ਵਾਪਸੀਯੋਗ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਰਕਮ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਮੈਡੀਕਲ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਲਈ ₹30,000, ਸਵੈ-ਵਿੱਤੀ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਰਕਾਰੀ ਕੋਟਾ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਲਈ ₹1,00,000 ਅਤੇ ਘੱਟਗਿਣਤੀ/NRI ਸਮੇਤ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਕੋਟੇ ਲਈ ₹2,00,000 ਹੈ। ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਅਤੇ ਚੁਣਿਆ ਕੋਟਾ ਵੇਖੋ। ਇਹ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਰਕਮ ਟਿਊਸ਼ਨ ਫੀਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਾਂਚੋ

ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਜਿੰਨੀ ਵਾਰ ਚਾਹੋ ਬਦਲ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਸਲ ਤਰਜੀਹ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਰੱਖੋ। ਅੰਤਿਮ ਲੌਕਿੰਗ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਕੋਰਸ ਜਾਂ ਕਾਲਜ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲ ਸਕਦੇ। ਲੌਕ ਨਾ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਲੌਕ ਹੋ ਜਾਣਗੀਆਂ।

ਚੋਣ ਕਮੇਟੀ ਦੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ

ਉਪਲਬਧ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਲਈ ਸੀਟ ਮੈਟ੍ਰਿਕਸ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਸਪੈਕਟਸ ਵੇਖੋ। ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਚੋਣ ਸੂਚੀ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ। ਲੌਗਿਨ ID, ਪਾਸਵਰਡ ਅਤੇ OTP ਕਿਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਸਾਂਝੇ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ।

ਆਦੇਸ਼ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ

ਚੁਣੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਆਰਜ਼ੀ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਆਦੇਸ਼ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਟਿਊਸ਼ਨ ਫੀਸ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਭਰਨੀ ਪਵੇਗੀ। ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ 10 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 3 ਵਜੇ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ ਕਾਲਜ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਲੈਣਾ ਹੈ। ਲੋੜੀਂਦੇ ਪੈਸਿਆਂ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਆਦੇਸ਼ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਮਿਆਦਾਂ ਇੱਕੋ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ।

ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਵੇਲੇ ਅਸਲ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਸਕੈਨ ਕਾਪੀਆਂ ਜਾਂਚ ਲਈ ਦੇਣੀਆਂ ਪੈਣਗੀਆਂ। ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਅਤੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੱਕ ਹਾਜ਼ਰ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ 'ਤੇ ਚੋਣ ਜਾਂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਰੱਦ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਬਦਲਣ 'ਤੇ ਨਵਾਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਤੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਆਦੇਸ਼ ਮੰਨੋ।

title: CBSE Class 12 Chemistry Syllabus 2025-26 | Units, Chapters & Marks Distribution
description: Check the complete CBSE Class 12 Chemistry syllabus 2025-26 (Code 043) with unit-wise topics, marks distribution, and practical exam details. Simple guide for CBSE board exam 2026 students.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Chemistry Syllabus 2025–26 | Complete Guide for Board Exam 2026

If you are preparing for the CBSE Class 12 board exam 2026, knowing the latest Chemistry syllabus (Code 043) is very important. CBSE has clearly divided the subject into theory (70 marks) and practical/internal assessment (30 marks), making a total of 100 marks.

The theory part includes 10 important units, all of which will be asked in the 2026 board exam.

This article explains the syllabus in simple language so every student can understand what to study and how much to focus on each unit.

CBSE Class 12 Chemistry Marks Distribution (2025–26)

Component Marks
Theory Exam 70 Marks
Practical / Internal Assessment 30 Marks
Total 100 Marks

CBSE Class 12 Chemistry Units & Marks (Theory – 70 Marks)

Unit No. Unit Name Marks
1 Solutions 7
2 Electrochemistry 9
3 Chemical Kinetics 7
4 d- and f-Block Elements 7
5 Coordination Compounds 7
6 Haloalkanes and Haloarenes 6
7 Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers 6
8 Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids 8
9 Amines 6
10 Biomolecules 7

Unit-Wise Topics Explained Simply

Unit 1: Solutions (7 Marks)

  • Types of solutions

  • Concentration methods

  • Raoult’s law

  • Colligative properties

  • Van’t Hoff factor & abnormal molar mass

Unit 2: Electrochemistry (9 Marks – High Weightage)

  • Electrochemical cells & EMF

  • Nernst equation

  • Gibbs energy relation

  • Conductance & Kohlrausch’s law

  • Electrolysis, batteries, fuel cells & corrosion

Unit 3: Chemical Kinetics (7 Marks)

  • Rate of reaction

  • Order & molecularity

  • Rate law & half-life

  • Arrhenius equation & activation energy

Unit 4: d- and f-Block Elements (7 Marks)

  • Properties of transition elements

  • Oxidation states, colour, magnetism

  • Potassium dichromate & potassium permanganate

  • Lanthanoids & actinoids

Unit 5: Coordination Compounds (7 Marks)

  • Ligands & coordination number

  • IUPAC naming

  • Werner’s theory

  • VBT & basic CFT

  • Isomerism

Unit 6: Haloalkanes & Haloarenes (6 Marks)

  • Nomenclature & properties

  • SN1 & SN2 reactions

  • Environmental effects of freons, DDT, etc.

Unit 7: Alcohols, Phenols & Ethers (6 Marks)

  • Preparation & properties

  • Identification of alcohol types

  • Phenol reactions

  • Uses of methanol & ethanol

Unit 8: Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids (8 Marks)

  • Carbonyl compounds

  • Nucleophilic addition

  • Acidity of carboxylic acids

  • Uses & reactions

Unit 9: Amines (6 Marks)

  • Classification

  • Basicity

  • Diazotization reactions

  • Uses

Unit 10: Biomolecules (7 Marks)

  • Carbohydrates

  • Proteins & enzymes

  • Vitamins

  • DNA, RNA & hormones

Practical & Internal Assessment (30 Marks)

The practical exam is very scoring and includes:

Component
Chemistry experiments
Salt analysis
Project / activities
Practical record file
Viva voce

Best Units to Focus More (For High Scores)

  • Electrochemistry

  • Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids

  • Coordination Compounds

  • Biomolecules

  • Solutions

Why This Syllabus Is Important

Knowing the CBSE Class 12 Chemistry syllabus 2025–26 helps students:

  • Make a smart study plan
  • Focus on high-weightage chapters
  • Prepare for theory + practical properly
  • Score 80+ easily in Chemistry

Simple Study Tips for Class 12 Chemistry

  • Revise formulas daily

  • Practice numericals from Units 1–3

  • Learn named reactions

  • Prepare diagrams & mechanisms

  • Complete practical files early

Final Words

The CBSE Class 12 Chemistry syllabus 2025–26 (Code 043) is balanced between physical, organic, and inorganic chemistry. With proper planning and concept clarity, Chemistry can become one of your highest-scoring subjects in the board exam.

title: NEET UG 2026 Round 3: What MCC Seat Resignation Means for Fees
description: Learn what can and cannot be confirmed about NEET UG 2026 Round 3 seat resignation, fee forfeiture, withdrawal and later-round eligibility.
content:
NEET UG 2026 Round 3 seat resignation rules are not verified in the supplied official evidence. So no parent should assume that resignation, non-reporting or college withdrawal will produce the same fee loss or eligibility result. MCC, not NTA, controls the counselling action; wait for the applicable MCC notice and record the exact status shown in the candidate login.

The NEET UG exam guide explains the wider exam process.

The official NEET UG website is relevant for exam notices, but it does not establish MCC counselling refunds or seat-exit rules. That distinction matters.

What should you expect after NEET UG 2026 Round 3 seat resignation?

At present, the verified position is that the financial and admission consequences cannot be stated as fixed 2026 rules. Before submitting anything, identify whether the portal action is resignation, non-reporting or withdrawal, and whether the candidate has reported, joined, paid college fees or received an upgrade.

Exit situationWhat is knownWhat must be confirmed in the MCC notice
Portal resignationA candidate gives up the allotted seat through the permitted MCC route.Security-deposit forfeiture, refund treatment and later-round eligibility.
Non-reportingThe candidate does not complete the required reporting or joining step.Whether the seat is cancelled, which deposit is affected and whether the record blocks another round.
College-level withdrawalThe candidate seeks to leave after reporting or admission.Whether MCC action is also required and how college fees, hostel charges and deposits are settled.

How can MCC Round 3 resignation affect your money?

Keep three payment trails separate: the MCC counselling payment, the security deposit and money paid to the medical college. A college’s written refund policy may govern tuition, hostel charges or other deposits, while MCC rules may govern the counselling transaction and eligibility. One refund does not guarantee the others.

Parents, ask the college for a fee-wise written calculation, the refund-claim deadline and an acknowledgement of the student’s current admission status. If the student has already reported, do not simply stop attending. That can leave the MCC and college records out of sync.

Before you click an exit option

  1. Save the allotment letter, reporting proof and every payment receipt.
  2. Read the 2026 MCC clauses on resignation, non-reporting, withdrawal, forfeiture, refund and later-round eligibility.
  3. Check the candidate-login label and take a dated screenshot before submission.
  4. Request written confirmation from the college if any fee or admission record changes.
  5. Keep the acknowledgement, transaction record and replies together.

For the current NEET exam notice route, use NTA’s official site. For the 2026 MCC Round 3 decision, rely only on the applicable MCC notice and candidate-login instruction when published. Guessing here can cost money.

The University has formally joined the list of educational establishments that provide students with the results of these design admission exams by making this declaration.

It should be mentioned that this news will allow students nationwide to apply using their UCEED and CEED results for the University's design courses.

About UCEED and CEED Exams

Both UCEED and CEED are national-level design entrance examinations conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay. These exams are widely recognized for admission into top design institutes in India.

  • UCEED is conducted for admission to undergraduate design programs such as Bachelor of Design (B.Des).

  • CEED is conducted for postgraduate programs such as Master of Design (M.Des).

These exams test candidates on creativity, visualization skills, logical reasoning, drawing ability, and design thinking.

Tezpur University Design Admission Overview

Particulars Details
University Tezpur University
Location Assam, India
Department Department of Design
Accepted Exams UCEED 2026, CEED 2026
Conducting Body of Exam IIT Bombay
Programs Offered Design-related courses

Benefits for Design Aspirants

By adding the result-sharing institutes list, Tezpur University would allow students to apply through the results of the UCEED and CEED scores. This would be advantageous in several ways.

It would provide students with more opportunities to seek education in the field of design in esteemed schools. It would also alleviate the stress of appearing for multiple entrance exams. It would also ensure transparency in the admission process.

Students who qualify in the UCEED and CEED 2026 results would now have the option of applying through this institute as well.

Admission Process

The interested candidates who want to pursue the Department of Design at Tezpur University need to submit the valid scores in the UCEED/ CEED 2026 during the admission process. Apart from the entrance test scores, the university can conduct other selection processes before the actual admission.

The interested candidates need to regularly follow the updates provided by Tezpur University regarding the admission guidelines and eligibility criteria.

Conclusion

The inclusion of Tezpur University’s Department of Design in the list of UCEED and CEED result-sharing institutions is a significant move for design education in India. This provides a new platform for students who want to make a career in creative fields like design. With this initiative, Tezpur University is trying to attract talented students from all over India for its design programs.

title: NIFT 2027 Situation Test: How to Plan the Task Before Materials
description: Prepare for the NIFT 2027 Situation Test by reading the prompt, planning construction, managing time and explaining your model clearly.
content:
The NIFT 2027 Situation Test rewards a clear, workable idea more than a bag full of fancy supplies. If you’re shortlisted for BDes, read the task, decide what the model must communicate, protect its structure and leave time to explain it. The National Institute of Fashion Technology may change instructions, so check the official NIFT admissions page for the current notice.

How should you read a NIFT 2027 Situation Test prompt?

Before cutting or folding anything, turn the prompt into three decisions: what is the subject, what action or feeling must the model show, and what can you build within the available time. This short pause prevents a common failure: a visually busy model that misses the actual task.

  1. Mark the task words, including the object, setting, user and action.
  2. Choose one main visual idea instead of combining unrelated concepts.
  3. Sketch the base, main form and two or three supporting details.
  4. Decide what you can remove if construction takes longer than expected.

What time plan works for the NIFT 2027 Situation Test?

The exact duration is an official instruction, not a figure to guess from coaching advice. Use the split below for practice only, then adjust it when the NIFT notice confirms the test format. Your model needs a stable centre before it gets surface detail.

Practice stageSuggested sharePurpose
Read and plan10%Stops you building the wrong idea
Base and main form55%Gives the model strength
Details and refinement25%Improves visual communication
Check and explain10%Catches loose parts and unclear logic

In a 40-minute practice task, that means about four minutes to plan, 22 minutes for the main form, 10 minutes for refinement and four minutes to check. If the structure is demanding, take time from decoration, not from the final check.

How can you build a stable model with simple materials?

Start with weight distribution. Use a broad base, attach large pieces before small ones and test whether the form stands without your hand. Paper, cardboard, thread, clay and recycled objects can all work when the joints are neat and the centre of balance is clear.

Practise with one box, folded paper and thread. Turn them into a shelter, movement or boundary, then explain the idea in two sentences. Say what the viewer should understand, who or what the model addresses, and which design choice makes that message visible.

For admission-stage context, read the NIFT exam guide. The NIFT 2027 Situation Test is timed design work, not a packing contest. Plan first, build for stability and spend the remaining minutes making the idea easier to read.

title: NEET UG 2026 Counselling: What Happens When Your Medical Report Is Missing
description: A missing medical fitness report can hold up joining after NEET UG 2026 allotment. Know the reporting risk and the next steps.
content:
NEET UG 2026 counselling doesn’t end with seat allotment. If your medical fitness report is missing or incomplete at reporting, the college may keep your file pending, delay joining or ask you to submit the document within a stated period. In some cases, failure to meet that requirement can put seat confirmation at risk. Act before the reporting date, not at the last minute.

Is a medical report the same as domicile or category proof?

No. They serve different admission checks. A medical fitness report records whether you’re fit to join the medical course. Domicile proof establishes a relevant state connection, while a category certificate supports an SC, ST, OBC, EWS or other reserved-seat claim. A valid domicile certificate cannot replace a medical report, and a medical report cannot repair a rejected category document.

This separation matters at the verification desk. Your allotment can be genuine while one part of your document file remains incomplete.

What can happen at reporting?

The response depends on the current instructions from the Medical Counselling Committee, the state counselling authority and the allotted college. The centre may accept provisional reporting, record a deficiency or hold joining until an acceptable report arrives. Don’t assume every college follows the same practice.

Ask the receiving officer three direct questions: What exactly is missing? Can I report provisionally? What is the final submission deadline? Request written instructions, an acknowledgement or an email reply. A verbal “we’ll see” won’t protect your seat.

What should you do after allotment?

  1. Read the medical-document instructions attached to your allotment letter.
  2. Check the latest notice on the official NEET UG website, then check the responsible MCC or state counselling portal.
  3. Call the allotted college’s admission office to confirm the prescribed format, examining doctor or hospital, and any validity condition.
  4. Book the examination with the authority accepted in those instructions. Don’t submit a private clinic certificate without confirming that it will be accepted.
  5. Report on time with the allotment letter, identity records, original medical report if available, photocopies and appointment evidence.

Keep medical papers in a separate folder, but carry them with your wider admission file. You can also review the NEET UG exam guide for the broader admission route.

What if the report contains an error?

Don’t overwrite a wrong name, date of birth, course detail or doctor entry. Ask the issuing authority to cancel and reissue it, then inform the college before reporting closes. The corrected report should match your NEET UG and identity records. If the report won’t arrive in time, attend the centre with proof of the appointment and seek a written decision on provisional submission.

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.
