title: Event Management Course After 12th: Eligibility & Career Scope
description: Learn about event management courses after Class 12, including certificate, diploma and degree options. Explore eligibility criteria, fees, admission process, career opportunities and salary prospects in India.
content:
Do you enjoy organising college festivals, planning celebrations, managing activities or bringing people together for special occasions? If yes, an event management course after Class 12 could help you turn these interests into a professional career.

Event management combines creativity with business skills. Professionals in this field plan weddings, concerts, corporate conferences, exhibitions, college festivals, product launches, sports events and entertainment programmes. Their responsibilities include budgeting, selecting venues, coordinating vendors, managing schedules and ensuring that an event runs smoothly.

Students from Science, Commerce and Arts can explore this field. Depending on their career goals, they can choose a certificate course, diploma or undergraduate degree in event management, event planning or a related discipline.

Event Management Course After 12th: Overview

Particular

Details

Course name

Event Management

Eligibility

Class 12 pass from a recognised board, subject to institute requirements

Eligible streams

Science, Commerce and Arts

Popular courses

BBA, BA, BMS, B.Sc. and Diploma in Event Management

Course duration

A few months to 3 years for common certificate, diploma and undergraduate options

Admission process

Merit-based admission or institute-specific selection

Approximate fees

Vary considerably by course, institution and duration

Career options

Event Coordinator, Event Planner, Wedding Planner, Production Coordinator and Event Manager

Work opportunities

Event agencies, hotels, entertainment companies, corporate organisations and independent businesses

What Is an Event Management Course?

An event management course teaches students how to plan, organise, promote and execute events within a given budget and timeline. It covers both the creative side of an event and the operational work required to deliver it successfully.

For example, organising a college fest involves much more than choosing a theme. The team must arrange the venue, obtain permissions, manage performers, coordinate food and equipment, promote registrations and prepare backup plans for unexpected problems.

Students pursuing event management may study subjects such as:

  • Event planning and production

  • Budgeting and financial management

  • Marketing and public relations

  • Venue and logistics management

  • Vendor and client coordination

  • Sponsorship and brand promotion

  • Hospitality and guest management

  • Risk management and event safety

Practical training, internships and live projects are particularly valuable because event management requires real-world coordination in addition to classroom knowledge.

Types of Event Management Courses After 12th

Students can choose from different programmes depending on how much time they want to invest in formal education and whether they prefer a degree or job-oriented training.

Course

Typical duration

Suitable for

Certificate in Event Management

6-12 months, depending on the provider

Students seeking basic knowledge and short-term training

Diploma in Event Management

1-2 years in many programmes

Students who want focused professional training

BBA in Event Management

Usually 3 years

Students interested in event operations and business management

BA in Event Management

Usually 3 years

Students interested in event planning, communication and creative production

BMS in Event Management or a related specialisation

Commonly 3 years

Students interested in management and coordination roles

B.Sc. in Events or Experiential Management

Commonly 3 years

Students interested in event production, experiences and practical execution

Duration varies by institution and programme structure. Some universities offer honours degrees, exit options or differently structured programmes.

1. Certificate Course in Event Management

A certificate course introduces the basics of planning and executing events. It may cover event concepts, logistics, marketing, budgeting and coordination.

This option is useful for students who want to explore the industry before committing to a longer programme. However, the course content, practical exposure and recognition of certificates vary between providers.

For example, IGNOU offers a Certificate in Event Management for learners who have completed Class 12. Its published programme information lists a minimum duration of six months and a programme fee of ₹4,200, excluding examination fees. Check the current admission notice for updated details.

2. Diploma in Event Management

A diploma generally focuses on practical skills needed for entry-level roles. Depending on the institute, subjects may include event planning, vendor coordination, production, marketing, budgeting and on-site management.

A diploma may be appropriate for students who want specialised training without completing a full undergraduate degree. Before enrolling, check whether the programme includes internships, live events and placement support.

3. BBA in Event Management

A Bachelor of Business Administration in Event Management combines management fundamentals with event-specific training. Students may study marketing, accounting, business communication, project management, event operations and sponsorship management.

This route can suit students who want to work with event companies or eventually manage their own event-planning business.

4. BA, BMS or B.Sc. in Event Management

Some institutions offer event-related programmes under arts, management or science degree titles. Their focus may differ: one programme might emphasise communication and creative planning, while another may focus on production technology, logistics or experiential design.

Always review the actual curriculum instead of selecting a course based on its name alone.

Event Management Course Eligibility After 12th

The eligibility criteria depend on the institution, course level and admission policy. However, the following points can help students understand the usual requirements.

Educational qualification

Most undergraduate and entry-level event management courses accept students who have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board.

Required stream

Students from all three major streams can generally explore event management:

  • Science: Suitable for students interested in event technology, production and management.

  • Commerce: Useful for those interested in budgeting, sponsorships, business operations and finance.

  • Arts and Humanities: Can provide a foundation for students interested in communication, creative planning, public relations and entertainment.

A specific course may impose additional subject requirements, so candidates should check the official eligibility criteria before applying.

Minimum marks

There is no single percentage requirement applicable to every event management course. Some institutes admit students based on passing Class 12, while others may require a minimum aggregate percentage or conduct an additional selection process.

Entrance exams

Many event management programmes offer merit-based admission. Other institutions may use their own entrance tests, interviews or other selection criteria. There is no single entrance examination required for every event management course in India.

Admission Process for Event Management Courses

Students can generally follow these steps when applying to a college or training institute:

  1. Choose a course: Decide whether you want a certificate, diploma or undergraduate degree.

  2. Shortlist institutions: Compare course content, fees, faculty, practical training and placement assistance.

  3. Check eligibility: Review the Class 12 requirements and any minimum marks or additional conditions.

  4. Submit the application: Complete the online or offline form and provide the required documents.

  5. Complete selection formalities: Attend an entrance test or interview if the institution requires one.

  6. Confirm admission: Pay the applicable fees after checking the offer, course duration and programme details.

Commonly required documents include Class 10 and 12 marksheets, identity proof, photographs and other documents specified by the institution.

Event Management Course Fees After 12th

The total cost depends on the programme's duration, institution, location, practical training facilities and additional charges.

Course type

General fee consideration

Certificate

Often the lower-cost option, particularly for short programmes

Diploma

Depends on the training provider, course duration and practical exposure

Undergraduate degree

Usually involves a larger total investment over multiple years

Online or short-term training

May cost less than a full-time degree, but recognition and practical exposure vary

Do not compare institutions only by their advertised tuition fees. Check for examination charges, registration fees, project costs, travel expenses and any additional charges for live-event participation.

Before paying, ask the institute for a complete fee breakdown and confirm the qualification awarded upon completion.

Career Scope After an Event Management Course

Event management offers opportunities across several industries because organisations use events to celebrate occasions, build relationships, promote brands and engage audiences.

Popular career options

Job profile

Main responsibilities

Event Coordinator

Manages schedules, vendors, venues and day-to-day event requirements

Event Planner

Develops event concepts, budgets, timelines and execution plans

Wedding Planner

Coordinates wedding arrangements, suppliers, décor, ceremonies and guest requirements

Corporate Event Executive

Helps organise conferences, meetings, award functions and business events

Event Production Coordinator

Supports staging, lighting, sound, equipment and production teams

Exhibition Coordinator

Manages exhibitor requirements, floor plans, registrations and logistics

Sponsorship Executive

Works with brands and partners to secure sponsorships

Artist or Talent Coordinator

Coordinates performers, artists, schedules and event requirements

Event Marketing Executive

Promotes events through advertising, partnerships and digital campaigns

Entrepreneur or Independent Planner

Builds and manages an event-planning business

Students usually begin in assistant, executive or coordinator positions. With experience, they may progress to project management, client servicing, production leadership or business ownership.

Event Management Salary in India

Salary depends on the employer, city, event type, experience, responsibilities and professional network. A candidate working on small local events may earn differently from someone managing large corporate events or premium weddings.

The following figures are broad indicative estimates, not guaranteed salaries or official industry averages.

Experience level

Indicative annual salary

Fresher or entry-level professional

₹2.4-4.0 lakh

Professional with 2-5 years of experience

₹4-7 lakh

Experienced event or project manager

₹6-12 lakh or more

Senior specialist or established business owner

Highly variable

Actual offers can fall below or above these ranges. Freelancers and business owners may earn project-based income, which can fluctuate considerably depending on bookings, operating costs and client demand.

How can freshers improve their earning potential?

Students can strengthen their career prospects by gaining experience in live events, building vendor and client communication skills, learning budgeting tools, understanding digital marketing and maintaining a portfolio of completed projects.

Internships and practical exposure can be particularly helpful when applying for a first job.

Top Event Management Colleges and Institutes to Explore

Instead of choosing a college only by popularity, shortlist institutions that offer the specific qualification you want and provide practical exposure.

Institution

What to investigate

Indian Institute of Creative Skills (IICS)

Its event and experiential management programmes, curriculum and practical training

National Institute of Event Management (NIEM)

Diploma and event-management training options

IGNOU

Certificate-level study in event management

University of Mumbai and affiliated institutions

Availability of event-related degree programmes and current admission rules

Whistling Woods International

Event-related or entertainment-industry programmes available in the current prospectus

Other universities offering BBA or BA specialisations

Degree recognition, course structure, internship access and total fees

Programme availability can change, and not every institution listed offers the same qualification or admission route. Check the current official prospectus for course names, eligibility, fees, campus location and application deadlines before applying.

Skills Required to Become a Successful Event Manager

A degree or diploma can provide a foundation, but professional success also depends on how well you handle people, time, budgets and unexpected situations.

The most useful skills include:

  • Communication: Clear coordination with clients, vendors, performers and team members.

  • Organisation: Managing multiple tasks and deadlines without losing track of details.

  • Budgeting: Planning expenses and monitoring costs against the available budget.

  • Problem-solving: Responding quickly when schedules, suppliers or equipment arrangements change.

  • Negotiation: Discussing prices, contracts and service requirements with vendors.

  • Creativity: Developing event concepts that match the client's goals and audience.

  • Teamwork: Coordinating different departments under time pressure.

  • Digital skills: Using spreadsheets, project-management tools, social media and event-registration platforms.

Students can start developing these abilities by volunteering at school or college events, assisting local event organisers and taking responsibility for small projects.

Is Event Management a Good Career After 12th?

Event management can be a suitable career for students who enjoy practical work, communication, planning and creative problem-solving. It offers different career paths, from corporate conferences and exhibitions to weddings, concerts, sports events and brand promotions.

However, the profession can involve irregular working hours, weekend duties, travel and high-pressure situations. Students should consider these working conditions alongside the creative opportunities.

Before choosing a programme, compare the cost of education with the practical experience, internship opportunities and career support offered by the institute. A recognised qualification, strong communication skills and hands-on experience can help build a more reliable starting point.

Conclusion

An event management course after 12th can help students turn their interest in organising events into a professional career. Certificate programmes and diplomas offer shorter learning routes, while a BBA, BA or related undergraduate degree provides a longer period of academic and practical development.

Before taking admission, compare eligibility, fees, course content, internship opportunities and the qualification awarded. Most importantly, seek hands-on experience through college festivals, internships or live projects. In an industry where execution matters as much as ideas, practical skills can make a meaningful difference to long-term career growth.

title: NEET 2026–27: Central and state counselling portals stepwise login guide
description: A practical, stepwise login guide for NEET 2026–27 counselling portals across central and state boards, tailored for students and parents navigating registrations, choices, and seat allotment.
content:
Quick takeaway

Knowing exactly how to access the central and state counselling portals saves time during a busy admission season. This guide outlines the login steps, required documents, and common pitfalls to help families complete registrations and seat allotment smoothly for NEET 2026-27.

Why counselling portals matter this year

NEET counselling involves both national and state authorities, with separate portals for central seats and state quota. Timelines vary by state, and many portals require distinct logins even if you used one for exam registration. Planning ahead reduces last‑minute hurdles and ensures you don’t miss allotment rounds or document submission windows.

Step 1: Gather essential documents and information

  • NEET roll number and application number
  • Candidate’s name, date of birth, contact details
  • Email ID and mobile number used during NEET registration
  • Category certificate if applicable (General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST, PwD)
  • Eligibility proof for the chosen state or central seat (domicile, residency, or other criteria as required)
  • RANK/percentile information if the portal requests it for seat filtering

Having scanned copies of documents ready (PDF/JPG) helps when uploading data during portal login and form submission.

Step 2: Identify the relevant portals for NEET 2026-27 counselling

Two broad categories exist: central counselling for all India seats and state counselling for state quota. Each category typically has its own dedicated portal. Some states run a single consolidated portal, while others require you to use separate portals for registration, choice filling, and document verification. Confirm the exact portals from official exam authority notices and your state government education department communications.

Step 3: Create or recover your account on the central portal

  • Visit the official central counselling portal using a secure device and reliable internet.
  • Choose the option to register or sign in. If you already registered for NEET counselling previously, use the existing credentials rather than creating a new account.
  • Set a strong password and enable any two‑factor authentication if available.
  • Verify your email and mobile number through the one‑time password (OTP) process. Do not share OTPs with others.

After login, you should be able to see your NEET roll number linked to the account, along with any advised eligibility flags for central counselling.

Step 4: Create or recover your account on state counselling portals

  • Some states require a separate login from the central portal. Use the state portal’s “New User” or “Forgot Password” options as needed.
  • Enter required details exactly as they appear on NEET records to avoid mismatches.
  • Capture or upload any state‑specific documents requested for verification.

Keep a record of the state portal username and password in a secure place. If you already hold a state education portal account, you may be able to reuse those credentials, but some states mandate fresh logins for counselling.

Step 5: Validate eligibility and view seat matrix

Once logged in, confirm your eligibility status for central and state seats. Review the seat matrix, category wise reservations, and any domicile requirements. Note that some states reserve seats for local candidates under specific criteria; others allocate across the entire state. The central portal will show all‑India seats and national categories.

Step 6: Fill choices and priorities carefully

  • Prepare a ranked list of up to a practical number of institutes per category. Focus on a realistic mix of dream institutes, solid options, and safety choices.
  • Be mindful of closing ranks and the date windows for each round. Enter choices in the order of your real preferences.
  • Save progress frequently. Do not exit the portal without confirming your selections.

Step 7: Document verification and lock you selections

After submitting choices, you may need to upload scanned documents for verification. Ensure documents are clear and legible, with all required pages included. Some portals require biometric verification or in-person checks at designated facilitation centers; follow the portal’s instructions for scheduling and attending these verifications.

Step 8: Track seat allotment and next steps

Round results are published on the relevant portal. If allotted a seat, you will typically have a deadline to accept the seat and complete reporting procedures at the allotted college or through the portal. If not allotted, review the next round’s schedule and keep your options active by maintaining your login and choices as required.

Best practices to avoid common snags

  • Double‑check spelling, date of birth, and category on every form to prevent mismatch errors.
  • Use a common, secure device for all counselling activities to reduce login issues.
  • Keep your login credentials confidential and store them securely.
  • Set calendar reminders for important registration and allotment deadlines.
  • If a portal is slow or unresponsive, try again during off-peak hours and clear browser cache.

What to verify if details seem unclear

Always rely on official notices for definitive timelines and required documents. If you are unsure about a step or a deadline, consult the official counselling authority’s announcements or contact the helpdesk through the portal’s support channels. Do not rely on third‑party summaries alone for essential decisions.

FAQ (embedded and repeatable)

Q1: Do I need separate logins for central and state counselling portals?

A1: Yes, many states require separate logins. Check each portal’s login page guidance and use the credentials specifically for that portal.

Q2: What if I forget my portal password?

A2: Use the portal’s password recovery option. You may need to answer security questions or access your registered email or mobile for an OTP.

Q3: How many choices should I fill for NEET counselling?

A3: Start with a practical list across dream, backup, and safe options. It is better to prioritize quality matches over a long list that you cannot evaluate thoroughly.

Q4: Can I change my choices after submission?

A4: Some rounds permit modification before the seat allotment deadline. Follow the portal’s instructions exactly, as changes may affect round results.

Q5: Where can I verify document requirements?

A5: Check the official counselling notice and the help or notification section on the portal. If in doubt, use the official helpline to confirm required documents before uploading.

Q6: My domicile status affects seat eligibility. What should I do?

A6: Submit the correct domicile proof as required by the state portal. Inconsistent documents can lead to seat rejection or vacancy withdrawals.

Timeline snapshot to keep in view

  • NEET result declaration date and counselling notice release
  • Central portal login and initial registration window
  • State portal registrations and document verification windows
  • First and subsequent round seat allotment results

Always verify the latest dates and procedural notes on the official channels before acting. If information changes, rely on the designated authority’s updates rather than secondary summaries.

title: CMAT 2026 Registration Extended: New Deadline Announced
description: NTA has extended the CMAT 2026 registration deadline. Check the updated last date and important instructions for candidates applying this year.

title: JEE Main 2027 Correction Window: Which Application Errors Matter Most
description: Find out which JEE Main 2027 application mistakes need correction, when a fresh form may create trouble, and how to protect your candidature.
content:
JEE Main 2027 application correction matters when an error changes your identity, category, paper choice or eligibility details. A wrong entry may not stop the form from being accepted, but it can raise questions during later document checks. For most candidates, correcting the existing form is safer than submitting a second one.

NTA has not confirmed the 2027 correction dates, fees or editable fields in the evidence available for this article. Check the official JEE Main website for the current notice and the action permitted on your application.

Which errors should you treat as serious?

Start with fields that can change how NTA or an institute identifies and assesses you. These deserve a careful review, not a quick click.

  • Name, date of birth and identity details: Match these with the identity record you plan to present. Even a small spelling difference can lead to extra verification.
  • Category or PwD status: Select only a status you can support with the required certificate. An incorrect claim can affect document scrutiny and admission benefits.
  • Paper or subject choice: Check whether the selected route fits BTech, BArch or BPlanning. A paper mismatch may affect your course plans even when the form itself goes through.
  • School and qualifying-exam details: Enter the passing year, school information and examination status exactly as your records show them. These details may be checked during eligibility review.

Should you submit a fresh form instead?

Usually, no. A duplicate application can create confusion around the application number, session or fee payment. Use a new form only when the current NTA notice clearly allows or requires it and explains what happens to the earlier application.

An unavailable edit button does not mean you should guess, overwrite another field or start again blindly. Record the application number and keep the original confirmation page. If a serious identity or category error cannot be edited, use the help details in the current NTA notice.

Check these points before final submission

  1. Compare every changed field with your identity, school and category records.
  2. Confirm that the selected paper matches the course route you intend to pursue.
  3. Read the declaration carefully. A parent can cross-check it, but you must approve the final information.
  4. Download the revised confirmation page and retain the submission or payment record.

Make one careful correction rather than several rushed edits. For context on other entrance tests, see DekhoCampus’ entrance exam comparison section.

title: SRMJEEE Last Minute Revision: Important Topics to Revise
description: Maximize your score with this SRMJEEE last minute revision guide. Focus on high-weightage topics across physics, chemistry, mathematics, and aptitude.
content:
SRMJEEE Last Minute Revision: Important Topics to Revise

Executing a focused SRMJEEE last minute revision is critical for maximizing your final score in the SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination. With 130 questions to solve in 150 minutes, the Remote Proctored Online Mode (RPOM) test requires rapid recall and strong time management. Attempting to learn new chapters in the final days is counterproductive. Instead, prioritizing subjects and specific chapters that historically carry the highest weightage ensures a better return on your study hours.

This guide details the exact exam structure, the chapter-wise weightage across Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Aptitude, and practical execution strategies for test day.

SRMJEEE Examination Pattern and Marking Rules

Understanding the exact format of the test dictates how you allocate your time across sections. The exam consists of 130 multiple-choice questions (MCQs) for a total of 130 marks.

  • Total Duration: 2 hours and 30 minutes (150 minutes).

  • Section Breakdown: Mathematics or Biology (40 Questions), Physics (35 Questions), Chemistry (35 Questions), and a combined English & Aptitude section (20 Questions).

  • Marking Scheme: Candidates receive +1 mark for every correct response. There is no negative marking for incorrect or unattempted questions.

Because there is no penalty for wrong answers, your primary goal is to ensure you attempt every single question before the timer expires.

Subject-Wise High-Priority Topics

Target your remaining study blocks directly toward the chapters that yield the highest number of questions.

Mathematics (40 Questions)

Mathematics holds the highest weightage for engineering candidates and often consumes the most time due to lengthy calculations.

  • Calculus: Differential and Integral Calculus together account for 18% to 22% of the math section. Focus on limits, continuity, application of derivatives, and definite integrals.

  • Algebra: Matrices and Determinants (8% to 10%) offer straightforward, formula-based questions. Also review Complex Numbers and Quadratic Equations.

  • Coordinate Geometry and Vectors: Analytical Geometry (straight lines, conic sections) and Vector Algebra consistently yield 4 to 5 questions per paper.

  • Probability: Review standard probability theorems and distributions, which make up 6% to 8% of the section.

Physics (35 Questions)

Physics questions in SRMJEEE test the direct application of formulas from Class 11 and Class 12 NCERT textbooks.

  • Electrodynamics: Electrostatics and Current Electricity form the heaviest unit, contributing 6 to 8 questions. Focus on Gauss's Law, capacitance, and Kirchhoff’s circuit rules.

  • Magnetism and EMI: Expect 5 to 7 questions covering the Biot-Savart law, moving charges, Faraday’s laws, and alternating current circuits.

  • Modern Physics and Electronics: Nuclear Physics (radioactivity, mass defect) and Semiconductor Devices (logic gates, diodes) yield a combined 8 to 10 questions. These are highly scoring as they require minimal calculation.

  • Optics: Ray and Wave Optics contribute 3 to 4 questions. Review lens formulas and interference patterns.

Chemistry (35 Questions)

Chemistry is the fastest section to navigate. The questions are primarily fact-based and directly align with NCERT textbook concepts.

  • Organic Chemistry: Compounds containing Oxygen (alcohols, phenols, ethers, aldehydes, ketones) hold the highest weightage (10% to 12%). Compounds containing Nitrogen (amines, diazonium salts) add another 8% to 10%.

  • Physical Chemistry: Focus heavily on Chemical Kinetics and Electrochemistry. Practice numericals involving rate laws and the Nernst equation.

  • Inorganic Chemistry: Coordination Compounds and the properties of p-Block, d-Block, and f-Block elements account for roughly 15% of the section.

English and Aptitude (20 Questions)

Do not ignore this combined section. The 20 marks here act as a major rank booster.

  • Aptitude: Practice standard numerical and logical reasoning problems, including number systems, percentages, profit and loss, and direction sense.

  • English: Review basic grammar rules, short reading comprehension passages, synonyms, and antonyms.

Actionable Exam Execution Strategy

  • Attempt Easy Sections First: Start with Chemistry, English, and Aptitude. These 55 questions can typically be completed in 45 minutes, banking a large portion of your score early.

  • Use Formula Sheets Only: Do not read full textbook chapters in the final 48 hours. Scan your handwritten formula sheets for Physics and Physical Chemistry.

  • Leverage Zero Negative Marking: Since there are no penalties, never leave a question blank on your screen. If you are stuck on a lengthy math problem, use logical elimination to guess the answer, mark it, and move forward.

  • Check Hardware Requirements: Since the exam is a Remote Proctored Online Mode (RPOM) test taken from home, ensure your laptop webcam, microphone, and internet connection meet the university's technical requirements well before the exam slot.

Conclusion

A successful SRMJEEE last minute revision focuses strictly on formula recall and high-weightage chapters like Calculus, Electrodynamics, and Organic Chemistry. Because the exam features absolutely no negative marking, speed is your greatest asset. Clear the fact-based Chemistry and Aptitude sections quickly to reserve the bulk of your 150 minutes for the calculation-heavy Mathematics and Physics problems. Stick to your formula sheets, eliminate options logically when unsure, and attempt all 130 questions to maximize your merit rank.

title: INI SS जनवरी 2027 चरण 1 परिणाम: अनंतिम सूची कैसे देखें
description: AIIMS ने जनवरी 2027 के DM और MCh प्रवेश के लिए INI SS चरण 1 की अनंतिम पात्र सूची जारी की है। रोल नंबर देखने और अगले चरण को समझने का तरीका पढ़ें।
content:
AIIMS ने जनवरी 2027 सत्र के DM और MCh पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए INI SS चरण 1 में अनंतिम रूप से पात्र उम्मीदवारों की सूची जारी की है। यदि आपने 24 अक्टूबर 2026 को प्रवेश परीक्षा दी थी, तो आधिकारिक PDF में अपना रोल नंबर और उसके ऊपर लिखा विशेषज्ञता का नाम देखें। सूची में नाम या रोल नंबर आना अंतिम प्रवेश या सीट मिलने की पुष्टि नहीं है।

आधिकारिक सूची में अपना रोल नंबर कैसे खोजें

AIIMS के परिणाम पृष्ठ पर जाएँ। वहाँ List of Provisionally qualified candidates in INI-SS DM/M.Ch. Entrance Examination for the January 2027 Session शीर्षक वाली सूचना खोलें। इसकी जारी होने की तारीख 31 अक्टूबर 2026 है। PDF डाउनलोड करके अपने रोल नंबर से खोजें और संबंधित विषय शीर्षक तथा ‘Applied Under’ कॉलम भी मिलाएँ। दस्तावेज़ 57 पृष्ठों का है और पाठ्यक्रम के अनुसार व्यवस्थित है।

AIIMS परीक्षा अनुभाग की सूचना, 31 अक्टूबर 2026। पूरी PDF आधिकारिक परिणाम पृष्ठ से खोलें।

‘अनंतिम रूप से पात्र’ का मतलब

यह चरण 1 का अनंतिम परिणाम है। AIIMS की सूचना के अनुसार इस सूची के लिए विस्तृत पात्रता, श्रेणी और प्रायोजन संबंधी दस्तावेज़ों की अभी जाँच नहीं हुई है। आगे किसी भी चरण में गलत जानकारी या दस्तावेज़ में अंतर मिलने पर उम्मीदवारी रद्द हो सकती है। इसलिए अपने पाठ्यक्रम और श्रेणी के अनुसार मूल दस्तावेज़ तैयार रखें।

चरण 1 में पात्र होने से विभागीय मूल्यांकन के लिए बुलावा अपने आप तय नहीं होता। AIIMS सीटों से जुड़े चयन नियमों के आधार पर अगले चरण के उम्मीदवार तय करेगा। 20 अंकों के विभागीय मूल्यांकन की तारीख और समय बाद के परिणाम में बताए जाएँगे। इस PDF को मूल्यांकन या काउंसलिंग का कार्यक्रम न समझें।

अब क्या करें

  1. आधिकारिक PDF सहेजें और जिस विशेषज्ञता के अंतर्गत आपका रोल नंबर है, उसे नोट करें।

  2. पात्रता, श्रेणी और प्रायोजन से जुड़े लागू मूल प्रमाणपत्र तैयार रखें।

  3. अगले परिणाम और मूल्यांकन निर्देशों के लिए AIIMS परीक्षा पोर्टल तथा आवेदन में दर्ज ईमेल और मोबाइल पर नज़र रखें।

रोल नंबर न मिले तो किसी साझा स्क्रीनशॉट पर निर्भर न रहें। पूरी आधिकारिक PDF में सही विशेषज्ञता के अंतर्गत दोबारा खोजें और नई सूचना के लिए AIIMS पोर्टल देखें।

title: UCEED 2027 Part A and Part B: Which Section Needs More Practice?
description: A practical UCEED 2027 plan for splitting time between aptitude, visual reasoning and drawing practice without neglecting Part B.
content:
UCEED 2027 preparation needs two different routines. Part A rewards quick decisions in aptitude, visual reasoning and problem-solving, while Part B tests how clearly you communicate an idea through drawing. If you practise only objective questions, your preparation has a blind spot.

Use the UCEED exam guide for the current paper outline, then check the 2027 notice from the official UCEED website. The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay is the responsible exam authority, so its notice, not coaching advice, should settle any change in pattern or instructions.

Which UCEED section needs more practice?

For most students, Part A deserves more frequent practice because it brings several question types and time pressure into one sitting. Part B needs fewer sessions, but those sessions must be deliberate. Your split should change if your error log shows that one section is costing you more marks.

SectionSkills to buildPractice taskLikely mark loss
Part ASpeed, observation, spatial reasoning and basic aptitudeTimed sets on rotation, folding, patterns, hidden shapes and quantitative reasoningStaying too long with one difficult question
Part BObservation, proportion, perspective and visual communicationSketch a bus stop, household object or street corner within a fixed timeDecorative detail hiding weak structure or action

How should you practise Part A?

Part A practice needs a stopwatch, not endless untimed worksheets. Solve short mixed sets and record the reason for every error: a misread diagram, weak spatial visualisation, calculation slip or poor time choice.

  • Rotate between mirror images, paper folding, counting shapes and visual patterns.
  • Keep a small notebook for formulas, traps and methods you repeatedly forget.
  • Review skipped questions to see whether the decision saved time or reflected avoidable fear.

Don’t chase attempts blindly. Leaving a time trap can protect marks from questions you can solve.

What should Part B drawing practice look like?

Part B isn’t a beauty contest. A readable drawing should show people, objects, proportion, depth and action without needing a long explanation. Shading won’t rescue a scene that has no clear structure.

Once a week, observe an everyday setting for two minutes. Make a thumbnail plan, then complete the scene under a fixed limit. Ask someone unfamiliar with the sketch to identify the place, people and action. If they can’t, simplify the composition before adding detail.

A workable weekly split

  1. Plan four Part A sessions, including two timed mixed sets.
  2. Reserve two sessions for drawing from real objects or public spaces.
  3. Use one review session for error logs, redraws and time analysis.

Parents should check the process rather than judge artistic style. Is the student finishing? Are repeated errors recorded? Those answers should decide the next week’s allocation.

title: B.Sc. Plant Pathology: Course Details, Eligibility, Syllabus & Career Scope
description: Explore B.Sc. Plant Pathology - course details, eligibility, syllabus, top colleges, and career opportunities. Learn how this field helps protect crops and ensure sustainable agriculture.
content:
Introduction

Plant Pathology, also known as Phytopathology, is the scientific study of plant diseases caused by pathogens such as fungi, bacteria, viruses, nematodes, and environmental factors. This field plays a vital role in agriculture, as plant diseases can cause massive yield losses and threaten food security. With the growing importance of sustainable farming and global demand for crop protection, Plant Pathology has emerged as one of the most crucial disciplines in agricultural sciences.

What is Plant Pathology?

Plant Pathology focuses on understanding the causes, mechanisms, and control of plant diseases. It combines aspects of microbiology, genetics, biotechnology, and crop science to develop solutions that ensure healthier crops. By studying plant-pathogen interactions, scientists can design disease-resistant plant varieties and eco-friendly management practices.

Importance of Plant Pathology

  • Food Security: Prevents crop losses and ensures a stable food supply.

  • Sustainable Agriculture: Promotes eco-friendly pest and disease management techniques.

  • Economic Benefits: Helps farmers reduce losses and increase productivity.

  • Innovation: Supports biotechnology and genetic research to develop disease-resistant crops.

Course Details: B.Sc. Plant Pathology

Many universities offer undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in Plant Pathology. The B.Sc. in Plant Pathology is a 3–4 year degree program.

Eligibility:

  • Completion of 10+2 in Science stream (Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Agriculture).

  • Minimum 50–55% aggregate marks (varies by institution).

  • Admission may be through entrance exams or merit-based selection.

Core Subjects:

  • Principles of Plant Pathology

  • Mycology (study of fungi)

  • Bacteriology and Virology

  • Nematology

  • Plant Disease Epidemiology

  • Disease Resistance in Plants

  • Integrated Disease Management

  • Biotechnology in Plant Pathology

Career Opportunities in Plant Pathology

Graduates in Plant Pathology can explore diverse career options in both government and private sectors.

Career Paths:

  • Agricultural Scientist / Researcher

  • Plant Pathologist in Govt. Research Institutes

  • Plant Disease Diagnostic Expert

  • Biotech and Seed Industry Specialist

  • Crop Consultant / Extension Officer

  • Teaching & Academia

  • Entrepreneurship in Agri-based Startups

Employment Areas:

  • ICAR and Agricultural Universities

  • State Agriculture Departments

  • Agrochemical & Biotech Companies

  • Food Security Organizations

  • International Research Institutes (like CIMMYT, IRRI, etc.)

Future Scope of Plant Pathology

With the rising global population and climate change, plant diseases are becoming more complex and widespread. This increases the demand for experts in Plant Pathology who can develop sustainable disease management practices and enhance crop resilience. Careers in research, biotechnology, precision agriculture, and global food security projects are expected to grow significantly.

Conclusion

Plant Pathology is more than just the study of plant diseases—it is the science that safeguards global food security. Students pursuing this field contribute directly to sustainable agriculture, economic development, and innovative research. With a strong scope in research, industry, and government sectors, Plant Pathology offers a rewarding and impactful career for those passionate about agriculture and science.

title: CAT பழைய வினாத்தாள்கள்: தவறுகளிலிருந்து அடுத்த மீள்பார்வைத் திட்டம்
description: CAT பழைய வினாத்தாளில் அறிவுக் குறைபாடு, கேள்வித் தேர்வு மற்றும் நேரச் செலவை ஆராயுங்கள். வீட்டுப் பயிற்சி மதிப்பெண் எதிர்காலப் பெர்சென்டைல் அல்ல.
content:
பழைய CAT வினாத்தாள் அடுத்து என்ன பயிற்சி செய்வீர்கள் என்பதை மாற்றினால்தான் அதிகப் பயன் தரும். முயற்சிக்குப் பிறகு மதிப்பெண்ணைச் சற்று ஒதுக்கிவிட்டு மூன்று கேள்விகள் கேளுங்கள்: எதில் தவறினீர்கள், தீர்க்கக்கூடிய எதனை விட்டீர்கள், முன்னேற்றமின்றி எங்கு நேரம் செலவிட்டீர்கள்?

நேரம் கணக்கிடுவதற்கு முன் வினாத்தாளைச் சரிபாருங்கள்

ஆண்டு, தேர்வு அமர்வு மற்றும் வினாத்தாளின் மூலத்தைக் குறிக்கவும். அது அசல் தாளின் மறுபதிப்பா, நினைவிலிருந்து தொகுக்கப்பட்டதா அல்லது பயிற்சித் தொகுப்பா என்பதை அறியுங்கள். நினைவிலிருந்து உருவாக்கப்பட்ட கேள்வியில் சொற்கள் விடுபடலாம். பதிப்பாளரின் தீர்வு தானாகவே அதிகாரப்பூர்வ விடையாகாது.

முயற்சிக்கும்போது விடைக்குறிப்பைப் பார்க்காதீர்கள். படம், அட்டவணை அல்லது பத்தி முழுமையில்லாவிட்டால் பயன்படுத்த முடியாத கேள்வியாகக் குறியுங்கள்; உங்கள் தயாரிப்பின் தோல்வியாகக் கணக்கிடாதீர்கள். நடப்பு அறிவுறுத்தல்களுக்கு அதிகாரப்பூர்வ CAT தளம் பார்க்கவும். பழைய தாள் இவ்வாண்டு விதிகளை அறிவிக்கும் அறிவிப்பு அல்ல.

அறிவுக் குறையையும் கேள்வித் தேர்வுத் தவறையும் பிரியுங்கள்

முயன்ற கேள்விகளையும் விட்ட கேள்விகளையும் ஆய்வு செய்யுங்கள். தவிர்த்திருக்கக்கூடிய ஒவ்வொரு இழப்புக்கும் ஒரு முக்கியக் காரணத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால் அடுத்த செயல் தெளிவாகும்.

என்ன நடந்தது

அடுத்த செயல்

முறை தெரியவில்லை

அடிப்படைக் கருத்தைப் படித்து சில ஒத்த கேள்விகளைத் தீர்க்கவும்.

முறை தெரிந்தும் கணக்கீடு அல்லது வாசிப்பில் தவறு

மெதுவாக மீண்டும் செய்து தவறு தொடங்கிய படியைக் கண்டறியவும்.

நீண்ட நேரத்துக்குப் பிறகு கேள்வியை விட்டீர்கள்

முன்பே அடுத்த கேள்விக்கு நகரச் சொல்லியிருக்க வேண்டிய அறிகுறியை எழுதவும்.

பிறகு தீர்க்க முடிந்த கேள்வியை விட்டீர்கள்

அப்பகுதியில் கேள்விகளைப் பார்த்துத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த முறையை ஆய்வு செய்யவும்.

வாசிப்புப் புரிதலில் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த விடை ஏன் பொருத்தமாகத் தோன்றியது, பத்தியின் எந்த பகுதி அதை மறுக்கிறது என்று விளக்குங்கள். தர்க்கத் தொகுப்பில் தொடக்க அமைப்பு தவறா அல்லது பிந்தைய முடிவு தவறா என்று பாருங்கள். முழுத் தீர்வை நகலெடுப்பதைவிட இது பயனுள்ளது.

விடையை மனப்பாடம் செய்யாமல் மீண்டும் முயலுங்கள்

சிறிது இடைவெளிக்குப் பிறகு மீண்டும் முயல சில தவறுகளைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள். முந்தைய செய்முறையைப் பார்க்காமல் தீர்க்கவும். விடை நினைவிலிருந்தும் முறையை விளக்க முடியாவிட்டால் அதே திறனைச் சோதிக்கும் வேறு கேள்வியைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

கேள்விக் குறிப்பு, தவறின் வகை, திருத்தச் செயல் மற்றும் மறுமுயற்சி முடிவை எழுதுங்கள். கடைசி வாக்கியத்தின் நிபந்தனையைத் தவறவிட்டால் வாசிப்புச் சரிபார்ப்பு தேவை; தொடர்பில்லாத முழு அத்தியாயத்தையும் மீண்டும் படிக்க வேண்டியதில்லை.

மதிப்பெண் பயிற்சிக்கான தகவல்; சேர்க்கைக் கணிப்பு அல்ல

முயற்சியின் சூழல், தாளுடன் பழக்கம் மற்றும் விடைகளின் மூலம் முடிவை மாற்றும். வீட்டில் பெற்ற ஒரே மதிப்பெண் எதிர்கால CAT பெர்சென்டைலையோ நிறுவனத் தேர்வுப் பட்டியலையோ நிர்ணயிக்காது. மீண்டும் வரும் தவறுகளை ஒப்பிட்டு திருத்தப் பயிற்சி உதவுகிறதா எனப் பாருங்கள்.

தேர்வுக்கான ஏற்பாடுகளைப் படிப்பு ஆய்விலிருந்து பிரித்து வையுங்கள். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ பதிவிறக்க வழிமுறையை உறுதிப்படுத்திய பிறகு CAT அனுமதி அட்டை வழிகாட்டி ஆவணச் சரிபார்ப்புக்கு உதவும். வரிசைப்படுத்தாத PDF குவியலுடன் முடிக்காமல், நாளைக்கான சிறிய தெளிவான திட்டத்துடன் முடிக்கவும்.

title: Decoding State and Central Counselling for Engineering Admissions 2026-27 across Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Delhi and Beyond
description: A practical guide for Indian students and parents on how engineering seat allocation works across state and central counsellors, key timelines, and how to prepare for 2026-27 admissions in Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Delhi and other states.
content:
Overview: Why counselling matters for 2026-27 engineering admissions

Engineering admissions in India are increasingly guided by two parallel channels: state-level counselling and central or national-level processes. Students who qualify through entrance exams or state boards may be offered seats via central bodies, state technical boards, or state-level portals. Understanding the interaction between these channels helps families plan timelines, verify eligibility, and optimise seat options before deadlines.

Key players and their roles

  • State counselling authorities oversee engineering admissions for public and private institutions within their jurisdiction, often using a common offer-and-allotment process for government and affiliated colleges.
  • Central or national processes manage common counselling for select national quota seats and participating institutes that accept centralized merit lists.
  • Participating institutes publish vacancy announcements, course availability, and cut-offs after each round of counselling.

Tamil Nadu: a focused pathway with traditional patterns

Tamil Nadu typically relies on a joint allotment process that includes government engineering colleges, government-aided institutions, and private colleges that participate in a state-level portal. Students should watch for the order of rounds, fee guidelines, and reservation policies. The state often aligns counselling rounds with the academic calendar, so staying aware of deadlines is essential for seat confirmation and fee payment.

Maharashtra: navigating CAP rounds and specialised streams

Maharashtra uses a centralized Admission Process (CAP) for engineering seats in government and aided colleges, with separate rounds for private unaided institutions. Important factors include quota rules, institute-level eligibility criteria, and the possibility of spot rounds in some years. Candidates should prepare their option entries (allotted college choices) carefully to balance dream branches with realistic alternatives.

Delhi: combining regional access with national tie-ins

Delhi delegates admissions through its own counselling framework, while some seats in new or participating institutes may be offered through national processes. Students in the capital should confirm eligibility for category-specific quotas and keep track of city-level deadlines alongside any national round announcements.

Beyond: other states and common considerations

Across India, many states implement their own counselling portals with multiple rounds, sometimes including upgrade and slide options after seat allotment. General patterns include:

  • Document requirements such as identity proofs, mark sheets, and reservation certificates must be verified at reporting.
  • Fee payment windows and declaration of choice locking are time-bound; delays can lead to seat loss.
  • Reserved category seats require timely verification and updated certificates if status changes between rounds.

Preparation tips for students and parents

  • List your target colleges and branches with both dream and safety options, including institutes in neighbouring states if feasible.
  • Keep track of all deadlines for application, choice filling, and fee payments across state and central portals.
  • Prepare required documents in advance: identity proofs, educational certificates, category certificates (if applicable), and transfer certificates from previous boards.
  • Understand reservation rules and eligibility criteria for each round you plan to participate in.
  • Have a clear plan for upgrading possibilities in later rounds and the impact on dues and eligibility.

What to verify before locking choices

Always confirm: seat status after each round, cut-off trends for your chosen branches, institute-specific requirements, and fee structures including any domiciliary or management quota implications. If information seems unclear, verify the official notification or portal guidance rather than relying on secondary summaries.

Timeline snapshot for 2026-27 admissions

  • Notification and registration window opens with state and central portals announcing rounds.
  • First allotment results release; candidates must report or surrender seats within specified timeframes.
  • Subsequent rounds include more seats and potential upgrading, subject to availability and policy changes.
  • Final rounds determine last remaining seats and closure of admissions for the academic year.

Common questions during the process

FAQs

1. How do I know which round to participate in?

Review official round schedules, consider your readiness and reservation needs, and prepare alternative branches to minimize risk of seat loss.

2. Can I change my college choices after submitting them?

Most systems allow editing during specific windows; after a round results are announced, changes may be restricted. Check the official portal for exact rules.

3. What documents are typically required at reporting?

Identities, educational certificates, mark sheets, migration or transfer certificates if applicable, domicile and minority or category certificates where relevant.

4. Do all institutes participate in central counselling?

No. Many institutes participate only in state-level counselling or have their own inclusive admission processes. Confirm before planning.

5. How should I interpret cut-off trends?

Cut-offs reflect the merit of applicants and seat availability. Compare year-on-year patterns for your target branches but base decisions on your current rank and options.

Bottom line: plan with clarity and verify details

Engineering admissions in 2026-27 involve coordinated steps across state and central bodies. Start early, prepare documents, and keep a flexible list of branches and institutes. Regularly check official portals for the latest notifications, round outcomes, and reporting instructions to secure the best possible seat without compromising timelines.

title: AIBE 21 Exam Guidelines 2026 Released: Check Important Dos & Don’ts
description: AIBE 21 Exam 2026 guidelines released by BCI. Check exam day rules, allowed items, prohibited materials, and important dos & don’ts for candidates.
content:
The guidelines for the AIBE 21 (All India Bar Examination) 2026 exam have been released by the Bar Council of India, which includes the necessary instructions that need to be followed by the candidates during the exam. The guidelines are necessary for the smooth conduct of the exam and to avoid disqualification.

Exam Day Overview Table

Particular Details
Exam Name AIBE 21
Conducting Body Bar Council of India
Mode of Exam Offline (Pen & Paper)
Type Open Book Exam
Mandatory Documents Admit Card + Valid Photo ID
Prohibited Items Electronics, notes, loose papers

Essential Instructions for Candidates

Aspirants are required to carry a hard copy of their admit card and a valid government-issued photo identity card. In the absence of these documents, candidates will not be allowed to enter the examination hall. It is advisable that candidates reach the exam center well in advance to facilitate the verification process. Additionally, candidates are advised to verify the address of their exam center and reporting time.

Allowed Items

  1. Absence of handwritten notes in bare acts
  2. Printed study guides that adhere to regulations
  3. Basic stationery, including pens and pencils
  4. ID proof and an admit card

Prohibited Items

  1. Smart devices or cell phones
  2. Calculators or electrical devices
  3. Books with annotations or highlights
  4. Readable chits or loose sheets

Important Dos & Don’ts

Dos

  • Follow invigilator instructions strictly
  • Keep documents ready for verification
  • Maintain discipline in the exam hall

Don’ts

  • Do not communicate with other candidates
  • Do not carry restricted materials
  • Do not leave the hall before permission

Final Advice

It is important for candidates to understand these guidelines before the exam so that they can avoid last-minute stress and have a smooth experience during the exam. It is essential for candidates to follow all the guidelines correctly because any minor deviation can lead to the cancellation of their candidature.

title: NMAT 2026: 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੱਕ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਸਲਾਟ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰੋ
description: NMAT 2026 ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਲਾਟ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਮਿਤੀ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਹੈ। ਫੀਸ, ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਕਾਲਜ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣੋ।
content:
NMAT 2026 ਦੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਕੰਮ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਰਨੇ ਹਨ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ ਭਰਨਾ ਕਾਫ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ; ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਪਾਇੰਟਮੈਂਟ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਵੀ ਹੋਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ। GMAC ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ 2 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਤੋਂ 20 ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਹੋਣਗੀਆਂ।

ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਕੰਮ ਮੁਕੰਮਲ ਕਰੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਮਿਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਫੀਸ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੈਡਿਊਲਿੰਗ ਲਈ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਹੈ। ਪੈਸੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਭਰ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ ਤਾਂ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਮਿਤੀ, ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਵੇਖੋ। ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਨੂੰ ਸਲਾਟ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਾ ਸਮਝੋ।

ਉਪਲਬਧ ਸਲਾਟ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਬੁੱਕ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸਫ਼ਰ ਲਈ ਢੁੱਕਵਾਂ ਸਮਾਂ ਚੁਣੋ। ਪਸੰਦ ਦਾ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਜਾਂ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਦੇ ਅਖੀਰ ਵਾਲਾ ਦਿਨ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਵੇਲੇ ਤੱਕ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ, ਇਹ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਬਾਅਦ ਦੀ ਰੀਸ਼ੈਡਿਊਲਿੰਗ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਵਧਾਉਂਦੀ।

GMAC ਦੀ NMAT 2026 ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ। ਵੈੱਬ ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਨ ਮਿਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੱਤੀ ਗਈ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਮਿਤੀਆਂ ਅਤੇ ਫੀਸ

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪਛਾਣ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਮਿਲਾਓ

GMAC ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਖਾਤਾ ਬਣਾਓ ਜਾਂ ਲਾਗਇਨ ਕਰੋ। ਈਮੇਲ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਕਰਕੇ ਪ੍ਰੋਫਾਈਲ ਅਤੇ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਭਰੋ। ਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਿਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਲਈ ਵਰਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਫੋਟੋ ਪਛਾਣ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਾਲ ਪੂਰੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਿਲਣੇ ਚਾਹੀਦੇ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਹੋ ਸਕਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਤਾਜ਼ਾ ਫੋਟੋ ਅਪਲੋਡ ਕਰੋ।

ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਫੀਸ ₹3,000 ਅਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਟੈਕਸ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੁਣੀਆਂ ਪੰਜ ਸੰਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਕੋਰ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਭੇਜਣੀ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਵਾਧੂ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਲਈ ₹400 ਅਤੇ ਟੈਕਸ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ। ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸੰਸਥਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਜਾਂਚੋ ਅਤੇ ਰਸੀਦ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਲਾਟ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ

ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ ਵਿੱਚ Book Exam Slot ਚੁਣੋ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਵਾਲਾ ਢੰਗ ਚੁਣ ਕੇ ਨਿਯਮ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ, ਫਿਰ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ, ਕੇਂਦਰ, ਮਿਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ ਚੁਣੋ। ਦੂਜੇ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਜਾਣਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਂਚੋ।

GMAC ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਬੁੱਕ ਕੀਤੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਸੱਤ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਡੈਸ਼ਬੋਰਡ ਤੋਂ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕੀਤਾ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਸ ਲਈ ਰਿਮਾਈਂਡਰ ਰੱਖੋ। ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਲਈ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਮਦਦ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦਾ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਤਿਆਰ ਰੱਖੋ; ਪਾਸਵਰਡ ਜਾਂ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਗੁਪਤ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ।

ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੇਣੀ ਪਵੇਗੀ

NMAT ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਨਾਲ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਜਾਂ ਬਿਜ਼ਨਸ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ MBA ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ। ਹਰ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੀ ਯੋਗਤਾ, ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਮੰਨਣ ਦੀ ਨੀਤੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਹੋ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਫੀਸ ਭਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਲਈ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ, ਸਕੋਰ ਰਿਪੋਰਟ ਦੀ ਚੋਣ ਅਤੇ ਅਗਲੇ ਚੋਣ ਪੜਾਵਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਰੱਖੋ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਣ ਨੂੰ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੋਣਾ ਨਾ ਸਮਝੋ।

title: पहली बार UPSC की तैयारी कैसे करें? Beginner’s Complete Guide
description: UPSC की तैयारी पहली बार शुरू कर रहे हैं? जानें सही strategy, books, study plan, और preparation tips इस complete guide में।
content:
अगर आप पहली बार UPSC (Union Public Service Commission) की तैयारी शुरू कर रहे हैं, तो शुरुआत थोड़ी confusing लग सकती है। सिलेबस बड़ा है, competition tough है, और सही दिशा न हो तो समय भी waste हो सकता है। लेकिन सही strategy और consistent मेहनत से इस journey को आसान बनाया जा सकता है।

यहाँ आपको detailed और practical guidance दी जा रही है, जिससे आप अपनी UPSC preparation strong तरीके से शुरू कर सकें।

UPSC Exam Pattern को समझें

UPSC Civil Services Exam तीन stages में होता है:

  • Prelims – Objective (GS + CSAT)
  • Mains – Descriptive (9 papers)
  • Interview – Personality Test
  • Prelims qualifying nature का होता है, लेकिन Mains और Interview final merit तय करते हैं।

UPSC Syllabus को अच्छे से पढ़ें

बहुत से students बिना syllabus देखे preparation शुरू कर देते हैं, जो एक बड़ी गलती है।

  • Official syllabus को print करके रखें
  • हर topic को mark करें
  • उसी के according पढ़ाई करें

Syllabus आपका roadmap है, इसे ignore नहीं करना चाहिए।

सही Books और Resources चुनें

Limited और standard books ही पढ़ें:

  • Polity – Laxmikanth
  • History – Spectrum + NCERT
  • Geography – NCERT + Atlas
  • Economy – NCERT + current updates

बार-बार resources बदलना avoid करें।

Notes बनाना सीखें

Short और crisp notes UPSC preparation में बहुत काम आते हैं।

  • खुद के handwritten notes बनाएं
  • Current affairs के separate notes रखें
  • Revision के समय यही notes काम आएंगे

Time Management Strategy

UPSC preparation में smart time management जरूरी है।

  • Pomodoro technique use कर सकते हैं
  • Daily targets set करें
  • Difficult subjects को peak hours में पढ़ें

Consistency motivation से ज्यादा important है।

Current Affairs और Static Subjects का Balance

  • Daily 1–2 घंटे current affairs दें
  • Static subjects के साथ link करें
  • Example: Polity के साथ current laws
  • Integrated preparation ज्यादा effective होती है।

Answer Writing और Essay Practice

Mains clear करने के लिए writing skills जरूरी हैं।

  • रोज़ answer writing practice करें
  • Weekly essay लिखें
  • Previous year questions solve करें

Structure रखें: Introduction, Body, Conclusion

Test Series कब Join करें

  • Prelims से 4–5 महीने पहले mock tests शुरू करें
  • Mains answer writing early stage से शुरू करें
  • Performance analysis करें

Mental Health और Motivation

UPSC journey लंबी होती है, इसलिए mental balance जरूरी है।

  • Break लेना ठीक है
  • Exercise या meditation करें
  • Comparison से बचें

Digital Resources और Online Preparation

  • YouTube lectures
  • Online test series
  • Government websites जैसे PIB

लेकिन distraction से बचना जरूरी है।

Daily Routine Example

  • Morning: Newspaper + Current Affairs
  • Afternoon: Static Subject
  • Evening: Optional Subject
  • Night: Revision + Answer Writing

Common Mistakes जो Avoid करनी चाहिए

  • Too many books पढ़ना
  • Revision skip करना
  • Test series ignore करना
  • Strategy के बिना पढ़ाई

Conclusion

UPSC preparation एक long-term journey है। सही strategy, limited resources और consistent effort से आप इस exam को crack कर सकते हैं। शुरुआत basics से करें, धीरे-धीरे level बढ़ाएं और खुद पर भरोसा रखें।

title: BTech Accreditation Labels: What AICTE, NAAC and NBA Actually Tell You
description: AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation answer different BTech admission questions. Learn what to match before paying fees.
content:
AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation are not three versions of the same quality label. For BTech admission, AICTE concerns the applicable technical approval, NAAC concerns an assessed institutional entity, and NBA concerns a named programme where the record applies. If you read one label as proof of all three, you could pay for a branch whose status you haven't checked.

Match the legal institution, campus, BTech branch and proposed intake. That is the practical test.

What does each label actually tell you?

LabelQuestion it helps answerWhat it doesn't prove
AICTE approvalWhether the applicable technical approval record covers the institution or programme, including the approved course and intake detailsPlacement results, teaching quality or hostel conditions
NAAC accreditationWhether the named institutional entity and covered campus have an assessed statusAutomatic coverage of every affiliated college, location or BTech branch
NBA accreditationWhether the named engineering programme has a programme-level accreditation record and stated validityAccreditation of every branch in that college

These labels aren't a ranking table. AICTE approval also isn't the same as university affiliation or the authority that awards the degree. Check both relationships in the admission documents.

Why the exact branch and entity matter

A college may display an NBA claim for Electrical Engineering while you are applying for Computer Science. That claim cannot be stretched across branches. Likewise, a NAAC record in the name of a university does not automatically establish the status of an affiliated college with a different legal name.

Use the responsible authority's current record for each check. The supplied material doesn't include fetched official records from AICTE, NAAC or NBA, so this article doesn't assign a current grade, approval status or validity period to any college. Treat the following as a verification method, not as proof of a particular institution's status.

What to check before paying the BTech fee

  1. Copy the institution's legal name, campus, branch and proposed intake from the offer or admission notice.
  2. Ask the college for the applicable AICTE approval details and match the approved course and intake, not just the logo or phrase “AICTE approved”.
  3. Check whether the NAAC record names the same institutional entity and campus. A university record and an affiliated college record aren't interchangeable.
  4. Check the NBA record for your exact branch, status and validity period. A claim for another branch is not enough.
  5. Request written clarification on affiliation, degree-awarding authority and any mismatch before paying.

Save the reply, fee notice and supporting documents. If the names or intake figures don't match, pause the payment and ask the university or counselling authority to clarify. You can also compare colleges using the same branch-level checks.

title: JEE Mainના વિકલ્પો 2027: VIT, SRMના ફોર્મ ખુલ્યાં; અમૃતા આગળ
description: VITEEE, SRMJEEE, AEEE, KIITEE અને GITAMની સત્તાવાર અરજી સ્થિતિ સરખાવો. ખુલ્લા 2027 ફોર્મ, આવનારો સમયગાળો અને જૂના પોર્ટલનો ભેદ સમજો.
content:
JEE Main સિવાયના એન્જિનિયરિંગ વિકલ્પો જોવા નવેમ્બરની એક જ સામાન્ય શરૂઆતની તારીખની રાહ જરૂરી નથી. VIT અને SRM પહેલેથી 2027ના ફોર્મ બતાવે છે, જ્યારે અમૃતા B.Tech 2027 અરજીઓ નવેમ્બરમાં શરૂ થશે કહે છે. KIIT અને GITAMના જૂના ફોર્મને 2027નું માનતાં પહેલાં નવું પ્રવેશ વર્ષ તપાસવું જરૂરી છે.

પાંચ રસ્તા, અરજીના અલગ તબક્કા

સરખામણીની સત્તાવાર લિંકો વાપરો અને વ્યક્તિગત માહિતી કે ચુકવણી પહેલાં પ્રવેશ વર્ષ ફરી જુઓ. રજિસ્ટ્રેશન બટન કાર્યરત હોવું એ સાચા વર્ષનું ફોર્મ હોવાની પુષ્ટિ નથી.

પ્રવેશ રસ્તો

સત્તાવાર પૃષ્ઠની સ્થિતિ

આગળનું પગલું

VITEEE

B.Tech 2027 રજિસ્ટ્રેશન અને લોગિન ઉપલબ્ધ

અરજી પહેલાં 2027ની સૂચનાઓ વાંચો

SRMJEEE

2027 પ્રવેશ ખુલ્યા; UG ફોર્મ દેખાય છે

ફોર્મમાં કોર્સ અને કેમ્પસ તપાસો

AEEE

B.Tech 2027 અરજીઓ નવેમ્બરમાં શરૂ થવાની જાહેરાત

શરૂઆતની સૂચના અને નવા નિયમોની રાહ જુઓ

KIITEE

પોર્ટલ હજી KIITEE 2026 બંધ કહે છે

અહીં 2027 અરજી ખૂલ્યાની પુષ્ટિ નથી

GITAM GAT

અરજી પૃષ્ઠ હજી GAT 2026 કહે છે

ફોર્મ વાપરતાં પહેલાં 2027 વર્ષ તપાસો

અમૃતાની નવેમ્બર જાહેરાતનો અર્થ

અમૃતાની સૂચના મહિનો જણાવે છે, ચોક્કસ શરૂઆતનો દિવસ નહીં. પૃષ્ઠ પર AEEE ઉપરાંત JEE Main પર્સેન્ટાઇલથી B.Tech પ્રવેશનો રસ્તો પણ છે. ફોર્મ ખૂલે ત્યારે 2027ની સૂચનાઓ વાંચો; જૂની ફી, પાત્રતા મર્યાદા કે તબક્કાના નિયમો આગળ લાગુ ન માનો.

નીચેનું ચિત્ર યુનિવર્સિટીની પોતાની અરજી શરૂ થવાની સૂચના છે. તે રજિસ્ટ્રેશન પહેલેથી ખુલ્યાનો પુરાવો નથી. આગળનું પગલું નક્કી કરતાં જાહેર કરાયેલા ભાવિ સમયગાળા અને ઉપલબ્ધ ફોર્મનો તફાવત રાખો.

અમૃતાનું B.Tech 2027 પ્રવેશ પૃષ્ઠ અરજીઓ નવેમ્બરમાં શરૂ થશે કહે છે. આ વેબ સૂચનામાં અલગ પ્રકાશન તારીખ નથી. અમૃતાની મૂળ અરજી સૂચના

ચુકવણી પહેલાં પસંદગીની યાદી બનાવો

પસંદ કરેલા દરેક કોર્સ માટે કેમ્પસ, કાર્યક્રમ, પ્રવેશ રસ્તો, અરજી સ્થિતિ અને સત્તાવાર URL નોંધો. વર્તમાન દસ્તાવેજોમાં પાત્રતા, શિક્ષણ અને રહેવાનો ખર્ચ, રિફંડ તથા શિષ્યવૃત્તિની શરતો સરખાવો. ઘણી પરીક્ષામાં અરજી વિકલ્પ વધારી શકે છે; પ્રવેશ કે દરેક કેમ્પસનો ખર્ચ પરવડવાની ખાતરી નથી.

ચોકસાઈથી પૂરી કરી શકો એવી અરજીઓને પ્રાથમિકતા આપો. પોતાનું ઇમેલ અને મોબાઇલ ઉપલબ્ધ રાખો, સાચી શૈક્ષણિક માહિતી આપો અને અંતિમ પુષ્ટિ સાચવો. VIT માટે અલગ દસ્તાવેજ અને લાઇવ ફોટો માર્ગદર્શિકા મદદરૂપ છે. અસ્પષ્ટ પ્રવેશ વર્ષ માટે સત્તાવાર પૃષ્ઠ સાચવો અને નવી સૂચનાની રાહ જુઓ; વહેલી બેઠકના નામે વચેટિયાને પૈસા ન આપો.

title: LSAT Exam: Syllabus, Preparation Tips & Registration Guide
description: Prepare for the LSAT exam with ease. Learn about the syllabus, exam pattern, preparation tips, registration process, and strategies to achieve top scores for law school admission.
content:
Introduction

The Law School Admission Test (LSAT) is a standardized exam required for admission to most law schools in the United States, Canada, and several other countries. It evaluates critical reading, logical reasoning, and analytical thinking skills essential for success in law school. A high LSAT score can significantly improve your chances of securing admission to top law schools.

LSAT Exam Structure

The LSAT consists of multiple sections designed to assess different skills:

  1. Reading Comprehension – Tests your ability to understand and analyze complex texts.

  2. Logical Reasoning – Assesses your critical thinking and argument evaluation skills.

  3. Analytical Reasoning (Logic Games) – Measures your ability to understand structures and relationships.

  4. Unscored Writing Sample – An essay that evaluates your persuasive writing skills (submitted with your application).

  5. Variable Section – Used to test new questions, does not affect the score.

LSAT Exam Syllabus

While the LSAT does not have a traditional syllabus, it focuses on the following areas:

  • Understanding and analyzing arguments

  • Identifying logical flaws and assumptions

  • Drawing inferences and conclusions from complex texts

  • Organizing and interpreting data and relationships

  • Writing coherent and persuasive essays

Registration Process

  1. Create an LSAT Account – Register on the official LSAC (Law School Admission Council) website.

  2. Choose Test Date & Location – Select your preferred date and test center or online option.

  3. Pay Exam Fee – Fees vary depending on your location and test format.

  4. Confirmation & Preparation – Receive confirmation and start focused exam preparation.

Preparation Tips

  • Understand the Exam Format – Familiarize yourself with question types and timing.

  • Practice Regularly – Solve sample questions and take full-length practice tests.

  • Strengthen Logical Reasoning – Focus on identifying premises, conclusions, and assumptions.

  • Improve Reading Comprehension – Practice reading dense texts critically.

  • Master Analytical Reasoning – Use diagrams and strategies to tackle logic games efficiently.

  • Time Management – Learn to pace yourself to complete each section on time.

  • Use Prep Resources – Consider official LSAT prep books, online courses, and mock tests.

Scoring and Results

  • LSAT scores range from 120 to 180.

  • Scores are based on the number of correct answers (raw score), converted to the scaled score.

  • Results are typically released 3–4 weeks after the test.

Benefits of a Good LSAT Score

  • Increases chances of admission to top law schools.

  • Can make you eligible for scholarships and financial aid.

  • Demonstrates strong analytical and critical thinking skills to law school admissions committees.

Conclusion

The LSAT is a gateway to a successful law career, testing skills essential for law school success. With consistent preparation, strategic practice, and understanding of the exam format, aspirants can achieve competitive scores and secure admission to prestigious law programs.

title: CEED 2027 ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ: Part A ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਅਤੇ ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ
description: CEED 2027 ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮਾਂ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਨਾਲ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦਿਓ। Part B ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ, Appendix 11 ਅਤੇ ਵਧਾਈਆਂ ਮਿਤੀਆਂ ਜਾਣੋ।
content:
CEED 2027 ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦੀ ਲੋੜ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਭਰਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਹੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੋ। IIT Bombay ਇਹ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ Part A ਲਈ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। Part B ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਆਪ ਲਿਖਣਾ ਪਵੇਗਾ। ਤਿਆਰੀ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਇਹ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਭਾਗ ਲਈ ਹੈ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CEED ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ Part A ਕੰਪਿਊਟਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਦਕਿ Part B ਵਿੱਚ ਉੱਤਰ ਲਿਖਣ ਅਤੇ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਬਣਾਉਣੇ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਸਾਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੀ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਲਾਉਣ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੀ ਲੋੜ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਕਰੋ।

IIT Bombay, CEED 2027 ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਹਦਾਇਤ। 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਲਿਆ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ; ਇਸ ਪੈਰੇ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹਦਾਇਤ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ.

ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਨਾਲ ਸਹੀ ਫਾਰਮ ਦਿਓ

1 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਦਾ ਭਾਗ 1.7.1 ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਫਾਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਦਾ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਚੁਣ ਕੇ ਦਿਵਿਆਂਗਤਾ ਦੇ ਸਬੂਤ ਅਪਲੋਡ ਕਰੋ। ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਅਤੇ/ਜਾਂ ਪੂਰਕ ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦਾ ਨਮੂਨਾ Appendix 11 ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ। ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮਾਂ ਹਰ ਘੰਟੇ ਲਈ 20 ਮਿੰਟ ਹੈ। Part A ਅਤੇ Part B ਦਾ ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਭਾਗ ਤੋਂ ਦੂਜੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਲਿਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।

ਜਿੱਥੇ ਵਾਧੂ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੋਵੇ, ਉੱਥੇ Appendix 10 ਲਾਗੂ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਦਿਵਿਆਂਗਤਾ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ; ਆਪਣੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। IIT Bombay ਨੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੇ ਨਮੂਨੇ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ।

ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਕੌਣ ਕਰੇਗਾ

CEED ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਹਾਇਕ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਲੋੜ ਹੋਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਈਮੇਲ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਅਗਲੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਭੇਜ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਯੋਗ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਦੇ ਪੈਨਲ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਚੁਣਦੇ ਹਨ, ਆਮ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਤੋਂ ਇੱਕ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ। ਆਪਣਾ ਲਿਖਾਰੀ ਲਿਆਉਣ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਭਰੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੀ ਕਾਪੀ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਲਈ ਵਰਤੀ ਈਮੇਲ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਰਹੋ। ਫਾਰਮ ਦੀ ਹਦਾਇਤ ਜਾਂ ਸਰਟੀਫਿਕੇਟ ਬਾਰੇ ਸ਼ੱਕ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ceed@iitb.ac.in ਉੱਤੇ CEED ਦਫ਼ਤਰ ਨੂੰ ਪੁੱਛੋ। ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਅੰਤਿਕਾ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਆਮ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਨਮੂਨਾ ਨਾ ਵਰਤੋ।

ਵਧਾਈ ਮਿਆਦ ਦਾ ਸਹੀ ਲਾਭ ਲਵੋ

IIT Bombay ਦੇ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਦੇ ਅਪਡੇਟ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਆਮ ਫੀਸ ਨਾਲ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ 5 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੇਰੀ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ ਨਾਲ 10 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਵਧਾਈ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਮਿਤੀ ਵਧਣ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਾਇਤਾ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀਆਂ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਮਿਆਦਾਂ ਲਈ UCEED ਅਤੇ CEED ਦੀਆਂ ਸੋਧੀਆਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਮਿਤੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵੇਖੋ।

title: DU CSAS UG Upgrade Round 2026 Seat Allotment Out - Action Plan and Fee Payment Last Date
description: Delhi University has released the DU CSAS UG Upgrade Round 2026 seat allotment. Learn the exact step-by-step action plan and make your fee payment before the August 4 deadline.
content:
The University of Delhi (UoD) has officially released the seat allotment results for the DU CSAS UG Upgrade Round 2026. For thousands of Delhi University aspirants who opted for an upgrade after the previous admission rounds, this is the final crucial window to secure their preferred college and course combinations.

With a very tight schedule announced by the university administration, candidates must act swiftly. The portal is currently open for processing, but the absolute last date for online fee payment is August 4, 2026. Failing to complete the formalities within this window will result in the forfeiture of your allotted seat.

Quick Answer: What You Need to Do Right Now

If you participated in the DU CSAS UG Upgrade Round 2026, log in to your personal admission dashboard at admission.uod.ac.in immediately. Check if your seat has been upgraded. If you have been allotted a new seat, you must accept the upgrade, wait for the respective college to verify your documents online, and pay the admission fee before the deadline on August 4, 2026.

Key Facts and Dates: DU CSAS UG Upgrade Round 2026

To keep your admission process on track, keep these essential dates and details handy:

Event / Parameter Details & Timelines
Allotment Result Date August 2, 2026
Official Website admission.uod.ac.in
Last Date for Online Fee Payment August 4, 2026
Mandatory Action Required Active acceptance of the upgraded seat and completion of payment
Next Expected Event CSAS Round 3 Schedule Announcement

Step-by-Step Guidance: Securing Your Upgraded DU Seat

Securing your seat in Delhi University requires careful attention to detail. Follow this comprehensive action plan to ensure you do not miss out on your allotment:

Step 1: Log in to the CSAS Portal

Visit the official Delhi University undergraduate admissions portal at admission.uod.ac.in. Use your registered credentials (CUET application number and password) to access your dashboard.

Step 2: Check Your Allotment Status

Navigate to the seat allotment tab. The screen will display whether your seat has been upgraded to a higher preference or if your previous allotment remains unchanged.

Step 3: Accept the Upgraded Allocation

If your seat has been upgraded, you must click on the "Accept" button. This step is mandatory. Once a seat is upgraded, your previous seat is automatically cancelled. If you do not accept the new upgraded seat, you will lose both the new seat and your old seat, effectively removing you from the CSAS counselling process.

Step 4: Await College Approval

After you accept the seat, the respective Delhi University college will review your uploaded documents and eligibility. This is an online process, and you do not need to visit the college campus physically. Monitor your dashboard regularly for any queries raised by the college convener.

Step 5: Complete the Fee Payment

Once the college approves your admission, the payment link will be activated on your dashboard.

  • If the fee for the upgraded course is higher: You will need to pay the balance amount.
  • If the fee is lower: The excess amount will be refunded to your registered bank account in due course.
  • Make sure to complete this transaction before the deadline on August 4, 2026.

Important Guidelines for Candidates Who Did Not Get an Upgrade

If your dashboard shows "No Upgrade," it means your previous allotment remains secure. You do not need to take any immediate action regarding fee payment if you have already paid the admission fee in the earlier round. Your current seat is safe, and you will continue to hold it as you prepare for subsequent counselling rounds, such as CSAS Round 3 or spot admission rounds.

What to Expect in Subsequent DU CSAS Rounds

Once the upgrade round concludes on August 4, 2026, Delhi University is expected to release the vacant seats matrix for CSAS Round 3. If you are aiming for further rounds, keep these points in mind:

  • Re-ordering Preferences: Candidates may get an option to re-order their preferences for the subsequent rounds based on the list of vacant seats.
  • Spot Admissions: For courses and colleges where seats remain vacant after Round 3, UoD will open Spot Admission rounds. Note that rules for spot rounds differ, and options like "Upgrade" and "Withdraw" are typically disabled during spot admissions.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What happens if I do not accept my upgraded DU CSAS seat?

If you do not actively accept your upgraded seat on the portal, your admission process will be terminated. Your previous seat has already been allocated to another candidate during the upgrade calculation, meaning you will lose both seats and be out of the CSAS 2026 process.

2. Is it necessary to pay the fee again if my seat is upgraded?

Yes, you must complete the payment step. However, you only need to pay the differential amount if the fee for the new college or course is higher. If it is lower, the university will initiate a refund for the difference after the admission cycle closes.

3. Can I reject the upgraded seat and go back to my previous college choice?

No. Once an upgrade is processed, your previous allotment is permanently cancelled. You cannot revert to your previous college or course selection.

4. When is the last date to complete the admission formalities for this round?

The absolute last date to make the online fee payment and secure your upgraded seat is August 4, 2026. It is highly recommended to complete the payment well in advance to avoid last-minute gateway failures.

title: CEED 2027 पंजीकरण बढ़ा: अपनी पढ़ाई के अनुसार सही प्रमाणपत्र चुनें
description: CEED 2027 की बढ़ी हुई आवेदन अवधि में डिग्री, अंतिम वर्ष की अंकसूची या कॉलेज प्रमाणपत्र तैयार करें। अपलोड से पहले सही प्रारूप और नई समय-सीमा जानें।
content:
CEED 2027 में सामान्य शुल्क के साथ पंजीकरण अब 5 नवंबर 2026 तक हो सकता है। शैक्षणिक दस्तावेज़ के कारण फॉर्म रुका है तो पहले यह देखें कि पढ़ाई पूरी हो चुकी है या अभी जारी है। डिग्री का छपा प्रमाणपत्र न मिलना और पाठ्यक्रम अधूरा होना, IIT Bombay के नियमों में अलग स्थितियाँ हैं।

पढ़ाई की स्थिति से दस्तावेज़ मिलाएँ

  • पढ़ाई पूरी और डिग्री उपलब्ध: डिग्री या डिप्लोमा प्रमाणपत्र की स्कैन कॉपी PDF में अपलोड करें।

  • पढ़ाई पूरी, अंतिम प्रमाणपत्र नहीं मिला: अंतिम वर्ष की अंकसूची या अस्थायी प्रमाणपत्र दें।

  • पढ़ाई अभी पूरी नहीं हुई: विवरणिका के Appendix 1 प्रारूप में प्राचार्य या विभागाध्यक्ष का प्रमाणपत्र लेकर PDF में अपलोड करें।

IIT Bombay की CEED 2027 विवरणिका, 1 अक्टूबर 2026 को जारी, मुद्रित पृष्ठ 11। पढ़ाई की स्थिति से दस्तावेज़ मिलाएँ.

कॉलेज को Appendix 1 का असली प्रारूप भेजें। साधारण पत्र या किसी दूसरे काम का बोनाफाइड प्रमाणपत्र स्वीकार हो जाएगा, यह न मानें। स्कैन करने से पहले नाम, पाठ्यक्रम, हस्ताक्षर और मुहर जाँचें।

बाकी अपलोड भी तैयार रखें

विवरणिका में पिछले छह महीनों में खिंचा रंगीन फोटो और साफ हस्ताक्षर, दोनों JPG में माँगे गए हैं। आकार के लिए पंजीकरण पोर्टल के निर्देश मानें; किसी दूसरी प्रवेश परीक्षा के नियम यहाँ लागू न करें।

आरक्षित श्रेणी का लाभ लेने पर निर्धारित वैध प्रमाणपत्र दें। EWS और OBC-NCL प्रमाणपत्र 1 अप्रैल 2026 या उसके बाद जारी होना चाहिए। शैक्षणिक प्रमाणपत्र से नाम अलग हो तो विवरणिका में बताए लागू प्रमाण भी देने होंगे।

समय बढ़ा है, दस्तावेज़ के नियम नहीं बदले

आधिकारिक CEED सूचना के अनुसार विलंब शुल्क के साथ पंजीकरण 10 नवंबर 2026 को शाम 5 बजे तक है और आगे विस्तार नहीं होगा। दस्तावेज़ जल्दी तैयार करें ताकि धुँधली या अधूरी स्कैन कॉपी सुधार सकें।

आधिकारिक पंजीकरण पोर्टल पर भुगतान से पहले हर अपलोड खोलें और आवेदन का पूर्वावलोकन पढ़ें। जमा फॉर्म और भुगतान की पुष्टि सुरक्षित रखें। दोनों परीक्षाओं की घोषणा के लिए UCEED और CEED की बढ़ी हुई तारीखों की जानकारी देखें।
