title: MCC NEET UG 2026 Special Stray Round: Registration and Choice Deadlines
description: MCC's special stray round has separate cutoffs for registration, payment and choice locking. Check the official schedule before the November deadlines.
content:
MCC's NEET UG 2026 special stray round has separate cutoffs for registration, payment and choices. If you are eligible for this round, do not treat the later choice deadline as extra time to register: the schedule closes registration at 3 pm on 4 November, while payment remains available until 6 pm that day.

The deadlines are not interchangeable

The official schedule covers the special stray vacancy round for MBBS and the fifth round for BDS/B.Sc Nursing. Follow the specific route and seat information displayed in your MCC account.

Step

Official schedule

Practical check

Registration

2-4 November; closes 3 pm on 4 November

Finish the registration form before the earlier cutoff.

Payment

2-4 November; available until 6 pm on 4 November

Confirm successful payment in your account.

Choice filling

2-5 November; closes 11 am on 5 November

Arrange choices and review fees before locking.

Choice locking

4 pm on 4 November to 11 am on 5 November

Save proof of your final choice order.

Result and reporting

Result 7 November; reporting 7-16 November, up to 5 pm

Follow your allotment letter and college instructions.

Medical Counselling Committee schedule generated 30 October 2026. See the original MCC schedule PDF for server-time cutoffs and the separate later BDS/B.Sc Nursing round.

What to do before locking a choice

Open the official MCC UG counselling page and confirm that your account shows this round and the choices available to you. Check the current information bulletin and any eligibility notice before paying. The schedule establishes the dates, but it does not by itself prove that every NEET-qualified candidate may participate.

Compare the college, course, seat type and financial terms before setting an order. Our bond and refund checklist can help you identify questions to verify against the current college documents. Keep the MCC payment receipt, final locked choices and allotment letter; if the portal status is unclear, use MCC's published help channels before the cutoff.

title: UPCATET படிப்பைத் தேர்வு செய்யும் முன் பிளஸ் 2 பாடங்களைச் சரிபாருங்கள்
description: UPCATET 2026 பாடத் தகுதிகளால் வேளாண்மை, மீன்வளம், கால்நடை மருத்துவப் படிப்புகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள். 2027 விதிகளை உறுதியாகக் கருதாமல் வளாகப் பட்டியல் தயாரிக்க உதவும் வழிகாட்டி.
content:
UPCATET படிப்புகளை ஒப்பிடும்போது முதலில் நீங்கள் பிளஸ் 2-வில் படித்த பாடங்களைப் பாருங்கள். 2026 அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இளநிலைப் பட்டியலில் வேளாண்மை, தோட்டக்கலை மட்டுமின்றி மீன்வளம், கால்நடை மருத்துவம் மற்றும் பல தொழில்நுட்பப் படிப்புகளும் உள்ளன. இவற்றை வைத்து முதற்கட்டத் தேர்வு செய்யலாம். ஆனால் 2026 தகுதிகளை 2027 சேர்க்கைக்கான உறுதியான விதிகளாக எடுத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டாம்.

படித்த பாடங்களும் நுழைவுத் தேர்வுக் குழுவும்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இளநிலைத் தகுதி அட்டவணை கல்வித் தகுதியையும் நுழைவுத் தேர்வுப் பாடக் குழுவையும் தனித்தனி பத்திகளில் காட்டுகிறது. இரண்டையும் படியுங்கள். ஒரு படிப்பில் ஆர்வம் இருப்பதால் எல்லா அறிவியல் பாடச் சேர்க்கைகளும் அதற்கு ஏற்றதாகிவிடாது.

  • 2026-இல் வேளாண்மை, தோட்டக்கலை, வனவியல் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு வேளாண் அறிவியல், PCB, PCM அல்லது PCMB குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளன.

  • மீன்வள அறிவியலுக்கு வேளாண் அறிவியல், PCB அல்லது PCMB உள்ளன. PCM மட்டும் அந்த வரிசையில் இல்லை.

  • வேளாண் பொறியியலுக்கு வேளாண் அறிவியல், PCM அல்லது PCMB உள்ளன; PCB மட்டும் சேர்க்கப்படவில்லை.

  • கால்நடை மருத்துவம் மற்றும் கால்நடை பராமரிப்புக்கு ஆங்கிலத்துடன் PCB அல்லது PCMB தேவை. இயற்பியல், வேதியியல், உயிரியல், ஆங்கிலம் ஆகியவற்றின் மொத்த மதிப்பெண் General, OBC, EWS பிரிவுகளுக்கு 50%; SC, ST பிரிவுகளுக்கு 47.5% எனக் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளது.

UPCATET 2026 சேர்க்கைக் கையேட்டின் பக்கம் 15: குறைந்தபட்ச இளநிலைக் கல்வித் தகுதி. இந்தத் தனி PDF பக்கத்தில் வெளியீட்டுத் தேதி இல்லை. அசல் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF

PCM என்பது இயற்பியல், வேதியியல், கணிதம். PCB-இல் கணிதத்திற்குப் பதில் உயிரியல் உள்ளது; PCMB-இல் இரண்டும் உள்ளன. பாடப்பிரிவின் பொதுவான பெயரை மட்டும் நம்பாமல் மதிப்பெண் சான்றிதழைப் பாருங்கள்.

பட்டத்தின் பெயரைத் தாண்டிப் பாருங்கள்

UPCATET தளம் உயிரித் தொழில்நுட்பம், பால் தொழில்நுட்பம், உணவுத் தொழில்நுட்பம், கம்யூனிட்டி சயின்ஸ் மற்றும் உணவு ஊட்டச்சத்து, உணவுமுறைப் படிப்புகளையும் பட்டியலிடுகிறது. எல்லாத் தொழில்நுட்பப் படிப்புகளுக்கும் வேளாண் பொறியியலின் பாட விதி பொருந்தும் எனக் கருதாதீர்கள். ஒவ்வொரு படிப்பிற்கும் தனி தகுதி வரிசை உள்ளது.

தேர்வு செய்த ஒவ்வொரு படிப்பின் பல்கலைக்கழகப் பாடத்திட்டத்தையும் திறந்து படியுங்கள். வகுப்பறை, ஆய்வகம், களப்பணி, செயல்முறைப் பயிற்சி ஆகியவை உங்கள் விருப்பத்துடன் பொருந்துகிறதா என ஒப்பிடுங்கள். கணக்கீடு, உயிரியல் அமைப்புகள் அல்லது உற்பத்திச் செயல்முறைகளுக்கு எவ்வளவு முக்கியத்துவம் இருக்கும் என்பதைப் பட்டத்தின் பெயர் மட்டும் காட்டாது.

படிப்பு மற்றும் வளாகப் பட்டியல் தயாரிக்கவும்

ஒவ்வொரு பல்கலைக்கழகத்தின் ஒவ்வொரு படிப்புக்கும் தனி வரிசை வைத்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள். தகுதியான பாடங்கள், தேர்வுக் குழு, வளாகம், வெளியிடப்பட்ட கட்டணம், தங்குமிடம், வெளியானதும் நடப்பு இட விவரங்கள் ஆகியவற்றைக் குறியுங்கள். கல்வித் தகுதி இருந்தாலே இடம் உறுதி அல்ல.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ பதிவிறக்கப் பக்கம் வயது, இருப்பிடம் மற்றும் கலந்தாய்வு ஆவண விதிகளையும் வழங்குகிறது. முழுக் கையேட்டுடன் படியுங்கள். பழைய சேர்க்கைச் சுற்றின் தேதி, பிரிவுத் தளர்வு அல்லது இட எண்ணிக்கையைப் புதிய விண்ணப்பத்திற்குப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்.

2027 விண்ணப்பதாரர் இப்போது செய்யக்கூடியவை

நடப்புப் பட்டியலால் தேர்வுகளைச் சுருக்கி, பாடக் கட்டுப்பாடுகளை முன்கூட்டியே கண்டறியுங்கள். கல்விச் சான்றுகளைத் திரட்டி, பல்கலைக்கழகத்திடம் கேட்க வேண்டியவற்றைக் குறியுங்கள். விண்ணப்பக் காலம், கட்டணம், தகுதியை இறுதியானதாகக் கருதும் முன் உரிய 2027 அறிவிப்புக்காகக் காத்திருங்கள்.

இரு படிப்புகளும் சமமாகப் பிடித்திருந்தால் அவற்றின் உண்மையான பாடத்திட்டங்களையும் வளாகச் செயல்முறை வசதிகளையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். பெயர் கவர்ச்சியாக இருப்பதால் மட்டும் தேர்வு செய்யாமல், நீங்கள் தகுதி பெற்றதும் படிக்க விரும்புவதுமான படிப்பைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்.

இந்தக் கட்டுரையை ஆங்கிலத்தில் படிக்கவும்

title: CBSE Class 12 Computer Science Last Minute Revision 2026 - Easy Overview to Pass
description: Prepare fast with this last minute revision guide for CBSE Class 12 Computer Science 2026 (Code 083). Unit-wise topics, marks distribution, Python, SQL, networks, practical tips, and FAQs to help you pass easily.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Computer Science Last Minute Revision 2026 – Easy Overview to Pass

If your CBSE Class 12 Computer Science board exam 2026 is near and you need quick preparation, this guide is for you. This last minute Computer Science revision article covers:

  • Important topics
  • Marks distribution
  • Python & SQL focus
  • Practical exam tips
  • Easy study strategy

Even with limited time, you can pass confidently by focusing on the right chapters.

CBSE Class 12 Computer Science Exam Pattern 2026

Component Marks
Theory Exam 70
Practical / Internal 30
Total 100
Exam Duration 3 Hours

Unit-Wise Marks Distribution (Theory)

Unit Name Marks
I Computational Thinking & Programming-2 40
II Computer Networks 10
III Database Management System (DBMS) 20
Total   70

Units You MUST Study First (For Easy Passing)

These cover 60+ marks:

  1. Python Programming & File Handling (Unit I) – 40 marks

  2. SQL & DBMS (Unit III) – 20 marks

Networks is theory based and easy scoring.

Unit-Wise Last Minute Topics to Revise

Unit I – Computational Thinking & Programming-2 (40 Marks)

Python Basics (Quick Revision)

  1. Variables & data types
  2. If-else conditions
  3. Loops (for, while)
  4. Lists, strings, dictionaries

Important Programming Topics

Topic Focus
Functions parameters, return
Recursion factorial, fibonacci
Exception handling try, except, finally
File handling read, write, append
File types text, binary, CSV
Stack push, pop using list

Tip: Practice at least 5 file handling programs.

Unit II – Computer Networks (10 Marks)

Easy theory scoring unit.

Important Topics

  1. LAN, MAN, WAN, PAN
  2. Network devices – router, switch, modem
  3. IP address, DNS, URL
  4. Protocols – HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SMTP
  5. Cyber safety – malware, phishing, passwords

Unit III – Database Management System (20 Marks)

DBMS Concepts

  1. Table, record, field
  2. Primary & foreign key
  3. Advantages of DBMS

SQL Commands to Revise

Type Commands
DDL CREATE, ALTER, DROP
DML INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Queries SELECT, WHERE
Functions COUNT, SUM, AVG
Clauses GROUP BY, HAVING
Joins Basic INNER JOIN

Python + SQL Connectivity

  1. Connect database
  2. Execute queries
  3. Fetch records

Practical Exam (30 Marks) – Easy Scoring

Includes:

Component
Python program
SQL queries
Project
Practical file
Viva

Tip: Revise file handling + SQL programs.

One-Day Last Minute Study Plan

Time Topic
3 hrs Python programs
2 hrs File handling
1.5 hrs SQL
1 hr Networks
30 min Revise theory

Most Important Python Functions to Remember

open()
read()
write()
append()
close()
len()
range()
push()
pop()

How to Score More in CS Exam

  • Write full programs
  • Use proper indentation
  • Mention comments
  • Write SQL queries neatly
  • Attempt all questions
  • Revise syntax carefully

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Wrong SQL syntax
  • Missing colon in Python
  • Not closing files
  • Forgetting semicolon in SQL
  • Skipping theory questions

title: JEE Main ಉಚಿತ ವಿಡಿಯೋಗಳು: IIT-PAL ಮೂಲಕ ಸಂದೇಹ ಪರಿಹರಿಸಿ
description: ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಗಣಿತದ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಂದೇಹಗಳಿಗೆ NTA ಲಿಂಕ್ ಮಾಡಿದ IIT-PAL ಬಳಸಿ. ಬಳಿಕ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಂದ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ.
content:
JEE Main ಅಧ್ಯಾಯ ಅರ್ಥವಾಗಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಮಯ ಹಿಡಿದರೆ NTA ಲಿಂಕ್ ನೀಡಿರುವ IIT-PAL ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸಗಳು ನೆರವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ IIT ಪ್ರಾಧ್ಯಾಪಕರು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯ ತಜ್ಞರ ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಹಾಗೂ ಗಣಿತದ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳಿವೆ. ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಹುಡುಕಲು ಅವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ, ನಂತರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕೆ ಮರಳಿ.

NTA ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಷಯ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ

NTA ವಿಷಯಾಧಾರಿತ ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ, ಗಣಿತ ಅಥವಾ ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಿ. ಲಿಂಕ್‌ಗಳು IIT-PAL ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಕರೆದೊಯ್ಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಅದೇ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ NEET ತಯಾರಿಗಾಗಿ ಜೀವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರವೂ ಇದೆ. ಆ ಲಿಂಕ್ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ಜೀವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ JEE Main ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರಿಂಗ್ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ವಿಷಯವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ಇವು ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಎಂದು NTA ಹೇಳಿದೆ. ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು ಈ ವಿಡಿಯೋಗಳಿಂದಲೇ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬ ಖಾತರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಇದು ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನೂ ಹೊಸ 2027ರ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಅಥವಾ ನೇರ ತರಗತಿ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ವಿಡಿಯೋ ನೋಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ

JEE Main ಅಧಿಕೃತ ತಾಣದ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಇರಿಸಿ. ಉದ್ದನೆಯ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಸಮಯ ನೀಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ವಿಡಿಯೋದ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆಯಿಂದಲೇ ಅದರ ಎಲ್ಲ ಭಾಗಗಳು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ತೀರ್ಮಾನಿಸಲಾಗದು.

ಭೌತಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಸಮೀಕರಣ ರೂಪಿಸುವುದೇ, ಗಣಿತದ ವಿಧಾನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡುವುದೇ ಅಥವಾ ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ವಿವರಿಸುವುದೇ ಕಷ್ಟ ಎಂದು ಬರೆಯಿರಿ. ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಸಂದೇಹ ಪರಿಹಾರವಾಗಿದೆಯೇ ಗುರುತಿಸಲು ಸುಲಭ.

ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವಾಗಿ ಪರಿವರ್ತಿಸಿ

ನೋಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ, ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಲೆಕ್ಕವನ್ನೂ ಉಳಿಸಿ. ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಉದಾಹರಣೆ ಮುಗಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಸ್ವತಃ ಮಾಡಿ ತರ್ಕ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ. ಬಳಿಕ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಮತ್ತು ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮುಚ್ಚಿ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಉಪನ್ಯಾಸ ಬರೆಯುವುದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿದ ತಪ್ಪನ್ನು ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ.

ಅದೇ ರೀತಿಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ಬಿಡಿಸಲಾಗದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಮೂಲ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಓದಿ ಅಥವಾ ಅಡಕವಾದ ಹಂತವನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಿ. ಸ್ವತಃ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳದೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ನೋಡುವುದರಿಂದ ಕಲಿಕೆಯ ಕೊರತೆ ಮರೆಮಾಚಬಹುದು.

ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಯ ಅಧ್ಯಯನ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ ಮಿತಿಯ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಇರಿಸಿ. ವಿಡಿಯೋ ವಿಧಾನ ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸಮಯ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಒತ್ತಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಅದನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ ಬಳಸಬಹುದೇ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಇನ್ನಷ್ಟು ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಸೇರಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਤੇ 12 ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
description: ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (ਕੋਡ 401) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (ਕੋਡ 801) ਪੇਪਰ 9 ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (ਕੋਡ 401) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (ਕੋਡ 801) ਪੇਪਰ 9 ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ
ਜਮਾਤ 10: Retail40125 ਫਰਵਰੀ 202710:30 - 12:302 ਘੰਟੇ
ਜਮਾਤ 12: Retail8019 ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 202710:30 - 13:303 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 5: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 12: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5, 12 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 401, 801 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (401) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਤ (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਚੂਨ ਵਪਾਰ (801) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 9 ਅਪ੍ਰੈਲ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Core (301) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 5 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 35 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

ਪੂਰੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ · ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ

title: CBSE Class 12 Mass Media Studies Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Class 12 Mass Media Studies: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Mass Media Studies is on 20 February 2027, from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST. Match subject code 835 with your registration details before adding the paper to your calendar.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Mass Media Studies dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 12: Mass Media Studies83520 February 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Mass Media Studies entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 8 and look for code 835. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The timetable entry is for Mass Media Studies under the code shown above. If your school record uses a different code or course name, ask the school to resolve that difference before following this date.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 12 Mass Media Studies (835) falls 13 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Keep school assessments separate

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

title: Hostel Fees Before Admission: What Parents Should Ask in Writing
description: Before paying college hostel fees, ask about deposits, mess billing, room allotment, vacancy and refunds in writing to protect your first-year budget.
content:
College hostel fee policies can add a large amount to the first-year budget. Before paying, ask the institution’s hostel or finance office for written details on the deposit, mess charges, room allotment, vacancy conditions and refund rules. A verbal assurance from a student coordinator isn’t enough.

Save the current hostel notice, fee circular, payment receipt and every email or message about the terms. If the college’s admission page and hostel office quote different amounts, pause and seek written clarification before transferring money.

What should parents ask before paying hostel fees?

Ask for a complete cost sheet, not just the advertised room fee. Request the amount payable now, the recurring cost and the maximum amount the family could lose if plans change.

  • What is the room fee for a term, semester and full academic year?
  • Is the security or caution deposit refundable, partly refundable or non-refundable?
  • Are electricity, water, laundry, internet, maintenance and medical charges included?
  • Is mess billing compulsory, prepaid, monthly or based on actual attendance?
  • Do charges continue during holidays, medical leave, training or other approved absence?
  • What payment dates apply, and can late payment affect room allotment?

Does a deposit guarantee a hostel room?

No. Payment may only complete the application or place the student in an allotment queue. Ask whether the institution assigns rooms by year, course, gender, application date or vacancy. Also ask for the student’s status, the expected confirmation date and the written remedy if no room is available.

A waiting-list position is not the same as confirmed accommodation. If the room is uncertain, compare college options and price nearby housing before paying a non-refundable amount.

When can the hostel fee be refunded?

Refund treatment usually depends on when the student cancels and which services have been used. The phrase “refundable deposit” is incomplete unless the notice states the cut-off date, deductions and processing time.

  1. Ask what happens if the student withdraws before joining.
  2. Confirm the rule if admission is cancelled, a college is changed or no vacancy is offered.
  3. Check whether room and mess charges are calculated for the full term or only the period used.
  4. Ask which office approves the refund, what documents are required and which bank account receives it.

The institution issuing the hostel notice is responsible for applying its published terms. Read the latest notice and fee circular before payment, then keep the written response with the receipt. If the office won’t state the payable amount, recurring charges and refund loss clearly, don’t rush the decision.

title: JoSAA Float or Freeze: Which Choice Fits Your Upgrade Risk
description: Understand how JoSAA Float, Slide and Freeze affect seat upgrades, acceptance duties and your admission choices before selecting an option.
content:
In JoSAA counselling, Float keeps you open to a higher preference at another participating institute or the same institute, Slide limits movement to a higher preference in the same institute, and Freeze stops further upgrades. Your choice should depend on which seats you would genuinely accept, not on which button sounds safest.

The Joint Seat Allocation Authority, or JoSAA, runs this process through its published business rules and round notices. Payment, document submission, query replies and institute reporting can fall at different stages, so don't assume that selecting Float or Slide completes every admission duty.

What do Float, Slide and Freeze mean?

ChoicePossible upgradeBest fit
FloatA higher preference at another institute or the same instituteYou would join any acceptable higher choice in your locked list
SlideA higher preference within the institute holding your seatYou want to stay at that institute but may change branch
FreezeNo further JoSAA upgradeYour current institute and branch are final for you

For example, if you have Mechanical Engineering at one NIT and Computer Science at another institute higher in your locked list, Float keeps that other institute in consideration. Slide won't move you there. If only a better branch at the same NIT appeals to you, Slide is the narrower choice.

Can an upgrade replace your current seat?

Yes. When a higher preference is allotted, it replaces the earlier allotment under the JoSAA process. Treat the new seat as your active allotment; don't assume the old seat will return if you change your mind later.

Your current allotment also isn't safe if you ignore a required action. A missed seat acceptance payment, document upload, query response or reporting instruction can affect the allotment under that counselling cycle's rules. This is where many students get caught: the willingness option and the payment obligation are separate decisions.

Which option should you select?

  1. Open your locked choice list and mark every higher preference you would actually join.
  2. Choose Float if those acceptable choices include another institute. Choose Slide if they stay within your allotted institute.
  3. Choose Freeze when you would reject every higher listed option, even if it becomes available.
  4. Check the current JoSAA notice, portal status, payment record, document queries and next reporting instruction before the stated deadline.

Keep your allotment letter and payment confirmation accessible. If your family cannot accept the possibility of moving to another institute, don't choose Float merely because an upgrade sounds attractive. You can also compare entrance exams while reviewing your wider admission choices.

title: IIT Delhi Mental Health Reforms: Emergency Help Desks, AIIMS Counseling Tie-Ups, and Student Governance Initiatives
description: Explore IIT Delhi's latest mental health initiatives, including 24/7 emergency help desks, clinical tie-ups with AIIMS, and enhanced student governance for campus wellness.
content:
Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) has introduced a comprehensive framework of mental health reforms designed to foster an environment of emotional safety, transparency, and academic balance. Premier engineering education in India carries rigorous academic deadlines, intense competitive pressure, and significant lifestyle adjustments for young scholars. In response to student feedback and internal review recommendations, IIT Delhi is strengthening its multi-layered support systems ranging from immediate crisis response desks to clinical partnerships with top medical institutions.

Key Pillars of IIT Delhi Mental Health Reforms

The updated campus mental health strategy shifts the focus from reactive counseling to active, preventive interventions. By combining medical support with administrative flexibility and student-led feedback, the institute aims to create a reliable safety net across undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs.

1. 24/7 Emergency Help Desks and Crisis Response

To ensure no student faces acute distress in isolation, IIT Delhi has operationalized dedicated emergency help desks across campus. These crisis support units serve as immediate points of contact during urgent situations.

  • Immediate Triage: Trained crisis personnel assess incoming calls and visits to deliver psychological first aid and determine the required level of care.
  • Hostel Level Coordination: Emergency units connect directly with hostel wardens, student mentors, and campus medical officers to reach individuals quickly.
  • Confidentiality Protections: Student interactions with counseling services remain strictly confidential to encourage proactive seeking of support without fear of academic repercussions.

2. Strategic Clinical Tie-Ups with AIIMS

Recognizing that complex mental health concerns require specialized medical expertise, IIT Delhi has established formal tie-ups with premier health institutes, including the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS). This collaborative model bridges campus counseling with advanced psychiatric care.

  • Visiting Specialists: Senior clinical psychologists and psychiatrists visit the campus regularly for expert consultations.
  • Priority Clinical Referrals: Students requiring specialized diagnostic evaluations or inpatient care receive direct referrals to AIIMS experts, minimizing wait times.
  • Gatekeeper Training: Clinical partners conduct workshop modules for student mentors and faculty advisers to help them identify early signs of emotional burnout and anxiety.

3. Empowering Student Governance and Advisory Panels

Student representation is central to sustainable institutional reform. IIT Delhi is systematically integrating student voices into administrative decisions regarding campus wellness and academic policy.

  • Student Advisory Committees: Representatives participate actively in committees reviewing campus health services, hostel conditions, and student welfare policies.
  • Structured Feedback Mechanisms: Regular surveys and open consultation forums enable students to voice concerns about workload distribution and evaluation rules.
  • Expanded Peer Mentorship: Senior students receive structured training to mentor incoming batches, easing their academic and personal transition into institute life.

Academic Workload Adjustments and Evaluation Reviews

Campus wellness reforms extend directly into the academic domain. IIT Delhi is reviewing academic structures to prevent continuous examination overload and extreme stress spikes during the semester.

Departmental committees are evaluating academic calendars to ensure balanced spacing between major continuous assessments, laboratory submissions, and final examinations. Faculty members are encouraged to offer flexible course drop windows and transparent grievance channels to help students manage academic pressure effectively.

Guidance for Parents and Prospective Students

For parents supporting students through high-stakes engineering programs, maintaining proactive communication and understanding available campus resources is essential. Academic success depends significantly on physical and psychological well-being.

  • Maintain Open Communication: Engage in regular, non-judgmental conversations with your child about their daily routine, balance, and academic challenges.
  • Save Campus Emergency Contacts: Keep official helpline numbers, campus health center contacts, and hostel administration details readily accessible.
  • Encourage Early Help Seeking: Reassure students that consulting campus counselors or clinical specialists is a standard, positive step toward personal wellness.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Are mental health counseling services free for IIT Delhi students?

Yes, primary counseling and guidance services provided on campus by internal counselors and visiting medical specialists are accessible to registered students as part of campus health services.

How does the AIIMS tie-up benefit IIT Delhi students?

The tie-up enables campus medical officers and counselors to refer students needing advanced psychiatric care or clinical evaluation directly to AIIMS specialists for prioritized care.

How do student governance bodies contribute to campus mental health reforms?

Student representatives participate in joint advisory committees with faculty members to review academic workload, hostel facilities, and wellness policies, ensuring student concerns directly shape campus rules.

Where can students access emergency mental health help desk contacts?

Emergency helpline numbers are displayed across all student hostels, academic blocks, the central health center, and official internal student portals. Students and parents should verify current administrative details on the official institute website.

title: UGC NET డిసెంబర్ 2026 దరఖాస్తు సవరణ: తేదీలు, వివరాల తనిఖీ
description: నవంబర్ 2 నుంచి 4 వరకు సవరణలకు షెడ్యూల్ ఉంది. మార్చగల వివరాలు, ఆధార పత్రాలు, అక్టోబర్ 31 దరఖాస్తు గడువును విడిగా తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
UGC NET డిసెంబర్ 2026 దరఖాస్తులో తప్పు చేశారా? NTA సమాచార బులెటిన్ ప్రకారం ఆన్‌లైన్ సవరణలు నవంబర్ 2 నుంచి 4, 2026 వరకు జరగనున్నాయి. చివరి రోజు రాత్రి 11:50 గంటలకు గడువు ముగుస్తుంది. సవరణ విండో ఇంకా తెరుచుకోవాల్సి ఉంది. ఇప్పుడు సమర్పించిన ఫారమ్‌ను మీ ధ్రువపత్రాలతో పోల్చి, సరిచేయాల్సిన వివరాలను రాసుకోండి.

ప్రతి వివరాన్ని మార్చే అవకాశం ఉండదు

NTA అనుమతించిన వివరాల్లోనే మార్పులు చేయవచ్చని అధికారిక బులెటిన్ చెబుతోంది. పేరు, ఫోటో, సంప్రదింపు వివరాలు లేదా మరో నమోదు తప్పకుండా మార్చవచ్చని భావించవద్దు. అభ్యర్థి పోర్టల్‌లో ఆయా వివరాలకు ఇచ్చే సూచనలు, అందుబాటులో ఉన్న ఎంపికలను అనుసరించండి.

అధికారిక సమాచార బులెటిన్

ప్రస్తుతం ఉన్న నమోదు, సరైన నమోదు, దానికి ఆధారమైన పత్రాన్ని ఒక చిన్న జాబితాగా తయారు చేసుకోండి. సవరణలు అందుబాటులోకి వచ్చినప్పుడు ఇది ఫారమ్‌ను సులభంగా తనిఖీ చేయడానికి ఉపయోగపడుతుంది.

దరఖాస్తు గడువు, సవరణ గడువు వేరు

అక్టోబర్ 27 పొడిగింపు నోటీసు ప్రకారం అక్టోబర్ 31 రాత్రి 11:50 గంటల వరకు ఆలస్య రుసుము లేకుండా దరఖాస్తు సమర్పణ, విజయవంతమైన ఫీజు చెల్లింపు పూర్తి చేయవచ్చు. బులెటిన్‌లోని ఇతర నిబంధనలు మారలేదు. తరువాత వచ్చే సవరణ సమయం, అసంపూర్తి దరఖాస్తును సమర్పించడానికి అదనపు గడువు కాదు.

అక్టోబర్ 27 పొడిగింపు నోటీసు

బులెటిన్‌లో నవంబర్ 2 నుంచి 4 వరకు సవరణలు, చివరి సమయం రాత్రి 11:50 అని ఉంది. తదుపరి నోటీసులు, అభ్యర్థి లాగిన్ కోసం అధికారిక UGC NET వెబ్‌సైట్‌ను ఉపయోగించండి.

అధికారిక UGC NET వెబ్‌సైట్

NTA UGC NET డిసెంబర్ 2026 సమాచార బులెటిన్, ముద్రిత పేజీ 4: ఆన్‌లైన్ సవరణలకు నిర్ణయించిన సమయం. అధికారిక సమాచార బులెటిన్

సేవ్ చేసిన మార్పులను మళ్లీ చూడండి

పోర్టల్‌లో సవరణ అందుబాటులోకి వచ్చిన తర్వాత చివరగా సేవ్ చేసిన వివరాలను మీ జాబితాతో పోల్చండి. బటన్ నొక్కినంత మాత్రాన పని పూర్తయిందని భావించవద్దు. ఫారమ్‌ను మళ్లీ తెరిచి మార్చిన వివరాలు చదవండి. పోర్టల్ అందించే తాజా నిర్ధారణను భద్రపరచుకోండి.

అవసరమైన వివరాన్ని మార్చలేకపోతే కనిపించే సందేశాన్ని రాసుకుని అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లోని హెల్ప్‌డెస్క్‌ను సంప్రదించండి. సమస్యను వివరించండి; పాస్‌వర్డ్ లేదా OTP పంచుకోవద్దు. అనధికార ఏజెంట్ ద్వారా సవరణ పంపవద్దు. సహాయం కోరుతూ సందేశం పంపితే దరఖాస్తు మారిపోతుందని అనుకోకండి. అసంపూర్తి దరఖాస్తుకు ఫారమ్, ఫీజు తనిఖీ జాబితా, కెమెరా సమస్యకు లైవ్ ఫోటో మార్గదర్శిని చదవవచ్చు.

ఫారమ్, ఫీజు తనిఖీ జాబితా · లైవ్ ఫోటో మార్గదర్శిని

title: JEE Advanced 2026 Registration Open LIVE Updates: Direct Link, Fees, Steps to Apply
description: JEE Advanced 2026 registration is now open. Check the direct application link, registration fees, eligibility, last date, and step-by-step process to apply online.
content:
The registration process for the JEE Advanced 2026 has begun. This exam will be organized by any of the IITs under the supervision of the Indian Institutes of Technology, where only candidates qualifying JEE Main can register.

Candidates interested in joining the prestigious IITs need to register themselves in the given time frame.

JEE Advanced 2026 Registration Date

Following are the critical dates for the registration process:

Date of Registration Beginning: April 2026
Final Date for Filing an Application: Expected around May 2026
Final Date for Fee Payment: May 2026
Availability of Admit Card: May 2026
Date of Examination: June 2026

Students need to apply well before the final date to avoid technical problems.

Official Website for Registration

Particulars Details
Exam Name JEE Advanced 2026
Conducting Body Indian Institutes of Technology
Mode of Application Online
Official Website https://jeeadv.ac.in

Eligibility Criteria for JEE Advanced 2026

In order to register for JEE Advanced 2026, one needs to fulfill the following criteria:

- Must clear JEE Main 2026 and secure ranks in the uppermost positions
- Must have cleared Class 12th in either 2025 or 2026
- Must qualify age limits specified in official notifications
- Can appear for JEE Advanced twice consecutively

It is suggested that applicants refer to the official site for more details regarding eligibility criteria.

JEE Advanced 2026 Application Fees

Application fee is dependent upon categories:

- General/OBC/EWS: Approximately Rs 2800
- SC/ST/PwD: Approximately Rs 1400
- Women Candidates: Lower fee as per guidelines

Fees can be paid by electronic methods like debit cards, credit cards, or net banking.

Steps to Apply for JEE Advanced 2026

These are the procedures that should be followed to fill the application form successfully:

- Go to the official site jeeadv.ac.in
- Click on the link “JEE Advanced 2026 Registration.\"
- Log in using JEE Main ID
- Fill in personal, educational, and contact information
- Upload required documents
- Make payment for the application.
- Submit form and generate confirmation page

All these procedures must be completed very carefully.

Documents Required for Registration

The candidate must provide the following documents:

- Class 10 Certificate (Proof of Date of Birth)
- Class 12 Mark Sheet/Certificate
- Category Certificate (if any)
- PwD Certificate (if any)
- Photograph & Signature (Passport Size)

The candidate must ensure that the documents are submitted in the prescribed format.

JEE Advanced 2026 Exam Pattern

Exam pattern at a glance:

- Format: Computer-Based Test
- Number of Papers: Two Compulsory Papers
- Time per Paper: 3 Hours
- Question Format: Multiple Choice Questions, Numerical Value Questions, and Match the Following

Topics: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics

What After Registration

After completing the registration process:

  • Download and keep the confirmation page
  • Wait for the admit card release
  • Start revising according to the exam pattern
  • Stay updated with official announcements

Conclusion

JEE Advanced 2026 can be said to be amongst the most highly contested examinations in India for students pursuing careers in engineering. Registration process is the foremost step towards getting admission into the IITs.

title: NIFT 2026 City Intimation Slip Soon @exams.nta.nic.in; Date, NIFTEE UG/PG Details
description: NIFT 2026 City Intimation Slip to be released soon. Check expected release date, download steps, exam city details for NIFTEE UG and PG at exams.nta.nic.in.
content:
The NIFT 2026 City Intimation Slip for candidates taking the NIFT Entrance Examination (NIFTEE) 2026 for Undergraduate (UG) and Postgraduate (PG) programs is anticipated to be released shortly by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Prior to the issue of the admission card, the city slip will be accessible online on the official NIFTEE website.

Candidates can arrange their journey and lodging by knowing their exam city ahead of time thanks to the city notification slip. It is crucial to realize that the municipal slip is not an entrance card and cannot be used to get access to the testing facility.

NIFT 2026 City Intimation Slip: Overview

Particulars Details
Exam Name NIFT Entrance Exam (NIFTEE) 2026
Conducting Authority National Testing Agency (NTA)
Courses UG & PG
City Slip Status To be released soon
Mode Online
Official Website https://exams.nta.nic.in/niftee

Details Mentioned on City Intimation Slip

Important information such the candidate's name, application number, program applied for, and the designated exam city will be included on the city notification sheet. The exam date may also be mentioned in specific circumstances.

How to Download NIFT 2026 City Intimation Slip

By going to the official website, clicking on the appropriate link, and checking in with their application number, date of birth, or password, candidates can get the city slip. Candidates should download and preserve the slip for their records after viewing the designated city.

City Slip vs Admit Card

The admit card contains the precise exam center address, reporting time, and exam-day instructions, while the city slip merely contains information about the exam city. Only those with the admit card will be permitted to enter the exam room.

A few days prior to the test, NTA will issue the NIFT 2026 Admit Card following the release of the city slip. The admission card must be downloaded, printed, and carried by candidates with a legitimate photo ID.

title: GATE 2027 Application Form Technical Delay: Resolving DigiLocker Aadhaar Verification Errors and GOAPS Profile Syncing Protocols
description: Troubleshoot GATE 2027 GOAPS application portal delays, resolve DigiLocker Aadhaar verification failures, and fix student profile sync errors effectively.
content:
With the opening of the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) registration window, thousands of candidates across India log into the GATE Online Application Processing System (GOAPS). However, candidates frequently experience technical roadblocks during the submission process. Server timeouts, DigiLocker integration glitches, failure in Aadhaar biometric data retrieval, and delays in profile synchronization often slow down applications.

Understanding how to handle these technical failures ensures that applicants submit their forms accurately long before the closing deadline, avoiding late fee surcharges or last-minute application rejection.

Common Technical Issues on the GOAPS Portal

The GOAPS portal handles heavy server traffic, especially during the opening weeks of registration. Technical issues typically fall into three distinct categories:

  • DigiLocker Authentication Failure: The portal fails to connect with the DigiLocker API to verify identity documents.
  • Aadhaar Profile Mismatch: Discrepancies between the applicant name, date of birth, or gender entered on GOAPS and the details stored in the UIDAI database.
  • Payment Gateway and Document Sync Delays: Payment deduction occurring without the generation of a transaction confirmation receipt or uploaded certificates failing to sync with the application preview.

Resolving DigiLocker and Aadhaar Verification Errors

Identity verification through Aadhaar or DigiLocker is a mandatory security step designed to reduce impersonation. When this process fails, applicants can follow these structured steps to resolve the issue:

1. Name and Date of Birth Alignment

Even minor typographical differences between your Class 10/12 certificates and your Aadhaar card can trigger an automatic rejection during the API validation call. If your Aadhaar details do not match your academic documents, update your Aadhaar card via the official UIDAI self-service portal prior to starting your GOAPS registration.

2. Clearing DigiLocker Session Cache

If the DigiLocker pop-up window freezes or throws a timeout error during authentication:

  • Log out completely from both GOAPS and DigiLocker on your device.
  • Clear your web browser history, cache, and cookies.
  • Switch to an updated version of Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox in an Incognito/Private window.
  • Ensure pop-up blockers and third-party ad-block extensions are disabled for both portals.

3. Mobile Number and OTP Sync

Ensure that the mobile number registered with your Aadhaar card is active and capable of receiving One-Time Passwords (OTPs). Network congestion can cause OTP delivery delays. If an OTP is not received within two minutes, do not click the resend button repeatedly; wait for the cooldown timer to finish to avoid blocking your IP address temporarily.

Fixing GOAPS Profile Syncing and Upload Errors

Once identity details are verified, applicants must upload their photograph, signature, and category certificates. System synchronization errors can occur if files fail to meet strict portal requirements.

Document TypeFile FormatFile Size RangeKey Requirements
Passport PhotographJPEG / JPG5 KB to 200 KBWhite background, clear face visibility, no caps or dark glasses
SignatureJPEG / JPG5 KB to 200 KBContinuous stroke signature in black or dark blue ink on white paper
Category / PwD CertificatePDF10 KB to 500 KBClear, legible scan issued by a competent authority

Handling Stuck Payment Transactions

If funds are debited from your bank account or UPI wallet but the GOAPS dashboard continues to show Payment Pending:

  • Do not immediately initiate a second payment transaction.
  • Wait for 24 to 48 hours for the automated reconciliation protocol to execute between your bank and the GATE organizing institute server.
  • Check your payment history tab inside the GOAPS portal; if the status updates to Successful, your application form is complete.
  • If the transaction fails permanently, the debited money is usually refunded automatically to the source account within 7 working days, allowing you to re-attempt the payment.

When to Contact the GATE Helpdesk

If persistent technical glitches remain unresolved after attempting all troubleshooting methods, contact your respective Zonal GATE Office. When lodging a query, keep your Enrollment ID, transaction details, and clear screenshots of the error screen ready. Always verify official notifications and instructions directly on the official organizing institute website.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do if DigiLocker Aadhaar verification fails repeatedly during GATE registration?

Ensure your name and date of birth on the GOAPS form match your Aadhaar record exactly. Clear your browser cache, turn off pop-up blockers, or try registering during off-peak hours such as early morning or late evening.

My payment was debited, but my GOAPS status shows pending. Should I pay again?

No, do not make an immediate duplicate payment. Wait 24 to 48 hours for the automated bank reconciliation process to update your status on the portal.

Can I complete the GATE application without using DigiLocker?

Yes, alternative valid photo identification options such as a Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Driving License can be used for verification on the portal if DigiLocker access is unavailable.

What is the recommended browser for accessing the GOAPS registration portal?

The latest versions of Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, or Microsoft Edge on a desktop or laptop computer are recommended for optimal performance.

title: AICTE Approval Check: How Students Can Verify a Technical Course
description: Learn how to verify AICTE approval for a technical course, confirm the institution, programme, campus, intake and awarding university before paying fees.
content:
AICTE approval status should be checked against the exact institution, campus, programme, academic year and approved intake before you pay fees. A college advertisement or counsellor’s assurance is not enough. Verify the AICTE record, confirm who will award the qualification, and save the documents that support your admission decision.

This matters because an incorrect assumption can affect enrolment, education loans, recruitment eligibility, transfers and future study plans. Treat approval as a linked set of checks, not as a logo on a brochure.

Key facts about AICTE approval status

  • AICTE approval is connected to the institution and the programmes and intake approved for a particular academic period.
  • Approval for one programme, campus or mode of study does not automatically cover another.
  • AICTE approval and university affiliation are separate checks.
  • The awarding university or other authorised degree-awarding body must be identified clearly.
  • An approved intake is not the same as the number of seats still available.
  • Current records matter more than an old approval letter or a general claim such as “AICTE registered”.

What an AICTE record does and does not prove

The All India Council for Technical Education, or AICTE, regulates specified areas of technical education. Its record may show whether an institution and a particular programme appear within the approved arrangement for an academic period.

That record does not, by itself, answer every question about a degree. You must also establish the authorised awarding university, the college’s current affiliation where applicable, the campus, the mode of study and the course described in your admission documents.

For example, approval shown for a Bachelor of Technology programme at one campus should not be treated as confirmation for a similarly named course at another campus. A private training centre may teach technical subjects but may not have authority to award a recognised degree. Read the offer letter carefully.

How to check AICTE approval status before paying fees

1. Write down the exact course details

Start with the formal details in the offer letter, not only the marketing name. Record the legal institution name, full programme title, campus address, study mode, academic year, proposed intake and awarding university.

“Engineering course” is too broad for a reliable check. Similar names can refer to different legal entities or campuses, so compare the address and institution name as well.

2. Search the current AICTE record

Use the current academic year in AICTE’s official institution or approval search facility. Match the result with the admission offer across four fields: institution, campus, exact programme and approved intake.

If the record shows Mechanical Engineering but the offer is for Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, do not treat the search result as confirmation. Ask the institution to identify the approval record or document covering the offered programme.

3. Check the intake carefully

Approval for a programme does not prove that every advertised seat is approved. If the record shows an approved intake of 60 and the college is collecting fees for 120 students in that programme, pause and request a written explanation with supporting documents.

The approved intake is a regulatory figure for the programme and academic period. It is different from the number of seats remaining after admissions.

4. Confirm the awarding university

Ask who will award and print the final qualification. Confirm the university name, the college’s affiliation for the same academic year, and whether that affiliation covers the exact programme and campus.

For a university department, the academic relationship may be direct. For an affiliated college, the relevant affiliation must be current and programme-specific. The documents should not promise a degree while describing only a certificate or diploma.

5. Build a dated evidence file

Save the approval search result, approval letter if provided, affiliation evidence, offer letter, fee schedule, refund terms and fee receipt. Keep the date visible in screenshots where possible, and preserve emails in which the college answers your questions.

Do not edit screenshots or rely on a forwarded PDF without checking its date and scope. If information changes during the admission cycle, a dated file helps you establish what was represented when you paid.

Use one comparison, not one approval claim

CheckWhat to matchWhat it helps establish
InstitutionLegal name, campus and academic yearWhether the entity offering the course appears in the relevant record
ProgrammeExact branch, qualification and study modeWhether the approval relates to the course you were offered
IntakeApproved seat capacity for the programmeWhether the advertised capacity needs clarification
University affiliationCollege, programme, campus and academic yearWhich body is responsible for awarding the qualification
Student paperworkOffer letter, fee receipt and enrolment detailsWhether the payment documents describe the same course

These checks support each other, but none replaces the others. A recognised university does not automatically validate an unrelated programme, and an AICTE record does not remove the need to confirm the awarding arrangement.

When to pause an admission payment

  • The college shows an old approval letter but cannot identify the current academic-year record.
  • The programme title differs between the brochure, offer letter and approval record.
  • The record names a different campus, spelling or legal institution.
  • The fee receipt names a company while the advertisement names a university or college.
  • The college refuses to state the approved intake or mode of study in writing.
  • The documents promise a degree, but the actual arrangement refers only to a certificate or diploma.
  • A large non-refundable payment is requested before approval and affiliation details are shared.

One mismatch may have an innocent explanation, but it still needs reconciliation. Ask for a written response that identifies the relevant AICTE record and university affiliation. If the answer remains vague, keep the admission unverified and compare another option.

A simple decision rule for students and parents

Pay only after three questions receive clear, document-backed answers:

  1. Does it match? Can you match the institution, campus, exact programme and academic year with the current AICTE record?
  2. Who awards it? Can you identify the authorised university or degree-awarding body and confirm the relevant affiliation?
  3. Do the papers agree? Do the approval details, offer letter, fee receipt and refund terms describe the same course?

If any answer is no, ask the institution for clarification before paying. If the discrepancy affects fees, enrolment or degree validity and is not resolved, contact the responsible regulatory or university authority through its current official channel. The applicable process can change, so verify the route directly rather than relying on an old contact detail.

Also calculate the full financial exposure: registration fee, tuition, hostel deposit, transport, examination charges and withdrawal penalties. A small first payment can lead to a costly dispute when refund terms are unclear.

FAQs about AICTE approval status

Is AICTE approval enough to prove that a degree is valid?

No. AICTE approval is one part of the check. Confirm the authorised awarding university, current affiliation where applicable, exact programme, campus, mode of study and academic year. Degree recognition depends on the complete regulatory and academic arrangement, not one logo or certificate.

How can I check AICTE approval status for a college course?

Search the current academic year in AICTE’s official institution or approval facility. Match the legal institution, campus, exact programme and approved intake with your offer letter. Then verify the university affiliation and save dated copies of the records.

Does approval for one branch apply to every branch?

Not automatically. A record may relate to a specific campus or institution. Check the address and legal name, especially when one education group operates multiple campuses.

Does AICTE approval apply to every course offered by a college?

No. Approval is not a blanket endorsement of every course. Check the exact programme and mode of study for the relevant admission year. Different programmes may follow different regulatory or awarding arrangements.

What should I do if the college shows an old approval letter?

Ask for the record covering your admission year, exact programme, campus and intake. An older document may not establish current approval. Do not pay a non-refundable amount until the discrepancy is resolved in writing.

Can an institution claim AICTE approval after starting admissions?

A marketing claim does not establish approval. Treat the course as unverified until the current official record and supporting documents confirm the institution, programme, campus and intake. If the records conflict, seek written clarification from the responsible authority before joining.

Date

November 22, 2026

Fresh application with late fee

November 23-26, 2026

Last date for late fee payment

November 26, 2026

Application correction window

November 27-29, 2026

Candidates must complete the application and fee payment within the applicable deadline.

JEE Main 2027 Application Fee Rules

NTA has made it clear that the examination fee paid for an application will not be returned. It also will not be used to cover the cost of an application.

For example, if a candidate pays the fee but later finds a mistake and submits an application, they will have to pay the fee again. There is no option to adjust or transfer the payment to the new one.

Let me clarify which JEE Main 2027 application form will be considered valid.

According to NTAs, instructions only: the recent JEE Main 2027 application form after the examination fee has been paid and the confirmation page has been generated will be valid.

If a candidate submits a JEE Main form but does not finish the payment or generate the confirmation page, the earlier completed JEE Main 2027 application will still stay valid.

Can candidates submit more than one JEE Main 2027 application?

Candidates can hold JEE Main 2027 application numbers after submitting a fresh form. However, this does not let them sit for the JEE Main 2027 exam more than once in the session.

Trying to appear or sit for the JEE Main exam using application numbers will be regarded as an Unfair Means (UFM) case. Simply holding JEE Main 2027 application numbers without using them for the exam will not be treated as UFM.

JEE Main 2027 Correction Window

If a candidate only needs to change some details in their existing JEE Main 2027 application, they should use the correction window from November 27 to 29, 2026, rather than submitting a new application.

NTA's fresh application facility offers JEE Main candidates another chance to fix registration errors. Before submitting a JEE Main application, candidates should carefully check the fee rules, deadlines, and validity conditions.

title: NMAT 2026 மதிப்பெண் அட்டை: 48 மணி நேரம், தணிக்கை, மறுதேர்வு விதிகள்
description: NMAT மதிப்பெண் அட்டை வரும் நேரம், பாதுகாப்புத் தணிக்கை விதிவிலக்கு, மதிப்பெண் வரம்பு மற்றும் மறுதேர்வு இடைவெளியை அறியுங்கள்.
content:
NMAT 2026 மதிப்பெண் அட்டை உங்கள் தேர்வு நாளைப் பொறுத்து வரும்; அனைவருக்கும் ஒரே முடிவு நாள் இல்லை. GMAC படி அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அட்டை பொதுவாக தேர்வுக்குப் பின் 48 மணி நேரத்திற்குள் பதிவிறக்கக் கிடைக்கும்; மின்னஞ்சல் அறிவிப்பும் வரும். அதிகாரப்பூர்வமற்ற மதிப்பெண் முன்னோட்டத்தைச் சேர்க்கை உறுதியாகக் கருதாதீர்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தளத்தில் 2026 தேர்வுக் காலம் 2 நவம்பர் முதல் 20 டிசம்பர் வரை என உள்ளது. நீங்கள் முன்பதிவு செய்த நாளுக்கு ஏற்ப மதிப்பெண் பரிசீலனையையும் கல்லூரி விண்ணப்பங்களையும் திட்டமிடுங்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ NMAT தளம்

பாதுகாப்புத் தணிக்கைக்கு தனிக் காலவரம்பு

தேர்வுப் பாதுகாப்புச் சம்பவம் தொடர்புடைய தேர்வுகள் தணிக்கைக்கு உட்படும்; அவற்றின் முடிவு 10 வேலை நாட்களில் வெளியாகும். தாமதத்தை உங்கள் கணக்கில் உள்ள செய்தியுடன் சேர்த்துப் புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள். தேர்வு முன்பதிவு விவரங்களை வைத்திருந்து தேவைப்பட்டால் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ உதவிக் குழுவிடம் விளக்கம் கேளுங்கள்.

GMAC-இன் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ NMAT Exam Score வழிகாட்டல். பக்கத்தில் வெளியீட்டுத் தேதி இல்லை; தணிக்கை விதிவிலக்கையும் படிக்கவும். மூல மதிப்பெண் அட்டை விதி

பிரிவு மதிப்பெண்களுடன் கல்லூரி விதிகளையும் பாருங்கள்

அட்டையில் மூன்று பிரிவுகளின் அளவீடு செய்யப்பட்ட மதிப்பெண்களும் மொத்தமும் இருக்கும். ஒவ்வொரு பிரிவும் 12 முதல் 120; மொத்தம் 36 முதல் 360. மூன்று பிரிவுகளுக்கும் சம எடை உண்டு; மதிப்பெண் ஓராண்டு செல்லுபடியாகும்.

மதிப்பெண்களின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ விளக்கம்

தேர்ந்தெடுத்த ஒவ்வொரு படிப்பின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ சேர்க்கைப் பக்கத்திலும் ஏற்றுக்கொள்ளப்படும் தேர்வுச் சுற்று, கடைசித் தேதி, தகுதி, மொத்த அல்லது பிரிவு மதிப்பெண் நிபந்தனையைப் பாருங்கள். பொதுவான கட்ஆஃப் கணிப்பு குறிப்பிட்ட வளாகத்திற்கான தகுதியை உறுதிப்படுத்தாது. விதிகளையும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இணைப்புகளையும் பட்டியலிடுங்கள்.

NMAT பதிவு மற்றும் வணிகப் பள்ளி விண்ணப்பம் தனித்தனி. மதிப்பெண் அனுப்புவது கல்லூரி விண்ணப்பத்தை முடிப்பதில்லை; நிறுவனத்தின் நடைமுறையைத் தனியாகப் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

மறுதேர்வுக்கு இடைவெளி விடுங்கள்

1 ஜூலை முதல் 30 ஜூன் வரையிலான ஒரு தேர்வுச் சுற்றில் அதிகபட்சம் மூன்று முயற்சிகள் உண்டு. செல்லுபடியாகும் மதிப்பெண் வந்த முயற்சிக்குப் பின் உடனே மறுபதிவு செய்யலாம்; ஆனால் அடுத்த தேர்வு குறைந்தது ஏழு நாட்கள் கழித்தே இருக்க வேண்டும். கட்டணம் செலுத்துமுன் நேர ஒதுக்கீடும் கல்லூரி விதிகளும் சரிபார்க்கவும்.

மறுதேர்வு விதிகள்

முதல் விண்ணப்பம் முடியவில்லை என்றால் எங்கள் NMAT பதிவு மற்றும் தேர்வு நேர முன்பதிவு வழிகாட்டியைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். சரியான தேர்வு முன்பதிவை உறுதிசெய்த பின் மதிப்பெண் திட்டமிடலை மேற்கொள்ளுங்கள்.

title: NEET UG 2026 bond and service rules students should check before college
description: Before locking an MBBS or BDS seat after NEET UG 2026, check state bond rules, service years, penalty amounts and college-specific affidavits. These can change the real cost of admission.
content:
Answer first

If you are choosing an MBBS or BDS seat after NEET UG 2026, do not look only at fees, rank and college name. Check the bond and service rules first. In many states, a seat can come with a mandatory rural or government service period, a monetary penalty if you skip it, or both. The same branch can therefore have a very different real cost across states, and sometimes even across colleges in the same state.

The safest next step is simple: before locking a choice in counselling, read the state counselling brochure, the college prospectus and the bond affidavit or admission undertaking together. If any of them mention service obligation, penalty, stipend, or internship-linked conditions, treat that as part of the admission cost.

Key facts

  • Bond rules are state-specific. There is no single all-India MBBS or BDS bond policy.
  • Service obligation can be mandatory. Some seats require post-course service in government, rural, or designated hospitals.
  • Penalty clauses can be large. If you do not complete the bond service, you may need to pay a fixed amount or face recovery conditions.
  • College type matters. Government, private, deemed, and minority institutions can all have different admission undertakings.
  • BDS also needs checking. Students often focus on MBBS, but BDS seats may also carry service or bond terms in some states.
  • Rules may differ for quota. State quota, management quota, and NRI quota can have different undertakings and liabilities.

What a bond really means for your decision

A bond is not just a formality. It is a legal or contractual commitment attached to admission. For a medical student, it can affect three things:

  • Time: you may have to spend one to several years in compulsory service after course completion.
  • Money: the penalty for not serving can be substantial compared with the tuition fee.
  • Career planning: a bond can delay postgraduate entrance preparation, internship planning, or private practice plans.

For families comparing two colleges, the lower-fee option is not always cheaper. A seat with a lighter bond may be better than a lower-ranked college with a heavy service obligation and a high exit penalty.

What to check before you accept a seat

CheckpointWhy it mattersWhat to look for
Bond periodShows how long service is requiredNumber of years, place of posting, category of hospital
Penalty amountDefines the financial risk if you do not serveFixed sum, yearly increase, or recovery rules
Eligible service locationClarifies where you may be postedRural PHC, CHC, district hospital, government college, or state facility
Stipend during serviceAffects real earnings during compulsory serviceWhether stipend is paid and if accommodation is included
Quota-linked ruleSome undertakings apply only to certain quota seatsState quota, all-India quota, management, NRI
Exit conditionsPrevents surprises at graduationNOC process, certificates, refund or penalty timelines

How to compare the true cost of two medical seats

Use a simple three-part comparison:

  1. Admission cost: tuition, hostel, mess, caution deposit, and other college charges.
  2. Bond cost: penalty risk multiplied by the chance you may skip service, plus the value of the service years you lose.
  3. Opportunity cost: whether the service period delays NEET PG preparation, employment, or relocation plans.

Example logic: a college with a lower annual fee but a strict service bond may become more expensive if the penalty is high or if the service posting is far from home. A family should compare the full four-year or five-year cost, not just one year of tuition.

Decision guidance for students and parents

Choose the seat only after answering these questions

  • Can I realistically complete the bond service if required?
  • If I cannot, can I afford the penalty without harming postgraduate plans?
  • Will the posting location affect safety, travel, family responsibilities, or preparation time?
  • Does this seat suit my long-term plan for PG, specialisation, or work abroad?
  • Are there similar colleges with lighter bond terms and acceptable academic quality?

When a bonded seat may still be worth it

  • The college is clearly better for academics, clinical exposure, or location.
  • The bond is manageable and service posting is acceptable.
  • The penalty is known, affordable, and unlikely to be triggered.
  • You are open to serving in the required system after graduation.

When you should be cautious

  • The bond terms are missing or unclear in the brochure.
  • The penalty is high but the service period is also long.
  • The posting area is not acceptable for personal or safety reasons.
  • You are choosing the seat only because it is available, not because it fits your career plan.

Documents to verify before reporting to college

  • State counselling information bulletin
  • College admission prospectus
  • Bond affidavit or service undertaking
  • Seat allotment letter and quota category
  • Hostel and fee structure notice
  • Any separate declaration about rural service, compulsory posting, or penalty recovery

If the wording is unclear, ask the counselling helpdesk or college admission office to confirm the exact clause in writing before paying the full fee.

Why this matters more after NEET UG results

Once results are out, many families focus only on rank and availability. That is when bond rules get missed. But the penalty and service clause can change the actual value of a medical seat as much as the annual fee. A careful comparison now can prevent regret later, especially if your plan includes postgraduate study, private practice, or moving to another state.

FAQs

Do all MBBS seats in India have a bond?

No. Bond rules are not the same everywhere. Some states and colleges have mandatory service bonds, some have only penalty clauses, and some may have no bond for certain seat types. Always check the official counselling and college documents for the exact seat you are taking.

Is the bond rule the same for MBBS and BDS?

No. BDS can have different bond or service conditions from MBBS, and these can vary by state, quota and college. Do not assume that a rule mentioned for MBBS automatically applies to BDS.

What should I check first if I want to avoid a surprise later?

Check the bond period, the penalty amount, the service location, and whether the clause applies to your quota category. These four details usually decide the real burden of the seat.

If a college brochure does not mention the bond clearly, can I ignore it?

No. If the bond appears in the state counselling rules, affidavit, or admission undertaking, it can still apply. Verify the exact clause before paying the fee or submitting the final acceptance form.

Does a lower fee always mean a better medical seat?

No. A lower-fee seat can become costlier if it comes with a long service bond, a high penalty, or a posting that affects your future study plans. Compare the full cost, not just tuition.

Can bond service affect NEET PG preparation?

Yes. Mandatory service can reduce the time available for exam preparation and may also affect where you live and work after graduation. That is why students planning for PG should check bond rules early.

What if I am willing to serve but want to stay close to home?

You should still verify posting rules. Some bonds allow posting anywhere in the state, while others may prioritise underserved areas. Home posting is not guaranteed unless the rule clearly says so.

title: CBSE Class 12 Political Science Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Class 12 Political Science: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Political Science is on 19 March 2027, from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST. Match subject code 028 with your registration details before adding the paper to your calendar.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Political Science dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 12: Political Science02819 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Political Science entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 11 and look for code 028. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The timetable entry is for Political Science under the code shown above. If your school record uses a different code or course name, ask the school to resolve that difference before following this date.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 12 Political Science (028) falls 14 calendar days after English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: CUET UG Datesheet 2025 Released - Subject-Wise Exam Schedule
description: NTA has officially released the CUET UG 2025 datesheet. Check and download the subject-wise CUET UG exam schedule PDF including important dates, shifts, and timings. Stay updated for your exam preparation.
content:
CUET UG Datesheet 2025 Released – Check Full Subject-Wise Schedule Here

The National Testing Agency (NTA) has officially released the CUET UG Datesheet 2025 for undergraduate admissions across central universities in India. As per the released schedule, the Common University Entrance Test (CUET UG 2025) will be conducted from May 8 to June 1, 2025. Students can now check the subject-wise CUET UG 2025 exam dates, slots, and timings to plan their preparation strategically.

The exam will be conducted in multiple shifts (Slot 1 and Slot 2) on all exam days. Here’s the detailed CUET UG 2025 timetable, including the list of subjects scheduled for each date.

What is CUET UG?

CUET UG (Common University Entrance Test – Undergraduate) is a national-level entrance exam conducted by NTA for admissions into central universities and other participating institutions across India. The test evaluates students in language, general awareness, and domain-specific subjects.

CUET UG 2025 Datesheet – Subject-Wise Exam Schedule

 

Date Subjects Scheduled Slot
May 8, 2025 English, General Test Slot 1, Slot 2
May 9, 2025 Physics, Chemistry, Biology Slot 1, Slot 2
May 10, 2025 Mathematics, Business Studies Slot 1, Slot 2
May 11, 2025 Accountancy, Economics Slot 1, Slot 2
May 12, 2025 Political Science, Sociology Slot 1, Slot 2
May 13, 2025 Geography, History Slot 1, Slot 2
May 14, 2025 Hindi, Sanskrit, Other Languages Slot 1, Slot 2
May 15, 2025 Computer Science, Environmental Science Slot 1, Slot 2
May 16, 2025 Reserved for additional domain-specific subjects Slot 1, Slot 2
May 17 – June 1 Buffer days and rescheduled exams (if any) To Be Notified

How to Prepare Based on the CUET UG Datesheet 2025?

With the release of the CUET UG 2025 exam schedule, students should now fine-tune their preparation strategies. Here are some tips:

  • Prioritize subjects based on exam dates
    Start revising the subjects that are scheduled earlier like English and General Test.

  • Focus on mock tests and revision
    Practice CUET mock tests for each domain-specific subject to boost confidence and speed.

  • Maintain a subject-wise study timetable
    Allocate daily slots for Science, Commerce, or Arts subjects as per your CUET domain selections.

  • Stay updated with the NTA CUET website
    Check for any updates or rescheduled dates during the buffer period from May 17 to June 1.

CUET UG 2025 Admit Card & Exam City Slip

NTA will release the CUET UG 2025 admit card and exam city intimation slip at least 7 days before the respective exam date. Candidates must keep checking the official portal regularly for updates.

Important Instructions for CUET UG 2025

  • Reach the center at least 1 hour before the exam time

  • Carry your admit card, photo ID proof, and required stationery

  • Avoid carrying electronic gadgets to the center

  • Follow all COVID safety protocols if applicable

Final Words

The CUET UG 2025 datesheet offers students a clear roadmap to prepare smartly and perform confidently in the exam. Make sure to align your study plan with the official schedule and stay focused.

For any updates regarding CUET UG admit card, exam city, and results, keep visiting the official NTA CUET website.

title: FMGE அக்டோபர் 2026: கேள்விப் பிழைக்கு நவம்பர் 2 வரை ஆட்சேபனை
description: FMGE கேள்வியில் தொழில்நுட்பப் பிழை இருந்தால் மருத்துவ ஆதாரங்களுடன் நவம்பர் 2க்குள் ஆட்சேபனை அளிக்கலாம். கேள்வி கடினமாக இருந்தது என்ற புகார் ஏற்கப்படாது.
content:
31 அக்டோபர் 2026 அன்று FMGE எழுதிய நீங்கள், ஒரு கேள்வியில் தொழில்நுட்பப் பிழை இருப்பதாகக் கருதினால், NBEMS தகவல் கையேட்டின்படி 2 நவம்பர் 2026 வரை ஆட்சேபனை அளிக்கலாம். ஆதரவான மருத்துவ நூல்கள் அல்லது ஆய்வுகளை இணைத்து, அதிகாரப்பூர்வ Communication Web Portal வழியாகப் பதிவு செய்த மின்னஞ்சல் முகவரியைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும். கேள்வி கடினமாக இருந்தது என்ற காரணம் மட்டும் ஏற்கப்படாது.

இரண்டு நாள் அவகாசம் யாருக்குப் பொருந்தும்?

அக்டோபர் 2026 அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தகவல் கையேடு பிரிவு 10.2ன்படி தேர்வை உண்மையில் எழுதியவர்கள் மட்டுமே இந்த வாய்ப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தலாம். தேர்வு நடந்த பிறகு அதிகபட்சம் இரண்டு நாட்காட்டி நாட்களுக்குள் ஆட்சேபனை வர வேண்டும். நவம்பர் 2க்குப் பிறகு வரும் கோரிக்கைகள் ஏற்கப்படாது. ஆதாரமுள்ள தொழில்நுட்ப ஆட்சேபனை இருந்தால் முடிவு வெளியாகும் வரை காத்திருக்க வேண்டாம்.

NBEMS, FMGE அக்டோபர் 2026 தகவல் கையேடு, பக்கம் 89. இந்தப் பகுதி ஆட்சேபனைக்கான கடைசித் தேதியை 2 நவம்பர் 2026 எனக் குறிப்பிடுகிறது. அக்டோபர் 2026 அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தகவல் கையேடு

குறிப்பிட்ட பிழையை ஆதாரத்துடன் விளக்குங்கள்

துல்லியமாக எந்தப் பகுதியில் பிழை உள்ளது, அது கேள்வியை எப்படி பாதிக்கிறது, உங்கள் கருத்தை எந்த மருத்துவ ஆதாரம் உறுதிப்படுத்துகிறது என்பதை எழுதுங்கள். வினாத்தாள் பற்றிய பொதுவான அனுபவம் தொழில்நுட்பப் பிழைக்கான சான்றாகாது. தேர்வாளர் சிக்கலைப் புரிந்துகொள்ளும் வகையில் சுருக்கமாகவும் தெளிவாகவும் விளக்குங்கள்.

  1. அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தேர்வு இணையதளத்திலிருந்து NBEMS Communication Web Portal திறக்கவும்.

  2. FMGE விண்ணப்பத்தில் பதிவு செய்த மின்னஞ்சலைப் பயன்படுத்தி, தளம் கேட்கும் தேர்வர் விவரங்களை அளிக்கவும்.

  3. தொழில்நுட்பப் பிழை பற்றிய விளக்கத்தையும் ஆதரவான மருத்துவ இலக்கியத்தையும் குறிப்பிட்ட அவகாசத்திற்குள் சமர்ப்பிக்கவும்.

  4. ஒப்புகை அல்லது குறிப்பு எண்ணையும் சமர்ப்பித்த ஆவணங்களின் நகலையும் பாதுகாக்கவும்.

இந்த விதியில் கடைசித் தேதி மட்டுமே உள்ளது; தனியான முடிவு நேரம் குறிப்பிடப்படவில்லை. நள்ளிரவு வரை அவகாசம் இருக்கும் என்று கருதாதீர்கள். உள்நுழைவு அல்லது ஆவணப் பதிவேற்றச் சிக்கல்களைச் சரிசெய்ய நேரமிருக்கும்போதே அனுப்புங்கள்.

விடைக்குறிப்பு வெளியீடு தனியான நடைமுறை

பிரிவு 10.3ன்படி அக்டோபர் 2026 விண்ணப்பதாரர் உள்நுழைவில் கேள்வி ID, சரியான விடை ID, தேர்ந்தெடுத்த பதிலின் ID, ஒவ்வொரு கேள்விக்கும் வழங்கப்பட்ட மதிப்பெண் ஆகியவை வெளியிடப்படும். இந்த விதி இருப்பது மட்டும் விடைக்குறிப்பு ஏற்கெனவே வெளியாகிவிட்டது என்பதைக் குறிக்காது. வெளியீட்டு அறிவிப்பையும் அணுகும் வழிமுறைகளையும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ FMGE பக்கம் வழியாகப் பாருங்கள்.

தேர்வு முடிவுக்குப் பிறகு மறுஆய்வு உண்டா?

முடிவுகள் 30 நவம்பர் 2026க்குள் வெளியாக வாய்ப்புள்ளதாகக் கையேடு கூறுகிறது. இது எதிர்பார்க்கப்படும் காலக்கெடு; முடிவு வெளியானதற்கான உறுதி அல்ல. மறுமதிப்பீடு, மறுசரிபார்ப்பு, மறுகூட்டல் அல்லது கருணை மதிப்பெண்களுக்கு FMGEயில் இடமில்லை. முடிவுக்கு முன் அளிக்கும் தொழில்நுட்ப ஆட்சேபனையுடன் இவற்றைக் குழப்ப வேண்டாம்.

தேர்ச்சி பெறுவதற்கான தனி மதிப்பெண் விதியை அறிய FMGE தேர்ச்சி மதிப்பெண் வழிகாட்டி படியுங்கள். தேர்வு கடினம் என்ற கருத்துகளும் நினைவிலுள்ள கேள்விகளும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ முடிவை நிர்ணயிக்காது.

title: INI-CET January 2027 Result Out: Find Your Roll Number and Check Your Percentile
description: AIIMS has published the January 2027 INI-CET qualified list. Find your roll number, read your percentile in MyPage and see what qualification means for seat allocation.
content:
AIIMS has published the INI-CET result for the January 2027 session. There are two places to check: the public PDF lists provisionally qualified candidates by roll number, while your personal MyPage shows your percentile even if you did not qualify.

Which result should you open?

On the AIIMS examinations website, look under Results & Announcements for the qualified-candidates list for INICET January 2027. The website lists it on 7 November. The PDF itself is Result Notification 304/2026, dated 6 November, for the computer-based exam held on 1 November. Those dates refer to the same result.

Search the PDF for the roll number printed on your admit card. It is a roll-number list, so the first row does not represent the highest rank. Check the course heading: MDS has a separate section from MD, MS, six-year DM and six-year MCh. Read the rank and percentile across your own row.

Where to find your score if your roll number is missing

Sign in to MyPage on the AIIMS examinations portal with your Candidate ID and password. The notice says all candidates who took the test have a percentile, including those outside the qualified list. A percentile is a measure of relative performance; it is not the percentage of questions you answered correctly.

Category in the result noticeQualifying percentile
Unreserved, EWS, sponsored, deputed, foreign nationals and OCI50th
OBC, SC, ST and PwBD45th
Bhutanese nationals, for PGIMER Chandigarh only45th

Why a rank is not a seat offer

The list is provisional. AIIMS has not confirmed eligibility or the validity of every certificate by publishing it. Check your registered email if you uploaded an OBC or EWS certificate: the notice says the outcome of preliminary verification will be communicated there. Wait for separate instructions before making choices of institute and subject.

AIIMS New Delhi, Result Notification 304/2026, dated 6 November 2026, page 880. Open the January 2027 qualified list in Results & Announcements.

The AIIMS examination calendar lists counselling dates separately from the result. If you bookmarked the earlier result-date article, use the published list and your own MyPage for your result now.

title: ਇਗਨੂ ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਹਾਲ ਟਿਕਟ: ਕੋਰਸ ਕੋਡ, ਪੇਪਰ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਜਾਂਚੋ
description: ਦਸੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਟਰਮ ਐਂਡ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਲਈ ਹਾਲ ਟਿਕਟ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਵੇਖਣੀ ਹੈ, ਕੋਈ ਕੋਰਸ ਰਹਿ ਜਾਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਕਾਗਜ਼ ਕੋਲ ਰੱਖਣੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਬਦਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਸ ਨਾਲ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਨੀ ਹੈ, ਜਾਣੋ।
content:
ਜੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਦੀ ਟਰਮ ਐਂਡ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਹਾਲ ਟਿਕਟ ਲੱਭ ਰਹੇ ਹੋ ਤਾਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਇਗਨੂ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵੇਖੋ। ਦੂਰ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਸੋਧੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਯੋਗ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਟਿਕਟਾਂ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਉੱਤੇ ਮਿਲਣਗੀਆਂ। ਇਹ ਟਿਕਟਾਂ ਜਾਰੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਣ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਸਮਰਥ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਦਾ ਲੌਗਇਨ ਪੰਨਾ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਤੋਂ ਇਹ ਪਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਕਿ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਿਕਟ ਆ ਗਈ ਹੈ। ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਵੇਖੋ। ਜੂਨ ਦੀ ਟਿਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਦਸੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਅਲਾਟ ਹੋਏ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰਦੀ।

ਟਿਕਟ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਹੋਣੇ ਚਾਹੀਦੇ ਹਨ?

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਬੈਠਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਅਧੀਨ ਹੈ। ਹਰ ਕੋਰਸ ਲਈ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਬਾਕੀ ਹੋਵੇ, ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦਾ ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ ਸਮਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਫ਼ੀਸ ਭਰੀ ਹੋਵੇ। ਜਿੱਥੇ ਅਸਾਈਨਮੈਂਟ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਮਿਤੀ ਤੱਕ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਹੋਣੀ ਚਾਹੀਦੀ ਹੈ। ਇਗਨੂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ ਉਸ ਕੋਰਸ ਦਾ ਨਤੀਜਾ ਐਲਾਨਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।

ਇਗਨੂ, 30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026: ਦਸੰਬਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਦੇ ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ’ਤੇ ਟਿਕਟ ਬਾਅਦ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ। ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਨੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਧੀ ਹੋਈ ਸੰਭਾਵੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਜੋਂ ਸੂਚੀਬੱਧ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ।

ਟਿਕਟ ਮਿਲਣ ’ਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਰਸ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਖੇਤਰੀ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਨਾਲ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਕੋਰਸ ਕੋਡ, ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਫ਼ੀਸ ਦੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਅਤੇ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਕੋਲ ਰੱਖੋ। ਇਗਨੂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਗਾਈਡ ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਬਾਰੇ ਹੈ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਫ਼ੀਸ ਭਰੇ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਰਸੀਦ ਨਾਲ ਕਰੋ।

ਸਫ਼ਰ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੋਰਸ ਵਾਲੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਰਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਸਵੇਰ ਦਾ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ 10 ਤੋਂ ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 1 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਪਹਿਰ ਦਾ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ 2 ਤੋਂ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਸੈਸ਼ਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਹਨ। ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਮਿਲੇਗਾ, ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ ਪੱਤਰ ’ਤੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ।

ਟਿਕਟ ਆਉਣ ’ਤੇ ਹਰੇਕ ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀ ਮਿਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਆਪਣੇ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਟਿਕਟ ’ਤੇ ਛਪੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਉਹੀ ਕੋਰਸ ਲੈ ਰਹੇ ਦੋਸਤ ਨੂੰ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਰ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਮਿਲ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।

ਜੇ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਵੇਲੇ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਬਦਲ ਜਾਵੇ

ਇਗਨੂ ਦਾ ਕਹਿਣਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਮਜਬੂਰੀ ਵੱਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਬਦਲਣਾ ਪੈ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਰਵਾਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਖੇਤਰੀ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਕਰੋ। ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਪਤੇ ’ਤੇ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਣ ਲਈ ਨਵਾਂ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਜ਼ਾ ਟਿਕਟ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਰੱਖੋ।
