title: IISER or NEST Scorecard: Which Details Matter Before Choosing a Course
description: Learn how to read IISER and NEST scorecards, ranks and programme conditions before choosing a science course or counselling route.
content:
Reading an IISER or NEST scorecard means more than spotting a high score. Check the qualifying status, rank, category details and programme conditions together, because a good-looking result doesn’t automatically mean a seat or the right course. This is the practical difference between reading your result and making a sensible course choice.

NEST is the entrance test for the five-year integrated MSc programme at NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai. IISER admissions have their own programme conditions and admission route. So don’t compare an IISER rank and a NEST rank as if they were the same currency.

Which scorecard fields should you check first?

Begin with the fields that can change your next action, not the number being circulated in family WhatsApp groups.

  • Qualifying status: Check whether the document says qualified, shortlisted or eligible for a later step. These labels may require different actions.
  • Score and percentile: Identify whether each figure is a raw score, percentile or merit position. They measure different things.
  • Rank: Note the overall rank, category rank and any other position shown. A category rank can affect your choice set, but it isn’t a seat promise.
  • Candidate details: Check your name, application number and category before saving the final PDF.
  • Issue details: Read the issue date, validity statement and instructions. A correction notice can make an older download unusable.

Why does the NEST scorecard issue date matter?

The official NEST website says an error in the qualifying percentile on some NEST 2026 scorecards was corrected. It also states that only scorecards carrying the issue date of 17 July 2026 will be accepted for future processes. Download the revised PDF after login from the official NEST website and keep it safely. A screenshot isn’t enough when the authority asks for the document.

How should rank influence your course choice?

Make two lists: programmes whose stated conditions you meet, and programmes you genuinely want to study. For each option, record the applicable subject requirements, rank conditions, course structure, research focus, location, fees and five-year commitment.

NEST-linked choices include NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai. An IISER result may not provide identical access to every programme or campus. Before submitting preferences, check the applicable admission notice and use the NEST exam guide for the exam-specific route.

What should you save before counselling?

  1. Download the final or revised scorecard.
  2. Mark the exact qualifying and rank fields.
  3. Remove programmes whose stated conditions you don’t meet.
  4. Place preferences by subject fit, not institute name alone.
  5. Keep certificates ready in the format requested by the responsible admission authority.

Your scorecard shows where you stand. The programme notice tells you what that position can actually lead to.

content:

title: AIAPGET 2026 Post-Exam Evaluation Rules: Scoring Methodology, Subject Group Normalization, and AYUSH PG Seat Allotment Steps
description: Understand the AIAPGET 2026 post-exam evaluation rules, including marking schemes, subject group percentile normalization, merit list generation, and AYUSH PG seat allotment steps.
content:
Navigating post-exam evaluation mechanisms is crucial for candidates aspiring to secure admission into postgraduate seats across Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy disciplines. The All India Ayurveda Central Entrance Test (AIAPGET) 2026 evaluation process involves standardized raw scoring, percentile calculation, and counseling mechanisms overseen by designated authorities.

AIAPGET 2026 Marking Scheme and Raw Score Calculation

The entrance examination evaluates candidates through a computer-based test structure consisting of multiple-choice questions. Understanding the exact raw scoring breakdown helps candidates estimate their performance before official results are published.

  • Correct Answer: Candidates earn +4 marks for every correct response.
  • Incorrect Answer: A negative marking rule applies where 1 mark is deducted for each wrong response.
  • Unanswered/Marked for Review: Zero marks are assigned to questions left unattempted or left marked for review.
  • Dropped Questions: If a question is cancelled or declared invalid due to technical or typographical errors during the answer key challenge phase, full marks (+4) are awarded to all candidates who appeared for that specific subject paper, regardless of whether they attempted it or not.

Subject Group Normalization and Percentile Score Methodology

AIAPGET is conducted across distinct discipline streams: Ayurveda, Siddha, Unani, and Homeopathy. Because each discipline has a separate paper, scores are not evaluated on a single merged raw marks scale. Instead, normalized percentile ranks are generated separately for each stream.

How Percentile Ranks Are Calculated

The percentile score reflects the percentage of candidates who scored equal to or lower than a specific candidate in that discipline stream. The standard formula utilized is:

Percentile = (100 x Number of candidates who secured raw marks equal to or less than the candidate) / Total number of candidates who appeared in that discipline

This ensures that candidates are evaluated strictly within their relevant discipline pool, avoiding cross-discipline mark comparisons.

Tie-Breaking Criteria for AIAPGET Merit Lists

When two or more candidates within the same discipline stream obtain identical raw scores or percentiles, post-exam tie-resolution protocols are applied in the following order:

  1. Fewer Negative Responses: The candidate with a lower number of incorrect answers across the test paper receives the higher merit rank.
  2. Higher Undergraduate (BAMS/BHMS/BUMS/BSMS) Marks: The aggregate marks scored during the qualifying professional degree are evaluated to break remaining ties.
  3. Age Preference: The candidate older in age is placed higher on the merit list.

Minimum Qualifying Cut-off Percentiles

To qualify for the AYUSH PG seat allotment process, candidates must meet the minimum cutoff percentile criteria determined for their respective category:

  • General / EWS Category: 50th Percentile
  • SC / ST / OBC Category: 40th Percentile
  • UR PwD Category: 45th Percentile
  • SC / ST / OBC PwD Category: 40th Percentile

AYUSH PG Seat Allotment Steps

Once results and merit percentiles are published, seat allotment is coordinated through centralized counseling systems managed by the AACCC (AYUSH Admissions Central Counseling Committee) for All India Quota (AIQ) seats and respective state authorities for state quota seats.

Step-by-Step Counseling Flow

  1. Online Registration: Candidates register on the official AACCC counseling portal, creating login credentials and paying non-refundable counseling fees along with refundable security deposits.
  2. Choice Filling and Locking: Candidates select their preferred colleges and postgraduate specialties (e.g., MD/MS Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Unani, Siddha). Choices must be submitted and locked before the deadline.
  3. Seat Processing and Allotment Result: Seats are allotted based on AIAPGET percentile merit ranks, candidate category, seat availability, and filled preferences.
  4. Reporting and Document Verification: Allotted candidates must report to the assigned institute within the specified window. Key documents required include the AIAPGET 2026 scorecard, admit card, UG degree certificate, internship completion certificate, state/central registration certificate, and valid category certificates.

Candidates should regularly verify updates and official guidelines directly on the official NTA and AACCC counseling web portals.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the marking scheme for AIAPGET 2026?

Candidates receive +4 marks for each correct response and lose 1 mark for every incorrect answer. No marks are deducted for unattempted questions.

How are dropped questions scored in AIAPGET?

If a question is dropped after answer key challenges, +4 marks are awarded to all candidates who appeared for that discipline stream.

Is there cross-discipline normalization between Ayurveda and Homeopathy?

No, normalization and percentile rank calculations are conducted independently within each specific discipline stream (Ayurveda, Homeopathy, Unani, Siddha).

What is the minimum qualifying percentile for the General category?

General category candidates must secure at least the 50th percentile in their respective discipline to qualify for counseling.

Who conducts the All India Quota counseling for AYUSH PG admissions?

The AYUSH Admissions Central Counseling Committee (AACCC) conducts centralized online counseling for 15% All India Quota seats, Deemed Universities, and Central Institutions.

title: BITSAT 2027: Notification, Eligibility, Registration Dates, Pattern, Syllabus, Preparation
description: BITSAT 2027 is the entrance exam for admission to eligible first-degree programmes at BITS Pilani. Check expected registration dates, eligibility criteria, exam pattern, syllabus and preparation strategy.
content:
Students planning to pursue engineering or science programmes at BITS Pilani can start preparing for BITSAT 2027 well before the application window opens. The Birla Institute of Technology and Science Admission Test (BITSAT) is the entrance examination used for admission to eligible first-degree programmes at the Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad campuses.

As of October 2026, BITS Pilani has indicated that the 2027-28 first-degree admission cycle is expected to open in December 2026. However, the complete BITSAT 2027 notification, application deadlines and examination dates have not yet been confirmed. Students should use the previous examination cycle as a planning reference and verify the final details in the official brochure when it becomes available.

BITSAT 2027: Overview

Particular

Details

Exam name

Birla Institute of Technology and Science Admission Test

Common name

BITSAT 2027

Conducting institute

BITS Pilani

Exam level

University-level entrance examination

Exam mode

Computer-based test, based on the previous pattern

Expected application start

December 2026, tentatively

April and May 2027, subject to official confirmation

Main subjects

Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics or Biology, English Proficiency and Logical Reasoning

Participating campuses

Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad

Official website

BITS Pilani Admissions portal

BITSAT 2027 Notification and Important Dates

BITS Pilani is expected to publish the detailed BITSAT 2027 schedule through its official admissions portal. Until then, the dates below are estimates based on the usual admission cycle, not confirmed deadlines.

Important: The dates may change when BITS Pilani releases the official notification. Candidates should not rely on estimated dates to make travel, payment or application decisions.

BITSAT 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Before applying, candidates should check whether they meet the academic requirements for their intended programme. The final eligibility rules for 2027 will be specified in the official information brochure. The following criteria are based on the previous admission guidelines.

1. Educational qualification

Applicants generally need to have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board, with the required subjects and English proficiency.

2. Required subjects

  • B.E. programmes: Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics (PCM), along with English.

  • B.Pharm. programmes: Physics, Chemistry and Biology (PCB) may be accepted, subject to the applicable rules.

  • Candidates choosing programmes with Mathematics requirements must carefully check the subject-specific conditions.

3. Minimum marks

Under the previous eligibility rules, candidates seeking admission to BITS first-degree programmes generally needed at least 75% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology, as applicable, and at least 60% in each of the required subjects.

Meeting the minimum marks does not guarantee admission. Selection also depends on the entrance score, programme preferences, seat availability and the institute’s admission rules.

4. Class 12 passing year

The eligible passing years will be confirmed in the BITSAT 2027 brochure. In previous admission cycles, eligibility was restricted by the year in which the candidate passed Class 12. Students who passed earlier should verify the rule before registering.

5. Improvement examination candidates

Candidates planning to improve their Class 12 marks should read the latest eligibility conditions carefully. BITS Pilani has specified conditions for improvement candidates in its admission guidelines, so students should not assume that appearing for only selected subjects will be accepted.

BITSAT 2027 Registration Process

The application process is expected to take place online through the official BITS Pilani admissions website. Follow these steps when registration opens:

  1. Visit the official portal: Open the BITS Pilani Admissions website and select the BITSAT 2027 application link.

  2. Register: Enter the required personal and contact details to create an application account.

  3. Fill in the form: Provide academic information, qualifying examination details and other requested particulars.

  4. Choose examination preferences: Select the available test cities or session options as instructed in the application form.

  5. Upload documents: Submit the photograph, signature and other documents in the specified format, wherever required.

  6. Pay the application fee: Pay the applicable fee for the selected session or sessions using an available payment method.

  7. Review and submit: Check every entry before submitting the form and save the confirmation page for future reference.

The application fee, document specifications, available test cities and final submission deadline will be announced for the 2027 cycle. Always use the official portal rather than an unofficial application link.

BITSAT 2027 Exam Pattern

BITSAT has traditionally been a computer-based examination that tests subject knowledge, English proficiency and logical reasoning. The exact 2027 pattern must be confirmed from the latest brochure.

The previous pattern used the following structure:

Section

Number of questions

Physics

30

Chemistry

30

English Proficiency

10

Logical Reasoning

20

Mathematics or Biology

40

Total

130

Exam feature

Previous pattern

3 hours

−1 mark

0 marks

BITSAT has previously included an additional-question opportunity for candidates who attempted all the regular questions, subject to specific conditions. Candidates should check the 2027 brochure for whether this provision continues and how it affects the test.

What does the exam pattern mean for students?

A good score requires more than solving difficult Physics or Mathematics problems. Candidates must also manage time across all sections and avoid unnecessary negative marking. English Proficiency and Logical Reasoning can provide valuable scoring opportunities when prepared consistently.

BITSAT 2027 Syllabus

The official BITSAT 2027 syllabus is awaited. Until it is released, candidates can use the latest available syllabus as a provisional study guide and confirm any changes before finalising their preparation.

Physics

Prioritise core concepts and numerical practice from areas such as:

  • Units, measurements and mechanics

  • Work, energy and power

  • Rotational motion and gravitation

  • Heat, thermodynamics and kinetic theory

  • Electrostatics and current electricity

  • Magnetism and electromagnetic induction

  • Optics and modern physics

  • Oscillations and waves

Chemistry

Revise concepts, reactions and numerical methods from:

  • Atomic structure and chemical bonding

  • States of matter and chemical equilibrium

  • Thermodynamics and electrochemistry

  • Chemical kinetics

  • Coordination compounds

  • Periodic properties and p-block chemistry

  • Organic chemistry fundamentals and functional groups

  • Biomolecules and other syllabus-prescribed topics

Mathematics

Give regular practice to:

  • Algebra and complex numbers

  • Matrices and determinants

  • Trigonometry

  • Coordinate geometry

  • Differential and integral calculus

  • Probability and statistics

  • Vectors and three-dimensional geometry

  • Sequences, series and binomial theorem

Biology

Biology is relevant to candidates applying through eligible PCB routes. Important areas may include:

  • Cell structure and function

  • Genetics and evolution

  • Plant and human physiology

  • Reproduction

  • Ecology and environment

  • Biotechnology

  • Diversity in the living world

English Proficiency and Logical Reasoning

These sections should not be left until the end of preparation.

English Proficiency: Grammar, vocabulary, sentence structure, usage and reading comprehension.

Logical Reasoning: Verbal reasoning, patterns, series, analogies, classification, figures and other reasoning exercises prescribed in the syllabus.

Use the official syllabus PDF to confirm the full chapter list before deciding which topics to skip.

How to Prepare for BITSAT 2027

A structured plan can help students balance board examinations with entrance preparation. Since BITSAT rewards both accuracy and speed, preparation should include concept revision, timed practice and mock-test analysis.

1. Strengthen Class 11 and Class 12 concepts

Begin with the fundamentals of Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics or Biology. Do not rely only on memorising formulas; understand when and how to apply them.

2. Practise questions under time limits

BITSAT is a speed-oriented examination. Set aside regular practice sessions in which you solve mixed questions within a fixed time. Gradually reduce the time spent on questions without sacrificing accuracy.

3. Prepare English and Logical Reasoning every week

Short, frequent practice sessions are more useful than trying to complete these sections at the last minute. Review incorrect answers and note recurring mistakes.

4. Take full-length mock tests

Start with a diagnostic test to identify weak areas. As the exam approaches, take full-length mocks under exam-like conditions and analyse your performance after each attempt.

Track three things after every mock test: accuracy, time spent per section and the topics responsible for incorrect answers.

5. Maintain a formula and revision notebook

Keep a concise record of formulas, reactions, definitions, exceptions and recurring mistakes. Revise this notebook regularly instead of repeatedly rereading entire chapters.

6. Balance board exams and BITSAT preparation

Class 12 performance matters for admission eligibility, so do not neglect board preparation. Align overlapping chapters and use board-study sessions to strengthen the concepts needed for BITSAT.

BITSAT 2027 Preparation Timeline

Period

Recommended focus

October-November 2026

Review Class 11 fundamentals, identify weak chapters and begin topic-wise practice

December 2026-January 2027

Follow the official notification, register when eligible and continue structured syllabus coverage

February-March 2027

Strengthen weak topics, revise formulas and increase timed practice

April 2027

Focus on mock tests and revision while checking the Session 1 schedule

After Session 1

Analyse performance and prepare for Session 2 if you plan to attempt it

Adjust this schedule according to your board examination dates, current preparation level and the official BITSAT timetable.

What Happens After BITSAT 2027?

Taking the entrance test is only one part of the admission process. Candidates should also track the institute’s instructions for submitting Class 12 marks, filling in programme preferences and participating in admission rounds.

The broad process is expected to include:

  1. Appear for the relevant BITSAT session or sessions.

  2. Check the score and official admission instructions.

  3. Submit qualifying examination marks and programme preferences within the announced window.

  4. Monitor the admission list and waiting list.

  5. Complete document verification and fee payment within the prescribed deadline if offered a seat.

Admission depends on meeting the eligibility requirements and the institute’s merit and seat-allocation rules. A qualifying score alone does not guarantee a particular branch or campus.

Conclusion

BITSAT 2027 aspirants should begin with a clear study plan rather than wait for the application form. Build strong subject fundamentals, practise English and Logical Reasoning regularly, and use timed mock tests to improve speed and accuracy. Since the official notification and complete schedule are still awaited, verify dates, eligibility, syllabus and exam rules directly through the BITS Pilani Admissions portal before applying.

JEE Advanced 2025 Registration Begins: Apply Before May 2 

The Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Kanpur has officially opened the registration window for the JEE Advanced 2025 exam. Candidates who qualified in the JEE Main 2025 and have secured a place in the top 2.5 lakh rank holders are eligible to apply for JEE Advanced. The registration process commenced on April 23, 2025, and the last date to submit the application form without a late fee is May 2, 2025. This crucial exam determines admission into prestigious IITs across the country. We firmly advise you to submit your application before the deadline to avoid any issues. 

How to Register for JEE Advanced 2025

To register, eligible candidates must visit the official website jeeadv.ac.in. The application process is entirely online, and candidates must upload scanned copies of documents and pay the registration fee to complete the process.

Important Dates for JEE Advanced 2025

Here’s a quick overview of the key dates for this year’s exam:

Event Date
Registration begins April 23, 2025
Last date to apply May 2, 2025
Last date for fee payment May 3, 2025
Admit card release May 17, 2025
Exam date May 26, 2025
Provisional answer key May 31, 2025
Final result announcement June 9, 2025

Eligibility Criteria

Only candidates who have qualified the JEE Main 2025 and are among the top 2.5 lakh rank holders are eligible. They must also satisfy the age, attempt, and educational qualification criteria set by IITs. Students who gave their exams of Class 12 or equivalent in the years 2024 or 2025 are eligible to apply.

Registration Fee

The fee structure for JEE Advanced 2025 is as follows:

Category Fee Amount
General/OBC (Male) ₹ 3,200
SC/ST/PwD/Female Candidates ₹ 1,600
Foreign Nationals (SAARC) USD 100
Foreign Nationals (Non-SAARC) USD 200

You can pay through net banking, UPI, or credit/debit card.

Documents Required

Applicants must keep the following documents ready in scanned format:

  • Class 10 and 12 certificates

  • Category certificate (if applicable)

  • PwD certificate (if applicable)

  • Passport-sized photograph and signature

  • JEE Main 2025 admit card

Exam Details

The examination of JEE Advanced 2025 will be held in two papers:

  • Paper 1: 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM

  • Paper 2: 2:30 PM to 5:30 PM

Both papers are compulsory, and the exam will be conducted in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode.

Conclusion

JEE Advanced 2025 is the gateway to the prestigious IITs and other top technical institutions. With the registration process now open, candidates should ensure that they complete the form carefully, upload the correct documents, and pay the fee on time. Do apply at the earliest.

Team DekhoCampus congratulates you for reaching this far and wishes you all the best for your journey ahead.

title: SRMJEEE 2027 Preparation Tips, Books & Mock Tests
description: Explore the best SRMJEEE 2027 preparation strategy, recommended books, mock test tips, subject-wise study plans and revision techniques to improve exam performance.
content:
Preparing for SRMJEEE 2027 needs a study plan, regular practice, and proper revision. Candidates aiming for BTech admission at SRM Institute of Science and Technology should understand the exam syllabus and pattern before starting preparation.

A balanced strategy that covers physics, chemistry, mathematics, biology, English, and aptitude can help candidates improve accuracy and manage time effectively.

SRMJEEE 2027 Preparation Strategy

Candidates should follow these preparation tips:

  1. Understand the syllabus: Check all topics in physics, chemistry, mathematics or biology, English, and aptitude.

  2. Create a study timetable: Divide daily study hours among subjects and reserve time for revision.

  3. Focus on concepts: Strengthen Class 11 and 12 fundamentals before solving advanced questions.

  4. Practise mock tests: Attempt online mock tests regularly to improve speed, accuracy and time management.

  5. Solve previous-year questions: Practise sample papers and previous-year questions to understand question patterns.

NCERT, H.C. Verma, D.C. Pandey

Chemistry

NCERT, O.P. Tandon, P. Bahadur

Mathematics

Mock Tests and Revision Tips

During the preparation stage you should take at least two or three mock tests each week. After each test you should analyse your incorrect answers and revise any weak topics. title: ఐఐఎం అహ్మదాబాద్ సమ్మర్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్లు: 70కి పైగా పాత్రలు అంటే ఏమిటి?
description: 2026-28 PGP బ్యాచ్‌కు ఐఐఎం అహ్మదాబాద్ సమ్మర్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్లు పూర్తయ్యాయి. క్లస్టర్ 3 పాత్రలు, నియామక రంగాలు, ఇంకా వెలువడని గణాంకాలను తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
ఐఐఎం అహ్మదాబాద్ 2026-28 PGP బ్యాచ్ సమ్మర్ ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ ప్రక్రియను 30 అక్టోబర్ 2026న క్లస్టర్ 3తో పూర్తి చేసింది. ఈ క్లస్టర్‌లో 70కి పైగా ఉద్యోగ పాత్రలను సంస్థ పేర్కొంది. దీనిని బ్యాచ్ మొత్తంలో ఎంపికైన విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్యగా భావించవద్దు.

చివరి క్లస్టర్‌లో ఏ రంగాలు ఉన్నాయి?

అక్టోబర్ 30 అధికారిక ప్రకటన ప్రకారం 12 నియామక సమూహాలు పాల్గొన్నాయి. ప్రక్రియ ఆన్‌లైన్‌తో పాటు ప్రత్యక్షంగా జరిగింది. కృత్రిమ మేధ, ఎంటర్‌ప్రైజ్ టెక్నాలజీ, బ్యాంకింగ్, బీమా, ప్రధాన తయారీ, పునరుత్పాదక ఇంధనం, సామాజిక సంస్థలు ఇందులో ఉన్నాయి.

ఎంటర్‌ప్రైజ్ టెక్నాలజీలో Microsoft, Sprinklr పాల్గొన్నాయి. అనలిటిక్స్, ఐటీ కన్సల్టింగ్ సమూహంలో Tata Consultancy Services అత్యధిక నియామకాలు చేసింది. బ్యాంకింగ్, బీమాలో Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, NaBFID ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి పాల్గొన్న సంస్థల ఉదాహరణలు మాత్రమే; జీతం లేదా స్టైపెండ్ ర్యాంకింగ్ కాదు.

అక్టోబర్ 30 అధికారిక ప్రకటన

ఇంకా ఏ గణాంకాలు రావాలి?

సమగ్ర ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ ప్రకటన తరువాత వస్తుందని IIMA తెలిపింది. ఈ క్లస్టర్ ప్రకటనలో బ్యాచ్ మొత్తపు సగటు లేదా మధ్యస్థ స్టైపెండ్, ఎంపికైన విద్యార్థుల పూర్తి సంఖ్య, సంస్థలవారీ తుది ఆఫర్ల పట్టిక లేవు. పాత బ్యాచ్ వివరాలతో ఈ లోటును పూరించవద్దు.

ఈ సమాచారం సమ్మర్ ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్‌లకు సంబంధించినది. MBA తరువాత పూర్తి కాల ఉద్యోగాలకు జరిగే తుది ప్లేస్‌మెంట్లతో ఇది ఒకే కొలమానం కాదు. సంస్థలను పోల్చేటప్పుడు లేదా కోర్సు ఫీజుకు ప్రయోజనాన్ని అంచనా వేసేటప్పుడు రెండింటినీ వేరుగా చూడండి.

కళాశాలల ఎంపికలో ఎలా ఉపయోగించాలి?

మీరు తెలుసుకోవాలనుకునే పని నుంచి మొదలుపెట్టండి. ఒక రంగం కనిపిస్తే ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్ పని ఏమిటి, ఏ నైపుణ్యాలు కావాలి, నియామక సంస్థల పరిధి ఎంత విస్తృతం వంటి ప్రశ్నలు అడగండి. ఒక కంపెనీ పేరు ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన భవిష్యత్ బ్యాచ్‌కు ఎన్ని అవకాశాలు వస్తాయో తెలియదు.

సంఖ్యలను పోల్చేందుకు ఒకే ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ రకం, ఒకే బ్యాచ్‌కు చెందిన నివేదికలను తీసుకోండి. స్టైపెండ్ నెలవారీదా, మొత్తం ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్‌కా అనేది చూడండి. నేపథ్యం కోసం క్లస్టర్ 2 వార్తను చదివి, సమగ్ర ఫలితాల కోసం అధికారిక ప్రకటనలను చూడండి. సంస్థ చెప్పని సంఖ్యను ఊహించవద్దు.

క్లస్టర్ 2 వార్త. అధికారిక ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ ప్రకటనలు.

title: CBSE 10 ಮತ್ತು 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 2027: ದಿನಾಂಕ, ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ
description: 10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (ಕೋಡ್ 415) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 18 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (ಕೋಡ್ 821) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 7 ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.
content:
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (ಕೋಡ್ 415) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 18 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (ಕೋಡ್ 821) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 7 ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.

2026ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 6ರಂದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ CBSE ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿವರಗಳಿವೆ. ಇದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ದಾಖಲೆ; ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. CBSE ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯವಿದೆ?

ತರಗತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಕೋಡ್ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕಸಮಯ (IST)ಅವಧಿ
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ: Multi-media41518 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 202710:30 - 12:302 ಗಂಟೆ
12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ: Multi-media8217 ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 202710:30 - 12:302 ಗಂಟೆ

ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರೌಢ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿ, 6 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 4: ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ. ಮೂಲ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟ ನೋಡಿ

ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರೌಢ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿ, 6 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 12: ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ. ಮೂಲ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟ ನೋಡಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ

ಪುಟ 4, 12ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ತರಗತಿಯ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ನೋಡಿ, ನಂತರ 415, 821 ಕೋಡ್ ಹುಡುಕಿ. ಒಂದೇ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಯದ ಕೋಶ ಹಲವು ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬಹುದು. ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿಸಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಾಲನ್ನೂ ಓದಿ.

ಶಾಲೆಯ ನೋಂದಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಠ್ಯವಿಷಯದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ತರಗತಿಗೂ ಅದೇ ಹೆಸರಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯ ಸಾಲನ್ನಷ್ಟೇ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ

10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (415) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 18 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು; English Language and Literature (184) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 26 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 8 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಮಲ್ಟಿಮೀಡಿಯಾ (821) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 7 ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 2027ರಂದು; English Core (301) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 5 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 33 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ.

ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನವೂ ಓದಲು ರಜೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದರ್ಥವಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉಳಿದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ನಡುವೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಣಿಸಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಈ ಸಾಲು ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ನಿಗದಿತ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ, ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ, ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ತರಬೇಕಾದ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಚಾರಿಸಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರದೊಳಗೆ ಸಂವಹನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಒಯ್ಯಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ CBSE ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

title: Scholarship Payment Stuck? Check These Portal and Bank Mismatch Traps
description: National Scholarship Portal payment stuck? Find whether approval, processing or bank-credit failure is delaying your scholarship, and take the right next step.
content:
A National Scholarship Portal payment can stay unpaid even after your application shows approval. That status may cover scrutiny only, while department processing or a bank-credit failure is still pending. Check the stage before changing any details or submitting another form.

Keep your application ID, status screenshot, passbook or bank statement and any payment reference ready. Compare the submitted name, account number, IFSC and Aadhaar seeding status with your current bank records.

Why is your National Scholarship Portal payment still pending?

An approved application is not the same as money credited. On the National Scholarship Portal, institute or department verification, payment processing and bank credit are separate points in the chain. The right contact depends on the status shown.

Status shownWhat it usually meansYour next action
Verification pendingInstitute or department review is incompleteContact the scholarship nodal officer
Application approvedScrutiny has cleared the applicationCheck the separate payment record
Payment processedTransfer has been sent for creditAsk the bank to trace it
Payment failed or returnedCredit could not reach the accountFind and correct the failed detail

This separation matters. A bank cannot complete college verification, and a college may not be able to repair a returned transfer without bank evidence.

Which bank mismatches can block National Scholarship Portal payment?

One wrong account digit, an inactive account, a changed IFSC after branch changes, or Aadhaar linked to another account can stop or return a transfer. A name difference may also need checking, but only the bank or scheme authority can confirm the exact rejection reason.

  • Match every account-number digit with the passbook or statement.
  • Confirm that the account is active and can receive government transfers.
  • Ask the bank which account is currently linked or seeded with Aadhaar.
  • Recheck the IFSC if the branch merged, moved or changed systems.
  • Save written confirmation of any correction.

What should you do after a failed scholarship payment?

Record the displayed status first. Ask the bank for the failure or trace details, then share them with your institute’s scholarship nodal officer. The responsible ministry or department decides the correction and grievance route for each scheme, so verify the current instruction on its official portal before making a change.

  1. Do not submit a duplicate application just to restart payment.
  2. If payment is processed but not credited, request a bank trace using the transaction details.
  3. Keep the bank response, screenshots and application ID together.
  4. Use the relevant grievance route if the nodal officer cannot resolve the case.

Never share an OTP, ATM PIN or banking password with anyone promising to release funds. You can also find scholarships, but keep the existing claim active until its status is formally closed.
author: Geethika Reddy
meta_title: National Scholarship Portal Payment Stuck? Fix It
meta_description: National Scholarship Portal payment stuck? Check approval, processing and bank errors, then take the right action to trace or correct your scholarship.

title: Psychological Disorders Class 12 One Shot Revision 2026 | Psychology CBSE Quick Notes
description: Quick one-shot revision notes for Psychological Disorders Class 12 CBSE 2026. Important definitions, anxiety disorders, mood disorders, schizophrenia, and exam tips included.
content:
Psychological Disorders Class 12 – One Shot Revision (CBSE 2026)

If your Class 12 Psychology Board Exam is near, this is your one-shot quick revision of the entire Psychological Disorders chapter. This unit is very high-weightage and often includes both theory and case-study questions.

Revise these points properly and you can easily score full marks from this chapter.

1. Meaning of Abnormal Behaviour (Very Important)

Definition:

Behaviour that is deviant, distressing, dysfunctional, or dangerous.

4 D’s of Abnormality:

  • Deviance

  • Distress

  • Dysfunction

  • Danger

These are frequently asked in 3–5 mark questions.

2. Anxiety Disorders (Highly Repeated)

Meaning:

Excessive fear and anxiety without real danger.

Types:

Type Key Feature
Generalised Anxiety Disorder (GAD) Constant worry
Phobia Irrational fear
Panic Disorder Sudden panic attacks
Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) Repeated thoughts & actions
Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) Trauma-related fear

Anxiety disorders are commonly asked in long answers and case studies.

3. Mood Disorders (Very Important)

Major Depressive Disorder:

  • Persistent sadness

  • Loss of interest

  • Low energy

  • Sleep disturbance

Bipolar Disorder:

  • Extreme mood swings

  • Mania + Depression

Mood disorders are simple and scoring.

4. Schizophrenia (Very High Probability Question)

Meaning:

Severe mental disorder affecting thinking, emotions, and behaviour.

Symptoms:

✔ Delusions (False beliefs)
✔ Hallucinations (False perceptions)
✔ Disorganized speech
✔ Emotional flatness

Schizophrenia is frequently asked in 5-mark questions.

5. Somatic Symptom & Related Disorders

  • Physical symptoms without medical cause

  • Person believes they are seriously ill

Short notes are commonly asked.

6. Dissociative Disorders

  • Loss of memory or identity

  • Example: Dissociative Amnesia

Usually appears in short answer format.

Case Study Preparation (Very Important)

CBSE often gives situations like:

  • Person afraid of heights → Phobia

  • Repeated hand washing → OCD

  • Extreme sadness → Depression

  • Hearing voices → Schizophrenia

Always:

  1. Identify disorder

  2. Define it

  3. Mention symptoms

5-Mark Sure Shot Areas

Topic Why Important
Anxiety Disorders Repeated
Schizophrenia Very High Weightage
Mood Disorders Common
4 D’s of Abnormality Conceptual

How to Write Answers in Exam

✔ Start with definition
✔ Use headings & bullet points
✔ Mention symptoms clearly
✔ Give example
✔ Underline keywords

Structured answers get higher marks.

30-Minute Quick Revision Plan

Time Task
10 min Anxiety Disorders
5 min Mood Disorders

title: BTech College Claims: Verify AICTE Approval, NBA and NAAC Separately
description: Learn how AICTE approval, NBA accreditation and NAAC grading differ, and what parents should verify before paying BTech fees or trusting placement claims.
content:
One college can be AICTE-approved, have NBA accreditation for only one engineering programme, and hold a separate NAAC grade for the institution. These are three different checks, not three badges for the same claim. Before you pay BTech fees, match each statement to the authority and the exact programme or campus it covers.

Start by checking the college’s legal name, campus, course title and current status in the relevant official records. A glossy brochure is not proof.

What do AICTE, NBA and NAAC actually cover?

AuthorityWhat it relates toWhat it doesn’t prove
AICTEApproval and regulatory permission for eligible technical education institutions or programmes, where applicableThat every branch has NBA accreditation or that placements will meet a promised figure
NBAAccreditation of a specific programme, such as BTech Computer Science or Mechanical EngineeringThat the entire college, all branches or every future batch carries the same status
NAACAssessment and grade of the institution as a wholeThat one BTech programme is NBA-accredited or that its fee offers good value

The programme-level point matters most. If a college says “NBA accredited”, ask: accredited for which branch, at which campus, and for which period? A student joining Civil Engineering cannot treat accreditation shown for Computer Science as a personal guarantee.

How should you test placement and fee claims?

AICTE approval or an NAAC grade doesn’t certify salary promises. Ask for the placement report for your branch, the number of eligible and placed students, the median or average package, recruiter names, internship details and the definition of “highest package”. Check whether the report covers the same campus and graduating batch you’re considering.

Fees deserve the same sharp check. Compare the approved fee notice, university charges, hostel costs, examination fees and refundable deposits with the amount demanded at admission. Keep screenshots or signed documents. Verbal assurances vanish when disputes begin.

A safer admission file for parents

  1. Write the exact institution, campus and BTech branch on one page.
  2. Record AICTE status separately from NBA status and NAAC grade.
  3. Save the relevant approval or accreditation record with its date and scope.
  4. Ask the admissions office to explain any mismatch in writing.
  5. Compare the claim with colleges listed on our college comparison page and review similar programmes through our course listings.

If a sales counsellor uses one badge to answer all three questions, slow down. The missing detail may affect recognition, transfer decisions, credibility with employers and whether the fees make sense.

title: KMAT 2026: ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31ರೊಳಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ; ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ನವೆಂಬರ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಸಮಯ
description: KMAT 2026 ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31ರಂದು ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ₹1,230 ಶುಲ್ಕ, ನವೆಂಬರ್ 14ರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಇನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರಕಟವಾಗದ ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರದ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
content:
KMAT 2026 ನವೆಂಬರ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ನೋಂದಣಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31, 2026. MBA ಅಥವಾ MCAಯ ಒಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ₹1,230 ಶುಲ್ಕ ಎಂದು ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ತಿಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿ GST ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ಲಾಟ್‌ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಸೇರಿವೆ. ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವಿದೆ, ಆದರೆ ಮುಕ್ತಾಯದ ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿಯವರೆಗೂ ಪಾವತಿ ಸಾಧ್ಯ ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ನವೆಂಬರ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಕಿಯಿರುವ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಶನಿವಾರ, ನವೆಂಬರ್ 14, 2026ರಂದು MBA ಮತ್ತು MCA ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 10:00ರಿಂದ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 12:00ರವರೆಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಎಂದು ಇದೆ. ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಇನ್ನೂ TBA ಎಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತಿವೆ. ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಬದಲಾಗಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

KPPGCAಯ KMAT 2026 ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ ನೀಡಿಲ್ಲ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ.

ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು Register, ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ನೋಂದಾಯಿಸಿದವರು Login ಬಳಸಬಹುದು. ಶಾಲೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿರುವಂತೆ ಹೆಸರು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ. ಸರಿಯಾದ MBA ಅಥವಾ MCA ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಿಂದ ಅಂಕಗಳ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ತಪ್ಪಾಗಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಗರಿಷ್ಠ 200 KB ಪಾಸ್‌ಪೋರ್ಟ್ ಗಾತ್ರದ ಭಾವಚಿತ್ರ ಹಾಗೂ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಸೂಚಿಸಿರುವಂತೆ 200 KB ಸಹಿಯ ಸ್ಕ್ಯಾನ್ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸಿ. ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ವೇಳೆ ಕಾಣಿಸುವ ಫೈಲ್ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನೂ ಪಾಲಿಸಿ. ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪದವಿ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ, ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿಸಿ, ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿಯ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಜಿಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

MBA ಮತ್ತು MCA ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಕುವುದಾದರೆ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟನೆ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ

ಎರಡೂ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಹಾಲ್ ಟಿಕೆಟ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಆದರೆ ಈಗಿನ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಒಂದೇ ಸಮಯವಿದೆ. ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಪಾವತಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಹೇಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸಹಾಯವಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ. ಒಂದು ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅಥವಾ ಒಂದು ಪಾವತಿ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಸಾಕು ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಮನೆಯಿಂದ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ದೂರಸ್ಥ ಮೇಲ್ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ತಿಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಸಾಧನಗಳ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಗೆ ಮುಂದೆ ಬರುವ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರದ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಂತಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ KMAT ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿ ಏನನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಲೇಖನ ಓದಿ. ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ಭರವಸೆಯಲ್ಲ.

title: GATE 2027 Application Process Begins: Essential Documents, Eligibility Criteria, and PSU Recruitment Directives
description: Comprehensive guide to GATE 2027 registration, covering eligibility norms, required documents, step-by-step application procedures, and PSU recruitment directives for students and parents.
content:
GATE 2027 Application Portal Opens for Engineering and Science Graduates

The Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) 2027 official registration portal is now operational. Administered by designated Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) alongside IISc Bengaluru on a rotational basis, GATE serves as the standard evaluation benchmark for postgraduate admissions across premier Indian universities. Beyond academic progression, GATE scores act as the primary filtering mechanism for executive and trainee engineer recruitment across major Indian Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

For engineering, technology, architecture, and science graduates, timely registration with accurate documentation is critical. Parents and candidates are advised to carefully review the published registration requirements, eligibility norms, and job directives to ensure a smooth application experience.

GATE 2027 Eligibility Criteria: Who Can Apply?

The organizing body maintains standard eligibility parameters to accommodate both final-year university students and working professionals. Candidates must verify their qualifications before starting the online application.

  • Academic Qualification: Candidates currently pursuing the 3rd year or higher of any undergraduate degree program in Engineering, Technology, Architecture, Science, Commerce, or Humanities are eligible. Graduates who have completed their degree from government-recognized institutions are also fully eligible.
  • Age Limit: There is no upper age limit for appearing in the GATE 2027 examination.
  • Pass Certificate Status: Final-year students are not required to upload a completion certificate during registration, but must submit an official certificate or mark sheet signed by their head of department or principal.
  • Nationality: Indian national candidates, as well as foreign nationals fulfilling prescribed academic equivalencies, can register.

Mandatory Documents Required for GOAPS Registration

Errors in uploaded documents lead to application rejection or delay during processing. Candidates should prepare clear scanned copies of all required files according to official size and format guidelines prior to initiating registration on the GATE Online Application Processing System (GOAPS).

Checklist of Essential Documents:

  • Passport Photograph: High-resolution photograph with a white or light-colored background taken within the last six months.
  • Applicant Signature: Clear signature on white paper using black or dark blue ink.
  • Category Certificate: Valid SC, ST, or OBC-NCL certificate issued by competent state or central authorities, if claiming fee concessions or seat relaxation.
  • PwD Certificate: Official disability certificate signed by an authorized medical board, if applicable.
  • Identity Proof: Valid Government ID (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, PAN Card, or Driving License) containing photo and date of birth details.
  • Educational Certificates: Final degree certificate, provisional degree certificate, or an official course completion certificate for current final-year students.

Step-by-Step Guide to Complete GATE 2027 Application

Completing the application involves a structured process via the official GOAPS portal. Applicants are urged to carefully verify each step before making payment.

1. Registration on GOAPS

Visit the official portal, enter full name, valid mobile number, and active email address. Create a strong password to generate an Enrollment ID.

2. Filling the Application Form

Log in using the generated Enrollment ID and password. Select preferred examination papers, choose up to three exam cities, and fill in personal and educational details accurately.

3. Document Upload

Upload scanned copies of photograph, signature, photo identity proof, and category certificates according to strict specification limits.

4. Application Fee Payment

Pay the non-refundable registration fee using net banking, UPI, credit card, or debit card. Ensure confirmation receipt is generated and saved.

5. Final Review and Submission

Preview the entire application form before pressing final submission. Download and store a printed copy of the final application confirmation for future reference.

PSU Recruitment Directives via GATE 2027

Scores achieved in GATE 2027 form the initial shortlist threshold for premier Public Sector Undertakings. Organizations in energy, infrastructure, manufacturing, and telecommunications utilize GATE scores instead of conducting separate preliminary written exams.

Key Highlights of PSU Hiring:

  • Separate Application Process: Registering for GATE does not automatically apply a candidate for PSU jobs. Candidates must apply individually on each PSU career portal using their GATE 2027 registration number.
  • Shortlisting Criteria: Shortlisting for Group Discussions (GD) and Personal Interviews (PI) relies heavily on GATE normalized marks and all-India ranks.
  • Direct Entry Positions: Roles usually offered include Management Trainee, Executive Engineer Trainee, Graduate Engineer Trainee, and Assistant Executive Engineer.
  • Validity of Scorecard: While GATE scores remain valid for three years for university admissions, PSU recruitment typically considers only the score of the current exam year. Candidates must always verify individual PSU job notifications.

Parental Guidance and Strategic Tips for Applicants

Preparing for GATE demands discipline, detailed planning, and mental clarity. Parents can support candidates by helping maintain organized documentation, managing timeline milestones, and offering consistent encouragement.

  • Verify Details Early: Verify name spelling on photo IDs match degree records exactly to prevent issues at examination centers.
  • Monitor Official Announcements: Ensure dates, exam schedules, and portal updates are checked exclusively on official websites.
  • Maintain Focus: Balance preparation between conceptual understanding of core engineering subjects and practice with engineering mathematics and general aptitude sections.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can a candidate appear for two paper combinations in GATE 2027?

Yes. GATE permits candidates to apply for either one paper or an approved combination of two papers, subject to the official primary and secondary paper grid published by the organizing institute.

What is the validity period of the GATE 2027 scorecard?

The GATE scorecard remains valid for three years from the date of result declaration for postgraduate academic admissions. However, PSUs generally require a current-year GATE score for recruitment.

What should I do if there is a discrepancy in my uploaded documents?

Candidates are usually notified via SMS or email during document scrutiny. Corrections must be submitted within the specified correction window provided on the GOAPS portal. Always verify official authority websites for official instructions.

description: MCCची तात्पुरती यादी प्रवेशाची हमी देत नाही. 30 ऑक्टोबरची सूचना वाचा आणि वाटप झालेल्या कॉलेजला जाण्यापूर्वी अंतिम निकाल तपासा.
content:
NEET MDS 2026च्या तिसऱ्या फेरीच्या तात्पुरत्या यादीत जागा दिसणे म्हणजे अंतिम वाटप झाले असे नाही. MCCच्या 30 ऑक्टोबरच्या सूचनेनुसार अंतिम निकाल जाहीर झाल्यानंतरच वाटप झालेल्या कॉलेजशी संपर्क साधावा. प्रवेशासाठी निघण्यापूर्वी निकालाचा प्रकार तपासा.

तात्पुरत्या यादीचा अर्थ काय?

MCCनुसार ही यादी सूचक आहे आणि बदलू शकते. त्यात दिसणाऱ्या जागेवर उमेदवाराचा हक्क निर्माण होत नाही. त्यामुळे तात्पुरत्या नोंदीचा स्क्रीनशॉट अंतिम वाटप किंवा पुढील प्रवेश सूचनांचा पर्याय नाही.

वैद्यकीय समुपदेशन समितीची 30 ऑक्टोबर 2026ची सूचना. MCCची मूळ सूचना वाचा.

विसंगती कळवण्याची मुदत संपली

उमेदवाराच्या लॉगिनमधील Candidates Grievances And Query Redressal Systemमार्फत 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026 सकाळी 10 वाजेपर्यंत विसंगती कळवता येत होती. ही मुदत संपली आहे. ईमेल, नवी तक्रार किंवा बातमीच्या मथळ्यामुळे मुदत वाढली असे समजू नका. आधी तक्रार दिली असल्यास पोचपावती जतन करा आणि लॉगिनमध्ये आलेल्या उत्तरानुसार पुढे जा.

आता अंतिम निकाल तपासा

  1. MCCच्या MDS समुपदेशन पानावर तिसऱ्या फेरीच्या निकालाचे पूर्ण नाव वाचा. सध्या जोडलेली सूचना तात्पुरत्या निकालाची आहे.

  2. MCCने अंतिम निकाल जाहीर केल्यावर जुन्या स्क्रीनशॉटवर अवलंबून न राहता स्वतःची नोंद पुन्हा तपासा.

  3. त्यानंतर प्रवास किंवा प्रवेश शुल्क भरण्यापूर्वी सध्याच्या रिपोर्टिंग सूचना आणि वाटप झालेल्या संस्थेच्या आवश्यकता वाचा.

MCCचे MDS समुपदेशन पान

अर्जाचा तपशील, जतन केलेले पसंतीक्रम आणि तक्रारीची पोचपावती एकत्र ठेवा. आधीचे फेरी 3 नोंदणी मार्गदर्शन मागील टप्पा समजावते; नोंदणीच्या तारखांवरून वाटप अंतिम झाल्याची खात्री होत नाही.

title: आयआयएम बेंगळुरू समर प्लेसमेंट: 608 विद्यार्थ्यांना ऑफर, मासिक विद्यावेतन समजून घ्या
description: आयआयएम बेंगळुरूच्या सर्व 608 सहभागी विद्यार्थ्यांना ऑफर मिळाल्या. मासिक मध्यक, सरासरी विद्यावेतन आणि कन्सल्टिंगचा वाटा जाणून घ्या.
content:
आयआयएम बेंगळुरूच्या 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026च्या घोषणेनुसार, PGP आणि PGPBAच्या 2026-28 तुकड्यांतील सर्व 608 सहभागी विद्यार्थ्यांना समर प्लेसमेंट ऑफर मिळाल्या. 26-29 ऑक्टोबरदरम्यान झालेल्या प्रक्रियेत 128 संस्था सहभागी होत्या. एमबीए पर्यायांची तुलना करताना हे मासिक इंटर्नशिप विद्यावेतनाचे आकडे आहेत, वार्षिक पगाराचे पॅकेज नाहीत, हे लक्षात ठेवा.

मोजमाप

संस्थेने जाहीर केलेला आकडा

हे आकडे अधिकृत समर प्लेसमेंट घोषणामधील आहेत. 100% निकाल या प्रक्रियेत सहभागी झालेल्या 608 विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी आहे. भावी अर्जदाराला हमी म्हणून किंवा संस्थेच्या सर्व अभ्यासक्रमांचा निकाल म्हणून तो वाचू नये.

कन्सल्टिंग आघाडीवर, इतर क्षेत्रांतही संधी

संस्थेने 22 कंपन्यांकडून 308 कन्सल्टिंग ऑफर नोंदवल्या आहेत. वित्त, तंत्रज्ञान, उत्पादनाशी संबंधित काम, विपणन आणि सामान्य व्यवस्थापन यांचाही घोषणेत समावेश आहे. सहभागी संस्थांपैकी सुमारे 40% पहिल्यांदाच भरतीसाठी आल्या होत्या.

विशिष्ट करिअरचे ध्येय असलेल्या विद्यार्थ्याला एकूण प्लेसमेंट टक्केवारीपेक्षा क्षेत्रनिहाय संधींची माहिती अधिक उपयुक्त ठरू शकते. तुमच्या आवडीच्या क्षेत्रातील भूमिका आणि नियोक्त्यांचे तपशील वाचा. मोठा एकूण आकडा म्हणजे प्रत्येक कामाच्या प्रकारात सारख्याच संधी आहेत असे नाही.

मध्यक आणि सरासरी वेगवेगळी माहिती देतात

विद्यावेतनाच्या रकमा क्रमाने मांडल्यावर मध्यभागी येणारे मूल्य म्हणजे मध्यक. सर्व रकमांची बेरीज त्यांच्या संख्येने भागल्यावर सरासरी मिळते. प्रत्येक विद्यार्थ्याला किती मिळाले हे यांपैकी कोणताही आकडा सांगत नाही. समर इंटर्नशिपची मासिक रक्कम गुणून वार्षिक पगाराचा अंदाज काढू नका.

दुसऱ्या बिझनेस स्कूलशी तुलना करताना ते मासिक विद्यावेतन, संपूर्ण इंटर्नशिपची रक्कम की पूर्णवेळ नोकरीचा पगार सांगते हे आधी पाहा. तुकडी आणि प्लेसमेंट चक्रही जुळवा. वेगळ्या एककांची तुलना खरा फरक नसतानाही एखादा अभ्यासक्रम चांगला किंवा कमी दर्जाचा वाटायला लावू शकते.

अभ्यासक्रम समजून घेण्यासाठी घोषणेसोबत आयआयएम बेंगळुरूची PGP आणि PGPBA पाने वाचा. आमचे आयआयएम अहमदाबाद क्लस्टर 3 स्पष्टीकरण उपलब्ध भूमिका आणि प्लेसमेंट मिळालेले विद्यार्थी यांच्या संख्येतील फरक स्पष्ट करते.

title: JoSAA Float or Freeze: Which Choice Protects Your Current Seat?
description: JoSAA float or freeze explained through seat security, upgrade chances, payment and the checks students must complete after allotment.
content:
In JoSAA counselling, freeze ends your upgrade route for the allotted institute and programme, while float keeps you open to a higher preference in a later round. Neither choice protects anything by itself: you must complete the seat acceptance steps shown in your JoSAA account.

So the real question isn’t “Which option sounds safer?” It’s this: would you join the seat you have today if no better allotment appears?

What do float and freeze change?

ChoiceSeat positionWhat remains possibleChoose it when
FreezeYou accept the allotted institute and programme as finalNo further JoSAA upgrade for that allotmentYou’d join this exact course and campus without second thoughts
FloatYou retain the allotted seat, subject to completing the required processMovement to a higher preference if JoSAA allots it laterYou would definitely prefer a higher programme or institute

Float is not a free trial. If no upgrade comes, the present allotment can remain the seat you must join or act on. That makes your fallback decision more important than the label on the screen.

When does freezing make sense?

Freeze when the branch, institute, location, fees and joining conditions already work for your family. A student who would choose an allotted Computer Science programme over every remaining preference gains certainty by closing the upgrade route.

Don’t freeze just because the payment window feels stressful. Read the allotted institute and programme carefully, then ask: “If this is my final seat, will I still report?” If yes, freeze is a sensible choice.

When is float the better risk?

Choose float only when a higher preference genuinely beats the seat in hand. For example, you may accept your present branch today but still prefer a different programme or institute listed above it. If that higher preference is allotted, your next reporting plan may change.

JoSAA is the responsible counselling authority, but its permitted choices, deadlines and instructions can change by year and round. Treat the notice and status displayed in your account as the working record, not a message forwarded in a student group.

Complete these checks before submitting

  1. Note the exact institute and programme allotted, then compare them with your preference order.
  2. Complete the payment, document submission and verification actions shown for your round.
  3. Save the acknowledgement and check whether verification is complete or requires correction.
  4. Decide where you’ll report if no upgrade arrives.

Keep an eye on your registered email and the JoSAA portal after each round. If you’re also weighing another entrance route, compare the timelines in our entrance exam comparison section, but don’t let that distract you from an incomplete JoSAA action.
author: Geethika Reddy

1. Make a Study Plan Based on Each Subject: Split the time you have for studying according to when each exam's scheduled. Focus more on the subjects that are harder for you.

2. Finish the NCERT Curriculum: Pay attention to the NCERT books. Study the ideas, the formulas, the definitions, and the exercises in each chapter.

3. Work on Past Exam Papers: Solve papers from years ago to get a feel for the types of questions, how marks are given, and what topics are most common.

4. Try Sample Papers: Practice, with the sample papers provided by CBSE. Do them in the amount of time as the real exam to build speed and accuracy.

5. Create Quick Revision Notes: Write down formulas, pictures, dates, definitions, and key ideas so you can review them easily later.

6. Manage Your Time Well: Keep a balance between studying, taking mock tests, and practicing so you don't get overwhelmed.

Students in science, commerce, and arts streams need to look at their specific exam schedules and get ready properly. Finishing the course, solving sample papers, and going over topics often will help students feel sure of themselves when taking the big board exams.

title: NEET UG 2026 Round 2 AIQ and State Quota Dual Seat Holding Rules: Verification Data Exchange Deadlines and Forfeiture Clause
description: Comprehensive guide to NEET UG 2026 Round 2 AIQ and State Quota dual seat holding regulations, shared candidate data exchange timelines, exit penalties, and security deposit forfeiture rules.
content:
Navigating NEET UG 2026 Round 2 All India Quota and State Counseling Rules

The Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) and state counseling authorities operate under strict regulatory frameworks to streamline MBBS and BDS admissions. As Round 2 counseling approaches, candidates must understand the updated regulations governing dual seat holding across 15% All India Quota (AIQ) and 85% State Quota seats. Holding two seats simultaneously is prohibited under national counseling guidelines to prevent seat blocking and ensure merit-based allotment efficiency.

The Mechanism of Data Verification Exchange

To eliminate duplicate admissions, MCC exchanges candidate admission databases with State Counseling Authorities. Upon the completion of Round 2 joining procedures, shared verification portals match candidate roll numbers, National Identity details, and allotment records across AIQ and State databases. If a candidate secures and joins a seat in Round 2 of AIQ, their details are automatically shared with all state authorities, barring them from participating in state Round 2 or subsequent state counseling rounds.

Understanding Dual Seat Holding Restrictions and Penalties

Under Supreme Court directives and Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) guidelines, seat holding across multiple quotas is strictly regulated. Candidates must choose their preferred seat before the designated reporting deadline for Round 2.

Key Provisions of the Exit and Security Deposit Forfeiture Clause

  • Exit with Forfeiture in Round 2: Candidates allotted a seat in AIQ Round 2 who choose not to join can exit, but their refundable security deposit will be forfeited. They remain eligible to participate in the AIQ Mop-Up or Stray Vacancy Round.
  • Joining Penalty: Candidates who accept and report to their allotted AIQ Round 2 seat cannot resign from the seat. Their names are submitted to the national blocked list, preventing them from joining state quota seats.
  • State Quota Reciprocity: State counseling bodies enforce matching rules. A candidate who joins a state Round 2 seat must resign within the permissible window; otherwise, their data is transmitted to MCC, removing them from AIQ stray vacancy eligibility.

Step-by-Step Reporting Timeline and Critical Deadlines

Timelines must be followed precisely to protect counseling deposits and preserve admission eligibility across quotas.

Counseling StageAction RequiredConsequence of Non-Compliance
AIQ Round 2 Allotment ResultCheck allotment status on the official MCC portal.Inaction leads to automatic seat cancellation.
AIQ Round 2 Joining WindowReport physically to the allotted college with original documents.Non-reporting forfeits security deposit; candidate can exit AIQ Round 2.
Data Portal ReconciliationMCC and State Authorities exchange joined candidate lists.Joined candidates are locked into their respective systems.
State Round 2 Final AllotmentVerify eligibility based on MCC released blocked candidate lists.Blocked candidates cannot be allotted state seats.

Actionable Advice for Aspirants and Parents

To avoid legal complications, financial forfeiture, or losing a valid medical seat, candidates should adopt a strategic approach during counseling:

  1. Evaluate Preferences Prior to Choice Filling: Clearly prioritize between an AIQ college and a State Quota seat before submitting final choices for Round 2.
  2. Track Reporting Deadlines: Always monitor the official MCC portal (mcc.nic.in) and respective state counseling websites for real-time schedule updates and database reconciliation announcements.
  3. Understand Exit Deadlines: If a state seat is preferred over an AIQ Round 2 seat, ensure you exit the AIQ seat before physically reporting, accepting the forfeiture of the initial deposit to retain state eligibility.

Frequently Asked Questions

What happens if I get a seat in AIQ Round 2 and do not join?

If you are allotted a seat in AIQ Round 2 and do not join, you can exit the round. However, your initial security deposit will be forfeited. You remain eligible to register and participate in subsequent counseling rounds.

Can a candidate hold seats in both AIQ Round 2 and State Quota Round 2 simultaneously?

No. Dual seat holding is prohibited. Once a candidate physically reports and joins a college in either AIQ Round 2 or State Quota Round 2, shared data verification locks their profile, making them ineligible for seat allotment in the other quota.

How do authorities track if a candidate has taken admission elsewhere?

MCC and State Counseling Authorities use a shared central candidate database. After Round 2 reporting, joined candidate details are matched electronically across state and central portals to identify and block duplicate candidates.

Is security deposit refund possible if I resign after joining an AIQ Round 2 seat?

Resignation after physically joining an AIQ Round 2 seat is generally not permitted under standard DGHS guidelines, and the security deposit is non-refundable upon joining.

Empowering Women Through Higher Education in Bihar

Higher education for female students in Bihar is entering a transformative phase with the establishment of Bihar Mahila Vishwavidyalaya. Designed to serve as a flagship institution for women's learning, research, and leadership development, the university aims to address regional gender disparities in higher learning. For parents and prospective students planning their academic pathways in 2026, understanding the admission framework, institutional structure, and financial assistance schemes is essential.

Bihar Mahila Vishwavidyalaya Admission Vision 2026

The admission vision of Bihar Mahila Vishwavidyalaya centers on accessibility, academic rigor, and inclusive growth. The university provides diverse academic tracks across undergraduate, postgraduate, and professional diploma disciplines.

Key Admission Pillars

  • Single-Window Digital Application: Prospective candidates can apply through a centralized digital portal designed to streamline application submission, document verification, and fee payment.
  • Merit and Entrance Dual Track: Undergraduate programs primarily utilize qualifying examination scores along with state common entrance scores where applicable. Postgraduate admissions emphasize merit combined with subject specific screening.
  • Skill-Integrated Curricula: Programs incorporate practical training, digital literacy, and vocational skills alongside traditional humanities, science, and commerce streams.
  • Reservation and Inclusive Policies: Admissions strictly follow state regulatory norms, offering dedicated quotas for economically weaker sections, rural background applicants, and reserve categories.

The All-Women Faculty Model: Academic Leadership and Campus Safety

A distinctive feature of Bihar Mahila Vishwavidyalaya is its commitment to an all-women faculty model across teaching and academic administration. This operational model is designed to foster a safe, supportive, and highly inspiring academic atmosphere.

Benefits of an All-Women Academic Staff

  • Direct Mentorship: Female professors act as accessible role models, encouraging young women to pursue non-traditional fields like data science, biotechnology, and advanced research.
  • Safe Campus Environment: Parents frequently prioritize campus security. An all-women instructional framework creates an environment focused on confidence building and personal safety.
  • Focused Leadership Opportunities: Students are encouraged to take charge of campus societies, student councils, research journals, and community outreach projects without gender biased hurdles.

Balika PhD Fellowship: Funding Higher Research

To retain local talent and encourage advanced scholarly work, the institution has introduced the Balika PhD Fellowship scheme. This financial aid package helps deserving female researchers complete doctoral studies without financial distress.

Fellowship Highlights and Eligibility

  • Financial Grant: Selected scholars receive a monthly research stipend alongside a yearly contingency fund to cover book purchases, field work, and laboratory consumables.
  • Eligibility Criteria: Applicants must hold a recognized master degree with prescribed minimum percentage marks. Preference is extended to permanent residents of Bihar and scholars pursuing socially relevant research topics.
  • Focus Research Areas: Priority funding is allocated to projects addressing rural development, healthcare innovation, environmental sustainability, local art preservation, and female entrepreneurship.
  • Selection Mechanism: Candidates are selected through a written research aptitude test followed by a presentation before an expert doctoral review panel.

Essential Advice for Parents and Prospective Students

Navigating university admissions requires early preparation and verification of official notifications. Families evaluating Bihar Mahila Vishwavidyalaya should keep the following practical tips in mind:

  • Verify Course Affiliations: Ensure that selected academic degree programs align with recognized state university regulations and UGC guidelines.
  • Prepare Documentation Early: Keep scanned copies of educational certificates, domicile documents, category certificates, and identity proofs ready prior to registration deadlines.
  • Track Official Announcements: Regularly check official state higher education portals for exact seat capacity updates, counselling dates, and fee structures.

The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in science, arts, commerce, computer applications, and vocational training, along with doctoral research programs in selected departments.

Female postgraduate degree holders who satisfy academic percentage requirements and pass the university doctoral entrance evaluation are eligible. Preference is often given to candidates holding Bihar domicile status.

3. Is the all-women faculty model implemented across all departments?

Yes, the institution aims to recruit qualified female professors, assistant professors, and academic administrators across all teaching departments to maintain a fully supportive academic ecosystem.

Applications are accepted online through the official admission portal. Students must register, fill in their academic details, select preferred courses, and submit the required documentation within the published timeline.

title: UPTET Result 2026 Declared: Pass Percentage Analysis, Marks Verification, and UP Super TET Eligibility
description: Comprehensive analysis of UPTET Result 2026 including Paper 1 and Paper 2 pass percentages, marks verification procedures, category cutoffs, and UP Super TET recruitment eligibility requirements.
content:
UPTET Result 2026: Official Announcement and Overview

The examination authority has officially declared the UPTET 2026 results for nearly 19 lakh registered candidates across Uttar Pradesh. Aspirants who appeared for Paper 1 (Primary Level for Classes 1 to 5) and Paper 2 (Upper Primary Level for Classes 6 to 8) can now check their individual scorecards online. The declaration marks a major milestone for teaching job seekers in the state, establishing eligibility for upcoming recruitment notifications.

Passing the Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test is mandatory for candidates aspiring to secure teacher appointments in state-run primary and upper primary schools. This article breaks down the overall performance metrics, explains the step-by-step marks verification process, and details the academic eligibility guidelines required to apply for the upcoming UP Super TET recruitment drive.

Paper 1 and Paper 2 Pass Percentage Analysis

The candidate performance in UPTET 2026 highlights strong success rates across both levels. High pass percentages reflect thorough preparation among candidates and structured examination evaluation.

Exam LevelTarget Teaching LevelPass PercentageGeneral CutoffReserved Cutoff
Paper 1Primary (Classes 1 to 5)80.07%60% (90/150)55% (82/150)
Paper 2Upper Primary (Classes 6 to 8)71.85%60% (90/150)55% (82/150)

Paper 1 recorded an impressive pass percentage of 80.07%, making a substantial pool of primary teachers eligible for future vacancies. Meanwhile, Paper 2 recorded a pass rate of 71.85% for candidates seeking upper primary teaching roles. Both metrics reflect robust candidate participation across test centers statewide.

How to Access Scorecard and Perform Marks Verification

Candidates can download their official scorecards through the designated state examination portal. Verifying all printed details on the marksheet immediately after downloading is crucial for preventing administrative issues during future candidate selection.

Steps to Download Your UPTET 2026 Scorecard:

  • Visit the official examination authority web portal (updeled.gov.in).
  • Select the UPTET 2026 Result link displayed on the primary homepage.
  • Enter your registration number, roll number, and security captcha code.
  • Click the submit button to display your detailed subject-wise marks statement.
  • Download the PDF scorecard and save multiple printed copies for administrative use.

Marks Verification and Correction Guidelines:

Upon downloading the scorecard, candidates must carefully verify their candidate name, father name, roll number, category designation, subject choices, and total qualifying marks. If an discrepancy appears on your digital scorecard, submit a formal grievance request to the examination board control room within the designated correction window. Candidates should also note that UPTET eligibility certificates carry lifetime validity, meaning qualified test-takers do not need to re-appear in future cycles unless they wish to improve their numerical score.

UPTET Qualifying Cutoff Criteria

The examination board enforces fixed category-based minimum qualifying thresholds out of a total 150 marks:

  • General / Unreserved Category: Candidates must secure a minimum score of 60 percent (90 out of 150 marks).
  • OBC / SC / ST / Differently Abled Categories: Candidates must secure a minimum score of 55 percent (82 out of 150 marks).

It is vital for candidates and parents to understand that qualifying UPTET provides teacher eligibility; it does not constitute a direct job offer or appointment order. Securing a teaching post requires qualifying in the subsequent Assistant Teacher Recruitment Exam, commonly referred to as UP Super TET.

UP Super TET Eligibility and Selection Framework

With UPTET results published, successful candidates must prepare for the upcoming UP Super TET recruitment. The recruitment exam evaluates subject knowledge, teaching aptitude, and general awareness to fill vacant teacher posts across state schools.

Educational Qualifications for Super TET:

  • Primary Level (Classes 1-5): A recognized Bachelor degree with a minimum of 50 percent aggregate marks, alongside D.El.Ed (BTC) or equivalent professional teacher training, AND a valid UPTET Paper 1 or CTET Paper 1 scorecard.
  • Upper Primary Level (Classes 6-8): A relevant Bachelor degree in Arts, Science, or Commerce, combined with D.El.Ed, B.Ed, or equivalent professional teaching qualifications, AND a valid UPTET Paper 2 or CTET Paper 2 scorecard.

Age Criteria:

General category applicants must be between 21 and 40 years of age on the notification cutoff date. Standard age relaxations apply for reserved category applicants under state rules, offering 5 years of relaxation for OBC, SC, and ST candidates, and up to 15 years for physically handicapped candidates.

Final Selection Merit Calculation:

Final recruitment selection for UP Super TET relies on a combined weightage model:

  • Academic Performance Weightage (40% total): 10% each from High School, Intermediate, Graduation, and Professional Teacher Training marks.
  • Written Super TET Examination (60% weightage): Score achieved in the Super TET competitive examination.

Strategic Next Steps for Candidates

Candidates who cleared UPTET 2026 should immediately organize their physical documents, including educational marksheets, professional training diplomas, category certificates, and domicile proofs. Concurrently, beginning structured preparation for the Super TET written syllabus across subjects such as Hindi, English, Mathematics, Environmental Studies, Pedagogy, and Current Affairs will place aspirants in a strong competitive position when formal recruitment vacancies are announced.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is UPTET certificate validity limited to a specific number of years?

No, the state government extended UPTET qualifying certificate validity to lifetime. Once passed, your certificate remains valid for lifetime recruitment opportunities.

Can CTET qualified candidates apply for UP Super TET?

Yes, candidates holding a valid CTET certificate are eligible to apply for UP Super TET recruitment, provided they satisfy all local academic qualification and domicile norms established by the state education board.

What is the minimum qualifying mark for general category candidates in UPTET?

General category candidates must score at least 60 percent, which equals 90 marks out of the total 150 marks, to pass the UPTET exam.

Where should I check official result updates if I notice technical errors online?

Always verify examination announcements directly on official Uttar Pradesh government educational portals (updeled.gov.in) to avoid unauthorized or unverified news updates.

title: SRMJEEE 2027 Exam Pattern: Questions, Marks & Duration
description: Discover the complete SRMJEEE 2027 exam pattern. Learn about the 125-mark structure, subject-wise question distribution, no negative marking rule, and exam duration.
content:
The SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination (SRMJEEE) evaluates candidates across core sciences, linguistic proficiency, and analytical aptitude through a rigorous 150-minute test. Understanding the exact layout of the computer-based test is the fundamental first step in designing an effective time-management strategy for the 2027 admission cycle. Because the university relies entirely on this entrance test to filter applicants for its highly competitive B.Tech programs, mastering the mechanics of the paper is just as important as mastering the syllabus.

Unlike many national-level engineering exams that strictly test Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, the SRMJEEE incorporates unique sections that evaluate a candidate's holistic capabilities. This comprehensive guide breaks down the total questions, the exact marking scheme, the testing mode, and the time management tactics required to maximize your merit rank.

Question Distribution and Subject Weightage

The SRMJEEE question paper contains a total of 125 Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs), adding up to a maximum possible score of 125 marks. The paper is divided into distinct sections, with the core sciences carrying the bulk of the weightage. Candidates applying for standard B.Tech programs (such as Computer Science or Mechanical Engineering) must attempt the Mathematics section, while those targeting Biotechnology or Biomedical Engineering must attempt the Biology section instead.

Marking Scheme and the Zero Negative Marking Advantage

A massive strategic advantage of the SRMJEEE over exams like JEE Main or BITSAT is the absolute lack of negative marking.

  • Correct Response: For every correct answer, you are awarded +1 mark.

  • Incorrect/Unattempted Response: You lose zero marks for incorrect or unattempted questions.

Because there is no penalty for guessing, candidates must ensure they attempt every single question on the paper before the timer expires. Leaving any question blank on your screen is a severe tactical error. If you encounter a highly complex calculus problem that consumes too much time, you should use logical elimination to make an educated guess, mark the response, and move forward without fear of losing points.

Examination Duration and Testing Mode

The total duration of the exam is exactly 2 hours and 30 minutes, which equates to 150 minutes of continuous testing time. Historically, SRMIST administers the SRMJEEE in a Remote Proctored Online Mode (RPOM). This format allows students to take the exam securely from their personal computers at home, utilizing an AI-monitored secure browser that records webcam and microphone feeds to ensure fair testing practices.

Managing 125 questions within a 150-minute window provides an average of 1.2 minutes per question. To succeed, candidates must rapidly clear the English and Aptitude sections-which consist of 15 highly scoring questions-to bank critical time for the calculation-heavy Mathematics and Physics sections.

Strategic Time Management Plan

To optimize your score, do not divide your 150 minutes equally among the five subjects. Adopt an asymmetric time allocation strategy:

  • English and Aptitude (15 Mins): Clear these 15 questions immediately. They require minimal calculation and rely on basic logic and reading comprehension.

  • Chemistry (30 Mins): Chemistry questions in the SRMJEEE are highly factual and derived directly from NCERT textbooks. Swiftly answering these 35 questions builds early momentum.

  • Physics (45 Mins): Dedicate a solid block of time to Physics, prioritizing direct formula applications in Modern Physics and Electrodynamics before tackling complex Mechanics problems.

  • Mathematics (60 Mins): Reserve your largest block of time for the 40 Mathematics questions, as they demand extensive multi-step algebra and calculus.

Conclusion

Thoroughly understanding the SRMJEEE 2027 exam pattern empowers you to navigate the 150-minute remote proctored test with absolute confidence. Because the 125-question paper features zero negative marking, your ultimate strategy should prioritize speed, aggressive time management, and a 100% attempt rate. By systematically clearing the fast-paced English, Aptitude, and Chemistry sections first, you can bank reliable marks and reserve crucial minutes for the calculation-dense Mathematics and Physics sections. Align your daily mock test practice strictly with this official structure to maximize your merit rank and secure your preferred B.Tech branch.
