title: CUET 2027: Stepwise central and state counselling registration dates
description: A practical timeline for CUET 2027 counselling registrations, detailing central and state processes, key deadlines, and tips for students and parents to stay on track.
content:
How CUET 2027 counselling affects you today

CUET 2027 admissions hinge on timely counselling registrations. Central and state bodies will publish distinct timelines for seat allotment, document verification, and choice filling. Knowing the stepwise schedule helps families plan ahead, avoid last‑minute technical glitches, and secure preferred institutes.

What to expect from the central counselling process

Central counselling coordinates admissions to certain universities and courses based on CUET scores. The process typically unfolds in clearly defined stages:

  • Registration window: Create or update your applicant profile and register for counselling. You will provide basic personal details, CUET score details, and preferences.
  • Choice filling: Select programs and institutes in order of priority. You can modify choices within the allotted window.
  • Document verification: Upload or present required documents for verification. Ensure scans are legible and all names match your CUET application.
  • Seat allotment: Based on merit, preferences, and availability. You will receive an allotment result with next steps.
  • Locking and reporting: Lock the allotted seat and complete any institute-specific formalities, including fee payment and reporting to the designated campus.

Central counselling usually covers a broad set of participating institutions. It is essential to monitor official portals for exact dates and to follow the instructed steps precisely to avoid loss of seats.

State counselling timelines and how they differ

State governments run their own counselling portals for state universities and colleges. While the model is similar to central counselling, there are critical differences to note:

  • Registration windows: States publish separate windows. Some states allow multi‑stage registrations, while others firm up in a single phase.
  • Quota and institute lists: State counselling often includes regional institutes, technical universities, and others that may not participate in central rounds.
  • Certificate requirements: States may require different sets of documents, such as domicile proofs or local category certificates, in addition to standard CUET results.
  • Reporting and fee processes: Fee structures and reporting centers vary by state. Prepare digital copies of essential documents in advance.

Students should track their state’s official counselling portal for precise dates, eligibility criteria, and the order of steps. When in doubt, verify details on the official authority site and follow the declared timelines closely.

Practical calendar and checklists for CUET 2027 counselling

Use this actionable timeline as a planning aid. Dates are subject to official announcements; always rely on the official portals for final confirmations.

  • Immediately after CUET results (late spring): Create profiles on both central and relevant state counselling portals. Note any required registration fees and accepted payment methods.
  • Registration phase (2-3 weeks): Complete personal details, CUET score, course preferences, and institute lists. Ensure contact details are accurate for updates.
  • Document readiness: Scan and compress PDFs of essential documents (identity proofs, category certificates if applicable, academic records, migration certificates). Keep originals ready for verification at designated centers if required.
  • Choice filling window (1-2 weeks): Prioritize programs by interest and feasibility. Use a conservative first‑choice strategy to avoid overcommitment.
  • Payment and confirmation: Pay required counselling fees if applicable. Confirm your submitted choices and watch for any correction windows.
  • Seat allotment and reporting: Check allotted seat details promptly. Complete reporting formalities within the deadline to avoid seat cancellation.
  • Seat surrender and upgradation: If the allotted seat is unsatisfactory, review upgradation policies and deadlines for possible better options in subsequent rounds.

Tips for families navigating the process

  • Set reminders: Create calendar alerts for each stage of registration, choice filling, and reporting deadlines. Missing a date can cost a preferred program.
  • Prepare documents in advance: Ensure that all required certificates and identifiers are up to date and match the spelling in CUET records.
  • Keep track of shifts in dates: Counselling timelines can be revised. Rely on official notices and avoid relying on rumors or unverified sources.
  • Prioritize programs with a realistic chance: Balance dream options with safety choices to maximize the likelihood of securing a seat in round 1 or round 2.
  • Have a backup plan: Prepare for either central or state options; many students find suitable paths across both after the first round results.

FAQs for CUET 2027 counselling registrations

1. When will central counselling registrations begin for CUET 2027?

Dates will be announced by the central administering body and posted on the official portal. Plan to register as soon as the window opens to ensure access to all participating programs.

2. Can I participate in both central and state counselling?

Yes, if you meet eligibility criteria and have completed the necessary registrations on both portals. Ensure you manage deadlines for each process separately.

3. What documents are typically required for verification?

Common documents include identity proof, academic transcripts, category certificate if applicable, domicile or residence proofs for state seats, passport-sized photographs, and the CUET score report.

4. How many rounds of seat allotment are there?

Most counselling processes involve multiple rounds, plus a possible remaining or special round. Dates for subsequent rounds are released after each allotment cycle.

5. What should I do if my preferred program is not allotted in the first round?

Review the upgradation policy for subsequent rounds, keep monitoring for new seat availability, and ensure you remain eligible for higher options if offered in next rounds.

6. How can I verify that I am looking at the official counselling information?

Always rely on the official counselling portals of the central or state authorities. Do not trust third‑party sites for deadlines or required steps, and avoid sharing sensitive information outside those portals.

Bottom line

CUET 2027 counselling requires disciplined planning across central and state channels. Early preparation of documents, timely registrations, and thoughtful option prioritization increase the chances of securing a seat in a preferred program. Keep an eye on official announcements, set reminders, and follow the stepwise process to navigate the admissions landscape with confidence.

Super Profit Actual Profit – Normal Profit
Goodwill (Super Profit) Super Profit × Years’ Purchase
Capitalised Value Average Profit ÷ Normal Rate × 100

Goodwill Valuation is a high-scoring topic in CBSE Class 12 Accountancy. title: CAT 2025: Complete Guide to Exam Dates, Pattern, Eligibility & Preparation
description: Explore CAT 2025 details, exam pattern, important dates, eligibility, and expert tips to help you crack the MBA entrance exam on your first attempt.
content:
If you want to pursue an MBA from a top school like the IIMs, FMS Delhi, or SPJIMR, the Common Admission Test (CAT) is your first big step. Every year, over two lakh students take the CAT to compete for a limited number of seats in India’s best business schools. CAT 2025 is expected to follow the same format as in previous years. With increasing competition, you will need more than just hard work; you will need a smart strategy.

In this blog, we will cover everything you need to know about CAT 2025: the exam pattern, important dates, eligibility, and how to start preparing.

What is CAT?

One of the Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) administers the Common Admission Test (CAT), a nationwide admission exam, every year. In addition to all 20 IIMs, more than 1,200 prestigious B-Schools in India accept the score. It assesses your capacity for logical thought, problem-solving under duress, and data interpretation—skills that are essential for every future corporate leader.

Why CAT 2025 Is Important

Not only can a high CAT score get you into a B-School, but it also opens you access to top-notch teachers, international exposure, robust alumni networks, and some of the highest-paying placements in the nation.

CAT is the common route for everyone, regardless of whether your goal is to enroll in an MBA program at IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, or institutions like MDI Gurgaon and IIT Bombay.

CAT 2025: Tentative Important Dates

Event

Date (Tentative)

Last week of July 2025

Start of Online Registration

First week of August 2025

Last Date to Apply

Second or Third week of September 2025

Correction Window

Last week of September 2025

Admit Card Release

Third or Fourth week of October 2025

CAT 2025 Exam Date

Sunday, 30th November 2025

First or Second week of December 2025

First week of January 2026

Eligibility Criteria

To apply for CAT 2025, you must:

  • Hold a Bachelor’s degree with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD)

  • Be in the final year of your graduation (if not already graduated)

  • Be from any stream (Arts, Science, Commerce, etc.)

  • There is no age limit

 How to Prepare for CAT 

Here are some practical tips for aspirants:

  1. Start Early: Begin your preparation at least 10–12 months before the exam. Early starters have more time to work on weak areas.

  2. Understand the Syllabus: Focus on key topics like Arithmetic, Algebra, Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation, and Logical Puzzles.

  3. Regular Mock Tests: From May or June onwards, start taking mock tests. These help in understanding the pattern and improving time management.

  4. Analyze Your Mistakes: Don’t just attempt mocks, review every wrong answer. This helps in identifying gaps in your preparation.

  5. Read Daily: Improve your reading speed and comprehension by reading editorials, magazines, or business articles regularly.

Final Thoughts

Cracking the CAT Exam is not just for the top students; it requires consistency, strategy, and focus. It doesn't matter if you come from an engineering background or study humanities. With the right preparation and mindset, you can reach the top B-Schools in the country.

If you’re serious about your MBA goals, start preparing today. CAT 2025 could be your path to a future filled with opportunities and leadership.

title: CBSE Class 10 English Exam 2027: Date for Communicative and Language & Literature
description: CBSE Class 10 English is on 26 February 2027. Check codes 101 and 184, the three-hour exam slot and how the date fits your registered subjects.
content:
CBSE Class 10 English is scheduled for 26 February 2027, in the 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST slot. The subject code or codes to match are 101 and 184.

The official CBSE date sheet issued on 6 November 2026 combines Classes 10 and 12. Use the Class 10 section and your school registration details to find the correct entry.

Read the official CBSE date-sheet PDF

Central Board of Secondary Education, date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. Open the original official document.

Two English courses, one scheduled date

English Communicative carries subject code 101, while English Language and Literature carries code 184. Both appear on 26 February in the official schedule. The shared date does not make the courses interchangeable: use the code recorded by your school when selecting practice papers and checking your timetable.

Keep that code beside the date in your calendar. If a downloaded worksheet or school message names a different English course, resolve the mismatch with your teacher before using it as your main revision resource.

Where English sits between Science and Hindi

Science is scheduled for 22 February and English for 26 February, leaving 23, 24 and 25 February between the two dates. However, Computer Applications, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence are scheduled for 24 February. Students registered for one of those papers do not have three uninterrupted study days for English.

Hindi Course A and Course B follow on 3 March. The four calendar dates between English and Hindi are 27 and 28 February and 1 and 2 March. Check your other registered subjects before treating any of these as a free day.

A useful English revision calendar

Prepare reading, writing and literature work before the Science paper rather than leaving all English revision to the interval afterwards. A timed practice paper can help you decide how to divide the three-hour slot; it is a planning exercise, not a promise about the actual question paper.

The printed start time is 10:30 am IST. It is not an instruction to arrive at the gate at that time. Use the admit card and school instructions for reporting arrangements when issued.

For the wider timetable, see the CBSE 2027 date-sheet guide and official PDF. Keep the complete source document with your personal subject list.

title: CAT Scorecard: What Sectional Percentiles Mean for MBA Calls
description: A high CAT overall percentile can still fail a sectional screen. Learn how to read all four percentile figures and judge MBA call chances sensibly.
content:
A high CAT overall percentile can still leave you out of an MBA interview shortlist if your VARC, DILR or QA percentile misses a particular institute’s published minimum. The CAT scorecard has four percentile figures: one overall result and three sectional results. Read all four before you judge your chances.

But clearing a minimum sectional cutoff only makes you eligible for consideration. It doesn’t guarantee a call. The institute’s admission policy, category rules, academic record, work experience, written assessment and interview process may affect the shortlist, where the policy provides for them.

Why can a strong overall percentile fail to produce a call?

Overall percentile reflects your position across the CAT paper. A sectional percentile shows your position in one area. So a candidate with strong VARC and QA performance but a weak DILR result can post an impressive overall number and still fail an early screen at an institute that sets a DILR minimum.

There isn’t one CAT cutoff that controls every IIM or MBA college. The responsible institute publishes its own admission policy for the relevant admission year. Treat a coaching estimate, social-media post or another candidate’s shortlist as discussion material, not as an admission rule.

What should you check on the CAT scorecard?

Write down these figures before making a college list:

  • Overall CAT percentile
  • VARC percentile
  • DILR percentile
  • QA percentile

Circle the lowest section first. Then check the published policy of each target IIM or B-school for your category and admission year. A minimum is a gate, not a prediction of selection. Even when you clear it, the applicant pool and the institute’s wider selection formula can affect whether you receive a call.

How should you build your MBA shortlist?

  1. Safer choices: Your overall and sectional figures sit clearly above the stated screens.
  2. Reach choices: You are close to a minimum, so a change in the relevant policy or a strong applicant pool could matter.
  3. Low-priority choices: You clearly miss a required sectional or overall minimum.

Don’t reject every college because one section is low. Compare only institutes whose published screens you meet, then assess course fit, fees, location and placement information through college comparisons. You can also review other entrance exam routes if CAT leaves too few suitable options.

What is the sensible next step?

Save your scorecard, list each target institute and record its published sectional and overall requirements. Check whether the policy applies to your category and admission year. The CAT result tells you your standing; the institute’s own policy decides whether you enter its shortlist process. That distinction can save you from both false hope and an unnecessary rejection.

content:
మహారాష్ట్ర NEET PG 2026 ఉమ్మడి తాత్కాలిక రాష్ట్ర మెరిట్ జాబితా, ఇన్‌సర్వీస్ అభ్యర్థుల ప్రత్యేక జాబితాను రాష్ట్ర CET సెల్ ప్రవేశ పోర్టల్‌లో చూడవచ్చు. మీ పేరు ఉండటం అంటే కళాశాల లేదా స్పెషాలిటీలో సీటు కేటాయించారని కాదు.

సవరించిన CAP 1 షెడ్యూల్ ప్రకారం అభ్యంతరాల గడువు 1 నవంబర్ 2026 మధ్యాహ్నం 12 గంటలు. ఆ గడువు ముగిసింది. తుది తాత్కాలిక మెరిట్ జాబితాలు, సీట్ల పట్టిక 2 నవంబర్‌కు నిర్ణయించారు. మీకు వర్తించే జాబితాలో వివరాలను నమోదు రికార్డులతో పోల్చండి.

ఎంపికలు నిర్ణయించే ముందు మీ రికార్డు పోల్చండి

సాధారణ రాష్ట్ర జాబితాకు ఉమ్మడి తాత్కాలిక జాబితా చూడండి. ఇన్‌సర్వీస్ మార్గం వర్తిస్తే ఆ జాబితా చూడండి. మరో అభ్యర్థి నమోదును మీదిగా భావించకుండా గుర్తింపు వివరాలు జాగ్రత్తగా పోల్చండి. PDFతో పాటు దరఖాస్తు రికార్డు, అవసరమైన ఆధారాలు ఉంచుకోండి.

నోటీసు 04 ప్రకారం సవరణకు పత్ర ఆధారాలు తప్పనిసరి. అవి లేకుండా మార్పు పరిగణించరు. అభ్యంతరంలో తప్పు నమోదు, సవరణను సమర్థించే పత్రం స్పష్టంగా ఉండాలి. CET సెల్ కొత్త సూచన ఇవ్వకుండా ఆలస్యమైన అభ్యర్థన అంగీకరిస్తారని ఊహించవద్దు.

తాత్కాలిక జాబితా తర్వాత CAP 1 షెడ్యూల్

6-10 నవంబర్; 10 నవంబర్ సాయంత్రం 5:30 వరకు

మహారాష్ట్ర రాష్ట్ర CET సెల్, నోటీసు 04, 30 అక్టోబర్ 2026; ఆంగ్ల పేజీ. పూర్తి అధికారిక నోటీసు తెరవండి.

సీట్ల పట్టికతో పాటు కోటా ఫీజులు చూడండి

ఎంపికల క్రమం పెట్టే ముందు విడుదలైన CAP 1 సీట్ల పట్టిక చూడండి. కళాశాల, స్పెషాలిటీ, కోటా కలయికలో అందుబాటును పరిశీలించండి. ఎంపికలకు ముందు కోటా వారీ ఫీజులను ధ్రువీకరించాలని నోటీసు ప్రత్యేకంగా చెబుతుంది. ఇష్టమైన స్పెషాలిటీ ఫీజు మీ బడ్జెట్‌కు సరిపోతేనే ఆచరణయోగ్యమైన ఎంపిక.

5 నవంబర్ ఎంపిక జాబితా మెరిట్ జాబితాకు వేరే దశ. సీటు వస్తే కళాశాల రిపోర్టింగ్ సూచనలు, CET సెల్ షెడ్యూల్, అసలు పత్రాలు, అవసరమైన ఫీజులను అనుసరించండి. నోటీసు 04లో DD, చెక్ లేదా ఆన్‌లైన్ చెల్లింపు ఉంది. చెక్ సెలవు రోజుల్లో మాత్రమే అనుమతిస్తారు; తర్వాతి పని రోజున DDతో మార్చాలి. ప్రయాణానికి ముందు కేటాయించిన కళాశాలతో ఏర్పాట్లు నిర్ధారించండి.

title: CSEET October 2026 Result: Revised Schedule Points to 15 November
description: ICSI revised the October-session CSEET result schedule to 15 November. Understand which notice applies and what to check before opening a result link.
content:
The revised ICSI schedule places the CSEET October 2026 result on 15 November 2026. The council decision dated 17-18 March 2026 says the new timeline applies from the October 2026 session onwards. Candidates should still wait for the session-specific result announcement to confirm the release time and access link.

If you have seen “last week of November” in an older document, there is a reason for the difference: ICSI subsequently revised the schedule.

Which timetable applies to the October session?

The earlier restructured-CSEET announcement used a November-end result window. The later ICSI council decision gives a specific date: 15 November for the October session. Its applicability note is essential because the first June 2026 examination under the restructured format was treated separately.

Institute of Company Secretaries of India, council decisions dated 17-18 March 2026, page 1. The revised timeline applies from the October 2026 session. Open the official document.

A scheduled date does not make a result link live

The council’s table does not state a release hour or provide an October-session scorecard link. Do not infer either from the date alone. The official ICSI CSEET page is the starting point for the result announcement.

Read the session label before entering candidate details. A June 2026 result notice belongs to that earlier sitting. It cannot establish the status of an October 2026 result, even when both appear under the same CSEET heading.

Keep these details ready for the announcement

  • Keep your registration details and October examination records accessible so you can use the fields requested by the official result service.

  • Check the session and year on the notice, then follow its result link from the ICSI website.

  • When the result becomes available, save the statement or record supplied by the portal and check that the candidate and session details match yours.

  • Read the accompanying instructions before acting on Executive Programme registration or any request concerning marks. Use the deadlines in the applicable notice.

The CSEET results page provides the exam context. For a change to the announced date, release time or result service, follow the subsequent ICSI notice.
author: Geethika Reddy
meta_title: CSEET October 2026 Result Date: Revised ICSI Schedule
meta_description: ICSI’s revised timetable lists 15 November for the October CSEET result. Check the applicable council decision and follow the official session-specific notice.

title: TS Inter 2027 સમયપત્રક: શૈક્ષણિક કેલેન્ડર શું કહે છે?
description: તેલંગાણા ઇન્ટરની પ્રેક્ટિકલ અને થિયરી પરીક્ષાનો સંભવિત સમય, સત્તાવાર સમયપત્રક શોધવાની રીત અને તૈયારીમાં રાખવાની કાળજી જાણો.
content:
તેલંગાણા ઇન્ટરમીડિયેટના વિદ્યાર્થીઓ માટે 2027ની પરીક્ષાનો સંભવિત સમય ઉપલબ્ધ છે. પરંતુ પરીક્ષાના દિવસની યોજના વિષયવાર સમયપત્રક આવ્યા પછી નક્કી કરો. બોર્ડના 2026-27 શૈક્ષણિક કેલેન્ડરમાં પ્રેક્ટિકલ પરીક્ષા જાન્યુઆરીના છેલ્લા અઠવાડિયામાં અને થિયરી પરીક્ષા ફેબ્રુઆરીના છેલ્લા અઠવાડિયામાં દર્શાવાઈ છે. આ તૈયારી માટેના સમયગાળા છે, દરેક પેપરની અંતિમ તારીખો નથી.

TGBIEએ હાલ શું આપ્યું છે?

સત્તાવાર શૈક્ષણિક કેલેન્ડર વાર્ષિક કાર્યક્રમને સંભવિત ગણાવે છે. પ્રી-ફાઇનલ પરીક્ષા માટે 18થી 23 જાન્યુઆરી 2027 દર્શાવ્યા છે. બોર્ડના નોટિસ પેજ પર IPE 2027નું વિષયવાર સમયપત્રક હજી આવવાનું છે.

ફોરવર્ડ કરેલા ચિત્રમાં પ્રથમ કે બીજા વર્ષનું સંપૂર્ણ સમયપત્રક હોય તો તેને કેલેન્ડરથી પ્રમાણિત ન માનો. ગણિત, જીવવિજ્ઞાન કે ભાષાના પેપરની તારીખ કેલેન્ડર નક્કી કરતું નથી. પરીક્ષા ફીના પરિપત્રથી પણ પેપરનો ક્રમ નક્કી થતો નથી.

TGBIEનું 28 માર્ચ 2026નું સંભવિત શૈક્ષણિક કેલેન્ડર, પાનું 2. પરીક્ષાનાં અઠવાડિયાં અંતિમ વિષયવાર તારીખો નથી. સંપૂર્ણ સત્તાવાર કેલેન્ડર (PDF)

સાચું વર્ષ અને અભ્યાસક્રમ ચકાસીને સમયપત્રક મેળવો

તેલંગાણા બોર્ડ ઓફ ઇન્ટરમીડિયેટ એજ્યુકેશનની વેબસાઇટના News & Announcements વિભાગમાં IPE 2027 સમયપત્રકની નોટિસ શોધો અને બોર્ડની PDF ખોલો. જૂના IPE તથા એડવાન્સ્ડ સપ્લિમેન્ટરી કાર્યક્રમો પણ ત્યાં હોય છે, તેથી વર્ષ અને પરીક્ષાનું નામ તપાસો.

પ્રવેશ રેકોર્ડ પ્રમાણે પ્રથમ કે બીજું વર્ષ પસંદ કરો. સામાન્ય કે વ્યવસાયલક્ષી વિષયો માટેનો કાર્યક્રમ છે તે જુઓ. શરૂઆતની તારીખ સાથે પેપરનાં નામ, પરીક્ષાનો સમય અને નોંધો વાંચો. પ્રેક્ટિકલ સૂચનાઓને થિયરી સમયપત્રકથી અલગ રાખો. સુધારેલું સમયપત્રક આવે ત્યારે જૂની નકલ બદલો.

રાહ જોતા વિષયવાર પુનરાવર્તન કરો

બાકી રહેલા વિષયો માટે સાપ્તાહિક યોજના બનાવો. સંભવિત કેલેન્ડરથી અભ્યાસ પૂરો કરવાનું સામાન્ય લક્ષ્ય નક્કી કરો. પેપરની અંતિમ તારીખ આવે ત્યાં સુધી રોજના પુનરાવર્તનનો ક્રમ બદલવાની જગ્યા રાખો.

TGBIEએ 2026-27ના પ્રથમ વર્ષના અભ્યાસક્રમ, વાર્ષિક શૈક્ષણિક યોજના અને મોડેલ પ્રશ્નપત્રોની લિંક્સ આપી છે. પોતાના વિષય અને વર્ષનું પેપર ઉકેલી ભૂલો પરથી ફરી અભ્યાસ કરો. પ્રથમ વર્ષનું નવું પેપર માળખું બીજા વર્ષને પણ લાગુ પડે એવું ન માનો.

પ્રેક્ટિકલ તૈયારી અને કોલેજની સૂચનાઓ માટે પોતાની જુનિયર કોલેજને પૂછો. બિનસત્તાવાર સમયપત્રકના સ્ક્રીનશોટ પરથી રિફંડ ન મળતું પ્રવાસ બુકિંગ ન કરો. સત્તાવાર સમયપત્રક આવે ત્યારે કોલેજની નકલ સાથે સરખાવો અને તફાવત પહેલાં સ્પષ્ટ કરો.
author: Geethika Reddy

meta_description: તેલંગાણા ઇન્ટરની પ્રેક્ટિકલ અને થિયરી પરીક્ષાનો સંભવિત સમય, સત્તાવાર સમયપત્રક શોધવાની રીત અને તૈયારીમાં રાખવાની કાળજી જાણો.

title: CEED 2027 लेखनिक मदत: Part Aची मर्यादा आणि अतिरिक्त वेळेची विनंती
description: CEED 2027साठी लेखनिक किंवा अतिरिक्त वेळ हवा असल्यास नोंदणीसोबत विनंती करा. Part Bचा नियम, Appendix 11 आणि वाढवलेल्या मुदती समजून घ्या.
content:
CEED 2027साठी लेखनिक हवा असल्यास अर्ज भरतानाच विनंती करा. IIT Bombay ही मदत Part Aसाठी देते. Part B लेखनिकाच्या मदतीशिवाय स्वतः सोडवावा लागेल. तयारी आणि परीक्षेचे नियोजन करताना हा फरक लक्षात ठेवा.

मदत कोणत्या भागासाठी आहे

अधिकृत CEED संकेतस्थळानुसार Part A संगणकावर असतो, तर Part Bमध्ये उत्तरे लिहिणे आणि चित्रे काढणे अपेक्षित असते. संपूर्ण परीक्षेत सारखीच मदत मिळेल असे गृहीत न धरता, विनंतीत गरज स्पष्ट करा.

IIT Bombay, CEED 2027 नोंदणी मार्गदर्शन. 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026 रोजी घेतलेला संकेतस्थळाचा उतारा; या परिच्छेदाला स्वतंत्र प्रसिद्धी तारीख नाही. अधिकृत सूचना वाचा.

नोंदणीसोबत योग्य अर्ज द्या

1 ऑक्टोबरच्या माहिती पुस्तिकेतील विभाग 1.7.1 प्रक्रिया सांगतो. नोंदणी अर्जात मदतीचा पर्याय निवडून दिव्यांगत्वाची आधार कागदपत्रे अपलोड करा. लेखनिक आणि/किंवा भरपाईचा अतिरिक्त वेळ मागण्याचा नमुना Appendix 11मध्ये आहे. अतिरिक्त वेळ दर तासाला 20 मिनिटे आहे. Part A आणि Part Bचा अतिरिक्त वेळ एका भागातून दुसऱ्याकडे वळवता येत नाही.

अतिरिक्त प्रमाणपत्र आवश्यक असेल तिथे Appendix 10 लागू होतो. सर्व दिव्यांगत्व श्रेणींना एकच नियम लागू होतो असे न मानता, आपल्या कागदपत्रांनुसार प्रमाणपत्राच्या तरतुदी वाचा. IIT Bombayने अधिकृत प्रमाणपत्रे आणि विनंतीचे नमुने एकत्र दिले आहेत.

लेखनिकाची व्यवस्था कोण करणार

CEED कार्यालय विनंती आणि आधार कागदपत्रे तपासते व गरज असल्यास ईमेलने पुढील सूचना पाठवू शकते. पात्र उमेदवार परीक्षा केंद्राच्या पॅनेलमधून लेखनिक निवडतात, साधारणपणे परीक्षेच्या आदल्या दिवशी. स्वतःचा लेखनिक आणण्याची परवानगी नाही.

भरलेल्या विनंतीची प्रत ठेवा आणि नोंदणीचा ईमेल तपासत राहा. अर्जातील सूचना किंवा प्रमाणपत्राबद्दल शंका असल्यास सादर करण्यापूर्वी ceed@iitb.ac.in येथे CEED कार्यालयाला विचारा. ठरवलेल्या परिशिष्टाऐवजी सर्वसाधारण ऑनलाइन नमुना वापरू नका.

वाढवलेल्या नोंदणी मुदतीचा उपयोग करा

IIT Bombayच्या 31 ऑक्टोबरच्या सूचनेनुसार नियमित शुल्कासह नोंदणी 5 नोव्हेंबर 2026पर्यंत आणि विलंब शुल्कासह 10 नोव्हेंबर सायंकाळी 5 वाजेपर्यंत वाढवली आहे. मुदतवाढीमुळे मदतीच्या विनंतीच्या अटी रद्द होत नाहीत. दोन्ही मुदतींसाठी UCEED आणि CEEDच्या सुधारित नोंदणी तारखांचे मार्गदर्शन पाहा.

title: A Practical Guide to State-Specific NEET and JEE Counseling: Timelines, Required Documents, and Contingency Plans for 2026-27
description: A concise, state-aware roadmap for medical and engineering counseling in India for 2026-27, covering timelines, documents, and backup plans tailored to students and parents.
content:
Overview

For aspiring medical and engineering students, the 2026-27 counseling cycle combines national norms with state-specific procedures. NEET counseling governs MBBS/BDS seats, while JEE Main and JEE Advanced pathways lead to engineering admissions in several states and central institutes. This guide outlines practical timelines, the documents you’ll need, and contingency plans to navigate potential delays or changes in state processes.

Key Timelines to Track

Timelines differ by state but share common milestones: registration windows, choice filling, seat allotment, document verification, and reporting. Start by noting the official state consultation portal dates and set reminders a week in advance for each stage.

  • NEET (Medical/Dental) Counseling: Registration opens after NEET results are announced. Expect multiple rounds, including mop-up rounds in some states. Record the dates for registration, choice filling, seat allotment, and reporting to the allotted college.
  • JEE Counseling and State Quotas: States often conduct separate rounds for state quota seats, sometimes in parallel with central processes. Note registration windows, placeholder allotments, and subsequent verification steps.
  • All-India vs. State Quota: Understand which seats are governed by national counseling and which are state-level. Some states require separate registrations even if you qualified through national exams.
  • Documentation Verification: Verification dates may occur after seat allotment. Have all documents ready to avoid delays or seat forfeiture.
  • Contingency Rounds: If you miss initial rounds, track mop-up or stray-round timelines and the deadlines to accept seats or withdraw without penalties.

Because schedules can shift with administrative changes or exam results, check the official counseling portal and the state education department announcements regularly. If a state issues an extraordinary notification due to policy updates, act promptly to avoid missing deadlines.

Documents You Will Need

As you approach verification and seat allotment, assemble a core set of documents common across most states. Create digital backups and keep multiple copies of originals in a safe place.

  • Neurological: Aadhar card or alternate identity proof, proof of date of birth, and domicile or residence certificate if required by the state.
  • Academic: NEET admit card and results, board mark sheets for qualifying exam, and the qualifying exam pass certificate if applicable.
  • Address and family: parent/guardian identity proofs, income certificate if reserved category or merit-based scholarships apply, and a category certificate if required by the state.
  • Counseling-specific: allotment letter (digital and print), verification slips, and any state-specific application forms or fees receipts.
  • Medical/Hospital records: if applicable, for candidates with special needs or applicants requesting admission under special categories.

Backup copies should include scanned PDFs of all documents, with clear, legible scans of both sides where needed. Ensure names match across all documents to prevent verification issues.

Contingency Plans for Delays and Changes

Plan for common disruptions so you can respond quickly without panicking. Here are practical options:

  • If a round is postponed: Reconfirm the new dates immediately, adjust travel and lodging plans, and prepare for extended verification windows. Keep communication channels open with college authorities and your school counselor.
  • If your documents are rejected during verification: Identify the specific deficiency, obtain the missing or corrected document, and schedule a re-verification slot as soon as allowed.
  • If you miss a round’s deadline: Do not wait for the next cycle. Explore mop-up round eligibility, standby lists, or direct admission options if the state provides them.
  • If you face seat changes after allotment: Review the institution’s refund or transfer policies, and consult the state portal for any permitted steps to withdraw with minimal loss before the deadline.
  • If there is a mismatch between national results and state processes: Contact the state counseling authority promptly and keep all notices in writing. Maintain a clear record of dates and conversations.

Strategies for a Smooth Experience

Small preparations can reduce stress and prevent costly mistakes:

  • Prepare a master timeline with all state-specific dates and set reminders a week before each stage.
  • Verify eligibility for reserved categories and ensure category certificates are valid and up-to-date.
  • Create a unified file for all necessary documents, with clearly labeled sections for NEET and JEE requirements.
  • Keep travel plans flexible in the months around counseling rounds to accommodate last-minute changes.
  • Engage with your school counselor or a trusted mentor to cross-check documents and deadlines before submission.

Insights for Parents

Parental support is crucial during 2026-27 counseling. Focus on managing timelines, ensuring the child’s preparedness for choices, and maintaining calm during announcements. Help your ward distinguish between national and state seats, and discuss contingency options early so decisions can be made without pressure.

Frequently Asked Questions

When should I start preparing for state counseling?

Begin as soon as final exam results are declared. Collect documents early, monitor official portals for registration openings, and prepare digital copies ahead of time.

What if my state requires a different set of documents?

Check the official counseling notice for state-specific documents. Prepare a core bundle that covers common items and a separate list for any state-only certificates to minimize last-minute issues.

Can I switch from state to central counseling after allotment?

Switching depends on the rules of the respective counseling authorities and seat availability. Verify the options on the official portal and consult the helpline if needed.

What should I do if there is a discrepancy in a seat allotment?

Document all communications, raise the issue through the official grievance or helpdesk channels, and ask for a re-verification or clarification within the specified window.

How can I prepare for document verification day?

Carry originals and copies of all required documents, organize them in a labeled folder, and arrive early to account for potential queues.

Final Note

State-specific NEET and JEE counseling for 2026-27 requires careful planning and timely action. Stay informed through the official portals, maintain organized documentation, and implement contingency plans to navigate delays or policy shifts with confidence.

title: JEE Main 2027 registration window: dates, documents and steps to apply
description: Understand the JEE Main 2027 registration window, list of required documents, and a clear step-by-step application process for Indian students and parents to ensure a smooth start to the exam cycle.
content:
Fast start for JEE Main 2027 registration

Getting the JEE Main 2027 registration right on time helps you lock in exam slots, prevent last‑minute issues, and keep your engineering admission options open. This guide provides the essential dates, documents, and a practical application sequence for Indian students and their parents.

Important registration window and timeline

National governing bodies typically announce registration windows several months before the exam session. Expect a defined opening date and a closing deadline. Track official notifications closely, as minor schedule changes can occur. Plan to complete key steps well before the deadline to avoid technical or documentation hurdles.

Tip: Mark the start date on your calendar and set reminders for document readiness, fee payment, and final submission. If your school or coaching center provides a verification step, use it to confirm your details before you apply.

Who should apply and when

  • Indian students seeking admission to undergraduate engineering programs in AICTE‑accredited institutes where JEE Main scores are used for entry or ranking.
  • Candidates who have completed or are completing qualifying courses of study and are within the eligible age and qualifying marks as defined for JEE Main 2027.
  • Parents should ensure the applicant’s details are accurate and aligned with school records to prevent mismatches during verification.

Documents typically required

  • Identity proof of the candidate (Aadhaar card is commonly used; passports are accepted where Aadhaar is unavailable).
  • Educational certificates or mark sheets for the qualifying examination and, if applicable, class 12 board details.
  • Date of birth certificate or a document proving date of birth as per the board records.
  • Residential address proof (as listed in the application form) and parental/guardian details for contact and correspondence.
  • Recent passport‑sized photographs as specified by the registration portal.
  • Category certificate (if applicable) for reserved categories, with the appropriate issuing authority and validity.
  • Application fee payment confirmation and a functioning email and mobile number for central communications.

Always check the official registration page for the exact list of documents and the accepted formats. If your documents are in regional languages, ensure they are translated and attested as required by the authority.

Step‑by‑step application process

  1. Visit the official JEE Main registration portal during the open window. Do not attempt to access the site during peak load times to minimize failures.
  2. Create a candidate profile by providing a valid email address and a mobile number. You will receive a unique registration number and user credentials.
  3. Login and fill the application form with accurate personal details, educational background, and communication address. Double‑check spellings and dates of birth to avoid later verification problems.
  4. Upload required documents in the accepted formats and sizes. If any document is not in the accepted format, convert it before uploading to prevent rejection.
  5. Preview the filled form to confirm all data matches the uploaded documents. Make any necessary corrections before final submission.
  6. Pay the registration fee using the available online modes. Keep the fee receipt or transaction ID for future reference.
  7. Submit the application. Take a screenshot of the submitted form or download the confirmation page as proof of submission.
  8. Download and print the confirmation slip and admit card when available; follow the instructions for exam city allotment and changes if required.

Tips for a smooth registration

  • Prepare a document folder in advance with scanned copies of all required certificates and IDs to speed up uploads.
  • Verify your name, parent/guardian name, and date of birth across all documents to prevent mismatches.
  • Keep a backup email address and mobile number accessible, as important notifications may be sent there.
  • If there is a fee waiver or concession, read the eligibility criteria carefully and gather supporting documents early.
  • Access the portal from a reliable internet connection and use a supported browser to avoid technical glitches.

Common issues and how to handle them

Forgot login credentials: Use the portal’s recovery option and have access to your registered email or mobile number. Blank fields or incorrect data: Revisit the form and correct the entries before final submission. Document mismatches: Ensure scanned copies are legible and match the details on your primary IDs. Payment failures: Try a different payment method or contact support with your transaction details.

What to verify on the official site

Always confirm the exact registration window, required documents, allowed formats, fee structure, and the process for any corrections or changes on the official authority page. If any aspect is uncertain, verify directly on the official site rather than relying on third‑party summaries.

What happens after registration

After successful submission, you will receive an acknowledgment with your registration number. Later steps include downloading the admit card, selecting or confirming examination city, and following exam day instructions. Stay alert for updates about slot changes or amendments to exam dates.

Parental role and guidance

Parents can help by reviewing the application with the candidate to ensure consistency across documents, monitoring deadlines, and maintaining a record of confirmations and receipts. Encourage the student to keep a checklist and set reminders for critical milestones like document readiness, form review, and fee payment.

Final checks before you submit

  • All required fields filled with accurate information.
  • Documents uploaded in the correct format and clearly readable.
  • Fees paid and payment receipt obtained.
  • Confirmation page saved or printed for future reference.

Important note

Details such as exact dates, document lists, and process steps are determined by the official examination authority. If you encounter uncertainties, consult the official portal and the latest candidate information bulletin for 2027 guidelines.

title: CAT के पुराने प्रश्नपत्र: गलतियों से अगली रिवीजन योजना बनाएं
description: CAT के पुराने पेपर से ज्ञान की कमी, सवाल चुनने की गलती और समय की बर्बादी पहचानें। अभ्यास के स्कोर को भावी पर्सेंटाइल न मानें।
content:
पुराना CAT पेपर तब अधिक उपयोगी होता है जब उससे आपकी अगली तैयारी बदलती है। प्रयास के बाद स्कोर कुछ देर अलग रखें और पूछें: कौन से उत्तर गलत हुए, कौन से हल करने योग्य सवाल छोड़े और कहां समय लगाने पर भी आगे नहीं बढ़े?

टाइमर शुरू करने से पहले पेपर पहचानें

पेपर का वर्ष, स्लॉट और स्रोत दर्ज करें। देखें कि यह मूल प्रश्नपत्र की प्रति, स्मृति पर आधारित पुनर्निर्माण या अभ्यास सेट है। पुनर्निर्मित सवाल में शब्द छूट सकते हैं। किसी प्रकाशक का हल अपने आप आधिकारिक उत्तर नहीं बन जाता।

हल करते समय उत्तर कुंजी बंद रखें। अधूरा चित्र, तालिका या गद्यांश मिलने पर सवाल को अनुपयोगी चिह्नित करें, अपनी तैयारी की विफलता न गिनें। मौजूदा निर्देशों के लिए आधिकारिक CAT वेबसाइट देखें; पुराना पेपर वर्तमान वर्ष के नियमों की घोषणा नहीं है।

ज्ञान और सवाल चुनने की गलतियां अलग करें

हल किए और छोड़े, दोनों तरह के सवाल देखें। हर टाली जा सकने वाली गलती का एक मुख्य कारण चुनें ताकि अगला कदम स्पष्ट रहे।

क्या हुआ

अगला कदम

तरीका नहीं आता था

मूल अवधारणा दोहराएं, फिर कुछ समान सवाल हल करें।

तरीका आता था, पर गणना या पढ़ने में गलती हुई

धीरे दोबारा हल करके गलती शुरू होने वाला ठीक कदम पहचानें।

बहुत समय लगाने के बाद सवाल छोड़ा

वह संकेत लिखें जिस पर पहले आगे बढ़ जाना चाहिए था।

बाद में हल हो सकने वाला सवाल छोड़ दिया

उस भाग में सवाल देखने और चुनने की प्रक्रिया जांचें।

रीडिंग कॉम्प्रिहेंशन में लिखें कि चुना विकल्प सही क्यों लगा और गद्यांश का कौन सा हिस्सा उसे गलत साबित करता है। रीजनिंग सेट में जांचें कि शुरुआती व्यवस्था गलत थी या बाद का निष्कर्ष। पूरा हल नकल करने से ज्यादा उपयोगी यह जांच है।

उत्तर याद किए बिना दोबारा हल करें

थोड़े अंतराल के बाद दोबारा करने के लिए गलतियों की छोटी सूची चुनें। पिछला काम देखे बिना हल करें। उत्तर याद है लेकिन तरीका समझा नहीं सकते, तो उसी कौशल का दूसरा सवाल लें।

प्रश्न संदर्भ, गलती का प्रकार, सुधार का कदम और दोबारा प्रयास का परिणाम दर्ज करें। जैसे अंतिम वाक्य की शर्त छूटना पढ़ने की जांच मांगता है, असंबंधित पूरे अध्याय की रिवीजन नहीं।

स्कोर को प्रतिक्रिया मानें, प्रवेश का अनुमान नहीं

अभ्यास की परिस्थितियां, पेपर से पुरानी परिचितता और उत्तरों का स्रोत स्कोर को प्रभावित करते हैं। घर का एक स्कोर भावी CAT पर्सेंटाइल या संस्थान की शॉर्टलिस्ट तय नहीं कर सकता। बार-बार होने वाली अपनी गलतियों की तुलना करें और देखें कि सुधार से फर्क पड़ रहा है या नहीं।

परीक्षा की व्यावहारिक व्यवस्था को पढ़ाई के विश्लेषण से अलग रखें। आधिकारिक डाउनलोड निर्देश की पुष्टि के बाद CAT एडमिट कार्ड मार्गदर्शिका दस्तावेज जांच में मदद कर सकता है। सत्र के अंत में कल के लिए छोटा स्पष्ट काम तय करें, बिना छांटे PDF का नया ढेर नहीं।

title: JEE Main ബദലുകൾ 2027: VIT, SRM അപേക്ഷകൾ തുറന്നു; അമൃത അടുത്തത്
description: VITEEE, SRMJEEE, AEEE, KIITEE, GITAM ഔദ്യോഗിക അപേക്ഷാ സ്ഥിതികൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാം. തുറന്ന 2027 ഫോമും വരാനിരിക്കുന്ന കാലവും പഴയ പോർട്ടലും വേർതിരിക്കൂ.
content:
JEE Mainന് പുറത്തെ എൻജിനീയറിങ് വഴികൾ നോക്കാൻ നവംബറിലെ ഒരു പൊതു തുടക്കത്തീയതിക്ക് കാത്തിരിക്കേണ്ടതില്ല. VITയും SRMഉം ഇതിനകം 2027 അപേക്ഷാ ഫോമുകൾ കാണിക്കുന്നു; അമൃത B.Tech 2027 അപേക്ഷകൾ നവംബറിൽ തുടങ്ങുമെന്നു പറയുന്നു. KIIT, GITAM പഴയ ഫോമുകളെ 2027 അപേക്ഷയായി കരുതുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് പുതിയ പ്രവേശനവർഷം പരിശോധിക്കണം.

അഞ്ച് വഴികൾ, വ്യത്യസ്ത അപേക്ഷാ ഘട്ടങ്ങൾ

താരതമ്യത്തിലെ ഔദ്യോഗിക ലിങ്കുകൾ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് വ്യക്തിവിവരങ്ങൾ നൽകുന്നതിനോ പണമടയ്ക്കുന്നതിനോ മുമ്പ് പ്രവേശനവർഷം വീണ്ടും നോക്കുക. രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ ബട്ടൺ പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നതുകൊണ്ടുമാത്രം ശരിയായ വർഷത്തെ അപേക്ഷയിലെത്തിയെന്ന് ഉറപ്പാകുന്നില്ല.

പ്രവേശനവഴി

ഔദ്യോഗിക പേജിന്റെ സ്ഥിതി

അടുത്ത നടപടി

VITEEE

B.Tech 2027 രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ, ലോഗിൻ ഫോം ലഭ്യം

അപേക്ഷയ്ക്ക് മുമ്പ് 2027 നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ വായിക്കുക

SRMJEEE

2027 പ്രവേശനം തുറന്നു; UG ഫോം കാണുന്നു

ഫോമിലെ കോഴ്സും ക്യാമ്പസും പരിശോധിക്കുക

AEEE

B.Tech 2027 അപേക്ഷകൾ നവംബറിൽ എന്ന് പ്രഖ്യാപനം

തുടക്ക അറിയിപ്പിനും പുതിയ നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾക്കും കാത്തിരിക്കുക

KIITEE

പോർട്ടൽ ഇപ്പോഴും KIITEE 2026 അടച്ചതായി പറയുന്നു

2027 അപേക്ഷ തുറന്നത് ഇവിടെ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചിട്ടില്ല

GITAM GAT

അപേക്ഷാ പേജ് ഇപ്പോഴും GAT 2026 എന്നാണ്

ഫോം ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് 2027 വർഷം ഉറപ്പാക്കുക

അമൃതയുടെ നവംബർ പ്രഖ്യാപനത്തിന്റെ അർത്ഥം

അമൃതയുടെ അറിയിപ്പ് ഒരു മാസം ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നു, കൃത്യമായ തുടക്കദിവസമല്ല. AEEEയ്ക്ക് പുറമെ JEE Main പെർസെന്റൈൽ വഴിയും B.Tech പ്രവേശനമുണ്ടെന്ന് പേജ് പറയുന്നു. ഫോം തുറക്കുമ്പോൾ 2027 നിർദ്ദേശങ്ങൾ വായിക്കുക; പഴയ ഫീസ്, യോഗ്യതാപരിധി, ഘട്ടനിയമങ്ങൾ തുടരുന്നു എന്ന് കരുതരുത്.

താഴെയുള്ള ചിത്രം സർവകലാശാലയുടെ സ്വന്തം അപേക്ഷാ തുടക്ക അറിയിപ്പാണ്. രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ ഇതിനകം തുറന്നുവെന്നതിന് തെളിവല്ല. അടുത്ത നടപടി ആസൂത്രണം ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ച ഭാവികാലവും ലഭ്യമായ അപേക്ഷാ ഫോമും തമ്മിലുള്ള വ്യത്യാസം ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക.

അമൃതയുടെ B.Tech 2027 പ്രവേശന പേജ് അപേക്ഷകൾ നവംബറിൽ തുടങ്ങുമെന്നു പറയുന്നു. ഈ വെബ് അറിയിപ്പിൽ പ്രത്യേക പ്രസിദ്ധീകരണ തീയതിയില്ല. അമൃതയുടെ മൂല അപേക്ഷാ അറിയിപ്പ്

പണമടയ്ക്കും മുമ്പ് തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പുകളുടെ പട്ടിക ഒരുക്കുക

തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്ത ഓരോ കോഴ്സിനും ക്യാമ്പസ്, പ്രോഗ്രാം, പ്രവേശനവഴി, അപേക്ഷാ സ്ഥിതി, ഔദ്യോഗിക URL എന്നിവ കുറിക്കുക. നിലവിലെ രേഖകളിൽ യോഗ്യത, പഠന-ജീവിത ചെലവ്, റീഫണ്ട്, സ്കോളർഷിപ്പ് വ്യവസ്ഥകൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യുക. പല പരീക്ഷകൾക്ക് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നത് സാധ്യതകൾ കൂട്ടാം; പ്രവേശനമോ എല്ലാ ക്യാമ്പസുകളുടെയും ചെലവ് താങ്ങാനാകുമെന്നോ ഉറപ്പില്ല.

കൃത്യമായി പൂർത്തിയാക്കാനാകുന്ന അപേക്ഷകൾക്ക് മുൻഗണന നൽകുക. സ്വന്തം ഇമെയിലും മൊബൈലും ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ശരിയായ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസവിവരങ്ങൾ നൽകി അന്തിമ സ്ഥിരീകരണം സൂക്ഷിക്കുക. VITയ്ക്ക് പ്രത്യേക രേഖ, തത്സമയ ഫോട്ടോ ഗൈഡ് സഹായിക്കും. ഉറപ്പാകാത്ത പ്രവേശനവർഷത്തിന് ഔദ്യോഗിക പേജ് സൂക്ഷിച്ച് പുതിയ അറിയിപ്പിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കുക; മുൻകൂർ സീറ്റെന്ന പേരിൽ ഇടനിലക്കാരന് പണം നൽകരുത്.

title: OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor 2026: Prelims vs Mains Scheme, Legal Practice Certificate Rules, and Syllabus Breakdown
description: Comprehensive guide to the OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor 2026 exam scheme, active legal practice certificate rules, and complete syllabus breakdown for law graduates.
content:
The Odisha Public Service Commission (OPSC) conducts recruitment for the post of Assistant Public Prosecutor (Group-B) under the Home Department. Securing a role as an Assistant Public Prosecutor requires a solid legal foundation, an active enrollment with a State Bar Council, and targeted preparation aligned with modern statutory updates. Candidates and parents seeking clarity on the selection framework must understand the two-tier examination structure, eligibility prerequisites, and detailed paper breakdowns.

OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor 2026: Selection Scheme

The recruitment process evaluates a candidate's grasp of criminal jurisprudence, procedural law, and practical courtroom applications. The selection architecture generally comprises a Written Examination followed by a Viva Voce test.

Preliminary vs. Mains Examination Scheme

Depending on the total volume of applications received, the commission determines whether a Preliminary screening exam is necessary prior to the Main written test.

  • Preliminary Examination (Screening): When conducted, the preliminary test consists of objective Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs). It serves strictly as a qualifying filter to shortlist candidates for the written main examination. Marks obtained in the screening test are not added to the final merit list.
  • Main Written Examination: The main examination is descriptive in nature. It tests comprehensive subject knowledge across two primary law papers. The scores earned here directly determine progression to the interview stage and final selection.
  • Viva Voce (Interview): Candidates qualifying the main examination are called for a personal interview to evaluate their suitability for public prosecution duties, articulate reasoning skills, and practical legal aptitude.

Legal Practice Certificate Rules & Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for the OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor position extends beyond an academic degree. Candidates must satisfy mandatory legal practice conditions and age limits set by statutory rules.

1. Educational Qualification

Candidates must possess a Bachelor's Degree in Law (LL.B.) from a recognized university in India.

2. Active Legal Practice Certificate Requirement

An essential requirement for this recruitment is practical experience at the Bar:

  • Candidates must be enrolled as an Advocate with a State Bar Council.
  • A minimum specified period of active legal practice (typically two years of active practice as an Advocate at the Bar) is mandatory.
  • Applicants must produce a valid Practice Certificate or Experience Certificate issued by the respective District Judge, Bar Association President/Secretary, or appropriate authority as prescribed in the official notification.

3. Language & Age Criteria

Applicants must be able to read, write, and speak Odia fluently and must have passed an Odia language test equivalent to at least the Middle School (Class VII) standard. Age limits generally range between 21 and 35 years, with standard relaxations applicable for reserved categories as per Odisha Government norms.

Detailed Syllabus Breakdown

The written examination curriculum focuses primarily on substantive and procedural criminal laws, evidence rules, and specific special statutes enforced across the state.

Paper I: Primary Criminal & Procedural Laws

This paper tests structural legal fundamentals and courtroom procedures:

  • Indian Penal Code / Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita: General exceptions, offences against the human body, offences against property, and criminal conspiracy.
  • Code of Criminal Procedure / Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita: Constitution of criminal courts, powers of prosecutors, arrest mechanisms, investigation procedures, bail provisions, trial processes before Magistrate and Sessions Courts, and judgment appeals.
  • Indian Evidence Act / Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam: Relevancy of facts, admissions and confessions, oral and documentary evidence, burden of proof, examination of witnesses, and expert testimonies.

Paper II: Special Acts & Local Laws

Paper II covers minor acts, special criminal statutes, and protective legislation frequently handled by public prosecutors:

  • Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act
  • Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act
  • Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act
  • Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
  • Arms Act and Information Technology (IT) Act provisions relevant to criminal proceedings
  • Local municipal and state police laws applicable within Odisha

Preparation Strategy for Aspiring Prosecutors

To succeed in the written examination, candidates should structure their study plan effectively:

  • Bare Act Mastery: Focus extensively on understanding section-wise provisions, exceptions, and procedural timelines outlined in core Bare Acts.
  • Case Law Analysis: Stay updated on landmark judgments of the Supreme Court of India and the High Court of Orissa concerning criminal procedure and evidence admissibility.
  • Answer Writing Practice: Regularly practice drafting legal answers to descriptive problems, highlighting appropriate statutory provisions and judicial precedents.
  • Official Verification: Always verify precise syllabus updates, fee structures, and submission deadlines directly on the official Odisha Public Service Commission website.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the selection process for OPSC Assistant Public Prosecutor 2026?

The selection process includes a written main examination followed by a viva voce test. A preliminary screening test may be conducted if the number of applicants is high.

Is active legal practice mandatory for OPSC APP eligibility?

Yes, applicants must possess a Law Degree (LL.B.), be enrolled as an Advocate with a Bar Council, and hold a valid certificate demonstrating the required active practice at the Bar.

What subjects are covered in the OPSC APP written syllabus?

The syllabus covers substantive criminal law, procedural codes, evidence law, legal drafting, and special statutes such as the POCSO Act, NDPS Act, and SC/ST Act.

Does the preliminary exam score count towards final merit?

No, marks from the preliminary screening exam are qualifying in nature and are not added to the final merit ranking.

title: A region wise admissions calendar for Indian central and state MBBS and engineering seats with contingency planning
description: A practical, region-by-region admissions calendar for MBBS and engineering seats across central and state boards in India, plus contingency planning strategies for students and parents to navigate seat allotments, refunds, and deadlines.
content:
Lead insight for families: align applications with regional timelines to maximize seat options and minimize lost opportunities

India’s medical and engineering admissions occur across central and state bodies, with regional variations in timelines, cutoffs, and counseling rounds. A region-focused plan helps students track key deadlines, identify alternate paths, and coordinate with colleges, boards, and authorities. This article provides a region-wise calendar, practical contingency steps, and guidance for parents planning transport, finances, and backup options.

Understanding the regional structure

India’s MBBS admissions typically involve state medical authorities for state quota seats and the central pool or national bodies for all-India seats. Engineering admissions follow similar patterns through state engineering councils or boards, and in some states through central entrance results. Regionally, timelines cluster around board results, counselling windows, and seat allotment cycles. A clear map of these regions helps but does not replace official notifications, which should be checked on the relevant authority websites for the current year.

Region-wise admissions calendar at a glance

Note: The dates below are indicative frameworks. Check the official portals for the current year’s exact deadlines. Where a state uses multiple rounds or special rounds, plan for additional processing time and possible fee adjustments.

  • : Central counselling for all-India medical and engineering seats often begins after state board results. Expect a series of rounds from late June to September. State counselling windows may open 2-4 weeks after results, with separate rounds for government and private institutions.
  • : Engineering admissions typically begin with declaration of scores and common merit lists, followed by multiple seat allotment rounds. Medical admissions may have a separate state round plus an all-India round for central seats. Late summer to early autumn are peak counselling months.
  • : Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Telangana have distinct counselling portals. Expect early rounds aligned with board results or entrance scores, followed by mop-up rounds. Medical seats may use central pools in addition to state quota.
  • : States like West Bengal, Odisha, and others coordinate with central boards for eligibility and counselling windows. Multiple rounds often extend into autumn, with reserve categories and supernumerary seats possible.
  • : Regions with uniform national testing timelines often have clear, sequential rounds across medical and engineering streams. Prepare for a tight schedule with deadlines clustered in the late summer and early autumn.

Contingency planning: steps for students and parents

Having a fall-back plan reduces stress and protects admission chances. Use these steps to stay prepared across regions.

1) Create a two-tier list of preferences

  • Tier A includes your first-choice government seats and top private institutes with strong placement histories.
  • Tier B covers backup government seats and reputable private colleges that fit budget and location considerations.

2) Track timelines actively

  • Mark counselling start dates, registration windows, document verification deadlines, and fee payment timelines on a shared family calendar.
  • Set reminder alerts for seat allotment results and option-filling deadlines, including mop-up rounds where applicable.

3) Prepare documents in advance

  • Keep digital and physical copies of mark sheets, category certificates, domicile proofs, identity proofs, passport photos, and parental income documents ready.
  • Carry reserved format copies as required by different portals to avoid last-minute delays.

4) Budget for all scenarios

  • Estimate tuition and hostel fees for top choices and realistic backups. Include registration fees, acceptance fees, and possible refunds that may be non-refundable or partially refundable.
  • Plan for transport, accommodation near counselling centers if required, and contingency funds for unforeseen charges.

5) Understand refund and seat cancellation policies

  • Read policy terms for each college or board portal, including timelines for seat allotment cancellation, and any administrative charges that apply.
  • Keep track of deadlines to avoid forfeiting deposits or partial fees due to late changes.

6) Prepare for local travel and housing logistics

  • Identify nearby hostels, PGs, or rental options in advance for shortlisted campuses. Consider travel time and safety, especially during counselling windows that require long commutes.
  • In regions with campus housing, verify bed availability and terms for early acceptance or delays in joining dates.

Practical regional actions for families

Direct actions help families stay ahead of the curve.

  • Register for all relevant portals early, even if results are pending. Some portals require provisional registrations during the counselling phase.
  • Maintain a single point of contact within the family who monitors updates from official portals and communicates decisions to all members.
  • Prepare a brief, clear set of questions for counsellors: eligibility criteria, fee structure, hostel facilities, transport options, and future reallocation or transfer policies.

What to verify on official channels

Official notifications will confirm the exact start dates for registrations, the number of rounds, seat allotment rules, fee payment processes, and documentation requirements. If information seems unclear, rely on the official authority’s guidance rather than third-party summaries. If in doubt, contact the designated helplines or help desks provided on the official site.

A final checklist

  • Two-tier preference list ready with A and B categories.
  • All required documents scanned and organized in an upload-ready folder.
  • Calendar with all regional counselling dates and reminders.
  • Budget plan including tuition, living expenses, and contingency funds.
  • Backups identified for both MBBS and engineering paths, with clear acceptance and withdrawal options.

FAQs

Which region should I prioritize for MBBS admissions in India?

Focus on the regions where you meet eligibility criteria and have a realistic chance of securing a seat, while also considering travel and family support. Always verify the current year’s official timelines for each state and central seat. If a preferred region has delayed counselling, keep alternative options ready.

How many rounds of counselling are typical for MBBS and engineering?

Most states and central authorities run multiple rounds, sometimes including mop-up rounds. Exact numbers vary by year and region, so check the latest official notifications and register for all rounds you may be eligible for.

What if I miss a deadline?

Missing a deadline usually means losing that round’s seat. Backups are essential. Use backup options promptly if a preferred seat becomes unavailable, and stay alert for any late-release rounds or special categories that may reopen seats.

What should I do about refunds if I choose to withdraw?

Refund policies differ by authority and college. Keep track of submission deadlines and monetary penalties. If a refund window is closing, contact the counselling desk immediately to understand eligibility and processing times.

How can families reduce last-minute stress during counselling?

Prepare in advance with organized documents, a clear budget, and a two-tier preference list. Assign one family member to monitor official updates and keep others informed. Having contingency plans in place minimizes stress and speeds decision-making during critical windows.

The paper included a mix of conceptual, theoretical and numerical questions, requiring students to balance accuracy with time management.

Mathematics was the most time-consuming section, with lengthy problems from Calculus, Coordinate Geometry, Vectors and 3D Geometry, and Algebra.   • Waves and Oscillations

  • Magnetism and Moving Charges

  • Modern Physics

  • Electrostatics

  • Ray Optics and Lenses

  • Semiconductor and Logic Gates

  • Projectile Motion

  • Units and Dimensions

  • Fluid Mechanics

  • Gravitation

  • Kinematics

The section offered an opportunity to score well through careful formula application and conceptual clarity. Students should pay particular attention to Mechanics, Magnetism and Modern Physics while revising this paper.

Chemistry Analysis

Chemistry was largely considered easy, although some candidates found particular theoretical questions tricky. Organic and Inorganic Chemistry had comparatively greater representation than Physical Chemistry. Questions were spread across different chapters, and many required students to remember reactions, properties and fundamental concepts.

Assertion-reason-type questions were also reported. These questions required candidates to evaluate both statements instead of relying only on memorised definitions. A strong understanding of NCERT concepts was useful for handling the theory-oriented portion.

Important Chemistry topics reported in the shift:

  • Organic Chemistry

  • Inorganic Chemistry

  • Biomolecules

  • Chemical Bonding

  • Coordination Compounds

  • p-Block Elements

  • Dipole Moment

  • Electrochemistry

  • Ionic Equilibrium

  • Thermodynamics

Candidates should use the paper to revise reaction-based concepts, chemical properties and important theoretical points. For Physical Chemistry, practising numerical questions can help improve calculation accuracy.

Mathematics Analysis

Mathematics was the most challenging and time-consuming section for many candidates. The difficulty was largely linked to the length of the questions and the calculations involved. Even when a question was based on a familiar chapter, reaching the answer could require several steps.

Calculus, Vectors and 3D Geometry, Matrices and Determinants, Quadratic Equations, Coordinate Geometry and Binomial Theorem were among the topics reported in the paper analysis. Conic Sections and Algebra also featured in student-based discussions of the shift.

Candidates who attempted questions without first assessing their length may have found it difficult to complete the section within the available time. A selective approach was therefore important.

Important Mathematics topics reported in the shift:

  • Calculus

  • Area Under the Curve

  • Vectors and 3D Geometry

  • Matrices and Determinants

  • Quadratic Equations

  • Coordinate Geometry

  • Hyperbola and Ellipse

  • Binomial Theorem

  • Complex Numbers

  • Sequences and Series

  • Arithmetic Progression

  • Algebra

The section highlights the importance of practising multi-step problems. Students should revise standard methods and learn to identify questions that can be solved quickly before moving to lengthy calculations.

Difficult Questions in JEE Main 2025 22 January Shift 2

The Mathematics section accounted for much of the reported difficulty in this shift. Several questions required more time because of their calculation-heavy nature. Physics and Chemistry were comparatively manageable, but some conceptual and theoretical questions still required careful reading.

The following table summarises the topics and question types that could demand additional effort.

1. Calculus and Integration

Calculus was one of the important areas in Mathematics. Integration-based questions can become lengthy when candidates need to identify the correct technique, simplify an expression and complete multiple calculation steps. Questions involving the area under a curve also require students to understand the function and the limits of integration.

Why these questions were challenging: A small mistake in selecting the method or handling the limits could affect the entire solution. Students should practise different integration patterns rather than depending on formula memorisation alone.

2. Vectors and 3D Geometry

Vectors and 3D Geometry require students to understand directions, coordinates and relationships between points, lines and planes. Questions from these chapters may involve several calculations before reaching the final result.

Why these questions were challenging: Candidates needed to translate the given information into the correct mathematical form and apply the appropriate vector or 3D geometry formula. A clear understanding of the concepts is essential for solving such problems efficiently.

3. Hyperbola and Ellipse

Conic Sections were among the Mathematics topics reported in the shift. Questions from Hyperbola and Ellipse generally require knowledge of standard equations and their properties, including parameters and geometrical relationships.

Why these questions were challenging: Students may need to identify the relevant property before beginning the calculation. Revising standard forms, important results and their applications can make these questions easier to approach.

4. Matrices and Determinants

Matrices and Determinants are important Algebra topics that involve operations, properties and calculations. Questions can become time-consuming when multiple steps are involved.

Why these questions were challenging: Candidates must maintain accuracy while applying matrix operations and determinant properties. Revising standard results and practising mixed question types can help reduce calculation errors.

5. Assertion-Reason Questions in Chemistry

Chemistry included theoretical and assertion-reason-style questions. These questions require candidates to examine whether both statements are correct and whether the reason properly explains the assertion.

Why these questions were challenging: Students relying only on memorisation may find it difficult to distinguish between a correct statement and a valid explanation. Understanding the underlying chemical concept is more useful than learning isolated facts.

This section discusses challenging topics and question formats identified through shift reviews. It does not claim that every listed question was difficult for all candidates or reproduce unverified question statements.

How to Practise with the JEE Main 2025 Previous Year Paper

A previous year paper is most useful when students attempt it like an actual examination and review their performance afterwards. Instead of checking solutions after every question, complete the paper first and then analyse the mistakes.

Follow these steps to get better results:

  1. Set a three-hour timer: Attempt the paper in one sitting to recreate the examination environment.

  2. Attempt familiar questions first: Begin with questions you can solve confidently and avoid spending too long on one problem.

  3. Track time spent per section: Mathematics may require more time, so practise balancing it with Physics and Chemistry.

  4. Check the answer key: Review every incorrect and unattempted question after completing the test.

  5. Understand the solution: Identify whether you missed a concept, selected the wrong method or made a calculation error.

  6. Revise weak chapters: Return to the relevant chapter and practise additional questions before attempting another paper.

Benefits of Solving JEE Main Previous Year Question Papers

Practising actual examination papers helps students understand the nature of questions asked in JEE Main. It also gives them an opportunity to test their preparation beyond chapter-wise exercises.

Some important benefits include:

  • Exam pattern familiarity: Students understand the structure and types of questions included in the test.

  • Better time management: Full-length practice helps candidates decide how to distribute their time.

  • Chapter-wise revision: Reviewing questions makes it easier to identify topics that require additional attention.

  • Improved accuracy: Regular practice helps reduce calculation and interpretation errors.

  • Performance assessment: Students can evaluate their preparation and plan their next revision cycle.

Conclusion

The JEE Main 2025 22 January Shift 2 question paper is a useful practice resource for students preparing for engineering entrance examinations. The paper was moderate overall, but Mathematics required more time because of its lengthy and calculation-intensive questions. Physics was comparatively manageable, while Chemistry focused considerably on theoretical concepts from Organic and Inorganic Chemistry.

Students should attempt the paper under timed conditions and review every incorrect or unattempted question. This approach can help them identify weak areas, improve accuracy and develop a more effective preparation strategy for JEE Main.

title: CBSE Class 12 English Flamingo Important Questions 2026 | High Weightage Chapters & Exam Guide
description: Get CBSE Class 12 English Flamingo important questions 2026 with chapter-wise topics, high-weightage units, easy-to-score questions, and revision tips to help students pass the board exam easily.
content:
CBSE Class 12 English Flamingo Important Questions (2026) – Complete Exam Guide

Introduction

Flamingo is the main literature book for CBSE Class 12 English Core. Every year, prose and poetry questions carry 40–50 marks in the board exam. If you prepare important questions chapter-wise, you can easily pass and score high.

This guide covers most expected Flamingo questions in simple language for quick revision.

High-Weightage & Easy-to-Score Flamingo Chapters (Fast Recap)

High-Weightage Prose Chapters

  • The Last Lesson

  • Lost Spring

  • Deep Water

  • The Rattrap

  • Indigo

High-Weightage Poetry Chapters

  • My Mother at Sixty-Six

  • An Elementary School Classroom in a Slum

  • Keeping Quiet

  • A Thing of Beauty

Poetry questions are easy to score if you explain themes and poetic devices clearly.

Important Flamingo Prose Questions (Chapter-Wise)

1. The Last Lesson

Important Questions:

  • Why was the last lesson important for Franz and his classmates?

  • Describe M. Hamel’s character.

  • What message does the story give about language and identity?

2. Lost Spring

Important Questions:

  • Explain the title “Lost Spring”.

  • Describe the life of Saheb-e-Alam.

  • What social issues are highlighted in the chapter?

3. Deep Water

Important Questions:

  • Describe the author’s fear of water.

  • How did Douglas overcome his fear?

  • What lesson does the story teach?

This chapter is easy to write and frequently asked.

4. The Rattrap

Important Questions:

  • Explain the theme of the story.

  • Describe the role of the ironmaster and his daughter.

  • What is the moral of the story?

5. Indigo

Important Questions:

  • Describe Gandhi’s role in the Indigo movement.

  • What problems did the farmers face?

  • Explain the Champaran episode.

Important Flamingo Poetry Questions

My Mother at Sixty-Six

  • What fear does the poet express?

  • Explain the significance of the smile at the end.

An Elementary School Classroom in a Slum

  • Describe the condition of slum children.

  • What solutions does the poet suggest?

Keeping Quiet

  • What does the poet mean by keeping quiet?

  • Why is silence important in the poem?

A Thing of Beauty

  • What are the sources of beauty?

  • Explain “a thing of beauty is a joy forever”.

CBSE Flamingo Marks Weightage Table (Expected)

Section Marks
Prose Short Answers 10–15
Prose Long Answers 10–15
Poetry Short Answers 10
Poetry Long Answers 5–10
Total Flamingo Marks 35–50
 

Easy-to-Score Flamingo Topics

  • Character sketches

  • Theme-based questions

  • Poetic devices (simile, metaphor, imagery)

  • Summary-based questions

Writing theme and moral points can fetch full marks.

How to Write Flamingo Answers in Exam

✔ Write answers in points and paragraphs
✔ Use keywords from NCERT
✔ Mention theme, characters, and message
✔ Quote short lines from poems
✔ Avoid long stories

1-Day Flamingo Revision Plan

Time What to Revise
Morning Prose summaries
Afternoon Important long questions
Evening Poetry themes
Night Poetic devices & quick notes
 

 

Conclusion

CBSE Class 12 English Flamingo is a high-weightage and easy-to-score unit if prepared smartly. Students should focus on The Last Lesson, Lost Spring, Deep Water, and Indigo, along with popular poems like My Mother at Sixty-Six and A Thing of Beauty for quick marks. Regular revision of themes and character-based questions can help students pass easily and score above 90 marks.

title: MAH MBA CET 2025: प्रवेशपत्र आणि परीक्षेच्या ताज्या अपडेट्स
description: MAH MBA CET 2025 परीक्षेसाठी प्रवेशपत्र लवकरच जाहीर होणार! परीक्षेच्या तारखा, पात्रता आणि महत्त्वाच्या सूचनांसाठी ताज्या अपडेट्स मिळवा.
content:
एमएएच एमबीए सीईटी 2025: प्रवेशपत्र, परीक्षा वेळापत्रक आणि महत्त्वाच्या सूचना

महाराष्ट्र कॉमन एंट्रन्स टेस्ट (MAH MBA CET) 2025 ही राज्यातील प्रमुख व्यवस्थापन अभ्यासक्रमांमध्ये प्रवेश घेऊ इच्छिणाऱ्या विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी एक महत्त्वाची परीक्षा आहे. परीक्षेच्या तारखा जसजशा जवळ येत आहेत, तसतसे काही महत्त्वाचे अपडेट्स जाहीर करण्यात आले आहेत.

प्रवेशपत्र जारी

महाराष्ट्र राज्य सामाईक प्रवेश परीक्षा कक्षाने MAH MBA CET 2025 साठी प्रवेशपत्र प्रसिद्ध केले आहे. परीक्षेसाठी नोंदणी केलेल्या उमेदवारांना अधिकृत वेबसाइट cetcell.mahacet.org वर लॉगिन करून प्रवेशपत्र डाउनलोड करता येईल. प्रवेशपत्र मिळवण्यासाठी अर्ज क्रमांक आणि जन्मतारीख आवश्यक आहे. परीक्षा केंद्रात प्रवेश मिळवण्यासाठी प्रवेशपत्राची छापील प्रत अनिवार्य आहे.

परीक्षा वेळापत्रक

MAH MBA CET 2025 परीक्षा 1, 2 आणि 3 एप्रिल 2025 रोजी विविध परीक्षा केंद्रांवर आयोजित केली जाणार आहे. परीक्षा दोन सत्रांमध्ये घेतली जाईल:

  • सकाळ सत्र: 7:30 AM ते 11:30 AM

  • दुपार सत्र: 12:30 PM ते 4:30 PM

उमेदवारांचे परीक्षेचे ठिकाण, सत्र वेळ आणि दिनांक संबंधित प्रवेशपत्रावर नमूद केलेले आहे.

गुणांकन प्रक्रिया सुधारणा

24 मार्च 2025 रोजी राज्य सीईटी सेलने परीक्षेतील विविध सत्रांमधील कठीण पातळीतील तफावत दूर करण्यासाठी सामान्यीकरण (Normalization) प्रक्रिया लागू करण्याची घोषणा केली. या पद्धतीमुळे परीक्षेतील गुणांकन अधिक पारदर्शक आणि न्याय्य राहील. या प्रक्रियेविषयी अधिक तपशील अधिकृत वेबसाइटवर दिले आहेत.

फसवणूक कॉलबाबत महत्त्वाची सूचना

राज्य सीईटी कक्षाने विद्यार्थ्यांना फसवणुकीसंबंधी सतर्क राहण्याचे आवाहन केले आहे. काही बनावट कॉल आणि ईमेलद्वारे प्रवेश प्रक्रियेबाबत चुकीची माहिती दिली जात आहे. अधिकृत घोषणांवरच विश्वास ठेवा आणि कोणत्याही संशयास्पद हालचाली तत्काळ अहवाल द्या.

परीक्षा दिन मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे

उमेदवारांनी परीक्षेच्या दिवशी खालील गोष्टींचे पालन करणे आवश्यक आहे:

✔ प्रवेशपत्र: अधिकृत वेबसाइटवरून डाउनलोड केलेली प्रवेशपत्राची प्रिंटआउट आवश्य बाळगा.
✔ ओळखपत्र: पॅन कार्ड, आधार कार्ड, पासपोर्ट, ड्रायव्हिंग लायसन्स किंवा मतदान ओळखपत्र यापैकी एक मूळ प्रत बाळगणे अनिवार्य आहे.
✔ छायाचित्र: अर्ज भरताना अपलोड केलेलेच एक पासपोर्ट साईज छायाचित्र सोबत ठेवा.
✔ अपंग उमेदवारांसाठी प्रमाणपत्र: PwD उमेदवारांनी अधिकृत प्रमाणपत्र किंवा UDID कार्ड सोबत आणणे आवश्यक आहे.

अधिकृत वेबसाइटवर नियमितपणे भेट देऊन परीक्षेसंबंधी अद्यतन तपासत राहा आणि सर्व नियमांचे पालन करा. परीक्षेच्या तयारीसह या मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वांचे पालन केल्यास परीक्षेचा अनुभव अधिक सुलभ आणि यशस्वी ठरेल.
