title: VITEEE Last Minute Revision: Important Topics & Strategy
description: Maximize your score with our VITEEE last minute revision guide. Discover high-weightage topics in physics, chemistry, and maths, plus smart exam strategies.
content:
VITEEE Last Minute Revision: High-Weightage Topics and Exam Strategy

Executing a flawless VITEEE last minute revision is often the deciding factor between an average rank and securing a top-tier engineering branch at the Vellore Institute of Technology. Because the exam features 125 questions to be answered in 150 minutes with absolutely no negative marking, your final days of preparation should not be spent learning complex new concepts. Instead, the smartest approach is to consolidate what you already know and heavily target chapters that historically carry the highest question volume.

This comprehensive guide breaks down the priority chapters across Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry, outlines an optimal exam-day attempt sequence, and provides a structured checklist for your final week.

Understanding the Scoring Dynamics

The VITEEE paper allocates 40 questions to Mathematics (or Biology), 35 to Physics, 35 to Chemistry, 10 to Aptitude, and 5 to English. Every correct answer awards you +1 mark, and unattempted or incorrect answers receive zero penalties.

Because you must solve a question every 72 seconds on average, your VITEEE last minute revision must prioritize subjects and chapters that yield quick, straightforward answers-specifically Chemistry, Aptitude, and foundational Physics formulas.

Subject-Wise High-Priority Chapters

Dedicating your time to the most frequently tested units ensures a maximum return on your study hours.

Mathematics: The Heavyweight Section

With 40 questions, Mathematics makes or breaks your percentile. However, it is also the most time-consuming section.

  • Calculus: This is the undisputed king of the math section, often accounting for 10 to 12 questions. Focus heavily on Definite Integrals, Differentiability, and Application of Derivatives.

  • Algebra: Matrices and Determinants are highly scoring and predictable. Also, quickly review the properties of Complex Numbers and standard Probability theorems.

  • Coordinate Geometry: Prioritize the standard equations and tangent properties of Conic Sections (Parabola, Ellipse, and Hyperbola) over Straight Lines.

  • Vectors and 3D Geometry: Formula-based questions involving dot/cross products and shortest distances between skew lines are practically guaranteed.

Physics: Formula-Driven Core Units

Physics generally consists of 60% Class 12 topics and 40% Class 11 topics. Do not waste time on lengthy rotational mechanics problems in the final days.

  • Electrodynamics: Electrostatics, Current Electricity, and Electromagnetic Induction (EMI) are must-cover chapters. Memorize the circuit formulas and potentiometer applications.

  • Optics: Both Ray and Wave Optics contribute significantly. Ensure you are clear on lens maker's formulas and Young's Double Slit Experiment (YDSE).

  • Modern Physics: Dual Nature, Atoms, Nuclei, and Semiconductors are highly rewarding because the questions are predominantly direct formula applications.

  • Thermodynamics: A high-yield unit that also overlaps with Chemistry.

Chemistry: The Ultimate Time Saver

Chemistry should be your fastest section. Most questions are factual and directly sourced from NCERT textbooks.

  • Organic Chemistry: Focus strictly on Class 12 Organic Chemistry. Review General Organic Chemistry (GOC), named reactions, and functional group tests (like Tollens' and Fehling's).

  • Physical Chemistry: Revise the formulas for Electrochemistry (Nernst equation), Chemical Kinetics (first-order reactions), and Solutions.

  • Inorganic Chemistry: Coordination Compounds and D & F Block Elements carry the highest weightage. Quickly glance through VSEPR theory and hybridization in Chemical Bonding.

Consolidated High-Weightage Summary

To help you organize your final study blocks, here is a breakdown of the chapters you must prioritize during your VITEEE last minute revision.

Subject

Must-Cover Priority Topics

Expected Weightage

Mathematics

Calculus, Conic Sections, Matrices, Vectors & 3D, Probability

22 - 25 Questions

Physics

Electrodynamics, Modern Physics, Optics, Thermodynamics

18 - 20 Questions

Chemistry

Class 12 Organic Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Coordination Compounds

15 - 18 Questions

Logical Aptitude

Data Interpretation, Missing Numbers, Direction Sense

7 - 8 Questions

English

Synonyms and Antonyms, Short Reading Comprehension

3 - 4 Questions

Exam Day Strategy and Attempt Sequence

Knowing the syllabus is only half the battle; executing a smart paper-attempting strategy is equally crucial. With no negative marking, your primary goal is to see and attempt all 125 questions.

  • Step 1: Start with Chemistry, Aptitude, and English. These 50 questions can often be completed in 40 to 45 minutes. Securing these marks early builds immense confidence.

  • Step 2: Move to Physics. Dedicate about 40 minutes here. Solve the theoretical and easy numerical questions first. If a calculation looks too lengthy, mark it for review and skip it temporarily.

  • Step 3: End with Mathematics. Dedicate your remaining 60 to 65 minutes to the 40 math questions. Because this section is calculation-heavy, having banked your easy marks already prevents panic.

  • Step 4: The Final 5 Minutes. Use this time strictly for educated guessing. Ensure no question is left blank.

Actionable Last-Minute Preparation Checklist

  • Stop Studying New Topics: If you have not touched a chapter yet, leave it. Focus entirely on strengthening what you already know.

  • Rely on Short Notes and Flashcards: Put away the thick reference books. Use your handwritten formula sheets to rapidly cycle through Physics and Physical Chemistry formulas.

  • Analyze Your Mock Tests: Identify your frequent unforced errors. Are you misreading questions? Are you making calculation mistakes? Fixing these minor errors can easily boost your score by 10 to 15 marks.

  • Fix Your Sleep Cycle: Do not study late into the night before the exam. Your brain requires adequate rest to maintain the speed and focus necessary for a 150-minute continuous computer-based test.

Conclusion

Your performance in the entrance examination ultimately comes down to speed, accuracy, and strategic execution. By structuring your VITEEE last minute revision around high-weightage chapters like Calculus, Electrodynamics, and Organic Chemistry, you maximize your scoring potential. Stick to a smart attempt sequence on exam day, clear the easier sections first, and take full advantage of the zero negative marking policy. Stay calm, trust your preparation, and confidently claim your engineering seat.

title: IIT Placements Beyond Packages: How to Read Branch-Wise Outcomes
description: Learn how to compare IIT placement reports using branch-wise participation, median pay, cohort size and unplaced-student data before choosing a programme.
content:
IIT placement reports can make one branch look unbeatable because of a single high package. Before you choose, compare the same programme-level figures: eligible cohort, students placed, median pay and students who did not receive or pursue placement. An institute-wide headline may not describe the branch you’ll actually study.

This is the real admission risk. A large offer from one department can influence your preference list even when recruiter demand, job roles and placement participation differ across branches.

Which figures matter in an IIT placement report?

Read the report for the relevant placement year and department. Then check how the institution defines each category.

  • Eligible cohort: This tells you how many students could take part. A median salary means more when you know whether it covers 40 students or 240.
  • Students placed: Compare this number with the eligible and registered groups. They may not be identical.
  • Median salary: The middle reported salary among the relevant group is usually more useful than the highest package for judging a typical placed student.
  • Average salary: A few very high offers can push the average up, so don’t read it alone.
  • Unplaced and non-participating students: Check whether the report separates students without offers from those who opted out, pursued higher studies or did not register.

How do you compare two IIT branches fairly?

Use the same placement year and the same definitions for both branches. Never compare one branch’s median with another branch’s highest package, or a final report with an early update.

Report fieldWhat it tells you
Programme and departmentWhether the result belongs to your likely branch
Eligible cohortThe student base behind the percentage
Median salaryA steadier view of the middle outcome
Placed and non-placed countsHow widely the result was shared
Recruiter and role mixWhether the jobs suit your intended career

What should you check before filling counselling preferences?

Create a comparison sheet for three or four branches across the latest available reports. Mark missing information as “not reported”; don’t fill gaps with social-media claims. If an IIT publishes only institute-wide results, treat them as limited evidence for branch selection.

Placement figures aren’t the whole decision. Check the course structure, internship access and whether you can handle the core subjects for four years. You can explore courses and compare colleges while assessing the wider academic setting.

The responsible IIT placement office publishes the report, so its definitions matter more than coaching-page summaries. Before paying fees or locking preferences, read the latest report released by the IIT and record which students each figure includes. If a category is unclear, treat the number cautiously instead of assuming it covers the full branch.

title: SLAT 2027: Check Both Payments Before You Finish Registration
description: SLAT 2027 applicants must pay both the test fee and the fee for each chosen law programme. Check the official 4 December registration cutoff.
content:
Paying for SLAT 2027 is not the same as applying to a Symbiosis law programme. The official registration instructions require a test fee and a separate programme fee for each programme you choose. If the second payment is missing, Symbiosis says that programme will not consider your application for shortlisting, whatever your test score.

Check the two payments in your SLAT account

The official SLAT registration guide lists ₹2,550 per test and ₹1,000 per programme, with government taxes extra where applicable. One or two SLAT test dates can be selected, but each test carries its own fee. After the test payment, select the law institute and programme you actually want, then complete its separate programme payment. Check the payment confirmation for every selection before you leave the portal.

Symbiosis International, SLAT 2027 official registration step 09 (no page date displayed). Read the full registration instructions for the live payment and programme rules.

Do the programme choice before final sign-off

Match the law programme and institute to your plans and read its official eligibility conditions. Recheck your name, email and phone number in the registration form, and keep both payment receipts and the SLAT ID. The registration page says changes are not permitted after registration, so review the displayed details before the final step. If a payment confirmation does not arrive, check your spam folder and use the account's “Raise A Query” route as the official guide advises.

Know the main dates without rushing

The official SLAT timetable closes test registration and payment on 4 December 2026. It schedules SLAT 01 for 19 December and SLAT 02 for 26 December; candidates who take both will have their higher score used for final percentile calculation. Programme payment deadlines can differ by institute, so check each selected institute's entry in the official portal as well.

description: Check the JEE Main 2027 Class 11 syllabus for Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics, including important topics, chapter-wise weightage and preparation tips.
content:
The JEE Main 2027 Class 11 syllabus includes topics from physics, chemistry, and mathematics that students must study for the engineering entrance exam. The National Testing Agency (NTA) has shared the JEE Main 2027 syllabus subject by subject. There is no special syllabus just for Class 11. Chemistry

Sets, Trigonometry, Complex Numbers, Sequences and Series, Permutations and Combinations, Binomial Theorem, Coordinate Geometry

Important Chapters for JEE Main 2027

I believe students should build a conceptual foundation in the following areas:

Physics: Focus on Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Rotational Motion, Work, Energy and Power, and Thermodynamics. Practice numerical. Review formulas often.

Chemistry: I suggest that chemistry students prioritize the mole concept, atomic structure, and chemical bonding numerically. Equilibrium and organic chemistry fundamentals. NCERT textbooks can help strengthen understanding.

Mathematics: For Mathematics I recommend practicing trigonometry, complex numbers, sequences and series, coordinate geometry, and permutations and combinations. Regular problem-solving is essential for improving speed and accuracy.

JEE Main 2027 Chapter-Wise Weightage

The NTA does not set weightage for each chapter. Past question papers can help students spot topics that come up often. The number of questions can be different in each exam session. Because of this, students should not focus on certain chapters.

Preparation Tips

  • Complete the prescribed syllabus systematically.

  • Solve previous-year questions after each chapter.

  • Maintain formula and revision notes.

  • Take timed mock tests.

  • Analyze mistakes and revisit weak topics.

Conclusion

The JEE Main 2027 Class 11 syllabus is a part of engineering entrance exam preparation. Students must study physics, chemistry, and mathematics in depth, practice previous‑year questions, and treat weightage estimates as a rough guide. Following the syllabus can help aspirants organize their preparation effectively.

title: BTech First-Year Curriculum: How to Check Workload Before Admission
description: Compare a BTech first-year curriculum by checking mathematics, physics, programming labs, practical hours, assessments and support before paying fees.
content:
A BTech first-year curriculum can change your college experience more than a ranking suggests. Before you apply or pay a seat-booking fee, compare the approved subject list, weekly contact hours, laboratory work, assessment pattern and academic support at each college.

Start with the university or affiliating institution’s academic section. If the latest scheme of study isn’t available, ask the college for it in writing. An admissions brochure may sell the branch well while leaving out lab attendance, repeat-course rules or the number of internal tests.

Which subjects reveal the real first-year workload?

Subject names don’t tell the whole story. Two colleges may list Engineering Mathematics, but one may add tutorials, weekly quizzes and a separate mathematics laboratory.

  • Mathematics: Count the papers, credits and tutorial hours. Check whether the syllabus includes calculus, linear algebra, differential equations or probability. If Class 12 mathematics was difficult for you, look for tutorials or remedial classes.
  • Physics and chemistry: Separate theory hours from practical sessions. Lab records, viva examinations and attendance can add work after class.
  • Programming: Check whether the first year has only a theory paper or also a coding lab. Ask which language is taught, how many submissions are expected and how practical marks are awarded.
  • Assessment: Record the marks split between end-semester examinations, internal tests, assignments, practicals, viva and attendance. Frequent tests mean a steady weekly load.

How should you compare two BTech colleges?

Make one sheet for every shortlisted college. Compare the same fields, not just total fees. The table below shows the questions that expose hidden workload.

Curriculum detailQuestion to askWhat it tells you
Programming labHow many sessions and submissions?Hands-on time and practice pressure
Mathematics supportAre tutorials or remedial classes available?Help available before backlogs grow
Internal assessmentHow often are tests and assignments held?Weekly pressure across the semester

Then check practical details such as staffed laboratories, software access, supplementary examinations and charges for repeated courses or practicals. Ask current students how many submissions and vivas they handle in a normal month, but treat their answers as useful context, not official rules.

When should the curriculum change your shortlist?

If you’re comfortable with coding but weak in mathematics, a college with several mathematics papers needs visible academic support. If practical work suits you, regular labs may fit better than a course built mainly around long theory examinations. Compare colleges through college comparison details and review BTech course information before deciding.

Use the university’s approved scheme and written examination rules for the final check. Choose the workload your skills, time and budget can realistically manage.

title: JEE Mainના મફત વીડિયો: IIT-PALથી ચોક્કસ શંકા દૂર કરો
description: ભૌતિકશાસ્ત્ર, રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર અને ગણિતની મુશ્કેલી માટે NTAની IIT-PAL લિંક્સ વાપરો. પછી હાલના અભ્યાસક્રમના પ્રશ્નોથી સમજ ચકાસો.
content:
JEE Mainનો કોઈ અધ્યાય સમજવામાં વધુ સમય લાગે તો NTA સાથે જોડાયેલા IIT-PAL વ્યાખ્યાન મદદરૂપ બની શકે છે. સત્તાવાર પેજ પર IITના પ્રોફેસરો અને વિષય નિષ્ણાતોની ભૌતિકશાસ્ત્ર, રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર અને ગણિતની પ્લેલિસ્ટ છે. ચોક્કસ શંકા દૂર કરવા વીડિયો પસંદ કરો અને પછી પ્રશ્નોના અભ્યાસ પર પાછા આવો.

NTAના પેજથી વિષય ખોલો

NTAના વિષય આધારિત વ્યાખ્યાન પેજ પર ભૌતિકશાસ્ત્ર, ગણિત કે રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર પસંદ કરો. લિંક્સ IIT-PAL પ્લેલિસ્ટ સુધી લઈ જાય છે. એ જ પેજ પર NEET માટે જીવવિજ્ઞાન પણ છે. તે લિંક હોવાથી જીવવિજ્ઞાન JEE Mainના એન્જિનિયરિંગ પેપરનો વિષય બનતું નથી.

NTA મુજબ આ સામગ્રી ખ્યાલો સમજવા અને અભ્યાસ માટે છે. પરીક્ષામાં આ વીડિયોમાંથી જ પ્રશ્ન આવશે તેવી ખાતરી નથી. આ સંસાધનોનો સંગ્રહ છે; દરેક પ્લેલિસ્ટને નવો 2027 કોર્સ કે લાઇવ વર્ગનું સમયપત્રક ન માનો.

વીડિયો પહેલાં મુશ્કેલી ઓળખો

JEE Mainની સત્તાવાર વેબસાઇટનો હાલનો અભ્યાસક્રમ નોંધ સાથે રાખો. લાંબી પ્લેલિસ્ટ જોતા પહેલાં વિષયને અભ્યાસક્રમ સાથે સરખાવો. માત્ર વીડિયોના શીર્ષકથી દરેક ભાગ તમારા પેપર માટે ઉપયોગી છે એવું નક્કી થતું નથી.

ભૌતિકશાસ્ત્રમાં સમીકરણ બનાવવું, ગણિતમાં રીત પસંદ કરવી કે રસાયણનો ખ્યાલ સમજાવવો, ક્યાં મુશ્કેલી છે તે લખો. સ્પષ્ટ પ્રશ્નથી ઉપયોગી ભાગ પસંદ કરવો અને શંકા દૂર થઈ છે કે નહીં તે જાણવું સરળ બને છે.

વ્યાખ્યાનને પ્રશ્નોની પ્રેક્ટિસમાં ફેરવો

જોતા પહેલાં સંબંધિત પ્રશ્ન ઉકેલવાનો પ્રયાસ કરો અને ખોટો પ્રયાસ પણ રાખો. શિક્ષક ઉદાહરણ પૂરું કરે તે પહેલાં રોકો, આગળનું પગલું જાતે કરો અને તર્ક સરખાવો. પછી વીડિયો તથા નોંધ બંધ કરીને નવો પ્રશ્ન ઉકેલો. સંપૂર્ણ વ્યાખ્યાન લખવાને બદલે સુધારેલી ભૂલ નોંધો.

સમાન પ્રશ્ન હજી ન ઉકલે તો મૂળભૂત ખ્યાલ ફરી જુઓ અથવા અટકેલા પગલાની શિક્ષકને પૂછપરછ કરો. પોતાને ચકાસ્યા વગર આખી પ્લેલિસ્ટ ફરી જોવાથી ખામી છુપાઈ શકે છે.

ખ્યાલનો અભ્યાસ અને સમયમર્યાદાની પ્રેક્ટિસ અલગ રાખો. વીડિયો રીત સમજાવે છે; સમય નક્કી કરીને કરેલા પ્રયાસ બતાવે છે કે દબાણમાં તેનો ઉપયોગ કરી શકો છો કે નહીં. વધુ વીડિયો ઉમેરતા પહેલાં ખોટા પ્રશ્નોની સમીક્ષા કરો.

title: CBSE इयत्ता 10 आणि 12 Electronics and Hardware परीक्षा 2027: तारीख, विषय संकेतांक आणि वेळ
description: इयत्ता 10च्या Electronics and Hardware (संकेतांक 420) विषयाचा पेपर 25 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 12:30 या वेळेत आहे. इयत्ता 12च्या Electronics and Hardware (संकेतांक 847) विषयाचा पेपर 4 मार्च 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे.
content:
इयत्ता 10च्या Electronics and Hardware (संकेतांक 420) विषयाचा पेपर 25 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 12:30 या वेळेत आहे. इयत्ता 12च्या Electronics and Hardware (संकेतांक 847) विषयाचा पेपर 4 मार्च 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे.

CBSEने 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026 रोजी प्रसिद्ध केलेल्या मुख्य परीक्षेच्या वेळापत्रकात ही नोंद आहे. हे परीक्षेचे वेळापत्रक आहे; गुणपत्रिका नाही. अधिकृत CBSE वेळापत्रक

Electronics and Hardware पेपरचा कालावधी

इयत्ता आणि विषयसंकेतांकपरीक्षेची तारीखवेळ (IST)कालावधी
इयत्ता 10: Electronics and Hardware42025 फेब्रुवारी 202710:30 - 12:302 तास
इयत्ता 12: Electronics and Hardware8474 मार्च 202710:30 - 13:303 तास

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षण मंडळ, 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 5: विषय संकेतांक, तारीख आणि वेळ. मूळ PDFमधील हे पृष्ठ पाहा

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षण मंडळ, 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 10: विषय संकेतांक, तारीख आणि वेळ. मूळ PDFमधील हे पृष्ठ पाहा

अधिकृत PDFमध्ये आपली नोंद कशी शोधाल?

पृष्ठ 5, 10 वर प्रथम इयत्तेचे शीर्षक पाहा, मग 420, 847 हा संकेतांक शोधा. तारीख किंवा वेळ दाखवणारा एकच रकाना अनेक ओळींना लागू असू शकतो. फोनवर पान मोठे करून पूर्ण ओळ वाचा.

शाळेतील नोंदणीवरचा संकेतांक आणि अभ्यासक्रमाचे पूर्ण नाव तपासा. दुसऱ्या इयत्तेलाही तेच नाव असल्यास फक्त स्वतःच्या इयत्तेची ओळ निवडा.

इंग्रजीच्या पेपरशी तारखांची तुलना

इयत्ता 10चा Electronics and Hardware (420) पेपर 25 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी आहे. English Language and Literature (184)चा पेपर 26 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी आहे. दोन तारखांमध्ये 1 दिवसांचे अंतर आहे. इयत्ता 12चा Electronics and Hardware (847) पेपर 4 मार्च 2027 रोजी आहे. English Core (301)चा पेपर 5 मार्च 2027 रोजी आहे. दोन तारखांमध्ये 1 दिवसांचे अंतर आहे.

हे सर्व दिवस अभ्यासासाठी सुट्टीचे असतील असे नाही. आपले इतर पेपरही दिनदर्शिकेत नोंदवून परीक्षा नसलेले मधले दिवस मोजा. सरावासाठी मूळ पेपरइतकाच वेळ ठेवा.

प्रात्यक्षिकाची वेळ वेगळी तपासा

या ओळीत बोर्डाच्या पेपरची वेळ दिली आहे. प्रात्यक्षिक, सादरीकरण, प्रकल्प किंवा अंतर्गत मूल्यमापन असल्यास त्याची तारीख व आवश्यक साहित्य शाळेला विचारा.

केंद्रात संपर्क साधने नेण्यास परवानगी नाही. काय नेता येईल हे ठरवताना CBSEच्या स्वतंत्र सूचना आणि प्रवेशपत्रावरील नियम पाळा.

title: NTA Scorecard Errors: What to Preserve Before Filing an Admission Challenge
description: Found an NTA score, response-sheet, identity or payment mismatch? Save the right records first and separate the complaint route from counselling action.
content:
Before you question an NTA scorecard error, save the record that proves what happened and when. Download the scorecard, response sheet or answer key, preserve the original files, and capture the portal page showing any download or submission time. Organised proof helps the reviewing authority identify the disputed record, but it doesn’t guarantee a correction, rank change or admission relief.

Start by naming the problem correctly. An answer-key objection, a final-score dispute, a personal-detail correction and a counselling or document-verification issue may arise at different stages and may be handled by different authorities.

What should you save for an answer-key or score dispute?

For a disputed response or mark calculation, retain the evidence linked to the relevant question, paper and session:

  • Download the scorecard, response sheet and provisional answer key as original PDF files. Don’t edit or rename the originals.
  • Save the question number, your recorded response, the answer displayed by the National Testing Agency and your calculation.
  • Take a full-page screenshot showing the application number, paper, session, disputed entry and visible portal address where possible.
  • Preserve the file properties or metadata, plus a screenshot of the portal page showing the download time or objection submission time when available.
  • Keep the exam notice that states the applicable window, fee or method, if that notice provides one.

A provisional-answer-key objection may close before the final result. A post-result challenge may not be available, or may require a different route and different proof. Don’t assume the same window stays open.

How is a personal-detail error different?

A wrong name, photograph, category or date of birth is an identity-record problem, not a marks objection. Keep the scorecard, confirmation page, registration details, correction request and acknowledgement number. Hold the document that proves the correct detail, but don’t send full Aadhaar, bank or UPI details through informal email, messaging groups or social media. Share sensitive records only through the named official route when the relevant exam notice asks for them.

What if payment failed but money was debited?

Save the amount, date, transaction ID, bank or UPI reference, portal status and account statement entry. If the bank shows a debit but the portal shows failure, don’t pay again immediately. Record both statuses and check the relevant exam notice or payment-support route for reconciliation.

Keep one dated folder for each issue and track counselling separately. If a pending dispute affects your choices, review other entrance exam options, but don’t miss a counselling or document-verification deadline while waiting for a reply.

title: NCET 2026 ITEP Institutional Seat Allocation Framework: Decentralized Campus Counselling, Document Screening, and Merit List Registration
description: A comprehensive guide to the NCET 2026 ITEP institutional seat allocation framework, detailing campus counselling, document screening, and merit list registration.
content:
NCET 2026 ITEP Institutional Seat Allocation Framework: Campus Counselling, Screening, and Merit Registration

The Integrated Teacher Education Programme (ITEP) represents a major structural shift in teacher preparation across India. Offered in dual-major four-year multidisciplinary bachelor degrees (such as B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed., and B.Com. B.Ed.), ITEP admissions rely on the National Common Entrance Test (NCET) scores conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA). However, once NTA declares the scorecard, the seat allocation process shifts entirely into a decentralized institutional framework. Participating central universities, state public universities, IITs, NITs, and RIEs publish individual merit portals, verify original documents, and finalize institutional seat matrix distribution independently.

Understanding this multi-tiered seat allocation model is critical for students and parents aiming to secure a seat in recognized institutions for the academic session.

Understanding the Decentralized Allocation Architecture

Unlike centralized single-window admissions systems, NCET operates through an institutional counselling model. NTA provides normalized subject-wise percentile scores to registered universities. Each participating university then releases its own eligibility guidelines, subject mapping criteria, and application window on its official admission portal.

Key features of this decentralized system include:

  • Independent Application Forms: Candidates must register separately on every target university portal using their NCET application number and roll number.
  • Institutional Subject Mapping: Universities evaluate candidates based on specific combinations of Section 1 (Languages), Section 2 (Domain Subjects), Section 3 (General Test), and Section 4 (Teaching Aptitude).
  • Category and State Quotas: Institutional seat allocation applies central or state reservation rules, home-state quotas (specifically in NITs and state universities), and institutional supernumerary seats.

Step-by-Step Merit List Registration Process

To participate in institutional allocation rounds, candidates must complete merit registration within each university's published deadline. Missing an individual institution's deadline disqualifies the applicant from that university's subsequent admission lists.

1. Registration and Profile Building

Candidates create an account on the university's admission portal. Details such as personal information, NCET score breakdown, Category Certificate details, and Class 12 aggregate marks must be entered carefully. Discrepancies between NTA data and university submissions can lead to rejection.

2. Program and Disciplinary Choice Preferences

During registration, candidates select their preferred disciplinary stream (B.A. B.Ed., B.Sc. B.Ed., or B.Com. B.Ed.) alongside specialization choices (e.g., Foundational, Preparatory, Middle, or Secondary stage specialization as aligned with the National Education Policy framework).

3. Processing Fee Submission

Each university charges a non-refundable counselling registration fee. Upon successful payment, a candidate profile summary is generated, serving as an official acknowledgment for future rounds.

Document Screening and Verification Protocols

Document screening occurs in two distinct stages: online preliminary verification during merit registration and physical document verification at the assigned campus prior to final seat confirmation.

Document Type Key Requirements for Verification Critical Points to Note
NCET 2026 Official Scorecard Original NTA issued scorecard displaying domain breakdown Must clearly show candidate roll number and subject marks
Class 10 & 12 Marksheets Recognized board certificate for age and subject eligibility Minimum aggregate percentage criteria set by institutions
Category & PwBD Certificates Issued by competent authority in central/state prescribed format OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must be valid for current financial year
Identity & Residence Proof Aadhaar Card, Passport, or Government photo ID Details must match official NCET registration records

Any failure to present authentic documents during physical screening leads to immediate cancellation of the allocated seat, with the seat transferred to the next eligible candidate in subsequent counseling rounds.

Institutional Merit List Publication and Seat Acceptance

Once registration and online screening close, universities release rank-wise merit lists. Depending on total seat capacity, institutions publish multiple admission lists (Round 1, Round 2, and Mop-Up/Spot Allocation rounds).

Upon receiving a seat offer, candidates must take action within the stipulated timeframe:

  • Freeze: Select this option if you are satisfied with the allocated stream/campus and wish to lock your seat. This requires immediate payment of the institutional admission fee.
  • Float/Upgrade: Select this option if you wish to accept the current seat offer tentatively but remain eligible for higher-preference streams in subsequent merit rounds at the same institution.
  • Withdraw/Reject: Decline the allocated seat to exit the university's admission process completely.

Always verify cut-offs, seat matrix details, and schedule updates on the official website of the target institution, as timelines vary significantly across different universities.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is NCET seat allotment conducted through a single common portal for all colleges?

No. While NTA conducts the entrance test, seat allocation for ITEP is decentralized. Each participating university, IIT, NIT, and RIE manages its own merit registration portal and counselling rounds.

What happens if a candidate fails to register on a university's portal before the merit deadline?

The candidate will not be considered for seat allotment rounds at that university, even if they have a valid and high NCET score.

Can a candidate apply to multiple universities using the same NCET 2026 scorecard?

Yes. Candidates can apply to as many participating universities as they wish, provided they meet the specific eligibility requirements and domain subject mapping of each individual institution.

What documents are mandatory for the online screening stage?

Mandatory documents typically include the NCET 2026 admit card and scorecard, Class 10 and 12 marksheets, valid photo ID proof, and valid category certificates (OBC-NCL, EWS, SC, ST, PwBD) if applicable.

What is the difference between Freeze and Float options during seat allocation?

Freeze locks your allotted seat and completes your admission at that institution. Float accepts the current seat provisionally while keeping you eligible for higher-preference options in subsequent rounds.

title: Online or On-Campus Degree: What’s Better in 2025?
description: Compare online degrees and on-campus education in 2025. Discover key differences, benefits, and which option is right for your career goals.
content:
In 2025, the educational environment will be more flexible, digital, and student-centered than in the past. Students today have more options when it comes to obtaining a degree thanks to the growth of online platforms and global virtual learning. But perplexity comes with choosing.

Does the value of an online degree match that of a conventional on-campus education? More significantly, which one best suits your lifestyle, learning preferences, and professional objectives?

Let's thoroughly examine both choices so you can make an informed choice.

What Is an Online Degree?

An online degree is a complete academic program that enables students to learn from a distance using digital media. In India, these degrees are frequently accepted by the UGC or AICTE and have a set curriculum that includes assignments, projects, and tests.

Key Point: Students can study at their own speed and from any location with an online degree, eliminating the need to travel to a traditional campus.

UGC-approved online programs are available at Indian colleges such as Amity, Manipal, IGNOU, and Jain University. Through websites like Coursera, edX, and upGrad, institutions in the US, UK, and Australia now provide flexible online degrees.

What Is On-Campus Education?

The conventional college experience known as \"on-campus education\" involves students living on or close to campus, attending classes in person, and taking part in extracurricular activities. It includes access to campus resources, classroom interactions, a set schedule, and hands-on research facilities.

The conventional college experience known as \"on-campus education\" involves students living on or close to campus, attending classes in person, and taking part in extracurricular activities. It includes access to campus resources, classroom interactions, a set schedule, and hands-on research facilities.

Cost and Accessibility

1. Online degrees are more cost-effective.

Hostel, travel, relocation, and physical infrastructure costs are all included. Students can continue working while they study, and tuition costs are frequently reduced.

2. On-campus education is more expensive.

Students must pay for housing, food, and other personal expenditures in addition to tuition.

Key Point: Online education offers the advantage if flexibility and cost are important considerations.

Placement and Career Opportunities

Because of their established industry connections, alumni networks, and career cells, on-campus universities typically offer superior placement assistance. During placement season, top recruiters frequently make in-person campus visits.

Though organized placement aid is still lacking in many institutions, online degrees are making progress in this regard. Although their reach isn't as great, some online platforms now provide resume assistance, job counseling, mentorship, and interview preparation.

Key Point: Campus programs are more dependable for recent graduates seeking employment assistance immediately following graduation.

Conclusion

The good news is that you have more options than ever before as the world of learning changes. Success will rely on your commitment, skill development, and resource management, whether you study in person or online.

Remember that companies today are more interested in your talents, internships, and problem-solving abilities than they are in your educational background.

Make sensible decisions, maintain consistency, and never stop learning.

Keep checking back with Dekho Campus, your reliable educational partner, for more information, advice for students, and career insights.

title: CUCET 2027: Notification, Eligibility, Pattern & Syllabus
description: Read the complete guide to CUCET 2027. Find out about the official notification, eligibility criteria, exam pattern, core syllabus, and preparation strategies.
content:
The Chandigarh University Common Entrance Test (CUCET) is a national-level examination that determines admissions and scholarship brackets for undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Chandigarh University. For engineering (B.Tech) aspirants, the exam evaluates proficiency in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and English. The test is conducted online in a Remote Proctored Online Mode (RPOM) or at designated testing centers. This guide details the 2027 notification timeline, academic eligibility criteria, application process, examination pattern, and core syllabus.

Official Notification and Important Dates

Chandigarh University conducts CUCET in multiple phases throughout the academic admission cycle. This allows students to attempt the exam at different times to improve their scholarship eligibility.

  • Application Form Release: Expected in October or November 2026 for Phase 1.

  • Phase 1 Examination Dates: Runs from December 2026 through May 2027.

  • Phase 2 Examination Dates: Runs from June 2027 through October 2027.

  • Slot Booking: Candidates can select their preferred exam date and time immediately after submitting the application fee.

  • Result Declaration: Results and scholarship brackets are typically communicated within 24 to 48 hours of completing the test.

Academic Eligibility Criteria

Before applying for CUCET 2027, candidates must ensure they meet the specific academic requirements for their chosen program.

  • Age Limit: There is no specific age limit to apply for CUCET.

  • Nationality: The exam is open to Indian nationals. Other nationalities can apply if they meet specific international admission criteria.

  • Academic Qualification (B.Tech): Applicants must have passed or be appearing for their Class 12 board examinations in 2027 from a recognized educational board.

  • Mandatory Subjects: For standard engineering branches, candidates must have studied Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects, along with one elective (such as Chemistry, Biotechnology, Computer Science, or Biology).

  • Minimum Marks Requirement: A minimum aggregate of 50% in the qualifying Class 12 examination is mandatory for B.Tech admissions.

Registration and Application Process

The application process is handled online via the official Chandigarh University admissions portal.

  1. New Registration: Create an account using an active email ID and mobile number.

  2. Profile Completion: Fill in personal details, select the target program, and enter your academic records.

  3. Document Upload: Upload a clear, recent passport-size photograph and a scanned signature.

  4. Fee Payment: Pay the registration fee (typically ₹1,000) using a debit card, credit card, or net banking.

  5. Slot Booking: Log into the portal to select the preferred examination date, time slot, and testing mode (remote proctored or center-based).

Examination Pattern and Marking Scheme

The CUCET 2027 is a Computer-Based Test (CBT) that requires candidates to solve 100 questions in 120 minutes. There is no negative marking, encouraging candidates to attempt the entire paper.

  • Total Duration: 120 minutes (2 hours).

  • Total Questions: 100 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).

  • Marking Scheme: Candidates receive +1 mark for every correct answer. Zero marks are deducted for incorrect or unattempted questions.

For B.Tech (Non-Medical) candidates, the question distribution is as follows:

Core Syllabus Overview

The undergraduate engineering syllabus for CUCET aligns directly with the standard Class 11 and Class 12 NCERT curriculum.

  • Mathematics: Algebra (Matrices, Determinants, Quadratic Equations), Calculus (Limits, Differentiation, Integration), Coordinate Geometry, Vectors, and Probability.

  • Physics: Kinematics, Laws of Motion, Work and Energy, Thermodynamics, Electrostatics, Current Electricity, Optics, and Modern Physics.

  • Chemistry: Physical Chemistry (Thermodynamics, Solutions, Kinetics), Organic Chemistry (Basic principles, Hydrocarbons, Mechanisms), and Inorganic Chemistry (Chemical Bonding, p-Block and d-Block elements).

  • English: Grammar rules (tenses, prepositions, subject-verb agreement), reading comprehension, synonyms, antonyms, and sentence correction.

Strategic Preparation Tips

Because the exam evaluates both speed and accuracy within a 120-minute window, a structured execution plan is necessary.

  • Attempt All Questions: With no negative marking, candidates must ensure every question is answered. Use logical elimination for difficult problems rather than leaving them blank.

  • Prioritize the English Section: The 10 English questions require minimal calculation and can typically be completed in under 10 minutes, securing early marks.

  • Focus on Class 12 Core Concepts: A significant portion of the test relies on direct formula application from the Class 12 curriculum. Maintain a dedicated formula sheet for Physics and Mathematics for daily review.

  • Simulate Test Conditions: Take full-length, 120-minute mock tests on a desktop or laptop to build mental stamina and adapt to the Computer-Based Test environment.

Conclusion

Securing a high score in CUCET 2027 guarantees both admission into Chandigarh University's engineering programs and significant scholarship benefits. Candidates must verify their 50% aggregate eligibility in Class 12 before applying and booking their test slots. By focusing daily revision strictly on the Class 11 and 12 NCERT curriculum and prioritizing high-weightage chapters like calculus and electrostatics, students build a reliable foundation. Because the 120-minute exam features 100 questions with absolutely no negative marking, success depends on maintaining a fast pace, clearing the straightforward English section early, and attempting every single question to maximize the final score.

title: JEE Main 2027 ਨਵਾਂ ਫਾਰਮ: ਕਿਹੜੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮੰਨੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫੀਸ ਦਾ ਕੀ ਬਣੇਗਾ?
description: ਗਲਤੀ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਨਵੇਂ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ 1 ਫਾਰਮ ਨੂੰ NTA ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫੀਸ ਟ੍ਰਾਂਸਫਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ। ਮੰਨੀ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਅਤੇ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਸੋਧ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
JEE Main 2027 ਸੈਸ਼ਨ 1 ਫਾਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਲਤੀ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਹਮੇਸ਼ਾ ਮੁੜ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਨਹੀਂ। NTA ਦਾ 30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਦਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨੰਬਰ ਬਣਨ ਜਾਂ ਫੀਸ ਭਰਨ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਵੀ ਨਵੀਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਕੁਝ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਬਦਲਣ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸੋਧ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਵਰਤਣ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ। ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਗਲਤੀ ਲਈ ਠੀਕ ਰਾਹ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਸੋਧ ਜਾਂ ਨਵੀਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਫੈਸਲਾ ਕਰੋ

ਸੋਧ ਸਹੂਲਤ 27 ਤੋਂ 29 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਲਈ ਨਿਰਧਾਰਤ ਹੈ। NTA ਵੱਲੋਂ ਮਨਜ਼ੂਰ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਮੰਨੋ; ਇਹ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਹਰ ਐਂਟਰੀ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੰਦਾ। ਨਵੇਂ ਫਾਰਮ ਦਾ ਨਵਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨੰਬਰ ਬਣੇਗਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ, ਫੋਟੋ, ਦਸਤਖ਼ਤ ਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਮੁੜ ਭਰਨ ਜਾਂ ਅਪਲੋਡ ਕਰਨੇ ਪੈਣਗੇ।

ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਫਾਰਮ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਫੀਸ ਨਾ ਵਾਪਸ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ, ਨਾ ਨਵੀਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਜੋੜੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ। ਗਲਤ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦੀ ਸੋਧ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਮੁੜ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ NTA ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਲਵੋ।

ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਹੀ ਮੰਨੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ

NTA ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਉਸ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨੂੰ ਮੰਨੇਗਾ ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ ਸਫਲਤਾਪੂਰਵਕ ਭਰੀ ਹੋਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੋਵੇ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਨਵੀਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲਦੀ। ਨਵੇਂ ਫਾਰਮ ਦਾ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਤਾਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦੀ ਉਹ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਮੰਨੀ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਨ।

ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨੰਬਰ, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਇਕੱਠੇ ਰੱਖੋ। ਨਵੀਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਜਾਂਚ ਕੇ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ, ਤਾਂ ਜੋ ਅੱਗੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਵੇਖਣ ਵੇਲੇ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਸਕੋ।

ਰਾਸ਼ਟਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਏਜੰਸੀ, 30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦਾ ਜਨਤਕ ਨੋਟਿਸ: ਨਵਾਂ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ 1 ਫਾਰਮ, ਫੀਸ ਅਤੇ ਮੰਨੀ ਜਾਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਾ ਨਿਯਮ। ਅਸਲ NTA ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਇਸ ਸਪਸ਼ਟੀਕਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੇਟ ਫੀਸ ਦੀ ਰਕਮ ਜਾਂ ਸੋਧ ਬੰਦ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਲਾਗੂ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਵੇਖੋ; ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਾ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਸੋਧ ਉੱਤੇ ਆਪਣੇ-ਆਪ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਇੱਕ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਹੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼

ਇੱਕ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਨੰਬਰ ਹੋਣ ਨਾਲ ਉਸੇ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਈ ਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਇਜਾਜ਼ਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦੀ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਕਈ ਨੰਬਰ ਰੱਖਣਾ ਗਲਤ ਸਾਧਨ (UFM) ਨਹੀਂ; ਪਰ ਕਈ ਨੰਬਰਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੇਣਾ ਜਾਂ ਦੇਣ ਦੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਬੁਲੇਟਿਨ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ UFM ਹੈ।

title: AACCC PG 2026 રાઉન્ડ 1: 3 નવેમ્બરની ત્રણ અલગ સમયમર્યાદા
description: રજિસ્ટ્રેશન બપોરે 2, ચુકવણી સાંજે 5 અને ચોઇસ લોકિંગ રાત્રે 11:55 વાગ્યે બંધ થશે. સુધારેલું રાઉન્ડ 1 સમયપત્રક સમજો.
content:
AACCCના સુધારેલા AYUSH અનુસ્નાતક કાઉન્સેલિંગ સમયપત્રકમાં રાઉન્ડ 1 રજિસ્ટ્રેશન 30 ઓક્ટોબરથી 3 નવેમ્બર 2026 સુધી છે. છેલ્લા દિવસે ત્રણ અલગ સમયમર્યાદા છે. રજિસ્ટ્રેશન પહેલાં બંધ થશે; ચોઇસ લોકિંગના છેલ્લા સમય સુધી રાહ જોશો તો નોંધણી માટે મોડું થશે.

દરેક તબક્કા માટે અલગ રિમાઇન્ડર રાખો

સત્તાવાર PG કાઉન્સેલિંગ પેજ પર નવા રજિસ્ટ્રેશનની લિંક છે. AACCC હેઠળની બેઠકો ઇચ્છતા પાત્ર AIAPGET 2026 ઉમેદવારોએ એ માર્ગ વાપરીને ચુકવણી પહેલાં હાલની કાઉન્સેલિંગ પુસ્તિકા વાંચવી જોઈએ.

સત્તાવાર PG કાઉન્સેલિંગ પેજ

તમારું કામ

સુધારેલો રાઉન્ડ 1 સમય

રજિસ્ટ્રેશન પૂરું કરો

30 ઓક્ટોબરથી 3 નવેમ્બર 2026, બપોરે 2 વાગ્યા સુધી

ફી ચૂકવો

3 નવેમ્બર, સાંજે 5 વાગ્યા સુધી

ચોઇસ ભરો

30 ઓક્ટોબરથી 3 નવેમ્બર, રાત્રે 11:55 સુધી

ચોઇસ લોક કરો

3 નવેમ્બર, બપોરે 2થી રાત્રે 11:55 સુધી

આ સમય કાઉન્સેલિંગ સર્વરની ઘડિયાળ પ્રમાણે છે. નોંધણી, સફળ ચુકવણી અને સાચવેલી ચોઇસની અલગ-અલગ તપાસ કરો.

AACCCનું સુધારેલું કાઉન્સેલિંગ સમયપત્રક 2026-27, પૃષ્ઠ 1: રાઉન્ડ 1ની સમયમર્યાદા અને રિપોર્ટિંગ તારીખો. સત્તાવાર સુધારેલું સમયપત્રક

લોકિંગ પહેલાં કોલેજો પસંદ કરો

ચોઇસ ફોર્મ ખોલતાં પહેલાં કોલેજોની ટૂંકી યાદી બનાવો. ઉપલબ્ધ કોર્સ, સંસ્થા, ફી અને સ્થળને તમે ખરેખર સ્વીકારી શકો એવી પસંદગી સાથે સરખાવો. હાલનું સીટ મેટ્રિક્સ વાંચો; ગયા વર્ષે ઉપલબ્ધ કોર્સ આ રાઉન્ડમાં પણ હશે એવું ન માનો.

ચુકવણી પછી ખાતામાં સ્થિતિ તપાસો અને રસીદ સાચવો. લોક કરતાં પહેલાં ચોઇસનો ક્રમ ધ્યાનથી જુઓ. પોર્ટલની પુષ્ટિ અથવા સાચવેલી ચોઇસનો રેકોર્ડ રાખો. ચુકવણી કે સબમિશનની સમસ્યા રહે તો સત્તાવાર હેલ્પડેસ્કનો સંપર્ક કરો. AIAPGET સ્કોરકાર્ડ તથા પુસ્તિકામાં જણાવેલા બીજા દસ્તાવેજો તૈયાર રાખો.

AIAPGET પરિણામ અને સ્કોરકાર્ડ માર્ગદર્શિકા

ચોઇસ લોકિંગ પછી શું થશે?

સુધારેલા કાર્યક્રમમાં બેઠક ફાળવણીની પ્રક્રિયા 4 નવેમ્બર, પરિણામ 5 નવેમ્બર અને ફાળવેલી સંસ્થામાં રિપોર્ટિંગ 6થી 13 નવેમ્બર માટે નક્કી છે. આ આવનારા તબક્કા છે; પરિણામ અત્યારે જાહેર થઈ ગયું છે એવો અર્થ નથી.

પરિણામ આવ્યા પછી ફાળવણીની સૂચનાઓ અને સંસ્થાની રિપોર્ટિંગ જરૂરિયાત સાથે વાંચો. તે પ્રમાણે દસ્તાવેજો અને મુસાફરી ગોઠવો તથા પછીની AACCC સૂચનાઓ તપાસો.

title: Important Questions for Class 12 History CBSE Arts 2026 | Easy to Pass Guide
description: Get chapter-wise important questions for Class 12 History CBSE Arts 2026. Simple explanations, exam-oriented questions, FAQs, and map tips to score high easily.
content:
Important Questions for Class 12 History CBSE (Arts) – 2026 Board Exams

History is one of the most scoring subjects for CBSE Class 12 Arts students if studied smartly. Instead of reading every page, focusing on important questions for Class 12 History CBSE can help you score high with less stress. This article covers chapter-wise important questions, written in a clear format so that students can understand topics just by reading them.

This guide is especially useful for CBSE board exams 2026, last-minute revision, and answer-writing practice.

CBSE Class 12 History Exam Overview (Quick View)

Particulars Details
Subject History (Arts)
Board CBSE
Class 12
Exam Year 2026
Theory Marks 80
Project Work 20
Question Types MCQs, short answers, long answers, source-based, map work

Part-wise Important Questions for Class 12 History CBSE

Part I: Ancient Indian History – Important Questions

  1. Explain the town planning features of the Harappan Civilization.

  2. What do seals and beads tell us about Harappan trade?

  3. Describe the varna system in early Indian society.

  4. Explain the main teachings of Buddhism and Jainism.

  5. How were stupas and temples important in cultural development?

Focus keywords: Harappan civilisation questions, ancient history class 12 important questions

Part II: Medieval Indian History – Important Questions

  1. Describe Ibn Battuta’s observations about Indian society.

  2. Explain the main ideas of the Bhakti movement.

  3. Why was Vijayanagara considered a powerful empire?

  4. Discuss the role of zamindars in the Mughal agrarian system.

  5. How did Sufi saints influence Indian culture?

Focus keywords: medieval history important questions class 12 CBSE

Part III: Modern Indian History – Important Questions

  1. Explain the causes and impact of the Revolt of 1857.

  2. Discuss the role of Mahatma Gandhi in the national movement.

  3. How did colonial land revenue systems affect Indian farmers?

  4. Describe the process of framing the Indian Constitution.

  5. What challenges did India face after independence?

Focus keywords: modern history class 12 important questions CBSE

Source-Based & Case-Study Questions (Very Important)

  • How do archaeological sources help historians reconstruct history?

  • Analyse a source related to Bhakti or Sufi traditions.

  • Interpret a passage related to nationalist movements.

Tip: Always mention author, context, and significance.

Map-Based Questions (5 Marks Guaranteed)

Area Important Locations
Harappan Sites Harappa, Mohenjo-daro, Dholavira
Medieval Hampi, Ajmer
Modern Dandi, Chauri Chaura, Lahore

Practice labeling maps regularly to avoid losing easy marks.

Smart Preparation Tips for Class 12 History CBSE

  • Read NCERT line by line (very important for CBSE)

  • Practice previous year question papers

  • Write answers with headings + keywords

  • Use maps and timelines for better retention

  • Revise high-weightage chapters first

Final Words

These important questions for Class 12 History CBSE (Arts) are carefully selected to help students understand concepts easily, revise faster, and score well in board exams 2026. If you revise these questions properly, passing — and even scoring high — becomes much easier.

Keep revising, practice answer writing, and stay confident.

description: ইউপি বোর্ডের প্রস্তাবিত কেন্দ্র তালিকায় জেলা ও স্কুল খোঁজার পদ্ধতি, আপত্তির সময়সীমা এবং ৬ নভেম্বরের প্রশাসনিক পদক্ষেপ জেনে নিন।
content:
ইউপি বোর্ডের ২০২৭ সালের জেলাভিত্তিক পরীক্ষাকেন্দ্রের তালিকা প্রস্তাবিত তালিকা। এখানে থাকা কেন্দ্রকেই চূড়ান্ত ধরে যাতায়াতের পরিকল্পনা করবেন না। আগে সঠিক জেলার সম্পূর্ণ PDF দেখুন এবং স্কুল থেকে বরাদ্দের অবস্থা নিশ্চিত করুন।

নিজের জেলার সঠিক তালিকা খুলুন

সরকারি পেজে জেলার নাম, কোড ও ডাউনলোডের লিঙ্ক রয়েছে। আগ্রার কোড 01, লখনউয়ের 34 এবং প্রয়াগরাজের 55। নাম ও কোড দুটোই মিলিয়ে নিন। সারণির ক্রমিক সংখ্যা স্কুলের কোড নয়।

সরকারি জেলাভিত্তিক প্রস্তাবিত কেন্দ্র তালিকা

সম্পূর্ণ PDF ডাউনলোড করে স্কুলের নাম বা কোড খুঁজুন এবং সংশ্লিষ্ট পুরো তথ্য পড়ুন। স্ক্যান করা নথিতে খোঁজার সুবিধা কাজ না করলে স্কুল অফিসের সাহায্য নিন। অন্যের পাঠানো স্ক্রিনশটের ওপরই নির্ভর করবেন না।

আপত্তির সময় শেষ হওয়ার পর কী হবে

২৬ অক্টোবর ২০২৬-এর বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে কারণ ও প্রমাণসহ অনলাইন আপত্তি ২৮ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ পর্যন্ত চাওয়া হয়েছিল। সেই সময়সীমা পেরিয়েছে; এরপর আপত্তি গ্রহণ করা হবে না বলে বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে জানানো হয়েছে। জেলা বিদ্যালয় পরিদর্শকদের আপত্তি পরীক্ষা ও নিষ্পত্তি করে জেলা কমিটির অনুমোদিত বা সুপারিশকৃত তালিকার রিপোর্ট ৬ নভেম্বর ২০২৬-এর মধ্যে অনলাইনে পাঠাতে হবে।

৬ নভেম্বর জেলা কর্তৃপক্ষের রিপোর্ট পাঠানোর সময়সীমা। সেদিনই চূড়ান্ত সর্বজনীন তালিকা বা অ্যাডমিট কার্ড প্রকাশ হবে, এমন ঘোষণা এটি নয়। প্রস্তাবিত বরাদ্দ ও চূড়ান্ত পরীক্ষাস্থলের পার্থক্য মনে রাখুন।

পরীক্ষাস্থল নিশ্চিত করার আগে

ডাউনলোড করা কপি রাখুন এবং কখন ডাউনলোড করেছেন তা লিখে রাখুন। সংশোধিত PDF এলে নিজের স্কুলের তথ্য আবার মিলিয়ে নিন। শেয়ার করা ছবিতে জেলার শিরোনাম, জরুরি মন্তব্য বা পরবর্তী পরিবর্তন বাদ পড়তে পারে।

স্কুলের নাম, বরাদ্দ বা জায়গা অস্পষ্ট হলে স্কুলে জিজ্ঞাসা করুন। সময়সীমার পরে পাঠানো বার্তা আপত্তির প্রক্রিয়া আবার চালু করে না। বোর্ড ও স্কুলের পরবর্তী নির্দেশ অনুসরণ করুন। পরীক্ষার আগে চূড়ান্ত অ্যাডমিট কার্ডের ঠিকানা দেখুন এবং কেন্দ্র নিশ্চিত হওয়ার পরই যাওয়ার পথ ঠিক করুন। প্রস্তাবিত তালিকা পরীক্ষায় প্রবেশের নথি নয়।

title: INI-CET 2026 Counselling: How to Read Seat Matrix and Institute Choices
description: Learn how to compare INI-CET 2026 seats by institute, specialty, category and seat type before locking your counselling preferences.
content:
In INI-CET 2026 counselling, a qualifying rank alone doesn’t decide your result. The seat matrix, your category, the institute, the specialty and the reporting conditions together decide whether a preference is sensible or risky. Read each row before placing it in your Choice Filling list, and verify the live matrix and schedule on the official AIIMS counselling portal before submission.

A seat that looks attractive because of its institute name may still be unsuitable if it belongs to a different category, has a restrictive seat type or requires reporting within a short window. The right approach is simple: compare the specialty first, then the institute, then the seat conditions.

Key facts to check in the INI-CET 2026 seat matrix

The Seat Matrix is not just a list of vacant postgraduate seats. It is a working map of what may be offered in a counselling round. The exact entries can change after additions, withdrawals, upgrades or corrections, so treat the version available during your active round as the controlling document.

  • Institute: Check the exact participating institute and campus. Similar-looking abbreviations can refer to different locations or institutions.
  • Specialty: Read the full course name. Do not assume that two related departments offer the same training or career path.
  • Seat type: Identify whether the row is open, reserved, sponsored, foreign national, institutional or another category listed in the current matrix.
  • Category: Match the seat with the category and certificate status you can legally claim.
  • Seat count: Note the number of seats, but don’t treat a vacant seat as a promise of allotment. Rank, choices, eligibility and round rules still apply.
  • Reporting conditions: Check the date, documents, fee, medical requirements and physical reporting instructions attached to the allotment.

Parents often focus on the institute’s reputation and ignore the row-level details. That’s where costly mistakes begin.

How to read each row before adding it to your list

Use a four-question test for every seat. If you cannot answer all four, keep the row aside until you verify it.

1. Is this the specialty you would actually join?

Do not place a specialty above your preferred course merely because its institute is better known. In PG Medical Admissions, your daily work, residency demands, future exams and career choices will be shaped more directly by the specialty than by the brand value of the campus.

Write your specialty order separately before looking at institute names. For example, a student who wants Paediatrics should not place an unwanted specialty above Paediatrics simply because it is available at a preferred institute. Choice Filling rewards the order you submit, not the preference you had in your head.

2. Does the category match your documents?

A reserved seat is useful only when your category claim is valid for that counselling process and your certificate meets the stated format and date requirements. Check whether the matrix uses category labels such as UR, OBC, EWS, SC or ST, and read the counselling notice for certificate rules.

Do not select a category-specific option on the assumption that a certificate can be arranged later. If the required document is missing, expired or in the wrong format, the seat may not remain available to you even after allotment.

3. What does the seat type really mean?

Seat type can change who is eligible and what paperwork is needed. An open seat, sponsored seat and foreign national seat should never be treated as interchangeable rows. A sponsored seat may involve employer permission or a sponsorship document, while another type may carry a separate eligibility condition.

Read the explanatory note attached to the matrix and prospectus. If a label is unclear, ask the responsible counselling authority before locking choices. Guesswork is a poor strategy when the preference list can affect your admission.

4. Can you report if this seat is allotted?

Reporting is not a formality to think about after allotment. Check whether reporting is online, physical or both; whether original documents are required; whether a medical examination is compulsory; and whether a fee must be paid within the stated deadline.

A student living far from the institute should plan travel and document access before ranking the seat. If the family cannot meet the reporting condition, placing that option high in the list creates avoidable risk.

Compare seats by consequence, not by name

The table below can help you separate a genuinely suitable preference from a seat that only looks impressive on screen.

What you compareQuestion to askWhat a wrong reading can causeAction before locking
SpecialtyWould I join this course if it is allotted?An allotment in an unwanted branchPlace only after writing your personal specialty order
InstituteIs this the exact institute and campus?Confusion between similar abbreviations or locationsMatch the full institute name with the prospectus
CategoryCan I prove this category under the current rules?Document objection or loss of the claimCheck certificate format, validity and issuing authority
Seat typeDo I meet the special condition for this row?Ineligible choice or failed verificationRead the seat-type note before ranking it
ReportingCan I complete every step by the deadline?Missed joining, forfeiture or cancellation under the rulesKeep originals, funds and travel plans ready

This is the part many candidates rush. Don’t.

Build a preference list that reflects your real choices

Make three groups in a spreadsheet or notebook:

  • Preferred: Seats you would accept immediately, subject to eligibility and reporting rules.
  • Acceptable: Seats you would join if your preferred options are not allotted.
  • Do not select: Specialties, institutes or seat types you would refuse even if allotted.

Then arrange options within each group. A practical order might be: preferred specialty at the best acceptable institute, preferred specialty at other acceptable institutes, then a second-choice specialty only where you would genuinely join.

Never include a seat just to make the list longer. In counselling, an unwanted choice is not harmless filler. If the system reaches that option the applicable rules, you may face a difficult decision after allotment.

A simple scoring method for anxious families

Give every possible choice a score from 0 to 3 for four factors:

  • Specialty fit
  • Institute preference
  • Category and eligibility confidence
  • Reporting practicality

A seat scoring 3 for institute but 0 for specialty should not automatically outrank a seat scoring 2 for institute and 3 for specialty. The course you will train in matters more than a familiar name.

Keep the scoring sheet for family discussions, but submit only the final preference order required by the counselling portal. The portal does not know your financial limits, family constraints or career priorities. You have to make those decisions before clicking the final button.

What to verify when the matrix or schedule changes

During the counselling cycle, check the official AIIMS notice and portal whenever a revised matrix, round notice, vacancy update or reporting instruction is published. Compare the new version with the one you used earlier.

  • Look for newly added or removed seats.
  • Check whether a category or seat type has changed.
  • Confirm the last date and time for choice submission or locking.
  • Read whether choices from an earlier round remain valid.
  • Check the rule for accepting, upgrading, withdrawing or joining an allotted seat.
  • Save the submitted choices and allotment letter as PDF files or screenshots.

Do not rely on a coaching message, a social media post or an old screenshot for a live counselling decision. The responsible authority’s current notice controls the process.

Common Choice Filling mistakes in INI-CET

Ranking institute before specialty

This is the classic error. A candidate chooses a famous institute first and only later realises that the specialty was never acceptable. Reverse the order: decide the course, then compare institutes offering it.

Assuming all seats are open to everyone

Seat availability and eligibility are different things. A row visible in the matrix may still carry a category, sponsorship or other condition. Read the eligibility note instead of relying on the seat count.

Ignoring the reporting calendar

An allotment can arrive when the student is travelling, waiting for documents or unable to arrange the required fee. Keep a document folder and a family decision plan ready before the result.

Filling choices under family pressure

Parents may prefer the institute name. The student may prefer the specialty. Both views matter, but the final order must reflect the course the candidate is willing and able to join. Have that conversation before counselling day, not during the locking window.

A final seat-matrix check before you lock

Read the list aloud with a parent or trusted person. For every choice, confirm the full institute name, specialty, category, seat type and reporting condition. Remove any option that you would reject after allotment.

Then verify the current matrix, prospectus, schedule and portal instructions issued for INI-CET 2026 counselling. The published rules can change between rounds, and the current official notice should prevail over any earlier explanation.

Your rank opens the door. Your preference order decides which door you walk through.

Frequently asked questions

How should I read the INI-CET 2026 seat matrix?

Read each row across five points: institute, specialty, category, seat type and reporting condition. Confirm that you meet the eligibility requirement and would genuinely join the seat before adding it to Choice Filling.

Should specialty or institute come first in my preference list?

For most candidates, specialty should come first because it shapes training and later work. Compare institutes after deciding which specialties you would accept. Do not rank an unwanted specialty above a preferred one only because the institute is famous.

Does a seat shown in the matrix guarantee allotment?

No. A listed seat only shows that it may be available under the stated conditions. Allotment also depends on rank, category, eligibility, submitted choices, seat availability in that round and the applicable counselling rules.

Can I select a reserved seat if my certificate is still pending?

Do not assume that a pending certificate will be accepted. Check the current prospectus for the required certificate format, issuing authority and submission deadline. If the document condition is not met, the reserved claim may not be accepted.

What should I do if I don’t understand a seat-type abbreviation?

Read the matrix legend and prospectus first. If the meaning or eligibility condition is still unclear, contact the official counselling authority before locking choices. Never rank a seat based only on an abbreviation or an informal explanation.

Should I fill every available choice?

No. Add only seats you would actually join after checking specialty, institute, category, seat type and reporting requirements. A longer list is not safer when it contains options you would reject.

title: UP Board Class 12 Biology Chapter 1: Reproduction in Organisms - Guide & Key Highlights
description: Get the complete UP Board Class 12 Biology Chapter 1 guide with key highlights, important questions, diagrams, and quick revision tables for 2025-26 exam preparation.
content:
A key chapter in Class 12 Biology is Chapter 1, \"Reproduction in Organisms.\" It covers sexual and asexual reproduction, the importance of reproductive adaptations, and how organisms reproduce to ensure the continuation of life. The numerous diagram-based and short-answer questions in this chapter are crucial for UP Board exams.

Key Highlights

  • Reproduction: The biological process by which organisms produce offspring.
  • Asexual Reproduction: Offspring arise from a single parent. Examples: binary fission (Amoeba), budding (Hydra, Yeast), spore formation (Spirogyra), vegetative propagation (Potato, Bryophyllum).
  • Sexual Reproduction: Fusion of male and female gametes produces genetically variable offspring.
  • Reproductive Adaptations: Mechanisms ensuring species survival (internal/external fertilization, seeds, spores).
  • Significance: Maintains species continuity, introduces genetic variation, supports evolution.
  • Important Terms: Gamete, zygote, spore, vegetative propagation, hermaphrodite.

Important Questions Table

Marks Question Type Sample Questions
1 Mark Very Short Answer Define reproduction; Give one example of asexual reproduction; Function of gametes
2 Marks Short Answer Difference between sexual and asexual reproduction; Two advantages of sexual reproduction; Define vegetative propagation
3 Marks Short Answer / Diagram Explain binary fission in Amoeba; Describe spore formation; Draw budding in Hydra
5 Marks Long Answer / Diagram Describe sexual reproduction in flowering plants; Explain internal vs external fertilization; Significance of reproduction in organisms

Key Highlights & Quick Revision Table

Topic Key Points Example / Diagram to Practice
Asexual Reproduction Single parent, no gametes, identical offspring Binary fission (Amoeba), Budding (Hydra)
Sexual Reproduction Gamete fusion, genetic variation Flowering plants reproduction, internal/external fertilization
Vegetative Propagation Part of plant develops into new plant Potato tuber, Bryophyllum leaf
Spore Formation Specialized cells reproduce asexually Spirogyra spores
Important Terms Gamete, zygote, hermaphrodite Label diagrams in notebook

Diagrams to Practice

  • Binary fission in Amoeba

  • Budding in Hydra

  • Structure of flower showing reproductive parts

  • Life cycle of Spirogyra

  • Reproduction in Yeast

Preparation Tips

  • Memorize definitions, diagrams, and key terms

  • Focus on diagram-based questions, as they carry marks

  • Compare asexual vs sexual reproduction in table format for quick revision

  • Practice examples and reproductive adaptations

  • Solve previous years’ UP Board questions

Conclusion:

If students concentrate on the main questions, pictures, and highlights in Chapter 1, \"Reproduction in Organisms,\" they will score highly. Students can study effectively and confidently for the UP Board Class 12 Biology test by using the aforementioned tables.

title: National Cadet Corps (NCC) Class 12: Chapter-wise Notes & Exam Guide
description: Prepare for CBSE Class 12 NCC exam with chapter-wise notes and a quick revision table covering drill, organization, and national integration.
content:
The subject of the National Cadet Corps is an important subject that students study in Class 12. This subject is about teaching students to be disciplined, how to be a good leader, and how to develop their personality. helps students feel more confident. It also helps them to be responsible. When it comes to the CBSE exams, students need to be aware of every chapter if they want to score good grades.

Chapter 1: Introduction to NCC

The National Cadet Corps, or NCC is a group for people that want to help students become better people, learn how to lead, and love their country. schools and colleges all over India, and it believes in being united and following rules. three parts: the Army part, the Navy part and the Air part of the NCC.

Chapter 2: NCC Organization

The NCC works under the Ministry of Defence and is headed by the Director General of simple organizational structure, which is not difficult to comprehend at the national level, at the state level, and at the school or college level. provides training to the students, in schools and colleges, to enable the students of work as a team and be more disciplined.

Chapter 3: Drill

For NCC training, drilling is crucial. The most crucial things that NCC training teaches you in drill are how to march, how to properly salute, and how to obey orders. For the kids, this is significant since it enhances their posture, confidence, and coordination. Drill enhances discipline, which is a key component of NCC training. Drill helps NCC training students become more adept at working and adhering to regulations.

Chapter 4: Weapon Training

Cadets learn the fundamentals of safely and responsibly using firearms during weapon training. Instead of emphasizing combat skills, it stresses discipline and appropriate application. During training, safety regulations are closely adhered to.

Chapter 5: Social Service and Community Development

The NCC promotes involvement in volunteer work. Students participate in awareness campaigns, sanitation drives, and disaster management initiatives that foster social responsibility.

Chapter 6: National Integration and Awareness

This chapter highlights the importance of unity in diversity. NCC organizes camps and cultural exchange programs to promote harmony and understanding among students from different regions.

NCC Quick Revision Table

Chapter Main Focus Key Concept
Introduction to NCC Basics of NCC Unity and Discipline, Wings
NCC Organization Structure Ministry of Defence, hierarchy
Drill Discipline training Marching, commands
Weapon Training Safety and handling Basic firearm knowledge
Social Service Community work Social responsibility
National Integration Unity Cultural exchange, awareness

Conclusion

Students can more easily grasp NCC ideas when they follow a chapter-by-chapter approach with rapid reassessment. Students can take the CBSE Class 12 NCC exam with confidence and do well if they review important material and practice frequently.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ (ਕੋਡ 403) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ
ਜਮਾਤ 10: Security40325 ਫਰਵਰੀ 202710:30 - 12:302 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 5: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 403 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਆ (403) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਤ (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

ਪੂਰੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ · ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਬਾਰੇ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ

title: NIOS Date Sheet 2026 Class 10 & 12 (April Exams) Soon: Check Latest Updates
description: NIOS Date Sheet 2026 for Class 10 and 12 April exams will be released soon at nios.ac.in. Check the expected exam schedule, important details, and steps to download the timetable.
content:
The National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS) is expected to announce the NIOS Date Sheet 2026 for Class 10 (Secondary Course) and Class 12 (Senior Secondary Course) April Examination. The students who have registered for the upcoming examination will be able to download the official date sheet for the April Examination from the official website of NIOS.

The National Institute of Open Schooling conducts public examinations twice in a year in April-May and October-November sessions. The April Examination dates will assist students in preparing for the examinations according to the dates of individual subjects.

NIOS Date Sheet 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Board Name National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)
Exam Session April 2026
Classes Class 10 & Class 12
Date Sheet Release Expected Soon
Exam Period April–May 2026
Official Website https://nios.ac.in

Expected Exam Schedule

The NIOS theory examinations of April 2026 are expected to commence in April 2026 and end in May 2026. The detailed date sheet would be available with information on the date of each subject, reporting time, and shift of the examinations.

Practical examinations would be conducted before the theory examinations. Students would be notified separately regarding the practical examination schedule from their respective study centers.

Steps to Download NIOS Date Sheet 2026

Following are the steps to download the timetable when it is released:

  1. To download the date sheet, students can visit the official website at nios.ac.in.
  2. Then click on the ‘Examination/Student Information’ section.
  3. After that, click on ‘NIOS Date Sheet April 2026.’
  4. Then click on ‘Class 10’ or ‘Class 12’ to download the date sheet.

Conclusion

The NIOS Date Sheet 2026 for the Class 10 and Class 12 April examination will be announced soon on the official website. The students need to keep an eye on the official website to remain updated on the latest information regarding the examination date sheet and prepare for their upcoming examination accordingly. The students can then download the date sheet in PDF format and check the dates for their subjects.

title: GATE 2026 CSE Admit Card Date OUT - Download at gate.iitkgp.ac.in
description: GATE 2026 CSE admit card release date has been announced. Download from the official portal and review exam pattern, syllabus, and important instructions.
content:
The GATE 2026 CSE Admit Card release date has been formally released by the organizing institute, enabling candidates to prepare for the last phase of the process.  With the exam approaching shortly, Computer Science applicants must stay informed with the timetable, question format, and essential topics to maximise their grades.

Admit Card Release Date & Download Window

January 2026 will see the release of the GATE 2026 CSE Admit Card.  To access and print the hall pass, candidates must provide their registration ID and password.  Verifying the exam date, shift schedule, and exam center facts listed on the admit card is essential because the exam will be administered throughout several sessions.

GATE 2026 CSE Exam Pattern

The CSE paper follows a computer-based test (CBT) format. It consists of 65 questions carrying 100 marks, divided into:

  • General Aptitude (GA) – 15 marks

  • Core CS Questions (MCQ, MSQ, NAT) – 85 marks

The total duration of the exam is 3 hours. Negative marking applies to MCQ-type questions, while NAT and MSQ questions carry no negative marks.

Official Link: https://gate.iitkgp.ac.in

Key Topics in GATE 2026 CSE Syllabus

The GATE CSE syllabus covers the major foundations of computer science, including:

  • Programming & Data Structures

  • Algorithms

  • Digital Logic & Computer Organization

  • Theory of Computation

  • Compiler Design

  • Operating Systems

  • Databases

  • Software Engineering

  • Discrete Mathematics

Final Preparation Tips

Candidates should review standard textbooks, work through papers from prior years, and take timed practice exams.  Planning the final round of preparation gets simpler and more organized once the admit card date is established.

title: CBSE 10 ಮತ್ತು 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 2027: ದಿನಾಂಕ, ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ
description: 10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (ಕೋಡ್ 413) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 25 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (ಕೋಡ್ 813) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 6 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 13:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.
content:
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (ಕೋಡ್ 413) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 25 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (ಕೋಡ್ 813) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 6 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 13:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.

2026ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 6ರಂದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ CBSE ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿವರಗಳಿವೆ. ಇದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ದಾಖಲೆ; ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. CBSE ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯವಿದೆ?

ತರಗತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಕೋಡ್ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕಸಮಯ (IST)ಅವಧಿ
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ: Health Care41325 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 202710:30 - 12:302 ಗಂಟೆ
12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ: Health Care8136 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 202710:30 - 13:303 ಗಂಟೆ

ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರೌಢ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿ, 6 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 5: ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ. ಮೂಲ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟ ನೋಡಿ

ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರೌಢ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿ, 6 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 10: ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ. ಮೂಲ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟ ನೋಡಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ

ಪುಟ 5, 10ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ತರಗತಿಯ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ನೋಡಿ, ನಂತರ 413, 813 ಕೋಡ್ ಹುಡುಕಿ. ಒಂದೇ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಯದ ಕೋಶ ಹಲವು ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬಹುದು. ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿಸಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಾಲನ್ನೂ ಓದಿ.

ಶಾಲೆಯ ನೋಂದಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಠ್ಯವಿಷಯದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ತರಗತಿಗೂ ಅದೇ ಹೆಸರಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯ ಸಾಲನ್ನಷ್ಟೇ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ

10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (413) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 25 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು; ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಭಾಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ (184) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 26 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 1 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಆರೈಕೆ (813) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 6 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು; English Core (301) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 5 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 1 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ.

ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನವೂ ಓದಲು ರಜೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದರ್ಥವಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉಳಿದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ನಡುವೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಣಿಸಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಈ ಸಾಲು ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ನಿಗದಿತ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ, ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ, ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ತರಬೇಕಾದ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಚಾರಿಸಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರದೊಳಗೆ ಸಂವಹನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಒಯ್ಯಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ CBSE ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

Find your Business Studies entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 12 and look for code 054. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The timetable entry is for Business Studies under the code shown above. If your school record uses a different code or course name, ask the school to resolve that difference before following this date.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 12 Business Studies (054) falls 27 calendar days after English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.
