title: ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ PGCET 2026: ನವೆಂಬರ್ 4ರೊಳಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಮೂದಿಸಿ
description: PGCET ಅಂತಿಮ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ಸುತ್ತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳು ಪರಿಗಣನೆಯಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಠೇವಣಿಗೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 3, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಮೂದಿಗೆ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 4 ಎಂಬ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಗಡುವುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
content:
ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ PGCET 2026 ಅಂತಿಮ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು 4 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2 ಗಂಟೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಬೇಕು. ಹಿಂದಿನ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಗಣಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು KEA ತಿಳಿಸಿದೆ. ಹಿಂದೆ ಉಳಿಸಿದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಈ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಖಚಿತವಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಮೂದಿಗಿಂತ ಮುಂಚೆ ಠೇವಣಿ ಅವಧಿ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ

ಹಂತ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಅವಧಿ

ಭದ್ರತಾ ಠೇವಣಿ ಪಾವತಿ

31 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್‌ನಿಂದ 3 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026

ಹೊಸ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಮೂದು

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರಿಂದ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 4 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರವರೆಗೆ

ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 1ರ ನಂತರ

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪ್ರಾಧಿಕಾರದ ಸೂಚನೆ, 29 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 2. ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಮೂದಿಗಿಂತ ಮುಂಚೆ ಠೇವಣಿ ಅವಧಿ ಮುಗಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

ಭದ್ರತಾ ಠೇವಣಿ ₹35,000; SC/ST ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ₹10,000. ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡವರು ಈ ಠೇವಣಿ ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ. ಪಾವತಿ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವವರಿಗೆ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾದರೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಶುಲ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಂದಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ನಂತರ ಬಾಕಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಅಥವಾ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಷರತ್ತು ತಪ್ಪಿದರೆ ಸೂಚನೆಯಂತೆ ಠೇವಣಿ ಮುಟ್ಟುಗೋಲು ಮತ್ತು ದಂಡ ವಿಧಿಸಬಹುದು.

ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ತುಂಬುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅರ್ಹತೆ ನೋಡಿ

ಹಿಂದೆ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯಾಗದವರಿಗೆ ಲಭ್ಯ ಸೀಟುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಭಾಗವಹಿಸಲು ಸೂಚನೆ ಅವಕಾಶ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ಈಗಾಗಲೇ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಂಡವರು ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗೆ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಬಹುದು. ದಂಡ ಪಾವತಿಸಿ ಸೀಟು ರದ್ದುಗೊಳಿಸಿದವರಿಗೂ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳಿವೆ.

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 13-15ರಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಟು ದೊರೆತರೂ ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸದೆ ಅಥವಾ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡದೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ, ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅರ್ಹತೆ ವಿಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಓದಿ. ವಿಶೇಷ ವರದಿ ಅವಕಾಶ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 31 ಸಂಜೆ 6 ಗಂಟೆಗೆ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ. ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಪುಟ ತೆರೆದಿರುವುದನ್ನು ಅರ್ಹತೆಯ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲು ಸಿದ್ಧವಿರುವ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನೇ ಕ್ರಮಗೊಳಿಸಿ

KEA PGCET ಪುಟ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ, ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಸೀಟು ವಿವರ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಜವಾದ ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಮೂದಿಸಿ. ಉಳಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರತಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯ ಕಾಲೇಜು ಮತ್ತು ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಅಂತಿಮವಾಗಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಅಗತ್ಯ ಠೇವಣಿಯ ರಸೀದಿ ಪ್ರತಿಯನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5ರ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವನ್ನು ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಅದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸದೆ ನಂತರದ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸೂಚನೆ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ. ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಠೇವಣಿ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ವಿವರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
author: Geethika Reddy

title: Gold Price Searches Are Rising: What It Means for Education Loan Planning
description: Gold and silver searches are rising in India. Learn when a gold loan may fit college fees and when an education loan is safer for your family.
content:
Gold and silver price outlook searches appeared among India’s recent Google Trends searches on 11 October 2026. That spike shows public interest, not a signal to borrow. If you’re paying college fees, don’t delay a confirmed payment or pledge jewellery just because gold prices are moving. Compare the loan’s total cost, repayment timing and risk to your family budget.

Should parents take a gold loan when prices are volatile?

Not automatically. A higher market price may affect how a lender values eligible jewellery, but it doesn’t make the loan safer or guarantee a larger amount. The lender’s purity assessment, loan-to-value limit, interest method, processing charges and repayment plan decide what you actually receive.

Gold loans also put a family asset at risk. If income falls and dues remain unpaid, the lender’s stated recovery terms may allow action against the pledged jewellery. Ask for those terms in writing before signing. Jewellery with family or emotional value deserves extra caution.

When does an education loan make more sense?

For fees and living costs spread across several academic years, compare an education loan before choosing short-term secured borrowing. Depending on the lender’s rules, repayment may start after a study period or may begin earlier. Don’t assume a moratorium is free: interest can continue to accumulate.

What to compareEducation loanGold loan
SecurityMay need a parent co-borrower or collateral, depending on the productJewellery is pledged
Typical fitPlanned multi-year course costsA short, clearly budgeted fee gap
Family riskLong repayment and interest burdenPossible loss of pledged jewellery after non-payment

What should you calculate before paying the college?

  1. List the immediate fee, later instalments, hostel charges, books and exam costs. Use the college’s written fee schedule, not an estimate.
  2. Ask every lender for the total payable, including interest, valuation, processing, renewal and late-payment charges.
  3. Check the first repayment date and test the monthly budget against a temporary income loss.
  4. Compare scholarships, college instalments and a lower-fee course through college comparisons before pledging jewellery.

The practical rule is simple: a gold loan may cover a short, certain gap when repayment capacity is clear. It’s a poor substitute for planning several years of fees. Confirm the college’s fee deadline and refund terms directly with its admissions office, then choose borrowing that doesn’t threaten rent, food, medical costs or essential family savings.
author: Geethika Reddy
meta_title: Education Loan or Gold Loan for College Fees?
meta_description: Compare education loans and gold loans for college fees. Check repayment, total cost and jewellery risk before borrowing in 2026.
meta_keywords: education loan, gold loan, college fees, parent finance, higher education, 2026

title: CLAT NLU Fees: What to Check Before Accepting the First Offer
description: Compare the first instalment, refund terms, exit rules and placement evidence before paying for a seat at a CLAT participating National Law University.
content:
Accepting your first CLAT offer can tie up a large amount of family money before you know whether a better NLU seat is coming. Compare the first instalment, refund terms, exit conditions and placement evidence before paying. A high rank or familiar name doesn’t make unclear payment rules safe.

The specific National Law University’s current admission notice and fee schedule must decide the payment. Don’t rely on a general fee list or a verbal assurance from an office.

What should you check in the first NLU payment?

Annual tuition is only one part of the bill. The first demand may include hostel, mess, admission, security deposit and other one-time charges. Your comparison should show the amount needed now, not just the advertised yearly fee.

CheckRead forWhy it matters
First instalmentTuition, hostel, mess, deposits and one-time chargesShows the immediate cash requirement
Refund ruleLast date, deductions, eligible items and refund methodShows how much money is exposed
Exit processWithdrawal form, documents, submission route and seat effectPrevents a missed procedural step
Placement evidenceBatch size, report year, recruiters, median or average figuresTests whether the claim fits your likely batch

Ask the admissions office for a written reply to one plain question: if the student leaves after accepting the seat, what amount will be retained, and when will the balance be returned? Save the email or notice with your payment records.

How do you read NLU placement claims?

Start with the report year and the group covered. A salary figure may apply only to students who registered for placements, not the entire graduating batch. Compare the median with the highest package, since one exceptional offer cannot describe the usual outcome.

Also check recruiter names, the number of offers and students choosing litigation, judicial services, higher studies or other routes. Missing context doesn’t prove a college is poor, but it does make a headline figure incomplete.

Should you accept the first offer while waiting?

Accept it when the seat fits your budget and the written exit terms are manageable. If you’re treating it as a backup, decide what your family can lose without taking a damaging loan. That amount is your real decision limit.

  1. Download the current notice and fee schedule for that NLU.
  2. Mark refundable, non-refundable and conditional amounts.
  3. Record the withdrawal deadline and required submission method.
  4. Compare other options through college comparisons.
  5. Pay only after the student and parent agree on the exit plan.

CLAT opens the admission route; it doesn’t remove the need to read the payment conditions. Rank matters. So does the money you may not get back.

title: CUET UG Preference Lists: How to Rank Courses Without Wasting Choices
description: Learn how to rank CUET UG university and course preferences using eligibility, subject fit, fees and realistic admission chances.
content:
CUET UG preference lists should reflect the course you would actually accept, not the university name you admire most. Rank each eligible, affordable and acceptable option by genuine preference, then place realistic alternatives below it. A poor order can leave you with an unwanted seat while a suitable course sits too low.

Before filling any university counselling form, keep its current admission notice open. The participating university, not CUET alone, decides programme eligibility, subject combinations, fees, documents and seat-allocation conditions.

Which CUET UG choices belong at the top?

Build your list in three groups before entering preferences. This stops a famous campus from crowding out a course that fits your subjects and budget.

  1. First choices: Courses you are eligible for, can afford and would select over every option below them.
  2. Realistic choices: Eligible courses where your CUET score, category position and available information suggest a reasonable possibility. No estimate is a promise.
  3. Safety choices: Eligible, affordable courses you would genuinely join if your higher choices aren’t allotted.

A course you dislike isn’t a safety choice. Remove it. Accepting an unwanted allotment may create pressure to pay quickly, arrange documents and later seek a change.

Should eligibility come before the university brand?

Yes. Match the programme’s required subjects with the subjects you selected or appeared for in CUET UG. A high score cannot repair a subject-combination mismatch when the university’s notice doesn’t permit your application.

Then calculate the first-year cost. Add tuition, hostel or rent, travel, meals, examination charges and any stated deposit. A nearby, lower-cost course may be the sensible choice if a famous campus would strain your family’s budget. Use course comparisons to inspect the subjects and career direction, and check college details for location and facilities.

How should you lock the final order?

Give every option four checks: eligible, affordable, willing to join and realistic for your score. Put the options with four positive answers highest. If two choices tie, prefer the course you understand better and can sustain financially.

  • Record each university’s eligibility, fee and document rules.
  • Confirm the family budget before submission.
  • Check payment, reporting and withdrawal conditions in the current notice.
  • Save the submitted preference order and confirmation.

CUET counselling is not a popularity contest. Your order tells the university which seat you would accept when more than one option is available. Read it once as a parent might, then once as the student who has to attend that course.
author: Geethika Reddy

title: CUET PG 2027 Subject Choice: Match Papers Before Picking Courses
description: Learn how to match CUET PG 2027 test papers with university programmes before applying, and avoid a subject choice that makes your score unusable.
content:
A high CUET PG score won’t rescue an incorrect test-paper choice. Before selecting any paper for the 2027 cycle, match each target programme with the paper accepted by that specific university, then check your bachelor’s-level eligibility separately.

Similar course names can hide different admission conditions. That’s the trap.

How should you choose a CUET PG test paper?

Work backwards from the university and programme, not forwards from your favourite subject. NTA manages the entrance examination, but participating universities set programme eligibility and decide which paper scores they’ll accept for PG Admission.

  1. List the exact university, department and programme title.
  2. Find the programme-wise Test Paper requirement published for that admission cycle.
  3. Record the paper name and code exactly as shown.
  4. Check whether your bachelor’s degree, studied subjects, marks and category meet the university’s eligibility terms.
  5. Repeat this Course Mapping exercise for every backup option before submitting the form.

Build your CUET PG 2027 mapping sheet

The 2027 paper codes and university mappings remain subject to the final NTA and participating-university documents. Don’t assume a previous cycle’s mapping will continue unchanged. Use older information only to plan preparation, never as the final basis for selecting a paper.

RecordWhy it mattersDecision
Exact programme titleSimilar names may follow different rulesCopy the university wording
Accepted paper codeYour score must match the listed paperSelect only after confirmation
Degree eligibilityA valid paper doesn’t override an ineligible degreeCheck subjects and marks
Backup overlapOne paper may support several targetsPrefer wider valid coverage

What if two universities accept different papers?

Treat them as separate admission routes. If the application permits multiple papers, compare the extra fee, timetable and preparation load before adding another test. If only one paper is practical, prioritise the programme you genuinely want and retain backups accepting the same score.

For preparation, compare the declared syllabus of each shortlisted paper topic by topic. Mark common units, missing units and high-effort areas, then practise timed sets from the paper you’ll actually take. Final check: confirm the paper code against both NTA’s 2027 information document and the university’s programme rules before submission. One wrong code can close the door before counselling even starts.
author: DekhoCampus Editorial

title: RRB NTPC Exam 2026 - How to Apply, Last Date & Eligibility Details
description: जानिए RRB NTPC Exam 2026 की पूरी जानकारी - कैसे करें आवेदन, अंतिम तिथि, पात्रता, चयन प्रक्रिया, सैलरी और तैयारी के सुझाव। सरकारी नौकरी का सुनहरा अवसर।
content:
RRB NTPC (Railway Recruitment Board Non-Technical Popular Categories) परीक्षा भारत में रेलवे में गैर-तकनीकी पदों के लिए आयोजित की जाती है। यह लाखों उम्मीदवारों के लिए सरकारी नौकरी का महत्वपूर्ण अवसर है।

पात्रता (Eligibility)

  • शैक्षणिक योग्यता: न्यूनतम 12वीं पास

  • आयु सीमा: 18–33 वर्ष (आरक्षित वर्ग के लिए छूट)

  • राष्ट्रीयता: भारतीय नागरिक

आवेदन और महत्वपूर्ण तिथियाँ (How to Apply & Important Dates)

चरण विवरण तिथि / अवधि
आवेदन प्रारंभ ऑनलाइन आवेदन शुरू जल्द ही नोटिफिकेशन जारी
आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि फॉर्म जमा करने की अंतिम तिथि 4 दिसंबर 2025
शुल्क जमा करने की अंतिम तिथि ऑनलाइन परीक्षा शुल्क जमा 6 दिसंबर 2025
फॉर्म सुधार विंडो फॉर्म में सुधार करने की अवधि 7–16 दिसंबर 2025
दस्तावेज़ जमा करने की विंडो शारीरिक/साक्षात्कार/साबित दस्तावेज़ 17–21 दिसंबर 2025

Official RRB Website: rrbcdg.gov.in

चयन प्रक्रिया (Selection Process)

  1. Stage 1 – CBT (Computer Based Test): प्रारंभिक परीक्षा

  2. Stage 2 – CBT: मुख्य परीक्षा

  3. Typing Test / Skill Test / Document Verification: अंतिम चरण

सैलरी और अन्य विवरण (Salary & Other Details)

  • शुरुआती सैलरी: ₹19,900–₹63,200 प्रति माह

  • उम्मीदवारों को विभिन्न भत्ते और सुविधाएँ भी प्रदान की जाती हैं

तैयारी के सुझाव (Preparation Tips)

  • सिलेबस और पैटर्न को ध्यान से समझें

  • पिछले साल के प्रश्नपत्र और मॉक टेस्ट से अभ्यास करें

  • समय प्रबंधन और नोट्स तैयार करें

  • सामान्य ज्ञान और करंट अफेयर्स पर विशेष ध्यान दें

RRB NTPC Exam 2026 उन उम्मीदवारों के लिए एक सुनहरा अवसर है जो स्थिर सरकारी नौकरी और भविष्य की सुरक्षा चाहते हैं।

title: NEET MDS 2026 Round 3: Check the Final Result Before Visiting Your College
description: MCC’s Round 3 provisional list does not confirm admission. Read the 30 October notice and check the final result before approaching the allotted institute.
content:
A seat in the NEET MDS 2026 Round 3 provisional list is not yet a confirmed allotment. MCC’s notice dated 30 October tells candidates to approach the allotted college only after the final result is declared. Check the result label before making a reporting trip.

What the provisional list means

MCC describes this list as indicative and subject to change. It does not give a candidate a right to the displayed seat. A screenshot of a provisional entry therefore cannot replace the final allotment or the later admission instructions.

Medical Counselling Committee notice dated 30 October 2026. Read the original MCC notice.

The discrepancy deadline has passed

The notice allowed discrepancies to be raised until 10 am on 31 October 2026 through the Candidates Grievances And Query Redressal System in the candidate login. That stated deadline has passed. Do not assume that an email, a fresh complaint or a website headline extends it. If you already submitted a query, keep its acknowledgement and follow any response in your login.

Your next check is the final result

  1. Open the MCC MDS counselling page and read the exact Round 3 result label. The currently linked notice concerns the provisional result.

  2. When MCC publishes the final result, check your own entry again rather than relying on the earlier screenshot.

  3. Then read the current reporting instructions and the allotted institute’s requirements before travelling or paying admission charges.

MCC MDS counselling page

Keep your application details, saved choices and any grievance acknowledgement together. The earlier Round 3 registration guide explains the previous stage; registration dates do not establish whether your allotment is final.

title: KLEE LLM 2026 Options Extended to 2 November, 5 pm
description: CEE Kerala has extended first-phase LL.M option registration to 5 pm on 2 November 2026. Check your saved college choices and complete any required payment before the deadline.
content:
Kerala’s Commissioner for Entrance Examinations has extended first-phase option registration for LL.M admissions to 5 pm on 2 November 2026. The official extension notice replaces the earlier 22 October cut-off. Eligible candidates have more time to submit their college choices; the extension does not announce a seat-allotment result.

Who needs to register options?

CEE’s first-phase allotment notice says candidates included in the 2026 LL.M rank list can enter college and course options online. Use the LL.M 2026 candidate portal with your application number and password, then find “Option Registration” on your home page. Sending choices by email, post or hand delivery does not count.

Do not treat the available options as a wish list. CEE says allotment depends on rank, category and the submitted order of preferences. Put a college-course combination on the list only if you would actually join it when offered; check the course and fees before confirming the order.

Fee and last-minute checks

The first-phase notice sets an option-registration fee of ₹2,000 for most candidates. It specifies ₹500 for eligible SC/ST/OEC candidates and candidates from the named homes listed in the notice. Check the category rules in that PDF before paying; a rank alone does not establish a fee concession.

Before 5 pm, sign back in and confirm that your saved options appear in the correct order. Keep a copy of the acknowledgement for your records. If you cannot access the portal, CEE lists helplines 0471-2332120 and 0471-2338487 in the extension notice. Follow the official notification page for any later allotment schedule rather than relying on an older timetable.

title: BBOSE Class 10 and 12 June Exam Answer Key Challenge 2026: Steps to Submit Objections and Scoring Policy
description: Learn how Bihar Board of Open Schooling and Examination (BBOSE) Class 10 and 12 candidates can challenge the June exam answer keys online, review key dates, upload supporting documents, and understand scoring policies.
content:
Overview of BBOSE June Examination Answer Key 2026

The Bihar Board of Open Schooling and Examination (BBOSE) has published the provisional answer keys for the Class 10 (Secondary) and Class 12 (Senior Secondary) June examinations. This release allows candidates to review official answers for objective and multiple-choice questions across core subjects. Examining provisional solutions is a critical step in maintaining evaluation transparency, giving candidates an opportunity to report errors before final mark sheets are finalized.

Students and parents should carefully cross-check marked responses against the official key. If discrepancies or factual errors are identified in the preliminary key, candidates can submit formal objections during the specified window. Prompt review ensures that any necessary corrections are incorporated prior to the publication of the final BBOSE results.

Important Dates and Objection Window

Candidates must strictly follow the official timeline announced for filing challenges against the provisional key:

  • Answer Key Release Date: August 25, 2026
  • Last Date to Submit Objections: August 27, 2026
  • Final Key & Result Declaration: Expected following expert review of all raised challenges

Because the submission window remains open for a limited duration, students must compile necessary academic proof immediately to avoid last-minute delays or technical bottlenecks.

Step-by-Step Guide to Challenge the BBOSE Answer Key

To raise an objection against the provisional BBOSE Class 10 or Class 12 answer key, candidates must follow the authorized online procedure:

  1. Visit the Official Portal: Access the official Bihar Board open schooling examination website designated for objection submissions.
  2. Locate the Objection Link: Click on the link titled 'BBOSE June Exam Answer Key Challenge 2026' for Secondary (Class 10) or Senior Secondary (Class 12).
  3. Log In to Student Account: Enter your Roll Code, Roll Number, Date of Birth, and Registration Details as printed on your examination admit card.
  4. Select Subject and Question: Choose the subject code, question set series, and specific question number you wish to dispute.
  5. Specify the Incorrect Option: Select the official answer option provided by the board and state the option you claim is correct.
  6. Provide Clear Rationale: Type a concise academic explanation detailing why the official key option is incorrect.
  7. Upload Supporting Evidence: Attach high-resolution scans or PDF files of standard references, such as recognized board textbooks, supporting your claim.
  8. Review and Submit: Double-check all entered details and confirm your submission to generate an objection acknowledgement receipt.

Rules for Submitting Evidence and Documentation

Submitting unsupported claims often leads to immediate rejection by the scrutiny panel. To ensure your objection is reviewed thoroughly, strictly adhere to these documentation standards:

  • Standard Textbooks: Rely primarily on standard state board or recognized national open school textbook chapters for citations. Unverified private study guides or personal notes are generally disregarded.
  • File Format Requirements: Keep documents clear, legible, and within the prescribed file size limit (typically PDF or JPEG format under specified megabyte limits).
  • Question-Specific References: Clearly circle or underline the specific passage, formula, or figure on the uploaded page that verifies your proposed correct answer.

BBOSE Evaluation Policy and Final Scoring Rules

Understanding how the objection committee processes challenges helps set accurate expectations for final mark updates:

1. Expert Panel Scrutiny

Once the challenge window closes on August 27, 2026, a specialized committee of subject experts reviews every submitted objection alongside the attached reference proofs.

2. Key Revisions and Credit Allocation

If an objection is deemed valid by the expert panel, the answer key is revised. The revised key applies to all students who attempted that question set, regardless of whether an individual student personally submitted a challenge.

  • Corrected Option: If the official answer choice is updated from Option A to Option B, full marks are awarded to all candidates who chose Option B.
  • Multiple Correct Options: If more than one option is determined to be scientifically or factually correct, credit is awarded to candidates who selected any of the valid choices.
  • Ambiguous or Defective Questions: If a question contains typographical errors, incorrect translation, or lacks any correct option among choices, the board may drop the question and distribute full grace marks to all affected examinees.

3. Finality of Official Results

The revised answer key forms the sole basis for evaluating optical mark sheets and descriptive papers. No further representations or appeals are entertained once the final BBOSE results are compiled and published.

Guidance for Parents and Students

Parents should assist students during the objection filing process to ensure details such as roll numbers and question codes are entered without error. Keep physical copies and digital backups of the online submission confirmation page for future reference. Always verify updates directly through official board notices to avoid falling for false rumors regarding answer adjustments or grace mark guarantees.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

When is the last date to submit BBOSE answer key objections for June exams?

The deadline to raise objections against the BBOSE Class 10 and Class 12 June exam provisional answer key is August 27, 2026.

Can I submit objections offline through post or manual delivery?

No. Objections must be submitted online through the designated board portal within the stipulated timeframe. Offline representations are usually not accepted.

Do all students get extra marks if an answer key objection is approved?

Yes. If the expert panel approves a correction or drops a flawed question, the benefit of revised scoring or grace marks is extended to all eligible candidates across the board.

What details are required to log in for the BBOSE objection challenge?

Candidates need their examination Roll Code, Roll Number, and Date of Birth as mentioned on their official BBOSE admit card.

title: India Admissions Pulse 2027: Regional Timelines for MBBS and Engineering with Contingency Paths
description: A clear, region-aware guide outlining 2027 MBBS and engineering admission timelines across Indian states, plus contingency paths for students facing delays, changes in cutoff predictions, or seat shortage scenarios.
content:
Sharp Regional Timelines for MBBS and Engineering 2027

For the 2027 admission year, Indian students and parents should follow state and central timelines closely for MBBS and engineering. Availability of seats, counseling schedules, and eligibility criteria vary by state and by institution type (government, private, deemed). Begin by identifying the state boards and central exams that govern the admission process in your region, and then map the typical windows for application, document verification, choice filling, and seat allotment. In many states, medical admissions hinge on national entrance results and state merit lists, while engineering often relies on state engineering entrance scores and centralized counseling.

MBBS: Regional Entry Points and Typical Windows

  • Central medical entrance results usually establish a baseline merit list. State counseling often starts a few weeks after results are announced, with separate rounds for government, private, and deemed institutions.
  • Document verification, fee payment, and seat allotment are typically spread over several rounds. Some states offer mop-up rounds to fill remaining seats after Round 1 and Round 2 outcomes.
  • Private and deemed medical colleges may publish admission criteria that include management and NRI quotas, which can modify the final seat mix and fee structure.

Engineering: Regional Timelines and Counseling Windows

  • State engineering admissions often depend on a common entrance score plus state merit. Counseling sessions usually run in multiple rounds across several weeks.
  • There are sometimes parallel tracks for BTech in common branches and minority or management quota seats. Fee structures depending on college type can affect eligibility documentation and verification timing.
  • Several states run special rounds for lateral entry or for students transferring from other institutes, which can alter the standard calendar.

Contingency Paths: Planning for Delays and Uncertain Outcomes

Not every admission pathway moves smoothly. Students and parents can build resilience by planning for possible interruptions and exploring alternatives that fit academic goals and financial considerations.

  • If counseling schedules slip, maintain readiness by keeping documents updated, reserved seats in preferred branches, and a plan for backup institutions in nearby districts.
  • In case of fee disputes or discrepancies in seat allotment, prepare to file objections within the official windows and have proof of eligibility ready for quick review.
  • Where a desired course or college is unavailable, consider allied programs with transfer pathways to MBBS or engineering after a foundational year, or pursue diploma and laterals that complement STEM trajectories.
  • For students affected by rescheduling or examiner delays, keep track of alternate entry routes such as pre-professional programs or bridging courses that align with MBBS or engineering prerequisites.

Practical Steps for 2027 Admissions

  • Create a regional shortlist of target institutions early, including safety, target, and stretch options across government, private, and deemed segments.
  • Monitor state and central portals for notification updates, counseling rounds, and cut-off trends rather than relying on rumors or social chatter.
  • Prepare a standardized document folder with identity proofs, academics, category certificates, domicile proofs, and recent photographs to speed verification across rounds.
  • Set a financial plan that accounts for potential variability in tuition, hostel charges, and incidental fees across colleges in different states.
  • Engage with school counselors or trusted education advisors to interpret state-specific rules and to review your application strategy before each round of counseling.

How to Approach State-Specific Variations

Advisers emphasize the importance of tailoring timelines to your region. While the structure of MBBS and engineering admissions is broadly similar, factors like the number of seats, fee structures, and quota allocations can differ. Confirm the exact schedules from the relevant state portal or official counseling authority when announcements are made. If you cannot locate the official calendars, verify the next available counseling window and the required documentation with the designated help desks of the state admissions body or the participating institutions.

Questions to Ask Your School and Counselors

  • Which rounds will include government versus private seat allotments in my state?
  • Are there any special rounds for reserved categories or management quota seats that I should plan for?
  • What is the process for verifying documents if there is a delay due to regional holidays or technical issues?
  • What alternatives exist if my preferred college is filled early or if I fail to qualify in the initial merit list?

Visible FAQ

FAQ 1: When does MBBS counseling typically begin in my state?

Counseling usually starts a few weeks after the national entrance results are announced. Exact dates vary by state, so monitor the official portal and competent authorities for the official calendar.

FAQ 2: Can I change my branch after seat allotment?

Branch changes are sometimes allowed in specific rounds or through special processes. Review the rules for the particular round and keep within the stated deadlines for any objections or modifications.

FAQ 3: What should I do if I miss a counseling round?

Missing a round typically leaves you with remaining seats in subsequent rounds or mop-up rounds. Stay connected to official channels and prepare for the next window with updated documents and backup options.

FAQ 4: How can I plan for contingency if regional delays occur?

Maintain a flexible list of colleges, have ready financial plans, and consider allied programs or transfer pathways that align with MBBS goals or engineering branches while awaiting official outcomes.

FAQ 5: Where can I verify the official admission schedule if there is a dispute?

Verify with the designated admissions authority or portal of your state. If an official page is unavailable, contact the helpdesk or the institutional admission office for the most current guidance.

Key Takeaways for 2027 Admissions

Regional calendars for MBBS and engineering require proactive tracking of official announcements and timely document preparation. Build a flexible plan that accommodates multiple rounds of counseling, potential seat changes, and backup options. By aligning with state-specific timelines and maintaining readiness for contingencies, hopeful students and their families can navigate the admission year with greater clarity and fewer last-minute surprises.

content:
VITEEE Expected Cutoff 2026: Campus-Wise Closing Rank for CSE, ECE, AI & Other Top Branches

Although Vellore Institute of Technology does not officially release detailed branch-wise cutoff lists publicly, previous counselling trends and student admission data provide a strong estimate of the expected VITEEE 2026 cutoff ranks.

What is VITEEE Cutoff?

The VITEEE cutoff refers to the minimum rank required by a candidate to secure admission into a specific branch and campus during counselling. The cutoff changes every year depending on several factors such as:

  • Number of applicants
  • Difficulty level of the exam
  • Seat availability
  • Branch popularity
  • Counselling participation rate
  • Category-wise seat allotment

Students with lower rank numbers generally have better chances of getting top branches at preferred campuses.

title: NEET UG 2026 counselling: state quota portals deadlines and login steps
description: Clear deadlines and login steps for NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling, with a practical checklist for students and parents to navigate portal registrations, seat allotment and self-reporting.
content:
Key takeaway: Timely state quota registrations can secure critical seats and save last‑minute stress

Nationwide counselling for NEET UG 2026 involves separate state quota processes along with the All India quota. State portals open on varying dates and have distinct login steps, document requirements, and deadlines. This article outlines practical deadlines, login steps, and a planning checklist to help students and parents complete registrations smoothly, avoid last‑minute hurdles, and track seat allotment progress.

Understanding the counselling landscape

NEET UG counselling typically includes an All India quota process and state/association quotas. State portals manage admissions to government and private medical and dental colleges within the respective state. Access to the state allotment results, choice filling, and self‑reporting is through the official state portal designated for medical admissions. Always verify the official state portal details on the respective state medical education department or counselling authority website before starting any login or document upload.

Common deadlines you should track

  • Registration window: States publish opening and closing dates for counselling registration. Missing the window can forfeit a seat opportunity.
  • Choice filling deadline: After registration, candidates select preferred colleges and courses. Submission by the deadline is essential to be considered for seat allotment.
  • Locking or confirmation: Some portals require final confirmation of choices. Do not navigate away or delay this step.
  • Seat allotment result: Result announcements occur in multiple rounds. Check the portal for roundwise results and subsequent steps.
  • Self‑reporting and document verification: After seat allotment, candidates must report to the allotted college and complete document verification by specified dates.

Step‑by‑step login and registration basics

While each state portal has its own login flow, the typical process follows a common pattern. Use the official portal URL provided by the state counselling authority and keep a record of your login credentials. If you forget your password, you can use the portal’s password recovery option usually tied to the registered mobile number or email.

  1. Registration - Create an account using a valid mobile number and email. You may be asked to provide NEET UG roll number, date of birth, and a password.
  2. Login - Return to the login page and sign in with your registered username and password.
  3. Candidate dashboard - Access the dashboard to view eligibility status, course and college preferences, and fee structures.
  4. Choice filling - Enter and save preferred colleges and courses. Ensure options are in order of preference and within eligibility criteria.
  5. Locking choices - Some portals require final submission of the choices. Confirm only when you’re confident about the selections.
  6. Seat allotment and reporting - After results, check allotted seats, download provisional allotment letters if available, and follow the reporting timeline.

Documentation you may need

  • NEET UG admit card and score card
  • Class 12 or equivalent mark sheet and board details
  • Category certificate (if applicable)
  • Proof of identity and date of birth
  • Dues and isurance documents if required by the state portal

Practical checklist for students and parents

  • Mark calendars with state‑level counselling opening and closing dates as soon as they are announced.
  • Prepare documents in digital format with clear scans to avoid upload issues.
  • Make a shortlist of states with preferred colleges and note their minimum eligibility criteria.
  • Keep your mobile number and email up to date on the portal for notifications and password resets.
  • Have a backup plan for late‑stage seat options in other states or in the All India quota if needed.

Coordination for parents: steps to supervise the process

Parents often handle the initial setup, document collection, and deadline reminders. Create a shared digital checklist, set reminders a week before each deadline, and confirm with the candidate before each submission. If a state portal requires legal guardian information or consent for minor applicants, ensure the guardian details are accurately entered and updated.

What to do if you miss a deadline

Missing a deadline can limit seat options significantly. In many states, late registrations or extended rounds are not guaranteed. Check if there is a special round or a waitlist process and whether late fee or additional documentation might be required. Always verify with the official state portal or helpline for any possible extensions or exceptional rounds.

Frequently asked questions

1. How do I access my state counselling portal account?

Visit the official state counselling portal, select the candidate login option, and use the credentials created during registration. If you forget the password, use the portal’s password recovery feature linked to your registered mobile number or email.

2. What documents are typically required for state counselling?

Common documents include the NEET UG admit card, score card, Class 12 mark sheet, identity proofs, category certificates if applicable, and residence or domicile proofs as required by the state.

3. Can I change my college choices after submitting?

Some portals allow edits up to a certain deadline. After locking choices, edits may not be permitted. Always complete a final review before submission.

4. What should I do if the portal shows technical problems during login?

Retry after some time, clear browser cache, or try a different browser. If issues persist, contact the official helpline or helpdesk provided on the portal homepage.

5. How do I know which state to apply for?

Consider your preferred states, availability of seats in your category, and the reputation of colleges. Some students apply to multiple states to maximize options, while others focus on a few top choices to streamline the process.

6. When does self‑reporting typically happen after seat allotment?

Self‑reporting windows are set by the state authority and occur after provisional seat allotment. It is essential to complete self‑reporting and verification within the stated dates to retain the seat.

Bottom line for NEET UG 2026 state counselling

Plan ahead, track each state portal’s deadlines, and keep documents ready for quick uploads. The most reliable path to a favorable outcome is timely registration, accurate information, and prompt self‑reporting after seat allotment. If you are unsure about a step, verify details on the official authority website for your state counselling process before proceeding.

title: CUET UG Subject Mapping Errors Can Lock You Out of the Right Course
description: A valid CUET UG score may not meet a programme’s subject rule. Learn how to check eligibility, score use and choice filling before applying.
content:
A valid CUET UG score doesn’t automatically make you eligible for every course. If you skipped a required paper, selected the wrong subject or misread a university’s score rule, your preferred programme may reject the choice even when your scorecard looks strong.

The score can be valid. The course claim can still fail. That’s the real risk of subject mapping errors.

Why doesn’t a high CUET UG score guarantee admission eligibility?

CUET UG scores apply to the subjects selected and attempted under the applicable application and exam instructions. A university then decides which language, domain subject or combination it will use for each programme. These rules can change between universities and between courses at the same university.

For example, a BSc programme may require Biology, while another science programme may accept a different subject group. A Physics and Chemistry score can’t normally create a Biology score later. This is an illustrative example, not a current university rule. Check the named programme bulletin for the year in which you’re applying.

In plain terms, choice filling generally can’t add a missing CUET subject score. A later preference form may let you rank courses, but it usually can’t turn a subject you didn’t select or attempt into a score. Any correction facility or exception must come from the applicable official notice.

What must you match before filling choices?

  1. Fix the exact target: Write the university, programme and admission route. “BCom” or “BSc” alone isn’t enough.
  2. Compare subjects: Match the bulletin’s required language and domain subjects with your selected and attempted papers.
  3. Check score use: See whether merit uses one named subject, a group of subjects, a language score or another stated combination.
  4. Separate eligibility from preference: A course may appear in a choice list but still be unusable for your subject combination.

What should you do after spotting an error?

Check the current CUET UG instructions for any permitted correction route. Don’t assume an edit is open or that a university can change an exam record.

Keep your application confirmation, selected-subject details and official score record, where available. If the rule remains unclear, send the university a precise written query through its stated admission channel. Include the programme name, selected subjects and attempted subjects. Ask whether they meet both eligibility and score-use conditions. Save the written reply and the exact programme bulletin version you consulted.

Sort choices into eligible, unclear and not eligible. Hold unclear options back until the university responds in writing. You can explore relevant courses and compare colleges, but neither replaces the programme’s own eligibility rule.

title: BSEB 2027 డమ్మీ అడ్మిట్ కార్డు: పదో తరగతి సవరణలు నవంబర్ 7 వరకు
description: బిహార్ బోర్డు డమ్మీ కార్డులో పేరు, పుట్టిన తేదీ, సబ్జెక్టులు చూడండి. పదో తరగతి అనుమతించిన సవరణలు పాఠశాల ద్వారా 1-7 నవంబర్ 2026లో ఆన్‌లైన్‌లో చేయించండి.
content:
బిహార్ బోర్డు 2027 వార్షిక పరీక్షకు నమోదైన పదో తరగతి విద్యార్థులు డమ్మీ అడ్మిట్ కార్డు తీసుకుని 1 నుంచి 7 నవంబర్ 2026లో పాఠశాల ద్వారా సవరణ కోరవచ్చు. పేర్ల అక్షరాలు, పుట్టిన తేదీ, సబ్జెక్టులు, ఫొటో, సంతకం ఇప్పుడే చూడండి. ప్రింట్‌పై సవరణ రాసినా పాఠశాల దాన్ని ఆన్‌లైన్‌లో నమోదు చేయాలి.

పన్నెండో తరగతి పోర్టల్‌లో 2025-27 విద్యా సత్రానికి విద్యార్థి డమ్మీ కార్డు లింక్ ఉంది. ఇక్కడి నవంబర్ 1-7 సవరణ కాలం పదో తరగతి నోటీసుతో నిర్ధారితమైంది. పన్నెండో తరగతి వారు తమ తేదీలు, సూచనలు కళాశాల లేదా ఇంటర్మీడియట్ పోర్టల్‌లో తీసుకోవాలి; అదే గడువు వర్తిస్తుందని అనుకోవద్దు.

పదో తరగతి కార్డు డౌన్‌లోడ్, సవరణ విధానం

అధికారిక సెకండరీ వార్షిక పరీక్ష 2027 పోర్టల్‌లో విద్యార్థి డమ్మీ కార్డు డౌన్‌లోడ్ ఎంచుకోండి. పాఠశాల రికార్డు ప్రకారం నమోదు సంఖ్య, పుట్టిన తేదీ ఇవ్వండి; కార్డు లేదా స్పష్టమైన ప్రింట్ ఉంచండి. BSEB PR 256/2026 ప్రకారం ప్రధానోపాధ్యాయుడు పాఠశాల లాగిన్‌లో కార్డు చూసి లేదా డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసి అనుమతించిన వివరాలు సవరించవచ్చు. విద్యార్థి, తల్లి లేదా తండ్రి పూర్తి పేరు మార్చేందుకు అనుమతి లేదు. పూర్తి పదో తరగతి నోటీసు చదవండి.

బిహార్ పాఠశాల పరీక్ష బోర్డు, PR 256/2026 నోటీసు, 30 అక్టోబర్ 2026, పేజీ 1. పూర్తి సూచనలకు మూడు పేజీలూ చదవండి. పదో తరగతి కార్డు డౌన్‌లోడ్, సవరణ విధానం.

సంతకం చేసిన సవరణ ప్రతిని పాఠశాలకు ఇవ్వండి

నమోదు, పాఠశాల రికార్డులతో పేర్ల అక్షరాలు, వర్గం, లింగం, సబ్జెక్టులు, పుట్టిన తేదీ, ఫొటో, సంతకం సరిపోల్చండి. అవసరమైతే తల్లిదండ్రులు లేదా సంరక్షకుడి సహాయం తీసుకోండి. అనుమతించిన తప్పును కార్డుపై సరిచేసి సంతకం చేసి, ఒక ప్రతిని ఆన్‌లైన్ సవరణకు ప్రధానోపాధ్యాయునికి ఇవ్వండి. మరో ప్రతిపై పాఠశాల సంతకం, ముద్ర తీసుకుని ఉంచుకోండి. గడువులో ఆన్‌లైన్ మార్పు పూర్తయిందా అడగండి; కాగితం ఇవ్వడమే చివరి దశ కాదు. దృష్టి లోపం ఉన్న విద్యార్థుల అనుమతించిన సబ్జెక్టులు, వృత్తివిద్య సబ్జెక్టు లేదా ట్రేడ్ వివరాలకు ప్రత్యేక సూచనలు ఉన్నాయి. వర్తిస్తే ఆమోదించిన కాంబినేషన్‌ను పాఠశాలతో పోల్చండి.

పన్నెండో తరగతి విద్యార్థి లాగిన్ వేరు

ఇంటర్మీడియట్ 2025-27 పోర్టల్‌లో విద్యార్థి డమ్మీ కార్డు లింక్ తెరవండి. పన్నెండో తరగతి డౌన్‌లోడ్ స్క్రీన్ కళాశాల కోడ్, నమోదు సంఖ్య, విభాగం, తెరపై ధృవీకరణ ప్రశ్న సమాధానం అడుగుతుంది. వివరాలు లేకపోతే కళాశాల నుంచి సరైనవి తీసుకోండి.

పన్నెండో తరగతి కార్డు చదివి తప్పులు వెంటనే కళాశాలకు చెప్పండి. ఇంటర్మీడియట్ సవరణ సూచనలే పాటించండి. పైన సెకండరీ నోటీసు పదో తరగతికి సంబంధించినది; పన్నెండో తరగతి గడువుకు ఆధారం కాదు.

కార్డు తెరుచుకోకపోతే

నమోదు చేసిన వివరాలు పాఠశాల లేదా కళాశాల రికార్డులతో మళ్లీ చూడండి. నమోదు సంఖ్యను పదేపదే ఊహించవద్దు. పదో తరగతి డౌన్‌లోడ్ లేదా సవరణ ఇబ్బందులకు నోటీసులో 9430429722, bseb@antiersolutions.com ఉన్నాయి. అనుమతించిన ఆన్‌లైన్ సవరణకు పాఠశాలే మార్గం.

డమ్మీ కార్డు పరీక్ష వివరాల తనిఖీ కోసం. దాన్ని భద్రపరచండి; పరీక్ష కేంద్రానికి ప్రవేశించే తుది అడ్మిట్ కార్డుగా భావించవద్దు. తుది ప్రవేశ పత్రం, తర్వాతి పరీక్ష సూచనల కోసం బోర్డు, సంస్థ మార్గదర్శకాలు పాటించండి.

title: CBSE ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਤੇ 12 ਅਸਾਮੀ ਪੇਪਰ 2027: ਤਾਰੀਖ, ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ
content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਅਸਾਮੀ (ਕੋਡ 014) ਪੇਪਰ 27 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ ਅਸਾਮੀ (ਕੋਡ 114) ਪੇਪਰ 3 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

CBSE ਵੱਲੋਂ 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਨੂੰ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿੱਤੇ ਹਨ। ਇਹ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਹੈ, ਅੰਕ ਪੱਤਰ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CBSE ਡੇਟਸ਼ੀਟ

ਅਸਾਮੀ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਜਮਾਤ ਤੇ ਪੇਪਰਕੋਡਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖਸਮਾਂ (IST)ਮਿਆਦ

ਜਮਾਤ 12: Assamese1143 ਮਾਰਚ 202710:30 - 13:303 ਘੰਟੇ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 5: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਸੈਕੰਡਰੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਬੋਰਡ, 6 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਸਫ਼ਾ 9: ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਕੋਡ, ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਤੇ ਸਮਾਂ। ਅਸਲ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੇਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5, 9 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 014, 114 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਅਸਾਮੀ (014) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 27 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਤ (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਅਸਾਮੀ (114) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 3 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Core (301) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 5 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 2 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ

ਪੇਪਰ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਦਾ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ, ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਵੇਖੋ। ਬਦਲਾਅ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਸੋਧੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਮਾਤ, ਕੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: TS Inter 2027: Plan for Practicals Before the Theory Timetable
description: Telangana’s tentative calendar places practicals in late January and theory exams in late February. See what this means before subject dates arrive.
content:
Telangana Intermediate students should leave room for practical preparation before the theory examinations. The board’s tentative 2026-27 academic calendar places IPE 2027 practicals in the last week of January and theory examinations in the last week of February. It does not give individual paper dates.

Three stages to include in your plan

Stage

Period in the tentative calendar

Pre-final examinations

18-23 January 2027

IPE practical examinations

Last week of January 2027

IPE theory examinations

Last week of February 2027

Telangana Board of Intermediate Education academic calendar, 28 March 2026, page 2. Read the official document.

“Last week” is a broad planning indication. Do not turn it into a particular start date or assume that your first-year and second-year papers fall on consecutive days. A separate examination timetable is needed for subject dates and sessions.

Ask your college about practical work now

For subjects with practical or project requirements, confirm what your college expects you to complete and which records you need to bring. Keep practical preparation alongside theory revision instead of leaving it until the end of the January pre-finals.

Use pre-finals to identify unfinished topics and problems that take too long under timed conditions. Leave some flexible revision time after them, because a broad calendar does not show the gap between your individual papers.

Use the correct timetable when it is issued

Go to the official Intermediate board website and match the examination year, first or second year, course and subject code. Check practical instructions separately from theory dates. Follow any later board revision and the directions issued through your college.

The calendar and timetable guide explains the distinction between an academic plan and an exam date sheet. Keep fixed travel or leave arrangements flexible until the timetable for your papers is available.

title: समता के नाम पर संग्राम: यूजीसी के नियमों पर विवाद
description: यूजीसी के नए नियमों को लेकर देशभर में विवाद क्यों है? समता, समानता और विश्वविद्यालयों की स्वायत्तता पर उठे सवालों की पूरी जानकारी।
content:
हाल ही में विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) के नए नियमों को लेकर देशभर में बहस तेज हो गई है। सरकार और यूजीसी का दावा है कि ये नियम शिक्षा में समता (Equality) और गुणवत्ता बढ़ाने के लिए लाए गए हैं, लेकिन दूसरी ओर शिक्षक संगठनों, छात्र समूहों और कुछ राज्य सरकारों ने इन्हें लेकर कड़ा विरोध जताया है। यही कारण है कि समता के नाम पर यह मुद्दा अब एक तरह का “संग्राम” बन गया है।

यूजीसी के नए नियम क्या कहते हैं?

UGC द्वारा प्रस्तावित/लागू किए गए नियमों में मुख्य रूप से नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, प्रमोशन सिस्टम और संस्थानों की स्वायत्तता से जुड़े बदलाव शामिल हैं। आयोग का कहना है कि इससे देशभर में एक समान मानक लागू होंगे और योग्य उम्मीदवारों को बेहतर अवसर मिलेंगे।

विरोध की मुख्य वजहें

विरोध करने वालों का मानना है कि ये नियम केंद्रिकरण (Centralization) को बढ़ावा देते हैं और राज्यों व विश्वविद्यालयों की स्वायत्तता को कमजोर करते हैं। इसके अलावा, आरक्षण व्यवस्था, सामाजिक प्रतिनिधित्व और क्षेत्रीय विविधता को लेकर भी सवाल उठाए जा रहे हैं।

प्रमुख विवाद बिंदु

मुद्दा आपत्ति
नियुक्ति नियम राज्यों की भूमिका कम होने का आरोप
प्रमोशन सिस्टम पहले से कार्यरत शिक्षकों को नुकसान
समता का दावा सामाजिक न्याय कमजोर होने की आशंका
स्वायत्तता विश्वविद्यालयों की स्वतंत्रता पर सवाल

“समता” बनाम “समानता” की बहस

आलोचकों का कहना है कि समान नियम सभी के लिए समान अवसर नहीं होते। भारत जैसे विविध देश में समता (Equity) के लिए अलग-अलग सामाजिक परिस्थितियों को ध्यान में रखना जरूरी है। सिर्फ एक जैसे नियम लागू करना, कई वर्गों के लिए नुकसानदायक हो सकता है।

सरकार और यूजीसी का पक्ष

UGC और केंद्र सरकार का तर्क है कि नए नियमों से पारदर्शिता, मेरिट-आधारित सिस्टम और वैश्विक स्तर की शिक्षा व्यवस्था विकसित होगी। उनका कहना है कि यह बदलाव लंबे समय में छात्रों और शिक्षकों दोनों के हित में हैं।

निष्कर्ष

यूजीसी के नियमों को लेकर मचा यह हंगामा सिर्फ नियमों का नहीं, बल्कि शिक्षा की दिशा और सामाजिक न्याय की परिभाषा का सवाल है। समता के नाम पर शुरू हुआ यह संग्राम आने वाले समय में शिक्षा नीति को किस दिशा में ले जाएगा, यह संवाद और संतुलन पर निर्भर करेगा—टकराव पर नहीं।

title: State board marks vs entrance scores: which colleges still consider both
description: State board marks can still matter in many admissions, especially where colleges use mixed merit, eligibility cut-offs or 10+2 percentages. Here is how to check whether your board score can improve your chances.
content:
Answer first

Yes, in many Indian admissions, state board marks still matter along with entrance scores. The exact impact depends on the state admission authority, the course, and the counselling route. In some colleges, board percentage is only used to check eligibility. In others, it is added to entrance scores, used for tie-breaking, or counted in a merit list. If you are applying this year, first check whether your chosen course uses entrance-only selection or a mixed merit formula. That single rule can change your final rank and college chance.

Key facts

Admission modelDo board marks matter?What it means for you
Entrance-only meritUsually no, after eligibilityYour score in the test drives selection
Mixed merit formulaYesBoard percentage may be combined with entrance marks
Eligibility thresholdYesYou must cross the minimum board percentage to apply
Tie-breaker stageSometimes yesBoard marks can decide between two close candidates
Document verificationAlways yesMarksheets are checked even where they do not affect merit

The biggest mistake students make is assuming that every college admission is decided only by the entrance exam. That is true for some central and many entrance-based seats, but not for all state-level admissions, self-financed college seats, or courses that publish a combined merit list.

Where board percentage still matters

1) Courses with combined merit lists

Some state admission authorities prepare a merit list using both board marks and entrance scores. The weightage can vary by course and state. In such cases, a higher board percentage can improve your final position even if your entrance score is average.

2) Eligibility cut-offs

Many colleges use board marks to decide whether you are even eligible. For example, a course may require a minimum percentage in Class 12, often with subject-specific conditions such as Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology. If you do not meet the board minimum, your entrance score may not help.

3) Tie-break situations

When two candidates have similar entrance scores, board marks may be used as a tie-breaker. This is common in merit-based counselling where seat allocation needs a clear ranking.

4) State quota and local counselling

Under many state quota processes, the admission authority may use board performance in its ranking rules, especially for professional undergraduate courses. The exact formula can differ from one state to another and from one counselling round to the next.

Where board marks usually do not matter much

If a course is strictly entrance-driven, board marks generally stop mattering after you clear the minimum eligibility requirement. In such admissions, the test score, category rules, rank list, and counselling choices decide the outcome. This is common in many national-level entrance processes and in some state counselling systems for technical and professional programs.

Even then, do not ignore your marksheet. A low board percentage can still block eligibility, subject combinations, or document verification later.

How to read the admission rule correctly

Before you compare colleges, look for these three lines in the official information bulletin or counselling notice:

  • Eligibility: minimum board percentage or subject requirement
  • Selection method: entrance-only, board-only, or combined merit
  • Tie-break rule: what happens when scores are equal

If the notice says the final merit list uses a percentage formula, your board marks matter directly. If it says merit is based on entrance rank only, your board marks matter indirectly through eligibility and verification.

Practical decision guidance for students and parents

Use this simple check before counselling starts:

  1. Identify the route: entrance exam, board-based admission, or counselling after a test.
  2. Check eligibility: confirm the minimum Class 12 percentage and required subjects.
  3. Look for weightage: see whether board marks and entrance marks are combined.
  4. Check category rules: reservation, domicile, and seat quota can change cut-offs.
  5. Keep documents ready: marksheet, passing certificate, category certificate, domicile proof, and entrance scorecard if applicable.

Scenario 1: A student with a strong board score but a moderate entrance rank may still get a better seat in a mixed-merit state counselling process.

Scenario 2: A student with a top entrance rank but a board percentage below the eligibility minimum may be rejected at verification stage.

Scenario 3: Two students with equal entrance scores may be separated by board marks in the final merit list.

What to verify before you rely on board marks

Because admission rules can vary by state, institution, and academic year, verify these details on the official counselling notice before you assume board marks will help:

  • Whether the seat is under state quota, management quota, or entrance-based counselling
  • Whether the college uses combined merit or entrance rank only
  • The exact board percentage required for eligibility
  • Whether improvement exam marks are accepted for the current cycle
  • Whether the board result date affects document deadlines

If the rules are unclear, ask the responsible state admission authority or the college admission office in writing. Keep a screenshot or copy of the notice so you can match your documents to the correct rule.

Bottom line

Board marks still matter in many admissions, but not everywhere. They are most useful when the system uses a mixed merit formula, an eligibility threshold, or a tie-breaker rule. If your target colleges are entrance-only, then the entrance score matters most after eligibility is cleared. The safest approach is to treat board marks as a real admission factor until the official counselling rules prove otherwise.

FAQs

Do board marks matter in all college admissions?

No. Board marks matter in some admissions, especially where the state admission authority uses eligibility cut-offs, mixed merit, or tie-break rules. In entrance-only admissions, they usually matter only for eligibility and document checks.

Can a high board percentage improve my admission chances?

Yes, if the college or counselling system uses combined merit or board marks as part of ranking. A strong board score can improve your final position even when your entrance score is only average.

What if I have a great entrance score but a low board percentage?

You may still lose the seat if the board percentage is below the minimum eligibility requirement. In some cases, board marks also affect ranking, so a low score can reduce your chances further.

How do I know whether a college uses board marks or not?

Check the official admission notice or counselling information bulletin. Look for the selection method, eligibility rules, and tie-break policy. If the rules are not clear, verify them with the responsible admission authority before applying.

Are board marks used in tie-breaking?

Sometimes yes. When two candidates have similar entrance scores or ranks, the admission authority may use board marks to decide the final order. This is common in merit-based counselling systems.

Should parents focus more on board marks or entrance preparation?

Both matter, but in different ways. Entrance preparation is crucial for entrance-driven courses, while board marks can decide eligibility and ranking in mixed-merit admissions. The right balance depends on the target course and state admission rules.

title: How to Read a College Accreditation Label Before Choosing BTech
description: Understand what AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation mean for a BTech college, and what these labels cannot prove.
content:
AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation are not three versions of the same college badge. AICTE deals mainly with permission to run technical education, NAAC assesses the institution as a whole, and NBA examines specific programmes such as BTech branches. Before paying fees, match the label with the exact college, campus, branch and validity period.

That distinction can save you from treating a polished website claim as proof of placements or teaching quality. Start by shortlisting colleges through college comparisons, then verify the relevant status with the responsible authority.

What does AICTE approval cover?

AICTE approval concerns the regulatory permission for technical education institutions and programmes under its scope. For a BTech applicant, it is a basic compliance check: does the institution have approval to offer the technical programme and intake being advertised?

But approval is not a promise of a high package, modern laboratories, good faculty attendance or strong student support. A college can meet permission requirements and still be a poor fit for your branch, budget or career plan. Check whether the approval applies to the same campus, academic session, programme and sanctioned intake shown in the admission offer.

NAAC and NBA answer different questions

LabelWhat it assessesWhat it cannot prove
AICTE approvalPermission and regulatory requirements for technical educationTeaching quality, placements or student outcomes
NAAC accreditationThe institution's broader systems, facilities, governance and academic practicesThat every BTech branch performs equally well
NBA accreditationA specific programme's outcomes, curriculum processes and quality systemsThat the entire college or all branches are accredited

NAAC accreditation belongs to the institution, so a college's grade does not automatically certify each engineering branch. NBA accreditation is programme-specific. Computer Science may have it while Civil or Mechanical does not, and the status may have a defined validity period. Read the programme name carefully, not just the college logo.

How should you use these labels in a BTech decision?

  1. Confirm AICTE approval for the exact institution, campus, session and BTech intake.
  2. Check the NAAC status and validity for the institution named in your offer letter.
  3. Look for NBA status against your exact branch, not a different department or another campus.
  4. Ask the college for branch-level placement data, faculty details, internship records, fees and refund rules. These are separate checks.

Use accreditation as a filter, not a final ranking. A sensible college choice combines regulatory status with branch results, commute or hostel cost, lab access, faculty stability and the actual placement record. If a brochure displays only “accredited” without naming the authority, programme and validity, treat that as an incomplete claim and ask for the missing details before you pay.

title: JoSAA Float or Freeze: When an NIT Upgrade Is Not Worth It
description: Compare JoSAA 2026 Float and Freeze choices through branch fit, upgrade uncertainty, reporting duties and the real cost of giving up a workable NIT seat.
content:
JoSAA 2026 Float or Freeze is a seat decision, not a prestige contest. Choose Freeze when your allotted NIT branch is affordable, acceptable and one you would actually study. Choose Float only when a higher preference is a clear personal improvement and you are ready to join it if allotted.

Under JoSAA rules, Float keeps a candidate in consideration for a higher preference in a later round, subject to the live counselling process. It doesn’t guarantee an upgrade. If a higher choice is allotted, you shouldn’t assume the present seat will remain available as a backup.

Before deciding, compare colleges by branch, fees, location and hostel costs, not just by closing rank.

When is Freeze the sensible choice?

Freeze is often the better call when the branch already fits your plans and the possible upgrade is mainly about a stronger-sounding name. A confirmed NIT Civil Engineering seat may serve you better than a higher-listed branch you have no interest in studying.

  • Freeze if you accept both the allotted institute and branch.
  • Freeze if travel, hostel or family finances make a change difficult.
  • Freeze if the course matches your work plans, higher-study interests or government-exam preparation.
  • Freeze if you would hesitate to join every higher preference above the current seat.

Your daily classes, core subjects and project work will follow the branch. A rank table can’t make that fit for you.

What should you check before selecting Float?

Float makes sense only when the upside is specific. “Better college” isn’t enough. Name the exact branch and institute you would accept, then check the cost of moving there.

  1. List the higher preferences you would genuinely join.
  2. Read the branch syllabus and compare its subjects with your interests.
  3. Record the current fee, payment, document and reporting instructions.
  4. Budget for fresh travel, hostel arrangements, deposits or institute charges if the seat changes.
  5. Keep every required document and payment receipt ready for the applicable round.

JoSAA is the responsible counselling authority for these choices. Its live allotment result and round instructions control what you must do next, while the decision about branch fit remains yours. Check those instructions immediately after any result. You can also organise your wider entrance-exam planning, but general advice must not replace the instructions attached to your allotment.

Use this final test before you click

Float if the possible upgrade improves branch fit, institute preference or location enough to justify uncertainty and extra cost. Freeze if the gain is vague and the current NIT seat works for your academics and family budget. A workable seat isn’t a defeat. Losing it for a preference you may not even join is the real risk.

title: AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27: Eligibility, Step-by-Step Application Guide on NSP, and Renewal Rules
description: A comprehensive guide to the AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27. Discover detailed eligibility criteria, a step-by-step NSP application guide, document requirements, and critical renewal rules for female technical students.
content:
Quick Answer: What is the AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27?

The AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27 is a landmark initiative by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and the Government of India designed to provide financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per year to meritorious girl students. The scheme supports young women who have gained admission to first-year degree or diploma courses (or second-year via lateral entry) in AICTE-approved institutions across India. Managed entirely through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP), this scholarship aims to promote technical education among girls and reduce gender disparity in STEM fields.

Key Facts: AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27

Before diving into the complex application process, let us look at the fundamental metrics of the AICTE Pragati Scheme:

FeatureDetails & Requirements
Scholarship AmountRs. 50,000 per annum (for a maximum of 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma)
Target AudienceFemale students enrolled in technical degrees or diplomas
Number of Scholarships10,000 scholarships annually (5,000 for Degree and 5,000 for Diploma) + extra slots for select Union Territories
Maximum Family IncomeRs. 8,000,000 (8 Lakhs) per annum from all sources
Application PlatformNational Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Eligible InstitutionsOnly AICTE-approved colleges, institutes, and universities

Detailed Eligibility Criteria for Applicants

To qualify for the AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27, applicants must strictly fulfill the following requirements:

  • Gender & Family Cap: The scholarship is exclusively open to female students. A maximum of two girl children per family can avail of the benefits of this scheme.
  • Academic Admission: Candidates must be admitted to the first year of a technical degree or diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution in the current academic year 2026-27. Alternatively, students admitted to the second year of a degree or diploma course through lateral entry are also eligible.
  • Income Ceiling: The annual income of the applicant’s family must not exceed Rs. 8 Lakh during the preceding financial year. A valid Income Certificate issued by a competent state authority is mandatory.
  • State-Specific Slots: While the overall scholarship pool is capped, allocations are distributed across Indian States and Union Territories based on standard government quotas.

Whether you have secured admission in a well-regarded regional college like Pragati Engineering College, East Godavari, or are evaluating independent pathways through exams like the Institute of Technology and Management National Entrance and Scholarship Test, verifying your institution’s AICTE approval status is the absolute first step.

Step-by-Step Guide to Applying on the NSP Portal

The entire application process for the AICTE Pragati Scholarship 2026-27 is hosted on the National Scholarship Portal (NSP). Follow this systematic blueprint to avoid rejection:

Step 1: One-Time Registration (OTR)

First-time users must generate a unique OTR (One-Time Registration) on the NSP portal. You will need a working mobile number, your Aadhaar card, and basic personal details. After verification via OTP, you will receive your unique OTR credentials.

Step 2: Log in and Fill out the Application Form

Log in using your OTR number and password. Complete the student profile sections, which include personal details, contact information, academic track record (such as 10th and 12th board marks), and your current college details.

Step 3: Select the AICTE Pragati Scheme

Under the "State Schemes" or "Central Schemes" tab on the NSP dashboard, locate the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) section. Select either the Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Degree) or the Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students (Diploma) based on your current course.

Step 4: Upload Required Documents

Ensure you have scanned copies of the following documents ready for upload. File sizes should comply with the NSP limits:

  • Mark sheet of Class 10 and Class 12 (or equivalent examination).
  • Annual Family Income Certificate issued by an officer not below the rank of Tehsildar.
  • Admission letter issued by the centralized admission authority or the institution.
  • Tuition fee receipt paid for the current academic year.
  • Bank passbook showing the student’s name, account number, and IFSC code (Note: The bank account must be linked to your Aadhaar number).
  • A declaration signed by the parent and the student confirming that the family income information is accurate and that only two girls in the family are applying.

Step 5: Review and Submit

Carefully verify every entered field against your official documents. Even minor typos in the bank account number, Aadhaar number, or name spelling can lead to payment failure or application rejection. Submit the form and keep a printed copy of the final application for your records.

Pragati Scholarship Renewal Rules

The scholarship is not automatically disbursed every year. To continue receiving the Rs. 50,000 grant in subsequent years, candidates must apply for renewal on the NSP by adhering to these strict rules:

  • Academic Consistency: The scholar must be promoted to the next consecutive class or semester without any backlogs. Accumulating active backlogs at the time of renewal will disqualify the candidate.
  • Discipline & Attendance: The student must maintain excellent conduct and meet the minimum attendance requirements set by the respective institution.
  • No Parallel Benefits: If a student is found to be receiving any other government-funded or private scholarship, the Pragati Scholarship will be terminated immediately. For example, students planning their funding options may compare this with private institutional frameworks like Veltech Admission in Chennai - Fee Structure and Scholarship Details to ensure they are not double-dipping.
  • Timely Submission: Renewal applications must be submitted within the designated timeline on the NSP, accompanied by a promotion certificate signed by the Head of the Institution.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Can I apply for this scholarship if I cleared the JEE Advanced exam?

Yes. If you cleared exams like JEE Advanced 2026 and secured a seat in an AICTE-approved technical degree program, you are fully eligible to apply, provided you meet the family income and other demographic criteria.

2. How is the Rs. 50,000 grant disbursed?

The scholarship amount is credited directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account through the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode. Ensure your bank account is active and linked with your Aadhaar card to avoid transaction failures.

3. What expenses does the scholarship amount cover?

The Rs. 50,000 grant is a consolidated amount that covers college tuition fees, purchase of books, equipment, soft-wares, laptop, and other academic accessories. No separate charges for hostel or books are provided.

4. Can a student who took admission via lateral entry apply?

Yes, female students admitted directly to the second year of a technical degree or diploma program through the lateral entry process in an AICTE-approved college can apply under the lateral entry category on the NSP.

Sources

  • National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Official Website
  • All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) Guidelines

title: NMAT 2026 स्कोअरकार्ड: 48 तास, ऑडिट आणि पुन्हा परीक्षा देण्याचे नियम
description: NMAT स्कोअरकार्डची वेळ, सुरक्षा ऑडिटचा अपवाद, गुणांची मर्यादा आणि पुन्हा परीक्षेतील अंतर जाणून घ्या. कॉलेजचा अर्ज स्वतंत्र असतो.
content:
NMAT 2026 स्कोअरकार्ड तुमच्या परीक्षेच्या तारखेनुसार मिळते; सर्वांसाठी एकच निकालाचा दिवस नसतो. GMACनुसार अधिकृत कार्ड साधारणपणे परीक्षा दिल्यानंतर 48 तासांत डाउनलोडसाठी उपलब्ध होते आणि ईमेल येतो. अनधिकृत स्कोअर प्रिव्ह्यूला प्रवेशाची ऑफर समजू नका.

अधिकृत संकेतस्थळावर 2026ची परीक्षा मुदत 2 नोव्हेंबर ते 20 डिसेंबर आहे. बुक केलेल्या दिवसानुसार गुणांचा आढावा आणि कॉलेजचे अर्ज यांचे नियोजन करा.

अधिकृत NMAT संकेतस्थळ

सुरक्षा ऑडिटसाठी वेगळी मुदत आहे

परीक्षा सुरक्षेशी संबंधित घटना असलेल्या प्रकरणात ऑडिट होते आणि निकाल 10 कामकाजाच्या दिवसांत प्रसिद्ध होतो. विलंबाचा अर्थ आपल्या खात्यातील संदेशाच्या संदर्भात समजून घ्या. अपॉइंटमेंटचे तपशील जतन करून गरज पडल्यास अधिकृत मदत पथकाकडून स्पष्टीकरण घ्या.

GMACचे अधिकृत NMAT Exam Score मार्गदर्शन. पानावर प्रकाशनाची तारीख दिलेली नाही; ऑडिटचा अपवादही वाचा. स्कोअरकार्डचा मूळ नियम

विभागांचे गुण आणि कॉलेजच्या अटी तपासा

कार्डवर तीन विभागांचे स्केल्ड गुण आणि एकूण गुण असतात. प्रत्येक विभागाची मर्यादा 12 ते 120 आणि एकूण 36 ते 360 आहे. तिन्ही विभागांना समान भार असून स्कोअर एक वर्ष वैध असतो.

गुणांचे अधिकृत स्पष्टीकरण

निवडलेल्या प्रत्येक अभ्यासक्रमाच्या अधिकृत प्रवेश पानावर स्वीकारले जाणारे परीक्षा चक्र, अंतिम तारीख, पात्रता आणि एकूण किंवा विभागनिहाय गुणांची अट तपासा. सर्वसाधारण कटऑफचा अंदाज एखाद्या कॅम्पससाठी तुमची पात्रता ठरवत नाही. अटी आणि अधिकृत लिंकची नोंद ठेवा.

NMAT नोंदणी आणि बिझनेस स्कूलचा अर्ज वेगवेगळ्या प्रक्रिया आहेत. गुण पाठवल्याने कॉलेजचा अर्ज पूर्ण होत नाही; संस्थेची प्रक्रिया स्वतंत्रपणे पाळा.

पुन्हा परीक्षेसाठी अंतर ठेवा

1 जुलै ते 30 जून या एका परीक्षा चक्रात जास्तीत जास्त तीन प्रयत्न करता येतात. वैध गुण मिळालेल्या प्रयत्नानंतर लगेच पुन्हा बुकिंग करता येते, पण पुढची परीक्षा किमान सात दिवसांनी असावी. पैसे भरण्यापूर्वी उपलब्ध स्लॉट आणि कॉलेजचे नियम तपासा.

पुन्हा परीक्षा देण्याचे नियम

पहिला अर्ज अपूर्ण असेल तर आमचे NMAT नोंदणी आणि स्लॉट बुकिंग मार्गदर्शन वाचा. योग्य परीक्षा अपॉइंटमेंट निश्चित केल्यानंतर गुणांचे नियोजन करा.

नोंदणी आणि स्लॉट बुकिंग मार्गदर्शन
