title: CBSE कक्षा 10 और 12 स्वास्थ्य देखभाल परीक्षा 2027: तारीख, विषय कोड और समय
description: कक्षा 10 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (कोड 413) का पेपर 25 फरवरी 2027 को 10:30 से 12:30 बजे तक है। कक्षा 12 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (कोड 813) का पेपर 6 मार्च 2027 को 10:30 से 13:30 बजे तक है।
content:
कक्षा 10 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (कोड 413) का पेपर 25 फरवरी 2027 को 10:30 से 12:30 बजे तक है। कक्षा 12 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (कोड 813) का पेपर 6 मार्च 2027 को 10:30 से 13:30 बजे तक है।

CBSE ने 6 नवंबर 2026 के मुख्य परीक्षा कार्यक्रम में ये तारीखें दी हैं। यह परीक्षा की डेट शीट है; इससे अंकतालिका डाउनलोड नहीं होती। आधिकारिक CBSE डेट शीट

कक्षा 12: Health Care8136 मार्च 202710:30 - 13:303 घंटे

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड, 6 नवंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 5: विषय कोड, तारीख और समय। मूल PDF का यह पृष्ठ देखें

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षा बोर्ड, 6 नवंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 10: विषय कोड, तारीख और समय। मूल PDF का यह पृष्ठ देखें

आधिकारिक PDF में अपना विषय कैसे पहचानें

पृष्ठ 5, 10 पर पहले कक्षा की पहचान करें, फिर कोड 413, 813 खोजें। तारीख या समय का एक ही खाना कई विषयों पर लागू हो सकता है। मोबाइल पर पूरा पृष्ठ बड़ा करके देखें ताकि गलत पंक्ति न पढ़ लें।

अपने स्कूल के पंजीकरण विवरण से कोड और विषय का पूरा नाम मिलाएँ। एक ही नाम अलग कक्षाओं में दिखे तो केवल अपनी कक्षा की पंक्ति चुनें।

अंग्रेज़ी के पेपर के हिसाब से पढ़ाई की योजना

कक्षा 10 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (413) की तारीख 25 फरवरी 2027 है। अंग्रेज़ी भाषा और साहित्य (184) की तारीख 26 फरवरी 2027 है। दोनों पेपरों की तारीखों में 1 दिन का अंतर है। कक्षा 12 में स्वास्थ्य देखभाल (813) की तारीख 6 मार्च 2027 है। English Core (301) की तारीख 5 मार्च 2027 है। दोनों पेपरों की तारीखों में 1 दिन का अंतर है।

यह दो तारीखों का अंतर है, पढ़ाई के लिए मिलने वाली छुट्टियाँ नहीं। अपने बाकी पेपर भी लिखें और केवल बीच के खाली दिनों को गिनें। अभ्यास के लिए अपने पेपर जितना समय रखें।

प्रैक्टिकल और लिखित परीक्षा की तारीख अलग रखें

यह प्रविष्टि बोर्ड के निर्धारित पेपर की है। यदि प्रैक्टिकल, प्रदर्शन, प्रोजेक्ट या आंतरिक मूल्यांकन है, तो उसका समय और ज़रूरी सामग्री स्कूल से पूछें।

परीक्षा केंद्र में संचार उपकरण ले जाने की अनुमति नहीं है। CBSE के अलग से जारी निर्देशों और प्रवेश पत्र के अनुसार ही सामान ले जाएँ।

title: NEET UG 2026 State Quota Choice: How Rural Service Bonds Affect You
description: A state quota MBBS seat may carry a rural service bond or exit penalty. Learn what to inspect before accepting a NEET UG 2026 seat.
content:
A NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling choice can decide more than your MBBS college and fee. A state or college may attach a rural service obligation, a posting condition or a financial penalty to the seat. Read the current counselling notice, admission undertaking and bond document before you lock the choice or report for admission.

The National Testing Agency conducts NEET UG, but it does not set every state’s service-bond rule. The state counselling authority and the concerned medical college control the documents that matter for your seat. Check current exam notices on the official NEET website, and use the NEET UG exam guide for exam-related information.

Why NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling needs a bond check

A bond can affect where you work after internship, how long you serve, who assigns your posting and what happens if you refuse or leave. This matters most if you plan an early NEET PG attempt, may shift to another state or need predictable income after MBBS. The exact rule varies by state, college and admission year.

Clause to findQuestion to askPossible consequence
Service periodWhen does it start and how long is it?It may affect PG plans
Posting authorityWho decides the rural or district facility?You may not choose the location
Exit termsWhat penalty or recovery process applies?Leaving may create a financial or administrative problem
Document controlWho issues release or relieving papers?Wrong office, delayed resolution

What should you verify before accepting the seat?

For NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling, treat the bond as a seat condition, not a footnote. If the seat matrix is silent, that does not prove there is no obligation. Ask the named counselling authority or college for a written clarification.

  1. Download the current state counselling bulletin and seat information document.
  2. Search for “bond”, “service”, “rural”, “undertaking”, “penalty” and “relieving”.
  3. Compare those clauses with the college admission form and fee notice.
  4. Save the signed undertaking, receipt and the version of each notice you relied on.

Compare the bond beside tuition, hostel cost, distance and likely posting conditions. A lower-fee seat may not suit a family that cannot manage the stated penalty or a graduate whose PG plan depends on immediate release. Ask the responsible authority before payment, and keep the reply.

title: Regional Counseling Windows 2027 How to Navigate Central and State MBBS Engineering Admissions with Contingency Plans
description: A practical map for families to understand the 2027 admission windows for MBBS and engineering in central and state streams, with contingency strategies, timelines, and decision checklists for Indian students and parents.
content:
What to know at a glance

Admission timelines in India hinge on central and state counseling processes. For MBBS and engineering aspirants, regional counseling windows in 2027 determine seat allocation, eligibility, and option sequencing. Prepare a robust contingency plan that covers overlapping counseling rounds, seat transfer possibilities, and backup choices if preferred institutes are unavailable.

Why regional windows matter in 2027

Central and state authorities typically coordinate multiple rounds of counseling. Individual states may run their own engineering seat allotment while MBBS admissions often follow a national or state quota system with specific reservation categories. The 2027 cycle is likely to include several stages: initial online registration, choice filling, mock allotments, and subsequent rounds. Understanding which window you qualify for reduces sudden deadlines and increases your ability to compare options across disciplines and locations.

Key decision points for MBBS and engineering applicants

  • Eligible programs and quota types: all India, state, management, and NRI seats for MBBS; state engineering quota and central seat allocations for engineering.
  • Ranking and choice strategy: prioritize programs with consistently high seat turnover and clear documentation of counseling outcomes.
  • Eligibility checks: verify required documents, NEET or JEE Main/Advanced eligibility, and minimum marks before each window.
  • Seat transfer and migration rules: understand transfer windows, compulsory service clauses, and post-allocation options.

Creating a practical contingency plan

Families should prepare for several plausible scenarios. A well-structured plan minimizes last-minute stress and preserves options across central and state systems.

  • Scenario planning: List top five programs across central and state avenues, plus backup choices in different states to diversify risk.
  • Document readiness: keep digital and physical copies of academic records, identity proofs, caste/benefit certificates, and category details ready for faster registration.
  • Deadline mapping: maintain a master calendar with registration, document verification, choice filling, and allotment announcement dates.
  • Financial planning: account for tuition, hostel, and living costs across states, along with potential scholarship and waiver opportunities.
  • Counseling alternatives: identify alternative streams like BTech in allied fields or MBBS in lesser-known institutions where outcomes remain favorable.

How to approach central and state processes

Central and state admissions typically share common steps but differ in documentation requirements and timelines. Begin with a comprehensive document checklist and a verified digital profile to speed up registrations. If you face a mismatch between expected and actual merit lists, use formal grievance channels within the stipulated window.

Step-by-step action plan

  1. Confirm eligibility for MBBS or engineering programs across all target windows.
  2. Register early where possible and complete necessary profile and document uploads.
  3. Prepare a prioritized list of institutes and course options, updating it after each allotment round if allowed.
  4. Monitor all round results and be ready to accept a seat or submit a grievance if required.
  5. If admitted to a less-preferred program, evaluate transfer or lateral entry opportunities subject to rules.

Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

  • Overlooking eligibility details: ensure you meet all subject, year, and practical requirements for each program before applying.
  • Mismanaging deadlines: keep a single, clear calendar and set reminders a week ahead of each critical date.
  • Not validating seat availability: cross-check institute websites and official notification portals for the latest vacancy information.
  • Ignoring backup options: always have a short list of acceptable alternatives to avoid last-minute compromises.

What parents should do now

Parental involvement should focus on organized planning, budget planning, and emotional support for students through the process. Begin by drawing up a household plan that aligns with educational goals, location preferences, and financial expectations. Encourage students to articulate their top choices and be open to discussing contingencies without pressuring a single outcome.

Verification and where to look for official guidance

Official websites and notifications remain the best sources for the latest eligibility rules, window dates, and seat allotment outcomes. If information changes after you have started registration, confirm details directly on the relevant authority portal before making any commitments.

Conclusion

The 2027 regional counseling windows for MBBS and engineering require careful planning, timely action, and flexible contingency strategies. A structured approach that combines early preparation, diversified options, and clear parent-student communication increases the chance of securing a seat that aligns with long-term goals. Stay informed about the official processes and deadlines, and ready a practical backup plan to navigate any unexpected changes.

FAQ

Which windows determine MBBS admissions in 2027 and how do they interact with engineering counseling?

MBBS admissions follow specific central or state counseling paths with predefined rounds. Engineering admissions may operate under a separate centralized system or state-based process. The interaction level varies by year and region, so verify the current year's guidance from the official portals before acting.

What should be included in a contingency plan for admission year 2027?

Develop a prioritized list of five institutes across central and state streams, document readiness with copies of essential records, map all deadlines, and identify backup options in case preferred programs are unavailable. Include financial planning and criteria for potential transfers or alternative courses.

How many rounds of counseling are typical, and what happens if I miss a round?

Most counseling cycles include multiple rounds with allotment results announced at each stage. Missing a round can limit options, but some authorities offer subsequent rounds or transfer opportunities. Always check official guidelines and register for new rounds within deadlines.

What constitutes a strong backup list for both MBBS and engineering?

Pick institutes with consistent admission activity, reachable locations, acceptable fee structures, and credible accreditation. Include programs in nearby states to diversify risk, and consider allied fields with similar entry requirements as a flexible alternative.

Where can I verify the latest counseling dates without confusion?

Consult the official notification portals of the central authority and the state education departments for MBBS and engineering. If dates or processes change after you begin, rely on the official portals for the most current information and communicate updates to your family promptly.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 5, 10 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 420, 847 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு Electronics and Hardware (420) தேர்வுத் தேதி 25 பிப்ரவரி 2027. English Language and Literature (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன. 12ஆம் வகுப்பு Electronics and Hardware (847) தேர்வுத் தேதி 4 மார்ச் 2027. English Core (301) தேர்வுத் தேதி 5 மார்ச் 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

செய்முறைத் தேர்வுக்கு வேறு தேதி இருக்கலாம்

இந்த வரி வாரியம் நடத்தும் தேர்வுக்குரியது. செய்முறை, செயல்திறன் மதிப்பீடு, திட்டப்பணி அல்லது அகமதிப்பீடு இருந்தால் அதன் தேதியையும் தேவையான பொருட்களையும் பள்ளியிடம் கேட்டுத் தெரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

title: ਸੀਬੀਐੱਸਈ ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਅਤੇ 12: ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ 7 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਤੱਕ ਕੀ ਕਰੀਏ?
description: ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਪਰਚੀ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਨਾਂ, ਜਨਮ ਮਿਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਮਿਲਾਓ। 2026-27 ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੋਧ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ 7 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਹੈ।
content:
ਸੀਬੀਐੱਸਈ ਦੀ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਸੂਚੀ (LOC) ਵਿੱਚ ਗ਼ਲਤੀ ਦਿਸੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੜਤਾਲ ਪਰਚੀ ਮੰਗੋ। ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਆਪ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਨਾਂ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲ ਸਕਦਾ। ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਅਤੇ 12 ਲਈ ਸਕੂਲਾਂ ਨੂੰ 2 ਤੋਂ 7 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਸੋਧ ਭੇਜਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹੈ।

ਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਮਿਤੀ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਮਿਲਾਈਏ

ਆਪਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਪਿਆਂ ਜਾਂ ਸਰਪ੍ਰਸਤ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਜੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਗੋਤ ਵੀ ਜਾਂਚੋ। ਜਨਮ ਮਿਤੀ ਦਾ ਦਿਨ, ਮਹੀਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲ ਵੱਖੋ-ਵੱਖ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਜੇ ਪਾਸਪੋਰਟ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਵੇਰਵਿਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਵੀ ਮੇਲ ਕਰੋ।

ਹਰ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਐਂਟਰੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਮੁੱਖ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਨਾ ਦੇਖੋ। ਜਿਹੜੇ ਵੀ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਲਏ ਹਨ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਚੀ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਕੋਈ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਦਰਜ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਸਕੂਲ ਨੂੰ ਸਹੀ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਦੱਸੋ। ਇਮਤਿਹਾਨ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਲਿਖਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਪੱਕੀ ਪਛਾਣ ਕਰੋ। ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਅਤੇ 12 ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਵੇਖੋ.

ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਸੋਧ ਭੇਜਣ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਲਵੋ

ਸਕੂਲ ਨੂੰ ਪਰਚੀ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਵੇਰਵਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਸਹੀ ਵੇਰਵਾ ਦੋਵੇਂ ਦੱਸੋ। ਬੋਰਡ ਨੇ 7 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਬੰਦ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਘੜੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੱਸੀ। ਅੱਧੀ ਰਾਤ ਤੱਕ ਉਡੀਕ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਮੌਕਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਆਸ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੇ ਕੰਮਕਾਜੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਕਰੋ।

title: FMGE అక్టోబర్ 2026: సాంకేతిక ప్రశ్న లోపాలపై నవంబర్ 2 వరకు అభ్యంతరం
description: FMGE ప్రశ్నలో సాంకేతిక లోపంపై వైద్య ఆధారాలతో నవంబర్ 2లోగా అభ్యంతరం తెలపవచ్చు. ప్రశ్న కష్టంగా ఉందన్న ఫిర్యాదు మాత్రమే అంగీకరించరు.
content:
31 అక్టోబర్ 2026న FMGE రాసి, ఏదైనా ప్రశ్నలో సాంకేతిక లోపం ఉందని భావిస్తే, NBEMS బులెటిన్ ప్రకారం 2 నవంబర్ 2026 వరకు అభ్యంతరం సమర్పించవచ్చు. మద్దతుగా వైద్య గ్రంథాలు లేదా పరిశోధన ఆధారాలు జతచేసి, అధికారిక Communication Web Portalలో మీ నమోదిత ఈమెయిల్ ఉపయోగించాలి. ప్రశ్న కష్టంగా ఉందన్న ఫిర్యాదు మాత్రమే ఈ నిబంధన కింద అంగీకరించరు.

రెండు రోజుల గడువు ఎవరికి వర్తిస్తుంది?

అక్టోబర్ 2026 అధికారిక సమాచార బులెటిన్లోని సెక్షన్ 10.2 ప్రకారం పరీక్షకు హాజరైన అభ్యర్థులకు మాత్రమే ఈ అవకాశం ఉంది. పరీక్ష ముగిసిన తర్వాత గరిష్ఠంగా రెండు క్యాలెండర్ రోజులలోపు అభ్యంతరం పంపాలి. నవంబర్ 2 తర్వాత చేసిన వాదనలు అంగీకరించరు. ఆధారాలతో కూడిన సాంకేతిక అభ్యంతరం ఉంటే ఫలితం వచ్చేవరకు వేచి ఉండవద్దు.

NBEMS, FMGE అక్టోబర్ 2026 సమాచార బులెటిన్, పేజీ 89. ఈ భాగంలో అభ్యంతరాల చివరి తేదీ 2 నవంబర్ 2026గా పేర్కొన్నారు. అక్టోబర్ 2026 అధికారిక సమాచార బులెటిన్

నిర్దిష్ట లోపాన్ని ఆధారాలతో వివరించండి

ఏ అంశంలో సాంకేతిక లోపం ఉంది, అది ప్రశ్నను ఎలా ప్రభావితం చేస్తుంది, మీ వాదనకు ఏ వైద్య ఆధారం మద్దతు ఇస్తుందో స్పష్టంగా రాయండి. ప్రశ్నపత్రం ఎలా అనిపించిందన్న సాధారణ వివరణ సాంకేతిక లోపాన్ని నిరూపించదు. పరీక్షకుడికి అసలు సమస్య అర్థమయ్యేలా సంక్షిప్తంగా వివరించండి.

  1. అధికారిక పరీక్ష వెబ్‌సైట్ నుంచి NBEMS Communication Web Portal తెరవండి.

  2. FMGE దరఖాస్తులో నమోదు చేసిన ఈమెయిల్ వాడి, పోర్టల్ అడిగే అభ్యర్థి వివరాలు ఇవ్వండి.

  3. సాంకేతిక అభ్యంతరాన్ని, దానికి మద్దతుగా వైద్య ఆధారాలను గడువులోగా సమర్పించండి.

  4. స్వీకరణ నిర్ధారణ లేదా రిఫరెన్స్ సంఖ్యను, సమర్పించిన పత్రాల ప్రతిని భద్రపరచండి.

ఈ నిబంధనలో చివరి తేదీ ఉంది కానీ ప్రత్యేకంగా ముగింపు సమయం లేదు. అర్ధరాత్రి వరకు సమయం ఉంటుందని అనుకోకండి. లాగిన్ లేదా పత్రాల అప్‌లోడ్ సమస్యలు పరిష్కరించుకునే అవకాశం ఉండేలా ముందుగానే సమర్పించండి.

జవాబు కీ విడుదల వేరే అంశం

సెక్షన్ 10.3 ప్రకారం అక్టోబర్ 2026 అభ్యర్థుల లాగిన్‌లో ప్రశ్నల IDలు, సరైన జవాబు కీ IDలు, ఎంచుకున్న సమాధానాల IDలు, ప్రతి ప్రశ్నకు ఇచ్చిన మార్కులు అందుబాటులో ఉంచుతారు. ఈ నిబంధన ఉండటమే జవాబు కీ ఇప్పటికే విడుదలైందనే నిర్ధారణ కాదు. విడుదల ప్రకటన, ప్రవేశ సూచనల కోసం అధికారిక FMGE పేజీ చూడండి.

ఫలితం తర్వాత పునఃపరిశీలనకు అవకాశం ఉందా?

ఫలితాలు 30 నవంబర్ 2026లోగా ప్రకటించే అవకాశం ఉందని బులెటిన్ చెబుతోంది. ఇది అంచనా గడువు మాత్రమే; ఫలితం విడుదలైనట్లు నిర్ధారణ కాదు. FMGEలో పునర్మూల్యాంకనం, మళ్లీ తనిఖీ, మార్కుల పునఃలెక్కింపు లేదా గ్రేస్ మార్కుల నిబంధన లేదు. ఫలితానికి ముందున్న సాంకేతిక ప్రశ్న అభ్యంతర ప్రక్రియతో వీటిని కలపవద్దు.

వేరుగా ఉండే అర్హత మార్కుల నిబంధన కోసం FMGE ఉత్తీర్ణత మార్కుల గైడ్ చదవండి. పరీక్ష కష్టతపై స్పందనలు లేదా గుర్తున్న ప్రశ్నల ఆధారంగా అధికారిక ఫలితం తేలదు.

title: ICSE, ISC Admit Card 2026 LIVE Updates @cisce.org: Direct Link & Steps to Download
description: ICSE and ISC Admit Card 2026 released by CISCE. Check live updates, how to download ICSE Class 10 and ISC Class 12 hall tickets, exam details, and instructions at cisce.org.
content:
The ICSE (Class 10) and ISC (Class 12) Admit Cards 2026 are now available on the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations' (CISCE) official website, cisce.org. Admit cards can now be downloaded online by schools and given to pupils taking the 2026 ICSE and ISC board exams.

In order to take the board exams, you must have the admit card. relevant information such the student's name, roll number, subjects, exam dates, exam location, and relevant instructions are all included. Students are required to verify that all information on their admit card is accurate. 

ICSE & ISC Admit Card 2026: Key Highlights

Particulars ICSE ISC
Conducting Body CISCE CISCE
Class 10 12
Admit Card Status Released Released
Mode of Exam Offline Offline
Official Website cisce.org cisce.org

How to Download ICSE, ISC Admit Card 2026

Students should note that the admit cards are downloaded through schools. Follow the steps below:

  1. Visit the official website cisce.org
  2. Login using school credentials
  3. Click on the ICSE/ISC Admit Card 2026 link
  4. Download the admit cards class-wise
  5. Print and distribute them to students

Details Mentioned on the Admit Card

  • Student’s name and roll number
  • Registration number
  • Subject-wise exam dates
  • Exam centre details
  • Exam-day instructions

Important Instructions for Students

  • Carry a printed admit card to the exam centre
  • Bring a valid school ID proof
  • Reach the exam centre well before reporting time
  • Follow all guidelines issued by CISCE

The release of the ICSE and ISC Admit Card 2026 marks the final stage before board exams. Students are advised to focus on revision and exam preparation and stay updated with official announcements.

title: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Sindhi Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Sindhi: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
Class 10 Sindhi (008) is on 27 February 2027; Class 12 Sindhi (108) is on 3 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Sindhi dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Sindhi00827 February 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours
Class 12: Sindhi1083 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Sindhi entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 5, 9 and look for codes 008, 108. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Sindhi (008) falls 1 calendar day after English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Sindhi (108) falls 2 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: AIAPGET 2026 Final Answer Key: How to View It and Check Your Scorecard
description: NTA’s AIAPGET 2026 final answer key is out. Use the key for official answers in your subject; your scorecard is a separate document for counselling.
content:
The AIAPGET 2026 final answer key is available on NTA's official candidate page. It is not the same as the earlier provisional key used for objections. If you need to check your own outcome, open the final key for your subject and download the separate 2026 scorecard; do not treat a hand-calculated estimate as your result.

How candidates can view the final key

NTA's 18 September 2026 final-key notice says candidates must log in to the registration portal with their credentials. The candidate home page then offers a “View & print Your Final Answer Key” button, which opens the key provided by NTA for the subject they took. Start from the official AIAPGET page so you can recognise the genuine candidate-activity links.

The final key is subject-specific. An Ayurveda candidate should not rely on a screenshot of a Homoeopathy key, and a forwarded answer image cannot establish what NTA has saved against your own application. Keep the official key and your scorecard as separate files.

Provisional key, final key and result are different

The three items can look similar in search results but answer different questions. This is the distinction to use before you share a score estimate or join counselling.

NTA item

What it was for

What to use now

Provisional key and recorded responses

Reviewing questions and raising objections in the announced challenge window

Keep any saved copy for your records; do not present it as the final key.

Final answer key

Showing NTA's final subject-specific answers after the review stage

Use the final-key link in your candidate login.

2026 scorecard

Showing your individual result for the admission process

Download it separately from NTA's Score Card link.

Source: the NTA final-key notice and the live AIAPGET candidate page, checked on 22 October 2026. The table explains the documents; it is not a copied answer sheet.

What if your estimate differs from the scorecard?

First check that you used the final key for the correct discipline, not the provisional version. Compare only the responses and question identifiers you saved from your own exam record; an option label shared by someone else may not correspond to your question. If there is still a discrepancy, use NTA's official helpdesk details on its AIAPGET page. Do not send an application number or password to a third-party blog or social account.

NTA's result notice reports that 49,864 candidates appeared out of 51,482 registered in 2026. Those aggregate figures do not change your personal score. Once your scorecard is in hand, the next decision is counselling: the AACCC AIAPGET round schedule explains the All India-quota process, while a state-quota applicant should follow their own authority's notice.
author: Geethika Reddy

title: KIITEE 2027 Applications: 10 November Opening Is Tentative
description: KIIT lists 10 November for the 2027 opening, with a tentative label in its Phase 1 calendar. Prepare your photograph, signature and Class 10 record.
content:
KIIT lists 10 November 2026 for the KIITEE 2027 application opening, but its official Phase 1 calendar labels the schedule tentative and subject to change. Prepare your documents now and confirm the current opening date on the university’s site before starting the form.

Use the KIITEE website for the announcement and the application route. A request for admission guidance is an enquiry; it does not submit the university application.

KIIT Deemed to be University, KIITEE 2027 Phase 1 calendar, undated. It lists 10 November and labels the schedule tentative. Read the original calendar.

Keep three documents ready

KIIT’s application-procedure page gives a preparation checklist: a clear photograph, a signature for upload, and the Class 10 certificate or marksheet requested by the portal. Gather the original records so you can enter the details consistently.

Preparation is separate from uploading. Use the file format and specifications displayed in the actual application form when it becomes available. A tick on an online checklist or submission of an enquiry does not complete registration.

Choose the programme before filling the form

Check the eligibility page and the current prospectus for your intended programme. KIIT’s procedure says programme-specific and international admission requirements can differ. Confirm the admission route and the edition that applies to you before entering academic details.

When the application opens, read its instructions, review the details before submission and keep a copy of the submitted form.

Check the phase and calendar before planning the test

The opening date does not give your test appointment. For the closing date, test phases and later milestones, use KIIT’s official calendar and the current application instructions. Check that the dates and document edition apply to 2027 and to your chosen phase.

The application procedure separates filling the form and uploading documents from appearing for KIITEE and following counselling or allotment. Completing the first stage does not establish a seat allotment.

For programme or application questions, KIIT’s site lists admissions support at 8080 735 735. Ask about the programme and applicable route before starting a form you are unsure about.

title: Indian Economy Class 12 Notes CBSE 2026 | Economics Commerce Important Topics
description: Indian Economy Class 12 notes for CBSE 2026 with high weightage topics, easy scoring chapters, revision tables, and exam tips to help students pass Economics easily.
content:
Introduction: What Is Indian Economy in Class 12 Economics?

The Indian Economy section in Class 12 Economics focuses on India’s development after independence, economic reforms, poverty, unemployment, infrastructure, and sustainable development.
These chapters are concept-based and scoring, especially for theory and case study questions.

Understanding Indian economy concepts helps students score well in CBSE board exams and competitive exams.

High Weightage & Easy-to-Score Chapters (CBSE 2026)

Chapter Weightage Level Difficulty Scoring Potential
Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence Medium Easy High
Indian Economy 1950–1990 High Moderate High
Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation (LPG) Very High Easy Very High
Poverty & Unemployment High Easy Very High
Infrastructure Medium Easy High
Sustainable Development Medium Easy High
 

LPG Reforms, Poverty, and Unemployment are HIGH WEIGHTAGE and EASY TO SCORE.

Key Topics in Indian Economy (Class 12)

1. Indian Economy on the Eve of Independence

  • Low income and productivity

  • Agriculture dominance

  • Poor industrial development

  • Foreign trade under colonial rule

2. Indian Economy 1950–1990

  • Planned economy

  • Five Year Plans

  • Public and private sector

  • Import substitution

3. Economic Reforms (LPG Reforms)

Liberalisation: Reduction of government control
Privatisation: Role of private sector
Globalisation: Integration with world economy

Most important chapter for CBSE boards.

4. Poverty and Unemployment

  • Types of poverty

  • Causes and measures

  • Types of unemployment (disguised, seasonal, educated)

5. Infrastructure

  • Energy

  • Transport

  • Communication

  • Health and education

6. Sustainable Development

  • Environmental protection

  • Renewable resources

  • Concept of sustainable growth

Quick Revision Table – Indian Economy Concepts

Concept Meaning
Liberalisation Removing government restrictions
Privatisation Increasing private sector role
Globalisation Economic integration with world
Poverty Line Minimum income for basic needs
Infrastructure Basic facilities for economy
 

How to Write Indian Economy Answers in Exam

✔ Write in points
✔ Use keywords like LPG, poverty line, planning
✔ Add examples
✔ Draw flowcharts if possible
✔ Keep answers simple and structured

CBSE prefers clarity over long answers.

Common Mistakes Students Make

  • Mixing microeconomics and Indian economy topics

  • Writing vague definitions

  • Ignoring keywords like LPG and poverty line

  • Not revising diagrams and case studies

Avoid these to score better.

Fast Revision Tips for Indian Economy

✔ Focus on LPG reforms and poverty chapter
✔ Revise key definitions daily
✔ Practice short and long answers
✔ Learn diagrams like circular flow of income
✔ Solve sample papers

These chapters are theory-based and easy scoring.

Conclusion

Indian Economy chapters in Class 12 Economics are high scoring and concept-based. Students should focus on LPG reforms, poverty, unemployment, and planning, as these are high-weightage and easy-to-score topics in CBSE 2026. Regular revision and clear answers can help students pass easily and score high marks in Economics.

title: Start Your Business After 12th Commerce
description: Discover practical business ideas and entrepreneurship opportunities for commerce students after 12th. Learn how to start and grow your own business at an early age.
content:
WHAT IS ENTERPRENEURSHIP ?

Entrepreneurship is the process of creating, developing, and managing a business venture to earn profits while solving problems or fulfilling market needs. An entrepreneur identifies opportunities, takes risks, and builds something valuable for society.

In simple words, entrepreneurship means starting something new — like a company, product, or service — that solves a problem or fulfills people’s needs. The person who takes this initiative is called an entrepreneur.

ARE THERE REAL LIFE EXAMPLES OF ENTREPRENEUSHIP ?

  • Ritesh Agarwal, who founded OYO Rooms, started as a young entrepreneur by identifying the need for affordable hotels in India.
  • Flipkart founders Sachin Bansal and Binny Bansal built an e-commerce platform to meet India’s growing demand for online shopping.
  • Kunal Bahl & Rohit Bansal (Snapdeal) Began with a small online coupon business which later grew into Snapdeal, one of India’s major e-commerce platforms. They took risks at a young age and built a successful venture.

WHY CHOOSE ENTREPRENEURSHIP AFTER 12TH ?

1. Early Start: Starting young gives you more time to learn from mistakes and grow.

2. No Limit on Growth: Unlike jobs, there is no fixed salary; your business has unlimited earning potential.

3. Creative Freedom: You can pursue your ideas without being bound by traditional career paths.

4. Job Creation: Entrepreneurs not only build wealth for themselves but also generate employment for others.

HOW TO START ENTREPRENEURSHIP ?

1. Identify Your Passion and Skills

Ask yourself: What do you enjoy doing? Are you good at finance, marketing, sales, or technology? Aligning your business idea with your skills increases your chances of success.

2. Find a Profitable Business Idea

Look for gaps in the market or problems that need solutions. Some ideas suitable for commerce students include:

  • Online retail or e-commerce store
  • Digital marketing agency
  • Accounting and bookkeeping services
  • Event management
  • Tutoring and coaching services
  • Social media management

3. Do Market Research

Before investing money, study your target audience, competitors, and industry trends. Market research will help you understand whether your business idea is practical and profitable.

4. Create a Business Plan

A business plan acts as a roadmap. It should include:

  • Business idea and goals
  • Target customers
  • Investment and funding needs
  • Marketing strategy
  • Growth plan

5. Arrange Capital

You may need funds to start your business. Possible sources include:

  • Personal savings
  • Family and friends
  • Bank loans or government schemes for young entrepreneurs
  • Angel investors or venture capitalists (for scalable startups)

6. Register Your Business

Legal registration adds credibility and protection. Depending on your business size, you can register as a sole proprietorship, partnership, LLP, or private limited company.

7. Build an Online Presence

In today’s digital world, every business needs visibility online. Create a website, set up social media pages, and use digital marketing strategies to attract customers.

8. Start Small and Scale Gradually

You don’t need to start big. Begin with small investments, learn from customer feedback, and grow step by step.

9. Stay Updated and Keep Learning

Business trends change quickly. Keep upgrading your skills through online courses, networking, and workshops.

WHAT ALL CHALLENGES YOU MAY FACE ?

Starting a business is exciting, but it also comes with difficulties. Some common challenges young entrepreneurs (especially after 12th Commerce) may face are:

  1. Lack of Experience
    • At a young age, you may not fully understand the business world, customer needs, or market strategies.
    • This can lead to mistakes, but also provides valuable learning.
  2. Limited Capital
    • Many new entrepreneurs struggle with arranging enough money to start and run their business.
    • Without proper funding, it may be difficult to buy resources, market the product, or expand.
  3. High Competition
    • The market often has established players who already have loyal customers.
    • Competing with them requires creativity, innovation, and strong marketing.
  4. Risk of Failure
    • Not every idea succeeds. There is always a chance of losing money or the business not growing as expected.
    • Handling failures with patience and persistence is important.

CONCLUSION

Starting a business after 12th Commerce is not only possible but also highly rewarding if you are determined and willing to work hard. With the right idea, planning, and execution, you can become an entrepreneur at a young age and build a successful career. Remember, entrepreneurship is a journey of learning, risk-taking, and innovation.

Choosing a career path after completing 12th Commerce can feel overwhelming. While many students go for higher studies like B.Com, BBA, or professional courses such as CA, CS, or CMA, there’s also an exciting and rewarding option — entrepreneurship. With the right mindset, skills, and planning, you can start your own business right after 12th Commerce.

title: Indian postgraduate options after BCom for students who want finance careers
description: BCom graduates can choose MCom, MBA, CMA, ACCA or work-first routes depending on whether they want accounting, banking, analytics or corporate finance roles.
content:
Answer first: For BCom graduates who want finance careers, the best postgraduate path depends on the job you want next. If you want accounting or teaching/research, MCom is the most direct academic route. If you want broader finance roles in banking, corporate finance, consulting or leadership, an MBA is usually the stronger placement-oriented option. If you want specialist accounting and compliance roles, CMA or ACCA can be better than another degree because they lead directly to finance job outcomes.

The right choice is not about the most famous course. It is about the role you want after graduation, how much time and money you can invest, and whether you need a degree, a professional qualification, or both.

Key facts for BCom graduates

  • BCom is a foundation degree for commerce, accounting, taxation and finance basics.
  • MCom usually deepens academic knowledge in accounting, finance, taxation, economics or banking.
  • MBA broadens career options and is often preferred for finance management, business analysis, credit, treasury and corporate roles.
  • CMA is useful for costing, management accounting, budgeting and performance control.
  • ACCA is widely used for accounting, audit, financial reporting and multinational finance roles.
  • Banking and analytics roles may value additional skills in Excel, SQL, financial modelling, data interpretation and communication as much as the degree itself.

Which postgraduate route fits which finance job

Path after BComBest forTypical role outcomesBest fit if you want...
MComAccounting, taxation, economics, academic trackAccountant, lecturer, tax assistant, finance support rolesA subject-focused, lower-cost postgraduate degree
MBA in FinanceCorporate finance, banking, investments, managementFinancial analyst, credit analyst, treasury, relationship manager, finance executivePlacement-linked business career growth
CMACosting, budgeting, management accountingCost accountant, FP&A support, budget analyst, management accountantCore internal finance and control roles
ACCAAccounting, audit, reporting, global financeAudit associate, financial reporting analyst, accounts executive, global finance supportInternational accounting recognition

How to choose based on your target finance role

1) Accounting and bookkeeping roles

If you want a career in accounts preparation, audit support, taxation assistance or financial reporting, MCom can help build depth in commerce subjects. ACCA can be a stronger choice if you want a more job-specific accounting qualification with wider recognition for reporting and audit-linked roles. For students who are serious about private-sector accounting careers, ACCA often adds more practical value than a second academic degree alone.

2) Banking and credit roles

For retail banking, credit appraisal, loan processing, branch operations or relationship roles, an MBA often has the better career signal because recruiters look for communication, business understanding and placement readiness. A BCom plus banking certifications, internships and strong Excel skills can also work. MCom is usually not the strongest route for banking if your goal is quick industry entry.

3) Analytics and financial modelling roles

If your interest is in financial analysis, business reporting, dashboarding or decision support, the most useful path is often a finance-focused MBA or a combination of BCom with analytics skills. These roles reward tool knowledge: Excel, Power BI, basic SQL and presentation skills. CMA can help if the work involves budgeting or planning, but the skill stack matters more than the label of the degree.

4) Corporate finance and FP&A roles

Corporate finance, treasury and financial planning and analysis, often called FP&A, usually favour MBA Finance, CMA, or a strong commerce background with practical internships. These roles need budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow understanding and business communication. ACCA can also help for reporting-heavy finance teams, especially in large companies and global service centres.

Decision guidance: degree or professional qualification

The biggest mistake BCom students make is choosing a course only because it sounds advanced. Use this simple rule:

  • Choose MCom if you want academic depth, a low-cost postgraduate degree, or plans for lectureship and research.
  • Choose MBA if you want broader job mobility, campus placements, and entry into management-track finance roles.
  • Choose CMA if you are drawn to internal costing, budgeting, management reporting and control systems.
  • Choose ACCA if you want accounting, audit and financial reporting roles with international orientation.
  • Consider working first if you are unsure, because 12 to 24 months of experience can clarify whether you prefer accounts, banking, analysis or planning.

Parents often ask which option is safest. The safer choice is the one that matches the student’s strengths. A student who dislikes presentations may struggle in an MBA, while a student who wants practical accounting may find MCom too academic. A course works best when the learning style matches the target job.

What to verify before applying

Before paying fees or locking a seat, check the following with the relevant college, university or professional body:

  • Eligibility rules for BCom graduates, including minimum marks and subject requirements
  • Entrance test requirement, interview process and selection criteria
  • Course duration, practical training, internships and placement support
  • Recognition of the qualification for your target job role
  • Total cost, exam attempts, coaching needs and likely return on time invested
  • Whether the program helps with audit, accounting software, finance tools or live industry exposure

If you are considering MBA, verify the admission test and college-level process from the institution you want. If you are considering CMA or ACCA, verify the current registration, exemption and exam structure directly with the professional body before planning your study timeline.

A practical route map for different students

  • High academic interest, low budget: BCom + MCom
  • Placement-first finance career: BCom + MBA Finance
  • Accounting and audit focus: BCom + ACCA
  • Costing and management accounting focus: BCom + CMA
  • Unsure about specialisation: BCom + 1 year work experience, then choose

For most students, the best decision is not the course with the biggest brand name. It is the one that creates a clearer bridge from BCom to the exact finance role they want in the next two to five years.

FAQs

Is MCom enough for a finance career after BCom?

MCom can be enough for accounting, taxation support, academic roles and some finance operations jobs. For corporate finance, banking or analyst roles, an MBA or professional qualification may give a stronger career advantage.

Which is better after BCom, MBA Finance or MCom?

For job-oriented finance careers, MBA Finance is usually better because it is more aligned with placements and management roles. For subject depth and lower fees, MCom is better. The right option depends on whether you want academic progression or industry mobility.

Is CMA useful after BCom?

Yes. CMA is useful for costing, budgeting, management accounting and internal finance roles. It is especially relevant if you want work in planning, analysis, cost control or performance reporting.

Does ACCA help Indian BCom students?

Yes. ACCA can help BCom students who want accounting, audit and financial reporting roles. It is a strong option for students aiming at global or multinational finance environments.

Can I get a banking job after BCom without an MBA?

Yes. Banking jobs are possible after BCom through direct hiring, exams, internships and skill-based profiles. However, an MBA can improve access to better finance and relationship-management roles.

What should I choose if I am confused between accounting and finance?

If you enjoy ledgers, reporting and compliance, choose accounting-oriented routes such as MCom, ACCA or CMA. If you enjoy analysis, business decisions and broader financial planning, an MBA in Finance is usually the better fit.

title: GATE 2027 അപേക്ഷയിലെ പിഴവ്: ഒക്ടോബർ 31നകം തിരുത്തലും ഫീസുള്ള മാറ്റങ്ങളും
description: GOAPS അപേക്ഷയുടെ നില മനസ്സിലാക്കാം. അറിയിച്ച പിഴവ് ഒക്ടോബർ 31നകം അധിക ഫീസില്ലാതെ തിരുത്താം; ഫീസുള്ള വിവരതിരുത്തലിന്റെ തീയതി പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.
content:
GATE 2027 അപേക്ഷ പരിശോധിച്ചപ്പോൾ പിഴവ് അറിയിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ 31 ഒക്ടോബർ 2026നകം തിരുത്തുക. പ്രത്യേകം തുറക്കാനിരിക്കുന്ന ഫീസോടെയുള്ള വിവരതിരുത്തൽ അവസരത്തിനായി കാത്തിരിക്കരുത്. അതിന്റെ തീയതി IIT മദ്രാസ് ഇതുവരെ പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചിട്ടില്ല.

ആദ്യം GOAPSയിലെ അപേക്ഷാ നില വായിക്കുക

ഔദ്യോഗിക GATE 2027 അറിയിപ്പ്

  • Under scrutiny എന്നത് ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട മേഖല അപേക്ഷ പരിശോധിക്കുന്നു എന്നാണ്. ഇമെയിലും GOAPS അക്കൗണ്ടും ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക. ഈ നില മാത്രം അപേക്ഷ നിരസിച്ചു എന്നർത്ഥമല്ല.
  • Defective എന്നാണെങ്കിൽ ഇമെയിലിൽ പറഞ്ഞ പിഴവ് വായിച്ച് GOAPS വഴി നിർദേശിച്ച തിരുത്തൽ നടത്തുക.
  • In order and accepted എന്നത് പരിശോധന കഴിഞ്ഞ് അപേക്ഷ സ്വീകരിച്ചു എന്നാണ്. സ്ഥിരീകരണ രേഖ സൂക്ഷിച്ച് തുടർന്നുള്ള ഔദ്യോഗിക അറിയിപ്പുകൾ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക.

തിരുത്തൽ സമർപ്പിച്ച് തെളിവ് സൂക്ഷിക്കുക

പരിശോധനയിൽ കണ്ടെത്തിയ പിഴവുകൾ 14 മുതൽ 31 ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 വരെ അധിക ഫീസില്ലാതെ തിരുത്താമെന്നാണ് ഔദ്യോഗിക അറിയിപ്പ്. GOAPS സന്ദേശം മുഴുവൻ വായിച്ച് ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ട രേഖയോ മാറ്റമോ തയ്യാറാക്കി സമർപ്പിക്കുക.

ഔദ്യോഗിക GOAPS ലോഗിൻ

സമർപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം സ്ഥിരീകരണ രേഖയോ അയച്ച വിവരങ്ങളുടെ സ്ക്രീൻഷോട്ടോ സൂക്ഷിക്കുക. അക്കൗണ്ടിലെ നില വീണ്ടും പരിശോധിക്കുക. പുതിയ ഫയൽ തിരഞ്ഞെടുത്തത് മാത്രം സമർപ്പണം പൂർത്തിയായതിനോ അപേക്ഷ സ്വീകരിച്ചതിനോ തെളിവല്ല.

ഉപയോഗിച്ച DigiLocker അക്കൗണ്ട് നീക്കം ചെയ്യരുത്

അപേക്ഷയ്ക്കുപയോഗിച്ച സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചതോ സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കാത്തതോ ആയ DigiLocker അക്കൗണ്ട് നിലനിർത്തുക. സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കാത്ത അക്കൗണ്ടിന് ഔദ്യോഗിക നിർദേശമനുസരിച്ച് DigiLocker Drive പ്രവേശനസമ്മതവും ഫോട്ടോ തിരിച്ചറിയൽ രേഖയും നൽകുക.

സന്ദേശം വ്യക്തമല്ലെങ്കിൽ GATE വെബ്‌സൈറ്റിലെ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട മേഖലയുടെ സമ്പർക്കവഴി ഉപയോഗിക്കുക. അപേക്ഷാ റഫറൻസും കൃത്യമായ പിഴവും അറിയിക്കാം; പാസ്‌വേഡോ OTPയോ പങ്കിടരുത്.

സ്വന്തം ആവശ്യപ്രകാരം അപേക്ഷയിലെ വിവരം മാറ്റുന്നത് പരിശോധനയിൽ അറിയിച്ച പിഴവിന് തുല്യമല്ല. ഫീസുള്ള തിരുത്തലിന്റെ തീയതിയും അനുവദിച്ച മാറ്റങ്ങളും പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നതുവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കുക. പിഴവ് പരിഹരിക്കാനുള്ള അവസാന തീയതി അതിനുള്ള തീയതിയാണെന്ന് കരുതരുത്.

title: NEET UG 2026 Stray Vacancy Round: When Waiting Becomes Risky
description: Should you wait for NEET UG 2026 stray vacancy counselling? Compare seat security, route-specific rules, fees and reporting risk before deciding.
content:
NEET UG 2026 stray vacancy counselling is a different gamble for two groups. If you have no confirmed MBBS seat, waiting may leave you without a college. If you already hold a seat, waiting may put that admission, its fees or your eligibility at risk if you resign or miss a notified condition.

No 2026 counselling notice is supplied here, so don’t treat any MCC or state process as confirmed. The Medical Counselling Committee may handle some seats, while a state counselling authority may conduct another stray vacancy process. Identify the authority for your seat and course before acting.

Do you have a confirmed MBBS seat?

Keep the seat only after checking the applicable rules for resignation, forfeiture, participation and joining. “Protect your seat” isn’t a universal instruction: one counselling route may permit a particular action, while another may restrict it. Don’t resign because a college, agent or coaching group says a vacancy is likely.

If you have no seat, waiting can preserve a chance at a preferred college, but it can also close other options as their reporting windows pass. Keep eligible state, private or other counselling choices active where the notified rules permit.

Which authority and conditions apply?

Start with the 2026 notice issued by the responsible authority, not a forwarded message. Check whether you must register again, whether earlier participation affects eligibility, and whether the seat is open to your category and counselling route. A vacant seat isn’t automatically available to every NEET UG candidate.

  • Confirm the authority: MCC or the relevant state counselling body.
  • Check merit, category, registration and seat-specific conditions.
  • Prepare NEET records, identity proof, photographs and original certificates.
  • Keep route-specific documents, such as domicile proof, only where that authority requires them.
  • Read the college’s written instructions for online and physical reporting.

What could the decision cost?

Make this worksheet before you wait or accept an allotment:

  1. Amount already paid for your present seat, including deposits.
  2. Possible forfeiture or withdrawal loss under the applicable rules.
  3. First-year tuition, hostel, security deposit and examination charges.
  4. Travel, document and living costs needed before reporting.
  5. Payment due by the allotment or joining deadline.

Then compare the likely academic and financial gain with the risk of having no confirmed seat. A small preference upgrade rarely justifies an admission loss you cannot absorb. Check the live 2026 notice and written college instructions before payment, resignation or travel.

Before you lock the next step, compare entrance exams against the options you have shortlisted.

title: CBSE 12th Result 2026 Declared Live: Check Direct Link, Pass Percentage, DigiLocker & UMANG Marksheet

content:

title: BSc Biotechnology After Class 12: Check Lab Work Before Choosing the Course
description: Planning BSc Biotechnology after Class 12? Check eligibility, lab training, biology and chemistry subjects, internships and postgraduate routes before paying fees.
content:
BSc Biotechnology after Class 12 can lead to laboratory support, quality testing, clinical assistance and further study. But the degree title alone won’t give you practical skills. Before choosing a college, inspect its laboratories, semester-wise syllabus, practical timetable and internship record. A polished brochure proves very little.

Start by comparing biotechnology colleges and ask one direct question: how often will students perform experiments instead of watching demonstrations?

What eligibility should you check after Class 12?

Many colleges ask for Biology, Chemistry and sometimes Physics in Class 12. Others may accept different science combinations under their own rules. Minimum marks, entrance tests and admission routes also vary. Passing Class 12 doesn’t automatically make you eligible everywhere.

Read the current eligibility notice issued by the college or university. Check these four points before applying:

  • Required Class 12 subjects
  • Minimum marks and category conditions
  • Any entrance test or counselling process
  • Whether admission is merit-based or handled through a university portal

If Biology or Chemistry isn’t in your subject combination, get written confirmation from the admitting institution before paying an application or seat fee.

How do you judge the laboratory before admission?

Ask for a lab visit or a live demonstration. Look for working equipment, safety practices and regular student access, not costly machines kept behind glass.

  • Check practical exposure in microbiology, biochemistry, genetics, cell biology and molecular biology.
  • Ask how many students share one workstation and whether they handle samples themselves.
  • Confirm procedures for sterilisation, chemical handling and laboratory waste.
  • Ask for the practical schedule, project rules and names of departments supporting internships.

This matters because weak lab exposure can leave you underprepared for a research project or entry-level testing role, even if classroom marks are good.

Which subjects and postgraduate routes matter?

Read the full syllabus, not just the course overview. Biology-heavy papers may suit students interested in genetics and cell science, while chemistry and biochemistry support laboratory analysis. Look for statistics, bioinformatics, instrumentation and a final project too. These subjects can affect your postgraduate choices.

For many students, BSc Biotechnology is a starting degree. An MSc in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry or a related subject may be needed for research-focused work. Compare related science courses by practical hours, project rules and higher-study options.

What should you verify before paying?

  1. Download the current syllabus and eligibility notice.
  2. Visit the teaching lab and ask about weekly practical hours.
  3. Check whether internships are arranged or only advertised.
  4. Compare total fees with the training the college can show you.

Choose evidence over salary claims. A college that can explain its lab access, curriculum and next-study route deserves a closer look.

title: NEET UG 2026: What Happens If You Miss Medical College Reporting
description: Missed NEET UG 2026 medical college reporting? Understand seat cancellation, fee exposure and the counselling routes that may still remain.
content:
Missing NEET UG 2026 medical college reporting can put your allotted seat at risk, and the amount you paid may not be treated the same way as your seat. The result depends on whether joining was recorded, which authority allotted the seat, and whether the deadline had already passed. Act immediately. Waiting for a college call can close the only available route.

Can your medical seat be cancelled?

Yes, it can. A missed reporting deadline may be treated as non-joining, allowing the counselling authority to cancel the allotment or move the seat in a later round. There is no universal one-day grace rule.

Your positionLikely consequenceWhat to do now
Admission and joining were recordedThe seat may remain protected, but only the recorded status matters.Keep the signed acknowledgement, portal status and fee receipt.
You reached the college but documents, verification or payment stayed incompleteThe allotment may remain pending or be rejected after the deadline.Ask for the missing requirement and status in writing.
You did not report at allThe seat may be cancelled as non-joining for that round.Request the authority's position without assuming late admission is possible.

What happens to the fees and deposit?

Do not club every payment together. Counselling registration charges, security deposits, tuition and college charges can follow different refund or forfeiture rules. Missing reporting may expose a security deposit to forfeiture, while a college fee may have a separate treatment. The applicable notice and the college's written fee rule decide the outcome.

  • Save the allotment letter, receipts, payment references, portal screenshots and emails.
  • Ask for a written breakup of refundable and non-refundable amounts.
  • Do not pay again until you know whether the first allotment is active or cancelled.

Can you join another counselling round?

Possibly, but later counselling is not an automatic safety net. MCC rules apply to All India Quota and applicable central institution seats, while a state authority controls its own quota process. A later round may require fresh registration, new choice filling or another deposit. It may also block participation after non-joining or resignation. A new seat is never assured.

Check the current notice and your recorded status with the responsible authority and college. For NTA notices, use the official NEET UG website; it does not decide every MCC or state reporting outcome. For broader planning, see the NEET UG exam guide. Ask for every decision in writing.

title: CBSE 10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮದ ಪರಿಚಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 2027: ದಿನಾಂಕ, ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ
description: 10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮದ ಪರಿಚಯ (ಕೋಡ್ 406) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 23 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.
content:
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮದ ಪರಿಚಯ (ಕೋಡ್ 406) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯು 23 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು 10:30ರಿಂದ 12:30ರವರೆಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಿದೆ.

2026ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 6ರಂದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ CBSE ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿವರಗಳಿವೆ. ಇದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ದಾಖಲೆ; ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. CBSE ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮದ ಪರಿಚಯ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಎಷ್ಟು ಸಮಯವಿದೆ?

ತರಗತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಕೋಡ್ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕಸಮಯ (IST)ಅವಧಿ
10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ: Introduction to Tourism40623 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 202710:30 - 12:302 ಗಂಟೆ

ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ ಪ್ರೌಢ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿ, 6 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026, ಪುಟ 5: ವಿಷಯದ ಕೋಡ್, ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಯ. ಮೂಲ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ಪುಟ ನೋಡಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ

ಪುಟ 5ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ತರಗತಿಯ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ನೋಡಿ, ನಂತರ 406 ಕೋಡ್ ಹುಡುಕಿ. ಒಂದೇ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಯದ ಕೋಶ ಹಲವು ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬಹುದು. ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿಸಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಾಲನ್ನೂ ಓದಿ.

ಶಾಲೆಯ ನೋಂದಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಠ್ಯವಿಷಯದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ತರಗತಿಗೂ ಅದೇ ಹೆಸರಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯ ಸಾಲನ್ನಷ್ಟೇ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ

10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪ್ರವಾಸೋದ್ಯಮದ ಪರಿಚಯ (406) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 23 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು; ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಭಾಷೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಹಿತ್ಯ (184) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 26 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 3 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ.

ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನವೂ ಓದಲು ರಜೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದರ್ಥವಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉಳಿದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ನಡುವೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಣಿಸಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಈ ಸಾಲು ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ನಿಗದಿತ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದೆ. ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ, ಪ್ರದರ್ಶನ, ಪ್ರಾಜೆಕ್ಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಅದರ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಮತ್ತು ತರಬೇಕಾದ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಚಾರಿಸಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರದೊಳಗೆ ಸಂವಹನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಒಯ್ಯಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ CBSE ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

ಪೂರ್ಣ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ · ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಅವಧಿ ವಿವರ

title: Culinary Arts: Courses, Careers, and Opportunities in the Culinary World
description: Explore Culinary Arts courses, career opportunities, and skills needed to succeed in the culinary world. Learn about top programs, job roles and future prospects.
content:
Introduction

Culinary Arts is more than just cooking—it is the art, science, and creativity of preparing and presenting food. Over the years, the culinary field has evolved into a professional discipline, blending traditional cooking techniques with modern gastronomy, nutrition, and global cuisines. Today, Culinary Arts is a highly sought-after career path, offering opportunities in hotels, restaurants, catering, food styling, and even entrepreneurship.

What is Culinary Arts?

Culinary Arts refers to the study and practice of food preparation, cooking, presentation, and service. It covers a wide spectrum, from baking and pastry arts to international cuisines, nutrition, and hospitality management. Students not only learn practical cooking techniques but also gain knowledge of kitchen management, food safety, and culinary innovation.

Popular Culinary Arts Courses

Several institutions worldwide offer diploma, undergraduate, and postgraduate programs in Culinary Arts. Common course options include:

  • Diploma in Culinary Arts – Short-term professional training programs focusing on core culinary skills.

  • Bachelor’s in Culinary Arts – A 3- or 4-year program covering food preparation, restaurant management, and hospitality.

  • Specialized Certifications – Courses in pastry arts, baking, international cuisines, food styling, and molecular gastronomy.

  • Master’s in Culinary Arts / Hospitality Management – Advanced programs for leadership roles in the food and beverage industry.

Skills Required in Culinary Arts

A career in Culinary Arts requires a blend of technical and creative skills:

  • Strong cooking and food preparation skills

  • Creativity in presentation and recipe development

  • Time management and multitasking

  • Knowledge of nutrition and food science

  • Leadership and teamwork for managing kitchens and staff

Career Opportunities in Culinary Arts

Graduates in Culinary Arts have diverse career options across industries:

  • Chef (Executive Chef, Sous Chef, Pastry Chef, etc.)

  • Food and Beverage Manager

  • Catering Entrepreneur

  • Food Stylist & Photographer

  • Nutritionist or Culinary Educator

  • Restaurant Consultant

The hospitality and tourism industries continue to expand globally, opening vast opportunities for skilled culinary professionals.

Future Prospects

The demand for skilled chefs and culinary experts is expected to grow, especially with the rise of food tourism, international cuisines, and health-conscious dining. Additionally, emerging trends like sustainable cooking, plant-based cuisine, and food technology are reshaping the industry, making it an exciting field for aspiring professionals.

Conclusion

Culinary Arts is an exciting career choice for those passionate about food, creativity, and hospitality. With specialized courses and growing opportunities worldwide, students can pursue rewarding careers that combine passion with profession.

title: DU UG Admissions 2026: CSAS Seat Allotment List on July 16 - What 1.9 Lakh Students Must Do Next
description: Delhi University releases its first CSAS UG seat allotment list on July 16, 2026 for over 1.9 lakh registered students competing for 71,624 seats. Here is what happens next, document checks, fee deadlines and what to keep ready.
content:
Delhi University is set to release its first undergraduate seat allotment list for the 2026-27 academic session on July 16, through the Common Seat Allocation System (CSAS) portal. With well over 1.9 lakh students registered for admission and only 71,624 seats available across DU's 69 affiliated colleges, this is one of the tightest and most closely watched admission cycles of the year.

If you are among the applicants, the next few days matter more than any other stage of the process. A missed document upload, a late fee payment or an ignored notification can cost you a seat you have worked years for. Here is a practical, step-by-step look at what led up to July 16 and what you need to do once the list is out.

Why This Year's Competition Is So Intense

DU runs its undergraduate admissions almost entirely through CUET UG scores now, and the CSAS portal handles registration, preference filling and allotment centrally instead of college-wise applications. This has made applying to DU simpler on paper, but it has also pushed registration numbers up sharply because students no longer need to apply separately to each college.

With more than 1.9 lakh candidates in the pool and roughly 71,624 seats on offer, the effective seat-to-applicant ratio works out to less than one seat for every two and a half aspirants across all programmes combined. For high-demand courses like B.Com (Hons), Economics, Computer Science and Political Science at marquee colleges, the real competition per seat is far steeper than this average suggests.

What Already Happened Before July 16

Before the first allotment, DU's CSAS process typically runs through a few structured stages:

  • Registration and CUET UG score linking on the CSAS 2026 portal
  • Programme and college preference filling by applicants, in order of priority
  • Release of a simulated rank list, giving students an estimate of where they stand for their chosen combinations
  • A short preference-locking or preference-change window, where students could reorder or edit their college-course choices based on the simulated rank

Once this preference-locking window closed, DU's admission committee proceeds to run the actual allotment algorithm, matching CUET scores, category, reservation status and preference order against actual seat matrices for each college and programme. The output of this process is the first seat allotment list expected on July 16.

What Happens Right After the List Is Out

Getting an allotment is not the same as securing a seat. Once the list is published on the CSAS portal, allotted students generally need to complete several steps within a fixed window, which DU announces along with the list itself:

1. Check Your Allotment Status

Log in to the CSAS portal using your registered credentials and check the programme and college you have been allotted. Students are usually allotted based on their preference order, so it is worth checking whether you got your first choice, or a lower-ranked preference from your list.

2. Accept or Freeze Your Seat

Most CSAS cycles require students to explicitly accept the allotted seat online. Depending on the round, there may be an option to freeze the seat (accepting it and exiting further rounds) or float it (accepting for now while remaining open to a better preference in later rounds). Read the instructions carefully before choosing, since this decision can affect your eligibility for upgrade in subsequent allotment rounds.

3. Upload and Verify Documents

Colleges will need to verify your original documents, either online through the portal or in a designated physical or hybrid verification process. Commonly required documents include:

  • Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets and pass certificates
  • CUET UG 2026 scorecard
  • Category certificate, if applicable (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS)
  • PwBD certificate, if applicable
  • Domicile or state eligibility documents, if required by the specific college or reservation category
  • Passport-size photographs and a valid photo ID
  • Migration certificate, where applicable

Since exact document requirements can vary slightly by category and college, always cross-check the official checklist published on the CSAS portal or your allotted college's website before verification day.

4. Pay the Admission Fee Before the Deadline

Seat confirmation is usually tied to an admission fee payment within a strict deadline. Missing this window can lead to automatic cancellation of the allotted seat, even if all documents were verified correctly. Because fee amounts differ by college and programme, students should confirm the exact figure and last date directly from the CSAS portal rather than relying on unofficial estimates.

What to Keep Ready Before Allotment Day

To avoid last-minute stress, it helps to have everything sorted in advance:

  • Scanned copies of all mark sheets, certificates and ID proofs in the specified format and size
  • Login credentials for the CSAS portal, saved securely
  • A backup payment method for the admission fee, since payment gateways can get slow during peak hours
  • Access to a stable internet connection on allotment day, since portals often see heavy traffic right after a list is released
  • A shortlist of your next-best preferences, in case you plan to float your seat for an upgrade

If You Don't Get Your Preferred College

DU's CSAS process typically runs multiple allotment rounds, not just one. Students who do not get their preferred college or course in the first list are usually not out of the race. Depending on vacancy positions after each round, subsequent allotment lists can open up better options, especially in less-competitive combinations or newer colleges. It is advisable to keep monitoring the CSAS portal and official DU admission notices rather than assuming the first list is final.

A Word on Verifying Information

Given how fast admission timelines move and how often minor details change between rounds, students and parents should treat the CSAS portal and official DU admission bulletins as the only reliable source for dates, fee amounts, and document requirements. Screenshots or messages circulating on social media or forwarded through student groups should always be cross-checked before acting on them.

FAQs on DU UG Seat Allotment 2026

When will the DU UG first seat allotment list 2026 be released?

The first allotment list is expected on July 16, 2026, on the CSAS portal. Students should confirm the exact release time through official DU notifications.

How many seats are available in this cycle?

Around 71,624 undergraduate seats are up for allotment across DU's 69 affiliated colleges this year.

What should I do immediately after checking my allotment?

Accept or freeze the seat as instructed, complete document verification, and pay the admission fee before the deadline mentioned on the portal.

What happens if I miss the fee payment deadline?

Missing the fee deadline can lead to automatic forfeiture of the allotted seat, so it is important to track deadlines directly from the CSAS portal.

Can I get a better college in a later round if I am not satisfied with the first allotment?

Yes, DU generally conducts multiple allotment rounds, and students can often improve their allotment in subsequent rounds depending on vacancy movement.

content:
പശ്ചിമ ബംഗാൾ NEET PG അപേക്ഷകർ കോളേജും വിഷയവും തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുംമുമ്പ് പരിശോധന പൂർത്തിയായ അപേക്ഷകരുടെ പട്ടികയിൽ സ്വന്തം രേഖ ഉറപ്പാക്കണം. താൽക്കാലിക സമയക്രമത്തിലെ അടുത്ത ഘട്ടങ്ങൾ

2026 ഒക്ടോബർ 14-ലെ ഔദ്യോഗിക സമയക്രമത്തിൽ ഈ തീയതികളുണ്ട്. ഇത് താൽക്കാലികമാണ്; പിന്നീട് WBMCC മാറ്റം അറിയിച്ചാൽ ഏറ്റവും പുതിയ നിർദേശങ്ങൾ പിന്തുടരുക.

ഘട്ടം

നിശ്ചയിച്ച സമയം

പരിശോധന പൂർത്തിയായവരുടെ പട്ടികയും റൗണ്ട് 1 സീറ്റ് വിവരവും

ഒക്ടോബർ 30, ഉച്ചയ്ക്ക് രണ്ടിനു ശേഷം

ഓപ്ഷൻ നൽകലും ലോക്കിങ്ങും

ഒക്ടോബർ 30 വൈകിട്ട് നാലുമുതൽ നവംബർ 1 അർധരാത്രിവരെ

റൗണ്ട് 1 അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് ഫലം

നവംബർ 4, വൈകിട്ട് നാലിനു ശേഷം

റിപ്പോർട്ടിങ്ങും പ്രവേശനവും

നവംബർ 5, 6, 7, 10 തീയതികളിൽ രാവിലെ 10 മുതൽ വൈകിട്ട് 4 വരെ

പശ്ചിമ ബംഗാൾ മെഡിക്കൽ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ ഡയറക്ടറേറ്റിന്റെ 2026 ഒക്ടോബർ 14-ലെ താൽക്കാലിക റൗണ്ട് 1 സമയക്രമം. റിപ്പോർട്ടിങ് പട്ടികപ്പെടുത്തിയ ദിവസങ്ങളിൽ മാത്രമാണ്. അസൽ ഔദ്യോഗിക സമയക്രമം വായിക്കൂ (PDF).

പരിശോധന പൂർത്തിയായെന്ന് ഉറപ്പാക്കുക

WBMCC PG മെഡിക്കൽ കൗൺസലിങ് പേജിൽ ശരിയായ വർഷത്തിന്റെയും റൗണ്ടിന്റെയും പട്ടിക തുറക്കുക. അപേക്ഷാ വിവരങ്ങൾ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് സ്വന്തം രേഖ കണ്ടെത്തി തിരിച്ചറിയൽ, യോഗ്യതാ വിവരങ്ങൾ ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. പേര് ഇല്ലെങ്കിലോ വിവരം വ്യത്യസ്തമാണെങ്കിലോ നിലവിലെ ഔദ്യോഗിക നിർദേശവും ബന്ധപ്പെടാനുള്ള മാർഗവും ഉപയോഗിക്കുക. പ്രശ്നം അറിയിക്കാൻ അപേക്ഷ, പണമടച്ച രസീത്, പരിശോധനയുടെ രേഖ എന്നിവ തയ്യാറാക്കിവയ്ക്കുക.

ഈ സമയക്രമത്തിൽ രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ ഒക്ടോബർ 28 വൈകിട്ട് ആറുവരെയും ഫീസ് അടയ്ക്കൽ അന്ന് അർധരാത്രിവരെയുമായിരുന്നു. ഓപ്ഷൻ നൽകൽ ആരംഭിക്കുന്നത് പുതിയ രജിസ്ട്രേഷൻ വീണ്ടും തുറക്കുന്നതായി കരുതരുത്. സംസ്ഥാന ക്വോട്ട, സ്വകാര്യ മാനേജ്മെന്റ് ക്വോട്ട, NRI സീറ്റുകളുടെ യോഗ്യതയും സീറ്റ് വിവരങ്ങളും പ്രത്യേകം നോക്കുക.

സ്വീകരിക്കാവുന്ന ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ മാത്രം നൽകുക

ലഭ്യമായ സീറ്റുകൾക്കൊപ്പം കോളേജ്, വിഷയം, ഫീസ്, ബോണ്ട് വ്യവസ്ഥകൾ വായിക്കുക. മുൻഗണനാക്രമത്തിൽ ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ നൽകി സമയത്തിനുള്ളിൽ ലോക്ക് ചെയ്യുക. സമർപ്പിച്ച പട്ടികയുടെ തെളിവ് സൂക്ഷിക്കുക. റാങ്കോ ഇഷ്ടമുള്ള കോളേജിന്റെ ഓപ്ഷനോ മാത്രം അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നില്ല.

റിപ്പോർട്ടിങ്ങിന് നാലുദിവസം, തുടർച്ചയായ ആറുദിവസമല്ല

നവംബർ 5 മുതൽ 10 വരെ എല്ലാ ദിവസവും റിപ്പോർട്ട് ചെയ്യാമെന്ന് കരുതി യാത്ര ആസൂത്രണം ചെയ്യരുത്. സമയക്രമത്തിൽ നവംബർ 5, 6, 7, 10 തീയതികളിൽ രാവിലെ 10 മുതൽ വൈകിട്ട് 4 വരെയാണ് പറഞ്ഞിരിക്കുന്നത്. അലോട്ട്മെന്റിനുശേഷം ശരിയായ റിപ്പോർട്ടിങ് സ്ഥലം, അസൽ രേഖകൾ, ഫീസ്, ബോണ്ട് പരിശോധിക്കുക. സ്വകാര്യ കോളേജുകളുടെ ചില നടപടികൾ നിർദേശിച്ച സർക്കാർ സ്ഥാപനത്തിലായിരിക്കാം; കോളേജിന്റെ പേര് മാത്രം നോക്കി പോകേണ്ട സ്ഥലം തീരുമാനിക്കരുത്. ആവശ്യമായ നേരിട്ടുള്ള രേഖാപരിശോധനയ്ക്കുശേഷമാണ് പ്രവേശനം പൂർത്തിയാകുന്നത്.

title: IIFT MBA 2027-29: CAT ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಅರ್ಜಿ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 25ರೊಳಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ
description: IIFT CAT 2026 ಅಂಕ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ MBA ಅರ್ಜಿ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಗಡುವು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ. IB ಮತ್ತು ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಅನಾಲಿಟಿಕ್ಸ್ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
content:
CATಗೆ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮಾಡಿದರೆ IIFT MBA ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದಂತಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. 2027-29 ಪ್ರವೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಿಟ್ಯೂಟ್ ಆಫ್ ಫಾರಿನ್ ಟ್ರೇಡ್‌ನ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು 25 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026ರೊಳಗೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಬೇಕು. ಕಿರುಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಆಯ್ಕೆಗೆ IIFT CAT 2026 ಅಂಕಗಳು ಹಾಗೂ ಇತರ ನಿಗದಿತ ಮಾನದಂಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಪಾವತಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಆರಿಸಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ 2027-29 ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಣಿ ತಾಣದ ಲಿಂಕ್‌ಗಳಿವೆ. MBA ಇಂಟರ್‌ನ್ಯಾಷನಲ್ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ (IB), MBA ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಅನಾಲಿಟಿಕ್ಸ್ (BA), ಅಥವಾ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವುದೇ ಎಂದು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿ. ಅರ್ಜಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಿ.

IIFT ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪುಟ

ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಯ ವರ್ಗ

MBA IB ಅರ್ಜಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ

MBA BA ಅರ್ಜಿ ಶುಲ್ಕ

ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ / OBC-NCL / EWS

₹3,000

₹2,000

SC / ST / ಅಂಗವಿಕಲರು / ಟ್ರಾನ್ಸ್‌ಜೆಂಡರ್

₹1,500

₹1,000

ಇವು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಶುಲ್ಕಗಳು, ಬೋಧನಾ ಶುಲ್ಕವಲ್ಲ. ಪಾವತಿಸಿದ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಶುಲ್ಕವನ್ನು ಹಿಂದಿರುಗಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

ಇಂಡಿಯನ್ ಇನ್‌ಸ್ಟಿಟ್ಯೂಟ್ ಆಫ್ ಫಾರಿನ್ ಟ್ರೇಡ್, MBA 2027-29 ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ, ಪುಟ 38. ಈ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣಾ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ

ಅರ್ಜಿ ಗಡುವು ಮತ್ತು CAT ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಬೇರೆ

ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ IIFT ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಲ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ 25 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026 ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನ; CAT ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 29 ನವೆಂಬರ್ 2026. IIFTಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮುಗಿಯುವವರೆಗೆ ಕಾಯಬೇಡಿ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪಾವತಿ ದೃಢೀಕರಣ ಉಳಿಸಿ, ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಹಾಗೂ ವರ್ಗ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿವೆಯೇ ನೋಡಿ.

CAT ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಗೆ ಈ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನೋಡಿ. ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ MBA ಅರ್ಜಿಗೆ IIFT ಪ್ರವೇಶ ತಾಣ ಬಳಸಿ.

CAT 2026 ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರ ಪರಿಶೀಲನಾ ಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ವರ್ಷದ ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಓದಿ

ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕದ 36 ಮತ್ತು 37ನೇ ಪುಟಗಳಲ್ಲಿ IB ಹಾಗೂ BAಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಅರ್ಹತೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಅರ್ಹತಾ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವವರಿಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಹತೆಯ ಪುರಾವೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು 31 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 2027 ಕೊನೆಯ ದಿನ. ಪಾವತಿಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಆಯ್ದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಭಾಗ, ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ BA ಗಣಿತದ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ.

ಅರ್ಜಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಮೂದಿಸಿದ ವರ್ಗವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಲಾಗದು. ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ವರ್ಗದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರ ಅಪ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅರ್ಜಿಯನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ; ಅಪೂರ್ಣ ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳು ತಿರಸ್ಕೃತವಾಗಬಹುದು. ನೋಂದಣಿ ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗೆ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಕಚೇರಿಗೆ ಖಾಸಗಿ ಇಮೇಲ್ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿ. ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ CAT ನೋಂದಣಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ, IIFT ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಮತ್ತು ನೋಂದಾಯಿತ ಇಮೇಲ್ ತಿಳಿಸಿ.
