title: Top Colleges in Rohini: Best Courses & Admissions
description: Discover the top colleges in Rohini and nearby areas. Explore top engineering, medical, and management institutes, their admissions, and career scope.
content:
Complete Guide to Higher Education: Best Institutes and Campuses in North-West Delhi

If you are planning to pursue higher education in North-West Delhi, exploring the top colleges in Rohini is likely at the very top of your priority list. Over the past two decades, this heavily populated region has rapidly transformed from a bustling residential sector into one of the most prominent, highly sought-after educational hubs in the National Capital Region (NCR). Whether you are an aspiring software engineer, an ambitious business manager, or a future medical professional, the institutions located here and in the immediate vicinity offer world-class infrastructure, reputed university affiliations, and exceptional placement records.

This guide breaks down the premier educational institutes situated in and around the area, categorizing them by their specialization so you can make an informed, strategic decision about your academic future.

1. Why Choose North-West Delhi for Higher Studies?

Before diving into specific campus profiles, it is important to understand why so many students actively seek admission in this specific zone. The region boasts exceptional connectivity via the Delhi Metro (primarily the Red and Yellow lines), making the daily commute feasible for students traveling from any part of Delhi or neighboring NCR cities like Gurugram and Noida. Furthermore, the presence of major commercial complexes, corporate offices, and bustling student-friendly neighborhoods like Pitampura and Kohat Enclave means you will have access to excellent PG accommodations, diverse food options, and vibrant campus life.

2. Engineering and Technology Powerhouses

For students hailing from a science background, securing a seat in one of the premier technical institutes here is a dream come true. The region houses some of the most prestigious engineering campuses in the country.

Delhi Technological University (DTU)

Formerly known as Delhi College of Engineering (DCE), DTU is a state university located in Shahbad Daulatpur, directly adjacent to Sector 16, Rohini. It stands as one of the most highly ranked engineering universities in India. Offering programs ranging from B.Tech in Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Mathematics & Computing to specialized master's and Ph.D. degrees, DTU is known for its sprawling 164-acre lush green campus. Admission to its undergraduate technical programs is highly competitive and is routed through the Joint Admission Counselling (JAC) Delhi, based exclusively on JEE Main ranks. The university features an 85% home-state quota for students who have completed their schooling in Delhi, making it a prime target for local aspirants.

Bhagwan Parshuram Institute of Technology (BPIT)

Situated in Sector 17, BPIT is a leading engineering and management institute affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University (GGSIPU). Approved by AICTE, BPIT offers high-demand undergraduate programs, including B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication, and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science. The campus is known for its rigorous academic curriculum and a highly active Training and Placement Cell that frequently brings top-tier multinational companies for campus recruitment. Admissions are primarily based on JEE Main scores followed by GGSIPU central counseling.

3. Premier Management and Business Schools

If corporate leadership, finance, or marketing is your calling, the business schools in this zone offer curriculums that rival the best in the country. Among the top colleges in Rohini, the management institutes stand out for their industry integrations.

Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies (SSCBS)

Located in PSP Area IV, Dr. K.N. Katju Marg, SSCBS is arguably the most prestigious undergraduate management college affiliated with the University of Delhi (DU). Established in 1987, it has a legacy of producing elite corporate leaders. The college offers highly coveted programs like the Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS) and B.B.A. in Financial Investment Analysis (FIA). SSCBS boasts a modern, state-of-the-art campus, air-conditioned classrooms, and a highly active corporate placement cell that regularly secures packages generally reserved for MBA graduates. Admission is extremely competitive and is now entirely dependent on scores obtained in the Common University Entrance Test (CUET).

Jagannath Institute of Management Sciences (JIMS)

With campuses in Sector 3 and Sector 5, JIMS is a household name for management and IT education in Delhi. Affiliated with GGSIPU, JIMS offers excellent programs like BBA, BCA, MCA, and PGDM. The institute is heavily focused on practical exposure, frequently organizing industrial visits, guest lectures from corporate veterans, and summer internship programs. Their PGDM program is AICTE approved and is known for maintaining a stellar placement record in sectors like banking, FMCG, and IT consulting.

Gitarattan International Business School (GIBS)

Located in Sector 14, GIBS is another highly ranked GGSIPU-affiliated college. It offers specialized programs including BBA, MBA, and integrated law degrees (BBA-LLB and BA-LLB). GIBS has earned a reputation for its strict academic discipline, modern moot courts for law students, and a massive library. It regularly hosts national-level seminars and hackathons to keep students engaged with current industry trends.

4. Excellence in Medical and Allied Sciences

For NEET aspirants, the area provides excellent avenues for medical education with heavily subsidized government fee structures and massive clinical exposure.

Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Medical College and Hospital

Situated in Sector 6, this is one of the premier government medical colleges in the capital. Affiliated with GGSIPU, the college offers the standard 5.5-year MBBS degree. Because it is directly attached to the 500-bedded Dr. BSA Hospital, students receive unparalleled, hands-on clinical exposure right from their early years of study. Securing admission here requires an exceptionally high score in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and participation in the centralized counseling process.

5. Overview of Top Institutions

To help you compare the educational landscape quickly, here is a structured breakdown of the most prominent academic institutions in the area.

(Note: VIPS is located in the neighboring Pitampura area on the Outer Ring Road, but is heavily frequented by students residing in the North-West corridor due to its proximity and outstanding infrastructure).

6. Navigating the Admission Procedures

While researching the top colleges in Rohini, you must pay close attention to the highly specific admission cycles. Unlike private universities that may offer direct admissions, the premier institutes here are governed by strict centralized examination criteria.

  • For Engineering (B.Tech): You must clear the JEE Main. If you are aiming for DTU, you will need to register for JAC Delhi counseling. If you are targeting BPIT, you will need to apply through the GGSIPU central counseling portal.

  • For Management and Commerce (BMS, BBA): If your target is SSCBS (Delhi University), the Common University Entrance Test (CUET) is mandatory, and you must select the specific domain subjects mapped to the course. For GGSIPU colleges like JIMS or GIBS, the university conducts its own IPU CET, though CUET scores are increasingly being integrated.

  • For Medical (MBBS): You must crack NEET-UG and apply through the Medical Counseling Committee (MCC) or the state quota counseling authorities.

7. Campus Life and Extracurricular Ecosystem

Choosing one of the top colleges in Rohini is not just about the academic rigor; it is equally about the holistic campus experience. Students here benefit from an incredibly vibrant ecosystem. The annual cultural fests, such as DTU’s Engifest or SSCBS’s Crescendo, attract footfalls in the tens of thousands and feature performances by top mainstream artists.

Additionally, these colleges host highly competitive technical societies, debate clubs, and entrepreneurship cells. BPIT regularly hosts major coding hackathons and technical fests, while JIMS and GIBS are known for their rigorous business plan competitions. The proximity to local hangouts like the Swarn Jayanti Park (Japanese Park), Metro Walk, and various bustling cafes ensures that students have ample spaces to decompress, network, and socialize after grueling academic hours.

Choosing the right institution is a monumental step in shaping your career trajectory. By evaluating the specializations, campus infrastructure, and placement histories of these esteemed campuses, you can find the perfect academic home to nurture your professional ambitions.

title: NID PhD in Design Admissions 2027: Eligibility, DRT Pattern, and Research Proposal Guidelines
description: Comprehensive guide to NID PhD in Design Admissions 2027. Discover eligibility criteria, Design Research Test pattern, proposal submission guidelines, and selection steps for Indian scholars.
content:
The National Institute of Design (NID) stands as one of India's premier autonomous institutions for design education and advanced research. Securing admission into the PhD in Design program at NID offers scholar-practitioners an exceptional opportunity to contribute to design theory, innovation, practice, and socio-cultural frameworks. As NID opens its PhD admissions process for the 2027 academic session, aspiring researchers must thoroughly understand the eligibility norms, entrance test format, and research proposal requirements to submit a competitive application.

Overview of NID PhD in Design Admission 2027

The doctoral program at NID is designed for candidates aiming to conduct deep, original inquiry across multidisciplinary design domains. Scholars can pursue research in areas such as industrial design, visual communication, interaction design, textile and apparel design, design pedagogy, design history, and social sustainability. Candidates can apply under full-time or part-time research categories, depending on institutional availability and their employment status.

Key Eligibility Criteria for Applicants

To apply for the NID PhD in Design program for 2027, applicants must fulfill academic qualifications and professional benchmarks set by the institute.

Educational Qualifications

  • Master's Degree: Applicants must possess a Master’s degree in Design (M.Des.), Architecture (M.Arch.), Fine Arts (MFA), Engineering (M.Tech. or M.E.), or a relevant discipline from a recognized institute or university.
  • 4-Year Bachelor's Degree: Candidates holding a four-year Bachelor’s degree in Design, Architecture, or Engineering with high academic standing and substantial relevant research or professional experience may also qualify.
  • Postgraduate Diploma: A recognized two-year Postgraduate Diploma in Design from a premier institution like NID satisfies the educational criteria.

Minimum Marks and Experience Requirements

Candidates generally require a minimum aggregate score of 55% marks (or an equivalent CGPA) in their qualifying postgraduate degree. Category-specific relaxations apply for reserved category applicants as per official regulations. Prior professional design experience, published research papers, or patented design work add significant strength to an applicant's profile.

Design Research Test (DRT) Exam Pattern

The primary screening stage for applicants is the Design Research Test (DRT). The DRT evaluates a candidate's readiness for doctoral-level theoretical and practical research.

Structure of the DRT Written Examination

The DRT comprises two core sections designed to evaluate general research competence alongside domain-specific knowledge:

  • Part A (General Research Aptitude): Focuses on logical reasoning, analytical ability, quantitative interpretation, research methodologies, and critical reading comprehension.
  • Part B (Design Sensitivity and Domain Knowledge): Evaluates critical thinking in design, socio-cultural context of design practice, design history, contemporary trends, and design-led problem-solving approaches.

Key Evaluation Focus Areas

The examination measures how effectively an applicant can articulate complex concepts, evaluate visual and contextual data, and formulate structured research arguments. Candidates are advised to verify official announcements regarding potential test exemptions for national fellowship holders.

Guidelines for Crafting a Winning Research Proposal

The research proposal is a critical document in the NID PhD selection process. It reflects your intellectual vision, research clarity, and alignment with NID institutional capabilities.

Core Components of the Proposal

  • Title and Abstract: A concise title capturing the essence of the proposed study, paired with a 200 to 300-word executive summary.
  • Background and Context: An introduction to the domain, defining the historical, social, technological, or systemic environment surrounding your research focus.
  • Problem Statement and Research Questions: Articulation of existing knowledge gaps, design challenges, or systemic issues your study intends to investigate.
  • Literature Review: A synthesis of current academic work proving that you have surveyed relevant literature and identified genuine research opportunities.
  • Proposed Methodology: Clear outline of methods (qualitative, quantitative, practice-led research, field studies, prototyping, or participatory design frameworks) you plan to employ.
  • Expected Contribution: An explanation of how your outcomes will advance design theory, benefit industry practice, or support social development.

Common Pitfalls to Avoid

Avoid overly broad research topics or proposals that sound like product design briefs rather than scholarly inquiries. Ensure your methodology directly addresses your core research questions and that your timeline is realistic for a doctoral program.

Selection Process and Final Interview Stage

The admission process moves through well-defined evaluation phases:

  1. Application Screening: Initial verification of application forms, academic transcripts, and preliminary research proposals.
  2. Written Entrance Test: Shortlisted candidates appear for the Design Research Test (DRT).
  3. Proposal Presentation and Interview: Candidates who clear the DRT present their research proposal to an expert panel, followed by an oral defense and portfolio evaluation.

Important Timelines and Application Checklist

Prospective scholars should organize their application materials ahead of key deadlines:

  • Regularly monitor the official NID portal during late August and September 2026 for 2027 admission cycles.
  • Submit application fees, academic transcripts, work portfolios, and research proposals strictly within the announced deadlines.
  • Verify all specific eligibility details directly on the official NID admissions portal before submitting your application.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

What is the basic qualification for NID PhD in Design?

Applicants require a Master's degree in Design, Architecture, Fine Arts, or Engineering with at least 55% aggregate marks, or an equivalent recognized qualification.

What does the Design Research Test (DRT) assess?

The DRT evaluates general research aptitude, logical reasoning, critical writing skills, design history, and domain-specific knowledge.

Is a portfolio mandatory for the NID PhD interview?

Yes, presenting a portfolio of creative work, design projects, or research publications is required during the final selection interview.

Can part-time scholars apply for the NID PhD 2027 program?

NID provides options for both full-time and part-time research scholars, subject to professional experience criteria and No Objection Certificates from current employers.

title: CAT 2026: Why Sectional Percentiles Can Block Your MBA Call
description: A high CAT 2026 overall percentile may not secure an MBA shortlist if one section misses an institute’s published cut-off. Learn how to filter choices.
content:
A high CAT 2026 overall percentile can still leave you without an MBA interview call if one section falls below an institute’s sectional cut-off. The practical move is to check Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension, Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning, and Quantitative Ability separately before you build an IIM or other MBA shortlist.

CAT is the entrance test, not a single-number admission guarantee. Each institute sets its own selection rules for the 2026 MBA admission cycle, and these rules can change from one year to the next.

Can one weak CAT section cancel a strong total?

Yes. If an institute requires minimum sectional percentiles and your score misses even one of them, you may be screened out before your overall percentile, academics or work experience are assessed. A 98 percentile total does not automatically repair a section that falls below the stated threshold.

That’s why a scorecard must be read in three parts, not one headline number. A candidate with a strong Quantitative Ability score but a weak VARC score should not treat every IIM or private B-school as equally realistic.

How academic profile and work experience enter the picture

Clearing the Sectional Cutoff is only the first gate. Institutes may then consider the overall CAT percentile, Class 10 and 12 marks, graduation performance, category rules, gender or academic diversity factors, work experience and performance in the written assessment or interview. The exact weight given to each item belongs to the institute’s published criteria.

Work experience can support a profile, but it usually cannot erase a basic sectional ineligibility condition. Freshers shouldn’t panic either. They need a shortlist that does not depend on work experience marks to remain competitive.

A safer CAT 2026 shortlist method

  1. Record the three sectional percentiles: keep them beside your overall percentile.
  2. Make an institute sheet: note the published sectional and overall thresholds, academic requirements and selection components for each target.
  3. Separate eligible from competitive: meeting a cut-off may permit consideration, but it doesn’t promise a call.
  4. Recheck the 2026 criteria: use the responsible institute’s admission notice before applying or paying any fee.

Use exam comparisons to keep backup routes visible, and compare likely institutions through college options rather than chasing one famous name. For parents, the key question is simple: does this shortlist survive the weakest section on the scorecard?

पृष्ठ 4, 10 पर पहले कक्षा की पहचान करें, फिर कोड 409, 809 खोजें। तारीख या समय का एक ही खाना कई विषयों पर लागू हो सकता है। मोबाइल पर पूरा पृष्ठ बड़ा करके देखें ताकि गलत पंक्ति न पढ़ लें।

अपने स्कूल के पंजीकरण विवरण से कोड और विषय का पूरा नाम मिलाएँ। एक ही नाम अलग कक्षाओं में दिखे तो केवल अपनी कक्षा की पंक्ति चुनें।

यह दो तारीखों का अंतर है, पढ़ाई के लिए मिलने वाली छुट्टियाँ नहीं। अपने बाकी पेपर भी लिखें और केवल बीच के खाली दिनों को गिनें। अभ्यास के लिए अपने पेपर जितना समय रखें।

प्रैक्टिकल और लिखित परीक्षा की तारीख अलग रखें

यह प्रविष्टि बोर्ड के निर्धारित पेपर की है। यदि प्रैक्टिकल, प्रदर्शन, प्रोजेक्ट या आंतरिक मूल्यांकन है, तो उसका समय और ज़रूरी सामग्री स्कूल से पूछें।

परीक्षा केंद्र में संचार उपकरण ले जाने की अनुमति नहीं है। CBSE के अलग से जारी निर्देशों और प्रवेश पत्र के अनुसार ही सामान ले जाएँ।

title: JKSSB PST and PET Schedule 2026: Physical Fitness Benchmarks, Document Verification, and Test Centre Guidelines
description: Comprehensive guide on JKSSB PST and PET 2026 schedule, physical standard benchmarks, endurance parameters, document verification list, and essential test centre rules for candidates.
content:
The Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has issued notifications regarding the Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Endurance Test (PET) schedule for 2026. Designed to evaluate candidates applying for uniformed and field-based administrative cadres across Jammu and Kashmir, these physical tests serve as crucial qualifying rounds. Candidates who successfully clear the written examinations must undergo these rigorous physical evaluations before moving forward in the selection process.

Understanding the exact measurement standards, endurance expectations, required documentation, and ground-level test centre rules is essential for every aspirant. This detailed overview covers all vital aspects of the JKSSB PST and PET 2026 process to ensure candidates and parents are fully prepared for test day.

JKSSB PST and PET 2026: Event Overview

The physical evaluation stage is divided into two sequential parts: the Physical Standard Test (PST) and the Physical Endurance Test (PET). Candidates must clear the PST measurements first to qualify for the PET events. Both tests are qualifying in nature, meaning marks obtained do not alter the written examination merit list, but failure to meet any minimum criteria results in immediate disqualification.

Evaluation StagePrimary FocusKey Parameters EvaluatedQualifying Nature
Physical Standard Test (PST)Body MeasurementsHeight, Chest Measurement (Expansion & Unexpanded)Qualifying (Mandatory minimums)
Physical Endurance Test (PET)Stamina & StrengthDistance Run, Push-ups / Shot Put, Timed TrialsQualifying (Time & attempt based)
Document Verification (DV)Eligibility AuthenticationDomicile, Educational Marksheets, Category CertificatesMandatory for final merit inclusion

Physical Standard Test (PST) Benchmarks

The PST measures key physical dimensions. The board strictly enforces these criteria, with automated or digital measuring instruments deployed at venue centers to ensure accurate recording.

Physical Standards for Male Candidates

  • Height: Minimum 5 feet 6 inches (167.64 cm).
  • Chest Measurement: Minimum 32 inches (81.28 cm) unexpanded, with a mandatory minimum expansion of 1.5 inches (3.81 cm).

Physical Standards for Female Candidates

  • Height: Minimum 5 feet 2 inches (157.48 cm).
  • Chest Measurement: Not applicable for female candidates.

Special Category Relaxations

Candidates belonging to specific recognized categories, such as the Gorkha community or candidates native to designated hilly zones within Jammu and Kashmir, may receive specific height relaxations as outlined in the official recruitment advertisement. Candidates claiming physical standard relaxations must present authentic supporting certificates issued by competent revenue authorities during verification.

Physical Endurance Test (PET) Standards

Candidates who successfully clear the PST advance immediately to the PET round on the ground. The endurance test assesses cardiovascular stamina, agility, and muscle endurance using electronically timed equipment, such as Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tracking tags attached to candidates.

PET Standards for Male Candidates

  • 1600-Meter Long Run: Must be completed within a maximum time of 6 minutes 30 seconds.
  • Push-Ups: 20 completed repetitions in one continuous cycle (touching the ground chest-level and extending arms fully).

PET Standards for Female Candidates

  • 1000-Meter Long Run: Must be completed within a maximum time of 6 minutes 30 seconds.
  • Shot Put: 4 kg shot put throw covering a minimum distance of 14.5 feet within 3 allowed attempts.

Document Verification (DV) Requirements at Test Centres

Document verification takes place alongside or immediately following the physical tests at the venue. Candidates must carry original documents along with two sets of self-attested photocopies. Failure to present authentic documents on the scheduled day can lead to cancellation of candidature.

  • Printed Admit Card: Official JKSSB PST/PET call letter downloaded from the official portal.
  • Identity Proof: Government-issued photo ID such as Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter Card, or Driving License.
  • Domicile Certificate: Valid J&K Domicile Certificate issued by the competent authority.
  • Date of Birth Proof: Class 10th (Matriculation) diploma or marks card showing the exact date of birth.
  • Educational Qualifications: Degree certificates, provisional passing certificates, or year-wise mark statements as required for the specific post.
  • Category Certificate: Reserved category certificates (SC, ST, RBA, ALC/IB, EWS, PSP) issued in the prescribed format by authorized officers.
  • Passport Photos: At least 4 to 6 recent color passport-size photographs identical to the photo uploaded in the application form.

Test Centre Guidelines and Operational Protocols

To ensure smooth operations and prevent malpractice, JKSSB maintains strict protocols across all designated stadium venues and sports grounds in Jammu and Kashmir divisions.

  • Reporting Time: Candidates must reach the ground by the exact reporting time stated on their admit cards. Late entries are strictly prohibited due to synchronized biometric logging.
  • Biometric Registration: Entry into the physical testing arena requires biometric fingerprint scanning and facial recognition matching against application records.
  • Dress Code: Candidates should wear suitable athletic gear, including comfortable running shoes, shorts, or tracksuits. Spiked shoes may be restricted depending on ground surface conditions.
  • Prohibited Items: Mobile phones, smartwatches, fitness bands, earphones, metallic accessories, and performance-enhancing substances are strictly forbidden inside the testing ground.
  • On-Site Measurement Appeals: If a candidate is dissatisfied with their PST height or chest reading, they must lodge an appeal with the Appellate Committee present at the venue on the same day before leaving the ground. Re-evaluation will not be permitted on later dates.

Preparation Tips for Candidates and Parents

Parents play a crucial role in supporting candidates through the physical preparation phase. A structured approach ensures optimum performance on test day.

  • Routine Practice: Practice running under timed conditions on standard 400-meter tracks to gauge pacing.
  • Hydration and Nutrition: Maintain balanced carbohydrate and protein intake while avoiding sudden dietary alterations right before event days.
  • Document Preparation: Organize all original certificates in a waterproof folder prior to travel, ensuring all spelling details match across records.
  • Verify Official Updates: Always check the official JKSSB portal regularly for live schedule updates, venue adjustments, or weather-related rescheduled dates.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What happens if a candidate fails the PST height measurement?

If a candidate does not meet the prescribed height benchmark during the initial PST round, they are disqualified from participating in the PET. Candidates can submit an immediate written appeal to the Appellate Authority present at the venue on the same day for a re-measurement.

2. Are electronic timing gadgets used during the PET run?

Yes, JKSSB utilizes RFID chip technology bound to candidates' shoes or bibs to track exact race timings down to the second, ensuring complete transparency and eliminate human timing errors.

3. Can the PST/PET date or centre be changed upon request?

Generally, JKSSB does not entertain individual requests for changing test dates or centres. Postponements or batch adjustments are granted only under extreme circumstances or severe weather interruptions at the board's discretion.

4. Is medical testing conducted on the same day as PST/PET?

The PST/PET stage evaluates baseline physical standards and endurance. Comprehensive medical fitness examinations for final shortlisted candidates are conducted in subsequent stages through authorized medical boards.

title: PG Diploma in Sustainable Science | Advance Your Career in Sustainability
description: Enroll in the PG Diploma in Sustainable Science to gain advanced knowledge in sustainability, environmental management, and green technologies. Boost your career in sustainable development and eco-friendly practices.
content:
In today’s rapidly evolving world, sustainability has become a central focus across industries. Organizations, governments, and communities are increasingly prioritizing eco-friendly practices, renewable resources, and environmental conservation. This growing demand has led to the rise of specialized programs like the PG Diploma in Sustainable Science, designed to equip professionals with the knowledge and skills necessary to address global environmental challenges.

What is PG Diploma in Sustainable Science?

The Postgraduate Diploma in Sustainable Science is a specialized program aimed at providing advanced understanding of sustainability principles, environmental management, and green technologies. Unlike traditional degrees, this diploma focuses on practical applications, research-oriented projects, and industry-relevant training to prepare students for careers that promote environmental responsibility.

Key Learning Areas

Students enrolled in this program can expect to cover a range of topics, including:

  • Sustainable Development: Strategies for balancing economic growth with environmental preservation.

  • Environmental Management: Techniques for reducing ecological impact and managing natural resources efficiently.

  • Renewable Energy and Green Technologies: Innovations in solar, wind, and other renewable energy sources.

  • Climate Change and Policy: Understanding global environmental policies and their impact on sustainability initiatives.

  • Waste Management and Conservation: Approaches to minimizing waste and promoting circular economy principles.

Who Should Enroll?

The program is ideal for:

  • Recent graduates in science, technology, or environmental studies looking to specialize in sustainability.

  • Professionals seeking career advancement in environmental management, renewable energy, or corporate sustainability.

  • Policy makers and social entrepreneurs aiming to implement sustainable initiatives in communities and organizations.

Career Opportunities

Completing a PG Diploma in Sustainable Science opens doors to a variety of career paths, such as:

  • Sustainability Consultant

  • Environmental Analyst

  • Renewable Energy Specialist

  • Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Manager

  • Climate Change Researcher

  • Policy Advisor in Environmental Agencies

These roles exist across government organizations, NGOs, corporate sustainability departments, and research institutions, reflecting the versatility and growing demand for sustainability experts.

Benefits of Pursuing This Diploma

  • Specialized Knowledge: Gain cutting-edge insights into sustainable practices and green technologies.

  • Industry Relevance: Practical training ensures readiness for real-world sustainability challenges.

  • Networking Opportunities: Connect with professionals, experts, and organizations in the sustainability sector.

  • Career Growth: Opens pathways to high-demand roles in both public and private sectors.

Conclusion

As sustainability continues to shape the future of business, policy, and research, the PG Diploma in Sustainable Science offers a valuable opportunity for individuals to become change-makers. By combining theoretical knowledge with practical skills, the program empowers students to contribute meaningfully to environmental conservation, renewable energy initiatives, and sustainable development globally.

title: CBSE 2027 സമയക്രമം കാത്തിരിക്കുമ്പോൾ: PDFലെ പരീക്ഷാവർഷം നോക്കൂ
description: CBSEയുടെ 2026 പ്രത്യേക പരീക്ഷാ അറിയിപ്പ് 2027 പ്രധാന ബോർഡ് സമയക്രമമല്ല. പദ്ധതി തയ്യാറാക്കുംമുമ്പ് വർഷം, ക്ലാസ്, വിദ്യാർഥിവിഭാഗം ഒത്തുനോക്കൂ.
content:
CBSE PDFൽ “date sheet” എന്നുണ്ടെന്നതുകൊണ്ട് അത് 2027ലെ പത്താം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ക്ലാസ് പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷയുടെ സമയക്രമമാകില്ല. ബോർഡിന്റെ പട്ടികയിൽ മധ്യപൂർവ/പശ്ചിമേഷ്യ മേഖലയിലെ 2026 പ്രത്യേക പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ക്ലാസ് പരീക്ഷാ അറിയിപ്പുണ്ട്. 2027 പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷയ്ക്കു തയ്യാറെടുക്കുന്നവർ അത് സ്വന്തം പേപ്പറുകൾക്കായി ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്.

ആദ്യം വർഷവും വിദ്യാർഥിവിഭാഗവും നോക്കൂ

ആ പ്രത്യേക പരീക്ഷാ അറിയിപ്പ് 2027 പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷയുടെ വിഷയവാരിയായ തീയതികൾ ഉറപ്പാക്കുന്നില്ല. പഠനപദ്ധതിയിൽ തീയതി പകർത്തുംമുമ്പ് പൂർണ തലക്കെട്ടും ആദ്യ ഖണ്ഡികയും വായിക്കൂ. ക്ലാസ്, പരീക്ഷാവർഷം, പ്രധാനമോ പ്രത്യേകമോ, മേഖലാ അല്ലെങ്കിൽ വിദ്യാർഥിവിഭാഗ നിയന്ത്രണങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ പരിശോധിക്കുക.

പൊരുത്തപ്പെടുന്ന അറിയിപ്പിന് CBSE പരീക്ഷാ സർക്കുലറുകളും ഔദ്യോഗിക ബോർഡ് വെബ്സൈറ്റും നോക്കൂ. ആദ്യ പേജില്ലാത്ത പങ്കുവച്ച ചിത്രം, അറിയിപ്പ് നിങ്ങൾക്കു ബാധകമാണോ എന്നു തീരുമാനിക്കുന്ന വിവരം മറയ്ക്കാം.

CBSE പരീക്ഷാ സർക്കുലർ പട്ടികയിലെ 9 ഒക്ടോബർ 2026 പ്രത്യേക പരീക്ഷാ അറിയിപ്പ്. പരീക്ഷയുടെ തരം തിരിച്ചറിയാനുള്ള ഉദാഹരണം; 2027 പ്രധാന സമയക്രമമല്ല. ആദ്യം വർഷവും വിദ്യാർഥിവിഭാഗവും നോക്കൂ.

മാറ്റാവുന്ന ആവർത്തനപഠന പദ്ധതി തയ്യാറാക്കൂ

സമയക്രമം വരുന്നതുവരെ സ്കൂളിന്റെ നിലവിലെ വിഷയം, സിലബസ് നിർദേശങ്ങൾ അനുസരിച്ചു പഠിക്കൂ. തീരാത്ത അധ്യായങ്ങൾക്ക് സമയം കൂട്ടി, എഴുത്തുപരിശീലനവും ആവർത്തനപഠനവും മാറിമാറി ചെയ്യുക. വിഷയക്രമം ഉറപ്പായശേഷം മാറ്റാൻ ഇടം വയ്ക്കൂ.

രണ്ടു പേപ്പറുകൾക്കിടയിൽ നിശ്ചിത ഇടവേളയുണ്ടെന്ന് കരുതരുത്. ഊഹിച്ച തുടക്കത്തീയതി നോക്കി പണം മടക്കിക്കിട്ടാത്ത യാത്ര ബുക്കിങ് ചെയ്യരുത്. പരീക്ഷാകാലത്തെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള പൊതുവായ പ്രതീക്ഷ ഒരു വിഷയത്തിന്റെ ദിവസമോ സെഷനോ ഉറപ്പാക്കില്ല.

പ്രധാന സമയക്രമം വന്നാൽ ചെയ്യേണ്ടത്

  1. നിർദേശങ്ങൾ ഉൾപ്പെടെ പൂർണ ഔദ്യോഗിക PDF സൂക്ഷിക്കൂ.

  2. പേരിന്റെ സാമ്യം മാത്രം നോക്കാതെ വിഷയപ്പേരും കോഡും ഒത്തുനോക്കൂ.

  3. തുടക്കസമയവും വിഷയത്തിനുള്ള പ്രത്യേക ദൈർഘ്യവും വായിക്കൂ.

  4. പ്രായോഗിക അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആഭ്യന്തര മൂല്യനിർണയ ക്രമീകരണം സ്കൂളിനോട് പ്രത്യേകം ചോദിക്കൂ.

  5. സൂക്ഷിച്ച പകർപ്പ് ആശ്രയിക്കുംമുമ്പ് പിന്നീടുള്ള സർക്കുലർ തിരുത്തിയിട്ടുണ്ടോ നോക്കൂ.

CBSE സമയക്രമ പരിശോധനപ്പട്ടിക ആ രേഖ വായിക്കാൻ കൂടുതൽ സഹായിക്കുന്നു. ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട അറിയിപ്പ് വരുന്നതുവരെ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്ന തീയതികളെ അനുമാനങ്ങളെന്ന് വ്യക്തമായി അടയാളപ്പെടുത്തുക.

title: CEED 2027 பதிவு நீட்டிப்பு: உங்கள் கல்விநிலைக்கு ஏற்ற சான்றைத் தயாரியுங்கள்
description: CEED 2027 நீட்டிக்கப்பட்ட பதிவு காலத்தில் பட்டச் சான்று, இறுதியாண்டு மதிப்பெண் பட்டியல் அல்லது கல்லூரிச் சான்றைத் தயாரிக்க உதவும் வழிகாட்டி.
content:
CEED 2027 சாதாரணக் கட்டணப் பதிவு இப்போது 5 நவம்பர் 2026 வரை நீட்டிக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. கல்விச் சான்று இல்லாததால் விண்ணப்பம் தடைப்பட்டிருந்தால், படிப்பை முடித்துவிட்டீர்களா அல்லது இன்னும் படிக்கிறீர்களா என்பதை முதலில் பாருங்கள். பட்டச் சான்றின் அச்சுப் பிரதி கிடைக்காததும் படிப்பு முடியாததும் IIT Bombay விதிகளில் வெவ்வேறு நிலைகள்.

கல்விநிலைக்கு ஏற்ற ஆவணத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்

  • படிப்பு முடிந்து பட்டச் சான்று உள்ளது: பட்டம் அல்லது டிப்ளமோ சான்றை ஸ்கேன் செய்து PDF ஆகப் பதிவேற்றுங்கள்.

  • படிப்பு முடிந்தும் இறுதிச் சான்று கிடைக்கவில்லை: இறுதியாண்டு மதிப்பெண் பட்டியல் அல்லது தற்காலிகச் சான்றைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

  • படிப்பு இன்னும் முடியவில்லை: கையேட்டின் Appendix 1 வடிவில் முதல்வர் அல்லது துறைத் தலைவரிடமிருந்து சான்று பெற்று PDF ஆகப் பதிவேற்றுங்கள்.

IIT Bombay CEED 2027 கையேடு, 1 அக்டோபர் 2026 அன்று வெளியிடப்பட்டது, அச்சுப் பக்கம் 11. கல்விநிலைக்கு ஏற்ற ஆவணத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்.

கல்லூரிக்கு Appendix 1 இன் உண்மையான வடிவத்தை அனுப்புங்கள். சாதாரணக் கடிதமோ வேறு தேவைக்கான bonafide சான்றோ இந்த நிபந்தனையை நிறைவேற்றும் எனக் கருத வேண்டாம். ஸ்கேன் செய்வதற்கு முன் பெயர், படிப்பு விவரம், கையொப்பம் மற்றும் முத்திரையைச் சரிபாருங்கள்.

மற்ற பதிவேற்றங்களையும் சரிபாருங்கள்

கடந்த ஆறு மாதங்களில் எடுத்த வண்ணப் புகைப்படமும் தெளிவான கையொப்பப் படமும் JPG வடிவில் தேவை எனக் கையேடு கூறுகிறது. அளவுகளுக்குப் பதிவுத் தளத்தின் வழிமுறைகளைப் பின்பற்றுங்கள்; மற்றொரு நுழைவுத் தேர்வின் அளவுகளைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்.

பிரிவு அடிப்படையில் விண்ணப்பித்தால் உரிய செல்லுபடியாகும் சான்று தேவை. EWS, OBC-NCL சான்றுகள் 1 ஏப்ரல் 2026 அல்லது அதற்குப் பிறகு வழங்கப்பட்டிருக்க வேண்டும். கல்விச் சான்றில் உள்ள பெயரிலிருந்து உங்கள் பெயர் மாறியிருந்தால், கையேட்டில் கூறிய பொருத்தமான ஆதாரத்தையும் அளிக்க வேண்டும்.

கடைசி நாள் மாறியுள்ளது; சான்று விதிகள் மாறவில்லை

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ CEED அறிவிப்பு தாமதக் கட்டணப் பதிவுக்கு 10 நவம்பர் 2026 மாலை 5 மணி வரை அவகாசம் தருகிறது; மேலும் நீட்டிப்பு இருக்காது என்றும் கூறுகிறது. தெளிவில்லாத அல்லது முழுமையற்ற ஸ்கேனைத் திருத்த நேரம் இருக்கும் வகையில் ஆவணத்தை முன்பே தயாரியுங்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ பதிவுத் தளத்தில் பணம் செலுத்துவதற்கு முன் ஒவ்வொரு பதிவேற்றத்தையும் திறந்து விண்ணப்ப முன்னோட்டத்தைப் படியுங்கள். சமர்ப்பித்த படிவத்தையும் கட்டண உறுதிப்படுத்தலையும் சேமியுங்கள். இரு தேர்வுகளின் அறிவிப்புக்கு UCEED, CEED பதிவு நீட்டிப்பு வழிகாட்டியை பார்க்கலாம்.

title: MPSC Prelims 2025 Postponed Due to Flood Situation in Maharashtra
description: MPSC Prelims 2025 exam postponed due to floods in Maharashtra. Check new date, official updates, and preparation tips for aspirants.
content:
The Civil Services Gazetted Combined Preliminary Examination 2025 has been formally postponed by the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC). Originally set for September 28, 2025, the exam will now take place on November 9, 2025.

This choice was made in light of the flood-like conditions and intense rains that have affected transport and communication in numerous Maharashtra districts.

Key Highlights of MPSC Prelims 2025 Postponement

  1. Date of Original Exam: September 28, 2025
  2. Date of the New Exam: November 9, 2025
  3. Floods, heavy rains, and poor connection throughout villages and talukas were the reasons for the postponement.
  4. Exam Centers: 37 districts with 524 sub-centers
  5. Official Notice: posted on the official MPSC website

Why Was the Exam Postponed?

In some regions of Maharashtra, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) has warned of ongoing, intense rains. Floods have badly damaged several regions, making it dangerous for candidates to travel or make exam preparations.

The commission made the decision to put student safety first and postpone the MPSC exam because it draws thousands of applicants from both urban and rural locations.

MPSC Exam 2025: Updated Schedule

 

Exam Name Old Date New Date Reason for Change
MPSC Civil Services Prelims 2025 28 Sept 2025 9 Nov 2025 Floods and heavy rainfall across districts

What Should Students Do Now?

  1. Update the syllabus. Completely: Make the most of the extra time by practicing more last year's question papers and mock exams.
  2. Keep abreast of any updates by often visiting the official MPSC website.
  3. Plan Your Trip Early: Because the centers are dispersed over 37 districts, make sure you have your travel plans in place before you go.
  4. Maintain Documents on Hand: It is important to have IDs, admit cards, and other documentation on hand.

 

Final Thoughts

Although the MPSC Prelims 2025 postponement may cause anxiety, it also allows candidates more time to get ready. Students should use this time to thoroughly review and take more practice exams rather than lose steam.

Candidates now have more than a month to improve their study and aspire for success as the exam is now set for November 9, 2025.

title: IIM లక్నో ఫ్యామిలీ బిజినెస్ MBA: CAT లేకుండా ఎవరు దరఖాస్తు చేయవచ్చు?
description: MBA-FB కోసం కుటుంబ వ్యాపార అర్హత, ₹20 కోట్ల నిబంధన, అంగీకరించే పరీక్షలు, రెండు దశల దరఖాస్తు గడువులను తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
IIM లక్నో MBA in Family Businessలో GMAT, GRE లేదా సంస్థ ప్రవేశ పరీక్ష ద్వారా దరఖాస్తు చేసే అవకాశం ఉంది. కుటుంబ వ్యాపారాల యజమానులు, తదుపరి తరం సభ్యుల కోసం ఈ కోర్సు రూపొందించారు. సాధారణ MBA ఎంపికగా భావించే ముందు వ్యాపారానికి సంబంధించిన అర్హత నిబంధనలను చూడండి.

ముందుగా కుటుంబ వ్యాపార నిబంధనను చూడండి

అధికారిక దరఖాస్తు సూచనల ప్రకారం అభ్యర్థి కుటుంబ వ్యాపార యజమాని లేదా వారసుడు కావాలి. వ్యాపారంలో పెట్టుబడి లేదా వార్షిక టర్నోవర్ కనీసం ₹20 కోట్లు ఉండాలి. ఇంటర్వ్యూకు ఎంపికైనవారు ఫారంలో తెలిపిన వ్యాపార వివరాలకు ఆధార పత్రాలు సమర్పించాలి.

10+2+3 లేదా 10+2+4 విద్యా విధానంలో బ్యాచిలర్ డిగ్రీ లేదా సమాన విద్యార్హతలో కనీసం 50% మార్కులు లేదా సమాన CGPA అవసరం. విశ్వవిద్యాలయం CGPA మార్పిడి సూత్రం ఇచ్చినట్లయితే దానినే ఉపయోగించాలి. అలాంటి సూత్రం లేనప్పుడు IIM లక్నో అనుసరించే పద్ధతి దరఖాస్తు పేజీలో ఉంది.

ఏ పరీక్ష స్కోరు అంగీకరిస్తారు?

చెల్లుబాటయ్యే GMAT లేదా GRE స్కోరు, లేదా IIM లక్నో ప్రవేశ పరీక్షను జాబితాలో పేర్కొన్నారు. MBA-FB ప్రవేశ మార్గంగా CAT లేదు. పరీక్ష కేంద్రంలో రాసిన GMAT లేదా GRE స్కోర్లనే అంగీకరిస్తారు. దరఖాస్తు చివరి తేదీ వరకు స్కోరు చెల్లుబాటు కావాలి. సంస్థ ప్రవేశ పరీక్ష నోయిడా క్యాంపస్‌లో జరుగుతుంది.

IIM లక్నో ఇతర కోర్సుల పరీక్ష లేదా పని అనుభవ నిబంధనలు దీనికీ వర్తిస్తాయని అనుకోకండి. MBA-FB సూచనలనే చదవండి.

ఫీజు చెల్లించే ముందు ఫారం సిద్ధం చేయండి

మొదటి దశ దరఖాస్తు గడువు 31 డిసెంబర్ 2026; రెండో దశకు 2 ఏప్రిల్ 2027. దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు ₹3,000. అది తిరిగి ఇవ్వరు. ఫారాన్ని ఆన్‌లైన్‌లోనే సమర్పించాలి.

ఫొటో, సంతకం, వర్తించే పరీక్ష స్కోరు పత్రం, పాఠశాల సర్టిఫికెట్లు, మార్కుల జాబితాలు, ఫారం కోరిన కలిపిన డిగ్రీ మరియు సెమిస్టర్ మార్కుల పత్రాలను సిద్ధం చేసుకోండి. వర్తిస్తే కేటగిరీ లేదా వైకల్య ధ్రువీకరణ పత్రాలు కూడా ఉంచుకోండి. వ్యాపార వివరాలను ఆధార రికార్డులతో సరిపోల్చండి.

సమర్పించే ముందు పలుమార్లు ప్రివ్యూ చూడవచ్చు. సమర్పించిన తరువాత మార్పులకు అనుమతి లేదు. చివరి క్లిక్‌కు ముందు పేరు, స్కోరు, అర్హతలు, అప్‌లోడ్ చేసిన ఫైళ్లను జాగ్రత్తగా చూడండి.

వ్యాపారం నుంచి కేటాయించాల్సిన సమయాన్ని లెక్కించండి

కోర్సు అధికారిక పేజీ ప్రకారం ఇది నోయిడా క్యాంపస్‌లో రెండేళ్ల MBA. ప్రతి నెల ఏడు రోజుల క్యాంపస్ మాడ్యూల్స్ ఉంటాయి. సొంత కుటుంబ వ్యాపారంపై పని చేసే ప్రాజెక్టులు కూడా ఉన్నాయి. దరఖాస్తు చేసే ముందు ఈ హాజరు అవసరాన్ని, వ్యాపారంలో కొనసాగించాల్సిన బాధ్యతలను చర్చించండి.

title: Assam NEET UG 2026: Choice Filling Extended to 6 November
description: Assam DME has extended special stray MBBS and round 5 BDS choice filling to 6 November, 10 pm. Check the revised locking window, 8 November result date and admission instructions.
content:
Assam's Directorate of Medical Education has extended choice filling to 6 November 2026, 10 pm for special stray MBBS counselling and round 5 BDS counselling under the state quota in government medical and dental colleges. The revised notice also moves the provisional result to 8 November. Use the new schedule when reviewing your choices.

The revised choice and allotment schedule

DME Assam's notice dated 5 November 2026 changes the remaining stages as follows. All dates in this table are in November 2026.

Stage

Revised date or window

Finish online choice filling

6 November, up to 10 pm

Lock your choices

6 November, 5 pm to 11:59 pm

Seat-allotment processing

7 November

Result and admission modalities

8 November

Admission at the allotted institution

16 November, as directed

Directorate of Medical Education, Assam, educational notice dated 5 November 2026. Read the revised official notice.

Choice filling and locking have different cutoffs

Open the choice-filling link from the DME Assam website and review the course and institution preferences saved in your account. Arrange them in the order you want considered, then check the complete list before locking.

The new locking window begins at 5 pm on 6 November and ends at 11:59 pm. The notice says choices will be locked automatically after that window if the candidate has not locked them earlier. Do not mistake the later locking cutoff for extra time to fill choices: filling ends at 10 pm.

The extension does not change the eligibility rules

The 5 November notice says all other conditions remain unchanged. Read it with the original 3 November counselling notice, including the restrictions concerning candidates who have already joined a seat.

The original notice allows candidates who already registered and participated up to the state stray round to take part in choice filling without registering again, subject to eligibility. This choice-filling extension should not be treated as an announcement of a fresh registration window.

Check the result together with the joining instructions

DME Assam will display the result and admission modalities on 8 November after processing allotments on 7 November. If provisionally selected, follow the directions for admission at your allotted institution on 16 November. Read the published instructions before travelling or arranging payment.

These are Assam state counselling dates. Keep them separate from the MCC special stray round and other states' schedules.

title: MAH MBA CET 2025: Latest Updates on Admit Card Release and Exam Details
description: Get the latest updates on MAH MBA CET 2025, including admit card release, exam dates, normalization process, and important guidelines. Stay informed with crucial news and exam day instructions to ensure a smooth experience.
content:
The Maharashtra Common Entrance Test (MAH MBA CET) 2025 is a significant examination for aspirants aiming to secure admission into premier management programs across Maharashtra. As the exam dates approach, several crucial updates have been announced:​

Admit Card Release

The State Common Entrance Test Cell, Maharashtra, has released the admit cards for MAH MBA CET 2025. Candidates who have registered for the exam can now download their hall tickets from the official website: cetcell.mahacet.org. To access the admit card, candidates need to log in using their application number and date of birth. It's imperative to carry a printed copy of the admit card to the examination center, as entry without it will not be permitted. ​

Exam Schedule

The MAH MBA CET 2025 is scheduled to be conducted on April 1, 2, and 3, 2025, across various examination centres. The exam will be held in two shifts each day:​

  • Morning Shift: 7:30 AM to 11:30 AM​

  • Afternoon Shift: 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM​

Candidates can find their specific exam date, shift timing, and venue details on their respective admit cards. ​

Normalisation Process Announcement

On March 24, 2025, the State CET Cell introduced a normalization process for the MAH MBA CET 2025. This method aims to ensure fairness and equity in scoring, accounting for any variations in difficulty levels across different exam sessions. Detailed information about the normalization procedure is available on the official CET Cell website. ​

Important Notice Regarding Scam Calls

The State CET Cell has issued a warning to candidates about fraudulent activities and scam calls related to the MAH MBA CET 2025 admissions. Aspirants are advised to rely solely on official communications from the CET Cell and to report any suspicious activities immediately. Staying vigilant will help ensure a secure and legitimate admission process. ​

Exam Day Guidelines

To ensure a smooth examination experience, candidates must adhere to the following guidelines:

  • Admit Card: Carry a printed copy of the admit card downloaded from the official CET Cell website.​

  • Photo Identification: Bring an original, valid photo ID such as PAN card, Driving License, Voter ID, Passport, or Aadhaar Card. Ensure the name matches the one on the admit card.​

  • Photograph: Have a passport-size photograph (same as uploaded during application) for the attendance sheet.​

  • PwD Certificate: If applicable, carry the necessary PwD certificate or UDID card issued by the competent authority.​

Candidates are encouraged to visit the official website regularly for the latest updates and to ensure compliance with all examination protocols. Proper preparation and adherence to guidelines will contribute to a successful examination experience.​

title: Scholarship Renewal 2026: Can an Aadhaar-Bank Mismatch Stop Payment?
description: An Aadhaar-bank mismatch can delay or stop scholarship renewal payment. Check identity, bank, attendance and document records before submission.
content:
Yes, an Aadhaar and bank mismatch can delay or stop a Scholarship renewal 2026 payment if the scheme checks identity and account details before transfer. Before submitting, compare your name, date of birth, Aadhaar details, bank account and college records line by line. One missing initial or wrong digit can hold up money meant for fees.

The exact payment rule belongs to the scholarship scheme and its administering authority. Your college scholarship cell must confirm whether the scheme uses Aadhaar-based payment, direct bank transfer or another approved route. Deadlines also vary during the 2026 renewal cycle, so treat the date in the current scheme notice as the working deadline.

Which mismatches can stop or delay renewal payment?

Renewal is a record-matching exercise, not just a form submission. The records should identify the same student and point to an active, usable account.

  • Identity: Compare your name, date of birth and gender across the renewal form, Aadhaar and college record. Check initials, spacing and surname order.
  • Aadhaar: Confirm that the number entered belongs to you and that the details required for verification are current.
  • Bank account: Check the account number, IFSC, branch and account holder name. A closed, dormant or incorrect account may cause a returned payment.
  • College record: Verify course, year, enrolment number, category, promotion status and attendance with the institution.
  • Documents: Keep readable copies of the marksheet, income certificate, caste or community certificate, fee receipt and previous scholarship proof if the scheme asks for them.

What should you verify before clicking submit?

Use your passbook or a bank-issued confirmation, not memory. Ask the bank whether the account is active and whether Aadhaar seeding or the payment mapping required by your scheme is complete. The bank handles account-side corrections; the college cannot fix an incorrect IFSC or account number.

  1. Print or save the draft renewal form.
  2. Mark every identity and payment field.
  3. Compare them with your Aadhaar, passbook and college ID.
  4. Ask the scholarship cell to verify attendance, promotion and course details.
  5. Save the submitted form, acknowledgement number and any correction request.

If your account is in a parent’s name, don’t assume it will pass. Some schemes require the student to hold the account, while the controlling notice decides the actual condition. You can also check relevant aid options through scholarships listed on DekhoCampus.

What if you find the mismatch after submission?

Contact the college scholarship nodal officer and ask whether the application can be returned for correction. For an Aadhaar error, use an authorised Aadhaar service channel. For an account or IFSC error, visit the bank. Keep written proof of each request. “Submitted” means the form entered processing; it doesn’t mean payment has cleared.

title: A Practical Guide to Indian Education Loans: Eligibility, Interest Subsidies, and Application Timelines
description: A clear, grounded overview of education loan options for Indian students and parents, covering who qualifies, subsidy schemes, interest relief, and key timeline milestones for applications.
content:
Understanding who can borrow and what you can borrow

Education loans in India are designed to cover tuition, books, accommodation, and other approved expenses for courses at recognized institutions. Eligibility typically hinges on the student being an Indian national or a resident, admission to a recognized course, and an approved collateral and co-borrower framework for larger loan amounts. Most lenders assess the student’s academic plan, the chosen course, and the cost of attendance. Parents or guardians usually act as co-borrowers, and some lenders offer loans in the student’s name with a parent as the primary applicant.

Common eligibility touchpoints

  • Admission to a recognized higher education program (UG, PG, or diploma) in India or abroad with lender-approved institutions.
  • Proof of admission letters, fee structure, and course details.
  • A borrower or co-borrower with a stable income or collateral for higher loan amounts, depending on the bank’s norms.
  • Depending on the loan size, collateral may be required for loans above a set threshold; some schemes offer collateral-free options up to a limit.
  • Minimum age and nationality requirements as specified by the lender.

Subsidies, interest relief, and government-supported schemes

Several government-backed schemes target students from economically weaker sections and first-time borrowers. Subsidies effectively lower interest burdens during study and for a grace period after course completion. Details vary by scheme and year, so verify the current terms on the official portal or with the lending institution.

  • Interest subsidies may apply during the course period and sometimes extend into the repayment phase for eligible students.
  • Some programs provide partial or full interest relief during the moratorium period, depending on category and course type.
  • Issue of scholarships and fee waivers can influence the total loan requirement and repayment schedule.

Remember that subsidies and interest relief are subject to eligibility and program-specific rules. If you are unsure about a subsidy’s applicability, check the current guidelines on the official government or issuing authority’s website and confirm with your lender before applying.

Timeline essentials: applying for an education loan

Planning ahead helps avoid last-minute hurdles. Here are practical milestones to align with your application timeline.

  • Early preparation (2-3 months before admission): gather academic records, identity documents, and proof of income for co-borrowers. Start conversations with potential lenders about required documents and eligibility.
  • Course and institution confirmation: secure admission and obtain an admission letter with cost breakdown and fee structure.
  • Loan pre-approval checks: approach banks or financial institutions to understand loan products, interest rates, and processing times. Some lenders offer faster pre-approval for applicants with strong academic credentials or existing relations.
  • Document submission: complete the loan application and attach income proofs, address verification, and admission-related documents. Some banks require collateral or co-borrower details at this stage.
  • Processing and sanction: the lender will verify documents, assess repayment capacity, and determine the loan amount and tenure. Sanction letters are issued upon approval.
  • Disbursement: funds are typically released in installments aligned with tuition payment milestones or directly to the educational institution. Ensure you have a disbursement plan that matches fee deadlines.

Note that processing times can vary widely-from a couple of days to several weeks-depending on the loan size, collateral requirements, and the lender’s workflow. Always build in extra time to accommodate document gaps or a need for clarifications.

Smart steps to manage your loan efficiently

Good planning makes repayment smoother. Consider these practical tips as you navigate the process.

  • Compare lender terms: interest rates, moratorium periods, processing fees, and repayment tenures. A small difference in rate can affect overall cost significantly over the full term.
  • Factor in total cost: include processing fees, insurance, and any ancillary charges when calculating the loan burden.
  • Assess collateral requirements: if a loan is collateral-free up to a threshold, confirm the exact limit and whether parental or other guarantees are necessary.
  • Mind the grace period: many loans offer a moratorium or repayment holiday after course completion. Plan repayment by budgeting monthly installments ahead of time.
  • Stay organized: keep digital copies of all sanction letters, repayment schedules, and correspondence. Set reminders for due dates and annual review points.

What to verify before you apply

Because terms can change, double-check key details with the lender and the official program guidelines. Important confirmations include:

  • Whether the course qualifies for subsidized or interest-relief options under current schemes.
  • The exact list of eligible institutions and courses for the loan product you plan to use.
  • Any changes to the moratorium period or repayment tenure based on the borrower’s category or course type.
  • Documentation requirements for co-borrowers, including proof of income and identity.

Visible FAQ

Who is eligible for an education loan in India?

Eligibility generally includes admission to a recognized program, Indian nationality, and eligibility criteria set by the lender. A co-borrower and potential collateral may be required for higher loan amounts.

What subsidies or interest relief options exist?

Several government-backed schemes provide subsidized interest or relief during the study period and sometimes beyond. Specific terms depend on the scheme and current guidelines.

How long does the loan application process take?

Processing times vary by lender and loan size. It can take from a few days to several weeks, depending on document adequacy and verification needs.

What documents are typically required?

Common documents include admission letters, identity and address proofs, income proofs for co-borrowers, academic records, and up-to-date fee structures. Collateral or guarantor details may be requested for larger loans.

When is the best time to apply?

Start 2-3 months before the start of the course, or as soon as admission is confirmed, to ensure funds are available when fees are due.

If details below seem uncertain, verify the current rules on the official authority’s site or with your lender before moving ahead. Loan terms shift with policy changes, and accurate timelines help you plan more effectively.

Key takeaways

  • Eligibility hinges on admission, nationality, and lender-specific criteria, with co-borrower and collateral as common considerations.
  • Subsidies and interest relief can reduce overall costs but depend on the program and borrower category.
  • Start the process well before fees are due to avoid funding gaps.
  • Compare terms across lenders to find the best combination of rate, tenure, and affordability.

title: CBSE 12th Result 2026 Finally Released: Download Your Marksheet in Minutes
description: CBSE Class 12 Result 2026 is now available online at results.cbse.nic.in. Check direct result link, overall pass percentage, gender-wise statistics, DigiLocker and UMANG marksheet download steps, region-wise performance, compartment updates, and more.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Result 2026 Declared: Students Can Download Scorecards Online

The Central Board of Secondary Education has officially released the CBSE Class 12 Board Result 2026 for students across the country. Candidates who appeared in the senior secondary examinations can now access their scorecards through the official CBSE portals and digital services including DigiLocker and UMANG.

The announcement has brought an end to the long wait for lakhs of students from Science, Commerce, and Humanities streams who appeared in the annual board examinations conducted earlier this year. According to the official data released by the board, the overall success rate for CBSE Class 12 students stands at 85.20%.

Students can now view their marks online using their examination credentials and download provisional marksheets for admission and counselling purposes.

CBSE Class 12 Result 2026: Key Highlights

Particulars Details
Board Name Central Board of Secondary Education
Examination CBSE Class 12 Board Exam 2026
Result Status Released
Result Date 13 May 2026
Overall Pass Percentage 85.20%
Official Websites results.cbse.nic.in, cbse.gov.in
Result Mode Online
Credentials Required Roll Number, School Number, Admit Card ID

More Than 15 Lakh Students Cleared the Examination

This year, approximately 17.68 lakh students appeared for the CBSE Class 12 examinations held between February and April. Out of the total candidates, more than 15 lakh students successfully qualified the board exams.

The board conducted the examinations at thousands of centres across India while ensuring smooth coordination and digital evaluation procedures.

Girls Continue to Outperform Boys in CBSE 12th Results

The latest result statistics reveal that female students once again performed better than male candidates in the board examinations.

Gender-Wise Performance

Category Pass Percentage
Girls 88.86%
Boys 82.13%
Overall 85.20%
CWSN Students 90.16%

The performance gap between girls and boys was recorded at 6.73 percentage points.

Top Performing Regions in CBSE Class 12 Result 2026

Among all CBSE regions, Trivandrum secured the highest performance with a pass percentage above 95%.

Best Performing Regions

Region Pass Percentage
Trivandrum 95.62%
Delhi West 92.34%
Delhi East 91.73%
Chennai Strong Performance
Bengaluru Strong Performance

Prayagraj recorded the lowest regional performance this year.

Institution-Wise Success Rate

Educational institutions under central government systems once again delivered remarkable results.

Institute Performance Statistics

  • Kendriya Vidyalayas (KV): 98.55%
  • Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalayas (JNV): 98.47%
  • Independent Schools: 84.22%

These institutions continued to maintain strong academic records in the CBSE board examinations.

Official Websites to Check CBSE 12th Result 2026

Students can access their results through multiple online platforms:

  • Official CBSE Result Portal
  • CBSE Main Website
  • DigiLocker
  • UMANG Application
  • SMS Services

The board activated alternative platforms to reduce pressure on official websites during peak traffic hours.

How to Check CBSE 12th Result 2026 Online

Students can follow these instructions to access their scorecards:

  1. Visit the official CBSE result portal.
  2. Open the Class 12 result section.
  3. Enter roll number, school number, admit card ID, and date of birth.
  4. Submit the details carefully.
  5. The marksheet will appear on the screen.
  6. Download and save the result PDF.

Students are advised to keep printed copies for future admission processes.

Download CBSE Marksheet Through DigiLocker

CBSE has uploaded digital documents for students through DigiLocker.

Steps to Access Marksheet

  1. Open the DigiLocker application or website.
  2. Login using the registered mobile number.
  3. Verify identity through Aadhaar if required.
  4. Search for CBSE documents.
  5. Select Class 12 marksheet.
  6. Enter examination details and download the certificate.

Migration certificates and passing certificates are also available digitally.

How to Access Result on UMANG App

Students can also use the UMANG mobile application to check results instantly.

Process to Check Result

  1. Install the UMANG app.
  2. Login using your mobile number.
  3. Search for CBSE services.
  4. Select the Class 12 result section.
  5. Enter required credentials.
  6. Download the digital scorecard.

This option becomes especially useful if websites slow down due to heavy traffic.

Click here to check your result: https://cbseresults.nic.in

CBSE Introduced Digital Evaluation System

The board continued the digital evaluation process this year to improve transparency and reduce calculation errors. Teachers assessed answer sheets through an on-screen marking system, helping streamline the evaluation process and improve accuracy.

Compartment Category Details Released

According to official data, over 1.63 lakh students have been placed in the compartment category this year. These students will receive another opportunity to clear failed subjects through supplementary examinations expected later in the academic session.

CBSE will soon release detailed notifications regarding:

  • Supplementary exam dates
  • Verification of marks
  • Revaluation process
  • Photocopy of answer sheets

Important Details Mentioned on CBSE Scorecard

The provisional marksheet includes:

  • Student Name
  • Roll Number
  • Parents’ Names
  • Subject Names and Codes
  • Subject-Wise Marks
  • Grades
  • Result Status
  • School Name and Code

Students should immediately report any discrepancies to school authorities.

Understanding CBSE Moderation Policy

CBSE follows a moderation process to maintain fairness during evaluation. In previous years, moderation often increased marks significantly. However, recent reforms focus more on realistic scoring and limited grace marks instead of excessive inflation.

The revised moderation approach aims to:

  • Maintain fairness across question papers
  • Standardise evaluation methods
  • Reduce unrealistic score inflation
  • Ensure accurate academic assessment

CBSE 12th Result Performance Trend Over the Years

Year Overall Pass Percentage
2026 85.20%
2024 87.98%
2023 87.33%
2022 92.71%
2021 99.37%
2020 88.78%

The latest figures show a decline compared to recent years, indicating a stricter and more balanced evaluation system.

What Students Should Do After Result Declaration

Following the result announcement, students can begin preparations for:

  • University admissions
  • CUET counselling
  • Engineering and medical entrance counselling
  • Scholarship applications
  • Professional certification courses

Students are advised to collect original marksheets and certificates from schools once officially distributed.

title: CBSE Class 10 Computer, IT and AI Exam 2027: Date, Codes and Two-Hour Slot
description: Computer Applications, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence are on 24 February 2027. Match codes 165, 402 and 417 and the 12:30 pm finish.
content:
CBSE Class 10 Computer Applications, IT and AI are scheduled for 24 February 2027, in the 10:30 am to 12:30 pm IST slot. Check subject codes 165, 402 and 417.

The official CBSE date sheet issued on 6 November 2026 combines Classes 10 and 12. Use the Class 10 section and your school registration details to find the correct entry.

Read the official CBSE date-sheet PDF

Central Board of Secondary Education, date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. Open the original official document.

Three different subjects share the same date

Computer Applications is code 165, Information Technology is 402 and Artificial Intelligence is 417. The three entries share 24 February and the 10:30 am to 12:30 pm IST slot. Matching the date is not enough: match the subject code in your school record too.

A student registered for one of these subjects should prepare for that course. The common time slot does not mean the three subjects have the same syllabus, question paper or assessment requirements.

Notice the earlier finish

These entries have a two-hour scheduled slot. Many major Class 10 subjects in the same PDF finish at 1:30 pm, so copying that finish time onto every row of a personal timetable would be incorrect.

Keep both start and finish times in your calendar. Use school and admit-card directions for entry and reporting arrangements; the 10:30 am start is not a suggested gate-arrival time.

Plan around Science and English

Science is on 22 February, leaving 23 February as the single intervening calendar date before this computer-subject slot. English follows on 26 February, with 25 February between the two papers. That short sequence makes advance preparation particularly useful.

Keep project, practical or internal-assessment instructions from school separately. The theory date in the main board timetable should not be treated as a new deadline for every component of the subject.

For the wider timetable, see the CBSE 2027 date-sheet guide and official PDF. Keep the complete source document with your personal subject list.

title: CBSE Class 10 and 12 Sample Question Papers 2027: Expected Release Timeline, Blueprint Shifts, and Marking Schemes
description: A comprehensive guide on CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 Sample Question Papers for 2027, covering the expected release schedule, blueprint shifts toward competency-based questions, marking schemes, and subject-wise preparation tips.
content:
CBSE Class 10 and 12 Sample Question Papers 2027: Overview

As the academic session 2026-2027 progresses, millions of students across India preparing for the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) Class 10 and Class 12 examinations are eagerly waiting for the official release of Sample Question Papers (SQPs). These sample papers serve as the gold standard for understanding the final board exam structure, question distribution, difficulty level, and marking conventions. In line with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, CBSE has systematically shifted its assessment philosophy from rote memorization toward application-oriented and skill-focused evaluation. Preparing with the latest sample papers enables students to align their study techniques with official expectations well before the board exams kick off in early 2027.

Expected Release Timeline for CBSE SQPs 2027

Historically, CBSE releases official sample question papers along with their corresponding marking schemes in the month of September for the ongoing academic year. For the 2026-2027 academic session, the board is expected to publish the Class 10 and Class 12 SQPs in the first or second week of September 2026.

Students, teachers, and parents can access the official documents directly on the official academic portal of CBSE. It is always recommended to verify documents directly from the central board website rather than relying on unverified third-party releases or speculative blueprints circulating online.

Key Blueprint Shifts and Question Weightage for 2027

Over the past few academic cycles, CBSE has progressively enhanced the percentage of competency-based questions in board papers. For the 2027 examinations, this pattern reaches an advanced level of implementation across core subjects.

1. High Ratio of Competency-Based Questions (CBQs)

In Class 10 and Class 12, competency-based questions are expected to constitute up to 50 percent of the total paper weightage. These formats include:

  • Case-study based questions with real-world scenarios
  • Source-based integrated questions
  • Assertion and reasoning-based multiple-choice items
  • Data interpretation and diagrammatic application problems

2. Restructuring of Short and Long Answer Sections

To accommodate higher competency weightage, traditional short-answer and long-answer questions have been streamlined. While total question counts may remain similar to previous years, questions now require concise, concept-focused explanations rather than lengthy memorized summaries.

3. Objective-Type Questions and MCQs

Multiple-Choice Questions (MCQs) will continue to account for approximately 20 percent of the question paper. These objective items test quick conceptual clarity, critical thinking, and accuracy under tight time constraints.

Understanding the CBSE 2027 Marking Scheme

Along with the sample question papers, CBSE issues detailed marking schemes that reveal how examiners grade answer scripts. Understanding step-wise marking is crucial for achieving high scores in board exams.

  • Step-Marking Rules: Partial marks are awarded for logical intermediate steps in numerical problems, correct formula statements, partial derivations, and key technical terms in theoretical answers.
  • Internal Choice Structure: Internal options are provided within specific sections rather than giving an overall paper choice. Students get options in select short-answer and long-answer questions of equal difficulty.
  • Word Count Precision: Marking guidelines instruct evaluators to focus on key concept points rather than exact word lengths. Writing clear, bulleted answers often yields higher precision and speed.
  • Internal Assessment Balance: For subjects with an 80-mark written exam, 20 marks are reserved for internal assessments, practical project work, and periodic tests. For practical-heavy subjects in Class 12 (such as Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and Geography), written papers carry 70 marks while practicals carry 30 marks.

Subject-Wise Strategy for Class 10 and 12 Students

Adapting your study approach to the blueprint shifts requires subject-specific adjustments:

  • Mathematics (Class 10 & 12): Focus on case-study problems derived from real-world applications. Ensure complete step-by-step presentation, including formulas and clearly highlighted final units.
  • Sciences (Physics, Chemistry, Biology): Practice graph interpretation, numerical derivations, and diagram labeling. Read conceptual reasoning questions carefully to identify the underlying principle before answering.
  • Social Science & Humanities: Work on source-based passages, map work precision, and structured analytical responses with distinct sub-headings.
  • Languages (English Core/Elective): Develop efficient reading comprehension speed and master prescribed formats for creative writing and formal correspondence.

Step-by-Step Guide to Download CBSE Sample Papers 2027

  1. Visit the official CBSE academic portal (cbseacademic.nic.in).
  2. Navigate to the Sample Question Paper section on the top menu bar.
  3. Select SQP 2026-2027 and choose Class X or Class XII.
  4. Click on the subject name to download the official Question Paper PDF and corresponding Marking Scheme PDF.
  5. Save both files for periodic timed practice throughout your revision schedule.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

When will CBSE release Class 10 and 12 Sample Papers for 2027?

CBSE is expected to publish official sample papers for the 2026-2027 session in September 2026 on its official academic website.

What is the weightage of competency-based questions in CBSE 2027 board exams?

Competency-based questions are expected to account for up to 50 percent of the total marks in Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations.

Are CBSE sample question papers identical to the final board exam papers?

No, sample papers are designed to show the structure, section layout, question types, difficulty distribution, and marking rules. The actual exam questions will be different but will follow the exact same blueprint.

Where can students verify updates regarding exam pattern changes?

Students and parents should always check official announcements on the official CBSE websites (cbse.gov.in and cbseacademic.nic.in) to verify official blueprints and notices.

title: JET Agriculture 2026 Third Allotment: Check and Accept Your Seat
description: Rajasthan JET 2026 third provisional allotment is available in the candidate login. Allotted candidates must accept the seat and pay the online fee to avoid cancellation.
content:
The Rajasthan JET 2026 third provisional seat allotment is available in the candidate login. If a college has been allotted to you, the next step matters: the official JET portal says you must accept it by paying the online acceptance fee, or the provisional allotment will be cancelled. Open the SKRAU JET 2026 portal and check your own allotment before making a decision.


Check the allotment in your login


Sign in using your JET 2026 registration credentials. Read the allotted college, course, seat type and category carefully. The public alert does not display your personal allotment, so a general list or a third-party claim cannot tell you whether you received a seat. Keep your login details private.


The Swami Keshwanand Rajasthan Agricultural University, Bikaner, posted a 2 November alert telling candidates to log in for the third provisional allotment. It also warns that an allotted seat needs online acceptance fee payment to remain valid. Read the live official alert for the complete instruction.

Swami Keshwanand Rajasthan Agricultural University, Bikaner, JET 2026 portal alert dated 2 November 2026. Read the original official alert.

Accepting a seat and checking the schedule


If you intend to keep the allotted seat, follow the acceptance and payment steps shown inside your account. Do not treat a viewed allotment as an accepted one. Save the payment confirmation and any acknowledgement generated by the portal.


Before paying, open the university's revised JET, Pre-PG and Pre-PhD counselling schedule. Check the row for your round and programme for its exact acceptance and reporting deadlines. The public alert itself does not state those deadlines, so use the current official schedule and the instructions in your login.


What if the college or category looks wrong?


Compare the details in your login with your submitted option form and documents. The JET cut-off guide explains why college, seat type and category must be matched before comparing cut-offs; it does not override your allotment record. If something appears incorrect, contact the official JET help desk through the portal before the relevant deadline. Avoid sending your password or payment details to anyone offering to change a seat.
