title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1: Should You Attempt It Early?
description: Should you take JEE Main 2027 Session 1 or wait for Session 2? Compare preparation readiness, correction rules, score review and planning risks.
content:
JEE Main 2027 Session 1 is worth attempting when most of your syllabus is covered and timed mocks show reasonably steady accuracy. If several major chapters remain untouched, waiting for Session 2 may protect your preparation, but you’ll lose an early exam benchmark. The right choice depends on readiness, not pressure.

NTA has not confirmed the 2027 dates, fees or exact attempt conditions in the available evidence. Check the official JEE Main website for the information bulletin, registration notice and correction-window instructions before acting.

Should you choose JEE Main 2027 Session 1 or wait?

Choose JEE Main 2027 Session 1 if you can complete full Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics papers under time limits and review every wrong answer. Session 2 gives you more preparation time, but a late weak performance leaves less room for admission planning and counselling decisions.

Your present positionPractical choiceLikely consequence
Most Class 11 and 12 topics are covered; mocks are regularConsider Session 1You get real data on speed, accuracy and question selection.
Several major units are still untouchedPrioritise Session 2 preparationAn early paper may expose gaps without leaving enough repair time.
Concepts are known but calculation errors are frequentAttempt only with a repair planTargeted error practice can make the next attempt more useful.
You need an early reference for college planningTake Session 1 if readyUse the score as a reference, not as a final admission prediction.

What should you measure after the early attempt?

A Session 1 result becomes useful only when you inspect the details behind it. Record chapter-wise accuracy, guessed answers, time spent, unanswered questions and avoidable calculation mistakes. A low score from unfinished units needs syllabus repair; a similar score from poor time control needs timed mixed-question sets.

  1. Mark each error as a concept gap, calculation slip, misread question or bad time choice.
  2. Set a weekly repair list for Physics numericals, Chemistry revision and Mathematics problem sets.
  3. Take another full mock after the repair cycle and compare accuracy, not just total marks.

Registration and correction checks

Enter your name, date of birth, category, identity details and exam choices exactly as the NTA form requires. Don’t assume every field can be changed later. NTA will specify the editable fields, dates and any applicable charges in its 2027 notice.

  • Save the submitted form and payment confirmation.
  • Check the photograph, signature and category certificate details before the correction window closes.
  • Use subject-wise study material for targeted revision and entrance exam planning when comparing related routes.

JEE Main 2027 Session 1 isn’t automatically the smarter attempt. Sit it when the paper will give you information you can act on, not just another stressful score.

title: JEE Main 2027 കോളേജുകൾ: പട്ടിക തയ്യാറാക്കും മുമ്പ് പ്രവേശനവഴി നോക്കാം
description: NIT, IIIT, IIT പ്രവേശനവും പ്രത്യേകം അപേക്ഷ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്ന കോളേജുകളും വേർതിരിക്കാം. 2027 സീറ്റുകൾ, യോഗ്യത, ഫീസ് എന്നിവ പ്രവേശന അതോറിറ്റിയോട് ഉറപ്പാക്കുക.
content:
JEE Main സ്കോർ സ്വീകരിക്കുന്ന എല്ലാ കോളേജുകളും ഒരേ പ്രവേശനരീതി പിന്തുടരണമെന്നില്ല. 2027ലെ പദ്ധതിയിൽ NIT, IIIT പ്രവേശനവഴി, JEE Advanced വഴിയുള്ള IIT പ്രവേശനം, സ്വന്തം അപേക്ഷയുള്ള സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവ വേർതിരിക്കുക. നല്ല സ്കോർ കിട്ടിയിട്ടും മറ്റൊരു അപേക്ഷാഘട്ടം വിട്ടുപോകുന്നത് ഒഴിവാക്കാൻ ഇത് സഹായിക്കും.

JEE Main പരീക്ഷയും IIT പ്രവേശനവും വ്യത്യസ്ത ഘട്ടങ്ങൾ

ഔദ്യോഗിക JEE Main 2027 ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ പ്രകാരം NIT, IIIT, കേന്ദ്ര ധനസഹായമുള്ള മറ്റു സാങ്കേതിക സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ, പങ്കെടുക്കുന്ന സംസ്ഥാന സർക്കാരുകളുടെ ധനസഹായമോ അംഗീകാരമോ ഉള്ള സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയിലെ ബിരുദ എൻജിനീയറിങ് പ്രവേശനത്തിനാണ് Paper 1 നടത്തുന്നത്.

IIT പ്രവേശനത്തിൽ JEE Main, JEE Advanced എഴുതാനുള്ള യോഗ്യതാ പരീക്ഷയാണ്. JEE Main കോളേജ് പട്ടികയിൽ IIT ഉൾപ്പെട്ടിട്ടുണ്ടെന്നതിനാൽ Main സ്കോർ മാത്രം നേരിട്ട് IIT പ്രവേശനം നൽകുമെന്ന് കരുതരുത്. Advancedന് ബാധകമായ നിബന്ധനകൾ പ്രത്യേകം പരിശോധിക്കുക.

NTAയുടെ JEE Main 2027 വിവര ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ, പേജ് 13, വകുപ്പ് 1.2: Main, Advanced പരീക്ഷകളുടെ പങ്ക്.

സീറ്റും പ്രവേശന യോഗ്യതയും ആരാണ് നിശ്ചയിക്കുന്നത്?

NTA പരീക്ഷ നടത്തുകയാണ് ചെയ്യുന്നത്. സ്ഥാപനങ്ങളുടെ ആകെ സീറ്റുകൾ, പ്രവേശന യോഗ്യത, സംവരണ മാനദണ്ഡങ്ങൾ എന്നിവയുടെ വിവരങ്ങൾ ശേഖരിക്കുന്നില്ലെന്ന് ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ പറയുന്നു. അവ പ്രവേശനം നൽകുന്ന അതോറിറ്റിയിൽ നിന്നുതന്നെ അറിയണം.

ഫലവും റാങ്കും വന്നതിനുശേഷമുള്ള സീറ്റ് അലോട്ട്മെന്റിന് JoSAA, CSAB എന്നിവയെ സമീപിക്കണമെന്ന് 2027 ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ നിർദേശിക്കുന്നു. നടപടിക്രമം പിന്നീട് പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുമെന്നും പറയുന്നു. കേന്ദ്രീകൃത അലോട്ട്മെന്റിന് പുറത്തുള്ള സ്ഥാപനങ്ങൾ സ്വന്തം റാങ്കിങ്ങും മറ്റു മാനദണ്ഡങ്ങളും ഉപയോഗിച്ചേക്കാം. പഴയ സീറ്റ് പട്ടികയോ മുൻവർഷത്തെ അവസാന പ്രവേശന റാങ്കോ 2027ലെ ഉറപ്പായ അവസരമായി കാണരുത്.

വിരുപ്പട്ടികയിൽ പ്രവേശനരീതിക്ക് ഒരു കോളം ചേർക്കുക

ഓരോ കോളേജിനും ബ്രാഞ്ചിനും ഔദ്യോഗിക പ്രവേശന പേജ്, സ്വീകരിക്കുന്ന പരീക്ഷാ പേപ്പർ, കൗൺസലിങ് അതോറിറ്റി, പ്രത്യേക അപേക്ഷ ആവശ്യമാണോ എന്നിവ കുറിക്കുക. കോഴ്സിന്റെ യോഗ്യത, പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച ഫീസ്, അപേക്ഷാ സമയപരിധി എന്നിവ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട അറിയിപ്പ് ഉറപ്പാക്കിയ ശേഷം മാത്രം ചേർക്കുക.

  • സ്ഥാപനത്തിന് പല ക്യാമ്പസുകളുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ കൃത്യമായ ക്യാമ്പസും ബിരുദവും പരിശോധിക്കുക.

  • എൻജിനീയറിങ്, ആർക്കിടെക്ചർ, പ്ലാനിങ് എന്നിവയുടെ പേപ്പർ ആവശ്യങ്ങൾ വേർതിരിക്കുക.

  • സ്ഥാപനത്തിന്റെ പേര് മാത്രം ആശ്രയിക്കാതെ ബ്രാഞ്ച് അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പുകൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യുക.

  • പഴയ അവസാന റാങ്കിനൊപ്പം വർഷം, വിഭാഗം, ക്വോട്ട, റൗണ്ട് എന്നിവയും രേഖപ്പെടുത്തുക.

  • കൗൺസലിങ് മുൻഗണനകൾ ഉറപ്പിക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് നിലവിലെ സീറ്റ് മാട്രിക്സ് വീണ്ടും നോക്കുക.

ഉദാഹരണത്തിന്, PES Universityയിലെ JEE Main, KCET പ്രവേശനവഴികളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള ഗൈഡ് സർവകലാശാലയുടെ സ്വന്തം നടപടിക്രമം എന്തുകൊണ്ട് പ്രത്യേകം പരിശോധിക്കണമെന്ന് വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു. കേന്ദ്ര കൗൺസലിങ് പദ്ധതിക്കൊപ്പം അതും പരിഗണിക്കുക; രണ്ടിനും ഒരേ ചട്ടമെന്ന് കരുതരുത്.

സ്കോർ പ്രവേശനത്തിന്റെ ഒരു ഭാഗം മാത്രം

സീറ്റ് അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ പ്രവേശന സമയത്ത് രേഖാ പരിശോധന ഉണ്ടാകുമെന്ന് ബുള്ളറ്റിൻ പറയുന്നു. യോഗ്യതാ പരീക്ഷയുടെയും ബാധകമായ വിഭാഗത്തിന്റെയും രേഖകൾ തയ്യാറാക്കി വയ്ക്കുക. ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട അതോറിറ്റി നിർദേശിക്കുന്ന മാതൃകകളും ചട്ടങ്ങളും പാലിക്കുക. അപേക്ഷാ ഫീസോ സീറ്റ് സ്വീകരിക്കുന്നതിനുള്ള ഫീസോ അടയ്ക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് ആ കോഴ്സിന് നിങ്ങൾ യോഗ്യരാണെന്നും അടുത്ത നടപടി അറിയാമെന്നും ഉറപ്പാക്കുക.

title: IIT Guwahati Cutoff 2026: Marks, Ranks & Categories
description: Check IIT Guwahati JEE Advanced Cutoff 2026, branch-wise closing ranks, category-wise cutoffs, marks required and JoSAA counselling details.
content:
The IIT Guwahati JEE Advanced Cutoff 2026 helps students know the ranks they need to get into BTech courses at the Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati. The cutoff changes depending on the course, the category, the type of seat, and the round of counselling.

Students need to keep in mind that getting into IIT Guwahati depends on JEE Advanced results and then JoSAA counselling. The official JoSAA website shares the opening and closing ranks for every course and every category.

IIT Guwahati JEE Advanced Cutoff 2026: Branch-Wise Ranks

The following table shows selected closing ranks for Round 6, in the Open category gender-neutral seats under the All India quota, based on the 2026 counselling data.

Note: These are reported closing ranks, not marks. Candidates should verify each program and round using the official JoSAA portal before making admission decisions.

How Many Marks Are Required for IIT Guwahati?

There is no one JEE Advanced score that is required for every branch at IIT Guwahati. The score that matches a rank can be different every year based on how hard the exam was and how well the students did.

To get an idea of what might happen, students should look at their JEE Advanced rank and compare it with the closing ranks for each branch from previous years and the current year. They should not depend on a fixed score prediction.

Category-Wise IIT Guwahati Cutoff

Cutoffs differ across the following categories and seat types:

  • Open: Closing ranks are generally based on the Common Rank List (CRL).

  • GEN-EWS: EWS category rank applies.

  • OBC-NCL: OBC-NCL category rank applies.

  • SC and ST: Separate category ranks apply.

  • PwD: Applicable disability-related rank and reservation rules apply.

  • Female-only seats: Separate seat pools may have different closing ranks.

JoSAA Counselling for IIT Guwahati Admission 2026

Candidates can check the cutoff by following these steps:

  1. Visit the official JoSAA website.

  2. Open the 2026 opening and closing ranks section.

  3. Select IIT Guwahati as the institute.

  4. Choose the desired BTech program.

  5. Select the relevant category, seat type, and round.

  6. Compare the closing rank with your JEE Advanced rank.

Conclusion

The IIT Guwahati JEE Advanced Cutoff 2026 gives information to students who want to join engineering programs at IIT Guwahati. Among the branches, computer science, engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, and mathematics and computing have lower open-category closing ranks compared to many other branches. Getting admission depends on the JEE Advanced rank of the candidates' category, seat availability, the order of choices, and the counselling rules set by JoSAA.

Students should always check the JoSAA data before making their choices. They should not rely on estimated marks as a way to get admission. The actual cutoffs can change every year. It is important to stay updated with the latest information.

title: JEE Main 2027 registration windowDates required documents and steps to apply
description: Understand the 2027 JEE Main registration window, required documents, and a clear, step-by-step guide for Indian students and parents to complete the application accurately and on time.
content:
Skip ahead to the essentials: when to register, what you need, and how to apply

For Indian students preparing for engineering admissions, the JEE Main 2027 registration window marks the first critical milestone. Getting in early with the right documents and a precise checklist helps you avoid last‑minute hurdles. Below is a practical, date‑oriented guide with steps, required documents, and tips to keep the process smooth.

Key registration window and notifications

The National Testing Agency typically announces the JEE Main registration dates in advance of the first exam cycle. Expect a multi‑stage process that opens online, allows application edits within a specified window, and requires verification of details. Students should monitor the official portal for the exact opening date, the last date to submit, and any late‑fee provisions. If you miss the window, delayed registrations may not be possible or could incur penalties, so plan to apply within the official period.

Who should apply and when to start

  • Only eligible Indian nationals who meet the qualifying criteria for JEE Main 2027 should initiate the application.
  • Start gathering personal and academic details well before the registration opens. This includes your board marks, year of passing, and contact information.
  • If you are a parent assisting a dependent student, keep both your and the student’s credentials ready for the form, especially email IDs and mobile numbers used for verification.

Documents you will need (digital copies)

Prepare scan‑ready versions of the following commonly required documents. Availability and exact file formats may be specified during the application; use the highest‑quality scans you can comfortably upload.

  • Aadhaar card or any government‑issued identity document (for identity verification).
  • 12th standard or qualifying examination mark sheet (proof of passing or anticipated results with board details).
  • Class 12 or equivalent board details: board name, roll number, registration number (if applicable).
  • Recent passport‑size photograph as per the prescribed specifications.
  • Signature image as per the size and format guidelines.
  • Category certificate (if applicable) for reserved quotas or special categories.
  • PwD certificate (if applicable) for candidates requesting accommodations or concessions.
  • Payment proof or payment details for the application fee, as required by the portal.

The application steps you can expect

  1. Visit the official JEE Main registration portal when the window opens and choose the option to register as a new user.
  2. Provide basic details to create your login ID and password. Keep these credentials secure for future logins and admit card downloads.
  3. Fill the application form with personal data, academic information, and preferred examination subjects (Paper 1 for BE/BTech, Paper 2 for BArch and BPlan, depending on the year and structure).
  4. Upload the required documents in the specified formats. Ensure file sizes stay within the allowed limits.
  5. Review all entered information for accuracy. Use the preview option to catch any typographical or data errors.
  6. Pay the application fee online via the portal using the acceptable payment methods. Save the transaction receipt or payment confirmation number.
  7. Submit the form and print the confirmation page for your records. Do not rely on screenshots alone; keep the official confirmation as proof of submission.

Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

  • Inaccurate board or roll numbers: double‑check against your board certificate before submission.
  • Mismatch between name on documents: ensure consistency across all uploaded files.
  • Expired or incorrect photo: use a recent photo meeting the specified dimensions and keep a copy ready for future documents.
  • Incorrect exam paper choice: select Paper 1 (BE/BTech) or Paper 2 (BArch/BPlan) as per your intended course and eligibility in that year.
  • Delayed payment or failed transaction: keep a backup payment method and confirm the payment receipt on the portal.

Steps after submitting: what comes next

After submission, you typically receive an acknowledgement on the registration portal and via email or SMS. The admit card for JEE Main is released closer to the examination dates. Check the portal and the official communications for the exact admit card release date, exam city allotment, and any instructions about day‑of‑exam protocols. If any discrepancy appears in your submitted data, contact the official help desk promptly to resolve it.

Tips for parents supporting the process

  • Assist with document collection early, especially if your child studies away from home. Create a checklist with the required documents and upload deadlines.
  • Monitor communications for changes in the application window or guidelines. Official announcements are the authoritative source for date changes or procedural updates.
  • Help your child allocate time for accurate data entry and document uploads. Rushing near the deadline increases the likelihood of errors.

Frequently asked questions

When does the JEE Main 2027 registration window open?

The exact opening date will be announced by the official authority. Check the official portal regularly in the weeks leading up to the window and set reminders for the opening date.

What documents are required to apply?

Typically you will need a government identity document, education certificates or mark sheets, recent photographs, signatures, and category or PwD certificates if applicable. You should also have payment details for the application fee ready.

Can I edit information after submitting the form?

There is usually a limited window during which you can edit some details. After the final submission, edits are not always allowed, so review carefully before submitting.

What are the payment options for the application fee?

Online payment methods such as debit/credit cards and net banking are commonly accepted. Keep a receipt of the transaction for your records.

When will admit cards be released?

Admit cards are typically released a few weeks before the exam date. Download your admit card from the official portal and verify all personal details on it.

What should I do if there is a discrepancy in my submitted data?

Contact the official help desk immediately and follow the instructions provided. Do not wait until the exam to resolve the issue.

Bottom line

Preparing for the JEE Main 2027 registration window requires early organization of documents, careful data entry, and timely submission within the official window. By starting early, using a concrete checklist, and staying informed through the official authority portal, Indian students and parents can navigate the process with greater confidence and reduce the risk of avoidable errors.

Checklist at a glance

  • Track official announcements for the opening and closing dates of the registration window.
  • Assemble identity proof, educational certificates, photos, signatures, and category/PwD documents if needed.
  • Prepare scanned copies and ensure file formats meet the portal requirements.
  • Confirm name and data consistency across all documents.
  • Complete the online form accurately and review before submission.
  • Submit, save the confirmation, and note the application number for reference.
author: DekhoCampus Editorial

title: APLAI 2026: Telangana CET eligibility criteria and exam pattern explained
description: Understand who can apply, how Telangana CET is structured, eligibility requirements, and how to prepare for APL AI 2026 admissions in Telangana for Indian students and parents.
content:
Key takeaway for readers

Know who qualifies for Telangana CET under APL AI 2026, and how the exam pattern and eligibility timelines affect your application plan as a student or parent.

Overview of APL AI 2026 Telangana CET

APL AI 2026 refers to Telangana’s central entrance framework for admissions in technical and allied programs. Exam pattern for APL AI 2026 Telangana CET

Official notifications determine exact eligibility, exam structure, and deadlines. If you are unsure about any criterion, consult the official portal for the most current details and consider contacting the helpdesk for confirmation. title: CUET 2027 central counselling dates and portal login steps explained
description: Understand CUET 2027 central counselling timelines, how to access the portal, and step-by-step login guidance for students and parents. Practical checks, timelines, and preparation tips included.
content:
Key takeaway: Timely access to the central counselling portal is essential for secure seat allocation and verification of documents.

CUET 2027 central counselling is a pivotal milestone for Indian aspirants seeking admission through the national entrance framework. The counselling window typically opens after results are announced and seat allotment rounds are released by the governing body. This article explains the expected timeline, how to login to the central counselling portal, and practical steps for students and parents to navigate the process confidently.

What to expect in CUET 2027 central counselling

  • Registration and login: Eligible candidates must register for central counselling in the designated portal, then log in using the credentials created during registration.
  • Choice filling: After login, students will fill and review their preferred programs and colleges based on their CUET scores and merit position.
  • Seat allotment: The system will publish seat allotment results for each round. Candidates must verify allotted seats and complete payment of acceptance fees, if required.
  • Document verification: Selected candidates may be asked to complete document verification at designated centers or online, depending on the process adopted that year.
  • Reporting and migration: Final admission will depend on reporting to the allotted institution and satisfying any college-level requirements for transfer or program selection.

Important dates: how to stay informed

Exact dates vary each year and are announced by the central admission authority. Here are practical anchors to monitor:

  • CUET result declaration window
  • Portal activation date for central counselling registration
  • Round-wise seat allotment announcements
  • Last date for accepting a seat and paying fees
  • Document verification and admission reporting deadlines

To avoid last-minute issues, set calendar reminders for each announced milestone and check the official portal frequently during the critical weeks after results.

Step-by-step portal login guide for students

Follow these steps to access the central counselling portal efficiently. If you encounter issues, use the official help channels provided by the authority and avoid third-party platforms.

  1. Open the official counselling portal in a secure browser on a trusted device.
  2. Click on the option for new registration if you are a first-time user; otherwise, select login for returning users.
  3. Enter required details such as your roll number, date of birth, and CUET application number as requested. Create a strong password if you are registering anew.
  4. Verify your contact details through the verification code sent to your registered mobile number or email.
  5. Set up your profile and create a recovery option in case you forget login credentials.
  6. Navigate to the seat allocation or choice filling section once your profile is verified and the round is open for processing.

Tips for a smooth login experience:

  • Use a device you frequently access and a stable internet connection during login and choice filling.
  • Keep your CUET application number, roll number, and registration details handy offline for quick reference.
  • Do not share login credentials with others. Enable two-factor authentication if offered by the portal.
  • Clear browser cookies if you have trouble loading pages or experiencing timeouts.

What to do after you log in

Once logged in, follow a disciplined process to maximize your chances:

  • Review your CUET scorecard and eligibility for programs of interest based on the ranking and eligibility criteria.
  • Fill your college and course preferences in order of priority. Save frequently and verify each step before submission.
  • Check the provisional seat allotment results carefully. If allotted a seat, follow the instructions to confirm or modify your choice within the specified window.
  • Prepare for document verification by organizing your mark sheets, identity proofs, category certificates (if applicable), and migration documents as required.
  • Track fee payment deadlines and fee structures for the allotted program to avoid loss of seat due to non-payment.

Common questions about CUET 2027 central counselling

1. When does CUET 2027 central counselling typically start?

Exact dates are announced by the governing body after CUET results are released. Anticipate registration to open in the weeks immediately following results, with multiple rounds of seat allocation announced subsequently.

2. Can I login with my CUET application number and date of birth?

Yes. The registration and login process commonly uses your application number, roll number, and date of birth, along with a password and, if offered, a verification code.

3. What should I do if I forget my login credentials?

Use the portal’s forgot password or account recovery option. Have your registered email and mobile number handy for verification codes.

4. Is there a fee for central counselling registration?

Some counselling processes require a processing or registration fee. Check the official portal for the exact amount and payment methods during the round you are applying.

5. What documents are needed for verification?

Keep marksheets, identity proofs, category certificates if applicable, transfer certificates, and migration documents ready. The authority will specify the exact list during the verification phase.

6. What if I am not allotted in the first round?

If seats are not allotted, you can participate in subsequent rounds by updating your preferences. Ensure you meet eligibility criteria and payment deadlines for each round.

Practical checklist for families

  • Mark important counselling dates on a shared family calendar and set reminders a week in advance.
  • Prepare a digital copy of all required documents and keep originals ready for verification.
  • Discuss possible college options with your ward to align expectations with CUET scores and rank ranges.
  • Schedule contingency plans if the preferred program is full in later rounds, including alternative courses or colleges.

Where to verify official information

Always rely on the official authority’s portal for the latest announcements, guidelines, and procedure changes. If you need clarification, contact the official helpdesk through the portal’s support channels or helpline numbers provided there.

Proactive planning and organized record-keeping will help students navigate CUET 2027 central counselling with less stress and a clearer path to admission.

title: CBSE ক্লাস 10 আর্থিক বাজারের পরিচয় পরীক্ষা 2027: তারিখ, বিষয় কোড ও সময়
description: ক্লাস 10-এ আর্থিক বাজারের পরিচয় (কোড 405) পরীক্ষা 18 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027, 10:30 থেকে 12:30 পর্যন্ত।
content:
ক্লাস 10-এ আর্থিক বাজারের পরিচয় (কোড 405) পরীক্ষা 18 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027, 10:30 থেকে 12:30 পর্যন্ত।

2026 সালের 6 নভেম্বর প্রকাশিত CBSE-র মূল পরীক্ষার রুটিনে এই তথ্য রয়েছে। এটি পরীক্ষার সময়সূচি, মার্কশিট নয়। CBSE-র সরকারি রুটিন

আর্থিক বাজারের পরিচয় পত্রের জন্য কত সময় পাওয়া যাবে?

ক্লাস ও পত্রকোডপরীক্ষার তারিখসময় (IST)মেয়াদ
ক্লাস 10: Introduction to Financial Markets40518 ফেব্রুয়ারি 202710:30 - 12:302 ঘণ্টা

কেন্দ্রীয় মাধ্যমিক শিক্ষা বোর্ড, 6 নভেম্বর 2026, পৃষ্ঠা 4: বিষয় কোড, তারিখ ও পরীক্ষার সময়। মূল PDF-এ এই পৃষ্ঠাটি দেখো

সরকারি PDF-এ নিজের বিষয়ের সারিটি খুঁজে নাও

পৃষ্ঠা 4 খুলে আগে ক্লাসের শিরোনাম দেখো, তারপর 405 কোডটি খুঁজে নাও। একটি তারিখ বা সময়ের ঘর একাধিক বিষয়ের জন্য প্রযোজ্য হতে পারে। ফোনে পুরো পৃষ্ঠাটি বড় করে পড়ো।

স্কুলের নিবন্ধনে থাকা কোড ও বিষয়ের সম্পূর্ণ নাম মিলিয়ে নাও। অন্য ক্লাসেও একই নাম থাকলে শুধু নিজের ক্লাসের সারিটি বেছে নাও।

ইংরেজি পরীক্ষার সঙ্গে তারিখ মিলিয়ে পড়ার ছক

ক্লাস 10-এর আর্থিক বাজারের পরিচয় (405) পরীক্ষা 18 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027। English Language and Literature (184) পরীক্ষা 26 ফেব্রুয়ারি 2027। দুই তারিখের ব্যবধান 8 দিন।

এই ব্যবধানের সব দিন পড়ার ছুটি নয়। ক্যালেন্ডারে তোমার বাকি পত্রগুলিও লিখে মাঝে পরীক্ষা নেই এমন দিন গুনে নাও। অনুশীলনের সময় আসল পত্রের জন্য বরাদ্দ সময় রাখো।

প্র্যাকটিক্যালের সময় আলাদা করে জেনে নাও

এটি বোর্ডের নির্ধারিত পত্রের সময়। প্র্যাকটিক্যাল, পারফরম্যান্স, প্রজেক্ট বা অভ্যন্তরীণ মূল্যায়ন থাকলে তার তারিখ ও কী কী লাগবে স্কুলে জেনে নাও।

পরীক্ষাকেন্দ্রে যোগাযোগের যন্ত্র নিয়ে যাওয়া নিষেধ। কী সঙ্গে নেওয়া যাবে, সে বিষয়ে CBSE-র আলাদা নির্দেশ ও অ্যাডমিট কার্ডের নিয়ম মেনে চলো।

content:
MP SI Exam Date 2026: Check Sub Inspector Exam Schedule, Latest Update and What Candidates Need to Know

For candidates waiting for the MP SI Exam Date 2026, the recruitment cycle has now moved into its application and preparation phase.

The Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has opened recruitment for Subedar and Sub-Inspector posts under the Police Headquarters, Home (Police) Department. The first written examination is scheduled to begin from 28 October 2026. The application window is open from 9 September to 23 September 2026, while candidates can make corrections in their submitted forms up to 28 September 2026.

The important point for aspirants is that 28 October is the starting date of the examination, not necessarily a date that should be interpreted as a single-day paper for every candidate. The detailed examination arrangement, centre information and candidate-specific instructions should be checked through the MPESB admit card and subsequent official notices.

The current recruitment includes both Subedar and Sub-Inspector cadres, with vacancies spread across non-technical and technical posts. Recent sources differ on the total vacancy count, with some reporting 504 and others 507; therefore, candidates should rely on the latest MPESB rulebook/official vacancy table for the final post-wise figure.

MP SI 2026: The Date Around Which Preparation Should Be Planned

The first stage of the recruitment is scheduled to commence on:

28 October 2026

This gives candidates a clear preparation deadline even though the complete recruitment process will continue beyond the preliminary examination.

The current timeline is:

Recruitment activity

23 September 2026

9 September to 28 September 2026

Preliminary examination begins

28 October 2026

Main examination

The application and examination dates are currently being reported consistently across multiple recent recruitment sources.

Candidates should still check the MPESB website for any subsequent change in the examination programme.

What Is the MP SI Examination 2026?

The MP SI recruitment is being conducted for positions in the Madhya Pradesh Police, under the Home (Police) Department.

This year's recruitment is not limited to one generic Sub-Inspector position. The notification covers different cadres, including:

  • Subedar

  • Sub Inspector - Special Armed Force

  • Sub Inspector - District Police Force

  • Sub Inspector - Arms

  • Sub Inspector - Photo

  • Sub Inspector - Questioned Documents

  • Sub Inspector - Fingerprint

The technical posts have separate educational requirements, so candidates should not assume that eligibility for one SI category automatically applies to every post.

Why 28 October Is Important for MP SI Aspirants

The date gives candidates something more useful than just a number on a calendar.

It provides a point at which preparation needs to shift from coverage to execution.

If the syllabus is still incomplete, the priority should be completing the important areas.

If most topics have already been covered, repeatedly studying the same material may provide less benefit than solving questions under timed conditions.

And if mock-test scores are already stable, the focus should gradually move towards reducing avoidable errors.

In other words, the closer the examination gets, the less useful it becomes to measure preparation by hours studied.

A better measure is:

How accurately can you solve questions within the time available?

MP SI Preliminary Exam: What Candidates Are Preparing For

The recruitment begins with the preliminary written examination.

Current recruitment information places the preliminary examination from 28 October 2026, with the paper being conducted in two shifts. Reported timings are:

Shift

Examination

Shift 1

10:00 AM to 12:00 PM

Shift 2

3:00 PM to 5:00 PM

Candidates should check their admit card for the exact reporting instructions applicable to them.

The preliminary stage is only the first part of the selection process. Candidates who progress further will have to prepare for the subsequent stages as prescribed for the recruitment.

The MP SI Selection Process Does Not End With the Written Test

One reason candidates should avoid treating the exam date as the entire recruitment schedule is that selection continues through additional stages.

The recruitment process includes:

Preliminary examination → Main examination → Physical stage → Interview

The exact applicability and requirements depend on the post/cadre for which the candidate has applied. Current recruitment sources report the main written examination, physical efficiency stage and interview as subsequent components, with their dates to be announced later.

This makes the preliminary examination an important screening point rather than the final destination.

What Should Candidates Do Between Now and 28 October?

There is still enough time for meaningful preparation, but only if it is used carefully.

A useful approach is to divide the remaining preparation into three parts.

First: Find the gaps

Take a full-length test or a representative set of questions.

Don't look only at the final score.

Identify:

  • Questions you knew but answered incorrectly

  • Topics you could not attempt

  • Questions that consumed too much time

  • Areas where your accuracy repeatedly falls

This gives you a much more useful preparation list than simply downloading another syllabus PDF.

Second: Repair the weak areas

Once the mistakes are identified, revise those specific concepts.

A candidate who repeatedly makes the same five types of mistakes does not necessarily need five new books.

They need to fix those five mistakes.

Third: Start practising like the actual examination

As October approaches, mock tests should increasingly resemble the actual examination environment.

Sit for the complete duration.

Avoid checking answers midway.

Analyse the paper only after completing it.

This helps build the concentration required for the actual examination.

Don't Treat Every Subject the Same Way

The most effective preparation schedule is rarely one in which every subject receives exactly the same number of hours.

A candidate may already be strong in one area and significantly weaker in another.

In that situation, equal time allocation may actually be inefficient.

Instead:

Strong area: Maintain performance.

Average area: Improve accuracy and speed.

Weak area: Cover the most useful topics first.

Repeated mistakes: Revise separately.

This creates a preparation plan based on actual performance rather than an arbitrary timetable.

The Technical SI Posts Need Special Attention

One interesting feature of the 2026 recruitment is that it includes technical SI positions alongside the larger non-technical recruitment.

For example, the recruitment information lists technical cadres such as Arms, Photo, Questioned Documents and Fingerprint. Their eligibility requirements are not identical to those for the general SI posts.

This matters when candidates search for “MP SI eligibility” or “MP SI exam pattern” and find information that may actually relate to a different cadre.

Before following any preparation strategy, candidates should first confirm:

Which post have I applied for?

That one check can prevent a lot of confusion.

MP SI Vacancy: Why Different Numbers Are Appearing Online

Candidates searching for the recruitment may notice that some websites mention 504 vacancies, while others mention 507.

This discrepancy is worth mentioning rather than quietly publishing one number as though there is no variation.

Recent recruitment sources report:

  • 504 vacancies in some summaries, including 462 non-technical and 42 technical posts.

  • 507 vacancies in other versions of the recruitment information, with 462 non-technical and 45 technical posts.

Because vacancy figures can be revised or represented differently across updated recruitment documents, candidates should use the latest MPESB rulebook and vacancy table as the final reference.

This is also why an article about the exam date should not blindly repeat an older vacancy number.

What Happens After the Preliminary Exam?

The next major written stage is the Main Examination.

The date for the main examination has not yet been announced in the sources currently available.

The same applies to the later physical and interview stages.

That means candidates should not create a fixed prediction for the complete recruitment calendar based on the preliminary examination date alone.

For now, the useful milestone is:

MP SI Preliminary Examination: From 28 October 2026

The Board will provide subsequent dates as the recruitment moves forward.

MP SI Exam Date 2026: What You Should Keep Ready

Before the examination approaches, candidates should make sure that the administrative side of preparation is also under control.

Keep your application details safe

The application number and other registration details may be required for downloading examination-related documents.

Check the admit card when released

Don't rely on social-media posts for the centre, reporting time or other candidate-specific information.

Check your examination centre

If the centre is in another city, work out the travel plan before examination day.

Read the instructions

The admit card and examination instructions may contain requirements that are not covered in general preparation articles.

A Practical Preparation Plan for the Coming Weeks

Instead of following a rigid “study X hours every day” plan, candidates can work through the following cycle:

Study → Solve → Analyse → Revise → Test again

The analysis stage is the part candidates often skip.

Suppose a mock test gives you 65 correct answers and 20 incorrect answers.

The useful question is not simply whether 65 is a good score.

Ask:

Why were those 20 wrong?

Were they:

  • Conceptual mistakes?

  • Calculation mistakes?

  • Guesswork?

  • Questions misunderstood because of speed?

  • Questions where you changed a correct answer?

The answer tells you what needs fixing before 28 October.

Conclusion

The MP SI Exam Date 2026 gives candidates a clear preparation deadline: the preliminary examination for the current Subedar and Sub-Inspector recruitment is scheduled to begin on 28 October 2026.

But the recruitment should not be viewed as a single examination day. The preliminary paper is followed by further stages, and the dates for those stages will be announced as the selection process progresses.

For candidates preparing now, the most productive approach is to stop measuring preparation only by how many chapters have been completed. Use mock tests to identify weak areas, correct repeated mistakes and gradually bring practice closer to actual examination conditions.

And because the recruitment has both general and technical SI cadres, always match your preparation with the post you have actually applied for.

description: UCEED 2027 பகுதி மதிப்பெண்கள், MSQ-இன் -1 கழிப்பு, NAT மற்றும் MCQ விதிகளை IIT Bombay அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அட்டவணையுடன் அறியுங்கள்.
content:
UCEED 2027 MSQ-இல் ஒரு சரியான தேர்வை மட்டும் குறிப்பிட்டால் எப்போதும் ஒரு மதிப்பெண் கிடைக்காது. அதுவே ஒரே சரியான தேர்வாக இருந்து அதை மட்டும் குறிப்பிட்டால் முழு நான்கு மதிப்பெண்களும் கிடைக்கும். பல சரியான தேர்வுகளில் சிலவற்றை மட்டும், தவறான தேர்வு எதுவுமின்றி குறிப்பிட்டால் பகுதி மதிப்பெண் கிடைக்கும். தவறான தேர்வையும் சேர்த்தால் -1 கிடைக்கும்.

15 MSQ கேள்விகளுக்கான மதிப்பீடு

IIT Bombay-இன் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வினாத்தாள் அமைப்பு கூறும் விதிகள் இவை. முழு அல்லது பகுதி மதிப்பெண்ணுக்கு தேர்ந்தெடுத்த அனைத்தும் சரியாக இருக்க வேண்டும்:

  • +4: அனைத்து சரியான தேர்வுகளையும் மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடுக்க வேண்டும்.

  • +3: நான்கும் சரியாக இருக்கும்போது மூன்றை மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால்.

  • +2: குறைந்தது மூன்று சரியான தேர்வுகள் இருக்கும்போது இரண்டு சரியானவற்றை மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால்.

  • +1: குறைந்தது இரண்டு சரியான தேர்வுகள் இருக்கும்போது ஒன்றை மட்டும் சரியாகத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால்.

  • 0: விடையளிக்காமல் விட்டால். மற்ற அனைத்து நிலைகளிலும் -1.

ஒரு உதாரணம் மூலம் புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள்

A, B, C சரியானவை எனக் கொள்வோம். A, B மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால் +2; A மட்டும் என்றால் +1; A, B, C அனைத்தையும் தேர்ந்தெடுத்தால் +4. தவறான D-ஐயும் சேர்த்தால் -1. A மட்டுமே சரியாக இருந்தால் A மட்டும் தேர்ந்தெடுப்பது +4 தரும். இவை வெளியிடப்பட்ட விதிகளுக்கான விளக்கங்கள்; தேர்வுக் கேள்விகள் பற்றிய கணிப்புகள் அல்ல.

அனைத்துப் பகுதிகளிலும் ஒரே ஊக முறையைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம்

Part A-இல் 57 கேள்விகள், 200 மதிப்பெண்கள், இரண்டு மணி நேரம் உள்ளன. 14 NAT கேள்விகளில் சரியான விடைக்கு +4; தவறான விடைக்கு கழிப்பு இல்லை. 28 MCQ கேள்விகளில் சரியான விடைக்கு +3, தவறான விடைக்கு -0.71. விடையளிக்காத கேள்விக்கு பூஜ்ஜியம். 15 MSQ கேள்விகள் அதிகபட்சம் 60 மதிப்பெண்கள் தருகின்றன.

IIT Bombay-இன் UCEED 2027 வினாத்தாள் அமைப்பு. இந்தப் பக்கத்தில் தனி வெளியீட்டுத் தேதி இல்லை. முழு அதிகாரப்பூர்வ மதிப்பீட்டு விதிகளைப் படிக்கவும்.

Part B-யும் கட்டாயம்: ஒரு மணி நேரம், 100 மதிப்பெண்கள். ஓவியம் வரைவதற்கான ஒரு கேள்வியும் வடிவமைப்புத் திறனுக்கான ஒரு கேள்வியும் தலா 50 மதிப்பெண்கள். கேள்விகள் திரையில் வரும்; வழங்கப்படும் விடைப் புத்தகத்தில் எழுதவோ வரையவோ வேண்டும். பயிற்சியிலும் இரண்டு பகுதிகளுக்கான நேரத்தைப் பிரிக்கவும்; மூன்று மணி நேரம் முழுவதையும் கொள்குறி கேள்விகளுக்குச் செலவிட வேண்டாம்.

பயிற்சிப் பதிவில் விடுபட்ட சரியான தேர்வையும் கூடுதலாகத் தேர்ந்தெடுத்த தவறான தேர்வையும் தனித்தனியாகக் குறிக்கவும். பாடப்புரிதலா அல்லது கவனமான தேர்வுச் சோதனையா தேவை என்பதை இது காட்டும். விரிவான பயிற்சிக்கு Part A, Part B பயிற்சி வழிகாட்டியை படிக்கவும்.
author: Geethika Reddy

title: AP EDCET 2026 hall ticket, exam day checklist and last week plan
description: A practical final-week guide for AP EDCET 2026 candidates covering hall ticket use, exam centre rules, documents to carry, and what to revise in the last seven days.
content:
AP EDCET 2026 candidates should download and verify the hall ticket as soon as it is available, carry the required ID documents, and spend the last seven days on revision plus exam-day planning. If your admit card is live, check your name, photo, exam centre, reporting time, and instructions first. Then use the final week to revise high-yield topics, solve timed practice sets, and avoid last-minute mistakes that can cost marks or cause entry issues at the centre.

Key facts

  • Hall ticket is mandatory: Do not plan to enter the exam centre without the admit card and the required ID proof.
  • Check details early: Verify your name, photograph, signature, exam date, reporting time, test centre address, and category-related instructions.
  • Reach early: Build in travel time, traffic delays, and security checks. Late entry is usually not allowed once the reporting window closes.
  • Carry only approved items: Keep the minimum items asked for in the admit card instructions. Unapproved items can lead to rejection at the gate.
  • Use the last week wisely: Focus on revision, weak areas, previous practice, and calm exam-day preparation rather than starting new heavy topics.

What the AP EDCET 2026 hall ticket means for you

The hall ticket is your entry pass for AP EDCET 2026. It confirms that you are scheduled to appear and usually carries the most important exam-day instructions. Treat it as a document that must be checked, saved, and carried safely, not just printed.

Before exam day, confirm that the details on the admit card match your application. Even small errors such as a spelling mistake, wrong photo, or unclear signature can create unnecessary stress at the centre. If any information looks wrong, verify the correction process immediately through the official exam portal.

Exam-day checklist for AP EDCET 2026

Use this checklist the night before the exam and again before leaving home.

Item Why it matters
Hall ticket printout Required for entry and identity verification
Valid photo ID Used to match your identity with the application
Passport-size photo, if instructed Sometimes needed for attendance or verification
Transparent water bottle, if allowed Keeps you prepared without breaking centre rules
Simple watch, if permitted Helps you manage time if the centre allows it
Travel plan Prevents late arrival and last-minute confusion

Important: Only carry what the admit card instructions permit. Centres can reject items such as notes, electronic devices, smart gadgets, calculators if not allowed, or any restricted material. When in doubt, leave it out.

What to verify on the hall ticket

  • Candidate name and spelling
  • Photo and signature clarity
  • Application number or registration details
  • Exam date and session, if shown
  • Reporting time and gate closing time
  • Exact exam centre address
  • Instructions on ID proof, rough work, and permitted items

If your centre is in a different part of the city, do a route check before exam day. A familiar route can save time, especially if you need to travel early in the morning.

Seven-day revision plan that actually helps

The final week should be about recall, practice, and confidence. A good plan is to divide the week into subject revision, timed practice, and error correction.

Days 7 to 5 before the exam

  • Revise core concepts and commonly repeated topics.
  • Make short notes from formulas, definitions, and key teaching or pedagogy ideas.
  • Review previous mistakes from mock tests.

Days 4 to 3 before the exam

  • Take one or two timed practice sessions.
  • Focus on speed, accuracy, and question selection.
  • Do not add brand-new chapters unless they are very small and easy to cover.

Days 2 to 1 before the exam

  • Revise only your short notes and marked questions.
  • Pack documents and check the route to the centre.
  • Sleep on time and avoid over-studying late at night.

A useful rule for the final week is simple: revise what you can remember poorly, not what you already know well. That usually gives better returns than trying to finish every remaining topic.

Decision guidance: what should students and parents do now

If the hall ticket is already available, print two copies and keep one spare at home. If it is not yet live, check the official exam portal regularly and avoid depending on forwarded screenshots or unofficial updates.

Students should also speak to parents or guardians about travel timing, centre location, and emergency contact details. Parents can help by preparing documents, planning transport, and ensuring the student reaches the venue without a rush.

If you are unsure about any instruction on the admit card, follow the printed guidance first. When the hall ticket and the official portal differ, the official portal should be treated as the final reference.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Downloading the hall ticket but not reading the instructions.
  • Carrying only a soft copy when a printout is required.
  • Arriving late after underestimating travel time.
  • Revising too many new topics in the last 24 hours.
  • Ignoring photo or ID mismatches until exam day.
  • Taking restricted items to the centre and risking disqualification or delay.

FAQs

1) What should I do immediately after downloading the AP EDCET 2026 hall ticket?

Check your name, photo, signature, exam centre, reporting time, and instructions. Print at least one clear copy and save a digital backup on your phone.

2) Is the hall ticket alone enough for AP EDCET 2026 entry?

No. You should also carry the valid photo ID proof mentioned in the exam instructions. The exam centre may reject entry if the ID and admit card details do not match.

3) What if there is a spelling mistake or photo issue on the hall ticket?

Verify the correction process immediately through the official exam portal. Do not wait until exam day, because identity mismatches can create avoidable problems at the centre.

4) What should I revise in the last seven days before AP EDCET 2026?

Revise core concepts, short notes, formulas, commonly repeated areas, and your mock-test mistakes. Use the final two days for light revision and packing, not for starting large new topics.

5) Can I carry a calculator, notes, or electronic items to the exam centre?

Only if the admit card instructions specifically allow them. In most exam settings, restricted items can lead to trouble at the gate, so keep your bag as simple as possible.

6) How early should I reach the AP EDCET 2026 exam centre?

Plan to reach well before the reporting time shown on the hall ticket. This gives you space for traffic, security checks, and locating your room without panic.

7) Should parents help on exam day?

Yes, especially with travel planning, document checking, and timing. Parents can reduce stress by making sure the student leaves early and carries the correct documents.

title: CLAT 2027: விண்ணப்பக் கெடு நவம்பர் 7 வரை நீட்டிப்பு
description: CLAT 2027 UG, PG விண்ணப்பங்களை நவம்பர் 7 இரவு 11:59 மணிக்குள் சமர்ப்பிக்கலாம். கட்டணம், திருத்தத் தடைகள் மற்றும் தேர்வு தேதியை அறியுங்கள்.
content:
CLAT 2027 விண்ணப்பத்தை முடிக்காதவர்கள் 7 நவம்பர் 2026 இரவு 11:59 மணிக்குள் சமர்ப்பிக்கலாம். தேசிய சட்டப் பல்கலைக்கழகங்களின் கூட்டமைப்பு UG, PG ஆகிய இரு படிப்புகளுக்கும் காலக்கெடுவை நீட்டித்துள்ளது. படிவத்தை முடித்ததும் உங்கள் கணக்கில் கட்டண நிலையை உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள்.

இரு படிப்புகளுக்கும் புதிய கடைசி நாள்

31 அக்டோபர் அறிவிப்பு முந்தைய விண்ணப்பக் கெடுவை மாற்றுகிறது. இது படிவத்தைச் சமர்ப்பிக்கக் கூடுதல் நேரம் அளிக்கிறது. கட்டணம் செலுத்திய பிறகு பூட்டப்பட்ட விவரங்களைத் திருத்தப் புதிய வசதி அறிவிக்கப்படவில்லை.

தேசிய சட்டப் பல்கலைக்கழகங்களின் கூட்டமைப்பு: 31 அக்டோபர் 2026 காலநீட்டிப்பு அறிவிப்பு. மூல அறிவிப்பைப் படிக்கவும்

ஏற்கெனவே உள்ள கணக்கில் முடிக்கவும்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ CLAT 2027 தளத்தில் உள்நுழையுங்கள். புதிய விண்ணப்பதாரர்கள் பதிவுசெய்யும் வழிமுறையைப் பின்பற்ற வேண்டும். கட்டணம் செலுத்தும் முன் பெயர், தனிப்பட்ட விவரங்களைச் சான்றிதழ்களுடன் ஒப்பிட்டு, UG அல்லது PG தேர்வு, பிரிவு மற்றும் பதிவேற்றிய ஆவணங்களைச் சரிபாருங்கள். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ CLAT தளம்

முழுமையான படிவமும் கட்டணமும் அவசியம். வரைவைச் சேமிப்பது விண்ணப்பச் சமர்ப்பிப்பு அல்ல. முடித்த பின் கணக்கில் நிலையைக் கண்டு, விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் கட்டண ஒப்புகையை வைத்திருங்கள். தோல்வியடைந்த அல்லது நிலுவையில் உள்ள பரிவர்த்தனையைக் கடைசி நிமிடம் வரை விடாதீர்கள்.

கட்டணத்துக்குப் பிறகு உள்ள கட்டுப்பாடுகள்

UG வழிமுறைகளின்படி சமர்ப்பித்துக் கட்டணம் செலுத்திய பிறகு படிப்பு, பிரிவு, BPL புலங்களை மாற்ற முடியாது. காலநீட்டிப்பு இந்தத் தடைகளை நீக்கவில்லை. தவறு இருந்தால் புதிய படிவமே தீர்வு என்று கருதாமல் CLAT உதவி மையத்திடம் அடுத்த நடவடிக்கையைக் கேளுங்கள். UG விண்ணப்ப வழிமுறைகள்

சமர்ப்பிப்பு அல்லது கட்டணச் சிக்கலுக்கு clat@consortiumofnlus.ac.in என்ற முகவரிக்கு எழுதலாம்; 080-47162020 எண்ணில் அழைக்கலாம். அறிவிப்பில் தொலைபேசி உதவி திங்கள் முதல் சனி வரை காலை 10 மணி முதல் மாலை 5 மணி வரை என உள்ளது. சிக்கலைத் தெளிவாக விளக்கிப் பதிலைச் சேமியுங்கள்.

தேர்வுத் தயாரிப்பைத் தொடருங்கள்

விண்ணப்பக் கெடு நீட்டிப்பு தேர்வு ஒத்திவைப்பு அல்ல. UG வழிமுறைகள் 6 டிசம்பர் 2026 தேர்வைக் குறிப்பிடுகின்றன; தேவைப்பட்டால் மாற்றத்திற்கு உட்பட்டது. விண்ணப்ப வேலையை முடித்துவிட்டு படிப்பைத் தொடருங்கள்; அடுத்த அறிவிப்புக்கு அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தளத்தைப் பாருங்கள்.

The official ICAI websites, icai.org and icai.nic.in, provide candidates with access to their results. Students must check in with their registration and roll numbers in order to view the scorecard. According to past patterns, ICAI typically releases results between 9:00 and 11:00 in the morning. A few hours before the release, ICAI's website and social media accounts will provide the formal announcement verifying the timing.

Passing Criteria

Official ICAI websites icai.org and icai.nic.in

Motorola Solutions is offering an excellent career opportunity for fresh graduates and entry-level professionals to start their journey in DevOps engineering. If you are passionate about automation, cloud technologies, and infrastructure management, this role is perfect for you.

title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Searches: Should Students Delay Buying a Phone?
description: Planning college applications or entrance exams? Use this student-focused test to decide whether to wait for the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra or buy a current phone.
content:
If your college application, entrance test or counselling work depends on your phone, don’t delay a necessary purchase for an unconfirmed model. Wait for the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra only when your present device works reliably and the money isn’t needed for fees, travel, hostel planning or first-semester costs.

Google Trends India’s daily trend feed listed “samsung galaxy s27 ultra” at 500+ on 10 October 2026. That records search activity, not a launch, specification or India price announcement by Samsung. Unverified online rumours may help explain the interest, but they aren’t a safe reason to postpone an academic task or make a payment.

Students often need a phone for application payments, OTPs, scanned certificates, entrance-test practice, video counselling calls and document uploads. A phone that shuts down, loses network access or has unreliable charging can create a bigger problem than missing a newer camera.

Should you wait or buy a current phone?

The decision turns on urgency, available cash and your academic calendar. Use this quick comparison:

  • Wait if your phone handles payment pages, OTPs, PDFs, video calls and study apps, and you can keep the money aside without touching college funds.
  • Buy a current model if battery or charging faults are disrupting applications, mock tests, counselling calls or document work.
  • Repair first if a modest repair can keep the phone dependable through admissions and your first college term.
  • Postpone a premium purchase if coaching fees, entrance forms, travel, hostel deposits or books are due soon.

Set the student budget before watching leak videos

Write one maximum amount and protect it. Count the phone, case, screen protection, data costs and every EMI payment. A monthly instalment that runs into college can quietly eat into transport and food money.

Compare the current Samsung model you can actually buy with at least two recent phones. Check battery health, storage, warranty, service access and repair cost. For entrance preparation, dependable PDFs, timed mock-test apps and clear video calls matter more than an unverified processor or camera claim.

What should you verify before paying?

Treat the Google Trends figure as a signal to research, not a buying deadline. Before reserving any Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, look for a product page, India price, warranty terms and seller details published by Samsung India. If those details aren’t available, don’t pay against a rumour. For reliable admissions updates, you can also read more education updates.

title: Class 12 Applied Art Important Questions 2026 CBSE | Commercial Art Most Asked Questions with Answers
description: Get Class 12 Applied Art (Commercial Art) important questions with answers for CBSE 2026. High-weightage topics, design principles, advertising questions, and exam tips to score full marks.
content:
Class 12 Applied Art / Commercial Art Important Questions (CBSE)

Applied Art, also known as Commercial Art, is one of the most scoring subjects in Class 12 Fine Arts CBSE.
The theory paper usually includes advertising design, elements of art, principles of design, typography, logo design, and Indian art history related to applied art.

If students revise important design concepts and practice structured answers, they can easily score 85–95+ marks.

High Weightage Topics in Applied Art (CBSE)

These topics are frequently asked in board exams:

  • Elements of Art

  • Principles of Design

  • Advertising Design

  • Logo and Poster Making

  • Typography

  • Layout and Composition

  • Role of Commercial Art in Society

Tip: Questions from advertising and design principles are repeated almost every year.

Most Asked Short Questions (2–3 Marks)

Q1. What is Applied Art?

Answer:
Applied Art refers to art used for practical purposes such as advertising, branding, posters, packaging, and commercial communication.

Q2. Define Commercial Art.

Answer:
Commercial Art is the creation of visual content to promote products, services, or ideas.

Q3. What are the Elements of Art?

Answer:

  • Line

  • Shape

  • Form

  • Color

  • Texture

  • Space

Q4. What is Typography?

Answer:
Typography is the art of arranging letters and text in a visually appealing and readable way.

Important Long Questions (5–8 Marks)

Q5. Explain the Principles of Design.

Answer (Points):

  • Balance (symmetrical and asymmetrical)

  • Contrast

  • Emphasis

  • Rhythm

  • Unity

  • Proportion

These principles help create effective and attractive designs.

Q6. Describe the Importance of Advertising Design.

Answer:
Advertising design helps promote products and services. It uses images, colors, typography, and layout to attract customers and communicate messages clearly.

Q7. What are the steps in creating a poster design?

Answer:

  1. Choose a theme

  2. Sketch layout

  3. Apply elements of art

  4. Use bold typography

  5. Maintain balance and contrast

  6. Final coloring and finishing

Elements and Principles Quick Revision Table

Elements of Art Principles of Design
Line Balance
Shape Contrast
Color Emphasis
Texture Rhythm
Space Unity

Questions often come from difference between elements and principles.

Important Topics in Advertising (Must Revise)

Components of Advertisement:

  • Headline

  • Subheading

  • Illustration

  • Slogan

  • Logo

  • Body Text

Types of Advertisements:

  • Product Advertisement

  • Social Awareness Advertisement

  • Public Service Advertisement

Most Asked Viva / Practical Questions

  • What is the theme of your design?

  • Which principles of design did you use?

  • Why did you choose these colors?

  • What is the importance of typography?

  • Difference between fine art and applied art?

Easy-to-Score Topics in Applied Art

  • Definitions of applied art and commercial art

  • Elements and principles of design

  • Steps of poster and logo design

  • Advertising components

  • Role of commercial art in society

Writing answers in bullet points helps in getting full marks.

Practical Exam Pattern (CBSE Applied Art)

Component Marks
Practical Design Work 20
Portfolio 05
Viva Voce 05
Total Practical 30 Marks
Theory Paper 70 Marks

Tips to Score Full Marks in Applied Art

  • Revise design principles daily

  • Practice one poster or logo daily

  • Use neat lettering and proper layout

  • Write structured theory answers

  • Learn art terminology

Applied Art is about creativity + presentation + theory knowledge.

Conclusion

Class 12 Applied Art / Commercial Art is a high-scoring subject in CBSE Fine Arts. By revising design principles, advertising components, typography, and poster-making steps, students can easily score excellent marks. Focus on structured answers and clean presentation for best results.

title: కర్ణాటక 2027: SSLC, II PUC తుది టైమ్‌టేబుల్‌లో సరైన PDF ఎంచుకోండి
description: కర్ణాటక SSLC, II PUC 2027 పరీక్ష 1, పరీక్ష 2 తేదీలు, అధికారిక PDFలు, సబ్జెక్టుల సమయాలు చూసి మీ సన్నద్ధత ప్రణాళిక రూపొందించుకోండి.
content:
కర్ణాటక విద్యార్థులు తాత్కాలిక షెడ్యూల్‌కు బదులుగా KSEAB విడుదల చేసిన 2027 తుది టైమ్‌టేబుల్‌ను ఉపయోగించవచ్చు. 29 అక్టోబర్ 2026 నాటి పత్రాల్లో SSLC, II PUCలకు పరీక్ష 1, పరీక్ష 2 కోసం వేర్వేరు PDFలు ఉన్నాయి. తేదీలు రాసుకునే ముందు మీ తరగతి, పరీక్షను సరిగా ఎంచుకోండి.

నాలుగు షెడ్యూళ్లు, నాలుగు వేర్వేరు PDFలు

క్రిందివి రాత పరీక్షల కాలవ్యవధులు. ప్రాక్టికల్, మౌఖిక పరీక్షల ప్రత్యేక సూచనలను కూడా PDFలో చదవండి. తేదీలన్నీ 2027 సంవత్సరానికి చెందినవి.

పరీక్షమొదటి పేపర్చివరి పేపర్అధికారిక పత్రం
II PUC పరీక్ష 127 ఫిబ్రవరి18 మార్చిపూర్తి PDF
II PUC పరీక్ష 23 మే15 మేపూర్తి PDF
SSLC పరీక్ష 122 మార్చి5 ఏప్రిల్పూర్తి PDF
SSLC పరీక్ష 224 మే31 మేపూర్తి PDF

II PUC: మీ సబ్జెక్టుల క్రమాన్ని రాసుకోండి

పరీక్ష 1లో ఇంగ్లిష్ మార్చి 1, ఫిజిక్స్ మార్చి 4, అకౌంటెన్సీ మార్చి 5, కెమిస్ట్రీ మార్చి 8, ఎకనామిక్స్ మార్చి 9న ఉన్నాయి. గణితం, బిజినెస్ స్టడీస్ మార్చి 12; బయాలజీ, పొలిటికల్ సైన్స్, కంప్యూటర్ సైన్స్ మార్చి 15; చరిత్ర మార్చి 18న జరుగుతాయి.

ఈ పేపర్లు ఉదయం 10 నుంచి మధ్యాహ్నం 1 గంట వరకు ఉంటాయి. అన్ని పేపర్లకూ ఇదే సమయం అనుకోవద్దు. మార్చి 11న హిందుస్థానీ సంగీతం, జాబితాలోని వృత్తి విద్యా పేపర్లు ఉదయం 10 నుంచి మధ్యాహ్నం 12:15 వరకు ఉంటాయి. పరీక్ష 2లో ఇవి మే 15న మధ్యాహ్నం 2 నుంచి సాయంత్రం 4:15 వరకు జరుగుతాయి.

మీరు నమోదు చేసుకున్న సబ్జెక్టులు, వాటి కోడ్‌లనే రాసుకోండి. పరీక్ష 2లో పేపర్ల క్రమం వేరుగా ఉంటుంది కాబట్టి ఆ PDFను విడిగా ఉంచండి.

SSLC: భాషా విభాగాలు, సమయాలు గమనించండి

పరీక్ష 1లో ప్రథమ భాష మార్చి 22, సైన్స్ మార్చి 25, ద్వితీయ భాష మార్చి 27, గణితం మార్చి 30, తృతీయ భాష ఏప్రిల్ 2, సోషల్ సైన్స్ ఏప్రిల్ 5న ఉన్నాయి. ప్రత్యామ్నాయ సబ్జెక్టులకు మీకు వర్తించే వరుసను చూడండి.

ప్రథమ భాష, ప్రధాన సబ్జెక్టులు, JTS పేపర్లు ఉదయం 10 నుంచి మధ్యాహ్నం 1:15 వరకు; ద్వితీయ, తృతీయ భాషలు ఉదయం 10 నుంచి మధ్యాహ్నం 1 వరకు ఉంటాయి. ప్రశ్నపత్రం చదివే సమయం ఇందులోనే ఉంది. సంగీతం, NSQF పేపర్లకు వేరు సమయాలు ఉన్నాయి.

JTS ప్రాక్టికల్, మౌఖిక పరీక్షలు సంబంధిత పాఠశాలల్లో పరీక్ష 1కు ఏప్రిల్ 6న, పరీక్ష 2కు జూన్ 1న జరుగుతాయి. అదనపు సమయం అవసరమయ్యే విద్యార్థులు తమకు వర్తించే సూచనలను పాఠశాలతో చర్చించాలి.

తుది PDFతో మీ వ్యక్తిగత క్యాలెండర్ తయారు చేసుకోండి

పూర్తి ఫైల్‌ను డౌన్‌లోడ్ చేసి అది తుది టైమ్‌టేబుల్ అని నిర్ధారించుకోండి. సూచనలున్న పేజీలను కూడా భద్రపరచండి. పాఠశాల లేదా కళాశాల రికార్డుతో సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్‌లను సరిపోల్చండి. మీ రెండు పేపర్ల మధ్య చదువుకునే రోజులను గుర్తించండి; మొత్తం పరీక్ష కాలంలో ప్రతి రోజూ మీకు పరీక్ష ఉండదు.

సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్ లేదా నమోదులో తేడా ఉంటే పాఠశాల లేదా కళాశాలను సంప్రదించండి. టైమ్‌టేబుల్ హాల్‌టికెట్ కాదు; మీ పరీక్ష కేంద్రాన్ని కూడా అది నిర్ణయించదు. అధికారిక సవరణలను గమనిస్తూ, కొత్త టైమ్‌టేబుల్ వస్తే పాత కాపీని మార్చండి.

title: How to compare NAAC grade NBA accreditation and placements before joining college
description: Learn how to compare NAAC grade, NBA accreditation, department approval and placement claims so you can judge college quality before admission.
content:
Answer first: To judge a college properly, do not rely on rank, fee, or brochure claims alone. Check the NAAC grade for overall institutional quality, the NBA accreditation for specific technical programmes, the department or programme approval for eligibility, and the placement record for actual outcomes. The safest choice is the college that matches your course, has valid approvals, shows recent accreditation, and gives placement data you can verify.

Key facts

  • NAAC evaluates the whole institution, not just one department. It is useful when you want to know the college’s overall academic environment, governance, student support, and quality systems.
  • NBA is programme-specific. It matters mainly for engineering, technology, pharmacy, management, and other professional programmes that seek course-level quality recognition.
  • Approvals matter more than marketing. A college may advertise strong results or placements, but your first check should be whether the programme is approved by the relevant regulator and whether the degree is valid for your course.
  • Placements are outcome data, not a guarantee. A placement figure is useful only if you know the batch size, number of placed students, salary range, and whether the number refers to one branch or the whole campus.
  • One strong signal is not enough. A college can have a good NAAC grade but weak department-level outcomes, or a good placement brochure but limited academic strength. Compare all four signals together.

Why students get misled by college marketing

Many colleges present a single highlight, such as a high NAAC grade, a good placement headline, or a large campus rank. That can hide important gaps. For example, a college may have a respectable overall accreditation but only some departments may be strong. Another college may show impressive placement numbers, but the data may come from a small branch, a single year, or a narrow group of students.

For students and parents making a major admission decision, the real question is not “Is this college famous?” The better question is: Will this college support my course, my degree validity, my learning, and my career path?

How to read NAAC grade the right way

NAAC grade is an institutional quality signal. It helps you understand how a college performs across teaching, learning, infrastructure, research support, student services, and internal systems. But it should be read with context.

What NAAC can tell you

  • Whether the institution has undergone quality review
  • How the college performs overall, not just in advertising
  • Whether student support and academic processes appear organised

What NAAC cannot tell you alone

  • Whether your chosen department is strong
  • Whether placements in your branch are good
  • Whether the college suits your career goal

Practical interpretation: If you are choosing a general degree college, NAAC matters a lot because it reflects the institution as a whole. If you are choosing a professional course, NAAC is only one part of the picture. You still need programme-level approval and department-specific outcome data.

How to read NBA accreditation for a course

NBA accreditation is more specific than NAAC. It is applied to individual programmes, which is why it is especially useful for technical and professional students. If you are comparing engineering branches, for instance, NBA status can help you check whether a specific department has been assessed for programme quality.

Use NBA when you are checking

  • Engineering branches such as CSE, ECE, Mechanical, Civil and related programmes
  • Other professional programmes where programme-level accreditation is relevant
  • Whether the department has a stronger quality track record than the rest of the college

Do not make this mistake

Do not assume that a college with NBA-accredited programmes means every programme is equally strong. Accreditation may apply to only selected branches. Always check the exact course name, the department, and the accreditation period.

How to judge placements without falling for big numbers

Placement brochures often use the most favourable version of the story. A large percentage can look impressive, but you need to ask what it actually means.

What to check Why it matters Good sign
Batch size A 90% placement rate means something very different for 50 students and for 500 students College clearly states the number of eligible students
Placement year Old data may not reflect current market conditions Recent year-wise data is shown
Branch-wise data One department may perform well while another does not Separate data for each branch or programme
Salary range Average packages can hide low offers and outliers Median, highest, and common salary bands are shared
Type of recruiters Recruiter brand names can be used without showing actual intake volume List of recruiters plus number of offers or roles

Best practice: Treat placement claims as a clue, not proof. Ask for the latest audited placement report, department-wise breakup, and the list of students placed from your intended course.

Decision guidance: how to compare two colleges in a practical way

If you are choosing between two colleges, compare them in this order:

  1. Programme validity - Is the course approved and valid for your goal?
  2. Accreditation fit - Does the institution have a useful NAAC grade? Does your department or programme have NBA accreditation where relevant?
  3. Department strength - Are labs, faculty, projects, internships and department outcomes solid?
  4. Placement evidence - Are the placement numbers recent, branch-wise and transparent?
  5. Cost and fit - Does the total fee, hostel cost and commute make sense for the likely outcome?

A simple comparison rule

If College A has a better NAAC grade but weak branch placement and no relevant department accreditation, while College B has a decent NAAC profile, NBA-accredited department, and clearer branch-wise placements, College B may be the safer choice for a professional course.

If you are choosing a general degree course where placements are not the only goal, then a stronger NAAC profile and better academic support may matter more than headline package claims.

What parents should ask before paying the fee

  • Is the degree valid for higher studies or employment in the intended field?
  • Does the exact department or programme have current approval and accreditation?
  • Are placement claims based on the whole college or only one branch?
  • How many students were actually eligible for placement?
  • What is the total four-year or three-year cost, including hostel, transport and exam fees?

These questions help parents move beyond brochure language and focus on value, safety, and long-term usefulness of the admission decision.

Red flags in college brochures

  • Only one big number is shown, with no year-wise breakup
  • Placement percentage is shown without batch size
  • NAAC grade is highlighted, but the course-specific approval is not mentioned
  • “Top recruiters” are listed, but no details of actual offers are shared
  • Different pages of the same college give different placement figures
  • Old accreditation status is repeated without checking whether it is still current

Best way to verify before admission

Before you pay, collect the exact programme name, accreditation status, approval details, placement record, and fee sheet from the official college admission office. Then compare them with the relevant official regulatory or accreditation record for your course. If the college refuses to share a department-wise placement record or cannot show current approval details, treat that as a warning sign.

The safest admission decision is usually the one backed by documented quality, current approval, and transparent outcomes, not the loudest marketing.

FAQs

Is NAAC grade enough to choose a college?

No. NAAC grade is useful, but it is only one signal. You should also check whether your course is approved, whether the department is strong, and whether placement claims are transparent and recent.

Is NBA accreditation better than NAAC?

They measure different things. NAAC looks at the institution overall, while NBA is programme-specific. For a professional course, NBA can be more useful for judging the exact department, but it does not replace the need to check overall college quality.

How do I know if placement data is real?

Ask for year-wise, branch-wise data with batch size, number of offers, salary range, and recruiter details. If the college only shares a percentage without context, the figure is not enough for a serious decision.

Should I prefer a college with good placements but no accreditation?

Not blindly. If the programme lacks the approval or quality signals needed for your course, the placement claim may not be a safe basis for admission. First confirm validity, then compare outcomes.

What should engineering students check first?

Engineering students should first verify programme approval, then check whether the branch has NBA accreditation, and then compare branch-wise placements, labs, faculty strength and internship opportunities.

Can a college have a good NAAC grade and weak placements?

Yes. NAAC reflects institutional quality, but placements depend on the branch, industry links, student preparation, and market demand. That is why both signals must be checked separately.

What is the smartest way to compare two colleges?

Compare the exact course approval, accreditation status, department strength, placement transparency, and total cost. The better college is the one that is valid, transparent, and aligned with your academic and career goals.

title: Bigg Boss 20 Searches Are Rising: What Students Should Learn About Career Claims
description: Bigg Boss 20 is trending in India, but viral celebrity advice is not proof of a reliable media career. Use this test before paying for a course.
content:
Bigg Boss 20 crossed 1,000+ on the Google Trends India daily search signal dated 10 October 2026. That attention can push students towards acting, media or influencer courses, but a contestant’s popularity isn’t proof that their career advice is sound. Treat viral claims as a lead, not a decision.

Before you or your parents pay any fee, separate three things: entertainment publicity, personal opinion and verified course information. They’re not interchangeable.

What should you trust in viral career advice?

Trust the part you can check independently. If a Bigg Boss 20 contestant says a short course guarantees work, ask for the institute’s written placement record, faculty details, total fee, refund terms and the exact qualification awarded. If the claim exists only in a reel, interview clip or fan post, it remains promotion or opinion until evidence appears.

Media careers also vary sharply. Acting, editing, cinematography, journalism, social media production and influencer work need different portfolios and entry routes. A student interested in editing shouldn’t choose an acting course just because a contestant speaks confidently about it.

Use this five-minute career verification test

  1. Name the job. Replace “media career” with a specific target such as assistant editor, casting assistant or video producer.
  2. Check the output. A credible course should show what students produce: edited reels, short films, scripts, portfolios or live projects.
  3. Question the result. “Industry exposure” is vague. Ask whether it means an internship, a guest lecture or simply a studio visit.
  4. Calculate the full cost. Add tuition, travel, equipment, software, accommodation and unpaid project time. A low headline fee can still become expensive.
  5. Compare the route. Explore related courses through verified course options, then compare syllabus, duration and assessment instead of following a celebrity name.

Publicity can help visibility, not prove employability

Bigg Boss 20 searches show what people are curious about on a particular day. They don’t show whether a course has recognised certification, useful teaching or repeatable job outcomes. Search spikes can also be driven by episode controversy or contestant news, so they’re a poor substitute for career research.

Parents should ask one blunt question before payment: “What can this student show an employer six months after finishing?” If the answer is only a certificate and promises of contacts, pause. Read the institute’s written terms, speak to recent students through independent channels and keep a safer alternative route open. Viral advice may start the conversation. Your evidence should finish it.

title: CLAT 2027 যোগ্যতা: ইউজি, পিজির নম্বর ও বয়সের নিয়ম
description: CLAT 2027-এর ইউজি ও পিজির শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা এবং ন্যূনতম নম্বর আলাদা। এসসি, এসটি, প্রতিবন্ধী এবং ফলাফলের অপেক্ষায় থাকা প্রার্থীদের শর্ত জেনে নিন।
content:
CLAT 2027-এর জন্য নিজের নম্বর যাচাই করার আগে সঠিক কোর্স বেছে নিন। স্নাতক স্তরে দ্বাদশ শ্রেণি বা সমতুল্য যোগ্যতা এবং স্নাতকোত্তর স্তরে এলএলবি বা সমতুল্য যোগ্যতা প্রয়োজন। এসসি, এসটি ও প্রতিবন্ধী প্রার্থীদের জন্য কনসোর্টিয়াম আলাদা ন্যূনতম নম্বর নির্ধারণ করেছে।

দুই কোর্সের যোগ্যতা তুলনা করুন

যোগ্যতা নির্ধারক পরীক্ষায় পাশ করা প্রার্থীদের শর্ত সরকারি ইউজি যোগ্যতার পৃষ্ঠা এবং সরকারি পিজি যোগ্যতার পৃষ্ঠায় দেওয়া রয়েছে।

কোর্স

যোগ্যতা

ন্যূনতম নম্বর

এসসি, এসটি বা প্রতিবন্ধী প্রার্থীদের জন্য

ইউজি

10+2 বা সমতুল্য

45% বা সমতুল্য গ্রেড

40% বা সমতুল্য গ্রেড

পিজি

এলএলবি ডিগ্রি বা সমতুল্য

50% বা সমতুল্য গ্রেড

45% বা সমতুল্য গ্রেড

আপনার প্রকৃত যোগ্যতা ও সহায়ক নথি মিললে তবেই সংশ্লিষ্ট শ্রেণির ছাড় ব্যবহার করুন। পিজির আবেদনে ইউজির নম্বরের নিয়ম ব্যবহার করবেন না। ন্যূনতম যোগ্যতা পূরণ করলেই ভর্তি নিশ্চিত হয় না।

কনসোর্টিয়াম অফ ন্যাশনাল ল ইউনিভার্সিটিজের CLAT 2027 ইউজি যোগ্যতার পৃষ্ঠা; প্রকাশের তারিখ উল্লেখ নেই। সম্পূর্ণ নিয়ম পড়ুন।

ফল বাকি থাকলেও ভর্তির সময় পাশের প্রমাণ দিতে হবে

ইউজির জন্য মার্চ বা এপ্রিল 2027-এ যোগ্যতা নির্ধারক পরীক্ষা দেবেন এমন প্রার্থীরা আবেদন করতে পারেন। পিজির ক্ষেত্রে 2027 সালে যোগ্যতা নির্ধারক পরীক্ষায় বসবেন এমন প্রার্থীদের আবেদন করার অনুমতি রয়েছে।

দুই কোর্সের নিয়মেই ভর্তির সময় পরীক্ষায় পাশের প্রমাণ দিতে হবে। যে প্রার্থী এই প্রমাণ দিতে পারবেন না, তিনি ভর্তির জন্য বিবেচিত হওয়ার অধিকার হারাবেন। আবেদন করার সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়ার সময় পরীক্ষার বছর এবং পরে পাশের প্রমাণ দেওয়ার শর্ত, দুটিই মনে রাখুন।

দুই কোর্সেই বয়সের ঊর্ধ্বসীমা নেই

কনসোর্টিয়াম জানিয়েছে, CLAT 2027-এর ইউজি ও পিজি প্রার্থীদের জন্য বয়সের ঊর্ধ্বসীমা নেই। এই নিয়ম শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতা বা ন্যূনতম নম্বরের শর্ত থেকে ছাড় দেয় না।

আবেদন জমা দেওয়ার আগে কোর্স নির্বাচন যাচাই করুন

আপনার কাঙ্ক্ষিত ডিগ্রি, যোগ্যতা নির্ধারক পরীক্ষা, নম্বর ও শ্রেণি সঠিক সরকারি পৃষ্ঠার সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিন। নথি বা যোগ্যতা নিয়ে প্রশ্ন থাকলে সরকারি CLAT পোর্টালের যোগাযোগের তথ্য ব্যবহার করুন। অন্য কোর্সের নিয়ম নিজের আবেদনে প্রযোজ্য বলে ধরে নেবেন না।

আবেদন ও সংশোধনের শেষ সময়ের জন্য CLAT আবেদন জমা ও সংশোধনের সময়সীমার নির্দেশিকা পড়ুন। যোগ্য হওয়া এবং আবেদন সম্পূর্ণ করা আলাদা প্রয়োজন।

title: CEETA PG 2026 Registration Starts March 16; MTech, ME, MArch, MPlan Exam on May 10
description: CEETA PG 2026 registration will start on March 16. Check the exam date, courses offered for MTech, ME, MArch, and MPlan, eligibility details, and application process.
content:
The registration process for the Common Engineering Entrance Test and Admission for Postgraduate (CEETA PG) 2026 is scheduled to commence on March 16, 2026. The entrance examination is conducted by **Anna University for admission to PG courses in engineering and planning in Tamil Nadu.**

For those aspiring to pursue MTech, ME, MArch, and MPlan courses in various colleges, they can register online once the registration link is activated.

CEETA PG 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Registration Start Date March 16, 2026
Last Date to Apply April 2026 (Expected)
Admit Card Release May 2026
CEETA PG 2026 Exam Date May 10, 2026
Official Website https://tancet.annauniv.edu

Courses Offered Through CEETA PG

CEETA PG 2026 scores are used for admission to several postgraduate programmes, including:

  • Master of Engineering (ME)
  • Master of Technology (MTech)
  • Master of Architecture (MArch)
  • Master of Planning (MPlan)

These programs are offered by Anna University and affiliated institutions across Tamil Nadu.

Steps to Apply for CEETA PG 2026

Applicants can finish the application process by following these steps:

  1. Go to tancet.annauniv.edu, the official website. Click the registration link for CEETA PG 2026.
  2. Enter a working mobile number and email address while registering.
  3. Carefully provide your academic and personal information.
  4. Upload the necessary files, including the signature and photo.
  5. Use the online payment link to pay the application cost.
  6. After completing the form, download the confirmation page.

Conclusion

The registration for CEETA PG 2026 will commence from March 16, and engineering graduates will get a chance to apply for postgraduate courses in Tamil Nadu.
