title: TOEFL iBT Exam: Eligibility, Test Format & Study Strategies
description: Get a complete guide to the TOEFL exam - eligibility, registration process, test format, scoring system, and preparation tips.
content:
Introduction

The Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) is one of the most popular English proficiency tests accepted by universities, professional organizations, and governments worldwide. Designed and administered by ETS (Educational Testing Service), TOEFL assesses non-native speakers’ ability to use and understand English in academic settings. For students planning to study abroad, a strong TOEFL score can significantly enhance admission prospects in leading universities, especially in the United States, Canada, Australia, and Europe.

What is TOEFL?

TOEFL measures how well candidates can read, write, speak, and understand English. It is widely recognized for academic admissions but is also accepted by employers and immigration authorities. The exam primarily evaluates English communication in academic and university-related contexts.

Types of TOEFL Tests

ETS offers different versions of TOEFL to meet varied requirements:

  1. TOEFL iBT (Internet-Based Test) – The most common version, taken online at test centers or at home in some countries.

  2. TOEFL Essentials Test – A shorter and more flexible version, focusing on academic and general English.

  3. TOEFL PBT (Paper-Based Test) – Conducted in limited locations where internet testing is not available.

Among these, TOEFL iBT is the most widely accepted and preferred by universities.

TOEFL Test Format

The TOEFL iBT is about 3 hours long and includes four sections:

  1. Reading (54–72 minutes) – 3–4 passages with multiple-choice questions to test comprehension.

  2. Listening (41–57 minutes) – Audio lectures, discussions, and conversations followed by questions.

  3. Speaking (17 minutes) – 4 tasks, including expressing opinions and responding to reading/listening materials.

  4. Writing (50 minutes) – 2 tasks: an integrated writing task (reading + listening + writing) and an independent essay.

TOEFL Scoring System

  • Each section is scored on a scale of 0–30.

  • The total score ranges from 0–120.

  • Universities generally require a score of 80–100+ depending on the program.

Eligibility for TOEFL

  • There is no strict eligibility criteria.

  • It is suitable for students aged 16 and above who wish to pursue higher studies abroad.

  • Candidates must hold a valid passport for registration.

TOEFL Registration Process

  1. Visit the ETS TOEFL official website.

  2. Create an account with personal details.

  3. Select the test type, location, and preferred date.

  4. Pay the registration fee (varies by country).

  5. Receive confirmation with exam details.

TOEFL Exam Fee

  • In India, the TOEFL iBT fee ranges from ₹16,000–₹18,500.

  • Fees vary depending on location, type of test, and additional services (rescheduling, score reports).

Preparation Tips for TOEFL Success

  1. Know the test format – Practice sample questions and past papers.

  2. Improve academic reading skills – Focus on comprehension and vocabulary.

  3. Practice listening daily – Use English podcasts, lectures, and movies.

  4. Develop speaking fluency – Practice structured responses under timed conditions.

  5. Enhance writing skills – Work on essay structure, grammar, and clarity.

  6. Take mock tests – Simulate the exam environment for better time management.

Why Choose TOEFL?

  • Widely accepted by over 11,500 universities and institutions across 160+ countries.

  • Fair and unbiased scoring with AI and human raters.

  • Flexible test options, including TOEFL iBT Home Edition.

  • Fast results – available within 4–8 days.

Conclusion

The TOEFL exam is a trusted measure of English proficiency for students aspiring to study abroad. With global recognition, flexible formats, and reliable scoring, it remains one of the top choices for international admissions. By understanding the exam structure and practicing consistently, candidates can achieve their target scores and secure admission to their dream universities.

title: HBSE ২০২৭ নিবন্ধন: স্কুলের সময়সীমা, ফি এবং ঐচ্ছিক APAAR ID
description: হরিয়ানা বোর্ডের নিয়মিত দশম ও দ্বাদশের ফর্ম ৩০ অক্টোবর থেকে। বিলম্ব ফি, বিষয়ভিত্তিক খরচ এবং UDISE-এর নিয়ম জানুন।
content:
হরিয়ানা বোর্ডের নিয়মিত দশম ও দ্বাদশ শ্রেণির ছাত্রছাত্রীরা ফেব্রুয়ারি-মার্চ ২০২৭ পরীক্ষার ফর্মের জন্য স্কুলে যোগাযোগ করুন। বোর্ডের সময়সূচি ৩০ অক্টোবর ২০২৬ থেকে; ২৬ নভেম্বর পর্যন্ত বিলম্ব ফি ছাড়া আবেদন গ্রহণ করা হবে। অনলাইন জমার কাজ স্কুল করে; আপনার তথ্য ও টাকা কবে চাই তা জেনে নিন।

নথি তৈরির আগে একটি তফাত বুঝুন: সরকারি বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে APAAR ID ঐচ্ছিক, কিন্তু UDISE কোড বাধ্যতামূলক। দুটিকে একই শর্তের ভাববেন না।

স্কুলকে যা সম্পূর্ণ করতে হবে

হরিয়ানা স্কুল শিক্ষা বোর্ডের ২৯ অক্টোবর ২০২৬-এর প্রেস নোট, বিজ্ঞপ্তি 90/2026, সংশ্লিষ্ট নিয়মিত সেকেন্ডারি, সিনিয়র সেকেন্ডারি এবং সমতুল্য গুরুকুল ও বিদ্যাপীঠ পরীক্ষা অন্তর্ভুক্ত করে। স্কুলপ্রধানেরা বোর্ডের সরকারি লিঙ্ক ব্যবহার করে স্কুল লগইনের নির্দেশ পড়বেন এবং যোগ্যতা ও তথ্য স্কুলের নথির সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে দেখবেন।

বোর্ডের মূল বিজ্ঞপ্তি পড়ুন · হরিয়ানা বোর্ডের সরকারি ওয়েবসাইট

স্কুলের পরীক্ষা সমন্বয়কারীর সঙ্গে নাম, বিষয়, ছবি ও স্বাক্ষর মিলিয়ে নিন। জমা ও ফি দেওয়ার নিশ্চিতকরণ নিন। স্কুলকে তথ্য দেওয়া মানেই প্রক্রিয়া সম্পূর্ণ হওয়া নয়।

আবেদনের চারটি সময়পর্ব

২০২৬-এ আবেদনের সময়

বিলম্ব ফি

৩০ অক্টোবর থেকে ২৬ নভেম্বর

বিলম্ব ফি নেই

২৭ থেকে ৩০ নভেম্বর

₹100

১ থেকে ৪ ডিসেম্বর

₹300

৫ থেকে ৮ ডিসেম্বর

₹1,000

বিলম্ব ফি পরীক্ষার ফি থেকে আলাদা। শেষ তারিখের পরে আবেদন নেওয়া হবে না বলে বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে আছে। নথি যাচাই ও টাকা দেওয়ার জন্য স্কুল আগে তথ্য চাইতে পারে; স্কুলের শেষ দিন ৮ ডিসেম্বর ধরে নেবেন না।

দশম ও দ্বাদশের ফি-র হিসাব

সেকেন্ডারিতে পরীক্ষার ফি ₹1,150 এবং মাইগ্রেশন ফি ₹100, মোট ₹1,250। সিনিয়র সেকেন্ডারিতে ₹1,200 ও ₹100 মিলিয়ে ₹1,300। প্রযোজ্য প্র্যাকটিক্যাল ফি এতে নেই।

প্রতি প্র্যাকটিক্যাল পরীক্ষার বিষয়ে আরও ₹100। সিনিয়র সেকেন্ডারির অতিরিক্ত বিষয়ে আলাদা ₹200। টাকা দেওয়ার আগে নিজের বিষয় ও আবেদনকাল অনুযায়ী মোট খরচ স্কুলের কাছে বুঝে নিন।

APAAR ঐচ্ছিক, UDISE বাধ্যতামূলক

বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে APAAR ID-এর পাশে স্পষ্ট Optional লেখা আছে; UDISE কোড পূরণ বাধ্যতামূলক। তথ্য বা নথিতে অমিল হলে স্কুল বোর্ড লগইনের নির্দেশ অনুসরণ করবে। ফর্ম পূরণের জন্য বানানো পরিচয় নম্বর দেবেন না।

হরিয়ানা স্কুল শিক্ষা বোর্ড, বিজ্ঞপ্তি 90/2026, ২৯ অক্টোবর ২০২৬: আবেদনের তারিখ, ফি এবং স্কুলের নির্দেশ। বোর্ডের মূল বিজ্ঞপ্তি পড়ুন

ছবি ও স্বাক্ষর আগেই যাচাই করুন

জমা দেওয়া আবেদনের ভুলের জন্য বোর্ড স্কুলপ্রধানকে দায়ী করে। পরীক্ষা শুরু হলে ছবি ও স্বাক্ষরের ভুল সংশোধন করা যাবে না। স্কুল ফর্ম তৈরির সময়ই দেখুন; অ্যাডমিট কার্ড আসা পর্যন্ত ভুল ফেলে রাখবেন না।

এই নিবন্ধন বিজ্ঞপ্তি বিষয়ভিত্তিক পরীক্ষার সময়সূচি নয়। সেই আলাদা তথ্যের জন্য আমাদের HBSE দ্বাদশের ডেটশিট নির্দেশিকা ও বোর্ডের ঘোষণা দেখুন।

title: CBSE 2027: ધોરણ 10 અને 12 માટે સાચું નમૂનાનું પેપર અને ગુણ યોજના કેવી રીતે મેળવવી?
description: વિષયનો કોડ ચકાસીને એક જ હરોળની બંને ફાઇલો લો. ધોરણ 10ના ગણિત અને ધોરણ 12ના અંગ્રેજી માટે સીધી પીડીએફ લિંક્સ અહીં છે.
content:
પ્રેક્ટિસ માટે CBSEની યાદીમાં એક જ વિષયની બે ફાઇલો ખોલો. SQP એ તમે જાતે ઉકેલવાનું નમૂનાનું પ્રશ્નપત્ર છે. MS એ પછી જવાબ તપાસવા માટેની ગુણ યોજના છે. ધોરણ 10માં બેઝિક ગણિત ભણતા હો તો બંને ફાઇલ પર 241 હોવો જોઈએ. 041 એ સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ ગણિતનો કોડ છે.

પહેલાં ધોરણ પસંદ કરો, પછી વિષયનું નામ તપાસો

CBSEની ધોરણ 10 અથવા ધોરણ 12ની યાદી ખોલો. શાળાના રેકોર્ડમાં જે વિષય નોંધાયેલો છે તેનું પૂરું નામ મેળવો. બંને પીડીએફના પહેલા પાને એક જ કોડ છે કે નહીં તે જુઓ.

21 સપ્ટેમ્બરની સૂચનામાં બોર્ડે નમૂનાના પેપરને પ્રશ્નપત્રની રચના સમજવાનું સાધન ગણાવ્યું છે. 2026-27માં પ્રશ્નપત્રની રચના અને મૂલ્યાંકનની પદ્ધતિ બદલાઈ નથી. નમૂનામાં હોય એ જ પ્રશ્ન પરીક્ષામાં આવશે એવી ખાતરી નથી.

સરખાં લાગતાં નામવાળા ચાર વિષય

તમારો વિષય નીચે ન હોય તો તમારા ધોરણની યાદીમાં તે વિષયની હરોળમાંથી બંને ફાઇલો લો.

ધોરણ અને વિષયકોડનમૂનાનું પેપરગુણ યોજના
10: બેઝિક ગણિત241બેઝિક ગણિત પેપરબેઝિક ગણિત યોજના
10: સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ ગણિત041સ્ટાન્ડર્ડ ગણિત પેપરસ્ટાન્ડર્ડ ગણિત યોજના
12: અંગ્રેજી કોર301અંગ્રેજી કોર પેપરઅંગ્રેજી કોર યોજના
12: અંગ્રેજી ઇલેક્ટિવ001અંગ્રેજી ઇલેક્ટિવ પેપરઅંગ્રેજી ઇલેક્ટિવ યોજના

પેપર લખ્યા પછી ગુણ યોજના ખોલો

પ્રશ્નપત્રમાં આપેલો સમય અને પ્રશ્નોની પસંદગી માટેની સૂચના અનુસરો. ગણિતનો જવાબ ન મળે તો તમારી ગણતરી કયા પગલે આપેલા ઉકેલથી જુદી પડી તે શોધો. અંગ્રેજી કોરની યોજનામાં જવાબના સૂચિત મુદ્દા હોય છે. તેમાંના શબ્દો ઉતાર્યા છે કે કેમ તેના કરતાં તમારા મુદ્દાને ટેકો આપ્યો છે કે કેમ તે જુઓ.

પ્રેક્ટિસની તારીખ નક્કી કરતાં પહેલાં બોર્ડ પરીક્ષાના સમયપત્રકમાં તમારા પેપરનો દિવસ જુઓ.

title: Scholarship Payment Failed? Check Aadhaar-Bank Link Before Reapplying
description: Find the real cause of an NSP scholarship payment failure by checking Aadhaar, bank and portal details before submitting another application.
content:
A scholarship payment failure on the National Scholarship Portal does not always mean your application was rejected. Check the payment status, Aadhaar details, bank account and institute record first. Reapplying with the same mismatch can send the payment back into the same rejection loop.

National Scholarship Portal payment verification depends on details matching across your application, identity record and bank account. Start with the exact status shown against your application, then correct the detail that has failed.

What does National Scholarship Portal payment verification check?

National Scholarship Portal payment verification checks whether the identity and banking information used for disbursement can be validated. A name mismatch, wrong account number, inactive account or Aadhaar mapped to another account can stop payment even when your eligibility and institute verification are complete.

Status or warningLikely causeProof or action needed
Aadhaar or identity failureName, number or authentication mismatchAadhaar record and submitted application details
Bank validation failureWrong account, IFSC error, inactive account or missing Aadhaar seedingPassbook or bank certificate and branch confirmation
Portal or institute mismatchDifferent details in the form, institute record and bank recordSubmitted form and correction acknowledgement

How can you fix a scholarship payment failure?

Take a screenshot of the status page and note the application ID before changing anything. Compare your name, date of birth, Aadhaar details, account number, account-holder name and IFSC across the application and bank proof. This simple comparison often identifies the faulty field.

  1. Aadhaar issue: Ask your bank or an authorised Aadhaar service point to verify the identity details and seeding status. Keep the acknowledgement.
  2. Bank issue: Visit the branch with your passbook. Ask whether the account is active, accepts benefit transfers and is mapped to the correct Aadhaar. Request written confirmation where possible.
  3. Portal issue: Contact your institute’s scholarship nodal officer. Ask whether the existing record can be corrected and save the response.

National Scholarship Portal payment verification may remain unchanged until the responsible department receives the corrected record. Bank staff can confirm account status, but they cannot fix a wrong institute or portal entry.

Should you submit another application?

Only consider a fresh submission after correcting the failed detail and checking the scheme’s current instructions. A duplicate form may create another record without repairing the original payment trail. Check relevant scholarship updates for renewal, correction and grievance instructions.

Keep the application ID, status screenshot, bank proof, correction acknowledgement and institute communication together. If the record still shows no movement, use the scheme’s designated grievance route instead of guessing.

title: AIIMS Paramedical Registration 2026 Last Date Extended: Check Revised Dates & Apply Online
description: AIIMS Paramedical Registration 2026 last date extended. Check the revised schedule, eligibility, fees, and steps to apply online at the official website.
content:
The AIIMS Paramedical Registration 2026 is now going on, and it can prove to be a crucial step for those students who want to go for paramedical courses from best institutions. This online registration form has been made available on the examination portal of the All India Institute of Medical Sciences.

According to the most recent information, the last date for registering will be April 24, 2026.

AIIMS Paramedical 2026 Important Dates

Particulars Details
Registration Start Date March 29, 2026
Last Date to Apply April 24, 2026
Correction Window April 29 – May 3, 2026
Admit Card Release June 2026
Exam Date July 4, 2026
Official Website https://aiimsexams.ac.in

Steps to Apply for AIIMS Paramedical 2026

Students need to follow the below-mentioned procedure:

- Go to the official website - aiimsexams.ac.in
- Select the option “Basic Registration” for UG Courses
- Enter all personal details like your name, email, mobile number, etc.
- Upload necessary documents
- Create Registration Code and password
- Register finally by entering course details
- Submit an application form along with paying fees

The whole process consists of basic registration, registration code generation, and finally registration.

Application Fee

  • General/OBC: Around Rs 2000
  • SC/ST: Around Rs 1600
  • PwD: Exempted

Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must:

  • Have passed Class 12 with Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Mathematics
  • Meet minimum qualifying marks criteria
  • Be at least 17 years old

Conclusion

Registration for AIIMS Paramedical Registration 2026 is a vital process for candidates who wish to pursue their careers in the field of health care. Candidates need to ensure that they submit their application on time and double-check all their information.

title: CBSE ക്ലാസ് 10 ബാങ്കിങ്ങും ഇൻഷുറൻസും പരീക്ഷ 2027: തീയതി, വിഷയ കോഡ്, സമയം
description: ക്ലാസ് 10 ബാങ്കിങ്ങും ഇൻഷുറൻസും (കോഡ് 411) പരീക്ഷ 25 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 12:30 വരെ നടക്കും.
content:
ക്ലാസ് 10 ബാങ്കിങ്ങും ഇൻഷുറൻസും (കോഡ് 411) പരീക്ഷ 25 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 12:30 വരെ നടക്കും.

2026 നവംബർ 6ന് പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച CBSE പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷാ ടൈംടേബിളിലാണ് ഈ വിവരം. ഇത് പരീക്ഷയുടെ തീയതിയും സമയവും അറിയാനുള്ള രേഖയാണ്; മാർക്ക് ലിസ്റ്റല്ല. ഔദ്യോഗിക CBSE ടൈംടേബിൾ

ബാങ്കിങ്ങും ഇൻഷുറൻസും പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് എത്ര സമയം ലഭിക്കും?

ക്ലാസും വിഷയവുംകോഡ്പരീക്ഷാ തീയതിസമയം (IST)ദൈർഘ്യം
ക്ലാസ് 10: Banking and Insurance41125 ഫെബ്രുവരി 202710:30 - 12:302 മണിക്കൂർ

സെൻട്രൽ ബോർഡ് ഓഫ് സെക്കൻഡറി എജ്യുക്കേഷൻ, 6 നവംബർ 2026, പേജ് 5: വിഷയ കോഡ്, തീയതി, സമയം. ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക

ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ശരിയായ വരി കണ്ടെത്താം

പേജ് 5ൽ ക്ലാസ് ഏതാണെന്നു നോക്കിയ ശേഷം 411 എന്ന കോഡ് കണ്ടെത്തുക. ഒരേ തീയതിയും സമയവും പല വരികൾക്കും ബാധകമാകാം. ഫോണിൽ മുഴുവൻ പേജും വലുതാക്കി നോക്കുക.

സ്കൂളിലെ രജിസ്ട്രേഷനിലുള്ള കോഡും വിഷയത്തിന്റെ മുഴുവൻ പേരും ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. മറ്റൊരു ക്ലാസിലും ഇതേ പേരുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലാസിന്റെ വരി മാത്രം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

ഇംഗ്ലിഷ് പരീക്ഷയുമായി തീയതികൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാം

ക്ലാസ് 10 ബാങ്കിങ്ങും ഇൻഷുറൻസും (411) പരീക്ഷ 25 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് ഭാഷയും സാഹിത്യവും (184) പരീക്ഷ 26 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ആണ്. തീയതികൾ തമ്മിൽ 1 ദിവസത്തെ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ട്.

ഈ ദിവസങ്ങളെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാൻ കിട്ടുന്ന അവധിയല്ല. മറ്റു പരീക്ഷകളും കലണ്ടറിൽ ചേർത്ത് ഇടയിൽ പരീക്ഷയില്ലാത്ത ദിവസങ്ങൾ മാത്രം എണ്ണുക. പരിശീലനത്തിന് യഥാർഥ പേപ്പറിന്റെ ദൈർഘ്യം തന്നെ എടുക്കുക.

പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് വേറെ തീയതിയുണ്ടാകാം

ഈ വരി ബോർഡ് പേപ്പറിനുള്ളതാണ്. പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ, പ്രകടനം, പ്രോജക്ട് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആന്തരിക മൂല്യനിർണയം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ തീയതിയും വേണ്ട സാമഗ്രികളും സ്കൂളിൽ ചോദിക്കുക.

ആശയവിനിമയ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിനുള്ളിൽ അനുവദിക്കില്ല. കൊണ്ടുപോകാവുന്ന സാധനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് CBSE നൽകുന്ന പ്രത്യേക നിർദേശങ്ങളും അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡും പിന്തുടരുക.

title: NEET UG 2026 State Counselling: When Category Certificates Get Rejected
description: Check domicile, caste, EWS and income certificates for validity, authority and wording before NEET UG 2026 state counselling verification.
content:
A high NEET UG score won’t protect a quota claim if the certificate fails verification. In NEET UG 2026 state counselling, rejection can follow an expired document, an unapproved issuing officer or category wording that doesn’t match the state rule. The result may be loss of reservation, delayed verification or consideration in a different fee category.

The NEET UG exam guide explains the wider exam process.

Exact formats and validity periods differ by state. Check the relevant state counselling authority’s 2026 notice, while the official NEET UG website remains the place for NTA exam notices, not state-quota document rules.

Which certificate errors affect NEET UG 2026 state counselling?

These documents aren’t substitutes for one another. Domicile shows the required state connection, caste certification supports a notified social category, EWS proof covers income-and-asset conditions, and an income certificate may serve a fee concession or another state benefit. Treat each claim separately.

DocumentCheck before uploadCommon rejection triggerLikely consequence
Domicile or residence certificateState connection, applicant details and accepted formatWrong state or incomplete residence informationState-quota claim may be refused
SC, ST or OBC certificateExact category wording, state list and officer designationCentral and state category details do not matchReservation benefit may not apply
EWS certificateIncome, assets, relevant period and prescribed authorityMissing asset details or unsuitable issue periodEWS claim may fail
Income certificatePurpose, income period and issuing officeUsed instead of the required EWS documentFee or state benefit may be denied

How can you check documents before NEET UG 2026 state counselling?

Don’t stop at the stamp. Compare every certificate with the state notice and inspect the name, parent’s name, category text, certificate number, issue date, signature and officer designation. A genuine document can still be unsuitable for that quota.

  1. Save the relevant state authority notice and identify its accepted format.
  2. Check any issue-date, financial-year or non-creamy-layer condition.
  3. Compare the category wording with the applicable state list, not only a central list.
  4. Seek correction or reissue from the issuing office if a core field is wrong.
  5. Upload clear scans and retain originals, receipts and acknowledgement records.

For example, an OBC certificate may be authentic but still fail if its wording does not match the state’s notified category. If the portal allows correction, follow only the published route and keep proof of submission. NEET UG 2026 state counselling decisions belong to the relevant state authority, so don’t rely on a general internet checklist.

title: ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಬಂಗಾಳ NEET PG 2026: ಆಯ್ಕೆಗೆ ಮೊದಲು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ನೋಡಿ
description: WBMCC ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಭರ್ತಿ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30 ಸಂಜೆ 4ಕ್ಕೆ ಆರಂಭ. ಮೊದಲು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ ಪಟ್ಟಿ, ಸೀಟು ವಿವರ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ವರದಿ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.
content:
ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಬಂಗಾಳ NEET PG ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಕಾಲೇಜು ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಮ್ಮ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬೇಕು. WBMCC ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಸುತ್ತು 1 ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಂತೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೀಟು ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು 2026 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30 ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರ ನಂತರ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಲು ನಿಗದಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಅದೇ ದಿನ ಸಂಜೆ 4ರಿಂದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಭರ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಸಮಯ ನಿಗದಿಯಾಗಿದೆ. ಅರ್ಜಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುವ ಅರ್ಹತೆಯನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಮುಂದಿನ ಹಂತಗಳು

2026 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 14ರ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳಿವೆ. ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕವಾಗಿದೆ; ನಂತರ WBMCC ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿದರೆ ಇತ್ತೀಚಿನ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

ಹಂತ

ನಿಗದಿತ ಸಮಯ

ಪರಿಶೀಲಿತ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳ ಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸುತ್ತು 1 ಸೀಟು ವಿವರ

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30, ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ 2ರ ನಂತರ

ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಭರ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಲಾಕ್

ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 30 ಸಂಜೆ 4ರಿಂದ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 1 ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿವರೆಗೆ

ಸುತ್ತು 1 ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 4, ಸಂಜೆ 4ರ ನಂತರ

ವರದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5, 6, 7 ಮತ್ತು 10, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 10ರಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆ 4ರವರೆಗೆ

ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಬಂಗಾಳ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ನಿರ್ದೇಶನಾಲಯದ 2026 ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 14ರ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಸುತ್ತು 1 ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ. ವರದಿಗೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳೇ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಮೂಲ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಓದಿ (PDF).

ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡಿರುವುದನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ

WBMCC PG ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವರ್ಷ ಮತ್ತು ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯನ್ನು ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ. ಅರ್ಜಿ ವಿವರಗಳಿಂದ ನಿಮ್ಮ ದಾಖಲೆ ಹುಡುಕಿ ಗುರುತು ಮತ್ತು ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಹೆಸರು ಕಾಣದಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಥವಾ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬೇರೆ ಇದ್ದರೆ ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸೂಚನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಮಾರ್ಗ ಬಳಸಿ. ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ತಿಳಿಸಲು ಅರ್ಜಿ, ಪಾವತಿ ರಸೀದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಸಿದ್ಧವಿರಲಿ.

ಈ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್ 28 ಸಂಜೆ 6ರವರೆಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಶುಲ್ಕ ಪಾವತಿ ಅದೇ ದಿನ ಮಧ್ಯರಾತ್ರಿವರೆಗೆ ಇತ್ತು. ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಭರ್ತಿ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುವುದು ಹೊಸ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ತೆರೆಯುವುದಲ್ಲ. ರಾಜ್ಯ ಕೋಟಾ, ಖಾಸಗಿ ಮ್ಯಾನೇಜ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್ ಕೋಟಾ ಮತ್ತು NRI ಸೀಟುಗಳ ಅರ್ಹತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸೀಟು ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿ.

ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲು ಸಿದ್ಧವಿರುವ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನೇ ನೀಡಿ

ಲಭ್ಯ ಸೀಟುಗಳ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಕಾಲೇಜು, ವಿಷಯ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಂಡ್ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ. ಆದ್ಯತೆಯ ಕ್ರಮದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಭರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಲಾಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ದಾಖಲೆ ಉಳಿಸಿ. ರ‍್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಅಥವಾ ಇಷ್ಟದ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ಖಾತರಿಯಲ್ಲ.

ವರದಿಗೆ ನಾಲ್ಕು ದಿನಗಳು, ಸತತ ಆರು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲ

ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5ರಿಂದ 10ರವರೆಗೆ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು ಎಂದು ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಯೋಜಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 5, 6, 7 ಮತ್ತು 10, ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ 10ರಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆ 4ರವರೆಗೆ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ. ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ನಂತರ ಸರಿಯಾದ ವರದಿ ಸ್ಥಳ, ಮೂಲ ದಾಖಲೆ, ಶುಲ್ಕ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಂಡ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ಖಾಸಗಿ ಕಾಲೇಜುಗಳ ಕೆಲವು ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗಳು ನಿಗದಿತ ಸರ್ಕಾರಿ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯಬಹುದು; ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ ಸ್ಥಳ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ಅಗತ್ಯ ನೇರ ದಾಖಲೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯ ನಂತರವೇ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

title: CBSE ધોરણ 10 મલ્ટી સ્કિલ ફાઉન્ડેશન કોર્સ પરીક્ષા 2027: તારીખ, વિષય કોડ અને સમય
description: ધોરણ 10માં મલ્ટી સ્કિલ ફાઉન્ડેશન કોર્સ (કોડ 416)નું પેપર 18 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ 10:30થી 12:30 વાગ્યા સુધી છે.
content:
ધોરણ 10માં મલ્ટી સ્કિલ ફાઉન્ડેશન કોર્સ (કોડ 416)નું પેપર 18 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ 10:30થી 12:30 વાગ્યા સુધી છે.

CBSEએ 6 નવેમ્બર 2026ના મુખ્ય પરીક્ષાના સમયપત્રકમાં આ વિગતો આપી છે. આ પરીક્ષાની તારીખો છે; આ PDF ગુણપત્રક નથી. સત્તાવાર CBSE સમયપત્રક

મલ્ટી સ્કિલ ફાઉન્ડેશન કોર્સના પેપર માટે કેટલો સમય મળશે?

ધોરણ અને પેપરકોડપરીક્ષાની તારીખસમય (IST)અવધિ
ધોરણ 10: Multi Skill Foundation Course41618 ફેબ્રુઆરી 202710:30 - 12:302 કલાક

કેન્દ્રીય માધ્યમિક શિક્ષણ બોર્ડ, 6 નવેમ્બર 2026, પાનું 4: વિષય કોડ, તારીખ અને સમય. મૂળ PDFનું આ પાનું જુઓ

સત્તાવાર PDFમાં તમારો વિષય શોધો

પાનું 4 ખોલીને પહેલાં ધોરણનું મથાળું જુઓ અને પછી કોડ 416 શોધો. એક જ તારીખ કે સમયનું ખાનું અનેક વિષયોને લાગુ પડી શકે છે. ફોન પર આખું પાનું મોટું કરીને વાંચો.

શાળાની નોંધણીમાં લખેલા કોડ અને વિષયના પૂરાં નામ સાથે સરખાવો. એક જ નામ બીજા ધોરણમાં પણ હોય તો તમારા ધોરણની પંક્તિ જ પસંદ કરો.

અંગ્રેજીના પેપર સાથે તારીખો સરખાવો

ધોરણ 10માં Multi Skill Foundation Course (416)ની પરીક્ષા 18 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ છે. English Language and Literature (184)ની પરીક્ષા 26 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ છે. બંને તારીખ વચ્ચે 8 દિવસનો તફાવત છે.

આ બધા દિવસ વાંચવા માટેની રજા નથી. બીજાં પેપર પણ કૅલેન્ડરમાં લખીને વચ્ચે પરીક્ષા ન હોય એવા જ દિવસો ગણો. પ્રેક્ટિસ કરતી વખતે મૂળ પેપર જેટલો સમય રાખો.

પ્રાયોગિક પરીક્ષાની તારીખ અલગ તપાસો

આ પંક્તિ બોર્ડે નક્કી કરેલા પેપરની છે. પ્રાયોગિક પરીક્ષા, પ્રદર્શન, પ્રોજેક્ટ કે આંતરિક મૂલ્યાંકન હોય તો તેની તારીખ અને જરૂરી સામગ્રી શાળાને પૂછો.

કેન્દ્રમાં સંચાર ઉપકરણો લઈ જવાની છૂટ નથી. બીજું શું લઈ જઈ શકાય તે માટે CBSEની અલગ સૂચનાઓ અને પ્રવેશપત્રના નિયમો પાળો.

title: B.Tech vs BCA: What Should You Choose After 12th?
description: Confused between B.Tech and BCA after 12th? Compare eligibility, duration, scope, salary & career growth. Find out what suits you best on Dekho Campus.
content:
After 12th, choosing a professional path is a great decision, particularly for students who want to work in technology. Courses like B.Tech in Computer Science and BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) have become popular among students due to the tech industry's rapid evolution. Which one, though, is best for you?

Although both degrees prepare students for careers in the IT sector, they vary in terms of their learning styles, depth, career scope, and structure. To assist you in making an informed and confident choice regarding your future, we will look at the distinctions between a B.Tech and a BCA in this article.

Understanding the Two Courses

The four-year professional degree known as a B.Tech (Bachelor of Technology) delves extensively into computer science and engineering. It blends practical technical instruction with theoretical ideas. Programming, algorithms, software engineering, networking, artificial intelligence, and even hardware-related topics like computer architecture and digital electronics are all studied by students pursuing a B.Tech in computer science or IT.

In contrast, the three-year undergraduate Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) program aims to give students real-world experience in software development and application design. Database administration, online technologies, programming languages, and mobile app development are the main topics of the curriculum. It's a course for people who wish to get into the IT industry fast and begin developing practical tech solutions.

Eligibility and Admission

The greatest candidates for a B.Tech are those who have earned a 12th-grade diploma in physics, chemistry, and mathematics (PCM). State-level CETs, university-specific entrance exams, or competitive exams like JEE Main are usually used for admission.

However, students from any stream, science, commerce, or the arts, can enroll in BCA as long as they have taken computer applications or mathematics courses in school. Admission to many universities is determined by merit and, in certain situations, by passing easy entrance exams.

Duration and Course Structure

The four-year B.Tech curriculum places a great emphasis on both technical depth and theory. Programming, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, system design, and other topics are provided to students. B.Tech students study computational theory, engineering mathematics, and hardware principles in addition to software.

The three-year BCA program is primarily concerned with the real-world applications of computer science. Students work with databases, software tools, web and app development, and programming languages. It's more industry-focused and less theoretical, which makes it perfect for people who want to rapidly develop employable skills.

What You'll Learn

The curriculum in a B.Tech program is extensive and demanding. Advanced subjects like data science, software engineering, cybersecurity, machine learning, and artificial intelligence will be covered. Students gain a strong foundation in both software and hardware thanks to the structured, engineering-focused instruction.

However, BCA students concentrate more on the development aspect of technology. Along with web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and backend development, you will learn languages like Python, Java, and C++. Tech employment instantly benefits from the practical abilities that BCA graduates bring to the table.

Career Opportunities After Graduation

Strong job opportunities are provided by both B.Tech and BCA programs, however the positions and progression paths may vary.

Software engineers, system architects, data scientists, cybersecurity analysts, and AI/ML engineers are among the jobs frequently offered to B.Tech graduates. Startups, MNCs, and product-based IT businesses regularly hire them for core engineering positions.

generally, BCA graduates begin their careers as database managers, UI/UX designers, web or app developers, software developers, or IT support analysts. Many start their careers in fast-paced startups or IT service providers. BCA graduates can advance in their jobs rapidly with the correct knowledge and expertise, particularly if they go on to earn an MCA or other pertinent qualifications.

Higher Education and Specialization

Depending on their employment objectives, many students decide to pursue an MBA, M.Tech, or MS (abroad) after earning a B.Tech. Common following steps include competitive tests like the CAT, GRE, or GATE. 

The most common postgraduate program for BCA graduates is the Master of Computer Applications (MCA), which improves their technical proficiency and expands their employment opportunities. To increase their employability, many may choose to enroll in MBA programs or earn certifications in UI/UX, cloud computing, and data science.

Salary Expectations

The college, skills, location, and company can all affect salary, but in generally :

Starting packages for B.Tech graduates can range from ₹4 to 12 LPA, particularly if they have strong coding skills or come from prestigious institutions.

Packages for BCA grads usually start around ₹3–6 LPA. However, this can gradually increase with experience, internships, and upskilling.

In actuality, your portfolio and abilities are more important than your degree. Both routes provide excellent chances if you are proficient in coding and have a firm grasp of contemporary tools and technology.

Which One Should You Choose?

B.Tech is an excellent choice if you have a strong background in math and physics, like to address challenging issues, and wish to pursue a career in software engineering or core technology. For students seeking a thorough, organized, and technical education in technology, it's perfect.

BCA is a wise option, nevertheless, if you're looking for a quicker, more adaptable route into the tech industry with a strong focus on practical application and development. It's perfect for people who wish to work in IT but have no expertise in science.

Final Thoughts

In the tech sector, both a B.Tech and a BCA can lead to fulfilling careers. Your curiosity, perseverance, and readiness to learn outside of the classroom will be just as important to your success as the course you select. You can succeed with either degree if you have the correct attitude, internships, projects, and certifications.

title: Top 20 Private Colleges in Maharashtra 2025 | Best Private Institutes
description: Discover the top 20 private colleges in Maharashtra for 2025. Explore the best private engineering, medical, management, and arts colleges with rankings, courses, fees, and admission details.
content:
Top 20 Private Colleges in Maharashtra | Best Private Universities & Institutes

Maharashtra is home to some of India’s best private colleges, offering top-notch education in various fields such as engineering, management, medical sciences, law, and humanities. These institutions are known for their high academic standards, excellent infrastructure, research contributions, and strong placement records. Below is a list of the top 20 private colleges in Maharashtra, along with a brief overview of each.

1. Symbiosis International University, Pune

Founded in 1971, Symbiosis International University is a premier multi-disciplinary deemed university offering programs in law, management, health sciences, computer studies, and media. With global collaborations and high industry relevance, the university stands out as a top choice for students.

2. Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, Pune

Dr. D.Y. Patil Vidyapeeth, established in 2003, is well-regarded for its excellence in medical, healthcare, and technical education. The university offers state-of-the-art facilities, extensive research opportunities, and a strong academic curriculum.

3. Amity University, Mumbai

Amity University, Mumbai, provides diverse programs in engineering, management, law, and arts. With a modern campus, research-driven curriculum, and industry tie-ups, it ensures students receive top-tier education and career prospects.

4. Ajeenkya D.Y. Patil University, Pune

Specializing in law, management, design, and engineering, Ajeenkya D.Y. Patil University focuses on innovation-led learning. It partners with various industries to provide students with hands-on experience and training.

5. ATLAS SkillTech University, Mumbai

ATLAS SkillTech University emphasizes futuristic education in technology, entrepreneurship, and management. With its modern approach and strong industry collaborations, students gain exposure to emerging career opportunities.

6. Vishwakarma University, Pune

Vishwakarma University offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses in engineering, business, law, and humanities. The institution is committed to research-driven education and holistic student development.

7. Somaiya Vidyavihar University, Mumbai

This university provides a variety of academic programs across multiple disciplines. It is well-known for its research initiatives, student-centric learning approach, and strong academic framework.

8. MIT World Peace University, Pune

MIT World Peace University combines technical education with value-based learning. With strong industry partnerships, it offers programs in engineering, business, and design.

9. Bharati Vidyapeeth Deemed University, Pune

A prestigious university with over five decades of legacy, Bharati Vidyapeeth is recognized for its wide-ranging programs in medicine, engineering, management, and social sciences.

10. Symbiosis Institute of Business Management (SIBM), Pune

SIBM Pune is one of India's leading B-schools, offering specialized MBA programs. With a rigorous curriculum, experienced faculty, and industry-driven learning, it consistently ranks among the best management institutes.

11. K.J. Somaiya Institute of Management, Mumbai

A part of Somaiya Vidyavihar University, this institute is renowned for its MBA and executive management programs. The curriculum emphasizes practical learning, leadership development, and corporate exposure.

12. D.Y. Patil International University, Akurdi

Offering engineering, management, and design programs, this university focuses on high-quality education and research, providing students with industry-oriented skills.

13. NMIMS School of Mathematical Sciences, Mumbai

A branch of NMIMS Deemed-to-be University, this institute specializes in mathematical sciences, emphasizing research, analytical skills, and career-oriented education.

14. Vijaybhoomi University, Karjat

This emerging university offers unique interdisciplinary programs in business, law, music, and liberal arts, preparing students for global career opportunities.

15. Symbiosis Centre for Management and Human Resource Development (SCMHRD), Pune

SCMHRD provides MBA programs with a focus on management and human resources. With high placement rates and industry-oriented training, it produces top professionals every year.

16. G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering, Nagpur

Affiliated with Rashtrasant Tukadoji Maharaj Nagpur University, this college offers diverse engineering and management programs. It is widely recognized for its innovation-driven curriculum.

17. Shri Ramdeobaba College of Engineering and Management, Nagpur

This institution provides engineering and management courses, with an emphasis on industry-based learning and quality education.

18. Institute of Chemical Technology (ICT), Mumbai

title: JEE Main Chemistry Last Minute Revision: Key Topics
description: Prepare for your exam with this JEE Main Chemistry last minute revision guide. Find the highest weightage chapters in Chemistry.
content:
JEE Main Chemistry Last Minute Revision: Key Topics and Strategy

A structured JEE Main Chemistry last minute revision is a proven method for scoring maximum marks in the Joint Entrance Examination. Chemistry is widely considered the fastest and most scoring section among the three subjects. Because many questions are factual or require basic calculations, students can complete this section quickly, saving valuable time for Physics and Mathematics. During the final weeks, studying new concepts leads to poor retention. Focusing on chapters that yield the highest number of questions ensures a better return on your study hours.

This guide details the exact chapters to prioritize across Physical, Organic, and Inorganic Chemistry, along with a practical strategy for the days leading up to the exam.

Chemistry Section Examination Pattern

The JEE Main Chemistry section features 30 questions. Candidates must attempt 25 questions to reach the maximum score of 100 marks.

  • Section A: 20 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs). All are compulsory.

  • Section B: 10 Numerical Value Type questions. Candidates must choose and attempt exactly 5 of these.

Every correct answer adds +4 marks to your total, while each incorrect answer results in a -1 mark penalty. Unattempted questions yield zero marks. Section B questions primarily test Physical Chemistry, though Organic and Inorganic numericals (like calculating oxidation states or the number of isomers) also appear.

High-Weightage Chapters by Branch

Dividing your revision across the three branches of chemistry prevents burnout and ensures you cover the most tested areas evenly.

Physical Chemistry: Numerical Focus

Physical Chemistry requires strong calculation skills and formula memorization.

  • Chemical Thermodynamics: Focus on the First Law of Thermodynamics, Hess's Law, Gibbs free energy, and thermochemistry (bond enthalpy calculations).

  • Electrochemistry: Expect questions based on the Nernst equation, cell electromotive force (EMF), Faraday’s laws of electrolysis, and molar conductivity.

  • Equilibrium: Both chemical and ionic equilibrium appear frequently. Practice calculating the pH of buffer solutions, solubility products, and using Le Chatelier’s principle.

  • Solutions: Colligative properties (elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure) and the van 't Hoff factor are standard testing areas.

Organic Chemistry: Reactions and Mechanisms

Organic Chemistry tests your understanding of reaction pathways and structural stability.

  • General Organic Chemistry (GOC) and Isomerism: This is the foundation of the organic section. Review inductive effects, mesomeric effects, carbocation stability, and optical isomerism.

  • Aldehydes, Ketones, and Carboxylic Acids: This unit holds the highest weightage in Organic Chemistry. Review named reactions like Aldol condensation, Cannizzaro reaction, and nucleophilic addition mechanisms.

  • Amines: Focus on basicity trends of amines in different phases and the reactions of diazonium salts.

  • Biomolecules: A highly predictable chapter. Review the structures of glucose, peptide linkages in proteins, and the basic components of nucleic acids.

Inorganic Chemistry: Fact-Based Scoring

Inorganic Chemistry provides fast marks, as questions require little to no calculation.

  • Coordination Compounds: This is the most heavily tested chapter in this branch. Focus on IUPAC nomenclature, isomerism (structural and stereoisomerism), and Crystal Field Theory (CFT).

  • d and f-Block Elements: Review the trends in atomic radii, oxidation states, and the colored compounds of transition metals.

  • p-Block Elements: While the syllabus has been adjusted recently, properties of group 15 to 18 elements and specific reactions of important compounds remain high-frequency topics.

Chapter-Wise Question Weightage

The table below outlines the historical weightage and the expected number of questions from the top chapters to help you allocate your final study blocks accurately.

Last-Minute Study Checklist

Execute these actionable steps during your final week to consolidate your memory.

  • Review Formula Sheets for Physical Chemistry: Do not read full textbook chapters for Physical Chemistry. Scan your formula sheets for Thermodynamics, Kinetics, and Electrochemistry. Practice applying these formulas to 5-10 numericals per chapter.

  • Read NCERT for Inorganic Chemistry: The NCERT textbook is the primary source for Inorganic questions. Review the highlighted exceptions in periodic trends, reaction tables for the p-Block, and the colors of compounds in salt analysis.

  • Create a Named Reaction Chart: Write down all standard Organic Chemistry named reactions along with their specific reagents and catalysts on a single sheet of paper for daily review.

  • Practice Section B Question Selection: During your final mock tests, practice scanning all 10 numerical questions to identify the 5 that require the least amount of calculation. This prevents you from wasting time on complex arithmetic.

Final Review Strategy

Your total score depends on how accurately you recall facts and formulas under time pressure. By structuring your JEE Main Chemistry last minute revision around top-heavy chapters like Coordination Compounds, Thermodynamics, and Aldehydes & Ketones, you ensure that your remaining study time yields tangible marks. Rely on the NCERT textbook for factual Inorganic questions, use your short notes for Physical Chemistry formulas, and practice selecting the easiest numerical questions. Maintain a steady pace on exam day to clear this section quickly and confidently.

description: ICAI has activated the September 2026 Foundation result and merit-list links. Use the Foundation entry, your six-digit roll number and registration number.
content:
ICAI has released the CA Foundation September 2026 result. The official portal marks it as announced on 6 November 2026. Open the Foundation result login to check your result; the separate merit-list link serves a different purpose.

Keep the two login numbers ready

The result page asks for a six-digit roll number, your registration number and the verification text displayed on screen. Read each field label before typing. Avoid pasting a number with an extra space, and compare it with your examination records if the login fails.

Use your own device where possible. If you save the result on a shared computer, move the copy to a private location and remove it from the shared Downloads folder after checking it.

Choose between your result and the merit list

On ICAI’s result homepage, Foundation September 2026 appears under both Check Results and Check Merit List. The Foundation merit-list entry is separate from the individual result login. If you cannot access the page, try the official homepage again and recheck your entries. Do not share your registration details in public comments or pay an intermediary to retrieve a result from this portal.

title: Can You Trust AI Career Advice Before Choosing a Course?
description: Learn how Class 12 students and parents can test AI career guidance against eligibility, fees, skills and real entry-level jobs before paying.
content:
AI career guidance can suggest a course in seconds, but a confident answer won’t tell you whether you’re eligible, what the full fees include or which entry-level jobs actually hire its graduates. Before paying an admission fee, test every chatbot claim against the institution’s prospectus, course structure and current job descriptions.

What should you verify before trusting AI career guidance?

Start by treating the chatbot’s answer as a list of questions, not as counselling. If it says a short-term data course leads to a high-paying role, ask what the job title is, what skills employers request and whether the course teaches them.

  1. Eligibility: Check the required Class 12 subjects, minimum marks, entrance test and recognition status in the college’s official admission notice. “Open to all streams” doesn’t always mean every specialisation has the same entry rule.
  2. Fees: Ask for the total payable amount, including registration, tuition, examination, hostel, lab and certificate charges. A low advertised fee can become expensive when compulsory charges appear later.
  3. Skills: Compare the syllabus with at least five current entry-level job descriptions. For a business analytics course, look for spreadsheets, SQL, statistics, dashboards and project work, not just the word “analytics” in the title.
  4. Work: Read what beginners actually do. “AI specialist” may mean cleaning data, writing reports, testing software or handling customer queries. Those daily tasks should match what you’re willing to learn.

Make the course choice evidence-based

Put the AI recommendation beside the course’s official syllabus and a small job sample. Then mark each claim as confirmed, unclear or unsupported. If the bot promises placement, ask the college for the placement report, graduating batch, median salary, recruiting roles and eligibility conditions. Don’t accept a placement percentage without these details.

Parents and students should also compare similar options through course listings and review the institution’s admission rules before submitting documents. A degree may offer wider eligibility for later exams, while a certificate can be quicker but narrower. That trade-off matters more than a polished course name.

When should you reject an AI recommendation?

Walk away when the answer gives a salary guarantee, invents an accreditation, ignores your subjects in Class 12, or recommends a course without asking about location, budget and learning level. AI tools often fill missing details with plausible-sounding claims. That’s the danger.

Use AI to build a shortlist, draft questions and compare skills. Use the college’s official notice to decide. If you’re comparing institutions, record the fee breakup, eligibility, syllabus and job evidence in one sheet before paying any admission fee. You’ll spot gaps quickly, and a rushed career choice becomes much harder to justify.

title: CAT 2025: Section-Wise Changes and Exam Strategy
description: Check CAT 2025 section-wise changes and effective exam strategies. Prepare for VARC, DILR, and QA with smart tips to achieve a high percentile.
content:
One of the hardest tests for Indian MBA candidates is the Common Admission Test (CAT) 2025. It provides access to esteemed management institutes and is run by the IIMs. Candidates eagerly await updates on the format and level of difficulty of the exam each year. Students should be aware of any section-specific changes, even though the general format of the exam is anticipated to stay the same. Let's examine the latest developments and methods for CAT 2025 success.

CAT 2025 Exam Pattern Overview

There are three main areas on the CAT exam:

  • Reading comprehension and verbal ability (VARC)
  • Logical reasoning and data interpretation (DILR)
  • Ability to Quantify (QA)

There is a time limit on each section, and it is not permitted to switch between them. Time management and preparation are therefore essential.

Section-Wise Changes and Strategy

Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC)

The emphasis has significantly changed in recent years to reading comprehension. Candidates should anticipate considerably more emphasis on RCs for CAT 2025, in addition to para-jumbles and summary questions.
Process: To increase speed and comprehension, read a variety of articles every day. Expand your vocabulary and concentrate on answering paraphrase-based questions accurately.

Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR)

The trend indicates more complex but fewer sets. Calculations and logical reasoning may be combined in CAT 2025.
Process: Rehearse previous year's questions and mocks. Quickly recognize solvable sets and steer clear of time-consuming ones. Logical clarity and quick computations will be essential.

Quantitative Ability (QA)

The focus of this part is shifting from direct formula-based questions to application-based problem-solving. The two subjects that are still most crucial are algebra and arithmetic.
Refresh your knowledge of the fundamentals of geometry, percentages, ratios, equations, and contemporary mathematics. Accuracy and speed can only be increased with daily practice.

General Exam Strategy

  1. Time management: Don't get bogged down in a single question and take your time.
  2. Try at least 25 to 30 practice tests prior to the test. Evaluate errors in detail.
  3. To maximize the overall percentile, prepare by giving each of the three areas equal attention.
  4. Accuracy First: To lessen bad marking, refrain from speculating.

Conclusion

Although there may be some slight adjustments to the CAT 2025 exam, the main emphasis will still be on problem-solving and astute preparation. Students must plan ahead because of the application-driven QA, the more difficult DILR, and the RC-heavy VARC. Time management, mock practice, and consistency will help applicants get a high percentile and gain admission to major B-schools.

title: National Scholarship Portal Application: How to Fix Institute Verification Delays
description: NSP institute verification pending? Learn what the status may indicate, which records to keep and how to contact the authority named for your scheme.
content:
If your National Scholarship Portal application is stuck at institute verification, contact your school or college scholarship office first and create a written record. Don’t submit another form just because the dashboard hasn’t changed. Submission alone doesn’t guarantee approval or payment, and the next processing stage depends on the scholarship scheme’s rules.

What can institute or district verification pending mean?

“Institute verification pending” commonly suggests that the application is waiting for checking by the school or college. “District verification pending” may indicate that the application has reached a later checking point. These are practical interpretations, not universal NSP rules. The exact responsibility can vary by scheme, state and the authority named on your application dashboard.

Dashboard statusLikely point to checkYour next action
Institute verification pendingSchool or college scholarship officeAsk the nodal officer whether the record is visible and whether any defect is shown.
District verification pendingDepartment or authority named for the schemeAsk the institute to confirm forwarding, then use the contact shown in the dashboard or scheme notice.
Defective or correction requiredStudent and the prescribed correction routeRead the stated issue and follow only the route and time window displayed for that scheme.

Which records should you check?

Compare the submitted application with your certificates and scheme guidelines. Aadhaar details, bank information, category proof, income proof, course data and admission records may be relevant, but no single checklist applies to every NSP scholarship.

  • Download the application PDF and note the application ID, submission date and status.
  • Keep the acknowledgement, uploaded files and status screenshot together.
  • Check the applicable scheme notice for bank, identity, income and category conditions.
  • Save defect messages, emails and written replies from the institute.

A staff member can trace an application ID more reliably than a search by name. Keep originals available, but hand over copies only when the office asks for them.

How should you escalate the delay?

Send a short request to the institute’s scholarship nodal officer. Include your scheme name, application ID, course, submission date, current status and the action you need. Ask whether the application was verified, returned, forwarded or marked defective.

If the institute cannot resolve it, check the NSP dashboard and the relevant scheme notice for the department, district contact or grievance route. There is no single district office that handles every scholarship. You can also review the verified scholarship information available on DekhoCampus, but treat your dashboard and scheme authority’s notice as controlling. Correction, withdrawal and duplicate-submission rules are scheme-specific.

title: AIBE XXII Corrections Close on 30 October: Check These Locked Fields
description: Paid AIBE XXII applicants should review permitted corrections before the published deadline. Five fields remain locked, and the schedule does not give a closing hour.
content:
The AIBE XXII application portal lists 30 October 2026 as the last date for corrections. If you paid successfully and need to fix your form, check the edit option in your existing account now. The published schedule does not specify a closing hour, so do not assume that you can wait until midnight.

Correction access is restricted to candidates who completed payment successfully. The BCI notice dated 26 October sets that condition and identifies five fields that cannot be changed. Use the instructions displayed in your account for the fields that are available to you.

Five entries stay locked

  • Caste category
  • Examination city preferences
  • Registered email address
  • Registered mobile number
  • PwBD category

If one of these entries is wrong, contact the official helpdesk and describe the error. Do not select another field to work around the restriction or assume that a second registration will replace your original application. A helpdesk request is not confirmation that a locked field will be changed.

Check the deadline separately from payment

The official AIBE XXII schedule gives 30 October for form corrections. The later payment notice extended fee payment to 29 October; it did not announce an extension of the correction deadline.

Review, save and reopen the form

  1. Enter through the official AIBE website and choose the candidate login for XXII.
  2. Confirm that payment is recorded successfully, then look for the available correction facility.
  3. Compare editable entries against your documents before making changes. Review the complete form again before submitting.
  4. Save the correction and reopen the application to confirm that the intended change appears. Retain the final form or acknowledgement provided by the portal.

If payment is successful but editing is unavailable, note the message shown and use the portal's helpdesk. Share the relevant application reference through the official support route, but never a password or OTP. For background on the separate payment extension, see our AIBE XXII payment and correction update.

ഈ ദിവസങ്ങളെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാൻ കിട്ടുന്ന അവധിയല്ല. മറ്റു പരീക്ഷകളും കലണ്ടറിൽ ചേർത്ത് ഇടയിൽ പരീക്ഷയില്ലാത്ത ദിവസങ്ങൾ മാത്രം എണ്ണുക. പരിശീലനത്തിന് യഥാർഥ പേപ്പറിന്റെ ദൈർഘ്യം തന്നെ എടുക്കുക.

പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് വേറെ തീയതിയുണ്ടാകാം

ഈ വരി ബോർഡ് പേപ്പറിനുള്ളതാണ്. പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ, പ്രകടനം, പ്രോജക്ട് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആന്തരിക മൂല്യനിർണയം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ തീയതിയും വേണ്ട സാമഗ്രികളും സ്കൂളിൽ ചോദിക്കുക.

ആശയവിനിമയ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിനുള്ളിൽ അനുവദിക്കില്ല. കൊണ്ടുപോകാവുന്ന സാധനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് CBSE നൽകുന്ന പ്രത്യേക നിർദേശങ്ങളും അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡും പിന്തുടരുക.

title: कर्नाटक PGCET 2026: 4 नोव्हेंबरपर्यंत नवीन पर्याय भरा
description: PGCETच्या अंतिम विस्तारित फेरीत जुने पर्याय ग्राह्य नाहीत. ठेवीसाठी 3 नोव्हेंबर व पर्याय भरण्यासाठी 4 नोव्हेंबरच्या स्वतंत्र मुदती आणि पात्रता समजून घ्या.
content:
कर्नाटक PGCET 2026च्या अंतिम विस्तारित फेरीतील उमेदवारांनी 4 नोव्हेंबर 2026 दुपारी 2 वाजेपर्यंत नवीन पर्याय सादर करावेत. KEAनुसार मागील फेरीतील पर्याय विचारात घेतले जाणार नाहीत. आधी जतन केलेली यादी या फेरीतील सहभाग निश्चित करत नाही.

पर्याय भरण्याआधी ठेवीची मुदत संपते

टप्पा

अधिकृत कालावधी

सुरक्षा ठेव भरणे

31 ऑक्टोबर ते 3 नोव्हेंबर 2026

नवीन पर्याय भरणे

31 ऑक्टोबर दुपारी 2 ते 4 नोव्हेंबर दुपारी 2

तात्पुरता जागावाटप निकाल

5 नोव्हेंबर दुपारी 1 नंतर

कर्नाटक परीक्षा प्राधिकरणाची सूचना, 29 ऑक्टोबर 2026, पान 2. पर्याय भरण्याआधी ठेवीची मुदत संपते.

सुरक्षा ठेव ₹35,000 आहे; SC/ST उमेदवारांसाठी ₹10,000 आहे. महाविद्यालयात आधीच हजर झालेल्या उमेदवारांना ही ठेव भरावी लागणार नाही. जिथे लागू असेल तिथे जागा मिळाल्यास रक्कम शुल्कात समायोजित होते. नंतर उर्वरित शुल्क किंवा हजेरीची अट चुकल्यास सूचनेनुसार ठेव जप्त होऊ शकते आणि दंड लागू शकतो.

पर्याय भरण्यापूर्वी पात्रता तपासा

आधी जागा न मिळालेल्यांना उपलब्ध जागांसाठी सहभागी होता येते. महाविद्यालयात हजर झालेले उमेदवार अधिक चांगल्या पर्यायासाठी प्रयत्न करू शकतात. दंड भरल्यानंतर जागा रद्द केलेल्यांसाठीही सूचनेत अटी आहेत.

13-15 ऑक्टोबरदरम्यान जागा मिळूनही शुल्क भरले नसेल किंवा हजर झाला नसाल, तर पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी पात्रतेचा भाग काळजीपूर्वक वाचा. विशेष हजेरीची संधी 31 ऑक्टोबर सायंकाळी 6 वाजता संपली आहे. लॉगिन पृष्ठ उघडते म्हणजे पात्रता निश्चित झाली असे समजू नका.

स्वीकारण्याची तयारी असलेले पर्याय क्रमाने भरा

KEA PGCET पृष्ठ उघडा, संबंधित जागांची माहिती तपासा आणि खऱ्या पसंतीच्या क्रमाने नवीन पर्याय भरा. जतन करण्यापूर्वी प्रत्येक पर्यायाचे महाविद्यालय आणि अभ्यासक्रम तपासा. अंतिम सादर केलेली यादी आणि लागू ठेवीची पावती जपून ठेवा.

5 नोव्हेंबरचा निकाल तात्पुरता असल्याचे म्हटले आहे. तो प्रसिद्ध झाला म्हणजे प्रवेश पूर्ण झाला असे न समजता पुढील अधिकृत सूचनांचे पालन करा. विस्तारित फेरी मार्गदर्शक आधीची घोषणा आणि ठेवीच्या अटी स्पष्ट करतो.

title: UGC NET ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026: ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਫਾਰਮਾਂ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ ਲਈ 1 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਤੱਕ ਮੌਕਾ
description: ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੀਤੇ UGC NET ਫਾਰਮ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ 1 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਰਾਤ 11:50 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਭਰੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ। ਨਵੀਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ, ਫਾਰਮ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨਾ ਅਤੇ ਤਸਵੀਰਾਂ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਮੁੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ।
content:
UGC NET ਦਸੰਬਰ 2026 ਦਾ ਫਾਰਮ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਸੀ ਪਰ ਫੀਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਭਰ ਸਕੇ? NTA ਨੇ ਸਫਲ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਲਈ 1 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਰਾਤ 11:50 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਸਮਾਂ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਵਾਧੂ ਦਿਨ ਕੇਵਲ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਆਨਲਾਈਨ ਫਾਰਮ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਹੋ ਚੁੱਕੇ ਹਨ।

ਨਵੀਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ, ਫਾਰਮ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨਾ ਜਾਂ ਤਸਵੀਰਾਂ ਅੱਪਲੋਡ ਕਰਨਾ ਮੁੜ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਇਆ। NTA ਦੇ 1 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਦੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਇਹ ਕੰਮ 31 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਰਾਤ 11:50 ਵਜੇ ਬੰਦ ਹੋਏ ਸਨ। ਅਧੂਰਾ ਸੁਰੱਖਿਅਤ ਕੀਤਾ ਖਰੜਾ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਫਾਰਮ ਦੇ ਬਰਾਬਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਵਾਧੂ ਸਮਾਂ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੈ?

ਨਵਾਂ ਫੀਸ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪਿਛਲੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸੀਮਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਫਾਰਮ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੀ ਪਰ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਕਰ ਸਕੇ। ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਚੁੱਕਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਵੇਖੋ। ਪੂਰਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਫੀਸ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ.

ਨੈਸ਼ਨਲ ਟੈਸਟਿੰਗ ਏਜੰਸੀ, 1 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਦਾ ਜਨਤਕ ਨੋਟਿਸ। ਪੂਰਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਫੀਸ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ.

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ UGC NET ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਦੇ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਲਿੰਕ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਆਪਣੇ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਓ। ਜਾਂਚੋ ਕਿ ਫਾਰਮ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਸਫਲ ਦਰਜ ਹੋਇਆ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ। ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਫਾਰਮ ਦੀ ਫੀਸ ਬਕਾਇਆ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਰਾਤ 11:50 ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸੀਮਾ ਤੋਂ ਕਾਫ਼ੀ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਤਰੀਕੇ ਨਾਲ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰੋ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ UGC NET ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ.

NTA ਨੇ ਸਫਲ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਬਣਨ ਵਾਲਾ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਕਰਕੇ ਸੰਭਾਲਣ ਲਈ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੈ। ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਨੰਬਰ ਨਾਲ ਰੱਖੋ। ਬੈਂਕ ਤੋਂ ਪੈਸੇ ਕੱਟਣ ਦਾ ਸੁਨੇਹਾ ਲਾਭਕਾਰੀ ਸਬੂਤ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੇਵਲ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ; ਪੋਰਟਲ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਵੀ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਨਾ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਦੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਦੇ ਹੈਲਪਡੈਸਕ ਨਾਲ ਸੰਪਰਕ ਕਰੋ। ਬਕਾਇਆ ਲੈਣ-ਦੇਣ ਕਾਰਨ ਘੋਸ਼ਿਤ ਮਿਆਦ ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਵਧਣ ਦੀ ਧਾਰਨਾ ਨਾ ਬਣਾਓ।

ਹੋਰ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਦਲੀਆਂ

ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਬੁਲੇਟਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਜਨਤਕ ਨੋਟਿਸਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਹੋਰ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਜਿਉਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਿਉਂ ਹਨ। ਨਵੀਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦਾ ਮੌਕਾ ਜਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਮੁੜ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਆਮ ਸਹੂਲਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਘੋਸ਼ੀ ਗਈ। ਸੋਧ ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ, ਬਦਲਣਯੋਗ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ NTA ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵੇਖੋ। UGC NET ਸੋਧ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਬਦਲਣਯੋਗ ਵੇਰਵੇ.

ਫੀਸ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਸੰਭਾਲਣ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਅਗਲੀਆਂ ਸੂਚਨਾਵਾਂ ਲਈ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਰਹੋ।

title: JEE Main Physics Mechanics Fundamentals: Core Strategy & Guide
description: A comprehensive preparation guide for the JEE Main Physics Mechanics unit. Explore the syllabus breakdown, high-yield topics like rotational dynamics and gravitation, essential strategies, and tracking methods to maximize your score in the 2027 engineering entrance exam.
content:
The Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main is designed to rigorously test an engineering aspirant’s conceptual clarity, spatial visualization, and mathematical application. Within the Physics section, JEE Main Physics Mechanics Fundamentals serves as the absolute backbone for the entire syllabus. Without a rock-solid understanding of mechanics, tackling advanced concepts in electrodynamics, wave optics, or modern physics becomes nearly impossible.

While mechanics is fundamentally crucial, it is also notoriously vast. Attempting to master complex rotational dynamics without first securing the basics of kinematics and free-body diagrams is a common tactical error. This comprehensive guide breaks down the core chapters within the mechanics block, highlights the high-yield topics, and provides a strategic roadmap to dominate this calculation-heavy segment of the JEE Main 2027 examination.

Core Syllabus Breakdown: What You Need to Master

The mechanics unit spans several chapters from the Class 11 physics curriculum. To master this block, you must study the concepts sequentially, as each chapter builds directly upon the previous one.

Kinematics and Laws of Motion: This is where your physics journey begins. You must have a crystal-clear understanding of 1D and 2D motion, projectile trajectories, and relative velocity. Following kinematics, Newton's Laws of Motion introduces the core of classical mechanics. Drawing accurate free-body diagrams is the single most important skill you will learn here. You must also master the nuances of static and kinetic friction, as well as the dynamics of circular motion (centripetal and centrifugal forces).

Work, Energy, and Power: This chapter acts as a universal problem-solving tool. Many complex kinematic problems can be solved in seconds using the Work-Energy Theorem. You must thoroughly understand the conservation of mechanical energy and the difference between conservative and non-conservative forces. Additionally, elastic and inelastic collisions in one and two dimensions are guaranteed testing areas.

System of Particles and Rotational Motion: Often considered the toughest chapter in the entire physics syllabus, rotational mechanics tests your analytical endurance. However, focusing on specific sub-topics can yield reliable marks. You must master the calculation of the moment of inertia for various continuous bodies, parallel and perpendicular axes theorems, torque, and the conservation of angular momentum. Problems involving rolling motion (pure rolling vs. rolling with slipping) frequently appear in Section B of the exam.

Gravitation: Gravitation is a highly rewarding chapter because it is mathematically highly predictable. It closely mirrors Electrostatics; therefore, mastering gravitation gives you a head start on the Class 12 electrodynamics syllabus. Focus heavily on Newton's law of gravitation, variation of 'g' with altitude and depth, escape velocity, and Kepler's laws of planetary motion.

High-Yield Topics and Expected Weightage

To ensure your revision is highly optimized, you must prioritize chapters that historically yield the most questions. The table below outlines the core segments in mechanics and their expected frequency in a standard JEE Main shift.

Core Segment

Key Focus Areas for Practice

Expected Questions

Rotational Motion

Moment of inertia, torque, conservation of angular momentum.

1 - 2

Laws of Motion & Work, Energy

Chapters like Rotational Motion, Laws of Motion, and Work, Energy & Power are considered High Priority, typically yielding 3 to 4 questions combined per paper.

Strategic Preparation and Progress Tracking

Securing marks in JEE Main Physics Mechanics Fundamentals requires more than just memorizing formulas; it requires a disciplined approach to problem-solving.

  • Master the Free-Body Diagram (FBD): Never attempt a mechanics problem without drawing a clean FBD. Visualizing all the forces acting on a body prevents fundamental setup errors, particularly in friction and rotational torque problems.

  • Avoid Early Complexity: Instead of getting bogged down in advanced rotational dynamics early on, focus first on securing your base in Kinematics, Work, Energy, and Power, and Gravitation.

  • Vector Resolution: A vast majority of mechanics errors stem from incorrect vector resolution. Ensure your mathematics foundation in trigonometry and vector addition is flawless.

Conclusion

Conquering the JEE Main Physics Mechanics Fundamentals block is the first major milestone in securing a top-tier percentile. Because mechanics serves as the foundation for the rest of the physics syllabus, you cannot afford to have conceptual gaps here. Focus your energy heavily on drawing accurate free-body diagrams, applying the conservation of energy, and mastering the moment of inertia. By maintaining a rigorous tracking routine and prioritizing high-yield chapters like Gravitation and Work, Energy & Power, you build an analytical resilience that will carry you confidently through the toughest calculation-heavy numericals on exam day.

2026ರ ನವೆಂಬರ್ 6ರಂದು ಪ್ರಕಟವಾದ CBSE ಮುಖ್ಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಈ ವಿವರಗಳಿವೆ. ಇದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕ ತಿಳಿಸುವ ದಾಖಲೆ; ಅಂಕಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. CBSE ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ PDFನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯವನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿ

ಪುಟ 4, 6, 9ರಲ್ಲಿ ಮೊದಲು ತರಗತಿಯ ಶೀರ್ಷಿಕೆ ನೋಡಿ, ನಂತರ 303, 003, 003, 303 ಕೋಡ್ ಹುಡುಕಿ. ಒಂದೇ ದಿನಾಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ಸಮಯದ ಕೋಶ ಹಲವು ಸಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸಬಹುದು. ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಟವನ್ನು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾಗಿಸಿ ಇಡೀ ಸಾಲನ್ನೂ ಓದಿ.

ಶಾಲೆಯ ನೋಂದಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪಠ್ಯವಿಷಯದ ಪೂರ್ಣ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಬೇರೆ ತರಗತಿಗೂ ಅದೇ ಹೆಸರಿದ್ದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ತರಗತಿಯ ಸಾಲನ್ನಷ್ಟೇ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ.

ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಿ

10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ Urdu Course B (303) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 20 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು; English Language and Literature (184) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 26 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 6 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. 10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ Urdu Course A (003) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 4 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು; English Language and Literature (184) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 26 ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 6 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ Urdu Elective (003) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 1 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು; English Core (301) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 5 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 4 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ. 12ನೇ ತರಗತಿ Urdu Core (303) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 1 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು; English Core (301) ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ 5 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2027ರಂದು. ಎರಡು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳ ನಡುವೆ 4 ದಿನಗಳ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದೆ.

ಇಷ್ಟು ದಿನವೂ ಓದಲು ರಜೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದರ್ಥವಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉಳಿದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ, ನಡುವೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಲ್ಲದ ದಿನಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಎಣಿಸಿ. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಯಾದಷ್ಟೇ ಸಮಯ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಕೇಂದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊರಡುವ ಮೊದಲು

ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗುವ ಸಮಯವೇ ಕೇಂದ್ರಕ್ಕೆ ಹಾಜರಾಗಬೇಕಾದ ಗಡುವಲ್ಲ. ಹಾಜರಾತಿ, ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಮತ್ತು ದಾಖಲೆಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ. ದಿನಾಂಕ ಬದಲಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದರೆ ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತರಗತಿ, ಕೋಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ದಿನಾಂಕ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಕೇಂದ್ರದೊಳಗೆ ಸಂವಹನ ಸಾಧನಗಳನ್ನು ಒಯ್ಯಲು ಅನುಮತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ. ಯಾವ ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಒಯ್ಯಬಹುದು ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ CBSE ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ.

title: GATE 2027 लाइफ सायन्सेस: XL0-XL5 कोड आणि ऐच्छिक विभाग
description: GATE 2027 XLमध्ये रसायनशास्त्र अनिवार्य आहे. नवीन विभाग कोड, दोन ऐच्छिक विभागांचे गुण आणि अधिकृत अभ्यासक्रमानुसार अभ्यासाचे नियोजन करा.
content:
GATE 2027 लाइफ सायन्सेसची तयारी करत असाल, तर जुने अभ्यासनियोजन वापरण्यापूर्वी नोट्समधील विभागांचे कोड बदला. IIT Madrasने सुधारित अभ्यासक्रम जाहीर केले आहेत. रसायनशास्त्राचा नवीन कोड XL0 असून तो अनिवार्य विभाग आहे. XL1 ते XL5 या पाच ऐच्छिक विभागांपैकी दोन सोडवावे लागतील.

मुख्य पेपरचा कोड अजूनही XL आहे. पुढील अंक त्याच पेपरमधील विभाग दर्शवतात. हे वेगवेगळे अर्ज करावे लागणारे सहा GATE पेपर नाहीत.

विषयांची नवीन कोडशी सांगड घाला

अधिकृत पेपर आणि अभ्यासक्रम पृष्ठावर जुन्या अक्षरी कोडसमोर नवीन कोड दिले आहेत. PDF, सराव प्रश्न आणि नोट्स लावताना कोडसोबत विषयाचे नावही पाहा.

सामान्य अभियोग्यतेचे आणखी 15 गुण आहेत. त्यामुळे XLमध्ये अभियोग्यता 15, रसायनशास्त्र 25 आणि दोन ऐच्छिक विभागांचे प्रत्येकी 30 असे एकूण 100 गुण होतात.

पाचपैकी दोन ऐच्छिक विभाग निवडा

अधिकृत प्रश्नपत्रिका पद्धतीनुसार दोन ऐच्छिक विभाग परीक्षेदरम्यान निवडायचे आहेत. XL देणाऱ्या सर्वांसाठी रसायनशास्त्र समान आहे. उदाहरणार्थ वनस्पतिशास्त्र आणि प्राणिशास्त्र निवडले, तरी रसायनशास्त्राचा भाग वगळता येणार नाही.

पूर्ण तयारी करता येईल असे दोन विषय आधी निवडा. पदवीत शिकलेल्या विषयांची सध्याच्या अभ्यासक्रमाशी तुलना करा आणि निवडलेल्या प्रत्येक विषयातील काही प्रश्न वेळ लावून सोडवा. विषयाचे नाव परिचित असण्यापेक्षा प्रश्न सोडवता येणे महत्त्वाचे आहे. आठवड्याच्या नियोजनात ऐच्छिक विषयांसोबत रसायनशास्त्र आणि सामान्य अभियोग्यतेलाही वेळ द्या.

सुधारित अभ्यासक्रमावरून यादी तयार करा

लाइफ सायन्सेसचा एकत्रित अभ्यासक्रम PDF किंवा अधिकृत पृष्ठावरील स्वतंत्र विभागांच्या PDF घ्या. रसायनशास्त्रात XL0.4 हा जैव-अकार्बनी रसायनशास्त्राचा विभाग आहे. त्यात ऑक्सिजन वाहतूक व साठवण करणारी मेटॅलोप्रोटीन्स, इलेक्ट्रॉन वाहतुकीतील Fe-S मेटॅलोप्रोटीन्स, कार्बोनिक अॅनहायड्रेज आणि Cu-Zn सुपरऑक्साइड डिसम्युटेज आहेत.

IIT Madrasचा GATE 2027 लाइफ सायन्सेस अभ्यासक्रम, पान 1. परीक्षा वर्ष 2027 दिले आहे; या पानावर प्रसिद्धीची तारीख छापलेली नाही. सुधारित अभ्यासक्रमावरून यादी तयार करा.

ऐच्छिक विषयही तितक्याच काळजीने तपासा. सध्याच्या जीवरसायनशास्त्रात DNA दुरुस्ती, वनस्पतिशास्त्रात जीनोम संपादन आणि अन्न तंत्रज्ञानात अन्नभेसळ व प्रोबायोटिक पदार्थ आहेत. ही नोट्स तपासण्याची उदाहरणे आहेत; पूर्ण अभ्यासक्रम किंवा प्रश्नांचा अंदाज नाही.

प्रत्येक विभागासाठी तीन याद्या करा: शिकलेले मुद्दे, उजळणी हवी असलेले मुद्दे आणि पुस्तकांत नसलेले मुद्दे. जुने उपयुक्त प्रश्न ठेवा; मात्र जुना प्रश्नसंच पूर्ण आहे असे मानण्यापूर्वी 2027च्या अभ्यासक्रमाशी जुळवा. एखादा मुद्दा अभ्यासक्रमात असल्याने त्याला ठरावीक गुण मिळतीलच अशी हमी नसते.

अभ्यासक्रम आणि अर्जदुरुस्ती स्वतंत्र बाबी आहेत

XLमधील दोन ऐच्छिक विभाग निवडणे आणि दुसरा GATE पेपर निवडणे या वेगळ्या गोष्टी आहेत. दुसऱ्या पेपरसाठी स्वतंत्र दोन-पेपर संयोजन नियम लागू होतात. अभ्यासक्रम बदलल्यानेच नोंदणी पुन्हा सुरू होत नाही किंवा अर्जाची नवी अंतिम तारीख ठरत नाही.

अर्जातील त्रुटीची सूचना आली असेल तर अधिकृत पोर्टलवर ती स्वतंत्रपणे दुरुस्त करा. GATE अर्जातील त्रुटी आणि शुल्कासह दुरुस्ती या मार्गदर्शकात दोन्ही प्रक्रियांतील फरक स्पष्ट केला आहे.

title: NEET 2026–27: Central and state counselling timelines with key dates
description: A clear, student-focused guide to NEET 2026–27 counselling timelines across central and state authorities, with important dates, steps to prepare, and how to track status.
content:
Quick takeaway: plan early for central and state counselling windows

NEET 2026-27 toppers and aspirants should align their admissions plan with the launch of counselling portals, registration windows, choice filling, and seat allotment cycles. Central counselling typically operates through a national framework, while state counselling runs under individual boards or state technical/faculty bodies. In 2026-27, expect distinct timelines for medical and dental seats, and for AIQ (All India Quota) and state quota seats. Keep track of notifications from the official authorities and be prepared for multiple rounds of counselling and possible mop-ups.

What to expect in NEET 2026-27 counselling cycles

  • : Generally coordinated by a national counselling authority for AIQ medical and dental seats. Registration windows open after NEET results are declared. Candidates can participate in multiple rounds, with eligibility determined by NEET rank, category, and seat availability.
  • : Each state conducts its own rounds for state quota seats. Availability depends on state quotas, reserves, and de-reservation norms. Some states allow an initial allotment followed by stray round options and stray vacancy rounds.
  • : The counselling process requires scanned documents, identity verification, category certificates, income certificates where applicable, and seat confirmation payments. Have digital copies ready to upload when portals open.
  • : After registration, candidates fill and lock their preferred streams and colleges. Prioritize courses with strong placement records, clinical exposure, and geographic preferences, alongside college accreditation and AIQ availability.

Central counselling timeline: typical milestones

Note that exact dates vary year to year. Use this as a framework to plan and confirm on official portals.

  • Post-neet declaration: NEET result/publication of merit list. Expect provisional merit lists and eligibility checks from the central portal.
  • Registration window: AIQ and central seats appear on the central counselling portal. Register with application number, NEET roll number, and basic personal details.
  • Choice filling: Submit college and course preferences. Be mindful of deadlines and ensure you save or lock choices before the cut-off.
  • First seat allotment: Allotted seats are announced. Candidates must report to the allotted institution or opt for a transfer through subsequent rounds.
  • Subsequent rounds: If not allocated in the first round, participate in further rounds. Some candidates may be offered mop-up rounds depending on vacancies and state participation.
  • Reporting and document verification: Physical or online verification occurs at the assigned institution. Pay fee and complete admission formalities within the given window.

State counselling timelines: common structure and tips

States vary in their sequencing, but several common elements appear across many states:

  • State roll-out: State boards or equivalent bodies publish notices for counselling windows, registration, and the start of choice filling.
  • Quota classification: States define state quota, all-India quota, and any supernumerary seats. Categories such as SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwD are applied per state rules.
  • Round structure: Most states run multiple rounds, with possible stray vacancy rounds after the main rounds. Seat release and transfer rules are state-specific.
  • Migration and upgrading: Some states permit upgrading to a higher preference in later rounds, subject to vacancy and applicable rules.

What students should do now

  • Mark key dates: Create a 2026-27 calendar with central and state counselling windows. Set reminders for registration and choice filing deadlines.
  • Prepare documents: Gather Class 12 marksheet, NEET admit card, NEET scorecard, identity proof, category certificate (if applicable), domicile certificates, and income proofs where required.
  • Verify AIQ and state rules: Review eligibility criteria for AIQ seats and state quotas, including reservation categories and domicile requirements.
  • Plan preferences carefully: Rank colleges and courses based on exposure, patient load, faculty, accreditation, campus facilities, and location convenience.
  • Keep options open: Maintain a balance between aspirational colleges and safety options to avoid last-minute constraints.

How to track and respond to updates

Routines should include checking official portals and trusted education boards for the latest notices. Always verify dates and required documents on the official authority’s site before acting. If you encounter conflicting information, rely on the official notices rather than third-party summaries.

Common questions about NEET 2026-27 counselling

FAQ

When will central counselling for NEET 2026-27 begin?

Expect registration and choice filling to begin after the NEET result is announced. Exact dates will be published by the central counselling authority on its official portal.

Can I participate in both central and state counselling?

Yes, many students pursue both to maximize their chances of securing a seat. You may need to register separately on each portal and follow respective deadlines.

What documents are typically required during counselling?

NEET scorecard, admit card, Class 12 marksheet, identity proof, domicile or residence certificates if applicable, category certificates for reserved categories, and fee payment details.

What if I don’t get a seat in the first round?

You can participate in subsequent rounds, apply for mop-up rounds if offered, and consider upgrading based on vacancy and rules of the state or central authority.

Is there a separate round for management quota or NRI seats?

Some states or institutions may have special categories; check the official notifications for eligibility and application steps specific to these seats.

Checklist: a practical 6-week pre-counselling plan

  • Compile all required documents in digital and print formats.
  • Register on central and state counselling portals as soon as windows open.
  • Prepare a prioritized list of colleges and courses with rationale for each choice.
  • Set reminders for deadline submissions and reporting to allotted institutes.
  • Monitor for any changes in eligibility, quotas, or seat availability.

Ultimately, the most important step is timely preparation and informed decision-making. While the exact dates are issued by the official authorities each year, starting early and keeping a close watch on the official portals will give you a solid footing for both central and state rounds.

title: Live Updates for TS EAMCET Hall Ticket 2025 (Released): Activated Download Link
description: Stay updated with the latest information on the TS EAMCET 2025 Hall Ticket, now officially released by JNTU Hyderabad. This blog provides step-by-step instructions to download the admit card, important exam dates, exam day guidelines, and answers to frequently asked questions. Make sure you’re fully prepared with everything you need to know before exam day.
content:
For thousands of Telangana students studying agriculture, engineering, and pharmacy, the wait is finally over. On behalf of TSCHE, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad (JNTUH) has formally published the TS EAMCET 2025 Hall Ticket. This is an important stage in every candidate's preparation process as the exam dates draw closer.

What is TS EAMCET?

A state-level entrance exam called the Telangana State Engineering, Agriculture, and Medical Common Entrance Test (TS EAMCET) provides access to undergraduate engineering, agriculture, and pharmacy programs offered by different Telangana institutions. To gain admission to some of the best state colleges, millions of students take this exam every year.

Hall Ticket 2025—What You Need to Know

You may now download the TS EAMCET 2025 hall pass from the official website. To access it, candidates must log in with their date of birth, registration number, and hall ticket number for the qualifying exam.

This hall pass serves as your access pass to the test room and is more than simply a piece of paper. It includes important details, including your name, roll number, exam date and time, location information, and guidelines to follow on the test day.

How to Download TS EAMCET 2025 Hall Ticket

Take these actions:

  1. Go to the TS EAMCET official website.
  2. The \"Download Hall Ticket\" link should be clicked.
  3. Enter your DOB, registration number, and ticket number for the qualifying exam.
  4. To download the hall pass, click submit.
  5. To be safe, print several copies.

TS EAMCET 2025 Exam Dates

  1. Pharmacy & Agriculture: April 29 and 30, 2025
  2. From May 2 to May 5, 2025, engineering

Verify your exam stream, and only show up at the time and date shown on your admission card.

What to Carry on Exam Day

  1. A hard copy of the hall pass
  2. A legitimate photo identification document (passport, voter ID, PAN card, or Aadhaar)
  3. Ballpoint pen in either blue or black

It is completely forbidden to bring electronic devices, books, notes, calculators, and smartwatches into the test room.

Troubleshooting Hall Ticket Issues

Having issues downloading your hall pass? Check the information you're entering twice first. You can email the TS EAMCET support team or call the official helpline if the problem continues. In the event of server delays or other technical difficulties, it is crucial to download the hall pass as soon as possible.

Final Tips for Aspirants

It's normal to feel a mixture of anxieties and excitement with only a few days left. Put all of your effort into final edits, practice exams, and maintaining composure. Get a good night's sleep before the big day, locate your exam location in advance, and prepare all of your paperwork and necessities.

Conclusion

The TS EAMCET 2025 hall ticket release serves as a reminder that the last phase of your preparation is now complete. Plan your exam day carefully, read all the instructions, and download it as soon as you can. Make the most of this opportunity to take a significant step toward a prosperous future.
