title: JEE Main 2027 Registration: Payment, Late Fee and Correction Windows
description: JEE Main Session 1 applications close on 22 November. Understand the payment deadline, late-fee window and confirmation page before submitting your form.
content:
JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration is open on the NTA portal. Complete both the application and successful fee payment by 22 November 2026, 11:50 pm IST. An application number is only one stage of the process: save the confirmation page after completing payment.

Use the official Session 1 application link. The current window is for the January examination; NTA will announce a separate opportunity to apply for Session 2.

Three November windows to keep separate

NTA’s 24 October application notice distinguishes regular submission, submission with a late fee and correction of an existing form.

What you need to do

Official window

Submit the regular application and complete payment

By 22 November 2026, 11:50 pm IST

Apply with an additional ₹500 late fee

23 to 26 November 2026; payment closes at 11:50 pm IST on 26 November

Correct permitted particulars online

27 to 29 November 2026, ending at 11:50 pm IST

National Testing Agency, public notice dated 24 October 2026: excerpt of the Session 1 schedule. Open the original notice.

The ₹500 is an additional late charge. It does not replace the examination fee applicable to your paper, category and examination-centre choice. Use the amount shown for your selections in the official form.

Finish the form before you close the portal

  1. Register through the NTA link with your own or your parent’s or guardian’s accessible mobile number and email address.

  2. Enter the personal and academic details, select the intended paper and upload every document the portal requests.

  3. Review the form, complete payment and download the confirmation page. Keep it with the application number and payment record.

For identity details, NTA’s 28 October registration advisory says the name and date of birth must match the Class 10 certificate or marksheet. It also advises DigiLocker Re-KYC before filling the form so that the latest details are fetched.

Starting again can mean paying again

The 30 October clarification allows a fresh Session 1 form even after an application number has been generated or a fee paid. The last form with successful payment and a generated confirmation page is treated as valid. If the fresh form remains unpaid or has no confirmation page, the earlier completed form remains valid.

A fresh form creates a new application number and requires all details and uploads again. The earlier fee is neither refunded nor adjusted. Where correction can address the change, follow NTA’s correction instructions before deciding to pay for a replacement. Our guide to identity details and fresh forms explains that decision.

More than one application number does not allow more than one examination attempt in the same session. For an application problem, contact NTA at 011-40759000 or 011-69227700, or email jeemain@nta.ac.in.

title: UGC Old Rule: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने लागू किया 2012 का नियम, जानिए नए और पुराने UGC रूल्स में अंतर
description: UGC Old Rule पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का बड़ा फैसला। जानिए UGC के 2012 वाले नियम क्या हैं, नए नियमों से क्या फर्क है और छात्रों व विश्वविद्यालयों पर इसका क्या असर पड़ेगा।
content:
यूनिवर्सिटी ग्रांट्स कमीशन (UGC) से जुड़े नियमों को लेकर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का एक बड़ा फैसला सामने आया है। कोर्ट ने UGC के 2012 वाले पुराने नियम को दोबारा लागू करने का आदेश दिया है। इस फैसले के बाद छात्रों, शिक्षकों और विश्वविद्यालयों के बीच यह सवाल उठ रहा है कि नया और पुराना UGC नियम आखिर अलग कैसे है और इसका असर किस पर पड़ेगा।

क्या है UGC का 2012 वाला पुराना नियम?

UGC का 2012 का नियम मुख्य रूप से शिक्षकों की नियुक्ति, प्रमोशन और शैक्षणिक योग्यता से जुड़ा हुआ था। इस नियम के अनुसार:

  • शिक्षकों की नियुक्ति में NET/PhD अनिवार्य थी

  • प्रमोशन के लिए Academic Performance Indicators (API) जरूरी थे

  • सभी केंद्रीय और राज्य विश्वविद्यालयों को UGC गाइडलाइंस का सख्ती से पालन करना होता था

इस नियम का उद्देश्य देशभर में शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता और समानता बनाए रखना था।

नए UGC नियमों में क्या बदला गया था?

हाल के वर्षों में UGC ने कुछ नए नियम लागू किए थे, जिनमें:

  • कुछ मामलों में NET की अनिवार्यता में छूट

  • विश्वविद्यालयों को अधिक स्वायत्तता (Autonomy)

  • शिक्षकों की नियुक्ति में लचीलापन

हालांकि इन बदलावों को लेकर यह आरोप लगे कि इससे शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता में गिरावट आ सकती है।

सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने पुराना नियम क्यों किया लागू?

सुप्रीम कोर्ट का मानना है कि:

  • 2012 के नियम अधिक स्पष्ट और मानकीकृत थे

  • नए नियमों से असमानता और भ्रम की स्थिति बन रही थी

  • शिक्षा जैसे संवेदनशील क्षेत्र में एक समान नियम जरूरी हैं

इसी वजह से कोर्ट ने UGC को निर्देश दिया कि 2012 का पुराना नियम ही प्रभावी माना जाए।

छात्रों और विश्वविद्यालयों पर क्या असर पड़ेगा?

इस फैसले का असर कई स्तरों पर दिखेगा:

  • छात्रों को बेहतर और योग्य फैकल्टी मिलने की संभावना

  • शिक्षकों की भर्ती प्रक्रिया होगी ज्यादा पारदर्शी

  • विश्वविद्यालयों की स्वायत्तता कुछ हद तक सीमित हो सकती है

निष्कर्ष

UGC Old Rule को लेकर सुप्रीम कोर्ट का फैसला भारतीय उच्च शिक्षा व्यवस्था में एक बड़ा बदलाव माना जा रहा है। 2012 का नियम दोबारा लागू होने से जहां शिक्षा की गुणवत्ता मजबूत होगी, वहीं कुछ संस्थानों को नए सिरे से अपनी नीतियां बनानी पड़ सकती हैं। छात्रों और शिक्षकों के लिए यह फैसला लंबे समय में सकारात्मक साबित हो सकता है।

title: BTech College Fees: Five Checks Before Paying Hostel and Admission Charges
description: Before paying BTech college fees, verify approval, fee breakup, refund rules, hostel costs and placement records with this practical document checklist.
content:
BTech college fees can jump sharply once admission charges, deposits and hostel costs are added. Before transferring money, ask the college for five documents in writing: course approval details, a complete fee breakup, refund rules, hostel terms and placement records. If a promise isn’t recorded in the offer letter, receipt or official college document, treat it as unconfirmed.

Is the exact BTech course approved?

Ask for the approval or affiliation details that apply to the exact course, campus and admission year. A university name alone may not settle the question if the college runs several engineering programmes or operates from another campus. Match the college name, BTech branch and campus address across the admission letter, website and fee receipt. A mismatch can create trouble during document checks, migration or later job applications.

What should the fee breakup include?

Demand a line-by-line statement before paying. It should separate tuition, university charges, examinations, registration, security deposit, development charges, transport and hostel costs. Ask whether every amount is one-time, annual or semester-wise, and whether it can be refunded.

  • Mark every deposit and ask when it will be returned.
  • Check if mess, electricity, laundry and maintenance are included in the hostel amount.
  • Request the payable amount for each year, not only the first instalment.

Compare the written breakup with other options on compare colleges. A low first-year figure may hide a large deposit or later institutional charges.

What does the refund rule actually say?

Ask what happens if the student withdraws after seat confirmation, document verification or hostel joining. The written rule should state deductions, deadlines and the person or office handling the refund. Keep the offer letter, payment receipt, bank proof and emails. “Refund as per rules” is not enough unless the rule is supplied with the admission papers.

Are hostel charges and facilities clear?

Check room occupancy, curfew, mess arrangements, medical support, internet charges and cancellation terms. Ask whether a room is guaranteed or allotted only after payment and availability. If a private contractor runs the hostel, read that agreement too; the college receipt may not cover every payment.

Do placement figures fit your branch?

Ask for the latest report showing the graduating batch, students seeking placements, recruiters, job locations, and average, median and highest salaries. A highest-package claim alone says little. Check whether the numbers cover your branch and campus, then ask for branch-wise records before signing. You can also explore courses while comparing the programme.

Pay only when these documents agree. If staff refuse a written breakup or rush your family into a transfer, pause. That pause can prevent a costly dispute.

title: MP SI 2026: మీ పరీక్ష తేదీ, షిఫ్ట్, కేంద్రం అడ్మిట్ కార్డులో చూడండి
description: MPESB సుబేదార్, సబ్-ఇన్‌స్పెక్టర్ 2026 అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ ఫారానికి కావాల్సిన వివరాలు, కేంద్రం తనిఖీ, కార్డు కనిపించకపోతే తీసుకోవాల్సిన చర్యలు.
content:
సుబేదార్, సబ్-ఇన్‌స్పెక్టర్ నియామక పరీక్ష 2026 అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ పేజీని MPESB అందుబాటులో ఉంచింది. మీ MP SI పరీక్ష తేదీ కోసం చూస్తుంటే అధికారిక ఫారంలో మీకు కేటాయించిన ఏర్పాట్లు చూడండి. సాధారణ నియామక తేదీ మీ వ్యక్తిగత అడ్మిట్ కార్డుకు ప్రత్యామ్నాయం కాదు.

అధికారిక అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ ఫారం తెరవండి

ఈ మూడు వివరాలు సిద్ధంగా ఉంచండి

ఫారం దరఖాస్తు సంఖ్య, పుట్టిన తేదీ, దరఖాస్తులోని వివరాలతో తయారయ్యే వెరిఫికేషన్ కోడ్ అడుగుతుంది. దరఖాస్తు సంఖ్య గరిష్ఠంగా 13 అంకెలు. పుట్టిన తేదీని DD/MM/YYYY పద్ధతిలో ఇవ్వండి.

వెరిఫికేషన్ కోడ్ కోసం దరఖాస్తులో నమోదైన తల్లి పేరులో మొదటి రెండు అక్షరాలకు మీ ఆధార్ సంఖ్య చివరి నాలుగు అంకెలు కలపాలి. పేరుకు ముందు ఇనిషియల్ లేదా బిరుదు ఉన్న ఉదాహరణలు ఫారం కింద ఉన్నాయి. నమోదైన పేరు ప్రారంభం సాధారణంగా వాడే పేరుకు భిన్నంగా ఉంటే ఆ ఉదాహరణలు చదవండి.

MPESB, భోపాల్: సుబేదార్, సబ్-ఇన్‌స్పెక్టర్ నియామక పరీక్ష 2026 పబ్లిక్ అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ ఫారం. అధికారిక అడ్మిట్ కార్డ్ ఫారం తెరవండి

ప్రయాణం నిర్ణయించే ముందు కార్డు చదవండి

  1. ఫారం శీర్షికలో సుబేదార్, సబ్-ఇన్‌స్పెక్టర్ నియామక పరీక్ష 2026 ఉందో నిర్ధారించండి.

  2. మీ దరఖాస్తు వివరాలు నమోదు చేసి పేజీలోని భద్రతా తనిఖీ పూర్తి చేయండి.

  3. Search ద్వారా అందుబాటులోని కార్డు సమాచారం పొందండి. కేటాయించిన తేదీ, షిఫ్ట్, రిపోర్టింగ్ సూచనలు, కేంద్రం పూర్తి చిరునామా చదవండి.

  4. కార్డు సేవ్ చేసి అందులోని సూచనల ప్రకారం ప్రింట్, పత్రాలు సిద్ధం చేయండి. నగరం మాత్రమే కాకుండా ఖచ్చితమైన కేంద్రానికి వెళ్లే మార్గం తెలుసుకోండి.

కార్డును వ్యక్తిగతంగా ఉంచండి. అందులోని గుర్తింపు వివరాలను పబ్లిక్ కామెంట్‌లో లేదా అనధికార డౌన్‌లోడ్ సేవతో పంచుకోవద్దు.

వివరాలు ఇచ్చినా కార్డు రాకపోతే

ముందుగా సేవ్ చేసిన దరఖాస్తుతో మీ ఎంట్రీలు పోల్చండి. తేదీ పద్ధతి, పేరు మొదటి రెండు అక్షరాలు తనిఖీ చేసి మళ్లీ ప్రయత్నించండి. ఫారం పరీక్షించడానికి మరో అభ్యర్థి వివరాలు వాడవద్దు.

సమస్య కొనసాగితే MPESB వెబ్‌సైట్‌లోని సంప్రదింపు మార్గం ఉపయోగించండి. లోపం, నియామక పరీక్షను స్పష్టంగా చెప్పండి. తర్వాత అధికారిక నోటీసు ఏర్పాటును మార్చితే దానిని పాటించండి.

MPESB అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్

నియామక చక్రం నేపథ్యం కోసం మా MP SI షెడ్యూల్ కథనం చూడండి. మీ వ్యక్తిగత పరీక్ష ఏర్పాట్లకు అడ్మిట్ కార్డు, తాజా MPESB సూచనలు అనుసరించండి.

title: Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27: Application Portal Opens, Eligibility Criteria, and Documents Checklist
description: Get complete information on Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27. Check official application portal links, eligibility rules for SC, ST, BC, EBC students, and a document checklist.
content:
Quick Answer: What is the Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27?

The Government of Bihar, through its Education Department, has officially opened the application cycle for the Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27. This financial aid scheme is specifically designed to support college-level students belonging to Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Backward Classes (BC), and Extremely Backward Classes (EBC). It helps cover tuition fees and other academic expenses for students pursuing post-matric courses (Class 11, Class 12, Graduation, Post-graduation, ITI, Polytechnic, Engineering, Medical, and other professional courses) within and outside the state of Bihar.

Students can apply online through the official PMS Bihar portal. There is no physical application submission required, making the process completely digital and highly transparent.

Key Facts and Scholarship Highlights

The following table provides a quick overview of the essential features of the Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27 cycle:

Parameter Details and Key Criteria
Scholarship Name Bihar Post Matric Scholarship (PMS) Scheme 2026-27
Department Education Department, Government of Bihar
Target Categories SC, ST, BC, and EBC students belonging to Bihar
Family Income Limit Up to INR 3,00,000 per annum (from all sources)
Eligible Courses Class 11th, 12th, Degree, PG, Diploma, ITI, B.Tech, B.Pharm, B.Ed, etc.
Official Portal Link pmsonline.bih.nic.in
Mode of Application 100% Online Registration and Verification

Detailed Eligibility Criteria

To ensure your application is not rejected, you must meet the eligibility benchmarks set by the state education department. The core parameters include:

  • Residential Status: The applicant must be a permanent resident (domicile) of the Bihar state.
  • Category Status: The scheme is strictly applicable to candidates who belong to SC, ST, BC, or EBC categories as recognized by the state list.
  • Annual Family Income: The collective annual income of the student's family (parents/guardians) from all sources must not exceed INR 3,00,000. Ensure you obtain an updated income certificate issued after April 1, 2026.
  • Educational Qualification: Students must have successfully cleared their matriculation (Class 10) or equivalent examination. They should currently be enrolled in a post-matric degree, diploma, or certificate program.
  • Institution Status: The college or university must be registered and active on the PMS portal. Students studying in state-run premium institutions like Bihar Agricultural University - [BAU] Sabour, Bhagalpur, medical institutions, or vocational setups such as the Bihar College of Pharmacy, Patna and teacher training facilities like the Bihar College of Teacher Education, Patna, are fully eligible to apply, provided their respective institutes are registered on the official portal.

Comprehensive Documents Checklist

Uploading incorrect or blurred documents is the primary reason behind scholarship application rejections. Gather the following self-attested documents before beginning your registration process on the portal:

  1. Aadhaar Card: Must be linked with your active mobile number and your primary bank account for DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer) processing.
  2. Domicile (Residential) Certificate: Issued by the authorized circle officer (CO) or revenue officer in Bihar.
  3. Caste Certificate: A valid category certificate confirming SC, ST, BC, or EBC status.
  4. Income Certificate: Must state the current family income, ideally issued in the current financial year.
  5. Bonafide Certificate: A certificate issued by the administrative head or registrar of your college confirming your current enrollment status.
  6. Fee Receipt: The official fee receipt mentioning the institutional tuition fee breaks for the 2026-27 academic session.
  7. Previous Academic Marksheets: Marksheets from the last passed examination (Class 10th, 12th, or last semester/year results).
  8. Passport Size Photograph: Recent, colored photograph in JPG/PNG format.
  9. Bank Account Details: The bank account must belong solely to the student (joint accounts or parents' accounts are generally not accepted). It should also be seeded with Aadhaar.

Step-by-Step Guidance to Apply Online

Follow this systematic guide to complete your application for the Bihar Post Matric Scholarship 2026-27:

Step 1: Check College Registration Status

Before registering yourself, navigate to the official portal (pmsonline.bih.nic.in) and click on the 'Registered Institution List' link. Verify if your college is listed for the academic year 2026-27. If it is not listed, request your institution's nodal officer to register on the platform.

Step 2: Student Registration

Click on the designated application link for your category (SC & ST Students registration / BC & EBC Students registration). Agree to the declarations and fill in basic details including your name, mobile number, email address, Aadhaar number, and date of birth. Verify these details using the OTP sent to your registered mobile and email.

Step 3: Login and Profile Completion

Upon successful registration, you will receive a unique User ID and Password on your registered mobile number. Log in to the portal, update your personal profile details, and add your current bank account particulars.

Step 4: Scholarship Application and Document Upload

Click on 'Apply for Scholarship'. Select your academic year (2026-27), institution state (Bihar or outside), institution name, course, and enter details such as roll number, admission date, and fee structures. Carefully upload PDF versions of your certificates (Aadhaar, Domicile, Caste, Income, Bonafide, and Fee Receipt) under the designated file limits.

Step 5: Final Submission and Print

Review the filled-in application form for accuracy. Any mismatch between your Aadhaar details, marksheet, or bank account could cause delay. Once satisfied, click on 'Finalize Application'. Download the soft copy and print the application form for your personal records and submission to your institution if required.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can students studying outside Bihar apply for this scholarship?

Yes, permanent residents of Bihar who are studying in government or AICTE-approved institutions located outside Bihar can apply, provided their colleges are registered on the Bihar PMS portal.

What should I do if my college is not showing in the list?

If your college is not listed, you should contact your college administration and request them to register on the Bihar Post Matric Scholarship portal. Students cannot apply unless their college completes its official institutional registration.

Is Aadhaar seeding mandatory for the scholarship bank account?

Yes, Aadhaar seeding with your bank account is absolutely mandatory. The Government of Bihar disburses scholarship funds directly using the Aadhaar-Enabled Payment System (AEPS). Applications with unseeded accounts may face transaction failures.

Can I edit my application after final submission?

No, you cannot edit your application after you click on 'Finalize Application'. If your application gets rejected or sent back for correction by your college nodal officer, only then can you log in and make the required corrections.

Sources

  • Official Bihar Post Matric Scholarship Portal: https://pmsonline.bih.nic.in/
  • Education Department, Government of Bihar: https://state.bihar.gov.in/education/

title: Jammu University UG/PG Semester Results 2026: Re-Evaluation Verification Protocols and Provisional Marksheet Discrepancy Fixes
description: Comprehensive guide for Jammu University students on checking UG/PG semester results, submitting re-evaluation applications, verifying marksheets, and resolving provisional grade discrepancies.
content:
The publication of undergraduate and postgraduate semester results by the University of Jammu is a crucial milestone for thousands of students enrolled across its main campus and affiliated colleges. Following the official announcement of scores, students must carefully inspect their provisional marksheets to ensure every entry accurately reflects their performance. When administrative mismatches, calculation errors, or missing grades occur, knowing the standard protocol for corrections and re-evaluation allows candidates to protect their academic standing without delay.

How to Access and Verify Jammu University UG/PG Semester Results

Students can check their semester performance online through the official examination portal of the University of Jammu. Results are published in downloadable scorecards or gazette format, categorized by degree program, batch, and semester.

Steps for Online Result Retrieval

  • Navigate to the official Controller of Examinations portal at jammuuniversity.ac.in or the designated examination portal.
  • Locate the UG/PG Semester Results 2026 section under the main notifications tab.
  • Select your specific course, semester, and academic year.
  • Input your official University Roll Number or Registration Number.
  • Download and save a copy of the provisional marksheet for future administrative reference.

Essential Details to Cross-Check on Your Scorecard

Once you access your provisional marksheet, verify the following details immediately:

  • Candidate Information: Correct spelling of student name, parent names, and registration number.
  • Course Codes and Titles: Accuracy of theory and practical subject titles listed for the given semester.
  • Internal and External Marks Breakup: Verification that continuous assessment scores and end-semester examination marks are accurately split and recorded.
  • Total Credit Points and SGPA/CGPA: Mathematical accuracy of aggregated points and semester grade point average.
  • Status Indicators: Confirmation of status tags such as Passed, Re-appear, Ab (Absent), or Discrepancy (Discr).

Understanding the Re-Evaluation Process

Students who suspect an error in answer script evaluation or grade calculation can request a formal re-evaluation. The University of Jammu follows strict institutional timelines and guidelines for script re-checking.

Application Timelines and Submission Rules

The window for applying for re-evaluation typically opens within 10 to 15 days from the date of result declaration. Candidates must submit their application forms online via the university portal along with the prescribed fee per paper. Applications submitted beyond the published deadline are generally rejected without consideration.

Re-Evaluation Rules and Mark Adjustments

  • Independent Re-Assessment: Your answer script is assigned to an independent examiner for unbiased re-evaluation.
  • Score Revision Criteria: If the difference between the original mark and the re-evaluated mark is within the university's defined threshold percentage, the higher mark is accepted. If the discrepancy exceeds the threshold, the script may be sent to a third evaluator, and the average of the two closest marks is finalized.
  • Finality of Re-Evaluated Results: Once the updated score is published, it replaces the old score, whether the mark increases or decreases.

Fixing Provisional Marksheet Discrepancies

Provisional marksheets can occasionally display missing internal marks, incorrect subject codes, or false absence entries. Addressing these errors requires prompt interaction with the college examination cell or the university controller of examinations.

Common Discrepancies and Immediate Solutions

  • Marked Absent (Ab) While Present: Submit an application to your department head or college principal accompanied by an attested copy of the examination attendance sheet signed by the invigilator.
  • Missing Internal Assessment Scores: Contact your course instructor or department head to ensure internal assessment award sheets were uploaded and transmitted to the university evaluation wing.
  • Typographical Name or Registration Errors: Submit a correction form along with your Class 10/12 matriculation certificates as proof of identity to the registration branch.

Steps to Obtain an Updated Official Marksheet

After your re-evaluation results are declared or discrepancy applications are processed, an updated marksheet is generated. Follow these steps to secure your revised document:

  1. Surrender the original provisional marksheet containing errors to the University Controller of Examinations office or your college administrative desk.
  2. Provide a copy of the official re-evaluation notification or discrepancy resolution memo.
  3. Collect the fresh, signed transcript or final degree grade card issued by the university examination division.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long after the result declaration can I apply for re-evaluation at Jammu University?

Applications for re-evaluation are typically accepted within 10 to 15 days from the date the semester results are uploaded to the official university portal.

What should I do if my Jammu University marksheet displays an Absent status even though I took the exam?

Obtain an attested copy of the exam attendance sheet from your examination center and submit it along with a formal correction request to your department head and the Controller of Examinations.

Can a candidate's marks decrease after re-evaluation?

Yes, during re-evaluation, the revised score evaluated by the fresh examiner becomes final, which means marks can increase, stay the same, or decrease.

Where can candidates verify their official Jammu University UG and PG semester results?

Candidates must verify all official notifications, gazettes, and marksheets directly through the university official portal at jammuuniversity.ac.in.

title: GATE 2027 Two Paper Combination: List of Allowed Subjects, Syllabus Overlap, and Strategy to Maximize PSU Score
description: A comprehensive guide on the GATE 2027 Two Paper Combination, detailing allowed subjects, syllabus overlaps, and strategies to boost PSU recruitment opportunities.
content:
Quick Answer: What is the GATE 2027 Two Paper Combination?

The GATE 2027 Two Paper Combination allows engineering aspirants to attempt two distinct papers in the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering. This policy, managed under the guidelines of the organizing IIT (such as IIT Madras), helps students maximize their opportunities. By taking a secondary paper with a highly overlapping syllabus, candidates double their chances of securing high scores. This strategy is highly beneficial for securing post-graduate admissions at premier institutes and expanding recruitment eligibility for Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).

Key Facts: Allowed Subject Combinations and Syllabus Overlaps

Choosing the right second paper requires a careful balance between your core engineering discipline and the syllabus overlap of the secondary subject. Choosing a paper with compatible topics minimizes extra study time while maximizing your overall performance on exam day.

The table below highlights some of the most popular primary papers, their permitted secondary papers, and the estimated syllabus overlap:

Primary Paper (Code) Allowed Secondary Paper Options Estimated Syllabus Overlap Key Benefit for Candidates
Computer Science (CS) Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (DA), Mathematics (MA) 60% - 70% (with DA) Excellent backup for modern software, research, and AI-focused PSU roles.
Mechanical Engineering (ME) Engineering Sciences (XE), Production & Industrial (PI) 70% - 80% (with XE) Highly scoring sections in XE help secure better ranks for IIT admissions.
Electronics & Comm. (EC) Electrical Engineering (EE), Physics (PH), Instrument Tech (IN) 50% - 60% (with EE) Expands core PSU options in power, semiconductor, and communication sectors.
Civil Engineering (CE) Environmental Science (ES), Geomatics Engineering (GE) 40% - 50% (with ES) Unlocks niche roles in municipal planning, green infrastructure, and PSUs.

Candidates must ensure they pay the separate application fees required for both papers. Additionally, the organizing committee structures the examination schedule so that no two allowed paper combinations clash on the official exam dates.

Step-by-Step Guidance: Choosing and Preparing for Your Dual Papers

To successfully navigate the dual-paper structure for the GATE exam, candidates should follow a structured approach. This guarantees that preparation for the secondary paper does not compromise your primary paper score.

Step 1: Evaluate Your Primary Target

Identify your primary engineering branch. Your main preparation must remain focused on this subject because most core PSU recruitments (such as NTPC, IOCL, ONGC, and HPCL) require a qualifying score in your specific undergraduate discipline.

Step 2: Map the Syllabus Overlap

Look at the syllabus of approved secondary papers. For example, if you are a Mechanical Engineering student, selecting Engineering Sciences (XE) is highly beneficial. The general engineering mathematics and basic fluid mechanics/thermodynamics sections of XE are already core parts of your ME preparation. This allows you to tackle a second exam with very little additional study.

Step 3: Check PSU Recruitment Policies

Some PSUs have started broadening their recruitment criteria to include allied branches. For instance, data-focused and research roles may accept candidates qualifying in the Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (DA) paper. Read the specific eligibility notifications issued by major PSUs before making your final combination choice.

Step 4: Practice Sectional Mock Tests

Time management is vital when dealing with two papers. Dedicate at least 80% of your study schedule to your primary subject. Use the remaining 20% to practice previous years' questions and mock tests specifically targeted at the unique sections of your secondary paper.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is it compulsory to opt for two papers in GATE 2027?

No, choosing a second paper is completely optional. Candidates can choose to sit for only one primary paper if they want to focus all their preparation efforts on a single subject.

Can I choose any two subjects for the exam?

No, you can only choose from the pre-approved list of two-paper combinations issued by the organizing IIT. Random subject combinations are not permitted to avoid scheduling conflicts during the online examination sessions.

Do PSUs recruit candidates based on the secondary paper score?

Most traditional PSUs still recruit through primary engineering branches like CE, ME, EE, and CS. However, specialized research wings, defense organizations, and modern technology departments are increasingly considering scores from papers like DA, XE, and ES. Even if a PSU does not accept the second paper, a high score in it can secure admission to premier master's programs, which open up excellent direct placement options.

What is the fee structure for applying for two papers?

Candidates must pay the standard application fee twice - once for each paper they choose to take. There are no discounted rates or package deals for selecting a dual-paper combination.

Sources and References

  • Official GATE Online Application Processing System (GOAPS) portal and examination guidelines.
  • IIT Madras Official Notifications and Information Brochures for postgraduate engineering admissions.
  • Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) career portals and official recruitment advertisements.

title: CBSE 10వ తరగతి ఆర్థిక మార్కెట్ల పరిచయం పరీక్ష 2027: తేదీ, సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్, సమయం
description: 10వ తరగతి ఆర్థిక మార్కెట్ల పరిచయం (కోడ్ 405) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.
content:
10వ తరగతి ఆర్థిక మార్కెట్ల పరిచయం (కోడ్ 405) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న 10:30 నుంచి 12:30 గంటల వరకు ఉంటుంది.

2026 నవంబర్ 6న విడుదల చేసిన CBSE ప్రధాన పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్‌లో ఈ వివరాలు ఉన్నాయి. ఇది పరీక్షల టైమ్‌టేబుల్ మాత్రమే; మార్కుల జాబితా కాదు. అధికారిక CBSE టైమ్‌టేబుల్

ఆర్థిక మార్కెట్ల పరిచయం పేపర్ ఎప్పుడు, ఎంతసేపు?

తరగతి, పేపర్కోడ్పరీక్ష తేదీసమయం (IST)వ్యవధి
10వ తరగతి: Introduction to Financial Markets40518 ఫిబ్రవరి 202710:30 - 12:302 గంటలు

కేంద్రీయ మాధ్యమిక విద్యా మండలి, 6 నవంబర్ 2026, పేజీ 4: సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్లు, తేదీలు, సమయాలు. అధికారిక PDFలో ఈ పేజీ చూడండి

అధికారిక PDFలో మీ పేపర్‌ను గుర్తించండి

పేజీ 4లో ముందుగా తరగతి శీర్షిక చూసి, తర్వాత 405 కోడ్ గుర్తించండి. ఒక తేదీ లేదా సమయం వరుసగా ఉన్న అనేక సబ్జెక్టులకు వర్తించవచ్చు. ఫోన్‌లో పూర్తి పేజీని పెద్దదిగా చేసి చదవండి.

పాఠశాల నమోదు వివరాల్లోని కోడ్, కోర్సు పేరు సరిపోల్చుకోండి. ఒకే పేరుతో వేర్వేరు తరగతుల పేపర్లు ఉన్నా మీ తరగతి వరుసనే ఎంచుకోండి.

ఇంగ్లిష్ పేపర్‌తో తేదీలను పోల్చుకోండి

10వ తరగతి ఆర్థిక మార్కెట్ల పరిచయం (405) పరీక్ష 18 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. English Language and Literature (184) పరీక్ష 26 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఈ రెండు తేదీల మధ్య 8 రోజుల తేడా ఉంది.

ఈ తేడా మొత్తం చదువుకోడానికి దొరికే సెలవు కాదు. మీ ఇతర పరీక్షలను కూడా క్యాలెండర్‌లో పెట్టి, మధ్యలో పరీక్ష లేని రోజులను మాత్రమే లెక్కించండి. సాధన చేసేటప్పుడు అసలు పేపర్ వ్యవధిని పాటించండి.

ప్రాక్టికల్స్‌కు వేరే షెడ్యూల్

ఈ వరుస బోర్డు పేపర్‌కు సంబంధించినది. ప్రాక్టికల్, ప్రదర్శన, ప్రాజెక్టు లేదా అంతర్గత మూల్యాంకనం ఉంటే వాటి తేదీ, తీసుకెళ్లాల్సిన సామగ్రి గురించి పాఠశాలలో అడగండి.

కేంద్రంలోకి కమ్యూనికేషన్ పరికరాలను అనుమతించరు. తీసుకెళ్లే వస్తువుల విషయంలో CBSE విడిగా ఇచ్చే సూచనలను, అడ్మిట్ కార్డులోని నియమాలను పాటించండి.

పూర్తి పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్ · పేపర్ వ్యవధి వివరాలు

title: UPSC CSE, IFS 2026 Registration 24 फरवरी को समाप्त: आवेदन से जुड़ी जरूरी जानकारी
description: Union Public Service Commission द्वारा आयोजित UPSC CSE और IFS 2026 के लिए आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि 24 फरवरी है। पात्रता, शुल्क, परीक्षा पैटर्न और जरूरी निर्देश यहां जानें।
content:
संघ लोक सेवा आयोग यानी Union Public Service Commission ने सिविल सेवा परीक्षा (CSE) और भारतीय वन सेवा (IFS) 2026 के लिए आवेदन प्रक्रिया शुरू की थी, जिसकी अंतिम तिथि 24 फरवरी 2026 निर्धारित है। जिन उम्मीदवारों ने अभी तक आवेदन नहीं किया है, उन्हें सलाह दी जाती है कि वे अंतिम तिथि से पहले आवेदन प्रक्रिया पूरी कर लें, क्योंकि इसके बाद किसी भी परिस्थिति में फॉर्म स्वीकार नहीं किए जाएंगे।

महत्वपूर्ण तिथियां और विवरण

विवरण जानकारी
परीक्षा नाम UPSC CSE & IFS 2026
आवेदन शुरू जारी
अंतिम तिथि 24 फरवरी 2026
आवेदन माध्यम ऑनलाइन
परीक्षा चरण प्रीलिम्स, मेन्स, इंटरव्यू
आयोजित करने वाली संस्था UPSC

आवेदन प्रक्रिया से जुड़ी जानकारी

CSE और IFS देश की सबसे प्रतिष्ठित परीक्षाओं में शामिल हैं, जिनके माध्यम से IAS, IPS, IFS और अन्य केंद्रीय सेवाओं में चयन किया जाता है। आवेदन केवल ऑनलाइन माध्यम से स्वीकार किए जाते हैं। उम्मीदवारों को आवेदन करते समय अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी, शैक्षणिक विवरण, फोटो, हस्ताक्षर और आवश्यक दस्तावेज सही तरीके से अपलोड करने होते हैं। गलत जानकारी भरने पर आवेदन अस्वीकार भी किया जा सकता है।

पात्रता मानदंड

इन परीक्षाओं के लिए उम्मीदवार का किसी मान्यता प्राप्त विश्वविद्यालय से स्नातक होना आवश्यक है। आयु सीमा सामान्यतः 21 से 32 वर्ष के बीच होती है, जबकि आरक्षित वर्गों को नियमानुसार छूट मिलती है। IFS परीक्षा के लिए विज्ञान विषयों की पृष्ठभूमि आवश्यक होती है, जबकि CSE में किसी भी स्ट्रीम के स्नातक आवेदन कर सकते हैं।

आवेदन शुल्क विवरण

सामान्य और ओबीसी वर्ग के उम्मीदवारों को निर्धारित शुल्क का भुगतान करना होता है, जबकि एससी, एसटी, दिव्यांग और महिला उम्मीदवारों को शुल्क में छूट प्रदान की जाती है। शुल्क का भुगतान ऑनलाइन माध्यम जैसे नेट बैंकिंग, कार्ड या अन्य डिजिटल विकल्पों से किया जा सकता है।

परीक्षा पैटर्न का संक्षिप्त विवरण

परीक्षा तीन चरणों में आयोजित होती है—प्रारंभिक परीक्षा, मुख्य परीक्षा और साक्षात्कार। प्रारंभिक परीक्षा वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रकार की होती है, जबकि मुख्य परीक्षा वर्णनात्मक होती है। अंतिम चयन मुख्य परीक्षा और इंटरव्यू के अंकों के आधार पर किया जाता है।

अंतिम सलाह उम्मीदवारों के लिए

उम्मीदवारों को आवेदन करते समय सभी विवरण सावधानीपूर्वक भरने चाहिए और अंतिम सबमिट करने से पहले फॉर्म का प्रीव्यू जरूर देखना चाहिए। अंतिम समय की तकनीकी समस्याओं से बचने के लिए जल्द आवेदन करना बेहतर होता है।

निष्कर्ष: UPSC CSE और IFS 2026 के लिए आवेदन की अंतिम तिथि नजदीक है, इसलिए इच्छुक अभ्यर्थियों को बिना देर किए आवेदन प्रक्रिया पूरी कर लेनी चाहिए। सही समय पर आवेदन और योजनाबद्ध तैयारी ही सफलता की दिशा में पहला कदम है।

title: Apple’s Smart-Home Push: What It Means for Indian Tech Careers
description: Apple’s reported work with LG on smart-home products offers Indian students a practical way to compare engineering branches, skills and project choices.
content:
Apple’s reported smart-home expansion may make hardware, embedded systems and connected-device skills more useful for Indian technology students. Reports linked Apple and LG to products such as a doorbell, lock and thermostat, while Google Trends India showed Apple-related search interest on 7 October 2026. Treat this as a career signal, not a hiring promise.

What could Apple’s smart-home plan mean for careers?

The work behind a connected lock isn’t limited to one smart-home job title. It can involve sensors, circuit design, firmware, wireless communication, mobile apps, cloud services, testing, privacy and security. A device must respond reliably, protect access and work with the user’s phone. That mix is the useful career lesson.

For parents comparing engineering options, the branch name won’t decide everything. A student who can connect hardware and software has more routes than one who only follows a fashionable course label.

Which course should an Indian student choose?

Choose the type of work you’re ready to practise, then compare the syllabus and lab access through engineering courses.

  • Electronics and communication engineering: A strong base for circuits, sensors, wireless systems and device testing. Add embedded programming.
  • Computer science engineering: Useful for apps, cloud systems, device communication, cybersecurity and data work. Build hardware exposure through projects.
  • Electrical engineering: Relevant to power management, batteries, motors and control systems used in appliances and home-energy products.
  • IoT or embedded systems: Worth considering only when the programme teaches microcontrollers, operating systems, networking and security. Some courses rely more on the label than the laboratory.

What should you build before or during first year?

Build one small connected device instead of collecting certificates. Use a microcontroller to read temperature or motion, send the data over a wireless connection and display it in a basic app. Then document the circuit, access controls, error cases and privacy risks.

That task gives you a sharper course check. If debugging a sensor feels satisfying, embedded work may suit you. If you prefer interfaces and user behaviour, product software or design could be a better fit.

Should you prepare specifically for Apple?

No. Apple’s plans, product markets and hiring needs can change, and the supplied reports don’t establish India recruitment. Build a base that also works for device makers, automation firms, chip companies and software teams. For any Apple application, check the role requirements on Apple’s own careers portal when a vacancy is published.

title: CLAT 2027 Admission: Eligibility, Exam, Counselling & Law Colleges
description: The CLAT 2027 Admission is an opportunity for students planning to pursue UG and PG law programs at participating (NLUs) in India.
content:
The CLAT 2027 Admission program is an opportunity for students planning to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate law programs at participating National Law Universities (NLUs) in India. The Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) is conducted by the Consortium of National Law Universities.

CLAT 2027 Eligibility

Undergraduate CLAT Eligibility

Candidates seeking admission, to a law programme generally need to:

- Pass or sit for Class 12 or a similar exam.

- Achieve the minimum percentage set by the CLAT admission rules.

- Meet the requirements set by the participating NLUs.

- Submit valid category or reservation documents when needed.

Postgraduate CLAT Eligibility

Candidates applying for postgraduate law programmes usually need a law degree from a recognized institution. They must also meet all the admission requirements that apply.

CLAT 2027 Exam Pattern

The UG CLAT examination generally tests areas such as:

  • English Language

  • Current Affairs, including General Knowledge

  • Legal Reasoning

  • Logical Reasoning

  • Quantitative Techniques

Candidates if you plan to study for CLAT 2027, candidates should consult the CLAT 2027 notification. The official CLAT 2027 notification contains the examination pattern, the syllabus, and the marking scheme.

CLAT 2027 Admission Process

The admission process comprises the following steps:

  1. Register yourself online for CLAT 2027.

  2. Fill the application form and attach the necessary documents.

  3. Submit the application fee.

  4. Take the CLAT exam.

  5. Check the result and your rank.

  6. Attend the counselling and admission session.

  7. Make payments and submit documents for verification.

  8. Report to the allotted NLU as per the instructions.

CLAT 2027 Counselling

Candidates who meet the requirements may participate in the counselling process conducted through the Consortium's admission system. The seat allocation can depend on the CLAT rank, the category, the preferences, the seat availability, and the applicable reservation rules in the counselling process.

title: MAT 2025 Registration Live: Don’t Miss Your Chance! Key Dates, Exam Details & How to Apply
description: MAT 2025 registration for the May session started on April 5, 2025. Get all the details on exam dates, eligibility criteria, application process, and exam pattern. Apply for MAT at mat.aima.in today!
content:
MAT 2025 Exam: Registration Open for May Phase, Know Dates, Eligibility & Exam Format

The registration for MAT 2025 May session began on April 5, 2025, and the official exam schedule was released earlier, confirming that the Paper-Based Test (PBT) will be held on May 31 and the Computer-Based Test (CBT) on June 8

The Management Aptitude Test (MAT) 2025, conducted by the All India Management Association (AIMA), is a prominent national-level MBA entrance exam accepted by over 600 B-schools across India. For the May 2025 session, AIMA has officially opened registrations for both PBT (Paper-Based Test) and CBT (Computer-Based Test) modes. MAT is one of the few entrance exams that offer candidates the flexibility to appear in multiple modes: PBT, CBT, and IBT (Internet-Based Test). This year, the May session is gaining attention due to early registration openings, revised test windows, and enhanced accessibility for students through remote proctored options like IBT. Candidates aiming to pursue an MBA or allied programs in the upcoming academic session must note the important deadlines and eligibility criteria for the MAT May 2025 phase.

Important Dates for MAT 2025 (May Session)

Event PBT (Paper-Based Test) CBT (Computer-Based Test)
Last Date to Apply May 25, 2025 June 2, 2025
Admit Card Release May 28, 2025 June 5, 2025
Exam Date May 31, 2025 June 8, 2025
Result Declaration (Tentative) Third Week of June 2025 Third Week of June 2025

The Internet-Based Test (IBT) is also available in multiple test slots in May, offering candidates the flexibility to appear from their homes.

MAT 2025 Eligibility Criteria

Candidates appearing for MAT 2025 must have completed their graduation in any discipline from a recognized university. Those in the final year of their bachelor's program are also eligible to apply. There is no upper age limit or minimum percentage requirement for appearing in MAT, making it accessible to a wide range of students.

MAT 2025 Application Process

The application process for MAT 2025 is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official MAT website at mat.aima.in and register as a new user. Once registered, they must fill out the application form with personal, academic, and test mode details. Scanned images of a recent passport-size photograph and signature must be uploaded. The application fee is ₹2,100 for one mode (either PBT or CBT), and ₹3,600 for those opting to appear in two modes.

MAT 2025 Exam Pattern and Structure

The MAT exam consists of five sections, each carrying equal weightage with 40 questions, making a total of 200 multiple-choice questions. The test duration is 2 hours and 30 minutes. Each correct answer awards 1 mark, and 0.25 marks are deducted for each wrong answer. The five sections include Language Comprehension, Intelligence and Critical Reasoning, Mathematical Skills, Data Analysis and Sufficiency, and Economic & Business Environment.

Conclusion

The MAT 2025 May session is a key opportunity for MBA aspirants to secure admission into reputed management institutes. With flexible exam modes, wide acceptability, and a relatively moderate difficulty level, MAT continues to be a preferred exam for many students. Candidates are advised to register on time, stay updated with the official schedule, and prepare thoroughly to improve their chances of scoring well.

title: NEET UG 2026 Private College Refund Rules: What to Check First
description: Compare security deposits, withdrawal windows, bond clauses and written refund proof before paying a private medical college seat deposit through NEET UG 2026 counselling.
content:
A low seat fee can still become an expensive mistake if the private medical college keeps a security deposit, applies a bond or sets a short withdrawal window. During NEET UG 2026 private medical college counselling, compare the written refund clause with the counselling authority’s allotment and resignation rules before transferring money.

Save the fee circular, offer letter, payment screen and every email. If the college’s promise is only verbal, treat the refund as uncertain.

Read the NEET UG exam guide for the wider admission process, then check current NEET UG notices on the official NTA website.

How should you compare refund rules in NEET UG 2026 private medical college counselling?

Put each college’s deposit, refund deadline and deduction wording in one sheet. The safest option isn’t always the college with the lowest first payment. It’s the one that states what happens if you withdraw, fail to join, take another seat or leave after reporting.

Clause to compareSafer wordingRisky wordingWhat it can mean
Security depositRefundable after written withdrawal, with a stated timeline“Adjustable at management’s discretion”Recovery may depend on an unclear internal decision
Withdrawal windowExact date, time and submission method“Refund as per rules”You may miss an unlisted deadline
BondAmount, trigger and release condition are listedBlanket exit penalty or unclear service conditionLeaving may lead to a separate demand
Proof of paymentOfficial receipt naming the college and fee headPersonal account or informal receiptHarder to prove what you paid and why

What must parents verify before paying a private medical college deposit?

Ask the college for a signed fee and refund document, not a WhatsApp assurance. Match the document against the relevant counselling instructions. NEET UG 2026 private medical college counselling can involve more than one authority, so the responsible counselling portal and the college’s own admission office must agree on the process.

  1. Mark the last date and exact time for withdrawal.
  2. Circle every phrase containing “non-refundable”, “forfeiture”, “bond” or “administrative charges”.
  3. Ask who receives the withdrawal request and whether email, portal submission or a physical letter is required.
  4. Request a written reply stating the refundable amount if you withdraw before joining.
  5. Pay only through the named institution or authorised counselling channel and keep the transaction reference.

Don’t confuse a counselling seat surrender rule with a college refund promise. Before choosing between two Private Medical Colleges, calculate the amount at risk: deposit plus any stated deduction or bond demand. If the college refuses to put the answer in writing, that refusal itself should affect your choice.

content:
GATE 2027 अर्जाच्या छाननीत त्रुटी कळवली असेल, तर ती 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026पर्यंत दुरुस्त करा. स्वतंत्रपणे उघडणाऱ्या शुल्कासह माहिती-दुरुस्तीच्या मुदतीची वाट पाहू नका. IIT मद्रासने तिच्या तारखा अद्याप जाहीर केलेल्या नाहीत.

सुरुवातीला GOAPSवरील स्थिती वाचा

अधिकृत GATE 2027 सूचना

  • Defective दिसत असल्यास ईमेलमधील नेमकी त्रुटी वाचून GOAPSमध्ये सांगितलेली दुरुस्ती करा.
  • In order and accepted म्हणजे छाननीनंतर अर्ज स्वीकारला आहे. पोच जतन करा आणि पुढील अधिकृत सूचना पाहत राहा.

दुरुस्ती सादर करा आणि पुरावा ठेवा

अधिकृत सूचनेनुसार छाननीत आढळलेल्या त्रुटी 14 ते 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026 या काळात अतिरिक्त शुल्काशिवाय दुरुस्त करता येतात. GOAPSमधील पूर्ण संदेश वाचा, मागितलेला दस्तऐवज किंवा बदल तयार करा आणि सादर करा.

अधिकृत GOAPS लॉगिन

सादर केल्यानंतर पोच किंवा पाठवलेल्या तपशिलांचा स्क्रीनशॉट ठेवा. खात्यातील स्थिती पुन्हा पाहा. केवळ नवीन फाइल निवडल्याने दुरुस्ती सादर झाली किंवा अर्ज स्वीकारला गेला असे मानू नका.

वापरलेले DigiLocker खाते हटवू नका

अर्जासाठी वापरलेले पडताळलेले किंवा न पडताळलेले DigiLocker खाते कायम ठेवा. न पडताळलेल्या खात्यासाठी अधिकृत सूचनेप्रमाणे DigiLocker Drive प्रवेशसंमती आणि छायाचित्र असलेला ओळखपुरावा द्या.

संदेश समजत नसेल तर GATE संकेतस्थळावरील संबंधित विभागाच्या संपर्कातून मदत घ्या. अर्जाचा संदर्भ आणि नेमकी अडचण सांगा; पासवर्ड किंवा OTP कधीही देऊ नका.

स्वतःच्या इच्छेने अर्जातील माहिती बदलणे आणि छाननीत कळवलेली त्रुटी दुरुस्त करणे वेगवेगळे आहे. शुल्काच्या दुरुस्तीच्या तारखा आणि परवानगी असलेले बदल जाहीर होईपर्यंत थांबा. त्रुटी-दुरुस्तीची अंतिम तारीख त्या प्रक्रियेची तारीख समजू नका.

title: GATE 2027 लॉगिन: भूला हुआ DigiLocker सुरक्षा PIN रीसेट करें
description: आधिकारिक तरीके से DigiLocker PIN वापस सेट करें, पुराने मोबाइल नंबर की समस्या समझें और GATE आवेदन में इस्तेमाल किए खाते पर लौटें।
content:
भूला हुआ DigiLocker सुरक्षा PIN आपका GATE 2027 खाता खोलने में बाधा बन रहा है तो पहले DigiLocker से पहुँच वापस पाएँ। जमा किए आवेदन वाला खाता बनाए रखें। IIT मद्रास आवेदन और शुल्क जमा करने के बाद उस खाते को न हटाने की सलाह देता है, क्योंकि आगे का GATE संवाद उसी से जुड़ा रहेगा।

DigiLocker साइन-इन से शुरुआत करें

आधिकारिक DigiLocker वेबसाइट खोलें, साइन-इन चुनें और सुरक्षा PIN भूलने वाला विकल्प खोलें। पुराने रिकवरी पेज के बुकमार्क में साइन-इन सत्र की जरूरी जानकारी नहीं हो सकती; वेबसाइट से शुरुआत करें। आधिकारिक DigiLocker वेबसाइट

  1. स्क्रीन पर माँगा गया पंजीकृत आधार या मोबाइल नंबर भरें।

  2. खाते में दर्ज जन्मतिथि भरें। आधार वाले तरीके में आधार की जन्मतिथि इस्तेमाल करें।

  3. DigiLocker का OTP और स्क्रीन पर दिया अन्य सत्यापन पूरा करें।

  4. कहने पर नया सुरक्षा PIN बनाएँ और फिर साइन-इन करें।

OTP और PIN केवल आधिकारिक सेवा पर दर्ज करें। आवेदन ठीक करने का दावा करने वाले किसी व्यक्ति को इन्हें न भेजें और सहायता के स्क्रीनशॉट में भी न रखें।

पुराना मोबाइल नंबर उपलब्ध न हो तो

आधिकारिक DigiLocker सहायता में पुराने मोबाइल नंबर के बिना PIN वापस सेट करने के लिए आधार OTP का विकल्प बताया गया है। आधार नंबर और उसमें दर्ज जन्मतिथि भरने के बाद, उपलब्ध होने पर आधार OTP विकल्प चुनें। OTP आधार से जुड़े मोबाइल पर आता है। OTP और कैप्चा सत्यापन पूरा करके नया PIN बनाएँ। DigiLocker के आधिकारिक निर्देश

DigiLocker, भारत सरकार: आधिकारिक सुरक्षा PIN सहायता। इस वेबपेज पर जारी होने की तारीख नहीं दी गई है। DigiLocker के आधिकारिक निर्देश

इस तरीके में भी आधार से जुड़े नंबर तक पहुँच जरूरी है। OTP न मिले या विवरण स्वीकार न हों तो DigiLocker वेबसाइट का सहायता लिंक इस्तेमाल करें। त्रुटि बताएँ, PIN या OTP नहीं। दूसरा खाता बनाना GATE आवेदन से जुड़े पुराने खाते की पहुँच वापस नहीं देता।

उसी GATE आवेदन पर वापस जाएँ

DigiLocker खुलने लगे तो आधिकारिक GATE वेबसाइट से GOAPS खोलें और जमा किए फॉर्म वाला खाता चुनें। GATE 2027 के खाता निर्देश बताते हैं कि उसी DigiLocker खाते को रखना क्यों जरूरी है। GATE 2027 खाता निर्देश

आवेदन की स्थिति और कमी का संदेश अलग से देखें। PIN रीसेट करने से फोटो, हस्ताक्षर या आवेदन का विवरण नहीं सुधरता, समय-सीमा नहीं बढ़ती और स्वीकृति की पुष्टि नहीं होती। GATE आवेदन की कमी सुधारने वाली मार्गदर्शिका अगला कदम बताती है। GATE आवेदन की कमी सुधारने की मार्गदर्शिका

title: CBSE ધોરણ 10 બેન્કિંગ અને વીમો પરીક્ષા 2027: તારીખ, વિષય કોડ અને સમય
content:
ધોરણ 10માં બેન્કિંગ અને વીમો (કોડ 411)નું પેપર 25 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ 10:30થી 12:30 વાગ્યા સુધી છે.

CBSEએ 6 નવેમ્બર 2026ના મુખ્ય પરીક્ષાના સમયપત્રકમાં આ વિગતો આપી છે. આ પરીક્ષાની તારીખો છે; આ PDF ગુણપત્રક નથી. સત્તાવાર CBSE સમયપત્રક

બેન્કિંગ અને વીમોના પેપર માટે કેટલો સમય મળશે?

ધોરણ અને પેપરકોડપરીક્ષાની તારીખસમય (IST)અવધિ
ધોરણ 10: Banking and Insurance41125 ફેબ્રુઆરી 202710:30 - 12:302 કલાક

કેન્દ્રીય માધ્યમિક શિક્ષણ બોર્ડ, 6 નવેમ્બર 2026, પાનું 5: વિષય કોડ, તારીખ અને સમય. મૂળ PDFનું આ પાનું જુઓ

સત્તાવાર PDFમાં તમારો વિષય શોધો

પાનું 5 ખોલીને પહેલાં ધોરણનું મથાળું જુઓ અને પછી કોડ 411 શોધો. એક જ તારીખ કે સમયનું ખાનું અનેક વિષયોને લાગુ પડી શકે છે. ફોન પર આખું પાનું મોટું કરીને વાંચો.

શાળાની નોંધણીમાં લખેલા કોડ અને વિષયના પૂરાં નામ સાથે સરખાવો. એક જ નામ બીજા ધોરણમાં પણ હોય તો તમારા ધોરણની પંક્તિ જ પસંદ કરો.

અંગ્રેજીના પેપર સાથે તારીખો સરખાવો

ધોરણ 10માં બેન્કિંગ અને વીમો (411)ની પરીક્ષા 25 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ છે. અંગ્રેજી ભાષા અને સાહિત્ય (184)ની પરીક્ષા 26 ફેબ્રુઆરી 2027ના રોજ છે. બંને તારીખ વચ્ચે 1 દિવસનો તફાવત છે.

આ બધા દિવસ વાંચવા માટેની રજા નથી. બીજાં પેપર પણ કૅલેન્ડરમાં લખીને વચ્ચે પરીક્ષા ન હોય એવા જ દિવસો ગણો. પ્રેક્ટિસ કરતી વખતે મૂળ પેપર જેટલો સમય રાખો.

પ્રાયોગિક પરીક્ષાની તારીખ અલગ તપાસો

આ પંક્તિ બોર્ડે નક્કી કરેલા પેપરની છે. પ્રાયોગિક પરીક્ષા, પ્રદર્શન, પ્રોજેક્ટ કે આંતરિક મૂલ્યાંકન હોય તો તેની તારીખ અને જરૂરી સામગ્રી શાળાને પૂછો.

કેન્દ્રમાં સંચાર ઉપકરણો લઈ જવાની છૂટ નથી. બીજું શું લઈ જઈ શકાય તે માટે CBSEની અલગ સૂચનાઓ અને પ્રવેશપત્રના નિયમો પાળો.

title: MH CET Law 2027: ఇంటర్ విద్యార్థులు, డిగ్రీ పూర్తి చేసినవారు ఏ ప్రకటన చూడాలి?
description: ప్రశ్నపత్రాల తయారీకి నిపుణులను పిలిచిన సర్క్యులర్ విద్యార్థుల దరఖాస్తు కాదు. ఐదేళ్ల, మూడేళ్ల ఎల్‌ఎల్‌బీ ప్రవేశ పరీక్షల ప్రకటనలను గుర్తించండి.
content:
ఇంటర్ రెండో సంవత్సరం చదువుతుంటే ఐదేళ్ల ఇంటిగ్రేటెడ్ ఎల్‌ఎల్‌బీ ప్రవేశ పరీక్ష ప్రకటన చూడండి. ఇప్పటికే డిగ్రీ పూర్తయితే మూడేళ్ల ఎల్‌ఎల్‌బీ మార్గం ఉంది. మహారాష్ట్ర CET సెల్ 2027-28 సర్క్యులర్‌లో రెండు పరీక్షల పేర్లూ ఉన్నాయి. కానీ అది విద్యార్థుల నమోదు ప్రారంభించలేదు; ఫీజు చెల్లించమనలేదు, పరీక్ష తేదీ కూడా ఇవ్వలేదు.

సెప్టెంబర్ సర్క్యులర్ ఎవరికి?

30 సెప్టెంబర్ 2026 సర్క్యులర్ ప్రశ్నలు రూపొందించడానికి, వాటిని సమీక్షించడానికి అనుభవం ఉన్న విద్యావేత్తల నుంచి దరఖాస్తులు కోరింది. ఈ దరఖాస్తుతో విద్యార్థులు ఏ ఎల్‌ఎల్‌బీ ప్రవేశ పరీక్షకూ నమోదు కాలేరు.

మీ చదువుకు సరిపోయే కోర్సు

2026 ఐదేళ్ల కోర్సు సమాచార పుస్తకం 12వ తరగతి లేదా సమాన అర్హత తరువాతి మార్గాన్ని వివరిస్తుంది. మూడేళ్ల కోర్సు పుస్తకం డిగ్రీ పూర్తిచేసినవారికి సంబంధించినది. కనీస మార్కులు, వర్గాలవారీ నియమాలు, పత్రాల కోసం 2027-28 పుస్తకాన్నే చూడండి.

డబ్బు చెల్లించే ముందు

విద్యాసంవత్సరం 2027-28 అని, కోర్సు వ్యవధి మీకు సరిపోతుందని, విద్యార్థుల CET నమోదును ప్రకటన స్పష్టంగా కోరుతోందని చూసుకోండి. CAP ప్రకటన కళాశాల ఎంపిక, సీట్ల కేటాయింపు కోసం. పాత లాగిన్ కొత్త పరీక్షకు దరఖాస్తు కాదు. రాష్ట్ర ప్రవేశ పరీక్షల ద్వారా న్యాయ విద్య గురించి కూడా చదవవచ్చు.

title: JEE Main 2027 City Intimation Slip: What to Check Before Exam Day
description: Learn what to verify on the JEE Main 2027 city intimation slip, what it does not confirm and when you still need the final admit card.
content:
A wrong exam city on the JEE Main 2027 city intimation slip can turn a manageable travel plan into a last-minute scramble. When NTA releases the slip for Session 1, download it from the official JEE Main website, check the details against your application and remember one hard rule: the city slip is not the admit card.

It tells you the allotted examination city so you can plan travel. It does not, by itself, confirm your exact exam centre, shift, reporting time or entry permission.

What should you check on the city intimation slip?

Start with identity and location, not the PDF filename. A small mismatch can become a problem at the gate or during a correction request.

  • Candidate details: Check your name, application number, photograph and other visible personal information against your submitted form and identity document.
  • Paper details: Confirm the session, examination paper and language information shown on the slip. Don’t assume a familiar city means every other detail is correct.
  • Allotted city: Read the city and state carefully. Check whether the location is practical for you by train, bus or flight, especially if you live outside the state.
  • Download record: Save the PDF, take a clear printout and keep a copy in your phone. Also note the date and time you accessed it.

City intimation slip versus JEE Main admit card

The difference matters. The intimation slip is mainly a travel-planning document. The admit card is the document used for examination-day instructions and centre entry, and it is issued separately as per NTA’s notice.

DocumentWhat it tells youWhat you should do
City intimation slipAllotted examination cityPlan travel and inspect details
Admit cardCentre, date, shift and instructionsCarry it as directed for entry

So don’t book a non-refundable ticket based only on a city slip if your centre details are still pending. Compare the slip with the later admit card when NTA publishes it.

What if the city or personal detail looks wrong?

Take a screenshot and retain the downloaded PDF before contacting NTA through the route stated in the official notice. Don’t edit the document yourself or download a file from a social-media link. For broader exam planning, you can also compare other entrance tests through the entrance exams section.

Parents should check the journey twice: the city named on the slip, and the actual centre address printed on the admit card. Those are not interchangeable. Keep travel, accommodation and a backup route ready only after the final hall ticket confirms the centre.

CBSE Class 12 Mathematics Last Minute Revision 2026 – Easy Overview to Pass

If your CBSE Class 12 Maths board exam 2026 is near and you feel nervous, don’t worry. This last minute Maths revision guide will help you revise only the most important chapters, formulas, and question types so that you can pass confidently and even score well.

Maths is all about practice + formulas + smart chapter selection.

CBSE Class 12 Maths Exam Pattern 2026 (Quick View)

Component Marks
Theory Exam 80
Internal Assessment 20
Total 100
Exam Duration 3 Hours

Unit-Wise Weightage (Very Important)

Unit Name Marks
I Relations & Functions 8
II Algebra 10
III Calculus 35
IV Vectors & 3D Geometry 14
V Linear Programming 5
VI Probability 8

Units You MUST Study First (To Pass Easily)

These units cover 60+ marks:

  1. Calculus (35 marks)

  2. Vectors & 3D Geometry (14 marks)

  3. Probability (8 marks)

  4. Linear Programming (5 marks)

Unit-Wise Last Minute Topics to Revise

1. Calculus (Highest Weight)

✔ Continuity & Differentiability
✔ Application of derivatives (maxima–minima)
✔ Indefinite & definite integrals
✔ Area under curves
✔ Differential equations

Tip: Learn formulas and practice 8–10 standard questions.

2. Vectors & 3D Geometry

✔ Dot & cross product
✔ Equation of line
✔ Equation of plane
✔ Shortest distance

3. Probability

✔ Conditional probability
✔ Bayes theorem
✔ Mean & variance
✔ Binomial distribution

4. Linear Programming

✔ Graphical method
✔ Feasible region
✔ Corner point method

Easy 5 marks if practiced once.

5. Algebra

✔ Matrices
✔ Determinants
✔ Inverse of matrix
✔ Solving equations

6. Relations & Functions

✔ Types of functions
✔ Inverse trigonometric functions

Most Important Formulas to Revise

Chapter Formula
Differentiation d(xⁿ)/dx = nxⁿ⁻¹
Integration ∫xⁿ dx = xⁿ⁺¹/(n+1)
Area ∫(y dx)
Line (3D) (x−x₁)/a = (y−y₁)/b = (z−z₁)/c
Probability P(A∩B)=P(A)P(B/A)
Binomial mean μ = np
Binomial variance σ² = npq

One-Day Last Minute Maths Study Plan

Time Topic
3 hrs Calculus
1.5 hrs Vectors & 3D
1 hr Probability
45 min Linear Programming
45 min Algebra
30 min Formula revision

Internal Assessment (20 Marks)

Includes:

  • Projects
  • Activities
  • Periodic tests

These marks are already added, so focus mainly on theory paper.

How to Score More in Maths Exam

  1. Write steps clearly
  2. Mention formulas
  3. Draw graphs neatly
  4. Avoid silly mistakes
  5. Attempt all questions
  6. Use rough work space properly

Common Mistakes to Avoid

  • Skipping steps
  • Wrong formula
  • Calculation errors
  • Leaving questions blank
  • Poor time management

नीचे दी गई सूची में राजस्थान के कुछ प्रमुख BSTC कॉलेजों का विवरण दिया गया है, जिसमें सीटें और अनुमानित फीस भी शामिल है। यह जानकारी 2026 एडमिशन ट्रेंड्स और उपलब्ध कॉलेज डेटा के आधार पर तैयार की गई है।

title: Gujarat NEET UG Round 1 Choice Filling 2026: Step-by-Step Option Entry Guide, Seat Matrix, and Cutoff Analysis
description: A comprehensive guide on Gujarat NEET UG Round 1 Choice Filling 2026. Learn about the ACPUGMEC registration steps, seat matrix, cutoff analysis, and strategic locking instructions.
content:
The Admission Committee for Professional Under Graduate Medical Educational Courses (ACPUGMEC) is commencing the choice-filling process for Gujarat MBBS and BDS admissions. Following the completion of registration and document verification, the choice-filling stage represents the most critical milestone for aspirants attempting to secure a medical seat in the state. Candidates must utilize their NEET UG scores strategically to select and prioritize their preferred institutions.

Establishing a well-researched preference list is key, as the sequence in which choices are entered directly dictates the automated seat allocation. This guide provides a detailed breakdown of the step-by-step option entry workflow, an overview of the seat matrix, and a cutoff analysis to help students lock their preferences with confidence.

Gujarat NEET UG Round 1 Choice Filling 2026: Key Highlights

Before proceeding with the portal steps, candidates should note the structural overview of the ACPUGMEC counselling process for the 2026 session:

Counselling Event Details
Counselling Authority Admission Committee for Professional Under Graduate Medical Educational Courses (ACPUGMEC), Gujarat
Admission Basis National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) score and rank
Official Website medadmgujarat.org
Available Courses MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery) and BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery)
Seat Quotas Covered Government Quota (GQ), Management Quota (MQ), and NRI Quota (NQ) in State Colleges

Understanding the Seat Matrix: GMC, GMERS, and SFIs

The seat matrix released by ACPUGMEC plays a significant role in helping students choose their colleges. Seats are categorized under three primary types of medical institutions in Gujarat:

  • Government Medical Colleges (GMC): These are fully government-funded institutions with the lowest fee structures. Getting a seat in GMCs is highly competitive and requires a high state rank.
  • GMERS Medical Colleges: Managed by the Gujarat Medical Education and Research Society, these semi-government colleges offer excellent infrastructure with moderate fee structures, acting as a middle ground between GMCs and private institutions.
  • Self-Financed Institutions (SFI): These are private medical colleges with higher fee structures. SFIs offer Government Quota (with standard private fees), Management Quota, and NRI Quota seats. An example of a prominent self-financed institution in the region is the Gujarat Adani Institute of Medical Sciences - [GAIMS], Kachchh.

Step-by-Step Guide to Gujarat NEET UG Round 1 Choice Filling 2026

To avoid errors during the option entry process, candidates are advised to follow these official step-by-step instructions on the ACPUGMEC portal:

Step 1: Log in to the Candidate Portal

Navigate to the official ACPUGMEC website (medadmgujarat.org). Click on the "Medical, Dental, Ayurvedic & Homeopathic Admission" tab. Enter your User ID, Password, 14-digit PIN, and captcha to access your candidate dashboard.

Step 2: Access the Choice Filling Area

Once logged in, click on the "Choice Details" option from the main menu and select "Available Choices". Here, you can view the complete list of colleges and courses you are eligible to choose based on your registration details.

Step 3: Filter and Select Preferences

To streamline your search, you can filter colleges based on branch (MBBS or BDS), institute type (Government, GMERS, Private SFI), and quota type (Government Quota or Management Quota). Click the "Add" button next to a college to move it to your preferred selection list.

Step 4: Reorder and Prioritize Choices

The sequence of your choices is crucial. You can modify the order of your selected colleges using the "Move", "Swap", or "Up/Down" arrows. Always place your absolute dream colleges at the top, followed by realistic options based on your NEET score, and finally backup options at the bottom.

Step 5: Save and Lock Choices

After finalizing your sequence, click on the "Save & Exit" or "Save & Continue" button to ensure you do not lose your selections in case of an unexpected session timeout. Once you are entirely satisfied with the order, proceed to click on "Lock Choices". If you do not lock your choices manually before the deadline, the system will automatically lock the last saved preferences.

Strategic Cutoff Analysis & Option Entry Strategy

A strategic approach to choice filling relies on analyzing last year's opening and closing ranks across various categories. Here are critical tips for setting up a balanced preference list:

  • Analyze Rank Trends over Marks: Score patterns fluctuate from year to year. Focus on your Gujarat state merit rank instead of raw NEET marks when comparing cutoffs from previous years.
  • Factor in the Fee Structure: There is a stark difference between the annual fees of GMCs (approx. INR 25,000 to INR 1 Lakh), GMERS (approx. INR 3.3 Lakhs to INR 3.75 Lakhs under government quota), and private SFIs (upwards of INR 6 Lakhs to INR 16 Lakhs per year). Ensure your choices align with your family's budget.
  • Mix Your Preferences Judiciously: A common mistake is filling only top-tier GMCs. If your rank is borderline, always include GMERS colleges and reliable SFIs to secure a seat in the first round and prevent getting left out of the initial cycle.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can I edit my choices after locking them?

No. Once choices are locked and submitted on the ACPUGMEC portal, they cannot be modified. If you do not lock your choices, the system will auto-lock your saved preferences when the choice-filling window closes.

What happens if I do not register or fill choices in Round 1?

Candidates who do not register during the registration phase cannot participate in subsequent rounds. However, candidates who registered but missed choice filling in Round 1 can participate in Round 2 choice filling, subject to ACPUGMEC's updated round-wise guidelines.

How is a GMERS college different from a Government Medical College?

GMERS institutions are semi-government colleges run by a state-managed society. While they feature excellent infrastructure and academic standards comparable to GMCs, their tuition fees are higher than traditional government medical colleges.

Are private colleges in Gujarat open to out-of-state students under State Quota?

No. The 85% state quota seats in government, GMERS, and private medical colleges in Gujarat are reserved exclusively for candidates who meet the specific state domicile and educational requirements laid down by ACPUGMEC.

Candidates who qualified in the JEECUP 2025 Polytechnic exam and wish to secure admission in UP polytechnic colleges must complete all counselling procedures before the deadline.

  • Eligibility: Candidates who qualified JEECUP 2025

What to Do Before JEECUP Counselling Ends?

  2. Fill in your course and college preferences.

  5. Confirm your seat allotment and freeze/float accordingly.

The JEECUP 2025 Polytechnic counselling process is a gateway to top diploma courses in engineering, pharmacy, and technology in Uttar Pradesh. Seats are allotted based on JEECUP rank, reservation category, and choice preferences.

The last date to complete JEECUP 2025 counselling is August 8, 2025. Ensure that all steps, from registration to document verification, are completed to avoid disqualification from admission.

title: MBA Admission Gap Year: What Work or Preparation Proof Should You Keep?
description: Learn which work, exam preparation and skill-building records can make a gap year clear in MBA applications and interviews.
content:
A gap year won’t automatically damage your MBA admissions profile. What hurts is a blank timeline that you can’t explain with dates, documents and a sensible account of what you did. Build a proof file now, before an application form or interview forces you to reconstruct the year from memory.

This file should support the facts you mention in your CV, application essays and interviews. It doesn’t need to look dramatic. It needs to be consistent.

What should your gap-year proof file contain?

Start with records that establish where your time went. Keep scanned copies in one folder and name each file with the month and activity. A parent or student can also maintain a simple month-by-month timeline.

  • Employment: offer letter, joining letter, payslips, bank salary credits, relieving letter and an experience certificate showing the employer, role and dates.
  • Internships or freelance work: appointment emails, invoices, client confirmations, project files and a short note describing your responsibilities. Don’t call informal help a full-time job.
  • Exam preparation: CAT, XAT, CMAT or other exam registration records, mock-test reports, coaching invoices, study schedules and scorecards where available.
  • Skill-building: course certificates, assessment results, project links and dated work samples. A certificate alone is weak; show what you produced with the skill.
  • Personal or family responsibility: medical documents or other supporting records, shared only when relevant and with care. You don’t have to reveal private details to every interviewer.

How do you explain a gap in MBA interviews?

Use a three-part account: what happened, what you did during the period and what the experience changed in your career decision. For example, “I left my role in June, prepared for CAT while completing a finance project, and then decided I need formal training in business analysis.” That is clearer than saying you were “exploring options” for a year.

Keep the dates identical across your entrance exam comparisons, CV and application forms. If your work experience was part-time, say so. Interview panels may ask about your manager, output, study routine or exam attempts. Vague answers create more suspicion than an ordinary gap.

What should you do before submitting MBA applications?

  1. Prepare a one-page timeline covering every month.
  2. Match each claim to a document or work sample.
  3. Write a 60-second explanation without blaming exams, employers or family members.
  4. Check each institute’s application wording for how it defines work experience and employment dates.

Use college comparisons to note each school’s document requirements. Your goal isn’t to disguise the gap. It’s to show that the year had a real purpose and that you can account for it honestly.

title: CTET September 2026 Application Reopens: Syllabus, Passing Marks, and Study Guide
description: A comprehensive guide on the reopened CTET September 2026 applications, paper-wise syllabus, passing criteria, and preparation strategies for candidates.
content:
The Central Board of Secondary Education has reopened the online application portal for the Central Teacher Eligibility Test September 2026. This application window extension brings relief to thousands of aspiring teachers across India who missed the initial registration deadline or needed to update details in their submitted forms. For candidates aspiring to secure teaching positions in Central Government schools such as Kendriya Vidyalayas, Navodaya Vidyalayas, and various state institutions, CTET remains an essential benchmark qualification.

Understanding the syllabus structure, minimum qualifying marks, and a structured study strategy is essential for cracking this national exam on the first attempt.

Overview of CTET Exam Structure and Papers

CTET consists of two main papers conducted in multiple shifts. Candidates can choose to appear for Paper I, Paper II, or both depending on their educational qualifications and career objectives:

  • Paper I: Designed for candidates who intend to teach Classes 1 to 5 (Primary Stage).
  • Paper II: Tailored for candidates who plan to teach Classes 6 to 8 (Elementary Stage).
  • Both Papers: Candidates meeting eligibility criteria for both primary and upper primary levels can register for both examinations.

Both papers carry a total of 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks, with a total duration of 150 minutes. There is no negative marking for incorrect answers.

Paper-Wise Syllabus Breakdown for CTET September 2026

A clear understanding of the syllabus helps candidates focus on high-weightage topics and avoid unnecessary study material.

Paper I Syllabus (Classes 1 to 5)

  1. Child Development and Pedagogy (30 Marks): Focuses on educational psychology, inclusive education, learning theories, and understanding children aged 6 to 11 years.
  2. Language I (30 Marks): Tests language proficiency, comprehension passages, and pedagogical concepts related to first-language instruction.
  3. Language II (30 Marks): Focuses on basic communication skills, reading comprehension, and language teaching methods in a second language.
  4. Mathematics (30 Marks): Covers basic mathematical concepts including numbers, geometry, measurement, volume, data handling, alongside pedagogical issues in teaching math.
  5. Environmental Studies (30 Marks): Covers topics related to family, relationships, food, shelter, water, travel, and environmental pedagogy.

Paper II Syllabus (Classes 6 to 8)

  1. Child Development and Pedagogy (30 Marks): Emphasizes the cognitive and social development of adolescents aged 11 to 14 years, inclusive education, and learning concepts.
  2. Language I (30 Marks): Evaluates advanced language comprehension and pedagogical strategies.
  3. Language II (30 Marks): Focuses on language elements, reasoning in language, and teaching principles.
  4. Subject Specific Section (60 Marks): Candidates choose between Mathematics and Science (for Science and Math teachers) or Social Studies/Social Science (for Social Science teachers). This section evaluates both domain knowledge and subject pedagogy.

Passing Criteria and Qualifying Marks

To qualify in CTET, candidates must meet the minimum cutoff percentage set by the conducting authority:

  • General Category: Candidates securing 60% marks (90 out of 150) are declared qualified.
  • Reserved Categories (SC, ST, OBC, Differently Abled): A concession of 5% is granted by most recruiting agencies, setting the passing threshold at 55% (82.5 or 83 marks out of 150).

Qualifying CTET grants a certificate that holds lifetime validity. However, clearing CTET is an eligibility criterion and does not guarantee direct employment without undergoing subsequent recruitment processes conducted by specific school boards.

Effective Preparation Plan for CTET September 2026

With limited time remaining before the revised examination dates, candidates should adopt a targeted approach:

1. Master Child Development and Pedagogy

Pedagogy accounts for nearly half of the total weightage across all sections. Prioritize understanding key theories proposed by Piaget, Vygotsky, Kohlberg, and modern framework principles such as NEP 2020 and NCF guidance.

2. Choose Languages Wisely

Select Language I as the language in which you possess strong reading and writing fluency, as its comprehension passages are comparatively more complex. Opt for Language II as a language you are comfortably familiar with.

3. Focus on NCERT Textbooks

For subject-specific sections in Paper I and Paper II, NCERT textbooks from Class 1 to 8 serve as the primary source material. Thoroughly cover core concepts, diagrams, and summary points provided in these standard books.

4. Solve Previous Year Question Papers

Practicing at least 5 to 7 years of past question papers helps candidates understand question framing, difficulty levels, and time management constraints.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Where can candidates complete the reopened CTET September 2026 application?

Candidates must visit the official CTET portal at ctet.nic.in to submit their online forms, upload necessary documents, and pay the registration fee before the updated deadline. Always verify notifications on the official authority website.

Is there any negative marking in CTET September 2026?

No, CTET does not carry any negative marking for incorrect answers. Candidates are advised to attempt all 150 questions.

How long is the CTET certificate valid after passing?

The CTET eligibility certificate comes with lifetime validity for all categories.
