title: NEET PG 2026 Admit Card Release: NBEMS Issues Advisory Against Social Media Paper Leak Rumors
description: Comprehensive guide for NEET PG 2026 candidates on downloading hall tickets from the official portal and understanding the essential NBEMS advisory regarding social media paper leak scams.
content:
Overview of NEET PG 2026 Admit Card & Official Security Advisory

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) is preparing to conduct the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Post Graduate (NEET PG) 2026 across designated test centers nationwide. As thousands of medical graduates await their hall tickets, NBEMS has activated the official portal updates for issuing hall tickets. Candidates who registered successfully can log in to their candidate accounts to secure their admit cards prior to the examination date.

Alongside the hall ticket issuance process, the exam authority has taken strong note of fraudulent activity across popular communication channels. NBEMS issued a stern warning advisory alerting aspirants and parents about fake social media accounts making misleading claims about question paper leaks. Candidates are strongly advised to focus on authentic preparation and rely solely on verified official notifications published on the official authority portals.

NBEMS Warning on Social Media Paper Leak Rumors & Fraudulent Claims

With high competition surrounding postgraduate medical admissions, unauthorized groups on platforms such as Telegram, Instagram, and WhatsApp often attempt to exploit candidates. The official advisory issued by NBEMS explicitly clarifies that the question paper preparation and deployment protocols for NEET PG are strictly confidential and encrypted with advanced multi-tier security systems.

Common Scams Identified on Social Media Platforms

Medical aspirants and their families should be aware of recurring deceptive practices reported during the examination season:

  • Fake Paper Samples: Unverified groups circulating fabricated question sets claiming to be the actual question paper in exchange for payment.
  • Guaranteed Rank Schemes: Fraudulent agents promising top scores or direct seat allotments through unauthorized backdoor channels.
  • Phishing Links: Fake website links designed to mimic official NBEMS portals in an effort to collect candidates' personal log-in credentials or fee payments.

NBEMS Action and Strict Legal Measures

NBEMS emphasized that candidates engaging with such unscrupulous elements, paying money for leaked materials, or spreading unverified rumors will face severe disciplinary action. Consequences include permanent debarment from taking medical entrance exams in India and formal police complaints under applicable cybercrime laws. If candidates notice suspicious activity or online groups claiming to hold leaked papers, they must report the incidents directly to local law enforcement or NBEMS authorities.

How to Download NEET PG 2026 Admit Card Securely

Candidates must download their admit cards directly from the official NBEMS web portals (nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in). Hard copies of hall tickets are not dispatched via post or email.

  1. Visit the official NBEMS portal at nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in.
  2. Select the NEET PG 2026 examination tab on the homepage.
  3. Click on the candidate log-in link and enter your User ID and Password created during registration.
  4. Locate the Download Admit Card option on your dashboard.
  5. Review all candidate details carefully and save the PDF file to your device.
  6. Print clear, color copies of the admit card on A4 paper for exam day verification.

Crucial Details to Verify on Your NEET PG Hall Ticket

After downloading the hall ticket, candidates should thoroughly cross-check every detail printed on the document. In case of any technical discrepancy, contact the NBEMS candidate helpdesk immediately for correction.

  • Personal Identification: Correct spelling of the candidate's name, father's name, date of birth, and category.
  • Roll Number & Application Number: Unique identifiers mandatory for desk allocation and computer system log-in.
  • Exam Center Address: Complete location details of the assigned test center, including landmark indicators.
  • Reporting & Gate Closure Time: Precise time windows indicating when entry to the testing laboratory will cease.
  • Uploaded Credentials: Ensure your uploaded passport-size photograph and signature are rendered clearly without blur.

Exam Day Guidelines & Security Protocols

To ensure a seamless examination process, candidates must adhere strictly to the conduct rules established by NBEMS. The examination takes place in a computer-based format with strict biometric and identity checks at every venue.

Candidates must carry a valid physical copy of their printed admit card with a passport photo pasted in the designated space, alongside an original valid photo ID proof (such as a PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, or Passport). Prohibited items inside the examination venue include electronic gadgets, mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, stationery pouches, and metallic ornaments. Candidates are advised to reach the exam city a day early to avoid unexpected travel delays on test day.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Where can candidates download the official NEET PG 2026 admit card?

Candidates can download their admit card exclusively from the official NBEMS websites (nbe.edu.in or natboard.edu.in) using their registered login credentials.

What should candidates do if they spot paper leak claims on Telegram or Instagram?

Candidates must ignore fake social media claims and report suspicious channels or links immediately to NBEMS support or cybercrime authorities. Paying money or sharing details with scammers can lead to permanent debarment.

Will NBEMS send physical hall tickets by post to candidates?

No, NBEMS does not dispatch printed admit cards by post or courier. Candidates must download and print their hall tickets online directly from the candidate portal.

What documents are mandatory to enter the NEET PG 2026 exam center?

Candidates must bring a printed color copy of their NEET PG 2026 admit card with a recent passport photograph pasted on it, along with an original, valid government-issued photo identity card.

title: Top 5 Short-Term Professional Courses After 12th
description: Looking for quick job options after 12th? Discover the top 5 short-term professional courses after 12th that offer industry-ready skills and fast career growth in 2025.
content:
For every student, finishing Class 12 marks an important turning point in their lives. There is an increasing trend of students choosing short-term professional courses that can rapidly prepare them for employment, even if many still opt to pursue traditional degree programs. These courses are ideal for people who wish to enter the workforce early because they are created to impart industry-specific skills, typically in a six-month to one-year timeframe.

The top 5 short-term courses after 12th for fast jobs that can provide you a great start to your career are listed below if you're wondering what to do after 12th grade without spending years on further education.

1. Digital Marketing

The way businesses function has changed as a result of the digital revolution. Every business, regardless of size, is establishing an internet presence. As a result, there is now a huge need for digital marketers.

Students can learn about search engine optimization (SEO), social media marketing, Google Ads, content marketing, and email campaigns in a short-term digital marketing course. Depending on the institute, the training usually lasts three to twelve months.

Career Opportunities: PPC Analyst, Social Media Manager, SEO Expert, and Digital Marketing Executive.

Why Select This Course? It is one of India's fastest-growing industries, and all sectors are in great demand for qualified workers.

2. Graphic Designing

A job in graphic design is a great choice if you are artistic and like dealing with images. In order to produce branding materials, ads, social media graphics, and website visuals, businesses today require designers.

Basic UI/UX concepts, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and CorelDRAW are covered in a brief graphic design course. Typically, it lasts six to twelve months.

Opportunities for employment include UI design, graphic design, creative executive, and visual content creation.

Why Select This Course? There is a steady increase in the need for creative workers in media, advertising, and IT firms, which provide both full-time and freelance positions.

3. Web Designing and Development

Websites are essential for startups, companies, and even individual brands. Because of this, the ability to design and develop websites has become quite valuable.

HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress, and responsive design are all covered in a web design course. Frameworks like Angular and React may also be covered in some advanced courses. Typically, these courses run between six and twelve months.

Opportunities for employment include front-end development, WordPress development, user interface development, and web design.

Why Select This Course? There are many positions in the IT sector, and for qualified web developers, freelance options are just as plentiful.

4. Data Analytics

Decisions in the modern business environment are based on data. Data analysis is essential to every business, from banking and e-commerce to healthcare and logistics.

MS Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, and Google Data Studio are frequently the main topics of short-term data analytics courses. The training lasts anything from six to twelve months.

Opportunities for employment include reporting specialist, MIS executive, business analyst, and data analyst.

Why Select This Course? Businesses need qualified experts who can analyze data, produce insights, and support the development of well-informed business plans.

5. Diploma in Financial Accounting

Financial accounting is among the short-term courses that are most focused on jobs for students with a background in commerce. Payroll administration, GST registration, Tally ERP, and financial reporting are all covered.

One of the easiest methods to get started in the finance field is to take the course, which lasts for approximately six months.

Opportunities for employment include payroll officer, tax consultant, accountant, and accounts executive.

Why Select This Course? Since accountants are necessary for any firm, there is a constant need for experts in accounting.

Final remarks

After completing your 12th grade, short-term professional courses are a great option to begin your career without having to spend years in typical degree programs. They offer useful, career-focused abilities that are pertinent in today's economy in addition to saving time.

Students with backgrounds in both science and commerce might benefit from the **top five courses—Digital Marketing, Graphic Designing, Web Designing, Data Analytics, and Financial Accounting—**. Strong development potential, immediate career prospects, and the opportunity to further upskill in the future are all provided by these disciplines.

title: CG NEET PG 2026 Round 1 Registration and Choice Filling: Official Dates and Fees
description: CGDME has opened Chhattisgarh NEET PG 2026 Round 1 applications for MD/MS seats. See the verified registration and choice-filling windows, fees and the steps to check before you lock choices.
content:
Chhattisgarh’s first round of NEET PG 2026 state counselling is underway for MD and MS admissions. The Commissionerate of Medical Education (CGDME), Raipur, has published its Round 1 online application and institute-and-subject choice notice. If you plan to take part, treat registration and choice filling as two separate deadlines. Finishing the form without saving and locking your choices is not the same as completing both steps.

CG NEET PG Round 1 dates and fee

The timings below are from the CGDME notice dated 21 October 2026 and its attached official PDF. The notice specifies server time.

Step

Opens

Closes

Online application

22 October 2026, 11:00 AM

27 October 2026, 11:59 PM

Institute and subject choice filling and locking

23 October 2026, 11:00 AM

28 October 2026, 11:59 PM

The notice lists a non-refundable online application fee of ₹2,000 for the regular categories and ₹10,000 for overseas Indian or NRI applicants. It refers candidates to a separate security-deposit schedule. Do not mistake the application fee for the full amount that may be payable in your category. Check the linked notice and the live counselling portal before payment.

What to do before choosing a seat

Start with the official CGDME MD/MS counselling page. Read the Round 1 notice and the relevant 2026 admission rules before entering the application portal. Confirm your NEET PG eligibility, candidate category and documents against those rules; a score alone does not establish eligibility for every state seat or quota.

Next, review the institution and specialty choices available to your category. The long PDF attached to the CGDME notice includes counselling material, so verify the current seat matrix there instead of assuming a seat visible in an older list is still available. Rank only options you would actually accept. Check tuition, bond terms, stipend and reporting requirements from the institution or competent authority before locking a high-cost choice. Our guide to comparing government and private NEET PG seat costs can help you frame those questions.

Registration is not the last step

Complete the online application before its own closing time, then return to fill and lock your institute and subject preferences before the later choice deadline. Save your application confirmation and a copy of the locked choices. If the portal displays a payment or submission failure, do not assume a deduction from your bank account means the application was accepted. Check the portal status and the official help route shown there.

For candidates considering the NRI quota, CGDME posted a separate document-verification notice on the same date. Read that alongside the main Round 1 notice rather than treating the regular application steps as the complete NRI process. Students comparing state counselling with the all-India route can also read our NEET PG Round 1 choice-filling guide.

title: AI BTech Course Claims: How Students Can Check the Actual Curriculum
description: Before paying AI BTech fees, learn how to verify the syllabus, labs, faculty, projects and assessment pattern behind a college’s course claims.
content:
A flashy AI BTech name doesn’t prove you’ll study artificial intelligence in depth. Before paying fees, compare the published curriculum with the lab timetable, faculty profiles, project rules and assessment pattern. That evidence will tell you whether the course is genuinely specialised or a familiar computer science degree with a fashionable label.

What should the curriculum actually contain?

AI and machine-learning BTech programmes should show a clear academic progression, not just one elective called “Machine Learning” in the final year. Read the semester-wise syllabus and look for programming, data structures, probability, statistics, linear algebra, databases and computer systems before the specialised papers.

Then check for subjects such as machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, data mining or reinforcement learning. A sensible course won’t necessarily include every topic, but it should explain how students move from mathematical foundations to models, evaluation and deployment.

Four checks that expose a weak AI BTech claim

  1. Read the paper details: A subject title is not enough. Look for unit-wise topics, recommended books, practical hours and marks for laboratory work.
  2. Inspect the labs: Ask whether students get scheduled access to systems, GPUs or cloud tools, and whether the lab list includes coding, model training, data cleaning and performance testing.
  3. Check who teaches it: Faculty pages should show relevant qualifications, research areas or project work. Also ask whether the listed faculty actually teach the specialised subjects.
  4. Examine projects: Find out when projects begin, whether students work with real datasets, how guides are assigned and whether a working demonstration counts in assessment.

Here’s the practical test: ask the admissions office to show the latest syllabus, lab schedule, faculty allocation and project handbook in writing. If the answer stays inside a brochure, slow down. You can also compare colleges by checking whether these documents are publicly available.

How do fees fit into the decision?

Compare the total four-year cost, not only the advertised tuition. Add examination charges, hostel costs, laptop requirements, lab or cloud charges and project expenses. A cheaper course with no practical access may leave your family paying later for outside certifications and training.

Before accepting a seat, make a short evidence file containing the syllabus, fee schedule, lab response and written answers from the college. Use it while you explore courses. If two colleges make similar AI claims, choose the one that gives clearer academic documents and a stronger project structure, not the one with the louder brochure.

title: IIT vs NIT: The Ultimate Comparison - Don’t Pick the Wrong One!
description: Confused between IIT and NIT? This ultimate comparison covers fees, placements, rankings, difficulty level, campus life, and career opportunities. Find out which institute is better for engineering aspirants and which one suits your goals. Don't make the wrong choice-read now!
content:
What is IIT (Indian Institute of Technology)?

The Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) are India's premier engineering institutions, known for their world-class education, cutting-edge research, and top-tier placements. Established by the Indian government, IITs are recognized globally for producing some of the best engineers, scientists, and entrepreneurs.

Academics & Courses:

IITs offer B.Tech, M.Tech, Dual Degree (B.Tech + M.Tech), Ph.D., and MBA programs in various fields like Computer Science, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Aerospace, and Biotechnology. The curriculum is rigorous and research-driven, ensuring students gain theoretical and practical expertise.

Admission Process:

Admission to IITs is through the JEE Advanced exam, which is one of the toughest competitive exams in India. Only students who qualify JEE Mains can appear for JEE Advanced.

Placements & Career Opportunities:

IIT graduates receive high-paying job offers from top companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Tesla, and Goldman Sachs. Many alumni become entrepreneurs, researchers, or pursue higher studies at institutions like MIT, Stanford, and Harvard.

Why Choose IIT?

IITs provide state-of-the-art infrastructure, experienced faculty, and global recognition, making them the dream destination for engineering aspirants. An IIT degree ensures excellent career growth, innovation opportunities, and networking with industry leaders.

 

What is NIT (National Institute of Technology)?

The National Institutes of Technology (NITs) are among India's top engineering institutions, known for their quality education, strong industry connections, and excellent placements. Recognized as Institutes of National Importance, NITs provide a great alternative to IITs for engineering aspirants.

Academics & Courses:

NITs offer B.Tech, M.Tech, Dual Degree, Ph.D., and MBA programs in various branches like Computer Science, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics, and Chemical Engineering. The curriculum is industry-focused, ensuring students gain both technical and practical knowledge.

Admission Process:

Admission to NITs is based on JEE Mains scores, making it relatively easier to get into compared to IITs. Students securing top ranks in JEE Mains can get admission into the best NITs like NIT Trichy, NIT Warangal, and NIT Surathkal.

Placements & Career Opportunities:

NIT graduates secure high-paying jobs from top companies like TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. Many students also pursue higher studies at IITs or international universities.

Why Choose NIT?

NITs provide strong academic foundations, affordable fees, great placements, and a diverse campus life, making them an excellent choice for engineering aspirants who aim for a successful career in technology and innovation.

 

IIT vs NIT: The Ultimate Comparison

Choosing between IIT (Indian Institute of Technology) and NIT (National Institute of Technology) is a major decision for engineering aspirants. Both institutes offer top-quality education, excellent placements, and career growth, but they differ in several aspects. Here’s a detailed comparison to help you decide.

1. Ranking & Reputation

Factor IIT NIT
Ranking Higher, globally recognized Nationally ranked, slightly below IITs
Reputation Prestigious, best in India Respected, second to IITs
Alumni Network Strong global network Strong national presence

2. Admission Process

Factor IIT NIT
Entrance Exam JEE Advanced (after JEE Mains) JEE Mains
Difficulty Level Very high Moderate
Seats Available Limited (23 IITs) More seats (31 NITs)

3. Academics & Curriculum

Factor IIT NIT
Programs Offered B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, Ph.D. B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, Ph.D.
Course Rigor More research-focused Industry-oriented
Faculty Highly qualified, global exposure Experienced, research-driven

4. Placements & Salary

Factor IIT NIT
Average Package ₹12-25 LPA ₹6-12 LPA
Top Recruiters Google, Microsoft, Tesla, Goldman Sachs TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon
Placement Rate 90-100% 80-95%

5. Campus Life & Facilities

Factor IIT NIT
Campus Infrastructure World-class, research labs, innovation hubs Well-equipped, but varies by NIT
Student Life Highly competitive, diverse opportunities Balanced, great extracurriculars
Hostel & Facilities Excellent, high-end amenities Good, but varies by location

Conclusion: Which One is Better?

  • Choose IIT if you aim for global opportunities, high salaries, and cutting-edge research.
  • Choose NIT if you want a strong engineering degree, great campus life, and good placements without the extreme competition of IITs.

Both IIT and NIT offer excellent career opportunities, but your choice should depend on your JEE rank, career goals, and personal preferences.

title: Building a Startup During Graduation
description: Starting a business during college is becoming more than a trend; it's a genuine possibility.
content:
Starting a business during college is becoming more than a trend; it's a genuine possibility. \"Can I build something of my own while still in college?\" is a question that many students are considering in light of the availability of technology, resources, and inspiration from young entrepreneurs worldwide.

There is no one-size-fits-all solution, but if done correctly, college is a great opportunity to try your hand at business.

Why College Might Be the Best Time to Start

  1. Freedom to Experiment : Students have fewer obligations than professionals who have jobs or families. This allows you to explore new things, take chances, and even fail without suffering a significant financial loss.

  2. Low Financial Pressure : The majority of college students have no dependents, bills, or EMIs. Because of this, it's simpler to take chances on novel concepts without being concerned about financial or professional setbacks.

  3.  Access to a Built-In Network : Potential partners abound in colleges, ranging from instructors and other students to alumni and visitors from the business world. To assist you in developing and expanding your idea, numerous institutions now provide students startup support programs, entrepreneurship cells, and growth facilities.
  4. Plenty of Time and Learning Opportunities : You can spend weekends, nights, or breaks from school working on your startup. Additionally, you're always learning - both in the classroom and via practical experience. The reward is steep, but so is the learning curve.

Skills You Develop Along the Way

You'll acquire abilities that will give you a distinct advantage even if your startup doesn't grow or flourish straight away:

  • Problem-solving under real-world pressure

  • Communication and pitching ideas effectively

  • Time management, especially while balancing classes and projects

  • Teamwork and leadership when working with peers

  • Understanding markets and users — a skill useful in any career

These are not the kinds of things you usually learn in a textbook, yet they are extremely useful in both life and the business.

What Are the Risks or Challenges?

These are not the kinds of things you usually learn in a textbook, yet they are extremely useful in both life and the business.

  1. Time Crunch : Managing a startup plus your studies can take up a lot of your time. Your business and your studies may suffer if you're not attentive.
  2. Lack of Experience : You may be inexperienced in customer service, brand development, and financial management. Along the process, you'll need to make a lot of mistakes and pick things up quickly.
  3.  Limited Resources : The majority of student entrepreneurs start off with little to no money. You will probably be funding your idea unless you receive assistance from outside competitions or campus incubators.
  4. Academic Pressure : Many Indian colleges continue to place a strong emphasis on grades and attendance. Your degree, which is still important in many professional pathways, could be impacted if you skip lectures or tasks.

So, Should You Go for It?

Yes, creating a startup while in college may be really fulfilling if you have a solid idea, a lot of passion, and time management skills. It's about the experience, the trip, and the lessons learned, not just about success or failure.

However, there's no harm in waiting if you're still hesitant or investigating your options. Participating in campus entrepreneurial activities, working on small projects, or joining a startup are still ways to obtain experience.

Final Thoughts

It's brave to launch a business while in college, but it's also one of the finest ways to gain practical experience. You'll become more self-assured, clearer, and more aware of your own abilities.

While many student founders leave with career-changing lessons, not all of them go on to become millionaires. Your startup adventure can begin immediately if you're prepared to take charge, deal with obstacles, and develop via action.

For more information on student entrepreneurship, startup advice, and how to maximize your college experience, keep checking back to Dekho Campus.

title: MP NEET UG 2026 round 2 seat allotment dates and process
description: Explain the Round 2 seat allotment timeline for MP NEET UG 2026, eligibility, how to participate, document requirements, and steps for reporting and acceptance. Includes a practical checklist and what to do if seats are not allotted.
content:
Quick takeaway for families

The MP NEET UG 2026 Round 2 seat allotment result is expected to be declared soon after the round closes. Once seats are allotted, candidates must complete physical reporting, document verification, and seat acceptance within specified windows to secure admission.

Overview of MP NEET UG 2026 Round 2

Madhya Pradesh conducts a state level seat allotment process for MBBS/BDS seats based on NEET UG scores. After Round 1, some seats remained vacant. Round 2 provides another chance for qualified candidates to secure admission in affiliated government and private medical and dental colleges in MP. The exact dates are announced by the Directorate of Medical Education (DME) MP and are published on the official MP online portal.

Who is eligible for Round 2

  • Candidates who appeared in NEET UG 2026 and fulfilled the MP DME eligibility criteria for Round 2.
  • Candidates who were allotted a seat in Round 1 but did not report or did not complete document verification may still be eligible for Round 2 if they meet the updated criteria published for the round.
  • New applicants who satisfy the eligibility criteria and have valid NEET UG ranks as per the MP DME guidelines for Round 2.

Important dates to watch

  • Round 2 result declaration: The official timetable states the allotment result will be announced online on the MP DME portal on the specified date. Check the portal login for status updates.
  • Seat acceptance window: After result declaration, candidates must log in and accept the allotted seat within the given time frame. Timely acceptance is mandatory to hold the seat.
  • Document verification and physical reporting: Once a seat is accepted, candidates must report to the designated college for document verification and physical filing of admission at the allotted college within the defined window.
  • Fee payment and completion of admission: After verification, pay required fees and complete admission formalities as directed by the college and DME MP.

Step-by-step process for Round 2

  1. Check eligibility and required documents: NEET UG admit card, NEET score card, 10th/12th mark sheets, birth certificate, domicile certificates (as applicable), category certificates (if relevant), passport-size photos, and any other documents listed on the official portal.
  2. Login to the MP DME portal: Use your registered credentials to access the Round 2 seat allotment section. Do not share login details with third parties.
  3. View and select allotted seats: The system will display available seats by college, course, and category. Choose the seat you want to accept within the time window.
  4. Seat acceptance: Confirm acceptance. A non-acceptance within the window can lead to cancellation of the allotted seat.
  5. Document verification: Visit the college for mandatory document verification in person. Carry original documents and their photocopies as specified. authorities may verify originals and retain copies for records.
  6. Fee payment and admission: Pay required tuition and admissions fees as directed. Submit any remaining documents or undertakings asked by the college.
  7. Reporting to the allotted college: After successful verification and fee payment, report to the college by the deadline to complete admission formalities.

What to bring for reporting and verification

  • NEET UG 2026 score card and admit card
  • Class 10 and 12 mark sheets and passing certificates
  • Domicile certificate (if MP domicile is claimed)
  • Caste certificate or other category certificates (if applicable)
  • Passport-size photographs as required
  • Aadhaar or other government ID
  • All original documents plus xerox copies
  • Provisional admission letter or allotment letter (if provided)

Common issues and how to handle them

  • Seat not allotted in Round 2: Explore any remaining rounds or a mop-up round if offered by the state. Verify if you meet the updated eligibility criteria for subsequent rounds.
  • Discrepancies in documents: Bring original copies and be prepared to provide additional affidavits or certificates if requested by the college or DME MP.
  • Delay in result: Check the official portal regularly and follow the official communication channels for any rescheduled dates.

Tips for parents and students

  • Prepare documents in advance to avoid last-minute errors or missing papers.
  • Keep a backup set of photocopies for each document to streamline verification.
  • If you anticipate difficulties with domicile, category, or eligibility, consult the official guidance and verify with the DME MP before the deadlines.
  • Do not rely on third-party services to complete your round process; use only the official MP online portal and college portals.
  • Stay mindful of deadlines; even a small delay can disqualify you from the Round 2 process.

Checklist at a glance

  • Confirm you are eligible for Round 2.
  • Note the exact result declaration date and the seat acceptance window.
  • Prepare all required documents and copies.
  • Visit the allotted college for verification and physical reporting on time.
  • Complete fee payment and admission formalities within the deadline.

If you need official confirmation

For the latest and precise dates, the official state portal and the DME MP website will publish the Round 2 timetable and any updates. If you are unsure about a date or required document, verify directly on the official portal before taking action.

title: NEET UG 2026 Round 2: Upgrade or Freeze Your MBBS Seat?
description: A practical NEET UG 2026 Round 2 guide to choosing upgrade or freeze, with MBBS seat, fee, reporting and retention risks explained.
content:
In NEET UG 2026 counselling Round 2, choose upgrade only when a higher-preference MBBS seat is worth its fee, distance and reporting demands. Freeze is safer when your allotted college is affordable and losing it would leave you without a workable option. Don’t click on rank hopes alone.

The National Testing Agency conducts NEET UG, while the relevant counselling authority handles allotment, reporting and seat-choice rules. Check the current notice on the official NEET UG website and the counselling portal for your seat pool. The NEET UG exam guide covers the exam, not the authority-specific post-allotment rules.

Should you choose upgrade in NEET UG 2026 counselling?

Choose upgrade only if you would genuinely join every higher choice still listed, including its tuition, hostel cost, travel burden and bond conditions. An upgrade request isn’t a guaranteed better seat, and the treatment of your present seat can depend on the counselling authority’s Round 2 instructions. Read the exact rule before submission.

ChoiceIt may suit you whenCheck before acting
UpgradeA listed higher choice is affordable and preferable.Seat retention, fresh reporting and payment terms.
FreezeYou will join the allotted college without waiting.Total cost, reporting deadline and documents.
Exit or declineThe seat cannot be financed or joined.Refund, forfeiture and future-round eligibility rules.

When is freezing the MBBS seat the safer call?

Freeze when the college passes three tests: your family can meet the published cost without unsafe borrowing, you can report within the stated window, and you’d still accept it if no better seat appears. For a private MBBS seat, calculate tuition, hostel, food, deposits, travel and any bond-linked liability on paper.

Government and private seats can create very different cash pressures, so don’t compare college names alone. If the present seat is your only affordable MBBS option, protecting it may matter more than chasing a small preference improvement.

What should you do before submitting the Round 2 choice?

  1. Write down the current seat and the higher choices you would actually join.
  2. Check the notice for upgrade, freeze, reporting, payment and exit language.
  3. Ask the allotted college for written details of fee heads, deposits and bond papers.
  4. Save the allotment letter, payment receipt, submitted-choice page and reporting acknowledgement.

One wrong selection can become a fee dispute or a lost-seat problem. In NEET UG 2026 counselling, separate the written rule from family advice, then decide based on the seat you can afford and physically join.

title: After Class 12: Is Forensic Science Better Than Psychology for You?
description: Compare Forensic Science and Psychology after Class 12 through subjects, practical work, admission routes, mathematics and career requirements.
content:
Forensic Science and Psychology can attract the same science student, but they prepare you for very different work. Forensic Science is closer to laboratory analysis and evidence records; Psychology focuses on behaviour, cognition, research and assessment. Choose the course whose daily tasks you can tolerate, not the one with the more exciting job title.

Before applying, check four things on every programme page:

  • Class 12 subjects and minimum eligibility
  • University merit, CUET-UG where applicable, or an institution-specific entrance test
  • Course duration, semester structure and practical requirements
  • The exact syllabus, laboratory components, internships and progression options

Rules vary by programme. A familiar course name doesn’t guarantee the same entry route at every university.

Which subject suits your working style?

Forensic Science may suit you if you’re comfortable with biology, chemistry, measurements, written records and controlled laboratory procedures. Course content varies, so inspect the exact semester syllabus and lab timetable before applying. Depending on the university, you may encounter forensic biology, toxicology, chemistry, crime-scene documentation and evidence handling.

Psychology suits a student who wants to study how people think, feel, learn and behave. You’ll still face research methods, psychological testing, case material and statistics. This isn’t simply listening to people’s problems.

What does mathematics look like in each course?

Neither course lets you avoid numbers completely. A forensic student may record measurements, compare observations and interpret analytical results. A psychology student may use statistics to design research, score tests and interpret behavioural data. The difference is application, not the absence of mathematics.

Decision pointForensic SciencePsychology
Typical practical workSamples, lab procedures and evidence documentationResearch tasks, assessment and behavioural observation
Early possibilitiesLaboratory, technical or research supportResearch, HR, social-sector or programme support
Further studyOften helpful for specialised forensic rolesCommonly needed for specialised practice and stronger options

What happens after graduation?

Forensic laboratory, government and technical posts can set their own degree, subject, experience and recruitment conditions. A bachelor’s degree may not match every advertised post. Psychology graduates commonly need postgraduate study for specialised counselling, research or applied roles. For clinical psychologist work, the Rehabilitation Council of India is the relevant regulator, and the recognised training and registration route must be checked against its current rules rather than guessed from a course advertisement.

Read one introductory toxicology chapter and one chapter on memory or learning. Then compare which task you’d willingly repeat. Check laboratory access, internships, faculty areas and postgraduate routes through course listings, but make the decision from the individual university’s programme page. You can also use relevant study material to test your comfort with biology diagrams, research-methods terms and basic statistics.

MHT CET 2026 Percentile vs Rank: How to Understand Your Position

A percentile shows the percentage of candidates who scored equal to or lower than a candidate. Rank tells you where a candidate stands in the merit list.

For instance, if a candidate has a 99th percentile, it means they have done better than about 99% of the candidates in the group. A higher percentile usually means a rank.

You can get an idea of the rank using this formula:

Estimated Rank = (100 − Percentile) × Total Candidates ÷ 100

This is just an estimate. The actual rank depends on how the official merit list is made, the total number of candidates, and the tie-breaking rules used.

For students in the PCB group, the rank must be viewed separately from the PCM group. These two groups have sets of students and different ways of getting admission.

How Is MHT CET 2026 Percentile Calculated?

The Maharashtra State CET Cell uses a normalization process because the exam is held in shifts. Different shifts may have question papers with different difficulty levels. Normalization makes sure that all candidates are compared fairly.

The percentile is calculated using this formula:

Percentile = (Number of candidates in the session scoring equal to or below the candidate ÷ Total candidates appearing in that session) × 100

For example, if 10,000 candidates take the test in one session and 9,500 of them scored equal to or lower than a candidate, the percentile will be 95.

The CET Cell calculates percentiles for each subject separately and an overall percentile. The total percentile is not simply the average of the subject percentiles.

Conclusion

title: CBSE Launching Free AI Bootcamps in September 2025
description: CBSE is introducing free AI bootcamps for students of Classes 9 and 10, along with AI training sessions for teachers, starting September 2025. Know schedule, details, and benefits.
content:
In order to prepare for the future of education, the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is offering free AI boot camps to both teachers and students. These bootcamps, which are set to start in September 2025, are intended to foster innovation, increase AI literacy, and get schools ready for a tech-driven future.

CBSE AI Bootcamp for Students

The boot camps are specifically tailored for kids in Classes 9 and 10. The four phases of the online sessions will take place in September, October, November, and December of 2025. Interactive workshops, project-based learning, and hands-on experience with AI ideas will all be covered in each step.

Students will gain knowledge of how artificial intelligence (AI) functions in the real world, how it is used in many industries, and how to use AI tools to create modest projects. It is anticipated that the interactive and captivating workshops would aid in the development of young students' critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.

AI Training for Teachers

Additionally, CBSE is working to increase teacher capacity, particularly for those instructing AI in Classes 11 and 12. Special training sessions will be held in September and October with IBM's cooperation. Teachers will gain a deeper understanding of AI ideas, adopt innovative teaching strategies, and effectively mentor students in their projects with the support of these sessions.

The program will enable educators to implement cutting-edge AI learning in the classroom in addition to improving their technical proficiency. This is consistent with the broader goal of the CBSE to integrate AI into mainstream Indian education.

India AI Impact Festival 2025

In addition to the bootcamps, CBSE will organize the India AI Impact Festival 2025 in partnership with Intel India, NITI Aayog, and the Ministry of Education. \"AI Innovation for Social Impact\" is the festival's topic.

Students, teachers, and organizations are invited to showcase AI-based solutions that have the potential to improve society during the festival. It's a fantastic chance for young educators and innovators because the chosen entrants will be recognized and mentored.

Why This Initiative Matters

Artificial Intelligence is shaping the future of industries, education, and daily life. By introducing AI bootcamps free of cost, CBSE is ensuring that students and teachers from diverse backgrounds can access this knowledge. It reduces the digital divide and prepares Indian classrooms to compete globally in emerging technologies.

Students will gain early exposure to future-ready skills, while teachers will be better equipped to guide them. The AI Impact Festival adds an exciting platform for showcasing innovation and creativity.

Conclusion

In September 2025, CBSE will begin offering free AI bootcamps, which is a significant step toward revolutionizing education. Through sophisticated teacher training, planned learning for students, and events like the AI Impact Festival, CBSE is preparing India's young people to lead the country in AI in the future.

This strategy confirms that AI will become a fundamental component of education in schools while also bolstering digital education.

title: CBSE Class 12 History Notes 2026 | Last Minute Revision Guide for Board Exams
description: Get easy and quick CBSE Class 12 History notes for 2026 board exams. Important chapters, short notes, key points, and FAQs to help Arts students pass easily.
content:
Introduction

History is an important subject for CBSE Class 12 Arts students. With proper notes and revision, you can easily score good marks in board exams. These last-minute revision notes are simple, short, and easy to understand.

Important Chapters for Class 12 History (CBSE 2026)

Chapter No. Chapter Name Important Topics
1 Bricks, Beads and Bones Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Indus Valley Civilization
2 Kings, Farmers and Towns Maurya & Gupta Empire
3 Kinship, Caste and Class Social structure in ancient India
4 Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings Buddhism, Jainism, Ashoka
5 Through the Eyes of Travellers Ibn Battuta, Al-Biruni
6 Bhakti-Sufi Traditions Kabir, Mirabai, Sufism
7 An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara Hampi, Krishnadevaraya
8 Peasants, Zamindars and the State Mughal revenue system
9 Colonialism and the Countryside Indigo revolt, British policies
10 Rebels and the Raj Revolt of 1857
11 Mahatma Gandhi and Nationalism Non-Cooperation, Civil Disobedience
12 Framing the Constitution Constituent Assembly, key leaders
 

High Weightage & Easy Scoring Units (Fast Recap)

These chapters usually carry more marks and are frequently asked in CBSE board exams:

  • Mahatma Gandhi and Nationalism

  • Framing the Constitution

  • Rebels and the Raj (Revolt of 1857)

  • Colonialism and the Countryside

  • Peasants, Zamindars and the State (Mughal System)

Tip: Focus more on these chapters for long answers and case-based questions.

Easy to Score Units (Concepts are Simple)

These chapters are easy to understand and very scoring if revised properly:

  • Bhakti-Sufi Traditions

  • Through the Eyes of Travellers

  • Thinkers, Beliefs and Buildings (Buddhism & Jainism)

  • Bricks, Beads and Bones (Indus Valley Civilization)

Tip: These chapters are best for short notes, MCQs, and 2–4 mark questions.

Medium Difficulty but Important Units

These chapters require understanding but are important for board exams:

  • Kings, Farmers and Towns (Maurya & Gupta)

  • Kinship, Caste and Class

  • An Imperial Capital: Vijayanagara

Tip: Revise timelines, maps, and key terms from these chapters.

Quick Revision Notes (Chapter-wise)

1. Indus Valley Civilization

  • One of the oldest civilizations in the world.

  • Planned cities, drainage system, brick houses.

  • Main cities: Harappa, Mohenjo-Daro, Dholavira.

2. Maurya and Gupta Empires

  • Maurya Empire founded by Chandragupta Maurya.

  • Ashoka promoted Buddhism and peace.

  • Gupta period called the Golden Age of India.

3. Caste and Social System

  • Indian society divided into castes and classes.

  • Brahmins, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas, Shudras.

  • Untouchability was practiced in ancient times.

4. Buddhism and Jainism

  • Buddha taught the Eightfold Path.

  • Jainism founded by Mahavira.

  • Both religions taught non-violence.

5. Medieval Travellers

  • Ibn Battuta, Marco Polo, Al-Biruni wrote about India.

  • Their accounts help historians understand medieval India.

6. Bhakti and Sufi Movement

  • Bhakti saints: Kabir, Mirabai, Guru Nanak.

  • Sufi saints: Chishti order.

  • They preached love and unity.

7. Mughal Administration

  • Akbar introduced Mansabdari system.

  • Land revenue system by Todar Mal.

8. British Colonial Rule

  • British exploited farmers and peasants.

  • Indigo revolt and other farmer movements happened.

9. Revolt of 1857

  • First major revolt against British rule.

  • Leaders: Rani Lakshmibai, Bahadur Shah Zafar, Nana Saheb.

10. Indian National Movement

  • Gandhi led Non-Cooperation, Salt Satyagraha, Quit India.

  • Role of Congress and freedom fighters was important.

11. Indian Constitution

  • Drafted by Constituent Assembly.

  • Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was Chairman of Drafting Committee.

  • Constitution adopted on 26 January 1950.

Important Dates Table for Quick Revision

Event Year

Maurya Empire 321 BCE
Gupta Empire 320 CE
Mughal Empire 1526
Revolt of 1857 1857
Indian Independence 1947
Constitution Adopted 1950
 

Tips to Score High in CBSE History Exam

  • Learn timelines and important dates.

  • Write short and clear answers.

  • Use maps and diagrams where required.

  • Revise key terms and personalities.

Conclusion

These CBSE Class 12 History last-minute revision notes 2026 are designed for Arts students to quickly revise important chapters and key points. Regular revision and practice will help you pass easily and score good marks in board exams.

title: JEE Main 2027 புதிய படிவம்: எந்த விண்ணப்பம் செல்லும், பழைய கட்டணம் என்ன ஆகும்?
description: பிழைக்குப் பிறகு புதிய செஷன் 1 படிவத்திற்கு NTA அனுமதி; பழைய கட்டணம் மாற்றப்படாது. செல்லுபடியாகும் விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் நவம்பர் திருத்த வசதியை அறியுங்கள்.
content:
JEE Main 2027 செஷன் 1 படிவத்தில் பிழை இருந்தால் கட்டாயம் மீண்டும் பணம் செலுத்த வேண்டும் என்பதில்லை. அக்டோபர் 30 NTA அறிவிப்பு, விண்ணப்ப எண் உருவான பிறகும் கட்டணம் செலுத்திய பிறகும் புதிய விண்ணப்பத்தை அனுமதிக்கிறது. ஆனால் சில விவரங்களை மட்டும் மாற்ற வேண்டியவர்கள் திருத்த வசதியைப் பயன்படுத்துமாறு அறிவுறுத்துகிறது. மீண்டும் தொடங்கும் முன் உங்கள் பிழைக்கேற்ற வழியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்.

திருத்தமா, புதிய விண்ணப்பமா என முதலில் முடிவெடுங்கள்

திருத்த வசதி 27 முதல் 29 நவம்பர் 2026 வரை திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. NTA அனுமதிக்கும் விவரங்களையும் நிபந்தனைகளையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்; ஒவ்வொரு பதிவையும் மாற்றலாம் என இந்த அறிவிப்பு உறுதியளிக்கவில்லை. புதிய படிவத்திற்கு புதிய விண்ணப்ப எண் உருவாகும்; எல்லா விவரங்கள், புகைப்படம், கையொப்பம், ஆவணங்களை மீண்டும் உள்ளிட அல்லது பதிவேற்ற வேண்டும்.

முந்தைய படிவத்தின் தேர்வுக் கட்டணம் திருப்பித் தரப்படாது; புதிய விண்ணப்பத்தில் சரிசெய்யப்படவும் மாட்டாது. பிழையுள்ள விவரத்தின் திருத்த விதி தெளிவில்லாவிட்டால் மீண்டும் கட்டணம் செலுத்தும் முன் NTA வழிகாட்டுதலைப் பெறுங்கள்.

கடைசியாக முழுமைபெற்ற விண்ணப்பமே செல்லும்

கட்டணம் வெற்றிகரமாகச் செலுத்தப்பட்டு உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கம் உருவான கடைசி விண்ணப்பத்தையே NTA செல்லுபடியாகக் கருதும். புதிய பதிவைத் தொடங்குவது மட்டும் பழைய முழுமையான விண்ணப்பத்தை மாற்றாது. புதிய படிவத்தில் கட்டணமும் உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கமும் நிறைவடையாவிட்டால், இரண்டும் முடிந்த பழைய விண்ணப்பமே செல்லும்.

விண்ணப்ப எண், கட்டண உறுதிப்படுத்தல், உறுதிப்படுத்தல் பக்கத்தை ஒன்றாக வைத்திருங்கள். புதிய சமர்ப்பிப்பின் இறுதிப் பக்கத்தில் விவரங்களைப் பார்த்துச் சேமியுங்கள்; பின்னர் தேர்வுத் தகவல்களைப் பார்க்கும்போது முழுமையான விண்ணப்பத்தை அடையாளம் காண இது உதவும்.

தேசிய தேர்வு முகமை, 30 அக்டோபர் 2026 பொதுஅறிவிப்பு: புதிய செஷன் 1 விண்ணப்பம், கட்டணம், செல்லுபடியாகும் விண்ணப்ப விதி. மூல NTA அறிவிப்பைப் படிக்கவும்

நவம்பரில் மூன்று தனித்தனி காலங்கள்

செயல்

NTA அட்டவணை

தாமதக் கட்டணமின்றி புதிய விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் கட்டணத்தை முடித்தல்

22 நவம்பர் 2026 இரவு 11:50 வரை

தாமதக் கட்டணத்துடன் புதிய விண்ணப்பம்

27-29 நவம்பர் 2026

இந்த விளக்கத்தில் தாமதக் கட்டணத் தொகையோ திருத்த வசதி முடியும் நேரமோ இல்லை. பொருந்தும் தள வழிமுறைகளைப் பாருங்கள்; விண்ணப்பத்தின் முடிவு நேரம் திருத்தத்திற்கும் பொருந்தும் எனக் கருத வேண்டாம்.

ஒரு செஷனில் ஒரு முயற்சி மட்டுமே

பல விண்ணப்ப எண்கள் இருப்பதால் ஒரே செஷனில் பலமுறை தேர்வு எழுத அனுமதியில்லை. எண்களை வைத்திருப்பது மட்டும் முறைகேடு (UFM) அல்ல; ஆனால் ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட எண்களைப் பயன்படுத்தி தேர்வு எழுதுவது அல்லது எழுத முயல்வது கையேட்டின்படி UFM ஆகக் கருதப்படும்.

விண்ணப்ப இணைப்புக்கும் புதிய வழிமுறைகளுக்கும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ JEE Main இணையதளத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள். உதவிக்கு அறிவிப்பில் 011-40759000, 011-69227700, jeemain@nta.ac.in உள்ளன. கடவுச்சொல் அல்லது OTP பகிர வேண்டாம். அடையாள விவரங்களை மீண்டும் உள்ளிடும்முன் எங்கள் DigiLocker மற்றும் 10ஆம் வகுப்பு விவர வழிகாட்டியைப் படியுங்கள்.

title: CBSE ക്ലാസ് 10, 12 കൃഷി പരീക്ഷ 2027: തീയതി, വിഷയ കോഡ്, സമയം
content:
ക്ലാസ് 10 കൃഷി (കോഡ് 408) പരീക്ഷ 25 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 12:30 വരെ നടക്കും. ക്ലാസ് 12 കൃഷി (കോഡ് 808) പരീക്ഷ 29 മാർച്ച് 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 13:30 വരെ നടക്കും.

2026 നവംബർ 6ന് പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച CBSE പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷാ ടൈംടേബിളിലാണ് ഈ വിവരം. ഇത് പരീക്ഷയുടെ തീയതിയും സമയവും അറിയാനുള്ള രേഖയാണ്; മാർക്ക് ലിസ്റ്റല്ല. ഔദ്യോഗിക CBSE ടൈംടേബിൾ

കൃഷി പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് എത്ര സമയം ലഭിക്കും?

ക്ലാസും വിഷയവുംകോഡ്പരീക്ഷാ തീയതിസമയം (IST)ദൈർഘ്യം
ക്ലാസ് 10: Agriculture40825 ഫെബ്രുവരി 202710:30 - 12:302 മണിക്കൂർ
ക്ലാസ് 12: Agriculture80829 മാർച്ച് 202710:30 - 13:303 മണിക്കൂർ

സെൻട്രൽ ബോർഡ് ഓഫ് സെക്കൻഡറി എജ്യുക്കേഷൻ, 6 നവംബർ 2026, പേജ് 5: വിഷയ കോഡ്, തീയതി, സമയം. ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക

സെൻട്രൽ ബോർഡ് ഓഫ് സെക്കൻഡറി എജ്യുക്കേഷൻ, 6 നവംബർ 2026, പേജ് 11: വിഷയ കോഡ്, തീയതി, സമയം. ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക

ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ശരിയായ വരി കണ്ടെത്താം

പേജ് 5, 11ൽ ക്ലാസ് ഏതാണെന്നു നോക്കിയ ശേഷം 408, 808 എന്ന കോഡ് കണ്ടെത്തുക. ഒരേ തീയതിയും സമയവും പല വരികൾക്കും ബാധകമാകാം. ഫോണിൽ മുഴുവൻ പേജും വലുതാക്കി നോക്കുക.

സ്കൂളിലെ രജിസ്ട്രേഷനിലുള്ള കോഡും വിഷയത്തിന്റെ മുഴുവൻ പേരും ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. മറ്റൊരു ക്ലാസിലും ഇതേ പേരുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലാസിന്റെ വരി മാത്രം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

ഇംഗ്ലിഷ് പരീക്ഷയുമായി തീയതികൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാം

ക്ലാസ് 10 കൃഷി (408) പരീക്ഷ 25 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് ഭാഷയും സാഹിത്യവും (184) പരീക്ഷ 26 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ആണ്. തീയതികൾ തമ്മിൽ 1 ദിവസത്തെ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ട്. ക്ലാസ് 12 കൃഷി (808) പരീക്ഷ 29 മാർച്ച് 2027നും English Core (301) പരീക്ഷ 5 മാർച്ച് 2027നും ആണ്. തീയതികൾ തമ്മിൽ 24 ദിവസത്തെ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ട്.

ഈ ദിവസങ്ങളെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാൻ കിട്ടുന്ന അവധിയല്ല. മറ്റു പരീക്ഷകളും കലണ്ടറിൽ ചേർത്ത് ഇടയിൽ പരീക്ഷയില്ലാത്ത ദിവസങ്ങൾ മാത്രം എണ്ണുക. പരിശീലനത്തിന് യഥാർഥ പേപ്പറിന്റെ ദൈർഘ്യം തന്നെ എടുക്കുക.

പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് വേറെ തീയതിയുണ്ടാകാം

ഈ വരി ബോർഡ് പേപ്പറിനുള്ളതാണ്. പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ, പ്രകടനം, പ്രോജക്ട് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആന്തരിക മൂല്യനിർണയം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ തീയതിയും വേണ്ട സാമഗ്രികളും സ്കൂളിൽ ചോദിക്കുക.

ആശയവിനിമയ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിനുള്ളിൽ അനുവദിക്കില്ല. കൊണ്ടുപോകാവുന്ന സാധനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് CBSE നൽകുന്ന പ്രത്യേക നിർദേശങ്ങളും അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡും പിന്തുടരുക.

മുഴുവൻ ടൈംടേബിൾ · പരീക്ഷയുടെ ദൈർഘ്യം അറിയാം

title: TG ICET 2026 Phase 1 Web Options Entry Starts: Dates, College Code List, and Choice Filling Instructions
description: The TG ICET 2026 Phase 1 web options entry is live. Get the complete schedule, step-by-step choice filling guide, and strategic tips to secure your MBA/MCA seat before the August 8 deadline.
content:
Quick Answer: TG ICET 2026 Web Options Live Now

The Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) has officially commenced the TG ICET 2026 web options entry process on August 3, 2026. This online gateway allows MBA and MCA aspirants in Telangana to select and prioritize their preferred business schools and technical institutes. The last date to submit and freeze your choices is August 8, 2026. Only candidates who have completed their physical certificate verification at designated helpline centers are eligible to participate in this phase.

Key Facts and Schedule for Phase 1 Counseling

Understanding the timeline is crucial to avoiding last-minute server delays. Below is the official schedule for the Phase 1 counseling process:

Counseling Event Important Dates
Commencement of Web Options Entry August 3, 2026
Last Date for Choice Filling and Option Modification August 8, 2026
Freezing of Submitted Web Options August 8, 2026 (Evening)
Provisional Seat Allotment Result On or before August 12, 2026
Payment of Tuition Fees & Self-Reporting August 12 to August 16, 2026

Step-by-Step Guidance: How to Enter TG ICET 2026 Web Options

To access the choice filling window, candidates must follow a standardized security procedure. Here is the step-by-step method to submit your preferences:

Step 1: Candidate Registration and Password Generation

Before logging in, candidates must generate a password. Visit the official TG ICET counseling website and click on the "Candidate Registration" link. Enter your Registration Number, TG ICET Hall Ticket Number, Rank, and Date of Birth. Once verified, create a secure password and save it for future steps.

Step 2: Accessing the Option Entry Portal

Click on the "Candidate Login" tab. Provide your Login ID, Hall Ticket Number, Password, and Date of Birth. A One-Time Password (OTP) will be sent to your registered mobile number. Enter the OTP to access the web options page.

Step 3: Filtering Colleges and Districts

The screen will display a list of districts and college categories (such as University, Private Aided, or Private Unaided). Select the districts where you prefer to study. This action filters out extra options, making the preference page easier to navigate.

Step 4: Selecting and Ranking Options

Your screen will present a list of eligible colleges alongside their respective codes. You must enter your priority numbers (e.g., 1, 2, 3) in the input boxes next to the college names. Priority "1" represents your top choice. To optimize your placement chances, there is no limit on the number of options you can select.

Step 5: Saving and Freezing Your Choices

Always click "Save Options" at regular intervals. This ensures your progress is not lost due to network interruptions. Once you are entirely satisfied with your rank sequence, you can choose to freeze them. Unfrozen options will lock automatically on the final night of August 8, 2026.

Understanding College Codes and Strategic Choice Filling

A critical step during the TG ICET counseling process is verifying the unique college codes. Many universities have multiple campuses or similarly named affiliated private institutes. Entering an incorrect code could lead to seat allocation in an undesired program or campus.

For instance, candidates looking for prominent engineering and management colleges in the Rangareddi district frequently search for the institutional codes of popular choices. A notable example is the Sri Indu College of Engineering and Technology - [SICET], Rangareddi, which participates in the central allocation. Ensure you match the code exactly with the official handbook provided on the TGCHE counseling website before hitting the submit button.

Smart Strategies for Web Options Entry:

  • Do Not Limit Your Choices: Enter a realistic mix of high-tier, mid-tier, and backup colleges to secure a seat in the very first round.
  • Prioritize Carefully: The algorithm evaluates options sequentially from choice 1 downward. Ensure your absolute dream colleges sit at the top, regardless of expected cutoffs.
  • Check Course Codes: Make sure you do not accidentally select MCA options if your goal is an MBA degree, or vice versa. Keep a close eye on shift timings and fee structures listed next to the college profiles.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Can I edit my web options after saving them?

Yes, you can edit and reorder your saved options as many times as you like before the final deadline on August 8, 2026. However, once you click "Freeze," no further modifications can be made.

What happens if I forget to lock my options before the deadline?

If you fail to freeze your selections, the system will automatically lock your last saved options on the evening of August 8, 2026, and evaluate your rank based on that order.

Who is eligible to participate in the TG ICET Phase 1 web options?

Only candidates who qualified in the TG ICET 2026 exam and successfully completed their physical certificate verification at official helpline centers are permitted to submit web options.

Is there a fee for entering web options?

No separate fee is charged for entering web options. The entry process is covered under the basic processing fee paid during the initial counseling registration phase.

title: மகாராஷ்டிரா SSC, HSC 2027: உத்தேச தேர்வுக் காலத்துடன் படிப்பைத் திட்டமிடுங்கள்
description: மகாராஷ்டிரா 2027 எழுத்து மற்றும் செய்முறைத் தேர்வுகளின் உத்தேச காலத்தை அறியுங்கள். பாடவாரியான இறுதித் தேதிகளுக்கு தனி அட்டவணை தேவை.
content:
மகாராஷ்டிராவில் 10, 12ஆம் வகுப்பு படிப்பவர்கள் வாரியம் அறிவித்துள்ள உத்தேச தேர்வுக் காலத்தை வைத்து மீள்பார்வையைத் திட்டமிடலாம். ஆனால் கணிதம், ஆங்கிலம் அல்லது வேறு பாடத்தின் தேர்வு நாளை முடிவு செய்ய தனிப் பாடவாரி அட்டவணை தேவைப்படும்.

17 செப்டம்பர் 2026 வாரியச் சுற்றறிக்கையில் கீழே உள்ள காலங்கள் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளன. இவற்றைத் தயாரிப்பிற்கான வழிகாட்டியாகப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்; ஒவ்வொரு பாடத்திற்குமான இறுதித் தேர்வுத் தேதியாக எடுத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டாம்.

எழுத்துத் தேர்வுக்கும் செய்முறைக்கும் வெவ்வேறு காலங்கள்

தேர்வுக் கட்டம்HSC, வகுப்பு 12SSC, வகுப்பு 10
எழுத்துத் தேர்வு, உத்தேசம்8 பிப்ரவரி முதல் 16 மார்ச் 2027 வரை15 பிப்ரவரி முதல் 11 மார்ச் 2027 வரை
செய்முறை, தர மதிப்பீடு, வாய்மொழி மற்றும் அக மதிப்பீடு, உத்தேசம்20 ஜனவரி முதல் 6 பிப்ரவரி 2027 வரை28 ஜனவரி முதல் 13 பிப்ரவரி 2027 வரை

இந்தக் காலங்களால் ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட பாடத்தின் தேர்வு நாள் தெரியாது. செய்முறை மற்றும் அக மதிப்பீட்டுக்கான பள்ளி அல்லது ஜூனியர் கல்லூரியின் ஏற்பாடுகளையும் தெரிந்துகொள்ள வேண்டும்.

மாற்றிக்கொள்ளக்கூடிய மீள்பார்வைத் திட்டம்

ஒவ்வொரு பாடத்திலும் இன்னும் முதல் மீள்பார்வை செய்யாத பகுதிகளைப் பட்டியலிடுங்கள். வாராந்திர சிறிய இலக்குகளை அமைத்து, நேரம் வைத்து வினாக்களைப் பயிற்சி செய்து, தவறுகளைத் திருத்துங்கள். தேர்வுகளின் வரிசை தெரிந்ததும் திட்டத்தை மாற்ற சில நாட்களை ஒதுக்கி வையுங்கள்.

செய்முறைப் பதிவேடு, திட்டப்பணி, வாய்மொழித் தயாரிப்பையும் அதே நாள்காட்டியில் சேருங்கள். எந்தப் பணிகள் நிலுவையில் உள்ளன, எப்போது சமர்ப்பிக்க வேண்டும் என்பதைப் பள்ளியிடம் கேளுங்கள். பள்ளிப் பணியை ஒப்படைக்கும் கடைசித் தேதியும் வாரியத் தேர்வுக் காலமும் ஒன்றல்ல.

விரிவான அட்டவணை வந்ததும் சரிபார்க்க வேண்டியவை

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அறிவிப்புப் பக்கத்தில் இருந்து முழு PDFஐ பெறுங்கள். தேர்வு ஆண்டு, SSC அல்லது HSC தலைப்பு, பாடப் பெயர்கள், குறியீடுகள் மற்றும் ஒவ்வொரு தேர்வின் நேரத்தையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். திருத்தப்பட்ட அட்டவணை வந்தால் பழைய நகலை மாற்றுங்கள். வெட்டப்பட்ட படத்தை மட்டும் வைத்திருக்காமல், வழிமுறைகளும் பாடக் குழுக் குறிப்புகளும் உள்ள முழு ஆவணத்தைச் சேமியுங்கள். இரண்டு பாடங்கள் அல்லது குறியீடுகளின் நேரம் மோதுவதாகத் தெரிந்தால் பள்ளியிடம் உறுதிப்படுத்துங்கள்.

மகாராஷ்டிரா வாரியத்தின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அறிவிப்புகள்

அடுத்தகட்டப் படிப்புகளுக்கான பாடநெறிகளைப் பார்க்கவும்

title: तामिळनाडू NEET PG गुणवत्ता यादी 2026: तुमचा कोटा आणि पुरवणी तपासा
description: सरकारी आणि व्यवस्थापन कोट्याच्या स्वतंत्र तात्पुरत्या क्रमवारीत अर्ज क्रमांक जुळवा. रँक मिळणे म्हणजे जागावाटप झाले असे नाही.
content:
तामिळनाडूतील 2026-27 सत्राच्या NEET PG तात्पुरत्या गुणवत्ता याद्या सरकारी आणि व्यवस्थापन कोट्यातील अर्जदारांसाठी उपलब्ध आहेत. तुम्ही अर्ज केलेल्या कोट्याची यादी उघडून अर्ज क्रमांक किंवा NEET रोल क्रमांकाने शोधा. नाव मिळणे हा समुपदेशनाचा एक टप्पा आहे, महाविद्यालयातील जागावाटप नव्हे.

तुमच्या अर्जाशी जुळणारी यादी वापरा

निवड समितीने सरकारी कोट्यातील PG पदवी आणि पदविका उमेदवारांसाठी व व्यवस्थापन कोट्यातील उमेदवारांसाठी स्वतंत्र PDF दिले आहेत. सरकारी यादीत सर्वसाधारण रँक, समुदायाची रँक, सेवास्थिती आणि प्रोत्साहनाची माहिती आहे. व्यवस्थापन यादीत तिच्या रँक व गुणांचे रकाने आहेत. आकड्यांची तुलना करण्यापूर्वी रकान्यांची नावे वाचा.

सेवेतील अर्जदारांसाठी DNB ब्रॉड स्पेशालिटी आणि पोस्ट-MBBS डिप्लोमाची यादी स्वतंत्र आहे. MD किंवा MS समुपदेशनाची स्थिती ठरवण्यासाठी DNB, दंतवैद्यकीय MDS किंवा पदवीस्तरीय वैद्यकीय यादी वापरू नका.

मूळ PDFसोबत पुरवणीही वाचा

निवड समितीच्या संकेतस्थळावर सरकारी कोट्याच्या PG क्रमवारीची पुरवणीही आहे. आधीच्या PDFमध्ये अर्ज सापडत नसल्यास ती नक्की तपासा. NRI, अल्पसंख्याक, PwD आणि विशिष्ट CMC जागांच्या मार्गांसाठी पात्रता याद्या स्वतंत्र आहेत. सर्वसाधारण क्रमवारी प्रत्येक प्रवर्गाच्या अटी ठरवते असे न मानता तुमच्या दाव्याला लागू सूचना वाचा.

तुमची नोंद कागदपत्रांशी जुळवा

अर्ज क्रमांक, NEET रोल क्रमांक, नाव, गुण आणि दिलेले प्रवर्ग किंवा सेवेचे तपशील तपासा. सादर केलेला अर्ज, स्कोअरकार्ड व प्रमाणपत्रे सोबत ठेवा. तफावत दिसल्यास समितीच्या सध्याच्या सूचना व अधिकृत संपर्क मार्ग वापरून कळवा. पाठवलेल्या माहितीची प्रत जतन करा.

केवळ नावाने शोधल्यास स्पेलिंगमधील फरकामुळे नोंद चुकू शकते किंवा दुसऱ्याचे नाव मिळू शकते. आधी अर्ज किंवा रोल क्रमांकाने शोधा, मग उर्वरित तपशील जुळवा.

जागा निश्चित न मानता पर्याय तयार करा

तुम्ही खरोखर स्वीकाराल अशा अभ्यासक्रम आणि महाविद्यालयांच्या जोड्या निवडा. प्राधान्यक्रम देण्यापूर्वी सध्याच्या माहितीपत्रकात शुल्क, बंधपत्र आणि कागदपत्रांच्या अटी वाचा. नोंदणी, पसंतीक्रम भरणे व जागावाटपासाठी स्वतंत्र समुपदेशन वेळापत्रक आणि रिक्त जागांच्या सूचना पाळा. क्रमवारी जाहीर झाल्याने रिपोर्टिंगची अंतिम तारीख ठरत नाही किंवा प्रवेशाची हमी मिळत नाही.

title: GATE 2027 લાઇફ સાયન્સિસ: XL0-XL5 કોડ અને વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગો
description: GATE 2027 XLમાં રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર ફરજિયાત છે. નવા વિભાગ કોડ, બે વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગના ગુણ અને સત્તાવાર અભ્યાસક્રમ મુજબ તૈયારી ગોઠવો.
content:
GATE 2027 લાઇફ સાયન્સિસની તૈયારી કરતા હો તો જૂની અભ્યાસયોજના અનુસરતાં પહેલાં નોંધોમાં વિભાગના કોડ સુધારો. IIT Madrasએ સુધારેલા અભ્યાસક્રમ જાહેર કર્યા છે. રસાયણશાસ્ત્રનો નવો કોડ XL0 છે અને તે ફરજિયાત રહે છે. XL1થી XL5ના પાંચ વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગમાંથી બેના જવાબ આપવાના છે.

મુખ્ય પેપરનો કોડ હજી XL જ છે. અંકો એ જ પેપરના વિભાગ બતાવે છે. આ છ જુદાં GATE પેપર નથી કે દરેક માટે અલગ અરજી કરવી પડે.

વિષયોને નવા કોડ સાથે સરખાવો

સત્તાવાર પેપર અને અભ્યાસક્રમ પૃષ્ઠ પર જૂના અક્ષરના કોડ સામે નવા કોડ આપેલા છે. PDF, પ્રેક્ટિસ પ્રશ્નો અને નોંધો ગોઠવતી વખતે કોડ સાથે વિષયનું નામ પણ જુઓ.

સામાન્ય અભિયોગ્યતાના બીજા 15 ગુણ છે. આમ XLમાં અભિયોગ્યતા 15, રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર 25 અને બે વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગના 30-30 મળીને કુલ 100 ગુણ થાય છે.

પાંચમાંથી બે વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગ પસંદ કરો

સત્તાવાર પ્રશ્નપત્ર માળખા મુજબ બે વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગ પરીક્ષા દરમિયાન પસંદ કરવાના છે. XLના બધા ઉમેદવારો માટે રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર સામાન્ય છે. ઉદાહરણ તરીકે વનસ્પતિશાસ્ત્ર અને પ્રાણીશાસ્ત્ર પસંદ કરવાથી રસાયણશાસ્ત્રનો ભાગ દૂર થતો નથી.

સારી રીતે પૂરા કરી શકો એવા બે વિષય તૈયારી માટે પસંદ કરો. સ્નાતકમાં ભણેલા વિષયોને હાલના અભ્યાસક્રમ સાથે સરખાવો અને દરેક પસંદ કરેલા વિષયના થોડા પ્રશ્નો સમય બાંધીને ઉકેલો. માત્ર નામ જાણીતું હોવા કરતાં પ્રશ્નો ઉકેલી શકવા વધારે ઉપયોગી છે. અઠવાડિયાની યોજનામાં બંને વૈકલ્પિક વિષય સાથે રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર અને સામાન્ય અભિયોગ્યતા પણ રાખો.

સુધારેલા અભ્યાસક્રમથી યાદી બનાવો

લાઇફ સાયન્સિસનો સંયુક્ત અભ્યાસક્રમ PDF અથવા સત્તાવાર પૃષ્ઠ પરથી અલગ વિભાગની PDF મેળવો. રસાયણશાસ્ત્રમાં XL0.4 જૈવ અકાર્બનિક રસાયણશાસ્ત્ર છે. તેમાં ઓક્સિજન વહન અને સંગ્રહના મેટાલોપ્રોટીન, ઇલેક્ટ્રોન વહનના Fe-S મેટાલોપ્રોટીન, કાર્બોનિક એનહાઇડ્રેઝ અને Cu-Zn સુપરઓક્સાઇડ ડિસમ્યુટેઝ છે.

IIT Madras, GATE 2027 લાઇફ સાયન્સિસ અભ્યાસક્રમ, પૃષ્ઠ 1. પરીક્ષાવર્ષ 2027 દર્શાવેલું છે; આ પૃષ્ઠ પર પ્રકાશનની તારીખ છપાયેલી નથી. સુધારેલા અભ્યાસક્રમથી યાદી બનાવો.

વૈકલ્પિક વિષયો પણ કાળજીથી જુઓ. હાલના જૈવરસાયણશાસ્ત્રમાં DNA સમારકામ, વનસ્પતિશાસ્ત્રમાં જીનોમ સંપાદન અને ખાદ્ય ટેક્નોલોજીમાં ખાદ્ય ભેળસેળ તથા પ્રોબાયોટિક ખોરાક છે. આ નોંધો તપાસવાના ઉદાહરણ છે, આખો અભ્યાસક્રમ કે આવનારા પ્રશ્નોનું અનુમાન નથી.

દરેક વિભાગ માટે ત્રણ યાદી બનાવો: ભણેલા મુદ્દા, પુનરાવર્તન જરૂરી મુદ્દા અને સામગ્રીમાં ન હોય તેવા મુદ્દા. જૂના ઉપયોગી પ્રશ્નો રાખો, પણ જૂના પ્રશ્નસંગ્રહને સંપૂર્ણ માનતાં પહેલાં 2027ના અભ્યાસક્રમ સાથે સરખાવો. કોઈ મુદ્દો અભ્યાસક્રમમાં હોવાથી તેના ચોક્કસ ગુણની ખાતરી થતી નથી.

અભ્યાસક્રમ અને અરજી સુધારો અલગ બાબતો છે

XLની અંદર બે વૈકલ્પિક વિભાગ પસંદ કરવા અને બીજું GATE પેપર પસંદ કરવું જુદી બાબત છે. બીજા પેપર માટે અલગ બે-પેપર સંયોજનના નિયમો લાગુ પડે છે. અભ્યાસક્રમ બદલાવાથી જ નોંધણી ફરી ખૂલતી નથી કે અરજીની નવી છેલ્લી તારીખ બનતી નથી.

અરજીમાં ખામીની સૂચના મળી હોય તો સત્તાવાર પોર્ટલ પર તેને અલગથી સુધારો. GATE અરજીની ખામી અને ફી સાથેના સુધારાની માહિતી બંને પ્રક્રિયાનો તફાવત સમજાવે છે.

title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Registration Last Date: लेट फीस से पहले करें आवेदन
description: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration की अंतिम तारीख 22 नवंबर है। जानें आवेदन प्रक्रिया, 500 रुपये लेट फीस, जरूरी दस्तावेज और परीक्षा की तारीखें।
content:
JEE Main 2027 की तैयारी कर रहे उम्मीदवारों के लिए सत्र-1 का आवेदन महत्वपूर्ण है। नेशनल टेस्टिंग एजेंसी (NTA) ने परीक्षा के लिए ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन प्रक्रिया शुरू कर दी है। इच्छुक उम्मीदवारों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे आवेदन की अंतिम तारीख से पहले अपना फॉर्म जमा कर दें। समय पर आवेदन करने से अतिरिक्त लेट फीस और अंतिम समय की तकनीकी परेशानियों से बचा जा सकता है।

JEE Main 2027 Session 1 Registration: महत्वपूर्ण तारीखें

JEE Main 2027 सत्र-1 के लिए आवेदन प्रक्रिया 24 अक्टूबर 2026 से शुरू हुई है। उम्मीदवार 22 नवंबर 2026 रात 11:50 बजे तक बिना लेट फीस के आवेदन कर सकते हैं। इसके बाद 23 से 26 नवंबर 2026 तक 500 रुपये अतिरिक्त लेट फीस के साथ रजिस्ट्रेशन किया जा सकेगा।

सत्र-1 की परीक्षा 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 और 28 जनवरी 2027 को आयोजित की जाएगी। उम्मीदवारों को सलाह दी जाती है कि वे आवेदन की अंतिम तारीख का इंतजार किए बिना रजिस्ट्रेशन पूरा कर लें।

JEE Main 2027 के लिए कैसे करें रजिस्ट्रेशन?

JEE Main 2027 के लिए आवेदन प्रक्रिया ऑनलाइन होगी। सबसे पहले उम्मीदवारों को NTA की आधिकारिक परीक्षा वेबसाइट पर जाकर Session 1 Registration विकल्प चुनना होगा। इसके बाद आवश्यक जानकारी भरकर नया रजिस्ट्रेशन करना होगा।

रजिस्ट्रेशन पूरा होने के बाद एप्लिकेशन नंबर और पासवर्ड से लॉगिन करें। आवेदन फॉर्म में व्यक्तिगत जानकारी, शैक्षणिक विवरण, परीक्षा से संबंधित विकल्प और परीक्षा शहर की प्राथमिकताएं भरें। निर्धारित निर्देशों के अनुसार फोटो, हस्ताक्षर और जरूरी दस्तावेज अपलोड करें।

इसके बाद अपनी कैटेगरी और चुने गए पेपर के अनुसार आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें। फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी विवरणों को ध्यान से जांच लें और कन्फर्मेशन पेज डाउनलोड करके सुरक्षित रखें।

JEE Main 2027 आवेदन के लिए जरूरी दस्तावेज

आवेदन करते समय उम्मीदवारों को पहचान संबंधी जानकारी, कक्षा 10 और 12 के शैक्षणिक विवरण, पासपोर्ट साइज फोटो, हस्ताक्षर और लागू होने पर कैटेगरी प्रमाणपत्र की जानकारी तैयार रखनी चाहिए। सभी दस्तावेज निर्धारित फॉर्मेट और साइज में होने चाहिए।

लेट फीस से बचने के लिए अभी करें आवेदन

JEE Main 2027 सत्र-1 के लिए 22 नवंबर अंतिम तारीख है। इसके बाद आवेदन करने वाले उम्मीदवारों को 500 रुपये अतिरिक्त लेट फीस देनी होगी। अंतिम दिनों में वेबसाइट पर अधिक ट्रैफिक, भुगतान में देरी और तकनीकी समस्याएं हो सकती हैं। इसलिए उम्मीदवारों को समय रहते आवेदन और फीस भुगतान पूरा कर लेना चाहिए।

आवेदन के बाद क्या करें?

आवेदन जमा करने के बाद उम्मीदवारों को कन्फर्मेशन पेज और फीस भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखनी चाहिए। निर्धारित कार्यक्रम के अनुसार 27 से 29 नवंबर 2026 तक आवेदन फॉर्म में सुधार के लिए करेक्शन विंडो उपलब्ध होगी। उम्मीदवारों को परीक्षा शहर की सूचना और एडमिट कार्ड से संबंधित अपडेट भी नियमित रूप से चेक करते रहना चाहिए।

निष्कर्ष

JEE Main 2027 Session 1 के लिए रजिस्ट्रेशन की अंतिम तारीख नजदीक आ रही है। उम्मीदवार 22 नवंबर 2026 तक बिना लेट फीस के आवेदन कर सकते हैं। इंजीनियरिंग प्रवेश परीक्षा में शामिल होने की योजना बना रहे छात्रों को समय रहते रजिस्ट्रेशन पूरा करना चाहिए और आवेदन फॉर्म में सभी जानकारियां सही भरनी चाहिए।

title: Rajasthan NEET PG 2026: Choices Auto-Lock on 29 October
description: The revised provisional merit list is available on Rajasthan’s PG counselling portal. Check your entry and save your choices before the 11:45 pm auto-lock on 29 October.
content:
Rajasthan NEET PG 2026 Round 1 choices will auto-lock at 11:45 pm on 29 October. Registered candidates should check the revised provisional state merit list and finish saving their preferences before that time.

The official counselling portal lists a revised provisional merit list dated 28 October. A place in that list does not itself allot a seat. The board’s Round 1 schedule puts publication of the provisional allotment list on 2 November.

Use the revised list for your own record

Open the revised provisional state merit list and locate your entry. Compare the details with your application and supporting documents. Read any remarks or category conditions that affect your participation before arranging course and college preferences.

The portal explains that Rajasthan state eligibility is linked to the location of the medical college where MBBS was completed; domicile is not the same test. Category-reservation documentation is a separate matter. In-service candidates with MBBS from outside Rajasthan should follow the specific verification and choice-enablement notice displayed on the portal.

Save choices before the server locks them

The schedule allows candidates to fill, save and change choices within the window, followed by auto-locking at 11:45 pm on 29 October. Review the order carefully, including the course and seat type, before leaving the account. A saved preference should reflect a seat you are prepared to accept under its fee and bond conditions.

Printing the online application after auto-locking is scheduled for 30 October. Keep that final record with your counselling documents.

Reporting is at the allotted college desk in Jaipur

For Round 1, the schedule directs reporting, document verification and submission to the allotted college desk at the Academic Block, SMS Medical College, Jaipur. It lists 3-6 November, from 9 am to 4 pm, for this step.

Bring the original relevant documents and required bonds, six copies of the allotment letter, two copies of the application form and two sets of self-attested photocopies, as specified in the schedule and information booklet.

Keep the letter, payment and reporting cut-offs separate

The allotment letter can be printed from 3 November until 1 pm on 6 November. The prescribed one-year tuition fee is to be deposited by NEFT or RTGS from 3 November until 3 pm on 6 November; the schedule says other payment modes will not be accepted. Reporting runs to 4 pm that day. Complete the earlier steps in time to reach the verification desk.

Use the college-specific fee and bond documents linked on the official portal before making a payment. For another state process, consult its own rules, such as the Odisha PG choice and reporting schedule.

title: AP EAMCET Phase 2 Counselling 2026: Expected Dates, Eligibility, and Registration Schedule
description: Looking for the AP EAMCET Phase 2 counselling schedule? Discover the expected registration dates, eligibility criteria, choice-filling process, and expert strategies to secure your BTech seat in Andhra Pradesh.
content:
Quick Answer: When Will AP EAMCET Phase 2 Counselling 2026 Start?

The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) is expected to announce the schedule for the AP EAMCET Phase 2 Counselling 2026 (also known as AP EAPCET) in the third week of August 2026, likely after August 15, 2026. This announcement will follow the completion of the Phase 1 physical reporting and seat acceptance process, which concluded after the Round 1 allotment result release on August 10, 2026.

Candidates who did not secure a seat in Phase 1, missed the initial registration, or want to upgrade their allotted branch will be eligible to participate in this second round of counselling.

Key Facts: AP EAMCET 2026 Phase 2 Schedule & Details

To help you prepare your strategy, here is an overview of the estimated timeline for the second round of Andhra Pradesh engineering admissions, based on previous trends and the current schedule of APSCHE:

Event / Phase Expected Timeline / Status
Phase 1 Seat Allotment Date August 10, 2026 (Released)
Phase 1 Self-Reporting & College Joining Mid-August 2026
Display of Vacant Seats (Seat Matrix) After August 15, 2026 (Tentative)
Phase 2 Registration & Fee Payment Third week of August 2026 (Expected)
Web Options / Choice Filling Process Fourth week of August 2026 (Expected)
Phase 2 Seat Allotment Result Late August or Early September 2026 (Expected)

Who is Eligible for AP EAPCET Phase 2 Counselling?

APSCHE maintains specific eligibility criteria for candidates wishing to enter the second round of admissions. You can participate in Phase 2 if you fall under any of the following categories:

  • No Seat Allotted: Candidates who registered and filled web options in Phase 1 but were not allotted any college due to rank limitations or limited choice entry.
  • Fresh Registrants: Candidates who qualified for the AP EAPCET 2026 exam but did not register, pay the fee, or upload documents during the first phase of counselling.
  • Betterment Seekers: Candidates who secured a seat and completed the online self-reporting process in Phase 1 but wish to try for a better college or branch upgrade.
  • Seat Cancelled/Not Reported: Candidates who were allotted a seat in Round 1 but chose not to self-report or report to the allotted college, thereby forfeiting their Round 1 seat.

Step-by-Step Guidance for Phase 2 Registration and Choice Filling

Participating in Phase 2 requires careful planning, as this is often the final major round before spot admissions. Follow these steps to ensure a smooth process:

Step 1: Registration and Processing Fee (For New Applicants Only)

If you did not register during Phase 1, you must visit the official APSCHE portal and pay the processing fee online. Already-registered candidates do not need to pay the registration fee again.

Step 2: Document Verification

New registrants must upload their documents for online verification. If your documents are flagged for manual verification, you must visit the designated Help Line Centers (HLCs) as scheduled by APSCHE.

Step 3: Analyze the Vacancy Position (Seat Matrix)

Before filling out fresh choices, download the official Phase 2 seat matrix. This document lists the leftover seats in each engineering branch across participating colleges. Prioritize colleges that have realistic vacancies matching your rank.

Step 4: Web Options Entry (Choice Filling)

Log in using your AP EAMCET hall ticket number and password to enter your choices. Even if you registered in Phase 1, you must fill fresh choices for Phase 2. Ensure you save your choices frequently.

Step 5: Choice Locking and Allotment

Lock your choices before the deadline. APSCHE will process these choices based on merit, category, and local area rules to release the Phase 2 seat allotment order.

Strategic Tips for Securing a Seat in Phase 2

Many candidates fail to get a seat in Round 1 because they only select top-tier institutions with high cutoffs. While top-ranking state students might look at national-level avenues like JEE Advanced 2026, regional state colleges remain highly competitive. Here is how to approach Phase 2:

  • Do Not Limit Your Choices: Enter a diverse range of options. Mix top-tier choices with reliable safety options to secure a seat.
  • Analyze Phase 1 Cutoffs: Review the closing ranks of Phase 1. If your rank is close to the closing rank of a desired college, keep it at the top of your list.
  • Understand the Risk of Sliding: If you choose the "sliding" option to try for a better branch, remember that if a new seat is allotted in Phase 2, your Phase 1 seat is automatically cancelled.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Can I change my college choices in Phase 2 if I already accepted a seat in Phase 1?

Yes, you can participate in Phase 2 choice-filling even after accepting a seat in Phase 1. If you are allotted a new college in Phase 2, your previous seat will be cancelled automatically. If no new seat is allotted, your Phase 1 seat remains safe.

2. Do I need to pay the registration fee again for Round 2?

No, candidates who registered and paid the processing fee in Phase 1 do not need to pay the fee again. Only fresh applicants must pay the registration fee.

3. When will the official Phase 2 seat matrix be released?

APSCHE typically publishes the vacancy list a day or two before the web options entry begins. It is expected to be released in the third or fourth week of August 2026.

4. What documents are needed for Phase 2 verification?

You will need your AP EAPCET 2026 Hall Ticket, Rank Card, Transfer Certificate (TC), Intermediate Marks Memo, SSC Marks Memo, Study Certificates (Class 6 to Intermediate), Residence Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), and EWS Certificate (if applicable).
