title: JEE Main 2027 Application Fee Refund: What Happens After Payment Failure
description: JEE Main 2027 payment failed after bank debit? Learn what proof to save, how to separate portal failure from successful submission and what to check next.
content:
A deducted JEE Main 2027 application payment doesn’t prove that your form was submitted. If the NTA portal still shows incomplete, save the payment trail first, then check the application status and the current notice before paying again.

The practical rule is simple: treat bank debit, portal failure and successful submission as three different events. Mixing them up can leave you with a missing application or a duplicate charge.

What kind of payment problem happened?

Start by recording what you can actually see. A bank message saying money was deducted is evidence of a debit, not proof that NTA received and matched the Application Fee.

What you seeWhat it means for your next step
Money not deducted and payment failedTry the payment again only after checking whether the portal created a transaction attempt.
Money deducted but application remains incompleteDo not assume submission. Save the transaction proof and raise the issue through the current NTA support route.
Payment successful and confirmation page generatedDownload the confirmation page and keep it with the receipt. This is the record that matters for submission.

This table is a working diagnosis, not a promise of refund. The exact refund or reversal process, if applicable, depends on the instruction issued for that JEE Main session by the National Testing Agency.

Which proof should students and parents save?

Take screenshots before the payment page disappears. Keep the original files, not only cropped images.

  • Application number, candidate name and registered email or mobile number.
  • Date and time of the attempt, amount paid and payment method.
  • Bank or UPI reference number, transaction ID and debit message.
  • Portal error message, failed status or incomplete application screen.
  • Any payment gateway receipt, email or SMS from the bank.
  • A screen showing whether the confirmation page was generated.

Write a short timeline in a notes file: “payment attempted”, “amount debited”, “portal status”, and “support request”. That prevents a confused complaint, especially when a parent is handling the bank call and the student is checking the form.

Should you pay again?

Don’t make a second payment just because the bank shows a debit. First check whether the portal has updated, whether a confirmation page is available and whether the current NTA notice explains failed or duplicate payments.

Use the official JEE Main website for the live notice and support instructions. For broader planning, you can also compare entrance exams, but that won’t replace the NTA record for this application.

If the status stays incomplete, submit one clear complaint with the application number, transaction reference, screenshots and timeline. Keep the complaint number. A bank debit without a completed application is a follow-up case, not a confirmed JEE Main form.

title: UP NEET UG Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026: How to Check, Admission Reporting Guidelines, and Security Fee Rules
description: Get complete details on the UP NEET UG Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026. Learn how to download your allotment letter, navigate security fee rules, and complete physical document verification.
content:
Quick Answer: UP NEET UG Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026

The Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh, has released the UP NEET UG Round 1 Seat Allotment 2026 results online. Candidates who participated in the choice-filling phase can download their official allotment letter by logging into the official portal (upneet.gov.in) using their NEET UG roll number and application number. Candidates must physically report to their designated nodal centers for document verification and complete the tuition fee payment within the prescribed timeline to secure their MBBS or BDS seats.

Key Facts: UP NEET UG Round 1 Counselling 2026

Before proceeding with your admission formalities, review the essential highlights of the Uttar Pradesh state-quota medical counselling process:

Counselling Component Details and Specifications
Counselling Authority Directorate General of Medical Education and Training (DGME), Uttar Pradesh
Official Portal upneet.gov.in or dgme.up.gov.in
Courses Offered MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) and BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery)
Admission Quota 85% State Quota Seats in Government Medical Colleges and 100% Seats in Private Universities
Reporting Mode Physical reporting with original documents at designated state Nodal Centers

Step-by-Step Guide: How to Check UP NEET UG Round 1 Allotment Result 2026

Candidates can view and download their seat allocation status by following these step-by-step instructions:

  1. Visit the Official Website: Navigate to the authorized portal at upneet.gov.in.
  2. Access the Allotment Link: Click on the link labeled "Seat Allotment Result - Round 1" available on the homepage.
  3. Enter Your Credentials: Select your course type, and input your NEET UG Roll Number, Application Number, and the system-generated security captcha code.
  4. View Allotment Status: Your allocation dashboard will display the assigned college, course stream (MBBS/BDS), and category under which you have been selected.
  5. Download the Allotment Letter: If you are satisfied with the allocation, pay the online admission deposit (if required) and download your provisional seat allotment letter. Take multiple printouts for physical reporting.

Physical Verification and Admission Reporting Guidelines

Unlike some states that offer completely online admission verification, Uttar Pradesh requires compulsory physical verification at designated nodal centers. Follow these strict reporting directives:

1. Locate Your Assigned Nodal Center

Your provisional seat allotment letter clearly lists your designated Nodal Center. Do not go directly to the allotted college unless instructed in the official prospectus. All document checks happen at the nodal centers first.

2. Essential Documents to Carry (Originals and Photocopies)

You must bring the following documents in original format, along with two sets of self-attested photocopies:

  • Provisional Seat Allotment Letter (issued by DGME UP)
  • NEET UG Admit Card and official Rank Card / Scorecard
  • Class 10 (High School) Certificate and Marksheet (for proof of date of birth)
  • Class 12 (Intermediate) Certificate and Marksheet
  • Domicile Certificate of Uttar Pradesh (if applicable)
  • Category Certificate (OBC, SC, ST, EWS, or sub-categories like Ex-Servicemen, PwD, Freedom Fighter) if seat is allocated under a reserved category
  • A valid government-issued ID proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Voter ID, or PAN Card)
  • Passport-sized photographs (matching the photograph used on the NEET application form)
  • Receipt or proof of registration fee and security deposit payment

3. Deposit the Tuition Fee

Upon successful verification of documents at the nodal center, candidates must submit the tuition fee via a Demand Draft (DD) drawn in favor of "Director General, Medical Education & Training, UP" payable at Lucknow, or complete the payment through the prescribed online mode. Seats will be summarily cancelled if the tuition fee is not paid within the specified period.

UP NEET UG Security Fee Forfeiture and Seat Acceptance Rules

The state of Uttar Pradesh enforces strict financial penalties during the counselling rounds to prevent seat blocking. Review these security fee retention and forfeiture guidelines carefully:

  • No Seat Allotted in Round 1: If you are not allocated any seat in the first round, your security fee remains safe. You automatically qualify to participate in Round 2 without paying the security deposit again.
  • Seat Allotted but Not Joined (Forfeiture Rule): If you are allotted an MBBS or BDS seat in Round 1 but choose not to report to your nodal center or decline the seat, your submitted security deposit (Rs. 30,000 for government, Rs. 2,00,000 for private medical, or Rs. 1,00,000 for private dental colleges) will be forfeited. To participate in Round 2, you must register and pay the security fee again.
  • Seat Allotted and Joined: If you accept the seat and complete the admission process, you can opt for free upgrading in Round 2. If your seat is upgraded, your previous security amount transfers to the new college database.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What are the security deposit amounts for UP NEET UG counselling?

The security deposit fees are categorized based on your choice of colleges:

  • Government Medical/Dental Colleges: Rs. 30,000
  • Private Medical Colleges (MBBS): Rs. 2,00,000
  • Private Dental Colleges (BDS): Rs. 1,00,000

2. Is there a free exit option in UP NEET UG Round 1?

No, Uttar Pradesh state quota counselling does not follow a completely free exit system similar to MCC All India Quota. If a seat is allotted to you in Round 1 and you fail to complete the admission formalities or decline it, your security deposit is forfeited.

3. Can I upgrade my allotted seat in Round 2?

Yes. Candidates who accept their Round 1 seat, complete physical document verification, and deposit the college tuition fee at the nodal center are fully eligible to opt for up-gradation in Round 2.

4. What happens if my documents are found invalid during physical reporting?

If your submitted documents (such as domicile or category certificates) do not match the state eligibility criteria during physical verification at the nodal center, your allotment will be cancelled, and you may be reclassified under the general category for subsequent counselling rounds, subject to eligibility rules.

Sources

  • Official Portal of Uttar Pradesh NEET UG Counselling: upneet.gov.in
  • Directorate General of Medical Education and Training, Uttar Pradesh (DGME UP): dgme.up.gov.in

title: BSc Physics After Graduation: Jobs, Exams and Skills That Matter
description: Compare BSc Physics career pathways in India and connect each route with the qualification, exam or practical skill it demands.
content:
A BSc Physics degree can lead to entry-level jobs, higher studies and government recruitment, but it doesn’t point to one automatic career. The right BSc Physics career pathway depends on whether you want school teaching, laboratory work, research support, government service or a technical private-sector role.

Don’t enrol in an MSc, BEd or coaching programme just because your friends are doing it. Pick the work first, then check the qualification, exam and skills that open that route.

Key facts about BSc Physics career pathways

RouteTypical workNext gateSkills to build
School teachingTeach science or Physics and assess learnersBEd and any required teacher eligibility or recruitment testLesson planning, explanation, classroom assessment
College teachingTeach undergraduate PhysicsMSc Physics, followed by the eligibility or recruitment rules of the institutionAdvanced Physics, problem solving, academic writing
Laboratory workHandle instruments, measurements, samples and recordsLab training; some posts may ask for an MSc or specialised qualificationCalibration, safety, error analysis, documentation
Research supportAssist with experiments, data and technical reportsMSc, project experience or an institute-specific requirementData analysis, coding, scientific writing
Government recruitmentWork in technical, administrative or general graduate-level postsEligibility set by the recruiting body and its notificationSubject knowledge or aptitude, reasoning, language, general awareness
Technical private rolesWork in testing, data operations, electronics or software supportRole-specific training and a work samplePython, spreadsheets, SQL, circuits or simulation

The table shows the real decision point: every route has a different next gate. A degree title alone won’t cover that gap.

Decision guidance: choose the route before paying for the next course

Teaching

School teaching suits you if you can explain the same idea in different ways, plan lessons and assess students patiently. A BEd is commonly part of the route, but requirements vary by school type, state, subject combination and post.

Before paying an institute, check the current rule issued by the relevant school-recruitment authority, teacher-eligibility authority or state department. Confirm accepted graduation subjects, minimum marks, age conditions, training requirements and the level you want to teach. For Classes 11 and 12, revise mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, modern Physics and practical demonstrations.

Higher studies and college teaching

An MSc Physics is the direct academic choice for deeper subject study, research support and many college-teaching routes. Admission may use university merit, an institutional entrance test or a national examination, and the accepted combination of Physics, Mathematics and laboratory credits can differ.

For college teaching and many research posts, an MSc may be only one stage. Eligibility tests, project work, interviews or doctoral study can follow, depending on the institution and post. Check the university prospectus and the recruiting institution’s rules before preparing for an exam.

Laboratory and research-support roles

These roles suit graduates who prefer instruments, measurements and careful records to daily classroom teaching. Employers may ask for laboratory safety, calibration, uncertainty calculations, sample handling, basic electronics and instrument-maintenance skills.

Create proof of work. Keep a project file with experiment notes, graphs, error calculations and a short explanation of what went wrong and how you corrected it. Learn spreadsheets for cleaning and plotting data, then add basic Python if your target role uses it. A working file is stronger than a certificate that cannot be demonstrated.

Government jobs: separate the post from the exam

A BSc Physics graduate may be eligible for some technical posts, scientific-assistant-type roles and graduate-level recruitment that accepts any recognised degree. Depending on the post, recruitment may be handled by bodies such as the Union Public Service Commission, Staff Selection Commission, state public service commissions or a department-specific authority.

Do not assume that Physics makes you eligible for every technical vacancy. The responsible recruiting body decides the accepted subject, marks, age limit, experience, physical standards, syllabus and selection stages. Read the current notification, especially the educational-qualification table and document requirements.

A general graduate exam usually demands steady preparation in reasoning, quantitative aptitude, language and general awareness. A technical post may reduce that burden but require stronger Physics or laboratory revision. Choose one main exam family for a preparation cycle. Five unrelated plans usually produce five incomplete ones.

Technical private-sector roles

Physics graduates can target technical support, testing, quality work, data operations, electronics support, software testing, scientific sales and entry-level analytics. These jobs don’t arrive automatically with the degree; employers need evidence that you can use a tool to solve a practical problem.

Choose one skill stack. For data work, combine spreadsheets, Python, basic statistics and SQL. For electronics and testing, practise circuits, sensors, measurement and troubleshooting. For simulation, learn one suitable tool and complete two small projects. Record the question, method, result and limits in a simple portfolio.

A practical 12-month plan after BSc Physics

  • Month 1: Select one primary route and one backup. Write down its next qualification, exam or skill test.
  • Months 2 to 4: Repair subject gaps and start one job-linked skill. Skip certificate collecting.
  • Months 5 to 7: Complete a project, teaching demo, laboratory record or mock-test cycle that produces visible evidence.
  • Months 8 to 10: Apply for relevant internships, project posts, entry-level jobs or higher-study admissions.
  • Months 11 to 12: Review applications, mock scores and feedback. Change direction only when the evidence gives you a reason.

A student targeting research support should compare MSc admissions, build data-analysis ability and look for project work instead of spending the whole year on an unrelated general exam. A student targeting school teaching should test classroom interest through tutoring or a teaching demo before committing to teacher training.

Skills and mistakes that affect your next move

  • Check the MSc syllabus, laboratory access, fee burden and likely next options before admission.
  • Match every government application to the current notification, not to a coaching advertisement or an old post.
  • Check the school level and teacher-training rule before enrolling in a BEd programme.
  • Put a project, result or working file behind every software skill on your CV.
  • Accept relevant internships, lab-assistant work or project roles when they add evidence, but don’t pay large sums for vague placement promises.

Rules can change between recruitment cycles and admission years. For the final decision, verify the current notice on the portal of the responsible recruiting body, university, teacher-eligibility authority or employer. DekhoCampus explains the route, but the issuing authority decides eligibility.

FAQs on BSc Physics career pathways

Is BSc Physics enough to get a job in India?

Yes, it can qualify you for some entry-level roles and graduate-level recruitment exams, but many technical, teaching and research jobs ask for an extra qualification or practical skill. Your options improve when you add a clear project, laboratory ability, coding or exam preparation.

Which higher studies are best after BSc Physics?

MSc Physics is the most direct academic option. An MSc can support research, college teaching and specialised technical work, while BEd suits students targeting school teaching. Choose after checking the admission rule, course content, cost and the jobs or exams it leads to.

Can BSc Physics graduates apply for government jobs?

Yes, graduates may apply for posts that accept any recognised degree and for selected technical posts. The exact rule depends on the recruiting body. Check subject requirements, marks, age limit, selection stages and document conditions in the current notification.

What skills should a BSc Physics graduate learn for private jobs?

Begin with one role-linked set of skills: spreadsheets, Python, statistics and SQL for data work; circuits, sensors and testing for electronics roles; or technical writing and documentation for laboratory and support roles. A small completed project is stronger evidence than a long list of courses.

Is teaching a good career after BSc Physics?

It can be a good choice if you enjoy explaining concepts, planning lessons and assessing students. School teaching commonly requires teacher training and may require an eligibility test or recruitment examination. Confirm the rules for the school type and state before enrolling.

Should I prepare for government exams or do an MSc?

Choose an MSc if you want deeper Physics study, research or a route towards college teaching. Choose exam preparation if you have a specific eligible post and can follow its syllabus for a sustained period. If you are unsure, spend a short, fixed period comparing notifications, MSc admissions and your own mock-test performance before committing money.

title: CUET 2027 central and state counselling portal login steps explained
description: A practical, step-by-step guide for Indian students and parents to access CUET 2027 central and state counselling portals, including login steps, document checks, and timelines.
content:
Key takeaway for applicants

CUET 2027 counselling requires timely portal login for both central and state admission processes. Prepare registration details early, keep documents ready, and follow prescribed deadlines to maximize seat opportunities across universities and states.

Overview of CUET 2027 counselling portals

After results are announced, participating authorities open separate counselling portals for central allocations and state/college-level allotments. Each portal has its own login URL, user ID requirements, and document verification workflow. Students may need to create an account, verify mobile numbers and emails, and submit choice fillings for preferred programs and campuses.

Central counselling portal

The central counselling portal coordinates admissions to participating national institutes and centrally affiliated campuses. It typically requires: application number or CUET login ID, date of birth, registered mobile number, and a password or OTP for secure access. The portal displays allotted seats, acceptance deadlines, and next steps such as fee payment and reporting to designated centers.

State counselling portals

State governments and state universities run individual portals. They may require slightly different identifiers (such as state-specific application IDs or unique serial numbers) in addition to CUET credentials. Timelines vary by state, and some states coordinate with Anna University, University of Mumbai, or other affiliating bodies for seat allocations and reporting norms.

Pre-login preparation checklist

  • Keep your CUET admit card details, application number, and exam scorecard handy.
  • Note the mobile number and email ID you used during registration; these are commonly used for OTP verification.
  • Identify the official central counselling portal URL and the state portal(s) for your choices.
  • Prepare digital copies of essential documents (12th mark sheet, ID proof, category certificate if applicable, migration certificate if required).
  • Set up a strong password and enable notification alerts for portal activity.

Logging into the central counselling portal

  1. Visit the official central counselling portal site and locate the login page.
  2. Enter your CUET registration number or roll number as required, along with your date of birth.
  3. Complete the OTP verification sent to your registered mobile number or email.
  4. Set or confirm your password to secure your account.
  5. Access the dashboard to check eligibility lists, seat allotments, and counselling rounds.

Logging into state counselling portals

  1. Navigate to the state portal designated for your domicile or the state where you applied for admission.
  2. Enter required identifiers, which may include CUET login details and a state-specific application ID.
  3. Verify via OTP and enter the portal using your chosen credentials.
  4. Review state-level allotment results, submit choice modifications if allowed, and proceed to document verification and fee payment as directed.

What to do after login

  • Check seat allotment status and deadlines for acceptance, fee payment, and reporting.
  • Confirm your admission by paying fees within the specified window; avoid late fees or seat cancellations.
  • Prepare for document verification at the designated college or reporting center with originals and photocopies as required.
  • Keep track of subsequent rounds or spot round procedures if you remain unassigned.

Common issues and quick fixes

  • If you don’t receive an OTP, verify that your mobile number is active and registered; try resending the OTP or using an alternate verification option if available.
  • Forgot password or login issues can usually be resolved by the portal’s password reset link or a helpdesk contact. Use the registered email for recovery steps.
  • Mismatch in personal details can block login; ensure your name, date of birth, and category details match the marksheet and certificate records.
  • If a portal shows a page not loading, clear browser cache, try a different browser, or attempt again during off-peak hours.

Timeline to track for CUET 2027 counselling

  • Result declaration and counselling notification: soon after CUET results are released.
  • Central and state portal opening for login and registration: typically within a week of result announcements.
  • Choice filling and seat allotment rounds: several cycles may occur, with clear deadlines for each round.
  • Document verification and reporting to allotted institutions: fixed by the respective central or state authorities.

Key tips for parents and guardians

  • Monitor official announcements for any portal updates, maintenance downtimes, or revised deadlines.
  • Help your student organize required documents in advance to prevent last‑minute delays.
  • Keep a record of all login attempts, allotment statuses, and payment receipts for future reference.
  • Encourage timely decisions on acceptances to avoid losing seats due to inactivity.

When in doubt, verify official guidance

Because portal procedures and deadlines can vary by year and by authority, always confirm details on the official counselling portal and the relevant state education department site. If you encounter a policy change or unclear instruction, rely on the official authority website for the most accurate information.

Frequently asked questions

Q1: How do I access the central CUET counselling portal?

A: Use the official portal link, enter your CUET registration number or roll number, verify with OTP, and set a secure password to reach your dashboard.

Q2: What documents are needed for counselling login and verification?

A: Carry your admit card, 12th mark sheet, identity proof, category certificate if applicable, migration or transfer certificates, and their scanned copies if required by the portal.

Q3: Can I change my choices after initial submission?

A: Many portals allow modification within specific windows between rounds. Check the round schedule on the portal and submit changes before the cut-off.

Q4: What should I do if I do not receive the OTP?

A: Verify the registered mobile number and email, request a resend if possible, or contact the helpdesk for assistance.

Q5: How soon after seat allotment must I report?

A: Follow the exact deadline stated on the portal for acceptance, fee payment, and reporting to the allotted college to secure the seat.

Q6: Are state and central portals synchronized?

A: They operate independently with their own timelines. Students should monitor both portals for updates and deadlines.

Q7: What if my portal shows a mismatch in personal details?

A: Contact the helpdesk immediately and have supporting documents ready to correct any discrepancies before the deadline.

Q8: Whose responsibility is it to verify documents?

A: Verification is generally conducted at the allotted institution or through the state/central authority’s designated verification center, following seat allotment.

title: GATE ২০২৭ আবেদনে ত্রুটি: ৩১ অক্টোবরের মধ্যে সংশোধন ও ফি দিয়ে বদলের পার্থক্য
description: GOAPS-এ আবেদনের অবস্থা বুঝুন। জানানো ত্রুটি ৩১ অক্টোবরের মধ্যে বাড়তি ফি ছাড়া ঠিক করুন; ফি দিয়ে তথ্য সংশোধনের তারিখ এখনও ঘোষণা হয়নি।
content:
GATE ২০২৭ আবেদন যাচাইয়ে ত্রুটি জানানো হলে ৩১ অক্টোবর ২০২৬-এর মধ্যে ঠিক করুন। আলাদা করে চালু হতে চলা ফি-সহ তথ্য সংশোধনের সুযোগের জন্য অপেক্ষা করবেন না। IIT মাদ্রাজ তার তারিখ এখনও ঘোষণা করেনি।

আগে GOAPS-এ আবেদনের অবস্থা পড়ুন

সরকারি GATE ২০২৭ বিজ্ঞপ্তি

  • Under scrutiny মানে সংশ্লিষ্ট জোন আবেদন পরীক্ষা করছে। ইমেল ও GOAPS অ্যাকাউন্ট দেখুন। শুধু এই অবস্থার অর্থ আবেদন বাতিল নয়।
  • Defective দেখালে ইমেলে জানানো নির্দিষ্ট ত্রুটি পড়ে GOAPS-এ নির্দেশিত সংশোধন করুন।
  • In order and accepted মানে যাচাইয়ের পরে আবেদন গৃহীত হয়েছে। প্রাপ্তিস্বীকার রাখুন এবং পরবর্তী সরকারি ঘোষণা দেখুন।

সংশোধন জমা দিয়ে প্রমাণ রাখুন

সরকারি বিজ্ঞপ্তি অনুযায়ী যাচাইয়ে ধরা ত্রুটি ১৪ থেকে ৩১ অক্টোবর ২০২৬-এর মধ্যে বাড়তি ফি ছাড়া ঠিক করা যায়। GOAPS-এর সম্পূর্ণ বার্তা পড়ে চাওয়া নথি বা পরিবর্তন প্রস্তুত করে জমা দিন।

সরকারি GOAPS লগইন

জমা দেওয়ার পরে প্রাপ্তিস্বীকার বা পাঠানো তথ্যের স্ক্রিনশট রাখুন। অ্যাকাউন্টের অবস্থা আবার দেখুন। নতুন ফাইল বেছে নেওয়াই সংশোধন জমা পড়া বা আবেদন গৃহীত হওয়ার প্রমাণ নয়।

ব্যবহৃত DigiLocker অ্যাকাউন্ট মুছবেন না

আবেদনে ব্যবহৃত যাচাইকৃত বা অযাচাইকৃত DigiLocker অ্যাকাউন্ট বজায় রাখুন। অযাচাইকৃত অ্যাকাউন্টের জন্য সরকারি নির্দেশ অনুসারে DigiLocker Drive ব্যবহারের সম্মতি এবং ছবিসহ পরিচয়পত্র দিন।

বার্তা অস্পষ্ট হলে GATE ওয়েবসাইটে দেওয়া সংশ্লিষ্ট জোনের যোগাযোগ ব্যবহার করুন। আবেদনের রেফারেন্স ও নির্দিষ্ট সমস্যাটি জানান; পাসওয়ার্ড বা OTP দেবেন না।

নিজের প্রয়োজনে আবেদনের তথ্য বদলানো এবং যাচাইয়ে জানানো ত্রুটি সংশোধন এক বিষয় নয়। ফি-সহ সংশোধনের তারিখ ও অনুমোদিত পরিবর্তন প্রকাশের জন্য অপেক্ষা করুন। ত্রুটি ঠিক করার শেষ দিনকে ওই সুযোগের তারিখ ভাববেন না।

অন্য শিক্ষাসংবাদ

title: CUET PG 2026 City Intimation Slip Release Date & Details
description: CUET PG 2026 city intimation slip will be released soon. Check release date, details mentioned, download steps, and important instructions for candidates.
content:
The Common University Entrance Test Postgraduate 2026 city notification slip, which will give candidates early access to the exam location, is expected to be out soon. The National Testing Agency has been releasing the city intimation slip, which provides candidates with information regarding the city in which their exam center will be located. While it is important for candidates to make their logistics arrangements in advance, the city notification slip is not the admit card.

What is the City Intimation Slip

Candidates are informed about the city designated for the test through an advance notice document called the city intimation slip. It lacks details like the exam instructions, the reporting time, and the exam center's address. Only the official admit card, which will be made public later, will contain all of this information.

Expected Release Timeline

Generally, the city intimation slip is available a few days before the admit card. Candidates should check the official updates regularly. After the official release, they can download it using their login details such as application number and date of birth.

Details Mentioned on City Slip

Detail Description
Candidate Name As per application form
Application Number Unique exam ID
Exam City Allotted city for test
Exam Date Scheduled exam day
Subject/Paper Chosen PG course

Important Points for Candidates

  1. Previous to the admit card, the city slip is released.
  2. The whole center address is not displayed; only the exam city is.
  3. In order to enter the exam room, an admit card is required.
  4. Candidates need to carefully check the details.
  5. Speak with authorities if you discover any errors.
  6. Planning a trip should be done in advance.
  7. Have your login information available for download.

Final Advice

The candidates need to remember that the city intimation slip is only for the purpose of information. They need to download and possess the admit card when it is available, as it is the mandatory document required for entry into the examination center. The candidates need to stay updated with the notifications from the authorities.

title: Bihar B.Ed Aspirants Alert! Bihar CET 2025 Registrations Are Now Open
description: Bihar B.Ed CET 2025 registration has started on April 4 at biharcetbed-lnmu.in. Check eligibility, important dates, application process, and exam pattern here.
content:
Bihar B.Ed CET 2025 Registration Begins

The registration process for the Bihar B.Ed Common Entrance Test (CET-B.Ed) 2025 has officially started. Lalit Narayan Mithila University (LNMU), the conducting authority for the exam, has activated the application link on the official website – biharcetbed-lnmu.in. This entrance exam is a gateway for admission into 2-year B.Ed and Shiksha Shastri programs offered by various government and private colleges in Bihar. Candidates who wish to pursue a career in teaching must complete their registration before the deadline and ensure they meet all the eligibility requirements.

Important Dates for Bihar B.Ed CET 2025

  • Online Registration Start Date: April 4, 2025

  • Last Date to Apply (without late fee): May 4, 2025

  • Application Window with Late Fee: May 5 – May 11, 2025

  • Admit Card Release: May 21, 2025

  • Exam Date: May 30, 2025

Candidates are advised not to wait until the last minute and complete the form submission at the earliest.

Eligibility Criteria

For B.Ed Program:

  • Must have a Bachelor's degree (BA/BSc/BCom or equivalent) with at least 50% marks.

  • Candidates with a BE/BTech degree need at least 55% marks and specialization in Science/Mathematics.

For Shiksha Shastri Program:

  • Must have completed Shastri or BA with Sanskrit.

  • Should have completed the first year of Acharya or MA in Sanskrit.

Candidates appearing in their final year of qualifying examination in 2025 are also eligible to apply. There is no upper age limit.

How to Apply for Bihar B.Ed CET 2025

  1. Visit the official portal: biharcetbed-lnmu.in

  2. Click on “Register for CET-B.Ed 2025”

  3. Fill in your personal, academic, and contact details

  4. Upload scanned copies of your photo and signature

  5. Pay the application fee:

    General

    		 1000/-

    EBC/BC/EWS/Women 

    		 750/-

    SC / ST

    		 500/-

  6. Submit and download the confirmation page for future use. 

Bihar B.Ed CET 2025 Exam Pattern

  • Mode of Exam: Offline (pen and paper-based)

  • Total Questions: 120 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs)

  • Total Marks: 120

  • Subjects Covered:

    • General English/General Sanskrit (15 marks)

    • General Awareness (40 marks)

    • Teaching Aptitude (25 marks)

    • Logical & Analytical Reasoning (25 marks)

    • General Hindi (15 marks)

  • Duration: 2 hours

  • Marking Scheme: 1 mark for each correct answer, no negative marking

What’s Next After the Exam?

After the exam is conducted on May 30, the result and counselling schedule will be released on the official website. Successful candidates will be invited to participate in the counselling process for admission to B.Ed and Shiksha Shastri programs.

Conclusion 

The Bihar CET-B.Ed 2025 is a significant opportunity for aspiring educators across the state. Candidates should apply on time, prepare as per the syllabus, and regularly check the official website.

Team DekhoCampus wishes you all the best!

title: NEET UG 2026 Private Medical College Refund Clauses to Check Before Joining
description: Before accepting a private MBBS seat through NEET UG 2026 counselling, check refund terms, security deposits, bonds and exit costs in writing.
content:
NEET UG 2026 private medical college refund clauses can decide whether your family loses a large sum after resignation. Before accepting a private MBBS seat, get the fee breakup, refund policy, security-deposit terms and bond in writing. A low annual fee means little if leaving later carries a heavy deduction.

The NEET UG exam guide explains the wider exam process.

The National Testing Agency's official NEET website handles exam communication, not every college-level refund decision. The applicable counselling authority and the college's signed admission documents control the financial position, so don't rely on a verbal promise.

What do NEET UG 2026 private medical college refund clauses cover?

These clauses don't treat every payment alike. Tuition, hostel charges, deposits and bond-linked liabilities may have separate conditions, including different resignation stages and clearance requirements. Read the exact document issued for your seat.

Payment or conditionAsk for this in writingPossible consequence
Tuition feeRefund window, deductions and resignation cut-offA large amount may be retained after a stated stage
Security depositRefund status, clearance rule and release timelinePayment may stay blocked until college clearance
Hostel and messUnused-period refund and notice requirementCourse resignation may not cancel these charges
Bond or undertakingExit amount, service duty, guarantor and triggerA separate demand may arise after signing

What should you check before joining a private MBBS seat?

NEET UG 2026 private medical college refund clauses matter most when you may move to a later counselling allotment. A student who reports, pays hostel fees and then resigns could face deductions or a bond claim, depending on the applicable rules and signed terms.

  1. Match the demand letter with the counselling authority's fee notice and the college's approved fee document.
  2. Confirm whether the deposit is held by the counselling authority or the college.
  3. Ask where and how resignation must be submitted, and request the final date in writing.
  4. Read every bond page, including penalty, service, witness and guarantor wording.
  5. Save receipts, screenshots, emails, the fee policy and the resignation acknowledgement.

Mark every use of “non-refundable”, “after joining”, “security deposit” and “bond”. If an admissions office gives a different answer orally, ask for an email or stamped reply before paying. This is the safest way to compare the real exit cost, not just the headline fee.

For the 2026 cycle, dates, authorities and procedures remain matters to verify in the current counselling notice. Check the relevant authority's notice and your college documents before reporting. The NEET UG exam guide can help with the wider admission context, but it cannot replace the signed refund terms.

title: Scholarship Renewal After College Transfer: Documents Students Often Miss
description: Changed college, course or bank account? Check the records, institute verification and bank-Aadhaar details that can affect post-matric scholarship renewal.
content:
Can you renew a post-matric scholarship after changing college, course or bank account? Often, yes, if the scheme permits renewal and the new institute can verify your record. But submitting the form isn’t enough: a missing transfer record, unverified attendance or mismatched bank details can hold up payment even when you still meet the eligibility rules.

Rules vary between central and state schemes. For the 2026-27 cycle, treat the notice on the relevant scholarship portal as the controlling source, not an old college message or last year’s process.

Why a college transfer can stop renewal

A transfer creates a record mismatch. The previous college may need to close or update its part of the record, while the new college must confirm your admission, course, year and attendance. If either institute has not acted, the application may remain pending or return for correction.

A course change needs even more care. Moving from BCom to BBA, for example, can change the course code, duration, fee details or scheme eligibility. The portal may allow a correction, require institute approval or treat the application as a fresh registration. Don’t assume ordinary renewal will carry the change automatically.

Documents students commonly miss

  • Transfer Certificate or Migration Certificate: Keep the document from your previous college and admission proof from the new one.
  • Bonafide certificate: It should show your current course, year and academic session.
  • Previous scholarship record: Save the application ID, sanction details and payment history before access to the old institute record becomes difficult.
  • Attendance and fee proof: The new institute may ask for current attendance, a fee receipt or an institute verification form.
  • Bank-Aadhaar proof: Match the student’s name, account number, IFSC and Aadhaar seeding status. A parent’s account may not be accepted if the scheme requires the student’s account.
  • Course-change approval: Ask whether a correction request or fresh application is required.

What to check before you submit

  1. Compare the old and new college details, course, year, category, income information and bank records.
  2. Ask the new college scholarship desk to confirm that it can view your application and complete institute verification.
  3. After submission, save the reference number and status screenshots.
  4. If the form is returned, read the stated reason first. Contact the institute nodal person for admission or attendance records, and the scheme authority for portal or payment issues.

Keep clear scans in one folder. A blurry certificate can delay the case as badly as a missing one. Parents should check updated bank details with the student instead of relying on an old passbook copy. You can also find scholarships and compare each scheme’s document requirements.

title: AACCC PG 2026 ਰਾਊਂਡ 1: 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਤਿੰਨ ਵੱਖ ਸਮਾਂ-ਹੱਦਾਂ
description: ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 2, ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਅਤੇ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨਾ ਰਾਤ 11:55 ਵਜੇ ਮੁੱਕੇਗਾ। ਸੋਧਿਆ ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
AACCC ਦੇ ਸੋਧੇ AYUSH ਪੋਸਟਗ੍ਰੈਜੂਏਟ ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ 30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੋਂ 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026 ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਤਿੰਨ ਵੱਖ ਸਮਾਂ-ਹੱਦਾਂ ਹਨ। ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਬੰਦ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ; ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਦੇ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸਮੇਂ ਤੱਕ ਉਡੀਕਣ ਨਾਲ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਲਈ ਦੇਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਵੇਗੀ।

ਹਰ ਕਦਮ ਲਈ ਵੱਖ ਰਿਮਾਈਂਡਰ ਰੱਖੋ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PG ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਪੇਜ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਵੀਂ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਦਾ ਲਿੰਕ ਹੈ। AACCC ਅਧੀਨ ਸੀਟਾਂ ਲੈਣ ਦੇ ਚਾਹਵਾਨ ਯੋਗ AIAPGET 2026 ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰ ਉਹ ਰਸਤਾ ਵਰਤਣ ਅਤੇ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PG ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਪੇਜ

ਤੁਹਾਡਾ ਕੰਮ

ਸੋਧਿਆ ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਸਮਾਂ

ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਰੋ

30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੋਂ 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ 2026, ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 2 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ

ਫੀਸ ਭਰੋ

3 ਨਵੰਬਰ, ਸ਼ਾਮ 5 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ

ਚੋਣਾਂ ਭਰੋ

30 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਤੋਂ 3 ਨਵੰਬਰ, ਰਾਤ 11:55 ਤੱਕ

ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰੋ

3 ਨਵੰਬਰ, ਦੁਪਹਿਰ 2 ਤੋਂ ਰਾਤ 11:55 ਤੱਕ

ਇਹ ਸਮੇਂ ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਸਰਵਰ ਦੀ ਘੜੀ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹਨ। ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ, ਸਫਲ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਦੀ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ।

AACCC ਦਾ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਕੌਂਸਲਿੰਗ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ 2026-27, ਸਫ਼ਾ 1: ਰਾਊਂਡ 1 ਦੀਆਂ ਸਮਾਂ-ਹੱਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ। ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸੋਧਿਆ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ

ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਾਲਜ ਚੁਣੋ

ਚੋਣ ਫਾਰਮ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਾਲਜਾਂ ਦੀ ਛੋਟੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ। ਉਪਲਬਧ ਕੋਰਸ, ਸੰਸਥਾ, ਫੀਸ ਅਤੇ ਥਾਂ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਕਰੋ ਜੋ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਵੀਕਾਰ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਸੀਟ ਮੈਟ੍ਰਿਕਸ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ; ਪਿਛਲੇ ਸਾਲ ਵਾਲਾ ਕੋਰਸ ਇਸ ਰਾਊਂਡ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਖਾਤੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਲਤ ਦੇਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਰਸੀਦ ਰੱਖੋ। ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਜਾਂਚੋ। ਪੋਰਟਲ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਜਾਂ ਸੰਭਾਲੀਆਂ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਰੱਖੋ। ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਜਾਂ ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਸਮੱਸਿਆ ਨਾ ਸੁਲਝੇ ਤਾਂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਹੈਲਪਡੈਸਕ ਵਰਤੋ। AIAPGET ਸਕੋਰਕਾਰਡ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਸਤਿਕਾ ਦੇ ਹੋਰ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਤਿਆਰ ਰੱਖੋ।

AIAPGET ਨਤੀਜੇ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੋਰਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਗਾਈਡ

ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲੌਕ ਕਰਨ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?

ਸੋਧੇ ਕਾਰਜਕ੍ਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੀਟ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ 4 ਨਵੰਬਰ, ਨਤੀਜਾ 5 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਅਤੇ ਅਲਾਟ ਹੋਈ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ 6 ਤੋਂ 13 ਨਵੰਬਰ ਤੈਅ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਪੜਾਅ ਹਨ; ਨਤੀਜਾ ਹੁਣੇ ਜਾਰੀ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਨਹੀਂ।

ਨਤੀਜਾ ਆਉਣ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਅਲਾਟਮੈਂਟ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਸੰਸਥਾ ਦੀ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ ਦੀਆਂ ਲੋੜਾਂ ਇਕੱਠੀਆਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਉਹਨਾਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਸਫ਼ਰ ਤਿਆਰ ਕਰੋ ਤੇ ਅਗਲੇ AACCC ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵੇਖੋ।

title: NEET PG Bond Rules: Compare Rural Service Risk Before Choice Filling
description: Learn how to compare NEET PG bond duration, penalties, postings and exit rules before locking counselling choices.
content:
A low-fee seat in NEET PG counselling can become expensive if its service bond is ignored. Before you lock choices, compare the required service period, penalty amount, posting conditions and exit process for each state or institution seat.

The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences conducts NEET PG, but bond conditions usually come from the responsible state authority or medical college. The exam notice does not replace the seat-specific admission rules. Check the current notice on the official NEET PG website and read the counselling authority’s bond document before payment or reporting.

What should you compare before selecting a bonded seat?

Don’t compare only tuition fees. A seat with lower fees may demand years of service in a rural or underserved posting, while leaving early could trigger a large recovery claim or affect document release.

Item to compareQuestion to askWhy it changes your choice
Service durationHow many months or years must you serve?A longer obligation delays fellowship, private practice or another course.
Penalty exposureWhat amount applies if you resign or fail to join?Calculate this as part of the seat’s real cost, not as a footnote.
Posting ruleCan the authority place you anywhere in the state?Your preferred city may not be available after training.
Specialty impactDoes the department or service need differ for your branch?Some specialties may face different workload or placement conditions.
Exit termsWhat happens after resignation, transfer or non-joining?Verbal assurances won’t protect you if the written clause says otherwise.

How do you calculate the real cost of a seat?

Make a one-page comparison for every serious option. Add tuition, hostel and living expenses to the possible bond penalty. Then mark the service period, likely posting area, deadline for joining and the authority that can approve release.

  1. Download the seat-specific prospectus, bond form and undertaking.
  2. Circle words such as compulsory service, liquidated damages, resignation, release and transfer.
  3. Ask the counselling helpdesk for a written reply if two documents appear inconsistent.
  4. Keep the signed bond and payment receipt with your counselling records.

For example, a candidate planning a fellowship immediately after residency should rank a shorter service obligation above a cheaper seat with an uncertain exit clause. That’s not being careless about fees. It’s pricing the next three years properly. Use the NEET PG exam guide for the wider counselling process, but rely on the current state or college notice for bond wording.

title: JEE Mains Registration 2027 Begins @jeemain.nta.nic.in, Session 1
description: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration began on October 24. Candidates can apply online at jeemain.nta.nic.in. Check the November 22 deadline, late-fee window, January exam schedule, eligibility, application fees and exam pattern.
content:
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has started the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration process for candidates seeking admission to undergraduate engineering, architecture and planning programmes. The online application window opened on October 24, 2026, and eligible candidates can apply through the official website, jeemain.nta.nic.in.

The last date to submit the JEE Main 2027 application form without a late fee is November 22, 2026. Candidates who miss the regular deadline can apply during the late-fee window from November 23 to November 26, 2026, by paying an additional fee.

JEE Main 2027 Session 1 examinations are scheduled for January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027. Candidates should complete their registration before the deadline and carefully review the eligibility criteria, application fee, required documents and examination pattern.

JEE Main 2027 Registration Link

Candidates can access the application form through the official NTA portal. Before beginning the process, keep the required personal, academic and identity details ready.

  • JEE Main 2027 Session 1 application form: Apply Online

  • JEE Main 2027 syllabus: Check the Official Syllabus

Candidates should use only the official website to register, pay the examination fee and download the confirmation page.

The city intimation slip and admit card are separate documents. Candidates must download the admit card and follow the examination-centre details and instructions mentioned on it.

How to Fill the JEE Main 2027 Application Form?

The JEE Main application process is conducted online. Candidates should enter accurate information and verify the details before submitting the form.

Follow these steps to complete registration:

  1. Visit the official website at jeemain.nta.nic.in.

  2. Click on the JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration link.

  3. Complete the registration process by entering the required personal and contact details.

  4. Create or access the candidate login as instructed on the portal.

  5. Fill in the application form with academic details, category information and examination preferences.

  6. Select the appropriate examination paper and preferred examination cities.

  7. Upload the required photograph, signature and other documents in the prescribed format.

  8. Pay the applicable examination fee through an available online payment method.

  9. Review the form and submit it.

  10. Download the confirmation page and save it for future reference.

Applicants should ensure that their names, dates of birth and other details are consistent with the relevant documents. If the portal requires a live photograph or a specific authentication method, candidates must follow the current instructions displayed during registration.

JEE Main 2027 Application Fee

The application fee depends on the candidate's category, gender, examination-centre location and the number of papers selected. The following is the reported fee structure for a single paper with an examination centre in India.

The amount payable may differ for third-gender candidates, examination centres outside India and candidates applying for multiple papers. The late-fee window also involves an additional charge. Candidates should confirm the exact amount displayed on the official payment page before paying.

Documents Required for JEE Main 2027 Registration

Candidates should keep the necessary documents and information ready before starting the application. The exact requirements depend on the candidate's circumstances and the instructions issued by NTA.

Commonly required items include:

  • Class 10 certificate or marksheet for verifying personal details.

  • A recent photograph in the prescribed format.

  • Signature image, where required.

  • Valid mobile number and email address.

  • Category certificate or relevant supporting details, where applicable.

  • PwD/PwBD or UDID certificate, if applicable.

  • Certificate relating to physical limitations affecting writing, if required.

  • Passport or other specified documents for foreign nationals and applicable overseas candidates.

Candidates should check the official information bulletin for image specifications, file sizes, document formats and identity-verification requirements. An incorrectly uploaded document may cause problems during application verification.

JEE Main 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Before registering, candidates should verify whether they meet the requirements for their intended course and institution.

Educational Qualification

Candidates who passed Class 12 or an equivalent qualifying examination in 2025 or 2026, or are appearing for the qualifying examination in 2027, can generally apply for JEE Main 2027, subject to the detailed NTA rules.

The qualifying examination must be recognised under the applicable eligibility provisions. Candidates with equivalent qualifications should check the official information bulletin before applying.

Age Limit

There is no general upper age limit for appearing in JEE Main 2027. However, candidates must satisfy the admission requirements of their chosen institution and programme.

Subject Requirements

For B.E./B.Tech admissions, candidates generally need to have studied Physics and Mathematics along with the additional subject or subjects specified in the official eligibility rules.

For B.Arch and B.Planning, the qualifying-subject requirements may differ. Candidates should select the correct paper and review the relevant course-specific conditions.

Class 12 Marks and Admission Eligibility

Appearing for JEE Main does not automatically guarantee admission to an engineering college. Institutions may impose additional requirements related to Class 12 marks, board percentile, subjects studied, category and other admission conditions.

Candidates targeting NITs, IIITs or other participating institutions should verify the current admission criteria applicable to their category and course.

JEE Main 2027 Exam Schedule

JEE Main 2027 is planned in two sessions: January and April. The first session provides candidates with an opportunity to attempt the examination early in the admission cycle.

JEE Main Session 1 Exam Dates

The January session is scheduled on the following dates:

  • January 20, 2027

  • January 21, 2027

  • January 22, 2027

  • January 23, 2027

  • January 24, 2027

  • January 28, 2027

The specific date, shift and examination centre assigned to an individual candidate will be provided through the relevant examination documents.

Candidates should not assume that every paper will be conducted on every listed date. They must check their admit card for the final schedule.

JEE Main 2027 Syllabus

The JEE Main syllabus covers Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics for Paper 1. Paper 2A and Paper 2B include additional components for architecture and planning aspirants.

Students should use the official JEE Main 2027 syllabus to prepare the complete topic list and confirm any changes for the current examination cycle.

Syllabus for B.Arch and B.Planning

Candidates applying for Paper 2A (B.Arch) must prepare Mathematics, Aptitude and the Drawing Test. Paper 2B (B.Planning) includes Mathematics, Aptitude and planning-based questions.

Students should select the paper that matches their intended programme and prepare the relevant sections accordingly.

JEE Main 2027 Preparation Tips

Candidates preparing for the January session should make a realistic study plan based on their syllabus coverage and available revision time.

  • Follow the official syllabus: Use the prescribed syllabus to identify topics that need to be completed or revised.

  • Practise previous-year questions: Familiarise yourself with the types of questions asked and the level of difficulty.

  • Revise NCERT Chemistry: Strengthen concepts, reactions and factual knowledge through regular revision.

  • Prepare formula notes: Keep a concise collection of important Physics and Mathematics formulas.

  • Take mock tests: Practise under timed conditions and analyse mistakes after each test.

  • Improve time management: Learn to distribute time across subjects without getting stuck on difficult questions.

  • Revise regularly: Revisit completed chapters instead of focusing only on new topics.

  • Complete registration carefully: Avoid last-minute problems by submitting the application and checking payment status early.

What Happens After JEE Main 2027 Registration?

After submitting the application, candidates should follow these stages:

  1. Application correction: Make permitted changes during the correction window, if necessary.

  2. City intimation slip: Check the examination city once NTA releases the slip.

  3. Admit card: Download the hall ticket and verify the date, shift and centre details.

  4. Examination day: Follow the instructions provided by NTA and carry the required documents.

  5. Answer key and result: Monitor official announcements for the provisional answer key, response sheet and result.

Candidates should keep their application number, login credentials and confirmation page safe throughout the examination process.

Conclusion

JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration has begun, giving engineering, architecture and planning aspirants an opportunity to apply for the January examination. The Session 1 examination is scheduled for January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027. Students should begin or continue their preparation using the official syllabus, practise previous-year questions and regularly check NTA announcements for updates about the admit card, examination instructions and results.

title: CAT 2026 प्रवेशपत्र: अधिकृत लॉगिन, विसरलेला पासवर्ड आणि PDF तपासणी
description: CATच्या अधिकृत वेबसाइटवरून प्रवेशपत्राचे लॉगिन उघडा. विसरलेले लॉगिन तपशील परत मिळवण्याचा मार्ग आणि केंद्र, सत्र व हजर राहण्याची वेळ कशी तपासायची ते जाणून घ्या.
content:
CAT 2026च्या अधिकृत वेबसाइटवर आता “Admit Card / Application Form Download” या पर्यायाखाली लॉगिन दिले आहे. प्रवेशपत्र डाउनलोड सुरू होण्याची तारीख 6 नोव्हेंबर अशी नमूद आहे. नोंदणीकृत User ID आणि पासवर्ड वापरून या मार्गाने लॉगिन करा आणि आपल्या खात्यात प्रवेशपत्राचा पर्याय पाहा.

सार्वजनिक लॉगिन लिंक दिसली म्हणजे प्रत्येक उमेदवाराचे प्रवेशपत्र तयार झाले असे नाही. डॅशबोर्डवर पत्र दिसत नसेल तर पोर्टलवरील सूचना वाचा आणि अधिकृत मदत कक्षाशी संपर्क साधा. आपला अर्ज नाकारला गेला असा निष्कर्ष काढू नका. वेबसाइटवर परीक्षेची तारीख 29 नोव्हेंबर 2026 अशी दिली आहे.

CATच्या वेबसाइटवरूनच उमेदवार लॉगिन उघडा

अधिकृत वेबसाइटवर “Admit Card / Application Form Download” खालील Login निवडा. त्यातून उघडणारे उमेदवार लॉगिन पान User ID, पासवर्ड आणि स्क्रीनवरील कॅप्चा मागते. कोणी पाठवलेल्या बनावट पानावर हे तपशील भरू नका आणि प्रवेशपत्र डाउनलोड करून देण्याची तयारी दाखवणाऱ्या व्यक्तीलाही देऊ नका.

लॉगिन पानाच्या शीर्षकात सर्वसाधारण अर्जाचा उल्लेख आहे. आयोजकांनी दिलेल्या मार्गानेच जात आहात याची खात्री करण्यासाठी CAT वेबसाइटवरून ते पान उघडा. लॉगिन झाल्यावर आपल्या डॅशबोर्डमधील प्रवेशपत्राचा पर्याय निवडा आणि PDF उपलब्ध झाल्यावर जतन करा.

User ID किंवा पासवर्ड विसरल्यास

उमेदवार लॉगिनवर Forgot User ID/Password ही लिंक आहे. ती उघडून तपशील परत मिळवण्याच्या सूचना पाळा. कॅप्चा नीट दिसत नसेल तर त्याच पानावरील “Get New Image” निवडा आणि नव्या चित्रातील अक्षरे किंवा अंक भरा.

अडचण कायम राहिल्यास अधिकृत CAT वेबसाइटवरील संपर्क तपशील वापरा. मदत कक्षाचा ईमेल cat2026_helpdesk@iimidr.ac.in असा दिला आहे. कोणत्या टप्प्यावर कोणती त्रुटी दिसते हे सांगा; पासवर्ड किंवा एकदाच वापरायचा कोड पाठवू नका.

प्रवास ठरवण्यापूर्वी आपल्याला नेमलेले केंद्र तपासा

प्रवेशपत्र मिळाल्यावर नाव व नोंदणीचे तपशील अर्जाशी जुळतात का ते पाहा. त्यावरील परीक्षेची तारीख, सत्र, हजर राहण्याची वेळ, केंद्राचे नाव आणि संपूर्ण पत्ता तपासा. एकाच नावाच्या अनेक शाखा किंवा परिसर असल्यास केवळ केंद्राचे नाव ओळखीचे असणे पुरेसे नाही.

  • ओळखपत्र, छायाचित्रे, घोषणापत्र आणि परवानगी असलेल्या वस्तूंबाबत प्रवेशपत्रावरील सूचना वाचा.

  • जतन केलेल्या PDFचे प्रत्येक पान उघडा. रिकामी, कापली गेलेली किंवा अस्पष्ट प्रिंट असल्यास प्रवासापूर्वी ती अडचण सोडवा.

  • PDFची प्रत सुरक्षित ठेवा आणि पत्रावरील सूचनेनुसार प्रिंट घ्या. फोनवरील प्रत प्रिंटऐवजी चालेल असे गृहीत धरू नका.

  • वैयक्तिक तपशील चुकीचा वाटल्यास त्वरित अधिकृत मदत कक्षाशी संपर्क साधा. दिलेल्या दस्तऐवजात स्वतः बदल करू नका.

सराव चाचणी प्रवेशपत्राची जागा घेत नाही

अधिकृत सराव चाचणी स्क्रीनवरील नियंत्रणे समजून घेण्यासाठी आहे. ती आपले परीक्षा सत्र किंवा केंद्र ठरवत नाही. सरावासाठी CAT सराव चाचणीच्या नियंत्रणांचे मार्गदर्शन पाहा. परीक्षेला हजर राहण्यासाठी स्वतःचे प्रवेशपत्र आणि नंतरच्या अधिकृत सूचना वापरा.

शोध निकालांमध्ये जुन्या डाउनलोड तारखांच्या बातम्या राहू शकतात. पुढील कृतीसाठी सध्याची CAT वेबसाइट आणि आपले खाते पाहा. अपेक्षित प्रकाशन वेळ किंवा दुसऱ्या उमेदवाराचा अनुभव आपल्या दस्तऐवजाच्या स्थितीचा पुरावा नाही.

title: Skippi Ice Pops Success Story | Shark Tank India Deal, Growth & Valuation
description: Discover the success story of Skippi Ice Pops, India’s first ice pop brand. Learn about its Shark Tank India deal, growth journey, and latest valuation.
content:
Skippi Ice Pops Success Story | How India’s First Ice Pop Brand Became a Sensation

Introduction

The story of Skippi Ice Pops is a true example of how innovation, nostalgia, and smart branding can transform a simple childhood memory into a multi-crore business. Founded by Ravi Kabra and Anuja Kabra in 2020, Skippi became India’s first ice pop brand and quickly captured the market with its unique flavors, hygienic packaging, and strong recall value.

Within months, the startup went viral after securing a historic deal on Shark Tank India Season 1, where all six sharks invested ₹1 crore collectively. Since then, Skippi has grown rapidly, spreading across retail stores, e-commerce platforms, and schools—bringing back the joy of colorful ice pops for a new generation.

Early Days of Skippi Ice Pops

Ravi and Anuja noticed a major gap in the Indian market—while ice candies were popular among kids, they lacked hygiene, branding, and consistency. By creating 100% natural, preservative-free, and safe ice pops, they reintroduced a nostalgic product with a modern twist.

Their idea wasn’t just about selling ice candies—it was about reviving childhood nostalgia in a safe, branded, and scalable way.

Shark Tank India Deal

Skippi Ice Pops made history by becoming the first brand on Shark Tank India to get investment from all six sharks:

  • Investment Amount: ₹1 Crore

  • Equity Dilution: 15%

  • Sharks: Ashneer Grover, Aman Gupta, Namita Thapar, Vineeta Singh, Peyush Bansal, and Ghazal Alagh

This deal gave them national visibility and made Skippi a household name overnight.

Growth Journey & Achievements

  • Expanded to over 20,000 outlets across India

  • Available on major e-commerce sites like Amazon and Flipkart

  • Featured in schools, multiplexes, and malls

  • Multiple flavors including Cola, Orange, Raspberry, Mango Twist, Lemon, and Bubblegum

  • Reported ₹30 crore valuation in just 2 years

Skippi Ice Pops Valuation Growth Chart

Year Valuation (Approx.) Milestone
2020 ₹5 Crore Brand Launch
2021 ₹10 Crore Pre-Shark Tank Growth
2022 ₹30 Crore Shark Tank Deal & Expansion
2023 ₹60 Crore Nationwide Retail Growth
2024 ₹100+ Crore Leading Ice Pop Brand in India

Conclusion

The success story of Skippi Ice Pops proves that even the simplest ideas—when executed with innovation, nostalgia, and branding—can become a nationwide craze. From reviving ice pops to becoming a Shark Tank India favorite, Skippi continues to inspire budding entrepreneurs in India.

title: NEET PG Round 2 Registration Opens: Three Separate Deadlines on 14 November
description: MCC has opened Round 2 registration. On 14 November, edit/reset ends at 1 pm, registration at 3 pm and payment at 6 pm. Choice locking runs into 15 November.
content:
MCC has opened NEET PG 2026 Round 2 registration. If you plan to apply on 14 November, save three cut-offs: edit or reset your registration by 1 pm, complete registration by 3 pm and pay by 6 pm. The later payment deadline does not extend registration. MCC uses its server time.

Apply first, then enter your choices

Use the candidate registration link on the MCC PG counselling page. Registration began at 1 pm on 7 November. If the portal is not offering choice filling yet, that is a separate step: it starts at 1 pm on 10 November.

Candidate actionOpensCloses
Edit or reset registration7 November, 3 pm14 November, 1 pm
Register7 November, 1 pm14 November, 3 pm
Fill choices10 November, 1 pm15 November, 11:55 pm
Lock choices14 November, 4 pm15 November, 11:55 pm

The result and reporting dates are a schedule

The revised MCC notice schedules processing and the provisional result for 16 November, the final result for 17 November and reporting from 18 to 24 November. Plan around those dates, but check the actual final allotment before travelling. The earlier seat-matrix update explained why MCC was changing the round; the new notice supplies the times.

If you are resigning a Round 1 seat

The MCC homepage lists 5 pm on 9 November, while Notice No. 5 lists 6 pm the same day for resignation without forfeiture of the security deposit. Do not rely on the later hour: finish before 5 pm and confirm acceptance. Freeze candidates must visit the allotted institute; float candidates use the online portal.

title: BITSAT 2027 Registration: December Opening Is Tentative
description: BITS Pilani lists December 2026 as the tentative opening for 2027-28 first-degree admissions. The exact BITSAT application date and deadline are still awaited.
content:
BITS Pilani has listed December 2026 as the tentative opening month for first-degree admissions for the 2027-28 academic year. That is an official planning indication, not a confirmed BITSAT 2027 registration date. An exact opening day and application deadline are still awaited.

The notice appears on the official first-degree admissions page. The same page still displays the detailed BITSAT 2026 schedule, so check the year before adding any date to your calendar.

What the December notice confirms

The notice concerns the next first-degree admission cycle for B.E., MSc and B.Pharm. programmes. It expressly calls the December opening tentative. Do not treat a predicted day in December, or last year’s opening day, as a deadline announced for 2027.

The previous academic-year admission cycle is marked closed. An Apply/Login link remaining on an admissions website does not by itself establish that the next cycle is accepting applications.

What to check when registration opens

  • The examination year and academic year on the application notice.

  • The opening and closing dates for the session you intend to take.

  • The applicable eligibility rules, including subjects and qualifying-examination year.

  • The fee for your selected application route and the payment deadline.

  • The required uploads, correction arrangements and confirmation instructions.

Read the new brochure before using an older checklist. Previous-year marks thresholds, fees and examination dates should not be assumed to be final for the next cycle.

Prepare your records without submitting an old form

Keep your academic records and identity details organised, and check that names and dates match. Use an email address and mobile number you can continue to access throughout admissions. This preparation is useful even while the exact application window is pending.

When the 2027 application is announced, enter through the official first-degree page and confirm the year on the form before paying. Save the submitted form and payment acknowledgement. BITS Pilani’s admissions site also warns against messages promising direct admission; use its published contact route if an offer is unclear.

For broader examination background, visit the DekhoCampus BITSAT guide. The current official admission notice should decide when and how you apply.

title: CBSE इयत्ता 10 आणि 12 कन्नड परीक्षा 2027: तारीख, विषय संकेतांक आणि वेळ
description: इयत्ता 10च्या कन्नड (संकेतांक 015) विषयाचा पेपर 27 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे. इयत्ता 12च्या कन्नड (संकेतांक 115) विषयाचा पेपर 3 मार्च 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे.
content:
इयत्ता 10च्या कन्नड (संकेतांक 015) विषयाचा पेपर 27 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे. इयत्ता 12च्या कन्नड (संकेतांक 115) विषयाचा पेपर 3 मार्च 2027 रोजी 10:30 ते 13:30 या वेळेत आहे.

CBSEने 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026 रोजी प्रसिद्ध केलेल्या मुख्य परीक्षेच्या वेळापत्रकात ही नोंद आहे. हे परीक्षेचे वेळापत्रक आहे; गुणपत्रिका नाही. अधिकृत CBSE वेळापत्रक

कन्नड पेपरचा कालावधी

इयत्ता आणि विषयसंकेतांकपरीक्षेची तारीखवेळ (IST)कालावधी
इयत्ता 10: Kannada01527 फेब्रुवारी 202710:30 - 13:303 तास
इयत्ता 12: Kannada1153 मार्च 202710:30 - 13:303 तास

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षण मंडळ, 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 5: विषय संकेतांक, तारीख आणि वेळ. मूळ PDFमधील हे पृष्ठ पाहा

केंद्रीय माध्यमिक शिक्षण मंडळ, 6 नोव्हेंबर 2026, पृष्ठ 9: विषय संकेतांक, तारीख आणि वेळ. मूळ PDFमधील हे पृष्ठ पाहा

अधिकृत PDFमध्ये आपली नोंद कशी शोधाल?

पृष्ठ 5, 9 वर प्रथम इयत्तेचे शीर्षक पाहा, मग 015, 115 हा संकेतांक शोधा. तारीख किंवा वेळ दाखवणारा एकच रकाना अनेक ओळींना लागू असू शकतो. फोनवर पान मोठे करून पूर्ण ओळ वाचा.

शाळेतील नोंदणीवरचा संकेतांक आणि अभ्यासक्रमाचे पूर्ण नाव तपासा. दुसऱ्या इयत्तेलाही तेच नाव असल्यास फक्त स्वतःच्या इयत्तेची ओळ निवडा.

इंग्रजीच्या पेपरशी तारखांची तुलना

इयत्ता 10चा कन्नड (015) पेपर 27 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी आहे. इंग्रजी भाषा आणि साहित्य (184)चा पेपर 26 फेब्रुवारी 2027 रोजी आहे. दोन तारखांमध्ये 1 दिवसांचे अंतर आहे. इयत्ता 12चा कन्नड (115) पेपर 3 मार्च 2027 रोजी आहे. English Core (301)चा पेपर 5 मार्च 2027 रोजी आहे. दोन तारखांमध्ये 2 दिवसांचे अंतर आहे.

हे सर्व दिवस अभ्यासासाठी सुट्टीचे असतील असे नाही. आपले इतर पेपरही दिनदर्शिकेत नोंदवून परीक्षा नसलेले मधले दिवस मोजा. सरावासाठी मूळ पेपरइतकाच वेळ ठेवा.

परीक्षा केंद्राकडे निघण्यापूर्वी

पेपर सुरू होण्याची वेळ म्हणजे केंद्रावर पोहोचण्याची अंतिम वेळ नव्हे. उपस्थिती, प्रवेश व कागदपत्रांसाठी प्रवेशपत्र पाहा. तारीख बदलल्याचे समजल्यास बोर्डाच्या सुधारित सूचनेत इयत्ता, संकेतांक व तारीख जुळवा.

केंद्रात संपर्क साधने नेण्यास परवानगी नाही. काय नेता येईल हे ठरवताना CBSEच्या स्वतंत्र सूचना आणि प्रवेशपत्रावरील नियम पाळा.

title: JEECUP 2026 Round 7 Choice Filling Roadmap: Seat Vacancy Evaluation, Out-of-State Cutoffs, and Allotment Timelines
description: Comprehensive guide for JEECUP 2026 Round 7 choice filling, seat vacancy analysis, out-of-state eligibility, cutoffs, and counseling timelines.
content:
The Joint Entrance Examination Council, Uttar Pradesh (JEECUP) conducts polytechnic counseling across multiple rounds each academic year. As counseling progresses into Round 7, candidates enter a crucial phase where strategic preference listing directly impacts allotment outcomes. This guide outlines the choice filling roadmap for JEECUP 2026 Round 7, focusing on seat vacancy evaluation, rules for out-of-state candidates, cutoff trends, and essential allotment schedules.

Understanding JEECUP 2026 Round 7 Significance

Round 7 belongs to the late-stage special counseling phase of JEECUP polytechnic admissions. During initial counseling cycles (Rounds 1 to 5), seats across major government institutes and popular branches fill rapidly. By Round 7, candidates are primarily competing for remaining seats, vacant quotas, and spots created through withdrawals or non-reporting.

Key characteristics of Round 7 include:

  • Open participation for both UP domicile and out-of-state candidates, subject to official guidelines.
  • Mandatory fresh choice submission or mandatory locking procedures depending on council rules for late rounds.
  • Fewer seats in top-tier urban polytechnic colleges, with higher availability in emerging regional institutions or specialized branches.

Step-by-Step Seat Vacancy Evaluation

Before filling choices, candidates must systematically analyze the official seat matrix published by the Joint Entrance Examination Council prior to Round 7. Relying on old vacancy data can result in wasted choices.

1. Download the Round 7 Vacancy Matrix

Access the official JEECUP portal and download the updated seat availability matrix. Filter seats by institution type: Government, Aided, and Private.

2. Categorize Branch Preferences

Group available seats into primary, secondary, and backup options based on your professional interest and branch flexibility (e.g., Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering).

3. Review Institute Category and Seat Category

Ensure that vacant seats match your specific category (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) or fall under the open quota available during special rounds.

Out-of-State Candidate Rules and Cutoffs

Out-of-state candidates play an active role in the special counseling rounds of UP Polytechnic admissions.

  • Quota Rules: UP domicile candidates receive primary preference during early rounds. In Round 7, remaining seats across participating institutes are typically opened to non-UP candidates under specific open allotment rules.
  • Cutoff Expectations: Closing ranks tend to relax significantly during Round 7 compared to initial rounds. Out-of-state applicants with higher rank numbers often find viable options in private and aided institutions, as well as specific government polytechnics in regional districts.
  • Document Verification: Out-of-state students must ensure all domicile, category, and educational certificates meet the standard formats prescribed in the official JEECUP information brochure.

JEECUP 2026 Round 7 Allotment Timeline and Process

Adhering to strict timelines is necessary to avoid losing allotted seats. Below is a operational overview of the Round 7 workflow:

Process PhaseKey Action Required
Seat Matrix ReleaseReview real-time seat vacancy data on the official portal.
Choice Filling & LockingSubmit and lock preferred colleges and branches online.
Seat Allotment ResultCheck result status using candidate credentials.
Document VerificationReport to designated help centers for physical verification.
Fee Payment & Freeze/FloatPay acceptance fees online to confirm seat allotment.

Strategic Choice Filling Advice for Round 7

To maximize your chances of securing a seat during Round 7 choice filling, follow these operational principles:

  1. Fill Maximum Realistic Options: Do not restrict choices to only 2 or 3 top colleges. Include a mix of competitive government institutes, stable aided polytechnics, and reliable private colleges.
  2. Prioritize Branch over Campus (or Vice Versa): Clarify whether your priority is a specific diploma branch or getting into any government institute. Align your order accordingly.
  3. Verify Institute Recognition: Ensure chosen private or self-financed polytechnic institutes are approved by AICTE and affiliated with BTEUP.

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is eligible to participate in JEECUP Round 7 choice filling?

Candidates who registered for JEECUP counseling, qualified the entrance test, and have not locked a final seat in earlier rounds are generally eligible, including out-of-state candidates subject to late-round eligibility criteria.

Can out-of-state students get government polytechnic seats in Round 7?

Yes, out-of-state students can receive seats in government polytechnics during Round 7 if vacancies exist after accounting for domicile reservations and state quota rules.

How can candidates check real-time seat vacancies for Round 7?

Candidates must log in to the official JEECUP portal and download the official Round 7 seat vacancy PDF published before choice filling opens.

What happens if a seat is allotted in Round 7 but document verification fails?

If document verification fails due to invalid certificates or discrepancies, the allotment is canceled, and the candidate may forfeit their claim for that seat.

title: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Malayalam Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Malayalam: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
Class 10 Malayalam (012) is on 27 February 2027; Class 12 Malayalam (112) is on 3 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Malayalam dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Malayalam01227 February 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours
Class 12: Malayalam1123 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Malayalam entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 5, 9 and look for codes 012, 112. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Malayalam (012) falls 1 calendar day after English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Malayalam (112) falls 2 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: CEED 2027 নথি: ডিগ্রির সার্টিফিকেট না এলে কী আপলোড করবেন?
description: CEED 2027-এর বিকল্প শিক্ষাগত নথি, Appendix 1, ছবি ও বিভাগভিত্তিক শংসাপত্র প্রস্তুত রাখুন। সাধারণ ও বিলম্ব ফি-র সময়সীমা জেনে নিন।
content:
CEED 2027-এর আবেদন প্রস্তুত করতে ছাপানো ডিগ্রি সার্টিফিকেটের জন্য অপেক্ষা করতে হবে না। সার্টিফিকেটের অপেক্ষায় থাকা স্নাতকদের বিকল্প নথি এবং এখনও পড়ছেন এমন শিক্ষার্থীদের আলাদা শংসাপত্রের ব্যবস্থা IIT Bombay-এর তথ্যপুস্তিকায় আছে। আপনার শিক্ষাগত অবস্থার সঙ্গে মানানসই পথ বেছে নিন।

সরকারি CEED ওয়েবসাইটে বিলম্ব ফি ছাড়া রেজিস্ট্রেশনের শেষ দিন 31 অক্টোবর 2026 বলা হয়েছে। বিলম্ব ফি দিয়ে রেজিস্ট্রেশন 1 থেকে 6 নভেম্বর পর্যন্ত চলবে, শেষ হবে 6 নভেম্বর বিকেল 5টায়। কলেজের সাহায্য লাগে এমন নথি আগে তৈরি করুন; টাকা দেওয়ার পর্যায় পর্যন্ত ফেলে রাখবেন না।

সরকারি CEED ওয়েবসাইট

পড়াশোনার অবস্থার সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নথি বাছুন

স্নাতকেরা ডিগ্রি বা ডিপ্লোমা সার্টিফিকেট PDF হিসেবে আপলোড করতে পারেন। চূড়ান্ত সার্টিফিকেট না এলে শেষ মার্কশিট বা প্রভিশনাল সার্টিফিকেট গ্রহণযোগ্য। এখনও পড়ছেন এমন আবেদনকারীদের অধ্যক্ষ বা বিভাগীয় প্রধানের দেওয়া Appendix 1 শংসাপত্র PDF হিসেবে দিতে হবে।

IIT Bombay, CEED 2027 তথ্যপুস্তিকা, 2027 সংস্করণ, পৃষ্ঠা 11। এই পৃষ্ঠায় প্রকাশের তারিখ দেওয়া নেই। মূল তথ্যপুস্তিকা ও Appendix 1

ছবি, স্বাক্ষর ও বিভাগভিত্তিক শংসাপত্র দেখুন

গত ছয় মাসে তোলা ছবি এবং স্ক্যান করা স্বাক্ষর JPG-তে রাখুন। বৈধ বিভাগভিত্তিক শংসাপত্র PDF-এ আপলোড করুন। EWS ও OBC-NCL শংসাপত্র 1 এপ্রিল 2026 বা তার পরে ইস্যু হতে হবে। প্রতিবন্ধিতা, লেখক-সহায়তা এবং নাম বদলের নথি প্রযোজ্য হলেই প্রয়োজন; তথ্যপুস্তিকার সংশ্লিষ্ট নির্দেশ পড়ুন।

আপলোডের আগে প্রতিটি ফাইল খুলুন। নাম, স্বাক্ষর, সিল এবং নথির কিনারা স্পষ্ট হতে হবে। ছবির জায়গায় যাতে স্বাক্ষর না বসে, ফাইলের পরিষ্কার নাম দিন। মূল ফাইলগুলি একটি ফোল্ডারে রাখুন।

আবেদন শেষ করে নিশ্চিতকরণ রাখুন

সরকারি CEED আবেদন পোর্টাল ব্যবহার করুন। দেখানো তথ্য নিজের নথির সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে প্রতিটি সংযুক্তি যাচাই করুন এবং সম্পূর্ণ আবেদন ও পেমেন্টের রসিদ রাখুন। প্রযুক্তিগত সমস্যা হলে Report Problem সুবিধা ব্যবহার করুন। টাকা দেওয়ার চেষ্টা হয়েছে মানেই ফর্ম জমা পড়েছে, এমন ধরে নেবেন না।

সরকারি আবেদন পোর্টাল

পুরো সময়সূচির জন্য আমাদের রেজিস্ট্রেশনের শেষ দিন ও বিলম্ব ফি-র সময়সীমার নির্দেশিকা পড়ুন। এই তালিকা নথি প্রস্তুত করতে সাহায্য করে; কোর্সের যোগ্যতার শর্তের বিকল্প নয়।

CEED রেজিস্ট্রেশনের শেষ দিন ও বিলম্ব ফি-র সময়সীমা
