title: Food Safety Crackdown: FDA Asks Two IIT Bombay Hostel Mess Facilities to Stop Operations
description: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has directed two hostel mess facilities at IIT Bombay to cease operations immediately due to missing compliance licenses. Learn about the impact on students and safety measures.
content:
Quick Answer: What Happened at IIT Bombay?

On August 8, 2026, the Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) directed two hostel mess operators at the IIT Bombay campus to halt operations immediately. The food safety department issued this directive following surprise audits which revealed that these dining halls were running without the mandatory compliance licenses and registrations. This regulatory action highlights the growing emphasis on food safety, student welfare, and strict regulatory standards within elite academic institutions in Maharashtra.

Key Facts: IIT Bombay Mess Closure

To help students and parents quickly grasp the key details of this regulatory enforcement, here is a summary of the facts surrounding the closure:

Parameter Details / Observations
Date of Action August 8, 2026
Regulatory Body Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
Campus Affected Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), Powai, Mumbai
Reason for Closure Lack of valid food business operator (FBO) licenses or registrations
Current Status Operations suspended until legal compliance is secured
Alternative Arrangements Students redirected to other functional campus mess halls

Why Did the FDA Shut Down the Hostels' Mess Operations?

The Maharashtra FDA has been actively monitoring bulk dining facilities across academic hubs like Mumbai and Pune. During a standard inspection drive, food safety officers examined the administrative records of various food services inside the Powai campus. They discovered that two prominent mess facilities, managed by third-party catering contractors, were serving meals to hundreds of students daily without a valid food safety license.

Under the Food Safety and Standards Act, any kitchen serving food on a commercial or institutional scale must maintain an active license. This legal requirement ensures that inspectors can routinely verify the quality of ingredients, clean storage practices, and water portability. In the food industry, compliance is highly technical. Students studying relevant disciplines, such as those in Food and Beverage Services Courses, are trained specifically in these strict regulatory protocols, emphasizing the real-world importance of compliance audits.

The Impact of the Closures on Student Welfare

With thousands of students residing on the campus, a sudden dining hall closure can cause immediate disruption to daily schedules. The student council at the institute has raised concerns about the quality of third-party vendors and the lack of internal administrative oversight. While the institute is known for its world-class engineering education, students and parents argue that the basic amenities, especially daily meals, must meet the highest health standards.

To mitigate the disruption, the student coordination committee and the hostel administration quickly worked out emergency solutions. The affected hostel residents are temporarily allowed to eat at neighboring mess facilities. Additionally, several retail food outlets on campus have been requested to remain open for longer hours to ensure that no student suffers from a lack of nutritious dining options.

Step-by-Step Guidance: How Students Can Report Food Concerns

If you live in a hostel or campus environment in India, you do not have to settle for subpar hygiene or illegal dining setups. Here is a clear step-by-step process to handle food safety issues on your campus:

  1. Locate the License Display: Check if your mess or canteen displays its FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number prominently near the kitchen entrance or main counter. This is a basic legal requirement for all food business operators.
  2. Document the Issue: If you notice pests, stale food, contaminated water, or staff not wearing proper gear (like hairnets and gloves), take clear photos or videos as evidence.
  3. Report to the Hostel Committee: Present your documented proof to your local student representatives or the hostel warden. Official student bodies have direct lines of communication with the administration.
  4. Escalate to State Authorities: If the campus administration fails to act, you can register a formal complaint on the FSSAI's online portal (FoSCoS) or file a grievance directly with the local FDA office in Maharashtra.

The Broader Challenge of Campus Food Safety in Maharashtra

This incident at IIT Bombay is not an isolated event but part of a wider statewide push to hold universities accountable for student health. Over the past year, the Maharashtra FDA has conducted inspections in multiple college hostels, canteens, and nearby private mess facilities. Educational hubs are high-density living spaces where any contamination can quickly lead to widespread waterborne diseases or food poisoning. Regulatory bodies are sending a clear message: even the most prestigious institutes must strictly adhere to the national safety codes.

FAQs: IIT Bombay Mess Closure and FDA Crackdown

Which hostels are affected by the FDA order?

The FDA has directed two specific hostel dining facilities to stop operations due to missing permits. The administration has kept the specific hostel numbers confidential to avoid panic while they transition the catering services.

Are other canteens and food stalls on the campus still open?

Yes. All other licensed food outlets, campus night canteens, and hostel mess facilities that possess active FSSAI approvals are operating normally. Only the two unlicensed kitchens were asked to shut down.

Can the closed mess facilities reopen?

The suspended mess halls can only reopen after the operators apply for, receive, and display a valid FSSAI license, followed by a formal verification inspection by the FDA authorities.

What are the consequences of operating a mess without a license?

Under the Food Safety and Standards Act, operating a food business without a license can lead to severe financial penalties, cancellation of vendor contracts, and potential legal prosecution for the operators.

title: Perplexity AI: The Next-Gen AI Search Engine Revolutionizing Information Discovery
description: Discover how Perplexity AI is transforming the search engine landscape with AI-driven answers, real-time data retrieval, and an intuitive user experience. Learn about its features, impact, and future potential.
content:
The Success Story of Perplexity AI: Revolutionizing Search with AI-Powered Intelligence

Introduction

In an era where search engines dominate how we access information, Perplexity AI has emerged as a groundbreaking innovation. Unlike traditional search engines, which rely on ranked web pages, Perplexity AI uses advanced artificial intelligence and natural language processing to provide direct, precise, and well-researched answers to user queries. This AI-driven platform is setting new standards for information retrieval, making online searches faster, more interactive, and highly accurate.

The Vision Behind Perplexity AI

Perplexity AI was founded with the vision of transforming the way people search for information. Recognizing the limitations of traditional search engines, the creators aimed to develop a system that provides instant, contextually relevant, and well-cited answers instead of directing users to multiple websites.

Their goal was simple: create a search tool that mimics human-like understanding and eliminates the need for users to sift through countless sources to find relevant information.

The Journey of Perplexity AI

Since its inception, Perplexity AI has grown rapidly, gaining attention from users who prefer a conversational and research-backed search experience.

AI-Powered Search: Unlike Google, Perplexity AI delivers direct answers, often supported by citations from credible sources.

User-Centric Interface: The platform provides a chat-like experience, allowing users to refine their searches interactively.

Real-Time Data Retrieval: Perplexity AI fetches up-to-date information, ensuring that users get the most relevant and recent insights.

No Clickbait, Just Answers: Unlike traditional search engines that prioritize SEO-based rankings, Perplexity AI focuses on factually accurate and relevant responses.

Perplexity AI’s Impact on the Digital World

Perplexity AI has quickly gained traction among researchers, professionals, and everyday users looking for concise yet detailed responses.

✔ Enhanced Productivity: Users spend less time navigating through multiple web pages and more time gaining insightful answers.

✔ Accuracy & Transparency: The platform often includes source citations, ensuring credibility and reducing misinformation.

✔ Future of Search Engines: With AI rapidly evolving, Perplexity AI is paving the way for a future where search queries yield tailored, instant, and interactive results.

What Sets Perplexity AI Apart?

AI-Driven Responses: Unlike traditional search engines, Perplexity AI curates its answers using sophisticated AI models.

Conversational Interface: It allows follow-up queries, making the search experience more interactive and efficient.

No Ads, No Bias: Unlike other search engines, Perplexity AI focuses on unbiased, advertisement-free results.

Challenges & The Road Ahead

While Perplexity AI is a revolutionary platform, it also faces challenges:

🔸 Competing with Google & Bing: The AI-powered search engine market is highly competitive, requiring continuous innovation.

🔸 AI Limitations: Ensuring accuracy, reducing bias, and improving real-time fact-checking remain ongoing areas of improvement.

🔸 Scaling & Adoption: Widespread adoption is still in progress as users adapt to a new way of searching for information.

However, with ongoing advancements in AI and growing user interest, Perplexity AI is positioned to disrupt the search industry in a major way.

Conclusion

Perplexity AI represents the future of AI-powered search engines. With its intelligent response system, transparent citations, and user-friendly interface, it is reshaping how people access information online. As AI continues to evolve, Perplexity AI stands at the forefront of an information revolution, proving that the future of search is conversational, accurate, and AI-driven.

title: NEET PG 2026 Deemed University Fees: Which Costs Are Non-Refundable?
description: Learn how to compare NEET PG 2026 deemed-university tuition, deposits, hostel costs and resignation conditions before accepting a seat.
content:
NEET PG 2026 deemed-university fees cannot be judged from tuition alone. Security deposits may be refundable after permitted deductions, hostel and mess charges may depend on use and written terms, while registration or processing charges may be retained when the applicable rules say so. The financial loss on resignation depends on the counselling notice, your admission undertaking and the university's signed fee schedule.

There is no verified 2026 refund rule, fee amount or resignation deadline in the evidence available for this article. So don't treat a general checklist as a 2026 promise.

Who controls deemed-university counselling and refunds?

The Medical Counselling Committee, or MCC, is the authority to verify for deemed-university seat allotment, reporting, resignation and refund conditions for the relevant counselling cycle. Confirm this in the 2026 MCC bulletin or notice when issued. The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences, or NBEMS, handles NEET PG examination notices and actions, not the college's fee schedule or counselling refund terms. Use the official NEET PG website for exam-related notices and the counselling authority's notice for seat decisions. You can also review the verified NEET PG exam guide for the wider route.

Which charges deserve separate treatment?

ChargeWhat may happenDocument to check
TuitionUsually tied to the course or payment year; instalments and unpaid dues matter.University fee schedule
Security depositMay be returned after deductions, clearance and the stated process.Signed fee schedule and undertaking
Hostel and messRefund can depend on occupancy, notice period and compulsory-hostel terms.Hostel rules and admission terms
Registration or processing chargesMay be retained if the written rules classify them as non-refundable.Counselling notice and receipt

What should you check before accepting?

Read the MCC seat and resignation notice, the university's signed fee schedule and the admission undertaking as three separate documents. A possible exit-linked charge isn't universal across deemed universities. It can depend on the round, resignation timing, joining status, seat upgradation and the exact undertaking you sign.

  1. Record the first payment, annual tuition, deposit, hostel, mess and other listed charges.
  2. Mark the last permitted resignation point and every stated deduction.
  3. Ask who processes the refund, how it is claimed and which receipt proves payment.
  4. Save the notice, undertaking, receipts and written clarification before reporting.

Compare the amount you may actually lose, not just the annual tuition. If a portal notice and college document conflict, pause and seek written clarification from MCC or the authority named in that cycle's notice. A verbal assurance from an agent won't protect your money.

title: NEET UG 2026 Bond Clauses: What MBBS Applicants Must Compare
description: Compare bond duration, exit penalties, refunds and fees before choosing a government or private MBBS seat through NEET UG 2026 counselling.
content:
A low-fee MBBS seat can become an expensive decision if its bond demands compulsory service or a large exit payment. During NEET UG 2026 counselling, compare the written bond, refund rule and fee liability before you lock a seat, not after reporting to the college.

The National Testing Agency handles NEET UG notices, but bond conditions usually come from the relevant counselling authority, state rules and the admitting medical college. Keep the current notice accessible through the official NEET UG website, then read the seat-specific documents issued for your counselling round.

What should NEET UG 2026 counselling applicants compare?

Compare four things side by side: the service period, the amount payable on leaving, the refund process and the person who must sign. A verbal assurance from a college office cannot safely replace a clause in the prospectus, allotment letter or bond form.

ClauseWhat to locateWhy it changes your seat choice
Service bondDuration, posting authority and start pointYou may have a duty after internship or registration
Exit amountFixed sum, fee recovery or another formulaLeaving can create a large payment demand
Refund ruleRefundable items, deadline and deductionsA seat surrender may not return every payment
Security and guarantorDeposit, surety, parent signature and documentsFinancial exposure may extend beyond the student

Do not compare only annual fees. A private college with higher fees but no stated service obligation may carry a different exit risk from a government seat with lower tuition and a long service clause. The cheaper seat is not automatically the safer seat.

How to check bond risk before locking a seat

For NEET UG 2026 counselling, download the applicable state or institutional prospectus and mark every clause dealing with resignation, migration, discontinuation, internship and refund. Ask for a written copy of the bond format before payment. If the answer is “you’ll know after admission”, treat that as a warning.

  1. Write the total first-year payment, including tuition, hostel, caution money and other listed charges.
  2. Record the exit amount separately. Don’t merge it into “fees”.
  3. Check whether the service period begins after MBBS, internship or registration.
  4. Confirm which authority receives the bond and whether a parent or guarantor signs it.
  5. Save the prospectus, fee notice, allotment letter and payment receipts in one folder.

Before choosing between two seats, make a one-page comparison and show it to a parent. The NEET UG exam guide can help with the wider admission process, but the bond decision must rely on the specific counselling and college documents for your seat.

content:
CUCET 2027 ਵਿੱਚ 80 ਅੰਕ ਆਮ ਪੜਾਅ I ਦੀ ਸਾਰਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ 50% ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਪੜਾਅ II ਵਿੱਚ 40%। ਕੁਝ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਆਪਣੀਆਂ ਦਰਾਂ ਹਨ। ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਦੇ ਖਰਚੇ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਲਾਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਕੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਸਹੀ ਪੜਾਅ, ਕੈਂਪਸ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਦੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

ਆਮ ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਦਰਾਂ ਪੜਾਅ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਬਦਲਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ

ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦਾ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਪੜਾਅ I ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਤੋਂ ਮਈ 2027 ਤੱਕ ਅਤੇ ਪੜਾਅ II ਜੂਨ 2027 ਤੋਂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਖ਼ਤਮ ਹੋਣ ਤੱਕ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪੜਾਅ I ਵਿੱਚ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦਾ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਹੈ; ਪੜਾਅ II ਬੰਦ ਦਿਖਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਮਿਆਦਾਂ ਹਨ, ਦਿਨਵਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਜਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੀ ਪੱਕੀ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ।

ਹੇਠਲੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ਼ਿਤ ਅੰਕ-ਸੀਮਾਵਾਂ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਹਨ। 30 ਤੋਂ 39.99 ਅੰਕਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਕਿਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਵਾਅਦਾ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਯੋਗ ਕਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਹੱਦ ਦੇ ਨੇੜਲੇ ਸਕੋਰ ਨੂੰ ਅਗਲੀ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀ ਤੱਕ ਵਧਾ ਕੇ ਨਾ ਗਿਣੋ।

Applied Finance and Analytics ਜਾਂ Forensic Accounting and Fraud Investigation ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਦਰਾਂ ਹਨ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ 90.01-100 ਅਤੇ 80-90 ਦੋਵਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ 40%; ਚਿੱਤਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਗਲੀਆਂ ਚਾਰ ਹੇਠਲੀਆਂ ਸ਼੍ਰੇਣੀਆਂ ਲਈ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ 30%, 20%, 15%, 10%। MBA (Applied Finance and Analytics) with PwC ਲਈ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਤੌਰ ਉੱਤੇ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਦੇਖਣ ਨੂੰ ਕਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਆਮ 100% ਵਾਲਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਹਰ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਕੋਰਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਾ ਲਗਾਓ।

ਪੋਰਟਲ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਮਾਈਗ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਹੀਂ। ਉੱਤਰ ਪ੍ਰਦੇਸ਼ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਦੇ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਕੋਰਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਭਾਗ ਹੈ; ਪੰਜਾਬ ਦੇ ਅਪਵਾਦਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਨਿਯਮਾਵਲੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਫ਼ੀਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਮੰਨਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਹੀ ਕੋਰਸ ਅਤੇ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਜਾਂਚੋ।

ਚੰਡੀਗੜ੍ਹ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦਾ CUCET 2027 ਪੋਰਟਲ: ਪੜਾਅ ਦਰਾਂ, ਪੰਜਾਬ ਮੈਨੇਜਮੈਂਟ ਅਪਵਾਦ ਅਤੇ ਮਾਈਗ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀਆਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਾ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਤ। ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ।

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ CUCET 2027 ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ਾ ਪੋਰਟਲ

ਫ਼ੀਸ ਦਾ ਬਜਟ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਲਾਭ ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰੋ

ਸਕੋਰਕਾਰਡ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ ਅਤੇ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਟੀਮ ਤੋਂ ਆਫ਼ਰ ਜਾਂ ਫ਼ੀਸ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਾਗੂ ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਲਵੋ। ਪੁੱਛੋ ਕਿ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਫ਼ੀਸਾਂ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹਨ, ਕਿੰਨੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਲਈ ਲਾਭ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਨਵਿਆਉਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਕੀ ਹਨ। ਸਾਰਣੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਟਿਊਸ਼ਨ, ਹੋਸਟਲ, ਖਾਣਾ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਖਰਚਾ ਮਾਫ਼ ਹੋਣਾ ਨਹੀਂ। ਵੇਰਵੇ ਸਪਸ਼ਟ ਹੋਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕੁੱਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਖਰਚੇ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਨਾ ਘਟਾਓ।

title: CBSE Class 12 Hindi Core Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Class 12 Hindi Core: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Hindi Core is on 13 March 2027, from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST. Match subject code 302 with your registration details before adding the paper to your calendar.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Hindi Core dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 12: Hindi Core30213 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Hindi Core entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 11 and look for code 302. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The timetable entry is for Hindi Core under the code shown above. If your school record uses a different code or course name, ask the school to resolve that difference before following this date.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 12 Hindi Core (302) falls 8 calendar days after English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: ICFAI Business School MBA Admissions 2026: Comparing Non-IBSAT Routes via CAT, XAT, NMAT, and GMAT Scores
description: Explore ICFAI Business School MBA admissions 2026 through non-IBSAT scores. Compare entrance requirements, cutoffs, and selection processes for CAT, XAT, NMAT, and GMAT applicants.
content:
Overview of ICFAI Business School MBA Admissions 2026

ICFAI Business School (IBS) is one of India's prominent private management institutions, offering MBA and PGPM programs across multiple campuses, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, and Dehradun. While the institute conducts its proprietary test, IBSAT, candidates can also secure admission using scores from national entrance examinations such as CAT, XAT, NMAT by GMAC, and GMAT.

For the academic session 2026, candidates seeking admission through non-IBSAT routes do not need to sit for the separate IBSAT exam if they meet the minimum cutoffs established for these national tests. Understanding how each non-IBSAT route compares in terms of difficulty, score submission, and cutoff requirements helps applicants optimize their admission strategy.

Accepted Non-IBSAT Entrance Exams and Eligibility Criteria

To apply for the MBA or PGPM program at any IBS campus for 2026, applicants must fulfill the general academic eligibility criteria alongside possessing valid entrance exam scores.

  • Basic Educational Qualification: Graduation in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate marks from a recognized university.
  • Medium of Instruction: The medium of instruction during graduation must be English. Applicants who did not complete graduation in English medium must submit TOEFL, IELTS, or NELT scores.
  • Work Experience: Prior work experience is preferred but not mandatory for fresh graduates.

Detailed Comparison of Non-IBSAT Admission Routes

Each non-IBSAT entrance exam offers a unique pathway into ICFAI Business School campuses. Below is a detailed breakdown of how scores from CAT, XAT, NMAT, and GMAT are evaluated.

1. CAT (Common Admission Test) Route

The CAT is accepted across all IBS campuses, with IBS Hyderabad maintaining the highest cutoff thresholds. Candidates who score well in CAT can directly apply for the selection process without appearing for IBSAT.

  • Target Cutoff Range: 60 percentile and above for flagship campuses like IBS Hyderabad; 50 to 55 percentile for other campuses.
  • Key Advantage: High CAT percentiles strengthen the candidate profile during final merit listing and interview rounds.

2. XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test) Route

XAT scores are treated on par with CAT scores across all IBS campuses. Candidates who have prepared for decision-making and verbal sections in XAT find this route highly effective.

  • Target Cutoff Range: 60 percentile and above for IBS Hyderabad; 50 to 55 percentile for regional campuses.
  • Key Advantage: Provides an additional opportunity in January for candidates seeking top-tier private management colleges.

3. NMAT by GMAC Route

NMAT offers a structured, adaptive examination format. IBS institutions accept NMAT scores, enabling students to leverage their performance across multiple test windows.

  • Target Cutoff Range: Scaled score of 150 and above for IBS Hyderabad; proportionately lower score requirements for other campuses.
  • Key Advantage: Multiple attempts and candidate-friendly exam delivery options lower test-day pressure.

4. GMAT Route

The GMAT route caters to candidates who prefer international testing standards or candidates with prior professional experience.

  • Target Cutoff Range: 500+ score on the traditional GMAT scale or equivalent standard scores on newer exam editions.
  • Key Advantage: Valid for a longer period, making it suitable for applicants planning their admissions over a broader timeline.

Comparative Summary of Non-IBSAT Routes for 2026

The following table summarizes the typical cutoffs required for admission consideration at IBS Hyderabad versus other IBS campuses:

Entrance ExamIBS Hyderabad Expected CutoffOther IBS Campuses Expected CutoffScore Validity
CAT60+ Percentile50+ PercentileCurrent Academic Year
XAT60+ Percentile50+ PercentileCurrent Academic Year
NMAT by GMAC150+ Scaled Score130+ Scaled ScoreCurrent Testing Window
GMAT500+ Score450+ ScoreUp to 5 Years

Selection Process for Non-IBSAT Applicants

Shortlisted candidates who qualify via CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT scores are invited to participate in the common selection process organized by ICFAI Business School. The selection process evaluates holistic performance beyond entrance exam scores.

  • Micro-Presentation: Candidates present on a designated topic for 2 to 3 minutes to demonstrate public speaking, structured thinking, and analytical abilities.
  • Personal Interview: Panelists assess the applicant's academic background, communication skills, general awareness, career goals, and suitability for management education.
  • Final Merit List Parameters: Final selection is based on academic history (10th, 12th, and Graduation marks), entrance test percentile/score, micro-presentation performance, and personal interview results.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do non-IBSAT applicants need to sit for the IBSAT exam?

No, candidates with valid CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT scores that meet the required cutoffs do not need to take the IBSAT exam.

What is the minimum CAT percentile required for IBS Hyderabad?

IBS Hyderabad generally expects a minimum CAT cutoff of 60 percentile for shortlisting candidates for the selection process.

Can I submit scores from multiple entrance exams when applying to IBS?

Yes, applicants can register with scores from multiple exams, and the best valid score meeting the threshold will be considered for shortlisting.

Are cutoffs lower for regional IBS campuses like Gurgaon or Mumbai?

Yes, regional campuses such as IBS Mumbai, IBS Gurgaon, and IBS Bengaluru typically have lower percentile requirements than the main Hyderabad campus.

Is work experience compulsory for non-IBSAT admission routes?

No, work experience is not mandatory. Fresh graduates meeting academic and score cutoffs are eligible to apply across all campuses.

title: Geeta University B.Tech Data Science with HCL | Geeta University Industry Integrated Program
description: Geeta University launches Industry-Integrated B.Tech in Data Science with HCL and GUVI. Learn about program highlights, industry exposure, career opportunities, and admission details.
content:
Geeta University Launches Industry-Integrated B.Tech in Data Science with HCL

In a major step toward bridging the gap between academics and industry requirements, Geeta University, Panipat (Delhi NCR) has introduced an Industry-Integrated B.Tech in Data Science program in collaboration with HCL and GUVI.

This strategic collaboration was formalized through a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) between the institutions and industry partners, marking a new milestone in career-focused education.

The program aims to provide students with real-world exposure, practical skills, and industry-relevant knowledge that are highly demanded in today’s technology-driven job market.

With leading technology companies like HCL involved in curriculum design and training support, students will gain hands-on experience in data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and big data technologies.

About the Industry-Integrated B.Tech in Data Science

The B.Tech in Data Science at Geeta University is designed to prepare students for the rapidly growing field of data analytics and AI-driven technologies.

Through the collaboration with HCL and GUVI, students will benefit from:

  • Industry-oriented curriculum

  • Hands-on projects and practical training

  • Expert mentorship from industry professionals

  • Internship opportunities with leading tech companies

  • Placement support and career guidance

This program ensures that graduates are job-ready from day one, equipped with both technical knowledge and practical industry skills.

Key Highlights of the Program

Feature Details
Program B.Tech in Data Science
University Geeta University, Panipat (Delhi NCR)
Industry Partners HCL & GUVI
Program Type Industry Integrated
Learning Approach Practical training + Industry exposure
Career Focus Data Science, AI, Analytics

Why Choose B.Tech Data Science at Geeta University?

Choosing the right engineering program is crucial for building a successful career. The Geeta University – HCL collaboration provides several advantages:

1. Industry Collaboration

Students learn from industry experts and professionals working in top technology companies.

2. Practical Learning

The course focuses on real-world projects, coding practice, and data analysis training.

3. High-Demand Skills

Students develop expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Analytics.

4. Career Opportunities

Graduates can pursue roles such as:

  • Data Scientist

  • Machine Learning Engineer

  • Data Analyst

  • AI Specialist

  • Business Intelligence Analyst

Career Scope in Data Science

Data science is one of the fastest-growing career fields worldwide. According to industry reports, the demand for data science professionals is increasing rapidly across sectors like finance, healthcare, e-commerce, and IT.

Students completing the B.Tech Data Science program can find career opportunities in companies such as:

  • Startups and tech companies

  • Research organizations

  • Consulting firms

Conclusion

The Industry-Integrated B.Tech in Data Science by Geeta University in collaboration with HCL and GUVI represents a major step toward modern, career-focused education.

By combining academic excellence with industry expertise, the program ensures that students gain practical skills, real-world exposure, and strong career opportunities in the fast-growing field of data science.

For students looking to build a future in AI, analytics, and technology, this program offers the perfect blend of education and industry experience.

title: CBSE 2027: ಮಕ್ಕಳ ವಾರದ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಗೆ ಪೋಷಕರು ನೆರವಾಗುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?
description: CBSE 2026-27 ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳ ನೆರವಿನಿಂದ ಮಗುವಿನ ವಾರದ ಓದನ್ನು ಯೋಜಿಸಿ. ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿದ್ದಲು ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಲಾ ಕೆಲಸಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಯ ಉಳಿಸಿ.
content:
ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮಗು 2027ರ CBSE ಹತ್ತನೇ ಅಥವಾ ಹನ್ನೆರಡನೇ ತರಗತಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗೆ ಸಿದ್ಧವಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ, ಮುಂದಿನ ಏಳು ದಿನಗಳ ಯೋಜನೆಯಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ. ಓದುವ ಗಂಟೆಗಳಿಂದ ತುಂಬಿದ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ ನೀಡಬಹುದು. ಆದರೆ ಉತ್ತರ ಏಕೆ ತಪ್ಪಾಯಿತು ಎಂದು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಅದರಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಯ ಇರಬೇಕು. ಯಾವ ವಿಷಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು, ಪ್ರಗತಿಯನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಬೇಕು ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಯಾವಾಗ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಮಗುವಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ.

CBSEಯ 2026-27ರ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯವಾರು ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳು ವಿಶ್ವಾಸಾರ್ಹ ಆರಂಭ ಒದಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಇಲ್ಲಿನ ಕ್ರಮ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಸಲಹೆ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಮಂಡಳಿ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದ ಓದುವ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. ಶಾಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ಅಗತ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಅನುಗುಣವಾಗಿ ಬದಲಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೆಡೆ ಇಡಿ

ಮಗುವಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮದ ಪುಟ ತೆರೆದು ಸರಿಯಾದ ತರಗತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ. ಸಂಬಂಧಿತ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದೇ ಫೋಲ್ಡರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಗೂ ಶಾಲೆಯ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಸಿ. ಫೈಲಿನ ಹೆಸರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಯ ಮತ್ತು ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ವರ್ಷ ಇರಲಿ. ಹಳೆಯ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ತಿಳಿಯದೆ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆಯ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗುವುದನ್ನು ಇದರಿಂದ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬಹುದು.

ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿದಿರುವುದು, ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಬೇಕಿರುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ವಿವರಣೆ ಬೇಕಿರುವುದು ಎಂದು ಮೂರು ಗುಂಪು ಮಾಡಿ. ಮೊದಲು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯೇ ತನ್ನ ಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಅಂದಾಜಿಸಲಿ. ಓದುವಾಗ ಪರಿಚಿತವೆನಿಸಿದ ಅಧ್ಯಾಯದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುವುದು ಕಷ್ಟವಾಗಬಹುದು. ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಲಾ ಸೂಚನೆ ಭಿನ್ನವೆನಿಸಿದರೆ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಬಿಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಖರವಾದ ವಿಚಾರವನ್ನು ಬರೆದು ವಿಷಯ ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ.

ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕೆಲಸ ಆರಿಸಿ

“ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಓದು” ಅಥವಾ “ಅರ್ಥಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ” ಎನ್ನುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಬದಲಾಗಿ, ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ ನೋಡದೆ ಒಂದು ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ ವಿವರಿಸುವುದು, ಆಯ್ದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸುವುದು ಅಥವಾ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ಬರೆದು ಸುಧಾರಿಸುವಂತಹ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಕೆಲಸ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿ. ಬಾಕಿ ಶಾಲಾ ಕೆಲಸಕ್ಕೂ ಬಿಟ್ಟ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಲೂ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸಮಯ ಇರಲಿ.

ಮೊದಲ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಗುಂಪಿನ ತಪ್ಪುಗಳನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಬಹುದು. ಮುಂದಿನ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅದರ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ನೋಡಬಹುದು. ನಂತರ ಹಳೆಯ ಉತ್ತರ ನೋಡದೆ ಹೋಲುವ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಬಹುದು. ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಅಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದರೆ ಅದರ ಪ್ರಮಾಣವನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿ. ಓದುವ ಗಂಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವುದೇ ಒಂದೇ ಪರಿಹಾರವಲ್ಲ.

ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡಿ

CBSE ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಹತ್ತನೇ ತರಗತಿಯ ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹಾಗೂ ಹನ್ನೆರಡನೇ ತರಗತಿಯ ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿಷಯ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಹತ್ತನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ Mathematics Basic ಮತ್ತು Mathematics Standard ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿವೆ; ಹನ್ನೆರಡನೇ ತರಗತಿಯಲ್ಲಿ English Core ಮತ್ತು English Elective ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿವೆ.

ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ಯೋಜನೆ ತೆರೆವ ಮೊದಲು ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಲಿ. ನಂತರ ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿಯನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಿವರಿಸಲಿ. ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ಅಂಶ ತಿಳಿಯದಿದ್ದರೆ ಬರೆದ ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ಯೋಜನೆಯನ್ನು ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರಿಗೆ ತೋರಿಸಿ. ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ; ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅದೇ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು ಬರುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂಬ ಭರವಸೆಯಲ್ಲ.

ವಾರದ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನಾಗಿಸಬೇಡಿ

ಸುಧಾರಿಸಿದ ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯ, ಮರುಕಳಿಸಿದ ಒಂದು ತಪ್ಪು ಮತ್ತು ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೇಳಬೇಕಾದ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಚರ್ಚೆ ನಡೆಸಿ. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ, ತಪ್ಪಿನ ಕಾರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದಿನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನವನ್ನು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ನೋಟ್‌ಬುಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆದರೆ ಸಾಕು. ಸಹಪಾಠಿಯ ಅಂಕಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಮಗುವಿನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಈಗಿನ ಕೆಲಸ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ.

ಶಾಲೆ ತಿಳಿಸಿರುವ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ, ಯೋಜನಾ ಕೆಲಸ ಮತ್ತು ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇಡಿ. CBSE 2027 ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಕಗಳ ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿಯನ್ನೂ ನೋಡಬಹುದು. ಯಾವುದೇ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಶಾಲೆಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಮುಂದಿನ ವಾರಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಭಾಯಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ಯೋಜನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚೆ ಮುಗಿಸಿ. ಶಾಂತವಾದ ಓದುವ ಸಮಯ ಉಳಿಸುವುದು, ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಾಯ ಕೇಳಲು ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿಸುವುದೂ ಪೋಷಕರ ಉಪಯುಕ್ತ ನೆರವೇ.

title: ICSE, ISC 2027: ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਲਈ ਸਹੀ ਨਮੂਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ-ਪੱਤਰ ਚੁਣੋ
description: CISCE ਨੇ ਚੁਣੇ 2027 ਨਮੂਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ-ਪੱਤਰ ਤੇ ਉੱਤਰ ਕੁੰਜੀਆਂ ਜਾਰੀ ਕੀਤੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ 2026 ਦੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਅਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
2027 ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰਦੇ ICSE ਅਤੇ ISC ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ CISCE ਦੇ ਜਾਰੀ ਚੁਣੇ 2027 ਨਮੂਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ-ਪੱਤਰਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਉੱਤਰ ਕੁੰਜੀਆਂ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ। ਕੌਂਸਲ ਦੇ 9 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ ਦੇ ਸਰਕੂਲਰ ਵਿੱਚ 2026 ਦੇ ਮੁੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਹਨ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਲਈ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਾਲ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

2027 ਦਾ ਨਮੂਨਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਢੰਗ ਸਮਝਣ ਵਿੱਚ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 2026 ਦਾ ਮੁੱਖ ਜਾਂ ਸੁਧਾਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਪਿਛਲੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ ਹੈ। ਇਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ਕੋਈ ਵੀ 2027 ਦੀ ਡੇਟ ਸ਼ੀਟ ਨਹੀਂ।

CISCE ਸਰਕੂਲਰ, 9 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026, ਪੰਨਾ 1। ਡਾਊਨਲੋਡ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ.

ਸਰਕੂਲਰ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਲਾਗੂ ਕਰਨ, ਵਿਸ਼ਲੇਸ਼ਣ, ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਰਜਣ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਉੱਚ ਯੋਗਤਾਵਾਂ ਜਾਂਚਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਵਾਲਾਂ ਦਾ 2027 ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਭਗ 50% ਭਾਰ ਹੈ। ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਨ ’ਤੇ ਨਿਰਭਰ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਇਹ ਸਮਝਾਉਣ ਦਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕਰੋ ਕਿ ਜਵਾਬ ਤੱਕ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ।

ਪੂਰੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਮਗਰੋਂ ਉੱਤਰ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਵੇਖੋ

ਸਹੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਚੁਣੋ, ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ ਅਤੇ ਦਿੱਤੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰੀ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰੋ। ਫਿਰ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਉੱਤਰ ਕੁੰਜੀ ਨਾਲ ਪਛਾਣੋ ਕਿ ਕਿੱਥੇ ਸਵਾਲ ਗ਼ਲਤ ਸਮਝਿਆ, ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਕਦਮ ਛੱਡਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਵੱਧ ਸਮਾਂ ਲਾਇਆ।

ਮੁੜ ਵੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਗ਼ਲਤੀਆਂ ਦੀ ਛੋਟੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਰੱਖੋ ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਨਾਲ ਚਰਚਾ ਕਰੋ। ਵਰਤੋਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਸਵਾਲਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕੋ ਮੁਸ਼ਕਲ ਮੁੜ ਆਉਣਾ ਉਸ ਹੁਨਰ ਦਾ ਦੁਬਾਰਾ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਸੰਕੇਤ ਹੈ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਅਧਿਆਇ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਲੱਗੇ।

ਚੁਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਦਾ ਮਤਲਬ ਸਾਰੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਬਦਲੇ ਨਹੀਂ

CISCE ਨੇ ਇਹ ਜਾਰੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਚੁਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਦੱਸੀ ਹੈ। ਬਾਕੀ ICSE ਵਿਸ਼ਿਆਂ ਲਈ 2026 ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਚੱਕਰ ਦੇ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਮਾਪਦੰਡ ਅਤੇ ਢਾਂਚਾ ਲਾਗੂ ਹਨ। ਇੱਕ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਤਬਦੀਲੀ ਸਾਰੇ ਸਿਲੇਬਸ ’ਤੇ ਨਾ ਲਾਓ; ਆਪਣੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਸਹੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਲਈ CISCE ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਅਤੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਮਦਦ ਲਓ। ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਲਾਗੂ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਸੋਧ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਕਰੋ। ICSE ਅਤੇ ISC ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਮਾਰਗਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਅਣਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ।

title: Telangana Sports University and KNSU Partnership: Sports Science Degrees and Elite Coaching Scope
description: Explore how the partnership between Telangana Sports University and Korea National Sport University brings global sports science degrees, elite coaching, and career opportunities for Indian students.
content:
In a major milestone for Indian sports education, the Telangana government has forged a strategic partnership with South Korea's renowned Korea National Sport University (KNSU). Signed through the Young India Sports University initiative in Telangana, this collaboration aims to transform how sports science, elite coaching, and athletic development are approached in India. For prospective students and parents seeking alternatives to traditional academic disciplines, this international alliance offers unprecedented pathways into high-performance sports management, exercise physiology, and scientific coaching.

Understanding the Telangana Sports University and KNSU Partnership

Korea National Sport University is internationally recognized for producing Olympic gold medalists and pioneering research in human movement sciences. The partnership brings top-tier South Korean training methodologies, technological infrastructure, and curriculum standards directly to Indian campuses.

Key pillars of this bilateral academic agreement include:

  • Faculty and Student Exchange Programs: Opportunities for Indian students to complete coursework or clinical training at KNSU facilities in Seoul.
  • Collaborative Research in Sports Science: Joint studies focusing on athlete recovery, biomechanics, talent identification, and sports nutrition tailored to Asian demographics.
  • Elite Coaching Certification: Specialized training modules designed to produce internationally accredited coaches across multi-sport disciplines.
  • Advanced Infrastructure Development: Setting up state-of-the-art sports science laboratories and high-performance testing centers in Telangana.

Academic Programs and Specializations in Sports Science

The academic curriculum offered through this partnership moves beyond basic physical education. Students gain deep scientific knowledge blended with practical field application across several degree options.

1. Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Sports Science

This undergraduate program covers foundational concepts in human anatomy, exercise physiology, kinesiology, and sports biomechanics. Students learn how to analyze athletic movement, optimize metabolic performance, and reduce injury risks.

2. Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Sports Biomechanics and Performance Analysis

Focusing on advanced motion analysis, video tagging software, and wearable technology integration, this program trains specialists to provide real-time data insights to professional sports teams and national federations.

3. Master's in Sports Psychology and Mental Conditioning

Understanding the psychological resilience required for elite competition is critical. This course equips graduates to assist athletes in managing competitive stress, goal setting, and cognitive recovery techniques.

4. Postgraduate Diploma in Elite Sports Coaching

Designed for former athletes and aspiring physical instructors, this specialized program incorporates South Korean tactical approaches, periodic training planning, and periodization frameworks.

Why Sports Science Holds Immense Scope for Indian Students

India is experiencing a massive expansion in professional sporting leagues across kabaddi, badminton, football, cricket, and athletics. Concurrently, government schemes like Khelo India have increased demand for scientific support personnel at grassroot academies and state centers.

Graduates from Telangana Sports University can target varied career avenues, such as:

  • Strength and Conditioning Specialist: Designing tailored physical routines for professional franchises and national teams.
  • Sports Performance Data Analyst: Utilizing tracking tools and statistical software to evaluate tactical decisions.
  • High-Performance Academy Director: Managing grassroots development centers and athlete talent pipelines.
  • Rehabilitation and Recovery Specialist: Working alongside orthopedic experts to assist in injury recovery.

Guide for Parents: Evaluating Career Viability in Sports

For decades, parents in India have prioritized medicine, engineering, and civil services. However, the rise of a billion-dollar sports industry has created sustainable, high-paying career opportunities outside traditional fields. Sports science offers a professional, science-backed career path with strong job security across private academies, corporate wellness firms, national sports governing bodies, and international franchises.

Admission Eligibility and Application Steps

Students interested in joining programs at Telangana Sports University should prepare early by reviewing standard eligibility criteria:

  • Undergraduate Programs: Completion of 10+2 higher secondary education from a recognized board, preferably with a background in science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology).
  • Postgraduate Degrees: A bachelor's degree in sports science, physical education, physiotherapy, or allied health sciences.
  • Selection Process: Admission typically involves a physical fitness assessment, academic merit evaluation, and a written aptitude entrance test.

Candidates are encouraged to verify detailed notifications, fee structures, and application timelines on the official Telangana Sports University portal.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. What makes the KNSU collaboration beneficial for Indian sports students?

KNSU brings proven South Korean athletic training programs, cutting-edge biomechanics labs, and international exposure opportunities directly to Indian students.

2. Is a background in professional sports mandatory to study sports science?

No. While a passion for sports is helpful, sports science is an academic and scientific field requiring interest in human biology, data analysis, and exercise physiology.

3. What are the primary job profiles available after completing a sports science degree?

Graduates can work as sports scientists, biomechanists, strength and conditioning coaches, athletic performance analysts, sports nutrition advisors, and academy administrators.

4. Are exchange opportunities to South Korea included in the university framework?

Yes, the memorandum of understanding includes provisions for student exchange visits, joint workshops, and short-term practical training stints at KNSU in South Korea.

5. Where should candidates verify official admission notices?

Applicants should regularly check the official portal of Young India Sports University or the Higher Education Board of Telangana for official policy releases and admission deadlines.

title: Animation Courses After 12th: Fees & Careers
description: Discover top animation courses after 12th. Explore eligibility criteria, fee structures, and the massive career scope in 3D animation and VFX.
content:
Animation Course After 12th: Eligibility, Fees & Career Scope

The entertainment landscape has undergone a massive evolution over the last decade. With the explosion of OTT platforms, mobile gaming, and high-budget visual effects (VFX) in mainstream cinema, the demand for skilled animators has never been higher. If you have a knack for storytelling, a keen eye for visual aesthetics, and a love for digital art, pursuing an animation course after 12th is one of the most creatively fulfilling and financially rewarding career choices available today.

Unlike traditional engineering or medical pathways, the animation industry prioritizes your portfolio and practical skills over your theoretical exam scores. You do not need to wait until post-graduation to break into the industry; you can start learning the mechanics of motion, character rigging, and 3D modeling right after high school.

1. Why Choose Animation as a Career?

The animation and VFX sector is no longer limited to children's cartoons. It is a multi-billion-dollar global industry that heavily supports real estate (architectural walkthroughs), healthcare (medical simulations), education (e-learning modules), and advertising. The career scope expands well beyond local borders. Major international studios frequently outsource post-production and rendering work to independent artists and design firms worldwide. By mastering industry-standard software early, you position yourself in a highly specialized, future-proof job market that offers high mobility and remote working opportunities.

2. Top Educational Pathways and Course Types

Choosing the right course depends entirely on the time you are willing to invest and the depth of knowledge you wish to acquire. Students can opt for full-fledged university degrees for a comprehensive education, or targeted diplomas to fast-track their entry into the workforce.

Course Type

Popular Program Options

Typical Duration

Focus Areas & Objective

Undergraduate Degrees

B.Sc in Animation & VFX, B.A. in Multimedia, B.Des (Animation)

3 to 4 Years

Deep foundation in art history, storytelling, 2D/3D animation, and advanced post-production.

Diplomas

Diploma in 3D Animation, Diploma in VFX and Post-Production

1 to 2 Years

Fast-tracked, software-centric training focusing on Maya, Blender, and practical lab assignments.

Certifications

Certificate in Character Rigging, Certificate in Motion Graphics

3 to 6 Months

Highly specialized, tool-specific mastery for students looking to upgrade a specific technical skill.

3. Eligibility Criteria After 12th

One of the greatest advantages of pursuing animation is its accessibility. You do not need a rigid academic background in science or mathematics to gain entry into top-tier programs.

  • Stream Requirements: Students from any stream (Science, Commerce, or Arts) are eligible to apply for most B.Sc, B.A., or Diploma animation courses.

  • Minimum Marks: Most recognized universities and private institutes require a minimum aggregate of 50% in your Class 12 board exams from a recognized state or national board.

  • Entrance Exams: While many private institutes offer direct admission based on a personal interview or basic aptitude test, premier design institutes (like NID or IDC IIT Bombay) require you to clear national-level design entrance exams (such as UCEED, NID DAT, or NIFT entrance) which heavily test your sketching skills, spatial visualization, and creative thinking.

4. Understanding the Fee Structure

The cost of your animation education varies dramatically based on the type of institution, the duration of the program, and the quality of the computer labs and rendering software provided.

  • Government/Public Institutes: Degrees from government-backed design schools typically cost between ₹50,000 to ₹1,50,000 for the entire program. These are highly cost-effective but fiercely competitive.

  • Private Universities & Specialized Academies: Pursuing a 3-year B.Sc or B.Des in a private university usually ranges from ₹3,000,000 to ₹8,00,000. These programs often justify the cost by offering state-of-the-art rendering labs, motion capture studios, and dedicated campus placement drives.

  • Diplomas & Short-Term Courses: A 1-year diploma from a reputed private academy generally costs between ₹80,000 to ₹2,50,000, depending on the software suites covered.

5. Core Syllabus and Essential Software Skills

A professional animation curriculum is designed to take you from basic paper-and-pencil sketching to complex digital simulations. Your early semesters will focus heavily on the 12 Principles of Animation, color theory, anatomy sketching, and storyboarding.

As you progress, the coursework becomes highly technical. You will learn character modeling, texturing, rigging (giving a skeleton to a 3D model so it can move), lighting, and rendering. To survive and thrive in this industry, you must achieve high proficiency in standard industry tools. You will spend hundreds of hours mastering Autodesk Maya and Blender for 3D modeling, Adobe After Effects and Nuke for compositing and VFX, and ZBrush for digital sculpting. Furthermore, learning game engines like Unreal Engine and Unity is becoming increasingly critical as real-time rendering takes over traditional film pipelines.

6. Portfolio Building and Progress Tracking

In the animation industry, your degree gets you the interview, but your portfolio gets you the job. From day one of your course, you must actively compile your best sketches, 3D renders, and short animation clips into a professional showreel.

To maintain total control over your creative pipeline and track your software mastery, you need a structured system. For tracking your daily progress and maintaining a detailed log of your weak spots and project ideas, refer to the Manav-Content WorkBook verbatim to keep your portfolio revision highly organized. Structured logging ensures that you are consistently upgrading your skills, addressing technical bottlenecks in your character rigging or lighting setups, and staying on track to deliver a flawless final showreel by the time you graduate.

7. Career Scope, Job Roles, and Salary Outlook

Graduating with an animation degree opens doors across multiple sectors, including film production houses, television networks, advertising agencies, and AAA game development studios. You can specialize in a variety of high-demand roles:

  • 3D Animator: Brings characters, vehicles, and creatures to life using keyframe animation and motion capture data.

  • VFX Artist / Compositor: Integrates live-action footage with computer-generated imagery (CGI) seamlessly, adding explosions, environment extensions, or removing wires.

  • Character Rigger: Develops the complex digital skeletons and control mechanics that allow animators to move a 3D model realistically.

  • Storyboard Artist: Translates a script into a visual blueprint, sketching out camera angles, character poses, and scene pacing before any digital work begins.

Salary Expectations: In India, an entry-level animator or junior VFX artist typically earns between ₹3.0 LPA to ₹5.5 LPA. However, the salary scales rapidly with experience. A mid-level technical director or senior 3D artist with 5+ years of experience and an exceptional showreel can easily command anywhere from ₹12 LPA to ₹25 LPA. Internationally, senior animators frequently earn upwards of $80,000 to $120,000 annually.

8. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Do I need to be exceptionally good at drawing to become an animator?

While basic sketching skills are crucial for storyboarding and understanding anatomy, you do not need to be a master painter. Many successful 3D animators, riggers, and lighting artists rely much more on their technical software skills, spatial awareness, and understanding of physics than on raw traditional drawing ability.

Can an Arts or Commerce student pursue a B.Sc in Animation?

Yes. Unlike traditional B.Sc degrees that strictly require a Science (PCM) background, B.Sc in Animation or Multimedia programs at most universities accept candidates from Arts and Commerce streams, as the core focus is on digital art and design logic.

Which is better: a 3-year Degree or a 1-year Diploma?

If you are right out of Class 12, a 3-year degree is highly recommended. It gives you the necessary time to build a strong foundation in art theory, develop a comprehensive portfolio, and secure internships. A diploma is better suited for individuals who already have a degree or want to fast-track their software skills for immediate freelance work.

Conclusion

Choosing an animation course after 12th is a strategic step into a booming global industry that heavily rewards creativity, technical precision, and continuous learning. Whether you opt for a comprehensive 3-year B.Sc degree to learn the intricacies of filmmaking or a fast-paced diploma to master Maya and Unreal Engine, your success hinges entirely on the quality of your portfolio. Focus intensely on understanding the core principles of motion, master the industry-standard software, and continuously build your showreel. With a structured approach and relentless practice, transitioning from a high school graduate to a sought-after animator or VFX professional is a highly achievable reality.

സ്കൂളിലെ രജിസ്ട്രേഷനിലുള്ള കോഡും വിഷയത്തിന്റെ മുഴുവൻ പേരും ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. മറ്റൊരു ക്ലാസിലും ഇതേ പേരുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലാസിന്റെ വരി മാത്രം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

ഇംഗ്ലിഷ് പരീക്ഷയുമായി തീയതികൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാം

ക്ലാസ് 10 Multi Skill Foundation Course (416) പരീക്ഷ 18 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും English Language and Literature (184) പരീക്ഷ 26 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ആണ്. തീയതികൾ തമ്മിൽ 8 ദിവസത്തെ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ട്.

ഈ ദിവസങ്ങളെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാൻ കിട്ടുന്ന അവധിയല്ല. മറ്റു പരീക്ഷകളും കലണ്ടറിൽ ചേർത്ത് ഇടയിൽ പരീക്ഷയില്ലാത്ത ദിവസങ്ങൾ മാത്രം എണ്ണുക. പരിശീലനത്തിന് യഥാർഥ പേപ്പറിന്റെ ദൈർഘ്യം തന്നെ എടുക്കുക.

പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് വേറെ തീയതിയുണ്ടാകാം

ഈ വരി ബോർഡ് പേപ്പറിനുള്ളതാണ്. പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ, പ്രകടനം, പ്രോജക്ട് അല്ലെങ്കിൽ ആന്തരിക മൂല്യനിർണയം ഉണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ തീയതിയും വേണ്ട സാമഗ്രികളും സ്കൂളിൽ ചോദിക്കുക.

ആശയവിനിമയ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിനുള്ളിൽ അനുവദിക്കില്ല. കൊണ്ടുപോകാവുന്ന സാധനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് CBSE നൽകുന്ന പ്രത്യേക നിർദേശങ്ങളും അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡും പിന്തുടരുക.

DUSU Elections 2025 Just 2 Days Away: Key Highlights

The Delhi University Students’ Union (DUSU) Elections 2025 are only two days away, and the campus is buzzing with anticipation. With nearly 2.75 lakh students eligible to vote, this election is set to be one of the most closely watched student polls in the country.

Final Candidate List

After scrutiny and withdrawals, 21 candidates remain in the fray across the four central posts of President, Vice President, Secretary, and Joint Secretary.

Key Presidential Candidates:

  • Aryan Maan (ABVP) – Department of Library & Information Science

  • Joslyn Nandita Choudhary (NSUI) – Department of Buddhist Studies

  • Anjali (SFI-AISA) – Indraprastha College for Women

Election Schedule

  • Voting Date: September 18, 2025

  • Voting Hours:

    • Day classes – 8:30 AM to 1:00 PM

    • Evening classes – 3:00 PM to 7:30 PM

Major Political Contenders

  1. ABVP (BJP-affiliated) – Contesting for all four posts with candidates Aryan Maan, Govind Tanwar, Kunal Choudhary, and Deepika Jha.

  2. NSUI (Congress-affiliated) – Fielding Joslyn Nandita Choudhary, Rahul Jhansla, Kabir, and Lavkush Bhadana.

The DUSU elections are often seen as a mini-battlefield for national politics, with ABVP, NSUI, and Left alliances treating the polls as a reflection of student sentiment across Delhi.

With the DUSU Elections 2025 just two days away, the excitement on Delhi University’s campus is at its peak. title: JEE Main 2027 Syllabus: Official PDF and Subject-Wise Guide
description: The official JEE Main 2027 syllabus covers Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry for Paper 1. Use the NTA PDF to check topics and the current 75-question format.
content:
The JEE Main 2027 syllabus PDF is available through NTA's official examination website. For B.E. and B.Tech. applicants, Paper 1 covers Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. Use the current document as your topic checklist before relying on a coaching handout or an older saved PDF.

Open the official JEE Main 2027 syllabus PDF. It contains separate sections for engineering, architecture and planning. This guide focuses on Paper 1; candidates choosing another paper should read its own section of the document.

Start with the right subject checklist

The broad areas below are a reading guide, not a substitute for the detailed subtopics in NTA's PDF.

  • Mathematics: algebra, calculus, coordinate and three-dimensional geometry, vectors, probability, statistics and trigonometry.

  • Physics: mechanics, thermal physics, waves, electricity and magnetism, optics, modern physics, electronic devices and experimental skills.

  • Chemistry: physical, inorganic and organic chemistry, including practical-chemistry principles.

Give each listed subtopic a status such as not started, studied or tested. A chapter marked studied may still need attention if you cannot solve a mixed problem without looking at a worked example. That distinction is more useful than treating every completed lecture as finished preparation.

Use the current paper format for mock tests

The 2027 information bulletin, Section 2.4, specifies the following Paper 1 structure.

Subject

MCQs

Numerical-value questions

Marks

Mathematics

20

5

100

Physics

20

5

100

Chemistry

20

5

100

Total

60

15

300

That is 75 questions overall, not a 90-question paper with a choice of five out of ten numerical questions in each subject. Incorrect answers attract negative marking in both sections. A mock built around the older numerical-question choice will not reproduce the current paper structure.

Check subtopics before dropping a chapter

A familiar chapter heading can contain a narrower or wider set of subtopics than the chapter in your textbook. Compare the actual lines in the syllabus with your notes before deciding that a topic is absent. Avoid making a deletion list from a short social-media summary.

Physics experimental skills and practical chemistry deserve their own entries in your revision plan. They can be overlooked when a timetable lists only theory chapter names. Work through the relevant concepts and observations rather than assuming school practical attendance has covered every requirement.

Do not turn a topic list into guaranteed weightage

A syllabus tells you what can be assessed. It does not promise that your preferred chapter will contribute a fixed number of questions in your shift. Past papers can help you practise different question styles, but a small sample should not become a reason to abandon the rest of the syllabus.

Build revision around mistakes you can identify

After a timed practice set, separate errors caused by missing concepts, calculation slips and time pressure. Each needs a different response. Rewatching an entire chapter may not help if your main problem is rushing arithmetic; repeating only easy questions will not repair a concept gap.

Keep a short weekly review of topics that still produce repeated errors, and revisit them with fresh questions. Use the confirmed Session 1 registration deadlines to complete the application separately from study planning. A revision timetable should not leave the form until the final evening.

title: JEE Main Previous Year Questions: Topic-Wise Practice
description: Maximize your JEE Main 2027 score with topic-wise previous year questions practice. Discover high weightage chapters and effective revision strategies.
content:
When preparing for the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main, studying theoretical concepts is only the first step. The true test of your preparation lies in your ability to apply these concepts to complex problems under strict time constraints. For this, practicing JEE Main Previous Year Questions (PYQs) is the most reliable strategy. However, instead of attempting full-length papers randomly, top rankers highly recommend a topic-wise practice approach.

Breaking down past papers by chapter helps you understand the National Testing Agency's (NTA) specific question patterns, identifies high-frequency topics, and allows you to systematically strengthen your weak areas before moving forward.

Why Choose Topic-Wise PYQ Practice?

Attempting full-length past papers too early in your preparation can lead to frustration if you haven't completed the syllabus. Topic-wise practice offers a much more targeted approach:

  • Immediate Concept Application: Right after finishing a chapter, solving its PYQs reinforces the theory and formulas immediately.

  • Identifying Exam Trends: You will quickly notice that the NTA repeats certain sub-topics almost every year. For example, in Current Electricity, questions on electrical measuring instruments frequently recur.

  • Targeted Weakness Isolation: If you consistently struggle with PYQs from a specific chapter like Rotational Motion or Definite Integration, you instantly know where to direct your revision efforts.

High-Frequency Chapters for Topic-Wise Practice

Based on an analysis of recent JEE Main papers, certain chapters yield a consistently high number of questions. Focus your initial PYQ practice on these high-weightage areas.

Subject

High-Frequency Chapters for PYQs

Most Tested Concepts to Focus On

Physics

Modern Physics, Current Electricity, Optics, Electrostatics

Bohr's model, Electric Instruments, Lens combinations, Electric Field.

Chemistry

Coordination Compounds, GOC, Chemical Bonding, Thermodynamics

Werner's theory, named reactions, VSEPR theory, enthalpy calculations.

Mathematics

3D Geometry, Integral Calculus, Matrices & Determinants, Vectors

Line in space, Definite integration properties, adjoint matrices.

How to Execute Your PYQ Strategy

To get the most out of your practice sessions, follow a structured workflow:

  • Revise First: Never jump into PYQs without revising your class notes and standard formulas.

  • Time Your Practice: Treat a block of 30 topic-wise PYQs as a mini-test. Condition yourself to solve them within a set time limit to build exam stamina.

  • Analyze Errors: When you get a question wrong, figure out if it was a calculation mistake, a formula recall error, or a fundamental conceptual gap.

Conclusion

Integrating a rigorous, topic-wise practice of JEE Main Previous Year Questions into your daily study routine is the most direct path to exam success. By systematically dismantling the syllabus chapter by chapter, you align your thought process with the examination setters. title: CBSE 2027: A Weekly Revision Plan Parents Can Help With
description: Help your child turn the CBSE 2026-27 syllabus and sample papers into a manageable weekly plan, with time for corrections and school commitments.
content:
If your child is preparing for the CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 exams in 2027, start with a plan for the next seven days. A timetable packed with study hours can look reassuring, yet leave little room to understand why an answer went wrong. A more useful conversation is: which topic needs work, what will count as progress, and when will the student revisit it?

CBSE's 2026-27 curriculum and subject-wise sample papers give families a reliable starting point. The routine below is a practical suggestion to adapt around school and the student's needs, not a Board-prescribed study schedule.

Build one folder for the subjects actually being studied

Open the curriculum page with your child and find the correct class and subjects. Save the relevant syllabus documents together, then add school instructions in a separate section. Use clear file names containing the subject and academic year so an older download does not quietly become the revision checklist.

Next, divide the topics into three groups: comfortable, needs practice, and needs an explanation. Let the student make the first assessment. A chapter they recognise while reading may still be difficult to answer questions on. Where the syllabus and a school instruction seem inconsistent, note the exact point and ask the subject teacher before dropping a topic.

Choose a small task that produces an answer

Instead of writing “revise Science” or “study Economics”, agree on something the student can complete and inspect: explain a concept without notes, solve a selected set of questions, or write one answer and improve it. Leave space for unfinished schoolwork and a short catch-up session.

For example, the first session could identify mistakes in a small question set. The next could revisit the underlying concept. A later session could attempt comparable questions without looking at the earlier solution. Adjust the size of the task if it repeatedly remains unfinished; adding more hours is not the only response.

Keep the sample paper and marking scheme together

CBSE provides separate Class 10 sample-paper and marking-scheme links and Class 12 sample-paper and marking-scheme links. Match the subject carefully. For instance, the Class 10 page lists Mathematics Basic and Mathematics Standard separately, while the Class 12 page distinguishes English Core and English Elective.

Let the student attempt the chosen work before opening the marking scheme. Then ask them to explain a correction in their own words. If a marking point is unclear, take the attempted answer and the relevant scheme to the teacher. A sample paper is a practice resource, not a promise that the same questions will appear in the examination.

Review the week without turning it into another test

A short review can focus on one topic that improved, one error that repeated, and one question to ask at school. A simple notebook entry is enough: the question, why the answer failed, and what to try next. Comparing this week's work with the student's own earlier attempt is more useful than comparing scores with a classmate.

Keep school commitments on a separate calendar, including any practical, project or assessment instructions the school has actually communicated. Families checking practical-exam information can also read the CBSE 2027 practicals and marks-distribution guide. Confirm the instructions applicable to your school before making arrangements.

End the review with a manageable plan for the next week. The parent's role can be as simple as protecting a quiet study period, helping organise documents and making it easier to ask for help.

title: Navigating the New Job Market: Career Tips for Students After 12th Commerce
description: Navigating the new job market requires a combination of careful planning, skill development, and adaptability. By exploring diverse career options, enhancing your skill set, gaining practical experience, and staying informed about industry trends, you’ll be well-positioned to seize the opportunities that come your way.
content:
There are many options available for students finishing their 12th grade in commerce as the global labor market continues to change. Rapid industry digitization, the emergence of new technologies, and changes in the economy have produced a dynamic environment with enormous possibilities as well as obstacles. Understanding these changes, acquiring the necessary abilities, and maintaining flexibility are the keys to success. After completing their 12th grade in commerce, students can use these crucial career recommendations to help them succeed in the modern employment market.

1. Explore Diverse Career Options

Students can pick from a wide range of job routes after completing their 12th grade in commerce. These choices extend beyond conventional positions in company management or accounting. There are currently more opportunities and new fields in the global job market than there were a few years ago. Among the well-known career choices are

  1. A flexible undergraduate degree with several concentrations, including accounting, finance, economics, and taxation, is the Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.). Students who want to work in accounting, financial analysis, or taxation should get a B.Com degree.
  2. Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA): A BBA degree will assist you in honing your abilities in marketing, management, and business operations if you are drawn to leadership and management positions. Additionally, it serves as a springboard for subsequent MBA studies.
  3. Students interested in finance, auditing, and accounting should choose a career in chartered accountancy (CA), one of the most prominent and well-respected fields in India and around the world.
  4. Secretary of the Company (CS): For those who are interested in the legal and compliance facets of firms, this career path is a wonderful choice. You will work with compliance management, legal paperwork, and corporate governance as a CS.
  5. Law: A five-year integrated law degree can be a fantastic option for commerce students interested in corporate law, legal practices, or even a job as a business legal counselor.
  6. Banking and Financial Services: Professionals in banking, investment analysis, and financial advising positions are in more demand. Gaining expertise in these areas can lead to lucrative positions in banks, investment businesses, and insurance organizations in the public and private sectors.
  7. Digital Marketing: As more companies move to digital platforms, there is a growing demand for experts in social media, SEO, content marketing, online advertising, and data analytics.

You can better match your career choices with your interests, abilities, and the newest developments in the labor market by investigating these varied sectors. Before choosing a choice, it's critical to do your homework and consider all of your possibilities.

2. Enhance Your Skills

Practical, real-world skills are more valued than ever in today's labor environment. Although your educational background is important, there is a growing need for skills-based learning. Improving your skill set will help you get a better job, attract more employers, and adjust to the demands of a changing sector.

  1. Technical Skills: Acquiring expertise in key software and tools is critical as industries become more technologically reliant. For example, in financial and accounting positions, Tally, QuickBooks, Microsoft Excel, and other accounting applications are highly regarded. It might also be helpful to have a basic understanding of business management software like CRM systems or data analysis tools like Google Analytics.
  2. Soft Skills: People with the ability to think critically, communicate well, and work well in teams are sought after by employers. Make an effort to enhance your interpersonal, time management, leadership, and problem-solving abilities. These abilities can set you apart from other applicants and are necessary for various careers.

Certificates: To improve your chances of landing a job, get online certificates. Financial modeling, digital marketing, project management, data analytics, and corporate communication are a few useful certifications. Your resume will stand out and your skill set will gain legitimacy if you have certifications from sites like Coursera, edX, or LinkedIn Learning.

3. Gain Real-World Experience

Experience is equally as important in today's employment environment as education. You can gain important practical experience in your field of interest through internships, part-time jobs, or freelancing possibilities. Internships give you the chance to develop your professional network while also teaching you how to apply theoretical knowledge in practical settings.

For instance, search for internships 

If you want to work in accounting or finance, consider internships in banks, tax advice services, or financial firms. Internships with corporate marketing departments, advertising agencies, or digital marketing agencies are also options for students interested in marketing.

Internships help you develop useful skills and give you the opportunity to build a portfolio of your work, and many of them provide opportunities for full-time employment upon completion.

4. Develop Digital Literacy

Since almost every facet of business has been impacted by the digital revolution, digital literacy has become essential. Whether you want to work in marketing, finance, or business management, having a solid grasp of digital technologies can help you stand out from the competition.

  1. Data analytics: Acquire the skills necessary to analyze data using programs like Google Analytics, Excel, and Power BI. Professionals with the ability to meaningfully evaluate and present data are in high demand as businesses depend more and more on data to inform their decisions.
  2. Social Media and Content Creation: One of the most in-demand competencies nowadays is digital marketing. Gaining knowledge of social media strategy, content marketing, and SEO might lead to new career prospects. As companies continue to place a high value on their online presence, managing these platforms requires qualified personnel.
  3. Financial Technology (Fintech): As internet banking, blockchain, and cryptocurrencies grow in popularity, it is becoming more and more crucial for students who want to study finance or banking to comprehend fintech.

5. Network and Build Professional Relationships

It's never too early to start networking, which is a crucial component of career advancement. Developing connections with experts in your sector might help you find out about career insights, industry trends, and job openings. You may connect with people in your chosen field and establish an online presence by using platforms such as LinkedIn.

Additionally, you can go to webinars, seminars, workshops, and career fairs that are relevant to your field. You can gain important exposure and potentially even employment leads by interacting with like-minded peers and professionals in the field.

6. Stay Informed and Adapt to Industry Trends

Both industry and the labor market are constantly changing. Keeping abreast with developing technology, economic shifts, and current trends is essential for job market adaptation. To stay informed, read news stories, engage in online groups, and follow industry blogs.

For example, if you're interested in a job in banking, it can be beneficial to know how AI is affecting financial services or to stay up to date with international economic policy. In a similar vein, gig economy opportunities and remote work trends are becoming more significant in industries like sales and marketing.

Conclusion

It takes a combination of skill development, flexibility, and meticulous planning to succeed in the new work market. You'll be in a strong position to take advantage of any possibilities that present themselves if you investigate various career options, develop your skill set, obtain real-world experience, and keep up with industry developments. Although the work market is always shifting, you may make a smooth transition from school to a fulfilling profession with the correct tactics.

title: IIT BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026: SAMARTH Portal Form Submission and Speed Post Hard Copy Verification Steps
description: Comprehensive guide for IIT BHU Non-Teaching Recruitment 2026 covering SAMARTH portal online form submission and Speed Post hard copy submission steps.
content:
Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi has released its non-teaching recruitment notification for various administrative and technical positions. For job seekers and their families navigating the application process, understanding the dual-stage submission procedure is essential. The process requires candidates to complete an online application on the SAMARTH recruitment portal and subsequently send a signed physical copy along with supporting documents via Speed Post.

Overview of IIT BHU Non-Teaching Positions

The recruitment drive aims to fill non-teaching staff roles spanning executive, technical, and administrative cadre. Candidates applying for these positions must ensure they meet the specific educational qualifications, experience criteria, and age limits detailed in the official institute notification.

Step-by-Step SAMARTH Portal Online Application

The online application must be processed through the central SAMARTH recruitment portal. Candidates should follow these steps to complete their registration:

  • Account Registration: Visit the official portal, click on new registration, and create an account using a valid email address and phone number.
  • Profile Completion: Enter basic personal details, permanent address, and category details accurately as per government documents.
  • Educational & Experience Credentials: Fill in academic records from secondary education onwards along with details of relevant work experience.
  • Document Upload: Upload scanned copies of your signature, recent passport-size photograph, educational mark sheets, degree certificates, and category certificates in the specified formats and file sizes.
  • Fee Payment & Final Submission: Pay the prescribed application fee through the online payment gateway, review the filled details carefully, and submit the online application form.

Mandatory Speed Post Hard Copy Verification Process

Completing the online application is only the first part of the application procedure. IIT BHU mandates that candidates send a physical printout of their submitted form along with verified testimonials.

Documents Required for Postal Dispatch

Ensure self-attested photocopies of the following documents are attached to the printed application form:

  • Printed copy of the submitted online application form with final transaction receipt.
  • Matriculation or Secondary School Certificate showing proof of birth date.
  • Mark sheets and degree certificates for all educational qualifications mentioned in the application.
  • Experience certificates from previous and current employers specifying post held, pay level, and duration.
  • Caste or Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS) and PwBD/Ex-Servicemen certificates, if applicable.
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer for candidates currently working in Central/State Government, PSUs, or Autonomous Bodies.

Envelope Super-scription and Dispatch Guidelines

Place all documents inside a durable envelope. Clearly write the following heading on top of the envelope: "Application for the post of [Name of Post] against Advertisement No. [Advt Number]". Send the completed envelope strictly via Speed Post or Registered Post to the designated recruitment cell address of IIT BHU Varanasi within the stipulated submission deadline.

Important Instructions for Candidates and Parents

Parents supporting applicants should ensure that candidate details match official certificates exactly across all forms. Incomplete applications, forms submitted without self-attested documents, or hard copies reaching after the specified deadline will lead to rejection. Always retain a photocopy of the dispatched envelope and track the postal tracking number until delivery confirmation is received.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is online application through the SAMARTH portal sufficient for IIT BHU recruitment?

No, candidates must complete the online application on the SAMARTH portal and also send a physical signed copy of the application along with self-attested documents via Speed Post or Registered Post.

What happens if the hard copy reaches IIT BHU after the deadline?

Applications received after the specified deadline are rejected. Applicants should post their documents well in advance to account for postal delays.

Are candidates required to send original certificates in the post?

No, candidates should only send self-attested photocopies of their certificates along with the printed application form. Original documents are verified in person during document verification.

Is a No Objection Certificate compulsory for government employees?

Yes, applicants currently employed in government departments, PSUs, or autonomous bodies must submit an NOC from their current employer along with their hard copy packet.
