title: JEE Main ਦੇ ਵਿਕਲਪ 2027: VIT, SRM ਫਾਰਮ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ; ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਅਗਲਾ
description: VITEEE, SRMJEEE, AEEE, KIITEE ਅਤੇ GITAM ਦੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ 2027 ਫਾਰਮ, ਆਉਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਅਤੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਪੋਰਟਲ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਸਮਝੋ।
content:
JEE Main ਤੋਂ ਇਲਾਵਾ ਇੰਜੀਨੀਅਰਿੰਗ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਦੇਖਣ ਲਈ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਦੀ ਇੱਕੋ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਜ਼ਰੂਰੀ ਨਹੀਂ। VIT ਅਤੇ SRM ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ 2027 ਫਾਰਮ ਦਿਖਾ ਰਹੇ ਹਨ; ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਕਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ B.Tech 2027 ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣਗੀਆਂ। KIIT ਅਤੇ GITAM ਦੇ ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਫਾਰਮ ਨੂੰ 2027 ਦਾ ਮੰਨਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਨਵਾਂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਸਾਲ ਜਾਂਚੋ।

ਪੰਜ ਰਾਹ, ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਪੜਾਅ

ਤੁਲਨਾ ਦੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਲਿੰਕ ਵਰਤੋ ਅਤੇ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਸਾਲ ਮੁੜ ਦੇਖੋ। ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਬਟਨ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨਾ ਹੀ ਸਹੀ ਸਾਲ ਦੇ ਫਾਰਮ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦਾ ਰਾਹ

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੰਨੇ ਦੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ

ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ

VITEEE

B.Tech 2027 ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਤੇ ਲਾਗਇਨ ਫਾਰਮ ਉਪਲਬਧ

ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ 2027 ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ

SRMJEEE

2027 ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹੇ; UG ਫਾਰਮ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ

ਫਾਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਰਸ ਤੇ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਜਾਂਚੋ

AEEE

B.Tech 2027 ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ

ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਤੇ ਨਵੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਕਰੋ

KIITEE

ਪੋਰਟਲ ਹਾਲੇ KIITEE 2026 ਬੰਦ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ

ਇੱਥੇ 2027 ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਦੀ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ

GITAM GAT

ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਪੰਨਾ ਹਾਲੇ GAT 2026 ਕਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ

ਫਾਰਮ ਵਰਤਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ 2027 ਸਾਲ ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰੋ

ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ

ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਮਹੀਨਾ ਪੱਕਾ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਖ਼ਾਸ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਨਹੀਂ। ਪੰਨੇ ਉੱਤੇ AEEE ਦੇ ਨਾਲ JEE Main ਪਰਸੈਂਟਾਈਲ ਰਾਹੀਂ B.Tech ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਦਾ ਰਾਹ ਵੀ ਹੈ। ਫਾਰਮ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਉੱਤੇ 2027 ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ; ਪੁਰਾਣੀ ਫ਼ੀਸ, ਯੋਗਤਾ ਹੱਦ ਜਾਂ ਪੜਾਅ ਦੇ ਨਿਯਮ ਅੱਗੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ।

ਹੇਠਾਂ ਯੂਨੀਵਰਸਿਟੀ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਦੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਦਾ ਚਿੱਤਰ ਹੈ। ਇਹ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਣ ਦਾ ਸਬੂਤ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਦਿਆਂ ਐਲਾਨੀ ਭਵਿੱਖੀ ਮਿਆਦ ਅਤੇ ਉਪਲਬਧ ਫਾਰਮ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਦੇ B.Tech 2027 ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਪੰਨੇ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਨਵੰਬਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣਗੀਆਂ। ਇਸ ਵੈੱਬ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਉੱਤੇ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਅਮ੍ਰਿਤਾ ਦੀ ਮੂਲ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਸੂਚਨਾ

ਭੁਗਤਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਆਪਣੀ ਚੋਣ-ਸੂਚੀ ਬਣਾਓ

ਹਰ ਚੁਣੇ ਕੋਰਸ ਲਈ ਕੈਂਪਸ, ਪ੍ਰੋਗਰਾਮ, ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਰਾਹ, ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਸਥਿਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ URL ਲਿਖੋ। ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਯੋਗਤਾ, ਟਿਊਸ਼ਨ ਤੇ ਰਹਿਣ ਦਾ ਖਰਚਾ, ਰਿਫੰਡ ਅਤੇ ਵਜ਼ੀਫ਼ੇ ਦੀਆਂ ਸ਼ਰਤਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਕਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆਵਾਂ ਲਈ ਅਰਜ਼ੀ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਵਧਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ; ਦਾਖ਼ਲੇ ਜਾਂ ਹਰ ਕੈਂਪਸ ਦਾ ਖਰਚਾ ਝੱਲ ਸਕਣ ਦੀ ਗਾਰੰਟੀ ਨਹੀਂ।

ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਰਜ਼ੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਪਹਿਲ ਦਿਓ ਜੋ ਸਹੀ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ। ਆਪਣਾ ਈਮੇਲ ਤੇ ਮੋਬਾਈਲ ਵਰਤੋ, ਸਹੀ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਵੇਰਵੇ ਦਿਓ ਅਤੇ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਪੁਸ਼ਟੀ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ। VIT ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਤੇ ਲਾਈਵ-ਫੋਟੋ ਗਾਈਡ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਅਪੁਸ਼ਟ ਸਾਲ ਲਈ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਪੰਨਾ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੇ ਨਵੀਂ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਕਰੋ; ਅਗਾਊਂ ਸੀਟ ਦੇ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਤੇ ਵਿਚੋਲੇ ਨੂੰ ਪੈਸੇ ਨਾ ਦਿਓ।

VITEEE ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਈਵ-ਫੋਟੋ ਗਾਈਡ

title: SRMJEEE 2027: Exam Dates, Two Phases, Registration & Exam Mode
description: Check SRMJEEE 2027 exam dates for both phases, April and June schedule, registration details, remote-proctored test mode and computer requirements.
content:
Engineering aspirants planning to take admission at SRM Institute of Science and Technology can now start preparing according to the SRMJEEE 2027 examination schedule. The institute has announced the dates for its upcoming entrance test and introduced a change in the number of examination opportunities available to applicants.

For the 2027 admission session, SRMJEEE will be held in two phases, replacing the three-phase arrangement followed in earlier cycles. The first examination window is scheduled for April 17 and 18, 2027, while the second will take place on June 19 and 20, 2027.

The entrance examination will be organised in an online remote-proctored format. This allows students to take the test from their chosen location using a compatible computer system, subject to the examination guidelines.

Applicants should pay attention to both the revised phase structure and the technical conditions attached to the online test. These details will help them plan their registration and examination preparation more effectively.

SRMJEEE 2027 Exam Schedule

SRMIST has divided the 2027 entrance examination into two separate windows. Students can decide which phase suits their preparation timeline and admission plans.

Event

Scheduled Date

SRMJEEE 2027 Phase 1

April 17-18, 2027

SRMJEEE 2027 Phase 2

June 19-20, 2027

Total Number of Phases

2

Examination Format

Online Remote-Proctored

Conducting Authority

SRM Institute of Science and Technology

The April round will be the first opportunity to take the entrance test, followed by the June examination. Applicants should refer to the official admission portal for phase-specific application deadlines and instructions.

What Is Different About SRMJEEE 2027?

The most noticeable change in the upcoming admission cycle is the reduction in examination phases.

Earlier, SRMJEEE aspirants had three examination rounds to consider. For 2027, SRMIST has announced only two phases. This means the examination calendar is more compact, with one round in April and another in June.

For students, this change makes early planning particularly important. Those who want to take the first examination should prepare for the April dates, while applicants looking for additional preparation time can consider the June window.

The two-phase arrangement also means that students should not plan their preparation around an assumed third attempt.

SRMJEEE 2027 Phase 1: April Examination

The first phase of SRMJEEE 2027 is scheduled for April 17 and 18, 2027.

Applicants who are ready to take the entrance examination during the initial window can plan their revision and mock-test schedule accordingly. Since this is the first examination opportunity of the admission cycle, students should complete their registration formalities and check the examination instructions well in advance.

The test will be conducted remotely, so candidates must also verify whether their computer and internet connection meet the prescribed requirements.

SRMJEEE 2027 Phase 2: June Examination

The second examination round will be held on June 19 and 20, 2027.

This phase gives applicants another opportunity to participate in the SRM engineering entrance examination. Students who prefer the later examination window can organise their preparation around the June schedule.

Those planning to appear in both rounds should carefully check the institute's application guidelines to understand the registration requirements for each phase.

SRMJEEE 2027 Exam Mode: How Will the Test Be Conducted?

Unlike a conventional computer-based examination held at a designated test centre, SRMJEEE 2027 will use an online remote-proctored format.

In this arrangement, the applicant takes the examination from a suitable location using a desktop computer or laptop. The test environment is monitored remotely, which means candidates must follow the instructions issued by the institute throughout the examination.

A working webcam and microphone are necessary for the test setup. Students must also ensure that their device has a compatible operating system, sufficient memory and a stable internet connection.

The remote examination format offers flexibility regarding the test location, but it does not remove the need to meet the technical conditions.

SRMJEEE 2027 System Requirements

Applicants should check their device configuration before the examination rather than waiting until the test day. A computer that does not meet the minimum specifications may create difficulties while accessing the examination platform.

The following technical requirements are mentioned for SRMJEEE 2027:

Requirement

Specification

Device

Desktop or laptop

Processor

Intel i3, 4th Generation equivalent or above

RAM

Minimum 4 GB

Internet Connection

Minimum 1 Mbps

Free Storage

2 GB

Windows

Windows 8 or later

macOS

macOS 10.14 Mojave or later

Webcam

Required

Microphone

Required

Mobile phones are not permitted for taking the examination. Applicants should arrange a compatible computer or laptop and check the camera, microphone and internet connection before the scheduled test.

SRMJEEE 2027 Registration: What Applicants Need to Know

The online registration process for SRMJEEE 2027 has commenced. Interested students can visit the SRMIST website to access the application facility and follow the instructions provided there.

The application process requires applicants to enter the requested details and complete the prescribed submission formalities. Students should check the phase they intend to appear in and review the applicable deadlines before submitting their forms.

It is advisable to complete the application well before the closing date. This leaves time to review the submitted information and address any problems that may arise during registration.

Should You Choose SRMJEEE Phase 1 or Phase 2?

The choice between the April and June examinations will largely depend on an applicant's preparation level and personal schedule.

Students who have completed most of their syllabus and are comfortable with their mock-test performance may consider appearing in Phase 1. Those who need more time for revision may prefer the June examination.

Applicants interested in taking both phases should check the official instructions for registration and participation.

A simple way to plan is:

  • Choose Phase 1: If you are prepared to take the examination in April.

  • Choose Phase 2: If you need additional preparation time before June.

  • Consider both phases: If you want to use both examination opportunities and meet the institute's application requirements.

There is no need to rush into a decision without considering your preparation. However, registration deadlines and official instructions should remain a priority.

Preparation for the SRMJEEE 2027 Remote Examination

Preparation for SRMJEEE involves more than revising the academic syllabus. Since the 2027 test will be remotely proctored, applicants must also become comfortable with the examination setup.

Students can divide their preparation into two parts: subject revision and technical readiness.

For academic preparation, follow a consistent revision schedule and practise questions regularly. Mock tests can help identify areas that require more attention and improve time management.

For the technical side, check the computer configuration, internet speed, webcam and microphone. Read the examination instructions carefully so that the remote-proctored format is familiar before the actual test.

What Comes After SRMJEEE 2027?

Appearing for the entrance examination is one part of the admission process. After the relevant examination phase, students should follow the result and admission announcements released by SRMIST.

The institute will provide further instructions regarding the next steps through its official admission channels. Applicants must keep checking their registered communication channels and the admission portal for updates.

Students should also make sure that they follow the instructions applicable to the examination phase in which they participated.

SRMJEEE 2027: Key Updates at a Glance

Before applying, keep these points in mind:

  • SRMJEEE 2027 will have two examination phases.

  • Phase 1 is scheduled for April 17 and 18, 2027.

  • Phase 2 will be conducted on June 19 and 20, 2027.

  • The earlier three-phase structure has been reduced to two phases.

  • The test will be conducted in online remote-proctored mode.

  • Applicants need a compatible desktop computer or laptop.

  • A webcam, microphone and stable internet connection are required.

  • Mobile phones cannot be used to take the examination.

  • Registration is available through the SRMIST admission portal.

Conclusion

The SRMJEEE 2027 examination schedule gives engineering applicants two opportunities to take the entrance test, with the first round in April and the second in June. The reduction from three phases to two is the major change in this year's examination arrangement.

Along with selecting an appropriate examination window, applicants must prepare for the remote-proctored format. A compatible laptop or desktop, working camera and microphone, and reliable internet connection will be necessary to take the test.

Students planning to seek admission through SRMJEEE should complete their registration within the prescribed timeline and keep track of updates released by SRMIST. Reviewing the examination instructions beforehand will help them avoid last-minute technical and application-related problems.

title: AICTE Approval, NAAC and NBA: What Each Label Means for BTech
description: AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation answer different questions. Learn what each label means and what to verify before choosing a BTech college.
content:
AICTE approval, NAAC accreditation and NBA accreditation are not three versions of the same quality certificate. AICTE mainly concerns whether an institution or technical programme is permitted under the applicable framework, NAAC reviews the institution as a whole, and NBA examines a specific programme. Before paying a BTech fee, check all three separately.

A college can have a NAAC grade without your chosen BTech programme having NBA accreditation. That distinction matters when a brochure places every logo together and leaves students to assume the course itself has been assessed.

What does each label actually answer?

LabelWhat it coversWhat it tells a BTech applicant
AICTE approvalTechnical education institutions and programmes under AICTE’s regulatory frameworkWhether the college or programme has the required regulatory approval shown for the relevant academic session
NAAC accreditationThe institution as a wholeHow the university or college was assessed across areas such as teaching, infrastructure, governance and student support
NBA accreditationA particular programme, such as Computer Science Engineering or Mechanical EngineeringWhether that named programme has undergone outcome-based academic assessment

Think of it this way: AICTE addresses permission and regulation, NAAC addresses the institution, and NBA addresses the course. None of these labels promises a job, a high package or a strong classroom experience in every department.

Why NBA deserves a closer look for BTech

NBA accreditation is programme-specific. If a college advertises “NBA accredited engineering courses”, ask whether the accreditation covers your exact branch, campus and applicable period. A Computer Science seat cannot borrow the claim from an accredited Electronics programme.

NAAC still has value, but its institutional scope makes it a broad signal rather than proof of department-level teaching. For a BTech decision, read it alongside faculty details, laboratory access, curriculum, internship records and branch-wise placement data.

What should you verify before admission?

  1. Match the college name, campus and academic session in the AICTE approval record or disclosure.
  2. Check the NAAC status and grade for the actual institution, not a similarly named university or parent trust.
  3. Confirm the exact BTech branch listed in the NBA accreditation record, including its validity or approval period.
  4. Ask the admissions office for branch-wise placement figures, internship details and the student intake behind those numbers.
  5. Save the relevant approval or accreditation documents before paying fees. Marketing claims alone aren’t enough.

When shortlisting, you can compare colleges and then explore BTech courses. The sensible choice is the one where regulatory approval, institutional review and programme evidence line up for your branch, not the college with the longest badge list.

title: Scholarship Payment Failed After Aadhaar-Bank Mismatch? Check These Records
description: Scholarship payment failed after an Aadhaar, bank or name mismatch? Match the records, identify the responsible office and follow the correct correction route.
content:
A scholarship payment can fail even after your application shows approved. If Aadhaar, bank, name or portal records differ, first save the exact error and identify who controls that record. Do not assume the process shown on the National Scholarship Portal applies to every scholarship. The responsible office and payment system can change by scheme, state, institute and portal.

Which record is causing the payment failure?

Put the relevant documents side by side. You’re looking for one mismatch, not trying random fixes.

  • Name: Compare spelling, initials, spacing and surname order on Aadhaar, the bank account, scholarship form and institute record.
  • Identity details: Check that the Aadhaar number belongs to you and that the portal accepted the submitted details. Never share the full number in an open complaint or message.
  • Bank details: Recheck the account number, IFSC, account-holder name, branch and account status. An old, closed or inactive account may block credit.
  • Payment mapping: Ask the bank to verify account status, KYC, IFSC and the payment mapping or mandate recorded in its system. A branch may not be able to confirm the scholarship scheme’s full payment route.
  • Portal message: Save a dated screenshot showing the status, rejection reason, verification stage and any correction-window notice.

Who should correct the record?

Use this order: capture the error, confirm the record owner, request correction, then file a grievance if the issue remains.

  1. Institute issue: If the message mentions institute verification, document scrutiny or a nodal officer, contact your college or school scholarship desk. Ask which field is pending and keep the acknowledgement.
  2. Bank issue: If it mentions KYC, IFSC, account details or payment mapping, visit the bank. Request confirmation of what it checked and what, if anything, needs correction.
  3. Scheme or portal issue: If the bank and institute records are correct, or the correction window is closed, use the grievance option shown inside the relevant scholarship portal. Attach only the requested documents.

The scheme authority may require a separate correction route, institute approval or renewal action. Check the scheme’s own instructions before submitting anything. If you’re unsure whether a fresh application or renewal is needed, review the relevant scholarship options before making a new claim through DekhoCampus scholarship listings.

Don’t open another bank account or submit a duplicate form without direction. Keep application numbers, screenshots and acknowledgements safely, and never share OTPs, passwords or full bank credentials with unofficial callers.

title: MH CET Law 2027: பிளஸ் 2 மாணவர்களும் பட்டதாரிகளும் எந்த அறிவிப்பைப் பார்க்க வேண்டும்?
description: வினாத்தாள் தயாரிப்பதற்கான மாநில செலின் அழைப்பு மாணவர் பதிவுக்கானது அல்ல. ஐந்தாண்டு, மூன்றாண்டு சட்டப் படிப்புகளுக்கான அறிவிப்புகளை வேறுபடுத்துவது எப்படி?
content:
பிளஸ் 2 படிக்கிறீர்கள் என்றால் ஐந்தாண்டு ஒருங்கிணைந்த எல்எல்பி நுழைவுத் தேர்வு அறிவிப்பைப் பாருங்கள். ஏற்கெனவே இளங்கலைப் பட்டம் பெற்றவர்களுக்கு மூன்றாண்டு எல்எல்பி பாதை உள்ளது. மகாராஷ்டிர மாநில CET செல் 2027-28 சுற்றறிக்கையில் இரண்டு தேர்வுகளையும் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளது. அதில் மாணவர் பதிவு தொடங்கவில்லை; கட்டணமோ தேர்வு தேதியோ அறிவிக்கப்படவில்லை.

செப்டம்பர் சுற்றறிக்கை யாருக்கானது?

30 செப்டம்பர் 2026 சுற்றறிக்கை தேர்வு வினாக்களை எழுதவும் பரிசீலிக்கவும் அனுபவமுள்ள கல்வியாளர்களை அழைக்கிறது. இந்த விண்ணப்பம் எந்தச் சட்ட நுழைவுத் தேர்வுக்கும் மாணவர்களைப் பதிவு செய்யாது.

உங்களுக்கான படிப்பை அடையாளம் காணுங்கள்

2026 ஐந்தாண்டு எல்எல்பி கையேடு பிளஸ் 2 அல்லது அதற்கு இணையான தகுதிக்குப் பிந்தைய படிப்பை விவரிக்கிறது. மூன்றாண்டு கையேடு பட்டதாரிகளுக்கானது. தேவையான மதிப்பெண், பிரிவுக்கான விதிகள், ஆவணங்களை 2027-28 கையேடு வெளியானதும் அதில் சரிபாருங்கள்.

கட்டணம் செலுத்தும் முன்

அறிவிப்பில் 2027-28 கல்வியாண்டு, சரியான படிப்புக் காலம், மாணவர் நுழைவுத் தேர்வுக்கான பதிவு ஆகிய மூன்றும் இருக்க வேண்டும். CAP என்பது கல்லூரி விருப்பத் தேர்வு மற்றும் இட ஒதுக்கீட்டுக்கானது. பழைய உள்நுழைவுப் பக்கமும் புதிய விண்ணப்பம் அல்ல. மாநில நுழைவுத் தேர்வு வழியாகச் சட்டம் படிப்பது குறித்தும் பார்க்கலாம்.

title: GRE, GMAT, SAT & ACT 2025 Updates: Exam Dates & Changes
description: Check the 2025 exam dates and updates for GRE, GMAT, SAT, and ACT. Stay informed and plan your preparation effectively.
content:
Students getting ready for college must keep up with important standardized tests like the SAT, ACT, GRE, and GMAT as 2025 draws near. Aspirants should strategically organize their preparation and prevent last-minute stress by being aware of the exam dates, registration deadlines, and recent changes.

GRE 2025 Updates

For students hoping to pursue graduate schools overseas, the Graduate Record Examinations, or GRE, continue to be a crucial test. Due to the GRE General Test's year-round availability, exam dates can be chosen with flexibility. In the meanwhile, the GRE Subject Tests are administered the next year in September, October, and April. Subject test registration often opens several months in advance. No major modifications to the exam format have been announced for 2025.

GMAT 2025 Updates

Throughout the year, testing facilities and online platforms continue to offer the GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), which is crucial for those aspiring to earn an MBA. The GMAT Focus Edition, which was released in recent years, has a condensed, simplified format that prioritizes analytical and reasoning abilities. This revised framework will be in place through 2025, assisting applicants in better meeting the standards of business schools.

SAT 2025 Updates

With its new, entirely digital format, the SAT is now only about two hours long. March, May, June, August, September, October, November, and December are the test dates for 2025. Candidates should schedule their preparation in accordance with the registration due dates which are set a few weeks before each exam.

ACT 2025 Updates

Starting in April 2025, the ACT will shorten test durations. By September, the new format will be used for both online and paper-based tests. Registration deadlines are set many weeks in advance, and the test dates for 2025 are February, April, June, July, September, October, and December.

2025 Exam Dates at a Glance

 

Exam Test Dates Registration Deadline Format/Changes

GRE Subject Sep, Oct, Apr 2–3 months prior Standard format
GMAT Year-round Flexible Focus Edition, shorter & streamlined
SAT Mar, May, Jun, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec 2–3 weeks prior Digital format, adaptive testing
ACT Feb, Apr, Jun, Jul, Sep, Oct, Dec 4–5 weeks prior Shorter duration from Apr 2025

Conclusion

Effective preparation for the GRE, GMAT, SAT, and ACT in 2025 requires maintaining up with exam dates and modifications. Aspirants can better organize their study time, practice strategically, and approach each test with confidence if they are aware of the official timetables and updated formats. Success in 2025 and beyond requires constant planning, time management, and change awareness.

title: Organise Notes & Formula Sheets for JEE Main 2026

Why You Need Properly Organised Study Material

Students frequently struggle with disorganized notes and uncontrolled edits as the test draws near.  You may remember information more quickly, revise more intelligently, and avoid making the same mistakes by using a specific set of revision tools.  During the last few weeks, being well-organized also lessens exam anxiety and increases confidence.

content:
Class 12 Computer Science is one of the most important and scoring subjects for students who are interested in pursuing a career in technology and programming. The subject is not only important for board exams but is also useful for a successful career in the field.

Syllabus Overview

The Class 12 Computer Science syllabus primarily consists of topics like Python programming, Data Structures, and Database Management Systems (DBMS). The topics in the computer science syllabus include advanced concepts of Python programming, including functions, file handling, and data structures like stacks, and DBMS concepts like SQL, database, and data handling, along with networking and computer concepts.

How to Prepare Effectively

To score well in Computer Science, students should focus on both theory and practicals.

  • Practice Python programs daily
  • Understand logic instead of memorizing code
  • Revise SQL queries regularly
  • Study NCERT thoroughly
  • Solve previous year question papers

Regular coding practice helps improve problem-solving skills and boosts confidence during exams.

Importance of Practical Exams

Practical exams are quite important in the subject of Computer Science, where the student has to write a program, run it, and explain the output. It is always advisable to keep a well-prepared practical file and project to achieve good marks.

Project Work

Project work is a significant part of internal assessment. It is suggested that students should do projects based on real-life situations, for example, student management systems, library systems, and simple applications. A good project is a reflection of your knowledge and skills.

Career Opportunities

Computer Science opens doors to many career options. Students can pursue B.Tech, BCA, B.Sc Computer Science, Data Science, and other IT-related courses. Future career paths include Software Developer, Data Analyst, AI Engineer, and Cybersecurity Expert.

Why Choose Computer Science?

Computer Science is not just a subject but a valuable skill for the future. It enhances logical thinking, problem-solving ability, and technical knowledge, which are highly demanded in today’s job market.

Conclusion

With consistent practice and clear understanding, Class 12 Computer Science can be a scoring subject. It also provides a strong base for higher studies and careers in the technology field.

title: JEE Main 2025 Question Paper 24 January Shift 1 PDF: Download, Analysis and Difficult Questions
description: Practise with the JEE Main 2025 24 January Shift 1 question paper PDF. Explore the exam analysis, subject-wise difficulty, important chapters and a breakdown of challenging questions from Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
content:
The JEE Main 2025 question paper 24 January Shift 1 is a useful resource for students preparing for engineering entrance examinations. Conducted during the January session, the morning shift included questions from Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. The paper tested candidates on conceptual understanding, numerical applications and their ability to manage time across different sections.

The overall difficulty was generally considered moderate. Physics was the easiest section for most candidates, while Chemistry ranged from easy to moderate. Mathematics was the most challenging and time-consuming, particularly because of questions involving Vectors and 3D Geometry, Calculus and Conic Sections.

Students preparing for upcoming JEE Main sessions can use this paper to understand the examination pattern, practise actual shift-level questions and identify chapters that need additional revision.

Download JEE Main 24 January Shift 1 Question Paper PDF

Solving a previous year paper under timed conditions helps students evaluate their preparation more realistically. Attempt the questions independently before checking the answer key or solutions.

JEE Main 24 January 2025 Shift 1 Paper Analysis

The morning shift was rated moderate overall, with noticeable differences between subjects. Physics was relatively straightforward and included several formula-based questions. Chemistry covered a broad range of chapters, with a stronger presence of Inorganic and Organic Chemistry. Mathematics was lengthy and difficult for many candidates, making question selection and time management particularly important.

Subject-Wise Analysis of the Question Paper

Physics Analysis

Physics was considered the easiest section in this shift. Questions were reported from Optics, Electromagnetism, Modern Physics, Semiconductors and Current Electricity. Several problems were formula-based, although candidates still needed conceptual clarity to select the correct approach.

Ray Optics had a noticeable presence, with questions also reported from Capacitance, Electrostatics and Mechanical Properties of Fluids. Students familiar with standard equations and their applications could attempt much of the section without spending excessive time.

Important Physics topics reported:

  • Ray Optics and Optical Instruments

  • Modern Physics

  • Semiconductors

  • Current Electricity

  • Electrostatics and Capacitance

  • Vectors

  • Mechanical Properties of Fluids

  • Electromagnetic Concepts

Chemistry Analysis

Chemistry was considered easy to moderate. The section covered nearly all major areas, with Inorganic Chemistry receiving the highest share according to expert feedback, followed by Organic Chemistry. Physical Chemistry had comparatively fewer questions.

Some questions were statement-based, requiring candidates to understand chemical properties and theoretical concepts. Important areas included Chemical Bonding, Mole Concept, Electrochemistry, Coordination Compounds and Organic Chemistry.

Important Chemistry topics reported:

  • Chemical Bonding

  • Mole Concept

  • Electrochemistry

  • Coordination Compounds

  • Organic Chemistry

  • Inorganic Chemistry

  • Physical Chemistry

  • Periodic Properties

NCERT revision was particularly useful for the theoretical portion. Students should also practise numerical problems from Physical Chemistry to improve accuracy.

Mathematics Analysis

Mathematics was the toughest and most time-consuming section for many candidates. Questions from Vectors and 3D Geometry, Conic Sections, Calculus and Coordinate Geometry required careful calculations. Some problems involved multiple steps, making it difficult to complete the section quickly.

Students who were comfortable with standard formulas still needed to manage their time carefully. Selecting familiar questions first was a useful strategy for avoiding unnecessary delays.

Important Mathematics topics reported:

  • Vectors and 3D Geometry

  • Conic Sections

  • Calculus

  • Area Under Curves

  • Coordinate Geometry

  • Integration

  • Differential Equations

  • Algebra

Difficult Questions in JEE Main 2025 24 January Shift 1

Mathematics accounted for most of the reported difficulty in this shift. Physics was comparatively easier, but questions involving Optics and electrical concepts required careful application of formulas. Chemistry included some statement-based and conceptual questions.

1. Vectors and 3D Geometry

Questions from Vectors and 3D Geometry were among the challenging areas in Mathematics. Problems involving coordinates, directions and spatial relationships require students to translate the given information into mathematical expressions before applying the relevant formula.

Why challenging: A small error in interpreting the geometry can affect the complete calculation. Students should practise questions involving lines, planes and vector relationships.

2. Conic Sections

Conic Sections were another important area in the Mathematics paper. Questions based on standard curves require knowledge of their equations, properties and geometrical parameters.

Why challenging: Candidates must identify the correct property before starting the calculation. Revising standard equations and practising application-based questions can improve speed.

3. Calculus and Integration

Calculus questions can become lengthy when students need to select an appropriate integration method, simplify expressions and complete multiple steps. Area Under Curves and related applications also require careful interpretation.

Why challenging: The questions test problem-solving ability rather than simple formula recall. Regular practice of different question patterns is important.

4. Ray Optics and Capacitance

Physics included questions from Optics and electrical concepts. Ray Optics requires an understanding of image formation and optical relations, while Capacitance involves the behaviour of capacitors and their combinations.

Why challenging: Students need to understand the physical situation and apply the correct formula without confusing related concepts.

5. Statement-Based Chemistry Questions

Chemistry included statement-based questions that tested theoretical understanding across different chapters.

Why challenging: Candidates had to evaluate the statements carefully instead of relying on memorised definitions. A thorough revision of NCERT concepts can help with such questions.

This breakdown describes reported challenging topics and question formats. It does not claim that every candidate found the same questions difficult or reproduce unverified question statements.

How to Practise with This Previous Year Paper

Use the paper as a full-length mock test rather than checking answers while solving it.

  1. Set a three-hour timer and attempt all three subjects.

  2. Begin with questions you can solve confidently.

  3. Mark lengthy problems and return to them later.

  4. Check the answer key after completing the paper.

  5. Separate conceptual mistakes from calculation errors.

  6. Revise weak chapters before attempting another shift paper.

Conclusion

The JEE Main 2025 24 January Shift 1 paper was moderate overall, with Mathematics emerging as the most difficult section. Physics was comparatively straightforward, while Chemistry tested concepts from Organic, Inorganic and Physical Chemistry.

Students should solve the paper in a timed setting and review their mistakes afterwards. This approach helps identify weak topics, improve calculation accuracy and build confidence for future engineering entrance examinations.

title: INI CET January 2027 Admit Card: 26 October Release Date
description: AIIMS schedules the INI CET January 2027 admit card for 26 October and the exam for 1 November 2026. Download it from MyPage and report errors promptly.
content:
The INI CET admit card for the January 2027 admission session is scheduled for 26 October 2026. The entrance examination follows on 1 November 2026. Applicants should use the January 2027 session in the AIIMS portal, even though both the admit-card release and the examination fall in 2026.

The dates appear in the Important Dates section of the official AIIMS Part A prospectus. The scheduled release date is not a confirmation that the download link is already active. Until it appears in the candidate dashboard, keep your registration ID and password ready.

Two dates to plan around

The prospectus lists final registration status and admit-card upload together. Check both when you sign in.

Stage

Scheduled date

Final registration status and admit-card upload

26 October 2026, Monday

INI CET examination for January 2027 admission

1 November 2026, Sunday

These dates come from Section XV of the Part A prospectus. Your reporting time, centre address and entry instructions must be taken from your own admit card. Do not substitute a timetable from an earlier INI CET session.

Where to download your admit card

Open the AIIMS January 2027 INI CET admission page and follow its Login to Apply link. Section X of the prospectus says the admit card will be available through MyPage after login with the registration ID and password.

  1. Select the January 2027 INI CET session and sign in to your candidate account.

  2. Review the final application status, then open the admit-card link when available.

  3. Save the document and check your personal information before printing it.

  4. Read every exam-centre instruction on the card, including the reporting requirements.

AIIMS does not send the admit card by email or post. It is issued to applicants who have completed all stages of the application process. A saved registration acknowledgement is not a replacement for the admit card.

Report an error through MyPage

If a detail on the card differs from the information you submitted, use the help/query section inside the candidate dashboard. The admit-card instructions in Section X identify this as the route for bringing discrepancies to the AIIMS Examination Section.

The prospectus says a response may take up to three working days, depending on the number of queries. Checking the card soon after release gives you more time to raise a problem before the examination. Describe the mismatch clearly and retain the query reference so that you can follow the response in the same account.

A centre-change request is different from a correction

AIIMS states that its allotment of examination centres and shifts is final. Reporting an incorrect personal detail does not create an option to choose another centre or shift. Plan travel around the location on your issued card.

Carry a printout and follow the card's entry rules

A printed admit card valid for this session is required for entry. AIIMS also requires candidates to follow the instructions printed on it, so read the issued document before deciding which identification and other permitted items to carry.

The card allows you to appear provisionally; it does not confirm final eligibility or admission. Eligibility conditions remain subject to verification, and original documents are checked at reporting or joining at the allotted institute. Keep the admission paperwork separately from your examination-day printout so that it remains available for that later stage.

title: NEET-UG Private Medical Seat: Calculate the Real Cost Before Choice Filling
description: Learn how to calculate the full cost of a NEET-UG private medical seat, including tuition, hostel, deposits, counselling charges and bond risks.
content:
A private medical seat can look affordable on the first fee sheet and still strain your family by the second year. For a safer NEET-UG private medical admission decision, calculate the full course cost, not just the advertised annual tuition, before you lock choices in counselling.

Keep the college fee notice, hostel rules, counselling brochure and admission undertaking together. If one document is missing, your calculation is incomplete.

What should the total private medical seat cost include?

Start with a five-year or course-duration estimate. Do not assume the first-year figure will remain unchanged unless the fee document clearly says so.

  • Tuition: Add the stated fee for every academic year and mark any year-wise increase or revision clause.
  • Hostel and mess: Include room rent, food charges, electricity, maintenance, laundry and refundable or non-refundable deposits.
  • One-time charges: Record admission, university registration, library, identity card, examination and laboratory charges separately.
  • Counselling payments: Note registration fees, security deposits and payment deadlines. A refundable deposit is still money your family must arrange upfront.
  • Living and travel costs: Add books, instruments, uniforms, local transport, medical expenses and travel home.

A simple working formula is: total cost = tuition + hostel and mess + one-time charges + yearly living expenses + likely exit liability. Keep a low and high estimate when the college has not published a fixed future fee.

Why a low first-year fee can mislead you

Suppose College A asks for less tuition in year one but charges a costly hostel and raises fees later. College B may show a higher first-year amount but offer a stable fee schedule and cheaper accommodation. College B could be the safer choice for a family using education loans.

Read the refund and bond clauses before choice filling. Check what happens if you resign after joining, leave during a later year, fail to report, or accept a seat in a subsequent counselling round. The word “bond” may refer to a service condition, an exit payment, or both. Ask the college for the exact written consequence, not a verbal assurance.

Make the choice-filling decision with numbers

  1. Prepare a separate cost sheet for every shortlisted private medical college.
  2. Mark each amount as refundable, non-refundable, fixed or subject to revision.
  3. Test the budget against a delayed loan, one failed year and a hostel fee increase.
  4. Remove any college where the family can pay year one but has no credible plan for later years.

Before submitting choices, compare the course cost with other college options and keep the relevant exam and counselling information accessible. The right seat is one your family can sustain, not merely secure.

ఇంగ్లిష్ పేపర్‌తో తేదీలను పోల్చుకోండి

10వ తరగతి వ్యాపార మౌలికాంశాలు (154) పరీక్ష 20 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. English Language and Literature (184) పరీక్ష 26 ఫిబ్రవరి 2027న ఉంటుంది. ఈ రెండు తేదీల మధ్య 6 రోజుల తేడా ఉంది.

ఈ తేడా మొత్తం చదువుకోడానికి దొరికే సెలవు కాదు. మీ ఇతర పరీక్షలను కూడా క్యాలెండర్‌లో పెట్టి, మధ్యలో పరీక్ష లేని రోజులను మాత్రమే లెక్కించండి. సాధన చేసేటప్పుడు అసలు పేపర్ వ్యవధిని పాటించండి.

పరీక్ష కేంద్రానికి బయలుదేరే ముందు

పేపర్ మొదలయ్యే సమయం కేంద్రానికి చేరే గడువు కాదు. రిపోర్టింగ్, ప్రవేశం, పత్రాల వివరాలకు అడ్మిట్ కార్డు చూడండి. తేదీ మారిందని వింటే బోర్డు సవరించిన నోటీసులో తరగతి, కోడ్, తేదీని పోల్చుకోండి.

కేంద్రంలోకి కమ్యూనికేషన్ పరికరాలను అనుమతించరు. తీసుకెళ్లే వస్తువుల విషయంలో CBSE విడిగా ఇచ్చే సూచనలను, అడ్మిట్ కార్డులోని నియమాలను పాటించండి.

పూర్తి పరీక్షల షెడ్యూల్ · పేపర్ వ్యవధి వివరాలు

title: How to Verify a Private College Before Paying Admission Fees in 2026
description: A practical 2026 checklist for Indian students and parents to verify private college approval, affiliation, fees, refund terms, hostel charges and payment proof before paying admission fees.
content:
Before paying admission fees to a private college in 2026, verify the exact college name, affiliating university, course approval, current academic year permission, full fee breakup, refund terms, hostel charges and receipt format. Use the relevant official authority portal and written documents from the college, not only a brochure, phone call or counselling promise.

If any approval, affiliation or refund detail is unclear, avoid non-refundable payment. A small seat-blocking amount can become a serious problem if the course is not recognised, the fee terms change or the receipt does not prove the purpose of payment.

Key facts students should know

  • College approval and course approval are different. A campus may be running, but the specific course and intake still need to be valid for the admission year.

  • Affiliation affects degree validity. For affiliated colleges, confirm the university name, campus address, course name and year of affiliation.

  • Professional courses need extra checks. Engineering, pharmacy, architecture, law, teacher education, nursing, medical and allied health programmes may require approval or recognition from the responsible regulator.

  • Refund promises must be written. A verbal assurance such as “fully refundable” is weak unless the amount, deduction, last date and processing time are clearly recorded.

  • Hostel cost can change the real budget. Check whether hostel, mess, transport and other facilities are optional, compulsory, refundable or charged separately.

  • Payment proof protects you. Pay through a traceable channel and collect an official receipt with student, course, amount, date and payment purpose details.

Private college admission verification checklist for 2026

Start verification before you visit the campus or pay a token amount. Once money is paid, families often feel pressured to continue even when important information is missing.

Check point

Who or where to verify

Proof to save

Exact college name and address

College admission office and official records

Admission letter, campus address and registration details

Affiliating university

Affiliating university or state higher education records

Screenshot or printout showing college and course

Course approval and intake

Relevant authority or professional regulator, where applicable

Current-year approval, recognition or intake details

Fee structure

Official fee notice or signed admission document

Tuition, deposits, exam fee, lab fee and other charges

Refund policy

Written admission terms

Cancellation deadline, deduction and refund timeline

Hostel and transport

Hostel office or official circular

Deposit, mess advance, cancellation rule and allotment terms

Payment receipt

Accounts office or authorised payment gateway

Receipt number, transaction proof and payment purpose

Step 1: Match the college name exactly

Do not verify a college only by its popular short name. Many private education groups run schools, colleges, training centres and campuses with similar names.

Match the name on the admission offer with the name shown in official records. Also compare the district, campus address, trust or society name and course title. If there is any difference, ask the admission office for written clarification before payment.

Step 2: Separate approval, affiliation and recognition

Approval generally means permission to run an institution or course under the rules of a responsible authority. Affiliation means a university permits the college to teach the course and present students for examination or degree award. Recognition is important in professional courses where future practice, registration or eligibility may depend on a regulator.

For regular degree programmes, the affiliating university and state higher education framework are usually central to verification. For professional programmes, also check the responsible national or state regulator for that course. If the college says approval is “applied for” or “expected soon”, treat it as pending until the official status is visible or confirmed in writing by the responsible authority.

Step 3: Confirm course, intake and admission year

A college may be approved for BCom but not for a specialised professional programme. It may also have approval for a limited intake. If the college offers a seat after the usual seats appear full, ask how your admission will be counted.

Check the admission year carefully. An old approval letter does not automatically prove permission for the 2026 batch. If a document is shared by the college, compare the course name, intake and year with the latest status available on the official authority portal.

Step 4: Ask for the complete fee breakup

Brochure fees can hide the real first-year cost. Ask for tuition fee, admission fee, registration fee, caution deposit, university charges, examination fee, lab fee, library fee, activity fee, uniform, laptop, transport, hostel and mess charges.

Every item should be marked refundable or non-refundable. If a facility is optional, the college should not pressure you to pay for it before you choose it. Parents should calculate the total first-year outflow, not only the first instalment.

Simple risk calculation before paying

Write down the amount you may lose if the student withdraws after another counselling allotment. For example, if the college asks for Rs 50,000 and states that only Rs 35,000 is refundable before a certain date, the immediate risk is Rs 15,000 plus any delay in receiving the refund.

This calculation helps families decide whether blocking a seat is worth the risk. It is especially useful when entrance counselling, scholarship results or a preferred college decision is still pending.

Step 5: Read refund terms like a contract

Refund disputes usually begin when families rely on a phone call or informal message. A safe refund policy should mention the last cancellation date, deduction amount, documents required, refund processing time and bank account process.

Be cautious if the admission team says “refund will be decided later”, “adjustable only”, “non-refundable in all cases” or “pay today to keep the scholarship”. Some deductions may be valid under written rules, but unclear deductions are a red flag.

If you are waiting for a government, university or centralised counselling result, tell the college in writing before payment. Ask how withdrawal after such allotment will be treated and keep the acknowledgement.

Step 6: Verify hostel and campus stay charges

For outstation students, hostel and mess fees can decide affordability. Ask whether hostel is compulsory for first-year students, whether room allotment is confirmed and whether the deposit is refundable.

Also check mess billing, electricity, laundry, transport between hostel and campus, leave rules and hostel cancellation deadline. Avoid paying hostel deposits without written terms or an official allotment note.

Step 7: Protect every payment with a proper receipt

Use a traceable payment method such as bank transfer, authorised payment gateway, cheque or demand draft. Avoid cash unless the accounts office gives an official receipt immediately.

A proper receipt should show the institution name, receipt number, date, student name, course, academic year, amount, payment mode and purpose of payment. If it only says “advance” without course or refund status, request correction.

Never transfer admission money to a personal account of a counsellor, agent, faculty member or student coordinator. If a consultant is involved, the final payment should still go to the institution through an authorised channel.

Decision guidance: pay, pause or walk away

Situation

Decision

Why it matters

Approval, affiliation and course status are clear for 2026

Pay only after written fee and refund terms

Main degree-validity risk is reduced

Approval is clear but fee breakup is incomplete

Pause

Hidden charges may affect affordability

Refund promise is verbal only

Do not pay yet

Verbal assurance is difficult to prove

Payment is demanded in a personal account

Walk away or escalate

Accountability and receipt risk is high

Course approval is pending or unclear

Avoid non-refundable payment

Degree or professional eligibility risk may arise

Documents to keep before paying admission fees

  • Admission offer or provisional allotment letter

  • Current-year approval, affiliation or recognition proof, where applicable

  • Course name, specialisation, duration and intake details

  • Written fee structure with refundable and non-refundable items

  • Refund policy and cancellation deadline

  • Hostel, mess and transport fee circular, if applicable

  • Payment receipt and bank transaction proof

  • Copies of documents submitted to the college

  • Acknowledgement for any original document deposited

Original document safeguards

Original marksheets, migration certificates, caste certificates, domicile documents and entrance scorecards should not be left without acknowledgement. If originals are needed for verification, ask when they will be returned.

If the college wants to retain originals beyond verification, ask for the written rule or admission condition. Keep scanned copies before visiting the campus.

FAQs

How do I verify a private college before paying admission fees in 2026?

Match the exact college name, campus address, affiliating university, course approval and academic year on the relevant official authority records. Then collect the written fee breakup, refund policy, hostel terms if applicable and receipt format before paying.

Is university affiliation enough for a private college admission?

University affiliation is important, but it may not be enough for professional courses. Programmes such as engineering, pharmacy, law, architecture, teacher education, nursing, medical and allied health courses may also need approval or recognition from the responsible regulator.

Should I pay a seat-blocking amount before counselling results?

Pay only if the college is verified and the refund terms are clear in writing. If counselling results are pending, calculate the non-refundable risk and get written confirmation on cancellation deadlines before paying.

What should be written on an admission fee receipt?

The receipt should mention the institution name, receipt number, date, student name, course, academic year, amount, payment mode and purpose of payment. Keep it with bank transaction proof.

Can a private college keep my original documents after admission?

Original documents may be checked for verification, but students should not leave them without a written acknowledgement. Ask when they will be returned and keep scanned copies of all documents submitted.

What if the college says approval is applied for?

Treat the course status as pending unless the responsible authority has confirmed approval or recognition for the relevant academic year. Avoid non-refundable payment when approval is unclear.

Are hostel fees refundable if I cancel admission?

It depends on the written hostel rules. Before paying, check the hostel deposit, mess advance, room allotment terms, cancellation deadline and deductions.

title: TS Inter 2027: థియరీ టైమ్‌టేబుల్‌కు ముందే ప్రాక్టికల్స్‌కు సిద్ధం కండి
description: తెలంగాణ తాత్కాలిక క్యాలెండర్‌లో ప్రాక్టికల్స్ జనవరి చివరి వారంలో, థియరీ ఫిబ్రవరి చివరి వారంలో ఉన్నాయి. సబ్జెక్టు తేదీలు రాకముందే ప్రణాళిక వేసుకోండి.
content:
తెలంగాణ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ విద్యార్థులు థియరీ పరీక్షలకు ముందే ప్రాక్టికల్ సిద్ధతకు సమయం ఉంచాలి. బోర్డు తాత్కాలిక 2026-27 విద్యా క్యాలెండర్ ప్రకారం IPE 2027 ప్రాక్టికల్స్ జనవరి చివరి వారంలో, థియరీ పరీక్షలు ఫిబ్రవరి చివరి వారంలో ఉంటాయి. ఒక్కో పేపర్ తేదీ ఇందులో లేదు.

ప్రణాళికలో ఈ మూడు దశలు చేర్చండి

దశ

తాత్కాలిక క్యాలెండర్‌లో కాలం

ప్రీ-ఫైనల్ పరీక్షలు

18-23 జనవరి 2027

IPE ప్రాక్టికల్ పరీక్షలు

జనవరి 2027 చివరి వారం

IPE థియరీ పరీక్షలు

ఫిబ్రవరి 2027 చివరి వారం

తెలంగాణ ఇంటర్మీడియట్ విద్యా బోర్డు విద్యా క్యాలెండర్, 28 మార్చి 2026, పేజీ 2. ప్రణాళికలో ఈ మూడు దశలు చేర్చండి.

“చివరి వారం” అనేది ప్రణాళికకు విస్తృత సూచన మాత్రమే. దానిని ఒక నిర్దిష్ట ప్రారంభ తేదీగా మార్చవద్దు. మొదటి, రెండో సంవత్సరం పేపర్లు వరుస రోజులలో ఉంటాయని అనుకోకండి. సబ్జెక్టుల తేదీలు, సెషన్లకు ప్రత్యేక పరీక్ష టైమ్‌టేబుల్ అవసరం.

ప్రాక్టికల్ పనుల గురించి కళాశాలను ఇప్పుడే అడగండి

ప్రాక్టికల్ లేదా ప్రాజెక్టు అవసరమైన సబ్జెక్టుల్లో ఏమి పూర్తి చేయాలి, ఏ రికార్డులు తీసుకురావాలో కళాశాలతో నిర్ధారించుకోండి. జనవరి ప్రీ-ఫైనల్స్ ముగిసే వరకు వాయిదా వేయకుండా థియరీ రివిజన్‌తో పాటు ప్రాక్టికల్ సిద్ధత కొనసాగించండి.

పూర్తికాని అంశాలు, సమయ పరిమితిలో సాధన చేస్తున్నప్పుడు ఎక్కువ సమయం తీసుకునే ప్రశ్నలను గుర్తించడానికి ప్రీ-ఫైనల్స్ ఉపయోగించుకోండి. వాటి తర్వాత మార్చుకోగల రివిజన్ సమయం కొంత ఉంచండి. విస్తృత క్యాలెండర్ మీ వ్యక్తిగత పేపర్ల మధ్య విరామాన్ని చూపదు.

విడుదలయ్యాక సరైన టైమ్‌టేబుల్ వాడండి

అధికారిక ఇంటర్మీడియట్ బోర్డు వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో పరీక్ష సంవత్సరం, మొదటి లేదా రెండో సంవత్సరం, కోర్సు, సబ్జెక్టు కోడ్ సరిపోల్చండి. ప్రాక్టికల్ సూచనలను థియరీ తేదీల నుంచి విడిగా చదవండి. బోర్డు తర్వాత చేసే సవరణలు, కళాశాల ద్వారా ఇచ్చే సూచనలు పాటించండి.

క్యాలెండర్, టైమ్‌టేబుల్ మార్గదర్శిని విద్యా ప్రణాళికకు, పరీక్ష తేదీల పట్టికకు మధ్య తేడాను వివరిస్తుంది. మీ పేపర్ల టైమ్‌టేబుల్ వచ్చే వరకు ప్రయాణం లేదా సెలవు ఏర్పాట్లను మార్చుకోగలిగేలా ఉంచండి.

title: SLS AIAT 2027: Apply by 4 December for 3-Year LLB and LLM
description: Symbiosis Law School Pune’s AIAT 2027 application and fee deadline is 4 December 2026 for the three-year LL.B. and one-year LL.M. routes. Check the verified fee difference, eligibility, admit-card date, test time and programme-specific interview schedule before applying.
content:
Symbiosis Law School Pune is accepting applications for its SLS AIAT 2027 admission process for the three-year LL.B. and one-year LL.M. programmes. The official schedule sets 4 December 2026 at 11:59 pm as the deadline to submit the online application and complete the required fee payment.

Applicants should use the page for their chosen programme because the eligibility rules, fee components and personal-interaction dates are not identical. Completing only the registration without the required payment may leave the application incomplete.

What must be completed by 4 December

The application form and the applicable registration payment must both be completed before 11:59 pm on 4 December 2026. The three-year LL.B. admissions page lists an AIAT registration fee of ₹2,150. For the LL.M. route, the official page lists ₹2,150 for AIAT plus ₹1,000 for each institution selected.

LL.M. applicants should therefore check the number of institutions in their application before paying. Keep the payment receipt and a saved copy of the completed form for reference.

Admission stage

Three-year LL.B.

One-year LL.M.

Application and fee deadline

4 December 2026, 11:59 pm

4 December 2026, 11:59 pm

Admit card

11 December 2026

11 December 2026

AIAT computer-based test

19 December 2026, 9:00 am to 10:45 am

19 December 2026, 9:00 am to 10:45 am

SLS Pune personal interaction

8 and 9 January 2027

4 and 5 January 2027

First merit list

20 January 2027

13 January 2027

The institute notes that admission dates may change, so candidates should continue checking the official programme page after submitting the form.

Choose the right eligibility route

Three-year LL.B.

Applicants must hold a graduate degree from a recognised university or an Institution of National Importance with at least 45% marks. The minimum is 40% for candidates belonging to the SC or ST categories.

One-year LL.M.

Applicants need a three-year or five-year LL.B. degree with at least 50% marks. The minimum is 45% for SC and ST candidates. Students appearing in the final year of their LL.B. may apply, but admission remains subject to submitting the qualifying degree or pass certificate with the required marks by the institute’s announced deadline.

How to apply without mixing the two forms

  1. Open the official SLS Pune admissions page for the three-year LL.B. or the one-year LL.M.

  2. Select the application link shown for the chosen programme and register with an active email address and mobile number.

  3. Enter academic, identity and category details exactly as they appear on supporting documents.

  4. Upload the documents requested by the portal in the stated format and size.

  5. Review the programme and, for LL.M. applicants, the institutions selected before making payment.

  6. Complete the payment and save the confirmation page, receipt and submitted form.

Avoid relying on a screenshot of the application page alone. A payment acknowledgement and the submitted-form record are better evidence if a portal query arises later.

Checks to make before paying

  • Confirm that the form is for the correct programme and admission year.

  • Match your name, date of birth and marks with the certificates you will present later.

  • Keep the relevant category certificate ready if you are claiming a reserved-category threshold.

  • Final-year LL.B. candidates should note the later proof requirement before applying for the LL.M.

  • Read the portal’s fee and refund conditions before the final payment step.

Symbiosis Law School Pune, 2027-28 LL.M. brochure, page 16 (undated).

What follows after the form

The official schedule lists admit-card availability on 11 December 2026, followed by the centre-based AIAT on 19 December from 9:00 am to 10:45 am. Candidates should read the admit card for reporting time, permitted items and centre instructions.

The personal-interaction dates differ by programme. SLS Pune lists 8 and 9 January 2027 for three-year LL.B. applicants and 4 and 5 January 2027 for LL.M. applicants. Keep original academic and category documents ready for the admission stages specified by the institute.

Official application pages

Use the official three-year LL.B. admission process page or the official LL.M. admission process page. Students comparing law entrance timelines can also read the MH CET Law 2027 candidate registration guide.

title: TS Inter 2027 സമയപ്പട്ടിക: അക്കാദമിക് കലണ്ടർ പറയുന്നത് എന്ത്?
description: തെലങ്കാന ഇന്റർ പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ, തിയറി പരീക്ഷകളുടെ താൽക്കാലിക കാലയളവ്, ഔദ്യോഗിക സമയപ്പട്ടിക കണ്ടെത്താനുള്ള വഴി, പഠനത്തിനുള്ള നിർദേശങ്ങൾ അറിയാം.
content:
തെലങ്കാന ഇന്റർമീഡിയറ്റ് വിദ്യാർഥികൾക്ക് 2027 പരീക്ഷകളുടെ താൽക്കാലിക കാലയളവ് ലഭ്യമാണ്. എന്നാൽ പരീക്ഷാദിവസത്തെ പദ്ധതികൾ ഉറപ്പിക്കാൻ വിഷയാടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലുള്ള സമയപ്പട്ടിക വരുന്നതുവരെ കാത്തിരിക്കണം. ബോർഡിന്റെ 2026-27 അക്കാദമിക് കലണ്ടറിൽ പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ പരീക്ഷകൾ ജനുവരി അവസാന ആഴ്ചയിലും തിയറി പരീക്ഷകൾ ഫെബ്രുവരി അവസാന ആഴ്ചയിലുമാണ്. ഇവ പഠനം ആസൂത്രണം ചെയ്യാനുള്ള സമയപരിധികളാണ്; ഓരോ പേപ്പറിന്റെയും അന്തിമ തീയതികളല്ല.

TGBIE ഇപ്പോൾ പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത് എന്താണ്?

ഔദ്യോഗിക അക്കാദമിക് കലണ്ടർ വാർഷിക പരിപാടിയെ താൽക്കാലികമെന്നാണ് വിശേഷിപ്പിക്കുന്നത്. പ്രീ-ഫൈനൽ പരീക്ഷകൾക്ക് 2027 ജനുവരി 18 മുതൽ 23 വരെ നൽകിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. IPE 2027 വിഷയാടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലുള്ള സമയപ്പട്ടിക ബോർഡിന്റെ അറിയിപ്പുപേജിൽ ഇനിയും പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുകയാണ്.

ഒന്നാം അല്ലെങ്കിൽ രണ്ടാം വർഷത്തിന്റെ പൂർണ സമയപ്പട്ടികയെന്ന പേരിൽ ലഭിക്കുന്ന ചിത്രം മാത്രം ആശ്രയിക്കരുത്. ഗണിതം, ബയോളജി, ഭാഷാ പേപ്പർ എന്നിവയുടെ തീയതി കലണ്ടർ ഉറപ്പിക്കുന്നില്ല. പരീക്ഷാഫീസ് സർക്കുലറും പേപ്പറുകളുടെ ക്രമം സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കുന്നില്ല.

TGBIEയുടെ 28 മാർച്ച് 2026 താൽക്കാലിക അക്കാദമിക് കലണ്ടറിലെ പേജ് 2. പരീക്ഷാ ആഴ്ചകൾ അന്തിമ വിഷയവാരിയായ തീയതികളല്ല. പൂർണ ഔദ്യോഗിക കലണ്ടർ (PDF)

ശരിയായ വർഷവും കോഴ്സും നോക്കി PDF തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക

തെലങ്കാന ബോർഡ് ഓഫ് ഇന്റർമീഡിയറ്റ് എജ്യുക്കേഷൻ വെബ്സൈറ്റിലെ News & Announcements ഭാഗത്ത് IPE 2027 സമയപ്പട്ടിക അറിയിപ്പ് നോക്കുക. ബോർഡിന്റെ PDF തുറക്കുക. പഴയ IPE, അഡ്വാൻസ്ഡ് സപ്ലിമെന്ററി സമയപ്പട്ടികകളും ഉള്ളതിനാൽ വർഷവും പരീക്ഷയുടെ പേരും പരിശോധിക്കുക.

പ്രവേശനരേഖയ്ക്കനുസരിച്ച് ഒന്നാം വർഷമോ രണ്ടാം വർഷമോ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക. ജനറൽ വിഷയങ്ങളാണോ വൊക്കേഷണൽ വിഷയങ്ങളാണോ എന്ന് ഉറപ്പാക്കുക. ആദ്യ തീയതി മാത്രമല്ല, പേപ്പർ പേരുകൾ, പരീക്ഷാസമയം, കുറിപ്പുകൾ എന്നിവയും വായിക്കുക. പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ നിർദേശങ്ങൾ തിയറി സമയപ്പട്ടികയിൽനിന്ന് വേർതിരിച്ച് സൂക്ഷിക്കുക. പുതുക്കിയ പട്ടിക വന്നാൽ പഴയ പകർപ്പ് മാറ്റുക.

ഈ സമയം വിഷയാടിസ്ഥാനത്തിലുള്ള ആവർത്തനപഠനത്തിന് ഉപയോഗിക്കുക

ഇനിയും പഠിക്കാനുള്ള വിഷയങ്ങൾ ഉൾപ്പെടുത്തി ആഴ്ചപ്പട്ടിക തയ്യാറാക്കുക. താൽക്കാലിക കലണ്ടർ പഠനം പൂർത്തിയാക്കാനുള്ള പൊതുവായ ലക്ഷ്യം നിശ്ചയിക്കാൻ സഹായിക്കും. പേപ്പർ തീയതികൾ വരുന്നതുവരെ ദിവസേനയുള്ള ആവർത്തനപഠനക്രമം മാറ്റാനുള്ള സൗകര്യം നിലനിർത്തുക.

2026-27 ഒന്നാം വർഷ സിലബസ്, വാർഷിക പഠനപദ്ധതി, മാതൃകാ ചോദ്യപേപ്പറുകൾ എന്നിവ TGBIE ലിങ്ക് ചെയ്തിട്ടുണ്ട്. സ്വന്തം വിഷയത്തിനും വർഷത്തിനും അനുയോജ്യമായ പേപ്പർ എഴുതി നോക്കി തെറ്റുകൾ തിരുത്തുക. ഒന്നാം വർഷത്തിന്റെ പുതുക്കിയ പേപ്പർ മാതൃക രണ്ടാം വർഷത്തിനും ബാധകമാണെന്ന് കരുതരുത്.

പ്രാക്ടിക്കൽ തയ്യാറെടുപ്പും കോളേജിന്റെ നിർദേശങ്ങളും ജൂനിയർ കോളേജിൽനിന്ന് അറിയുക. അനൗദ്യോഗിക സ്ക്രീൻഷോട്ട് നോക്കി പണം തിരികെ കിട്ടാത്ത യാത്ര ബുക്ക് ചെയ്യരുത്. ഔദ്യോഗിക പട്ടിക കോളേജ് നൽകിയ പകർപ്പുമായി താരതമ്യം ചെയ്ത് വ്യത്യാസങ്ങൾ ആദ്യം വ്യക്തമാക്കുക.

title: SBI Clerk Prelims Result 2026: Check the Recruitment Number
description: The regular Junior Associate recruitment and the special backlog drive have separate result notices. Match your advertisement number before opening a link.
content:
Waiting for the SBI Clerk prelims result for the regular 2026-27 recruitment? Start with the advertisement number on your application: CRPD/CR/2026-27/17. The official careers listing currently shows the preliminary examination call-letter link for this recruitment, but no prelims-result link under that entry.

A result link elsewhere on the same page may belong to a different recruitment. Do not treat it as your result merely because its heading says “Junior Associates”.

Two Clerk recruitments appear separately

On SBI’s Current Openings page, the regular Customer Support and Sales recruitment carries number CRPD/CR/2026-27/17. The special recruitment drive for SC, ST and OBC backlog vacancies carries CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16 and has a preliminary-result link under its own heading.

The special-drive result does not establish the result status of the regular recruitment. Older recruitment results also remain on the careers site, so the year alone is not enough to identify the correct notice.

How to find your result when the link appears

  1. Open the official careers page through the link above.

  2. Locate the Junior Associates entry that matches your application’s advertisement number.

  3. Look for the result notice within that entry, rather than opening the first result link on the page.

  4. Read whether the notice provides a list or asks you to sign in. Follow the details requested by that specific result page.

  5. Save the result or notice and read any next-stage instructions attached to it.

Keep these details ready without sharing them

Keep your application confirmation, registration or roll number and access to your registered contact details nearby. Use them only if the official result page asks for them. Avoid posting screenshots containing passwords, dates of birth or registration details in public groups to ask someone else to check.

If you cannot sign in once a result facility becomes available, check the entry format on that page first. Use its supported recovery or help route rather than repeatedly entering guessed credentials.

Do not plan around an unannounced result time

The regular-recruitment entry does not establish a result release date or time. A “soon” message or a result link for another drive cannot confirm one. Continue your preparation while following notices for your own recruitment number.

Use the education news section for related updates, and return to the SBI notice for the exact next-stage instructions that apply to you.

title: Top Polytechnic After 10th: Complete Guide to Colleges, Eligibility & Career
description: A complete, comprehensive guide for students planning to pursue a polytechnic diploma after 10th. Learn about the best colleges like VJTI and Pusa Polytechnic, state-level entrance exams (JEECUP, JEXPO), fee structures, and how to secure high-paying Junior Engineer jobs.
content:
Finishing your 10th-grade board exams brings up the classic dilemma: what exactly comes next? While most students default to the traditional 11th and 12th-grade route, a growing number of tech-savvy minds are choosing a more direct path to an engineering career.

Enrolling in a top polytechnic after 10th allows you to skip the grueling two years of high school and jump straight into practical, skill-based engineering. A 3-year polytechnic diploma transforms you into an industry-ready professional much faster. Plus, it leaves the door wide open for you to pursue a B.Tech later through lateral entry directly into the second year.

Whether your goal is to secure a government job as a Junior Engineer or launch a career in software, civil, or mechanical domains, choosing the right college is critical. This guide breaks down the premier polytechnic institutes in India, the core admission processes, expected fees, and the lucrative career roadmap waiting for diploma holders.

Top Polytechnic Colleges in India

The reputation of your polytechnic institute plays a massive role in your campus placements and hands-on training quality. India is home to several elite government and private polytechnic colleges that offer world-class workshops and stellar placement cells.

Here is a look at some of the highest-ranked polytechnic institutes across the country:

Popular Engineering Branches & Scope

Just like a traditional B.Tech degree, polytechnic diplomas offer various specializations. Your choice of branch dictates your daily work environment and long-term career trajectory.

Diploma Branch

Real estate, L&T, PWD, government infrastructure projects.

Electrical Engineering

Circuit design, power transmission, motors and transformers.

State electricity boards, power grids, electronics manufacturing.

Eligibility Criteria & State Entrance Exams

Getting into a reputed polytechnic college requires you to navigate specific state-level entrance exams. The process is straightforward but highly competitive for top government seats.

  • Academic Eligibility: You must have successfully passed your Class 10 board exams from a recognized state or central board (CBSE, ICSE, or State Boards).

  • Mandatory Subjects: Mathematics and Science are compulsory subjects. Most top colleges require a minimum aggregate of 35% to 50% in your 10th boards, depending on the specific state category rules.

  • Popular Entrance Examinations: Admission to government colleges is almost entirely dictated by state-level common entrance tests (CETs).

    • Delhi CET: For institutes like Pusa Polytechnic and Aryabhatt Institute of Technology.

    • JEECUP (UPJEE): The gateway for all government and private polytechnics in Uttar Pradesh.

    • JEXPO: Conducted for admissions across West Bengal.

    • AP POLYCET & TS POLYCET: State exams for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana respectively.

    • MSBTE Merit-Based: Maharashtra conducts admissions based on 10th-grade merit marks rather than a separate entrance test for elite institutes like VJTI.

Fee Structure: Government vs. Private

Budgeting for your diploma is much easier compared to a full-fledged engineering degree. Government institutes are heavily subsidized, offering an incredible return on investment (ROI).

Highly competitive entry via state entrance exams; incredible ROI.

Private Polytechnics

₹35,000 to ₹1,00,000+

Easier admission process, modern labs, and dedicated placement cells.

Career Opportunities and B.Tech Lateral Entry

A polytechnic diploma is recognized as a highly functional, skill-based qualification. Graduates have two very distinct, rewarding pathways immediately after completion.

The Job Pathway: Industries love hiring diploma holders because they possess practical, on-the-ground technical skills.

  • Junior Engineer (JE): The most coveted role. You can crack exams like SSC JE or RRB JE to secure high-paying, ultra-secure government jobs in the Railways, CPWD, or State Electricity Boards.

  • Technical Assistant / Supervisor: Overseeing assembly lines, managing construction sites, or maintaining IT networks in the private corporate sector.

  • Starting Salaries: A fresh diploma holder generally starts between ₹2.0 Lakhs to ₹4.5 Lakhs per annum. Government JE roles offer significantly better perks and rapid pay scale increments.

The Higher Education Pathway (Lateral Entry): If you decide you want a full engineering degree, your diploma allows you to bypass the 1st year of B.Tech completely. Through exams like LEET (Lateral Entry Entrance Test), you are admitted directly into the 2nd year (3rd semester) of a B.Tech program. This means you still complete your engineering degree in the same total timeframe as a regular 12th-grade student, but with vastly superior practical workshop experience.

Conclusion

Deciding to pursue a top polytechnic after 10th is a brilliant, time-saving strategy for students who are absolutely certain they want an engineering career. By securing a seat in elite institutes like VJTI, Jamia Millia Islamia, or Pusa Polytechnic, you gain access to hands-on industrial training at a fraction of the cost of private high schools. Focus hard on your state’s polytechnic entrance exams (like JEECUP, Delhi CET, or JEXPO), choose a branch that aligns with your technical interests, and you will build a rock-solid foundation for either landing a secure Junior Engineer job or dominating your future B.Tech lateral entry program.
