title: VFX Course After 12th: Eligibility, Fees & Career Options
description: Discover the best VFX courses after 12th. Explore B.Sc, BA, and diploma programs, check eligibility criteria, fee structures, and the massive career scope in the film and gaming industries.
content:
The global entertainment landscape has been completely transformed by digital technology. From blockbuster superhero films and highly immersive AAA video games to OTT series and interactive advertising, Visual Effects (VFX) are at the heart of modern visual storytelling. For creative students who are fascinated by CGI, digital simulations, and seamless post-production magic, pursuing a VFX course after 12th is one of the most exciting and future-proof career moves available today.

Unlike traditional academic paths, the VFX and animation industry prioritizes practical software mastery, spatial awareness, and a strong creative portfolio over theoretical exam scores. You can dive directly into character rigging, 3D modeling, and motion graphics right after high school. This comprehensive guide breaks down the best undergraduate degrees, short-term diplomas, eligibility rules, fee structures, and the high-paying job roles awaiting certified VFX professionals.

Top Educational Pathways in VFX

Students can choose between comprehensive multi-year university degrees or short-term, highly focused technical diplomas, depending on how quickly they wish to enter the industry.

  • B.Sc. in Animation and Visual Effects (VFX): A popular 3- to 4-year undergraduate degree that focuses heavily on the technical and creative aspects of CGI, compositing, rendering, and post-production. It provides a deep foundation in both art history and advanced software.

  • B.A. / B.Des in Visual Effects: A 3- to 4-year program that leans more toward the artistic, design, and storytelling elements of animation, including character design, storyboarding, and motion graphics.

  • Diploma in VFX and Post-Production: A fast-tracked 1- to 2-year program designed for immediate entry into the workforce. It offers hands-on, practical training in specific software domains like rotoscoping, camera tracking, and basic compositing.

Overview of Programs, Duration, and Fees

The financial investment required for a VFX education varies based on the institute's infrastructure, access to high-end rendering labs, and global affiliations.

Course Type

Typical Duration

Estimated Total Fees

Primary Career Focus

B.Sc. in Animation & VFX

3 to 4 Years

₹2,50,000 to ₹8,00,000

VFX Artist, Compositor, Technical Director, Lighting Artist.

B.A. / B.Des in VFX

3 to 4 Years

₹2,00,000 to ₹6,00,000

Storyboard Artist, Character Designer, Motion Graphics Designer.

Diploma in VFX

1 to 2 Years

₹80,000 to ₹2,50,000

Roto Artist, Junior Compositor, Video Editor, Matchmove Artist.

Top institutes offering these programs include the National Institute of Design (NID), Chandigarh University, Lovely Professional University (LPU), Parul University, and specialized academies like MAAC and Arena Animation.

Core Eligibility Criteria

Gaining admission into a VFX program is generally more dependent on creative aptitude and digital literacy than a strict science or math background.

  • Academic Stream: Candidates from any stream (Arts, Commerce, or Science) are entirely eligible to apply for most B.Sc., B.A., B.Des, and Diploma programs in visual effects.

  • Minimum Marks: Most universities and private academies require a minimum aggregate of 50% in the Class 12 board examinations from a recognized central or state board.

  • Admission Process: Many private institutes and specialized academies offer direct admission based on Class 12 merit or a basic personal interview. However, premier design colleges (like NID or specific B.Des programs) require you to clear national-level design entrance exams (such as NID DAT or UCEED) that evaluate your sketching skills and spatial visualization.

Core Syllabus and Essential Software Skills

A professional VFX curriculum moves you from basic digital art concepts to complex live-action integration. Core modules typically include:

  • Fundamentals of Art & Design: Color theory, anatomy sketching, and storyboarding.

  • 3D Modeling & Rigging: Creating digital skeletons and control systems that allow animators to move 3D characters realistically.

  • Compositing & CGI: Merging live-action footage with computer-generated imagery seamlessly using green screens and matte paintings.

  • Lighting & Rendering: Applying lighting sets in 3D environments to replicate natural/artificial light sources and improve realism.

  • Industry Software Mastery: You will spend hundreds of hours mastering Autodesk Maya, Blender, Adobe After Effects, Nuke, ZBrush, and Cinema 4D.

Career Scope and Job Roles

The career scope following your VFX course after 12th is vast, spanning film production, television networks, advertising agencies, and AAA game development studios.

  • VFX Artist: Combines digital effects with live-action footage to generate imaginative scenes (explosions, weather phenomena) that cannot be filmed in reality.

  • Compositor: Modifies colors, lighting, and shadows to seamlessly merge different visual components (CGI, live-action) into a cohesive final frame.

  • Rigging Artist: Creates the complex digital skeletons and muscle responses that allow 3D models to move accurately.

  • Motion Graphics Designer: Develops animated graphic content, blending text and visual components for promotional videos, UI/UX, and social media.

Salary Expectations: An entry-level VFX artist or junior compositor in India typically earns between ₹3.0 Lakhs to ₹5.0 Lakhs per annum. With 4-5 years of specialized experience, an exceptional showreel, and expertise in software like Nuke or Unreal Engine, professionals can easily command ₹10.0 Lakhs to ₹18.0 Lakhs per annum.

Conclusion

Enrolling in a VFX course after 12th is the perfect pathway to turn your creative vision into a tangible, high-paying profession. As the global demand for high-quality visual content skyrockets across cinema, gaming, and digital media, your success will rely entirely on your practical execution and the strength of your portfolio. By choosing the right program, mastering industry-standard compositing and 3D software, and continuously updating your creative showreel, you can establish a highly rewarding and dynamic career in the entertainment industry.

title: CUET UG 2027 Subject Mapping Errors Can Block Your University Choices
description: A wrong CUET UG 2027 subject combination may limit programme choices. Learn how to match test papers with university eligibility before submission.
content:
CUET UG 2027 subject mapping matters because a strong score may not fit every programme. If you skip a paper that a target course accepts or requires, that score may not help for that particular admission route. Check the exact university and programme before you submit your subject choices.

There’s an important limit to what can be stated now: the supplied evidence does not verify a CUET UG 2027 bulletin or a university’s 2027 subject table. So treat this as a planning check, not as a confirmed 2027 rule.

Why can the same CUET score work for one course but not another?

Participating universities publish their own programme conditions. These can cover accepted CUET domain papers, language papers, general tests and Class 12 subjects. A scorecard isn’t a universal pass for every course listed during preference filling.

For example, don’t assume that a paper accepted for one university’s economics programme will be accepted for another university’s economics programme. A named university and programme example can be published only after the relevant 2027 bulletin is available and checked. Until then, any fixed subject combination would be guesswork.

What should you check before choosing CUET papers?

Start with your actual targets, not a broad stream such as commerce or humanities. Make a separate row for every university-programme pair. Then run this mismatch test:

  1. Does the exact programme accept the domain paper you plan to select?
  2. Does it require a language paper, general test or another paper?
  3. Do its Class 12 subject conditions match your school subjects?
  4. Will the selected paper combination keep your strongest targets open?

Mark each row as “matches”, “needs confirmation” or “does not match”. Don’t treat a course remaining visible in a preference form as proof that you’re eligible. A university may apply its published conditions during its own admission or document checks, and a mismatch could make you ineligible for that programme.

How should you separate planning from final verification?

Now, list likely courses and identify the subjects you may need. Before submission, check the issued CUET instructions and every target university’s 2027 eligibility notice. The exam authority’s instructions govern the test application, while the concerned university’s bulletin governs programme conditions. Keep screenshots or downloaded copies of the pages you used.

When you later compare courses, match your scorecard to the exact eligibility wording again. If the 2027 notice changes your planned combination, stop and reassess before payment or final submission.

title: UPSC NDA 1 2025 Admit Card Released - Download Hall Ticket
description: UPSC has released the NDA 1 2025 admit card. Candidates can download their hall ticket from upsc.gov.in. Check exam date, timings, important instructions, and FAQs here.
content:
UPSC NDA 1 2025 Admit Card Released: Download Your Hall Ticket Now

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the admit cards for the National Defence Academy & Naval Academy Examination (NDA & NA) I, 2025, as of April 3, 2025. Candidates who have already registered for this prestigious examination can now download their hall tickets from the official UPSC website. The NDA 1 2025 examination is scheduled to take place on April 13, 2025, across various centers nationwide, aiming to fill 406 vacancies in the Army, Navy, and Air Force wings of the National Defence Academy and the Indian Naval Academy. ​

Examination Schedule:

  • Mathematics: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM​

  • General Ability Test (GAT): 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM​

Candidates are advised to reach their respective examination centers at least 30 minutes before the commencement of the exam. Late entry may not be permitted to enter the examination hall. ​

Steps to Download the NDA 1 2025 Admit Card:

  1. Visit the Official Website: Click on your web browser and go to upsc.gov.in.​

  2. Navigate to the Admit Card Section: On the homepage, locate the “What’s New” section or the “Examinations” tab and click on the link titled “E-Admit Card: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination (I), 2025.”​

  3. Access the Login Page: You will be redirected to a login page where you can choose to log in either “By Registration ID” or “By Roll Number.”​

  4. Enter Your Credentials: Input your Registration ID or Roll Number, along with your Date of Birth and the Captcha code displayed on the screen.​

  5. Download and Print: After submitting the required details, your admit card will be displayed. Carefully review all the information for accuracy, then download and print the admit card on A4-sized paper.​

Important Instructions for Candidates:

  • Mandatory Documents: On the day of the examination, candidates must carry a printed copy of their admit card along with a valid photo identification proof, such as an Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, Passport, or Driving License. If you are unable to present these documents, it may result in disqualification from the examination. ​

  • Technical Requirements: To avoid technical issues while downloading the admit card, it is recommended to use updated web browsers like Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox. ​

  • Verification of Details: After downloading, verify all details mentioned on the admit card, including your name, roll number, examination center, and timings. If any discrepancies are found, immediately contact the UPSC helpline at 011-23385271 or via email at usna-upsc@nic.in. ​

  • Prohibited Items: Electronic gadgets such as mobile phones, calculators, and any other communication devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. Candidates are advised not to bring any valuable items to the center, as the examination authority will not be responsible for their safekeeping. ​

  • Adherence to Guidelines: Follow all instructions provided by the examination authorities and adhere to the COVID-19 guidelines, if any, to ensure a smooth and safe examination process.​

For further updates and information, candidates should regularly check the official UPSC website. Proper preparation and adherence to the provided instructions will contribute to a seamless examination experience.

Team DekhoCampus wishes you all the best!

title: UGC इक्विटी रेगुलेशन पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट की रोक, नए नियमों पर देशभर में विरोध
description: UGC के नए इक्विटी रेगुलेशन पर सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने रोक लगा दी है। जानें छात्रों और शिक्षकों के विरोध की वजह, CJI की टिप्पणी और इसका उच्च शिक्षा पर क्या असर पड़ेगा।
content:
सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने UGC के नए इक्विटी (Equity) रेगुलेशन पर फिलहाल रोक लगा दी है। यह फैसला देशभर में छात्रों, शिक्षकों और शैक्षणिक संगठनों के विरोध के बीच आया है। नई नियमावली को लेकर आशंका जताई जा रही थी कि इसका गलत इस्तेमाल हो सकता है और इससे उच्च शिक्षा प्रणाली में असमानता बढ़ सकती है।

विश्वविद्यालय अनुदान आयोग (UGC) ने हाल ही में उच्च शिक्षा संस्थानों में समानता और प्रतिनिधित्व बढ़ाने के उद्देश्य से नए इक्विटी नियम जारी किए थे। हालांकि, इन नियमों के लागू होते ही कई छात्र संगठनों और शिक्षाविदों ने इसे अस्पष्ट और भ्रामक बताया।

सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने क्या कहा?

सुनवाई के दौरान मुख्य न्यायाधीश (CJI) ने कहा कि किसी भी नियम का उद्देश्य भले ही अच्छा हो, लेकिन यदि वह स्पष्ट नहीं है, तो उसका दुरुपयोग संभव है। अदालत ने यह भी कहा कि ऐसे नियम, जो लाखों छात्रों को प्रभावित करते हों, उन्हें लागू करने से पहले स्पष्टता और पारदर्शिता जरूरी है।

विरोध क्यों हो रहा है?

छात्रों और शिक्षकों का कहना है कि नए UGC इक्विटी नियमों से:

  • प्रवेश और नियुक्ति प्रक्रिया में भ्रम पैदा हो सकता है

  • संस्थानों को अत्यधिक विवेकाधिकार मिल सकता है

  • मेरिट आधारित व्यवस्था पर असर पड़ सकता है

  • विभिन्न वर्गों के बीच असमानता बढ़ सकती है

इसी वजह से कई जगहों पर प्रदर्शन और विरोध देखने को मिला।

इस रोक का क्या मतलब है?

सुप्रीम कोर्ट की रोक के बाद फिलहाल नए UGC इक्विटी नियम लागू नहीं होंगे। सभी विश्वविद्यालयों और कॉलेजों को पहले से लागू नियमों के अनुसार ही प्रवेश और प्रशासनिक प्रक्रियाएं जारी रखने को कहा गया है।

अदालत ने UGC से यह भी कहा है कि वह नियमों के उद्देश्य, सुरक्षा प्रावधानों और दुरुपयोग रोकने की व्यवस्था पर विस्तृत जवाब दाखिल करे।

आगे क्या होगा?

आने वाली सुनवाई में यह तय होगा कि ये नियम संशोधित किए जाएंगे, स्पष्ट किए जाएंगे या पूरी तरह वापस लिए जाएंगे। शिक्षा विशेषज्ञों का मानना है कि इस फैसले का उच्च शिक्षा नीति पर दूरगामी प्रभाव पड़ेगा।

निष्कर्ष

UGC इक्विटी रेगुलेशन विवाद ने एक बार फिर समानता और मेरिट के बीच संतुलन का सवाल खड़ा कर दिया है। सुप्रीम कोर्ट की दखल के बाद अब सभी की नजरें अगले फैसले पर टिकी हैं, जो भारत की उच्च शिक्षा व्यवस्था की दिशा तय करेगा।

title: KCET 2026: Complete counselling timeline and portal access steps
description: A practical guide for KCET 2026 counselling: key dates, portal access steps, document checklist, seat allotment process, and tips for smooth completion.
content:
Lead: Plan your KCET 2026 counselling now to secure a seat in time

KCET counselling in 2026 will follow a structured timeline with state admissions authorities handling registrations, choice filling, document verification, and seat allotment. Understanding the sequence helps families prepare early, avoid last‑minute stress, and ensure you meet all eligibility and document requirements.

What KCET counselling covers in 2026

The counselling process typically includes eligibility verification, choice filling for engineering and agriculture courses, seat allotment, and shifting/withdrawal options. Candidates may also need to complete document uploads, paying fees, and reporting to the allotted college. Always confirm the official counselling portal steps and deadlines on the competent authorities’ site, as the process and timelines can vary slightly year to year.

Key dates you should track

  • Registration window for counselling: opens after results are declared or as notified by the authority.
  • Document verification period: usually begins soon after registration closes.
  • Choice filling and locking: a fixed window; late submissions may not be accepted.
  • Seat allotment results: published in rounds; candidates must report to the allotted college within the specified period.
  • Reporting and document verification at the designated college: final admission validation.

Because official announcements can change, rely on the state admissions portal for the authoritative calendar and any supplementary notices. If you miss a date, there is often a limited window for corrections or extended rounds, but options are not guaranteed.

Portal access steps you can follow now

  1. Identify the official KCET counselling portal issued by the state authorities. Bookmark it on all devices used for study planning.
  2. Register with a valid email address and mobile number. Create a strong password and note the login details somewhere secure.
  3. Complete basic applicant information as required, including KCET hall ticket number, rank, and category.
  4. Verify your mobile number and email via the verification codes sent by the portal.
  5. Upload requested documents in the prescribed format and size. Common documents include mark sheets, identity proofs, birth certificate, category certificates (if applicable), domicile proof, and passport-size photographs. Keep scanned copies ready in advance.
  6. Continue to the eligibility screen to ensure you meet the criteria for engineering or agriculture programs you intend to apply for. If there is any discrepancy, contact the help desk promptly.
  7. Proceed to the choice filling stage. Create a short list of preferred branches and colleges, ordered by priority. Use available seat matrix and branch eligibility guidelines to inform decisions.
  8. Save and confirm your choices. Exit the portal only after you see a confirmation screen or receipt that your choices are recorded.
  9. Monitor the portal for seat allotment results and any further instructions. If allotted a seat, follow the reporting process and pay required fees within the deadline.

Tip: Use a desktop or laptop for better navigation during critical steps like document upload and choice locking. Keep a printed copy of your registration number, application details, and a screenshot of your submitted choices for reference.

Document preparation checklist

  • KCET admit card and mark sheets from the qualifying exam year
  • Category certificate (if applicable) and domicile/proof of residency
  • Identity proof (Aadhaar, passport, or other government ID as allowed)
  • Passport-size photographs (as per portal specifications)
  • Birth certificate or age proof
  • Bank challan or fee payment receipt (if required at the time of reporting)
  • Any special eligibility certificates (if applicable for certain categories or services)

Keep these documents in both digital and printed formats. Double-check file size, format, and naming conventions as specified by the portal to prevent upload failures.

Understanding seat allotment and reporting

Seat allotment in KCET counselling is usually done in rounds. Seats are allotted based on rank, choice order, and eligibility. After allotment, candidates must report to the allotted college within the specified window. This reporting typically includes document verification at the college, payment of admission fees, and confirmation of the seat. If you do not receive a desired seat, you may be eligible for subsequent rounds or mop-up rounds, depending on the authority’s rules in a given year. Stay alert to any changes announced on the portal and follow the instructions precisely to avoid losing a chance at admission.

Tips to navigate the process smoothly

  • Prepare a prioritized list of courses and colleges using a realistic assessment of fees, location, and career goals.
  • Regularly check the official portal for updates and any corrections to the schedule.
  • Keep a contingency plan for backup options in case your first choices do not secure a seat.
  • Coordinate with your school or coaching center to ensure your academic records are accurate and ready for verification.
  • If you encounter issues with the portal, use the helpline or official contact channels promptly to avoid missing deadlines.

Common questions about KCET 2026 counselling

FAQ 1: When will KCET 2026 counselling begin and how do I know the dates?

Counselling dates are announced by the state admissions authority and published on the official portal. Check the portal regularly after the results are declared for the exact schedule and round dates.

FAQ 2: What should I do if I miss a counselling date?

Missed dates may lead to penalties or loss of seat in that round. Look for any extended rounds announced by the authority and follow their instructions promptly on the official site.

FAQ 3: How many and which documents are required for verification?

Typical documents include identity proof, qualifying exam marks, domicile proof, category certificates (if applicable), birth certificate, and recent photos. The exact list is provided on the counselling portal during the document verification stage.

FAQ 4: Can I modify my choices after locking them?

Choice modification is usually allowed only within specific windows or in certain rounds. After final submission and a round is processed, changes may not be permitted. Refer to the official instructions for details.

FAQ 5: What should I do after being allotted a seat?

Report to the allotted college within the given timeframe, complete document verification, pay admission fees, and confirm your seat as directed by the college authorities.

FAQ 6: Where can I verify the status of my application and seat allotment?

Check the official counselling portal for real-time status updates on registration, document verification, choice filling, and seat allotment results. If needed, contact the helpline provided on the site for assistance.

title: UGC NET டிசம்பர் 2026 விண்ணப்பத் திருத்தம்: தேதிகளும் சரிபார்ப்பும்
description: விண்ணப்பத் திருத்தம் நவம்பர் 2 முதல் 4 வரை திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. மாற்ற அனுமதிக்கப்படும் விவரங்களையும் அக்டோபர் 31 விண்ணப்பக் காலக்கெடுவையும் அறியுங்கள்.
content:
UGC NET டிசம்பர் 2026 விண்ணப்பத்தில் தவறு உள்ளதா? NTA தகவல் கையேட்டின்படி இணையவழித் திருத்தம் நவம்பர் 2 முதல் 4, 2026 வரை நடைபெறத் திட்டமிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. கடைசி நாளில் இரவு 11:50 மணிக்கு அவகாசம் முடியும். திருத்த வசதி இன்னும் திறக்கப்படவில்லை. இப்போது சமர்ப்பித்த விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சான்றிதழ்களுடன் ஒப்பிட்டு, சரிசெய்ய வேண்டிய விவரங்களைக் குறித்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.

எல்லா விவரங்களையும் மாற்ற முடியாது

NTA அனுமதிக்கும் விவரங்களில் மட்டுமே மாற்றம் செய்யலாம் என்று அதிகாரப்பூர்வ கையேடு தெரிவிக்கிறது. பெயர், புகைப்படம், தொடர்பு விவரம் அல்லது வேறு பதிவு தானாகவே மாற்றக்கூடியதாகிவிடும் என்று கருதாதீர்கள். தேர்வர் தளத்தில் அந்தந்த விவரத்திற்கான வழிமுறைகளையும் கிடைக்கும் வசதிகளையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தகவல் கையேடு

தற்போதுள்ள பதிவு, சரியான பதிவு, அதற்கான ஆதார ஆவணம் ஆகியவற்றை எழுதிவையுங்கள். சுருக்கமான, தெளிவான பட்டியல் இருந்தால் திருத்த வசதி திறக்கும்போது விண்ணப்பத்தை விரைவாகச் சரிபார்க்கலாம்.

விண்ணப்பச் சமர்ப்பிப்பும் திருத்தமும் வேறு

அக்டோபர் 27 நீட்டிப்பு அறிவிப்பின்படி விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பிப்பதும் கட்டணத்தை வெற்றிகரமாகச் செலுத்துவதும் அக்டோபர் 31 இரவு 11:50 மணி வரை தாமதக் கட்டணமின்றி செய்யலாம். கையேட்டின் மற்ற நிபந்தனைகள் மாறவில்லை. பின்னர் வரும் திருத்தக் காலம், முடிக்காத விண்ணப்பத்தைச் சமர்ப்பிக்கக் கூடுதல் அவகாசம் அல்ல.

அக்டோபர் 27 நீட்டிப்பு அறிவிப்பு

கையேட்டில் நவம்பர் 2 முதல் 4 வரை திருத்தம் என்றும் கடைசி நேரம் இரவு 11:50 என்றும் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளது. அடுத்த அறிவிப்புகளுக்கும் தேர்வர் உள்நுழைவுக்கும் அதிகாரப்பூர்வ UGC NET இணையதளத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ UGC NET இணையதளம்

NTA UGC NET டிசம்பர் 2026 தகவல் கையேடு, அச்சிடப்பட்ட பக்கம் 4: திட்டமிடப்பட்ட இணையவழித் திருத்தக் காலம். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ தகவல் கையேடு

சேமித்த மாற்றங்களை மீண்டும் பாருங்கள்

திருத்த வசதி கிடைத்த பிறகு இறுதியாகச் சேமித்த விவரங்களை உங்கள் பட்டியலுடன் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். பொத்தானை அழுத்தியதாலேயே மாற்றம் முடிந்துவிட்டதாகக் கருத வேண்டாம். விண்ணப்பத்தை மீண்டும் திறந்து திருத்தப்பட்ட தகவல்களைப் படித்து, தளம் வழங்கும் புதுப்பிக்கப்பட்ட உறுதிப்படுத்தலைச் சேமியுங்கள்.

மாற்ற வேண்டிய விவரம் பூட்டப்பட்டிருந்தால் காட்டப்படும் செய்தியைக் குறித்துவைத்து அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இணையதள உதவி மையத்தைத் தொடர்புகொள்ளுங்கள். சிக்கலை விளக்குங்கள்; கடவுச்சொல் அல்லது OTP-ஐ பகிர வேண்டாம். அங்கீகாரமற்ற முகவர் மூலம் திருத்தம் அனுப்ப வேண்டாம். உதவி கோரிக்கை அனுப்பியதாலேயே விண்ணப்பம் மாறிவிடாது. முடிக்காத விண்ணப்பத்திற்கு படிவம் மற்றும் கட்டணச் சரிபார்ப்புப் பட்டியலையும் கேமரா சிக்கலுக்கு நேரடி புகைப்பட வழிகாட்டியையும் படிக்கலாம்.

விண்ணப்பம் மற்றும் கட்டணச் சரிபார்ப்புப் பட்டியல் · நேரடி புகைப்பட வழிகாட்டி

title: ಉತ್ತರಾಖಂಡ ನರ್ಸಿಂಗ್ 2026: ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ, ಅಂತಿಮ ಕೀ ಮತ್ತು ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ
description: ಉತ್ತರಾಖಂಡ ನರ್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತಿಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೀಯನ್ನು ಎಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಬೇಕು? ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ತೆರಳುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.
content:
ಉತ್ತರಾಖಂಡ ನರ್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಸೀಟು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಬೇಕು. 2026ರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ವಾರು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಹಾಗೂ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೀಗಳಿವೆ. ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತುವಾರು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ವಿವರಗಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಕೇವಲ ಅಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ರ‍್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಬಂದರೆ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಖಚಿತವಾದಂತಲ್ಲ.

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ನ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ

HNBUMU ವೆಬ್‌ಸೈಟ್‌ನಿಂದ Nursing/Paramedical Entrance Examinations 2026 ಲಿಂಕ್ ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ. ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನ Result ಮೆನುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಆರಿಸಿ. BSc Nursing, Post Basic Nursing, MSc Nursing, ANM ಮತ್ತು GNMಗಳಿಗೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಿವೆ. ಪ್ಯಾರಾಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ಗಳನ್ನೂ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ.

ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯದ 18 ಜುಲೈ 2026ರ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಸೂಚನೆ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳು ತಮ್ಮ ಲಾಗಿನ್ ಮೂಲಕ 20 ಜುಲೈ 2026ರಿಂದ ಅಂಕ ಅಥವಾ ರ‍್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಇದು ಜುಲೈನ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆ; ಅಕ್ಟೋಬರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊಸ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಬಂದಿರುವ ಸೂಚನೆ ಅಲ್ಲ. ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿದ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ಅರ್ಜಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

HNBUMUಯ 18 ಜುಲೈ 2026ರ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಸೂಚನೆ. ಇದರಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಜುಲೈ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲ. ಮೂಲ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಸೂಚನೆ

ಪಟ್ಟಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಸರನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನೋಡದೆ ರೋಲ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ. ಮೊಬೈಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ PDF ಖಾಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಂಡರೆ ಡೌನ್‌ಲೋಡ್ ಮಾಡಿ PDF ರೀಡರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಡುಕಿ. ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ತೆಗೆಯುವುದಾಗಿ ಹೇಳುವವರಿಗೆ ಲಾಗಿನ್ ವಿವರ ಅಥವಾ OTP ನೀಡಬೇಡಿ.

ಅಂತಿಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೀ ಮತ್ತು ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಣೆಯ ಗಡುವು

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನ Answer Key ಮೆನುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ. ಉತ್ತರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಸೆಟ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ. ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಅಂತಿಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಕೀಗಳನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಿರುವುದಾಗಿ ಜುಲೈ ಸೂಚನೆ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

ಹಳೆಯ ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಣೆ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ ಈಗಲೂ ತೆರೆದಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ. ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಕುರಿತು ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು 22 ಜುಲೈ 2026 ಸಂಜೆ 5 ಗಂಟೆ ಗಡುವಾಗಿತ್ತು. ಅದು ಈಗ ಮುಗಿದಿದೆ. ಹಳೆಯ PDF ಇನ್ನೂ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವುದು ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಣೆಯ ಅವಧಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆರಂಭವಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಾಕ್ಷಿಯಲ್ಲ.

ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ತೆರಳುವ ಮೊದಲು ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ನರ್ಸಿಂಗ್ ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ಯಾರಾಮೆಡಿಕಲ್ ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರನೇ ಸುತ್ತಿನ ಕೋರ್ಸ್‌ವಾರು ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ವಿಸ್ತೃತ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಯ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳಿವೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ದಾಖಲೆಗಾಗಿ Applicant Login ಬಳಸಿ. ಆ ಸುತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಓದಿ.

ಹೊಸ stray-vacancy ಸುತ್ತಿನ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿ ದೃಢಪಟ್ಟಿಲ್ಲ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಸುತ್ತು ತೆರೆದಿದೆ ಎಂಬ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಬಂದರೆ ದಿನಾಂಕವಿರುವ ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯದ ಸೂಚನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ದಾಖಲೆಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ. ಹರಿದಾಡುವ ಸ್ಕ್ರೀನ್‌ಶಾಟ್ ಆಧರಿಸಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಸಬೇಡಿ ಅಥವಾ ಕಾಲೇಜಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಪಾವತಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

  • ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲೇಜನ್ನು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

  • ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುವ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸೂಚನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಜರಾಗುವ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ.

  • ಅಗತ್ಯ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೂಲ ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

  • ಹಣ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕಾಲೇಜುವಾರು ಶುಲ್ಕ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.

  • ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಳಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಹಂತದ ಸ್ವೀಕೃತಿ ಪತ್ರವನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಮತ್ತು ಕೌನ್ಸೆಲಿಂಗ್ ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವಿದ್ದರೆ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪೋರ್ಟಲ್ ಮೂಲಕ ವಿಶ್ವವಿದ್ಯಾಲಯವನ್ನು ಸಂಪರ್ಕಿಸಿ ಕೋರ್ಸ್, ಸುತ್ತು ಮತ್ತು ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಸಿ. ಮುಂದಿನ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಈಗಿನ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಕೈಗೊಳ್ಳಿ; ಹಳೆಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಸೂಚನೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವನ್ನು ಆಧರಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

title: After Class 12, Is Dietetics or Optometry the Better Fit?
description: Compare dietetics and optometry after Class 12 on eligibility, study load, practical work, cost checks and early career settings.
content:
Dietetics and optometry courses after Class 12 suit science students who want health-related work, but they lead to very different routines. Dietetics is built around food assessment, nutrition plans and repeated counselling. Optometry involves eye testing, optics, instruments and precise patient measurements. Choose the daily work first, not the course title.

Shortlist colleges through explore courses, then compare the qualification, practical hours, internship arrangement and total fee. A familiar hospital name doesn't guarantee hands-on training.

Dietetics and optometry courses after Class 12: which daily work suits you?

Dietetics may fit you if you enjoy Biology, food science, record-keeping and patient conversations that continue over several visits. Optometry may fit you better if you prefer anatomy, Physics, instruments and structured testing. Both require practical exposure and patient confidence, so neither should be treated as an easy alternative to other health courses.

Decision pointDieteticsOptometry
Core studyHuman nutrition, biochemistry, food science and diet planningOcular anatomy, optics, refraction and eye-care procedures
Practical workFood-history assessment, meal planning and progress trackingVision testing, equipment handling and clinical assistance
Patient contactLonger counselling and follow-up discussionsShorter, technical consultations with measurements
Early settingsHospitals, clinics, wellness centres and food servicesEye hospitals, optical centres, clinics and community programmes
Main pressurePatients may struggle to follow a planMeasurement errors can affect lens or vision advice

What must science students check before applying?

Eligibility is set by the individual institution, not by the course label alone. Many undergraduate routes ask for Class 12 science subjects, but Biology, Chemistry, Physics, English, marks and entrance conditions can differ. A nutrition degree, dietetics degree and allied-health programme may not offer the same training or job route.

  • Read the college's exact eligibility clause and admission method.
  • Ask where supervised practice occurs: a hospital, clinic, laboratory or classroom.
  • Compare tuition with examination charges, equipment, uniform, transport and internship costs.
  • Check the qualification awarded and employer requirements in the state where you plan to work.

For dietetics, revise digestion, metabolism and human physiology, then turn a sample food diary into a sensible meal plan. For optometry, practise ray diagrams, basic calculations and eye-anatomy labelling. This small exercise can expose whether you enjoy counselling or measurement-based clinical work.

Which course is the safer career choice?

There isn't one universal winner. Choose dietetics if you can listen patiently and explain behaviour change without quick results. Choose optometry if you prefer instruments, visual accuracy and structured tasks. Before applying for Dietetics and optometry courses after Class 12, compare colleges on supervised practical hours, faculty, internship access and total cost through compare colleges. The college's current prospectus is the final word on eligibility and fees.

title: NPAT 2027: தேதிகளுக்கு முன் சரியான படிப்பையும் வளாகத்தையும் தேர்வு செய்யுங்கள்
description: NMIMS NPAT 2027 பக்கத்தில் படிப்புகளைப் பாருங்கள். விண்ணப்ப தேதி, கட்டணம், தகுதி ஆகியவற்றை முடிவு செய்வதற்கு முன் அந்தச் சேர்க்கை ஆண்டுக்கான அதிகாரப்பூர்வ கையேட்டைச் சரிபாருங்கள்.
content:
NPAT 2027க்காகத் தயாராகிறீர்கள் என்றால், முதலில் உங்களுக்கு ஏற்ற படிப்பையும் NMIMS வளாகத்தையும் தேர்வு செய்யுங்கள். அதிகாரப்பூர்வ இணையப் பக்கத்தில் 2027 என்ற தலைப்பு உள்ளது. ஆனால் இணைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள சேர்க்கைக் கையேடு 2026-27 கல்வியாண்டுக்கானது. எனவே 2027 விண்ணப்பக் காலம், கட்டணம், தேர்வு தேதிகள் உறுதியானதாக அந்தப் பழைய ஆவணத்தை எடுத்துக்கொள்ள வேண்டாம்.

எந்தப் படிப்புகளை ஒப்பிடலாம்?

அதிகாரப்பூர்வப் பட்டியலில் BBA, B.Com., B.Sc. Finance, BBA FinTech, ஒருங்கிணைந்த BBA-MBA, B.Sc. Economics மற்றும் BA Liberal Arts உள்ளன. Branding and Advertising, International Business, Management and Marketing, Finance போன்ற சிறப்புப் பிரிவுகளுடன் BBA படிப்புகளும் இடம்பெறுகின்றன. படிப்புப் பெயர் மட்டும் பார்த்து விண்ணப்பிப்பதைவிட அதன் பாடத்திட்டத்தைப் படிப்பது நல்ல தொடக்கம்.

மும்பை, பெங்களூரு, நவி மும்பை, ஹைதராபாத், இந்தூர், சண்டிகர், அகமதாபாத் ஆகிய வளாகங்கள் பக்கத்தில் குறிப்பிடப்பட்டுள்ளன. எல்லாப் படிப்புகளும் எல்லா வளாகங்களிலும் இருக்கும் என்று பொருள் கொள்ள வேண்டாம். நீங்கள் விரும்பும் படிப்பு எந்த வளாகத்தில் வழங்கப்படுகிறது என்பதை அந்தப் படிப்பின் அதிகாரப்பூர்வத் தகவலில் உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ NPAT படிப்புகள் பக்கம்

கையேட்டில் உள்ள கல்வியாண்டு ஏன் முக்கியம்?

Admissions Handout மற்றும் Important Dates இணைப்புகள் 2026-27 ஆவணத்திற்கே செல்கின்றன. இணையப் பக்கத்தின் 2027 தலைப்பையும் PDF ஆவணத்தின் கல்வியாண்டையும் தனித்தனியாகப் பார்க்க வேண்டும். பழைய கட்டணம் அல்லது கடைசித் தேதியை புதிய சேர்க்கைக்குப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டாம். தெளிவாக 2027 சுழற்சியைக் குறிப்பிடும் கையேடும் அட்டவணையும் வரும் வரை அந்த விவரங்கள் உறுதிப்படுத்தப்படவில்லை.

SVKM’s NMIMS 2026-27 சேர்க்கைக் கையேட்டின் முதல் பக்கத் தலைப்பு. இந்தப் பகுதியில் தனியான வெளியீட்டுத் தேதி இல்லை. இது 2027 தேர்வு அட்டவணை அல்ல. அசல் 2026-27 சேர்க்கைக் கையேடு

விருப்பப் பட்டியலை இப்போதே தயாரிக்கலாம்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ FAQ அதிகபட்சம் ஐந்து படிப்புகளைத் தேர்வு செய்யலாம் எனக் குறிப்பிடுகிறது. அதற்குள் உங்கள் விருப்பங்களை ஒழுங்குபடுத்துங்கள்; 2027 விண்ணப்பத்தில் வரும் விதிகளை மீண்டும் உறுதிசெய்யுங்கள். ஒவ்வொரு விருப்பத்திற்கும் படிப்பு, வளாகம், தகுதி, பிளஸ் 2 பாடங்கள், கணிதம் அல்லது புள்ளியியல் நிபந்தனை உள்ளதா, பாடத்திட்டம், இடம் மற்றும் செலவு ஆகியவற்றை எழுதிவையுங்கள்.

Finance படிப்பை விரும்பினால் அதன் கணக்கியல் மற்றும் அளவியல் உள்ளடக்கத்தைப் பாருங்கள். Management அல்லது Liberal Arts விருப்பங்களில் பாடங்களையும் சிறப்புப் பிரிவுகளையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒத்த பெயர்களுள்ள இரண்டு படிப்புகளுக்கும் ஒரே தகுதி இருக்கும் என்று எண்ண வேண்டாம். உங்கள் பள்ளிப் பாடங்கள் பொருந்துகிறதா, எந்த நுழைவுத் தேர்வு வழி பொருந்தும், வளாக விருப்பம் எப்படி பதிவு செய்யப்படும் என்ற சந்தேகங்களை NMIMS சேர்க்கைப் பிரிவிடம் கேளுங்கள்.

விசாரணை படிவமும் விண்ணப்பமும் ஒன்றல்ல

விவரம் கேட்கும் படிவம் அல்லது திரும்ப அழைக்கக் கோரும் படிவத்தை நிரப்புவது NPAT தேர்வுப் பதிவை முடிப்பதில்லை. அந்தச் சுழற்சிக்கான விண்ணப்பம், கட்டணம், தேவையான தேர்வு முன்பதிவு குறித்த அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அறிவுறுத்தல்களைப் பின்பற்ற வேண்டும். அவை திறக்கப்பட்டதாகத் தெளிவான உறுதி கிடைத்த பிறகே செயல்படுங்கள்; சமர்ப்பிப்பு ஒப்புகையையும் பணம் செலுத்திய ரசீதையும் வைத்துக்கொள்ளுங்கள்.

புதிய கையேடு வந்ததும் படிப்புப் பெயர்கள், பாடத் தகுதி, கட்டணம், தேர்வு மற்றும் தேர்வுசெய்யும் நடைமுறையின் தேதிகளை மீண்டும் சரிபாருங்கள். இப்போது செய்யக்கூடிய நடைமுறை வேலை, சரியான படிப்பு-வளாகப் பட்டியலை உருவாக்குவதுதான்.

title: NEP 2020 in BSc Agriculture: How Multiple Entry-Exit Options Are Restructuring Agribusiness Education
description: Explore how the NEP 2020 multiple entry-exit model in BSc Agriculture provides flexibility, reduces drop-out risks, and prepares Indian students for agribusiness careers.
content:
The implementation of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020 across higher education institutes in India has brought a structural transformation to agricultural education. Traditionally, undergraduate programs like BSc Agriculture followed rigid four-year curricula with limited options for students facing financial, personal, or career adjustments. Under the modernized NEP framework, state agricultural universities and affiliated institutes are rolling out flexible curriculum pathways designed to align scientific farming knowledge with modern agribusiness demands.

Central to this reform is the Multiple Entry and Exit System (MEES). This framework empowers students to customize their academic journeys, gain industry-relevant certifications, and re-enter higher education without losing earned academic credits.

Understanding the Multiple Entry-Exit Pathways in BSc Agriculture

The restructured curriculum divides the four-year undergraduate program into clear progression levels, each awarding a distinct academic credential based on completed credit requirements:

  • First Year Exit (Undergraduate Certificate in Agriculture): Students who exit after completing the first year (around 40 credits) alongside a mandatory summer skill internship receive a Certificate in Agricultural Science or Agribusiness Skills. This credential equips learners with foundational knowledge in soil health, crop propagation, and basic farm inputs.
  • Second Year Exit (Undergraduate Diploma in Agriculture): Exiting after two years (around 80 credits) awards a Diploma. Students gain practical experience in crop protection, farm machinery operations, seed technology, and elementary agribusiness economics, qualifying them for technical support roles in rural supply chains.
  • Third Year Exit (Bachelor of Science in Agriculture): Completing three years (around 120 credits) earns a general Bachelor's degree. Graduates hold a foundational science qualification suitable for administrative roles, competitive civil services examinations, and general agribusiness operations.
  • Fourth Year Completion (BSc Honours / Honours with Research): Students completing the full four-year track (around 160 credits) receive an Honours degree. The fourth year emphasizes advanced research, intensive practical field learning (such as Rural Agricultural Work Experience), and specialized training in areas like modern precision farming, agritech, and post-harvest technology.

How Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) Enables Lifelong Learning

The Multiple Entry-Exit System is supported by the Academic Bank of Credits (ABC). ABC operates as a digital repository storing academic credits earned by students throughout their higher education journey. If a student chooses to exit after the second year to work at an agricultural cooperative or launch an agritech venture, their accumulated credits remain secure in the ABC system.

When the student decides to complete their degree later, they can re-enter their previous institution or transfer credits to another accredited university. This mechanism eliminates the penalty of repeating completed coursework, transforming agricultural learning into a modular experience.

Key Benefits for Students and Parents

The adoption of NEP 2020 guidelines in agricultural education resolves long-standing concerns for both students and parents across India:

  • Mitigating Financial and Personal Risks: Students facing unexpected socio-economic constraints no longer drop out empty-handed. Leaving after one or two years yields a valid certificate or diploma that aids immediate employment.
  • Integration of Agribusiness and Technology: Modern agricultural education goes beyond traditional crop cultivation. The curriculum incorporates modules on agricultural data analytics, cold-chain logistics, supply chain management, and food processing, opening doors to high-growth corporate sectors.
  • Enhanced Practical Exposure: Hands-on training, field attachments, and industry internships are integrated at every exit level, ensuring students possess employment-ready practical skills.
  • Direct Pathway to Higher Research: Students who complete the four-year BSc (Honours with Research) build a strong foundation for direct admission into Ph.D. programs or specialized Master's degrees in agribusiness administration.

Expanding Career Opportunities in Modern Agribusiness

Agricultural education in India is shifting from traditional farming instruction to managing corporate agricultural enterprises and technology-driven supply networks. Students exiting with certificates or diplomas can secure employment as field technicians, seed quality analysts, input sales specialists, or farm supervisors.

Four-year degree graduates are prepared for strategic roles such as agribusiness managers, agritech product managers, agricultural loan officers in banking sectors, and quality compliance managers in export firms. The flexibility allows students to alternate between gainful employment and higher academic specializations as their career goals evolve.

Guidelines for Students and Parents Before Seeking Admission

While the NEP 2020 framework provides unprecedented flexibility, implementation timelines can vary among institutions. Parents and students are advised to check the following parameters before selecting a college:

  • Confirm whether the university has fully implemented the Academic Bank of Credits framework.
  • Verify the institutional accreditation and affiliation status with relevant national regulatory bodies.
  • Review the specific credit structure and practical internship facilities offered at each exit level.
  • Check official academic notices published on target university websites for up-to-date eligibility rules regarding re-entry into upper-year semesters.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

1. Can a student who exits after the first year re-enter the degree program at a different university?

Yes, provided both institutions are registered under the Academic Bank of Credits framework and the receiving university accepts the transferred credits based on its admission guidelines. Students should verify individual university transfer regulations.

2. Is the four-year BSc Agriculture degree mandatory for applying to postgraduate agribusiness programs?

While many MBA in Agribusiness Management programs accept three-year bachelor's degrees, specific specialized master's programs or research tracks may require a four-year undergraduate honours degree. Applicants must verify requirements on the official website of the destination university.

3. Does exiting after Year 1 or Year 2 impact future career prospects negatively?

No. The multiple exit options provide formal, recognized qualifications (Certificates and Diplomas) that showcase certified practical skills to employers in input supply, retail, and farm operations.

4. How does the credit transfer process function when resuming studies?

Credits earned during completed semesters are digitally stored in the student's ABC account. Upon re-applying to an accredited college, the institution evaluates the stored credits and places the candidate into the appropriate semester.

title: VITEEE 2027 Exam Pattern: Questions, Marks & Structure
description: Discover the revised VITEEE 2027 exam pattern. Learn about the total questions, 500-mark structure, negative marking scheme, and time duration for the CBT.
content:
For engineering aspirants targeting the Vellore Institute of Technology, understanding the specific mechanics of the entrance test is the most critical step in preparation. The Vellore Institute of Technology will release the VIT 2027 exam pattern on its official website along with the official notification.

The paper pattern has been revised, significantly shifting how candidates must approach the test by introducing negative marking. A thorough grasp of this updated 500-mark structure will dictate your speed, accuracy, and overall strategy during the computer-based test.

Mode and Medium of the Examination

Before diving into the subjects, it is important to understand the testing environment.

  • Exam Mode: The examination will be conducted exclusively as an online computer-based test (CBT).

  • Medium: The question paper will be presented in English only.

  • Duration: Candidates will have a total of 2.5 hours (150 minutes) to complete the test.

  • Sectional Limits: There is no sectional time limit, giving students the freedom to navigate between subjects as they prefer.

Subject-Wise Question Breakdown

The VITEEE evaluates candidates across five distinct sections: Maths/Biology, Physics, Chemistry, English, and Aptitude. The test consists of a total of 125 questions.

The distribution of these 125 questions is strictly categorized as follows:

  • Maths / Biology: 40 questions.

  • Physics: 35 questions.

  • Chemistry: 35 questions.

  • Aptitude: 10 questions.

  • English: 5 questions.

Revised Marking Scheme: The Impact of Negative Marking

The most crucial update to the VITEEE is its evaluation metrics. The exam carries a maximum of 500 Total Marks. Because the paper pattern has been revised introducing negative marking, blind guessing is now a highly risky strategy.

  • Correct Answers: Candidates are awarded 4 marks for every correct answer.

  • Incorrect Answers: A penalty of -1 mark is enforced for every wrong answer.

  • Unattempted Questions: Questions left blank will receive 0 marks.

Strategic Preparation and Tracking

Navigating 125 complex questions within 150 minutes requires extreme precision, especially with the newly introduced -1 penalty for incorrect answers. Candidates must prioritize accuracy over attempting every single question on the screen. Since there is no sectional time limit, a smart strategy is to clear the fact-based Chemistry, English, and Aptitude sections rapidly to save the bulk of the time for calculation-heavy Physics and Mathematics.

Conclusion

The VITEEE 2027 exam pattern demands a highly disciplined preparation strategy. With 125 total questions spanning five sections and a rigid 500-mark evaluation structure, candidates can no longer rely on guesswork. Prepare thoroughly for the online CBT environment, respect the 150-minute time constraint, and focus your daily practice on achieving high accuracy to secure your desired B.Tech branch at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

title: IIFT MBA 2027-29: CATతో పాటు ప్రత్యేక దరఖాస్తు నవంబర్ 25లోపు చేయాలి
description: IIFT CAT 2026 స్కోర్ వాడుతుంది. కానీ MBA ఫారం, ఫీజు, గడువు వేరు. IB, బిజినెస్ అనలిటిక్స్ దరఖాస్తు ఛార్జీలు చూడండి.
content:
CATకు రిజిస్టర్ చేస్తే IIFT MBA దరఖాస్తు పూర్తికాదు. 2027-29 ప్రవేశాలకు ఇండియన్ ఇన్‌స్టిట్యూట్ ఆఫ్ ఫారిన్ ట్రేడ్ ప్రత్యేక ఆన్‌లైన్ ఫారం, దరఖాస్తు ఫీజును 25 నవంబర్ 2026లోపు సమర్పించాలి. షార్ట్‌లిస్టింగ్, ఎంపికకు IIFT CAT 2026 స్కోర్‌తో పాటు ఇతర నిర్దేశిత ప్రమాణాలను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

చెల్లింపుకు ముందు కోర్సు ఎంచుకోండి

అధికారిక ప్రవేశ పేజీలో 2027-29 ప్రాస్పెక్టస్, దరఖాస్తు సూచనలు, రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ పోర్టల్ లింకులు ఉన్నాయి. MBA ఇంటర్నేషనల్ బిజినెస్ (IB), MBA బిజినెస్ అనలిటిక్స్ (BA), లేదా రెండింటికీ దరఖాస్తు చేయాలా నిర్ణయించుకోండి. ఫారంలో కోర్సువారీ సూచనలు పాటించండి.

IIFT అధికారిక ప్రవేశ పేజీ

ఇవి దరఖాస్తు ఫీజులు, ట్యూషన్ ఫీజులు కావు. చెల్లించిన దరఖాస్తు ఫీజు తిరిగి ఇవ్వరని ప్రాస్పెక్టస్ చెబుతోంది.

ఇండియన్ ఇన్‌స్టిట్యూట్ ఆఫ్ ఫారిన్ ట్రేడ్, MBA 2027-29 ప్రాస్పెక్టస్, పేజీ 38. ఈ పేజీలో ప్రత్యేక విడుదల తేదీ ముద్రించలేదు. అధికారిక ప్రాస్పెక్టస్ తెరవండి

దరఖాస్తు గడువు, CAT పరీక్ష తేదీ వేరు

ప్రాస్పెక్టస్ ప్రకారం IIFT ఫారం, ఫీజు చివరి తేదీ 25 నవంబర్ 2026; CAT పరీక్ష 29 నవంబర్ 2026. IIFTకు దరఖాస్తు చేయడానికి పరీక్ష పూర్తయ్యే వరకు వేచి ఉండవద్దు. పూర్తి చేసిన ఫారం, చెల్లింపు ధ్రువీకరణ భద్రపరచి కోర్సు, వర్గం సరిగ్గా ఉన్నాయో చూడండి.

CAT సన్నద్ధతకు ఈ జాబితా చూడండి. ప్రత్యేక MBA దరఖాస్తుకు IIFT ప్రవేశ పోర్టల్ వాడండి.

CAT 2026 అడ్మిట్ కార్డు తనిఖీ జాబితా

సరైన ప్రవేశ సంవత్సరపు అర్హత చూడండి

ప్రాస్పెక్టస్ 36, 37 పేజీల్లో IB, BA అర్హతలు వేర్వేరుగా ఉన్నాయి. అర్హత పరీక్ష రాస్తున్న వారు అవసరమైన అర్హత రుజువును సమర్పించే చివరి తేదీ 31 అక్టోబర్ 2027. చెల్లింపుకు ముందు ఎంచుకున్న కోర్సు వివరాలు, ముఖ్యంగా BA గణిత అర్హతలు చదవండి.

ఫారంలో నమోదు చేసిన వర్గాన్ని మార్చలేరు. వర్తించే వర్గ ధ్రువపత్రాన్ని అప్‌లోడ్ చేసి ఫారం పూర్తిగా తనిఖీ చేయండి; అసంపూర్ణ దరఖాస్తులు తిరస్కరించవచ్చు. రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ సమస్య ఉంటే ప్రాస్పెక్టస్‌లో ఇచ్చిన ప్రవేశ కార్యాలయానికి వ్యక్తిగత ఈమెయిల్ పంపండి. CAT రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ నంబర్, IIFT దరఖాస్తు నంబర్, రిజిస్టర్డ్ ఈమెయిల్ వివరాలు ఇవ్వండి.

ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਲੱਭੋ

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5, 9 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 008, 108 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿੰਧੀ (008) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 27 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Language and Literature (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿੰਧੀ (108) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 3 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Core (301) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 5 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 2 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਜਾਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ

ਪੇਪਰ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਣ ਦਾ ਆਖ਼ਰੀ ਸਮਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਹਾਜ਼ਰੀ, ਦਾਖ਼ਲਾ ਤੇ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਵੇਖੋ। ਬਦਲਾਅ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਬਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਸੋਧੇ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਮਾਤ, ਕੋਡ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: CSAB Special Rounds: When the Extra Fee Is Worth the Upgrade
description: Should you join CSAB after JoSAA? Compare a possible new seat with fees, withdrawal risk, reporting duties and the cost of leaving your current admission.
content:
CSAB special rounds are worth considering only if you would genuinely choose at least one listed option over your current JoSAA seat and can accept the financial and seat-related consequences stated for that counselling year. This isn’t a guaranteed branch upgrade. You may receive a different eligible seat, depending on your choices, available vacancies and the applicable round rules.

If no CSAB option appears, can you still live with your present NIT, IIIT or other eligible institute seat? If the answer is no, don’t pay first and think later. Make a backup plan before you enter.

What is the real decision after accepting a JoSAA seat?

The key issue is seat control. Whether you can retain, surrender or otherwise affect your JoSAA seat depends on the exact action you take and the rules in force for that CSAB and JoSAA cycle. Registration, payment, choice submission, allotment acceptance and institute reporting may not have the same effect.

The Central Seat Allocation Board’s applicable information brochure and fee notice must decide this point. Treat general counselling advice as interpretation, not as a rule. A missed payment, withdrawal step or reporting requirement can change your admission position.

When does the possible move make financial sense?

Compare the whole change, not just a branch name or institute ranking. A new seat is worth the risk only when its academic fit and personal value are clearly higher than what you already hold.

Cost or riskWhat to checkWhy it matters
Counselling paymentRefundable or non-refundable terms in the year’s noticeYou may lose this amount even without joining a new institute.
Institute chargesAdmission fee, deposit, hostel and mess paymentThese are separate from the CSAB payment and may follow different refund rules.
Travel and relocationVisits, transport, documents and moving costsA small branch change can become an expensive switch.
Current seatEffect of every CSAB or JoSAA actionYou must know what you may give up before submitting.

What should you do before paying?

  1. Write down your current institute, branch, category and seat status.
  2. List only choices you would actually join, not options chosen for prestige.
  3. Read the applicable CSAB notice for eligibility, payment, withdrawal, seat acceptance and reporting.
  4. Keep certificates, identity proof and payment records ready.
  5. Save the relevant notice and check the latest instructions before each submission.

The practical test is simple: if the possible seat isn’t clearly preferable, and losing money or disturbing your current admission would hurt, keeping the JoSAA seat may be the safer decision.

Before you lock the next step, compare entrance exams against the options you have shortlisted.

title: NEET 2027 counselling: central and state portal deadlines explained
description: Understand the key deadlines for NEET 2027 counselling across central and state portals, what they mean for students and parents, and how to prepare a timeline to secure seats.
content:
Clear deadlines, clear path: what NEET 2027 counselling requires now

For students preparing to join medical or dental courses in 2027, understanding the counselling timelines is as crucial as cracking the exam itself. Central and state portals operate on distinct schedules, and missing a window can delay admission by a full academic year. This article breaks down the deadlines, the steps to take, and practical timelines to keep you on track.

Why counselling timelines matter

NEETeligibility is not the final hurdle. After results, the admission offers come through counselling rounds conducted by central and state authorities. Each portal has its own registration, choice filling, and seat allotment cycles. Being aware of exact dates helps families allocate time for document preparation, mock registrations, and correction windows.

Central counselling: what to expect and when

Central counselling typically handles specific national-level seats, including certain medical and dental programs, and sometimes seats for national institutes. Key steps often include:

  • Registration on the central counselling portal within the announced window
  • Document verification and choice filling for preferred colleges and courses
  • Allotment results released on scheduled dates, followed by reporting to the allotted institute
  • Reporting and admission confirmation within the specified deadline

Important reminders for central counselling:

  • Keep your contact details and email address consistent across all documents to receive timely updates.
  • Ensure your NEET final score, rank, and category certificates are ready for verification.
  • Be prepared for immediate payment of required fees to secure the seat after allotment.

State counselling: variations by region

State counselling is run by state authorities and sometimes by corresponding state universities or boards. Each state may have multiple rounds, including mop-up rounds, special rounds for management and NRI seats, and in some cases, exam-based preferences. Typical state counselling steps include:

  • State or union territory portal registration during the stated window
  • Option entry, locking, and seat preference selection
  • Seat allotment lists announced in several rounds (Round 1, Round 2, mop-up)
  • Mandatory reporting to the allotted college and completion of admission formalities

Key considerations for state counselling:

  • Dates differ from state to state; some states align with the national timeline, others publish earlier or later windows.
  • Private colleges within a state may have separate processes or fees in addition to government quotas.
  • Many states require verification of documents at designated centers; plan travel accordingly.

How to align central and state timelines

To avoid missing opportunities, create a single, consolidated calendar that captures both central and state deadlines. Here’s a practical approach:

  • Mark the announced registration start and end dates for the central portal in your family calendar.
  • List each state’s counselling start dates if available, and add their last submission date for applications.
  • Prepare the document set (class 10 and 12 marks sheets, NEET admit card, category certificate, domicile certificate, birth certificate, passport-sized photographs) and keep both digital and hard copies ready.
  • Reserve a block of time for application submission and document verification on each portal to prevent last-minute delays.
  • Set reminders for fee payment deadlines and reporting dates after allotment.

Documentation checklist that travels with you through both portals

  • NEET scorecard and rank details
  • Class 12 mark sheet and passing certificate
  • Class 10 mark sheet and passing certificate
  • Date of birth certificate or proof
  • Category certificate (if applicable)
  • Domicile or resident certificate (if required by the state)
  • Passport-sized photographs as per portal requirements
  • Provisional allotment letter and admission confirmation documents

Common pitfalls and how to avoid them

A few frequent missteps can derail a smooth counselling experience. Be mindful of:

  • Missing the registration window or failing to complete the choice filling on time
  • Inaccurate information or mismatched documents during verification
  • Delays in fee payment or reporting after seat allotment
  • Not checking for changes in seat allotment or new rounds announced by the authorities

Practical timeline example

Suppose central counselling opens in the first half of September and state counselling follows within the next few weeks. A practical plan would be:

  • Week 1: Prepare documents, verify NEET results, check eligibility criteria for both portals
  • Week 2: Complete central portal registration and initial choice filling
  • Week 3: Complete state portal registrations and begin option entry where possible
  • Week 4: Monitor allotment results, prepare for reporting to the allotted institutes

What if dates shift or new rounds are announced?

Counselling authorities sometimes publish revised schedules or additional rounds. If that happens, verify the latest information directly on the official portals and adjust your plan accordingly. Rely on official announcements for any date changes and avoid relying on third-party summaries.

Bottom line

Tracking central and state counselling deadlines in parallel is essential for NEET 2027 admissions. Build a unified timeline, prepare the required documents in advance, and stay ready to act quickly as allotment results are released. A disciplined, informed approach increases the chances of securing a seat in the preferred course and college.

FAQs

FAQ 1: When do central and state counselling portals usually open for NEET 2027?

Portal opening dates vary by year and authority. Start by checking the official announcements as soon as results are declared and plan to register within the first available window.

FAQ 2: Can I participate in both central and state counselling?

Yes, many students participate in both streams to maximize seat options. Keep track of separate deadlines and ensure you complete registrations on both portals if eligible.

FAQ 3: What should I do if I miss a counselling deadline?

Missed deadlines often mean waiting for the next round or the next academic cycle. In such cases, verify if a mop-up or special round is announced and follow the official process to apply again.

FAQ 4: Are there differences in documents for central vs state counselling?

Core documents like NEET scorecard, qualifying marks, and identity proofs are common. States may require additional domicile or category certificates. Always verify the specific requirements on the official portals.

FAQ 5: Where can I verify the authenticity of allotment results?

Allotment results are published on the respective official portals. Do not trust third-party copies; cross-check the result with the official portal and follow the official reporting steps for admission.

title: CBSE ക്ലാസ് 10 ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷ 2027: തീയതി, വിഷയ കോഡ്, സമയം
description: ക്ലാസ് 10 ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ (കോഡ് 154) പരീക്ഷ 20 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 13:30 വരെ നടക്കും.
content:
ക്ലാസ് 10 ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ (കോഡ് 154) പരീക്ഷ 20 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027ന് 10:30 മുതൽ 13:30 വരെ നടക്കും.

2026 നവംബർ 6ന് പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ച CBSE പ്രധാന പരീക്ഷാ ടൈംടേബിളിലാണ് ഈ വിവരം. ഇത് പരീക്ഷയുടെ തീയതിയും സമയവും അറിയാനുള്ള രേഖയാണ്; മാർക്ക് ലിസ്റ്റല്ല. ഔദ്യോഗിക CBSE ടൈംടേബിൾ

ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷയ്ക്ക് എത്ര സമയം ലഭിക്കും?

ക്ലാസും വിഷയവുംകോഡ്പരീക്ഷാ തീയതിസമയം (IST)ദൈർഘ്യം
ക്ലാസ് 10: ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ (Elements of Business)15420 ഫെബ്രുവരി 202710:30 - 13:303 മണിക്കൂർ

സെൻട്രൽ ബോർഡ് ഓഫ് സെക്കൻഡറി എജ്യുക്കേഷൻ, 6 നവംബർ 2026, പേജ് 4: വിഷയ കോഡ്, തീയതി, സമയം. ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ഈ പേജ് തുറക്കുക

ഔദ്യോഗിക PDFൽ ശരിയായ വരി കണ്ടെത്താം

പേജ് 4ൽ ക്ലാസ് ഏതാണെന്നു നോക്കിയ ശേഷം 154 എന്ന കോഡ് കണ്ടെത്തുക. ഒരേ തീയതിയും സമയവും പല വരികൾക്കും ബാധകമാകാം. ഫോണിൽ മുഴുവൻ പേജും വലുതാക്കി നോക്കുക.

സ്കൂളിലെ രജിസ്ട്രേഷനിലുള്ള കോഡും വിഷയത്തിന്റെ മുഴുവൻ പേരും ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. മറ്റൊരു ക്ലാസിലും ഇതേ പേരുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലാസിന്റെ വരി മാത്രം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക.

ഇംഗ്ലിഷ് പരീക്ഷയുമായി തീയതികൾ താരതമ്യം ചെയ്യാം

ക്ലാസ് 10 ബിസിനസിന്റെ അടിസ്ഥാനങ്ങൾ (154) പരീക്ഷ 20 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും English Language and Literature (184) പരീക്ഷ 26 ഫെബ്രുവരി 2027നും ആണ്. തീയതികൾ തമ്മിൽ 6 ദിവസത്തെ വ്യത്യാസമുണ്ട്.

ഈ ദിവസങ്ങളെല്ലാം പഠിക്കാൻ കിട്ടുന്ന അവധിയല്ല. മറ്റു പരീക്ഷകളും കലണ്ടറിൽ ചേർത്ത് ഇടയിൽ പരീക്ഷയില്ലാത്ത ദിവസങ്ങൾ മാത്രം എണ്ണുക. പരിശീലനത്തിന് യഥാർഥ പേപ്പറിന്റെ ദൈർഘ്യം തന്നെ എടുക്കുക.

പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിലേക്കു പോകും മുൻപ്

പരീക്ഷ തുടങ്ങുന്ന സമയം കേന്ദ്രത്തിൽ എത്തേണ്ട അവസാന സമയമല്ല. റിപ്പോർട്ടിങ്, പ്രവേശനം, രേഖകൾ എന്നിവയ്ക്ക് അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡ് നോക്കുക. തീയതി മാറിയെന്നു കേട്ടാൽ ബോർഡിന്റെ പുതുക്കിയ അറിയിപ്പിൽ ക്ലാസ്, കോഡ്, തീയതി എന്നിവ ഒത്തുനോക്കുക.

ആശയവിനിമയ ഉപകരണങ്ങൾ പരീക്ഷാകേന്ദ്രത്തിനുള്ളിൽ അനുവദിക്കില്ല. കൊണ്ടുപോകാവുന്ന സാധനങ്ങളെക്കുറിച്ച് CBSE നൽകുന്ന പ്രത്യേക നിർദേശങ്ങളും അഡ്മിറ്റ് കാർഡും പിന്തുടരുക.

title: ICFAI Business School Non-IBSAT Admission Routes 2026: Qualifying Cutoffs, Score Normalization, and Preference Allotments
description: Comprehensive guide to securing admission to ICFAI Business School campuses through CAT, XAT, NMAT, and GMAT scores in 2026. Explore qualifying cutoffs, score normalization methods, and campus allotment processes.
content:
ICFAI Business School (IBS) is one of India's prominent management education networks, offering PGPM and MBA programs across nine campuses nationwide. While the institution conducts its proprietary entrance test, IBSAT, thousands of applicants secure seats every year through alternative national-level management exams. If you hold a valid score in CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT, understanding the non-IBSAT admission routes for 2026 can help you navigate qualifying cutoffs, score normalization, and campus allotment preferences effectively.

Alternative Entrance Exams Accepted by IBS Campuses

ICFAI Business School accepts multiple national and international management exam scores in place of IBSAT. Candidates submitting alternative exam scores are exempted from taking IBSAT, provided their scores meet the minimum qualifying thresholds set by the admissions board.

  • CAT (Common Admission Test): Accepted across all nine IBS campuses.
  • XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test): Valid for all PGPM and MBA campuses.
  • NMAT by GMAC: Accepted across all campuses with scaled score evaluation.
  • GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test): Open to both domestic and international applicants.

Qualifying Cutoffs for Non-IBSAT Applicants (2026 Session)

Admissions to IBS Hyderabad (which confers the MBA degree) and off-campus centers in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Gurgaon, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Dehradun, and Pune (offering PGPM/MBA degrees) follow differential cutoff criteria based on campus reputation and seat availability.

Expected Percentile Cutoffs

  • IBS Hyderabad: CAT/XAT percentile around 70 to 75+; NMAT scaled score of 180+; GMAT score of 500+.
  • IBS Mumbai & IBS Gurgaon: CAT/XAT percentile around 60 to 65+; NMAT scaled score of 150+ to 160+.
  • IBS Bengaluru: CAT/XAT percentile around 60+; NMAT scaled score around 150+.
  • Other Campuses (Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Dehradun, Pune): CAT/XAT percentile around 50 to 55+; NMAT scaled score of 140+.

Candidates must ensure they verify exact score eligibility thresholds on the official ICFAI website before submitting their application.

Score Normalization and Equating Process

Because applicants present test scores from different examination bodies with varying difficulty levels, scoring structures, and mark ranges, IBS employs a standardized score normalization framework. This ensures a fair evaluation platform during the shortlisting phase.

The normalization process maps raw or percentile scores from CAT, XAT, NMAT, and GMAT to an internal comparative index based on statistical scaling. This index ranks candidates on a unified scale, evaluating percentile performance, exam difficulty distribution, and section-wise consistency where applicable. Shortlisted applicants move forward to the selection process regardless of which accepted exam route they utilized.

Selection Process: GD and PI Parameters

Meeting the non-IBSAT cutoffs qualifies candidates for the centralized selection process, typically hosted at IBS Hyderabad. The final selection depends on a composite score calculated from multiple components:

  • Academic Record (10th, 12th, and Graduation): Weightage assigned to consistent academic performance.
  • Entrance Exam Performance: Scaled score from CAT, XAT, NMAT, GMAT, or IBSAT.
  • Micro Presentation / Group Discussion (GD): Evaluation of communication skills, clarity of thought, and domain awareness.
  • Personal Interview (PI): Assessment of managerial attitude, motivation, confidence, and extra-curricular achievements.

Campus Preference Allotment Strategy

During the application process, candidates submit their preferred choices among the nine IBS campuses. Seat allotment is conducted strictly on a merit-cum-preference basis following the central selection rounds.

Key Factors Influencing Campus Allotment

  • Composite Merit Rank: High overall scores increase the probability of getting first-choice campuses like IBS Hyderabad or IBS Mumbai.
  • Order of Preference: Candidates should order their campus choices carefully during registration, as seat allotment locks once top preferences are matched to merit scores.
  • Seat Availability: Higher demand for specific campuses may raise the effective final intake cutoff during allotment rounds.

How to Apply Using Non-IBSAT Scores

  1. Visit the official ICFAI Business School admissions portal.
  2. Complete the common application form online.
  3. Select your entrance exam pathway (CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT) and input your registration details along with official test scores.
  4. Fill out your campus preference order accurately.
  5. Pay the prescribed application fee and submit the application before the specified cutoff date.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need to appear for IBSAT if I have a valid CAT or NMAT score?

No. If you possess a valid score in CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT that meets the minimum qualifying cutoff, you do not need to take the IBSAT exam.

Is there a difference in fee structure for non-IBSAT candidates?

No. The program fee structure across all IBS campuses remains identical regardless of whether a candidate enters through IBSAT or an alternative score route like CAT, XAT, NMAT, or GMAT.

How are NMAT scores evaluated compared to CAT percentiles?

IBS normalizes NMAT scaled scores against CAT percentiles using internal statistical scaling to place all candidates on a balanced comparative merit list.

Can I update my entrance exam score after submitting the application?

Candidates can usually update their exam scores on the official application portal prior to the final score submission deadline specified by IBS admissions authorities. Check the official portal for exact cutoff dates.

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 4: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 4 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 154 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு வணிகத்தின் அடிப்படைகள் (154) தேர்வுத் தேதி 20 பிப்ரவரி 2027. English Language and Literature (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 6 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்திற்குப் புறப்படும் முன்

தேர்வு தொடங்கும் நேரமும் மையத்துக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டிய நேரமும் வேறு. வருகை, நுழைவு, ஆவணங்கள் குறித்த விவரங்களுக்கு அனுமதிச் சீட்டைப் பாருங்கள். தேதி மாறியதாகத் தகவல் வந்தால் வாரியத்தின் திருத்தப்பட்ட அறிவிப்பில் வகுப்பு, குறியீடு, தேதி மூன்றையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

title: CBSE Class 12 Arts Date Sheet 2027: History, Geography, Political Science and More
description: Check the CBSE Class 12 Humanities timetable for Geography, Psychology, Political Science, History and Sociology, with codes and optional-subject guidance.
content:
The CBSE Class 12 Arts or Humanities timetable for 2027 depends on the subjects you have chosen. Geography is on 25 February, Political Science on 19 March, History on 27 March and Sociology on 30 March. All four papers are scheduled from 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST.

These dates appear in the official CBSE date sheet released on 6 November 2026. The Board's PDF lists subjects rather than a separate fixed Arts-stream calendar.

Humanities subject dates at a glance

SubjectCodeDate in 2027
Geography02925 February
Psychology0372 March
English Elective / Core001 / 3015 March
Hindi Elective / Core002 / 30213 March
Economics03016 March
Political Science02819 March
History02727 March
Sociology03930 March
Legal Studies0748 April

All subjects listed here have a 10:30 am to 1:30 pm IST session. The official PDF below includes Geography and Psychology on page 9; use its later pages for the other March and April entries.

Official CBSE date sheet PDF

Central Board of Secondary Education, notice dated 6 November 2026. Relevant section: PDF page 9. Open the original official document.

Your final paper may be later than a friend's

Someone taking Legal Studies has a listed paper on 8 April, while another student's registered subjects may finish in March. Do not use the last date in a friend's Arts timetable as your own. The full Class 12 schedule continues to 9 April for other subjects.

Check languages and optional subjects as carefully as the main Humanities papers. English Core and English Elective have different codes but share 5 March. Hindi Core and Hindi Elective similarly share 13 March. A course code is a better check than a shortened subject label.

Plan across the March sequence

Students taking Hindi, Economics and Political Science have papers on 13, 16 and 19 March. There are two full intervening dates between each pair, before accounting for any other registered subject. Prepare the main notes and unresolved topics before that sequence starts.

History on 27 March and Sociology on 30 March also leave two full intervening dates. Use your actual subject list to decide how much revision is realistic. It is better to identify an incomplete topic now than to reserve a short gap for learning it from the beginning.

Turn revision into work you can review

Choose a task with a visible outcome: write an answer, explain a concept without notes or practise the relevant subject skill. Keep a small correction list and revisit it in the next session. The timetable does not announce chapter weightage or predict questions, so do not infer either from the length of a gap.

Use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview to check the overall exam windows. Follow school and admit-card instructions for assessments, reporting and the examination centre.

title: IBPS PO Prelims 2025 | Exam Pattern, Cut-Off Trends & Preparation Guide
description: IBPS PO Prelims 2025 will be held in October. Check IBPS PO exam pattern, cut-off trends, preparation tips, and FAQs to boost your chances of success.
content:
IBPS PO Prelims 2025: Exam Schedule, Pattern & Preparation Guide

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has announced the IBPS PO Prelims 2025 schedule. The exam will be held in October 2025 across India, making it one of the most competitive banking exams of the year. With lakhs of aspirants eyeing a career in public sector banks, the IBPS PO exam continues to be one of the most prestigious recruitment tests.

IBPS PO Prelims 2025: At a Glance

Particulars Details
Exam Conducting Body Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS)
Exam Name IBPS PO Prelims 2025
Exam Month October 2025
Mode of Exam Online (Computer-Based)
Purpose Recruitment of Probationary Officers (PO) in Public Sector Banks
Selection Process Prelims → Mains → Interview

IBPS PO Prelims 2025 Exam Pattern

Section Questions Marks Time Allotted
English Language 30 30 20 minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 35 35 20 minutes
Reasoning Ability 35 35 20 minutes
Total 100 100 60 minutes

  • Negative Marking: 0.25 marks will be deducted for each wrong answer.

  • Candidates must clear both sectional cut-offs and the overall cut-off to qualify for the Mains exam.

IBPS PO Prelims Cut-Off Trends (Previous Years)

Cut-off scores help aspirants understand the competition level and set realistic preparation goals.

Year General OBC SC ST
2022 49.75 49.75 46.75 40.50
2021 50.50 50.50 44.50 38.00
2020 58.75 58.50 51.00 43.50
2019 59.75 59.75 53.50 46.00

 

Why IBPS PO Exam is Important

  • Prestigious Career: IBPS PO offers a respected job profile in public sector banks.

  • Job Security: Government-backed banking jobs are stable with long-term growth.

  • High Competition: Every year, lakhs of aspirants apply, making it one of the most competitive exams in India.

Preparation Tips for IBPS PO Prelims 2025

  • Practice Mock Tests: Improve speed and accuracy by attempting online test series.

  • Focus on Weak Areas: Revise quantitative formulas, logical reasoning tricks, and English grammar basics.

  • Time Management: Each section has a fixed time; practice solving within the limit.

  • Previous Papers: Analyze past year papers to understand question trends.

title: ఐఐఎం బెంగళూరు సమ్మర్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్స్: 608 మందికి ఆఫర్లు, నెలవారీ స్టైపెండ్ వివరాలు
description: ఐఐఎం బెంగళూరులో పాల్గొన్న 608 మందికీ సమ్మర్ ఆఫర్లు వచ్చాయి. నెలవారీ మధ్యగత, సగటు స్టైపెండ్ మరియు కన్సల్టింగ్ వాటాను అర్థం చేసుకోండి.
content:
ఐఐఎం బెంగళూరు 31 అక్టోబర్ 2026న విడుదల చేసిన ప్రకటన ప్రకారం, PGP, PGPBA 2026-28 బ్యాచ్‌ల నుంచి పాల్గొన్న మొత్తం 608 మంది విద్యార్థులకు సమ్మర్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ ఆఫర్లు వచ్చాయి. అక్టోబర్ 26-29 మధ్య జరిగిన ప్రక్రియలో 128 సంస్థలు పాల్గొన్నాయి. ఎంబీఏ ఎంపికలను పోల్చేటప్పుడు ఇవి నెలవారీ ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్ స్టైపెండ్ మొత్తాలని గుర్తుంచుకోండి; వార్షిక జీతం ప్యాకేజీలు కావు.

సంఖ్యతోపాటు అది దేనిని కొలుస్తుందో చూడండి

కొలమానం

సంస్థ ప్రకటించిన వివరాలు

ఆఫర్లు పొందిన పాల్గొన్న విద్యార్థులు

608

నియామక సంస్థలు

128

మధ్యగత స్టైపెండ్

నెలకు ₹2 లక్షలు

సగటు స్టైపెండ్

నెలకు ₹1.95 లక్షలు

ఆఫర్లలో కన్సల్టింగ్ వాటా

50.7%

ఈ గణాంకాలకు ఆధారం అధికారిక సమ్మర్ ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ ప్రకటన. 100% ఫలితం ఈ ప్రక్రియలో పాల్గొన్న 608 మందికి సంబంధించినది. భవిష్యత్తు దరఖాస్తుదారులకు హామీగానో, సంస్థలోని అన్ని కోర్సుల ఫలితంగానో దీనిని భావించకూడదు.

కన్సల్టింగ్ ముందున్నా ఇతర రంగాల్లోనూ అవకాశాలు

22 సంస్థల నుంచి 308 కన్సల్టింగ్ ఆఫర్లు వచ్చినట్లు సంస్థ తెలిపింది. ఫైనాన్స్, టెక్నాలజీ, ఉత్పత్తులకు సంబంధించిన పనులు, మార్కెటింగ్, జనరల్ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ కూడా ప్రకటనలో ఉన్నాయి. పాల్గొన్న సంస్థల్లో దాదాపు 40% తొలిసారి నియామకాలకు వచ్చినవే.

ఒక నిర్దిష్ట కెరీర్ లక్ష్యమున్న విద్యార్థికి మొత్తం ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ శాతం కంటే రంగాలవారీ అవకాశాల వివరాలు ఉపయోగపడతాయి. మీరు కోరుకునే రంగంలోని పాత్రలు, యాజమాన్య సంస్థలను పరిశీలించండి. మొత్తం సంఖ్య ఎక్కువగా ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన ప్రతి విభాగంలో సమాన అవకాశాలు ఉండవు.

మధ్యగత విలువ, సగటు చెప్పేది వేరు

స్టైపెండ్ మొత్తాలను వరుసగా అమర్చినప్పుడు మధ్యలో ఉండేది మధ్యగత విలువ. అన్ని మొత్తాలను కలిపి వాటి సంఖ్యతో భాగిస్తే సగటు వస్తుంది. ప్రతి విద్యార్థి అందుకున్న మొత్తాన్ని ఈ రెండింటిలో ఏదీ చెప్పదు. సమ్మర్ ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్ నెలవారీ మొత్తాన్ని గుణించి వార్షిక వేతనంగా అంచనా వేయవద్దు.

మరో బిజినెస్ స్కూల్‌తో పోల్చే ముందు అది నెలవారీ స్టైపెండా, మొత్తం ఇంటర్న్‌షిప్ కాలానికి చెల్లింపా, పూర్తికాల ఉద్యోగ వేతనమా అనేది చూడండి. బ్యాచ్, ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ చక్రం కూడా సరిపోలాలి. వేర్వేరు ప్రమాణాలను పోల్చితే నిజమైన తేడా లేకున్నా ఒక కోర్సు మెరుగ్గా లేదా తక్కువగా కనిపించవచ్చు.

కోర్సుల గురించి తెలుసుకోవడానికి ప్రకటనతోపాటు ఐఐఎం బెంగళూరు PGP, PGPBA పేజీలు చదవండి. మా ఐఐఎం అహ్మదాబాద్ క్లస్టర్ 3 వివరణ, అందుబాటులో ఉన్న పాత్రల సంఖ్యకు, ప్లేస్‌మెంట్ పొందిన విద్యార్థుల సంఖ్యకు ఉన్న తేడాను వివరిస్తుంది.
