title: NEET SS 2026 अर्ज: शुल्क भरण्यापूर्वी योग्य परीक्षा गट निवडा
description: 18 नोव्हेंबर रात्री 11:55पर्यंत अर्ज करता येईल. तुमच्या पात्रतेनुसार परीक्षा गट, प्रत्येक पेपरचे शुल्क आणि बदलता न येणारे तपशील आधी तपासा.
content:
NEET SS 2026चे अर्ज सुरू झाले आहेत. अर्ज सादर करण्याची मुदत 18 नोव्हेंबर 2026 रोजी रात्री 11:55ला संपेल. शुल्क भरण्यापूर्वी तुमची पदव्युत्तर पात्रता आणि इच्छित सुपर स्पेशालिटी अभ्यासक्रम यांना कोणता परीक्षा गट योग्य आहे ते तपासा. निवडलेल्या प्रत्येक गटासाठी स्वतंत्र शुल्क लागते, त्यामुळे हा निर्णय अर्ज आणि खर्च दोन्हींवर परिणाम करतो.

मूळ विशेष शाखेच्या पात्रतेनुसार पेपर निवडा

पात्र DM, MCh आणि DrNB सुपर स्पेशालिटी अभ्यासक्रमांच्या प्रवेशासाठी NEET SS ही परीक्षा आहे. NBEMSच्या अधिकृत NEET SS पानानुसार संबंधित फीडर स्पेशालिटीच्या अटी पूर्ण करणारी मान्यताप्राप्त MD, MS, DNB किंवा समकक्ष पात्रता आवश्यक आहे. 2026च्या माहितीपत्रकात ही पात्रता मिळवण्याची अंतिम तारीख 31 जानेवारी 2027 आहे. केवळ त्या तारखेपर्यंत पात्रता पूर्ण केल्याने सर्व अभ्यासक्रमांसाठी पात्र ठरत नाही.

पेपर निवडण्यापूर्वी अधिकृत माहितीपत्रकातील गट आणि फीडर पात्रतेचे तक्ते वाचा. शुल्काच्या उदाहरणात MD Paediatrics उमेदवाराने Medical आणि Paediatrics हे दोन्ही गट निवडल्याचे दाखवले आहे. अशा वेळी एकाऐवजी दोन पेपरचे शुल्क भरावे लागते.

प्रत्येक गटाचा खर्च वेगळा मोजा

परीक्षा शुल्क प्रति गट ₹3,500 आहे. लागू पेमेंट गेटवे शुल्क यामध्ये समाविष्ट नाही. दोन गटांसाठी त्या अतिरिक्त शुल्कापूर्वी ₹7,000 होतील. सादर केलेला अर्ज मागे घेता येत नाही. शुल्क परत मिळत नाही किंवा भविष्यातील परीक्षेसाठी हस्तांतरित करता येत नाही.

अधिकृत NEET SS पानावरील 2026 अंतर्गत Application Link वापरा. फॉर्म आणि अपलोड पूर्ण झाल्यावर पेमेंट यशस्वी झाल्याची स्थिती तपासा. सादर केलेला अर्ज आणि पेमेंटचा पुरावा जतन करा. केवळ बँकेतून पैसे वजा झाले म्हणजे अर्ज पूर्ण झाल्याची खात्री होत नाही.

सामान्य दुरुस्तीच्या कालावधीत नाव, राष्ट्रीयत्व, ईमेल, आधार, मोबाइल क्रमांक आणि परीक्षा शहर बदलता येणार नाही. अर्ज सादर करण्यापूर्वीच हे तपासा. नंतरची प्रतिमा दुरुस्तीची संधी ठरावीक प्रतिमांमधील दोषांसाठी आहे; ती नोंदणीची मुदतवाढ नाही.

पात्रतेचे तपशील कागदपत्रांशी जुळवा, निवडलेला गट माहितीपत्रकानुसार तपासा आणि अपलोड केलेली प्रत्येक प्रतिमा पाहा. प्रवेश प्रक्रियेदरम्यान वापरता येईल असा ईमेल आणि फोन क्रमांक द्या. परीक्षा व त्यानंतरच्या समुपदेशनाच्या अटी वेगळ्या वाचून पुढील नियोजन करा.

title: GATE 2027 விண்ணப்பக் குறை: அக்டோபர் 31க்குள் சரிசெய்வதும் கட்டணத் திருத்தமும்
description: GOAPS விண்ணப்ப நிலையைப் புரிந்துகொள்ளுங்கள். அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட குறையை அக்டோபர் 31க்குள் கூடுதல் கட்டணமின்றிச் சரிசெய்யலாம்; கட்டணத் திருத்தத் தேதி இன்னும் வரவில்லை.
content:
GATE 2027 விண்ணப்ப ஆய்வில் குறை தெரிவிக்கப்பட்டிருந்தால், அதை 31 அக்டோபர் 2026க்குள் சரிசெய்யுங்கள். தனியாகத் திறக்கப்படவுள்ள கட்டணத் தரவுத் திருத்தச் சாளரத்திற்காகக் காத்திருக்க வேண்டாம். அதன் தேதியை IIT மதராஸ் இன்னும் அறிவிக்கவில்லை.

முதலில் GOAPS நிலையைப் பாருங்கள்

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ GATE 2027 அறிவிப்பு

  • Under scrutiny என்றால் தொடர்புடைய மண்டலம் விண்ணப்பத்தை ஆய்வு செய்கிறது. மின்னஞ்சலையும் GOAPS கணக்கையும் கவனியுங்கள். இது மட்டும் விண்ணப்பம் நிராகரிக்கப்பட்டதைக் குறிக்காது.
  • Defective என்றால் மின்னஞ்சலில் குறிப்பிடப்பட்ட குறையைப் படித்து, அதற்கான திருத்தத்தை GOAPS வழியாகச் செய்யுங்கள்.
  • In order and accepted என்றால் ஆய்வுக்குப் பிறகு விண்ணப்பம் ஏற்கப்பட்டுள்ளது. ஒப்புகையைப் பாதுகாத்து, அடுத்த அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அறிவிப்புகளையும் கவனியுங்கள்.

திருத்தத்தைச் சமர்ப்பித்து ஆதாரத்தை வைத்திருங்கள்

ஆய்வில் கண்டறியப்பட்ட குறைகளை 14 முதல் 31 அக்டோபர் 2026 வரை கூடுதல் கட்டணமின்றிச் சரிசெய்யலாம் என அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அறிவிப்பு கூறுகிறது. GOAPS செய்தியை முழுமையாகப் படித்து, கேட்கப்பட்ட ஆவணம் அல்லது திருத்தத்தைத் தயாரித்துச் சமர்ப்பிக்கவும்.

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ GOAPS உள்நுழைவு

சமர்ப்பித்ததும் ஒப்புகை அல்லது அனுப்பிய விவரங்களின் திரைப்பிடிப்பை வைத்திருங்கள். கணக்கின் நிலையை மீண்டும் பாருங்கள். புதிய கோப்பைத் தேர்ந்தெடுப்பது மட்டும் திருத்தம் முடிந்துவிட்டது அல்லது விண்ணப்பம் ஏற்கப்பட்டது என்பதற்கு ஆதாரமல்ல.

பயன்படுத்திய DigiLocker கணக்கை நீக்காதீர்கள்

விண்ணப்பத்திற்குப் பயன்படுத்திய சரிபார்க்கப்பட்ட அல்லது சரிபார்க்கப்படாத DigiLocker கணக்கைத் தொடர்ந்து வைத்திருங்கள். சரிபார்க்கப்படாத கணக்குக்கு அதிகாரப்பூர்வ வழிமுறைகளின்படி DigiLocker Drive அணுகல் அனுமதியும் புகைப்பட அடையாள ஆவணமும் வழங்க வேண்டும்.

செய்தி தெளிவாக இல்லாவிட்டால் GATE தளத்தில் உள்ள மண்டலத் தொடர்பு வழியாக உதவி பெறுங்கள். விண்ணப்பக் குறிப்பையும் சரியான பிழையையும் தெரிவிக்கலாம்; கடவுச்சொல் அல்லது OTP பகிர வேண்டாம்.

நீங்களாகவே விண்ணப்பத் தகவலை மாற்ற விரும்புவது ஆய்வில் அறிவிக்கப்பட்ட குறையிலிருந்து வேறுபட்டது. கட்டணத் திருத்தத்தின் தேதிகளும் அனுமதிக்கப்பட்ட மாற்றங்களும் வெளியிடப்படும் வரை காத்திருக்கவும். குறை சரிசெய்யும் கடைசித் தேதியை அதற்கான தேதியாகக் கருதாதீர்கள்.

title: AI-assisted college matching: building personalized, deadline-aware admission plans for Indian undergraduates
description: A practical guide for Indian students and parents on using AI tools to build personalized college-match strategies that align with board results, entrance exams, and application deadlines.
content:
Why AI can change how Indian students choose colleges

For many families, college selection is a blend of gut feeling, family expectations, and a crowded calendar of exams and deadlines. Artificial intelligence offers a way to organize this complexity. By analyzing academic records, exam patterns, course interests, and financial considerations, AI can suggest targeted college lists and build a step-by-step admission plan that updates as dates move closer.

Setting up a personalized college profile

Begin with a clear profile that captures essential details. Include board marks, class XII compulsory subjects, interest areas, preferred locations, budget range, and any preferred streams such as engineering, sciences, arts, or professional diplomas. If a student has more than one interest, AI can weight options to reflect both passion and practicality.

  • Academic strengths and subject choices
  • Exam boards and anticipated scores
  • Location preferences and travel feasibility
  • Financial constraints and scholarship possibilities
  • Backup plans for revised cutoffs or test dates

Mapping exams to opportunities: a deadline-aware plan

Indian admissions unfold through a mix of board scores, national/state entrance tests, and university-level applications. An AI-driven plan tracks all deadlines-from forms to submission dates-and prioritizes tasks by proximity and importance. A typical workflow looks like this:

  • Identify target programs and their required exams
  • Match deadlines for each program with your exam timeline
  • Create a calendar with reminders for form opening, document readiness, and fee payments
  • Allocate time for essays, letter of recommendation requests, and test registrations

Building a dynamic college list

AI helps balance reach, match, and safety options. It considers which colleges accept scores from specific boards, weightage of board marks in the selection process, and how a candidate’s profile aligns with program prerequisites. The output is a curated list that can be refined as the year progresses, not a one-time snapshot.

Factors AI typically weighs

  • Academic rigor and subject fit
  • Entrance exam viability and historical cutoff ranges
  • Seat availability and intake year dynamics
  • Campus location, living costs, and internship opportunities
  • Scholarships, agency support, and merit-based awards

Crafting individualized timelines

Each applicant benefits from a timeline that adapts to changing circumstances, such as unexpected exam delays or new eligibility criteria. A personalized plan typically includes:

  • Month-by-month milestones for form submissions and document uploads
  • Strategic preparation blocks for entrance tests, with progress checkpoints
  • Reservations for college visits or online information sessions
  • Contingency buffers for last-minute changes in deadlines or criteria

Practical steps for Indian students and parents

1) Gather essentials early: Prepare your mark sheets, identity proofs, and intersection of subjects studied. 2) Define non-negotiables: location, budget, and field of study. 3) Start with a broad, then narrow down to target programs. 4) Use AI to simulate admission outcomes based on past data, while keeping a human review layer. 5) Regularly review and adjust the plan as important dates approach.

Ensuring fairness and transparency

AI suggestions should augment decision-making, not replace it. Parents and students should cross-check AI outputs with official admission portals and prospectus documents. When details are uncertain or new policies emerge, verify dates, eligibility, and required documents on the official authority websites.

What a sample plan might look like

A compact example shows how deadlines align with actions. For a student aiming at engineering programs, the plan might include:

  • Month 1: Finalize preferred streams; gather prerequisite subjects; register for any necessary state-level entrance tests
  • Month 2: Create shortlists; request recommendation letters if required
  • Month 3-4: Practice tests; refine essays if applicable
  • Month 5-6: Submit applications; monitor status and respond to additional documents requests

Choosing between online and offline experiences

India has robust campus networks and virtual information sessions. AI can schedule a mix of campus visits and online webinars to maximize exposure without travel fatigue. Parents can accompany students to critical sessions or request virtual tours that fit family schedules.

Final thoughts

AI-assisted college matching offers a structured way to navigate India’s diverse higher education landscape. By correlating board performance, entrance exam readiness, and personal preferences with real-time deadlines, families can build a proactive, deadline-aware admission plan. The goal is to increase clarity, reduce last-minute stress, and improve the chances of a good match between student aspirations and available programs. Always verify official dates and eligibility on the relevant admission portals as policies update.

Visible FAQ

What is AI-assisted college matching?

It uses artificial intelligence to align a student’s academic profile, preferred programs, and deadlines with suitable colleges and admission routes, then generates a personalized, deadline-aware action plan.

How do I start building a personalized plan?

Begin with a concise student profile, list target programs, and input key deadlines. The AI tool will propose a short list of colleges and a calendar of tasks aligned to each program’s requirements.

Will AI replace human guidance?

No. AI augments guidance by organizing data and suggesting options. Families should review AI outputs with school counselors, mentors, and official portals to confirm details.

How should I handle deadline changes?

Keep a live plan that updates in real time. Set reminders a week before each deadline and maintain a contingency subset of backup colleges in case of last-minute shifts.

What if I am unsure about eligibility?

Verify criteria on the official admission site. If needed, consult school counselors or trusted education advisors for clarity on niche programs or state-level variations.

title: UCEED 2027 MSQ: కొన్ని సరైన ఎంపికలకే మార్కులు ఎప్పుడు వస్తాయి?
description: UCEED 2027 పాక్షిక మార్కులు, MSQలో -1 కోత, NAT మరియు MCQ నియమాలను IIT బాంబే అధికారిక పట్టికతో తెలుసుకోండి.
content:
UCEED 2027 MSQలో ఒక సరైన ఎంపికను గుర్తిస్తే ఎప్పుడూ ఒక మార్కు మాత్రమే రాదు. అదే ఏకైక సరైన ఎంపిక అయి, దానినే ఎంచుకుంటే మొత్తం నాలుగు మార్కులు వస్తాయి. సరైన ఎంపికల్లో కొన్నింటిని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకుని తప్పు ఎంపిక ఏదీ చేర్చనప్పుడు పాక్షిక మార్కులు వస్తాయి. తప్పు ఎంపికను కలిపితే -1 వస్తుంది.

15 MSQలకు మార్కుల లెక్క

IIT బాంబే అధికారిక ప్రశ్నపత్ర నిర్మాణం ప్రకారం నియమాలు ఇవి. పూర్తి లేదా పాక్షిక మార్కులకు ఎంచుకున్న ప్రతి ఎంపిక సరైనదై ఉండాలి:

  • +4: అన్ని సరైన ఎంపికలను మాత్రమే ఎంచుకోవాలి.

  • +3: నాలుగూ సరైనవైనప్పుడు మూడింటిని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకుంటే.

  • +2: కనీసం మూడు సరైన ఎంపికలు ఉన్నప్పుడు రెండు సరైనవాటిని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకుంటే.

  • +1: కనీసం రెండు సరైన ఎంపికలు ఉన్నప్పుడు ఒక సరైనదాన్ని మాత్రమే ఎంచుకుంటే.

  • 0: సమాధానం ఇవ్వకపోతే. మిగతా అన్ని సందర్భాల్లో -1.

ఒక ఉదాహరణతో తేడా చూడండి

A, B, C సరైనవని అనుకుందాం. A, B ఎంచుకుంటే +2; A మాత్రమే అయితే +1; A, B, C అన్నీ అయితే +4. తప్పు ఎంపిక Dను కూడా చేరిస్తే -1. A ఒక్కటే సరైనదైతే Aను మాత్రమే ఎంచుకోవడం +4 ఇస్తుంది. ఇవి ప్రకటించిన నియమాలకు ఉదాహరణలు; పరీక్షలో వచ్చే ప్రశ్నల అంచనాలు కావు.

అన్ని విభాగాల్లో ఒకే ఊహా పద్ధతి వద్దు

Part Aలో 57 ప్రశ్నలు, 200 మార్కులు, రెండు గంటల సమయం ఉంటాయి. 14 NAT ప్రశ్నల్లో సరైన జవాబుకు +4; తప్పుకు మార్కుల కోత లేదు. 28 MCQల్లో సరైన జవాబుకు +3, తప్పుకు -0.71. వదిలేసిన ప్రశ్నకు సున్నా. 15 MSQలకు గరిష్ఠంగా 60 మార్కులు.

IIT బాంబే UCEED 2027 ప్రశ్నపత్ర నిర్మాణం. ఈ పేజీలో ప్రత్యేక విడుదల తేదీ లేదు. పూర్తి అధికారిక మార్కుల నియమాలు చదవండి.

Part B కూడా తప్పనిసరి: ఒక గంట, 100 మార్కులు. స్కెచింగ్‌లో ఒక ప్రశ్న, డిజైన్ ఆప్టిట్యూడ్‌లో ఒక ప్రశ్న, ఒక్కొక్కటి 50 మార్కులు. ప్రశ్నలు తెరపై కనిపిస్తాయి; ఇచ్చిన జవాబు పుస్తకంలో రాయాలి లేదా గీయాలి. సాధనలో రెండు భాగాల సమయ పరిమితులను పాటించండి; మూడు గంటలన్నీ ఆబ్జెక్టివ్ ప్రశ్నలకు కేటాయించవద్దు.

సాధనలో వదిలేసిన సరైన ఎంపికను, అదనంగా ఎంచుకున్న తప్పు ఎంపికను వేరుగా నమోదు చేయండి. విషయ పరిజ్ఞానమా, ఎంపికలను జాగ్రత్తగా పరిశీలించడమా మెరుగుపరచాలో అర్థమవుతుంది. విస్తృత సాధన కోసం Part A, Part B సాధన మార్గదర్శిని చూడండి.

title: XAT 2026 Registration Opens
description: XAT 2026 registration starts tomorrow! Check key dates, eligibility, fee, and top MBA colleges accepting XAT scores. Apply early, don’t miss out!
content:
Hello, future studies MBA students! A big change is on the way: if you want to get into a famous B-school like XLRI, XIMB, IMT, etc., you should absolutely prepare for the XAT 2026 registration, which is scheduled to start tomorrow.

Many serious MBA candidates apply for the Xavier Aptitude Test, or XAT, one of those management entrance tests. The exam is organized annually by XLRI Jamshedpur and is recognized by over 160 Business colleges in India.

XAT 2026 - Key Things to Keep in Mind

  • Registration Starts: From tomorrow, i.e., July 10, 2025

  • Official Website: xatonline.in

  • Application Mode: Online only

  • Expected Exam Date: First Sunday of January 2026 (usually around Jan 5)

You can register and complete the form on the official XAT website as soon as the link goes live. Although it is anticipated that the form will be available for a few months, it is always preferable to apply ahead of time to prevent the last-minute rush (you know how exam sites go down at the last minute, don't you?).

Who Can Apply?

To be honest, qualifying is rather simple to understand: you are eligible if you have completed at least three years of coursework toward a bachelor's degree in any field. No CGPA or minimum percentage is necessary. Final-year students are also eligible to apply.

What About the Application Fee?

The typical XAT registration fee is ₹2100, though this year's price may vary somewhat. If you are applying particularly to XLRI's programs, there is an additional cost.

Keep your documents ready

such as your academic information, signature, and photo. Verify that your phone number and email address are operational and reachable. During registration, you will also have to select the exam city of your choice.

Final Word

Therefore, don't pass the XAT if you want to enroll in one of the best MBA programs in India. Watch the official website and get started as the form goes live tomorrow.

description: CBSE ધોરણ 10 અને 12ની 2027 મુખ્ય પરીક્ષાની ડેટશીટની રાહ છે. વર્ષ, ધોરણ, પરીક્ષા પ્રકાર અને વિષય કોડ તપાસીને યોગ્ય PDF પસંદ કરો.
content:
CBSE ધોરણ 10 અને 12ની 2027 મુખ્ય પરીક્ષાની ડેટશીટ હજી અપેક્ષિત છે. 31 ઑક્ટોબર સુધી જાહેર થવાનો અંદાજ બોર્ડની સત્તાવાર સમયમર્યાદા નથી. વિષયોની તારીખ નક્કી કરતાં પહેલાં સત્તાવાર સૂચના અને સંપૂર્ણ સમયપત્રક જરૂરી છે.

ડાઉનલોડ પહેલાં ત્રણ ઓળખ તપાસો

  1. વર્ષ: સમયપત્રક 2027ની પરીક્ષાનું હોવું જોઈએ, અગાઉના સત્રનું નહીં.
  2. ધોરણ અને પ્રકાર: ધોરણ 10 તથા 12, મુખ્ય પરીક્ષા અને પૂરક કે વિશેષ પરીક્ષા વચ્ચે ફરક કરો.
  3. વિષય: નોંધાયેલા વિષયનું નામ અને કોડ સરખાવી પછી તારીખ અને સમય વાંચો.

CBSEના પરીક્ષા પરિપત્ર પાનાં પર 9 ઑક્ટોબર 2026ની ધોરણ 12 માટેની West Asia વિશેષ પરીક્ષાનું સમયપત્રક પણ છે. તે બધા વિદ્યાર્થીઓ માટે 2027ની મુખ્ય પરીક્ષાની ડેટશીટ નથી.

સંપૂર્ણ દસ્તાવેજ સાચવો

સાચું સમયપત્રક જાહેર થાય ત્યારે મૂળ PDF લો. પોતાના વિષયોની પંક્તિઓ સાથે બધી સૂચનાઓ અને નોંધો વાંચો. અસ્પષ્ટ વિષય કોડ શાળાને પૂછો. સુધારેલી ડેટશીટ આવે તો જૂની ફાઇલ બદલી દરેક વિષયની વિગતો ફરી તપાસો. અભ્યાસના ફોલ્ડરમાં સ્પષ્ટ નામવાળી એક નકલ રાખો જેથી અલગ આવૃત્તિઓ ભળી ન જાય.

ડેટશીટ વગર પણ પુનરાવર્તન ચાલુ રાખો

વર્તમાન અભ્યાસક્રમ અને CBSEના નમૂના પ્રશ્નપત્ર પાનાંમાંથી યોગ્ય સામગ્રી લો. ફાઇલ પસંદ કરતાં પહેલાં સત્ર જુઓ. જૂના પેપર અભ્યાસમાં ઉપયોગી છે, પરંતુ હાલની પરીક્ષા પદ્ધતિ કે અભ્યાસક્રમનો પુરાવો નથી. નબળા વિષયો, સમયબદ્ધ જવાબો અને ભૂલોની સમીક્ષા માટે સાપ્તાહિક યોજના બનાવો. પરીક્ષાનો ક્રમ આવે ત્યારે ફેરફારની જગ્યા રાખો. પ્રાયોગિક કામ, આંતરિક મૂલ્યાંકન અને બાકી રેકોર્ડ વિશે શાળાને અલગ પૂછો.

title: JMI Admissions: जामिया में चाहिए एडमिशन तो CUET के साथ करना होगा यह जरूरी काम, क्या है अप्लाई करने की शर्तें?
description: जामिया मिल्लिया इस्लामिया (JMI) में UG और PG एडमिशन के लिए CUET देना अनिवार्य है। साथ ही JMI की वेबसाइट पर अलग से आवेदन करना भी जरूरी है।
content:
जामिया मिल्लिया इस्लामिया (JMI) में एडमिशन लेने का सपना देख रहे छात्रों के लिए एक अहम अपडेट है। शैक्षणिक सत्र 2025–26 में जामिया के कई UG और PG कोर्सेज़ में एडमिशन CUET (Common University Entrance Test) के जरिए होगा। लेकिन सिर्फ CUET देना ही काफी नहीं है, इसके साथ एक जरूरी स्टेप भी पूरा करना होगा।

अगर आप यह स्टेप मिस कर देते हैं, तो CUET स्कोर होने के बावजूद आपका एडमिशन रुक सकता है।

CUET के साथ कौन-सा जरूरी काम करना होगा?

CUET परीक्षा पास करने के बाद उम्मीदवारों को Jamia की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर अलग से आवेदन (Application Form) करना अनिवार्य होगा। यानी:

  • CUET देना जरूरी है
  • JMI पोर्टल पर अलग से रजिस्ट्रेशन भी जरूरी है

केवल CUET स्कोर के आधार पर ऑटोमैटिक एडमिशन नहीं मिलेगा।

JMI Admissions 2025–26: मुख्य जानकारी

विवरण जानकारी
यूनिवर्सिटी Jamia Millia Islamia (JMI)
एडमिशन मोड CUET + JMI Application
लागू कोर्स UG और PG (चयनित कोर्स)
CUET आयोजित NTA
आधिकारिक वेबसाइट jmi.ac.in

JMI में एडमिशन के लिए जरूरी शर्तें

जामिया में एडमिशन के लिए उम्मीदवारों को निम्न शर्तें पूरी करनी होंगी:

  • संबंधित कोर्स के लिए CUET परीक्षा में शामिल होना अनिवार्य
  • CUET में वही subjects चुनने होंगे जो जामिया ने तय किए हैं
  • JMI का ऑनलाइन एप्लिकेशन फॉर्म समय पर भरना होगा
  • न्यूनतम शैक्षणिक योग्यता (12वीं / ग्रेजुएशन) पूरी होनी चाहिए
  • आरक्षण नियम JMI और सरकारी गाइडलाइंस के अनुसार लागू होंगे

कुछ कोर्सेज़ में इंटरव्यू या अतिरिक्त टेस्ट भी लिया जा सकता है।

JMI एडमिशन प्रक्रिया (Step-by-Step)

  1. CUET परीक्षा के लिए आवेदन करें
  2. CUET परीक्षा में शामिल हों
  3. JMI की वेबसाइट पर जाकर एप्लिकेशन फॉर्म भरें
  4. CUET स्कोर के आधार पर मेरिट / कट-ऑफ जारी होगी
  5. डॉक्यूमेंट वेरिफिकेशन और एडमिशन

निष्कर्ष (Conclusion)

अगर आप Jamia Millia Islamia में एडमिशन लेना चाहते हैं, तो सिर्फ CUET पास करना काफी नहीं है। CUET के साथ-साथ JMI का अलग आवेदन फॉर्म भरना सबसे जरूरी स्टेप है। सही समय पर सभी प्रक्रियाएं पूरी करने से ही आपका एडमिशन कन्फर्म हो पाएगा।

title: CBSE Class 12 Kathakali Dance Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Class 12 Kathakali Dance: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
CBSE Class 12 Kathakali Dance is on 17 February 2027, from 10:30 am to 12:30 pm IST. Match subject code 061 with your registration details before adding the paper to your calendar.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Kathakali Dance dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 12: Kathakali Dance06117 February 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours

Find your Kathakali Dance entry in the PDF

Open PDF page 8 and look for code 061. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

Use the exact discipline and instrument or dance-form label. A neighbouring music or dance row is not a substitute for your registered subject, even where the examination time is identical.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 12 Kathakali Dance (061) falls 16 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Keep school assessments separate

This row gives the scheduled board paper. Do not use it to guess a practical, performance, project or internal-assessment appointment. Where your course has a separate assessed component, obtain that schedule and the instructions for materials from your school.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling timelines and portal access
description: A practical, timeline-focused guide for Indian students and parents on NEET UG 2026 state quota counselling, including portal access steps, key dates, and how to prepare documents.
content:
First steps you should take now

State quota counselling for NEET UG 2026 typically begins after the initial NEET results are announced and the All India counselling process is underway. Having a verified login, a clear list of preferred states, and ready document copies can save hours when windows open for choice filling and seat allotment. This article focuses on the practical timeline, portal access steps, and how to stay updated for your specific state process.

Understanding the counselling landscape

NEET UG is the national entrance for MBBS and BDS seats, with a portion reserved for state quota in most states. Counselling for state seats runs in parallel to or after the All India Counselling, depending on state rules. Each state typically conducts its own registration, choice filling, document verification, and seat allotment rounds. Some states may also have special rounds for management and NRI seats under their quota. Always refer to your state counselling portal for the exact sequence and deadlines.

Key portals and access steps

Access to state counselling portals is usually restricted to eligible candidates who have cleared the NEET UG exam and meet domicile or other state-specific criteria. Here are common steps to prepare for portal access:

  • Collect your NEET UG roll number, NEET score, and rank card. You will need these to verify your identity on the state portal.
  • Ensure your contact details (mobile number and email) are up to date, as portals often send OTPs and important notifications.
  • Keep scanned copies of your documents ready in the required size and format (typical formats include PDF, JPG, or PNG). Common documents include 10th and 12th mark sheets, NEET scorecard, domicile or category certificates, identity proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
  • Visit the official state counselling portal when it opens for registration. Do not rely on third-party sites for essential actions such as registration or seat allotment.
  • Log in using the credentials created during registration. If you forget a password, use the portal’s password recovery option.

Timeline to track for NEET UG 2026 state counselling

While exact dates vary by state, you can plan around a typical sequence observed across many states:

  • Declaration of NEET UG results and admission committe processing begins: Prepare for a possible short delay after results day.
  • Registration window opens: Create your login and register within the allotted period. Begin gathering required documents if you have not done so already.
  • Choice filling and locking: Prioritize MBBS and BDS seats under your state quota. Consider backup options in case your top choices are not allocated.
  • Document verification: Complete in-person verification at designated centres or via online verification if the state portal offers it.
  • Seat allotment rounds: Monitor allotment results on the portal and confirm or report to the allotted college within the stated timeline.
  • Reporting to allotted college: Physical or online reporting as required, including submission of original documents and payment of fees.

Because timelines can differ between states, the best approach is to check your state counselling portal or the official admission authority’s notices regularly. If a state provides a common nationwide portal for state quotas, use the link provided on that state’s education department site and avoid relying on secondary listings for critical actions.

Why portal access matters and how to ensure a smooth process

Portal access is the gateway to registration, choice filling, and seat allotment. A few practical tips can reduce last-minute stress:

  • Complete registration early and verify that all personal details are accurate before the deadline.
  • Keep a saved copy of your registration confirmation or receipt as proof of submission.
  • Frequently check the portal for any updates, changes to deadlines, or additional document requirements.
  • Coordinate with family members for timely decision-making during the seat allotment rounds, especially if multiple candidates share the same domicile or category status.
  • Follow official instructions for any improvisations or contingency steps if a round is postponed or if technical issues occur on the portal.

Documents checklist for state quota counselling

Have ready a complete, neatly scanned set of documents including:

  • NEET UG hall ticket and scorecard
  • Class 10 and Class 12 mark sheets (and passing certificates)
  • Domicile certificate (as applicable)
  • Category certificate (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS, etc.)
  • Identity proof (Aadhaar, passport, driver’s license)
  • Passport-size photographs as per portal specifications
  • Migration certificate or equivalent, if required by the state

What to do if you miss a deadline or face portal issues

If you encounter technical difficulties or miss a window, do not panic. States often offer an extended window or a separate grace period for technical issues. Contact the official helpline or helpdesk listed on the portal. Keep a record of all communications, including timestamps and reference numbers. If needed, consult with a trusted educational advisor to understand the options available for late registration or late round participation.

What to expect in the weeks ahead

Expect state authorities to publish detailed counselling schedules, seat matrices, and required documents. They may also release instructions for special rounds or management quota seats. Staying aligned with the official portal and any accompanying notices will ensure you do not miss critical updates. The landscape of state quota counselling can shift with policy updates, so regular verification is essential.

Bottom line for students and parents

State quota counselling for NEET UG 2026 hinges on timely portal access, accurate information, and disciplined preparation. Start early, gather documents, and keep all login credentials secure. By following state-issued guidelines and keeping a close eye on the official portal, you can navigate the process with confidence and make informed seat choices when rounds open.

Visible FAQ

Q1: When will state quota counselling for NEET UG 2026 begin?

A: Dates vary by state. Monitor your state's official counselling portal and education department notices for the opening of registration and subsequent rounds.

Q2: How do I access the state counselling portal?

A: Use the official link provided by the state education department. Do not rely on unofficial sites for submission or sensitive actions.

Q3: What documents are typically required?

A: NEET scorecard, board marksheets, domicile or category certificates, identity proof, and passport-size photos. Have digital copies ready in requested formats.

Q4: What if I miss a deadline?

A: Some states offer grace periods or extended windows for technical issues. Contact the official helpline promptly and follow instructions on the portal.

Q5: Can I change my choices after locking?

A: Many states allow modifications within a specific window before a subsequent round. Check the portal instructions for exact rules.

Q6: Do I need to report to the allocated college immediately?

A: Yes. After seat allotment, you must verify and complete reporting to secure the seat, following the college and state guidelines.

title: TS Inter 2027 ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ: ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಏನು ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ?
description: ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ಇಂಟರ್ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಅವಧಿ, ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಹುಡುಕುವ ವಿಧಾನ ಹಾಗೂ ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಸಲಹೆಗಳು.
content:
ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ಇಂಟರ್ಮೀಡಿಯಟ್ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಿಗೆ 2027ರ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಅವಧಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ದಿನದ ಯೋಜನೆ ರೂಪಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು ವಿಷಯವಾರು ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಾಯಿರಿ. ಮಂಡಳಿಯ 2026-27 ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜನವರಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯ ವಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು ಫೆಬ್ರವರಿಯ ಕೊನೆಯ ವಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದೆ. ಇವು ಸಿದ್ಧತೆಗೆ ನೆರವಾಗುವ ಅವಧಿಗಳು; ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಅಂತಿಮ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳಲ್ಲ.

TGBIE ಈಗ ನೀಡಿರುವ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಯಾವುದು?

ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಪೂರ್ವ ಅಂತಿಮ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳನ್ನು 2027 ಜನವರಿ 18ರಿಂದ 23ರವರೆಗೆ ನಿಗದಿಪಡಿಸಿದೆ. IPE 2027ರ ವಿಷಯವಾರು ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಇನ್ನೂ ನಿರೀಕ್ಷಿತವಾಗಿದೆ.

ಮೊದಲ ಅಥವಾ ಎರಡನೇ ವರ್ಷದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಎಂದು ಬಂದ ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಚಿತ್ರವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ನಂಬಬೇಡಿ. ಗಣಿತ, ಜೀವಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾಷಾ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವನ್ನು ಈ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಶುಲ್ಕದ ಸುತ್ತೋಲೆಯೂ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ದೃಢಪಡಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

TGBIEಯ 28 ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2026ರ ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್, ಪುಟ 2. ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ವಾರಗಳು ಅಂತಿಮ ವಿಷಯವಾರು ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳಲ್ಲ. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ (PDF)

ಸರಿಯಾದ ವರ್ಷದ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಗುರುತಿಸುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ?

ತೆಲಂಗಾಣ ಇಂಟರ್ಮೀಡಿಯಟ್ ಶಿಕ್ಷಣ ಮಂಡಳಿಯ ತಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ News & Announcements ವಿಭಾಗ ನೋಡಿ. IPE 2027 ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಸೂಚನೆ ಹುಡುಕಿ ಮಂಡಳಿಯ PDF ತೆರೆಯಿರಿ. ಹಳೆಯ IPE ಮತ್ತು ಮುಂದುವರಿದ ಪೂರಕ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಗಳ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳೂ ಇರುವುದರಿಂದ ವರ್ಷ ಹಾಗೂ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಹೆಸರು ಓದಿ.

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಪ್ರವೇಶ ದಾಖಲೆಗೆ ತಕ್ಕಂತೆ ಮೊದಲ ಅಥವಾ ಎರಡನೇ ವರ್ಷವನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಅಥವಾ ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ವಿಷಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆಯೇ ನೋಡಿ. ಆರಂಭದ ದಿನಾಂಕದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ವಿಷಯದ ಹೆಸರು, ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಸಮಯ ಮತ್ತು ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ ಓದಿ. ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಿದ್ಧಾಂತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕವಾಗಿ ಇರಿಸಿ. ಪರಿಷ್ಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಬಂದರೆ ಹಳೆಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯನ್ನು ಬದಲಿಸಿ.

ಕಾಯುವ ಅವಧಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಷಯವಾರು ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ

ಇನ್ನೂ ಓದಬೇಕಿರುವ ವಿಷಯಗಳ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ವಾರದ ಯೋಜನೆ ರೂಪಿಸಿ. ತಾತ್ಕಾಲಿಕ ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ ಮುಗಿಸುವ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಗುರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಂತಿಮ ದಿನಾಂಕಗಳು ಬರುವವರೆಗೆ ದಿನನಿತ್ಯದ ಮರುಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ಕ್ರಮವನ್ನು ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲು ಅವಕಾಶ ಇರಲಿ.

TGBIE ತಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ 2026-27ರ ಮೊದಲ ವರ್ಷದ ಪಠ್ಯಕ್ರಮ, ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ಶೈಕ್ಷಣಿಕ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಾದರಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಗಳಿವೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ವಿಷಯ ಹಾಗೂ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾದುದನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ಬಿಡಿಸಿ, ತಪ್ಪುಗಳ ಆಧಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಓದಿ. ಮೊದಲ ವರ್ಷದ ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯ ಮಾದರಿ ಎರಡನೇ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೂ ಅನ್ವಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ.

ಪ್ರಾಯೋಗಿಕ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಸೂಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೂನಿಯರ್ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನಿಂದ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ. ಅನಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿಯ ಚಿತ್ರ ನೋಡಿ ಹಣ ಮರಳಿ ಸಿಗದ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಬುಕಿಂಗ್ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ. ಅಧಿಕೃತ ವೇಳಾಪಟ್ಟಿ ಬಂದಾಗ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವನ್ನು ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

title: CLAT 2027 College Choice: What to Check Before Paying the Admission Fee
description: Before paying after CLAT 2027 allotment, compare counselling charges, NLU fees, refund terms, upgrade rules and reporting conditions.
content:
CLAT 2027 seat acceptance is not proof of final admission to an NLU. Before you pay, identify whether the amount is for counselling, seat confirmation or institute admission, then check the rule for your allotment round. A missed deadline can cost the seat; an unclear refund term can cost money too.

The responsible authority is the Consortium of National Law Universities, often called the Consortium. Don’t confuse it with Chanakya National Law University, which is also abbreviated as CNLU in some contexts. For exam background, see the CLAT exam guide, but treat the CLAT 2027 counselling notice and your allotted institute’s written instructions as the controlling documents.

What does accepting a CLAT seat actually do?

It depends on the round and the wording of the CLAT 2027 notice. A payment or selection may keep your candidature active, confirm a seat, permit consideration for movement, or close an option. The words accept, freeze, upgrade, withdraw and exit shouldn’t be treated as interchangeable.

Practical interpretation: compare the notice against your portal screen before selecting anything. Check whether an upgrade remains possible, whether you must report, and what happens if you reject or leave the seat. Don’t assume that waiting automatically protects your current allotment.

Which payment are you being asked to make?

PaymentWhat it may secureWho collects itRefund document
Counselling feeParticipation or processing in the Consortium’s processConsortiumApplicable counselling notice
Seat-confirmation amountRetention of an allotted seat, if the round permitsConsortium or named portalRound-specific notice
Institute admission feeReporting or admission processing at the NLUAllotted NLUInstitute’s written fee and refund terms

Also separate tuition, hostel, mess, deposits and one-time charges. The institute may apply different terms to each.

How should you compare an upgrade with the seat you hold?

Make one row for your current allotment and one for the possible upgrade. Record:

  • current allotment and preference position;
  • upgrade eligibility under that round;
  • freeze, withdrawal or exit effect;
  • payment and reporting deadlines;
  • first-year cash requirement and refundable amount;
  • documents, originals and reporting mode.

If the NLU gives no refund reply before the deadline, preserve the notice, payment page, transaction proof and unanswered email. Follow the portal or grievance route stated in the documents. Silence is not approval. Keep every screenshot and acknowledgement.

title: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Lepcha Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Lepcha: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
Class 10 Lepcha (026) is on 5 March 2027; Class 12 Lepcha (126) is on 3 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Lepcha dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Lepcha0265 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours
Class 12: Lepcha1263 March 202710:30 am to 1:30 pm IST3 hours

Find your Lepcha entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 6, 10 and look for codes 026, 126. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Lepcha (026) falls 7 calendar days after English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Lepcha (126) falls 2 calendar days before English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: TANCET 2025 Answer Key Out Now: Check Direct Link, Raise Objections by April 6
description: TANCET 2025 answer key is now available at tancet.annauniv.edu. Download your response sheet, raise objections by April 6, and check result date.
content:
TANCET 2025 Answer Key Released at tancet.annauniv.edu: Direct Link to Download Here

Anna University has officially released the provisional answer key for the Tamil Nadu Common Entrance Test (TANCET) 2025. Candidates who appeared for the exam on March 22, 2025, can now download the answer key from the official website — tancet.annauniv.edu. The answer key is available for both the MBA and MCA entrance exams and serves as an essential resource for students to evaluate their performance.

The provisional answer key enables candidates to cross-check their responses and estimate their likely scores. This transparency in the evaluation process gives students clarity ahead of the final result announcement.

How to Download the TANCET 2025 Answer Key:

  1. Visit the official website: tancet.annauniv.edu

  2. Click on the “TANCET 2025 Answer Key” link

  3. Log in using your registered email ID and password

  4. Complete the captcha verification

  5. Access and download the provisional answer key from your dashboard

Objection Window and Final Answer Key

Anna University has opened an objection window for candidates who find discrepancies in the answer key. If a candidate believes any answer is incorrect, they can raise objections through the official portal. The objection window is open from April 4 to April 6, 2025. All objections must be submitted with proper justification or supporting documents.

Once the objection window closes, the university will evaluate all challenges submitted. If any corrections are required, a final answer key will be released accordingly. This revised key will serve as the basis for result computation.

Important Dates to Remember:

  • Exam Date: March 22, 2025

  • Provisional Answer Key Release: April 4, 2025

  • Objection Deadline: April 6, 2025

  • Result & Final Answer Key Release: April 24, 2025

Candidates are advised to regularly visit the official website for any updates regarding the final answer key, result declaration, and the subsequent admission process. It is important to adhere to all deadlines to ensure smooth participation in the TANCET 2025 admission cycle.

For direct access to the answer key and other details, visit tancet.annauniv.edu.

title: Licious Success Story | How India’s Premium Meat Brand Became a Foodtech Unicorn
description: Read the inspiring success story of Licious, India’s first D2C meat and seafood unicorn. Learn about its founders, growth journey, funding, valuation, and how it redefined India’s meat industry.
content:
Licious Success Story | How India’s Premium Meat Brand Became a Foodtech Unicorn

Licious, founded in 2015 by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, has revolutionized the way Indians purchase and consume meat. The brand became India’s first D2C unicorn in the fresh meat and seafood category, setting a benchmark in the country’s foodtech industry.

The Vision Behind Licious

Before Licious, the Indian meat industry was mostly unorganized, with little focus on hygiene, cold storage, and quality checks. Abhay and Vivek realized that millions of Indian consumers were compromising on quality every day. Their vision was to build trust, ensure hygiene, and provide world-class quality in a segment that was rarely spoken about in terms of premium branding.

Starting from Bengaluru, the founders created a farm-to-fork supply chain, giving them control over every process—sourcing, processing, storage, and final delivery. This strategy became Licious’ biggest differentiator.

Rapid Growth and Expansion

  • By focusing on premium quality and reliable delivery, Licious quickly gained popularity in metro cities.

  • Today, Licious operates in 20+ cities including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Hyderabad, and Chennai.

  • It serves millions of customers with a diverse product range including chicken, mutton, seafood, eggs, ready-to-cook meals, spreads, marinades, and gourmet products.

  • The company has built strong brand loyalty, especially among young professionals and families who value convenience and trust.

Licious is not just about selling meat—it has successfully built a lifestyle brand around non-vegetarian food consumption in India.

Funding and Unicorn Status

Licious attracted top investors such as Temasek Holdings, Multiples PE, Vertex Ventures, and 3one4 Capital. In October 2021, the company raised $52 million in Series G funding, pushing its valuation past $1 Billion, making it a unicorn.

Licious Valuation Table

Year Funding Raised (INR) Funding Raised (USD) Valuation (Approx. INR) Valuation (Approx. USD)
2015 ₹15 Crore $2.2 Million ₹100 Crore $15 Million
2017 ₹132 Crore $20 Million ₹700 Crore $100 Million
2019 ₹465 Crore $65 Million ₹3,500 Crore $500 Million
2021 ₹1,650 Crore $240 Million ₹7,500 Crore $1 Billion
2023 ₹2,500 Crore+ $300+ Million ₹12,500 Crore $1.6 Billion

Why Licious Stands Out

  1. Farm-to-Fork Supply Chain – Full control over sourcing, processing, packaging, and delivery.

  2. Focus on Hygiene & Quality – Elevating standards in an unorganized meat market.

  3. Cold-Chain Logistics – Ensuring freshness from farms to consumers’ kitchens.

  4. Product Innovation – Ready-to-cook meals, marinades, cold cuts, and spreads.

  5. Customer Trust – Strong loyalty among urban, health-conscious, and premium customers.

  6. Premium Branding – Positioned as India’s go-to brand for fresh, hygienic meat.

Future Plans of Licious

  • Expanding to more Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities to capture India’s massive meat-eating population.

  • Strengthening its ready-to-eat and gourmet food range.

  • Leveraging technology and AI to optimize demand prediction and supply chain management.

  • Exploring global expansion opportunities in Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

Conclusion:

The Licious success story is not just about a startup scaling big—it’s about transforming an entire industry. By addressing the gaps in India’s meat supply chain, ensuring hygiene, and building consumer trust, Licious has carved its place as a premium foodtech brand. Its journey from a Bengaluru-based startup to a unicorn valued at over $1.6 Billion proves how innovation and vision can redefine consumer habits in India.

title: SSC GD 2026 Admit Card TODAY LIVE: Constable Exam Date, Hall Ticket Download
description: SSC GD 2026 admit card is expected today. Check Constable exam date, region-wise hall ticket download link, steps to download, and exam guidelines here.
content:
The SSC GD Admit Card 2026 is likely to be released today by the Staff Selection Commission for the applicants who are going to appear in the examination for the post of Constable (GD). After releasing the admit card, the aspirants can easily download their admit cards through the official website/SSC region-wise websites.

SSC GD 2026 Admit Card Release and Exam Date

According to the recent news, the SSC GD admit card is to be published online and might come region-wise. The examination is supposed to take place in different shifts on various days in 2026. Applicants need to be very cautious about their scheduled date, time, and centre as given on the admit card.

Particulars Details
Exam Name SSC GD Constable 2026
Conducting Body Staff Selection Commission
Admit Card Mode Online
Official Website https://ssc.nic.in

Steps to Download SSC GD Admit Card

The candidates should take the following measures:

- Go to the website www.ssc.nic.in.
- Navigate to the Admit card page.
- Choose the required region.
- Click on the link for SSC GD Admit Card 2026.
- Provide the registration number and date of birth.
- Print the hall ticket.

Details Mentioned on Admit Card

The hall ticket will include:

  • Candidate name and roll number
  • Exam date and shift timing
  • Exam centre address
  • Photograph and signature
  • Important instructions

Candidates must verify all details. In case of errors, contact SSC immediately.

Exam Day Guidelines

Candidates should carry:

  • Printed admit card
  • Valid photo ID proof

At least 30 to 60 minutes before reporting time, they must arrive at the exam location. It is completely forbidden to use electronic devices, study materials, or unfair methods within the exam room.

Selection Process

The SSC GD Constable recruitment includes:

  • Computer-Based Test (CBT)
  • Physical Efficiency Test (PET)
  • Physical Standard Test (PST)
  • Medical Examination

Conclusion

The SSC GD Admit Card 2026 plays a pivotal role in appearing for the examination. It should be downloaded by all candidates as soon as it becomes available, and instructions should be strictly followed.

title: CBSE 2027 ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ: ਹਰ PDF ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਾਲ ਵੇਖੋ
description: CBSE ਦੀ 2026 ਖ਼ਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸੂਚਨਾ ਨੂੰ 2027 ਮੁੱਖ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ। ਯੋਜਨਾ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਾਲ, ਜਮਾਤ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਵਰਗ ਮਿਲਾਓ।
content:
CBSE ਦੀ PDF ਵਿੱਚ “date sheet” ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਣਾ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ 2027 ਦੀ ਦਸਵੀਂ ਜਾਂ ਬਾਰ੍ਹਵੀਂ ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ। ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੱਧ ਪੂਰਬ/ਪੱਛਮੀ ਏਸ਼ੀਆ ਖੇਤਰ ਲਈ 2026 ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਬਾਰ੍ਹਵੀਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦਾ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਹੈ। 2027 ਮੁੱਖ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੀ ਤਿਆਰੀ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਨਾ ਵਰਤਣ।

ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਵਰਗ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਉਸ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਨਾਲ 2027 ਮੁੱਖ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਸ਼ੇਵਾਰ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ਾਂ ਪੱਕੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦੀਆਂ। ਯੋਜਨਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ਲਿਖਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਅਤੇ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਪੈਰਾ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ। ਜਮਾਤ, ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਾਲ, ਮੁੱਖ ਜਾਂ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਖੇਤਰ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਦੀਆਂ ਪਾਬੰਦੀਆਂ ਵੇਖੋ।

ਮਿਲਦੀ ਘੋਸ਼ਣਾ ਲਈ CBSE ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਰਕੂਲਰ ਅਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਬੋਰਡ ਵੈੱਬਸਾਈਟ ਵੇਖੋ। ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪੰਨੇ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਅੱਗੇ ਭੇਜੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਉਹ ਜਾਣਕਾਰੀ ਲੁਕਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਦੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ’ਤੇ ਲਾਗੂ ਹੈ ਜਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ।

CBSE ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਸਰਕੂਲਰ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ 9 ਅਕਤੂਬਰ 2026 ਦਾ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨੋਟਿਸ। ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਕਿਸਮ ਪਛਾਣਨ ਦੀ ਮਿਸਾਲ ਹੈ, 2027 ਮੁੱਖ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਨਹੀਂ। ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸਾਲ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਦਿਆਰਥੀ ਵਰਗ ਮਿਲਾਓ.

ਬਦਲੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਦੀ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਰੱਖੋ

ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਦੀ ਉਡੀਕ ਦੌਰਾਨ ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀਆਂ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਵਿਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਿਲੇਬਸ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੇ ਰਹੋ। ਅਧੂਰੇ ਅਧਿਆਇਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਧ ਸਮਾਂ ਦਿਓ, ਲਿਖਤੀ ਅਭਿਆਸ ਅਤੇ ਦੁਹਰਾਈ ਵਾਰੋ-ਵਾਰੀ ਕਰੋ। ਵਿਸ਼ਾ-ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪੱਕਾ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ ਯੋਜਨਾ ਬਦਲਣ ਦੀ ਥਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਦੋ ਪੇਪਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਵਕਫ਼ਾ ਨਾ ਮੰਨੋ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ ’ਤੇ ਪੈਸੇ ਵਾਪਸ ਨਾ ਮਿਲਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਸਫ਼ਰ ਬੁਕਿੰਗ ਨਾ ਕਰੋ। ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਮੌਸਮ ਦਾ ਆਮ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਂ ਸੈਸ਼ਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਤੈਅ ਕਰਦਾ।

ਮੁੱਖ ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਜਾਰੀ ਹੋਣ ’ਤੇ

  1. ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਸਮੇਤ ਪੂਰੀ ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ PDF ਸੰਭਾਲੋ।

  2. ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਮਿਲਦੇ ਨਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ, ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਨਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੋਡ ਮਿਲਾਓ।

  3. ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਹੋਣ ਦਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਸ ਮਿਆਦ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

  4. ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਬੰਧ ਸਕੂਲ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

  5. ਸੰਭਾਲੀ ਕਾਪੀ ਵਰਤਣ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਦੇ ਸਰਕੂਲਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੋਧ ਵੇਖੋ।

CBSE ਸਮਾਂ-ਸਾਰਣੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਸਤਾਵੇਜ਼ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਰ ਮਦਦ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ। ਲਾਗੂ ਨੋਟਿਸ ਆਉਣ ਤੱਕ ਉਮੀਦ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਤਾਰੀਖ਼ਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਤੌਰ ’ਤੇ ਅੰਦਾਜ਼ੇ ਵਜੋਂ ਹੀ ਲਿਖੋ।

title: कर्नाटक बोर्ड 2027: SSLC व II PUCची योग्य अंतिम वेळापत्रक PDF निवडा
description: SSLC आणि II PUC 2027 परीक्षा 1 व परीक्षा 2च्या तारखा, अधिकृत PDF आणि विषयांचे वेळापत्रक पाहून अभ्यासाचे नियोजन करा.
content:
कर्नाटकातील विद्यार्थी आता संभाव्य परीक्षा दिनदर्शिकेऐवजी KSEABचे 2027चे अंतिम वेळापत्रक वापरू शकतात. 29 ऑक्टोबर 2026च्या कागदपत्रांमध्ये SSLC आणि II PUCसाठी परीक्षा 1 व परीक्षा 2च्या स्वतंत्र PDF आहेत. तारीख लिहिण्यापूर्वी योग्य वर्ग आणि परीक्षा निवडा.

चार वेळापत्रके, चार स्वतंत्र PDF

खाली लेखी पेपरचा नियोजित कालावधी दिला आहे. प्रात्यक्षिक व तोंडी परीक्षांसाठी PDFमधील सूचनाही वाचा. सर्व तारखा 2027मधील आहेत.

परीक्षापहिला पेपरशेवटचा पेपरअधिकृत कागदपत्र
II PUC परीक्षा 127 फेब्रुवारी18 मार्चसंपूर्ण PDF
II PUC परीक्षा 23 मे15 मेसंपूर्ण PDF
SSLC परीक्षा 122 मार्च5 एप्रिलसंपूर्ण PDF
SSLC परीक्षा 224 मे31 मेसंपूर्ण PDF

II PUC: तुमच्या विषयांचा क्रम नोंदवा

परीक्षा 1मध्ये इंग्रजी 1 मार्च, भौतिकशास्त्र 4 मार्च, लेखाशास्त्र 5 मार्च, रसायनशास्त्र 8 मार्च आणि अर्थशास्त्र 9 मार्चला आहे. गणित व व्यवसाय अध्ययन 12 मार्चला; जीवशास्त्र, राज्यशास्त्र व संगणकशास्त्र 15 मार्चला; इतिहास 18 मार्चला आहे.

हे पेपर सकाळी 10 ते दुपारी 1 वाजेपर्यंत आहेत. तीच वेळ प्रत्येक पेपरला लागू करू नका. 11 मार्चचे हिंदुस्तानी संगीत आणि यादीतील व्यावसायिक विषयांचे पेपर सकाळी 10 ते दुपारी 12:15पर्यंत आहेत. परीक्षा 2मध्ये हे पेपर 15 मे रोजी दुपारी 2 ते सायंकाळी 4:15पर्यंत आहेत.

नोंदणी केलेले विषय आणि त्यांचे संकेतांकच लिहून ठेवा. परीक्षा 2चा विषयक्रम वेगळा असल्याने तिची PDF स्वतंत्र ठेवा.

SSLC: भाषा गट आणि वेळ तपासा

परीक्षा 1मध्ये प्रथम भाषा 22 मार्च, विज्ञान 25 मार्च, द्वितीय भाषा 27 मार्च, गणित 30 मार्च, तृतीय भाषा 2 एप्रिल आणि सामाजिक शास्त्र 5 एप्रिलला आहे. पर्यायी विषयांसाठी तुम्हाला लागू असलेली ओळ पाहा.

प्रथम भाषा, मुख्य विषय आणि JTS पेपर सकाळी 10 ते दुपारी 1:15पर्यंत आहेत. द्वितीय व तृतीय भाषा सकाळी 10 ते दुपारी 1 वाजेपर्यंत आहेत. यात प्रश्नपत्रिका वाचण्याचा वेळ समाविष्ट आहे. संगीत व NSQF पेपरच्या वेळा वेगळ्या आहेत.

JTS प्रात्यक्षिक व तोंडी परीक्षा संबंधित शाळांमध्ये परीक्षा 1साठी 6 एप्रिलला आणि परीक्षा 2साठी 1 जूनला होतील. अतिरिक्त वेळ आवश्यक असणाऱ्या विद्यार्थ्यांनी लागू सूचना शाळेकडून समजून घ्याव्यात.

अंतिम PDFवरून स्वतःचे अभ्यास दिनदर्शक बनवा

संपूर्ण फाइल डाउनलोड करून ते अंतिम वेळापत्रक असल्याची खात्री करा. सूचना असलेली पानेही जतन करा. शाळा किंवा महाविद्यालयाच्या नोंदीशी विषय संकेतांक जुळवा. तुमच्या दोन पेपरमधील तयारीचे दिवस नोंदवा; संपूर्ण परीक्षा कालावधीतील प्रत्येक दिवशी तुमचा पेपर असेलच असे नाही.

विषय संकेतांक किंवा नोंदणीत तफावत असल्यास शाळा किंवा महाविद्यालयाशी संपर्क करा. वेळापत्रक म्हणजे प्रवेशपत्र नाही आणि त्यावरून तुमचे परीक्षा केंद्र ठरत नाही. पुढील अधिकृत दुरुस्त्या पाहत राहा आणि सुधारित वेळापत्रक आल्यास जुनी प्रत बदला.

title: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Physical Activity Trainer Exam 2027: Dates, Codes and Timings
description: CBSE Classes 10 and 12 Physical Activity Trainer: check the 2027 exam date, exact subject code, paper duration and official PDF entry before making your timetable.
content:
Class 10 Physical Activity Trainer (418) is on 2 March 2027; Class 12 Physical Activity Trainer (845) is on 17 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Physical Activity Trainer dates and paper durations

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration
Class 10: Physical Activity Trainer4182 March 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours
Class 12: Physical Activity Trainer84517 March 202710:30 am to 12:30 pm IST2 hours

Find your Physical Activity Trainer entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 6, 11 and look for codes 418, 845. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

Class 10 Physical Activity Trainer (418) falls 4 calendar days after English Language and Literature (184), which is on 26 February 2027. Class 12 Physical Activity Trainer (845) falls 12 calendar days after English Core (301), which is on 5 March 2027.

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Keep school assessments separate

This row gives the scheduled board paper. Do not use it to guess a practical, performance, project or internal-assessment appointment. Where your course has a separate assessed component, obtain that schedule and the instructions for materials from your school.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

For the wider schedule, use the Class 10 and 12 date-sheet overview and the paper-duration guide.

title: CBSE 10 மற்றும் 12ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி தேர்வு 2027: தேதி, பாடக் குறியீடு, நேரம்
description: 10ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (குறியீடு 008) தேர்வு 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (குறியீடு 108) தேர்வு 3 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.
content:
10ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (குறியீடு 008) தேர்வு 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (குறியீடு 108) தேர்வு 3 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 9: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 5, 9 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 008, 108 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (008) தேர்வுத் தேதி 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027. English Language and Literature (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன. 12ஆம் வகுப்பு சிந்தி (108) தேர்வுத் தேதி 3 மார்ச் 2027. English Core (301) தேர்வுத் தேதி 5 மார்ச் 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 2 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்திற்குப் புறப்படும் முன்

தேர்வு தொடங்கும் நேரமும் மையத்துக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டிய நேரமும் வேறு. வருகை, நுழைவு, ஆவணங்கள் குறித்த விவரங்களுக்கு அனுமதிச் சீட்டைப் பாருங்கள். தேதி மாறியதாகத் தகவல் வந்தால் வாரியத்தின் திருத்தப்பட்ட அறிவிப்பில் வகுப்பு, குறியீடு, தேதி மூன்றையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

title: Before Paying a Private College Fee, Verify These Four Records
description: A practical private college admission verification guide for Indian students and parents, covering recognition, affiliation, fees, placements and refund terms before payment.
content:
Before paying a private college admission fee, verify the institution’s legal identity, current approval or recognition, course affiliation, complete fee schedule and written refund policy. Treat placement claims as a separate evidence check. Pay only when the course, campus, session, amount and receiving account are clear in writing.

This private college admission verification check can prevent avoidable financial loss. A receipt proves that money was paid, but it may not prove what a counsellor promised about a seat, scholarship, placement or refund.

Key facts to check before transferring money

  • Approval or recognition must cover the exact course, campus, academic session and permitted intake.
  • Affiliation identifies the university relationship for admission, examinations and degree issuance. It is not automatically the same as approval.
  • The written fee schedule should show recurring, one-time, compulsory and optional charges.
  • Placement figures need a batch, course, student-count and salary context.
  • Refund terms should explain the withdrawal route, deadlines, deductions and documents required.

Keep copies of the offer letter, fee schedule, prospectus version, payment instructions, receipt, emails and messages. Ask an authorised admissions office to clarify any mismatch before paying.

1. Check approval, recognition and the awarding university

A private college may use one brand name, operate under a trust or society, and offer degrees through another university. Record the exact legal name, campus address, course, intake, academic session and name of the degree-awarding university.

For technical programmes, check the applicable approval position with the All India Council for Technical Education. For universities and degree institutions, check the relevant University Grants Commission status. Professional programmes can have an additional regulator or council, so the responsible authority depends on the course.

Save the current official record or document and compare its details with the offer letter. Check whether it covers your campus, course, academic year and intake. A statement that approval is “under process” is not confirmation.

Approval and affiliation answer different questions

Approval may concern permission to conduct a type of programme. Affiliation identifies the university relationship under which students are admitted, examined and awarded a qualification. Ask who will register the student, issue examination instructions and award the final degree.

If the college cannot answer these questions clearly, pause the payment. A broad claim about university association does not establish that your exact course and campus are covered.

2. Match the fee schedule with the offer and receipt

“Pay ₹25,000 to block your seat” is not a complete cost disclosure. Request a year-wise schedule covering tuition, admission, registration, examination, laboratory, library, training, hostel, mess, transport, uniform and other compulsory charges. Optional services should be marked separately.

RecordWhat to verifyDecision value
Approval or recognition recordLegal name, course, campus, session and permitted intakeShows whether the programme is covered by the relevant authority
Affiliation or university listingUniversity, programme, campus and validity for the joining yearClarifies examination and degree arrangements
Fee schedule and offer letterTotal charges, payment dates, recurring items and withdrawal termsShows the likely financial commitment
Payment page and receiptBeneficiary name, official payment channel and transaction referenceCreates a clear payment trail
Placement reportBatch, course, student count, salary definition and job typeHelps separate evidence from promotional claims

Compare the schedule with the offer letter, payment page and receipt. If a counsellor quotes one amount and the written document shows another, ask for a dated clarification from an authorised office. Do not assume that a multi-year package is fixed unless the college states this clearly.

Estimate the first-year cost by adding compulsory academic fees, hostel and mess charges, examination costs, travel or relocation expenses and a realistic personal allowance. Multiply only clearly recurring items for later years.

3. Test placement claims against the same course and batch

Claims such as “100% placement assistance” or “highest package” do not show how many students received full-time offers. Ask for the latest dated placement report and check whether it covers the same campus, course and graduating batch offered to the student.

  • Course-wise student strength and number of students placed.
  • Number of unique students placed, separate from total offers.
  • Median or average salary, not only the highest package.
  • Employer names, job roles and work locations where disclosure is permitted.
  • Internships, training roles and full-time jobs shown separately.
  • Students who chose higher education, entrepreneurship or other routes.

Ask what the reported salary means. Fixed pay, total compensation and incentive-linked earnings are not interchangeable. A university-wide figure or a selected small batch should not be treated as the result for every student in the programme.

If the college provides only verbal percentages or refuses to share a dated, course-level report, record the claim as unverified. Placement assistance is not a guaranteed job.

4. Read the written cancellation and refund policy

The policy should identify the withdrawal process, deadline, deductions, required documents, responsible office and expected processing route. It should also explain whether admission deposits, tuition, hostel, mess and other charges are treated differently.

Ask the college to identify the applicable rule of the university, regulator or state authority for your course and admission route. Rules can differ by institution and programme, so verify the current position through the relevant official authority portal rather than relying on a general verbal assurance.

Send a withdrawal request through the official email or portal stated in the policy and keep its acknowledgement. If staff say a refund depends on a replacement student, ask them to show that condition in the written policy.

A safer payment decision

  1. Write down the college’s legal name, campus, course, session and awarding university.
  2. Check approval, recognition and affiliation for those exact details.
  3. Obtain the complete fee schedule, offer letter and refund policy before payment.
  4. Examine placement evidence for the same programme and recent graduating batch.
  5. Pay only through the authorised channel named in the written documents.
  6. Save the receipt and request an admission and document-submission acknowledgement.

Compare the cost and evidence with at least two realistic alternatives, including travel and accommodation. A same-day deadline is not a substitute for documentation.

Pause when these details are missing

  • The awarding university is not named.
  • Approval relates to a different course, campus or academic year.
  • Payment is requested by an individual or unrelated account without an authorised explanation.
  • The offer letter is withheld until money is transferred.
  • Placement figures lack a course, batch or student-count context.
  • The refund rule is verbal, incomplete or supplied only after admission.
  • A counsellor promises a guaranteed job, recognition or scholarship without written terms.

One unexplained mismatch may be clerical. Several together should stop the payment until the authorised admissions office provides written clarification and the relevant authority records support the claim.

FAQs on private college admission verification

What should I verify first before paying a private college admission fee?

Verify the institution’s legal identity, awarding university, current approval or recognition, exact course, campus and academic session. Then obtain the fee schedule and refund policy in writing before transferring money.

Is affiliation the same as approval?

No. Approval may concern permission to conduct a type of programme, while affiliation identifies the university relationship for admission, examinations and degree issuance. Check both for the exact course, campus and joining year.

How can parents check whether a placement claim is reliable?

Ask for a dated, course-wise placement report showing batch size, students placed, salary definitions, employer details and the difference between internships and full-time jobs. Do not rely on the highest package alone.

Should I pay a seat-booking amount before receiving the offer letter?

Avoid paying until the college provides the course, campus, session, amount, payment deadline and refund terms in writing. If an urgent deposit is requested, ask for an authorised receipt and the applicable cancellation policy before proceeding.

What should a private college fee schedule include?

It should identify tuition, one-time charges, examination and registration fees, hostel and mess costs, transport, laboratory or training charges, optional services and expected payment dates. Ask which items recur each year.

What can I do if a college refuses to follow its written refund policy?

Send a dated written request with the admission and payment records, keep proof of delivery, and escalate through the college’s grievance office, affiliating university and applicable regulator or state authority. The correct forum depends on the course and institution.

title: NIFT Portfolio Review: What Counts as Original Work in an Admission File
description: Learn how NIFT applicants can audit sketches, photographs and digital work for originality before design assessment or an interview.
content:
A polished NIFT portfolio can still weaken your application if it looks traced, copied or assembled from internet references without thought. For National Institute of Fashion Technology applicants, original work means showing your observation, decisions and changes, not just attractive final images. That distinction matters when you submit work or discuss it during an assessment.

Keep it honest. Keep it explainable.

What does original work look like in a NIFT portfolio?

Original work usually begins with your own observation, question or idea. A sketch based on a street vendor’s arrangement, a photograph taken at a local market, or a garment detail developed through several rough drawings can show how you think.

A reference can help you learn, but copying its pose, composition, character or surface detail too closely creates doubt. If an image influenced you, change the setting, purpose or visual treatment and record what you changed. Ask yourself whether you could explain the piece clearly if a reviewer asked, “Why did you make this choice?” If not, rework it or leave it out.

How should you check each type of work?

  • Sketches: Keep selected rough versions, corrections and notes beside finished drawings. Remove trace-overs, copied logos and near-identical online studies.
  • Photographs: Use images you shot yourself where possible. Note the subject and setting, and never present a downloaded photograph as your own observation.
  • Digital work: Retain layered files, early drafts and dated exports. A poster built around an unedited stock image may look polished while revealing little independent thinking.
  • Fashion work: Show proportion, fabric, function and the intended user. A clothing illustration copied from a brand campaign isn’t evidence of your own design process.

What should you retain before submission?

Keep a small process folder with dated scans, photographs, source notes and digital drafts. It can help you explain genuine development, but it won’t repair copied work. Use this five-question audit:

  1. Did I make or directly observe the source material?
  2. Can I explain the first idea and later changes?
  3. Have I credited a reference or borrowed technique where needed?
  4. Does the work stand on its own without the reference beside it?
  5. Can I discuss it calmly in an assessment or interview?

National Institute of Fashion Technology’s admission requirements can change by cycle. Check the current NIFT notice on the responsible official portal for the exact assessment and submission instructions before you upload anything. You can also compare design colleges if your preferred course asks for a different type of portfolio.

Choose fewer pieces you can defend honestly over a crowded file full of doubtful work. Originality is visible in the trail of decisions behind each piece.

title: NMAT 2026: 31 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत नोंदणी आणि परीक्षेची वेळ बुक करा
description: NMAT 2026 नोंदणीसोबत परीक्षेची वेळही 31 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत बुक करा. शुल्क, प्रवेशपत्र आणि महाविद्यालयाच्या स्वतंत्र अर्जाबद्दल जाणून घ्या.
content:
NMAT 2026 उमेदवारांना नोंदणी आणि परीक्षेची वेळ निश्चित करणे, या दोन्ही प्रक्रिया 31 ऑक्टोबर 2026पर्यंत पूर्ण करायच्या आहेत. परीक्षा शुल्क भरल्यानेच वेळ निश्चित होत नाही; उमेदवाराच्या डॅशबोर्डवर अपॉइंटमेंटची पुष्टी असणे गरजेचे आहे. GMACच्या वेळापत्रकानुसार परीक्षा 2 नोव्हेंबर ते 20 डिसेंबर 2026दरम्यान होतील.

मुदतीपूर्वी दोन प्रक्रिया पूर्ण करा

अधिकृत तारखा व शुल्काच्या पानावर नोंदणी आणि वेळ निश्चित करण्याची अंतिम तारीख 31 ऑक्टोबर आहे. आधीच पैसे भरले असल्यास डॅशबोर्डमध्ये परीक्षा दिनांक, वेळ आणि केंद्र निश्चित झाले आहे का पाहा. पेमेंटची पावती म्हणजे स्लॉटची पुष्टी नव्हे.

उपलब्ध स्लॉट आधी बुक करणाऱ्यांना मिळतात. प्रवासाला सोयीचा पर्याय निवडा. आवडते केंद्र किंवा शनिवार-रविवारचा स्लॉट शेवटपर्यंत शिल्लक राहील असे गृहीत धरू नका. नंतरची रीशेड्यूलिंग सुविधा सुरुवातीच्या नोंदणी व बुकिंगची मुदत वाढवत नाही.

GMACच्या NMAT 2026 अधिकृत वेळापत्रकाचा अंश. वेब पानावर दस्तऐवजाची प्रकाशन तारीख दिलेली नाही. अधिकृत तारखा आणि शुल्क

पैसे भरण्यापूर्वी ओळखपत्राशी तपशील जुळवा

GMACच्या नोंदणी सूचनांद्वारे खाते उघडा किंवा त्यात प्रवेश करा. ईमेल पडताळून प्रोफाइल आणि अर्ज भरा. नाव व जन्मतारीख परीक्षेसाठी वापरणार असलेल्या फोटो ओळखपत्राशी तंतोतंत जुळली पाहिजे. तुमची ओळख पटेल असे अलीकडील छायाचित्र अपलोड करा.

नोंदणी शुल्क ₹3,000 आणि लागू कर आहे. निवडलेल्या पाच संस्थांना गुण अहवाल पाठवणे यात समाविष्ट आहे. प्रत्येक अतिरिक्त अहवालासाठी ₹400 आणि कर लागतो. पैसे भरण्यापूर्वी संस्थांच्या निवडी तपासा आणि पावती जतन करा.

नोंदणी व परीक्षा बुकिंगच्या सूचना

बुकिंगची पुष्टी आणि प्रवेशपत्र जपून ठेवा

पेमेंटनंतर डॅशबोर्डवरील Book Exam Slot निवडा. परीक्षा केंद्रावर परीक्षा देण्याचा पर्याय निवडून नियम वाचा; मग उपलब्ध शहर, केंद्र, तारीख व वेळ निवडा. दुसऱ्या शहरात प्रवास असल्यास अंतिम पुष्टी काळजीपूर्वक तपासा.

बुक केलेल्या परीक्षेच्या सात दिवस आधी डॅशबोर्डमधून प्रवेशपत्र डाउनलोड करता येते, असे GMAC सांगते. त्यासाठी स्मरणपत्र ठेवा. नोंदणीची अडचण सोडवण्यासाठी अधिकृत मदत घेताना व्यवहाराचा संदर्भ तयार ठेवा; पासवर्ड किंवा पेमेंटची गोपनीय माहिती शेअर करू नका.

महाविद्यालयांसाठी स्वतंत्र अर्ज आवश्यक

NMAT नोंदणीमुळे विद्यापीठ किंवा बिझनेस स्कूलचा MBA अर्ज आपोआप सादर होत नाही. प्रत्येक संस्थेची पात्रता, अर्जाची मुदत व गुण स्वीकारण्याची पद्धत वेगळी असू शकते. संस्थेचे अर्ज शुल्क भरण्यापूर्वी अधिकृत अटी वाचा.

प्रत्येक अभ्यासक्रमासाठी अर्ज, पेमेंटची पुष्टी, गुण अहवालाची निवड आणि पुढील निवड टप्प्यांची स्वतंत्र यादी ठेवा. परीक्षेची नोंदणी पूर्ण झाली म्हणजे प्रवेश अर्ज पूर्ण झाला, असे समजू नका.

title: NEET UG Counselling: Compare Bond and Refund Terms Before Choice Filling
description: Compare tuition, bonds, deposits and withdrawal clauses before NEET UG choice filling, so a low-fee medical seat does not become an expensive exit.
content:
NEET UG counselling choices should be compared on exit cost, not tuition alone. Before locking a seat, check its bond, security deposit, withdrawal deadline, refund deductions and the authority that controls resignation. A cheaper government seat can carry a service obligation, while a private seat may expose you to large non-refundable charges.

For current exam notices, check the official NEET UG website. The Medical Counselling Committee or the relevant state counselling authority controls admission terms for its seats, so its current notice and the college fee document matter more than a verbal assurance.

What should you compare in NEET UG counselling?

Make one sheet for every serious option. Record the amount payable at joining, the yearly fee, the deposit, the bond liability and the exact exit route. Mark each entry as confirmed, conditional or unclear. If a college cannot explain a clause in writing, treat that uncertainty as a cost.

TermRecord thisFinancial consequence
Tuition and chargesYear-wise fee, hostel, mess and university chargesShows the real first-year outflow
Security depositAmount, refund trigger and deductionsMoney may stay blocked or be forfeited
BondService period, amount and exit conditionsLeaving early may create a separate liability
WithdrawalDeadline, resignation channel and documentsA late or informal request may not protect a refund

How do government and private medical seats compare?

Government medical seats generally have lower tuition, but the applicable state notice may attach a service bond or exit payment. Private colleges can charge more at joining, yet their refund wording may be clearer or may list heavy deductions. The label alone tells you very little.

Use this calculation: joining payment plus non-refundable charges plus possible bond liability. A seat needing ₹2 lakh at joining, with ₹50,000 non-refundable and a possible ₹5 lakh bond, carries a much larger risk than the tuition headline suggests. This is a decision rule, not a claim that every college applies these figures.

What must you verify before locking a choice?

  1. Download the current fee, bond and refund notices, including annexures.
  2. Ask whether resignation goes through the counselling portal, college office or both.
  3. Confirm the deadline tied to refund eligibility, not just the reporting date.
  4. Get every answer in writing and keep the payment receipt naming each fee head.

Read the NEET UG exam guide for the wider admission process, but use the seat-specific notice for the money decision. If terms conflict, pause and seek clarification from the responsible counselling authority before paying.

title: तमिलनाडु NEET PG रैंक सूची 2026: अपना कोटा और अतिरिक्त सूची जाँचें
description: सरकारी और मैनेजमेंट कोटे की अलग-अलग अस्थायी रैंक सूचियाँ देखें। आवेदन नंबर मिलाएँ और रैंक मिलने को सीट आवंटन न मानें।
content:
तमिलनाडु में 2026-27 सत्र के NEET PG सरकारी और मैनेजमेंट कोटे की अस्थायी रैंक सूचियाँ उपलब्ध हैं। जिस कोटे में आवेदन किया है, उसी सूची में आवेदन नंबर या NEET रोल नंबर से खोजें। नाम मिलना काउंसलिंग का एक चरण है, कॉलेज आवंटन नहीं।

अपने आवेदन से मेल खाने वाली सूची खोलें

चयन समिति ने सरकारी कोटे के PG डिग्री और डिप्लोमा उम्मीदवारों तथा मैनेजमेंट कोटे के उम्मीदवारों के लिए अलग PDF जारी किए हैं। सरकारी सूची में सामान्य रैंक, सामुदायिक रैंक, सेवा स्थिति और प्रोत्साहन संबंधी जानकारी है। मैनेजमेंट सूची में अपने रैंक और अंकों के कॉलम हैं। संख्याओं की तुलना से पहले कॉलम का अर्थ पढ़ें।

सेवारत आवेदकों के DNB ब्रॉड स्पेशलिटी और पोस्ट-MBBS डिप्लोमा की सूची अलग है। MD या MS की स्थिति तय करने के लिए DNB, MDS डेंटल या स्नातक मेडिकल सूची न देखें।

मूल PDF के साथ अतिरिक्त सूची भी पढ़ें

चयन समिति की वेबसाइट पर सरकारी कोटे की PG रैंक सूची का अतिरिक्त दस्तावेज भी है। पहले PDF में आवेदन न मिले तो इसे विशेष रूप से जाँचें। NRI, अल्पसंख्यक, PwD और निर्दिष्ट CMC सीट मार्गों की पात्रता सूचियाँ अलग हैं। सामान्य रैंक सूची को हर श्रेणी की पात्रता का अंतिम निर्णय न मानें; अपने दावे से जुड़ी सूचना पढ़ें।

अपनी प्रविष्टि को रिकॉर्ड से मिलाएँ

आवेदन नंबर, NEET रोल नंबर, नाम, अंक और दिखाए गए श्रेणी या सेवा विवरण जाँचें। जमा किया गया फॉर्म, स्कोरकार्ड और प्रमाणपत्र साथ रखें। अंतर दिखने पर चयन समिति के वर्तमान निर्देश और आधिकारिक संपर्क माध्यम से विषय उठाएँ। भेजी गई जानकारी की प्रति रखें।

केवल नाम से खोजने पर वर्तनी का अंतर छूट सकता है या किसी और की प्रविष्टि मिल सकती है। पहले आवेदन या रोल नंबर से खोजें, फिर बाकी विवरण मिलाएँ।

सीट पक्की माने बिना विकल्प तैयार करें

उन कोर्स और कॉलेज संयोजनों की सूची बनाएँ जिन्हें आप वास्तव में स्वीकार करेंगे। प्राथमिकता तय करने से पहले वर्तमान प्रॉस्पेक्टस में शुल्क, बॉन्ड और दस्तावेजों की शर्तें पढ़ें। पंजीकरण, विकल्प भरने और आवंटन के लिए अलग काउंसलिंग कार्यक्रम और रिक्तियों की सूचनाएँ देखें। रैंक सूची जारी होने से रिपोर्टिंग की समय-सीमा तय नहीं होती और प्रवेश की गारंटी नहीं मिलती।

title: JEE Main 2027 Session 1: What to Do If Your Aadhaar Details Differ
description: A practical decision guide for JEE Main 2027 applicants whose Aadhaar, application form and school records show different names, dates of birth or gender details.
content:
If your Aadhaar, JEE Main 2027 application and Class 10 records differ, don’t assume the mismatch is harmless or that an admit card will settle it. The right action depends on the field that differs and on what the National Testing Agency, or NTA, permits in the current Session 1 notice or correction notice.

Start by checking the latest instruction on the official JEE Main website. The points below are practical guidance, not a confirmed 2027 rule about which document will control.

Which Aadhaar differences need action?

Use the three records as a comparison set. A difference in spacing, initials or punctuation may be a formatting variation, but you must not label it harmless without checking the exact NTA instructions. A changed spelling, date of birth or gender entry needs closer attention.

DifferenceWhat it may meanPractical next step
Name spacing, initials or punctuationPossible format variationCheck the application instructions and keep all matching identity records ready
Different spelling or missing name partPossible identity mismatchUse the NTA correction route if the field is available
Different date of birthMaterial identity differenceCompare the source records and seek clarification through the stated NTA process
Different gender entryApplication data differenceCheck whether NTA has opened that field for correction

Class 10 records can help you compare academic details, while Aadhaar is an identity record. But the supplied evidence does not establish which document NTA will treat as controlling for JEE Main 2027. The current bulletin or correction notice must answer that.

What if Aadhaar itself is wrong?

Separate the two problems. If the error is in Aadhaar, use only the authorised Aadhaar correction process. If the error is in the JEE Main form, use the NTA route when available. Correcting one record does not automatically update the other.

  1. Save the submitted application confirmation page and note the application number.
  2. Compare every letter of the name, the complete date of birth and the gender entry across all records.
  3. Take a screenshot if a correction field, notice or response appears on the portal.
  4. Don’t file a second application or alter a certificate. If no correction option appears, follow the contact method in the current NTA notice.

A valid admit card may still leave an identity difference needing clarification because no supplied JEE Main 2027 rule confirms that the admit card overrides inconsistent records. Keep the documents named in the current exam-day instructions together. For wider exam planning, see entrance exam updates, but don’t apply another exam’s document rules to JEE Main.
