title: चित्तौड़गढ़ कौशल विकास योजना घोटाला: कोर्ट के आदेश पर FIR दर्ज
description: चित्तौड़गढ़ में कौशल विकास योजनाओं के तहत करोड़ों रुपये की कथित धांधली सामने आई है। कोर्ट के आदेश पर प्राथमिकी दर्ज, जांच शुरू।
content:
राजस्थान के चित्तौड़गढ़ जिले में कौशल विकास योजनाओं के तहत करोड़ों रुपये की कथित वित्तीय धांधली का मामला सामने आया है। इस मामले में अदालत के आदेश के बाद संबंधित व्यक्तियों और संस्थाओं के खिलाफ प्राथमिकी (FIR) दर्ज की गई है। मामला सामने आने के बाद प्रशासनिक और राजनीतिक हलकों में हलचल मच गई है।

आरोप है कि कौशल विकास योजनाओं के नाम पर फर्जी प्रशिक्षण, अपात्र लाभार्थियों का चयन और सरकारी धन के दुरुपयोग के जरिए बड़े पैमाने पर गड़बड़ी की गई। शिकायतकर्ताओं ने पहले प्रशासनिक स्तर पर कार्रवाई की मांग की थी, लेकिन संतोषजनक कार्रवाई न होने पर मामला अदालत तक पहुंचा।

क्या हैं आरोप?

  • प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रमों का कागजों में संचालन

  • वास्तविक लाभार्थियों को प्रशिक्षण न मिलना

  • सरकारी अनुदान का गलत उपयोग

  • फर्जी दस्तावेजों के आधार पर भुगतान

कोर्ट का रुख

मामले की गंभीरता को देखते हुए अदालत ने पुलिस को प्राथमिकी दर्ज कर जांच शुरू करने के निर्देश दिए। इसके बाद संबंधित थाने में मामला दर्ज कर लिया गया है और जांच प्रक्रिया प्रारंभ हो चुकी है।

आगे क्या होगा?

पुलिस अब:

  • योजना से जुड़े दस्तावेजों की जांच करेगी

  • प्रशिक्षण एजेंसियों और अधिकारियों से पूछताछ करेगी

  • वित्तीय लेन-देन का ऑडिट कराएगी

यदि आरोप साबित होते हैं, तो दोषियों के खिलाफ कड़ी कानूनी कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।

यह मामला सरकारी योजनाओं में पारदर्शिता और जवाबदेही को लेकर गंभीर सवाल खड़े करता है। जांच के नतीजों पर सभी की नजरें टिकी हुई हैं।

The information bulletin lists 2 to 7 April 2027 for Session 2. That is a tentative schedule: the application notice says a separate Session 2 notification will follow. Do not treat the April window as an individual allotment or make non-refundable travel bookings around it.

January and April exam windows

Registration is open. NTA's Session 1 notice sets 22 November 2026, 11:50 pm, as the regular application and fee-payment deadline. A late-fee window runs from 23 to 26 November, with an additional ₹500 over the applicable examination fee. The correction window is scheduled for 27 to 29 November.

The bulletin's tentative Session 2 calendar lists an application window from 5 January to 3 February 2027. NTA says the separate notification will come later, so this does not mean Session 2 applications are open now.

title: JEE Main Maths Last Minute Revision: Core Formulas
description: Review key formulas for your JEE Main Maths last minute revision. Master essential calculus, algebra, coordinate geometry, and vector formulas quickly.
content:
JEE Main Maths Last Minute Revision: Core Formulas & Exam Strategy

Executing a targeted JEE Main Maths last minute revision is essential for engineering aspirants aiming to secure a high percentile in the mathematics section. Mathematics is traditionally considered the most time-consuming and calculation-heavy portion of the Joint Entrance Examination (JEE) Main. Under strict examination time limits, attempting to derive standard results or formulas from scratch wastes valuable minutes. Memorizing key formulas, coordinate identities, and calculus properties allows candidates to identify problem types quickly and execute accurate calculations.

This guide provides a consolidated review of high-yield formulas across Coordinate Geometry, Calculus, Vectors, 3D Geometry, and Algebra, along with proven question-selection strategies for exam day.

Mathematics Paper Format and Scoring Structure

The Mathematics section of JEE Main contains 30 questions evaluated out of 100 marks. Candidates must attempt 25 questions in total.

  • Section A: 20 compulsory Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).

  • Section B: 10 Numerical Value Type questions, from which candidates must select and answer exactly 5.

Correct answers receive +4 marks, while incorrect answers receive a deduction of -1 mark. Unattempted questions carry zero marks. Because Section B offers an elective choice (attempting 5 out of 10), formula fluency allows you to identify the 5 shortest numerical problems quickly, avoiding lengthy multi-step calculations.

Essential Formulas by Mathematical Branch

Focusing on high-yield branches ensures that your final preparation hours target the questions most likely to appear on your test paper.

Coordinate Geometry: Conics and Lines

Coordinate geometry accounts for roughly 20% of the mathematics section. Questions frequently test standard forms and tangent conditions.

  • Distance between Parallel Lines

  • Condition of Tangency for a Circle

  • Parabola

  • Ellipse

  • Hyperbola

Calculus: Differential and Integral Applications

Calculus forms the largest individual component in the paper, usually contributing 8 to 10 questions.

  • Leibniz Rule for Differentiation under Integral Sign

  • King’s Property of Definite Integrals

  • Standard Definite Integral Reduction

  • First-Order Linear Differential Equations

Vectors and Three-Dimensional Geometry

Vectors and 3D geometry provide high scoring returns because problems are governed by fixed, standard vector relationships.

  • Shortest Distance Between Two Skew Lines

  • Scalar Triple Product (Box Product

  • Vector Triple Product Expansion

Algebra: Matrices, Complex Numbers, and Probability

  • Properties of Adjoint and Determinants

  • Complex Numbers (Cube Roots of Unity

  • Bayes' Theorem for Conditional Probability

Comprehensive Formula Reference Table

The table below summarizes the critical algebraic, geometric, and calculus identities required during your JEE Main Maths last minute revision.

Mathematical Area

Core Identity / Formula

Primary Application

Definite Integration

$\int_{-a}^{a} f(x)dx = 2\int_{0}^{a} f(x)dx$ (Even), $0$ (Odd)

Eliminating complex algebraic expressions over symmetric bounds.

Limits

$\lim_{x \to 0} (1 + f(x))^{\frac{1}{g(x)}} = e^{\lim_{x \to 0} \frac{f(x)}{g(x)}}$

Solving $1^\infty$ indeterminate exponential forms rapidly.

Matrices

$adj(AB) = adj(B) \cdot adj(A)$

Simplifying multi-matrix expressions without direct multiplication.

Conics (Parabola)

$T^2 = S \cdot S_1$

Finding the combined equation of a pair of tangents from an external point.

3D Geometry

$\cos^2\alpha + \cos^2\beta + \cos^2\gamma = 1$

Resolving directional cosines for line projections and angular rotations.

Binomial Theorem

$T_{r+1} = \binom{n}{r} a^{n-r} b^r$

Isolating term coefficients and finding terms independent of $x$.

Section B Selection and Time Management Tactics

A major scoring differentiator in the mathematics paper is question selection in Section B. Because only 5 out of the 10 numerical questions need to be attempted, careful filtering saves significant time.

  • First Pass Selection (2 Minutes): Spend two minutes reading all 10 numerical prompts in Section B before writing any steps. Mark questions on Vectors, 3D Geometry, Matrices, and Limits, which typically have straightforward solutions.

  • Skip Lengthy Integration by Parts: If an integral in Section B requires repeated integration by parts or trigonometric conversions, leave it. Look instead for differential equations that simplify quickly using an integrating factor.

  • Watch for Direct Quadratic & Sequence Questions: Arithmetic and geometric progression formulas are direct. If a problem involves finding the sum of infinite terms or simple matrix equations, prioritize it over multi-variable coordinate geometry problems.

Practical Revision Checklist

Ensure the following operational tasks are completed before you enter the examination hall:

  • Review Standard Curves and Graphs: Revise graphs of standard functions, such as greatest integer function, fractional part, and inverse trigonometric functions. These are critical for checking continuity and differentiability.

  • Practice Arithmetic Without Shortcuts: Many students lose marks in Section B due to basic arithmetic slips. Keep your scratch-paper calculations neat and legible to verify your signs and steps.

  • Avoid Deriving Standard Properties: Do not spend exam time re-deriving formulas like the shortest distance between lines or matrix adjoint properties. These must be recalled instantly from memory.

  • Set a Strict Sectional Time Budget: Allocate between 60 and 70 minutes to the Mathematics section. Complete Chemistry in 35 to 40 minutes and Physics in 45 to 50 minutes to leave adequate time for mathematical problem-solving.

Final Review Approach

A high score in the mathematics paper depends directly on formula recall and disciplined problem selection. By prioritizing high-yield areas during your JEE Main Maths last minute revision, such as definite integration properties, matrix determinants, and vector formulas, you reduce the time needed to plan each solution. During the exam, focus on Section A's conceptual MCQs first, scan Section B to attempt the five most direct numerical problems, and maintain clean calculations to avoid arithmetic penalties. Approach the section methodically to turn your preparation into a high percentile.

content:
Class 10 Tibetan (017) is on 9 March 2027; Class 12 Tibetan (117) is on 3 March 2027. The table below keeps each registered course and its exam slot separate, so you can select the entry that applies to you.

These entries appear in the CBSE main examination date sheet issued on 6 November 2026. It contains the examination schedule for Classes 10 and 12. It is not a result or marksheet download.

Class and paperCodeExam dateTime (IST)Duration

Find your Tibetan entry in the PDF

Open PDF pages 7, 10 and look for codes 017, 117. First check the class heading, then read across the subject row to the date and time. Some date labels and time cells cover several rows. On a phone, enlarge the page rather than reading an isolated screenshot without its heading.

The entries above do not all fall on the same date. A subject name alone is therefore not enough to choose a day. Copy the code and course label from your school record and retain only the matching row in your personal timetable.

Place this paper in your revision calendar

That is a calendar comparison, not a guaranteed preparation break. Count only the clear days between your own registered papers. Put other examinations into the calendar first, then choose realistic revision sessions and a timed practice slot matching the duration of this paper.

Before travelling to the examination centre

The start time is not an arrival deadline. Read the admit-card instructions for reporting, entry and the documents you need. If the school shares a revised CBSE notice, compare its class, code and date before changing your calendar. Do not infer a new date from a social-media headline.

CBSE says important instructions will be issued separately and students must follow the admit card. Communication devices are not allowed inside the examination centre. Check the instructions for permitted materials before packing your bag.

title: ICSE, ISC 2027: রিভিশনের জন্য সঠিক নমুনা প্রশ্নপত্র বাছুন
description: CISCE নির্বাচিত 2027 নমুনা প্রশ্নপত্র ও উত্তরসূচি প্রকাশ করেছে। এগুলিকে 2026-এর পুরনো পেপার এবং পরীক্ষার সময়সূচি থেকে আলাদা করে চিনুন।
content:
2027-এর জন্য প্রস্তুত ICSE ও ISC পড়ুয়ারা CISCE প্রকাশিত নির্বাচিত 2027 নমুনা প্রশ্নপত্র ও উত্তরসূচি দিয়ে শুরু করতে পারেন। কাউন্সিলের 9 অক্টোবরের বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে 2026-এর মূল ও উন্নয়ন পরীক্ষার পেপারও আছে। এগুলির ব্যবহার আলাদা, তাই অনুশীলন শুরুর আগে বছর দেখুন।

ডাউনলোডের আগে শিরোনাম পড়ুন

2027-এর নমুনা পেপার সেই পরীক্ষার মূল্যায়ন পদ্ধতি বুঝতে সাহায্য করে। 2026-এর মূল বা উন্নয়ন পেপার আগের পরীক্ষার নথি। এগুলির কোনওটিই 2027-এর পরীক্ষার তারিখের তালিকা নয়।

CISCE বিজ্ঞপ্তি, 9 অক্টোবর 2026, পৃষ্ঠা 1। ডাউনলোডের আগে শিরোনাম পড়ুন.

প্রয়োগ, বিশ্লেষণ, মূল্যায়ন ও সৃষ্টি করার মতো উচ্চতর দক্ষতা যাচাইয়ের প্রশ্নের গুরুত্ব 2027 পরীক্ষায় প্রায় 50% বলে বিজ্ঞপ্তি জানায়। শুধু মনে রাখার ওপর নির্ভর না করে কীভাবে উত্তরে পৌঁছেছেন তা ব্যাখ্যা করার অনুশীলন করুন।

পুরো চেষ্টা করার পর উত্তরসূচি দেখুন

সঠিক শ্রেণি ও বিষয় বেছে পেপারের নির্দেশ পড়ুন এবং নির্দিষ্ট শর্তে পুরোটা চেষ্টা করুন। তারপর সরকারি উত্তরসূচি দেখে কোথায় প্রশ্ন ভুল বুঝেছেন, প্রয়োজনীয় ধাপ বাদ দিয়েছেন বা বেশি সময় নিয়েছেন তা ধরুন।

পুনরায় দেখার ভুলগুলির ছোট তালিকা রাখুন এবং শিক্ষকের সঙ্গে আলোচনা করুন। প্রয়োগভিত্তিক প্রশ্নে একই সমস্যা বারবার হলে, অধ্যায় পরিচিত লাগলেও সেই দক্ষতা আবার অনুশীলনের প্রয়োজন বোঝায়।

নির্বাচিত বিষয় মানে সব বিষয় বদলেছে নয়

CISCE এই প্রকাশনাকে নির্বাচিত বিষয়ের জন্য বলেছে। বাকি ICSE বিষয়ের ক্ষেত্রে 2026 পরীক্ষাচক্রের বর্তমান মূল্যায়নের মানদণ্ড ও কাঠামো প্রযোজ্য বলে বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে আছে। একটি বিষয়ের পরিবর্তন গোটা সিলেবাসে ধরে না নিয়ে নিজের পেপারের নির্দেশ দেখুন।

সঠিক উপকরণের জন্য CISCE ওয়েবসাইট ও স্কুলের সাহায্য নিন। তারিখের জন্য প্রযোজ্য সরকারি সময়সূচি ও সংশোধনের অপেক্ষা করুন। ICSE ও ISC সময়সূচির নির্দেশিকা রিভিশন পরিকল্পনাকে অনিশ্চিত বিষয়ভিত্তিক তারিখ থেকে আলাদা রাখতে সাহায্য করে।

title: Google Trends India Shows Education News Gaps Beyond Exam Announcements
description: Google Trends is only an attention signal. Use this decision-led watchlist to track correction windows, reporting, refunds and document checks in Indian admissions.
content:
Result headlines don’t tell you whether a form can still be corrected, a seat must be accepted, a college requires physical reporting or a fee will be refunded. For Indian higher education admissions, those conditions sit inside the relevant exam-body bulletin, counselling notice or university admission notice. Google Trends can point to public attention, but it cannot decide your admission.

The supplied Google Trends India daily feed for 11 October 2026 did not show an education item. That supports a limited editorial reading only: an attention feed may miss the admission action that matters to one student. It does not prove a nationwide gap in education coverage or search behaviour.

Which admission updates deserve your attention?

Watch for notices that change your next action, the deadline or the proof you need. A result says what happened. The controlling notice says what you must do now.

  • Correction window: Check which fields can be edited and whether changes to category, subject choice, address or certificates need separate proof.
  • Seat acceptance: Confirm whether payment, choice confirmation, online acceptance and reporting are separate steps. A transaction receipt may not confirm every step.
  • Reporting: Read the reporting place, date, document list and original-copy requirement in the allotment or admission notice.
  • Fee refund: Find the withdrawal deadline, deductions, eligible fee component and refund route. “Refundable” does not automatically mean the full amount returns.
  • Document check: Match your application with your marksheet, identity proof, category or income certificate, domicile record and migration or transfer document where the notice requires them.

How should you record each admission deadline?

Make one small record for every active application. This is more useful than collecting ten result headlines.

  1. Action: Write edit, accept, pay, report, upload or withdraw.
  2. Document to open: Save the exact counselling notice, university notice, allotment letter or exam-body bulletin.
  3. Proof to save: Keep the submitted form, payment receipt, acknowledgement, screenshot and downloaded PDF.
  4. Consequence: Note what may happen if you miss it, such as losing an edit option, a seat, a reporting chance or a refund claim.

Use compare entrance exams to identify the relevant admission route, then open the named authority’s current notice from that route. When a college is allotted, check its admission instructions too. You can use compare colleges for the choice itself, but Google Trends and news reports remain attention signals, not proof of eligibility, seat confirmation or refund entitlement.

title: How Indian students can apply for PM YASASVI scholarships in 2026
description: Check if your child qualifies for PM YASASVI, then apply on the scholarship portal with the right school, category and income documents.
content:
Answer first: who should apply and what to do next

PM YASASVI is the PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India. It is meant for eligible school students from notified OBC, EBC and DNT categories, subject to the scheme rules for the current cycle. For families, the safest first step is to check three things together: the student’s category, the family income limit and the school or class level covered in the 2026 cycle.

The application is typically submitted through the National Scholarship Portal, then verified by the school and the designated government authority for the scheme cycle. If the student fits the rules and the documents match exactly, the form can move forward. If the school cannot confirm eligibility, the application should not be forced through.

Key facts

  • Scheme name: PM YASASVI
  • Full form: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India
  • Primary beneficiary groups: notified OBC, EBC and DNT school students
  • Where to apply: National Scholarship Portal for the active cycle
  • Who verifies the form: the school first, then the designated scholarship authority for the cycle
  • Income rule: the family income limit is commonly set at up to ₹2.5 lakh per year, but readers must verify the exact 2026 rule in the live notification before applying
  • Common class coverage: Classes 9 and 11 in the notified school categories for the cycle

What PM YASASVI covers

PM YASASVI is a school-level scholarship scheme, not a general scholarship for all students. It is intended for students who belong to the notified beneficiary groups and study in the classes and school types covered for that cycle. The practical test is simple: if the student is in the right category, the family income is within the limit and the school is covered, the student can usually proceed with the application.

This matters because many rejections happen when families assume that any school student can apply. That is not how this scheme works. Eligibility depends on the exact notification for the year, so the 2026 cycle should be checked before submitting the form.

Who can apply in 2026

For the 2026 cycle, the student should verify the following points before applying:

  • Beneficiary group: the student must belong to a notified OBC, EBC or DNT category.
  • Income limit: the family income must be within the ceiling set for the current cycle. The commonly used ceiling is ₹2.5 lakh per year, but this must be verified for 2026 before submission.
  • Class level: PM YASASVI is generally linked to specific school classes, most commonly Class 9 and Class 11.
  • School coverage: the student must study in the school type accepted under the scheme rules for that cycle.
  • Record match: the name, date of birth, category and bank details should match across all documents.

Decision guidance: if the category or school type is unclear, ask the school before applying. If the family income is above the limit, the student should not expect approval. If the class is not covered, the form should not be submitted until the notification is checked.

Which school categories and class levels are covered

For most applicants, the important school-level detail is not just whether the child is in school, but whether the child is in the eligible class and institution category named in the scheme notification. The scheme is commonly applied to students in Class 9 and Class 11 studying in schools covered under the rules for that year.

Families should not treat this as a generic private school or government school scholarship unless the current notification says so. The exact institution type and class list should always be confirmed for the 2026 cycle because that is what determines whether the school can verify the form.

Documents you should keep ready

Before starting the application, keep these documents ready in clear scanned format:

DocumentWhy it matters
Aadhaar cardUsed for identity matching and form verification
School admission proof or bonafide certificateConfirms the student is enrolled in the eligible class and school
Category certificateProves the student belongs to the notified OBC, EBC or DNT group
Income certificateShows the family income is within the scheme ceiling
Bank account detailsNeeded for scholarship transfer
Recent passport-size photographUsually required in the online form
Mobile number and email IDUsed for OTP, notices and status updates

If the bank account is in the student’s or parent’s name, make sure it is active and the details are entered exactly as they appear in the bank record. Scholarship payments can stall when the account name, IFSC code or account number does not match.

How the application flow works

  1. Confirm eligibility. Check category, income, class and school type first.
  2. Prepare documents. Keep clear scanned copies ready in the required format.
  3. Apply on the National Scholarship Portal. Use the active 2026 cycle on the official portal.
  4. Fill student and parent details carefully. Use the same spelling as in official documents.
  5. Enter school and bank details. Match them exactly with school and bank records.
  6. Upload documents. Ensure they are readable, complete and not cropped.
  7. Submit the form and save the application number. This is needed for tracking.
  8. Undergo verification. The school verifies the application first, and the designated authority for the cycle completes the next level of verification.

The responsible pathway matters. For PM YASASVI, the application is not just a self-submitted form. It moves through the scholarship portal and then through verification by the school and the authority handling the scheme for that cycle. If the school does not confirm the student’s eligibility or enrollment, the application can stop there.

How to judge whether your child should apply

Use this simple rule:

  • Apply now if the student clearly belongs to the notified category, the income is within the current limit and the school and class are covered.
  • Apply after correction if the student is eligible but the category certificate, income certificate or bank details need to be fixed.
  • Do not apply yet if the school cannot confirm the class or institution category, or if the 2026 income rule is still unclear.

This sequence is safer than guessing. A scholarship application is only useful if it can pass verification.

Common rejection reasons families should avoid

  • Wrong beneficiary group: the student does not belong to the notified OBC, EBC or DNT category for the scheme.
  • Income above the limit: the family income exceeds the current ceiling.
  • School or class not covered: the student is not in the eligible class or school type for the cycle.
  • Document mismatch: name, date of birth or category details differ across records.
  • Bad bank details: account number, IFSC or account holder name is incorrect.
  • Unreadable uploads: blurred, cropped or incomplete documents cannot be verified.
  • Late submission: the form is not submitted within the live application window.

Practical tip: before submitting, compare the form with the school record, Aadhaar, category certificate and bank passbook. One mismatch is enough to trigger a problem later.

What to verify before pressing submit in 2026

  • The active 2026 application window is open on the National Scholarship Portal
  • The student belongs to the notified OBC, EBC or DNT group
  • The family income is within the current scheme limit
  • The student’s class is covered for the cycle, commonly Class 9 or 11
  • The school type is accepted under the scheme rules
  • The documents are clear, valid and consistent
  • The bank account details are correct and active

If one of these items is not confirmed, pause and verify it first. For PM YASASVI, accuracy is more important than speed.

FAQs

1) Can all school students apply for PM YASASVI in 2026?

No. PM YASASVI is meant for notified OBC, EBC and DNT school students who also meet the income, class and school-type conditions of the current cycle.

2) Where should I apply for PM YASASVI?

Apply on the National Scholarship Portal for the active 2026 cycle. The application then goes through verification by the school and the designated authority handling the scheme.

3) Who verifies the PM YASASVI form?

The school verifies the student’s details first. After that, the scholarship authority designated for the cycle completes the next level of verification according to the scheme process.

4) What if my child’s school cannot confirm eligibility?

Do not submit the form blindly. Ask the school to check the student’s class, school category and category records first. If the school cannot confirm eligibility, verify the current notification before applying.

5) What documents are most important for PM YASASVI?

Aadhaar, category certificate, income certificate, school proof and bank account details are the most important documents. They must match the application exactly.

6) What is the income limit for PM YASASVI?

The commonly used family income ceiling is ₹2.5 lakh per year, but applicants should verify the exact 2026 rule in the live notification before submitting the form.

7) Which classes are usually covered under PM YASASVI?

The scheme is commonly linked to Class 9 and Class 11, but students should confirm the exact class coverage for the 2026 cycle before applying.

8) Why do PM YASASVI applications get rejected?

Common reasons include category mismatch, income above the limit, school or class not covered, wrong bank details, unreadable uploads and document differences across records.

9) What should parents do if one document is still pending?

If the pending document is essential for eligibility or verification, wait and complete it first. If it is only a supporting document, check whether the portal allows submission, but never guess on category, income or school proof.

10) What is the safest way to avoid mistakes in the form?

Match every entry with official documents, upload clear scans, check the school’s confirmation of eligibility, use correct bank details and save the application number after submission.

PM YASASVI can help the right student, but only when the beneficiary group, school category, class level and income rule all line up. Families that verify the scheme first and apply through the proper portal pathway are in the strongest position to avoid rejection.

title: NEET 2027: Central and state counselling timelines by portal explained
description: Understand NEET 2027 counselling timelines for central and state seats, including portal access, key dates, eligibility, and step-by-step processes for students and parents.
content:
Start with the practical takeaway: what you need to do now

For NEET 2027, counselling timelines are staggered across central and state portals. Knowing when registries open, how to choose seats, and the documents required can save precious time. This article explains the portals, the typical timeline, and the actions students and parents should prioritize to avoid last‑minute hassles.

What changes to expect in 2027 counselling timelines

Central and state counselling for NEET typically operates on separate portals with distinct dates. The central process often handles admission to institutes funded by the central government or major public medical colleges, while state counselling allocates seats in government and aided medical colleges within the state. Students securing All India Rank (AIR) in NEET may participate in the central process, but many states also run their own counselling in parallel or sequentially.

Key distinctions between central and state counselling

  • : often uses a common application form, aggregates seats across participating institutes, and may include reputed national institutes. Seat allotment is released on a unified portal, with a centralized reporting and document verification system.
  • : conducted by each state’s medical education authority. The portal, eligibility criteria, and seat matrix vary by state. Some states run parallel rounds, while others schedule it after or alongside the central rounds.

Typical timeline pattern for NEET 2027 counselling

While exact dates shift yearly, the following pattern reflects common sequencing. Always verify on the official portal when registrations open.

  • : both central and state portals open for new registrations and option entry. International or NRI candidates may have separate tracks in some states.
  • : applicants select preferred institutes and courses; changes are often allowed within a stipulated period.
  • : once options are finalized, the candidate confirms the choice, triggering seat allotment rounds.
  • : multiple rounds may occur. AIR and eligibility determine allotment; candidates can accept or opt for further rounds as per rules.
  • : after allotment, candidates must complete document verification online or at designated centres. Some states require physical verification during reporting at the allotted college.
  • : final admission occurs after payment of fees and completion of verification. Some institutes require physical presence for acceptance of the seat.

Portal access: central vs state applications

Central counselling typically uses a single, nationwide portal, with options to link your NEET result and register for counselling in one place. State portals are state-specific; they may require separate registration, application numbers, or state domicile proofs. In some states, the central portal allows linkage for convenience, but you must still complete state-specific steps to secure a seat.

Eligibility basics you should confirm early

  • Eligibility for central seats often requires NEET aspirants to meet minimum percentile or marks, with considerations for category reservations. AIR is a key reference point for admission chances in central rounds.
  • State eligibility depends on domicile status, reservation category, and qualifying marks in NEET. Some states have tie‑break rules or special rounds for economically weaker sections or medical‑education reservations.

Document checklist you should prepare in advance

  • NEET admit card and official scorecard
  • Class 10 or 12 mark sheets and passing certificate
  • Domicile or residency proof as required by the state portal
  • Category certificate if applicable (SC/ST/OBC, EWS, PwD)
  • Identity proof and passport-sized photographs
  • Any institute‑specific documents requested by the portal or allotted college

Strategy for students: how to maximize your chances

  • Keep track of both portals. Even if you aim for central seats, a strong state seat option can provide a timely backup path and reduce waiting time.
  • Register early and complete the profile with accurate details to avoid last‑minute mismatches during allotment.
  • Prepare a prioritized list of institutes by preference and rank-include a mix of high‑ranked institutes and safer options in nearby states.
  • Read the seat matrix and eligibility notes carefully. Some institutes reserve seats for certain categories or require additional qualifying criteria.
  • Stay ready for the document verification window. Delays here can postpone admission even after seat allotment.

What to verify on the official portals

If you are unsure about any instruction, verify directly on the official portal. Official portals publish the most accurate schedules, seat matrices, and eligibility rules. Do not rely on third‑party summaries for critical deadlines or required documents.

Frequently asked questions

Q1: When will counselling for NEET 2027 begin?

A1: Counselling typically begins a few weeks after the NEET result declaration. Central and state rounds may start on different dates; check the official portals for the exact opening dates.

Q2: Can I participate in both central and state counselling?

A2: Yes, in most cases you can register for both. You must meet each system’s eligibility criteria and follow the respective process for seat allotment and reporting.

Q3: Do I need to provide domicile documents for central counselling?

A3: Domicile requirements vary by state. Central counselling typically focuses on merit and AIR, while state counselling may require domicile proofs for reservation categories.

Q4: What happens if I don’t get a seat in the first round?

A4: You can participate in subsequent rounds if eligible, or opt to upgrade through the central or state rounds. Ensure you follow the exact deadlines for each round.

Q5: How long is the seat allotment final after issuance?

A5: After seat allotment, you must complete document verification and report to the allotted college within the timeframe specified by the portal. Delays can lead to seat cancellation.

Q6: Can I modify choices after saving?

A6: Many portals allow modifications within a stated window before the final declaration of rounds. After rounds begin, changes are typically restricted or not allowed.

Bottom line

NEET 2027 counselling will rely on clear timelines from both central and state portals. Early registration, accurate profile information, and a well‑thought‑out seat‑allocation plan increase your chances of admission without last‑minute stress. Prepare your documents in advance, monitor the official portals for updates, and be ready to act quickly when rounds are announced.

title: Career Prospects for Plastic and Polymer Engineering | Jobs, Salary & Future Scope
description: Explore the career prospects for Plastic and Polymer Engineering, including job opportunities, salary trends, required skills, and future scope. Discover top industries, recruiters, and career growth in this evolving field.
content:
Introduction

Plastic and Polymer Engineering is a specialized field that focuses on the study, design, production, and application of polymers, plastics, and related materials. As the demand for lightweight, durable, and cost-effective materials continues to grow, plastic and polymer engineers play a crucial role in industries such as automotive, aerospace, healthcare, packaging, and consumer goods. This field offers promising career prospects with numerous job opportunities in research, manufacturing, quality control, and environmental sustainability.

What is Plastic and Polymer Engineering?

Plastic and Polymer Engineering involves the study of polymer science, polymer processing, and the development of plastic materials. Engineers in this field work with various types of polymers, including thermoplastics, thermosetting plastics, and elastomers, to design innovative solutions for industrial and commercial applications. They contribute to the advancement of sustainable materials, biodegradable plastics, and recycling technologies.

Career Opportunities in Plastic and Polymer Engineering

The career prospects in plastic and polymer engineering are vast, offering opportunities in different industries and sectors. Below are some of the major career paths available:

1. Research and Development (R&D) Engineer

  • Work in laboratories to develop new polymers and enhance existing materials.

  • Conduct research on biodegradable plastics and eco-friendly alternatives.

  • Innovate in areas such as smart polymers and nanotechnology applications.

2. Polymer Production Engineer

  • Oversee the manufacturing process of plastics and polymer-based products.

  • Improve production efficiency and quality control.

  • Work with industrial equipment such as extrusion, molding, and compounding machines.

3. Quality Control and Testing Engineer

  • Ensure that polymer products meet industry standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Conduct mechanical, thermal, and chemical testing on materials.

  • Work in compliance with organizations such as ASTM, ISO, and FDA.

4. Environmental and Sustainability Engineer

  • Develop sustainable and biodegradable polymers to reduce environmental impact.

  • Work on recycling technologies and waste management systems.

  • Collaborate with environmental agencies to promote green manufacturing.

5. Product Design Engineer

  • Design innovative plastic products for various industries such as packaging, healthcare, and automotive.

  • Use CAD software for modeling and prototyping.

  • Work with material scientists to enhance product durability and performance.

6. Processing Engineer

  • Specialize in polymer processing techniques like injection molding, extrusion, and blow molding.

  • Optimize production techniques for cost-effectiveness and efficiency.

  • Work with industries such as medical devices, sports equipment, and construction materials.

7. Sales and Marketing Executive

  • Work with polymer manufacturers and suppliers to promote and sell plastic products.

  • Educate clients about material properties and applications.

  • Develop business strategies for new polymer-based solutions.

Industries Hiring Plastic and Polymer Engineers

Plastic and polymer engineers are in demand across multiple industries. Some of the key industries hiring professionals in this field include:

  • Automotive Industry: Use of lightweight plastics for fuel efficiency and durability.

  • Aerospace Industry: Development of high-performance composite materials.

  • Healthcare and Biomedical Sector: Production of medical implants, prosthetics, and surgical equipment.

  • Packaging Industry: Design of sustainable packaging solutions.

  • Electronics and Consumer Goods: Manufacturing of plastic casings, cables, and accessories.

  • Construction Industry: Use of polymers in insulation, pipes, and flooring.

  • Energy and Renewable Sector: Development of polymer-based solar panels and wind turbine components.

Skills Required for Plastic and Polymer Engineers

To excel in the field of plastic and polymer engineering, professionals need the following skills:

  • Strong knowledge of polymer chemistry and material science.

  • Proficiency in polymer processing techniques such as extrusion and injection molding.

  • Understanding of sustainable manufacturing and recycling techniques.

  • Problem-solving and analytical skills for research and development.

  • Familiarity with software like AutoCAD, SolidWorks, and MATLAB for design and simulation.

  • Strong communication and teamwork skills for collaboration in industrial projects.

Salary Trends and Growth Prospects

The salary of plastic and polymer engineers varies based on experience, industry, and location. Below is an overview of the salary trends:

  • Entry-Level Engineers: ₹3-6 LPA (India) / $50,000 - $70,000 (USA)

  • Mid-Level Engineers: ₹7-12 LPA (India) / $80,000 - $120,000 (USA)

  • Senior-Level Engineers: ₹15-25 LPA (India) / $150,000+ (USA)

The job prospects in this field continue to grow due to the increasing demand for advanced polymer-based materials and sustainable solutions.

Future Trends in Plastic and Polymer Engineering

1. Biodegradable and Eco-Friendly Polymers

  • Development of plant-based plastics and compostable materials.

  • Reduction in the use of single-use plastics to promote environmental sustainability.

2. Smart Polymers and Nanotechnology

  • Innovations in shape-memory polymers and self-healing materials.

  • Application of nanotechnology for enhanced material properties.

3. Advanced 3D Printing with Polymers

  • Use of high-performance polymers in additive manufacturing.

  • Customization of products for healthcare, automotive, and aerospace industries.

4. Circular Economy and Recycling Innovations

  • Enhanced techniques for plastic waste recycling and reuse.

  • Integration of sustainable materials in mainstream industries.

Challenges in the Field

Despite its growth, plastic and polymer engineering faces several challenges:

  • Environmental Concerns: Need for eco-friendly alternatives to reduce pollution.

  • Regulatory Challenges: Compliance with global safety and quality standards.

  • Technological Advancements: Rapid innovations require continuous skill upgrades.

  • Material Costs: High costs of advanced polymer production.

Conclusion

Plastic and Polymer Engineering offers a wide range of career opportunities across various industries. With growing emphasis on sustainability, innovations in biodegradable plastics, and advancements in polymer technology, this field is set to expand significantly in the coming years. Professionals with expertise in polymer science, manufacturing, and environmental sustainability can look forward to rewarding careers in research, product development, and industrial applications.

If you are passionate about material science and innovative solutions, a career in Plastic and Polymer Engineering is an excellent choice with vast growth potential. The future of this industry lies in sustainable advancements, making it an exciting and impactful field to be a part of.

title: Maharashtra BSc Nursing CAP 2026 Registration Opens: MUHS Affiliation Rules and Application Deadlines
description: Maharashtra State CET Cell has initiated the BSc Nursing CAP 2026 registration. Learn about key deadlines, MUHS affiliation guidelines, and application steps.
content:
The Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell has officialized the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) for B.Sc. Nursing courses for the 2026-2027 academic session. Qualified candidates who appeared for the MH B.Sc. Nursing CET can now complete their online registration, upload required documents, and submit their preference forms through the official portal.

Maharashtra BSc Nursing CAP 2026 Registration Overview

Candidates must carefully navigate the counseling schedule to ensure their participation in seat allotment across government, corporation, and private nursing institutions across the state. Registration involves creating a portal profile, paying the requisite non-refundable fee, and submitting academic documents for online verification.

Key Deadlines for CAP Registration 2026

  • Online Registration & Document Upload: Late August to early September 2026
  • Application Fee Payment Window: Open concurrently with online registration
  • Publication of Provisional Merit List: First week of September 2026
  • Preference Filling (Choice Locking): Subsequent to merit list publication
  • Round 1 Seat Allotment Result: Early September 2026

MUHS Affiliation Guidelines for Nursing Colleges

All participating institutions in the state allotment process must possess active affiliation with the Maharashtra University of Health Sciences (MUHS), Nashik, along with approval from the Indian Nursing Council (INC) and Maharashtra Nursing Council (MNC). Candidates are strongly advised to verify an institution's MUHS affiliation status before adding it to their preference list.

Why MUHS Affiliation Matters

  • Degree Recognition: Degrees awarded to graduates from non-affiliated institutes may not be legally valid for clinical practice or higher studies.
  • Seat Matrix Inclusion: Only MUHS-approved seats are included in the official CAP seat allotment rounds.
  • Standardized Curriculum: Affiliated colleges follow the unified syllabus and clinical training guidelines mandated by the state university.

Step-by-Step Application Process for Applicants

  1. Visit the official State CET Cell candidate portal.
  2. Enter your MH B.Sc. Nursing CET credentials to log in.
  3. Fill out the detailed registration form including personal, academic, and category details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of original documents (10th mark sheet, 12th mark sheet, CET score card, domicile certificate, and category certificates if applicable).
  5. Pay the registration fee online using net banking, UPI, or credit/debit card.
  6. Save and print the final application confirmation page for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions

When does the Maharashtra BSc Nursing CAP 2026 registration start?

Online registration for Maharashtra B.Sc. Nursing CAP 2026 opens in late August 2026 on the official State CET Cell portal.

Is MUHS affiliation mandatory for all participating nursing colleges?

Yes, all participating colleges in the CAP allotment process must hold valid affiliation with MUHS Nashik and approval from state and national nursing councils.

What documents are required for BSc Nursing CAP registration?

Required documents include the MH B.Sc. Nursing CET scorecard, Class 10 and 12 mark sheets, Maharashtra domicile certificate, nationality certificate, and valid caste or EWS certificates if applicable.

How are seats allotted during the CAP rounds?

Seat allotment is based on the applicant's MH CET merit rank, category reservations, seat availability, and the order of preferences submitted during choice filling.

title: Cognitive Criticism & Cognitive Poetics: Exploring the Mind in Literature
description: Delve into Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics, literary approaches that examine how the human mind processes, interprets, and engages with literature, enhancing understanding of narrative and meaning.
content:
Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics are innovative approaches in literary studies that explore the intersection between literature and the human mind. Unlike traditional literary theories, which focus primarily on historical context, authorial intent, or textual analysis, these approaches emphasize how readers mentally process, understand, and emotionally engage with texts. By incorporating insights from cognitive science, psychology, and neuroscience, Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics offer a fresh perspective on the mechanics of reading and interpretation.

1. Understanding Cognitive Criticism

Cognitive Criticism is a branch of literary theory that examines how literature interacts with the reader’s cognitive processes. It investigates the mental mechanisms involved in perception, memory, reasoning, and imagination when engaging with a text.

For example, when reading a narrative, a reader constructs mental models of characters, settings, and events. Cognitive Criticism studies how these mental representations influence comprehension, emotional response, and interpretation. By focusing on the reader’s mind, it moves beyond purely textual or historical analysis, highlighting the active role of cognition in literature.

2. Introduction to Cognitive Poetics

Cognitive Poetics is closely related to Cognitive Criticism but specifically targets poetry and literary language. It examines how linguistic structures, figurative language, and narrative techniques are processed by the human brain.

For instance, metaphor comprehension, imagery, and narrative pacing involve complex cognitive operations. Cognitive Poetics explores how these elements create emotional resonance, aesthetic pleasure, and meaning. By analyzing the interplay between language and cognition, this approach provides deeper insights into why certain texts evoke specific responses.

3. Key Concepts in Cognitive Approaches

Some central concepts in Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics include:

  • Mental Spaces: Readers create dynamic mental representations of narrative worlds, enabling them to track events, character intentions, and relationships.

  • Schema Theory: Prior knowledge or cognitive frameworks shape how readers interpret new information in a text.

  • Embodied Cognition: Physical and sensory experiences influence comprehension, meaning that readers often simulate actions, emotions, or sensations described in literature.

  • Conceptual Metaphor Theory: Many literary metaphors map abstract concepts onto concrete experiences, facilitating understanding through cognitive patterns.

These concepts show that reading is not a passive act but an active cognitive engagement involving memory, imagination, and emotional processing.

4. Applications in Literary Analysis

Cognitive approaches offer practical tools for analyzing literature:

  • Narrative Understanding: Exploring how readers mentally organize stories enhances insights into plot structure and character development.

  • Poetic Devices: Examining how metaphors, imagery, and rhythm affect cognitive and emotional responses deepens appreciation of poetic artistry.

  • Reader Response: Cognitive methods complement traditional reader-response theories by explaining how and why readers react to texts.

For example, in novels like Pride and Prejudice, cognitive analysis can reveal how anticipation, empathy, and moral reasoning shape the reader’s engagement with Elizabeth Bennet’s choices.

5. Advantages of Cognitive Literary Studies

Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics bring several advantages to literary studies:

  • Bridges Literature and Science: They integrate insights from neuroscience, psychology, and linguistics.

  • Focus on the Reader: These approaches highlight the active role of cognition, rather than solely authorial intent.

  • Explains Emotional Impact: By linking literary techniques to cognitive processes, they clarify why certain texts evoke strong emotions or aesthetic pleasure.

Moreover, cognitive literary studies encourage interdisciplinary research, offering richer, evidence-based interpretations of texts.

Conclusion

Cognitive Criticism and Cognitive Poetics represent a shift in literary studies—from viewing literature as a static object to seeing it as a dynamic interaction between text and mind. By examining how readers think, feel, and imagine while engaging with literature, these approaches deepen our understanding of narrative, language, and human cognition. As interdisciplinary research continues to grow, the cognitive approach promises to illuminate not only literature but also the universal processes of human thought and imagination.

content:
ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਦਾ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (ਕੋਡ 408) ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 12:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਦਾ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (ਕੋਡ 808) ਪੇਪਰ 29 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ 10:30 ਤੋਂ 13:30 ਵਜੇ ਤੱਕ ਹੈ।

ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟੇ ਦਾ ਹੈ?

ਸਫ਼ਾ 5, 11 ਖੋਲ੍ਹ ਕੇ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਜਮਾਤ ਦਾ ਸਿਰਲੇਖ ਵੇਖੋ ਤੇ ਫਿਰ 408, 808 ਕੋਡ ਲੱਭੋ। ਤਾਰੀਖ ਜਾਂ ਸਮੇਂ ਦਾ ਇੱਕ ਖਾਨਾ ਕਈ ਕਤਾਰਾਂ ਲਈ ਹੋ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ। ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਫ਼ਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ।

ਸਕੂਲ ਦੀ ਰਜਿਸਟ੍ਰੇਸ਼ਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਦਰਜ ਕੋਡ ਤੇ ਵਿਸ਼ੇ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ। ਦੂਜੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹੀ ਨਾਂ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਆਪਣੀ ਜਮਾਤ ਦੀ ਕਤਾਰ ਚੁਣੋ।

ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਦੇ ਪੇਪਰ ਨਾਲ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਮਿਲਾਓ

ਜਮਾਤ 10 ਵਿੱਚ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (408) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 25 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਹਿਤ (184) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 26 ਫਰਵਰੀ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 1 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ। ਜਮਾਤ 12 ਵਿੱਚ ਖੇਤੀਬਾੜੀ (808) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 29 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। English Core (301) ਦਾ ਪੇਪਰ 5 ਮਾਰਚ 2027 ਨੂੰ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵਾਂ ਤਾਰੀਖਾਂ ਵਿਚਕਾਰ 24 ਦਿਨ ਦਾ ਫ਼ਰਕ ਹੈ।

ਇਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਦਿਨ ਪੜ੍ਹਾਈ ਦੀਆਂ ਛੁੱਟੀਆਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਹਨ। ਆਪਣੇ ਹੋਰ ਪੇਪਰ ਵੀ ਕੈਲੰਡਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾਓ ਅਤੇ ਵਿਚਕਾਰਲੇ ਉਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਗਿਣੋ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ। ਅਭਿਆਸ ਲਈ ਅਸਲ ਪੇਪਰ ਜਿੰਨਾ ਸਮਾਂ ਰੱਖੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਵੱਖਰੀ ਪਤਾ ਕਰੋ

ਇਹ ਕਤਾਰ ਬੋਰਡ ਦੇ ਤੈਅ ਪੇਪਰ ਲਈ ਹੈ। ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰੈਕਟੀਕਲ, ਪੇਸ਼ਕਾਰੀ, ਪ੍ਰੋਜੈਕਟ ਜਾਂ ਅੰਦਰੂਨੀ ਮੁਲਾਂਕਣ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਤੇ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਸਮੱਗਰੀ ਬਾਰੇ ਸਕੂਲ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ।

ਪ੍ਰੀਖਿਆ ਕੇਂਦਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਸੰਚਾਰ ਉਪਕਰਨ ਲੈ ਜਾਣ ਦੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ। ਕਿਹੜਾ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਲਿਜਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਬਾਰੇ CBSE ਦੀਆਂ ਵੱਖਰੀਆਂ ਹਦਾਇਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਐਡਮਿਟ ਕਾਰਡ ਦੀ ਪਾਲਣਾ ਕਰੋ।

title: JEE Main 2027: Dates, Eligibility, Registration and Admit Card
description: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 registration is open. Check the latest examination schedule, application deadline, eligibility requirements, registration process, admit card date and important instructions for engineering aspirants.
content:
JEE Main 2027 is an important entrance examination for students seeking admission to undergraduate engineering, architecture and planning programmes. The National Testing Agency (NTA) has opened the Session 1 application window, and candidates can complete their registration through the official website.

The first session is scheduled for January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027. Candidates should also note the application deadline and admit card schedule to prepare for the examination without missing important formalities.

The examination will be conducted in two sessions, January and April. Candidates can appear in one or both sessions, subject to the applicable rules.

Official website: jeemain.nta.nic.in

JEE Main 2027 Important Dates

The examination schedule helps candidates plan registration, revision and travel arrangements. The following dates reflect the published schedule available as of October 28, 2026.

Event

Date

Session 1 registration begins

October 24, 2026

Last date to apply without late fee

November 22, 2026

Late application window

November 23 to 26, 2026

Application correction window

November 27 to 29, 2026

Session 1 city intimation slip

December 31, 2026

Session 1 admit card

January 13, 2027

Session 1 examination

January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24 and 28, 2027

Session 2 registration

January 5 to February 3, 2027

Session 2 city intimation slip

March 12, 2027

Session 2 admit card

March 25, 2027

Session 2 examination

April 2 to 7, 2027

Candidates should check the official NTA portal for any subsequent changes to these dates.

JEE Main 2027 Registration Process

Candidates can complete their applications online through the official examination portal. Before beginning, keep the required personal information, academic details and documents ready.

Steps to apply online

  1. Visit the official JEE Main website.

  2. Open the Session 1 application form link.

  3. Register using the permitted identity verification method and provide the required details.

  4. Note the application number and create or retain the required login credentials.

  5. Complete the application form with personal information, academic qualifications and examination preferences.

  6. Upload the photograph, signature and other applicable documents in the prescribed format.

  7. Pay the examination fee through an available online payment method.

  8. Review the information and submit the application.

  9. Download the confirmation page and retain a copy.

Candidates should verify their personal details before submission. If an error is discovered later, check whether the relevant field can be changed during the official correction window.

For additional application guidance, read the DekhoCampus article on JEE Main 2027 registration, deadlines and required documents.

JEE Main 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Checking eligibility before applying helps students avoid problems during admission. Candidates must satisfy the qualifying examination conditions and the requirements of their chosen course.

Educational qualification

Candidates who passed Class 12 or an equivalent qualifying examination in 2025 or 2026, or are appearing in 2027, can generally apply under the prescribed conditions.

The accepted qualifying examinations include recognised board examinations and other equivalent qualifications specified by NTA.

Subject requirements

The subjects required depend on the paper selected:

  • Paper 1: For B.E. and B.Tech programmes, candidates generally need Physics and Mathematics along with the other prescribed subjects.

  • Paper 2A: For B.Arch admissions, candidates must satisfy the applicable Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry requirements.

  • Paper 2B: For B.Planning admissions, candidates must meet the prescribed subject requirements, including Mathematics.

Candidates should consult the official information bulletin for the precise requirements applicable to their course.

Age limit and Class 12 marks

There is generally no upper age limit for appearing in JEE Main. However, institutions may impose separate admission conditions.

Similarly, the eligibility criteria for appearing in the examination are different from those for admission to a college. NITs, IIITs and other institutions may prescribe minimum Class 12 marks or qualifying examination requirements.

JEE Main 2027 Admit Card

The admit card is an essential document for entry into the examination centre. As per the published schedule, the Session 1 admit card is scheduled for release on January 13, 2027.

Candidates should download it from the official website using the required login credentials. The admit card will contain important details such as the candidate's name, roll number, examination date, shift, centre address and reporting instructions.

How to download the admit card

  1. Visit the official JEE Main website.

  2. Open the admit card download link when it becomes available.

  3. Log in using the requested application credentials.

  4. View the admit card and verify all printed details.

  5. Download and print a copy for examination day.

If the admit card contains an error, candidates should contact NTA through the official helpdesk instructions promptly.

JEE Main City Intimation Slip and Admit Card: Difference

The city intimation slip and admit card serve different purposes. Candidates should not treat them as interchangeable documents.

The city intimation slip informs candidates about the city where their examination centre will be located. It helps them plan travel and accommodation in advance.

The admit card contains the more specific examination details, including the centre address, reporting time and candidate instructions. Candidates must follow the instructions regarding which documents to carry on examination day.

Documents Required on Examination Day

Candidates should prepare their examination documents before the admit card is released.

The usual requirements include:

  • A printed copy of the JEE Main admit card.

  • A valid photo identification document, as accepted under NTA instructions.

  • Any additional certificate or document required for the candidate's category or examination accommodations.

  • Other items specifically permitted or required by the official examination guidelines.

Candidates should check the admit card instructions carefully. Do not assume that items permitted in previous years will automatically be allowed in 2027.

JEE Main 2027 Examination Pattern

Understanding the paper structure helps students organise their preparation and practise within the examination time limit.

Paper 1 for B.E./B.Tech covers Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Paper 2A is designed for B.Arch admissions, while Paper 2B is for B.Planning.

The examination is conducted primarily in computer-based mode, with the drawing component of B.Arch following its prescribed format. Candidates should refer to the official syllabus and information bulletin for the final question distribution, marking scheme and paper-specific instructions.

Students preparing for the January session should revise the complete syllabus, practise previous-year questions and take timed mock tests. A consistent revision plan can help improve speed, accuracy and time management.

Conclusion

JEE Main 2027 registration is open for Session 1, and candidates should submit their applications by November 22, 2026, to avoid the late application window. The January examination is scheduled across six dates, and the admit card is scheduled for January 13, 2027.

Applicants should verify their eligibility, complete the form carefully and save the confirmation page. Before the examination, they should download the admit card, check their centre details and follow the official instructions issued by NTA.

For the latest examination announcements, candidates should regularly visit the official JEE Main website and check verified updates from DekhoCampus.

title: Banking  Class 12 Notes: Chapter-wise Guide & Exam Preparation
description: Prepare for CBSE Class 12 Banking (811) exam with chapter-wise notes, important topics, banking terms, and exam tips for 2026.
content:
Banking (Code 811) is a scoring and practical subject for Class 12 CBSE. This subject includes banking operations, financial services, and customer handling skills. With proper knowledge of concepts and their applications in practical life, students can easily attain high marks in the board exam.

Chapter-wise Important Topics

Chapter 1: Banking System in India
This chapter includes topics related to the structure of Indian bank systems, RBI, commercial banks, and types of banks. This chapter is mainly based on theoretical questions.

Chapter 2: Bank Accounts
Students need to have proper knowledge regarding types of bank accounts, such as savings bank account, current bank accounts, fixed deposit account, and recurring deposit account. 

Chapter 3: Banking Services
Students need to have proper knowledge regarding bank services such as ATM services, internet services, mobile services, NEFT services, RTGS services, and UPI services. This chapter is mainly based on practical questions.

Chapter 4: Cash Handling and Transactions
This chapter will include topics such as deposits, withdrawals, and cheque transactions. Students will be able to understand the step-by-step process.

Chapter 5: Negotiable Instruments
This chapter will cover cheque, bill of exchange, and promissory notes. Features and differences will also be exam questions.

Chapter 6: Insurance and Financial Services
This chapter will cover topics such as the different types of insurance, the principles of insurance, and financial products offered by the bank.

Chapter 7: Customer Relationship Management
This chapter will cover customer service and communication skills.

Important Concepts for Exam

Key concepts include types of accounts, digital banking, negotiable instruments, and RBI functions. Students should write answers with examples from real banking scenarios to score better.

Important Banking Terms Table

Term Meaning
NEFT Electronic fund transfer system
RTGS Real-time large value transfer
UPI Instant mobile-based payment system
Cheque Written payment order
Fixed Deposit Investment for fixed period

Conclusion

Banking (811) is a scoring subject if the students prepare well. If the concepts are clear and the students revise regularly and understand the concepts, they will definitely score well in the Class 12 board exams.

title: NIFT 2027 Situation Test: How to Build a Stronger Material Model
description: A practical NIFT Situation Test plan for shortlisted BDes candidates, with drills for observation, proportion, construction, material control, timing and model explanation.
content:
The NIFT Situation Test rewards more than an attractive idea. A model that leans, has uneven proportions or shows rushed finishing can lose impact quickly. Once the BDes shortlist is published, practise turning an observation into a stable form within the time and material limits stated for your cycle.

Check the official NIFT admissions website for the current notice, candidate instructions and required actions. NIFT is the responsible authority for those rules. The practice advice below is preparation guidance, not a substitute for your shortlisted candidate notice.

What should your Situation Test practice measure?

Each attempt should test observation, proportion, construction, material handling and presentation together. Decoration comes later. If the base fails, extra detail won’t rescue the model.

  1. Observe: Choose an everyday object such as a steel tumbler, school bag or bus ticket. Sketch its main shapes and useful features in two minutes.
  2. Set proportion: Decide the height, width and depth before cutting. Repeat one unit, such as the width of a paper strip, to keep related parts consistent.
  3. Build: Test folds, joints and supports on scrap material. A bridge, arch or stand should survive a gentle table movement.
  4. Control the material: Use one material through folding, rolling, layering or interlocking. Don’t force every technique into one model.
  5. Finish: Reserve time to trim loose edges, remove excess adhesive and place the model on a clean base.

How can you practise when the clock is running?

Use three different practice sessions each week. One should focus on proportion, with a rough plan made before construction. Another should test a simple theme using fewer parts. The third should reproduce the complete task within the time stated in your official instructions, including the explanation.

Keep an error log after every attempt. Note whether you selected materials too slowly, cut parts too large, used weak joints or left no time for cleaning. That record tells you what to fix. Repeating similar models without reviewing the failure won’t.

How should you explain the finished model?

Keep your explanation tied to visible decisions. State the idea, explain the material choice and describe the function or visual effect. For example, say that interlocked strips create a stable open form, rather than calling the model attractive.

For wider admission context, see the NIFT exam guide. Parents can arrange safe materials and timed practice, but the student should make the design choices and explain the result.

title: UCEED 2027 MSQ: ಕೆಲವು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಂಕ ಸಿಗುವುದು ಯಾವಾಗ?
description: UCEED 2027 ಭಾಗಶಃ ಅಂಕಗಳು, MSQಯ -1 ಕಡಿತ ಮತ್ತು NAT, MCQ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು IIT ಬಾಂಬೆಯ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪಟ್ಟಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
content:
UCEED 2027 MSQಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಗುರುತಿಸಿದರೆ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಒಂದು ಅಂಕವೇ ಸಿಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ. ಅದೊಂದೇ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಯಾಗಿದ್ದು ಅದನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಅಂಕಗಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಹಲವು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಲವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಿ, ತಪ್ಪು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದನ್ನೂ ಸೇರಿಸದಿದ್ದರೆ ಭಾಗಶಃ ಅಂಕಗಳು ಸಿಗುತ್ತವೆ. ತಪ್ಪು ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ -1 ಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.

15 MSQಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ವಿಧಾನ

IIT ಬಾಂಬೆಯ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸದ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಇವು. ಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾಗಶಃ ಅಂಕಕ್ಕೆ ಆರಿಸಿದ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದು ಆಯ್ಕೆಯೂ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿರಬೇಕು:

  • +4: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಬೇಕು.

  • +3: ನಾಲ್ಕೂ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿರುವಾಗ ಮೂರನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ.

  • +2: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಮೂರು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಿರುವಾಗ ಎರಡು ಸರಿಯಾದವುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ.

  • +1: ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ಎರಡು ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳಿರುವಾಗ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ.

  • 0: ಉತ್ತರಿಸದೆ ಬಿಟ್ಟರೆ. ಉಳಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸಂದರ್ಭಗಳಲ್ಲಿ -1.

ಒಂದು ಉದಾಹರಣೆಯಿಂದ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ

A, B, C ಸರಿಯಾಗಿವೆ ಎಂದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. A, B ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ +2; A ಮಾತ್ರವಾದರೆ +1; A, B, C ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಆರಿಸಿದರೆ +4. ತಪ್ಪಾದ Dಯನ್ನೂ ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ -1. A ಮಾತ್ರ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ Aಯನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಆರಿಸುವುದು +4 ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಇವು ಪ್ರಕಟಿತ ನಿಯಮಗಳ ಉದಾಹರಣೆಗಳು; ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳ ಊಹೆಗಳಲ್ಲ.

ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವಿಭಾಗಗಳಿಗೂ ಒಂದೇ ಊಹೆಯ ವಿಧಾನ ಬೇಡ

Part Aಯಲ್ಲಿ 57 ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು, 200 ಅಂಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು ಗಂಟೆಗಳಿವೆ. 14 NAT ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ +4; ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ ಅಂಕ ಕಡಿತವಿಲ್ಲ. 28 MCQಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ +3, ತಪ್ಪಾದ ಉತ್ತರಕ್ಕೆ -0.71. ಬಿಡಲಾದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ಶೂನ್ಯ. 15 MSQಗಳ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಅಂಕ 60.

IIT ಬಾಂಬೆಯ UCEED 2027 ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಪತ್ರಿಕೆ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ. ಈ ಪುಟದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಯ ದಿನಾಂಕವಿಲ್ಲ. ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಅಧಿಕೃತ ಅಂಕ ನೀಡುವ ನಿಯಮ ಓದಿ.

Part B ಕೂಡ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ: ಒಂದು ಗಂಟೆ, 100 ಅಂಕಗಳು. ಒಂದು ರೇಖಾಚಿತ್ರ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಮತ್ತು ಒಂದು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯದ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗೆ ತಲಾ 50 ಅಂಕಗಳು. ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳು ಪರದೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ; ಕೊಟ್ಟ ಉತ್ತರ ಪುಸ್ತಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರೆಯಬೇಕು ಅಥವಾ ಚಿತ್ರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದಲ್ಲೂ ಎರಡೂ ಭಾಗಗಳ ಸಮಯ ಮಿತಿಯನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸಿ; ಮೂರು ಗಂಟೆಗಳನ್ನೂ ವಸ್ತುನಿಷ್ಠ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಕೊಡಬೇಡಿ.

ಅಭ್ಯಾಸದ ದಾಖಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿಕೊಂಡ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಆರಿಸಿದ ತಪ್ಪು ಆಯ್ಕೆಯನ್ನು ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಸಿ. ವಿಷಯ ತಿಳುವಳಿಕೆಯೋ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುವುದೋ ಯಾವುದನ್ನು ಸುಧಾರಿಸಬೇಕೆಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ವಿಶಾಲ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಕ್ಕಾಗಿ Part A ಮತ್ತು Part B ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ ಓದಿ.

title: NEP 2025: How the New Education Policy is Changing College Admissions
description: Discover how NEP 2025 is transforming college admissions in India. Learn about flexible subject choices, CUET changes, multiple entry-exit options, credit transfers, and skill-based admission policies.
content:
One of the most significant changes to India's educational system is the National Education Policy (NEP) 2025. It seeks to increase learning's adaptability, skill focus, and student-friendliness. College admissions is one significant area where parents and students have seen significant changes. NEP 2025 is changing the Indian admissions process, from the subjects offered in Class 12 to the manner in which entrance examinations are administered.

Multiple Entry and Exit Options

In the past, in order to achieve any kind of qualification, students needed to finish their full degree. Several exit points have been added in NEP 2025. This implies that students who drop out after a year can receive a certificate, a diploma after two years, and a degree after three or four years. In order to accommodate this flexible framework, colleges are already modifying their admissions policies.

CUET as a Central Admission Test

The primary entrance exam for both public and private universities is now the Common University Entrance Test (CUET). In order to give students from various boards and geographical areas an equal opportunity, NEP 2025 advocates a uniform testing procedure. Board exam scores are no longer the sole determining factor for admissions as CUET gains prominence.

Flexibility in Subject Choices

The option to mix subjects is one of the most significant changes under NEP 2025. The streams of science, commerce, and the arts are no longer the only options available to students. For instance, a student can enroll in Political Science with Computer Science or Physics with Economics. Colleges are therefore revising their admission requirements to accommodate a wider range of academic combinations.

Academic Bank of Credits (ABC)

The Academic Bank of Credits is another invention that makes it possible for students to transfer credits between colleges. This suggests that if a student starts a course at one university and completes it at another, they won't lose any progress. Admissions are becoming more student-friendly as a result of the ability for students to tour multiple universities during their academic careers.

Skill-Based Admissions

NEP 2025 places a high value on internships, vocational training, and hands-on learning. Board scores and entrance examinations are no longer the only criteria used by many colleges. When making admissions decisions, they now take into account applicants' abilities, portfolios, and even in-person interviews. This change guarantees improved prospects for students with practical knowledge and expertise.

Regional Languages in Higher Education

NEP 2025 promotes the use of regional languages in higher education in order to make education more inclusive. Colleges are providing lectures, entrance tests, and study materials in a variety of Indian languages. Students from various linguistic backgrounds can now more easily apply for admissions thanks to this modification.

Conclusion

The NEP 2025 is a total overhaul of education, not only an update. Fairness, flexibility, and skill-based evaluation are becoming more prevalent in college admissions. This gives students more options, less stress, and chances that align with their interests and professional aspirations. Admissions in 2025 and beyond will be significantly different from previous years as universities implement the new strategy.

title: CBSE 10 மற்றும் 12ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் தேர்வு 2027: தேதி, பாடக் குறியீடு, நேரம்
description: 10ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (குறியீடு 014) தேர்வு 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (குறியீடு 114) தேர்வு 3 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.
content:
10ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (குறியீடு 014) தேர்வு 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும். 12ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (குறியீடு 114) தேர்வு 3 மார்ச் 2027 அன்று 10:30 முதல் 13:30 மணி வரை நடைபெறும்.

2026 நவம்பர் 6 தேதியிட்ட CBSE முதன்மைத் தேர்வு அட்டவணையில் இந்த விவரங்கள் உள்ளன. இது தேர்வு நடைபெறும் நேரத்தைக் காட்டும் ஆவணம்; மதிப்பெண் சான்றிதழ் அல்ல. CBSE அதிகாரப்பூர்வத் தேர்வு அட்டவணை

அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் தேர்வின் நேரமும் கால அளவும்

வகுப்பு மற்றும் பாடம்குறியீடுதேர்வுத் தேதிநேரம் (IST)கால அளவு
10ஆம் வகுப்பு: Assamese01427 பிப்ரவரி 202710:30 - 13:303 மணி
12ஆம் வகுப்பு: Assamese1143 மார்ச் 202710:30 - 13:303 மணி

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 5: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

மத்திய இடைநிலைக் கல்வி வாரியம், 6 நவம்பர் 2026, பக்கம் 9: பாடக் குறியீடு, தேதி, நேரம். மூல PDF-இல் இந்தப் பக்கத்தைப் பார்க்க

அதிகாரப்பூர்வ PDF-இல் உங்கள் பாடத்தைப் படிப்பது எப்படி?

பக்கம் 5, 9 இல் முதலில் வகுப்பின் தலைப்பைப் பாருங்கள். பிறகு 014, 114 என்ற பாடக் குறியீட்டைத் தேடுங்கள். ஒரு தேதியோ நேரமோ பல வரிகளுக்குப் பொதுவாக இருக்கலாம். கைப்பேசியில் முழுப் பக்கத்தையும் பெரிதாக்கிப் பாருங்கள்.

பள்ளிப் பதிவில் உள்ள பாடப் பெயரையும் குறியீட்டையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள். ஒன்றுக்கும் மேற்பட்ட வகுப்பில் பெயர் வந்தால் உங்கள் வகுப்புக்கான வரியை மட்டும் எடுத்துக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.

ஆங்கிலத் தேர்வுடன் தேதிகளை ஒப்பிடுங்கள்

10ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (014) தேர்வுத் தேதி 27 பிப்ரவரி 2027. ஆங்கில மொழி மற்றும் இலக்கியம் (184) தேர்வுத் தேதி 26 பிப்ரவரி 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 1 நாட்கள் உள்ளன. 12ஆம் வகுப்பு அஸ்ஸாமீஸ் (114) தேர்வுத் தேதி 3 மார்ச் 2027. English Core (301) தேர்வுத் தேதி 5 மார்ச் 2027. இரு தேதிகளுக்குமிடையே 2 நாட்கள் உள்ளன.

இந்த இடைவெளி முழுவதும் படிக்க விடுமுறை என்று பொருளல்ல. உங்கள் மற்ற பாடங்களையும் நாட்காட்டியில் குறித்து, எந்தத் தேர்வும் இல்லாத நாட்களைக் கணக்கிடுங்கள். மாதிரித் தேர்வை எழுதும்போது உங்கள் தாளுக்கு ஒதுக்கிய நேரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்துங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்திற்குப் புறப்படும் முன்

தேர்வு தொடங்கும் நேரமும் மையத்துக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டிய நேரமும் வேறு. வருகை, நுழைவு, ஆவணங்கள் குறித்த விவரங்களுக்கு அனுமதிச் சீட்டைப் பாருங்கள். தேதி மாறியதாகத் தகவல் வந்தால் வாரியத்தின் திருத்தப்பட்ட அறிவிப்பில் வகுப்பு, குறியீடு, தேதி மூன்றையும் ஒப்பிடுங்கள்.

தேர்வு மையத்துக்குள் தொடர்பு சாதனங்களை எடுத்துச் செல்ல அனுமதி இல்லை. எடுத்துச் செல்லக்கூடிய பொருட்களுக்கு வாரியத்தின் தனி அறிவுறுத்தல்களையும் அனுமதிச் சீட்டையும் பின்பற்றுங்கள்.

title: TS LAWCET 2026 Admit Card Release Date Out - Download Hall Ticket at lawcet.tgche.ac.in
description: TS LAWCET 2026 admit card will be available online at lawcet.tgche.ac.in. Check Telangana LAWCET hall ticket release date, download process, exam schedule, important instructions, and FAQs.
content:
TS LAWCET 2026 Hall Ticket Expected on May 12; Telangana Candidates Can Download Admit Card Online

The Telangana State Law Common Entrance Test (TS LAWCET) 2026 hall ticket is expected to be released on May 12 through the official examination portal, lawcet.tgche.ac.in. Candidates who completed the registration process for the state-level law entrance examination will be able to access their admit cards online using their application credentials.

TS LAWCET is conducted every year for students seeking admission into 3-year LLB and 5-year integrated law programmes offered by participating colleges and universities across Telangana. The entrance examination for 2026 is scheduled to take place in online mode on May 18.

The admit card is one of the most important documents required for the examination process. Applicants will not be permitted inside the examination centre without a valid hall ticket and government-issued identity proof.

TS LAWCET 2026 Important Dates

Event Date
Hall Ticket Release Date May 12, 2026
TS LAWCET 2026 Exam May 18, 2026
Examination Mode Computer-Based Test
Official Portal lawcet.tgche.ac.in

Steps to Download TS LAWCET 2026 Hall Ticket

Candidates can follow the procedure below once the admit card link becomes active:

  1. Open the official TS LAWCET website
  2. Click on the “Hall Ticket Download” option available on the homepage
  3. Enter required login details such as:
    • Registration Number
    • Date of Birth
    • Mobile Number or Hall Ticket Number
  4. Submit the details carefully
  5. The admit card will appear on the screen
  6. Download the PDF and take a clear printout for examination use

Students are advised to keep multiple printed copies of the hall ticket to avoid last-minute issues.

Details Candidates Should Verify on the Admit Card

After downloading the TS LAWCET hall ticket, applicants should check all information carefully. The admit card generally includes:

  • Candidate’s full name
  • Roll number
  • Photograph and signature
  • Examination centre details
  • Reporting time
  • Exam date and session timing
  • Course applied for
  • Important exam-day guidelines

If any mistake is found in the details, candidates should contact the official authorities immediately before the examination date.

TS LAWCET 2026 Exam Day Instructions

Candidates appearing for the Telangana law entrance examination should strictly follow the instructions mentioned on the admit card. Important guidelines include:

  • Reach the exam venue before the reporting time
  • Carry a printed hall ticket and valid photo identity proof
  • Avoid carrying electronic gadgets inside the examination hall
  • Follow the instructions provided by invigilators during the CBT exam
  • Do not carry written notes, books, or prohibited materials

Authorities may deny entry to candidates who fail to follow examination guidelines.

Telangana Students Advised to Download Hall Ticket Early

Students from Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Warangal, Karimnagar, Nalgonda, Khammam, and other Telangana districts are advised to download the admit card immediately after release. Heavy traffic on the official website is expected closer to the examination date.

Candidates should also confirm the location of their allotted exam centre and plan travel arrangements in advance to avoid delays on exam day.

About TS LAWCET 2026

TS LAWCET is a state-level entrance examination conducted for admissions into undergraduate law courses in Telangana. The exam evaluates candidates on subjects such as:

  • General Knowledge
  • Current Affairs
  • Mental Ability
  • Aptitude for the Study of Law

Thousands of law aspirants appear for the examination every year to secure admission into top law colleges across the state.

title: CBSE 2027 టైమ్‌టేబుల్ కోసం వేచి చూస్తూ: ప్రతి PDFలో పరీక్ష సంవత్సరం చూడండి
description: CBSE 2026 ప్రత్యేక పరీక్ష నోటీసును 2027 ప్రధాన బోర్డు టైమ్‌టేబుల్‌గా భావించవద్దు. ప్రణాళికకు ముందు సంవత్సరం, తరగతి, విద్యార్థి వర్గం సరిపోల్చండి.
content:
CBSE PDFలో “date sheet” అని ఉన్నంత మాత్రాన అది 2027 పదో లేదా పన్నెండో తరగతి ప్రధాన పరీక్ష టైమ్‌టేబుల్ కాదు. బోర్డు జాబితాలో మధ్యప్రాచ్యం/పశ్చిమ ఆసియా ప్రాంతానికి 2026 ప్రత్యేక పన్నెండో తరగతి పరీక్ష నోటీసు ఉంది. 2027 ప్రధాన పరీక్షలకు సిద్ధమయ్యేవారు దానిని తమ పేపర్ల షెడ్యూల్‌గా వాడకూడదు.

ముందుగా సంవత్సరం, విద్యార్థి వర్గం చూడండి

ఆ ప్రత్యేక పరీక్ష నోటీసు 2027 ప్రధాన పరీక్షల సబ్జెక్టుల తేదీలను నిర్ధారించదు. రివిజన్ ప్రణాళికలో తేదీలు రాసుకునే ముందు పూర్తి శీర్షిక, మొదటి పేరా చదవండి. తరగతి, పరీక్ష సంవత్సరం, ప్రధానమా ప్రత్యేకమా, ప్రాంతం లేదా అభ్యర్థుల పరిమితులు ఉన్నాయా చూడండి.

వర్తించే ప్రకటన కోసం CBSE పరీక్ష సర్క్యులర్లు, అధికారిక బోర్డు వెబ్‌సైట్ చూడండి. మొదటి పేజీ లేని ఫార్వర్డ్ చిత్రం, నోటీసు మీకు వర్తిస్తుందో లేదో నిర్ణయించే సమాచారాన్ని దాచవచ్చు.

CBSE పరీక్ష సర్క్యులర్ జాబితాలో 9 అక్టోబర్ 2026 ప్రత్యేక పరీక్ష నోటీసు. ఇది పరీక్ష రకాన్ని గుర్తించే ఉదాహరణ; 2027 ప్రధాన పరీక్ష టైమ్‌టేబుల్ కాదు. ముందుగా సంవత్సరం, విద్యార్థి వర్గం చూడండి.

మార్చుకోగల రివిజన్ ప్రణాళిక ఉంచండి

టైమ్‌టేబుల్ కోసం వేచి ఉండగా పాఠశాల ప్రస్తుత సబ్జెక్టు, సిలబస్ సూచనల ప్రకారం చదవండి. పూర్తికాని అధ్యాయాలకు అదనపు సమయం ఇచ్చి, రాత సాధన, రివిజన్ మారుస్తూ చేయండి. సబ్జెక్టు క్రమం ఖరారయ్యాక ప్రణాళిక మార్చడానికి అవకాశం ఉంచండి.

రెండు పేపర్ల మధ్య నిర్దిష్ట విరామం ఊహించవద్దు. అంచనా ప్రారంభ తేదీ ఆధారంగా డబ్బు తిరిగి రాని ప్రయాణ బుకింగ్ చేయవద్దు. పరీక్షల సీజన్‌పై సాధారణ అంచనా ఒక్కో సబ్జెక్టు రోజు లేదా సెషన్‌ను ఖరారు చేయదు.

ప్రధాన టైమ్‌టేబుల్ వచ్చినప్పుడు చేయాల్సినవి

  1. సూచనలతో సహా పూర్తి అధికారిక PDF భద్రపరచండి.

  2. పేర్లు దగ్గరగా ఉన్నాయని కాకుండా సబ్జెక్టు పేరు, కోడ్ రెండూ సరిపోల్చండి.

  3. ప్రారంభ సమయం, ప్రత్యేక సబ్జెక్టు పరీక్ష వ్యవధి చదవండి.

  4. ప్రాక్టికల్ లేదా అంతర్గత మూల్యాంకన ఏర్పాట్లు పాఠశాలను విడిగా అడగండి.

  5. భద్రపరిచిన ప్రతిని నమ్మే ముందు తర్వాతి సర్క్యులర్ ఏదైనా సవరించిందా చూడండి.

CBSE టైమ్‌టేబుల్ తనిఖీ జాబితా పత్రాన్ని చదవడానికి మరింత సహాయపడుతుంది. సంబంధిత నోటీసు వచ్చే వరకు అంచనా తేదీలను స్పష్టంగా అంచనాలుగానే గుర్తించండి.
