title: NEST 2026 Result: Scorecard, Merit List & Counselling
description: Check NEST 2026 result updates, scorecard download steps, merit rank, admission eligibility, counselling process and important instructions for NISER and CEBS.
content:
The NEST 2026 result has been released for students who took the National Entrance Screening Test. NEST is held every year for students who want to join the 5-year Integrated MSc program. This program is offered at NISER Bhubaneswar. Also, at UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai. The NEST 2026 result was made public on June 24, 2026.

NEST 2026 Result

Candidates can check their NEST 2026 merit rank using the NEST portal. They need to enter their application number, date of birth and captcha. The result that appears after logging in is considered final.

The official portal also allowed qualified candidates to access their scorecard starting from June 30, 2026.

How to Check the NEST 2026 Result

Candidates can follow these steps:

  1. Visit the NEST website.

  2. Open the result login section.

  3. Enter the application number and date of birth.

  4. Complete the captcha verification.

  5. Check the merit rank. Result details.

  6. Download the scorecard if available.

NEST 2026 Scorecard

The NEST scorecard holds exam details. It shows the candidate information, how the candidate did in each section the scores and the merit data. The candidate should keep a copy of the scorecard for the admission process.

NEST 2026 Counselling

NEST admission counselling is carried out separately by NISER Bhubaneswar and UM‑DAE CEBS Mumbai, of one single central counselling. NEST admission counselling requires that qualified candidates follow the instructions issued by each institute.

NEST admission counselling steps can include:

- Registration or Expression of Interest (EOI)

- Admission queue or merit list

- Seat allocation/admission communication

- Document verification

- Reporting, to the institute

- Payment of admission fees

What Should Candidates Do After the Result?

Candidates should check their merit status. They should download any documents. They must keep an eye on admission notices, from the institutes. They need to complete all counselling or admission requirements. All of this must be done within the deadlines.

Official NEST website: https://www.nestexam.in

Conclusion

NEST 2026 candidates should use their result and merit status to proceed with the admission process at NISER or CEBS. Because counselling is handled separately by the institutes, NEST 2026 candidates should regularly check the official admission updates, for instructions.

title: ATLAS ISDI B.Des 2027: പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോ, പരീക്ഷാ കാലയളവ് നവംബർ 5 വരെ
description: ജൂലൈ 2027 B.Des പ്രവേശനത്തിന് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നവർ Cycle 1 പരീക്ഷ, പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോ, അഭിമുഖം, ഫീസ് തീയതികൾ അറിയുക.
content:
ATLAS ISDIയുടെ ജൂലൈ 2027 B.Des പ്രവേശനത്തിന് അപേക്ഷിക്കുന്നുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ പരീക്ഷയുടെയും പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോയുടെയും തയ്യാറെടുപ്പ് 2026 നവംബർ 5ന് മുമ്പ് പൂർത്തിയാക്കുക. കോഴ്‌സിന്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക പ്രവേശന കലണ്ടറിൽ Cycle 1 Design Aptitude Test, പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോ കാലയളവ് അന്നാണ് അവസാനിക്കുന്നത്. ഇത് എല്ലാ ATLAS കോഴ്‌സുകൾക്കുമുള്ള പൊതുവായ അവസാന തീയതിയല്ല.

ATLAS SkillTech Universityയുടെ ISDI B.Des ജൂലൈ 2027 പ്രവേശന കലണ്ടർ. വെബ്‌പേജിൽ പ്രത്യേക പ്രസിദ്ധീകരണ തീയതി നൽകിയിട്ടില്ല. അസൽ B.Des പ്രവേശന കലണ്ടർ കാണുക

പണമടയ്ക്കും മുമ്പ് യോഗ്യത വായിക്കുക

ISC, CBSE, സംസ്ഥാന ബോർഡ് വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾക്ക് ഏത് വിഭാഗത്തിലായാലും പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ക്ലാസിൽ മൊത്തം 50% മാർക്ക് വേണമെന്ന് പേജ് പറയുന്നു. A-Levels, International Baccalaureate യോഗ്യതകൾക്ക് പ്രത്യേക തുല്യതാ വ്യവസ്ഥകളുണ്ട്. അന്താരാഷ്ട്ര ബോർഡിൽ പഠിച്ചവരാണെങ്കിൽ ബന്ധപ്പെട്ട ഭാഗം വായിക്കുക.

അപേക്ഷാ ഫീസ് ₹3,500 എന്നാണ് പേജിലുള്ളത്. ഫീസ് തുകകൾ സൂചനയ്ക്കുള്ളതാണെന്നും മാറ്റത്തിന് വിധേയമാണെന്നും വ്യക്തമാക്കുന്നു. പണമടയ്ക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് സർവകലാശാലയുടെ പേയ്‌മെന്റ് സ്ക്രീനിൽ തുക ഉറപ്പാക്കുക. അപേക്ഷാ ഫീസ്, എൻറോൾമെന്റ് ഫീസിൽനിന്നും കോഴ്‌സ് ഫീസിൽനിന്നും വ്യത്യസ്തമാണ്.

അപേക്ഷയും പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോയും അഭിമുഖവും ഒരുമിച്ച് തയ്യാറാക്കുക

സർവകലാശാലയുടെ അപേക്ഷയിൽ ശരിയായ സ്കൂൾ, ബിരുദം, സ്പെഷ്യലൈസേഷൻ എന്നിവ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക. ഫോട്ടോയും പത്താം ക്ലാസ് മാർക്ക് ലിസ്റ്റും തയ്യാറാക്കുക; പന്ത്രണ്ടാം ക്ലാസ് പാസായിട്ടുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ അതിന്റെ മാർക്ക് ലിസ്റ്റും നൽകുക. പരമാവധി 250 വാക്കുകളിലുള്ള ഉദ്ദേശ്യവിവരണം ആവശ്യമാണ്. സമർപ്പിച്ച ശേഷം മാറ്റങ്ങൾ അനുവദിക്കില്ലെന്ന് ഫോം മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകുന്നു. അതിനാൽ വിവരങ്ങളും അപ്‌ലോഡുകളും ആദ്യം പരിശോധിക്കുക.

സർവകലാശാലയുടെ അപേക്ഷാ ഫോം തുറക്കുക

അപേക്ഷ സമർപ്പിക്കുന്നത് ആദ്യഘട്ടം മാത്രമാണ്. അന്തിമ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പിനും ഓഫർ ലെറ്ററിനും മുമ്പ് Design Aptitude Test, പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോ വിലയിരുത്തൽ, വ്യക്തിഗത അഭിമുഖം എന്നിവയുമുണ്ട്. പൊതുവായ കാലയളവിനെ നിങ്ങളുടെ വ്യക്തിഗത അപ്പോയിന്റ്‌മെന്റായി കാണാതെ, നിങ്ങൾക്ക് അയയ്ക്കുന്ന വിലയിരുത്തൽ നിർദേശങ്ങൾ പാലിക്കുക.

പോർട്ട്‌ഫോളിയോയെക്കുറിച്ചോ അപേക്ഷയുടെ ഘട്ടത്തെക്കുറിച്ചോ വിശദീകരണത്തിന് കോഴ്‌സിന്റെ ഔദ്യോഗിക വിലാസമായ isdi@atlasuniversity.edu.in ഉപയോഗിക്കുക. തുടർ ആശയവിനിമയത്തിനായി അപേക്ഷയുടെ സ്ഥിരീകരണവും പേയ്‌മെന്റ് രസീതും സൂക്ഷിക്കുക.

title: IISER or NEST: Which Science Route Fits Your Aptitude Better?
description: Compare IISER and NEST by subject comfort, preparation demands and course direction before choosing a science entrance route.
content:
Choosing IISER or NEST comes down to two checks: can you handle the required science preparation, and do you genuinely want the course route attached to the exam? The NEST website clearly links its test to admission into five-year integrated MSc programmes at NISER Bhubaneswar and UM-DAE CEBS Mumbai. IISER details need separate checking in the current admission notice, so don’t treat both routes as interchangeable.

What can you verify about each route?

NEST has a defined destination in the supplied official information: a five-year integrated MSc programme at two named institutions. Calling it a research-focused choice is a reasonable interpretation of that long science degree, not a separate admission rule. Read the official NEST website for the current syllabus, brochure and admission conditions.

For IISER, the available evidence here doesn’t establish a single admission route, a fixed list of programme options or identical choices across institutes. That means your decision must begin with the current IISER notice. Check which test or route applies, which institutes and programmes are included, and what later admission steps are required.

Decision pointIISERNEST
What to verifyCurrent route, participating institutes and programme detailsCurrent NEST syllabus, brochure and admission conditions
Course questionWould the listed IISER option suit your academic plans?Would you accept a five-year integrated MSc at NISER or UM-DAE CEBS?
Main riskRelying on an old IISER pattern or institute listAssuming a score alone guarantees a seat

How should you test your aptitude?

Don’t practise a made-up “common paper” for both exams. Use the official syllabus or notice for each route, then run a diagnostic session rather than pretending it is a current exam simulation.

  1. Pick one Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics or Biology topic you have already studied.
  2. Set a short timer and record skipped questions, calculation errors, weak concepts and rushed reading separately.
  3. Repeat the exercise with another subject from the relevant syllabus.
  4. Compare not only marks, but also whether you can tolerate sustained work in your weaker areas.

A Biology-strong student should draw and label diagrams, then check whether Physics numericals or Mathematics problems create repeated gaps. A Mathematics-strong student should test scientific recall instead of staying inside comfortable problem types. This is a fit check, not a promise of the actual paper pattern.

Which route should you prioritise?

Prioritise NEST when its verified destination matches the kind of five-year science degree you are willing to pursue. Prioritise IISER only after confirming the live route and programme choices that apply to your cycle. You may consider both, but only if you would genuinely accept either academic destination. Keep the NEST exam guide alongside the official notice while you check the details.

title: SAT Preparation 2025 - Exam Pattern, Strategies & Resources
description: Get a complete guide to the SAT exam - registration process, test format, scoring system, eligibility, and preparation tips.
content:
Introduction

The SAT (Scholastic Assessment Test) is a standardized exam widely used for college admissions in the United States and other countries. Administered by the College Board, the SAT evaluates students’ abilities in reading, writing, and mathematics, serving as a key factor in the admissions process. A strong SAT score can significantly enhance your chances of getting into top universities and scholarship programs.

What is the SAT?

The SAT measures academic skills essential for college success, including critical thinking, problem-solving, and analytical reasoning. Unlike other tests, the SAT is designed to assess both knowledge and application, giving colleges insight into a student’s preparedness for higher education.

SAT Test Format

The SAT consists of three main sections and an optional essay (discontinued in most administrations):

  1. Reading (65 minutes) – Passage-based questions testing comprehension, interpretation, and analysis.

  2. Writing and Language (35 minutes) – Grammar, punctuation, and editing skills assessed through passage-based questions.

  3. Mathematics (80 minutes) – Covers algebra, problem-solving, data analysis, and advanced math concepts.

  4. Optional Essay – Evaluates analytical writing skills by analyzing a provided passage (check latest College Board updates, as most schools no longer require this).

Total test duration: Approximately 3 hours (without the essay).

SAT Scoring System

  • Each section (Reading/Writing and Math) is scored from 200–800.

  • Total score: 400–1600.

  • Essay scoring (if applicable) is separate and ranges from 2–8 in three dimensions: Reading, Analysis, and Writing.

  • Most competitive universities require total scores of 1200–1500+, depending on the program.

Eligibility for SAT

  • Students in high school (grades 11–12) are the primary test-takers.

  • There is no strict age limit, but candidates typically take SAT before applying to undergraduate programs.

  • SAT is suitable for students planning to study in the US, Canada, and other international universities accepting SAT scores.

SAT Registration Process

  1. Visit the official College Board SAT website.

  2. Create a College Board account with personal details.

  3. Select the test date, location, and test type (SAT or SAT Subject Tests if applicable).

  4. Pay the registration fee (generally around $60–$70, subject to region).

  5. Receive confirmation with your test center and instructions.

Preparation Tips for SAT Success

  1. Understand the test format – Practice section-wise sample questions.

  2. Improve reading and vocabulary – Focus on comprehension, inference, and contextual usage.

  3. Strengthen math skills – Cover algebra, geometry, and data analysis thoroughly.

  4. Practice writing and grammar – Focus on sentence correction and editing passages.

  5. Take timed practice tests – Simulate exam conditions to improve speed and accuracy.

  6. Analyze weak areas – Focus on topics where mistakes are frequent.

Why Take the SAT?

  • Widely recognized by over 4,000 colleges and universities worldwide.

  • Helps in securing merit-based scholarships and financial aid.

  • Offers standardized evaluation of critical reading, math, and writing skills.

  • Flexible test dates and multiple attempts allow students to improve scores.

Conclusion

The SAT exam is a crucial step for students aiming for undergraduate studies abroad. With proper preparation, understanding of the exam structure, and consistent practice, candidates can achieve competitive scores, enhancing their chances of admission and scholarships. The SAT remains a trusted benchmark for academic readiness and college potential.

title: Graphic Design: Creativity Meets Visual Communication
description: Discover how graphic design blends creativity and visual communication to craft impactful designs that inspire and engage audiences.
content:
WHAT IS GRAPHIC DESIGN ?

Graphic design is the art and practice of creating visual content to communicate messages, ideas, or information. It combines elements like typography, images, colours, shapes, and layouts to make designs that are visually appealing and effective in conveying meaning.
Graphic design is used in various fields such as branding, advertising, web design, packaging, publications, and social media.

WHAT IS THE HISTORY OF GRAPHIC DESIGN ?

The roots of graphic design go back centuries, from ancient cave paintings to the invention of printing in the 15th century. However, modern graphic design began in the early 20th century with the growth of advertising and mass media. Over time, technology has transformed the field.

In the past, designers worked mostly with paper, ink, and physical printing tools. Today, they use advanced software like Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and online tools like Canva to create digital designs that can be shared instantly across the globe. The rise of social media has made graphic design even more important, as brands compete for attention in an image-driven world.

WHAT ARE THE KEY ELEMENTS OF GRAPHIC DESIGN ?


Every design relies on a few basic building blocks:

1.Line – Used to divide space, guide the viewer’s eye, or create patterns and textures. Lines can be straight, curved, thick, thin, solid, or dashed.

2.Shape – Geometric (circles, squares), organic (natural, irregular), or abstract shapes help create structure, focus, and interest in a design.

3.Color – One of the most powerful elements in design. Colors evoke emotions, set moods, and influence perceptions. Designers use color theory to choose harmonious combinations.

4.Typography – The style, arrangement, and appearance of text. Typography affects readability and can express the personality of the design.

5.Texture – Adds depth and surface quality to a design, making it look smooth, rough, soft, or glossy.

6.Space – Also called “white space,” it’s the empty area around elements. Good use of space prevents clutter and draws attention to important parts.

7.Form – In 3D design, form refers to depth, volume, and dimension, making objects look more realistic.

8.Value – The lightness or darkness of an element, which helps create contrast and visual interest

HOW MANY GRAPHIC DESIGNS ARE THERE ?

Graphic design is a broad field with many specializations:

·       Brand Identity Design – Creating logos, color palettes, and style guides that represent a company’s image.

·       Advertising and Marketing Design – Making posters, flyers, billboards, and social media ads.

·       Web and App Design – Designing website layouts, user interfaces, and digital experiences.

·       Publication Design – Creating layouts for magazines, newspapers, books, and brochures.

·       Packaging Design – Designing product labels, boxes, and wrappers that attract buyers.

·       Motion Graphics – Creating animated graphics for videos, presentations, and advertisements.

·       Environmental & Experiential Design-Focusing on Designing spaces and environments to enhance user experience,Includes signage, exhibition designs, murals, and event branding.

·       Illustration & Art Design – Focusing on Hand-drawn or digital illustrations used for branding, storytelling, and advertising. Includes book covers, comic art, product illustrations, and concept art.

HOW IS GRAPHIC DESIGN IMPORTANT ?

In a fast-paced, visually-driven world, graphic design plays a crucial role in communication and branding. Good design can:

·       Create a strong first impression – A well-designed logo or ad can instantly attract attention.

·       Build brand recognition – Consistent design elements help people remember a business.

·       Improve communication – Visuals often communicate complex ideas faster than words alone.

·       Influence decisions – Eye-catching packaging or a clean website can persuade customers to choose one product over another.

WHAT SKILLS ARE REQUIRED FOR THIS ?

A successful graphic designer needs a mix of creativity, technical knowledge, and problem-solving skills. Some important skills include:

·       Creativity and originality

·       Understanding of design principles

·       Knowledge of design software

·       Attention to detail

·       Good communication skills to understand client needs

·       Ability to adapt to new trends and technologies

AT LAST

Graphic design is more than making something “look nice.” It is a powerful tool for communication, storytelling, and branding. As technology advances, the possibilities for creativity in graphic design are endless. Whether you are a business owner looking to promote your brand, a student considering a creative career, or simply someone who enjoys making art, graphic design offers countless ways to turn ideas into visual reality.

In short, graphic design is where creativity meets strategy, transforming messages into visuals that inspire, inform, and persuade.

title: CAT, XAT or CMAT: Which MBA Exam Fits Your Work and Study Plan?
description: Choose CAT, XAT or CMAT by your target colleges, available study time and full application budget instead of paying for exams you may not use.
content:
CAT, XAT and CMAT suit different MBA application plans. Your target colleges should decide the main exam; your work schedule and budget should decide whether you add a second one. Registering for all three without a shortlist can spread your preparation thin and leave you paying for forms you never use.

Which exam matches your college shortlist?

Start with the schools, not the exam names. CAT belongs at the top when your chosen institutes accept CAT scores. XAT becomes a sensible choice when XLRI or another XAT-accepting programme is genuinely on your list. CMAT works only when the colleges you want list it for the programme and admission cycle you’re considering.

Your intended collegesMain exam to assessCheck before registration
Institutes accepting CATCATProgramme eligibility and score-use rules
XLRI or other XAT-accepting institutesXATWhether your selected programme accepts XAT
Institutes listing CMATCMATCurrent admission notice and score validity

Do not assume that a college accepts every popular MBA test. The responsible exam authority publishes the current notice, while each institute decides how it uses a score. That separation matters.

What changes if you’re working or in final year?

Work experience changes the hours you can give preparation; it doesn’t automatically make one exam better. If you can study in six short weekday sessions, choose one main paper and add a backup only when it opens a real college option. A final-year student may have more daytime flexibility, but that’s useful only after fixing a realistic school list.

Keep exam eligibility separate from selection policy. A college may consider work experience while reviewing your profile, but the exam notice sets its own eligibility rules. Check both before you commit.

How much will the plan really cost?

Don’t compare registration fees alone. Make one college-wise budget:

  1. Note the fee in the current notice issued by the relevant testing body.
  2. Add every separate college or programme application charge.
  3. Include test-centre travel, meals and a possible overnight stay.
  4. Reserve money for interview travel and document needs.

Before choosing, take a timed quant set, one reading-comprehension passage and a short error review for your leading exam. CAT and XAT preparation can overlap in parts, but their papers and rules aren’t identical. CMAT needs its own current pattern check. Use MBA entrance exam comparisons and college comparisons to record accepted tests, course fit and location.

title: GOAPS GATE 2027 Aadhaar Name Discrepancy Fixes: Correcting Mismatches Between Class 10 Certificate and DigiLocker
description: A complete guide for GATE 2027 applicants on resolving name discrepancies between Class 10 certificates, Aadhaar records, and DigiLocker profiles on the GOAPS portal.
content:
Understanding Name Mismatches in GATE 2027 Registration

When applying for the Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering through the GATE Online Application Processing System, known as GOAPS, candidate verification relies heavily on official identification databases. For GATE 2027 registration, applicant information must match across three critical data points: your Class 10 passing certificate, your Aadhaar card details, and the linked DigiLocker profile. A discrepancy in spelling, spacing, expanded initials, or surname order can block authentication or cause issues during admit card generation and examination center entry.

Because national conducting authorities use automated cross-verification with DigiLocker, even minor spelling variances between your secondary school documents and UIDAI records can lead to application rejection. Resolving these mismatches early prevents last minute stress during the registration window.

Identifying Common Types of Name Discrepancies

Mismatches generally fall into specific categories during online registration. Identifying the exact nature of your discrepancy helps determine whether UIDAI updates or manual uploads on GOAPS are required.

  • Expanded Initials vs Abbreviated Initials: Your Class 10 certificate might read S. K. Sharma while Aadhaar displays Santosh Kumar Sharma.
  • Order of Names: Reversal of surname and first name between Class 10 records and UIDAI registration.
  • Spelling Typos: Differences in vowel placement or double letters, such as Choudhary versus Chaudhary.
  • Missing Surnames: Instances where a candidate has a single name on their Aadhaar card but a two-part name on their school certificate.
  • Inclusion of Honorifics: Presence of prefixes like Shri, Kumar, or Devi in one document but absent in another.

Step-by-Step Process to Fix Aadhaar and Class 10 Mismatches

When discrepancies occur, the official guideline is to ensure that your application name strictly aligns with your Class 10 secondary school certificate or equivalent official identity proof.

Step 1: Update Your Aadhaar Profile First

If time permits before the GOAPS application deadline, update your Aadhaar details via the official UIDAI portal or an authorized Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. Submit your Class 10 certificate or official identity document as valid proof of name. Aadhaar updates typically process within a few working days. Once updated, fetch the revised document inside DigiLocker before initiating GATE application verification.

Step 2: Correct Details in DigiLocker

DigiLocker automatically syncs records with UIDAI and secondary education boards like CBSE, CISCE, or state boards. If your updated Aadhaar does not automatically reflect in DigiLocker, clear the profile sync, re-link your mobile number, and pull the fresh Aadhaar document under the Issued Documents tab.

Step 3: Manual Verification on GOAPS Portal

If UIDAI updates cannot be completed before the registration deadline, GOAPS provides alternative verification mechanisms. Candidates who cannot verify seamlessly through DigiLocker can choose manual document upload options:

  • Select the option to upload identity documents manually on the GOAPS portal.
  • Upload a clear scanned copy of a valid government photo ID, such as a Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID, or Driving License that strictly matches your Class 10 details.
  • Ensure the uploaded photo ID is valid and presentable at the examination hall on exam day.

Best Practices for Filling the GOAPS Application

To avoid portal flags and smooth out admission processes later, follow these precise steps when filling out personal details:

  • Enter your full name exactly as printed on your Class 10 mark sheet or secondary certificate.
  • Do not add titles, honorifics, or prefixes like Mr, Ms, Dr, or Shri.
  • Double check spacing between your first name, middle name, and surname.
  • Keep active mobile numbers and email addresses registered with both UIDAI and DigiLocker to receive OTPs during verification.
  • Always verify the official GATE authority website for specific guidelines if your document mismatch involves legal name changes due to marriage or gazette notifications.

Frequently Asked Questions

What should I do if my name on Aadhaar does not match my Class 10 certificate for GATE 2027?

You should prioritize updating your name in the UIDAI database using your Class 10 certificate as proof. If time is short before the registration deadline, choose the manual photo ID upload option on the GOAPS portal using an identity proof that matches your Class 10 certificate.

Can I edit my name after submitting the GOAPS GATE application?

GOAPS typically opens an application correction window after the initial registration closes. During this period, candidates can request updates to certain fields like candidate name, category, or document uploads by paying a minor correction fee through the official portal.

Is DigiLocker verification compulsory for GATE 2027 registration?

While DigiLocker authentication is recommended for fast verification, candidates facing technical issues or data mismatches can opt for manual identity proof uploads as permitted by the official GATE administration guidelines.

Which name is considered primary for GATE 2027 admit card generation?

The name entered in the GOAPS portal, which must match your Class 10 certificate and the physical photo identity card brought to the exam center, will appear on the admit card and official scorecard.

title: GTU Cancels PhD & Rolls Out Academic Reforms: Key Updates for Students
description: GTU cancels a tainted PhD and rolls out reforms including internships, major-minor system, and stricter academic policies. Key updates for students in 2025.
content:
In an important step to maintain academic integrity, Gujarat Technological University (GTU) recently abolished a PhD program and made several programmatic changes. Keyur Shah, a suspended system analyst engaged in the 'Triple C' affair, had his PhD revealed to contain stolen material published in a predatory journal, which led to the judgment. The necessity for stronger evaluation and verification procedures has been highlighted by this incident, which has had repercussions throughout the higher education community.

Why This Decision Matters

Academic fraud harms students who put a lot of effort into earning their degrees and damages universities' reputations. The university's dedication to upholding justice and openness is demonstrated by GTU's prompt action. This action guarantees that GTU degrees and certifications are respected by both academic institutions and employers, which is good news for students.

Key Reforms Introduced by GTU

GTU has implemented a number of significant reforms to improve academic standards and better prepare students for the working world:

1. Honoring Defense Personnel
Defense personnel's technical experience will now be recognized by GTU, enabling it to count toward degrees and diplomas. This guarantees that the academic system values real-world experience outside of regular classrooms.

2. Tougher disciplinary actions
GTU has implemented improved monitoring measures to stop academic misconduct in light of the surge in contemporary exam cheating, particularly using technological devices.

3. System of Major-Minor
Even if all credit requirements are not met, students can now choose to graduate with a regular degree. As a result, students can continue their education without needless delays and inclusion is guaranteed.

4. Reforms to the Architecture Program
GTU has set minimal passing scores for architecture courses at 40% for theory and 50% for practicals in order maintain strong academic standards.

5. Required Internship
In order to enable students to apply their theoretical knowledge in practical settings and better prepare them for their future jobs, a two-week internship program has been implemented.

How These Reforms Impact Students

  1. guarantees an impartial and open assessment of academic achievement.
  2. promotes the development of skills through useful internships.
  3. allows for flexibility for students who might not be able to fulfill all credit requirements right away.
  4. safeguards each student's GTU degree's worth and legitimacy.
  5. helps graduates meet the needs of the industry and overcome obstacles in their careers.

Final Thoughts

The corrupted PhD has been cancelled at GTU, and new reforms place an emphasis on student flexibility, practical learning, and academic integrity. These modifications guarantee that merit and genuine effort continue to be at the heart of higher education while also enhancing degree credibility and preparing students for real-world professions.

title: MHT CET 2026 PCM Exam LIVE: May 15 Shift 2 Ends, Shift-wise Paper Analysis Solutions
description: MHT CET 2026 PCM Exam LIVE: May 15 Shift 2 Ends, Shift-wise Paper Analysis Solutions
content:
Key Takeaways

  • Eligibility matters more than dates - check every criterion before you start filling the form.
  • Apply at least 3 days before the deadline. Portals crash under peak load every single year.
  • OBC-NCL and other category certificates must be from the current financial year to be valid.
  • Download your application confirmation immediately after submission - do not wait.
  • The correction window is your last resort, not your plan - get the form right first time.
What nobody tells you: Uploading documents is where 30% of applications quietly die. The portal accepts the file, but it is blurry, oversized, or in the wrong format. Always preview what you uploaded.

The Dates That Actually Matter (And Why Most Students Track the Wrong Ones)

Everyone tracks the last date to apply. The students who actually get in track three dates: when registration opens, when the correction window closes, and when admit cards release. The last date is just the deadline - the earlier dates are where the real preparation happens.

Event Tentative Date What to Do Right Now
Official Notification Check official site Download and read the full PDF - all 30+ pages
Registration Opens Check official site Register on Day 1, not Day 10
Last Date to Apply Check official site Submit 3 days before - treat this as your real deadline
Correction Window After registration closes Check the official site daily - it opens without announcement
Admit Card Check official site Download immediately and verify every detail
Exam Date Check official site Do a location recce 2 days before - find the center, check transport
Result After exam Keep your roll number saved in 3 places
Counselling After result Register separately - it is a different process from the exam

The Eligibility Checklist Nobody Reads Carefully Enough

This is the section most students skim. Do not. One missed criterion means rejection after you have already paid - and there is no refund. Go through this slowly.

What to Check What It Means The Catch
Educational Qualification Class 12 pass or appearing from recognised board \"Recognised board\" has a specific list - open boards are sometimes excluded
Minimum Percentage 45-75% in Class 12 (varies by exam) The percentage is calculated on specific subjects, not overall
Subject Combination Per official notification This changes year to year - do not assume last year's applies
Age Limit 17-25 years typically, varies Some exams also cap the number of attempts - check both
Category Certificate SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD OBC-NCL expires every April 1. Get a fresh one if yours is older.

 

How to Actually Apply (The Version That Works)

Here is a student story that explains why the order matters: Anjali from Delhi spent two days confused about the subject combination requirement. The answer was on page 4 of the official notification she had not read. Do not let this be you.

Step 1 - Read the official notification before you do anything else

Not a summary. The actual PDF. It takes 20 minutes and prevents 90% of application errors. Everything else you read - including this guide - is secondary to the official document. The URL will end in .nic.in or .gov.in for government exams.

Step 2 - Register with your own details, not your parents'

Use your own email and phone number. Every OTP, admit card link, counselling update, and result notification goes to these. If you lose access, recovery takes weeks of formal correspondence. Your parents' numbers may not always be reachable.

Step 3 - The three fields that kill most applications

Name (must match Aadhaar exactly, character by character), date of birth (must match board certificate), and category. These cannot be changed after final submission in most cases. Double-check all three before you click submit.

Step 4 - Documents: the format trap

Portals specify exact file format, maximum size, and pixel dimensions. A 400KB JPG when the portal asks for 100KB fails silently - the form looks submitted but the document is missing. Use a scanner app. Check file size before uploading. Preview the uploaded document in the portal before moving to the next section.

Step 5 - Pay, then screenshot everything

Download your application PDF and payment receipt before you close the browser. Take a screenshot of your application number. Write it in your phone notes, email it to yourself, and keep a physical note. This number is your identity for every future step - admit card, result, counselling.

If your payment fails: Do not pay again immediately. Wait 24-48 hours for the transaction to auto-reverse. If you make a second payment, you may end up paying twice with no way to get one back. Contact your bank with the transaction reference number if it has not reversed after 48 hours.

The 5 Mistakes That Will Cost You a Year

These are not theoretical. They happen every cycle, to thousands of students. Every single one is preventable.

  • Wrong photo: Recent (within 3 months), white background, both ears visible, no spectacles, no cap. Phone selfies are the most common rejection reason. Use a proper passport photo service or a well-lit white wall.
  • Expired category certificate: OBC-NCL certificates expire every April 1st. If your certificate was issued before this April, it is already invalid. Get a fresh one this week.
  • Applying on the last day: Every exam portal in India slows to a crawl between 6pm and midnight on deadline day. Every year. Apply at 7am, three days before the deadline.
  • Name mismatch: One extra space, one different spelling, or a missing middle name compared to your Aadhaar flags your application at verification. Check character by character.
  • Not reading the form before submitting: Go through the preview page carefully before clicking final submit. What is wrong at this stage cannot be fixed later - only the correction window gives you another chance, and not all fields can be corrected even then.

title: AI Assisted Counseling Timelines for Indian EDU Admissions 2027 Including Regional Portals and Backup Plans
description: A practical timeline and regional portal roadmap for AI-enhanced counseling ahead of Indian higher education admissions in 2027, including contingency plans and guidance for students and parents.
content:
Unlocking AI guided counseling for admission timelines

For Indian students aiming to secure seats in 2027, AI-assisted counseling can align aspirations with available programs, scholarship options, and admission processes. This article outlines actionable timelines, regional portal access, and robust backup plans to navigate uncertainties. Readers will discover how to structure decision points, verify deadlines, and leverage AI tools responsibly to compare institutions, courses, and career outcomes.

Key milestones and timelines for 2027 admissions

Admit cycles vary by state, board results, and national entrance processes. A practical approach is to anchor decisions around three phases: exploration, shortlisting, and final application. AI can help calibrate preferences to timelines, while regional portals provide localized guidance.

  • Phase 1: Exploration (June-August 2026) - Use AI powered counselors to map interests to streams (engineering, sciences, commerce, arts, design). Gather information on eligibility, reservation policies, and early application windows. Maintain a dynamic list of potential programs and expected cutoff trends using regional data dashboards.
  • Phase 2: Shortlisting (September-November 2026) - AI assists in ranking programs by fit, cost, distance, and placement outcomes. Start obtaining prospectus, connect with current students via regional portals, and note important dates for entrance tests and eligibility criteria.
  • Phase 3: Applications and backups (December 2026-March 2027) - Submit applications with tailored essays or statements where required. Prepare backup plans for waitlists and alternative streams or institutes. Use AI to monitor deadlines and document requirements in multiple regional portals to avoid missing caps or dates.

Regional portals: regional access points and how to use them

Regional portals aggregate state-wise admission data, counselling schedules, and college-level notices. They help students compare options across public universities, institutes, and private colleges within a state. When using these portals, prioritize these actions:

  • Register early with a valid mobile number and email to receive updates and admit card notifications.
  • Enable notifications for important dates such as application openings, document submissions, and entrance test windows.
  • Cross-check program codes, eligibility criteria, and reservation categories specific to your region.
  • Use AI powered filters to sort programs by branch, campus location, fee range, and placement statistics.
  • Maintain a centralized dossier of scanned documents and test scores to streamline submissions across portals.

Admit cycles can shift due to changes in policy, exam schedules, or technical issues on portals. A strong backup plan reduces risk and keeps options open.

  • Backup 1 - Alternative streams: If an engineering seat is delayed, consider allied programs such as data science, information technology, or applied sciences that align with interests and have flexible transfer policies.
  • Backup 2 - Distance and regional options: Include accredited regional institutes or universities offering online or hybrid programs with local campuses to keep timelines intact.
  • Backup 3 - Test and score adjustments: In case of postponements, be ready to retake or substitute with parallel entrance scores or qualifying exams that are accepted by regional institutes.
  • Backup 4 - Financial and scholarship planning: Keep a rolling view of scholarships, fellowships, and fee waivers across regions to minimize timing gaps in funding decisions.

AI counseling can synthesize data from multiple regional portals, compare program requirements, and forecast likely admission outcomes based on historical trends and current inputs. Practical uses include:

  • Personalized program recommendations based on academic strengths, interests, and location preferences.
  • Dynamic deadline tracking and document checklists tailored to each portal and program.
  • Scenario planning to weigh acceptances, waitlists, and backups with estimated timelines.
  • Cost of attendance estimations, scholarships, and ROI proxies for different regions.

  1. Set a primary and one or two backup target programs in each region that match your profile.
  2. Use AI assisted planning to build a calendar with all deadlines, document requirements, and test date alignment.
  3. Engage with regional portals early to verify eligibility and application processes; update profiles with new scores or achievements as they occur.
  4. Prepare a concise statement of purpose or personal essay where required, focusing on how your goals align with the chosen programs.
  5. Maintain a centralized file of proof documents and ensure backups for critical items such as identity proofs, mark sheets, and payment receipts.

Regional portals and admission authorities publish official notices and notifications. Always verify deadlines, eligibility criteria, and fee structures on the relevant authority's website. Do not rely on third party summaries alone and confirm any region-specific reservations or eligibility changes directly with the portal or institute.

What is AI assisted counseling for admissions?

It uses AI to analyze interests, marks, and regional portal data to suggest programs, optimize timelines, and monitor deadlines for admissions across multiple institutes and regions.

How early should I start using regional portals?

Begin exploration in mid to late 2026, with initial registrations and alerts activated as soon as portals open for the new admission cycle.

What if timelines shift due to portal outages or delays?

Have a defined backup plan for alternate programs and regions. Keep offline copies of documents and maintain contact with counselors or helplines to receive timely updates.

How can parents stay involved without overwhelming the process?

Set up shared calendars, review essential deadlines together, and use AI summaries to understand program fit and costs. Focus on informed decision-making rather than micromanagement.

Are regional portals the only source for admission information?

No. Cross-check with official notifications from the institute and state education authorities. If unsure, verify details on the official authority website.

title: IIM अहमदाबाद समर प्लेसमेंट: 70हून अधिक भूमिकांचा आकडा कसा वाचावा?
description: IIM अहमदाबादच्या 2026-28 PGP तुकडीचे समर प्लेसमेंट पूर्ण झाले. क्लस्टर 3मधील भूमिका, भरती क्षेत्रे आणि अद्याप न आलेले आकडे समजून घ्या.
content:
IIM अहमदाबादने 30 ऑक्टोबर 2026 रोजी क्लस्टर 3नंतर 2026-28 PGP तुकडीची समर इंटर्नशिप प्लेसमेंट प्रक्रिया पूर्ण केली. संस्थेने या क्लस्टरमध्ये 70हून अधिक कामाच्या भूमिका नोंदवल्या आहेत. हा संपूर्ण तुकडीतील निवड झालेल्या विद्यार्थ्यांचा एकूण आकडा नाही.

शेवटच्या क्लस्टरमध्ये कोणती क्षेत्रे होती?

30 ऑक्टोबरच्या अधिकृत प्रसिद्धिपत्रकात 12 भरती गट आणि ऑनलाइन तसेच प्रत्यक्ष पार पडलेल्या प्रक्रियेचे वर्णन आहे. यात कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता, एंटरप्राइज तंत्रज्ञान, बँकिंग व विमा, मुख्य उत्पादन, नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा आणि सामाजिक उद्योग यांचा समावेश होता.

Microsoft आणि Sprinklr एंटरप्राइज तंत्रज्ञान क्षेत्रातील भरतीदार होते. अॅनालिटिक्स आणि आयटी कन्सल्टिंग गटात Tata Consultancy Servicesने सर्वाधिक भरती केली. बँकिंग व विमा गटात Axis Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank आणि NaBFID होते. ही सहभागाची उदाहरणे आहेत; वेतन किंवा विद्यावेतनाची क्रमवारी नाही.

30 ऑक्टोबरचे अधिकृत प्रसिद्धिपत्रक

कोणते आकडे अद्याप उपलब्ध नाहीत?

IIMAनुसार एकत्रित प्लेसमेंट प्रसिद्धिपत्रक पुढे येईल. या क्लस्टरच्या घोषणेत संपूर्ण तुकडीचे सरासरी किंवा मध्यक विद्यावेतन, निवड झालेल्या विद्यार्थ्यांची पूर्ण संख्या किंवा नियोक्तानिहाय अंतिम ऑफर तक्ता नाही. जुन्या तुकडीच्या आकड्यांनी ही उणीव भरू नका.

ही माहिती समर इंटर्नशिपची आहे. MBAनंतर पूर्णवेळ नोकरीसाठी होणारे अंतिम प्लेसमेंट हे वेगळे मोजमाप आहे. संस्थांची तुलना करताना किंवा अभ्यासक्रमाच्या शुल्काचा परतावा मोजताना दोन्ही वेगळे ठेवा.

महाविद्यालय निवडताना याचा उपयोग

तुम्हाला जाणून घ्यायच्या कामापासून सुरुवात करा. संबंधित क्षेत्र दिसल्यास इंटर्नशिपमध्ये नेमके काम काय, कोणती कौशल्ये लागतात आणि भरतीदारांचा आवाका किती आहे असे प्रश्न विचारा. एखाद्या कंपनीचे नाव असल्याने पुढील तुकडीला किती संधी मिळतील हे ठरत नाही.

आकड्यांची योग्य तुलना करण्यासाठी समान प्लेसमेंट प्रकार आणि तुकडीचे अहवाल घ्या. विद्यावेतन मासिक आहे की संपूर्ण इंटर्नशिपसाठी, ते तपासा. संदर्भासाठी क्लस्टर 2चे वृत्त आणि एकत्रित निष्कर्षासाठी अधिकृत प्रसिद्धिपत्रके पाहा. संस्था देत नाही तोपर्यंत गायब आकड्याचा अंदाज बांधू नका.

क्लस्टर 2चे वृत्त. अधिकृत प्लेसमेंट प्रसिद्धिपत्रके.

title: അസം നീറ്റ് യുജി 2026: നവംബർ 7 അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് നടപടികൾക്ക്; പട്ടികയ്ക്ക് നിശ്ചയിച്ചത് 8
description: അസം സംസ്ഥാന ക്വാട്ടയിലെ എംബിബിഎസ് പ്രത്യേക സ്ട്രേ റൗണ്ടിന്റെയും ബിഡിഎസ് അഞ്ചാം റൗണ്ടിന്റെയും പട്ടികയ്ക്ക് നിശ്ചയിച്ച തീയതി നവംബർ 8 ആണ്. തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കപ്പെട്ടവർ നവംബർ 16ന്റെ പ്രവേശന നിർദേശങ്ങൾ ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക.
content:
ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ ലോക്ക് ചെയ്ത വിദ്യാർഥികൾക്ക് നവംബർ 7 അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് നടപടികൾ നടക്കുന്ന ദിവസമാണ്. പുതുക്കിയ സമയക്രമത്തിൽ ഫലവും പ്രവേശന നിർദേശങ്ങളും പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നത് 2026 നവംബർ 8 ആണ്. നടപടികൾ തുടങ്ങിയതുകൊണ്ട് മാത്രം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് സീറ്റ് ലഭിച്ചതായി കരുതരുത്.

കോഴ്സും റൗണ്ടും ഒത്തുനോക്കുക

അസം മെഡിക്കൽ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ ഡയറക്ടറേറ്റിന്റെ അറിയിപ്പ് സർക്കാർ മെഡിക്കൽ, ഡെന്റൽ കോളേജുകളിലെ ഒഴിവുള്ള എംബിബിഎസ് സീറ്റുകളിലേക്കുള്ള പ്രത്യേക സ്ട്രേ റൗണ്ടിനും ബിഡിഎസ് അഞ്ചാം റൗണ്ടിനുമാണ്. പഴയ റൗണ്ടിന്റെ പട്ടികയോ അഖിലേന്ത്യാ ക്വാട്ടയിലെ ഫലമോ ഈ റൗണ്ടിലെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് സ്ഥിരീകരിക്കില്ല.

തീയതിനിശ്ചയിച്ച നടപടിവിദ്യാർഥി അറിയേണ്ടത്
7 നവംബർ 2026സീറ്റ് അലോട്ട്മെന്റ് നടപടികൾലോക്ക് ചെയ്ത ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ പരിഗണിക്കും. ഇത് തിരഞ്ഞെടുപ്പ് പട്ടികയല്ല.
8 നവംബർ 2026ഫലവും പ്രവേശന നിർദേശങ്ങളും പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കാൻ നിശ്ചയിച്ച ദിവസംഎവിടെ ഹാജരാകണമെന്ന് തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് രണ്ടും വായിക്കുക.
16 നവംബർ 2026താൽക്കാലികമായി തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കപ്പെട്ടവരുടെ പ്രവേശനംനിർദേശമനുസരിച്ച് അനുവദിച്ച സ്ഥാപനത്തിൽ പ്രവേശനം നേടുക.

അസം മെഡിക്കൽ വിദ്യാഭ്യാസ ഡയറക്ടറേറ്റ്, 5 നവംബർ 2026: അലോട്ട്മെന്റ്, ഫലം, പ്രവേശനം എന്നിവയുടെ പുതുക്കിയ തീയതികൾ നൽകുന്ന ഔദ്യോഗിക അറിയിപ്പ്.

ഫലം വരുമ്പോൾ പരിശോധിക്കേണ്ടത്

DME Assam: ഡയറക്ടറേറ്റിന്റെ സൈറ്റിൽ 2026 സെഷനും നിങ്ങളുടെ കോഴ്സിനും റൗണ്ടിനും യോജിച്ച അറിയിപ്പ് നോക്കുക. ഓപ്ഷൻ നൽകാനുള്ള ലിങ്ക് ഫലമല്ല. ഫലം പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിക്കുന്ന സമയം അറിയിപ്പിൽ പറഞ്ഞിട്ടില്ല.

പട്ടികയിലെ തിരിച്ചറിയൽ നമ്പർ, കോഴ്സ്, സ്ഥാപനം എന്നിവ നിങ്ങളുടെ കൗൺസലിങ് രേഖയുമായി ഒത്തുനോക്കുക. ഹാജരാകേണ്ട സ്ഥലം, സമയം, രേഖകൾ എന്നിവയ്ക്ക് പട്ടികയ്ക്കൊപ്പം വരുന്ന നിർദേശങ്ങൾ വായിക്കുക. രണ്ടും സൂക്ഷിക്കുക.

ഓപ്ഷൻ സ്ലിപ്പ് മാത്രം കൈയിലുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ

സ്ലിപ്പ് നിങ്ങൾ നൽകിയ മുൻഗണനകളുടെ രേഖ മാത്രമാണ്. ഓപ്ഷനുകൾ നൽകി ലോക്ക് ചെയ്യാനുള്ള സമയം നവംബർ 6ന് അവസാനിച്ചു. പുതിയ അറിയിപ്പ് വന്നാൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ റൗണ്ടിന് ബാധകമായ നിർദേശങ്ങൾ പാലിക്കുക. നവംബർ 6ന് അവസാനിച്ച ഓപ്ഷൻ നടപടികളുടെ വിശദാംശങ്ങൾ.

title: Class 12 Political Science Exam 2026: Preparation Tips & Strategy
description: Prepare for Class 12 Political Science exam 2026 with smart tips, NCERT focus, answer writing strategy, and revision plan to score high marks.
content:
The Class 12th Political Science Exam is considered one of the highest-scoring exams if prepared in the right manner. As the examination date is near, you might be feeling confused about how to start and prepare well for the exams. With proper planning and smart techniques of preparation, you can score well in the exams and obtain good marks.

Understand the Syllabus Clearly

Before you start preparing for the exams, it is very important to understand the syllabus properly. The subject of Political Science can be broadly divided into two parts: Contemporary World Politics and Politics in India Since Independence. Both parts carry equal marks, so do not focus only on one part of the subject. Divide the subject into small parts to make it easier to understand.

Focus on NCERT Books

NCERT Books are the most important source of information for the subject of Political Science. Most of the questions in the exams are asked directly or indirectly from NCERT Books. So, make sure you read each chapter of NCERT Books properly and understand the main points, definitions, and events.

Practice Answer Writing

Answer writing plays a crucial role in scoring well in Political Science. It is not just about what you write, but also how you present it. Follow a structured format:

  • Start with a brief introduction
  • Explain the main content with clear points
  • End with a proper conclusion

Using headings, bullet points, and examples can make your answers more impressive and easier to read.

Solve Previous Year Question Papers

Practicing previous year question papers is very helpful. This will help you get an idea about the exam pattern, important topics, and frequently asked questions. Also, you will get better time management skills while writing the exam.

  • Try to solve papers within the given time limit
  • Analyze your mistakes and improve
  • Focus on repeated questions and key themes

Make an Effective Revision Plan

The secret to passing any exam is revision. Information retention becomes challenging in the absence of appropriate revision.

  1. Make at least two or three revisions to each chapter.
  2. Take brief notes to facilitate rapid revision.
  3. Pay attention to significant dates, case studies, and ideas.
  4. Give weaker subjects extra time.

Conclusion

The Class 12th Political Science exam can be easy to crack with the right preparation strategy. Focus on NCERT, practice answer writing, and revise regularly. Stay consistent and confident, and you will be able to achieve excellent results in your exam.

title: Journalism Course After 12th: Eligibility, Fees & Career Scope
description: Learn about journalism courses after Class 12, including BA Journalism, BJMC, BAJMC and diploma options. Explore eligibility, fees, admission, job opportunities and salary prospects in India.
content:
Are you interested in news, storytelling, current affairs, writing or presenting information to an audience? A journalism course after Class 12 can help you explore careers in news reporting, television, digital media, radio, documentary production and other communication fields.

Journalism is no longer limited to newspapers and television news channels. Digital news platforms, podcasts, online publications and independent media organisations have created different ways to research stories, produce content and reach audiences. Students can choose a traditional journalism degree or a broader programme in Journalism and Mass Communication, depending on their interests.

Before selecting a course, it is important to understand the eligibility criteria, duration, fees, subjects and career opportunities available after graduation.

Journalism Course After 12th: Overview

Particular

Details

Course field

Journalism and Mass Communication

Eligibility

Class 12 pass for many undergraduate programmes

Eligible streams

Arts, Commerce and Science

Popular courses

BA Journalism, BAJMC, BJMC, Diploma in Journalism

Course duration

Several months to 4 years, depending on the programme

Admission process

Merit-based admission, entrance test or interview, depending on the institution

Popular subjects

News reporting, editing, media ethics, broadcasting and digital journalism

Career options

Reporter, News Writer, Video Journalist, Copy Editor, News Anchor and Digital Journalist

Employment sectors

Newspapers, TV channels, digital news platforms, radio, media agencies and production houses

What Is Journalism?

Journalism involves collecting information, verifying facts, interviewing people and presenting news or information to the public. Journalists investigate events, explain developments and help audiences understand issues affecting society.

The work can involve covering politics, education, business, sports, entertainment, science, public policy or local community issues. Depending on the role, a journalist may write articles, conduct interviews, record video reports, edit news content or present stories on camera.

A journalism course teaches students how to research information, distinguish facts from opinions, communicate clearly and follow professional standards. Modern programmes may also include mobile journalism, multimedia storytelling, podcasting and digital publishing.

Types of Journalism Courses After 12th

Students can choose a programme based on their academic goals, budget and preferred area of work.

Course

Typical duration

Suitable for

Certificate in Journalism

A few months to 1 year

Students seeking introductory training

Diploma in Journalism

Around 1-2 years, depending on the institution

Students wanting focused journalism training

BA in Journalism

Usually 3-4 years, depending on the degree structure

Students interested in reporting, writing and news production

BA in Journalism and Mass Communication (BAJMC)

Usually 3-4 years

Students who want to study journalism alongside other media fields

Bachelor of Journalism and Mass Communication (BJMC)

Commonly 3 years

Students seeking an undergraduate qualification in journalism and media

BA in Mass Communication

Usually 3-4 years

Students interested in journalism, broadcasting, advertising and communication

Course titles and durations vary across institutions. Always check the official programme structure before applying.

1. Certificate Course in Journalism

A certificate course introduces students to the fundamentals of journalism. Topics may include news writing, interviewing, media ethics, reporting and basic editing.

This option can help students explore the profession before committing to a full-time degree. However, a certificate is not equivalent to an undergraduate qualification, and its value depends on the provider and practical training offered.

2. Diploma in Journalism

A diploma provides focused training in areas such as news reporting, editing, writing, media production and journalism practices. Some programmes include newsroom exercises, field assignments or opportunities to work on student publications.

For example, Parul University lists a one-year Diploma in Journalism. Its published programme page specifies Class 12 completion as the eligibility requirement and lists a fee of ₹25,000. Students should verify the current fee and course availability directly with the institution.

3. BA in Journalism

A BA in Journalism generally focuses on news reporting, writing, editing, media law, ethics and the role of journalism in society.

It may suit students who want to develop a strong foundation in news and current affairs. Depending on the university, the course may also include electives related to digital journalism, broadcast reporting or specialised reporting.

4. BAJMC or BJMC

Journalism and Mass Communication programmes cover journalism alongside other communication disciplines. Students may study reporting, television production, advertising, public relations, photography, radio, digital media and communication theory.

This broader qualification can suit students who are interested in journalism but also want to explore related career options in media production, content creation or communication.

Journalism Course Eligibility After 12th

Eligibility requirements depend on the course and institution. Many undergraduate journalism programmes accept students from all three major academic streams.

Educational qualification

Candidates generally need to pass Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board.

Required stream

  • Arts: Can provide useful background knowledge in languages, history, politics and society.

  • Commerce: May be useful for students interested in business, finance, markets and economic reporting.

  • Science: Can help students explore science, technology, healthcare and environmental journalism.

No single stream is compulsory for all journalism courses. However, some universities may specify particular subject or language requirements.

Minimum marks

Some institutions accept candidates who have passed Class 12, while others require a minimum aggregate percentage, such as 45% or 50%. The exact requirement depends on the university and programme.

Entrance examination

Admission may be based on Class 12 marks, an entrance test, an interview or a combination of these methods. Some universities also accept relevant common entrance examination scores. Students should check the current admission notice for the course they want to pursue.

Journalism Course Fees After 12th

The total cost of studying journalism depends on the institution, location, course duration, facilities and additional charges.

Course type

Fee considerations

Certificate course

Often lower in total cost, especially for short-term programmes

Diploma in Journalism

Depends on duration, practical training and the provider

BA in Journalism

Varies by university and course structure

BAJMC or BJMC

Depends on the institution, campus facilities and degree duration

As an example, Parul University lists ₹25,000 for its one-year Diploma in Journalism, while its BA in Journalism and Mass Communication page lists ₹95,000 per year for the three-year programme. These are institution-specific published figures, not standard fees for all colleges.

Before admission, confirm the complete fee structure, including tuition, registration, examination charges, equipment or project costs, and hostel or transport expenses if applicable.

Journalism Course Syllabus

The syllabus generally combines classroom learning with practical assignments. Students learn how to research, verify and communicate information in different media formats.

Subject

What students learn

Introduction to Journalism

The role, history and principles of journalism

News Reporting

Gathering facts, interviewing sources and writing reports

Editing and Proofreading

Improving accuracy, clarity, grammar and structure

Media Ethics

Fairness, responsible reporting, privacy and professional conduct

Media Law

Legal considerations affecting journalists and publications

Print Journalism

Newspaper and magazine reporting, editing and layout

Broadcast Journalism

Radio, television and audio-visual news production

Digital Journalism

Online publishing, multimedia reporting and digital storytelling

Photography and Video

Capturing and presenting visual information

Current Affairs

Understanding political, social, economic and international developments

The exact subjects differ across universities. Review the official syllabus to see how much practical work, field reporting and digital media training the course includes.

Career Scope After a Journalism Course

Journalism graduates can work in traditional newsrooms as well as digital media organisations, production houses and communication teams. The type of work depends on their skills, specialisation and professional experience.

Popular career options

Job profile

Main responsibilities

News Reporter

Covers events, interviews sources and prepares news reports

Journalist

Researches, verifies and presents news or feature stories

News Writer

Writes news articles, scripts and reports

Copy Editor

Checks facts, language, structure and editorial consistency

News Anchor

Presents news and conducts interviews on television or digital platforms

Video Journalist

Researches, shoots and presents video-based stories

Photojournalist

Documents events and stories through photography

Digital Journalist

Produces and publishes news for online platforms

Feature Writer

Develops in-depth stories, profiles and explanatory articles

Radio Journalist

Researches and presents news or current-affairs content for radio

Podcast Producer

Helps research, plan, record and edit audio programmes

Media Researcher

Supports research, fact-checking and background analysis

Fresh graduates often begin as trainees, reporters, editorial assistants, content writers or production assistants. With experience, they may move into senior reporting, editing, newsroom management or specialised journalism.

Journalism Salary in India

Salary depends on the employer, city, language skills, beat, work experience and type of media organisation. A local publication, a national television channel and a digital news startup may offer very different compensation.

The following figures are broad indicative estimates, not guaranteed salaries or official industry averages.

Experience level

Indicative annual salary

Fresher or trainee

₹1.8-3.5 lakh

Journalist with 2-5 years of experience

₹3-6 lakh

Experienced reporter, editor or specialist

₹5-10 lakh or more

Senior editor or newsroom leader

Highly variable

Actual offers may fall below or above these ranges. Freelancers may receive payment per article, assignment, video or project, so income can vary from month to month.

How can journalism students improve their career prospects?

Students can build a stronger portfolio by writing news reports, conducting interviews, producing short videos, creating audio stories and practising fact-checking. Internships and campus publications can help them understand newsroom workflows and deadlines.

Strong writing, research, communication and digital production skills can be valuable when applying for entry-level roles.

Best Journalism Colleges and Institutes to Explore

When shortlisting institutions, compare the course curriculum, faculty, practical facilities, internship access, fees and qualification awarded.

Institution

Programme to investigate

Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC)

Journalism and media programmes; check the current admission eligibility because many programmes are postgraduate

University of Delhi and affiliated colleges

Journalism or media-related undergraduate programmes available in the current admission cycle

Jamia Millia Islamia

Journalism and mass communication programmes listed in the current prospectus

Parul University

BA in Journalism and Mass Communication and Diploma in Journalism

Jagannath University, Haryana

BA in Journalism and Mass Communication

University of Mumbai and affiliated colleges

Journalism and mass communication programmes available through the relevant institutions

Important: Do not assume that every well-known media institute offers an undergraduate course immediately after Class 12. Some of its journalism programmes may require a bachelor's degree. Verify the current course level, eligibility, fees and admission procedure before applying.

Skills Required to Become a Journalist

A journalism qualification introduces students to the profession, but practical skills are essential for doing the work well.

  • Writing and editing: Present information clearly, accurately and concisely.

  • Research and fact-checking: Verify information before publishing or broadcasting it.

  • Communication: Interview sources and ask relevant follow-up questions.

  • Curiosity: Identify meaningful stories and investigate unfamiliar subjects.

  • Critical thinking: Evaluate claims, evidence and conflicting accounts.

  • Language proficiency: Develop strong command of the language used in your chosen newsroom.

  • Digital skills: Learn basic audio, video, photography and online publishing tools.

  • Ethical judgement: Respect privacy, avoid misleading presentation and correct mistakes responsibly.

  • Working under deadlines: Organise reporting tasks and deliver accurate work on time.

Students can begin developing these skills by writing for school or college publications, covering campus events and producing short news or interview projects.

Is Journalism a Good Career After 12th?

Journalism can be a rewarding choice for students who enjoy current affairs, research, writing, communication and understanding different perspectives. It also offers opportunities to work across print, television, radio and digital media.

However, the profession can involve irregular hours, field assignments, tight deadlines and challenging working conditions. Starting salaries can vary widely, and career progression often depends on the quality of work, specialisation, professional experience and networking.

Before selecting a college, check whether the course provides practical reporting assignments, internships, access to production facilities and opportunities to build a portfolio. A programme that combines theory with hands-on learning can help students prepare for the realities of newsroom work.

Conclusion

A journalism course after 12th can open pathways into reporting, news writing, broadcasting, digital journalism and other media careers. Students can choose a certificate, diploma or undergraduate degree depending on their career goals, budget and preferred learning format.

Before applying, compare eligibility, total fees, course structure, practical training and internship opportunities. Developing strong writing, research and fact-checking skills alongside classroom learning can help you prepare for a career in journalism.

title: Top Competitive Exams After 12th Commerce | Best Career Options & Eligibility
description: Explore the top competitive exams after 12th Commerce for a successful career. Find details on eligibility, exam pattern, career opportunities, and the best options for Commerce students.
content:
Top Competitive Exams After 12th Commerce

Choosing the right career path after completing 12th Commerce is crucial for students aiming for a successful and stable future. Many competitive exams open doors to prestigious careers in finance, management, law, accountancy, and government services. This guide explores the top competitive exams after 12th Commerce to help you make an informed decision.

1. Chartered Accountancy (CA)

The Chartered Accountancy (CA) exam, conducted by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), is one of the most sought-after career options for Commerce students.

Eligibility:

  • Students must clear the CA Foundation Course after completing their 12th.

  • Graduates can directly enter the Intermediate Course.

Exam Stages:

  1. CA Foundation

  2. CA Intermediate

  3. CA Final

Career Opportunities:

  • Chartered Accountant

  • Financial Analyst

  • Auditor

  • Investment Banker

2. Company Secretary (CS)

The Company Secretary (CS) Exam, conducted by the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), is another excellent option for Commerce students interested in corporate law and governance.

Eligibility:

  • After 12th, students must enroll in the CS Foundation Program.

Exam Stages:

  1. CS Executive Entrance Test (CSEET)

  2. CS Executive

  3. CS Professional

Career Opportunities:

  • Company Secretary

  • Legal Advisor

  • Corporate Governance Consultant

3. Cost and Management Accountancy (CMA)

The Cost and Management Accountancy (CMA) course, conducted by the Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI), is a highly respected qualification for finance professionals.

Eligibility:

  • 12th pass students can enroll in the CMA Foundation Course.

Exam Stages:

  1. CMA Foundation

  2. CMA Intermediate

  3. CMA Final

Career Opportunities:

  • Cost Accountant

  • Financial Controller

  • Risk Manager

4. Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) Entrance Exams

A Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) is a great stepping stone for a career in business and management.

Popular BBA Entrance Exams:

  • DU JAT (Delhi University Joint Admission Test)

  • IPMAT (Integrated Program in Management Aptitude Test)

  • SET (Symbiosis Entrance Test)

  • NMIMS NPAT (National Test for Programs After Twelfth)

Career Opportunities:

  • Business Analyst

  • Marketing Manager

  • Entrepreneur

5. Law Entrance Exams (CLAT, AILET, LSAT)

Commerce students interested in law can pursue LLB programs by clearing law entrance exams.

Top Law Entrance Exams:

  • CLAT (Common Law Admission Test)

  • AILET (All India Law Entrance Test)

  • LSAT (Law School Admission Test)

Career Opportunities:

  • Corporate Lawyer

  • Legal Consultant

  • Judge (After further studies)

6. Banking and Finance Exams

Students looking for a career in the banking sector can appear for IBPS Clerk, IBPS PO, and SBI PO exams.

Eligibility:

  • Minimum 12th pass for clerical roles

  • Graduation required for officer-level positions

Career Opportunities:

  • Bank Clerk

  • Probationary Officer (PO)

  • Financial Advisor

7. National Defence Academy (NDA) Exam

The NDA Exam, conducted by UPSC, offers Commerce students an opportunity to join the Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force.

Eligibility:

  • 12th pass with Maths & Physics for Air Force/Navy

  • 12th pass with any stream for the Army wing

Career Opportunities:

  • Lieutenant

  • Pilot

  • Naval Officer

8. Hotel Management Entrance Exams

For students interested in hospitality and tourism, NCHMCT JEE (National Council for Hotel Management and Catering Technology Joint Entrance Exam) is the gateway to top hotel management colleges.

Career Opportunities:

  • Hotel Manager

  • Event Planner

  • Chef

9. Digital Marketing Certification Programs

With the rise of digital business, Digital Marketing certifications are gaining popularity.

Popular Certifications:

  • Google Digital Marketing Certification

  • Facebook Blueprint Certification

  • HubSpot Content Marketing Certification

Career Opportunities:

  • SEO Specialist

  • Social Media Manager

  • Digital Marketing Executive

10. Government Jobs After 12th Commerce

Students looking for government jobs can apply for SSC CHSL, RRB NTPC, and State Government Exams.

Career Opportunities:

  • Tax Assistant

  • Income Tax Inspector

  • Railway Clerk

How to Prepare for Competitive Exams After 12th Commerce?

1. Understand the Exam Pattern

Each competitive exam has a different structure. Go through previous years' question papers to understand the format.

2. Time Management

Create a proper study plan to cover all subjects within the stipulated time frame.

3. Take Mock Tests

Mock tests and sample papers help in self-evaluation and improving speed and accuracy.

4. Stay Updated with Current Affairs

For exams like NDA, Banking, and Government Jobs, staying updated with current affairs is essential.

5. Coaching vs. Self-Study

Depending on the complexity of the exam, students can opt for coaching or self-study with online resources.

Conclusion

The right competitive exam after 12th Commerce depends on your career aspirations and interests. Whether you want to become a Chartered Accountant, Lawyer, Business Executive, or Government Officer, these exams provide numerous opportunities. With proper planning and dedication, you can achieve success in your chosen field.

title: GATE 2027 Login: Reset a Forgotten DigiLocker Security PIN
description: Recover your DigiLocker PIN through the official route, handle an old mobile number and return to the account used for your GATE 2027 application.
content:
If a forgotten DigiLocker security PIN is stopping you from opening your GATE 2027 account, recover access through DigiLocker first. Keep the account you used for your submitted application. IIT Madras advises candidates not to delete that DigiLocker account after submission and fee payment because future GATE communication remains tied to it.

Start recovery from DigiLocker sign-in

Open the official DigiLocker website, choose sign-in and then the forgotten security PIN option. Starting from the website is preferable to using an old recovery-screen bookmark that may lack the sign-in session details.

  1. Enter the registered Aadhaar or mobile number requested by the recovery screen.

  2. Enter your date of birth as recorded in the account. For the Aadhaar recovery route, use the date of birth in Aadhaar.

  3. Continue through the OTP and any other verification shown by DigiLocker.

  4. Set a new security PIN when prompted, then sign in again.

Enter the OTP and PIN only on the official service. Do not send them to someone offering to fix your application or include them in a support screenshot.

If you no longer have the old mobile number

The official DigiLocker FAQ describes an Aadhaar OTP alternative for PIN recovery. After entering Aadhaar and its date of birth, choose the Aadhaar OTP option when offered. The OTP goes to the mobile number registered with Aadhaar. Complete the OTP and captcha verification, then set the new PIN.

DigiLocker, Government of India, official security PIN recovery FAQ. The webpage does not display an issue date. Read the official instructions.

This route still requires access to the Aadhaar-linked number. If you cannot receive that OTP or the recovery details are rejected, use the support link on the DigiLocker website. Describe the error without sharing your PIN or OTP. Creating another account does not recover access to the account linked to your GATE application.

Return to the same GATE application

Once DigiLocker access works, open GOAPS from the official GATE website and use the account associated with your submitted form. The GATE 2027 account guidance explains why the existing DigiLocker account should be retained.

Check the application status and any defect message separately. Resetting a login PIN does not correct a photograph, signature or application detail, extend a deadline, or confirm acceptance. The GATE scrutiny-defect guide explains the next step for an application that needs rectification.

title: Aviation Management: Guide to Career in the Aviation Industry
description: Aviation Management is a specialized field that focuses on the business, operations, and leadership aspects of the aviation industry, including airlines, airports, and related services.
content:
WHAT IS AVIATION MANAGEMENT ?

Aviation management involves overseeing the business operations, logistics, and safety regulations of airlines, airports, and other aviation-related organizations. It is a blend of management principles and specialized aviation knowledge. Professionals in this field ensure smooth airline operations, efficient passenger handling, and compliance with international aviation standards .

Aviation Management is a part of Aviation Industry that has been most dynamic and influencing sector , connecting the worlds through air travel and trade . Aviation Management has emerged as a vital career path for those passionate flyers and travellers .

WHAT ARE THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES IN AVIATION MANAGEMENT ?

ü  Airport Operations: Managing daily airport activities, including passenger services, baggage handling, and flight scheduling

ü  Airline Management: Overseeing ticket sales, marketing, staff training, and aircraft maintenance coordination.

ü  Safety and Security: Ensuring compliance with aviation safety protocols and security measures.

ü  Customer Experience: Improving passenger satisfaction through service quality and operational efficiency.

 WHAT ARE THE SKILLS REQUIRED FOR THIS FIELD ?

·       Strong communication and leadership abilities.

·       Knowledge of aviation laws and safety regulations

·       Problem-solving and decision-making skills

·       Time management and multitasking ability

·       Customer service orientation

  

WHAT IS THE ELIGIBILITY FOR AVIATION MANAGEMENT ?

Usually, candidates must have completed 10+2 in any stream. For postgraduate programs, a bachelor’s degree in any field is required.

Undergraduate (BBA/B.Sc. in Aviation Management): Completion of 10+2 from a recognized board (any stream, preferably with English as a subject).Minimum aggregate: Usually 50–60% .Postgraduate MBA - Airline and Airport Management: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (management, engineering, commerce, or aviation preferred). Minimum aggregate: Usually 50–60%.

 WHAT ARE FURTHER CAREER OPPORTUNITIES ?

JOBS

ROLES

Airlines (Domestic & International)

Airport Manager

Airports (Public & Private)

Airline Operations Manager

Air Cargo Companies

Flight Scheduler

Aviation Consultancy Firms

Ground Handling Manager

Aircraft Manufacturing Companies

Aviation Safety Officer

WHY TO CHOOSE AVIATION MANAGEMENT ?

Choosing aviation management as a career offers the perfect combination of business expertise and the excitement of the aviation industry. It is a fast-growing global field that provides opportunities to work in airports, airlines, cargo services, and other aviation-related organizations. The profession not only offers attractive salary packages and chances for career growth but also provides exposure to international travel, diverse cultures, and a dynamic work environment. With the aviation sector constantly expanding, skilled professionals in aviation management are in high demand, making it a rewarding and adventurous career choice for those who have a passion for travel, leadership, and operational excellence.

·       Opportunity to work in a global and fast-growing industry

·       Exposure to international travel and diverse cultures

·       High demand for skilled professionals 

·       Attractive salary packages and career growth

WHAT ARE ADMISSION STRUCTURE FOR AVIANTION MANAGEMENT COURSE ?

§  Application Form: Apply through the university/college website or offline mode

§  Entrance Exams: Some institutes require scores from exams like :

1.       Undergraduate: Common University Entrance Test (CUET), institute-specific tests.

2.       Postgraduate: CAT, MAT, XAT, CMAT, or university-specific tests.

§  Personal Interview: Shortlisted candidates may have to appear for group discussions or interviews.

§  Final Selection: Based on entrance exam scores, academic performance, and interview result.

 

 WHAT ALL DOCUMENTATION IS REQUIRED ?

 

·       10th and 12th mark sheets (and degree certificate for PG courses)

·       Entrance exam scorecard (if applicable)

·       Passport-size photographs

·       ID proof (Aadhar, Passport, etc.)

·       Transfer/Migration certificate

 WHAT ARE THE TOP PROSPECTS  AFTER AVIATION MANAGEMENT ?

Those who have successfully completed their respective course have better chances that they will be hired in best Airport Authorities of India where they have allotted their work specifically. Sometimes it also depends on candidates, in which particular field they want to see themselves and preferred at the entrance of the course.

Roles in operations, scheduling, crew management, and customer service with domestic or international carriers. Positions in airport management, terminal operations, ground handling, and passenger services. Managing cargo operations, customs clearance, and international freight services. Ensuring compliance with safety regulations and implementing security protocols.

IN THE END 

Aviation Management has emerged as one of the most promising fields in today’s globalized world, where air travel plays a central role in connecting people, businesses, and nations. This discipline not only focuses on the technical aspects of aviation but also emphasizes management, leadership, and strategic planning, making it an ideal choice for students who aspire to work in dynamic and challenging environments.

The scope of Aviation Management continues to expand with the growth of airlines, airports, and related services worldwide. Professionals trained in this field are highly valued for their ability to balance efficiency, safety, and customer satisfaction while ensuring smooth operations. From airline management to airport operations, logistics, and international aviation services, the career opportunities are vast and diverse.
